label: aspirin cardiovascular response
description: COMT genotype determines the cardiovascular response to aspirin: slow (Met/Met) individuals gain protection against cardiovascular disease, whereas fast (Val/Val) individuals may see increased risk or no benefit. This pharmacogenetic effect arises from genotype-dependent differences in catecholamine and folate metabolism that modify aspirin's actions on platelets, vascular endothelium, and redox balance. Stratifying aspirin therapy by COMT status could improve risk-benefit profiling in primary and secondary cardiovascular prevention. The finding exemplifies how a common polymorphism can gate a widely used drug's efficacy.
description_zh_TW: COMT genotype 決定了阿斯匹靈的心血管反應：慢速 (Met/Met) 個體獲得預防心血管疾病的保護，而快速 (Val/Val) 個體可能會看到風險增加或沒有益處。這種藥物基因效應源自於兒茶酚胺和 folate 代謝的基因型依賴性差異，這些差異改變了阿斯匹靈對血小板、血管內皮和氧化還原平衡的作用。以 COMT 狀態對阿斯匹靈治療進行分層可以改善第一級和第二級心血管預防的風險效益分析。這項發現例證了常見的多態性如何控制廣泛使用的藥物的功效。

description_zh_TW: COMT genotype 決定了阿斯匹靈的心血管反應：慢速 (Met/Met) 個體獲得預防心血管疾病的保護，而快速 (Val/Val) 個體可能會看到風險增加或沒有益處。這種藥物基因效應源自於兒茶酚胺和 folate 代謝的基因型依賴性差異，這些差異改變了阿斯匹靈對血小板、血管內皮和氧化還原平衡的作用。以 COMT 狀態對阿斯匹靈治療進行分層可以改善第一級和第二級心血管預防的風險效益分析。這項發現例證了常見的多態性如何控制廣泛使用的藥物的功效。

label: Bax (pro-apoptotic)
description: Once deacetylated by SIRT1, Ku70 binds the BH3 domain of the pro-apoptotic protein Bax and retains it in the cytosol, preventing Bax translocation to and permeabilization of mitochondria. This sequestration blocks the intrinsic apoptosis cascade downstream of many stress signals, including DNA damage and oxidative stress. Directionally, deacetylated Ku70 is the binding partner that neutralizes Bax, converting a DNA-repair factor into an anti-apoptotic scaffold. The net effect is cytoprotection, though as with p53 suppression this can also shield damaged cells in oncogenic contexts, where the Ku70–Bax interaction becomes a target for restoring apoptosis in cancer therapy.
description_zh_TW: Ku70 一旦被 SIRT1 去乙醯化，便結合促凋亡蛋白 Bax 的 BH3 結構域並將其保留在細胞質中，防止 Bax 轉位到粒線體並造成粒線體外膜通透化。這種封存阻斷了許多壓力信號（包括 DNA 損傷和氧化壓力）下游的內在凋亡級聯反應。在方向性上，去乙醯化的 Ku70 是中和 Bax 的結合夥伴，將 DNA 修復因子轉化為抗凋亡支架。淨效應是細胞保護，但與 p53 抑制一樣，在腫瘤情境中也可能保護受損細胞，使得 Ku70–Bax 相互作用成為癌症治療中恢復凋亡的靶點。

label: Bcl-2 anti-apoptotic proteins
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: The BH3 domain of Beclin1 binds anti-apoptotic Bcl-2/Bcl-xL proteins, which sequester it and inhibit autophagy, linking apoptosis and autophagy regulation. Directionally, Bcl-2 sits upstream of Beclin1 sequestration. SIRT1 deacetylation of Beclin1 modulates this interaction, illustrating the molecular crosstalk between cell-death and clearance pathways. When Bcl-2 sequesters Beclin1, autophagy is suppressed, but under stress signals that release Beclin1, autophagy proceeds. This interplay determines whether cells commit to apoptosis or to autophagic survival, and it is central to both normal physiology and cancer cell fate decisions.
description_zh_TW: Beclin1 的 BH3 結合域結合抗凋亡 Bcl-2/Bcl-xL 蛋白質，後者將其隔離並抑制自噬，將凋亡和自噬調控聯繫起來。在方向性上，Bcl-2 位於 Beclin1 隔離的上游。SIRT1 對 Beclin1 的去乙醯化調節此相互作用，說明了細胞死亡和清除途徑之間的分子串擾。當 Bcl-2 隔離 Beclin1 時，自噬被抑制，但在釋放 Beclin1 的壓力訊號下，自噬進行。這種相互作用決定細胞是承諾凋亡還是自噬性存活，在正常生理和癌細胞命運決定中都至關重要。

label: β-amyloid plaques and gliosis (Alzheimer's disease)
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: Brain-specific SIRT1 knockout elevates β-amyloid plaques and gliosis, implicating SIRT1 in Alzheimer's protection (per the review's neurobiology section).
description_zh_TW: 大腦特異性 SIRT1 敲除增加 β-類澱粉斑塊和神經膠質增生，暗示 SIRT1 在阿茲海默症保護中的作用（參見文獻綜述的神經生物學章節）。

label: SIRT1 brain-specific knockout
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: Brain-specific SIRT1 knockout elevates β-amyloid plaques and gliosis, implicating SIRT1 in Alzheimer's protection (per the review's neurobiology section).

label: beta-catenin deacetylation
description: MMP-7 (matrilysin) is a secreted metalloproteinase that degrades ECM components and mediates EMT and tissue remodeling. SIRT3 deacetylates beta-catenin, influencing MMP-7 and PAI-1 expression, two mediators implicated in ECM remodeling via EMT induction in renal fibrosis.
description_zh_TW: MMP-7（基質溶解素）是一種分泌性金屬蛋白酶，降解 ECM 成分並介導 EMT 和組織重塑。SIRT3 去乙醯化 β-catenin，影響 MMP-7 和 PAI-1 的表達，這兩種介導因子透過 EMT 誘導參與腎纖維化中的 ECM 重塑。

label: MMP-7
description: MMP-7 (matrilysin) is a secreted metalloproteinase that degrades ECM components and mediates EMT and tissue remodeling. SIRT3 deacetylates beta-catenin, influencing MMP-7 and PAI-1 expression, two mediators implicated in ECM remodeling via EMT induction in renal fibrosis.
description_zh_TW: MMP-7（基質溶解素）是一種分泌性金屬蛋白酶，降解 ECM 成分並介導 EMT 和組織重塑。SIRT3 去乙醯化 β-catenin，影響 MMP-7 和 PAI-1 的表達，這兩種介導因子透過 EMT 誘導參與腎纖維化中的 ECM 重塑。

label: 35% of cancer cell lines
description: A survey of approximately one thousand human cancer cell lines revealed that the SIRT6 locus was deleted in 35% of the samples. This high deletion frequency supports SIRT6's role as a tumor suppressor that acts through repression of HIF-1alpha and c-MYC and suppression of glycolytic metabolic reprogramming. Directionally, SIRT6 loss sits upstream of enhanced oncogenic metabolism and tumor growth. Without SIRT6, the brakes on aerobic glycolysis and proliferation are released, promoting the metabolic phenotype that sustains cancer. The prevalence of SIRT6 deletion across diverse cancer cell lines underscores its broad importance in restraining malignancy.
description_zh_TW: 對約一千種人類癌症細胞系的調查顯示，SIRT6基因座在35%的樣本中被刪除。這種高頻率的刪除支持SIRT6作為透過抑制HIF-1alpha和c-MYC以及抑制糖解代謝重編程來發揮作用的腫瘤抑制因子。方向上，SIRT6缺失位於致癌代謝增強和腫瘤生長的上游。沒有SIRT6，對有氧糖解和增殖的制動被釋放，促進維持癌症的代謝表型。SIRT6刪除在不同癌症細胞系中的普遍性突顯了其在抑制惡性腫瘤方面的廣泛重要性。

label: H3K9ac and H3K56ac
description: Activated SIRT6 rapidly deacetylates histone H3K9ac and H3K56ac at chromatin, promoting compaction and facilitating DNA-repair and silencing programs. Directionally, SIRT6 enzymatically removes these active marks. Loss of H3K56ac in particular is associated with genome stability and stress resistance, and H3K9ac removal at specific promoters silences glycolytic, inflammatory, and other target genes. This chromatin action underlies SIRT6's roles in longevity and tumor suppression, and it is complemented by SIRT6's mono-ADP-ribosyltransferase activity, which recruits repressive complexes to repetitive elements and DNA-damage sites.
description_zh_TW: 活化的 SIRT6 快速去乙醯化染色質上的組蛋白 H3K9ac 和 H3K56ac，促進凝縮並促進 DNA 修復和沉默程序。在方向性上，SIRT6 在酶學上移除這些活躍標記。H3K56ac 的缺失特別與基因組穩定性和壓力抗性相關，H3K9ac 在特定啟動子處的移除沉默糖解、發炎和其他靶基因。這種染色質作用是 SIRT6 在長壽和腫瘤抑制中作用的基礎，並與 SIRT6 的單 ADP-核糖基轉移酶活性互補，後者招募抑制性複合物到重複元件和 DNA 損傷位點。

label: Apoptosis in cancer cell lines
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: Acute overexpression of SIRT6 in cancer cell lines of different histology induces apoptosis, supporting a tumor-suppressive role for this nuclear sirtuin. The pro-apoptotic activity appears linked to SIRT6's mono-ADP-ribosyltransferase function rather than its deacetylase activity. Directionally, increasing SIRT6 abundance or enzymatic activity triggers cell death in tumor cells. This contrasts with SIRT1's context-dependent duality and stresses that sirtuin outputs in cancer depend on the specific isoform and its dominant catalytic modality.
description_zh_TW: 在不同組織學類型的癌細胞系中急性過量表現 SIRT6 可誘導凋亡，支持此核 sirtuin 具有腫瘤抑制功能。此促凋亡活性似乎與 SIRT6 的單 ADP-核糖基轉移酶功能而非去乙醯酶活性相關。方向性上，增加 SIRT6 的豐度或酵素活性會在腫瘤細胞中觸發細胞死亡。這與 SIRT1 因情境而異的雙重性形成對比，強調 sirtuin 在癌症中的輸出取決於特定的同工型及其主要的催化模式。

label: Progerin-induced stress
description: Centenarian SIRT6 variants ameliorate multiple aging phenotypes in progerin-expressing hMSCs, including higher Ki67, reduced SA-β-gal, decreased p16/p21, reduced IL-6, and increased Lamin B1. Directionally, CentSIRT6 sits upstream of progerin-stress resistance. This shows the variant buffers premature-aging pathology and ties SIRT6 to laminopathy resilience. By maintaining proliferation, reducing senescence markers, and lowering inflammatory output in progerin-stressed cells, the variants counteract key features of Hutchinson-Gilford progeria. These findings support SIRT6-boosting strategies for laminopathy and related premature-aging conditions.
description_zh_TW: 百歲人瑞 SIRT6 變異體改善了表達 progerin 的 hMSC 的多種衰老表型，包括較高的 Ki67、較低的 SA-β-gal、減少的 p16/p21、降低的 IL-6 和增加的 Lamin B1。在方向性上，CentSIRT6 位於抗 progerin 壓力的上游。這表明變異體緩衝早衰病理並將 SIRT6 與核纖層蛋白病抗性聯繫起來。透過在 progerin 壓力下的細胞中維護增殖、減少衰老標誌物和降低發炎輸出，變異體對抗了 Hutchinson-Gilford 早衰症的關鍵特徵。這些發現支持提升 SIRT6 的策略用於核纖層蛋白病和相關早衰疾病。

label: apoptosis in tumor cells
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Compared to healthy cells, SIRT6 overexpression significantly accelerates apoptosis in tumour cells. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of tumour cell death, preferentially killing cancer cells while sparing healthy cells. This tumour-selective pro-apoptotic activity supports SIRT6 activation as a potential therapeutic strategy against cancers that retain SIRT6 expression.
description_zh_TW: 與健康細胞相比，SIRT6過表達顯著加速腫瘤細胞的凋亡。方向上，SIRT6位於腫瘤細胞死亡的上游，優先殺傷癌細胞同時保護健康細胞。這種腫瘤選擇性的促凋亡活性支持SIRT6活化作為對抗保留SIRT6表達的癌症的潛在治療策略。

label: Cyanidin
description: Cyanidin, a natural anthocyanidin from red berries, increases SIRT6 activity by over 50-fold in certain in vitro assays, making it one of the most powerful natural SIRT6 activators identified. Directionally, cyanidin sits upstream of SIRT6 stimulation. Its potency suggests strong binding to the SIRT6 activation pocket, and it is particularly abundant in elderberries, which provide roughly 350-450 mg of cyanidin-3-glucoside per 100 g of fresh fruit. This links berry polyphenols to SIRT6-dependent metabolic and anti-aging effects, and positions dietary anthocyanins as a practical means of engaging SIRT6 biology.
description_zh_TW: 花青素（Cyanidin）是一種來自紅色漿果的天然花青素，在某些體外試驗中將 SIRT6 活性提高 50 倍以上，使其成為已鑑定的最強效天然 SIRT6 活化因子之一。在方向性上，花青素位於 SIRT6 刺激的上游。其效力表明與 SIRT6 活化口袋的強結合，且在接骨木漿果中特別豐富，每 100 克新鮮水果含有約 350-450 毫克 cyanidin-3-glucoside。這將漿果多酚與 SIRT6 依賴性的代謝和抗衰老效應聯繫起來，並將飲食中的花青素定位為參與 SIRT6 生物學的實際手段。

label: SIRT6 deacetylase activity
description: Despite higher SIRT6 protein, centenarian hMSCs show increased histone acetylation at H3K9, H3K18, and H3K27, confirming reduced deacetylase activity. Directionally, the variant sits upstream of weaker deacetylation. This indicates that the longevity benefit may hinge more on the ADP-ribosyltransferase than on the deacetylase function of SIRT6, and it reframes how active SIRT6 should be interpreted. The dissociation between increased protein abundance and reduced deacetylation highlights that SIRT6's two enzymatic activities are independently regulated. These findings are central to understanding the molecular basis of SIRT6's longevity association.
description_zh_TW: 儘管 SIRT6 蛋白較高，百歲人瑞 hMSC 在 H3K9、H3K18 和 H3K27 位點顯示組蛋白乙醯化增加，確認了去乙醯酶活性降低。在方向性上，變異體位於較弱去乙醯化的上游。這表明長壽益處可能更多取決於 SIRT6 的 ADP-核糖基轉移酶而非去乙醯酶功能，並重新定義了如何詮釋 SIRT6 活性。蛋白豐度增加和去乙醯化減少之間的分離突顯了 SIRT6 的兩種酶活性是獨立調控的。這些發現對理解 SIRT6 長壽關聯的分子基礎至關重要。

label: ATM-p53/p73 pathway
description: Ectopic SIRT6 overexpression results in increased p53- and p73-dependent apoptosis through the ataxia telangiectasia mutated (ATM) kinase, and this effect requires SIRT6's mono-ADP-ribosyltransferase activity. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of ATM-dependent activation of p53 and p73. This reveals a deacetylation-independent tumor-suppressive mechanism of SIRT6, in which its enzymatic transfer of ADP-ribose rather than histone deacetylation triggers the cell-death program. By engaging the p53 family, SIRT6 can eliminate stressed or transformed cells before they become established tumors. This expands our understanding of sirtuin catalytic diversity in cancer suppression.
description_zh_TW: 異位SIRT6過表達透過ataxia telangiectasia mutated（ATM）激酶導致p53和p73依賴性的凋亡增加，此效果需要SIRT6的單-ADP-核糖基轉移酶活性。方向上，SIRT6位於ATM依賴性p53和p73活化的上游。這揭示了SIRT6的一種不依賴去乙醯化的腫瘤抑制機制，其中其ADP-核糖的酵素轉移而非組蛋白去乙醯化觸發細胞死亡程序。透過參與p53家族，SIRT6可以在壓力或轉化細胞成為 Established 腫瘤之前將其消除。這擴展了我們對sirtuin催化多樣性在癌症抑制中的理解。

label: LINE-1 expression (HGPS fibroblasts)
description: Fucoidan-FV (50-100 μg/mL) reduces LINE-1 ORF1p and ORF2p protein levels in Hutchinson-Gilford progeria (HGPS) patient-derived fibroblasts, indicating suppressed retrotransposition. Directionally, fucoidan/SIRT6 sits upstream of LINE-1 silencing. This addresses a progeria-associated chromatin defect and supports SIRT6's role in repetitive-element control. By restoring SIRT6-mediated silencing of LINE-1 elements, fucoidan mitigates a key feature of progeria biology, and AAV-mediated centenarian-SIRT6 delivery produces a similar reduction. These findings link fucoidan and SIRT6 to the maintenance of genome integrity in premature-aging syndromes.
description_zh_TW: Fucoidan-FV（50-100 μg/mL）在 Hutchinson-Gilford 早衰症（HGPS）患者來源的成纖維細胞中降低 LINE-1 ORF1p 和 ORF2p 蛋白水平，表明逆轉座被抑制。在方向性上，fucoidan/SIRT6 位於 LINE-1 沉默的上游。這解決了早衰症相關的染色質缺陷，並支持 SIRT6 在重複元件控制中的角色。透過恢復 SIRT6 介導的 LINE-1 元件沉默，fucoidan 緩解了早衰症生物學的一個關鍵特徵，而 AAV 介導的百歲人瑞 SIRT6 遞送產生了類似的降低。這些發現將 fucoidan 和 SIRT6 與早衰症候群中基因組完整性的維護聯繫起來。

label: ICAM-1
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: ICAM-1, an endothelial/leukocyte adhesion molecule elevated during inflammation and aging, is a target of SIRT6-repressed NF-κB signaling; its upregulation opposes SIRT6's vascular-protective role and it is listed among negative regulators of the SIRT6 pathway in Table 3.
description_zh_TW: ICAM-1 是一種內皮/白血球黏附分子，在發炎和老化期間升高，是 SIRT6 抑制的 NF-κB 訊號的下游靶標；其上調對抗 SIRT6 的血管保護作用，並被列入表 3 中 SIRT6 途徑的負向調節因子。

label: IGF-1/AKT
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: IGF-1/AKT signaling can modulate SIRT6 activity and expression in metabolic and intestinal-fitness contexts, generally promoting SIRT6-dependent metabolic and tumor-suppressive programs; Table 3 lists IGF-1/AKT among positive regulators of the SIRT6 pathway.
description_zh_TW: IGF-1/AKT 訊號可在代謝和腸道適能情境中調節 SIRT6 的活性和表現，通常促進 SIRT6 依賴的代謝和腫瘤抑制程序；表 3 將 IGF-1/AKT 列為 SIRT6 途徑的正向調節因子。

label: telomere position effect
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: In humans, SIRT6 is necessary to maintain the telomere position effect. SIRT6 was discovered as the first enzyme that modifies histones to regulate the telomere position effect in human cells, a novel role for SIRT6 in the regulation of age-related genome silencing. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of telomeric chromatin silencing, providing a new approach for telomere chromatin silencing and linking SIRT6 to telomere biology and genome stability.
description_zh_TW: 在人類中，SIRT6對於維持端粒位置效應是必要的。SIRT6被發現為第一個修飾組蛋白以調節人類細胞中端粒位置效應的酶，這是SIRT6在調節與年齡相關的基因組沉默方面的新角色。方向上，SIRT6位於端粒染色質沉默的上游，為端粒染色質沉默提供了新的方法，並將SIRT6與端粒生物學和基因組穩定性聯繫起來。

label: oxidative damage via NRF2 coactivation
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: It has been discovered in humans that SIRT6 interacts with the nuclear factor erythroid-derived 2-like 2 (NRF2) for the protection of mesenchymal stem cells from oxidative damage. SIRT6 safeguards human mesenchymal stem cells from oxidative stress by coactivating NRF2. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of NRF2-dependent antioxidant gene expression and thereby of stem cell survival under oxidative conditions.
description_zh_TW: 在人類中已發現SIRT6與核因子紅系2相關因子2（NRF2）相互作用，保護間充質幹細胞免受氧化損傷。SIRT6透過共活化NRF2來保護人類間充質幹細胞免受氧化壓力。方向上，SIRT6位於NRF2依賴性抗氧化基因表達的上游，從而位於氧化條件下幹細胞存活的上游。

label: prostate cancer cells
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Lack of SIRT6 decreases the viability of prostate cancer cells while increasing chemotherapeutic sensitivity. Directionally, SIRT6 loss sits upstream of reduced prostate cancer cell survival and heightened responsiveness to chemotherapy. This indicates that targeting SIRT6 could render prostate cancer cells more vulnerable to cytotoxic agents, supporting SIRT6 inhibition as an adjunct to prostate cancer treatment.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6的缺乏降低前列腺癌細胞的存活能力，同時增加化療敏感性。方向上，SIRT6缺失位於前列腺癌細胞存活降低和化療反應性增強的上游。這表明靶向SIRT6可能使前列腺癌細胞更容易受到細胞毒藥物的影響，支持SIRT6抑制作為前列腺癌治療的輔助手段。

label: IGF-1 signaling
description: Male SIRT6 transgenics have lower serum IGF-1 and reduced downstream insulin/IGF-1-like signaling (AKT, pAKT); reduced insulin/IGF-1-like signaling is strongly associated with increased longevity in model organisms, providing the leading explanation for SIRT6's male-specific lifespan extension. Directionally, SIRT6-mediated inhibition of IGF-1 signaling sits upstream of lifespan extension. By suppressing the growth-promoting IGF-AKT axis, SIRT6 may recapitulate the longevity benefits of reduced insulin/IGF signaling. This mechanism connects SIRT6 to one of the most conserved longevity pathways across species.
description_zh_TW: 雄性SIRT6轉基因小鼠具有較低的血清IGF-1和減少的下游胰島素/IGF-1類訊號（AKT、pAKT）；胰島素/IGF-1類訊號的減少與模式生物中壽命的增加強烈相關，為SIRT6雄性特異性壽命延長提供了首要解釋。方向上，SIRT6介導的IGF-1訊號抑制位於壽命延長的上游。透過抑制促生長的IGF-AKT軸，SIRT6可能重現了降低胰島素/IGF訊號的長壽益處。此機制將SIRT6與物種間最保守的長壽通路之一聯繫起來。

label: Nrf2 signaling
description: Overexpression of SIRT6 in the brain via in vivo gene transfer enhances Nrf2 signaling and reduces oxidative stress, linking SIRT6 to antioxidant transcription. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of Nrf2 pathway activation. This complements SIRT6's AMPK/MnSOD/catalase axis, providing multiple redundant antioxidant mechanisms. It reinforces SIRT6's role in neuronal and systemic antioxidant defense, and suggests that SIRT6 activation could protect the aging brain from oxidative injury. The convergence of SIRT1 and SIRT6 on Nrf2 highlights the importance of this transcription factor in sirtuin-mediated cytoprotection.
description_zh_TW: 通過體內基因轉移在大腦中過量表達 SIRT6 增強 Nrf2 信號並減少氧化壓力，將 SIRT6 與抗氧化轉錄聯繫起來。在方向性上，SIRT6 位於 Nrf2 通路活化的上游。這與 SIRT6 的 AMPK/MnSOD/catalase 軸互補，提供多種冗餘的抗氧化機制。它強化了 SIRT6 在神經元和全身抗氧化防禦中的作用，並提示 SIRT6 活化可能保護衰老大腦免受氧化損傷。SIRT1 和 SIRT6 在 Nrf2 上的趨同突顯了此轉錄因子在 sirtuin 介導的細胞保護中的重要性。

label: COPD development
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Reduced SIRT6 expression is associated with COPD development through enhancement of cellular senescence that arises from insufficient autophagy during cigarette smoke exposure. SIRT6 deficiency impairs autophagy and promotes premature senescence in lung cells. Directionally, SIRT6 deficiency sits upstream of impaired autophagy and accelerated cellular aging in the lung. By failing to clear damaged components, cells accumulate and enter senescence, contributing to the structural remodeling and functional decline characteristic of COPD.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6表達的降低與COPD發展相關，源於香菸煙霧暴露期間自噬不足引起的細胞衰老增強。SIRT6缺乏損害自噬並促進肺細胞的過早衰老。方向上，SIRT6缺乏位於肺部自噬受損和加速細胞老化的上游。透過未能清除受損成分，細胞積累並進入衰老，導致COPD特徵性的結構重塑和功能衰退。

label: endothelial senescence via oxidative stress
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Research has shown that senescence of endothelial cells is induced by oxidative stress due to SIRT6 downregulation. Directionally, SIRT6 loss sits upstream of oxidative stress-driven endothelial senescence. Because SIRT6 normally supports antioxidant defences and DNA repair, its decline leaves endothelial cells vulnerable to oxidative damage and the senescent phenotype, linking SIRT6 to vascular ageing.
description_zh_TW: 研究表明，由於SIRT6下調導致的氧化壓力誘導了內皮細胞的衰老。方向上，SIRT6缺失位於氧化壓力驅動的內皮細胞衰老的上游。因為SIRT6通常支持抗氧化防禦和DNA修復，其下降使內皮細胞容易受到氧化損傷和衰老表型的影響，將SIRT6與血管老化聯繫起來。

label: GLUT2
description: SIRT6 deacetylates FoxO1 and subsequently increases expression of glucose-dependent transporter 2 (GLUT2) in pancreatic β-cells. Directionally, SIRT6 activates FoxO1, which induces GLUT2. Higher GLUT2 restores glucose sensing and appropriate insulin release, maintaining systemic glucose tolerance. This complements SIRT6's role in β-cell metabolic health and its repression of TXNIP to preserve insulin secretion. By supporting β-cell identity and function, SIRT6 protects against the β-cell failure that characterizes type 2 diabetes, and its actions in β-cells illustrate how a nuclear sirtuin controls nutrient sensing.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 去乙醯化 FoxO1，隨後在胰腺 β 細胞中增加葡萄糖依賴性轉運蛋白 2（GLUT2）的表達。在方向性上，SIRT6 活化 FoxO1，FoxO1 再誘導 GLUT2。更高的 GLUT2 恢復葡萄糖感知和適當的胰島素釋放，維持全身葡萄糖耐量。這與 SIRT6 在 β 細胞代謝健康中的作用及其抑制 TXNIP 以保留胰島素分泌互補。通過支持 β 細胞特性和功能，SIRT6 保護對抗 2 型糖尿病特徵的 β 細胞衰竭，其在 β 細胞中的作用說明了一種核內 sirtuin 如何控制營養感知。

label: H2BK12
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT6 deacetylates H2BK12ac, contributing to its chromatin-silencing/heterochromatin program.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 去乙醯化 H2BK12ac，有助於其染色質沉默/異染色質程序。

label: Telomere maintenance
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT6 deacetylates H3K9 at telomeres and stabilizes WRN helicase, preventing telomere dysfunction-induced senescence; SIRT6-depleted cells undergo accelerated telomere replication problems and senescence (Michishita et al., 2008, Cell; source review).
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 去乙醯化端粒處的 H3K9 並穩定 WRN 解旋酶，防止端粒功能障礙引起的衰老；SIRT6 缺失的細胞出現加速的端粒複製問題及衰老現象（Michishita et al., 2008, Cell; 來源文獻）。

label: Histone H3K9
description: SIRT6 deacetylates H3K9 at the promoters of NF-κB target genes, reducing their transcription and thereby dampening inflammation. Directionally, SIRT6 enzymatically represses NF-κB-driven loci through chromatin modification. This complements SIRT6's direct promotion of p65 proteasomal degradation and underscores its anti-inflammatory role. Loss of SIRT6 elevates H3K9ac and inflammatory output, contributing to the pro-inflammatory phenotype of SIRT6-deficient tissues. Together with SIRT1, SIRT6 thus provides both chromatin-level and protein-level restraint on the NF-κB pathway that drives chronic inflammation in aging and disease.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 去乙醯化 NF-κB 靶基因啟動子處的 H3K9，降低其轉錄，從而抑制發炎。在方向性上，SIRT6 在酶學上通過染色質修飾抑制 NF-κB 驅動的基因座。這與 SIRT6 直接促進 p65 蛋白酶體降解互補，並強調其抗發炎角色。SIRT6 的缺失升高 H3K9ac 和發炎輸出，導致 SIRT6 缺乏組織的促發炎表型。與 SIRT1 一起，SIRT6 因此在驅動衰老和疾病中慢性發炎的 NF-κB 通路上提供染色質水平和蛋白質水平的雙重抑制。

label: Snail-dependent KLF4 repression
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT6 drives epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EMT) and metastasis in non-small-cell lung cancer through Snail-dependent transrepression of the transcription factor KLF4. This represents an oncogenic function of SIRT6 that contrasts sharply with its tumor-suppressive roles in other cancers. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of EMT induction and metastatic progression in this context. By repressing KLF4, an epithelial-fate factor, SIRT6 allows Snail to drive the mesenchymal program that promotes invasion and spread.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6透過Snail依賴性的轉錄因子KLF4反式抑制驅動非小細胞肺癌中的上皮-間質轉化（EMT）和轉移。這代表了SIRT6的一個致癌功能，與其在其他癌症中的腎瘤抑制角色形成鮮明對比。方向上，SIRT6位於此環境中EMT誘導和轉移進展的上游。透過抑制KLF4（一個上皮命運因子），SIRT6允許Snail驅動促進侵襲和擴散的間質程序。

label: cardiac hypertrophy and heart failure
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT6 expression blocks the development of cardiac hypertrophy and heart failure.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 表達阻斷心臟肥大和心臟衰竭的發展。

label: aging and reprogramming of human iPSCs
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT6 has a part to play in ageing of human induced pluripotent stem cells as well as their reprogramming. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of pluripotent stem cell aging dynamics and the efficiency of somatic cell reprogramming. By influencing these processes, SIRT6 links chromatin-based ageing regulation to stem cell biology and regenerative medicine.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6在人類誘導多能幹細胞的老化及其重編程中發揮作用。方向上，SIRT6位於多能幹細胞老化動態和體細胞重編程效率的上游。透過影響這些過程，SIRT6將基於染色質的老化調節與幹細胞生物學和再生醫學聯繫起來。

label: JAK2/STAT3 pathway
description: SIRT6 inhibits the Janus kinase 2/STAT3 pathway, suppressing growth and survival signaling in gastric cancer. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of JAK2/STAT3 blockade. This restrains STAT3-driven proliferation and is part of SIRT6's tumor-suppressive repertoire, with SIRT6 loss associated with increased STAT3 activity and tumor aggressiveness. It adds a cytokine-receptor-linked mechanism to SIRT6's anti-cancer actions, complementing its repression of HIF-1α, c-MYC, and glycolysis. Because STAT3 integrates multiple growth and inflammatory signals, its suppression by SIRT6 is relevant to both oncology and chronic inflammation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 抑制 Janus kinase 2/STAT3 通路，抑制胃癌中的生長和存活信號。在方向性上，SIRT6 位於 JAK2/STAT3 封鎖的上游。這限制 STAT3 驅動的增殖，是 SIRT6 腫瘤抑制能力的一部分，SIRT6 的缺失與 STAT3 活性增加和腫瘤侵襲性相關。這為 SIRT6 的抗癌作用增加了一個與細胞因子受體相關的機制，與其對 HIF-1α、c-MYC 和糖解的抑制互補。由於 STAT3 整合多種生長和發炎信號，其被 SIRT6 抑制對腫瘤學和慢性發炎均具有相關性。

label: tumor suppressor protein (TSP)
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT6 is described as tumor suppressor protein (TSP); it is a tumor-suppressor protein whose deficiency causes genomic instability and premature aging.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 被描述為腫瘤抑制蛋白（TSP）；它是一種腫瘤抑制蛋白，其缺乏導致基因組不穩定和早衰。

label: metabolic homeostasis
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT6 maintains metabolic homeostasis by repressing HIF-1alpha and c-MYC to limit glycolysis, deacetylating H3K9 at glycolytic promoters, and restraining lipogenesis (SREBP-1c/2) and insulin/IGF-1 signaling while promoting lipolysis via FoxO1-ATGL; it protects against diet-induced obesity and diabetes.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 透過抑制 HIF-1α 和 c-MYC 來限制糖酵解，去乙醯化糖酵解啟動子上的 H3K9，並抑制脂肪生成（SREBP-1c/2）和胰島素/IGF-1 信號同時透過 FoxO1-ATGL 促進脂解，從而維持代謝恆定；它保護免受飲食誘導的肥胖和糖尿病。

label: telomere function
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT6 maintains telomere function by deacetylating H3K9 at telomeric chromatin and stabilizing WRN helicase, preventing telomere dysfunction-induced senescence; it also preserves the telomere position effect, linking SIRT6 to genome stability.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 透過去乙醯化端粒染色質中的 H3K9 並穩定 WRN 解旋酶來維持端粒功能，防止端粒功能障礙引發的衰老；它還維持端粒位置效應，將 SIRT6 與基因組穩定性聯繫起來。

label: Akt phosphorylation
source_file: _document_ - The Sirtuin Network Linking NAD+ Metabolism, Mitochondrial Function, and Metabolic Homoeostasis.md
description: SIRT6 negatively regulates the insulin-signaling cascade by suppressing upstream signaling through the insulin receptor and insulin receptor substrates. This restraint reduces downstream Akt phosphorylation, preventing excessive glucose uptake and helping to maintain metabolic balance in peripheral tissues. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of dampened insulin-PI3K-Akt signaling. Loss of SIRT6 elevates this signaling, contributing to insulin resistance and metabolic dysfunction. By toning down insulin-driven anabolic responses, SIRT6 protects cells from nutrient overload and supports the metabolic flexibility that is lost in obesity and type 2 diabetes.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6透過抑制胰島素受體和胰島素受體底物的上游訊號來負向調節胰島素訊號級聯。這種抑制降低了下游Akt磷酸化，防止過度的葡萄糖攝取，並幫助維持周邊組織的代謝平衡。方向上，SIRT6位於胰島素-PI3K-Akt訊號減弱的上游。SIRT6的缺失提升了此訊號，導致胰島素阻抗和代謝功能障礙。透過調節胰島素驅動的合成代謝反應，SIRT6保護細胞免受營養過載，並支持在肥胖和第二型糖尿病中失去的代謝靈活性。

label: diet-induced obesity
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT6 overexpression protects mice from diet-induced obesity, with increased glucose tolerance and reduced fat accumulation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 過表達保護小鼠免受飲食誘導的肥胖，具有增加的葡萄糖耐受性和減少的脂肪積累。

label: NF-κB-mediated inflammatory responses
description: SIRT6 overexpression suppresses NF-κB-mediated inflammatory responses, as shown in models such as osteoarthritis development where cytokine production is reduced. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of inhibited NF-κB inflammation. This protection arises from both chromatin deacetylation of NF-κB target genes and promotion of p65 degradation, providing redundant brakes on the pathway. It positions SIRT6 as a nuclear inflammation brake, and its loss derepresses inflammatory gene programs. This anti-inflammatory function is part of SIRT6's broader protective phenotype, alongside its roles in DNA repair, metabolism, and the suppression of age-related pathologies.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 過量表達抑制 NF-κB 介導的發炎反應，如在骨關節炎發展模型中所示，細胞因子產生減少。在方向性上，SIRT6 位於被抑制的 NF-κB 發炎的上游。這種保護來自 NF-κB 靶基因的染色質去乙醯化和 p65 降解的促進，為該通路提供了冗餘的制動。它將 SIRT6 定位為核內發炎制動器，其缺失解除對發炎基因程序的抑制。這種抗發炎功能是 SIRT6 更廣泛保護表型的一部分，與其在 DNA 修復、代謝和抑制衰老相關病理中的作用並列。

label: TGF-β1/Smad3 signaling
description: SIRT6 prevents TGF-β1-induced lung myofibroblast differentiation by inactivating TGF-β1/Smad3 signaling, limiting fibrogenesis. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of TGF-β1/Smad3 blockade. This complements SIRT6's other antifibrotic actions in heart and kidney, and it positions SIRT6 as a broad suppressor of Smad3-driven fibrosis. By blocking myofibroblast differentiation, SIRT6 prevents the accumulation of contractile, matrix-producing cells that drive tissue scarring. SIRT6 activation therefore represents a potential strategy for pulmonary fibrosis and other fibrotic diseases where TGF-β signaling is central.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 透過使 TGF-β1/Smad3 訊號失活來防止 TGF-β1 誘導的肺肌成纖維細胞分化，限制纖維化生成。在方向性上，SIRT6 位於 TGF-β1/Smad3 阻斷的上游。這與 SIRT6 在心臟和腎臟中的其他抗纖維化作用互補，將 SIRT6 定位為 Smad3 驅動的纖維化的廣泛抑制因子。透過阻斷肌成纖維細胞分化，SIRT6 防止驅動組織疤痕的收縮性、基質產生細胞的積累。因此 SIRT6 活化代表了肺纖維化和其他以 TGF-β 訊號為核心的纖維化疾病的潛在策略。

label: ARDS (acute respiratory distress syndrome)
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT6 regulates macrophage polarization to alleviate sepsis-induced acute respiratory distress syndrome via dual mechanisms that are both dependent on and independent of autophagy. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of anti-inflammatory macrophage phenotypes in lung injury. By steering macrophages away from proinflammatory states, SIRT6 dampens the excessive inflammatory response that drives ARDS, while its autophagy-related actions support cellular quality control. This coordinated regulation helps limit lung damage during sepsis.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6調節巨噬細胞極化以緩解敗血症誘導的急性呼吸窘迫症候群，透過依賴和不依賴自噬的雙重機制。方向上，SIRT6位於肺損傷中抗發炎巨噬細胞表型的上游。透過將巨噬細胞從促發炎狀態引導開來，SIRT6抑制驅動ARDS的過度發炎反應，而其自噬相關作用支持細胞品質控制。這種協調的調節有助於限制敗血症期間的肺損傷。

label: genomic stability
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT6 safeguards genomic stability by deacetylating H3K9 at telomeres and repetitive elements, suppressing LINE-1 retrotransposons, and supporting double-strand-break repair via CtIP and PARP1; SIRT6 deficiency causes genomic instability and premature aging.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 透過去乙醯化端粒和重複元件上的 H3K9、抑制 LINE-1 反轉錄轉座子，以及透過 CtIP 和 PARP1 支持雙股斷裂修復來保障基因組穩定性；SIRT6 缺乏導致基因組不穩定和早衰。

label: JAK2/STAT3 inhibition
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT6 suppresses hepatocellular carcinoma cell growth through induction of apoptosis, inhibition of oxidative stress, and blockade of the JAK2/STAT3 signaling pathway. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of JAK2/STAT3 blockade and tumor suppression. By restraining this oncogenic signaling axis, SIRT6 limits the proliferative and survival signals that drive liver cancer progression. The combination of apoptosis induction and oxidative-stress suppression reflects SIRT6's multi-pronged tumor-suppressive activity. This positions SIRT6 as a promising target for hepatocellular carcinoma, where restoring or enhancing SIRT6 function could complement existing treatments.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6透過誘導凋亡、抑制氧化壓力和阻斷JAK2/STAT3訊號通路來抑制肝細胞癌細胞生長。方向上，SIRT6位於JAK2/STAT3阻斷和腫瘤抑制的上游。透過抑制此致癌訊號軸，SIRT6限制了驅動肝癌進展的增殖和存活訊號。凋亡誘導和氧化壓力抑制的結合反映了SIRT6多方面的腫瘤抑制活性。這將SIRT6定位為肝細胞癌的有前景的靶點，其中恢復或增強SIRT6功能可以補充現有治療。

label: osteogenic transdifferentiation of VSMCs
description: SIRT6 suppresses osteogenic transdifferentiation of vascular smooth-muscle cells via repression of runt-related transcription factor 2 (Runx2), limiting vascular calcification. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of inhibited VSMC osteogenesis. This protects against vessel stiffening in atherosclerosis and aging, and it is a vascular-homeostasis function of SIRT6. By preventing VSMCs from adopting an osteoblast-like phenotype, SIRT6 preserves arterial compliance and reduces the calcific burden of aged vessels. The mechanism complements SIRT6's inhibition of NF-κB and inflammatory gene programs in the vasculature.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 通過抑制矮小相關轉錄因子 2（Runx2）來抑制血管平滑肌細胞的成骨轉分化，限制血管鈣化。在方向性上，SIRT6 位於被抑制的 VSMC 骨生成的上游。這保護對抗動脈粥樣硬化和衰老中的血管僵硬，是 SIRT6 的血管穩態功能。通過防止 VSMC 採取類骨母細胞的表型，SIRT6 保留動脈順應性並減少老化血管的鈣化負擔。此機制與 SIRT6 在血管中抑制 NF-κB 和發炎基因程序互補。

label: stabilized by USP48
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT6, stabilized by the deubiquitinase USP48, attenuates glycolysis in hepatocellular carcinoma and impedes metabolic reprogramming, thereby hampering HCC malignancy. Directionally, USP48-dependent stabilization of SIRT6 sits upstream of suppressed glycolytic metabolism and reduced tumor aggressiveness. By maintaining SIRT6 protein levels, USP48 sustains SIRT6-mediated repression of glycolysis, preventing the metabolic shift that fuels liver cancer growth. This identifies the USP48-SIRT6 axis as a potential therapeutic node in HCC.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6被去泛素酶USP48穩定化，減弱肝細胞癌中的糖解作用並阻礙代謝重編程，從而阻礙HCC的惡性程度。方向上，USP48依賴性的SIRT6穩定化位於糖解代謝抑制和腫瘤侵襲性降低的上游。透過維持SIRT6蛋白水平，USP48維持SIRT6介導的糖解作用抑制，防止驅動肝癌生長的代謝轉換。這將USP48-SIRT6軸確定為HCC中的潛在治療節點。

label: Healthspan and lifespan (aged mice)
description: SIRT6-activating fucoidan extends healthspan and lifespan in aged wild-type mice, confirming in vivo geroprotection. Directionally, fucoidan sits upstream of improved survival and function. This mirrors the longevity association of centenarian SIRT6 variants and positions fucoidan as a natural SIRT6-targeted intervention. The benefit in naturally aged mice suggests that SIRT6 activation can counteract age-related decline even when initiated late in life. Fucoidan's dual activation of SIRT6 protein and ADP-ribosyltransferase activity is thought to mediate its healthspan effects.
description_zh_TW: 活化 SIRT6 的 fucoidan 延長老年野生型小鼠的健康壽命和壽命，確認了體內抗衰老保護。在方向性上，fucoidan 位於改善存活和功能的上游。這反映了百歲人瑞 SIRT6 變異體的長壽關聯，將 fucoidan 定位為天然的 SIRT6 靶向干預措施。在自然衰老小鼠中的益處表明，即使在生命後期才開始 SIRT6 活化也能對抗年齡相關退化。Fucoidan 對 SIRT6 蛋白和 ADP-核糖基轉移酶活性的雙重活化被認為是其健康壽命效應的介導機制。

label: human osteoblasts
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Sirtuin 6 inhibits the generation of reactive oxygen species and glycolysis, which decreases the inflammatory response generated by hypoxia in human osteoblasts. This has therapeutic implications in inflammatory bone resorption. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of reduced ROS and glycolysis and thereby of dampened hypoxic inflammation in bone cells. SIRT6 thus protects osteoblasts from hypoxia-induced inflammatory damage.
description_zh_TW: Sirtuin 6抑制活性氧和糖解作用的產生，這降低了缺氧在人類成骨細胞中產生的發炎反應。這對炎性骨吸收具有治療意義。方向上，SIRT6位於活性氧和糖解作用減少的上游，從而位於骨細胞中缺氧發炎的抑制上游。因此SIRT6保護成骨細胞免受缺氧誘導的發炎損傷。

label: SIRT6 N308K mutation
description: The N308K substitution selectively reduces SIRT6-vimentin interaction, which normally promotes SIRT6 degradation, thereby increasing SIRT6 protein levels. Directionally, N308K sits upstream of weakened vimentin binding. This stabilizes SIRT6 and enhances its functional output, and it is the molecular explanation for the centenarian variant phenotype. Because vimentin normally targets SIRT6 for proteasomal degradation, the N308K variant escapes this turnover. This post-translational stabilization, rather than transcriptional upregulation, underlies the increased SIRT6 abundance seen in carriers of the longevity-associated variant.
description_zh_TW: N308K 取代選擇性地減少 SIRT6-vimentin 的相互作用——後者通常促進 SIRT6 降解——從而增加 SIRT6 蛋白水平。在方向性上，N308K 位於 vimentin 結合弱化的上游。這穩定 SIRT6 並增強其功能輸出，是百歲人瑞變異體表型的分子解釋。由於 vimentin 通常靶向 SIRT6 進行蛋白酶體降解，N308K 變異體逃避了這種周轉。這種轉錄後穩定化（而非轉錄上調）構成了長壽相關變異體攜帶者中 SIRT6 豐度增加的基礎。

label: UUO-induced kidney tubulointerstitial inflammation and fibrosis
description: The SIRT6 activator MDL-800 mitigates unilateral ureteral obstruction (UUO)-induced kidney tubulointerstitial inflammation and fibrosis, validating SIRT6 activation therapeutically. Directionally, MDL-800 activates SIRT6, which protects the kidney. This complements other evidence that SIRT6 restrains TGF-β/Smad3 fibrogenesis and NF-κB-mediated inflammation. It supports SIRT6 as a target for chronic kidney disease, where tubulointerstitial fibrosis determines outcome. The efficacy of a pharmacologic SIRT6 activator in a standard fibrosis model provides important proof-of-concept for SIRT6-based therapies in renal and fibrotic disease.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 活化因子 MDL-800 減輕單側輸尿管阻塞（UUO）誘導的腎小管間質發炎和纖維化，在治療上驗證了 SIRT6 活化。在方向性上，MDL-800 活化 SIRT6，SIRT6 保護腎臟。這與 SIRT6 限制 TGF-β/Smad3 纖維化和 NF-κB 介導發炎的其他證據互補。它支持 SIRT6 作為慢性腎病的靶點，在該疾病中小管間質纖維化決定預後。藥理性 SIRT6 活化因子在標準纖維化模型中的療效為基於 SIRT6 的腎臟和纖維化疾病療法提供了重要的概念驗證。

label: NAD+ metabolite sensor (potential)
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: The crystal structure of human SIRT6 reveals a more open conformation than other sirtuins, with the small domain displaced and the cofactor binding loop replaced by a stable single helix. Kinetic and structural data indicate SIRT6 is the unique sirtuin able to bind NAD+ in the absence of an acetyl-lysine substrate. This raises the possibility that SIRT6 evolved away from a conventional NAD+-dependent deacetylase toward a NAD+ metabolite sensor function. Directionally, this distinctive structural feature sets SIRT6 apart from SIRT2, SIRT3, and SIRT5 and informs the search for SIRT6-specific modulators.
description_zh_TW: 人類 SIRT6 的晶體結構揭示了較其他 sirtuin 更為開放的構象，其小型結構域發生位移，輔因子結合環被一個穩定的單一螺旋取代。動力學和結構數據顯示 SIRT6 是唯一能在沒有乙醯-離胺酸受質存在下結合 NAD+ 的 sirtuin。這提出了 SIRT6 可能從傳統的 NAD+ 依賴性去乙醯酶演化為 NAD+ 代謝物感測器功能的可能性。方向性上此獨特的結構特徵將 SIRT6 與 SIRT2、SIRT3 和 SIRT5 區分開來，並為尋找 SIRT6 特異性調節劑提供了依據。

label: LINE-1 derepression (under progerin stress)
description: Under progerin-induced stress, centenarian-variant hMSCs better maintain LINE-1 repression, with reduced ORF1p and ORF2p proteins. Directionally, CentSIRT6 sits upstream of continued LINE-1 silencing. This protects genome integrity against retrotransposition, and it connects the ADP-ribosyltransferase gain to repetitive-element control. By preserving heterochromatic silencing of LINE-1 elements during progerin stress, the variant maintains a key genome-defense mechanism. These results link the enhanced ADP-ribosylation activity of centenarian SIRT6 to the suppression of retroelement expression that destabilizes aging genomes.
description_zh_TW: 在 progerin 誘導的壓力下，百歲人瑞變異體 hMSC 更好地維護 LINE-1 抑制，ORF1p 和 ORF2p 蛋白減少。在方向性上，CentSIRT6 位於持續 LINE-1 沉默的上游。這保護基因組完整性免受逆轉座的影響，並將 ADP-核糖基轉移酶增強與重複元件控制聯繫起來。透過在 progerin 壓力期間維護 LINE-1 元件的異染色質沉默，變異體維護了關鍵的基因組防禦機制。這些結果將百歲人瑞 SIRT6 增強的 ADP-核糖基化活性與在衰老基因組中不穩定化的逆轉元件表達的抑制聯繫起來。

label: as regulated by KLF10
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Upregulation of SIRT6 by the tumor suppressor KLF10 activity influences glycolysis, epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition, and distant metastasis of pancreatic cancer cells. Directionally, KLF10-driven SIRT6 upregulation sits upstream of altered metabolic and invasive behaviors in pancreatic cancer. By modulating glycolysis and EMT, SIRT6 shapes the aggressiveness and metastatic capacity of pancreatic cancer cells, indicating that the KLF10-SIRT6 axis may serve as a therapeutic or prognostic target in pancreatic cancer.
description_zh_TW: 腫瘤抑制因子KLF10活性上調的SIRT6影響胰腺癌細胞的糖解作用、上皮-間質轉化和遠端轉移。方向上，KLF10驅動的SIRT6上調位於胰腺癌中代謝和侵襲行為改變的上游。透過調節糖解作用和EMT，SIRT6塑造胰腺癌細胞的侵襲性和轉移能力，表明KLF10-SIRT6軸可能作為胰腺癌中的治療或預後靶點。

label: severe metabolic defects and rapid aging
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: Zhao et al. note that loss of SIRT6 causes severe metabolic defects and rapid aging, positioning SIRT6 as holding the most potential for actual mammalian life-span extension.
description_zh_TW: Zhao 等人指出，SIRT6 的缺失導致嚴重的代謝缺陷和快速衰老，使 SIRT6 在實際延長哺乳動物壽命方面具有最大的潛力。

label: p21 Cip1/Waf1
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: p21 (CDKN1A), whose expression is antagonized by SIRT6 (SIRT6 suppresses p21-driven senescence), accumulates with age and opposes SIRT6-regulated cell-cycle and DNA-repair programs; Table 3 lists p21 among negative regulators of SIRT6 (source review).
description_zh_TW: p21（CDKN1A）的表現受 SIRT6 拮抗（SIRT6 抑制 p21 驅動的衰老），其隨年齡增長而累積，並對抗 SIRT6 調節的細胞週期和 DNA 修復程序；表 3 將 p21 列為 SIRT6 的負向調節因子（來源文獻）。

label: Rspo1
description: SIRT6 preserves Rspo1 expression to confer intestinal epithelium injury resistance in inflammatory bowel disease. Rspo1 potentiates canonical Wnt signaling by stabilizing the LGR5 receptor complex, maintaining intestinal stem-cell function.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 保存 Rspo1 表現，以賦予發炎性腸病中腸道上皮的損傷抵抗力。Rspo1 透過穩定 LGR5 受體複合體增強典型 Wnt 訊號，維持腸道幹細胞功能。

label: USP10
description: USP10 is a deubiquitinating enzyme that binds the C-terminal region of SIRT6 and deubiquitinates it, protecting SIRT6 from proteasomal degradation. This interaction stabilizes SIRT6 and links USP10 to the sirtuin-stabilization network.
description_zh_TW: USP10 是去泛素化酶，結合 SIRT6 的 C 端區域並為其去泛素化，保護 SIRT6 免受蛋白酶體降解。此交互作用穩定 SIRT6，並將 USP10 與 sirtuin 穩定網路相連結。

label: JAK2/STAT3
description: SIRT6 inhibits JAK2/STAT3 inflammatory signaling, a sirtuin counter-regulation node converging on the same inflammaging axis metformin targets. Slash object normalizes to one node.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 抑制 JAK2/STAT3 發炎訊號，是匯聚於 metformin 標靶的相同發炎老化軸的 sirtuin 反調節節點。斜線物件正規化為單一節點。

label: UBCS039
description: UBCS039 is a synthetic allosteric activator of SIRT6 that binds a distal hydrophobic pocket adjacent to the catalytic site and increases deacetylase activity by up to 22-fold, stabilizing the active conformation with bound NAD+ and acylated substrate. Unlike orthosteric modulation, it does not compete with NAD+, sparing the other six sirtuins and the many NAD+-dependent enzymes.
description_zh_TW: UBCS039 是 SIRT6 的合成異位（allosteric）活化劑，結合於催化位附近的遠端疏水性口袋，藉由穩定與 NAD+ 及乙醯化受質結合的活性構型，使去乙醯化活性最高提升約 22 倍。與正位調節不同，它不與 NAD+ 競爭，因此可避免影響其餘六個 sirtuin 與許多 NAD+ 依賴酵素。

label: Neuronal survival
description: Mitophagy acts as a double-edged sword in neuronal survival. Insufficient clearance allows damaged mitochondria to accumulate, triggering inflammation and cell death, while excessive mitophagy depletes healthy mitochondria, causing bioenergetic failure. This bidirectional regulation means that both impairment and overactivation of mitophagy can precipitate neuronal damage. Striking the precise balance between removing dysfunctional and preserving healthy mitochondria is the central challenge for therapeutics.
description_zh_TW: Mitophagy 在神經元存活中扮演雙刃劍。清除不足使受損粒線體累積，觸發發炎和細胞死亡，而過度的 mitophagy 耗盡健康粒線體，造成生物能量衰竭。此雙向調節意味著 mitophagy 的受損和過度活化都可能引發神經元損傷。在移除功能失常與保留健康粒線體之間取得精確平衡是治療的核心挑戰。

label: p62/SQSTM1
description: The LIR motif (LC3-interacting region) is a short linear sequence found in autophagy receptors including p62/SQSTM1. It mediates direct binding to ATG8-family proteins such as LC3, tethering ubiquitinated cargo into the autophagosome.
description_zh_TW: LIR 模體（LC3 交互作用區）是存在於包括 p62/SQSTM1 在內之自噬受體的短線性序列。它介導與 LC3 等 ATG8 家族蛋白的直接結合，將泛素化貨物繫入自噬體。

label: Atg4
description: Atg4 cysteine protease cleaves the C-terminal extension of Atg8 to expose glycine, enabling phosphatidylethanolamine conjugation. Processing is the prerequisite for lipidation.
description_zh_TW: Atg4 半胱氨酸蛋白酶切割 Atg8 C 端延伸以暴露甘胺酸，使磷脂醯乙醇胺接合得以進行。加工是脂化的先決條件。

label: Atg16
description: Atg16 non-covalently binds the Atg12-Atg5 conjugate; this complex multimerizes and localizes to the expanding phagophore, functioning as an E3-like enzyme that specifies the site of LC3-II formation and facilitates conjugation of LC3 to phosphatidylethanolamine on the Autophagosome membrane.
description_zh_TW: Atg16 以非共價方式結合 Atg12-Atg5 結合物；此複合體多聚化並定位於擴張中的吞噬泡，作為 E3 類酵素指定 LC3-II 形成的位點，促進 LC3 與 phosphatidylethanolamine 在 Autophagosome 膜上的結合。

label: Ubiquitin-like domain
description: Parkin is a multidomain E3 ubiquitin ligase whose N-terminal Ubiquitin-like domain engages RING0 in the autoinhibited state, folding the enzyme closed so that RING2 is occluded. Displacement of the UBL — by PINK1-mediated phosphorylation and ubiquitin-dependent relief of repression — releases active Parkin, which then ubiquitinates mitochondrial substrates during Mitophagy.
description_zh_TW: Parkin 是多結構域的 E3 泛素連接酶，其 N 端 Ubiquitin-like domain 在自抑制狀態下與 RING0 結合，使酵素摺疊成封閉構形而遮蔽 RING2。UBL 的位移——由 PINK1 媒介的磷酸化與泛素依賴性的去抑制促成——會釋出活性 Parkin，後者在 Mitophagy 期間泛素化粒線體受質。

label: Beta-glucan
description: Beta-glucan reverses the epigenetic program of LPS tolerization, restoring robust proinflammatory cytokine production upon LPS re-exposure in human cells. This demonstrates that training and tolerance use distinct but interconvertible epigenetic routes. It provides proof-of-principle for retraining a tolerized innate compartment.
description_zh_TW: Beta-glucan 可逆轉 LPS tolerization 的表觀遺傳程式，在人類細胞中恢復 LPS 再暴露時的強勁促發炎細胞激素產生。這顯示 training 與 tolerance 使用不同但可互換的表觀遺傳路徑。它為 retraining 已耐受的先天免疫區間提供了原理驗證。

label: LPS Tolerance
description: Beta-glucan reverses the epigenetic program of LPS tolerization, restoring robust proinflammatory cytokine production upon LPS re-exposure in human cells. This demonstrates that training and tolerance use distinct but interconvertible epigenetic routes. It provides proof-of-principle for retraining a tolerized innate compartment.
description_zh_TW: Beta-glucan 可逆轉 LPS tolerization 的表觀遺傳程式，在人類細胞中恢復 LPS 再暴露時的強勁促發炎細胞激素產生。這顯示 training 與 tolerance 使用不同但可互換的表觀遺傳路徑。它為 retraining 已耐受的先天免疫區間提供了原理驗證。

label: Betaine supplementation
description: Betaine (trimethylglycine, TMG) supplementation can cause mood sensitivity, including irritability, anxiety, or overstimulation, in slow COMT individuals because it increases methyl availability that these individuals clear more slowly. The resulting elevation in SAMe and the overall methyl burden can push catecholamine metabolism and mood regulation beyond the optimal range, particularly when combined with other methyl donors. Because slow COMT already processes catecholamines and methyl groups inefficiently, the added methyl load is poorly tolerated. Dose titration, monitoring, and low starting doses are advised when using betaine in this genetically defined subgroup.
description_zh_TW: Betaine（三甲基甘氨酸，TMG）補充劑可能會導致緩慢的 COMT 個體情緒敏感，包括煩躁、焦慮或過度刺激，因為它增加了這些個體清除速度較慢的甲基可用性。由此產生的 SAMe 和整體甲基負擔的增加可以推動兒茶酚胺代謝和情緒調節超出最佳範圍，特別是與其他甲基供體結合時。因為緩慢的 COMT 已經低效地處理 catecholamines 和 methyl groups，所以添加的甲基負載的耐受性很差。在這個基因定義的亞群中使用甜菜鹼時，建議進行劑量滴定、監測和低起始劑量。

label: mood sensitivity in slow COMT
description: Betaine (trimethylglycine, TMG) supplementation can cause mood sensitivity, including irritability, anxiety, or overstimulation, in slow COMT individuals because it increases methyl availability that these individuals clear more slowly. The resulting elevation in SAMe and the overall methyl burden can push catecholamine metabolism and mood regulation beyond the optimal range, particularly when combined with other methyl donors. Because slow COMT already processes catecholamines and methyl groups inefficiently, the added methyl load is poorly tolerated. label: Burn Injury
description: Burn injury induces a chronic mTOR-dependent hyper-responsive training state in innate immunity, with increased neutrophil recruitment to lungs and enhanced reactive oxygen and nitrogen species production upon rechallenge. Rapamycin administration reverses this hyperresponsiveness but impairs bacterial clearance and increases mortality, showing mTOR balances antimicrobial benefit against maladaptive inflammation after burns.
description_zh_TW: Burn Injury 可誘發先天免疫慢性 mTOR-dependent 過度反應訓練狀態，再刺激時肺部嗜中性球招募增加，活性氧與活性氮產量上升。Rapamycin 給藥可逆轉此過度反應，但同時損害細菌清除並增加死亡率，顯示 mTOR 在燒傷後需平衡抗菌效益與失調性發炎。

label: mTOR-Dependent Neutrophil Hyperresponsiveness
description: Burn injury induces a chronic mTOR-dependent hyper-responsive training state in innate immunity, with increased neutrophil recruitment to lungs and enhanced reactive oxygen and nitrogen species production upon rechallenge. Rapamycin administration reverses this hyperresponsiveness but impairs bacterial clearance and increases mortality, showing mTOR balances antimicrobial benefit against maladaptive inflammation after burns.

label: Butein, piceatannol and isoliquiritigenin
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Plant polyphenols notably butein, piceatannol, and isoliquiritigenin (ILQ) have been demonstrated to activate recombinant SIRT1, and are known as sirtuin activating compounds (STACs). Directionally, these natural polyphenols sit upstream of enhanced SIRT1 enzymatic activity. Together with resveratrol, these plant-derived compounds represent natural STACs, and synthetic STACs such as SRT1720 activate SIRT1 substantially more potently.
description_zh_TW: 植物多酚中較為突出的成分，包括紫檀芪（piceatannol）、丁香酚（butein）和異甘草素（ILQ），已被證實能夠活化重組 SIRT1，並被歸類為 sirtuin 活化化合物（STACs）。從作用方向而言，這些天然多酚位於增強 SIRT1 酶活性的上游。與白藜蘆醇一起，這些植物來源的化合物代表了天然 STACs，而合成 STACs 如 SRT1720 活化 SIRT1 的效力則顯著更強。

label: recombinant SIRT1
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Plant polyphenols notably butein, piceatannol, and isoliquiritigenin (ILQ) have been demonstrated to activate recombinant SIRT1, and are known as sirtuin activating compounds (STACs). Directionally, these natural polyphenols sit upstream of enhanced SIRT1 enzymatic activity. Together with resveratrol, these plant-derived compounds represent natural STACs, and synthetic STACs such as SRT1720 activate SIRT1 substantially more potently.

label: Ca2+ surge (cytoplasmic)
description: The cytoplasmic calcium surge activates calmodulin-dependent protein kinase kinase β (CaMKKβ), which phosphorylates and activates AMPK, the central cellular energy sensor. Directionally, Ca2+ activates CaMKKβ, which in turn phosphorylates AMPK. Activated AMPK then induces NAMPT and raises NAD+, closing the loop on SIRT1 activation and promoting catabolic metabolism. This is a key branch point linking calcium flux to metabolic homeostasis, and it explains how agents that raise cytosolic calcium can indirectly boost sirtuin activity, complementing the direct actions of SIRT1 activators and integrating calcium signaling into energy metabolism.
description_zh_TW: 細胞質鈣離子激增活化鈣調蛋白依賴性蛋白激酶激酶 β（CaMKKβ），後者磷酸化並活化 AMPK——細胞的中心能量感測器。在方向性上，Ca2+ 活化 CaMKKβ，CaMKKβ 再磷酸化 AMPK。活化的 AMPK 然後誘導 NAMPT 並升高 NAD+，完成 SIRT1 活化的迴路並促進分解代謝。這是將鈣離子通量與代謝穩態聯繫起來的關鍵分支點，解釋了提高細胞質鈣離子的試劑如何能間接增強 sirtuin 活性，與 SIRT1 活化因子的直接作用互補，並將鈣離子信號整合到能量代謝中。

label: Capillary electrophoresis-based sirtuin assay
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: Recently, non-peptide substrates for SIRT1 have been synthesized, and two capillary electrophoresis assays were developed and validated to monitor the deacetylation of these substrates and to screen sirtuin inhibitor activity, complementing earlier CE assays using N-terminally fluorescence-labeled peptides. Directionally, CE separates substrate and product by their charge/mass differences without relying on fluorophore-release effects. The non-peptide substrates broaden the assay chemistry available for studying SIRT1 and its modulators.
description_zh_TW: 最近已合成非胜肽類 SIRT1 受質，並開發和驗證了兩種毛細管電泳測定來監測這些受質的去乙醯化及篩選 sirtuin 抑制劑活性，補充了早期使用 N 端螢光標記胜肽的毛細管電泳測定。方向性上毛細管電泳透過電荷/質量差異分離受質和產物，不依賴螢光基團釋放效應。非胜肽受質擴展了研究 SIRT1 及其調節劑的可用測定化學方法。

label: Capsaicin
description: Capsaicin from chili peppers induces a stimulatory hormetic response by activating transient receptor potential (TRP) channels. Downstream effects include increased thermogenesis, improved mitochondrial function and insulin sensitivity, and reduced risk of obesity, type 2 diabetes, and cardiovascular disease.
description_zh_TW: 來自辣椒的 Capsaicin 透過活化 transient receptor potential (TRP) channels 引發興奮性 hormesis 反應。下游效應包括產熱增加、粒線體功能與胰島素敏感性改善，以及肥胖、第二型糖尿病與心血管疾病風險降低。

label: Cardiovascular Events
description: IL-1beta inhibition with canakinumab reduces cardiovascular events, as the CANTOS trial showed fewer recurrent myocardial infarction, stroke, and cardiovascular death independent of lipid lowering. This validated inflammation (not just LDL) as a treatment target. The directionality is IL-1beta blockade to lower CVD events. A caveat is that the trial also showed increased infection risk and that not all patients benefited, indicating a selected responder population. The results of CANTOS established the inflammatory hypothesis of atherosclerosis and opened the door to targeted immunomodulation for CVD.
description_zh_TW: 卡那奴單抗抑制 IL-1beta 會降低 cardiovascular events，因為 CANTOS 試驗顯示，與降血脂無關的複發性心肌梗塞、中風和心血管死亡較少。這驗證了發炎（不僅僅是低密度脂蛋白）作為治療目標。方向性是IL-1beta封鎖以降低CVD事件。需要注意的是，該試驗還顯示感染風險增加，並且並非所有患者都受益，這表明特定的反應族群。 CANTOS的結果建立了atherosclerosis的發炎假說，為CVD的標靶免疫調節打開了大門。

label: Cardiovascular Risk
description: The L-arginine to ADMA ratio is a biomarker of cardiovascular risk because it reflects the balance between NOS substrate and the endogenous inhibitor ADMA. A low ratio predicts impaired NO bioavailability and endothelial dysfunction. The directionality is substrate-inhibitor balance to vascular risk. A caveat is that the ratio is one of several endothelial markers and is influenced by renal function and inflammation, which regulate ADMA clearance. The ratio has been proposed as a clinically accessible biomarker for monitoring NO-related vascular health in at-risk populations.
description_zh_TW: L-arginine 與 ADMA 的比率是 cardiovascular risk 的生物標記物，因為它反映了 NOS 底物和內源性抑制劑 ADMA 之間的平衡。低比率預示著 NO 生物利用度和 endothelial dysfunction 受損。方向性是血管風險的底物-抑制劑平衡。需要注意的是，該比率是幾種內皮標記物之一，並受到腎功能和發炎的影響，從而調節 ADMA 清除率。該比率已被提議作為臨床上可用的生物標記物，用於監測高風險族群中與一氧化氮相關的血管健康。

label: Heterochromatin Decompaction
description: SADS (senescence-associated distal satellite) is a form of heterochromatin decompaction in senescent cells, specifically the relaxation of constitutive pericentromeric and pericentrosomal satellite heterochromatin. Unlike SAHF (which compacts facultative heterochromatin), SADS decompacts constitutive repeats. This structural change alters the nuclear architecture and chromatin accessibility of repetitive regions. SADS represents a distinct, counterintuitive chromatin reorganization during senescence.
description_zh_TW: SADS（senescence-associated distal satellite，衰老相關遠端衛星）是衰老細胞中異染色質去緻密化的一種形式，具體為組成性著絲粒周與中心體周衛星異染色質的鬆弛。不同於 SAHF（緻密化兼性異染色質），SADS 去緻密化組成性重複序列。此結構改變改變重複區域的核架構與染色質可及性。SADS 代表衰老期間一種獨特、違反直覺的染色質重組。

label: METTL3/METTL14
description: The METTL3-METTL14 m6A methyltransferase complex promotes SASP factor expression by installing N6-methyladenosine marks on mRNA that facilitate enhancer-promoter looping and stabilize SASP transcripts. This epitranscriptomic layer adds post-transcriptional control to the secretome, coordinating the sustained expression of multiple SASP genes. The relationship is mechanistically plausible and supported by knockout studies showing reduced SASP, but the field is newer and less consolidated than the NF-kB/mTOR axes, so confidence is moderate.
description_zh_TW: METTL3-METTL14 m6A 甲基轉移酶複合體透過在 mRNA 上安裝 N6-甲基腺苷標記，促進 SASP 因子表現，該標記促進增強子—啟動子環化並穩定 SASP 轉錄本。此表觀轉錄層次為分泌組添加轉錄後控制，協調多種 SASP 基因的持續表現。此關係在機制上合理且獲剔除研究（顯示 SASP 降低）支持，但此領域較新、較不如 NF-κB/mTOR 軸整合，故信度中等。

label: Secretory Phenotype
description: The SASP is a hypersecretory state -- a specialized secretory phenotype -- in which senescent cells upregulate and release hundreds of factors including interleukins, chemokines, growth factors, proteases, and extracellular vesicles. This secreted output contrasts with the quiescent, low-turnover secretome of non-senescent cells and is a defining non-cell-autonomous feature of the senescent state. The composition of the SASP is variable, shaped by the senescence inducer, cell type, and tissue context. Its classification as a secretory phenotype emphasizes that senescence exerts its effects largely through communication with the microenvironment.
description_zh_TW: SASP 是一種高分泌狀態——一種特化的分泌表型——衰老細胞在此狀態下上調並釋放數百種因子，包括介白素、趨化因子、生長因子、蛋白酶與細胞外囊泡。此分泌輸出與非衰老細胞靜止、低更新的分泌組形成對比，是衰老狀態定義性的非細胞自主性特徵。SASP 的組成是可變的，受衰老誘發因子、細胞類型與組織脈絡塑造。將其歸類為分泌表型，強調衰老主要透過與微環境的溝通發揮作用。

label: SIRT6/KAP1
description: SIRT6-mediated mono-ADP-ribosylation of KAP1 recruits HP1α to package LINE-1 retrotransposons into heterochromatin, silencing their expression. Directionally, SIRT6/KAP1 sits upstream of HP1α tethering. This protects genome stability by containing mobile elements, and it explains how SIRT6 loss derepresses LINE-1. By maintaining heterochromatic silencing of retrotransposons, SIRT6 prevents the insertional mutations and genomic instability caused by active LINE-1 elements. The KAP1-HP1α axis is thus a critical effector of SIRT6's genome-protective function, and its disruption contributes to the instability seen in SIRT6-deficient cells.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 介導的 KAP1 單 ADP-核糖基化招募 HP1α 將 LINE-1 逆轉座子包裝成異染色質，沉默其表達。在方向性上，SIRT6/KAP1 位於 HP1α 拴繫的上游。這透過限制可動元件保護基因組穩定性，並解釋了 SIRT6 缺失如何解除 LINE-1 的抑制。透過維護逆轉座子的異染色質沉默，SIRT6 防止了活性 LINE-1 元件引起的插入突變和基因組不穩定性。KAP1-HP1α 軸線因此是 SIRT6 基因組保護功能的關鍵效應器，其破壞導致 SIRT6 缺陷細胞中所見的不穩定性。

label: CD9
description: CD9 is a tetraspanin surface marker used to define senescent and immune cell populations. It helps identify senescent cells and is discussed as a surface marker for ligand-conjugated nanoparticle delivery targeting senescent cells within the SASP context.
description_zh_TW: CD9 是 tetraspanin 表面標記，用於定義衰老與免疫細胞族群。它有助於辨識衰老細胞，並被討論作為在 SASP 脈絡下針對衰老細胞之配體共軛奈米顆粒遞送的表面標記。

label: VDAC1
description: VDAC1 oligomerization mediates mtDNA release upstream of cGAS-STING and SASP induction (Li 2024). This positions the outer-membrane channel as a SASP-licensing pore.
description_zh_TW: VDAC1 寡聚化在 cGAS-STING 與 SASP 誘發上游介導 mtDNA 釋放（Li 2024）。此將外膜通道定位為 SASP 許可孔。

label: mtDNA ribonucleotide misincorporation
description: Senescent cells show an elevated rNTP/dNTP ratio with continued mtDNA replication, causing ribonucleotide misincorporation into mtDNA that promotes its cytosolic release and SASP; exogenous deoxyribonucleoside supplementation lowers this release and suppresses inflammatory SASP without affecting SA-beta-gal arrest.
description_zh_TW: 衰老細胞呈現升高的 rNTP/dNTP 比值且 mtDNA 持續複製，導致核糖核苷酸錯誤摻入 mtDNA，促進其胞質釋放與 SASP；補充外源去氧核糖核苷可降低釋放並抑制發炎性 SASP，且不影響 SA-beta-gal 停滯。

label: Charcoal Binding Assay
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: The charcoal binding assay measures sirtuin activity by quantifying 3H-labeled OAADPr released as free acetate: incubation of recombinant sirtuins with a 3H-acetylated peptide and NAD+ produces 3H-OAADPr, which binds activated charcoal, but the 3H-acetate hydrolyzed from OAADPr remains in the supernatant and is counted. This method was used to screen nicotinamide analogs and NAD+ metabolites as inhibitors of SIRT2. Directionally, the assay traces sirtuin catalytic flux through its unique OAADPr by-product rather than through fluorophore release, giving an artifact-free alternative to fluorescent assays.
description_zh_TW: 活性炭結合測定透過量化釋放為游離乙酸的 3H 標記 OAADPr 來測量 sirtuin 活性：將重組 sirtuin 與 3H-乙醯化胜肽和 NAD+ 孵育產生 3H-OAADPr，其與活化活性炭結合，而從 OAADPr 水解的 3H-乙酸留在上清液中並被計數。此方法被用於篩選尼可醯胺類似物和 NAD+ 代謝物作為 SIRT2 的抑制劑。方向性上該測定透過其獨特的 OAADPr 副產物而非螢光基團釋放來追溯 sirtuin 催化通量，提供了無假象的螢光測定替代方案。

label: Chromatin modifiers (SIRT1, SIRT6, HDAC1, PARP1)
source_file: _document_ - relocalization of sirtuins - chromatin modifiers, grok.md
description: Chromatin modifiers including sirtuins like SIRT1 and SIRT6, as well as HDAC1 and PARP1, normally sit at specific genomic loci to maintain proper gene expression patterns that define cell identity. When DNA damage, especially double-strand breaks, occurs, these proteins are recruited to damage sites to assist in repair. This temporarily disrupts their original positions, altering local gene expression, and repeated relocalization over a lifetime contributes to the progressive loss of epigenetic information.
description_zh_TW: 包括 SIRT1 和 SIRT6 等 sirtuins 在內的染色質修飾因子，以及 HDAC1 和 PARP1，通常位於特定的基因組位點以維持定義細胞身分的正確基因表達模式。當 DNA 損傷（特別是雙股斷裂）發生時，這些蛋白質被招募到損傷位點以協助修復。這暫時破壞了它們的原始位置，改變局部基因表達，而在一生中反覆的再定位則導致表觀遺傳資訊的漸進性喪失。

label: cisplatin nephrotoxicity
description: Silybin is the principal flavonolignan of milk thistle. It attenuates cisplatin-induced nephrotoxicity by preserving renal tubular integrity and mitochondrial bioenergetics, likely via SIRT3-mediated mechanisms, placing it among natural compounds engaging the mitochondrial deacetylase axis in kidney injury.
description_zh_TW: Silybin 是水飛薊的主要黃酮木脂素。它透過維護腎小管完整性和粒線體生物能學，可能透過 SIRT3 介導的機制，減輕 Cisplatin 誘導的腎毒性，將其定位為在腎損傷中參與粒線體去乙醯酶軸線的天然化合物之一。

label: clear cell renal cell carcinoma tumorigenesis
community_name: clear cell renal cell carcinoma tumorigenesis
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT5-mediated desuccinylation of succinate dehydrogenase A (SDHA) promotes clear cell renal cell carcinoma tumorigenesis. Directionally, SIRT5 desuccinylation of SDHA sits upstream of increased growth of clear cell renal cell carcinoma tumours. By activating SDHA and thereby modulating the TCA cycle, SIRT5 supports the metabolic reprogramming that drives this kidney cancer, identifying SIRT5 as a potential target in ccRCC.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5介導的琥珀酸脫氫酶A（SDHA）去琥珀醯化促進透明細胞腎細胞癌的腫瘤發生。方向上，SIRT5對SDHA的去琥珀醯化位於透明細胞腎細胞癌腫瘤生長增加的上游。透過活化SDHA從而調節TCA循環，SIRT5支持驅動此腎癌的代謝重編程，將SIRT5確定為ccRCC中的潛在靶點。

label: Cochlea
description: The cochlea is the auditory organ where cumulative oxidative damage drives age-related hearing loss. Caloric restriction reduces oxidative damage in cochlear cells, but this protection is abolished in SIRT3-deficient mice, making SIRT3 indispensable for CR-induced auditory resilience and a candidate therapeutic target in AHL.
description_zh_TW: 耳蝸是聽覺器官，累積的氧化損傷驅動年齡相關性聽力損失。熱量限制減少耳蝸細胞中的氧化損傷，但此保護在 SIRT3 缺陷小鼠中被消除，使 SIRT3 成為 CR 誘導聽覺韌性不可或缺的因子和 AHL 的候選治療靶標。

label: COMT activity in humans
source_file: _document_ - COMT How to Optimize Your Supplements for Your COMT Genotype.md
description: EGCG supplementation at doses up to 750 mg does not impair COMT activity in humans in controlled studies, indicating that realistic supplemental levels do not meaningfully inhibit the enzyme. This reassures that moderate EGCG intake is safe with respect to catecholamine metabolism and COMT function. Higher experimental doses, however, can inhibit COMT, so the conclusion is dose-dependent. Slow COMT individuals in particular benefit from knowing that typical EGCG supplements are unlikely to perturb catechol clearance.
description_zh_TW: 在對照研究中，EGCG supplementation 劑量高達 750 mg 時不會損害 COMT activity in humans，這表明實際的補充水平不會有意義地抑制該酶。這確保了適量的 EGCG 攝取對於兒茶酚胺代謝和 COMT 功能是安全的。然而，較高的實驗劑量可以抑制 COMT，因此結論是劑量依賴性的。慢速 COMT 個體特別受益於了解典型的 EGCG 補充劑不太可能幹擾兒茶酚清除。

label: COVID-19 lymphocyte homeostasis
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: The unbalanced p53/SIRT1 axis may impact lymphocyte homeostasis in COVID-19 patients. COVID-19 is characterized by increased p53 transcription in circulating lymphocytes and a persistently activated form of p53, possibly due to low SIRT1 levels. Directionally, low SIRT1 and elevated p53 activity sit upstream of disturbed lymphocyte homeostasis. Because SIRT1 normally deacetylates p53 and restrains its pro-apoptotic activity, its deficiency could leave lymphocytes vulnerable to p53-driven apoptosis and contribute to the lymphopenia seen in severe disease. Increased SIRT1 expression might therefore help alleviate COVID-19 pathogenesis by restoring the balance of this axis.
description_zh_TW: 失衡的p53/SIRT1軸可能影響COVID-19患者的淋巴細胞恆定。COVID-19的特徵是循環淋巴細胞中p53轉錄增加和p53持續活化形式，可能源於低SIRT1水平。方向上，低SIRT1和升高的p53活性位於淋巴細胞恆定受擾的上游。因為SIRT1通常去乙醯化p53並抑制其促凋亡活性，其缺乏可能使淋巴細胞容易受到p53驅動的凋亡，並促成重症中可見的淋巴細胞減少症。因此增加SIRT1表達可能透過恢復此軸的平衡來幫助緩解COVID-19的發病機制。

label: DAF-16
description: The lifespan extension produced by sir-2.1 overexpression in C. elegans is strictly dependent on the forkhead transcription factor DAF-16, the worm FOXO ortholog. DAF-16 is the downstream effector that induces stress-resistance and xenobiotic-detoxification genes once sir-2.1 releases it from repression. Mechanistically, sir-2.1 deacetylates and cooperates with DAF-16 to drive the longevity transcriptional program. Thus the directionality is sir-2.1 → DAF-16 → lifespan, and removing DAF-16 abolishes the benefit.
description_zh_TW: sir-2.1 過量表達在 C. elegans 中產生的壽命延長嚴格依賴於叉頭轉錄因子 DAF-16，即線蟲的 FOXO 直系同源物。DAF-16 是下游效應因子，一旦 sir-2.1 將其從抑制中釋放，它便誘導壓力抗性和外源物質解毒基因。在機制上，sir-2.1 去乙醯化並與 DAF-16 協同驅動長壽轉錄程序。因此方向性為 sir-2.1 → DAF-16 → 壽命，去除 DAF-16 則消除此益處。

label: Deptor
description: Deptor is an endogenous inhibitor that binds both mTORC1 and mTORC2, suppressing the catalytic activity of each complex. By dampening both arms of mTOR signaling, Deptor broadly restrains anabolic growth, survival, and autophagy suppression. Its expression is itself feedback-regulated by mTORC1/mTORC2 activity, forming part of a homeostatic loop. Reduced Deptor levels in certain cancers correlate with hyperactive mTOR signaling, highlighting its tumor-suppressive potential.
description_zh_TW: Deptor 是一種內生抑制劑，結合 mTORC1 和 mTORC2 兩者，抑制各複合物的催化活性。透過阻尼 mTOR 信號的兩條臂，Deptor 廣泛地約束合成代謝生長、存活和自噬抑制。其表現本身受 mTORC1/mTORC2 活性回饋調節，構成恆定性迴圈的一部分。某些癌症中 Deptor 水平降低與過度活化的 mTOR 信號相關，凸顯了其腫瘤抑制潛力。

label: Dimethyl fumarate
description: Dimethyl fumarate (Tecfidera) activates the NRF2 pathway in MS therapy by modifying KEAP1 cysteines, inducing HO-1, NQO1, and GPx to bolster antioxidant defense in glia and neurons. This is a registered disease-modifying treatment for relapsing MS. The directionality is fumarate to NRF2-dependent cytoprotection. A caveat is that dimethyl fumarate also shifts lymphocyte subsets and can cause flushing and GI effects, so NRF2 activation is one of several mechanisms. Clinical trials show reduced relapses and disability progression, though the precise contribution of NRF2 versus other fumarate actions remains debated.
description_zh_TW: Dimethyl fumarate (Tecfidera) 透過修飾 KEAP1 半胱氨酸活化 NRF2 pathway in MS therapy，誘導 HO-1、NQO1 和 GPx，以增強神經膠質和神經元的抗氧化防禦。這是一種針對復發性多發性硬化症的註冊疾病緩解治療方法。方向性為富馬酸鹽至 NRF2 依賴性細胞保護。需要注意的是，富馬酸二甲酯也會改變淋巴細胞亞群，並可能引起潮紅和胃腸道效應，因此 NRF2 活化是多種機制之一。臨床試驗顯示，儘管 NRF2 與其他富馬酸鹽藥物相比，其確切貢獻仍有爭議，但復發和殘疾進展有所減少。

label: TFEB at S122/S109/S114
source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md
description: Protein phosphatase 2A (PP2A) dephosphorylates TFEB at serines 122, 109, and 114, removing repressive mTORC1 and other kinase marks to permit TFEB nuclear translocation. By counteracting the multiple N-terminal phosphorylations that enforce cytosolic retention, PP2A acts as a key permissive switch for TFEB activation. Its activity is regulated by nutrient state and by regulatory subunits that target it to TFEB. Through this dephosphorylation, PP2A enables the rapid engagement of lysosomal biogenesis when mTORC1 is inhibited.
description_zh_TW: 蛋白磷酸酶 2A（PP2A）在 serine 122、109 和 114 去磷酸化 TFEB，移除抑制性的 mTORC1 及其他激酶標記，以許可 TFEB 核轉運。透過對抗強制細胞質保留的多重 N 端磷酸化，PP2A 充當 TFEB 活化的關鍵許可開關。其活性受營養狀態以及將其標靶至 TFEB 的調節次單元所控制。透過此去磷酸化，PP2A 使得在 mTORC1 受抑制時能快速啟動溶酶體生物發生。

label: SIRT2 disruption
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: Disruption of SIRT2 in the mouse raises the levels of the mitotic regulators Aurora-A and Aurora-B, leading to aneuploidy and mitotic cell death. Because SIRT2 is a tubulin deacetylase and a guardian of mitotic fidelity, its loss impairs the control that normally keeps Aurora kinase abundance in check during division. The directionality is that SIRT2 sits upstream: reduced SIRT2 permits Aurora kinase accumulation, which then destabilizes mitosis. This pathway connects sirtuin biology to chromosome segregation and genomic instability in tumorigenesis.
description_zh_TW: 在小鼠中破壞 SIRT2 會提高有絲分裂調節因子 Aurora-A 和 Aurora-B 的水平，導致非整倍體和有絲分裂細胞死亡。由於 SIRT2 是微管蛋白去乙醯酶且是有絲分裂精準度的守護者，其缺失損害了正常情況下在細胞分裂期間控制 Aurora 激酶豐度的機制。方向性上 SIRT2 位於上游：SIRT2 減少允許 Aurora 激酶累積，進而使有絲分裂不穩定。此途徑將 sirtuin 生物學與染色體分離和基因組不穩定性在腫瘤發生中的作用聯繫起來。

label: HIC1 transcription
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: p53 directly activates transcription of HIC1, a tumor suppressor that in turn represses the SIRT1 promoter, forming a negative feedback loop that restrains SIRT1 abundance. This loop ensures that p53 activity is not indefinitely suppressed by SIRT1-mediated deacetylation, because sustained p53 signaling drives HIC1 to limit SIRT1 expression. Directionally, p53 is the transcription factor and HIC1 the induced target gene, with SIRT1 sitting downstream of both. The biological significance is genome protection: by inducing HIC1, p53 prevents SIRT1 from over-deacetylating and silencing p53 itself, preserving the capacity for apoptosis and senescence in response to damage.
description_zh_TW: p53 直接活化 HIC1 的轉錄，HIC1 是一種腫瘤抑制因子，反過來抑制 SIRT1 啟動子，形成一個負回饋迴路以限制 SIRT1 的表達量。這個迴路確保 p53 活性不會被 SIRT1 介導的去乙醯化無限期抑制，因為持續的 p53 信號驅動 HIC1 來限制 SIRT1 表達。在方向性上，p53 是轉錄因子，HIC1 是被誘導的靶基因，而 SIRT1 位於兩者的下游。其生物學意義在於基因組保護：通過誘導 HIC1，p53 防止 SIRT1 過度去乙醯化和沉默 p53 本身，維持對損傷的凋亡和衰老反應能力。

label: Neuroendocrine
description: Small-cell lung cancer is classified as a high-grade neuroendocrine carcinoma expressing neuroendocrine markers including Synaptophysin, Chromogranin A, and CD56. These markers are used in SCLC diagnosis. The neuroendocrine phenotype defines SCLC biology.
description_zh_TW: Small-cell lung cancer 被歸類為高惡性度神經內分泌癌，表現包括 Synaptophysin、Chromogranin A 和 CD56 在內的神經內分泌標記。這些標記用於 SCLC 診斷。神經內分泌表型定義了 SCLC 的生物學。

label: BCG
description: Bladder Cancer is treated with BCG. BCG (Bacillus Calmette–Guérin) is a live attenuated mycobacterium delivered as intravesical immunotherapy for non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer, reducing recurrence and progression; it activates immune-mediated cytotoxicity against urothelial tumor cells.
description_zh_TW: 膀胱癌（Bladder Cancer）以 BCG 治療。BCG（卡介苗）是一種活的減毒分枝桿菌，以膀胱內灌注免疫療法用於非肌肉侵犯性膀胱癌，可降低復發與進展；它會啟動針對尿路上皮腫瘤細胞的免疫介導細胞毒性。

label: cervical cancer
description: Cisplatin is the standard chemotherapy backbone for cervical cancer.
description_zh_TW: Cisplatin 是子宮頸癌標準化療主幹。

label: Decoy Receptor
description: B18R is a soluble interferon-sequestering decoy receptor.
description_zh_TW: B18R 是可溶性干擾素隔離誘餌受體。

label: Vaccinia Virus
description: B18R is a vaccinia-encoded virulence factor secreted during infection.
description_zh_TW: B18R 是感染期間分泌的痘苗病毒編碼毒力因子。

label: drug response
description: SNPs can predict individual drug response by altering the structure or expression of drug-metabolizing enzymes, transporters, or drug targets, as exemplified by COMT Val158Met predicting aspirin and modafinil responses. Pharmacogenetic testing leverages such variants to personalize dosing and choice of therapy, improving efficacy and reducing adverse effects. The predictive power varies with the size and direction of each variant's effect and with gene-environment interactions. This approach is central to precision medicine.
description_zh_TW: SNPs 可以透過改變藥物代謝酶、轉運蛋白或藥物標靶的結構或表現來預測個別 drug response，例如 COMT Val158Met 預測阿斯匹靈和莫達非尼反應。藥物基因學測試利用這些變異來個人化劑量和治療選擇，提高療效並減少不良反應。預測能力隨每個變異效應的大小和方向以及基因-環境交互作用而變化。這種方法是精準醫學的核心。

label: Endothelial nitric oxide bioavailability
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: SIRT3 plays a pivotal role in maintaining endothelial cell function by preserving mitochondrial integrity via the SIRT3/ATG5 axis, thereby reducing ROS levels and sustaining nitric oxide bioavailability. Directionally, the axis sits upstream of maintained endothelial NO signaling. Conversely, absence of SIRT3 in EC-specific knockout models leads to exaggerated NLRP3 inflammasome activation and endothelial dysfunction, fostering a pro-inflammatory, pro-atherogenic phenotype.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 透過 SIRT3/ATG5 軸保持粒線體完整性，從而降低 ROS 水平並維持一氧化氮生物利用度，從而在維持內皮細胞功能中發揮關鍵作用。從方向上看，該軸位於維持的內皮 NO 訊號傳導的上游。相反，EC特異性敲除模型中SIRT3的缺失會導致NLRP3發炎小體過度活化和內皮功能障礙，進而形成促發炎、促動脈粥狀硬化的表型。

label: SIRT3/ATG5 axis
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: SIRT3 plays a pivotal role in maintaining endothelial cell function by preserving mitochondrial integrity via the SIRT3/ATG5 axis, thereby reducing ROS levels and sustaining nitric oxide bioavailability. Directionally, the axis sits upstream of maintained endothelial NO signaling. Conversely, absence of SIRT3 in EC-specific knockout models leads to exaggerated NLRP3 inflammasome activation and endothelial dysfunction, fostering a pro-inflammatory, pro-atherogenic phenotype.

label: Energy homeostasis and autophagy
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT1 and AMPK form a reciprocal regulatory loop in which each can activate the other, jointly promoting energy homeostasis and autophagic flux. Directionally, the interaction is bidirectional: SIRT1 deacetylates and activates LKB1 and PGC-1α while AMPK phosphorylates and activates SIRT1. This creates a self-reinforcing metabolic circuit, and it is a central node integrating nutrient sensing and clearance. By activating each other, SIRT1 and AMPK amplify catabolic and protective programs, including mitochondrial biogenesis and autophagy. This loop is a key target for interventions that aim to restore metabolic health in aging.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 和 AMPK 形成雙向調控迴路，兩者可以互相活化，共同促進能量恆定性和自噬通量。在方向性上，此相互作用是雙向的：SIRT1 去乙醯化並活化 LKB1 和 PGC-1α，而 AMPK 磷酸化並活化 SIRT1。這創造了一個自強化的代謝迴路，是整合營養感知和清除的核心節點。透過互相活化，SIRT1 和 AMPK 放大分解代謝和保護程式，包括粒線體生物合成和自噬。此迴路是旨在恢復衰老代謝健康的干預措施的關鍵靶標。

label: Enzyme-coupled nicotinamide assay
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: The enzyme-coupled assay for nicotinamide detection measures sirtuin activity continuously by coupling nicotinamidase (which hydrolyzes nicotinamide to nicotinic acid and ammonia) to glutamate dehydrogenase, which converts ammonia, alpha-ketoglutarate, and NAD(P)H to glutamate and NAD(P)+, quantified spectrophotometrically at 340 nm. It was developed in 2009 and, while not used yet on the scale of large screenings, could be adapted to a high-throughput format. Directionally, a continuous enzyme-coupled readout avoids the artifacts associated with fluorescent and end-point assays.
description_zh_TW: 用於尼可醯胺偵測的酵素偶聯測定透過將尼可醯胺酶（水解尼可醯胺為尼可酸和氨）與穀氨酸脫氫酶偶聯來連續測量 sirtuin 活性，後者將氨、α-酮戊二酸和 NAD(P)H 轉化為穀氨酸和 NAD(P)+，在 340 nm 處進行分光光度法定量。它於 2009 年開發，儘管尚未大規模應用於大型篩選，但可以改編為高通量格式。方向性上連續的酵素偶聯讀取避免了與螢光和終點測定相關的假象。

label: ETS1
description: SIRT3 decreases H3K27 crotonylation at the ETS1 promoter, constraining neoplastic dissemination. The lncRNA LINC00922 decoys SIRT3 from the ETS1 promoter, upregulating H3K27 crotonylation and driving colorectal cancer metastasis (Liao et al., Mol Cancer 2023).
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 降低 ETS1 啟動子處的 H3K27 巴豆醯基化，限制腫瘤擴散。lncRNA LINC00922 將 SIRT3 誘離 ETS1 啟動子，上調 H3K27 巴豆醯基化並驅動大腸癌轉移（Liao et al., Mol Cancer 2023）。

label: SIRT3 via H3K27 crotonylation
description: SIRT3 decreases H3K27 crotonylation at the ETS1 promoter, constraining neoplastic dissemination. The lncRNA LINC00922 decoys SIRT3 from the ETS1 promoter, upregulating H3K27 crotonylation and driving colorectal cancer metastasis (Liao et al., Mol Cancer 2023).

label: Extensive myocardial fibrosis and cardiomyopathy
description: SIRT7-deficient mice show extensive myocardial fibrosis, high basal apoptosis, and cardiomyopathy, reflecting SIRT7's role in maintaining cardiac homeostasis. Directionally, SIRT7 loss leads to fibrotic cardiomyopathy. This contrasts with contexts where SIRT7 promotes fibrosis under stress, indicating that SIRT7 is overall required for myocardial integrity. The phenotype likely reflects SIRT7's contributions to ribosome biogenesis, mitochondrial function, and transcriptional regulation in cardiomyocytes, and it is consistent with SIRT7's deacetylation of GATA4 in stress-induced hypertrophy. SIRT7 thus has both protective and pathological cardiac roles depending on context.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 缺陷小鼠顯示廣泛的心肌纖維化、高基礎凋亡率和心肌病變，反映了 SIRT7 在維護心臟恆定性中的角色。在方向性上，SIRT7 的缺失導致纖維化性心肌病變。這與 SIRT7 在壓力下促進纖維化的情況形成對比，表明 SIRT7 整體上是心肌完整性所必需的。此表型可能反映了 SIRT7 對核糖體生物合成、粒線體功能和心肌細胞轉錄調控的貢獻，並與 SIRT7 在壓力誘導肥大中對 GATA4 的去乙醯化一致。因此，SIRT7 根據情境具有保護性和病理性心臟角色。

label: FGF21 signaling
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: Restoring SIRT3 expression via lifestyle interventions or fibroblast growth factor-21 (FGF21) signaling improves mitochondrial integrity and myocardial function in diabetes. Directionally, FGF21 sits upstream of recovered SIRT3-dependent mitochondrial quality control. This points to metabolic reprogramming as a promising avenue for diabetic patients, coupling endocrine FGF21 biology to the mitochondrial deacetylase axis.
description_zh_TW: 透過生活方式介入或纖維母細胞生長因子 21 (FGF21) 訊號恢復 SIRT3 表現可改善糖尿病患者的粒線體完整性和心肌功能。從方向上看，FGF21 位於恢復的 SIRT3 依賴性粒線體品質控制的上游。這表明代謝重編程對於糖尿病患者來說是一條有前途的途徑，將內分泌 FGF21 生物學與粒線體去乙醯化酶軸結合起來。

label: Fisetin Bioavailability
source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md
description: Nano-sized formulations of fisetin, including polymeric nanoparticles, lipid nanoparticles, nanoemulsions, and nanocrystals, have been developed to overcome its poor solubility and low oral bioavailability. These systems increase fisetin's dissolution rate, protect it from degradation and first-pass conjugation, and can enable sustained release and improved tissue targeting, including brain delivery. Studies summarized in the review report several-fold increases in fisetin peak plasma concentration and area under the curve for nanoformulations compared with free fisetin suspension, and enhanced efficacy in tumor and neuroprotection models, although clinical data remain limited.
description_zh_TW: 非瑟酮的奈米製劑，包括聚合物奈米粒子、脂質奈米粒子、奈米乳液和奈米晶體，已被開發以克服其溶解度差和口服生物利用度低的問題。這些系統提高非瑟酮的溶解速率，保護其免受降解和首過結合，並可實現持續釋放和改善組織靶向，包括腦部遞送。綜述中總結的研究報告顯示，與游離非瑟酮懸浮液相比，奈米製劑的非瑟酮峰濃度和曲線下麵積增加數倍，並在腫瘤和神經保護模型中增強療效，但臨床數據仍然有限。
