Directionally, grape content sits upstream of limited resveratrol exposure. Skin concentration explains why wine, not flesh, carries most of the compound, and it reinforces that supplementation, rather than diet alone, reaches high doses. Even so, grape-derived resveratrol contributes to the polyphenol intake associated with Mediterranean-style diets. Understanding the natural abundance of resveratrol is important for interpreting both dietary and supplement-based research.
description_zh_TW: 生紅葡萄每 100 克含有約 0.15-1.3 mg resveratrol，主要在果皮中，使得從水果攝入的飲食量有限。在方向性上，葡萄含量位於 resveratrol 暴露量有限的上游。果皮中的濃度解釋了為何葡萄酒而非果肉攜帶大部分化合物，並強化了需要補充劑而非僅靠飲食才能達到高劑量的觀點。即便如此，葡萄來源的 resveratrol 對地中海飲食相關的多酚攝入量有所貢獻。理解 resveratrol 的天然豐度對於詮釋飲食和補充劑研究都很重要。

label: calorie restriction in lower organisms
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Resveratrol (3, 5, 4'-trihydroxystilbene) is a natural plant polyphenol found in grapes and red wines. In lower organisms, resveratrol replicates the effects of calorie restriction, and mice fed a high-fat diet have lower insulin resistance. STACs interact directly with SIRT1 and other isoforms, and resveratrol remains the most prominent natural sirtuin activator with longevity-relevant effects.
description_zh_TW: 白藜蘆醇（3,5,4'-三羥基芪）是一種天然植物多酚，存在於葡萄和紅酒中。在低等生物中，白藜蘆醇能夠複製熱量限制的效果；餵食高脂飲食的小鼠在白藜蘆醇作用下胰島素抵抗降低。STACs 直接與 SIRT1 及其他亞型相互作用，而白藜蘆醇仍然是最具代表性的天然 sirtuin 活化劑，具有與壽命相關的效應。

label: Dual mechanism (direct + indirect)
description: Resveratrol activates SIRT1 through both direct allosteric binding at the N-terminal domain (Glu230) and an indirect cascade via PDE4/cAMP/Epac1/Ca2+/CaMKKβ/AMPK/NAMPT/NAD+. Directionally, resveratrol sits upstream of dual SIRT1 activation. The indirect limb raises NAD+ to fuel SIRT1, amplifying the direct effect, and this dual mechanism explains resveratrol's robust pleiotropic metabolic benefits. Because the two arms are complementary, blocking either reduces but does not eliminate SIRT1 activation. This layered regulation is a defining feature of resveratrol as a sirtuin-activating compound.
description_zh_TW: Resveratrol 透過 N 端域（Glu230）的直接變構結合和透過 PDE4/cAMP/Epac1/Ca2+/CaMKKβ/AMPK/NAMPT/NAD+ 的間接級聯兩種機制活化 SIRT1。在方向性上，resveratrol 位於雙重 SIRT1 活化的上游。間接臂提高 NAD+ 以供 SIRT1 使用，放大直接效應，這種雙重機制解釋了 resveratrol 強大的多效性代謝益處。由於兩條臂是互補的，阻斷任何一條都會減少但不會消除 SIRT1 活化。這種分層調控是 resveratrol 作為 sirtuin 活化化合物的定義特徵。

label: PDE4
description: Resveratrol competitively inhibits cAMP phosphodiesterase 4 (PDE4), the enzyme that degrades cAMP to AMP, thereby slowing cAMP clearance. Directionally, resveratrol sits upstream of PDE4 inhibition. This indirect action raises intracellular cAMP, which then engages the Epac1/Ca2+/CaMKKβ/AMPK/NAMPT cascade that further activates SIRT1 through NAD+ elevation. It is one arm of resveratrol's dual (direct plus indirect) SIRT1-activation mechanism, alongside allosteric binding to the SIRT1 N-terminal domain, and it explains how resveratrol can activate SIRT1 even when direct binding is weak.
description_zh_TW: 白藜蘆醇競爭性抑制 cAMP 磷酸二酯酶 4（PDE4），即降解 cAMP 為 AMP 的酶，從而減緩 cAMP 的清除。在方向性上，白藜蘆醇位於 PDE4 抑制的上游。這種間接作用提高細胞內 cAMP，然後啟動 Epac1/Ca2+/CaMKKβ/AMPK/NAMPT 級聯反應，通過 NAD+ 升高進一步活化 SIRT1。這是白藜蘆醇雙重（直接加間接）SIRT1 活化機制的一個臂，與對 SIRT1 N 端結構域的變構結合並列，並解釋了白藜蘆醇即使在直接結合較弱時也能活化 SIRT1。

label: Anti-viral effects
description: Resveratrol demonstrates antiviral effects in some experimental systems, though the evidence base is moderate and mechanism-dependent. Directionally, resveratrol sits upstream of viral inhibition in those models. Potential mechanisms include modulation of host stress and inflammatory pathways, inhibition of viral replication enzymes, and effects on cellular signaling that restrict viral spread. Clinical relevance remains preliminary, and the poor bioavailability of resveratrol limits translation. Nonetheless, the antiviral observations contribute to the compound's broad bioactivity profile and warrant further investigation of its role in host defense against specific viruses.
description_zh_TW: Resveratrol 在某些實驗系統中展現抗病毒效應，但證據基礎為中等且取決於機制。在方向性上，resveratrol 在這些模型中位於抑制病毒的上游。潛在機制包括調節宿主壓力和發炎途徑、抑制病毒複製酶以及影響限制病毒傳播的細胞訊號。臨床相關性仍處於初步階段，且 resveratrol 的低生物利用度限制了轉化。儘管如此，抗病毒觀察結果促進了該化合物廣泛的生物活性特徵，值得進一步研究其在宿主對抗特定病毒防禦中的作用。

label: Coronary relaxation
description: Resveratrol enhances coronary relaxation, reduces ventricular arrhythmias, and inhibits platelet aggregation and smooth-muscle proliferation, collectively protecting the heart. Directionally, resveratrol sits upstream of improved coronary function. These integrated effects support myocardial perfusion under stress and reduce the risk of ischemic events and arrhythmogenesis. They reinforce resveratrol's cardioprotective profile, which is largely attributed to SIRT1, eNOS, and AMPK activation. The combination of improved vasodilation, reduced thrombotic tendency, and restrained vascular remodeling makes resveratrol a multifaceted cardiovascular agent in preclinical models.
description_zh_TW: Resveratrol 增強冠狀血管舒張、減少心室心律不整並抑制血小板聚集和平滑肌增生，從而整體保護心臟。在方向性上，resveratrol 位於改善冠狀血管功能的上游。這些整合效應在壓力下支持心肌灌注，並降低缺血事件和心律失常發生的風險。它們強化了 resveratrol 的心臟保護特徵，這主要歸因於 SIRT1、eNOS 和 AMPK 的活化。改善血管舒張、降低血栓傾向和抑制血管重塑的組合使 resveratrol 成為臨床前模型中的多面向心血管活性物質。

label: leukemia, DMBA-induced mammary tumors, skin cancer, prostate cancer
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: Resveratrol exhibits chemopreventive activity against leukemia, DMBA-induced mammary tumors, skin cancer, and other malignancies, in part through SIRT1-dependent and -independent pathways (reviewed in the sirtuin literature; Baur 2006 PMID 17086191).
description_zh_TW: 白藜蘆醇對白血病、DMBA 誘導的乳腺腫瘤、皮膚癌和其他惡性腫瘤表現出化學預防活性，部分透過 SIRT1 依賴性和非依賴性通路（參見 sirtuin 文獻綜述；Baur 2006 PMID 17086191）。

label: ~8–14 minutes
description: Resveratrol has a very short plasma half-life of roughly 8-14 minutes because of rapid conjugation and clearance. Directionally, rapid metabolism sits upstream of low systemic exposure. This severely limits the duration of any SIRT1 activation after a single dose, and it is the central pharmacological obstacle to translating resveratrol's preclinical benefits to humans. Sustained-release formulations, metabolic inhibitors such as quercetin, and delivery within the red-wine matrix are strategies to improve exposure. Understanding the half-life is essential for interpreting both negative clinical trials and claims about resveratrol's efficacy.
description_zh_TW: Resveratrol 的血漿半衰期非常短，約 8-14 分鐘，因為快速的結合和清除。在方向性上，快速代謝位於低系統暴露量的上游。這嚴重限制了單次劑量後 SIRT1 活化的持續時間，是將 resveratrol 臨床前益處轉化到人體的核心藥理學障礙。緩釋製劑、槲皮素等代謝抑制劑以及在紅酒基質中的遞送是改善暴露量的策略。理解半衰期對於詮釋陰性臨床試驗和關於 resveratrol 療效的主張至關重要。

label: Smooth muscle cell proliferation
description: Resveratrol inhibits vascular smooth-muscle cell proliferation, limiting neointimal hyperplasia and atherosclerotic plaque growth. Directionally, resveratrol sits upstream of suppressed VSMC expansion. This restrains the remodeling that narrows vessels after injury, and it complements resveratrol's anti-platelet and vasodilatory effects. The anti-proliferative action likely involves SIRT1, AMPK, and cell-cycle regulation in smooth-muscle cells, and it is relevant to restenosis and the progression of atherosclerosis. By controlling VSMC growth and migration, resveratrol contributes to preserving vascular lumen patency.
description_zh_TW: Resveratrol 抑制血管平滑肌細胞增殖，限制新生內膜增生和動脈粥樣硬化斑塊生長。在方向性上，resveratrol 位於抑制 VSMC 擴增的上游。這限制了損傷後血管縮窄的重塑過程，並與 resveratrol 的抗血小板和血管舒張效應互補。抗增殖作用可能涉及 SIRT1、AMPK 和平滑肌細胞中的細胞週期調控，與再狹窄和動脈粥樣硬化進展相關。透過控制 VSMC 的生長和遷移，resveratrol 有助於維護血管腔的通暢性。

label: Direct antioxidant (weaker than vitamin C)
description: Resveratrol is a relatively poor direct antioxidant, weaker than vitamin C or cysteine at scavenging free radicals in vitro. Directionally, its redox-scavenging capacity is minor. Its biological benefits therefore arise mainly from signaling modulation—activation of SIRT1, AMPK, and eNOS, and inhibition of PDE4—rather than from stoichiometric antioxidant action. This corrects the simplistic antioxidant framing of resveratrol and explains why its effects can persist well after the compound has been metabolized. Understanding resveratrol as a hormetic signaling molecule rather than a direct antioxidant is central to interpreting its pharmacology.
description_zh_TW: Resveratrol 是相對較弱的直接抗氧化劑，在體外清除自由基的能力弱於維生素 C 或半胱氨酸。在方向性上，其氧化還原清除能力較次要。因此其生物學益處主要來自訊號調制——活化 SIRT1、AMPK 和 eNOS，以及抑制 PDE4——而非化學計量的抗氧化作用。這修正了對 resveratrol 簡單化的抗氧化框架，並解釋了為何其效應在化合物被代謝後仍能持續存在。將 resveratrol 理解為激效性訊號分子而非直接抗氧化劑，是詮釋其藥理學的關鍵。

label: Grape skin
description: Resveratrol is found concentrated in grape skins, where it contributes to the anti-atherosclerotic benefits attributed to red wine consumption. Directionally, dietary resveratrol sits upstream of vascular protection. Skin content is modest and matrix-dependent, influencing how much reaches circulation, and typical red wine contains 1.5-3 mg/L, so a single glass provides only about 0.3 mg. This botanical source motivated the French-paradox hypothesis, and the presence of resveratrol in the skin rather than the flesh explains why wine, not grape juice, carries most of the compound.
description_zh_TW: Resveratrol 在葡萄皮中濃度較高，有助於歸因於飲用紅酒的抗動脈粥樣硬化益處。在方向性上，飲食中的 resveratrol 位於血管保護的上游。皮中的含量有限且受基質影響，影響其進入循環的量，典型紅酒含有 1.5-3 mg/L，因此一杯酒僅提供約 0.3 mg。這種植物來源催生了法國悖論假說，而 resveratrol 存在於果皮而非果肉中，解釋了為何葡萄酒而非葡萄汁攜帶大部分此化合物。

label: Polyphenol stilbene (3,4',5-trihydroxystilbene)
description: Resveratrol is the polyphenolic stilbene 3,4',5-trihydroxystilbene, a plant defensive compound produced under stress such as pathogen attack or UV exposure. Its chemical structure features three phenolic hydroxyls that confer redox activity and enable binding to sirtuin and phosphodiesterase targets. Directionally, resveratrol acts as the small-molecule upstream activator of SIRT1. Though a weak direct antioxidant compared with vitamin C or cysteine, its biological impact flows mainly through signaling modulation—activating SIRT1, AMPK, and eNOS, and inhibiting PDE4—rather than through stoichiometric scavenging of free radicals.
description_zh_TW: Resveratrol（白藜蘆醇）是多酚類芪類化合物 3,4',5-三羥基芪，一種在病原體侵襲或紫外線照射等壓力下產生的植物防禦化合物。其化學結構具有三個酚羥基，賦予其氧化還原活性並使其能夠結合 sirtuin 和磷酸二酯酶靶標。在方向性上，resveratrol 作為 SIRT1 的小分子上游活化劑。儘管作為直接抗氧化劑其效力弱於維生素 C 或半胱氨酸，但其生物學影響主要透過訊號調制實現——活化 SIRT1、AMPK 和 eNOS，並抑制 PDE4——而非透過化學計量自由基清除。

label: Vasodilation via nitric oxide synthesis modulation
description: Resveratrol promotes vasodilation by modulating nitric-oxide synthesis, principally via SIRT1-mediated activation of eNOS. Directionally, resveratrol sits upstream of NO-dependent relaxation. Improved vasodilation lowers vascular resistance and blood pressure, and enhanced NO bioavailability also reduces platelet aggregation and smooth-muscle proliferation. This is a direct mechanism behind its cardiovascular effects, and it connects resveratrol's SIRT1-activating action to endothelial function. Because endothelial NO is central to vascular health, resveratrol's ability to boost the SIRT1-eNOS axis underlies much of its reported cardiovascular benefit.
description_zh_TW: Resveratrol 透過調制一氧化氮合成促進血管舒張，主要透過 SIRT1 介導的 eNOS 活化。在方向性上，resveratrol 位於 NO 依賴性舒張的上游。改善的血管舒張降低血管阻力和血壓，增強的 NO 生物利用度也減少血小板聚集和平滑肌增生。這是其心血管效應的直接機制，並將 resveratrol 的 SIRT1 活化作用與內皮功能聯繫起來。由於內皮 NO 對血管健康至關重要，resveratrol 增強 SIRT1-eNOS 軸線的能力構成了其大部分報導的心血管益處的基礎。

label: Endothelial cells from lipid damage
description: Resveratrol protects endothelial cells from lipid (e.g., oxidized-LDL) damage, helping preserve vascular barrier and nitric-oxide function. Directionally, resveratrol sits upstream of endothelial protection. This action is mediated through SIRT1/eNOS and antioxidant pathways, reducing the injurious effects of oxidized lipoproteins on the endothelium. It is a foundational vascular benefit supporting resveratrol's cardiovascular reputation, and it is consistent with resveratrol's inhibition of Lox-1-mediated foam-cell formation and its promotion of vasodilation. Preserving endothelial integrity is central to preventing the initiation and progression of atherosclerosis.
description_zh_TW: Resveratrol 保護內皮細胞免受脂質（如氧化型 LDL）損傷，有助於維護血管屏障和一氧化氮功能。在方向性上，resveratrol 位於內皮保護的上游。此作用透過 SIRT1/eNOS 和抗氧化途徑介導，減少氧化脂蛋白對內皮的損傷效應。這是支持 resveratrol 心血管聲譽的基礎血管益處，與 resveratrol 抑制 Lox-1 介導的泡沫細胞形成和促進血管舒張的作用一致。維護內皮完整性對於預防動脈粥樣硬化的啟動和進展至關重要。

label: Hormetic (biphasic) dose-response
description: Resveratrol shows a hormetic, biphasic dose-response: at low-to-moderate doses it acts as a mild stressor that triggers beneficial adaptive responses such as sirtuin activation and antioxidant defense, whereas at very high doses it can produce off-target or pro-oxidant effects. The directionality is dose determining outcome, not simple monotonic benefit. This complicates dosing in therapeutics. It also rationalizes why modest, diet-like exposures may be more effective than pharmacological megadoses.
description_zh_TW: 白藜蘆醇表現出毒物興奮效應的雙相劑量反應：在低至中等劑量下，它作為輕度壓力源觸發有益的適應性反應（如 sirtuin 活化和抗氧化防禦），而在非常高的劑量下，它可能產生脫靶或促氧化效應。其方向性為劑量決定結果，而非簡單的單調益處。這使治療中的劑量確定複雜化。它也合理化了為什麼適度的、類似飲食的暴露可能比藥理學大劑量更有效。

label: Anti-neoplastic effects
description: Resveratrol shows anti-neoplastic effects in preclinical models, including cell-cycle arrest and apoptosis induction, though confidence in human translation is moderate. Directionally, resveratrol sits upstream of suppressed tumor phenotype in those systems. Mechanisms may involve modulation of SIRT1, AMPK, NF-κB, and p53, which together restrain proliferation and promote death of cancer cells. Robust human anticancer efficacy is unproven, and bioavailability remains a major limitation. Nonetheless, the breadth of resveratrol's anti-cancer mechanisms continues to drive interest in its use as an adjunctive agent in oncology research.
description_zh_TW: Resveratrol 在臨床前模型中展現抗腫瘤效應，包括細胞週期阻滯和凋亡誘導，但對人體轉化的信心為中等。在方向性上，resveratrol 在這些系統中位於抑制腫瘤表型的上游。機制可能涉及 SIRT1、AMPK、NF-κB 和 p53 的調節，共同抑制癌細胞的增殖並促進其死亡。resveratrol 在人體中的抗癌療效尚未被證實，生物利用度仍是主要限制。儘管如此，resveratrol 抗癌機制的廣度持續推動著將其作為腫瘤學研究中輔助用藥的興趣。

label: Blood glucose and insulin
description: Resveratrol treatment lowers blood glucose and circulating insulin in animals on a high-calorie diet, improving glycemic control and insulin sensitivity. These metabolic benefits are linked to SIRT1/AMPK activation and improved insulin signaling in liver and muscle, together with reduced hepatic steatosis. Directionally, resveratrol activates SIRT1/AMPK to lower glycemia. Caveats include that human trials have been inconsistent, likely owing to the compound's poor oral bioavailability, short half-life, and extensive first-pass metabolism, which limit the translation of preclinical efficacy to physiological exposures achievable through dietary or supplement intake in people.
description_zh_TW: 白藜蘆醇治療降低高熱量飲食動物的血糖和循環胰島素水平，改善血糖控制和胰島素敏感性。這些代謝益處與 SIRT1/AMPK 活化以及肝臟和肌肉中胰島素信號改善相關，同時減少肝脂肪變性。在方向性上，白藜蘆醇活化 SIRT1/AMPK 以降低血糖。需要注意的是，人體試驗結果不一致，可能是由於該化合物口服生物利用度差、半衰期短和廣泛的首過代謝，限制了臨床前療效向人們通過飲食或補充劑攝入可達到的生理暴露量的轉化。

label: Oral bioavailability
description: Resveratrol undergoes extensive first-pass metabolism, including glucuronidation and sulfation in the gut and liver, yielding very low systemic free concentrations after oral intake. Its plasma half-life is roughly 8-14 minutes. Directionally, oral administration leads to rapid conjugation and poor bioavailability. This undermines many preclinical benefits when translating to humans, because tissue concentrations rarely approach the levels shown to activate SIRT1 in vitro. Formulation strategies, higher doses, and co-administration with absorption enhancers are being explored to overcome these pharmacokinetic limitations.
description_zh_TW: 白藜蘆醇經歷廣泛的首過代謝，包括腸道和肝臟中的葡萄糖醛酸化和硫酸化，導致口服攝入後系統性游離濃度極低。其血漿半衰期約為 8-14 分鐘。在方向性上，口服給藥導致快速結合和較低的生物利用度。這在轉化為人類時削弱了許多臨床前益處，因為組織濃度很少接近在體外顯示能活化 SIRT1 的水平。正在探索製劑策略、更高劑量和與吸收增強劑的共同給藥來克服這些藥代動力學限制。

label: Traditional East Asian medicine (Veratrum formosanum)
description: Resveratrol-containing plants such as Veratrum formosanum have long been used in traditional East Asian medicine, foreshadowing modern interest in the compound. Directionally, the traditional botanical use precedes and motivates contemporary pharmacological study. This ethnobotanical precedent parallels other stilbene-bearing remedies, and it contributed to the identification of resveratrol as a bioactive compound with cardiovascular and longevity-associated properties. It is historical context rather than a mechanistic claim, but it illustrates how traditional medicine has repeatedly pointed modern pharmacology toward bioactive natural products.
description_zh_TW: 含 resveratrol 的植物如台灣藜蘆（Veratrum formosanum）長期以來被用於傳統東亞醫學，預示了現代對此化合物的興趣。在方向性上，傳統植物使用先於並推動了當代藥理學研究。這種民族植物學先例與其他含芪類的藥方相似，並促進了 resveratrol 作為具有心血管和壽命相關特性的活性化合物的鑑定。這是歷史背景而非機制性主張，但它說明了傳統醫學如何一再指引現代藥理學發現活性天然產物。

label: 1.5 to 3 mg per liter
description: Typical red wine contains 1.5-3 mg/L trans-resveratrol, up to about 5.8 mg/L in some cool-climate wines, with a 5-ounce glass providing only about 0.3 mg. Directionally, wine content sits upstream of modest resveratrol intake. This low dose highlights why drinking alone may not reach pharmacologic exposures, and it contextualizes the French-paradox and matrix-bioavailability discussion. Because red wine's co-constituents, including quercetin and ethanol, may improve resveratrol's bioavailability, the whole-matrix effect matters for interpreting epidemiological associations with wine consumption.
description_zh_TW: 典型紅酒含有 1.5-3 mg/L 反式 resveratrol，在某些涼爽氣候葡萄酒中可高達約 5.8 mg/L，一杯 5 盎司的酒僅提供約 0.3 mg。在方向性上，葡萄酒含量位於適度 resveratrol 攝入量的上游。這種低劑量突顯了為何單靠飲酒可能無法達到藥理學暴露量，並為法國悖論和基質生物利用度討論提供背景。由於紅酒的共同成分（包括槲皮素和乙醇）可能改善 resveratrol 的生物利用度，全基質效應對於詮釋與葡萄酒消費的流行病學關聯至關重要。

label: Thrombin
description: Heparin is a glycosaminoglycan anticoagulant that binds antithrombin III and induces a conformational change that accelerates antithrombin-mediated inactivation of thrombin (factor IIa) and factor Xa by roughly 1000-fold. Unfractionated heparin inhibits both thrombin and Xa, whereas low molecular weight heparin such as enoxaparin and dalteparin primarily targets Xa.
description_zh_TW: Heparin 是一種醣胺聚醣類抗凝血劑，可與 antithrombin III 結合並誘導構形改變，使 antithrombin 對 thrombin（factor IIa）與 factor Xa 的抑制加速約 1000 倍。未分級肝素同時抑制 thrombin 與 Xa，而 enoxaparin、dalteparin 等低分子量肝素則主要作用於 Xa。

label: Erythrocyte Plasma Membrane
description: Studies have shown that the human erythrocyte plasma membrane can convert epinephrine (adrenaline) to aminochromes, including adrenochrome and further derivatives, in a two-phase reaction. Aminochromes are the cyclized oxidation products of catecholamines, and this membrane-associated conversion represents a route for adrenochrome formation in blood even though erythrocytes lack the organelles and oxidative enzymes that actively produce it. This makes the erythrocyte membrane a site where catecholamine oxidation products can form, with potential consequences for red blood cell membrane integrity.
description_zh_TW: 研究顯示，人類erythrocyte plasma membrane能在two-phase reaction中將epinephrine（adrenaline）轉化為aminochromes，包括adrenochrome及進一步的derivatives。Aminochromes是catecholamines的cyclized oxidation products，而這種membrane-associated conversion代表了一條血液中adrenochrome形成的途徑，儘管erythrocytes缺乏主動生成它的胞器與oxidative enzymes。這使得erythrocyte membrane成為catecholamine oxidation products可以形成的位置，並可能對red blood cell membrane integrity造成影響。

label: MCC950
description: MCC950 is a potent, selective, and cell-active inhibitor of the NLRP3 inflammasome. It binds the NACHT domain of NLRP3, blocking inflammasome assembly, ASC speck formation, and caspase-1 activation to reduce IL-1beta and IL-18 secretion.
description_zh_TW: MCC950 是 NLRP3 發炎體的強效、選擇性、細胞活性抑制劑。它結合 NLRP3 的 NACHT 結構域，阻斷發炎體組裝、ASC 斑點形成與 caspase-1 活化，以減少 IL-1β 與 IL-18 分泌。

label: Neurotransmitters
description: Neurotransmitters are endogenous chemical messengers that relay signals between neurons, and the catecholamines dopamine, norepinephrine, and epinephrine are paramount in neuromelanin research. Their oxidative metabolism generates the aminochromes that polymerize into neuromelanin.
description_zh_TW: 神經傳導物質是神經元間傳遞訊號的內源性化學信使，而兒茶酚胺（dopamine、norepinephrine、epinephrine）在 neuromelanin 研究中至關重要。其氧化代謝產生聚合為 neuromelanin 的 aminochrome。

label: Monosodium Urate Crystals
description: After MyD88-dependent NF-kB priming induces pro-IL-1beta, monosodium urate crystals activate the NLRP3 inflammasome to generate active caspase-1, which cleaves pro-IL-1beta. The resulting IL-1-mediated inflammation underlies gout pathology. mTOR activation accompanies this program and rapamycin or metformin dampens inflammasome activity.
description_zh_TW: 在 MyD88-dependent NF-kB priming 誘導 pro-IL-1beta 之後，Monosodium Urate Crystals 活化 NLRP3 Inflammasome 以產生具活性的 caspase-1，進而切割 pro-IL-1beta。所產生的 IL-1-mediated inflammation 是 gout 病理的基礎。此過程伴隨 mTOR activation，而 rapamycin 或 metformin 可減弱 inflammasome activity。

label: Indoline
description: Indoline — a benzene ring fused to a five-membered nitrogen-containing ring, the partially hydrogenated form of indole — forms the structural core of Aminochromes such as Adrenochrome and Dopaminochrome. During Oxidation of Catecholamines the catechol ring is converted to a Quinone while the side-chain nitrogen cyclizes to close the five-membered indoline ring.
description_zh_TW: Indoline——由苯環與五員含氮環稠合而成、為 indole 部分氫化型態——構成 Aminochromes（如 Adrenochrome 與 Dopaminochrome）的結構核心。在 Catecholamines 的 Oxidation 過程中，catechol 環被轉換為 Quinone，同時側鏈氮原子環化閉合形成五員 indoline 環。

label: anti-inflammatory effects
description: Berberine exerts potent anti-inflammatory effects through multiple molecular pathways, including inhibition of NF-kappaB signaling, downregulation of pro-inflammatory cytokines such as TNF-alpha and IL-6, and activation of AMPK that improves metabolic and inflammatory status. These actions contribute to its benefits in metabolic syndrome, insulin resistance, type 2 diabetes, and gastrointestinal inflammation, and extend to modulation of the gut microbiota. Because its anti-inflammatory activity is independent of the methylation cycle, it does not add methyl burden or inhibit COMT. This makes it a versatile and relatively safe adjunct in inflammation management.
description_zh_TW: Berberine 透過多種分子途徑發揮有效的 anti-inflammatory effects 作用，包括抑制 NF-kappaB 訊號傳導、下調促發炎細胞因子（如 TNF-α 和 IL-6）以及活化 AMPK，進而改善代謝和發炎狀態。這些作用有助於其治療代謝症候群、胰島素抗性、2 型糖尿病和胃腸道炎症，並延伸至腸道微生物群的調節。由於其抗發炎活性獨立於 methylation cycle，因此不會增加甲基負荷或抑制 COMT。這使其成為發炎管理中多功能且相對安全的輔助手段。

label: Successful Aging
description: Higher Christensenellaceae abundance in the Gut Microbiome is consistently associated with lower Body Mass Index, lean body composition and successful aging, and the family is enriched in Centenarians. The same taxon is among the most heritable in the human Gut Microbiome, tracking host genotype more strongly than most other microbes.
description_zh_TW: Gut Microbiome 中較高的 Christensenellaceae 豐度，與較低的 Body Mass Index、瘦體組成及 successful aging 高度相關，且此菌科在 Centenarians 中被富集。在人類 Gut Microbiome 中，它是遺傳性最高的類群之一，與宿主基因型的關聯強於多數其他微生物。

label: Verrucomicrobia
description: Verrucomicrobia is a bacterial phylum ubiquitous in soil and water that appears in the human Gut Microbiome as a consistent but low-abundance component, represented primarily by the genus Akkermansia. Their relevance to human health is mediated mainly through that genus and its effects on the gut barrier and host metabolism.
description_zh_TW: Verrucomicrobia 是一個廣泛存在於土壤與水中的細菌門，在人類 Gut Microbiome 中為一致但低豐度的成員，主要由 Akkermansia 屬代表。其與人體健康的關聯主要透過該屬對腸道屏障與宿主代謝的影響而中介。

label: Glutathione Depletion
description: Asthma is associated with glutathione depletion, as the GSH/GSSG ratio is markedly decreased in asthmatic airways, weakening local antioxidant defense. This sensitizes the airway to oxidant triggers and allergen-induced inflammation. The directionality is disease to lowered thiol buffer. A caveat is that glutathione changes vary by asthma phenotype and severity, and some patients show different redox patterns. Replenishing airway GSH with N-acetylcysteine has been explored as an adjunctive strategy to restore antioxidant capacity in asthmatic airways.
description_zh_TW: Asthma 與 glutathione depletion 相關，因為 asthmatic 氣道中的 GSH/GSSG 比率顯著降低，削弱了局部抗氧化防禦。這會使氣道對氧化劑觸發物和過敏原引起的發炎變得敏感。方向性是降低硫醇緩衝液的疾病。需要注意的是，glutathione 的變化因 asthma 表型和嚴重程度而異，並且一些患者表現出不同的氧化還原模式。人們已經探索以 N-乙醯半胱氨酸補充氣道 GSH 作為恢復 asthmatic 氣道抗氧化能力的輔助策略。

label: colorectal, gastric, and luminal breast cancer
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: In humans, SIRT7 takes part in the genesis of colorectal cancer, gastric cancer, and luminal breast cancer. SIRT7 is overexpressed in multiple cancer tissues, promoting the survival of cancer cells and the maintenance of a transformed state. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of tumorigenesis in these cancer types, and its overexpression supports the transformed phenotype across a broad range of tumours.
description_zh_TW: 在人類中，SIRT7參與大腸直腸癌、胃癌和管腔型乳腺癌的發生。SIRT7在多種癌症組織中過表達，促進癌細胞的存活和轉化狀態的維持。方向上，SIRT7位於這些癌症類型中腫瘤發生的上游，其過表達在廣泛的腫瘤中支持轉化表型。

label: Replicative lifespan
description: Overexpression of SIRT7 extends the replicative lifespan of primary human cells by maintaining rDNA stability and reducing mitochondrial dysfunction. Directionally, SIRT7 gain sits upstream of prolonged cellular lifespan. This mirrors the pro-longevity roles of other sirtuins and supports a broadly conserved lifespan-promoting function for the family. The mechanism likely involves preservation of ribosomal DNA repeats, maintenance of heterochromatin, and support of mitochondrial gene expression through GABPβ1. SIRT7's ability to extend replicative lifespan is consistent with the theme that sirtuin activity generally counteracts cellular senescence.
description_zh_TW: 過度表達 SIRT7 透過維護 rDNA 穩定性和減少粒線體功能障礙來延長原代人類細胞的複製壽命。在方向性上，SIRT7 功能增強位於延長細胞壽命的上游。這反映了其他 sirtuin 的促長壽角色，支持該家族具有廣泛保守的壽命促進功能。其機制可能涉及核糖體 DNA 重複序列的保存、異染色質的維護以及透過 GABPβ1 對粒線體基因表達的支持。SIRT7 延長複製壽命的能力與 sirtuin 活性普遍對抗細胞衰老的主題一致。

label: rDNA transcription
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT7 activates RNA polymerase I transcription of ribosomal DNA and is required for pre-rRNA cleavage, driving ribosome biogenesis and protein synthetic capacity; this nucleolar function supports growth and, in cancer, tumor proliferation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 活化 RNA 聚合酶 I 對核糖體 DNA 的轉錄，並為前 rRNA 切割所需，驅動核糖體生物合成和蛋白質合成能力；這種核仁功能支持生長，在癌症中支持腫瘤增殖。

label: RNA Polymerase I transcription
description: SIRT7 activates RNA polymerase I-mediated transcription of ribosomal DNA, driving ribosome biogenesis and protein synthetic capacity in proliferating cells. It does so in part through deacetylation of histone H3K18 at rDNA loci and by stabilizing the Pol I transcriptional apparatus, ensuring sufficient ribosome output for growth. Directionally, SIRT7 acts upstream to enhance rRNA production and ribosome biogenesis. By sustaining this biosynthetic capacity, SIRT7 supports cell growth and proliferation, which underlies its roles in development and in cancer, where ribosome biogenesis is frequently upregulated.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 活化 RNA 聚合酶 I 介導的核糖體 DNA 轉錄，驅動增殖細胞中的核糖體生物合成和蛋白質合成能力。它部分通過去乙醯化 rDNA 基因座處的組蛋白 H3K18 以及穩定 Pol I 轉錄裝置來實現，確保足夠的核糖體產出以支持生長。在方向性上，SIRT7 在上游增強 rRNA 產生和核糖體生物合成。通過維持這種生物合成能力，SIRT7 支持細胞生長和增殖，這是其在發育和癌症中作用的基礎，在癌症中核糖體生物合成經常被上調。

label: ERK and STAT3 signaling
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT7 affects the malignancy of glioma cells mainly by promoting glioma proliferation and invasion through the ERK and STAT3 signaling pathways. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of ERK- and STAT3-driven glioma progression. By sustaining these proliferative and invasive signaling cascades, SIRT7 supports the aggressive growth and spread characteristic of glioma. This identifies SIRT7 as a pro-tumorigenic factor in this brain cancer and suggests that SIRT7 inhibition could suppress glioma progression. The finding adds to the emerging picture of SIRT7 as an oncogenic sirtuin in certain malignancies, where its functions diverge from the longevity-promoting roles of other family members.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7主要透過ERK和STAT3訊號通路促進膠質瘤增殖和侵襲來影響膠質瘤細胞的惡性程度。方向上，SIRT7位於ERK和STAT3驅動的膠質瘤進展的上游。透過維持這些增殖性和侵襲性訊號級聯，SIRT7支持膠質瘤特徵性的侵略性生長和擴散。這將SIRT7確定為此腦癌中的促腫瘤因子，並表明SIRT7抑制可以抑制膠質瘤進展。此發現增加了SIRT7作為某些惡性腫瘤中致癌sirtuin的新興圖景，其功能與其他家族成員的促長壽角色不同。

label: human stem cell aging as a heterochromatin stabilizer
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT7 antagonizes human stem cell aging as a heterochromatin stabiliser and safeguards chromatin structure. As a heterochromatin stabiliser, SIRT7 counteracts human stem cell ageing. SIRT7 also regulates innate immune modulation and ensures geroprotection during stem cell ageing. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of heterochromatin maintenance and stem cell rejuvenation, protecting stem cells from age-related chromatin deterioration.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7作為異染色質穩定劑對抗人類幹細胞老化並維護染色質結構。作為異染色質穩定劑，SIRT7對抗人類幹細胞老化。SIRT7也調節先天免疫調節並在幹細胞老化期間確保老年保護。方向上，SIRT7位於異染色質維護和幹細胞回春的上游，保護幹細胞免受與年齡相關的染色質惡化。

label: glucose availability with mitochondrial biogenesis
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT7 arginine methylation maintains energy balance by coordinating glucose availability with mitochondria biogenesis. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of the coupling between nutrient (glucose) status and mitochondrial mass. By linking glucose sensing to mitochondrial biogenesis, SIRT7 helps the cell match energy production to substrate availability, contributing to metabolic homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7精氨酸甲基化透過協調葡萄糖可用性與粒線體生成來維持能量平衡。方向上，SIRT7位於營養（葡萄糖）狀態與粒線體質量之間耦合的上游。透過將葡萄糖感知與粒線體生成聯繫起來，SIRT7幫助細胞使能量產生與底物可用性匹配，有助於代謝恆定。

label: Epigenetic regulation
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT7 deacetylates H3K18 on promoters (Barber et al., 2012, Nature, PMID 22722849) and associates with chromatin remodelers (including PAF1 complex) to regulate rDNA transcription, ribosomal biogenesis, and global gene expression; age-related SIRT7 decline perturbs these epigenetic landscapes (source review; Vakhrusheva et al., 2008).
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 去乙醯化啟動子上的 H3K18（Barber et al., 2012, Nature, PMID 22722849），並與染色質重塑因子（包括 PAF1 複合物）結合，以調節 rDNA 轉錄、核糖體生成和整體基因表現；與年齡相關的 SIRT7 下降會擾亂這些表觀遺傳景觀（來源文獻; Vakhrusheva et al., 2008）。

label: H2A
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT7 deacetylates histone H2A, contributing to its nucleolar/chromatin regulatory program.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 去乙醯化組蛋白 H2A，有助於其核仁/染色質調控程序。

label: H2B
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT7 deacetylates histone H2B as part of its chromatin modification repertoire.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 去乙醯化組蛋白 H2B，作為其染色質修飾 repertoire 的一部分。

label: histone desuccinylation
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT7 functions as a histone desuccinylase that links chromatin compaction to genome stability, deacetylating H3K18 at promoters and desuccinylating histones to maintain heterochromatic state and suppress DNA damage.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 作為組蛋白去琥珀酰酶，將染色質凝縮與基因組穩定性聯繫起來，去乙醯化啟動子上的 H3K18 並去琥珀酰化組蛋白以維持異染色質狀態並抑制 DNA 損傷。

label: aging and lifespan of hematopoietic cells
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT7 has deacetylase activity and plays a critical role in ageing and lifespan of hematopoietic cells in humans. SIRT7 is an influence factor in healthy aging and the development of age-dependent myeloid stem-cell disorders. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of haematopoietic stem cell maintenance and healthy aging, with dysregulation linked to age-dependent blood disorders.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7具有去乙醯酶活性，在人類造血細胞的老化和壽命中發揮關鍵作用。SIRT7是健康老化和年齡依賴性骨髓幹細胞疾病發展的影響因子。方向上，SIRT7位於造血幹細胞維護和健康老化的上游，其失調與年齡依賴性血液疾病相關。

label: Stress resistance
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT7 promotes cellular stress resistance by suppressing ER stress and reactive-ROS programs via Myc-linked silencing of ribosomal protein genes and by stabilizing DNA repair; SIRT7-depleted cells show increased apoptosis and metabolic stress (Shin et al., 2013, PMID 24210820; source review).
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 透過抑制內質網壓力和活性氧自由基程式（經由 Myc 連結的核糖體蛋白基因沉默）以及穩定 DNA 修復，促進細胞抗壓力能力；SIRT7 缺失的細胞表現出凋亡增加和代謝壓力上升（Shin et al., 2013, PMID 24210820; 來源文獻）。

label: rRNA transcription
description: SIRT7 regulates rRNA transcription by activating RNA polymerase I and deacetylating histone H3K18 at ribosomal DNA, controlling ribosome biogenesis and protein synthetic capacity. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of Pol I activity and ribosome production. Because excessive ribosome biogenesis fuels proliferation, this activity aligns SIRT7 with growth and, in cancer, with tumor promotion. It also ties SIRT7 to nucleolar stress responses and, through deacetylation of GABPβ1, to the transcriptional control of nuclear-encoded mitochondrial genes, such that SIRT7 deficiency causes systemic mitochondrial dysfunction with lactate accumulation and cardiac abnormalities.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 通過活化 RNA 聚合酶 I 並去乙醯化核糖體 DNA 處的組蛋白 H3K18 來調節 rRNA 轉錄，控制核糖體生物合成和蛋白質合成能力。在方向性上，SIRT6 位於 Pol I 活性和核糖體產生的上游。由於過度的核糖體生物合成促進增殖，此活性使 SIRT7 與生長一致，在癌症中與腫瘤促進一致。它也將 SIRT7 與核仁壓力反應以及通過 GABPβ1 去乙醯化對核編碼粒線體基因的轉錄控制聯繫起來，使得 SIRT7 缺乏導致伴隨乳酸堆積和心臟異常的系統性粒線體功能障礙。

label: VSMC proliferation and migration
description: SIRT7 regulates vascular smooth-muscle cell (VSMC) proliferation and migration through the Wnt/β-catenin signaling pathway, limiting the neointimal hyperplasia that drives vascular disease. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of VSMC quiescence. By restraining VSMC activation, SIRT7 protects against atherosclerotic and restenotic remodeling after vascular injury. It adds a vascular-stability role to SIRT7, complementing its cardiac functions, and loss of SIRT7 permits excessive VSMC growth and migration. The Wnt/β-catenin pathway is a central driver of VSMC phenotypic switching, and SIRT7's regulation of it links sirtuins to vascular remodeling.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 通過 Wnt/β-catenin 信號通路調節血管平滑肌細胞（VSMC）的增殖和遷移，限制驅動血管疾病的新生內膜增生。在方向性上，SIRT7 位於 VSMC 靜止的上游。通過限制 VSMC 活化，SIRT7 保護對抗血管損傷後的動脈粥樣硬化和再狹窄重塑。這為 SIRT7 增加了血管穩定性角色，與其心臟功能互補，SIRT7 的缺失允許過度的 VSMC 生長和遷移。Wnt/β-catenin 通路是 VSMC 表型轉換的中心驅動因子，SIRT7 對其的調節將 sirtuin 與血管重塑聯繫起來。

label: rDNA transcription and pre-rRNA cleavage
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Sirtuin 7 is required not only for rDNA transcription but also for particular pre-rRNA cleavage. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of ribosomal RNA synthesis and processing in the nucleolus. By supporting both rDNA transcription and pre-rRNA cleavage, SIRT7 is essential for ribosome biogenesis, connecting SIRT7 to growth, protein synthesis, and cellular proliferation.
description_zh_TW: Sirtuin 7不僅是rDNA轉錄所必需的，也是特定pre-rRNA切割所必需的。方向上，SIRT7位於核仁中核糖體RNA合成和加工的上游。透過支持rDNA轉錄和pre-rRNA切割，SIRT7對核糖體生成至關重要，將SIRT7與生長、蛋白質合成和細胞增殖聯繫起來。

label: dependent on N- and C-terminal domains
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: The DNA-activated deacetylase activity of SIRT7 is dependent on both the N- and C-terminal domains. The SIRT7 N-terminal domain (NTD) is made up of three helices, and according to the findings SIRT7-NTD has structural similarities to transcription factor regulators and may have a role in DNA binding. Directionally, the SIRT7 NTD sits upstream of DNA binding and enzymatic activation, connecting SIRT7 structure to its chromatin-associated functions.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7的DNA活化去乙醯酶活性依賴於N端和C端結構域。SIRT7 N端結構域（NTD）由三條螺旋組成，根據研究結果，SIRT7-NTD與轉錄因子調節器具有結構相似性，可能在DNA結合中具有作用。方向上，SIRT7 NTD位於DNA結合和酵素活化的上游，將SIRT7結構與其染色質相關功能聯繫起來。

label: H3K18
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins, a promising target in slowing down the ageing process.md
description: SIRT7 deacetylates histones, in particular H3K18, whose deacetylation is associated with repression of tumor suppressor genes. SIRT7 can therefore support a cancer phenotype by inhibiting expression of tumor suppressors, though it is required only to sustain, not initiate, oncogenic transformation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7 去乙醯化組蛋白，尤其是 H3K18，其去乙醯化與腫瘤抑制基因的抑制相關。因此 SIRT7 可透過抑制腫瘤抑制因子的表達來支持癌症表型，但僅用於維持而非啟動致癌轉化。

label: benzene ring with two hydroxyl groups
description: Catechols contain a benzene ring bearing two adjacent (ortho) hydroxyl groups, a structural motif that is both chemically reactive and the specific recognition site for COMT. This vicinal diol is methylated at the meta position by COMT using SAMe, yielding O-methylated metabolites that are less reactive and more readily excreted. The presence of this group defines whether a molecule, endogenous or xenobiotic, is a COMT substrate or, at high concentrations, a competitive inhibitor. The motif also renders catechols prone to oxidation, linking them to reactive quinone chemistry.
description_zh_TW: Catechols 含有一個帶有兩個相鄰（鄰位）羥基的苯環，這是一種具有化學反應性的結構基序，也是 COMT 的特異性識別位點。這種鄰位二醇被 COMT 使用 SAMe 在間位甲基化，產生反應性較低且更容易排泄的 O-甲基化代謝物。該基團的存在決定了分子（內源性或外源性）是 COMT 底物還是高濃度的競爭性抑制劑。該基序也使兒茶酚易於氧化，將它們與反應性醌化學聯繫起來。

label: Estrogen metabolites
description: Estrogen metabolites, such as 2-hydroxyestrone and 4-hydroxyestrone, are catechols because they retain a catechol ring formed during hydroxylation, making them substrates for COMT. COMT O-methylates these metabolites into less genotoxic methoxyestrogens, a protective detoxification step that reduces exposure to reactive catecholestrogen quinones. Slow COMT can therefore slow the clearance of catecholestrogens, with implications for hormone-related cancer risk. This connection links COMT genotype to estrogen metabolism and cancer susceptibility hypotheses.
description_zh_TW: Estrogen metabolites，如 2-羥基雌酮和 4-羥基雌酮，是兒茶酚，因為它們保留了羥基化過程中形成的兒茶酚環，使其成為 COMT 的底物。 COMT 將這些代謝物 O-甲基化成遺傳毒性較小的甲氧基雌激素，這是一種保護性解毒步驟，可減少活性兒茶酚醌的暴露。因此，緩慢的 COMT 可以減緩兒茶酚雌激素的清除，進而影響荷爾蒙相關的癌症風險。這種關聯將 COMT genotype 與雌激素代謝和癌症易感性假設聯繫起來。

label: neuroprotective properties
description: Luteolin has neuroprotective properties, including suppression of neuroinflammation, reduction of oxidative stress, and modulation of microglial activation, which may protect neurons in models of neurodegeneration and neuroinflammation. These effects are mediated through pathways such as Nrf2 and NF-kappaB rather than through COMT. Its catechol structure, however, means high doses can interact with COMT as both substrate and competitive inhibitor. It is studied for potential benefit in cognitive decline and brain injury.
description_zh_TW: Luteolin 具有 neuroprotective properties，包括抑制神經發炎、減少氧化壓力和調節小膠質細胞活化，這可能會保護神經退化性和神經發炎模型中的神經元。這些作用是透過 Nrf2 和 NF-kappaB 等途徑介導的，而不是透過 COMT 介導的。然而，其茶酚結構意味著高劑量可以與作為底物和競爭性抑制劑的 COMT 相互作用。研究了它對認知能力下降和 brain 損傷的潛在益處。

label: dual substrate-inhibitor of COMT
description: Oleacein is a dual substrate-inhibitor of COMT: its phenolic structure is O-methylated by COMT as a substrate while simultaneously competing for the active site and for SAMe as an inhibitor, reducing clearance of other catechols. This bifunctional interaction means oleacein both feeds and partially blocks the COMT pathway, with the net effect depending on dose and on the individual's COMT genotype. It is a notable example of dietary polyphenols modulating catechol metabolism. Its olive oil source links diet to COMT-related biochemistry.
description_zh_TW: Oleacein 是 dual substrate-inhibitor of COMT：其酚類結構被 COMT 作為底物 O-甲基化，同時競爭活性位點和 SAMe 作為抑制劑，減少其他兒茶酚的清除。這種雙功能交互作用意味著油酸素既供給又部分阻斷 COMT 途徑，淨效應取決於劑量和個體的 COMT genotype。這是膳食多酚調節兒茶酚代謝的一個顯著例子。其橄欖油來源將飲食與 COMT 相關的生物化學聯繫起來。

label: extra virgin olive oil
description: Oleacein is a phenolic secoiridoid compound found in extra virgin olive oil, where it contributes to the oil's characteristic bitterness and health-promoting profile. As a dietary polyphenol it is metabolized in part by COMT, linking olive oil consumption to COMT-dependent polyphenol disposition. It exhibits antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties that underlie part of the Mediterranean diet's cardiovascular benefits. Its presence makes olive oil a significant dietary source of COMT-interacting phenolics.
description_zh_TW: Oleacein 是一種在 extra virgin olive oil 中發現的酚類環烯醚萜化合物，它賦予了油特有的苦味和促進健康的特性。作為一種膳食多酚，它部分由 COMT 代謝，將橄欖油消耗與 COMT 依賴性多酚處置聯繫起來。它所含的抗氧化劑和 anti-inflammatory properties 是地中海飲食對心血管的部分益處的基礎。它的存在使得橄欖油成為 COMT 相互作用酚類物質的重要飲食來源。

label: EGCG bioavailability
source_file: _document_ - COMT How to Optimize Your Supplements for Your COMT Genotype.md
description: Quercetin enhances EGCG bioavailability by inhibiting the metabolism and efflux of EGCG, increasing the proportion of the parent catechin available in its bioactive form. As a catechol flavonoid itself, quercetin may also compete for COMT, further slowing EGCG O-methylation and extending its exposure. The quercetin-EGCG combination is therefore studied for synergistic polyphenol effects on metabolism and oxidative stress. This interaction illustrates how co-ingested flavonoids modulate each other's pharmacokinetics.
description_zh_TW: Quercetin 透過抑制 EGCG 的代謝和流出來增強 EGCG bioavailability，從而增加母體兒茶素以其生物活性形式提供的比例。作為 catechol flavonoid 本身，槲皮素也可能與 COMT 競爭，進一步減緩 EGCG O-甲基化並延長其暴露時間。因此，研究了槲皮素-EGCG 組合對代謝和氧化壓力的協同多酚效應。這種相互作用說明了共同攝取的黃酮類化合物如何調節彼此的藥物動力學。

label: glycoside of quercetin
description: Rutin is a glycoside of quercetin, formed by rutinose, a disaccharide, attached to the quercetin aglycone, which modifies its solubility, absorption, and bioavailability in the gut. After deglycosylation, the quercetin backbone, a catechol flavonoid, is metabolized partly by COMT, linking rutin intake to COMT-dependent disposition. This structural relationship explains rutin's COMT-interacting potential once converted to quercetin. Found in buckwheat, apples, and citrus, it is a common dietary flavonoid glycoside.
description_zh_TW: Rutin 是 glycoside of quercetin，由芸香糖（一种二糖）形成，附着在槲皮素苷元上，改变其在肠道中的溶解度、吸收和生物利用度。去糖基化后，槲皮素骨架（catechol flavonoid）部分被 COMT 代谢，将芦丁摄入与 COMT 依赖性处置联系起来。這種結構關係解釋了蘆丁在轉化為槲皮素後具有 COMT 相互作用潛力。它存在於蕎麥、蘋果和柑橘中，是一種常見的膳食黃酮苷。

label: COMT at supplement doses
source_file: _document_ - COMT How to Optimize Your Supplements for Your COMT Genotype.md
description: Although animal and cell studies show EGCG to be an inhibitor of COMT, studies in humans give a different result. A study involving people with both fast and slow COMT variants showed that 750 mg of supplemental EGCG did not impair COMT activity. Research does show that people with slow COMT break down EGCG more slowly than people with fast COMT.
description_zh_TW: 雖然動物和細胞研究顯示 EGCG 是 COMT 的抑制劑，但人體研究給出不同的結果。一項涉及快速和緩慢 COMT 變異個體的研究顯示，750 毫克的補充 EGCG 不會損害 COMT activity。研究確實顯示緩慢 COMT 個體分解 EGCG 的速度比快速 COMT 個體慢。

label: Nrf2 pathway
description: Luteolin upregulates endogenous antioxidant enzymes such as heme oxygenase-1 via activation of the Nrf2 pathway. This Nrf2-dependent action helps it scavenge reactive oxygen species and counter oxidative stress. It contributes to luteolin's neuroprotective and anti-inflammatory profile.
description_zh_TW: Luteolin 透過活化 Nrf2 途徑上調內源性抗氧化酶，例如血紅素加氧酶-1。這種依賴 Nrf2 的作用幫助它清除活性氧物種並對抗氧化壓力。這有助於 luteolin 的神經保護和抗發炎特性。

label: quercetin-3-rutinoside
description: Rutin is chemically quercetin-3-O-rutinoside, a glycosylated flavonol found in buckwheat, citrus peel, apples, and onions. It is used to support vascular integrity and is valued for antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. Its quercetin aglycone bears the catechol moiety that engages COMT.
description_zh_TW: Rutin 化學上為 quercetin-3-O-rutinoside，是一種糖基化黃酮醇，存在於蕎麥、柑橘皮、蘋果和洋蔥中。它用於支持血管完整性，並因其抗氧化和抗發炎特性而受重視。其槲皮素苷元帶有接合 COMT 的兒茶酚部分。

label: SAMe when methylated
description: Rutin, via its quercetin aglycone, is O-methylated by COMT, a reaction that consumes SAMe and methyl groups. At high supplemental doses it can competitively inhibit COMT, slowing methylation of endogenous catechols. This places rutin in the same COMT-modulating class as luteolin and oleacein.
description_zh_TW: Rutin 透過其槲皮素苷元被 COMT O-甲基化，此反應消耗 SAMe 和 methyl groups。在高補充劑量下，它可競爭性抑制 COMT，減緩內源性兒茶酚的甲基化。這使 rutin 與 luteolin 和 oleacein 屬於同一 COMT 調節類別。

label: Non-amyloidogenic APP Processing
description: EGCG from green tea enhances alpha-secretase (TACE/ADAM17) activity, shifting APP processing toward the non-amyloidogenic pathway with increased sAPPalpha. This reduces Abeta generation and plaques while modulating tau phosphorylation and improving cognition in APPsw transgenic mice. Efficacy varied with dose and route, with intraperitoneal delivery outperforming oral dosing for cognition.
description_zh_TW: 來自綠茶的 EGCG 可增強 alpha-secretase (TACE/ADAM17) 活性，將 APP 處理轉向非類澱粉生成路徑並增加 sAPPalpha。此作用減少 Abeta 生成與斑塊，同時調控 tau 磷酸化並改善 APPsw 轉基因小鼠的認知。療效隨劑量與給藥途徑而異，腹腔注射在認知改善上優於口服。

label: DNA Methyltransferases
description: Epigallocatechin-3-gallate (EGCG) abundant in green tea inhibits DNA methyltransferases. This epigenetic modulation alters DNA methylation patterns governing stress resistance and inflammation genes, conferring long-lasting hormetic adaptation.
description_zh_TW: 綠茶中豐富的 Epigallocatechin-3-gallate (EGCG) 可抑制 DNA Methyltransferases。這種表觀遺傳調控改變了控制壓力抗性與發炎基因的 DNA 甲基化模式，賦予持久的 hormesis 適應優勢。

label: Chronic venous insufficiency
description: Hesperidin, often with diosmin, is used in venous disorders for its venotonic and capillary-resistance effects, historically applied to chronic venous insufficiency. Endothelial and microcirculation benefits support this indication.
description_zh_TW: Hesperidin 常與 diosmin 合併用於靜脈疾病，憑其靜脈張力與微血管阻力效應，歷史上應用於慢性靜脈功能不全。內皮與微循環益處支持此適應症。

label: Green tea
description: Green tea is the primary dietary source of EGCG, the dominant polyphenol of the beverage. EGCG is abundant in green tea, while its concentration is much lower in fermented teas such as black tea.
description_zh_TW: 綠茶是 EGCG 的主要膳食來源，EGCG 為綠茶中含量最高的多酚；在黑茶等發酵茶中，其濃度則大幅降低。

label: Chronic SASP
description: Chronic SASP, through IL-6 and IL-8 via JAK/STAT3, promotes cancer stem-cell traits and expands the CSC pool in neighbouring epithelial and tumour cells, enhancing tumour initiation and relapse potential. By driving stemness and survival, the persistent secretome fosters malignant progression and therapy resistance. The relationship is a key mechanism by which senescence can become tumor-promoting and is supported by cancer-stemness and senescence co-culture studies. It motivates the one-two punch strategy of senescence induction followed by senolytic clearance.
description_zh_TW: 慢性 SASP 透過 IL-6 與 IL-8 經 JAK/STAT3 促進癌症幹細胞特性，並擴張鄰近上皮與腫瘤細胞中的 CSC 池，增強腫瘤起始與復發潛力。透過驅動幹性與存活，持續分泌組助長惡性進展並削弱治療。此促進將衰老與治療誘發衰老連結到腫瘤幹性，說明 SASP 在慢性脈絡中的雙重、促腫瘤面。它是年齡相關癌症的關鍵機制。

label: Temozolomide
description: MGMT expression confers temozolomide resistance in a subset of GBM.
description_zh_TW: MGMT 表達在部分 GBM 中賦予 temozolomide 抗藥性。

label: ZIC3
description: Nanog is a direct ZIC3 target in the pluripotency network. Regulation places ZIC3 upstream of Nanog.
description_zh_TW: Nanog 是多能性網絡中直接的 ZIC3 標的。調節將 ZIC3 置於 Nanog 上游。

label: Self-Renewal
description: Nanog sustains indefinite stem-cell proliferation without differentiation. Maintenance separates renewal from lineage exit.
description_zh_TW: Nanog 在不分化下維持幹細胞無限增殖。維持將更新與譜系退出分開。

label: Nuclear Transport
description: Importin-beta1 KPNB1 mediates NLS-dependent nuclear import as its primary function.
description_zh_TW: Importin-β1 KPNB1 以 NLS 依賴核輸入為主要功能。

label: TUTase
description: ZCCHC11 is terminal uridylyltransferase 4, the Lin28-recruited enzyme.
description_zh_TW: ZCCHC11 是末端尿苷醯轉移酶 4，即 Lin28 招募的酶。

label: Cardiomyocyte Toxicity
description: Cardiomyocyte Toxicity is damage or dysfunction of heart muscle cells that is the major dose-limiting adverse effect of Chemotherapy, particularly the anthracyclines Doxorubicin and Daunorubicin. Doxorubicin redox-cycles at Mitochondrial Complex I, generating superoxide and hydroxyl radical that damage cardiomyocyte DNA, proteins and lipids; cardiotoxic agents also impair Oxidative Phosphorylation, open the mitochondrial permeability transition pore and deplete ATP, while TOP2B poisoning triggers p53-dependent apoptosis, disrupted SERCA and ryanodine receptor calcium handling adds calcium overload, and NLRP3 inflammasome activation adds IL-1β-mediated damage. Dexrazoxane is the FDA-approved iron-chelating cardioprotectant.
description_zh_TW: Cardiomyocyte Toxicity 指心臟肌肉細胞的損傷或功能障礙，是 Chemotherapy（尤其是 anthracyclines 類的 Doxorubicin 與 Daunorubicin）最主要的劑量限制性不良反應。Doxorubicin 在 Mitochondrial Complex I 進行氧化還原循環，產生 superoxide 與 hydroxyl radical 損傷心肌細胞的 DNA、蛋白質與脂質；具心毒性的藥物也會損害 Oxidative Phosphorylation、開啟粒線體通透性轉換孔並耗竭 ATP，而 TOP2B 中毒引發 p53 依賴的凋亡，SERCA 與 ryanodine 受體的鈣處理失調加上鈣過載，NLRP3 發炎小體活化再加上 IL-1β 介導的損傷。Dexrazoxane 是 FDA 核准的鐵螯合型心臟保護劑。

label: Lysosomal catabolic process
description: Autophagy is a conserved lysosome-dependent catabolic process in which cytoplasmic constituents—including misfolded proteins, protein aggregates, damaged organelles, and intracellular pathogens—are sequestered into double-membrane autophagosomes and delivered to lysosomes for enzymatic degradation. The resulting macromolecular building blocks such as amino acids, fatty acids, and nucleotides are recycled to sustain metabolism and biosynthetic capacity during nutrient stress. As the cell's principal quality-control and nutrient-recycling system, autophagy is essential for maintaining proteostasis and organellar integrity across nearly all eukaryotic cells. Defects in autophagic flux are causally linked to aging, neurodegeneration, cancer, and metabolic disease, making it a central node in cellular homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: 自噬是一種保守的、依賴溶酶體的分解代謝過程，其中細胞質成分——包括錯誤折疊蛋白、蛋白聚集物、受損胞器和細胞內病原體——被隔離進入雙層膜自噬體，並遞送至溶酶體進行酶解降解。所產生的巨分子建構單元如胺基酸、脂肪酸和核苷酸被回收，以在營養壓力下維持代謝和生合成能力。作為細胞主要的品質控制和營養回收系統，自噬對於在幾乎所有真核細胞中維持蛋白質穩態和胞器完整性至關重要。自噬流缺陷與老化、神經退化、癌症和代謝疾病有因果關聯，使其成為細胞穩態中的核心節點。

label: Cancer treatment
description: During cancer treatment, autophagy plays a dual role that depends on context: it can protect tumor cells from chemotherapy- and radiation-induced damage, limiting therapeutic efficacy, yet it can also promote therapy-induced cell death when excessive or when it facilitates terminal differentiation and antigen presentation. In normal tissues, treatment-induced autophagy is generally cytoprotective and reduces toxicity, widening the therapeutic window. The opposing outcomes necessitate careful stratification of when to inhibit versus enhance autophagy in the clinic. This duality mirrors autophagy's broader role in cancer initiation versus progression.
description_zh_TW: 在癌症治療期間，自噬扮演依脈絡而定的雙重角色：它可保護腫瘤細胞免於化療和放療引起的損傷，限制治療效能，但它也可在過度或促進終末分化和抗原呈現時，促進治療誘發的細胞死亡。在正常組織中，治療誘發的自噬通常是細胞保護性的並減少毒性，拓寬治療窗口。相反的結果要求在臨床上仔細分層何時抑制 versus 增強自噬。此雙重性反映了自噬在癌症起始與進展中更廣泛的角色。

label: TFEB at S134/S138
description: Glycogen synthase kinase 3 beta (GSK3β) phosphorylates TFEB at serines 134 and 138, residues that influence its subcellular localization and association with lysosomal membranes. These phosphorylations contribute to the regulated shuttling of TFEB and modulate its activity in response to Wnt and growth-factor signaling contexts. Because GSK3β activity is itself controlled by Akt and by nutrient state, this modification embeds TFEB within the broader insulin/PI3K signaling network. The sites complement the better-characterized S211 mark in fine-tuning TFEB localization.
description_zh_TW: 糖原合成酶激酶 3 beta（GSK3β）於 serine 134 和 138 磷酸化 TFEB，這些殘基影響其亞細胞定位和與溶酶體膜的關聯。這些磷酸化有助於 TFEB 的調節性穿梭，並在 Wnt 和生長因子信號背景下調節其活性。由於 GSK3β 活性本身受 Akt 和營養狀態控制，此修飾將 TFEB 嵌入更廣泛的胰島素／PI3K 信號網絡。這些位點補充了特徵更清楚的 S211 標記，以微調 TFEB 定位。

label: B Cell responses
source_file: _document_ - The autophagy enhancer spermidine reverses arterial aging.md
description: Spermidine supplementation rejuvenates age-impaired B cell responses by inducing autophagy in memory T and B lymphocytes, restoring their functional competence. The polyamine's ability to clear damaged organelles and enhance proteostasis in these cells counteracts the decline in vaccine responsiveness seen with immune aging. By supporting lymphoid cell fitness, spermidine addresses a key component of immunosenescence through an autophagy-dependent mechanism. These effects complement its broader rejuvenation of adaptive immunity.
description_zh_TW: 補充spermidine透過在記憶性T和B淋巴細胞中誘導自噬，恢復因年齡受損的B細胞反應，使其功能能力復原。此多胺清除受損胞器和增強這些細胞中蛋白質穩態的能力，抵消了免疫老化所見的疫苗反應性下降。透過支持淋巴樣細胞健康，spermidine透過依賴自噬的機制解決免疫老化的關鍵組成部分。這些效應補充了其對適應性免疫更廣泛的恢復作用。

label: PI3K III complex
description: The class III phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase (PI3K III) complex, centered on Vps34 and including Beclin 1, Atg14, Vps15, and Ambra-1, generates phosphatidylinositol 3-phosphate (PI3P) at membranes to drive autophagosome nucleation. PI3P recruits effector proteins carrying PI3P-binding domains that organize the expanding phagophore and tether downstream ATG conjugation systems. Beclin 1 is a tumor suppressor whose activity is modulated by interacting partners and by anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family proteins that restrain autophagy under fed conditions. This nucleation complex functions immediately downstream of the ULK1 initiator and is a critical control node for the magnitude of autophagic responses.
description_zh_TW: 第三類磷脂醯肌醇3-激酶（PI3K III）複合體以Vps34為核心，並包含Beclin 1、Atg14、Vps15和Ambra-1，在膜上生成磷脂醯肌醇3-磷酸（PI3P）以驅動自噬體成核。PI3P招募帶有PI3P結合域的效應蛋白，這些蛋白組織擴展中的吞噬泡並繫留下游的ATG共軛系統。Beclin 1是一種腫瘤抑制因子，其活性受交互作用夥伴以及抗凋亡Bcl-2家族蛋白的調節，後者在進食狀態下抑制自噬。此成核複合體作用於ULK1起始者緊接的下游，是自噬反應強度的關鍵控制節點。

label: S130
source_file: _document_ - The Beneficial and Adverse Effects of Autophagic Response to Caloric Restriction and Fasting.md
description: The small-molecule ATG4B inhibitor S130 blocks the cysteine protease required for LC3 processing and autophagosome maturation; when combined with caloric restriction, this inhibition shifts the balance toward apoptotic death in colorectal cancer cells. By preventing autophagic protection of tumor cells while CR imposes metabolic stress, S130 sensitizes malignancy to cell death. The synergy illustrates a therapeutic strategy of pairing CR or CR-mimetics with targeted autophagy inhibition in cancer. The approach exploits the reliance of some tumors on basal autophagy for survival.
description_zh_TW: 小分子 ATG4B 抑制劑 S130 阻斷 LC3 處理和自噬體成熟所需的半胱氨酸蛋白酶；當與熱量限制結合時，此抑制在大腸癌細胞中將平衡推向凋亡性死亡。透過防止腫瘤細胞的自噬保護，同時熱量限制施加代謝壓力，S130 使惡性腫瘤對細胞死亡敏感化。此協同作用說明了一種將熱量限制或熱量限制擬似物與標靶性自噬抑制配對用於癌症的治療策略。此方法利用了某些腫瘤對基礎自噬存活的依賴。

label: Yoshinori Ohsumi
description: Yoshinori Ohsumi was awarded the 2016 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for his pioneering work using yeast genetics to identify the core autophagy-related (ATG) genes that govern the process. Through systematic mutagenesis screens, he uncovered the molecular machinery responsible for autophagosome formation, including the ubiquitin-like conjugation systems that build the phagophore membrane. His discoveries established autophagy as a genetically tractable and evolutionarily conserved degradation pathway, providing the conceptual framework for all subsequent mammalian autophagy research. The recognition underscored the fundamental importance of autophagy in cellular homeostasis, development, and human disease.
description_zh_TW: 大隅良典（Yoshinori Ohsumi）因開創性地利用酵母遺傳學鑑定出主導此過程的核心自噬相關（ATG）基因，而獲頒2016年諾貝爾生理學或醫學獎。透過系統性的突變篩選，他揭示了負責自噬體形成的分子機制，包括建構吞噬泡膜的泛素樣共軛系統。他的發現確立了自噬作為一種可遺傳操作且演化上保守的降解途徑，為後續所有哺乳動物自噬研究提供了概念框架。此項榮譽凸顯了自噬在細胞穩態、發育和人類疾病中的根本重要性。

label: H19
source_file: _document_ - Epigenetic changes during aging and their reprogramming potential.md
description: H19 is a long non-coding RNA whose expression changes with age, and it functions to repress IGF-1 signaling. H19 associates with MBD1, a methyl-CpG-binding domain protein, to repress the expression of longevity genes including insulin-like growth factor 1, and loss of H19-dependent IGF-1 silencing may contribute to cellular senescence. Because IGF-1 signaling is a conserved regulator of the insulin/IGF-1 pathway that influences lifespan, the age-related deregulation of H19 has implications for both senescence and longevity.
description_zh_TW: H19 是一種長鏈非編碼 RNA，其表現隨年齡而變化，其功能是抑制 IGF-1 訊號傳導。 H19 與 MBD1（一種甲基 CpG 結合域蛋白）結合，抑制包括類胰島素生長因子 1 在內的長壽基因的表達，H19 依賴性 IGF-1 沉默的喪失可能導致細胞老化。由於 IGF-1 訊號傳導是影響壽命的胰島素/IGF-1 路徑的保守調節因子，因此 H19 與年齡相關的失調對老化和長壽都有影響。

label: SIRT7 inactivation
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT7 inactivation reduces breast cancer metastasis by blocking TGF-β signalling. SIRT7 deacetylase activity inhibits metastasis of breast cancer by antagonising transforming growth factor-β signalling. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of TGF-β-driven metastasis in breast cancer. By promoting TGF-β signalling, SIRT7 supports the metastatic spread of breast cancer cells, and its inactivation curbs this process regardless of changes in original tumour development.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7失活透過阻斷TGF-β訊號來減少乳腺癌轉移。SIRT7去乙醯酶活性透過拮抗轉化生長因子-β訊號來抑制乳腺癌轉移。方向上，SIRT7位於乳腺癌中TGF-β驅動的轉移的上游。透過促進TGF-β訊號，SIRT7支持乳腺癌細胞的轉移性擴散，其失活無論原始腫瘤發展的變化如何都限制了此過程。

label: Energy Homeostasis
description: Autophagic recycling of nutrients during fasting supports energy homeostasis. Support is the clearance-to-balance output.
description_zh_TW: 禁食期間自噬回收營養支持能量恆定。支持是清除到平衡的輸出。

label: 3-Methyladenine
description: 3-Methyladenine inhibits class-III PI3K (Vps34) in the Beclin1 nucleation complex, preventing phagophore formation and blocking canonical autophagy at initiation.
description_zh_TW: 3-Methyladenine 抑制 Beclin1 啟動複合體中的 class-III PI3K（Vps34），阻止 phagophore 形成，在起始步驟阻斷典型自噬。

label: Chloroquine
description: Chloroquine raises lysosomal pH and blocks autophagosome-lysosome fusion, arresting autophagic flux at the degradation step; it is the standard late-stage autophagy inhibitor.
description_zh_TW: Chloroquine 提高溶酶體 pH 並阻斷自噬體-溶酶體融合，在降解步驟中止自噬流；是標準的晚期自噬抑制劑。

label: Mortality
source_file: _document_ - Natural Bioactive Compounds Spermidine Fisetin Berberine Urolithin A.md
description: In the prospective Bruneck cohort (n=829, 20-year follow-up), higher dietary spermidine intake was independently associated with reduced all-cause mortality (40.5 to 15.1 deaths/1000 person-years across tertiles), replicated in the Salzburg cohort; observational, residual confounding possible.
description_zh_TW: 前瞻性 Bruneck 世代（n=829，追蹤 20 年）顯示，較高飲食 spermidine 攝取與較低全因死亡率獨立相關（三分位由 40.5 降至 15.1 deaths/1000 person-years），Salzburg 世代亦複驗；屬觀察性研究，仍有殘餘干擾可能。

label: Autophagy Inhibitor
description: An autophagy inhibitor is a compound that blocks autophagic flux. Classes include lysosomotropic agents (Chloroquine, Hydroxychloroquine, Bafilomycin A1), PI3K inhibitors, ULK1 inhibitors (SBI-0206965, MRT68921), and ATG4 inhibitors.
description_zh_TW: 自噬抑制劑是阻斷自噬流的化合物。其類別包括溶酶體親和性藥物（Chloroquine、Hydroxychloroquine、Bafilomycin A1）、PI3K 抑制劑、ULK1 抑制劑（SBI-0206965、MRT68921）以及 ATG4 抑制劑。

label: C. elegans
description: C. elegans is a transparent nematode used as a premier model organism in genetics and ageing research, with autophagy, insulin signaling (DAF-2) and nutrient sensing (mTOR) highly conserved with humans. It has provided critical insight into nutrient regulation of autophagy via HLH-30 and MXL-3.
description_zh_TW: C. elegans 是透明的線蟲，為遺傳學與老化研究的首要模式生物，其 Autophagy、胰島素訊號（DAF-2）與營養感測（mTOR）與人類高度保守。它透過 HLH-30 與 MXL-3 提供了營養調控自噬的重要洞見。

label: Nuclear Export
description: Nuclear export of TFEB suppresses Autophagy: nutrient-rich conditions activate mTORC1 at the lysosome and ERK2, which phosphorylate TFEB at S142 (priming S138), creating a nuclear export signal that recruits CRM1 and traps TFEB in 14-3-3-bound cytosolic complexes. Under starvation, mTORC1 inhibition dephosphorylates TFEB, allowing nuclear accumulation and activation of CLEAR-network genes.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 的核輸出會抑制 Autophagy：營養充足時，溶酶體上的 mTORC1 與 ERK2 被活化，磷酸化 TFEB 的 S142（並使 S138 先行磷酸化），產生可招募 CRM1 的核輸出訊號，將 TFEB 困在與 14-3-3 結合的細胞質複合體中。禁食時 mTORC1 抑制使 TFEB 去磷酸化，因而在核內累積並活化 CLEAR network 基因。

label: HepG2
description: HepG2 is a human hepatocellular carcinoma cell line widely used to model human liver metabolism, protein synthesis and Autophagy. It supports siRNA-mediated knockdown of TFEB and nutrient-deprivation protocols, making it a convenient human system for lysosomal-autophagy studies.
description_zh_TW: HepG2 是人類肝細胞癌細胞系，廣泛用於模擬人類肝臟代謝、蛋白質合成與 Autophagy。它支援 TFEB 的 siRNA 敲低與營養剝奪實驗流程，是研究 lysosome-自噬的便利人類系統。

label: Carnosine
description: Carnosine (beta-alanyl-L-histidine) is a dipeptide concentrated in muscle and brain with antioxidant, pH-buffering and anti-glycation activity. In the Glyco-Oxidative Proteostasis Shield strategy it acts as a synergist for metal chelation and AGE inhibition, stabilizing the proteostatic environment against oxidative damage to the extracellular matrix, alongside aminoguanidine and the autophagy inducer spermidine — the GOPS protocol pairing a carnosine-stabilized adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine hybrid with spermidine-driven autophagy.
description_zh_TW: Carnosine（beta-alanyl-L-histidine）是高度濃縮於肌肉與腦部的二胜肽，具有抗氧化、pH 緩衝與抗糖化活性。在 Glyco-Oxidative Proteostasis Shield 策略中，它作為金屬螯合與 AGE 抑制的協同劑，與 aminoguanidine 及自噬誘導物 spermidine 一同穩定蛋白質穩態環境、對抗細胞外基質的氧化損傷——GOPS 方案 以 carnosine 穩定的 adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine 雜交分子搭配 spermidine 驅動的自噬。

label: Chemotherapy sensitivity
description: Caloric restriction increases the sensitivity of tumor cells to chemotherapy by creating a differential stress resistance in which normal cells enter a protective, autophagy-dependent quiescent state while cancer cells remain vulnerable. CR additionally stimulates CD8+ T cell-mediated anti-tumor immunity and enhances apoptotic priming of malignant cells. The improved therapeutic index allows lower effective doses and reduced toxicity. These effects position CR and its mimetics as adjuncts to conventional cancer therapy.
description_zh_TW: 熱量限制透過創造差異性壓力抵抗來增加腫瘤細胞對化療的敏感性：正常細胞進入保護性、依賴自噬的靜止狀態，而癌細胞仍保持脆弱。熱量限制還刺激 CD8+ T 細胞介導的抗腫瘤免疫，並增強惡性細胞的凋亡啟動。改善的治療指數允許更低的有效劑量和減少的毒性。這些效應將熱量限制及其擬似物定位為常規癌症治療的輔助手段。

label: Caloric Restriction Mimetics
description: Caloric restriction mimetics are pharmacological agents that reproduce the metabolic and autophagic benefits of caloric restriction without sustained food reduction. Representatives such as 2-deoxyglucose, metformin, and spermidine activate AMPK and/or inhibit mTORC1, recapitulating the low-energy signaling state that drives autophagy. By mimicking nutrient scarcity at the signaling level, these compounds induce lysosomal and autophagic gene programs similar to those engaged during DR. They are attractive translationally because they avoid the practical and compliance limitations of long-term dietary restriction in humans.
description_zh_TW: 熱量限制擬似物是能再現熱量限制的代謝和自噬益處而無需持續減少食物的藥理劑。代表物如2-deoxyglucose、metformin和spermidine活化AMPK和／或抑制mTORC1，重現驅動自噬的低能量訊號狀態。透過在訊號層面模擬營養匱乏，這些化合物誘導與DR期間相似的溶酶體和自噬基因程序。它們在轉譯上具吸引力，因為它們避免了人類長期飲食限制的實際和依從性限制。

label: Adaptive autophagy
description: Moderate caloric restriction induces adaptive autophagy—a beneficial, hormetic form of the pathway that enhances cellular clearance and resilience without causing damage. This adaptive response, driven by AMPK activation and mTORC1 inhibition, contributes substantially to the lifespan and healthspan extension observed with CR. Unlike pathological autophagy, adaptive autophagy is precisely regulated and supports rather than threatens cell survival. It represents the mechanistic core of CR's pro-longevity effects.
description_zh_TW: 適度的熱量限制誘發適應性自噬——一種有益的、激效型（hormetic）的途徑形式，在不造成損傷的情況下增強細胞清除和韌性。此由 AMPK 活化和 mTORC1 抑制驅動的適應性反應，對熱量限制所觀察到的壽命和健康壽命延長貢獻良多。不同於病理性自噬，適應性自噬受到精確調節，支持而非威脅細胞存活。它代表了熱量限制促長壽效應的機制核心。

label: Excessive autophagy
description: Prolonged or severe caloric restriction can drive excessive autophagy that crosses into autophagic cell death, particularly when degradative flux outpaces biosynthetic capacity. This maladaptive extreme underscores the biphasic, hormetic nature of autophagy, where too little or too much is detrimental. The balance between adaptive and excessive autophagy determines whether CR is protective or harmful. Understanding this threshold is important for safely translating CR-mimetic strategies.
description_zh_TW: 長期或嚴重的熱量限制可能驅動過度的自噬，跨越到自噬性細胞死亡，特別是當降解流超越合成能力時。此適應不良的極端凸顯了自噬的雙相、激效型本質，即過少或過多都有害。適應性與過度自噬之間的平衡決定了熱量限制是有保護性還是有害。理解此閾值對於安全轉譯熱量限制擬似策略至為重要。

label: High-AGE diet
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: In a study of three groups of mice fed a caloric restriction (CR) diet, a regular diet, or a CR diet high in AGEs, CR mice lived longer than regular or CR-high mice, with median and maximal survival increased by 13.2% and 6%, respectively. Survival in CR-high mice was shorter than in regular-fed mice, and the CR-high group showed significantly increased oxidative stress and accelerated aging-related cardiovascular and renal disease. High dietary AGEs thus compete with the benefits of caloric restriction, indicating that the AGE content of the diet modulates lifespan.
description_zh_TW: 在一項針對三組小鼠的研究中，分別餵食熱量限制（CR）飲食、一般飲食或高 AGE 的 CR 飲食，CR 小鼠比一般或 CR-高 AGE 小鼠活得更久，中位與最大存活分別增加 13.2% 與 6%。CR-高 AGE 小鼠的存活短於一般飲食小鼠，且 CR-高 AGE 組顯示氧化壓力顯著增加與加速老化的心血管及腎臟疾病。因此，高飲食性 AGE 與熱量限制的好處相抗衡，顯示飲食的 AGE 含量會調節壽命。

label: AGE inhibition
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: The inhibition of AGE formation and accumulation in tissues can lead to an increase in lifespan, as concluded from extensive evidence that AGE accumulation accompanies aging and age-related diseases. Because there are no enzymes to remove glycated products, AGEs accumulate as metabolic waste and contribute to tissue senescence. Inhibiting the glycation process and removing existing glycation products may prolong lifespan, and dietary herbal supplements or physiological exercise are advantageous in reducing the AGE burden in the body.
description_zh_TW: 抑制組織中 AGE 的形成與堆積可導致壽命延長，此結論源自大量證據顯示 AGE 堆積伴隨老化與老化相關疾病。由於體內缺乏可移除糖化產物的酵素，AGEs 便作為代謝廢物堆積並促進組織衰老。抑制糖化過程並清除既有的糖化產物或可延長壽命，而飲食草本補充劑或生理性運動則有利於減輕體內的 AGE 負擔。

label: Glucose Homeostasis
description: Protein restriction improves glucose homeostasis and insulin sensitivity in both rodents and humans. In young and aged rodents, PR reduces body weight and fat mass, increases energy expenditure, and improves glucose handling even when initiated late in life. Randomized controlled trials in humans show low-protein diets reduce body weight, fat mass, and fasting blood glucose, improve insulin sensitivity, and lower hemoglobin A1C and kidney disease outcomes in diabetic patients. BCAA restriction similarly improves insulin sensitivity and glucose/insulin homeostasis in humans, and methionine restriction improves glucose homeostasis in humans on strict vegan diets. These metabolic benefits contrast with high-protein diets associated with increased diabetes risk.
description_zh_TW: 蛋白質限制改善囓齒動物和人類的葡萄糖恆定性和胰島素敏感性。在年輕和年老的囓齒動物中，PR減少體重和脂肪量，增加能量消耗，並改善葡萄糖處理，即使在生命晚期開始。人類的隨機對照試驗顯示低蛋白飲食減少體重、脂肪量和空腹血糖，改善胰島素敏感性，並降低糖尿病患者的血紅素A1C和腎臟疾病結果。BCAA限制同樣改善人類的胰島素敏感性和葡萄糖/胰島素恆定性，甲硫氨酸限制改善嚴格素食者的人類葡萄糖恆定性。這些代謝益處與與糖尿病風險增加相關的高蛋白飲食形成對比。

label: NAD+/nicotinamide ratio (brain)
description: Caloric restriction elevates the brain NAD+/nicotinamide ratio, which both supplies more co-substrate for sirtuins and relieves nicotinamide-mediated feedback inhibition of SIRT1. The resulting gain in sirtuin activity supports neuronal stress resistance, mitochondrial function, and suppression of neuroinflammatory signaling. The relationship is directional: CR shifts the ratio upward, which then potentiates sirtuin-dependent protective programs. This mechanism is frequently invoked to explain CR's protective effects against age-related cognitive decline and neurodegenerative pathology.
description_zh_TW: 熱量限制提高大腦的 NAD+/菸鹼醯胺比值，這既為 sirtuin 提供了更多共同受質，又解除了菸鹼醯胺介導的 SIRT1 回饋抑制。由此產生的 sirtuin 活性增強支持神經元的壓力抗性、粒線體功能和抑制神經發炎信號。這種關係是方向性的：CR 使比值上升，然後增強 sirtuin 依賴性的保護程序。這種機制經常被用來解釋 CR 對抗年齡相關認知退化和神經退行性病變的保護效應。

label: Drosophila melanogaster
description: Dietary restriction in Drosophila extends lifespan and, as in yeast, this benefit requires the dSir2 (Sir2) gene, indicating evolutionary conservation of the sirtuin-mediated CR pathway. The effect is thought to operate through improved protein homeostasis, stress resistance, and metabolic efficiency rather than simple calorie shortage. Directionally, reduced nutrient signaling upstream engages dSir2 to produce the longevity phenotype. Caveats include that the magnitude and requirement vary with sex, genetic background, and the precise restriction paradigm used.
description_zh_TW: 在果蠅中，飲食限制延長壽命，且與酵母中一樣，這種益處需要 dSir2（Sir2）基因，表明 sirtuin 介導的 CR 通路具有演化保守性。該效應被認為是通過改善蛋白質穩態、壓力抗性和代謝效率，而非簡單的熱量不足來運作。在方向性上，減少的營養信號在上游啟動 dSir2，從而產生長壽表型。需要注意的是，該效應的強度和需求因性別、遺傳背景和所使用的具體限制方案而異。

label: β-amyloid neuropathology (Alzheimer's mouse model)
description: In mouse models engineered to develop Alzheimer's-like pathology, caloric restriction prevents accumulation of β-amyloid neuropathology, an effect consistent with SIRT1-driven reductions in neuroinflammation and oxidative stress. CR also preserves cognitive function and synaptic integrity in these models. Directionally, caloric restriction sits upstream of reduced amyloid burden. This supports the hypothesis that CR protects the brain through sirtuin-mediated resilience, and is consistent with SIRT1's promotion of the non-amyloidogenic α-secretase ADAM10. Human translation remains uncertain, but the findings motivate lifestyle interventions and NAD+-boosting strategies in neurodegeneration.
description_zh_TW: 在被設計發展出阿茲海默症樣病變的小鼠模型中，熱量限制防止 β-amyloid 神經病理學的累積，這種效應與 SIRT1 驅動的神經發炎和氧化壓力減少一致。CR 還在這些模型中保留認知功能和突觸完整性。在方向性上，熱量限制位於減少澱粉樣蛋白負擔的上游。這支持了 CR 通過 sirtuin 介導的韌性保護大腦的假說，與 SIRT1 促進非澱粉樣生成的 α-分泌酶 ADAM10 一致。人類轉化仍然不確定，但這些發現為神經退行性疾病中的生活方式干預和 NAD+ 提升策略提供了動力。

label: Autophagic Cell Death
description: Prolonged calorie restriction is not uniformly protective: when the autophagic response becomes excessive, the resulting type II autophagic cell death becomes harmful, making the dose and duration of dietary restriction a determinant of whether autophagy supports or destroys the cell.
description_zh_TW: 長期熱量限制並非一律有益：當自噬反應過度時，所引發的第二型自噬性細胞死亡反而有害，因此飲食限制的劑量與持續時間決定了自噬究竟支持還是摧毀細胞。

label: Methemoglobin Restriction
description: placeholder
description_zh_TW: placeholder

label: hepatocellular carcinoma and esophageal squamous cell carcinoma
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Expression of SIRT4 is considerably downregulated in hepatocellular carcinoma tumour tissues and in esophageal squamous cell carcinoma. Lower expression of SIRT4 promotes esophageal squamous cell carcinoma and hepatocellular carcinoma development. Directionally, loss of SIRT4 sits upstream of tumorigenic progression in these cancers, and its reduced expression is associated with poorer outcomes, supporting SIRT4 as a biomarker and tumor suppressor in HCC and esophageal cancer.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4的表達在肝細胞癌腫瘤組織和食道鱗狀細胞癌中顯著下調。SIRT4的較低表達促進食道鱗狀細胞癌和肝細胞癌的發展。方向上，SIRT4缺失位於這些癌症中腫瘤發生進展的上游，其降低的表達與較差的預後相關，支持SIRT4作為HCC和食道癌中的生物標誌物和腫瘤抑制因子。

label: endothelial cells of the umbilical vein and osteoarthritis
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: In humans, SIRT4 inhibits inflammation in endothelial cells of the umbilical vein and in osteoarthritis. SIRT4 suppresses the inflammatory response and oxidative stress in osteoarthritis. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of dampened inflammatory signalling in vascular endothelium and joint tissue. By restraining inflammation and oxidative stress, SIRT4 exerts protective effects in osteoarthritis and may help preserve endothelial function.
description_zh_TW: 在人類中，SIRT4抑制臍靜脈內皮細胞和骨關節炎中的發炎。SIRT4在骨關節炎中抑制發炎反應和氧化壓力。方向上，SIRT4位於血管內皮和關節組織中發炎訊號減弱的上游。透過抑制發炎和氧化壓力，SIRT4在骨關節炎中發揮保護作用，可能有助於維持內皮功能。

label: SIRT1 deacetylation of H2A.Z
description: SIRT1-mediated deacetylation and degradation of H2A.Z helps protect the heart from failure by removing a histone variant that drives maladaptive cardiac hypertrophic gene programs. Deacetylated H2A.Z is targeted for proteasomal degradation, reducing its presence at promoters that would otherwise sustain pathological remodeling. Directionally, SIRT1 promotes H2A.Z loss, which attenuates hypertrophy. This is a mechanistically plausible explanation for why SIRT1 activation is cardioprotective, though the in vivo evidence carries moderate confidence.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 介導的 H2A.Z 去乙醯化和降解通過移除驅動適應不良心臟肥大基因程序的組蛋白變體，幫助保護心臟免於衰竭。去乙醯化的 H2A.Z 被標記進行蛋白酶體降解，減少其在否則會維持病理性重塑的啟動子處的存在。在方向性上，SIRT1 促進 H2A.Z 的缺失，從而減弱肥大。這是 SIRT1 活化具有心臟保護作用的一個機制上合理的解釋，儘管體內證據的信心程度為中等。

label: PDH (Pyruvate Dehydrogenase)
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT4 (as a lipoamidase) inhibits the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex, modulating glucose-derived acetyl-CoA entry into the TCA cycle.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4（作為硫辛酰胺酶）抑制丙酮酸脫氫酶複合體，調節葡萄糖衍生的乙醯輔酶 A 進入 TCA 循環。

label: Tumour suppressor (glutamine metabolism)
description: SIRT4 acts as a tumor suppressor by inhibiting GDH and restricting glutamine-derived anaplerosis into the TCA cycle, starving cancer cells of carbon for proliferation. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of suppressed glutamine metabolism. This limits the glutamine addiction of tumors, which rely on glutamine for both energy and biosynthesis, and it is a context where SIRT4 opposes rather than promotes growth. By restraining glutamine utilization, SIRT4 reduces the metabolic support for rapid proliferation, and its loss in some cancers relieves this brake. SIRT4's tumor-suppressive role is thus tied to its regulation of mitochondrial metabolism.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 透過抑制 GDH 並限制穀氨醯胺衍生的回補作用進入 TCA 循環來發揮腫瘤抑制因子的作用，使癌細胞缺乏增殖所需的碳源。在方向性上，SIRT4 位於抑制穀氨醯胺代謝的上游。這限制了腫瘤對穀氨醯胺的成癮性——腫瘤依賴穀氨醯胺同時提供能量和生物合成原料——在這個情境下 SIRT4 對抗而非促進生長。透過限制穀氨醯胺利用，SIRT4 減少了快速增殖的代謝支持，其在某些癌症中的缺失解除了此制動。SIRT4 的腫瘤抑制角色因此與其對粒線體代謝的調控相關。

label: AMPK retrograde signaling
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT4 controls ATP homeostasis and uses AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK) to mediate retrograde signalling. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of cellular energy sensing and mitochondrial-to-nuclear communication. By modulating ATP levels and engaging AMPK-mediated retrograde signalling, SIRT4 helps the cell adapt its nuclear gene expression to mitochondrial metabolic status under conditions of energy stress.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4控制ATP恆定並使用AMP活化蛋白激酶（AMPK）來介導逆行訊號。方向上，SIRT4位於細胞能量感知和粒線體到核通訊的上游。透過調節ATP水平並參與AMPK介導的逆行訊號，SIRT4幫助細胞在能量壓力條件下根據粒線體代謝狀態調整其核基因表達。

label: ATP homeostasis
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT4 controls ATP homeostasis and uses AMPK-mediated retrograde signaling to couple mitochondrial metabolic status to nuclear gene expression under energy stress, influencing cellular fuel choice and bioenergetic balance.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 控制 ATP 恆定，並利用 AMPK 介導的逆行信號將粒線體代謝狀態與能量壓力下的核基因表達耦合，影響細胞燃料選擇和生物能量平衡。

label: breast cancer cells
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT4 enhances the tamoxifen sensitivity of breast cancer cells by inhibiting the STAT3 signaling pathway. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of restored endocrine responsiveness in breast cancer. By suppressing STAT3 signaling, SIRT4 makes breast cancer cells more vulnerable to tamoxifen, in contrast to SIRT3 overexpression, which reduces tamoxifen sensitivity. This positions SIRT4 as a potential enhancer of anti-estrogen therapy efficacy in breast cancer.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4透過抑制STAT3訊號通路增強乳腺癌細胞的Tamoxifen敏感性。方向上，SIRT4位於乳腺癌中內分泌反應性恢復的上游。透過抑制STAT3訊號，SIRT4使乳腺癌細胞更容易受到Tamoxifen的影響，與降低Tamoxifen敏感性的SIRT3過表達形成對比。這將SIRT4定位為乳腺癌中抗雌激素療法效果的潛在增強因子。

label: 5-fluorouracil by inhibiting the cell cycle
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT4 increases the sensitivity of colorectal cancer cells to the chemotherapeutic drug 5-fluorouracil by inhibiting the cell cycle. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of cell-cycle arrest, which primes CRC cells for 5-fluorouracil-induced killing. By restraining proliferation, SIRT4 enhances the cytotoxic effect of the drug, suggesting that SIRT4 expression status could predict or improve responses to 5-fluorouracil-based therapy in colorectal cancer.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4透過抑制細胞週期來增加大腸直腸癌細胞對化療藥物5-氟尿嘧啶的敏感性。方向上，SIRT4位於細胞週期停滯的上游，使CRC細胞為5-氟尿嘧啶誘導的殺傷做好準備。透過抑制增殖，SIRT4增強了藥物的細胞毒作用，表明SIRT4表達狀態可能預測或改善大腸直腸癌中5-氟尿嘧啶基治療的反應。

label: Glutamate dehydrogenase
description: SIRT4 inhibits glutamate dehydrogenase by mono-ADP-ribosylation, reducing conversion of glutamate to α-ketoglutarate and limiting anaplerotic carbon entry into the TCA cycle. Directionally, SIRT4 enzymatically suppresses GDH activity within mitochondria. This restrains amino-acid-stimulated insulin secretion and mitochondrial ATP generation, marking SIRT4 as a metabolic brake in the organelle. Because SIRT4 also inhibits MTPα, glutamine metabolism, and PPARα signaling, it broadly opposes the oxidative, catabolic programs that SIRT3 promotes, and the antagonistic SIRT3/SIRT4 balance is emerging as an important determinant of mitochondrial health and metabolic resilience.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 通過單 ADP-核糖基化抑制穀氨酸脫氫酶，減少穀氨酸轉化為 α-酮戊二酸，限制回補性碳源進入 TCA 循環。在方向性上，SIRT4 在酶學上抑制粒線體內的 GDH 活性。這限制了胺基酸刺激的胰島素分泌和粒線體 ATP 產生，將 SIRT4 標記為該細胞器中的代謝制動器。由於 SIRT4 也抑制 MTPα、穀氨酰胺代謝和 PPARα 信號，它廣泛對抗 SIRT3 促進的氧化、分解代謝程序，拮抗性的 SIRT3/SIRT4 平衡正在成為粒線體健康和代謝韌性的重要決定因素。

label: NSCLC, colorectal cancer, neuroblastoma, and gastric cancer
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT4 is an effective tumour suppressor in non-small cell lung cancer cells, human colorectal cancer, neuroblastoma, and gastric cancer. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of restrained tumour growth across multiple cancer types, in part by inhibiting glutamine metabolism and modulating mitochondrial dynamics. Low SIRT4 expression thereby permits tumorigenic behaviour, and SIRT4 represents a prognostic and therapeutic target in these cancers.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4在非小細胞肺癌細胞、人類大腸直腸癌、神經母細胞瘤和胃癌中是有效的腫瘤抑制因子。方向上，SIRT4位於多種癌症類型中腫瘤生長抑制的上游，部分透過抑制穀氨醯胺代謝和調節粒線體動力學。因此低SIRT4表達允許致瘤行為，SIRT4在這些癌症中代表了預後和治療靶點。

label: Phylogenetic Class II (evolutionarily ancient)
description: SIRT4 is classified in phylogenetic Class II, which includes sirtuins from bacteria, insects, nematodes, mould, and protozoa—among the most ancient sirtuin lineages. Directionally, this is an evolutionary placement rather than a causal pathway. This antiquity implies conserved mitochondrial metabolic roles, and it situates SIRT4 early in sirtuin evolution. Because Class II sirtuins predate the divergence of major eukaryotic lineages, SIRT4's mono-ADP-ribosyltransferase function likely represents an ancestral enzymatic activity.
