Understanding SIRT4's phylogenetic position helps contextualize its metabolic-brake functions relative to the more derived deacetylases.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 被分類為系統發育 II 類，包括來自細菌、昆蟲、線蟲、黴菌和原生動物的 sirtuin——是最古老的 sirtuin 譜系之一。在方向性上，這是演化定位而非因果途徑。這種古老性暗示保守的粒線體代謝角色，並將 SIRT4 置於 sirtuin 演化的早期。由於 II 類 sirtuin 先於主要真核生物譜系的分化，SIRT4 的單 ADP-核糖基轉移酶功能可能代表一種通過演化保留的祖先酶活性。理解 SIRT4 的系統發育位置有助於將其代謝制動功能置於更衍生的去乙醯酶的背景中。

label: mitotic cell division regulation
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT4 plays a crucial role in mitotic cell division regulation. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of proper cell cycle progression and mitotic fidelity. In addition to its roles in glutamine metabolism and tumor suppression, SIRT4 contributes to the orderly execution of mitosis, extending the functional repertoire of this mitochondrial sirtuin beyond metabolism.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4在有絲分裂細胞分裂調節中發揮關鍵作用。方向上，SIRT4位於正常的細胞週期進展和有絲分裂保真度的上游。除了其在穀氨醯胺代謝和腫瘤抑制中的角色外，SIRT4還有助於有絲分裂的有序執行，將此粒線體sirtuin的功能譜擴展到代謝之外。

label: E-cadherin promotion
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT4 suppresses epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EMT) by promoting expression of the epithelial marker E-cadherin in gastric cancer cells. This maintains an epithelial phenotype and inhibits cancer cell proliferation, migration, and invasion. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of maintained epithelial phenotype and suppressed metastasis. By preventing the loss of E-cadherin that characterizes EMT, SIRT4 blocks a key step in the acquisition of invasive and migratory behavior. This supports SIRT4's role as a tumor suppressor in gastric cancer, where its downregulation may allow tumors to progress toward metastatic disease.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4透過促進上皮標記E-cadherin在胃癌細胞中的表達來抑制上皮-間質轉化（EMT）。這維持了上皮表型並抑制癌細胞增殖、遷移和侵襲。方向上，SIRT4位於上皮表型維持和轉移抑制的上游。透過阻止EMT特徵性的E-cadherin喪失，SIRT4阻斷了獲得侵襲和遷移行為的關鍵步驟。這支持SIRT4作為胃癌中的腫瘤抑制因子，其下調可能使腫瘤向轉移性疾病進展。

label: MTPα (fatty acid oxidation)
description: SIRT4 suppresses fatty-acid oxidation in liver by inhibiting the mitochondrial trifunctional protein α subunit (MTPα), promoting lipid accumulation under nutrient-replete conditions. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of reduced β-oxidation. This contrasts with SIRT3 and SIRT5, which support fat oxidation, and it positions SIRT4 as a mitochondrial anabolic brake that conserves lipids when nutrients are abundant. The inhibition of MTPα and of PPARα signaling shifts metabolism away from mitochondrial fatty-acid utilization toward lipid storage. SIRT4's opposition to oxidative metabolism is central to the antagonistic SIRT3/SIRT4 balance.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 透過抑制粒線體三功能蛋白 α 亞基（MTPα）來抑制肝臟中的脂肪酸氧化，在營養充足條件下促進脂質積累。在方向性上，SIRT4 位於減少 β-氧化的上游。這與支持脂肪氧化的 SIRT3 和 SIRT5 形成對比，將 SIRT4 定位為在營養豐富時保存脂質的粒線體合成代謝制動器。對 MTPα 和 PPARα 訊號的抑制使代謝從粒線體脂肪酸利用轉向脂質儲存。SIRT4 對氧化代謝的對抗是拮抗性 SIRT3/SIRT4 平衡的核心。

label: MTPα (mitochondrial trifunctional protein α)
description: SIRT4 suppresses fatty-acid oxidation in liver by inhibiting the mitochondrial trifunctional protein α subunit (MTPα), promoting lipid accumulation under nutrient-replete conditions. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of reduced β-oxidation. This contrasts with SIRT3 and SIRT5, which support fat oxidation, and it positions SIRT4 as a mitochondrial anabolic brake. By inhibiting MTPα, SIRT4 conserves fatty acids for storage when nutrients are abundant. This opposition to oxidative metabolism is central to the antagonistic SIRT3/SIRT4 balance that determines mitochondrial metabolic state.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 透過抑制粒線體三功能蛋白 α 亞基（MTPα）來抑制肝臟中的脂肪酸氧化，在營養充足條件下促進脂質積累。在方向性上，SIRT4 位於減少 β-氧化的上游。這與支持脂肪氧化的 SIRT3 和 SIRT5 形成對比，將 SIRT4 定位為粒線體合成代謝制動器。透過抑制 MTPα，SIRT4 在營養豐富時保存脂肪酸以供儲存。這種對氧化代謝的對抗是決定粒線體代謝狀態的拮抗性 SIRT3/SIRT4 平衡的核心。

label: p16 and p21
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT4 upregulates expression of the cell-cycle inhibitor genes p16 and p21, while suppressing CyclinB1/Cdc2 and Cdc25c, and this cell-cycle blockade induces apoptosis in hepatocellular carcinoma cells. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of cell-cycle arrest and apoptosis induction. By enforcing these checkpoints, SIRT4 functions as a tumor suppressor in liver cancer, limiting proliferation and promoting death of transformed cells. The coordinated upregulation of p16 and p21 with suppression of cell-cycle drivers reflects SIRT4's broad influence on the machinery that governs entry into mitosis. This supports interest in SIRT4 as a therapeutic target for hepatocellular carcinoma.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4上調細胞週期抑制因子p16和p21的表達，同時抑制CyclinB1/Cdc2和Cdc25c，這種細胞週期阻斷誘導肝細胞癌細胞的凋亡。方向上，SIRT4位於細胞週期停滯和凋亡誘導的上游。透過強制執行這些檢查點，SIRT4在肝癌中作為腫瘤抑制因子發揮作用，限制增殖並促進轉化細胞的死亡。p16和p21的協調上調與細胞週期驅動因子的抑制反映了SIRT4對控制有絲分裂進入機制的廣泛影響。這支持了SIRT4作為肝細胞癌治療靶點的興趣。

label: GABAergic inhibitory cells
description: Medium spiny neurons are GABAergic inhibitory projection neurons, the principal output cells of the striatum that integrate cortical, thalamic, and dopaminergic inputs. Their inhibitory nature means dopamine modulation via D1/D2 receptors reshapes striatal output to basal ganglia circuits, controlling movement, habit, and reward. As the main targets of nigrostriatal dopamine, they are central to COMT's striatal effects and to dopamine-regulated behavior. They comprise about 95% of striatal neurons.
description_zh_TW: Medium spiny neurons 是 GABA 能抑制性投射神經元，是整合皮質、丘腦和多巴胺能輸入的紋狀體的主要輸出細胞。它們的抑制性質意味著透過 D1/D2 受體的多巴胺調節來重塑 basal ganglia 電路的紋狀體輸出，控制 movement、習慣和 reward。作為黑質紋狀體多巴胺的主要標靶，它們是 COMT 紋狀體效應和多巴胺調節行為的核心。它們大約包括95% of striatal neurons。

label: 95% of striatal neurons
description: Medium spiny neurons comprise approximately 95% of the neuronal population in the striatum, making them the dominant cell type through which dorsal and ventral striatal circuits operate. Their density underscores why striatal dopamine signaling, and its modulation by COMT and DAT, exerts such broad control over movement, habit, and reward behavior. The remaining 5% consist of interneurons that shape MSN activity. This cellular composition defines the functional architecture of the striatum and of the basal ganglia input stage.
description_zh_TW: Medium spiny neurons 約佔紋狀體神經元群的 95%，使其成為背側和腹側紋狀體迴路運作的主要細胞類型。它們的密度強調了為什麼紋狀體多巴胺訊號傳導及其由 COMT 和 DAT 的調節對 movement、習慣和 reward 行為發揮如此廣泛的控制。剩下的 5% 由塑造 MSN 活動的中間神經元組成。這種細胞組成定義了紋狀體和 basal ganglia 輸入級的功能架構。

label: nigrostriatal projection
description: Medium spiny neurons receive dopamine from the nigrostriatal projection originating in the substantia nigra pars compacta, making them the principal postsynaptic targets of striatal dopamine. The dopamine they receive is terminated mainly by DAT reuptake but also shaped by COMT in regions of lower DAT density. This dopaminergic input is essential for the motor and reward functions medium spiny neurons mediate, and its degeneration underlies Parkinson's disease. It is the central interface between dopamine neurons and striatal output.
description_zh_TW: Medium spiny neurons 從源自黑質緻密部的 nigrostriatal projection 接收多巴胺，使它們成為紋狀體多巴胺的主要突觸後目標。他們接收到的多巴胺主要透過 DAT 再攝取而終止，但在 DAT 密度較低的區域也受到 COMT 的影響。這種多巴胺能輸入對於中等棘神經元介導的運動和 reward 功能至關重要，其退化是帕金森氏症的基礎。它是多巴胺神經元和紋狀體輸出之間的中央介面。

label: catecholamine balance in Prefrontal Cortex
description: NET is critical for catecholamine balance in the prefrontal cortex because, in the relative absence of DAT, it is a major mechanism clearing both norepinephrine and dopamine, while COMT handles O-methylation. Disruption of NET, whether genetic or pharmacological, markedly alters prefrontal catechol tone and thus attention, arousal, working memory, and stress responses. Its role makes it a target for antidepressants and attention-deficit treatments. It functions in concert with COMT to maintain prefrontal dopamine homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: NET 對於前額葉皮質中的兒茶酚胺平衡至關重要，因為在相對缺乏 DAT 的情況下，它是清除 norepinephrine 和多巴胺的主要機制，而 COMT 則處理 O-甲基化。 NET 的破壞，無論是遺傳的還是藥理學的，都會顯著改變前額葉兒茶酚的張力，從而改變注意力、喚醒、工作記憶和壓力反應。它的作用使其成為抗憂鬱藥物和注意力缺陷治療的目標。它與 COMT 協同作用，維持前額多巴胺穩態。

label: inhibitory dopamine receptor
description: The D2 receptor is an inhibitory (Gi/o-coupled) dopamine receptor whose activation reduces cAMP and opens GIRK potassium channels, hyperpolarizing neurons in the central nervous system. It is a major mediator of dopamine's modulatory effects on movement, reward, motivation, and cognition, and is highly expressed on striatal medium spiny neurons. Its inhibition of cAMP signaling contrasts with the excitatory D1 receptor, enabling bidirectional dopaminergic tuning of basal ganglia output. It is also the principal target of antipsychotic medications.
description_zh_TW: D2 receptor 是一種抑制性（Gi/o 偶聯）多巴胺受體，活化可降低 cAMP 並打開 GIRK 鉀通道，使中樞神經系統中的神經元超極化。它是多巴胺對 movement、reward、動機和認知的調節作用的主要介質，並且在紋狀體中型多棘神經元上高度表達。它對 cAMP 訊號傳導的抑制與興奮性 D1 receptor 形成對比，從而實現 basal ganglia 輸出的雙向多巴胺能調節。這也是antipsychotic medications的主要目標。

label: antipsychotic medications
description: The D2 receptor is the principal target of antipsychotic medications, especially typical (first-generation) antipsychotics, which exert therapeutic effect by blocking D2 signaling to reduce psychotic symptoms. Occupancy of striatal D2 receptors correlates with both clinical efficacy and the development of extrapyramidal side effects such as parkinsonism and tardive dyskinesia. This targeting links dopaminergic tone, shaped partly by COMT, to psychiatric treatment response. D2 blockade remains the common mechanism across most antipsychotic drug classes.
description_zh_TW: D2 receptor是antipsychotic medications的主要靶點，尤其是典型的（第一代）抗精神病藥，它透過阻斷D2訊號傳導以減輕精神病症狀來發揮治療作用。紋狀體 D2 受體的佔據與臨床療效和錐體外系副作用（如帕金森氏症和遲發性運動障礙）的發生有關。這種標靶將多巴胺能音調（部分由 COMT 塑造）與精神治療反應聯繫起來。 D2 阻斷仍然是大多數抗精神病藥物類別的共同機制。

label: reward
description: The D2 receptor modulates reward processing by inhibiting medium spiny neurons of the striatal indirect pathway, thereby shaping the salience and reinforcement of rewarding stimuli. Its activity integrates dopamine signals that govern motivated behavior, reward learning, and incentive motivation in the ventral striatum and nucleus accumbens. Dysregulation of D2 signaling, including reduced receptor availability, is implicated in addiction, obesity, and schizophrenia. Because dopamine availability is partly set by COMT, genotype can indirectly influence D2-mediated reward function.
description_zh_TW: D2 receptor 透過抑制紋狀體間接路徑的中型多棘神經元來調節 reward 處理，從而塑造獎勵刺激的顯著性和強化。其活性整合了控制動機行為的多巴胺訊號，reward learning，以及腹側紋狀體和伏隔核的激勵動機。 D2 訊號傳導失調，包括受體可用性降低，與成癮、肥胖和精神分裂症有關。由於多巴胺的可用性部分由 COMT 決定，因此基因型可以間接影響 D2 介導的 reward 功能。

label: dopamine in Prefrontal Cortex
description: The norepinephrine transporter (NET) also reuptakes dopamine in the prefrontal cortex, because DAT is sparse there and NET, with modest affinity for dopamine, clears a meaningful fraction of extracellular dopamine. This dual substrate specificity means prefrontal dopamine clearance is shared between NET and COMT, with both contributing to setting dopamine tone. The arrangement explains why noradrenergic drugs, such as NET inhibitors used as antidepressants and attention treatments, can influence prefrontal dopamine levels. It is a key feature of prefrontal catecholamine regulation.
description_zh_TW: norepinephrine 轉運蛋白 (NET) 也在前額葉皮質中重新攝取多巴胺，因為那裡的 DAT 很稀疏，而 NET 對多巴胺具有適度的親和力，可以清除相當一部分細胞外多巴胺。這種雙重底物特異性意味著 NET 和 COMT 共享前額多巴胺清除率，兩者都有助於設定多巴胺基調。這種安排解釋了為什麼去甲腎上腺素能藥物，例如用作抗憂鬱藥物和注意力治療的 NET 抑制劑，可以影響前額葉多巴胺水平。這是前額葉兒茶酚胺調節的關鍵特徵。

label: DAT expression
description: The prefrontal cortex has limited dopamine transporter expression compared with the striatum, meaning dopamine persists longer in the extracellular space and is inactivated mainly by diffusion, NET uptake, and COMT O-methylation. This anatomical constraint is the reason COMT genotype exerts its strongest cognitive effects in prefrontal-dependent tasks. It contrasts sharply with the DAT-dominated striatum, where reuptake is fast. This regional difference is foundational to understanding dopamine regulation and COMT's cognitive role.
description_zh_TW: 與紋狀體相比，前額葉皮質的多巴胺轉運蛋白表達有限，這意味著多巴胺在細胞外空間中持續時間更長，並且主要透過擴散、NET 攝取和 COMT O-甲基化而失去活性。這種解剖學限制是 COMT genotype 在前額葉依賴性任務中發揮最強認知作用的原因。它與 DAT 主導的紋狀體形成鮮明對比，後者的再攝取速度很快。這種區域差異是理解多巴胺調節和 COMT 認知作用的基礎。

label: primary brain region for Working Memory
description: The prefrontal cortex is the primary brain region for working memory, as demonstrated by lesion, neuroimaging, and single-neuron recording studies showing its necessity for holding and manipulating information online. Its dopamine-dependent networks are exquisitely sensitive to COMT activity, since DAT is sparse and COMT dominates dopamine clearance there. This regional specialization makes it the focal point of COMT-cognition research and of the inverted-U dopamine model. Working memory is among the functions most strongly influenced by COMT genotype.
description_zh_TW: 病變、神經影像學和單神經元記錄研究表明，前額葉皮質是工作記憶的主要 brain 區域，表明其在線保存和操作資訊的必要性。它的多巴胺依賴性網絡對 COMT activity 非常敏感，因為 DAT 稀疏，而 COMT 在那裡主導多巴胺清除。這種區域專業化使其成為 COMT 認知研究和倒 U 型多巴胺模型的焦點。工作記憶是受 COMT genotype 影響最強烈的功能之一。

label: balanced dopamine in Prefrontal Cortex
description: Working memory depends on balanced dopamine in the prefrontal cortex, where too little (fast COMT) or too much (slow COMT) dopamine degrades performance according to the inverted-U principle, with D1 receptor signaling particularly critical. Because prefrontal DAT is sparse, COMT and NET set this dopamine level, making working memory exquisitely sensitive to COMT genotype. Optimal working memory therefore requires COMT activity within a narrow functional window. This is the core of the inverted-U model of dopamine and cognition.
description_zh_TW: 工作記憶取決於前額葉皮質中多巴胺的平衡，根據倒 U 原理，多巴胺太少（快 COMT）或太多（慢 COMT）都會降低性能，其中 D1 receptor 訊號尤其重要。由于前额叶 DAT 稀疏，COMT 和 NET 设置了这种多巴胺水平，使工作记忆对 COMT genotype 极其敏感。因此，最佳工作记忆需要 COMT activity 在狭窄的功能窗口内。這是多巴胺和認知倒U模型的核心。

label: limited-capacity cognitive system
description: Working memory is a limited-capacity cognitive system that temporarily holds and manipulates information for use in reasoning, comprehension, and planning, distinct from long-term storage. Its capacity is constrained by prefrontal resources and modulated by dopamine, which sets the efficiency of maintenance and manipulation. COMT genotype influences the dopamine tuning that determines an individual's working memory efficiency. It is a core component of executive function and a major focus of cognitive neuroscience.
description_zh_TW: 工作記憶是一種暫時保存和操作資訊以用於推理、理解和計劃的 limited-capacity cognitive system，與長期儲存不同。它的能力受到前額葉資源的限制，並受到多巴胺的調節，多巴胺決定了維護和操縱的效率。 COMT genotype 影響決定個人工作記憶效率的多巴胺調節。它是executive function的核心組件，也是認知神經科學的主要焦點。

label: COMT for dopamine clearance
description: Because the dopamine transporter is scarce in the prefrontal cortex, the region relies principally on COMT to methylate dopamine and norepinephrine at the synapse, making it the dominant clearance route. This dependence means genetic variation in COMT strongly influences PFC dopamine tone. The Met (slow) allele preserves higher dopamine while the Val (fast) allele lowers it.
description_zh_TW: 由於多巴胺轉運蛋白在前額葉皮質稀缺，該區域主要依賴 COMT 在突觸甲基化 dopamine 和 norepinephrine，使其成為主要的清除途徑。這種依賴意味著 COMT 的遺傳變異強烈影響 PFC 多巴胺張力。Met（慢）等位基因保留較高的多巴胺，而 Val（快）等位基因則降低它。

label: sparse Dopamine Transporter in Prefrontal Cortex
description: In the prefrontal cortex, where the dopamine transporter is sparsely expressed, NET assumes an outsized role by clearing a substantial fraction of extracellular dopamine in addition to norepinephrine. This makes NET a critical determinant of catecholamine tone in the frontal lobes. The complementary actions of NET and COMT define prefrontal dopamine dynamics.
description_zh_TW: 在前額葉皮質，多巴胺轉運蛋白表達稀疏，NET 除了清除 norepinephrine 外還清除大量細胞外 dopamine，因此承擔了超乎尋常的角色。這使 NET 成為額葉兒茶酚胺張力的關鍵決定因素。NET 和 COMT 的互補作用定義了前額葉多巴胺動力學。

label: spiny dendritic arbors
description: Medium spiny neurons are named for their medium-sized somata and densely spiny dendritic arbors, which receive massive glutamatergic input from the cortex and thalamus. They require convergent excitatory input to transition from a resting down-state to an up-state depolarization that triggers action potentials. This morphology supports their role as integrators of diverse inputs.
description_zh_TW: Medium spiny neurons 因其中等大小的胞體和密集的棘狀樹突樹而得名，後者接收來自皮質和丘腦的大量穀氨酸能輸入。它們需要匯聚的興奮性輸入才能從靜止的 down-state 過渡到觸發動作電位的 up-state 去極化。這種形態支持它們作為多種輸入整合者的角色。

label: atomoxetine
description: NET can be inhibited by drugs such as atomoxetine and methylphenidate, which raise both norepinephrine and dopamine in the prefrontal cortex. These NET inhibitors enhance attention and executive function, relevant to ADHD and the cognitive effects of Modafinil. Amphetamine-like compounds reverse NET transport, causing catecholamine efflux.
description_zh_TW: NET 可被 atomoxetine 和 methylphenidate 等藥物抑制，這些藥物會升高前額葉皮質中的 norepinephrine 和 dopamine。這些 NET 抑制劑增強注意力和 executive function，與 ADHD 和 Modafinil 的認知效應相關。安非他命類化合物會逆轉 NET 運輸，導致兒茶酚胺外流。

label: methyl donor availability
description: Prefrontal cortex function sits at the intersection of genetics and nutrition because COMT activity is itself modulated by methyl-donor availability such as Methylfolate, MethylB12, and SAMe. By supplying the methyl groups COMT consumes, methyl-donor status influences PFC dopamine tone. This links dietary and supplement choices to prefrontal cognition.
description_zh_TW: 前額葉皮質功能位於遺傳和營養的交匯點，因為 COMT activity 本身會受到 Methylfolate、MethylB12 和 SAMe 等甲基供體可用性的調節。透過供應 COMT 消耗的甲基，甲基供體狀態影響 PFC 多巴胺張力。這將飲食和補充劑選擇與前額葉認知連結起來。

label: ADHD
description: Prefrontal dopamine dysregulation is central to ADHD, where deficits in executive function and attention arise from suboptimal PFC dopamine tone. Interventions such as NET-inhibiting drugs raise PFC dopamine and norepinephrine to improve attention. The PFC therefore sits at the intersection of genetics, cognition, and ADHD treatment.
description_zh_TW: 前額葉多巴胺失調是 ADHD 的核心，執行功能和注意力的缺陷源於次佳化的 PFC 多巴胺張力。抑制 NET 的藥物等介入措施會提高 PFC 的 dopamine 和 norepinephrine 以改善注意力。因此 PFC 位於遺傳、認知和 ADHD 治療的交匯點。

label: SLC6A2 sodium-dependent symporter
description: The norepinephrine transporter (NET) is a sodium- and chloride-dependent symporter of the SLC6 family encoded by SLC6A2. It couples the inward transport of one norepinephrine molecule with the co-transport of one Na+ and one Cl-. NET is the target of many antidepressants such as reboxetine and of psychostimulants.
description_zh_TW: Norepinephrine transporter (NET) 是 SLC6 家族的鈉和氯依賴性共同轉運體，由 SLC6A2 編碼。它將一個 norepinephrine 分子的向內運輸與一個 Na+ 和一個 Cl- 的共同運輸耦合。NET 是許多抗憂鬱藥（如 reboxetine）和精神興奮劑的靶點。

label: Norepinephrine transporter for dopamine clearance
description: The prefrontal cortex relies on the norepinephrine transporter (NET) to clear dopamine in this region because the dopamine transporter (DAT) is sparse. NET takes up both norepinephrine and a substantial fraction of extracellular dopamine. This makes NET a critical determinant of catecholamine tone in the frontal lobes.
description_zh_TW: 由於多巴胺轉運蛋白 (DAT) 稀疏，前額葉皮質依賴 norepinephrine transporter (NET) 清除該區域的 dopamine。NET 同時攝取 norepinephrine 和大量細胞外 dopamine。這使 NET 成為額葉兒茶酚胺張力的關鍵決定因素。

label: excitatory dopamine receptor
description: D1 is a Gs-coupled excitatory dopamine receptor driving direct-pathway facilitation, the mirror of Gi-coupled inhibitory D2. This excitatory character explains its pro-movement and reward signaling.
description_zh_TW: D1 是 Gs 耦合的興奮性多巴胺受體，驅動直接路徑的促進，與 Gi 耦合的抑制性 D2 互為鏡像。此興奮特性解釋其促運動與獎賞訊號。

label: A53T
description: Alpha-synuclein and A53T are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Alpha-synuclein and A53T may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Alpha-synuclein 和 A53T 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Alpha-synuclein 和 A53T 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Pale Bodies
description: Pale Bodies and Lewy Bodies are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Pale Bodies and Lewy Bodies may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Pale Bodies 和 Lewy Bodies 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Pale Bodies 和 Lewy Bodies 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: TOM20
description: In Parkinson's disease, toxic α-synuclein (α-Syn) binds to the TOM20 receptor on the outer mitochondrial membrane. This binding blocks protein import into Mitochondria by 50%–60%, triggering ROS production and the accumulation of damaged mitochondria, thereby contributing to mitochondrial dysfunction and impaired Mitophagy.
description_zh_TW: 在 Parkinson's Disease 中，有毒的 α-synuclein (α-Syn) 會結合外層粒線體膜上的 TOM20 受體。此結合使進入 Mitochondria 的蛋白質輸入被阻斷 50%–60%，觸發 ROS 產生與受損粒線體累積，進而促成粒線體功能失調與受損的 Mitophagy。

label: TFEB at S466/S467/S469
description: AMPK phosphorylates TFEB on a cluster of serine residues (S466, S467, S469) located in its C-terminal regulatory region in response to energy stress. These phosphorylations enhance TFEB transcriptional activity and promote its nuclear accumulation, synergizing with the relief of mTORC1 repression. The modification thereby directly couples low cellular energy status to activation of the autophagy-lysosomal transcriptional program. This AMPK-TFEB axis provides a transcription-level reinforcement of the rapid post-translational induction of autophagy.
description_zh_TW: AMPK 在能量壓力下，於其 C 端調節區的絲胺酸殘基簇（S466、S467、S469）磷酸化 TFEB。這些磷酸化增強 TFEB 轉錄活性並促進其核累積，與 mTORC1 抑制的解除產生協同。此修飾因此直接將低細胞能量狀態耦合到自噬—溶酶體轉錄程序的活化。此 AMPK-TFEB 軸提供了對自噬快速轉譯後誘導的轉錄層次強化。

label: SIRT1 activity in triple-negative breast cancer
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: AMPK activation reduces the expression of the oncogenic protein metadherin through enhanced SIRT1 activity, acting independently of GSK-3β in triple-negative breast cancer. Directionally, AMPK activation sits upstream of SIRT1-driven repression of metadherin. Because metadherin promotes cancer progression, metastasis, and chemoresistance, its downregulation via the AMPK-SIRT1 axis represents a tumor-suppressive mechanism in triple-negative breast cancer.
description_zh_TW: AMPK活化透過增強SIRT1活性來降低致癌蛋白metadherin的表達，在三陰性乳腺癌中不依賴GSK-3β。方向上，AMPK活化位於SIRT1驅動的metadherin抑制的上游。由於metadherin促進癌症進展、轉移和化療耐藥性，其透過AMPK-SIRT1軸的下調代表了三陰性乳腺癌中的一種腫瘤抑制機制。

label: Ca2+ release (ER → cytoplasm)
description: Epac1 activation induces calcium release from the endoplasmic reticulum into the cytoplasm, raising cytosolic Ca2+ that serves as a second messenger. Directionally, Epac1 sits upstream of cytoplasmic Ca2+ elevation. The Ca2+ surge then activates calmodulin-dependent protein kinase kinase β (CaMKKβ), bridging cAMP signaling to AMPK activation. This couples resveratrol's PDE4 inhibition to metabolic kinase activation, and it is the key branching point that converts a rise in cyclic AMP into a change in cellular energy sensing. Disrupting any step in this cascade attenuates resveratrol's indirect activation of SIRT1.
description_zh_TW: Epac1 活化誘導鈣離子從內質網釋放到細胞質中，提高作為第二信使的細胞質 Ca2+。在方向性上，Epac1 位於細胞質 Ca2+ 升高的上游。Ca2+ 激增然後活化鈣調蛋白依賴性蛋白激酶激酶 β（CaMKKβ），將 cAMP 信號橋接到 AMPK 活化。這將白藜蘆醇的 PDE4 抑制與代謝激酶活化偶聯起來，是將環磷酸腺苷升高轉化為細胞能量感知變化的關鍵分支點。破壞此級聯中的任何一步都會減弱白藜蘆醇的間接 SIRT1 活化。

label: Vine Tea (Ampelopsis grossedentata)
description: Vine tea (Ampelopsis grossedentata) leaves contain 20-30% dihydromyricetin (DHM) by weight, so 1-1.5 g of dry leaf suffices for roughly a 300 mg therapeutic dose. Directionally, the botanical source sits upstream of DHM availability. DHM is a potent SIRT3 and AMPK activator, and this makes vine tea a practical natural source of the compound. The high DHM content distinguishes vine tea from most other botanical sources and supports its traditional use as a metabolic tonic. This abundance is a key practical advantage for studying and using DHM clinically.
description_zh_TW: 藤茶（Ampelopsis grossedentata）葉片含有 20-30% 的二氫楊梅素（DHM），因此 1-1.5 克乾葉即可提供約 300 mg 的治療劑量。在方向性上，植物來源位於 DHM 可用性的上游。DHM 是強效的 SIRT3 和 AMPK 活化劑，使藤茶成為該化合物的實用天然來源。高 DHM 含量使藤茶有別於大多數其他植物來源，並支持其作為代謝滋補品的傳統用途。這種豐度是研究和臨床使用 DHM 的關鍵實際優勢。

label: Peroxisome Biogenesis
description: AMP-activated protein kinase (AMPK), a master energy sensor activated by rising AMP/ATP ratios, lipid stress, or low glucose, promotes peroxisome biogenesis by stimulating lipid synthesis and incorporation of lipids into developing peroxisomal membranes. In disorders like ALD, however, VLCFA-driven AMPK activation is overwhelmed by the massive lipid load.
description_zh_TW: AMPK（AMP-activated protein kinase）是主要的能量感測器，會因 AMP/ATP 比值上升、脂質壓力或低血糖而活化；它透過刺激脂質合成並促進脂質嵌入發育中的過氧化物體膜來促進過氧化物體生成。然而在 ALD 等疾病中，VLCFA 驅動的 AMPK 活化仍敵不過巨大的脂質負荷。

label: PQQ
description: Pyrroloquinoline quinone (PQQ) is a small redox-active compound that acts as a potent promoter of mitochondrial biogenesis and stimulant of mitochondrial function. It modulates cellular redox state and activates PGC-1alpha-associated pathways that increase mitochondrial number.
description_zh_TW: 吡咯喹啉醌（PQQ）是小型氧化還原活性化合物，是粒線體生合成的強效促進劑與粒線體功能刺激劑。它調控細胞氧化還原狀態並活化增加粒線體數量的 PGC-1α 相關途徑。

label: Heat Stress
description: Controlled heat stress induces HSP70/90 chaperones for proteostasis, with Finnish sauna cohort CVD/dementia benefit. XenohormesisESIS-grade evidence for thermal hormesis.
description_zh_TW: 受控熱壓力誘發 HSP70/90 伴侶以維持蛋白穩態，芬蘭桑拿隊列具 CVD/失智益處。熱荷爾蒙的 xenohormesis 級證據。

label: Calmodulin
description: Calmodulin is the primary Ca2+ sensor in the cytosol, and Ca2+–calmodulin binding induces a conformational change that activates CaMKKβ, which then phosphorylates AMPK. This creates a feed-forward loop linking cytosolic Ca2+ to the AMPK–NAMPT–NAD+–SIRT1 axis, connecting calcium signalling to insulin sensitivity and exercise adaptation.
description_zh_TW: Calmodulin 是細胞質中主要的 Ca2+ 感測器，Ca2+ 與 calmodulin 結合後誘導構形改變而活化 CaMKKβ，後者再磷酸化 AMPK。這形成一個前饋迴路，把細胞質 Ca2+ 與 AMPK–NAMPT–NAD+–SIRT1 軸連結起來，將鈣離子訊號與胰島素敏感性及運動適應相連。

label: Compound C
description: Compound C (Dorsomorphin, BML-275) is a potent, selective and cell-permeable reversible ATP-competitive inhibitor of AMPK (Ki ≈ 109 nM), binding the kinase domain of the catalytic α subunit and preventing phosphorylation of targets such as ACC and TSC2. It is the most widely used pharmacological tool for establishing whether a phenotype requires AMPK activity.
description_zh_TW: Compound C（Dorsomorphin、BML-275）是強效、具選擇性且可穿透細胞的可逆性 AMPK ATP 競爭性抑制劑（Ki ≈ 109 nM），結合催化 α 次單元的激酶區並阻止 ACC 與 TSC2 等標的的磷酸化。它是判定某一表型是否需要 AMPK 活性時最廣泛使用的藥理工具。

label: CD206
description: CD206 (mannose receptor MRC1) is a canonical surface marker of alternatively activated (M2) macrophages. Its expression is induced by IL-4 and IL-13 and suppressed by inflammatory stimuli, making CD206 a defining M2 polarization marker.
description_zh_TW: CD206（甘露糖受體 MRC1）是交替活化（M2）巨噬細胞的典型表面標記。其表現由 IL-4 與 IL-13 誘導，並受發炎刺激抑制，使 CD206 成為 M2 極化的定義性標記。

label: S100A4
description: In a multi-DAMP TRIM screen including HMGB1, fibrinogen, and HSP90, only oligomeric S100A4 reached beta-glucan-level trained responses via TLR4/RAGE-MyD88 signaling. It upregulates IL-1/IL-6 programs and bypasses tolerance to subsequent LPS. Whether this reflects classical TRIM or prolonged priming remains unresolved.
description_zh_TW: 在包含 HMGB1、fibrinogen 與 HSP90 的多 DAMP TRIM 篩選中，只有 oligomeric S100A4 經由 TLR4/RAGE-MyD88 signaling 達到 beta-glucan 等級的訓練反應。它上調 IL-1/IL-6 程式並 bypass 對後續 LPS 的 tolerance。究屬 classical TRIM 或延長的 priming 仍未定論。

label: Soluble Urate
description: Soluble urate induces H3K27ac and H3K4me3 reprogramming in monocytes, and uric-acid priming followed by LPS restimulation boosts IL-1beta production. Methyltransferase inhibitors reverse this primed output. HDAC inhibition likewise modulates MSU-induced proinflammatory cytokines, tying urate training to histone control.
description_zh_TW: Soluble Urate 可在單核球中誘導 H3K27ac 與 H3K4me3 重編程，且 uric-acid priming 後再以 LPS 再刺激可提升 IL-1beta 產量。Methyltransferase inhibitors 可逆轉此 primed 輸出。HDAC inhibition 同樣調節 MSU 誘導的促發炎細胞激素，將 urate training 與 histone control 連結起來。

label: PARPs
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: As the innate immune response activates to fight infection, the activation of PARPs increases due to extensive DNA damage and IFN-induced MARylation (mono-ADP-ribosylation) of target SARS-CoV-2 proteins, and this PARP response is required for inhibition of viral replication. However, this antiviral effect is reversed by the ADP-ribosylhydrolase macrodomain of the viral nonstructural protein nsp3, whose activity is required for virulence. These findings indicate that key events in the innate immune response to viral infections occur within the infected cell's NAD+ metabolome, and boosting NAD+ content through NAM and NR kinase pathways may restore antiviral PARP functions to support
description_zh_TW: 當先天免疫反應活化以對抗感染時，由於廣泛的 DNA 損傷與 IFN 誘發的目標 SARS-CoV-2 蛋白 MARylation（單-ADP-核糖基化）作用，PARPs 的活化增加，而此 PARP 反應是抑制病毒複製所必需的。然而，此抗病毒效果被病毒非結構蛋白 nsp3 的 ADP-ribosylhydrolase（ADP-核糖水解酶）macrodomain 所逆轉，其活性為毒力所必需。這些發現指出，對病毒感染的先天免疫反應中的關鍵事件發生在被感染細胞的 NAD+ 代謝組內，而透過 NAM 與 NR 激酶路徑提升 NAD+ 含量可能恢復抗病毒 PARP 功能以支援

label: Damage-associated molecular pattern
description: HMGB1 is a chromatin protein released as a damage-associated molecular pattern (DAMP) from dying or stressed cells.
description_zh_TW: HMGB1 是一種染色質蛋白，從死亡或受壓細胞中以損傷相關分子模式（DAMP）的形式釋放。

label: Immunogenic cell death
description: HMGB1 release is a hallmark DAMP of immunogenic cell death, necessary for anticancer immune priming.
description_zh_TW: HMGB1 釋放是免疫原性細胞死亡的標誌性 DAMP，對抗癌免疫 priming 必不可少。

label: hs-CRP
description: High-sensitivity C-reactive protein (hs-CRP) is a high-sensitivity assay for C-reactive protein, an acute-phase reactant whose circulating concentration rises with systemic inflammation. It is the preferred marker for low-grade, chronic inflammation in monitoring protocols.
description_zh_TW: 高敏感 C 反應蛋白（hs-CRP）是 C 反應蛋白的高敏感檢測，C 反應蛋白是循環濃度隨全身發炎升高的急性期反應物。它是監測方案中低度慢性發炎的首選標記。

label: Training Versus Tolerance
description: Acute low-dose HMGB1 via RAGE/TLR2/TLR4 favors mTOR-driven glycolysis and weak TRIM, with splenocyte priming for enhanced LPS responses. Chronic or high-dose HMGB1-RAGE signaling instead raises SIRT1/AMPK activity, suppresses mTOR and FAO programs, and enforces tolerance. HMGB1 also represses CPT1a to tune the FAO/glycolysis balance in macrophages.
description_zh_TW: 急性低劑量 HMGB1 經由 RAGE/TLR2/TLR4 偏向 mTOR-driven glycolysis 與微弱 TRIM，並使 splenocyte priming 以增強 LPS 反應。慢性或高劑量 HMGB1-RAGE signaling 反而升高 SIRT1/AMPK activity，抑制 mTOR 與 FAO 程式，並強制進入 tolerance。HMGB1 還可抑制 CPT1a，以調節巨噬細胞中的 FAO/glycolysis 平衡。

label: Immune Complex
description: An immune complex is an aggregate of immunoglobulin bound to soluble antigen. Such complexes activate complement, engage Fc receptors on phagocytes and deposit in tissues, driving type III hypersensitivity reactions such as serum sickness, rheumatoid vasculitis and glomerulonephritis. They are functionally distinct from inflammasomes, which are cytosolic multiprotein scaffolds rather than antibody-based aggregates.
description_zh_TW: immune complex 是免疫球蛋白與可溶性抗原結合形成的聚集體。此類複合體會活化 complement、與吞噬細胞上的 Fc receptor 結合並沉積於組織，驅動血清病、類風濕性血管炎與腎小球腎炎等第三型過敏反應。它們在功能上不同於 inflammasome——後者是細胞質多蛋白支架，而非抗體形成的聚集體。

label: Th17 inflammatory profile
source_file: _document_ - Autophagy takes it all – autophagy inducers target immune aging.md
description: Metformin reverses the pro-inflammatory Th17 CD4+ T cell profile toward a more juvenile, balanced phenotype, an effect attributed to enhancement of autophagic flux within lymphocytes. By activating AMPK and inducing autophagy, metformin reduces the mitochondrial and metabolic perturbations that favor pathogenic Th17 differentiation. This phenotypic rebalancing may contribute to the drug's anti-inflammatory and immune-modulatory benefits beyond glycemic control. The observation links metformin's autophagy-inducing capacity to attenuation of age- and inflammation-associated T cell skewing.
description_zh_TW: Metformin 將促發炎的 Th17 CD4+ T 細胞譜系逆轉為更年輕、平衡的表型，此效應歸因於淋巴細胞內自噬流的增強。透過活化 AMPK 和誘導自噬，metformin 減少有利於致病性 Th17 分化的粒線體和代謝擾動。這種表型再平衡可能有助於該藥物超越血糖控制之外的抗發炎和免疫調節益處。此觀察將 metformin 誘導自噬的能力與減緩年齡和發炎相關的 T 細胞偏移聯繫起來。

label: Myeloid Differentiation
description: GM-CSF and CCL2 skew myeloid differentiation toward immunosuppressive MDSCs and specific macrophage phenotypes, reshaping the myeloid compartment in senescence and cancer. This biases haematopoiesis away from inflammatory resolution toward tolerance and suppression, exemplifying SASP-driven paracrine reprogramming of immune lineage fate. The relationship links SASP factors to myeloid lineage outcomes and is supported by myeloid-differentiation and tumor-immunology studies. Targeting these factors can restore protective myeloid responses.
description_zh_TW: GM-CSF 與 CCL2 將骨髓分化偏斜向免疫抑制性 MDSC 與特定巨噬細胞表型，重塑衰老與癌症中的骨髓區室。這將造血偏離發炎解決而朝向耐受與抑制，改變免疫景觀以利腫瘤進展與慢性發炎。在衰老中，此偏斜由 SASP 驅動，貢獻監視受損與免疫逃逸。它是連結分泌組到骨髓生成重塑的關鍵機制。

label: Procyanidin C1
description: Procyanidin C1 (PCC1) is an oligomeric proanthocyanidin with selective senolytic activity, killing senescent cells and extending healthspan in mice. It served as a positive senolytic control in the screen that identified apigenin as a senomorphic.
description_zh_TW: 原花青素 C1（PCC1）是具有選擇性 senolytic（清除衰老細胞）活性的寡聚原花青素，可清除衰老細胞並延長小鼠健康壽命。它在鑑定 apigenin 為 senomorphic 的篩選中作為陽性 senolytic 對照。

label: JQ1
description: JQ1 is the prototype BET inhibitor displacing BRD4 from acetylated histones and suppressing MYC. Tool-compound edge of the BET axis.
description_zh_TW: JQ1 是將 BRD4 從乙醯化組蛋白移開並抑制 MYC 的原型 BET 抑制劑。BET 軸的工具化合物邊。

label: STAT
description: JAK (Janus kinase) phosphorylates latent cytoplasmic STAT transcription factors on tyrosine residues, triggering their dimerization and nuclear translocation.
description_zh_TW: JAK（Janus 激酶）對潛伏於胞質的 STAT 轉錄因子進行酪胺酸磷酸化，促使其二聚化並轉位入核。

label: Immature Myeloid Cell
description: Myeloid-derived suppressor cells (MDSCs) are the most functionally important population of immature myeloid cells: rather than representing a single lineage, their classification reflects an arrested differentiation state with polymorphonuclear and monocytic subsets. They are scarce at steady state but expand dramatically under pathological stress, and are recruited into the tumor microenvironment where they suppress T-cell and NK-cell function through arginine depletion, reactive oxygen species and induction of regulatory T cells.
description_zh_TW: Myeloid-derived suppressor cells (MDSCs) 是 immature myeloid cells 中功能上最重要的族群：其分類反映的是一種分化停滯狀態（具有 polymorphonuclear 與 monocytic 亞群），而非單一譜系。她們在穩態下稀少，但在病理壓力下大幅擴張，並被招募進 tumor microenvironment，透過消耗 arginine、產生 reactive oxygen species 及誘導 regulatory T cells 來抑制 T 細胞與 NK 細胞功能。

label: TAME Trial
description: The TAME Trial (Targeting Aging with Metformin) is a FDA-approved clinical study testing whether Metformin delays aging-related multimorbidity. It enrolled 3000 participants aged 65 to 79 and examines whether metformin can attenuate the hallmarks of Aging and delay the onset of age-related diseases, using a framework of blood-based Biomarkers to monitor the intervention's effects.
description_zh_TW: TAME Trial（Targeting Aging with Metformin）是一項經 FDA 核准的臨床研究，測試 Metformin 能否延緩與老化相關的多病共存。它納入了 3000 名 65 至 79 歲的受試者，檢視 metformin 能否減弱老化的特徵並延後年齡相關疾病的發生，並以血液生物標記的框架監測介入的效應。

label: STAT1
description: Interferon-gamma receptor engagement activates the JAK kinases (JAK1, JAK2), which phosphorylate STAT1; phosphorylated STAT1 homodimers (GAF) translocate to the nucleus and bind gamma-activated sequences in the promoters of hundreds of interferon-stimulated genes.
description_zh_TW: Interferon-gamma 受體的接合活化 JAK 激酶（JAK1、JAK2），後者磷酸化 STAT1；被磷酸化的 STAT1 同源二聚體（GAF）轉位入核，結合數百個干擾素刺激基因啟動子上的 gamma 活化序列。

label: Pathological fibrosis
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: TGF-β1 activates SMAD3-dependent transcription of pro-fibrotic genes including COL1A1, COL3A1, FN1, ACTA2, and TIMP1, driving collagen deposition and tissue scarring in multiple organs. Directionally, TGF-β1 sits upstream of fibrogenesis. This makes TGF-β1 a central target in fibrosis therapeutics, and sirtuins that inhibit SMAD3 signaling, such as SIRT6 and SIRT7, are antifibrotic. Because fibrosis is the common final pathway of chronic organ injury, understanding the TGF-β1/SMAD3 axis is central to developing treatments for heart, lung, kidney, and liver fibrosis. Sirtuin activation is emerging as one such strategy.
description_zh_TW: TGF-β1 活化 SMAD3 依賴性的促纖維化基因轉錄，包括 COL1A1、COL3A1、FN1、ACTA2 和 TIMP1，驅動多個器官的膠原沉積和組織疤痕形成。在方向性上，TGF-β1 位於纖維化生成的上游。這使 TGF-β1 成為纖維化治療的核心靶標，而抑制 SMAD3 訊號的 sirtuin（如 SIRT6 和 SIRT7）具有抗纖維化作用。由於纖維化是慢性器官損傷的共同最終通路，理解 TGF-β1/SMAD3 軸線對開發心臟、肺、腎臟和肝臟纖維化的治療至關重要。Sirtuin 活化正成為此類策略之一。

label: N-cadherin
description: CDH2 encodes the N-cadherin protein product. Gene-to-protein definitional edge.
description_zh_TW: CDH2 編碼 N-cadherin 蛋白產物。基因到蛋白的定義邊。

label: FGF Receptor
description: N-cadherin engagement drives FGFR survival and motility signaling at the protein level; CDH2 gene used as canonical subject. Activation is the motility output.
description_zh_TW: N-cadherin 結合在蛋白層級驅動 FGFR 存活與遷移訊號；CDH2 基因用作典型主詞。活化是遷移輸出。

label: ABCA1 mutations
description: ABCA1 mutations cause Tangier disease, a rare disorder in which loss-of-function ABCA1 alleles lead to extremely low HDL and accumulation of cholesteryl esters in macrophages and other tissues. The defect blocks cholesterol efflux, producing enlarged orange tonsils and neuropathy. The directionality is transporter loss to lipid accumulation. A caveat is that incomplete versus complete loss of function yields a spectrum of severity, and modifier genes influence phenotype. Heterozygotes show intermediate HDL reduction, illustrating a gene-dosage effect and the clinical spectrum between Tangier disease and familial HDL deficiency.
description_zh_TW: ABCA1 mutations 導致 Tangier disease，這是一種罕見的疾病，其中 ABCA1 等位基因功能喪失導致 HDL 極低以及巨噬細胞和其他組織中膽固醇酯的累積。此缺陷阻礙了 cholesterol 的流出，導致橙色扁桃體增大和神經病變。方向性是轉運蛋白損失導致脂質累積。需要注意的是，不完全與完全功能喪失會產生一系列嚴重程度，且修飾基因會影響表型。雜合子表現出中等程度的 HDL 降低，說明了基因劑量效應以及 Tangier disease 和家族性 HDL 缺乏症之間的臨床光譜。

label: Cholesterol Homeostasis
description: ABCA1 regulates cholesterol homeostasis by mediating the efflux of cellular cholesterol and phospholipids to lipid-poor apolipoproteins such as apoA-I. This is the first step in reverse cholesterol transport and HDL biogenesis. The directionality is transporter activity to lipid export. A caveat is that ABCA1 also influences phospholipid trafficking and immune cell function, so its role extends beyond pure cholesterol handling. Loss of ABCA1 function underlies Tangier disease, and its deficiency in macrophages promotes foam-cell formation and accelerated atherosclerosis.
description_zh_TW: ABCA1 透過介導細胞 cholesterol 和磷脂質向脂質貧乏的 apolipoproteins（例如 apoA-I）的流出來調節 cholesterol homeostasis。這是reverse cholesterol transport和HDL生物發生的第一步。方向性是脂質輸出的轉運蛋白活性。需要注意的是，ABCA1 也影響磷脂運輸和免疫細胞功能，因此其作用超出了純粹的 cholesterol 處理範圍。 ABCA1 功能的喪失是 Tangier disease 的基礎，巨噬細胞中的 ABCA1 功能缺失會促進泡沫細胞的形成並加速 atherosclerosis。

label: Inflammatory Gene Expression
description: LXRalpha suppresses inflammatory gene expression, as SUMOylated LXRalpha recruits corepressors such as NCoR to NF-kappaB target promoters, dampening cytokine responses. This links cholesterol sensing to immune moderation. The directionality is LXRalpha to transcriptional repression of inflammation. A caveat is that the anti-inflammatory effect is gene- and context-specific and can be overshadowed by pro-lipogenic actions at high activation. This transrepression is SUMO-dependent and independent of DNA binding, distinguishing it from classic LXR agonist responses.
description_zh_TW: LXRalpha 抑制 inflammatory gene expression，因為 SUMO 化的 LXRalpha 會將 NCoR 等輔阻遏物招募到 NF-kappaB 目標啟動子上，從而抑制細胞激素反應。這將 cholesterol 感測與免疫調節聯繫起來。 LXRα 的方向性是發炎轉錄抑制。需要注意的是，抗發炎作用是基因和環境特異性的，並且可能被高活化時的促脂肪生成作用所掩蓋。這種反式抑制是 SUMO 依賴性的並且獨立於 DNA 結合，使其與經典的 LXR 激動劑反應區分開來。

label: Oxidized Phospholipids
description: PON1 hydrolyzes oxidized phospholipids on HDL, preventing their transfer to LDL and thereby protecting against lipoprotein oxidation. This paraoxonase activity is a key anti-atherogenic function of HDL. The directionality is enzyme to lipid-peroxide detoxification. A caveat is that PON1 activity is highly polymorphic in humans and is also reduced by oxidative stress, creating a variable defensive capacity. PON1 also hydrolyzes lactones and specific organophosphates, and its activity is used as an index of HDL antioxidant capacity.
description_zh_TW: PON1 水解 HDL 上的 oxidized phospholipids，防止轉移為 LDL，從而防止脂蛋白氧化。這種對氧磷酶活性是 HDL 的關鍵抗動脈粥狀硬化功能。方向性是酵素到脂質過氧化物解毒。需要注意的是，PON1 活性在人類中具有高度多態性，並且也會被 oxidative stress 降低，從而產生可變的防禦能力。 PON1也能水解內酯和特定的有機磷酸酯，其活性被用作HDL抗氧化能力的指標。

label: Oxysterols
description: LXRalpha is activated by oxysterols such as 22(R)-, 24(S)-, and 27-hydroxycholesterol, which serve as endogenous ligands that trigger the receptor's transcriptional program. This couples cellular cholesterol status to gene regulation. The directionality is oxysterol ligand to LXRalpha activation. A caveat is that synthetic LXR agonists activate more potently but can cause undesirable lipogenesis, revealing context-dependent outcomes. Because oxysterol levels rise with cholesterol oxidation, LXRalpha links oxidative stress to protective transcriptional responses.
description_zh_TW: LXRalpha 被 22(R)-、24(S)- 和 27-羥基cholesterol 等 oxysterols 激活，它們作為觸發受體轉錄程序的內源配體。這將細胞 cholesterol 狀態與基因調控結合。方向性是氧甾醇配體對LXRα 的活化。需要注意的是，合成 LXR 激動劑的活化作用更有效，但可能會導致不良的脂肪生成，從而揭示與環境相關的結果。由於氧甾醇水平隨著 cholesterol 氧化而升高，因此 LXRalpha 將 oxidative stress 與保護性轉錄反應聯繫起來。

label: Inflammatory Gene Promoters
description: oxLDL-trained monocytes gain H3K4me3 at inflammatory promoters, similar to beta-glucan training, and methyltransferase inhibitors block the trained cytokine output. H3K4me3/H3K27ac enrichment is also seen on the TNF-alpha promoter in monocytes from symptomatic atherosclerosis patients. The mark poises promoters for enhanced transcription upon rechallenge.
description_zh_TW: Oxidized LDL 訓練後的單核球在發炎啟動子處獲得 H3K4me3，類似於 beta-glucan 訓練，且 methyltransferase inhibitors 可阻斷訓練後的細胞激素輸出。在 symptomatic atherosclerosis 患者的單核球中，也可在 TNF-alpha 啟動子上看到 H3K4me3/H3K27ac 富集。該標記使啟動子處於 poised 狀態，以便再刺激時增強轉錄。

label: Heart disease
description: Atherosclerosis is the central mechanism of most cardiovascular events through endothelial injury to plaque. Causation records the etiology.
description_zh_TW: 動脈粥狀硬化經由內皮損傷到斑塊是多數心血管事件的中央機制。因果記錄病因。

label: Apolipoprotein A1
description: Apolipoprotein A1 is the primary protein component of HDL and the specific acceptor for ABCA1-mediated cholesterol efflux: ABCA1 transfers cholesterol and phospholipids to lipid-poor apoA-1, and lipidated apoA-1 then initiates HDL biogenesis and reverse cholesterol transport. Low apoA-1 levels are associated with increased atherosclerosis and cardiovascular disease risk. Resveratrol enhances apoA-1-mediated efflux by upregulating ABCA1.
description_zh_TW: Apolipoprotein A1 是 HDL 的主要蛋白質成分，也是 ABCA1 媒介膽固醇外排的特定受體：ABCA1 將膽固醇與磷脂轉移給脂質貧乏的 apoA-1，而經脂質化的 apoA-1 隨後啟動 HDL 生成與逆向膽固醇運輸。apoA-1 濃度偏低與動脈粥狀硬化及心血管疾病風險升高相關。Resveratrol 藉由上調 ABCA1 增強 apoA-1 媒介的外排。

label: Apolipoprotein E
description: Apolipoprotein E mediates cholesterol transport and clearance via LDL receptor family members, and the APOE gene has isoforms (ε2, ε3, ε4) with differential cardiovascular and neurodegenerative risk. ApoE-knockout mice spontaneously develop atherosclerosis and are a standard model; in these diabetic ApoE-KO mice, inhibiting DRP1 reduced endothelial dysfunction and lesion progression, showing excess mitochondrial fission contributes to atherogenesis.
description_zh_TW: Apolipoprotein E 透過 LDL receptor 家族成員介導膽固醇的運輸與清除，APOE 基因具有 ε2、ε3、ε4 等型，其心血管與神經退行性風險各不相同。ApoE 剔除小鼠會自發性產生動脈粥狀硬化，是標準模型；在這些糖尿病 ApoE-KO 小鼠中，抑制 DRP1 可減少內皮功能障礙與病灶進展，顯示過度的粒線體分裂促成動脈粥狀硬化形成。

label: SARS-CoV-2 Nsp3
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: The ADP-ribosylhydrolase macrodomain of the viral nonstructural protein nsp3 reverses the antiviral effect of PARPs, which is required for inhibition of viral replication during infection, and the activity of nsp3 is itself required for SARS-CoV-2 virulence. By removing mono-ADP-ribose (MARylation) marks deposited on viral proteins by IFN-induced PARP activation, nsp3 counteracts the host's antiviral ADP-ribosylation response. These events occur within the infected cell's NAD+ metabolome, and boosting NAD+ content through nicotinamide riboside and nicotinamide kinase pathways may restore antiviral PARP functions to support innate immunity to SARS-CoV-2.
description_zh_TW: 病毒非結構蛋白 nsp3 的 ADP-ribosylhydrolase（ADP-核糖水解酶）macrodomain 逆轉了 PARPs 的抗病毒效果，而後者為感染期間抑制病毒複製所必需，且 nsp3 的活性本身為 SARS-CoV-2 毒力所必需。透過移除由 IFN 誘發的 PARP 活化沉積在病毒蛋白上的 mono-ADP-ribose（MARylation，單-ADP-核糖）標記，nsp3 抵銷了宿主的抗病毒 ADP-ribosylation（ADP-核糖基化）反應。這些事件發生在被感染細胞的 NAD+ 代謝組內，而透過 nicotinamide riboside 與 nicotinamide 激酶路徑提升 NAD+ 含量可能恢復抗病毒 PARP 功能，以支援對 SARS-CoV-2 的先天免疫。

label: BRCA1 mutation
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: BRCA1-deficient tumors are exquisitely sensitive to PARP inhibitors because blocking base-excision (PARP) repair in the setting of defective homologous recombination causes catastrophic, lethal DNA damage through synthetic lethality. Directionally, BRCA1 mutation sits upstream of PARP-inhibitor vulnerability. This is a cornerstone of precision oncology, targeting the specific repair defect of the tumor. It illustrates how repair-pathway context determines therapeutic selectivity, and it has transformed the treatment of BRCA-mutated breast and ovarian cancer. Sirtuins that modulate repair pathways may influence sensitivity to such agents.
description_zh_TW: BRCA1 缺陷型腫瘤對 PARP 抑制劑高度敏感，因為在同源重組缺陷的情況下阻斷鹼基切除（PARP）修復會透過合成致死導致災難性的致死 DNA 損傷。在方向性上，BRCA1 突變位於 PARP 抑制劑脆弱性的上游。這是精準腫瘤學的基石，靶向腫瘤的特定修復缺陷。它說明了修復途徑情境如何決定治療選擇性，並已改變了 BRCA 突變乳腺癌和卵巢癌的治療。調控修復途徑的 sirtuin 可能影響對此類藥物的敏感性。

label: double-strand breaks in NHEJ
description: DNA ligase IV (LIG4) catalyzes the final phosphodiester-bond sealing step of non-homologous end joining with XRCC4/XLF. SIRT3 promotes NHEJ efficiency via 53BP1 recruitment and H3K56 deacetylation and interacts with DNA repair proteins including DNA ligase 4 to repair mtDNA damage.
description_zh_TW: DNA ligase IV（LIG4）催化非同源末端接合與 XRCC4/XLF 一起的最終磷酸二酯鍵封口步驟。SIRT3 透過 53BP1 招募和 H3K56 去乙醯化促進 NHEJ 效率，並與 DNA 修復蛋白（包括 DNA ligase 4）互動以修復 mtDNA 損傷。

label: Compensatory autophagy
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Loss of BRCA1 triggers increased autophagy as a compensatory survival mechanism in breast and ovarian cancers, buffering the viability impact of defective homologous recombination. Directionally, BRCA1 deficiency sits upstream of autophagic upregulation. This metabolic rewiring can be co-opted by tumors to survive despite genome instability, and it connects genome-maintenance failure to lysosomal clearance pathways. Because autophagy supports the survival of BRCA-deficient cells, combining PARP inhibitors with autophagy inhibitors is being explored as a therapeutic strategy. The compensatory autophagy illustrates how cancer cells adapt to DNA-repair defects.
description_zh_TW: BRCA1 的缺失觸發自噬增加作為乳腺和卵巢癌中的代償性存活機制，緩衝同源重組缺陷對細胞活性的影響。在方向性上，BRCA1 缺陷位於自噬上調的上游。這種代謝重編程可被腫瘤利用在基因組不穩定的情況下存活，將基因組維護失敗與溶酶體清除途徑聯繫起來。由於自噬支持 BRCA 缺陷細胞的存活，正在探索將 PARP 抑制劑與自噬抑制劑結合的治療策略。代償性自噬說明了癌細胞如何適應 DNA 修復缺陷。

label: NAM (nicotinamide) and O-acetyl-ADP-ribose
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Sirtuin-catalyzed deacetylation couples the cleavage of NAD+ to the removal of acetyl groups from lysine residues. Each round of deacetylation converts one molecule of NAD+ into nicotinamide (NAM) and O-acetyl-ADP-ribose. NAM then acts as an end-product inhibitor of sirtuins by binding to a conserved pocket adjacent to the NAD+ site, thereby blocking further NAD+ hydrolysis. This product-based feedback links cellular NAD+ status and NAM levels directly to sirtuin enzymatic output.
description_zh_TW: Sirtuin催化的去乙醯化反應將NAD+的裂解與賴氨酸殘基上乙醯基的移除耦合。每輪去乙醯化將一分子NAD+轉化為菸鹼醯胺（NAM）和O-乙醯-ADP-核糖。NAM隨後作為sirtuin的末端產物抑制劑，結合到與NAD+位點相鄰的保守口袋，從而阻斷進一步的NAD+水解。這種基於產物的反饋直接將細胞NAD+狀態和NAM水平與sirtuin酵素輸出聯繫起來。

label: EREG
description: EREG (epiregulin) is a transmembrane EGFR-family ligand secreted by senescent stromal cells as part of the SASP. It promotes cancer therapy resistance and immunosuppression, and apigenin treatment reverses the elevated circulating EREG induced by chemotherapy.
description_zh_TW: EREG（epiregulin）是衰老基質細胞作為 SASP 一部分分泌的穿膜 EGFR 家族配體。它促進癌症治療抗藥性與免疫抑制，而 apigenin 治療可逆转化療誘導升高的循環 EREG。

label: WNT16B
description: WNT16B is a Wnt family ligand induced and secreted by senescent stromal cells as part of the SASP, where it promotes paracrine therapy resistance in adjacent cancer cells. Apigenin treatment reduces WNT16B expression dose-dependently.
description_zh_TW: WNT16B 是衰老基質細胞作為 SASP 一部分誘導並分泌的 Wnt 家族配體，在相鄰癌細胞中促進旁分泌治療抗藥性。Apigenin 治療以劑量依賴方式降低 WNT16B 表現。

label: AIF
description: Apoptosis-inducing factor translocates from mitochondria to the nucleus with MIF to execute large-scale DNA fragmentation in parthanatos. This caspase-independent route distinguishes parthanatos from classical apoptosis.
description_zh_TW: Apoptosis-inducing factor 與 MIF 從粒線體轉位至核，在 parthanatos 中執行大規模 DNA 片段化。此 caspase 非依賴途徑區分 parthanatos 與典型凋亡。

label: nNOS
description: In male ischemic neurons, nNOS-derived peroxynitrite drives the DNA damage that hyperactivates PARP1; nNOS blockade protects males by cutting off parthanatos at its source.
description_zh_TW: 在雄性缺血神經元中，nNOS 衍生的 peroxynitrite 造成 DNA 損傷並使 PARP1 過度活化；阻斷 nNOS 可從源頭切斷 parthanatos，保護雄性。

label: PJ-34
description: PJ-34 is a PARP inhibitor that blocks parthanatos by preventing PARP1 hyperactivation and downstream PAR/AIF/MIF signaling; in stroke models it protects males only.
description_zh_TW: PJ-34 是 PARP 抑制劑，透過阻止 PARP1 過度活化及下游 PAR/AIF/MIF 訊號來阻斷 parthanatos；在中風模型中僅保護雄性。

label: O-acetyl-ADP-ribose
description: ARH3 hydrolyzes O-acetyl-ADP-ribose, the sirtuin deacetylation byproduct that regulates SIRT activity, TRPM2 gating and redox, using the same Mg2+-dependent alpha-anomer stereospecific mechanism as for PAR and serine-ADPr.
description_zh_TW: ARH3 以與 PAR 及絲氨酸 ADPr 相同的 Mg2+ 依賴、alpha-anomer 立體專一機制，水解 sirtuin 去乙醯化副產物 O-acetyl-ADP-ribose，該分子調控 SIRT 活性、TRPM2 通道與氧化還原。

label: Cyclophilin A
description: Cyclophilin A is proposed to form an AIF-cyclophilin A-histone H2AX complex in which AIF provides nuclease activity for large-scale DNA fragmentation, an alternative to the MIF/PAAN nuclease model of AIF-dependent parthanatos (Moura et al. 2024).
description_zh_TW: Cyclophilin A 被提出與 AIF 及組蛋白 H2AX 形成複合體，其中由 AIF 提供核酸酶活性以進行大規模 DNA 斷裂，為 AIF 依賴性 parthanatos 中 MIF/PAAN 核酸酶模型之外的替代機制（Moura et al. 2024）。

label: MMS
description: MMS is a direct-acting methylating agent whose DNA lesions (mainly N3-methyladenine and N7-methylguanine, repaired by base excision repair) activate PARP1 and can trigger PARP1-dependent parthanatos, alongside apoptosis at other doses (Moura et al. 2024).
description_zh_TW: MMS 是直接作用的甲基化劑，其 DNA 損傷（主要為 N3-methyladenine 與 N7-methylguanine，經鹼基切除修復）會活化 PARP1，並可觸發依賴 PARP1 的 parthanatos，於其他劑量下亦可引發 apoptosis（Moura et al. 2024）。

label: PARG53
description: PARG53 is a catalytically active ~53-kDa splice isoform of PARG (exons 1-8) described in 2026; its existence revises the prior PARG55/60 annotation and explains why exon 2-7 knockout clones can retain PAR-hydrolytic activity and still die, confounding knockout-versus-inhibitor comparisons (bioRxiv 2026.05.12.724507).
description_zh_TW: PARG53 是 2026 年描述的 PARG 具催化活性之約 53 kDa 剪接異構體（外顯子 1-8）；其存在修正了先前的 PARG55/60 註解，並解釋為何外顯子 2-7 敲除株仍可保留 PAR 水解活性並死亡，因而混淆了敲除與抑制劑的比較（bioRxiv 2026.05.12.724507）。

label: Ca2+ overload
description: Ca2+ overload is the sustained rise of cytosolic free calcium from ~100 nM toward micromolar levels after ATP-dependent extrusion fails, via reverse-mode Na+/Ca2+ exchange, voltage-gated channels and ER release. It is a point-of-no-return intermediate in necrosis: calcium activates calpain cysteine proteases, opens the mitochondrial permeability transition pore, stimulates phospholipases and loads mitochondria until membrane potential collapses. Calcium chelation protects renal ischemia-reperfusion and H2O2 models but not MNNG parthanatos, making the step context-obligatory rather than universal.
description_zh_TW: Ca2+ overload 是 ATP 依賴性排出失效後，經由 Na+/Ca2+ 交換體反向模式、電壓閘控通道與內質網釋放，使胞質游離鈣由約 100 nM 上升至微莫耳濃度。它是壞死過程中無法回頭的中間步驟：鈣會活化 calpain 半胱胺酸蛋白酶、開啟粒線體通透性轉換孔、刺激磷脂酶並使粒線體負載鈣，直至膜電位崩潰。鈣螯合可保護腎臟缺血再灌流與 H2O2 模型，但無法保護 MNNG 引發的 parthanatos，顯示此步驟依情境而定並非普遍必要。

label: MitoQ
description: MitoQ reduces mitochondrial ROS as a mitochondria-targeted ubiquinone derivative that accumulates in the matrix and chain-breaks peroxyl radicals at their source. By concentrating antioxidant capacity inside mitochondria, it limits the downstream damage from leaked electrons. The directionality is targeted antioxidant to lowered mitochondrial oxidant burden. A caveat is that high doses of MitoQ can accumulate and potentially act as a pro-oxidant by virtue of its redox-cycling quinone structure. MitoQ has shown benefit in models of ischemia-reperfusion, neurodegeneration, and age-related vascular dysfunction.
description_zh_TW: MitoQ 將 mitochondrial ROS 還原為 mitochondria 靶向泛醌衍生物，該衍生物在基質中積累，並在其源頭斷鏈過氧自由基。透過將抗氧化能力集中在 mitochondria 內部，它限制了洩漏電子對下游的損害。方向性是靶向抗氧化劑以降低mitochondria1氧化劑負荷。需要注意的是，高劑量的 MitoQ 可能會積累，並可能因其氧化還原循環醌結構而充當促氧化劑。 MitoQ 在缺血再灌注、neurodegeneration 和年齡相關血管功能障礙模型中顯示出益處。

label: JNK Activation
description: Mitochondrial ROS are required for JNK activation downstream of TNFR1, representing an obligatory event in sustained JNK signaling that drives apoptosis and inflammation. The oxidants act as upstream amplifiers of the kinase cascade. The directionality is mtROS to JNK activation. A caveat is that JNK can also be activated by non-mitochondrial ROS and by MAPKKK upstream of mitochondria, so the requirement is context-dependent. Persistent JNK activation downstream of mitochondrial ROS promotes apoptosis and is implicated in stress-induced tissue injury.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial ROS 是 TNFR1 的 JNK activation 下游所必需的，代表驅動 apoptosis 和發炎的持續 JNK 訊號傳導中的必然事件。氧化剂充当激酶级联的上游放大器。方向性是mtROS 到JNK activation。需要注意的是，JNK 也可以由非 mitochondrial ROS 和 mitochondria 上游的 MAPKKK 激活，因此該要求取決於上下文。 mitochondrial ROS 下游持續存在的 JNK activation 會促進 apoptosis，並參與壓力誘發的組織損傷。

label: SMAD7 downregulation in TGF-beta signaling
description: Mitochondrial ROS are required for SMAD7 downregulation in TGF-beta signaling, as mtROS promote removal of this negative feedback inhibitor, permitting full Smad2/3 activation. This embeds mitochondria within the TGF-beta pathway. The directionality is mtROS to loss of SMAD7 restraint. A caveat is that SMAD7 is also regulated by ubiquitination and other mechanisms, so ROS modulates rather than exclusively controls it. This places mitochondria as regulators of TGF-beta signaling strength and explains why mitochondrial antioxidants blunt fibrosis in some models.
description_zh_TW: SMAD7 downregulation in TGF-beta signaling 需要 Mitochondrial ROS，因為 mtROS 促進去除這種負回饋抑制劑，從而允許完全活化 Smad2/3。這將 mitochondria 嵌入到 TGF-beta 路徑中。方向性是 mtROS 到 SMAD7 失去約束。需要注意的是，SMAD7 也受到泛素化和其他機制的調節，因此 ROS 調節而不是專門控制它。這使得 mitochondria 成為 TGF-beta 訊號強度的調節器，並解釋了為什麼 mitochondrial antioxidants 在某些模型中會鈍化 fibros。

label: TNFR1 signaling
description: TNFR1 signaling generates mitochondrial ROS when TRAF2 recruits TRIM21, causing electron leak at Complex I and raising mtROS. These ROS then propagate the TNFR1 pro-inflammatory and pro-death program. The directionality is receptor signaling to mitochondrial oxidant production. A caveat is that TNFR1 also engages cytosolic NOX and other ROS sources, so mitochondria are one node in the oxidative response. This mitochondrial ROS signal contributes to necroptosis and inflammatory gene induction downstream of TNF-alpha, and can be suppressed by mitochondrial-targeted antioxidants.
description_zh_TW: 當 TRAF2 招募 TRIM21 時，TNFR1 signaling 產生 mitochondrial ROS，導致複合物 I 處的電子洩漏併升高 mtROS。然後，這些 ROS 傳播 TNFR1 促發炎和促死亡程序。方向性是針對mitochondria1氧化劑所產生的受體訊號傳導。需要注意的是，TNFR1 也參與胞質 NOX 和其他 ROS 來源，因此 mitochondria 是氧化反應中的一個節點。此mitochondrial ROS訊號有助於necroptosis和TNF-alpha下游的發炎基因誘導，並且可以被靶向mitochondria1的antioxidants抑制。

label: Succinate
description: Succinate oxidation at Complex II drives reverse electron transport at Complex I, bursting mitochondrial ROS that stabilize HIF-1alpha and interleukin-1beta. Metabolite oxidation signals immune activation.
description_zh_TW: Complex II 的琥珀酸氧化驅動 Complex I 逆向電子傳遞，爆發粒線體 ROS 以穩定 HIF-1alpha 與 interleukin-1beta。代謝物氧化傳遞免疫活化訊號。

label: Angiotensin II
description: NADPH oxidase is activated by angiotensin II via the AT1 receptor, which triggers assembly of NOX isoforms (especially NOX1) in vascular smooth muscle and endothelial cells. This couples the renin-angiotensin system to vascular oxidative stress and hypertension. The directionality is hormone to enzyme activation. A caveat is that AT1 signaling also activates other ROS sources and inflammatory pathways, so NOX is a major but not sole mediator of angiotensin-II effects. Angiotensin-II-driven NOX activation is a well-established mechanism in hypertension, contributing to vascular remodeling and target-organ damage.
description_zh_TW: NADPH oxidase 被 angiotensin II 透過 AT1 受體激活，從而觸發血管平滑肌和內皮細胞中 NOX 同工型（尤其是 NOX1）的組裝。這將腎素-血管緊張素系統與血管 oxidative stress 和高血壓聯繫起來。方向性是荷爾蒙到酵素的活化。需要注意的是，AT1 訊號傳導也會活化其他 ROS 來源和發炎途徑，因此 NOX 是血管張力素 II 效應的主要但不是唯一的介質。血管張力素 II 驅動的 NOX 活化是高血壓的一種成熟機制，有助於血管重塑和目標器官損傷。

label: Uncoupled eNOS
description: Uncoupled eNOS produces superoxide radicals when BH4 or L-arginine becomes limiting, causing the enzyme to redirect electron flow from NO synthesis to oxygen reduction. This converts the principal vascular protective enzyme into a ROS source. The directionality is cofactor deficiency to superoxide generation. A caveat is that partial uncoupling may still yield some NO, and the transition is graded rather than binary. This uncoupling is a central mechanism of endothelial dysfunction in hypertension, diabetes, and atherosclerosis, and therapies that restore BH4 or arginine aim to re-couple the enzyme.
description_zh_TW: 當 BH4 或 L-arginine 受到限制時，Uncoupled eNOS 會產生 superoxide radicals，導致酵素將電子流從 NO 合成重新導向到氧還原。這將主要的血管保護酶轉化為 ROS 源。方向性是超氧化物生成的輔因子缺乏。需要注意的是，部分解耦仍可能產生一些 NO，而且轉變是分級的而不是二元的。這種解偶聯是 endothelial dysfunction 在高血壓、糖尿病和 atherosclerosis 中的核心機制，恢復 BH4 或精氨酸的療法旨在重新偶聯該酶。

label: Innate Immune Defense
description: iNOS produces high-output NO for innate immune defense, generating micromolar NO in activated macrophages and other innate cells to kill intracellular pathogens. This sustained output is transcriptionally induced by cytokines and microbial products. The directionality is immune activation to bactericidal NO burst. A caveat is that the same high NO combines with superoxide to form peroxynitrite, causing collateral nitrative tissue damage. Because its expression is transcriptionally controlled, iNOS is absent from resting cells but appears within hours of cytokine or pathogen exposure.
description_zh_TW: iNOS為innate immune defense產生高輸出NO，在活化的巨噬細胞和其他先天細胞中產生微摩爾NO以殺死細胞內病原體。這種持續的輸出是由細胞激素和微生物產物轉錄誘導的。方向性是對殺菌性NO爆發的免疫活化。需要注意的是，同樣高的 NO 與超氧化物結合形成 peroxynitrite，導致附帶的硝化組織損傷。因為其表現受轉錄控制，所以 iNOS 在靜止細胞中不存在，但在細胞激素或病原體暴露後數小時內出現。

label: 3-Nitrotyrosine
description: 3-nitrotyrosine is a biomarker for nitrative stress, reflecting peroxynitrite- or myeloperoxidase-mediated nitration of protein tyrosines. It is elevated across many inflammatory and neurodegenerative conditions. The directionality is nitrative insult to stable protein modification. A caveat is that 3-nitrotyrosine can arise from multiple nitrating pathways and can be repaired or degraded, so it indicates historical rather than instantaneous nitrative load. Quantification in plasma, CSF, and tissue by mass spectrometry or immunoassay has made 3-NT a standard endpoint in redox biomarker studies.
description_zh_TW: 3-nitrotyrosine 是 nitrative stress 的生物標記物，反映 peroxynitrite 或 myeloperoxidase 介導的蛋白質 tyrosines 硝化。它會導致許多發炎和神經退化性疾病。方向性是對穩定蛋白質修飾的硝化損害。需要注意的是，3-nitrotyrosine 可以由多種硝化途徑產生，並且可以修復或降解，因此它表示歷史硝化負荷而不是瞬時硝化負荷。透過質譜或免疫分析對血漿、腦脊髓液和組織進行定量，使 3-NT 成為氧化還原生物標記研究的標準終點。

label: Hypotension
description: Massive nitric oxide release during septic shock, anaphylaxis, or post-cardiopulmonary bypass vasoplegia causes excessive vasodilation and life-threateningly low blood pressure (hypotension). NO overproduction is driven largely by the inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNOS) enzyme during the inflammatory response. Therapeutic strategies target this cascade at different levels: aminoguanidine inhibits iNOS to block NO synthesis upstream, while methylene blue inhibits soluble guanylyl cyclase to block NO signaling downstream and restore blood pressure when vasopressors fail.
description_zh_TW: 在敗血症性休克、過敏反應或心肺分流術後血管麻痺期間，大量一氧化氮釋放導致過度血管舒張和危及生命的低血壓（低血壓）。NO過度產生主要由誘導型一氧化氮合酶（iNOS）在炎症反應期間驅動。治療策略在不同層面靶向此級聯：氨基胍抑制iNOS以在上游阻斷NO合成，而亞甲藍抑制可溶性鳥苷酸環化酶以在下游阻斷NO信號並在血管加壓素失效時恢復血壓。

label: Lipids
description: Nitrative stress nitrates unsaturated fatty acids to yield nitrated lipids such as nitrolinoleic acid and nitro-oleic acid. Unlike the destructive protein modifications, nitrated lipids act as endogenous signaling molecules that activate PPARgamma and inhibit NF-kB signaling, representing a negative feedback loop in inflammation. They also undergo Michael addition with cysteine thiols to activate the Nrf2 antioxidant program.
description_zh_TW: Nitrative stress 硝化不飽和脂肪酸，產生 nitrated lipids，例如 nitrolinoleic acid 和 nitro-oleic acid。與破壞性的蛋白質修飾不同，nitrated lipids 作為內源性 signaling molecules，活化 PPARgamma 並抑制 NF-kB 訊號，構成發炎中的負回饋迴路。它們也會與半胱胺酸硫醇進行 Michael addition，活化 Nrf2 抗氧化程序。

label: Methotrexate
description: Methotrexate, a first-line disease-modifying antirheumatic drug, increases extracellular adenosine, which suppresses NADPH Oxidase activity in neutrophils and inhibits TNF-induced ROS production in synovial fibroblasts, blunting oxidative joint damage in Rheumatoid Arthritis.
description_zh_TW: Methotrexate 是第一線的疾病修飾抗發炎藥物，它提高細胞外 adenosine，進而抑制 Neutrophils 中的 NADPH Oxidase 活性並阻止滑膜纖維母細胞中 TNF 誘發的 ROS 產生，減輕 Rheumatoid Arthritis 的氧化性關節損傷。

label: Yeast
description: Overexpression of the sirtuin Sir2 extends lifespan in budding yeast by suppressing the formation of toxic extrachromosomal rDNA circles. Sir2 maintains silencing at the rDNA locus, and its activity prevents the homologous recombination events that generate these circles during aging. This early discovery established sirtuins as longevity regulators and motivated extensive study of their mammalian homologs, particularly SIRT1, in aging and age-related disease, including the search for small-molecule sirtuin activators.
description_zh_TW: Sirtuin Sir2 的過度表現可透過抑制有毒染色體外 rDNA 環的形成來延長芽殖酵母的壽命。 Sir2 在 rDNA 基因座上保持沉默，其活性可防止在老化過程中產生這些環的同源重組事件。這項早期發現確立了去乙醯化酶作為長壽調節劑的地位，並推動了對其哺乳動物同源物（特別是 SIRT1）在衰老和年齡相關疾病中的廣泛研究，包括尋找小分子去乙醯化酶激活劑。

label: Mono-ADP-ribosyl transferases
description: Beyond deacetylation, several sirtuins catalyze mono-ADP-ribosylation, transferring the ADP-ribose moiety of NAD+ onto target proteins without removing an acetyl group. SIRT4 and SIRT6 prominently display this mono-ADP-ribosyltransferase activity, with SIRT6 using it to recruit heterochromatin proteins such as KAP1/HP1α. The directionality is that NAD+ is the donor and the target lysine (or other residue) is the acceptor, producing a mono-ADP-ribosylated product rather than free OAADPr. Biologically, ADP-ribosylation allows sirtuins to regulate processes—such as DNA repair and LINE-1 repression—distinct from their deacetylase functions.
description_zh_TW: 除了去乙醯化作用外，多種 sirtuin 還能催化單 ADP-核糖基化，將 NAD+ 的 ADP-核糖基團轉移到目標蛋白上，而不移除乙醯基。SIRT4 和 SIRT6 顯著表現出這種單 ADP-核糖基轉移酶活性，其中 SIRT6 利用該活性招募異染色質蛋白如 KAP1/HP1α。其方向性為 NAD+ 作為供體，目標離胺酸（或其他殘基）作為受體，產生單 ADP-核糖基化的產物而非游離的 OAADPr。在生物學上，ADP-核糖基化允許 sirtuin 調節 DNA 修復和 LINE-1 抑制等過程，這些功能與其去乙醯酶功能不同。

label: p53 (via hyperacetylation)
description: By inhibiting SIRT1/SIRT2-mediated deacetylation, Tenovins promote p53 hyperacetylation and reactivation of p53-dependent transcriptional networks. Directionally, Tenovin-mediated sirtuin inhibition sits upstream of p53 activation. This restores p53 tumor-suppressive function in cells where sirtuins silence it, and it is the basis for Tenovins' anticancer activity. Because p53 is a central tumor suppressor, its reactivation by sirtuin inhibition represents a compelling strategy for p53-wild-type tumors. The hyperacetylation increases p53 stability and transcriptional potency, driving cell-cycle arrest and apoptosis.
description_zh_TW: 透過抑制 SIRT1/SIRT2 介導的去乙醯化，Tenovin 促進 p53 超乙醯化和 p53 依賴性轉錄網路的重新活化。在方向性上，Tenovin 介導的 sirtuin 抑制位於 p53 活化的上游。這在 sirtuin 沉默 p53 的細胞中恢復其腫瘤抑制功能，是 Tenovin 抗癌活性的基礎。由於 p53 是核心腫瘤抑制因子，透過 sirtuin 抑制重新活化它是 p53 野生型腫瘤的引人注目策略。超乙醯化增加 p53 穩定性和轉錄效力，驅動細胞週期阻滯和凋亡。

label: mTOR signaling
source_file: _document_ - The Sirtuin Network Linking NAD+ Metabolism, Mitochondrial Function, and Metabolic Homoeostasis.md
description: Nutrient abundance activates the mTOR pathway, which promotes anabolic processes such as protein synthesis and lipid accumulation while suppressing autophagy. Sirtuins counterbalance this anabolic state by favoring catabolic pathways that restore metabolic equilibrium. Directionally, sirtuins and mTOR act as opposed nutrient-sensing axes. This opposition is most evident during caloric restriction or fasting, when falling nutrient signals dampen mTOR while NAD+-sensitive sirtuins drive fatty-acid oxidation, mitochondrial maintenance, and autophagy.
description_zh_TW: 營養豐富活化mTOR通路，促進蛋白質合成和脂質積累等合成代謝過程，同時抑制自噬。Sirtuin透過有利於恢復代謝平衡的分解代謝途徑來平衡此合成代謝狀態。方向上，sirtuin和mTOR作為對立的營養感知軸。這種對抗在熱量限制或禁食時最為明顯，此時營養訊號下降抑制mTOR，而NAD+敏感的sirtuin驅動脂肪酸氧化、粒線體維護和自噬。

label: PARP1 and PARP2
source_file: _document_ - The Sirtuin Network Linking NAD+ Metabolism, Mitochondrial Function, and Metabolic Homoeostasis.md
description: PARP1 and PARP2 are major NAD+-consuming enzymes whose activity can deplete cellular NAD+ pools and compromise sirtuin function, creating competition for the same limited co-substrate. Directionally, PARP activity sits upstream of NAD+ consumption and reduced sirtuin availability. This competition is especially relevant during DNA damage, when PARP activation surges and rapidly consumes NAD+ to synthesize ADP-ribose polymers. Because both PARPs and sirtuins are essential for genome maintenance and stress responses, their shared dependence on NAD+ creates an intrinsic trade-off.
description_zh_TW: PARP1和PARP2是主要的NAD+消耗酶，其活性可以耗竭細胞NAD+池並損害sirtuin功能，造成對相同有限共同底物的競爭。方向上，PARP活性位於NAD+消耗和sirtuin可用性降低的上游。這種競爭在DNA損傷期間尤為重要，因為PARP活化急劇上升並迅速消耗NAD+以合成ADP-核糖聚合物。由於PARP和sirtuin都對基因組維護和壓力反應至關重要，它們對NAD+的共同依賴造成了一種內在的權衡。

label: Adenosine-binding site with kinases
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: Sirtuins and protein kinases both contain an adenosine-binding pocket in their catalytic machinery, an overlap that allowed screening of known kinase inhibitors against SIRT2. This shared scaffold led to the discovery that bisindolylmaleimides such as Ro31-8220 and indolinones such as GW5074 inhibit SIRT1 and SIRT2 in the low micromolar range. Directionally, the shared adenosine site is the molecular basis for cross-inhibition between kinase inhibitors and sirtuins, but it also means these compounds retain kinase activity, complicating the attribution of cellular effects to sirtuin inhibition alone.
description_zh_TW: Sirtuin 和蛋白激酶在其催化機制中都包含一個腺嘌呤結合口袋，這種重疊使得已知激酶抑制劑對 SIRT2 的篩選成為可能。這種共享的骨架結構導致發現雙吲哚基馬來酰亞胺如 Ro31-8220 和吲哚啉酮如 GW5074 在低微摩爾範圍內抑制 SIRT1 和 SIRT2。方向性上共享的腺嘌呤位點是激酶抑制劑和 sirtuin 之間交叉抑制的分子基礎，但也意味著這些化合物保留了激酶活性，使將細胞效應歸因於單純 sirtuin 抑制變得複雜。

label: Xenograft models
description: Tenovin-1 and Tenovin-6 significantly delay tumor growth in human cancer mouse xenografts at single-digit micromolar concentrations. Directionally, Tenovin treatment sits upstream of reduced tumor growth. This effect is attributed to p53 reactivation and sirtuin inhibition, and it validates sirtuin inhibition as an anticancer strategy in p53-wild-type tumors. The xenograft data demonstrate that sirtuin inhibitors can exert anti-tumor efficacy in vivo, complementing the extensive in vitro evidence. These results support the continued development of sirtuin inhibitors for oncology, particularly in combination with DNA-damaging agents.
description_zh_TW: Tenovin-1 和 Tenovin-6 在個位數微摩爾濃度下顯著延緩人腫瘤小鼠異種移植模型中的腫瘤生長。在方向性上，Tenovin 治療位於減少腫瘤生長的上游。此效應歸因於 p53 重新活化和 sirtuin 抑制，驗證了 sirtuin 抑制作為 p53 野生型腫瘤抗癌策略。異種移植數據表明 sirtuin 抑制劑可以在體內發揮抗腫瘤療效，與大量體外證據互補。這些結果支持繼續開發用於腫瘤學的 sirtuin 抑制劑，特別是與 DNA 損傷藥物的組合使用。

label: Rossmann fold domain
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: The conserved catalytic core of sirtuins features a large Rossmann fold domain typical of NAD+ binding proteins, together with a small zinc-binding domain and flexible loops that bring the two domains together around an extended cleft for cofactor and substrate. The Rossmann domain contains six parallel beta-strands and a Gly-X-Gly phosphate-binding motif. Directionally, this architecture is intrinsic to the sirtuin family and explains their strict NAD+ dependence. Understanding the structure underscores why NAD+ analogs and pocket C binders act as sirtuin modulators.
description_zh_TW: Sirtuin 的保守催化核心具有大型 Rossmann 摺疊結構域，這是 NAD+ 結合蛋白的典型特徵，還有一個小型鋅結合結構域和柔性環，將兩個結構域圍繞在一個延伸的溝槽周圍以容納輔因子和受質。Rossmann 結構域包含六條平行 beta 鏈和一個 Gly-X-Gly 磷酸鹽結合基序。方向性上這種架構是 sirtuin 家族固有的，解釋了其嚴格的 NAD+ 依賴性。理解此結構凸顯了為何 NAD+ 類似物和口袋 C 結合分子可作為 sirtuin 調節劑。

label: NAD+-dependent enzyme
description: The sirtuin family comprises seven mammalian members (SIRT1–SIRT7) plus the ancestral yeast Sir2, all sharing an NAD+-dependent catalytic core that performs deacetylation and ADP-ribosylation. They differ in subcellular localization—nuclear (SIRT1, SIRT6, SIRT7), cytoplasmic (SIRT2), and mitochondrial (SIRT3, SIRT4, SIRT5)—which dictates their substrate portfolios. The directionality is that NAD+ is the obligate co-substrate for every family member. This unifying dependence ties sirtuin activity to the cellular energy and redox state.
description_zh_TW: Sirtuin 家族包含七個哺乳動物成員（SIRT1–SIRT7）加上祖先型酵母 Sir2，均共享一個 NAD+ 依賴性催化核心，執行去乙醯化和 ADP-核糖基化。它們在次細胞定位上有所不同——核內（SIRT1、SIRT6、SIRT7）、細胞質（SIRT2）和粒線體（SIRT3、SIRT4、SIRT5）——這決定了它們的受質譜。其方向性為 NAD+ 是每個家族成員的必需共同受質。這種統一的依賴性將 sirtuin 活性與細胞能量和氧化還原狀態聯繫起來。

label: five classes (I-IV and U)
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: The sirtuin family has been classified into five distinct classes (I-IV and U) based on a phylogenetic study of sirtuins from a wide range of prokaryotes and eukaryotes. SIR-2.1, Drosophila melanogaster Sir2 (D.mel1), Hst1, and SIRT1 all belong to subclass Ia. Subclass Ib includes Hst2, D.mel2, and various fungi and protozoa sirtuins along with SIRT2 and SIRT3. SIRT4 and SIRT5 belong to classes II and III, respectively. SIRT6 and SIRT7 belong to Class IV, which includes only eukaryotic sirtuins. Sir2 homologues from bacteria with undifferentiated motifs constitute class U.
description_zh_TW: Sirtuin家族根據對廣泛原核和真核生物sirtuin的系統發育研究被分為五個不同的類別（I-IV和U）。SIR-2.1、黑腹果蠅Sir2（D.mel1）、Hst1和SIRT1都屬於Ia亞類。Ib亞類包括Hst2、D.mel2以及各種真菌和原生動物sirtuin，連同SIRT2和SIRT3。SIRT4和SIRT5分別屬於第II和第III類。SIRT6和SIRT7屬於第IV類，僅包括真核sirtuin。具有未分化基序的細菌Sir2同源物構成U類。

label: Potassium ferricyanide
description: Adrenochrome has been commercially prepared by oxidizing adrenaline or its salts with potassium ferricyanide in an aqueous medium. This process is uneconomical because of the large quantities of potassium ferricyanide needed, the ensuing effluent disposal problems, and variability in product quality. The patent presents a bismuth-catalyzed persulfate process as a superior alternative that precludes these problems and yields less-colored carbazochrome and adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine products.
description_zh_TW: 腎上腺紅的商業製備一直是於水相介質中以鐵氰化鉀氧化腎上腺素或其鹽類。此製程不具經濟效益，因為需要大量鐵氰化鉀、隨之產生廢液處理問題，且產品品質不穩定。該專利提出一種鉍催化過硫酸鹽製程作為更優的替代方案，可避免這些問題，並產生色澤較淺的carbazochrome和腎上腺紅單胺基胍產物。

label: Acidic pH
description: Epinephrine is most stable in an acidic environment, which is why pharmaceutical adrenaline used in emergency injectors is stored in slightly acidic solution. In acidic solutions the hydroxyl groups on the catechol ring are protonated, making it much harder for oxygen to steal electrons and thereby greatly slowing the oxidation that initiates the adrenochrome pathway. pH is described as the most important factor controlling the cyclization reaction because the reaction depends on chemical oxidation and is highly sensitive to environment. This pH dependence explains both the formulation chemistry of epinephrine products and the broader principle that tissue acid-base status may modulate how readily catecholamines undergo oxidative transformation in vivo, with more alkaline conditions favoring oxidation to quinones and downstream adrenochrome formation.
description_zh_TW: Epinephrine 在酸性環境中最為穩定，這也是為什麼急救注射器中使用的藥用 adrenaline 儲存於微酸性溶液中。在酸性溶液中，兒茶酚環上的羥基被質子化，使氧氣更難奪取電子，從而大幅減緩啟動 adrenochrome 途徑的氧化。pH 值被描述為控制環化反應最重要的因素，因為反應依賴化學氧化且對環境高度敏感。這種 pH 依賴性同時解釋了 epinephrine 產品的配方化學，以及更廣泛的原則：組織酸鹼狀態可能調節兒茶酚胺在體內發生氧化轉化的容易程度，鹼性越強的條件越有利於氧化成醌及下游 adrenochrome 的形成。

label: Liver microsomes
description: Liver microsomes are subcellular fractions of hepatic endoplasmic reticulum enriched in oxidative enzymes. In the presence of NADPH and oxygen, hepatic microsomal enzymes can oxidize epinephrine to adrenochrome, and the rate is modulated by high oxygen tension or inhibitors such as cyanide. This demonstrates that hepatic microsomal oxidases contribute to adrenaline oxidation alongside the well-known neutrophil and myocardial routes. The microsomal pathway represents an enzymatic or semi-enzymatic route of catecholamine oxidation that may be more relevant when oxidative stress or drug-induced enzyme activity is elevated, though it remains a minor pathway relative to COMT- and MAO-mediated metabolism.
description_zh_TW: 肝微粒體是富含氧化酶的肝內質網次細胞分馏物。在 NADPH 與氧氣存在下，肝微粒體酶可將 epinephrine 氧化為 adrenochrome，且其速率受高氧張力或氰化物等抑制劑調節。這證明肝微粒體氧化酶與眾所周知的中性球與心肌途徑並行，共同促成 adrenaline 氧化。微粒體途徑代表一種兒茶酚胺氧化的酶性或半酶性途徑，在氧化壓力或藥物誘導酶活性升高時可能更為相關，儘管相對於 COMT 與 MAO 介導的代謝，它仍是次要途徑。

label: Endogenous Antioxidant Upregulation
description: Exogenous antioxidants prevent the upregulation of endogenous defense enzymes (SOD, GPx) that exercise normally induces via NRF2. The Ristow 2009 study showed antioxidant-supplemented subjects failed to upregulate endogenous SOD/GPx and lost the insulin-sensitizing benefit of exercise.
description_zh_TW: 外源性抗氧化劑防止運動通常經由 NRF2 誘發的內生防禦酵素（SOD、GPx）上調。Ristow 2009 研究顯示補充抗氧化劑的受試者未能上調內生 SOD/GPx，並喪失運動的胰島素增敏益處。

label: Melatonin in DCM
description: Mst1 (STK4) is a Hippo-pathway kinase that promotes apoptosis and suppresses protective autophagy. In diabetic cardiomyopathy, melatonin counteracts adverse left-ventricle remodeling by inhibiting Mst1 phosphorylation and upregulating SIRT3, promoting autophagy, reducing apoptosis, and mitigating mitochondrial dysfunction.
description_zh_TW: Mst1（STK4）是一種 Hippo 途徑激酶，促進凋亡並抑制保護性自噬。在糖尿病心肌病變中，melatonin 透過抑制 Mst1 磷酸化和上調 SIRT3 對抗不良的左心室重塑，促進自噬、減少凋亡並減輕粒線體功能障礙。

label: Nitrogen gas
description: Because leuco-adrenochrome and epinephrine intermediates are extremely oxidation-sensitive, they are stored and handled under an inert atmosphere of nitrogen gas (or argon) to prevent catecholamine autoxidation.
description_zh_TW: 由於 [[Leuco-adrenochrome]] 與 [[Epinephrine]] 中間產物對氧化極度敏感，它們在 [[Nitrogen gas]]（或 [[Argon]]）的惰性氣氛下儲存與操作，以防止兒茶酚胺自氧化。

label: Neffy
description: Neffy is a needle-free intranasal epinephrine spray approved for emergency treatment of anaphylaxis; its stabilized formulation reduces epinephrine autoxidation and thus limits formation of Adrenochrome and related aminochromes.
description_zh_TW: Neffy 是免針式鼻內 [[Epinephrine]] 噴劑，核准用於過敏性休克的緊急治療；其穩定配方減少 [[Epinephrine]] 的自氧化，因而抑制 [[Adrenochrome]] 及相關 aminochrome 的生成。

label: ALK4
description: Activin A signals through the type I receptor ALK4 and type II receptors activin receptor RIIA/RIIB, which phosphorylate SMAD2 and SMAD3 to transmit signals to the nucleus. This receptor architecture is canonical for activin/nodal signaling within the TGFbeta superfamily and is required for Activin A's biological effects in senescence. The ALK4-SMAD2/3 axis links ligand binding directly to transcriptional reprogramming of recipient cells, including induction of cell-cycle inhibitor genes. Because ALK4 is shared with other TGFbeta-family ligands, its engagement integrates Activin A signaling into the broader paracrine senescence network.
description_zh_TW: Activin A 經第一型受體 ALK4 與第二型受體 activin receptor RIIA/RIIB 訊號，磷酸化 SMAD2 與 SMAD3 將訊號傳遞至核。此受體架構對 TGFbeta 超家族內的 activin/nodal 訊號為典型，且為 Activin A 在衰老中的生物效應必要。ALK4-SMAD2/3 軸將配體結合直接連結到受體細胞的轉錄重編程，包括細胞週期抑制因子的誘發。由於 ALK4 與其他 TGFbeta 家族配體共享，其參與將 Activin A 訊號整合到更廣的旁分泌衰老網絡。

label: Chemokine
description: CCL20 (MIP-3alpha) is a CC chemokine that signals exclusively through the receptor CCR6, belonging to the broader chemokine family that directs leukocyte trafficking. Its classification as a chemokine situates it among the SASP components that recruit immune cells to senescent tissue. As a SASP factor, CCL20 extends the communicative reach of senescent cells to adaptive immunity, attracting CCR6-expressing cells such as TH17 lymphocytes and immature dendritic cells. Its restricted receptor usage gives it a focused recruitment profile distinct from broadly acting chemokines.
description_zh_TW: CCL20（MIP-3alpha）是一種專一透過受體 CCR6 訊號的 CC 趨化因子，屬於引導白血球遷移的更廣趨化因子家族。其歸類為趨化因子將它置於招募免疫細胞至衰老組織的 SASP 成分中。作為 SASP 因子，CCL20 擴展衰老細胞對適應性免疫的溝通觸及，吸引表達 CCR6 的細胞如 TH17 淋巴球與未成熟樹突細胞。其受限的受體使用賦予其不同於廣泛作用趨化因子的聚焦招募輪廓。

label: CCR6
description: CCL20 is the sole ligand for CCR6, a Gai-coupled GPCR that drives chemotaxis via PI3K/Akt, p38 MAPK, and calcium flux in target cells. This exclusive pairing directs recruitment of CCR6-positive cells such as TH17 lymphocytes and dendritic cells to sites of ligand production. In the senescence context, CCL20-CCR6 links the SASP to adaptive immune infiltration, shaping the local immune landscape around senescent foci. The signaling mechanism is well characterized in lymphocyte biology and is a canonical chemokine-receptor interaction.
