description_zh_TW: CCL20 是 CCR6 的唯一配體，CCR6 是一種經由 PI3K/Akt、p38 MAPK 與鈣流驅動趨化性的 Gai 耦合 GPCR。此專一配對引導 CCR6 陽性細胞如 TH17 淋巴球與樹突細胞招募至配體產生部位。在衰老脈絡中，CCL20-CCR6 將 SASP 連結到適應性免疫浸潤，塑造衰老灶周圍的局部免疫景觀。此訊號機制在淋巴球生物學中確立良好，且是典型的趨化因子—受體交互作用。

label: Biological Process
description: Paracrine reprogramming is the biological process by which SASP factors alter the differentiation status and fate of neighbouring cells, pushing them toward stemness, EMT, or altered lineage commitment. Distinct from paracrine senescence, which induces growth arrest, it remodels recipient identity and is dose- and time-dependent, with acute exposure promoting plasticity and chronic exposure driving fibrosis and cancer stemness. The process is mediated by cytokines such as IL-6, TGFbeta, and VEGF family members. It expands the non-cell-autonomous influence of senescent cells beyond growth arrest.
description_zh_TW: 旁分泌重編程是 SASP 因子改變鄰近細胞分化狀態與命運、將其推向幹性、EMT 或改變譜系承諾的生物學過程。不同於誘發生長停滯的旁分泌衰老，它重塑受體身分而非使其停滯。此過程將衰老分泌組定位為組織重塑的形態發生素來源，且其與旁分泌衰老的並存說明 SASP 具多重非細胞自主性後果。它是衰老相關組織重塑的核心機制。

label: H2O2-induced cell death in cardiomyocytes
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: A finding suggests that in cardiomyocytes, SIRT5 is a key moderator in cell death induced by H2O2. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of the cardiomyocyte response to oxidative stress, dampening or modulating hydrogen peroxide-induced cell death. This places SIRT5 in the cardiac stress response network and suggests that modulating SIRT5 activity could influence oxidative injury in the heart.
description_zh_TW: 一項發現表明，在心肌細胞中，SIRT5是H2O2誘導的細胞死亡的關鍵調節因子。方向上，SIRT5位於心肌細胞對氧化壓力反應的上游，抑制或調節過氧化氫誘導的細胞死亡。這將SIRT5置於心臟壓力反應網路中，並表明調節SIRT5活性可能影響心臟的氧化損傷。

label: HCC growth and metastasis via glycolysis reprogramming
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Activation of mitochondrial SIRT5 promotes the growth and metastasis of hepatocellular carcinoma cells via glucose metabolism reprogramming from oxidative phosphorylation to glycolysis. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of the glycolytic switch that fuels liver cancer progression. By favoring glycolysis, SIRT5 supplies the biosynthetic and bioenergetic demands of rapidly growing HCC cells, supporting tumor aggressiveness. This oncogenic role is opposed by SIRT5's bile-acid-metabolism-mediated suppression of HCC, underscoring the dual, context-dependent functions of SIRT5 in liver cancer.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體SIRT5的活化透過從氧化磷酸化到糖解作用的葡萄糖代謝重編程促進肝細胞癌細胞的生長和轉移。方向上，SIRT5位於驅動肝癌進展的糖解轉換的上游。透過有利於糖解作用，SIRT5為快速生長的HCC細胞提供生物合成和生物能量需求，支持腫瘤的侵襲性。此致癌角色與SIRT5透過膽汁酸代謝介導的HCC抑制相對抗，突顯了SIRT5在肝癌中的雙重、環境依賴性功能。

label: cellular energy metabolism and AMPK activity under energy stress
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: As a result of energy stress, SIRT5 modulates cellular energy metabolism and AMP-activated protein kinase activity. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of metabolic adaptation and AMPK activation during energy deprivation. By influencing energy metabolism and engaging AMPK signalling, SIRT5 helps cells maintain energy homeostasis under stress conditions, linking mitochondrial deacylation to the cellular energy sensing network.
description_zh_TW: 作為能量壓力的結果，SIRT5調節細胞能量代謝和AMP活化蛋白激酶活性。方向上，SIRT5位於能量剝奪期間代謝適應和AMPK活化的上游。透過影響能量代謝並參與AMPK訊號，SIRT5幫助細胞在壓力條件下維持能量恆定，將粒線體去醯基化與細胞能量感知網路聯繫起來。

label: FOXO3a in lung epithelial cells
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: In lung epithelial cells, SIRT5-mediated deacetylation of Forkhead protein FOXO3a inhibits apoptosis induced by cigarette smoke extract. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of FOXO3a deacetylation and reduced apoptosis under cigarette smoke stress. By dampening FOXO3a-driven pro-apoptotic signalling, SIRT5 helps lung epithelial cells survive the toxic effects of cigarette smoke, with potential relevance to smoking-related lung pathology.
description_zh_TW: 在肺上皮細胞中，SIRT5介導的Foxhead蛋白FOXO3a的去乙醯化抑制香菸煙霧提取物誘導的凋亡。方向上，SIRT5位於香菸煙霧壓力下FOXO3a去乙醯化和凋亡減少的上游。透過抑制FOXO3a驅動的促凋亡訊號，SIRT5幫助肺上皮細胞在香菸煙霧的毒性作用下存活，可能與吸煙相關的肺部病理相關。

label: VLCAD, LCAD, MCAD, ECHA (fatty acid oxidation)
source_file: _document_ - The Sirtuin Network Linking NAD+ Metabolism, Mitochondrial Function, and Metabolic Homoeostasis.md
description: SIRT5 activates multiple fatty acid beta-oxidation enzymes through desuccinylation, including very-long-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase (VLCAD), long-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase (LCAD), medium-chain acyl-CoA dehydrogenase (MCAD), and the alpha subunit of enoyl-CoA hydratase (ECHA). Directionally, SIRT5 enzymatic activation of these enzymes sits upstream of enhanced lipid catabolism. Deficiency of SIRT5 compromises fatty acid metabolism, leading to acylcarnitine accumulation and decreased ATP production.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5透過去琥珀醯化作用活化多種脂肪酸β-氧化酶，包括極長鏈醯基CoA脫氫酶（VLCAD）、長鏈醯基CoA脫氫酶（LCAD）、中鏈醯基CoA脫氫酶（MCAD）和烯醯CoA水合酶的α亞基（ECHA）。方向上，SIRT5對這些酶的酵素活化位於脂質分解代謝增強的上游。SIRT5的缺乏損害脂肪酸代謝，導致醯基肉鹼積累和ATP產量減少。

label: Nrf2/HO-1-mediated ROS suppression
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT5 can promote cisplatin resistance in ovarian cancer by suppressing DNA damage in a ROS-dependent manner via regulation of the Nrf2/Heme Oxygenase-1 pathway. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of reduced ROS, diminished DNA damage, and enhanced survival of ovarian cancer cells treated with cisplatin. By activating Nrf2/HO-1-dependent antioxidant defense, SIRT5 protects ovarian cancer cells from platinum-induced damage, contributing to chemoresistance. This contrasts with SIRT2, whose overexpression enhances cisplatin sensitivity in resistant ovarian cancer cells.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5可以透過調節Nrf2/血紅素加氧酶-1通路以ROS依賴的方式抑制DNA損傷來促進卵巢癌的順鉑耐藥性。方向上，SIRT5位於接受順鉑治療的卵巢癌細胞中ROS降低、DNA損傷減少和存活增強的上游。透過活化Nrf2/HO-1依賴性抗氧化防禦，SIRT5保護卵巢癌細胞免受鉑誘導的損傷，促成化療耐藥性。這與過表達增強耐藥卵巢癌細胞順鉑敏感性的SIRT2形成對比。

label: IDH2 and SDHA (TCA cycle)
description: SIRT5 desuccinylates TCA-cycle enzymes IDH2 and SDHA, tuning their activity and coordinating mitochondrial energy metabolism. Directionally, SIRT5 enzymatically modulates TCA flux. This helps match oxidation to demand during fasting or stress, and it reinforces SIRT5's role as a central mitochondrial metabolic regulator. By adjusting the activity of key TCA-cycle enzymes, SIRT5 balances carbon entry, ATP production, and the supply of reducing equivalents. This regulation supports the metabolic flexibility that allows cells to adapt fuel utilization to nutrient availability.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 去琥珀醯化 TCA 循環酶 IDH2 和 SDHA，調節其活性並協調粒線體能量代謝。在方向性上，SIRT5 以酶性方式調節 TCA 通量。這有助於在禁食或壓力期間使氧化與需求匹配，並強化 SIRT5 作為核心粒線體代謝調節因子的角色。透過調整關鍵 TCA 循環酶的活性，SIRT5 平衡碳的進入、ATP 產生和還原當量的供應。此調控支持使細胞能根據營養可用性調整燃料利用的代謝靈活性。

label: LCAD and ACADS (fatty acid β-oxidation)
description: SIRT5 desuccinylates multiple fatty-acid β-oxidation enzymes including LCAD and ACADS, coordinating mitochondrial lipid catabolism. Directionally, SIRT5 enzymatically activates these acyl-CoA dehydrogenases. This supports energy harvest from fat, and it exemplifies SIRT5's broad desuccinylase control of metabolism. By activating the enzymes of β-oxidation, SIRT5 promotes the use of fatty acids as fuel, particularly during fasting. This catabolic role aligns SIRT5 with SIRT3 in supporting lipid oxidation, in contrast to SIRT4's inhibition of the same pathways.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 去琥珀醯化多種脂肪酸 β-氧化酶，包括 LCAD 和 ACADS，協調粒線體脂質分解代謝。在方向性上，SIRT5 以酶性方式活化這些醯基-CoA 脫氫酶。這支持從脂肪獲取能量，並體現了 SIRT5 對代謝的廣泛去琥醯化酶控制。透過活化 β-氧化酶，SIRT5 促進脂肪酸作為燃料的使用，特別是在禁食期間。這種分解代謝角色使 SIRT5 與 SIRT3 在支持脂質氧化方面一致，與 SIRT4 對相同途徑的抑制形成對比。

label: GOT1 acetylation
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT5 expression is directly correlated with favorable prognosis in pancreatic cancer, as SIRT5 loss promotes glutamic-oxaloacetic transaminase 1 acetylation, thus promoting cell proliferation by enhancing glutamine and glutathione metabolism. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of GOT1 deacetylation that restrains pancreatic cancer growth. When SIRT5 is lost, GOT1 acetylation rises, boosting glutamine and glutathione metabolism to drive proliferation. This identifies SIRT5 as a tumor suppressor in pancreatic cancer whose levels could inform prognosis.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5表達與胰腺癌的良好預後直接相關，因為SIRT5缺失促進穀草轉氨酶1（GOT1）乙醯化，從而透過增強穀氨醯胺和穀胱甘肽代謝促進細胞增殖。方向上，SIRT5位於抑制胰腺癌生長的GOT1去乙醯化的上游。當SIRT5缺失時，GOT1乙醯化升高，促進穀氨醯胺和穀胱甘肽代謝以驅動增殖。這將SIRT5確定為胰腺癌中的腫瘤抑制因子，其水平可能為預後提供資訊。

label: GLS (glutaminase)
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT5 inhibits glutaminase (GLS) via desuccinylation, suppressing glutaminolysis in cancer metabolism.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過去琥珀酰化抑制穀氨醯胺酶（GLS），抑制癌症代謝中的穀氨醯胺分解。

label: Preadipocyte differentiation
description: SIRT5 inhibits preadipocyte differentiation and lipid deposition by activating AMPK and repressing MAPK signaling pathways. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of suppressed adipogenesis. This keeps progenitors from becoming lipid-laden fat cells and positions mitochondrial SIRT5 as a negative regulator of fat accumulation. The AMPK arm likely raises NAD+ and reinforces catabolic metabolism, while MAPK repression blocks the mitogenic signaling required for adipocyte maturation. SIRT5's anti-adipogenic function is consistent with the sirtuin family's general opposition to lipid storage and its promotion of oxidative metabolism.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 通過活化 AMPK 並抑制 MAPK 信號通路來抑制前脂肪細胞分化和脂質沉積。在方向性上，SIRT5 位於被抑制的脂肪生成的上游。這防止前體細胞成為富含脂質的脂肪細胞，將粒線體 SIRT5 定位為脂肪累積的負調節因子。AMPK 分支可能提高 NAD+ 並強化分解代謝，而 MAPK 抑制阻斷脂肪細胞成熟所需的促有絲分裂信號。SIRT5 的抗脂肪生成功能與 sirtuin 家族對脂質儲存的一般反對和對氧化代謝的促進一致。

label: breast tumor, HCC, and NSCLC cells
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT5 is important in the growth of breast tumour cells, hepatocellular carcinoma, and human non-small cell lung cancer tissues. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of tumour growth in these cancer types, and its overexpression indicates a poor prognosis in human non-small cell lung cancer. SIRT5 thereby acts as a tumour-promoting factor in breast cancer, HCC, and lung cancer, making it a candidate therapeutic target.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5在乳腺腫瘤細胞、肝細胞癌和人類非小細胞肺癌組織的生長中很重要。方向上，SIRT5位於這些癌症類型中腫瘤生長的上游，其過表達在人類非小細胞肺癌中預示不良預後。因此SIRT5在乳腺癌、HCC和肺癌中作為促腫瘤因子，使其成為候選治療靶點。

label: Phylogenetic Class III (prokaryotic origin)
description: SIRT5 is the sole mammalian member of phylogenetic Class III, a group distributed widely across prokaryotes, marking it as one of the most ancient mammalian sirtuins. Directionally, this is an evolutionary classification. Its prokaryotic origin aligns with SIRT5's fundamental mitochondrial metabolic functions, and this situates SIRT5 at the root of sirtuin biology. Because Class III sirtuins predate the eukaryotic sirtuins, SIRT5's desuccinylase activity may represent an ancestral enzymatic function retained through evolution. SIRT5's phylogenetic position helps explain its resistance to nicotinamide inhibition and its distinct substrate preferences.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 是系統發育 III 類唯一的哺乳動物成員，該類群廣泛分布於原核生物中，標誌著它是最古老的哺乳動物 sirtuin 之一。在方向性上，這是演化分類。其原核生物起源與 SIRT5 基本的粒線體代謝功能一致，並將 SIRT5 置於 sirtuin 生物學的根源。由於 III 類 sirtuin 先於真核 sirtuin，SIRT5 的去琥珀醯酶活性可能代表一種通過演化保留的祖先酶功能。SIRT5 的系統發育位置有助於解釋其對菸鹼醯胺抑制的抗性和其獨特的底物偏好。

label: SHMT2 desuccinylation
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: SIRT5 is upregulated during cellular transformation and is involved in cancer and its proliferation by desuccinylating serine hydroxymethyltransferase 2 (SHMT2). Directionally, SIRT5 desuccinylation of SHMT2 sits upstream of enhanced one-carbon metabolism and cancer cell proliferation. By activating SHMT2, SIRT5 supports the biosynthetic demands of proliferating cancer cells, contributing to tumorigenesis.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5在細胞轉化期間上調，並透過去琥珀醯化絲氨酸羥甲基轉移酶2（SHMT2）參與癌症及其增殖。方向上，SIRT5對SHMT2的去琥珀醯化位於一碳代謝增強和癌細胞增殖的上游。透過活化SHMT2，SIRT5支持增殖癌細胞的生物合成需求，促成腫瘤發生。

label: ammonia detoxification
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT5 mediates ammonia detoxification by activating CPS1 in the urea cycle, converting ammonia to urea; this is critical during fasting and high-protein load when nitrogen must be cleared.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過在尿素循環中活化 CPS1 來調介氨解毒，將氨轉化為尿素；這在禁食和高蛋白負荷期間至關重要，因為此時必須清除氮。

label: intracellular signaling
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT5 participates in intracellular signaling by deacylating metabolic enzymes and transcription-linked targets (e.g., FOXO3a, SOD1) and by modulating AMPK, linking mitochondrial acylation state to cellular signaling and redox responses.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過去酰基化代謝酶和轉錄相關靶點（例如 FOXO3a、SOD1）以及調節 AMPK 來參與細胞內信號傳導，將粒線體酰化狀態與細胞信號和氧化還原反應聯繫起來。

label: bile acid metabolism orchestration
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT5 prevents tumor immune evasion and suppresses the development of hepatocellular carcinoma by orchestrating bile acid metabolism. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of anti-tumor immunity and restrained HCC growth. By shaping the bile acid milieu, SIRT5 influences the immune microenvironment of the liver tumor, reducing the ability of HCC to evade immune destruction. This tumor-suppressive metabolic function contrasts with SIRT5's glycolysis-reprogramming role that can promote HCC growth, reflecting SIRT5's context-dependent effects in liver cancer.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5透過協調膽汁酸代謝來預防腫瘤免疫逃逸並抑制肝細胞癌的發展。方向上，SIRT5位於抗腫瘤免疫和HCC生長抑制的上游。透過塑造膽汁酸環境，SIRT5影響肝腫瘤的免疫微環境，降低HCC逃避免疫破壞的能力。此腫瘤抑制性代謝功能與SIRT5促進HCC生長的糖解重編程角色形成對比，反映了SIRT5在肝癌中的環境依賴性效果。

label: Nrf2/HO-1 pathway (ovarian cancer)
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT5 promotes cisplatin resistance in ovarian cancer by suppressing DNA damage in a ROS-dependent manner through regulation of the Nrf2/Heme Oxygenase-1 pathway. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of Nrf2-mediated chemoresistance. By activating this antioxidant program, SIRT5 helps cancer cells neutralize the reactive oxygen species that contribute to cisplatin-induced DNA damage. This reduces the genotoxic burden of the drug and blunts its cytotoxicity, allowing tumor cells to survive treatment. Inhibiting SIRT5, therefore, could re-sensitize ovarian cancer cells to cisplatin by dismantling their antioxidant defenses.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5透過調節Nrf2/血紅素加氧酶-1（HO-1）通路以ROS依賴的方式抑制DNA損傷，從而促進卵巢癌的順鉑耐藥性。方向上，SIRT5位於Nrf2介導的化療耐藥性的上游。透過活化此抗氧化程序，SIRT5幫助癌細胞中和促成順鉑誘導的DNA損傷的活性氧。這降低了藥物的基因毒性負荷並削弱其細胞毒性，使腫瘤細胞能够在治療中存活。因此抑制SIRT5可能透過瓦解其抗氧化防禦來使卵巢癌細胞對順鉑重新敏感。

label: ATP synthesis regulation
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT5 supports ATP synthesis by desuccinylating electron-transport and TCA-cycle enzymes, maintaining mitochondrial function; its loss compromises energy production under metabolic stress.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過去琥珀酰化電子傳輸和 TCA 循環酶來支持 ATP 合成，維持粒線體功能；其缺失在代謝壓力下損害能量產生。

label: Tofersen
description: Tofersen (Qalsody) is an intrathecal antisense oligonucleotide against SOD1 mRNA, approved April 2023 on biomarker grounds (plasma NfL −55%) for SOD1-ALS and now tested presymptomatically in the ATLAS trial — the first precision neurodegenerative therapy.
description_zh_TW: Tofersen（Qalsody）是針對 SOD1 mRNA 的鞘內反義寡核苷酸，2023 年 4 月依生物標記（血漿 NfL −55%）獲准用於 SOD1-ALS，現於 ATLAS 試驗中做症狀前測試——是第一個精準神經退化療法。

label: muscle fatigue
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Existing evidence suggests that urolithin A may have a positive role in improving endurance and delaying muscle fatigue, both of which are intricately linked to mitochondrial function. By enhancing mitochondrial activity and ATP synthesis, urolithin A provides sustained energy support during prolonged or high-intensity exercise, and its anti-inflammatory properties alleviate tissue damage and muscle soreness caused by inflammation. Most studies have been conducted in vitro or on animals, so more human studies are needed to validate these effects.
description_zh_TW: 現有證據顯示 urolithin A 可能在改善耐力與延遲肌肉疲勞方面具有正面作用，兩者皆與粒線體功能密切相關。透過增強粒線體活性與 ATP 合成，urolithin A 在長時間或高強度運動期間提供持續的能量支持，且其抗發炎特性可減輕由發炎引起的組織損傷與肌肉痠痛。大多數研究為體外或動物實驗，因此需要更多人體研究來驗證這些效應。

label: Glycated proteins
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Glycated proteins are normally removed from cells via ubiquitin-dependent 20S proteasome-mediated proteolysis, an important quality control pathway for damaged proteins. AGE modifications can disturb this proteolytic degradation, contributing to a further increase in the cellular content of glycated proteins. The resulting accumulation of glycated proteins is a hallmark of aging and is associated with loss of cellular function. Proteasomal degradation of glycated proteins is thus a key cellular defense against glycation stress, and its impairment creates a feed-forward loop of AGE accumulation.
description_zh_TW: Glycated proteins 通常經由 ubiquitin-dependent 20S proteasome-mediated proteolysis 從細胞中移除，這是 damaged proteins 的重要 quality control pathway。AGE modifications 會 disturb 此 proteolytic degradation，導致細胞內 glycated proteins 含量進一步增加。由此產生的 glycated proteins accumulation 是 aging 的標誌，並與 loss of cellular function 相關。因此，glycated proteins 的 proteasomal degradation 是對抗 glycation stress 的關鍵細胞防禦，而其 impairment 會創造 AGE accumulation 的 feed-forward loop。

label: Nitrated lipids
description: Nitrated lipids activate PPARgamma, as electrophilic nitrated fatty acids such as nitrolinoleic acid act as ligands that promote the receptor's transcriptional program. This redirects metabolism and induces anti-inflammatory and antioxidant genes. The directionality is lipid nitration product to nuclear receptor activation. A caveat is that nitrated lipids can also signal through PPARalpha and other targets, so PPARgamma is a major but not exclusive node. This pathway represents a feedback mechanism in which nitrative stress generates endogenous ligands that dampen inflammation.
description_zh_TW: Nitrated lipids 活化 PPARgamma，因為硝基亞麻油酸等親電子硝化脂肪酸充當配體，促進受體的轉錄程序。這會改變新陳代謝並誘導抗炎和抗氧化基因。方向性是脂質硝化產物對核受體的活化。需要注意的是，nitrated lipids 還可以透過 PPARalpha 和其他目標發出訊號，因此 PPARgamma 是一個主要但不是唯一的節點。該通路代表了一種反饋機制，其中 nitrative stress 生成抑制發炎的內源性配體。

label: Pomegranate
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Pomegranate is cited as one of the primary and richest dietary sources of urolithin A. Pomegranate peel and seeds contain abundant polyphenolic compounds, including ellagitannins that are metabolized by the gut microbiota into urolithin A. Consequently, consuming pomegranate supplies an abundance of precursor molecules for intestinal microbial metabolism, facilitating the generation of urolithin A, and pomegranate consumption is a standard dietary route to increase systemic urolithin A exposure alongside other sources such as walnut, almond, strawberry, and blueberry.
description_zh_TW: 石榴被引述為 urolithin A 的主要且最豐富的膳食來源之一。石榴皮與籽含有豐富的多酚類化合物，包括被腸道菌叢代謝為 urolithin A 的 ellagitannins（鞣花單寧）。因此，食用石榴提供了豐富的前驅物分子供腸道微生物代謝，促進 urolithin A 的生成，且食用石榴是增加全身性 urolithin A 暴露的標準膳食途徑，與核桃、杏仁、草莓與藍莓等其他來源並列。

label: muscle protein degradation
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: The FoxO (forkhead box O) family is a group of transcription factors involved in regulating the synthesis and degradation of muscle proteins. Under catabolic conditions, nuclear FoxO drives expression of atrophy-related genes and activates specific protein degradation pathways that break down muscle proteins. Urolithin A suppresses FoxO activation, primarily by inhibiting its nuclear activity and reducing its regulation of these degradation pathways, thereby attenuating muscle protein degradation and helping to preserve muscle mass.
description_zh_TW: FoxO (forkhead box O) 家族是一群參與調節肌肉蛋白合成與降解的轉錄因子。在分解代謝條件下，核內 FoxO 驅動萎縮相關基因的表現，並活化分解肌肉蛋白的特定蛋白降解路徑。Urolithin A 抑制 FoxO 活化，主要是透過抑制其核活性並降低其對這些降解路徑的調節，從而減緩肌肉蛋白降解並有助於保留肌肉量。

label: TLR3/TRIF signaling
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: The literature indicates that urolithin A blocks the NF-κB/STAT1 axis through the inactivation of TLR3/TRIF signaling, reducing inflammation and enhancing antioxidant defense. TLR3/TRIF is an upstream innate immune signaling route whose inactivation dampens downstream NF-κB activation and the production of inflammatory mediators. This mechanism contributes to urolithin A's anti-inflammatory activity in settings such as poly(I:C)-stimulated RAW264.7 macrophages and supports its role in muscle recovery and protection from inflammation-induced damage.
description_zh_TW: 文獻指出 urolithin A 透過使 TLR3/TRIF 訊號失活來阻斷 NF-κB/STAT1 軸，從而減少發炎並增強抗氧化防禦。TLR3/TRIF 是一條上游先天免疫訊號路線，其失活會抑制下游 NF-κB 活化與發炎介質的產生。此機制有助於 urolithin A 在如 poly(I:C) 刺激的 RAW264.7 巨噬細胞等情境中的抗發炎活性，並支持其在肌肉恢復與免受發炎誘發損傷中的角色。

label: ATP synthesis
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Urolithin A can promote the formation and enhanced function of mitochondrial respiratory chain complexes, thereby improving the synthesis rate of ATP in muscle cells. ATP is the primary energy molecule for muscle cells and is crucial for muscle contraction and exercise performance. By promoting mitochondrial function and muscle energy metabolism, urolithin A increases the energy supply to muscle cells, improving endurance, strength, and recovery, and providing sustained energy support during prolonged or high-intensity exercise.
description_zh_TW: Urolithin A 可促進粒線體呼吸鏈複合體的形成與功能增強，從而改善肌肉細胞中 ATP 的合成速率。ATP 是肌肉細胞的主要能量分子，對肌肉收縮與運動表現至關重要。透過促進粒線體功能與肌肉能量代謝，urolithin A 增加對肌肉細胞的能量供應，改善耐力、力量與恢復，並在長時間或高強度運動期間提供持續的能量支持。

label: Bax/Bcl-2 ratio
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: Urolithin A induces apoptosis by increasing the Bax/Bcl-2 ratio, which results in the loss of mitochondrial membrane potential, release of cytochrome c, and activation of the cascade of caspases, ultimately leading to cell apoptosis. Modulation of the pro-apoptotic to anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family ratio is a classical intrinsic (mitochondrial) apoptosis trigger. It represents one of the several mechanisms through which urolithin A promotes programmed cell death, in addition to its activation of JNK and p38 MAPK signaling.
description_zh_TW: Urolithin A 透過提升 Bax/Bcl-2 比值誘導凋亡，此比值升高導致粒線體膜電位喪失、cytochrome c 釋出，以及 caspase 級聯反應活化，最終導致細胞凋亡。調節促凋亡與抗凋亡 Bcl-2 家族比值，是經典的內在（粒線體）凋亡觸發因子。這代表了 urolithin A 促進程序性細胞死亡的數種機制之一，此外還包括其對 JNK 與 p38 MAPK 訊號的活化。

label: E3 Ubiquitin Ligase
description: MuRF1 (Muscle RING Finger 1, also known as TRIM63) is a muscle-specific E3 ubiquitin ligase whose expression rises during muscle wasting and atrophy; it tags sarcomeric proteins so they can be degraded through the ubiquitin-proteasome system.
description_zh_TW: MuRF1（Muscle RING Finger 1，又稱 TRIM63）是一種肌肉特異性的 E3 泛素連接酶，在肌肉消耗與萎縮時表現上升；它標記肌節蛋白，使其經由泛素-蛋白酶體系統被降解。

label: ATLAS
description: The ATLAS trial (Singh et al., 2022, NCT03464500) is a randomized controlled test of Urolithin A at 500 or 1000 mg/day versus placebo over 4 months in 88 middle-aged adults. It produced roughly a 12% hamstring-strength increase at 500 mg/day, improved peak VO2 and 6-minute walk distance, and reduced plasma acylcarnitines and C-reactive protein, providing core human functional evidence for the compound.
description_zh_TW: ATLAS 試驗（Singh 等，2022，NCT03464500）是一項隨機對照試驗，在 88 名中年成人中以 Urolithin A 每日 500 或 1000 mg 對比安慰劑、持續 4 個月。結果顯示 500 mg/日組腿後肌力量增加約 12%，尖峰 VO2 與 6 分鐘步行距離改善，血漿 acylcarnitines 與 C 反應性蛋白下降，為該化合物提供了核心的人體功能性證據。

label: adipogenesis
description: Adipogenesis is the differentiation program by which mesenchymal cells commit to the adipocyte lineage. Early commitment is driven by C/EBPβ and C/EBPδ and by the master regulator PPARγ, whose induction alone is sufficient to convert fibroblasts into fat cells. PPARγ heterodimerizes with RXR to activate adipocyte genes including aP2/FABP4 and GLUT4, and a later phase orchestrated by C/EBPα stabilizes the differentiated state in cooperation with PPARγ.
description_zh_TW: Adipogenesis 是間質細胞朝向脂肪細胞譜系 commitments 的分化程式。早期 commitment 由 C/EBPβ 與 C/EBPδ 以及主調節因子 PPARγ 驅動，單獨誘導 PPARγ 即足以將纖維母細胞轉化為脂肪細胞。PPARγ 與 RXR 形成異二聚體，活化包括 aP2/FABP4 與 GLUT4 在內的脂肪細胞基因；後期則由 C/EBPα 統籌，與 PPARγ 合作穩定已分化狀態。

label: Lymphangiogenesis
description: Full-length VEGF-C preferentially activates VEGFR-3 and promotes lymphatic vessel sprouting, driving lymphangiogenesis. In senescence, this contributes to lymphatic remodeling and potentially to immune cell trafficking routes, shaping how immune cells access senescent tissue. The relationship is the canonical lymphangiogenic function of VEGF-C and expands the vascular consequences of the SASP beyond blood vessels. It is supported by studies of lymphatic development and tumor-associated lymphangiogenesis.
description_zh_TW: 全長 VEGF-C 偏好活化 VEGFR-3 並促進淋巴管出芽，驅動淋巴生成。在衰老中，這貢獻淋巴重塑並可能影響免疫細胞遷移路徑，塑造免疫細胞如何接近衰老灶。其淋巴特異性角色補充 VEGF-A 的血血管生成，使 SASP 的血管效應具雙重性。它是連結細胞衰老到淋巴系統重塑的關鍵因子。

label: Anti-CD38 mAbs
description: Anti-CD38 monoclonal antibodies eliminate CD38+ Tregs and MDSCs and reduce adenosine-mediated immunosuppression, restoring T- and NK-cell function in the tumor microenvironment. Directionally, anti-CD38 therapy sits upstream of tumor-microenvironment reprogramming. This is both an anticancer action and a means to spare NAD+ for sirtuins, and it illustrates the dual therapeutic logic of CD38 targeting. By depleting immunosuppressive cells and reducing adenosine, these antibodies restore effector immune responses. The resulting reshaping of the tumor microenvironment contributes to the efficacy of anti-CD38 antibodies in multiple myeloma and other cancers.
description_zh_TW: 抗 CD38 單克隆抗體消除 CD38+ 調節性 T 細胞和 MDSC，並減少腺苷介導的免疫抑制，恢復腫瘤微環境中 T 細胞和 NK 細胞的功能。在方向性上，抗 CD38 治療位於腫瘤微環境重編程的上游。這既是抗癌作用也是為 sirtuin 節省 NAD+ 的手段，說明了 CD38 靶向的雙重治療邏輯。透過清除免疫抑制細胞和減少腺苷，這些抗體恢復效應免疫反應。由此產生的腫瘤微環境重塑有助於抗 CD38 抗體在多發性骨髓瘤和其他癌症中的療效。

label: CendR motif
description: CendR-receptor binding triggers transcytosis and tissue penetration.
description_zh_TW: CendR-受體結合觸發胞吞轉運與組織穿透。

label: VEGFR3
description: VEGF-C is the primary ligand defining the VEGFR3 lymphatic axis.
description_zh_TW: VEGF-C 是定義 VEGFR3 淋巴軸的主要配體。

label: Mitochondrial Fission Sites
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Fusion and Fission The fine-tune balance for cellular homeostasis.md
description: DRP1 is recruited from the cytosol to defined sites on the mitochondrial outer membrane, where division occurs. Its adaptor proteins, including MFF, FIS1, MID49, and MID51, serve as receptors that concentrate DRP1 at prospective fission sites, often at positions where mitochondria are already constricted or associated with the endoplasmic reticulum. In cultured cells, MFF recruits DRP1 to the majority of fission events, while MID49 and MID51 recruit DRP1 to mitochondria independently of MFF in certain conditions. Once concentrated, DRP1 oligomerizes into spirals that wrap around the tubule, and GTP hydrolysis drives the membrane constriction required for complete scission.
description_zh_TW: DRP1 從細胞質被招募至粒線體外膜上的特定位置，分裂即在此發生。其接合蛋白（包括 MFF、FIS1、MID49 與 MID51）作為受體，將 DRP1 集中於預定的分裂位點，這些位點通常位於粒線體已收縮或與內質網相關的位置。在培養細胞中，MFF 將 DRP1 招募至大多數的分裂事件，而在某些條件下，MID49 與 MID51 則獨立於 MFF 將 DRP1 招募至粒線體。一旦集中，DRP1 便寡聚化為環繞管狀結構的螺旋，而 GTP 水解驅動完成完全分裂所需的膜收縮。

label: Kinesin
description: Kinesin is a family of microtubule-based motor proteins that transport cargo including mitochondria along axons. The outer mitochondrial membrane protein Miro, together with the adaptor Milton, forms a complex bridging MFN2 to kinesin motors, enabling processive mitochondrial movement to distal neuronal compartments. This Miro/Milton/kinesin axis ensures local ATP delivery and axonal mitochondrial integrity.
description_zh_TW: Kinesin 是一類以微管為軌道、沿軸突運送貨物的馬達蛋白，可運送包括粒線體在內的物質。粒線體外膜蛋白 Miro 與轉接蛋白 Milton 形成的複合體將 MFN2 與 kinesin 馬達相連，使粒線體能持續運送至神經元遠端區室。此 Miro/Milton/kinesin 軸確保局部 ATP 供應與軸突粒線體完整性。

label: Oxidized Methionine
description: Methionine sulfoxide reductases repair oxidized methionine by reducing methionine sulfoxide back to methionine using the thioredoxin system. This restores protein function and acts as an antioxidant defense because methionine oxidation can be a benign, reversible sink for oxidants. The directionality is MsrA/MsrB-catalyzed reduction to repaired protein. A caveat is that repeated oxidation and repair of the same residue has a kinetic cost and is not unlimited, so chronic stress still accrues damage.
description_zh_TW: Methionine sulfoxide reductases 透過使用硫氧還蛋白系統將甲硫胺酸亞砜還原回甲硫胺酸來修復 oxidized methionine。這可以恢復蛋白質功能並起到抗氧化防禦作用，因為蛋氨酸氧化可以成為氧化劑的良性、可逆的吸收池。方向性是 MsrA/MsrB 催化還原為修復蛋白。需要注意的是，相同殘留物的重複氧化和修復會產生動力成本，而且不是無限的，因此慢性壓力仍然會造成損害。

label: Tau protein
description: Peroxynitrite nitrates tau protein at tyrosine residues, impairing tau-microtubule interaction and enhancing formation of paired helical filaments. Nitration adds to the spectrum of oxidative modifications that destabilize tau. The directionality is nitrative modification to tau dysfunction. A caveat is that tau is targeted by many oxidative and kinase modifications, so nitration is one of several converging insults. Elevated nitrotyrosine is detected on tau in neurofibrillary tangles, supporting nitration as a contributor to tau pathology in vivo.
description_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite 在 tyrosine 殘基處硝酸鹽 tau protein，損害 tau-微管相互作用並增強成對螺旋絲的形成。硝化增加了氧化修飾的範圍，從而破壞了 tau 的穩定性。方向性是tau功能障礙的硝基修飾。需要注意的是，tau 是許多氧化和激酶修飾的目標，因此硝化是幾種聚合損傷之一。在神經纖維纏結中的 tau 上檢測到升高的硝基rosine，支持硝化是體內 tau 病理學的貢獻者。

label: Tetrahydrobiopterin
description: Peroxynitrite oxidizes tetrahydrobiopterin (BH4) to BH2, depriving eNOS of its essential cofactor and thereby promoting eNOS uncoupling and superoxide production. This establishes a feed-forward loop of vascular oxidative stress. The directionality is nitration of cofactor to enzyme dysfunction. A caveat is that BH4 can be regenerated by dihydrofolate reductase, partially buffering peroxynitrite-driven loss. Restoring BH4 by supplementation or by dihydrofolate reductase-dependent recycling re-couples eNOS and improves endothelial function in experimental studies.
description_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite 將 tetrahydrobiopterin (BH4) 氧化為 BH2，剝奪 eNOS 的必需輔助因子，進而促進 eNOS 解偶聯和超氧化物產生。這就建立了血管oxidative stress的前饋迴路。方向性是輔因子硝化導致酵素功能障礙。需要注意的是，BH4 可以透過二氫葉酸還原酶再生，部分緩衝 peroxynitrite 驅動的損失。在實驗研究中，透過補充或二氫葉酸還原酶依賴性回收來恢復 BH4 可重新偶聯 eNOS 並改善內皮功能。

label: SIRT1 deacetylation of FOXO3a
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Deacetylated FOXO3a transcriptionally upregulates endogenous antioxidant enzymes, prominently mitochondrial MnSOD and catalase, bolstering ROS scavenging. Directionally, SIRT1 deacetylates FOXO3a to drive increased antioxidant capacity. This reduces oxidative damage in resveratrol-treated cells and animals, and it is a central mechanism for sirtuin-mediated protection against aging and metabolic disease. The same FOXO3a-dependent antioxidant program is engaged by SIRT3 in mitochondria and is complemented by FOXO1- and FOXO4-mediated stress responses, establishing the sirtuin-FOXO axis as a primary node coupling nutrient sensing to cellular redox defense.
description_zh_TW: 去乙醯化的 FOXO3a 在轉錄水平上調內源性抗氧化酶，特別是粒線體 MnSOD 和 catalase，增強 ROS 清除能力。在方向性上，SIRT1 去乙醯化 FOXO3a 以驅動增加的抗氧化能力。這減少白藜蘆醇處理的細胞和動物中的氧化損傷，是 sirtuin 介導的抗衰老和代謝疾病保護的核心機制。同樣的 FOXO3a 依賴性抗氧化程序在粒線體中被 SIRT3 啟動，並與 FOXO1 和 FOXO4 介導的壓力反應互補，確立 sirtuin-FOXO 軸作為將營養感知與細胞氧化還原防禦偶聯的主要節點。

label: DNA-binding domain
description: Not every CxxC sequence is redox-active: CxxC-type zinc-binding modules, such as the CFP1/MLL1 DNA-binding domains, coordinate zinc and recognize unmethylated CpG in chromatin and DNA recognition rather than catalyzing thiol-disulfide exchange. The variable residues between the cysteines tune the motif's redox potential and substrate selectivity.
description_zh_TW: 並非每個 CxxC 序列都具有氧化還原活性：CxxC 型鋅結合模組（如 CFP1/MLL1 的 DNA 結合域）配位鋅並辨識未甲基化的 CpG，用於染色質與 DNA 辨識，而非催化硫醇-雙硫交換。兩個半胱氨酸之間的變異殘基會調整基序的氧化還原電位與受質選擇性。

label: Cytochrome c Oxidase
description: Peroxynitrite inactivates cytochrome c oxidase (Complex IV of the respiratory chain) through tyrosine nitration, contributing to bioenergetic failure. Among the 20-50 proteins preferentially nitrated in vivo are MnSOD, cytochrome c oxidase, aconitase, and glutamine synthetase. Tyrosine nitration typically inactivates these enzymes, causing loss of function.
description_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite 透過酪氨酸硝化使 cytochrome c oxidase（呼吸鏈的 Complex IV）失活，促成生物能量衰竭。在體內優先被硝化的 20-50 種蛋白質中，包括 MnSOD、cytochrome c oxidase、aconitase 與 glutamine synthetase。酪氨酸硝化通常使這些酵素失活，造成功能喪失。

label: Locked Nucleic Acid
description: Locked nucleic acid (LNA) is a synthetic RNA analog that can be incorporated into antisense oligonucleotides and siRNAs to hybridize to target messenger RNA. Hybridizing an LNA raises melting temperature and protects against nucleases for potent silencing.
description_zh_TW: 鎖核酸（LNA）是合成 RNA 類似物，可整合入反義寡核苷酸與 siRNA 以雜交至目標信使 RNA。雜交 LNA 可提高熔解溫度並抵抗核酸酶，實現強效靜默。

label: Mitochondrial Catalase
description: Only mitochondria-targeted catalase (mCAT) extends median lifespan ~20% (Schriner 2005); cytosolic catalase is null (Perez 2009). Qualified subject replaces the overstated generic edge.
description_zh_TW: 僅粒線體標靶 catalase（mCAT）延長中位壽命約 20%（Schriner 2005）；胞質 catalase 無效（Perez 2009）。限定主詞取代誇大的通用邊。

label: TFEB at K91/K103/K116/K430
description: Acetyl-CoA acetyltransferase 1 (ACAT1) acetylates TFEB at multiple lysines (K91, K103, K116, K430), an enzymatic activity that, in this context, promotes TFEB nuclear translocation and DNA binding. These acetylations counteract repressive deacetylation cycles and enhance TFEB's ability to engage CLEAR elements, thereby boosting autophagy-lysosomal transcription. The observation that ACAT1-mediated acetylation can be activatory contrasts with the repressive acetylation by GCN5 at other sites. The net effect depends on the specific lysine and cellular context, underscoring the complexity of TFEB acetylation.
description_zh_TW: 乙醯輔酶 A 乙醯轉移酶 1（ACAT1）在多個離胺酸（K91、K103、K116、K430）乙醯化 TFEB，在此脈絡下此酵素活性促進 TFEB 核轉運和 DNA 結合。這些乙醯化對抗抑制性的去乙醯化循環，並增強 TFEB 接合 CLEAR 元件的能力，從而提升自噬—溶酶體轉錄。ACAT1 介導的乙醯化可為活化性的此一觀察，與 GCN5 在其他位點的抑制性乙醯化形成對比。淨效應取決於特定離胺酸和細胞背景，凸顯了 TFEB 乙醯化的複雜性。

label: TFEB at K274/K279
description: GCN5, a lysine acetyltransferase, acetylates TFEB at lysines 274 and 279 within its DNA-binding domain, an modification that hinders TFEB dimerization and its ability to bind CLEAR elements. Acetylation at these sites therefore represses TFEB transcriptional activity independently of its localization. This post-translational modification expands the regulatory vocabulary of TFEB beyond phosphorylation to include acetylation-dependent control of DNA engagement. The finding situates TFEB within the broader acetylome that governs transcription factor function.
description_zh_TW: GCN5 是一種離胺酸乙醯轉移酶，於 lysine 274 和 279 乙醯化 TFEB，這些位點位於其 DNA 結合域內，此修飾阻礙 TFEB 二聚化及其結合 CLEAR 元件的能力。因此這些位點的乙醯化獨立於其定位而抑制 TFEB 轉錄活性。此轉譯後修飾將 TFEB 的調節詞彙從磷酸化擴展到包含依賴乙醯化的 DNA 接合控制。此發現將 TFEB 置於控制轉錄因子功能的更廣泛乙醯體中。

label: MALAT1 in renal carcinoma
source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md
description: In a subset of translocation renal cell carcinomas (t(6;11) RCC), the TFEB gene is fused with the long non-coding RNA locus MALAT1, producing a MALAT1-TFEB fusion that drives overexpression of intact TFEB. The fusion places TFEB under the strong promoter activity of MALAT1, leading to constitutive activation of the lysosomal-autophagic and proliferative programs. This genetic rearrangement defines a distinct clinicopathologic entity of RCC with characteristic biphasic histology. The finding established TFEB as an oncogene when deregulated by chromosomal translocation.
description_zh_TW: 在一部分轉位性腎細胞癌（t(6;11) RCC）中，TFEB 基因與長鏈非編碼 RNA 基因座 MALAT1 融合，產生 MALAT1-TFEB 融合體，驅動完整 TFEB 的過度表現。此融合將 TFEB 置於 MALAT1 強啟動子活性之下，導致溶酶體—自噬性和增生性程序的組成型活化。此基因重排定義了一種具有特徵性雙相組織學的獨特 RCC 臨床病理實體。此發現確立了 TFEB 在因染色體轉位而失調時是一種致癌基因。

label: Oxidation at C212
source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md
description: Oxidation of TFEB at cysteine 212—for example by reactive oxygen species or oxidants—impairs mTORC1-mediated phosphorylation at adjacent regulatory sites and thereby enhances TFEB activity. This redox-sensitive control links cellular oxidative status directly to activation of the lysosomal-autophagy program, functioning as a stress sensor. By relieving kinase repression under oxidative conditions, TFEB oxidation promotes clearance of damaged components that generate ROS. The C212 modification exemplifies how cysteine-based redox switches integrate stress signaling with degradative transcription.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 在 cysteine 212 的氧化——例如由活性氧物種或氧化劑引起——損害 mTORC1 介導的鄰近調節位點磷酸化，從而增強 TFEB 活性。這種對氧化還原敏感的控製將細胞氧化狀態直接連結到溶酶體—自噬程序的活化，作為一種壓力感測器。透過在氧化條件下解除激酶抑制，TFEB 氧化促進清除會產生 ROS 的受損組分。C212 修飾舉例說明了基於半胱胺酸的氧化還原方程序如何將壓力信號與降解轉錄整合。

label: TFEB independent of mTOR
description: Protein kinase C (PKC) activation induces TFEB nuclear translocation through an mTORC1-independent route, primarily by inactivating GSK3β, which otherwise phosphorylates TFEB at cytosolic-retention sites. This alternative regulatory input allows TFEB to be engaged by diacylglycerol and calcium signaling without requiring nutrient deprivation. The pathway diversifies the contexts—such as immune cell activation—in which the autophagy-lysosomal program can be turned on. It demonstrates that TFEB is controlled by parallel kinase networks rather than solely by mTOR.
description_zh_TW: 蛋白激酶 C（PKC）的活化透過不依賴 mTORC1 的途徑誘導 TFEB 核轉運，主要是透過使 GSK3β 失去活性，而後者本會在細胞質保留位點磷酸化 TFEB。這種替代性調節輸入使得 TFEB 能夠在不需要營養匱乏的情況下，被二醯甘油和鈣信號所啟動。此途徑使自噬—溶酶體程序可被開啟的脈絡多元化——例如免疫細胞活化。它證明了 TFEB 受平行激酶網絡而非僅由 mTOR 所控制。

label: S-sulfhydration at C212
source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md
description: S-sulfhydration of TFEB at cysteine 212, catalyzed by the cystathionine gamma-lyase (CTH)-derived hydrogen sulfide (H2S) system, promotes its nuclear translocation and activation. This post-translational modification, distinct from oxidation, converts C212 into a persulfide that alters TFEB interactions and favors a transcriptionally active state. The regulation ties sulfur metabolism and H2S signaling to the autophagy-lysosomal network, with implications for cardiovascular and neurodegenerative protection. It represents a gasotransmitter-based mechanism controlling cellular clearance.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 在 cysteine 212 的 S-硫化（S-sulfhydration），由 cystathionine gamma-lyase（CTH）衍生的硫化氫（H2S）系統催化，促進其核轉運和活化。此轉譯後修飾不同於氧化，將 C212 轉化為過硫化物，改變 TFEB 交互作用並有利於轉錄活化狀態。此調節將硫代謝和 H2S 信號聯繫到自噬—溶酶體網絡，對心血管和神經退化保護具有意義。它代表了一種控制細胞清除的氣體傳遞分子（gasotransmitter）基礎機制。

label: Phosphorylated TFEB
description: STUB1 (CHIP), an E3 ubiquitin ligase, recognizes and ubiquitinates phosphorylated TFEB, targeting the transcription factor for proteasomal degradation. This mechanism ensures that TFEB levels are coupled to its phosphorylation state, providing a negative-feedback brake on sustained activation. By eliminating phosphorylated, cytosolically retained TFEB, STUB1 limits the accumulation of inactive protein and fine-tunes the amplitude of the autophagic response. The pathway connects TFEB turnover to the ubiquitin-proteasome system rather than to lysosomal degradation.
description_zh_TW: STUB1（CHIP）是一種 E3 泛素連接酶，辨識並泛素化磷酸化的 TFEB，將此轉錄因子標定為蛋白酶體降解。此機制確保 TFEB 水平與其磷酸化狀態耦合，提供對持續活化的負回饋制動。透過清除磷酸化、細胞質保留的 TFEB，STUB1 限制非活性蛋白的累積並微調自噬反應的幅度。此途徑將 TFEB 更新連結到泛素—蛋白酶體系統，而非溶酶體降解。

label: PGC1-alpha
source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md
description: TFEB and the mitochondrial biogenesis coactivator PGC-1α form a positive feedback loop: PGC-1α modulates mitophagy by regulating TFEB expression, while TFEB induces PGC-1α transcription, reinforcing mitochondrial turnover and biogenesis. This reciprocal regulation couples lysosomal-autophagic clearance with mitochondrial network expansion under stress. The loop ensures coordinated enhancement of both degradative and biosynthetic mitochondrial programs. Its disruption impairs metabolic adaptation and is relevant to aging and myopathy.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 與粒線體生物發生共活化因子 PGC-1α 形成正向回饋環：PGC-1α 透過調節 TFEB 表現來調控粒線體自噬，而 TFEB 誘發 PGC-1α 轉錄，強化粒線體週轉與生物發生。此相互調節在壓力下將溶酶體—自噬性清除與粒線體網絡擴張耦合起來。此迴圈確保降解性和合成性粒線體程序的協調增強。其失調損害代謝適應，並與老化和肌病相關。

label: Autophagy-lysosomal pathway
source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md
description: TFEB is a master transcriptional regulator of the autophagy-lysosomal pathway, coordinating the expression of genes required for autophagosome formation, cargo recognition, lysosomal biogenesis, and substrate degradation. Its activation simultaneously boosts both the supply of autophagosomes and the degradative capacity of lysosomes, ensuring coherent flux rather than unbalanced initiation. TFEB thereby couples the two halves of autophagy—sequestration and degradation—into a single coordinated program. Dysregulation of this axis contributes to lysosomal storage disorders, neurodegeneration, and cancer.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 是自噬—溶酶體途徑的主轉錄調控因子，協調自噬體形成、貨物辨識、溶酶體生物發生和受質降解所需基因的表現。其活化同時提升自噬體的供應和溶酶體的降解能力，確保協調的流而非不平衡的起始。TFEB 因此將自噬的兩半——隔離和降解——耦合為單一協調程序。此軸的失調促成溶酶體儲存障礙、神經退化和癌症。

label: Mitochondrial stress
source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md
description: TFEB is activated in response to mitochondrial stress, a process requiring mitophagy machinery including PINK1, Parkin, Atg9A, and Atg5 to signal and enable TFEB nuclear translocation. As damaged mitochondria are selected for autophagic removal, TFEB coordinates a compensatory lysosomal and autophagic response that restores organelle quality. This coupling ensures that mitochondrial turnover is matched by degradative capacity. The axis links mitochondrial quality control to the broader autophagy-lysosomal network and to metabolic homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 在回應粒線體壓力時被活化，此過程需要包括 PINK1、Parkin、Atg9A 和 Atg5 在內的粒線體自噬機械來傳遞信號並促成 TFEB 核轉位。當受損粒線體被選擇進行自噬移除時，TFEB 協調一個代償性的溶酶體和自噬反應，以恢復胞器品質。此耦合確保粒線體週轉由降解能力所匹配。該軸將粒線體品質控制連結到更廣泛的自噬—溶酶體網絡以及代謝恆定性。

label: Immune response
source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md
description: TFEB regulates innate and adaptive immune responses, becoming activated during dendritic cell maturation to enhance antigen processing and presentation via expanded lysosomal and MHC-related machinery. By boosting degradative capacity, TFEB improves the efficiency of antigen degradation and epitope loading, strengthening T cell priming. TFEB activity also influences macrophage polarization and immune cell metabolism. These roles position the autophagy-lysosomal master regulator as an important modulator of immunity.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 調節先天和適應性免疫反應，在樹突細胞成熟過程中被活化，透過擴增的溶酶體和 MHC 相關機械來增強抗原處理與呈現。透過提升降解能力，TFEB 改善了抗原降解和表位加載的效率，強化了 T 細胞啟動。TFEB 活性也影響巨噬細胞極化和免疫細胞代謝。這些角色將自噬—溶酶體主調節者定位為免疫的重要調節者。

label: Lipid Catabolism
description: TFEB regulates lipid catabolism by upregulating genes involved in fatty acid import, beta-oxidation, lysosomal acid lipase (LAL)-mediated lipophagy, and the transcriptional coactivators PGC-1α and PPAR-α. Through these targets, TFEB coordinates the mobilization and oxidation of stored lipids during fasting and stress. This lipid-catabolic program complements TFEB's role in protein and organelle turnover, rendering it a comprehensive metabolic regulator. Enhanced TFEB activity improves lipid handling and protects against hepatic steatosis.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 透過上調參與脂肪酸輸入、β 氧化、溶酶體酸性脂肪酶（LAL）介導的脂噬，以及轉錄共活化因子 PGC-1α 和 PPAR-α 的基因，來調節脂質分解代謝。透過這些標的，TFEB 在禁食和壓力期間協調儲存脂質的動員和氧化。此脂質分解代謝程序補充了 TFEB 在蛋白質和胞器週轉中的角色，使它成為全面的代謝調節者。增強的 TFEB 活性改善脂質處理並保護對抗肝臟脂肪變性。

label: K316
source_file: _document_ - From the regulatory mechanism of TFEB to its therapeutic implications - Cell Death Discovery.md
description: TFEB undergoes SUMOylation at lysine 316, a small ubiquitin-like modifier conjugation that attenuates its transcriptional activity. SUMOylation typically modulates protein-protein interactions and subnuclear compartmentalization, and at K316 it dampens TFEB-driven expression of lysosomal genes. This modification adds another layer to the post-translational code governing TFEB, acting in opposition to activatory marks such as deacetylation. The reversibility of SUMOylation by SENPs allows dynamic tuning of the degradative program.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 在 lysine 316 發生 SUMOylation，這是一種削弱其轉錄活性的小型泛素樣修飾物共軛。SUMOylation 通常調節蛋白質—蛋白質交互作用和亞核區室化，在 K316 處它抑制 TFEB 驅動的溶酶體基因表現。此修飾為控制 TFEB 的轉譯後密碼增添了另一層次，作用與去乙醯化等活化標記相反。SUMOylation 可被 SENPs 逆轉，允許對降解程序進行動態微調。

label: TNKS1
description: Tankyrase 1 (TNKS1) poly-ADP-ribosylates (PARsylates) TFEB, a modification that promotes its nuclear translocation and activation of target genes. PARsylation addsADP-ribose polymers that alter TFEB interactions and trafficking, providing a non-phosphorylation route to TFEB activation. This modification broadens the enzymatic toolkit—alongside kinases, phosphatases, acetylases, and ubiquitin ligases—that regulates the autophagy-lysosomal master switch. The TNKS1-TFEB relationship suggests potential crosstalk with Wnt/β-catenin and other PARsylation-dependent pathways.
description_zh_TW: Tankyrase 1（TNKS1）對 TFEB 進行聚 ADP-核糖基化（PARsylation），此修飾促進其核轉運和標的基因的活化。PARsylation 添加 ADP-核糖聚合物，改變 TFEB 交互作用和運輸，提供一條非磷酸化的 TFEB 活化路線。此修飾拓寬了調節自噬—溶酶體主開關的酵素工具箱——與激酶、磷酸酶、乙醯酶和泛素連接酶並列。TNKS1-TFEB 關係暗示了與 Wnt/β-catenin 和其他依賴 PARsylation 途徑的潛在串擾。

label: Rag GTPases
description: TFEB binds Rag GTPases as part of the amino acid-sensing machinery at the lysosomal surface, and this interaction is modulated by post-translational modification: oxidation of cysteine 212 inhibits TFEB's binding to Rag GTPases (PMID 31826695). The Rag GTPase complex is central to nutrient sensing, recruiting mTORC1 and its substrate machinery to the lysosome when amino acids are abundant, and TFEB's association with this complex links TFEB localization to nutrient availability. Oxidation at C212, by disrupting this binding, represents a redox-responsive mechanism that influences TFEB's cellular localization and activity, coupling oxidative stress to the regulation of the autophagy-lysosome pathway.
description_zh_TW: TFEB作為溶酶體表面氨基酸感應機制的一部分與Rag GTPases結合，並且這種相互作用受翻譯後修飾調節：半胱氨酸212的氧化抑製TFEB與Rag GTPases的結合（PMID 31826695）。Rag GTPase复合物是營養感應的核心，當氨基酸充足時將mTORC1及其底物機制招募到溶酶體，TFEB與該复合物的關聯將TFEB定位與營養可用性聯繫起來。C212處的氧化通過破壞這種結合，代表了一種氧化還原響應機制，影響TFEB的細胞定位和活性，將氧化應激與自噬-溶酶體途徑的調節聯繫起來。

label: Aneuploid cells
source_file: _document_ - TFEB AND TFE3, LINKING LYSOSOMES TO CELLULAR ADAPTATION TO STRESS.md
description: TFEB is activated in aneuploid cells as a cellular response to lysosomal stress following lysosomal accumulation of undegraded autophagic cargo. This activation occurs through an mTORC1-independent mechanism involving TFEB nuclear translocation and upregulation of its downstream targets. The response appears wired to stimulate autophagosomal rather than lysosomal biogenesis in these cells. It represents an adaptive mechanism by which aneuploid cells cope with proteotoxicity.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 在非整倍體細胞中被活化，作為對溶酶體累積未降解自噬貨物後之溶酶體壓力的細胞反應。此活化透過不依賴 mTORC1 的機制發生，涉及 TFEB 核轉位及其下游標靶的上調。此反應似乎被設計為刺激這些細胞的自噬體而非溶酶體生物發生。它代表非整倍體細胞應對蛋白毒性的適應機制。

label: Osteoclast function
source_file: _document_ - TFEB AND TFE3, LINKING LYSOSOMES TO CELLULAR ADAPTATION TO STRESS.md
description: TFEB is required for osteoclast function in vivo, as its depletion results in decreased expression of lysosomal genes, reduced lysosome number, and defective bone matrix resorption. RANK treatment promotes TFEB phosphorylation via PKCbeta kinase, leading to TFEB nuclear translocation and induction of lysosomal biogenesis. Nuclear TFEB facilitates secretion of lysosomal hydrolases at the site of bone resorption. This establishes TFEB as essential for skeletal homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 在活體中為破骨細胞功能所必需，因為其缺失導致溶酶體基因表現下降、溶酶體數量減少和骨基質吸收缺陷。RANK 處理經由 PKCbeta 激酶促進 TFEB 磷酸化，導致 TFEB 核轉位和溶酶體生物發生誘導。核 TFEB 促進溶酶體水解酶在骨吸收部位分泌。這確立了 TFEB 對骨骼恆定性的必要性。

label: Lysosomal Exocytosis
source_file: _document_ - TFEB AND TFE3, LINKING LYSOSOMES TO CELLULAR ADAPTATION TO STRESS.md
description: TFEB induces lysosomal exocytosis by increasing the number of lysosomes ready to dock and fuse with the plasma membrane and by eliciting intracellular calcium release through activation of its target gene TRPML1 (MCOLN1). This process promotes cellular clearance in several lysosomal storage disease cell models, including Sanfilippo syndrome, multiple sulfatase deficiency, and Batten disease. TFEB-mediated lysosomal exocytosis plays important roles in bone remodeling and copper homeostasis. Overexpression of TFEB or TFE3 is sufficient to induce lysosome fusion with the plasma membrane.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 透過增加準備停靠並與質膜融合的溶酶體數量，並經由活化其標的基因 TRPML1（MCOLN1）誘發細胞內鈣釋放，來誘導溶酶體胞吐。此過程在數種溶酶體儲存疾病細胞模型中促進細胞清除，包括 Sanfilippo 症候群、多重硫酸酯酶缺乏症和 Batten 病。TFEB 介導的溶酶體胞吐在骨重塑和銅恆定性中發揮重要作用。TFEB 或 TFE3 的過度表現足以誘導溶酶體與質膜融合。

label: bHLH-LZ Transcription Factors
description: The MiT/TFE subfamily including TFEB belongs to the bHLH-LZ factor class. Classification nests the subfamily.
description_zh_TW: 包括 TFEB 的 MiT/TFE 亞家族屬於 bHLH-LZ 因子類。歸類嵌套亞家族。

label: Eltrombopag
description: Eltrombopag is a direct inhibitor of TFEB: it disrupts TFEB's interaction with DNA, preventing induction of autophagy genes and thereby blocking autophagic flux.
description_zh_TW: Eltrombopag 是 TFEB 的直接抑制劑：它破壞 TFEB 與 DNA 的交互作用，阻斷自噬基因的誘導，因而阻斷自噬流。

label: MiT Family Translocation RCC
description: MiT family translocation renal cell carcinoma is a kidney cancer subtype defined by chromosomal translocations fusing TFE3 or TFEB to partner genes, causing constitutive nuclear localization of these MiTF/TFE factors. TFEB overexpression is the driver in t(6;11) disease, where MALAT1 is the fusion partner.
description_zh_TW: MiT 家族轉位腎細胞癌是一種腎癌亞型，由將 TFE3 或 TFEB 與夥伴基因融合的染色體轉位所定義，造成這些 MiTF/TFE 因子的組成性核內定位。在 t(6;11) 型中 TFEB 過度表現為驅動力，其融合夥伴為 MALAT1。

label: PARsylation
description: PARsylation (poly-ADP-ribosylation) is a reversible post-translational modification in which poly(ADP-ribose) chains are added to target proteins by PARP family enzymes (TNKS1, PARP1, PARP2) using NAD+ as substrate. It regulates TFEB nuclear localization via Tankyrases and also acts on ULK1 and mTORC1 components to control Autophagy; PARP inhibitors such as Olaparib induce autophagy in cancer cells.
description_zh_TW: PARsylation（poly-ADP-ribosylation）是一種可逆的轉譯後修飾，由 PARP 家族酵素（TNKS1、PARP1、PARP2）以 NAD+ 為受體將 poly(ADP-ribose) 鏈加到目標蛋白上。它透過 Tankyrases 調控 TFEB 的核內定位，也作用於 ULK1 與 mTORC1 組件以控制 Autophagy；PARP 抑制劑如 Olaparib 可在癌細胞中誘發自噬。

label: Glucosylation
description: Glucosylation is one of the post-translational modifications that set TFEB activity and subcellular localization, alongside phosphorylation, acetylation, ubiquitination, PARylation, SUMOylation, oxidation and S-sulfhydration. SetA-mediated glucosylation of TFEB shifts it to the nucleus.
description_zh_TW: Glucosylation 是決定 TFEB 活性與細胞內定位的轉譯後修飾之一，與磷酸化、乙醯化、泛素化、PAR 化、SUMO 化、氧化及 S-硫氫化並列。SetA 媒介的 TFEB glucosylation 會使其轉移至細胞核。

label: dopamine in Striatum
description: Stimulus-response learning depends on dopamine signaling in the striatum, particularly within corticostriatal circuits where dopamine modulates the synaptic plasticity underlying habit formation. Both excessive and insufficient striatal dopamine, shaped by DAT, COMT, and receptor tone, disrupt S-R acquisition and procedural learning. COMT overexpression models demonstrate that altered dopamine clearance impairs this learning. This makes striatal dopamine a key determinant of habit and skill learning efficiency.
description_zh_TW: Stimulus-response learning 依賴紋狀體中的多巴胺訊號傳導，特別是在皮質紋狀體迴路中，其中多巴胺調節 habit formation 底層的 synaptic plasticity。由 DAT、COMT 和受體音調形成的紋狀體多巴胺過多和不足都會擾亂 S-R 獲取和程序性學習。 COMT 過度表現模型顯示多巴胺清除率的改變會損害這種學習。這使得紋狀體多巴胺成為習慣和技能學習效率的關鍵決定因素。

label: better Working Memory performance
description: The Met/Met (slow) COMT genotype is associated with better performance on complex working memory tasks, attributed to the elevated prefrontal dopamine tone produced by reduced enzyme activity. Under non-stressful conditions, this higher dopamine level falls near the peak of the inverted-U curve for cognition, favoring stability, accuracy, and maintenance of information. The association is robust at the group level but moderate in effect size and sensitive to task demands, sex, and environmental context such as stress. It is among the most replicated gene-cognition associations in humans.
description_zh_TW: Met/Met（慢）COMT genotype 與複雜工作記憶任務的較佳表現有關，這歸因於酵素活性降低產生的前額葉多巴胺張力升高。在無壓力的情況下，這種較高的多巴胺水平落在認知倒 U 曲線的峰值附近，有利於訊息的穩定性、準確性和維護。這種關聯在群體層面上很強，但效應大小適中，並且對任務要求、性別和壓力等環境背景敏感。它是人類複製最多的基因認知關聯之一。

label: higher anxiety
description: The Met/Met genotype is associated with higher anxiety traits, consistent with the worrier phenotype in which elevated prefrontal dopamine and norepinephrine promote heightened vigilance and emotional reactivity. Multiple studies report increased anxiety sensitivity in slow COMT individuals, though effect sizes are modest and context-dependent. The association follows from altered catecholamine tone rather than a direct anxietogenic mutation. It is frequently discussed in gene-environment and stress reactivity research.
description_zh_TW: Met/Met 基因型與 higher anxiety 性狀相關，與擔憂者表型一致，其中前額葉多巴胺升高和 norepinephrine 促進提高警覺性和情緒反應性。多項研究報告稱，慢速 COMT 個體的焦慮敏感性有所增加，但效果大小適中且取決於具體情況。這種關聯源自於兒茶酚胺音調的改變，而不是直接的焦慮突變。它在基因環境和壓力反應研究中經常被討論。

label: higher baseline dopamine
description: The Met/Met genotype is associated with higher baseline extracellular dopamine, because reduced COMT activity diminishes the primary route of cortical dopamine inactivation. This elevated tonic dopamine especially affects the prefrontal cortex, where DAT is sparse and COMT dominates clearance. The resulting dopamine surplus shapes cognition, anxiety, and reward sensitivity in slow COMT individuals, consistent with the worrier phenotype. It is the mechanistic link between COMT genotype and its behavioral correlates.
description_zh_TW: Met/Met 基因型與較高的基線細胞外多巴胺相關，因為減少的 COMT activity 減少了皮質多巴胺失活的主要途徑。這種升高的強直性多巴胺尤其影響前額葉皮質，該處 DAT 稀疏，而 COMT 主導清除。由此產生的多巴胺過剩影響了慢速 COMT 個體的認知、焦慮和 reward 敏感性，與憂慮者表型一致。它是 COMT genotype 與其行為相關物之間的機制連結。

label: Worrier phenotype
description: The Met/Met genotype is called the Worrier phenotype, a popularized label reflecting the tendency toward heightened anxiety, vigilance, and careful, deliberative cognitive processing linked to elevated catecholamine tone. The term contrasts with the Warrior label for fast (Val/Val) genotypes, who are described as stress-resilient and rapid processors. While useful heuristically, the phenotype oversimplifies a continuous, context-dependent trait influenced by stress and environment. It remains widely used in science communication about COMT genetics.
description_zh_TW: Met/Met 基因型被稱為 Worrier phenotype，這是一個流行的標籤，反映了與兒茶酚胺張力升高相關的焦慮、警覺性和仔細、深思熟慮的認知處理傾向。該術語與快速（Val/Val）基因型的戰士標籤形成鮮明對比，後者被描述為具有抗壓能力和快速處理能力。雖然啟發式有用，但表型過度簡化了受壓力和環境影響的連續的、依賴背景的特徵。它仍然廣泛用於有關 COMT 遺傳學的科學傳播。

label: low COMT activity
description: The Met/Met genotype produces low COMT enzyme activity, roughly three- to four-fold below Val/Val levels, due to the thermolabile methionine-containing protein that is degraded more readily at body temperature. This reduced activity slows elimination of catecholamines and catechol drugs, prolonging their action and raising extracellular dopamine, particularly in the prefrontal cortex. It is the defining biochemical feature of the slow COMT end of the spectrum. This biochemical phenotype underpins the associated cognitive, mood, and drug-response differences.
description_zh_TW: Met/Met 基因型產生較低的 COMT 酶活性，大約比 Val/Val 水平低三到四倍，這是因為含有不耐熱蛋氨酸的蛋白質在體溫下更容易降解。這種活性的降低減緩了 catecholamines 和兒茶酚藥物的消除，延長了它們的作用並提高了細胞外多巴胺，特別是在前額葉皮質。這是光譜中緩慢的 COMT 端的決定性生化特徵。這種生化表型是相關認知、情緒和藥物反應差異的基礎。

label: poorer Working Memory under stress
description: The Val/Val (fast) COMT genotype is associated with poorer working memory performance, especially under stress, because rapid dopamine clearance lowers prefrontal dopamine below the optimal range of the inverted-U curve. Stress-induced dopamine release is more quickly inactivated in fast genotypes, worsening cognitive efficiency precisely when performance matters most. This effect is most evident on demanding, load-bearing working memory tasks and under challenging conditions. The interaction between genotype and environmental stress is a hallmark finding in COMT research.
description_zh_TW: Val/Val（快速）COMT genotype 與較差的工作記憶表現相關，尤其是在壓力下，因為快速多巴胺清除會將前額葉多巴胺降低到倒 U 曲線的最佳範圍以下。在快速基因型中，壓力引起的多巴胺釋放會更快失活，從而在表現最重要的時候使認知效率惡化。這種效應在要求高、承載工作記憶任務和具有挑戰性的條件下最為明顯。基因型與環境壓力之間的相互作用是 COMT 研究的一個標誌性發現。

label: lower prefrontal dopamine
description: The Val/Val genotype is associated with lower prefrontal dopamine because rapid COMT-mediated clearance depletes the extracellular catecholamine pool in a region where DAT is sparse and COMT dominates inactivation. This reduced dopamine tone shifts working memory and executive function away from the inverted-U optimum, producing poorer performance on stability-dependent and load-heavy tasks. The relationship is a primary mechanism linking COMT genotype to cognition and behavior. It underlies the fast COMT cognitive phenotype and its stress-related trade-offs.
description_zh_TW: Val/Val 基因型與 lower prefrontal dopamine 相關，因為 COMT 介導的快速清除會耗盡 DAT 稀疏且 COMT 失活占主導地位的區域中的細胞外兒茶酚胺庫。這種減少的多巴胺色調使工作記憶和 executive function 偏離倒 U 形最佳狀態，從而在依賴穩定性和負載繁重的任務中產生較差的性能。這種關係是將 COMT genotype 與認知和行為連結起來的主要機制。它是 COMT 快速認知表型及其與壓力相關的權衡的基礎。

label: stress resilience
description: The Val/Val genotype is associated with stress resilience, the Warrior phenotype, because fast COMT rapidly clears stress-evoked catecholamines, preventing excessive dopaminergic and noradrenergic buildup that could impair performance under pressure. This contrasts with slow COMT, which is linked to anxiety and the worrier phenotype. The label is heuristic, and effects depend on context and task, with the advantage most evident under demanding conditions. It is a widely cited example of gene-environment interaction.
description_zh_TW: Val/Val 基因型與 stress resilience、Warrior phenotype 相關，因為快速 COMT 可以快速清除壓力誘發的 catecholamines，防止多巴胺能和去甲腎上腺素能過度積聚，從而損害壓力下的表現。這與緩慢的 COMT 形成鮮明對比，COMT 與焦慮和擔憂表型有關。這個標籤是啟發式的，效果取決於上下文和任務，在苛刻的條件下優勢最為明顯。這是基因與環境相互作用的一個被廣泛引用的例子。

label: Warrior phenotype
description: The Val/Val genotype is called the Warrior phenotype, a popularized descriptor for the putative advantage in stress resilience and rapid processing conferred by fast COMT and lower baseline dopamine. It contrasts with the Worrier Met/Met label, which is associated with anxiety and careful, deliberative processing. While memorable and useful heuristically, the phenotype is an oversimplification of a continuous, context-dependent trait influenced by stress and environment. It remains widely used in science communication about COMT genetics.
description_zh_TW: Val/Val 基因型被稱為 Warrior phenotype，這是 stress resilience 的假定優勢以及快速 COMT 和較低基線多巴胺賦予的快速處理的流行描述符。它與“Worrier Met/Met”標籤形成鮮明對比，後者與焦慮和仔細、深思熟慮的處理有關。雖然令人難忘且啟發式地有用，但表型是受壓力和環境影響的連續的、依賴於背景的特徵的過度簡化。它仍然廣泛用於有關 COMT 遺傳學的科學傳播。

label: psychiatric disorder risk
description: Val158Met impacts risk for psychiatric disorders such as schizophrenia, with the Val allele associated with modestly increased risk through prefrontal dopaminergic dysregulation, though effects are modified by environment and other genes. The association is replicated but small in absolute terms, reflecting the polygenic architecture of psychiatric disorders. It illustrates how a single functional polymorphism can contribute to complex neuropsychiatric vulnerability. COMT remains a candidate gene of sustained interest in psychiatric genetics.
description_zh_TW: Val158Met 影響精神分裂症等精神疾病的風險，Val 等位基因透過前額葉多巴胺能失調與適度增加的風險相關，儘管影響會受到環境和其他基因的影響。這種關聯是重複的，但絕對值很小，反映了精神疾病的多基因結構。它說明了單一功能多態性如何導致複雜的神經精神脆弱性。 COMT 仍然是精神遺傳學領域持續關注的候選基因。

label: response to methyl donor supplements
description: Val158Met impacts the response to methyl donor supplements because COMT activity determines how quickly an individual processes the added methyl load; slow (Met) carriers are more prone to mood side effects from methylfolate or methylB12, while fast (Val) carriers tolerate them better. This makes genotype relevant to personalizing methylation supplements, with slow individuals advised to use lower doses or non-methylated forms. The directionality is consistent with COMT's role in methyl clearance. It is a practical pharmacogenetic consideration in supplementation.
description_zh_TW: Val158Met 影響 response to methyl donor supplements，因為 COMT activity 決定個體處理添加的甲基負載的速度；慢速（Met）攜帶者更容易受到甲基葉酸或甲基B12的情緒副作用的影響，而快速（Val）攜帶者則能更好地耐受它們。這使得基因型與個人化甲基化補充劑有關，建議慢速個體使用較低劑量或非甲基化形式。方向性與COMT在甲基清除中的作用一致。這是補充劑中實用的藥物基因考慮因素。

label: Valine to Methionine substitution
description: Val158Met involves a valine-to-methionine amino acid substitution at codon 158 of the COMT enzyme, replacing a hydrophobic residue with a polar one that destabilizes the protein and reduces its catalytic activity in the Met form. This single missense change is the molecular basis of the fast-slow COMT dichotomy and of the three- to four-fold differences in enzyme activity among genotypes. It is the defining feature of the rs4680 polymorphism. The substitution alters protein thermostability rather than substrate binding directly.
description_zh_TW: Val158Met 涉及 COMT 酶密碼子 158 處的纈氨酸至甲硫氨酸氨基酸取代，以極性殘基取代疏水性殘基，從而使蛋白質不穩定並降低其 Met 形式的催化活性。這種單一的錯義變化是快慢 COMT 二分法以及基因型之間酵素活性三到四倍差異的分子基礎。這是 rs4680 多態性的定義特性。這種取代改變了蛋白質的熱穩定性，而不是直接改變底物結合。

label: SNP in COMT
description: Val158Met is a SNP in the COMT gene, specifically a missense variant that alters enzyme function rather than merely regulatory sequence, making it a functional polymorphism. Its location within the COMT coding region directly changes protein thermostability and activity, producing the fast-slow enzyme dichotomy. It is therefore both a marker and a mechanistic driver of COMT-related traits, including cognition, mood, and drug response. It exemplifies how a single coding variant can have broad biological consequences.
description_zh_TW: Val158Met 是 COMT 基因中的 SNP，特別是一種錯義變異體，它改變酵素功能而不僅僅是調節序列，使其成為功能性多態性。它在 COMT 編碼區內的位置直接改變蛋白質的熱穩定性和活性，產生快慢酶二分法。因此，它既是 COMT 相關特徵（包括認知、情緒和 drug response）的標記，也是機械驅動因素。它舉例說明了單一編碼變體如何產生廣泛的生物學後果。

label: rs4680
description: Val158Met is also known as rs4680, the dbSNP reference identifier for the G-to-A single nucleotide change at this locus that produces the Val/Met amino acid polymorphism. This designation is used in genome-wide and candidate-gene studies to tag COMT function and to standardize reporting of COMT genotype across research. The rs4680 annotation allows results to be compared across studies and populations. It is one of the most frequently genotyped SNPs in neuropsychiatric and pharmacogenetic research.
description_zh_TW: Val158Met 也稱為 rs4680，是產生 Val/Met 氨基酸多態性的該基因座上 G 至 A 單核苷酸變化的 dbSNP 參考標識符。此名稱用於全基因組和候選基因研究，以標記 COMT 功能並標準化整個研究中 COMT genotype 的報告。 rs4680 註釋允許跨研究和人群比較結果。它是神經精神病學和藥物遺傳學研究中最常見的基因分型 SNPs 之一。

label: vitamin E cancer prevention
description: Val158Met modulates the effect of vitamin E (alpha-tocopherol) supplementation on cancer prevention, such that slow COMT individuals derive protective benefit whereas fast COMT individuals may experience increased cancer risk. The proposed mechanism involves COMT-dependent metabolism of vitamin E-related catecholic intermediates and interactions with catecholestrogen handling, which differ by enzyme activity. This gene-nutrient interaction has emerged from genotype-stratified analyses of supplementation trials. It highlights the need for genotype-aware antioxidant recommendations.
description_zh_TW: Val158Met 調節維生素 E（α-生育醇）補充劑對癌症預防的作用，使得行動緩慢的 COMT 個體獲得保護性益處，而行動快速的 COMT 個體可能會經歷更高的癌症風險。所提出的機制涉及維生素 E 相關兒茶酚中間體的 COMT 依賴性代謝以及與兒茶酚雌激素處理的相互作用，其因酶活性而異。這種基因與營養素的相互作用是從補充劑試驗的基因型分層分析中得出的。它強調了對基因型敏感的抗氧化劑建議的需求。

label: Aspirin response
description: Val158Met modulates the response to aspirin, determining whether cardiovascular outcomes are protective, as in slow/Met individuals, or neutral or harmful, as in fast/Val individuals, through genotype-dependent alterations in catecholamine and folate metabolism that modify aspirin's vascular effects. This interaction positions COMT as a biomarker for aspirin chemoprevention and cardiovascular risk stratification. The directionality is among the better-studied COMT-drug effects. It exemplifies pharmacogenetics in cardiovascular medicine.
description_zh_TW: Val158Met 調節對阿斯匹靈的反應，透過兒茶酚胺和 folate 代謝的基因型依賴性改變改變阿斯匹靈的血管效應，確定心血管結果是否具有保護性（如慢速/Met 個體）或中性或有害（如快速/Val 個體）。這種相互作用使 COMT 成為阿斯匹靈化學預防和心血管風險分層的生物標記。方向性是 COMT 藥物作用中研究得最好的之一。它體現了心血管醫學中的藥物遺傳學。

label: Modafinil response
description: Val158Met modulates the response to modafinil, with faster (Val) genotypes showing greater cognitive and wake-promoting benefit because modafinil's DAT inhibition raises dopamine from a lower COMT-set baseline, whereas slow (Met) carriers are nearer the optimum and gain less or may be over-stimulated. This pharmacogenetic interaction guides personalized stimulant use and has been demonstrated in cognitive and clinical studies. It is one of several COMT-dependent drug responses. Genotype-aware prescribing could optimize modafinil outcomes.
description_zh_TW: Val158Met 調節對莫達非尼的反應，較快 (Val) 基因型顯示出更大的認知和喚醒促進益處，因為莫達非尼的 DAT 抑制使多巴胺從較低的 COMT 設定基線升高，而較慢 (Met) 基因型更接近最佳狀態，增益較少或可能被過度刺激。這種藥物基因交互作用指導個人化興奮劑的使用，並已在認知和臨床研究中得到證實。它是幾種 COMT 依賴性藥物反應之一。基因型感知處方可以優化莫達非尼的療效。

label: Methyl donor supplements
source_file: _document_ - COMT How to Optimize Your Supplements for Your COMT Genotype.md
description: People with slow COMT enzyme variants may find that supplements affecting the methylation cycle can affect their neurotransmitter levels. A sudden influx of methyl groups from high doses of methyl donor supplements can cause irritability, anger, or anxiety. Clinicians often recommend against taking methyl donor supplements for slow COMT (rs4680 A/A).
description_zh_TW: 具有緩慢 COMT 酶變異的人可能發現，影響 methylation cycle 的補充劑會影響其神經傳導物質水平。高劑量甲基供體補充劑帶來的甲基群突然湧入可能導致煩躁、憤怒或焦慮。臨床醫師常建議緩慢 COMT (rs4680 A/A) 者不要服用甲基供體補充劑。

label: habit learning
description: Stimulus-response (S-R) learning is a form of procedural/habit learning in which a specific stimulus comes to automatically trigger a stereotyped behavioral response, independent of outcome valuation. It contrasts with goal-directed action and is the basis of habits, skills, and conditioned motor routines. It underlies both adaptive expertise and maladaptive habits such as addiction.
description_zh_TW: Stimulus-response (S-R) learning 是程序性/習慣學習的一種形式，其中特定刺激會自動觸發刻板的行為反應，與結果評價無關。它與目標導向行動形成對比，是習慣、技能和條件化運動常規的基礎。它既構成適應性專長，也構成成癮等適應不良習慣的基礎。

label: nootropic response
description: Val158Met stratifies nootropic benefit because COMT-set cortical dopamine determines how much modafinil-class dopaminergic enhancement can help. Fast genotypes gain more from the same dose.
description_zh_TW: Val158Met 分層 nootropic 效益，因 COMT 設定的皮質多巴胺決定多巴胺增強能幫多少。快速基因型從相同劑量獲益更多。

label: cADP-Ribose
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: CD38 is the primary NADase in mammals, an ectoenzyme that uses NAD+ to produce and hydrolyze cADP-ribose, a Ca2+-mobilizing second messenger. Because CD38 also degrades the NAD+ intermediates nicotinamide riboside (NR) and nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN), its activity further decreases the content of NAD+. CD38 content increases with age, contributing to the age-related decline in NAD+ and mitochondrial dysfunction. In CD38-deficient mice, NAD+ levels remain high, preserving mitochondrial respiration and metabolic function with age, and pharmacological inhibition of CD38 can increase NAD+ levels and improve glucose and lipid metabolism.
description_zh_TW: CD38 是哺乳動物中主要的 NADase，為一種胞外酶，利用 NAD+ 產生並水解 cADP-ribose，後者是一種可動員 Ca2+ 的第二信使。由於 CD38 也會降解 NAD+ 中間代謝物 nicotinamide riboside（NR）與 nicotinamide mononucleotide（NMN），其活性進一步降低 NAD+ 含量。CD38 含量隨年齡增加而上升，促成與年齡相關的 NAD+ 下降與粒線體功能障礙。在 CD38 缺陷小鼠中，NAD+ 水平維持高值，隨年齡保留粒線體呼吸與代謝功能，而 CD38 的藥理抑制可提升 NAD+ 水平並改善葡萄糖與脂質代謝。

label: Viral Translation
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: PARPs play a critical antiviral role by inhibiting the translation of viral transcripts through ADP-ribosylation of the viral genome, a process requiring NAD+. However, several viral families including SARS-CoV encode a macrodomain protein that hydrolyses the ADPR units from proteins and nucleic acids, inhibiting this PARP protective effect and facilitating replication and virulence. Excessive PARP activation then occurs to compensate for ADPR hydrolysis, accompanied by NAD+ consumption. This suggests that increasing NAD+ levels may restore the antiviral functions of PARPs to support immunity against SARS-CoV-2, providing a rationale for NAD+ precursor supplementation in COVID-19.
description_zh_TW: PARPs 透過對病毒基因組進行 ADP-核糖基化以抑制病毒轉錄本的轉譯，發揮關鍵的抗病毒作用，此過程需要 NAD+。然而，包括 SARS-CoV 在內的數個病毒家族編碼一種 macrodomain 蛋白，可水解蛋白質與核酸上的 ADPR 單元，抑制此 PARP 保護效應並促進複製與毒力。隨後發生過度的 PARP 活化以補償 ADPR 水解，伴隨 NAD+ 消耗。這顯示提升 NAD+ 水平可能恢復 PARPs 的抗病毒功能以支持對抗 SARS-CoV-2 的免疫力，為 COVID-19 中 NAD+ 前驅物補充提供了理據。

label: SARS-CoV-2 macrodomain
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: The SARS-CoV-2 macrodomain is a viral protein that hydrolyses the ADP-ribose (ADPR) units added by PARPs to proteins and nucleic acids, thereby inhibiting the protective antiviral effect of PARPs and facilitating viral replication and virulence. Because PARPs require NAD+ to ADP-ribosylate viral transcripts, this counteraction leads to excessive PARP activation and NAD+ consumption during infection, dysregulating the NAD+ metabolome. Restoring NAD+ levels with precursors may therefore restore PARP antiviral function and support innate immunity to SARS-CoV-2, connecting NAD+ metabolism directly to COVID-19 severity and immune defense.
description_zh_TW: SARS-CoV-2 macrodomain 是一種病毒蛋白，可水解 PARPs 加到蛋白質與核酸上的 ADP-核糖（ADPR）單元，從而抑制 PARPs 的保護性抗病毒效應並促進病毒複製與毒力。由於 PARPs 需要 NAD+ 來對病毒轉錄本進行 ADP-核糖基化，此對抗作用導致感染期間過度的 PARP 活化與 NAD+ 消耗，使 NAD+ 代謝組失調。因此，以前驅物恢復 NAD+ 水平可能恢復 PARP 抗病毒功能並支持對 SARS-CoV-2 的先天免疫，將 NAD+ 代謝直接連結到 COVID-19 嚴重程度與免疫防禦。

label: Purine Nucleoside Phosphorylase
description: Purine nucleoside phosphorylase (NP) converts nicotinamide riboside (NR) into nicotinamide (NAM), which can then be converted back to NAD+ via NMN through the NAMPT and NMNAT enzymes. This NP-mediated cleavage is believed to be the variable step that degrades NR to NAM in the gut, potentially explaining the low and interindividually variable oral bioavailability of NR. NAM is the most common NAD+ precursor in mammals, and when administered at higher doses it can exert sirtuin-inhibiting effects. The balance between the direct NMRK pathway and this NP/NAMPT route determines how efficiently supplemented NR is converted to NAD+ in different tissues.
description_zh_TW: 嘌呤核苷磷酸化酶（NP）將菸鹼醯胺核糖苷（NR）轉化為菸鹼醯胺（NAM），後者隨後可透過 NMN 經由 NAMPT 與 NMNAT 酵素轉回 NAD+。此種由 NP 介導的裂解被認為是在腸道中將 NR 降解為 NAM 的變異步驟，可能解釋了 NR 口服生體可用率偏低且在個體間存在差異的現象。NAM 是哺乳動物中最常見的 NAD+ 前體，當以較高劑量投予時，可產生抑制 sirtuin 的效應。直接 NMRK 路徑與此 NP/NAMPT 途徑之間的平衡，決定了補充的 NR 在不同組織中轉化為 NAD+ 的效率。

label: NAD+ in tumor microenvironment
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins (overview, CD38 KO risks, cancer therapies).md
description: CD38 enzymatic activity depletes NAD+ in the tumor microenvironment and generates adenosine, suppressing anti-tumor T-cell and NK-cell responses. Directionally, CD38 sits upstream of NAD+ depletion and immunosuppression. This links CD38 to cancer immune evasion, and anti-CD38 antibodies both target myeloma and reshape the tumor microenvironment. By consuming NAD+ and producing immunosuppressive adenosine, CD38 on tumor and immune cells dampens anti-tumor immunity. This dual role makes CD38 both a therapeutic target and a mechanism of immune escape in cancer.
description_zh_TW: CD38 酶活性在腫瘤微環境中耗竭 NAD+ 並產生腺苷，抑制抗腫瘤 T 細胞和 NK 細胞反應。在方向性上，CD38 位於 NAD+ 耗竭和免疫抑制的上游。這將 CD38 與癌症免疫逃逸聯繫起來，抗 CD38 抗體既能靶向骨髓瘤也能重塑腫瘤微環境。透過消耗 NAD+ 和產生免疫抑制性腺苷，腫瘤和免疫細胞上的 CD38 削弱抗腫瘤免疫。這種雙重角色使 CD38 成為癌症中的治療靶標和免疫逃逸機制。

label: Axonal/Wallerian degeneration (via SIRT1)
description: Nmnat, the NAD+-biosynthetic enzyme, protects axons from Wallerian degeneration largely by raising NAD+ and thereby activating SIRT1, which supports axonal survival after injury. The protection is upstream of SIRT1-dependent maintenance of mitochondrial and chromatin function in neurons, preserving axon integrity when the soma is damaged. Directionally, Nmnat increases NAD+, which activates SIRT1 to provide axonal protection. This established a key NAD+/sirtuin axis in neuronal resilience, informed subsequent studies of SARM1-mediated NAD+ depletion in axonal degeneration, and helped motivate the use of NAD+ precursors such as NMN and NR to protect neurons.
description_zh_TW: NAD+ 生物合成酶 Nmnat 主要通過提高 NAD+ 並從而活化 SIRT1 來保護軸突免於 Wallerian 變性，SIRT1 支持損傷後的軸突存活。這種保護位於 SIRT1 依賴性維持神經元粒線體和染色質功能的上游，在胞體受損時保留軸突完整性。在方向性上，Nmnat 增加 NAD+，進而活化 SIRT1 以提供軸突保護。這確立了神經元韌性中一個關鍵的 NAD+/sirtuin 軸，為後續 SARM1 介導的軸突變性中 NAD+ 耗竭的研究提供了資訊，並推動了使用 NAD+ 前體（如 NMN 和 NR）來保護神經元的研究。

label: Chemotherapy-Induced Peripheral Neuropathy
description: Chemotherapy-Induced Peripheral Neuropathy (CIPN) is a dose-limiting toxicity of taxane and platinum agents. These drugs downregulate NMNAT2 in sensory neurons, raising the NMN/NAD+ ratio and activating SARM1, whose NAD+-depletion activity drives axonal degeneration; SARM1 knockout protects against CIPN in preclinical models.
description_zh_TW: Chemotherapy-Induced Peripheral Neuropathy（CIPN）是 taxane 與白金類藥物的劑量限制性毒性。這些藥物在感覺神經元中下调 NMNAT2，使 NMN／NAD+ 比值上升並活化 SARM1；SARM1 的 NAD+ 耗竭活性驅動軸突退化，且 SARM1 敲除在臨床前模型中可防止 CIPN。

label: Isatuximab
description: Isatuximab is the second approved anti-CD38 monoclonal antibody (2020), binding a CD38 epitope distinct from daratumumab's and showing stronger direct induction of apoptosis; it is standard of care in Multiple Myeloma.
description_zh_TW: Isatuximab 是第二個獲核准的 anti-CD38 單株抗體（2020 年），其結合的 CD38 表位與 Daratumumab 不同，且直接誘發凋亡的作用更強；它是 Multiple Myeloma 的標準治療。

label: Coenzyme
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) is an essential coenzyme that plays central roles in cellular oxidation-reduction reactions, including most catabolic and anabolic processes such as glycolysis, fatty acid beta-oxidation, the tricarboxylic acid cycle, and the synthesis of fatty acids, cholesterol, and steroids. Beyond its redox function, NAD+ is consumed by enzymes including sirtuins, poly-ADP-ribose polymerases (PARPs), CD38/CD157 ectoenzymes, and mono-ADP-ribose transferases, whose activity can deplete cellular NAD+ content.
description_zh_TW: NAD+（nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide）是一種必需的輔酶，在細胞氧化還原反應中扮演核心角色，包括大多數分解代謝與合成代謝過程，如 glycolysis、fatty acid beta-oxidation、tricarboxylic acid cycle，以及脂肪酸、膽固醇與類固醇的合成。除了其氧化還原功能外，NAD+ 會被包括 sirtuins、poly-ADP-ribose polymerases（PARPs）、CD38/CD157 ectoenzymes，以及 mono-ADP-ribose transferases 在內的酵素所消耗，這些酵素的活性可能耗竭細胞內的 NAD+ 含量。

label: CD38 inhibitors (apigenin, quercetin)
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: CD38 consumes NAD+; inhibiting it (apigenin, quercetin) boosts NAD+ availability, the obligate co-substrate for all sirtuins (and thus for SIRT1-SIRT7 activity).
description_zh_TW: CD38 消耗 NAD+；抑制它（芹菜素、槲皮素）可增強 NAD+ 的可用性，NAD+ 是所有 sirtuins 的必需共底物（因此影響 SIRT1-SIRT7 的活性）。

label: DNA Topoisomerase I
description: SN-38 traps the topoisomerase I cleavage complex, causing fork-collision breaks.
description_zh_TW: SN-38 捕獲拓樸異構酶 I 切割複合體，導致複製叉碰撞斷裂。

label: SIRT1 as CR mediator
description: David Sinclair identified SIRT1 as a mediator of caloric-restriction benefits and, in a landmark 2003 study, discovered resveratrol as a sirtuin-activating compound (STAC). Directionally, the discovery establishes SIRT1/STAC centrality to longevity research. This launched the modern sirtuin field, and it connects basic yeast findings to mammalian therapeutics. By showing that resveratrol extends yeast lifespan through Sir2, Sinclair bridged the caloric-restriction and sirtuin fields. This work catalyzed decades of sirtuin-drug development and made SIRT1 a central target in geroscience.
description_zh_TW: David Sinclair 鑑定 SIRT1 為限制熱量益處的介導因子，並在 2003 年的里程碑研究中發現 resveratrol 作為 sirtuin 活化化合物（STAC）。在方向性上，此發現確立了 SIRT1/STAC 在長壽研究中的核心地位。這啟動了現代 sirtuin 領域，並將基礎酵母發現與哺乳動物治療學聯繫起來。透過展示 resveratrol 透過 Sir2 延長酵母壽命，Sinclair 架起了限制熱量和 sirtuin 領域之間的橋樑。此工作催化了數十年的 sirtuin 藥物開發，使 SIRT1 成為老年科學的核心靶標。

label: Sequence-specific double-strand breaks
description: I-PpoI recognizes and cleaves a specific 15-20 base-pair sequence within rRNA gene repeats, generating sequence-specific double-strand breaks. Directionally, I-PpoI sits upstream of targeted double-strand-break formation. Its specificity makes it ideal for the ICE Mouse's controlled damage, and this enables reproducible epigenetic-aging studies. Because I-PpoI cleaves at a defined sequence, researchers can induce breaks at known genomic loci in a controlled manner. This precision distinguishes the ICE Mouse from treatments that cause random DNA damage, allowing the isolation of repair-driven effects.
description_zh_TW: I-PpoI 識別並切割 rRNA 基因重複序列中的特定 15-20 基鹼對序列，產生序列特異性的雙鏈斷裂。在方向性上，I-PpoI 位於靶向雙鏈斷裂形成的上游。其特異性使其成為 ICE 小鼠受控損傷的理想工具，實現可重複的表觀遺傳衰老研究。由於 I-PpoI 在確定的序列處切割，研究人員可以在已知的基因組位點以受控方式誘導斷裂。這種精確性區別了 ICE 小鼠與造成隨機 DNA 損傷的處理，允許分離修復驅動的效應。

label: Resveratrol as STAC
description: In 2003, Sinclair showed resveratrol extends yeast lifespan via Sir2 and later demonstrated parallel effects in higher organisms, discovering it as the first STAC. Directionally, the discovery sits upstream of the STAC concept. This catalyzed decades of sirtuin-drug development, and it remains a seminal finding in geroscience. By identifying a natural compound that activates sirtuins, Sinclair provided the prototype for pharmacologically engaging longevity pathways. The STAC concept has since driven the search for more potent and specific sirtuin activators for therapeutic use.
