Like C. elegans ATFS-1, ATF5 partitions between the nucleus and mitochondria, and under mitochondrial stress it localizes to the nucleus to induce chaperones and proteases that restore mitochondrial proteostasis.
description_zh_TW: ATF5 是介導 Mitochondrial Unfolded Protein Response 的哺乳類轉錄因子。與 C. elegans 的 ATFS-1 相同，ATF5 在細胞核與粒線體之間分配；在粒線體壓力下它定位至細胞核，誘導 chaperone 與 protease 以恢復粒線體蛋白恆定。

label: DVE-1
description: UBL-5 uses its ubiquitin-like fold as a binding interface to interact physically with the homeobox transcription factor DVE-1 — it does not conjugate to targets like ubiquitin. This interaction stabilizes the UPRmt transcriptional complex, enabling DVE-1's proper nuclear accumulation and DNA-binding activity; without UBL-5 the UPRmt is nonfunctional even when ATFS-1 is activated.
description_zh_TW: UBL-5 以其類泛素摺疊作為結合介面，與同源盒轉錄因子 DVE-1 發生物理交互作用——它不像泛素那樣與標的共價結合。此交互作用穩定 UPRmt 轉錄複合體，使 DVE-1 得以正常在細胞核內累積並結合 DNA；缺乏 UBL-5 時，即使 ATFS-1 被活化，UPRmt 仍無法運作。

label: Denham Harman
description: Denham Harman proposed the free radical theory of aging in 1955, postulating that reactive oxygen species produced during aerobic respiration cause cumulative oxidative damage that drives aging. This theory made ROS the central agents of aging for the field and redirected ageing research toward antioxidant biology.
description_zh_TW: Denham Harman 於 1955 年提出 free radical theory of aging，主張 aerobic respiration 過程中產生的 reactive oxygen species 會造成累積性氧化損傷並驅動老化。此理論使 ROS 成為老化研究領域的核心因子，並將老化研究重新導向抗氧化生物學。

label: Free Radical Theory of Aging
description: Denham Harman proposed the free radical theory of aging in 1955, postulating that reactive oxygen species produced during aerobic respiration cause cumulative oxidative damage that drives aging. This theory made ROS the central agents of aging for the field and redirected ageing research toward antioxidant biology.
description_zh_TW: Denham Harman 於 1955 年提出 free radical theory of aging，主張 aerobic respiration 過程中產生的 reactive oxygen species 會造成累積性氧化損傷並驅動老化。此理論使 ROS 成為老化研究領域的核心因子，並將老化研究重新導向抗氧化生物學。

label: HEK293
description: HEK293 is the workhorse human cell line for transient and stable recombinant protein production, lentiviral packaging, and CRISPR screens, and is heavily used in mitochondria-related and signaling studies. Its high transfectability makes it ideal for reporter assays probing mTOR, apoptosis, and stress pathways.
description_zh_TW: HEK293 是從事暫時性與穩定性重組蛋白生產、lentiviral packaging 與 CRISPR screen 的主力人類細胞株，並廣泛用於粒線體相關與訊號研究。其高轉染效率使其成為偵測 mTOR、apoptosis 與壓力途徑的 reporter assay 理想模型。

label: Rheumatoid synovial fluid
description: Extracellular myeloperoxidase activity is detectable in rheumatoid synovial fluid as in plaque and ischemic myocardium. Localization records the inflammatory exudate.
description_zh_TW: 細胞外髓過氧化物酶活性可在類風濕滑液測得，如同斑塊與缺血心肌。定位記錄發炎滲出。

label: CXCL2
description: CXCL2 (GRObeta/MIP-2alpha) is an ELR+ C-X-C chemokine that engages CXCR2 with high affinity and CXCR1 weakly. Ligand-receptor coupling activates Galphai, stimulating PLCbeta/IP3/Ca2+, PI3K/Akt and p38 MAPK/ERK pathways, and CXCL2 recruits and activates neutrophils to induce chemotaxis, degranulation and ROS release that propagate inflammatory signalling to neighbouring cells.
description_zh_TW: CXCL2（GROβ/MIP-2α）是 ELR+ 的 C-X-C 趨化因子，以高親和力結合 CXCR2，並微弱作用於 CXCR1。配體–受體耦合活化 Gαi，刺激 PLCβ/IP3/Ca2+、PI3K/Akt 與 p38 MAPK/ERK 路徑；CXCL2 募集並活化中性球，誘發趨化、脫顆粒與 ROS 釋放，將發炎訊號傳遞給鄰近細胞。

label: Cl-amidine
description: Cl-amidine is a covalent pan-peptidylarginine deiminase inhibitor with a chloro-acetamidine warhead that blocks citrullination by PAD4 and related deiminases. In NETosis assays it suppresses histone citrullination (cit-H3) and NET extrusion, making it — with DNase digestion and NE/MPO inhibition — the standard blockade panel proving PAD-dependent NET formation.
description_zh_TW: Cl-amidine 是具有 chloro-acetamidine 親電子基團的共價廣譜 peptidylarginine deiminase 抑制劑，可阻斷 PAD4 及相關 deiminase 的 citrullination 作用。在 NETosis 分析中，它抑制 histone citrullination（cit-H3）與 NET 挤出，因此與 DNase 消化及 NE/MPO 抑制並列，構成證明 PAD 依賴性 NET 形成的標準阻斷組合。

label: Detoxification
description: The electrophilic o-quinone aminochromes generated by catecholamine oxidation (Adrenaline-quinone, Dopaminochrome, Adrenochrome) are detoxified by glutathione S-transferases, which conjugate them at ring positions such as C2 and C5 to form stable thioethers. This directly prevents the quinone from cyclizing to adrenochrome or arylating protein thiols, spares Glutathione consumed as mercapturate, and suppresses redox cycling and secondary ROS production.
description_zh_TW: 兒茶酚胺氧化產生的親電子 o-quinone aminochrome（Adrenaline-quinone、Dopaminochrome、Adrenochrome）由 glutathione S-transferase 去毒，後者於 quinone 環上如 C2 與 C5 位置接合形成穩定硫醚。這直接阻止 quinone 環化生成 adrenochrome 或對蛋白質 thiol 進行芳基化，節省以 mercapturate 形式排出的 Glutathione，並抑制 redox cycling 與次級 ROS 產生。

label: Pycnogenol
description: Pycnogenol exerts anti-inflammatory effects by inhibiting NF-κB signalling and adhesion-molecule expression. Combined with its enhancement of eNOS activity and NO bioavailability, this makes the extract clinically positioned against chronic venous insufficiency, edema, and retinal/capillary microcirculation defects, and against the vascular dysfunction of cardiovascular disease and diabetes.
description_zh_TW: Pycnogenol 藉由抑制 NF-κB 訊息傳遞與黏附分子表現發揮抗發炎作用。加上它增強 eNOS 活性與 NO 生體可用性的效果，使這種萃取物在臨床上被定位於對抗慢性靜脈功能不足、水腫與視網膜／微循環缺陷，以及心血管疾病與糖尿病的血管功能異常。

label: Muscle Mass
description: Creatine supplementation increases muscle creatine and phosphocreatine stores and, particularly when combined with resistance training, promotes gains in lean tissue mass and strength. Randomized trials in older adults show greater gains in muscle mass and isometric strength with creatine plus heavy resistance training compared to training alone, and meta-analyses confirm larger gains in muscle mass and upper-body strength in older individuals supplementing creatine during resistance exercise. Creatine also decreases protein breakdown and can preserve muscle mass during energy-restricted weight loss, making it a broadly useful strategy for maintaining muscle across the lifespan and in clinical rehabilitation populations.
description_zh_TW: 補充肌酸可增加肌肉肌酸與磷酸肌酸儲備，尤其是與阻力訓練結合時，能促進去脂組織質量與肌力的增長。在老年人中的隨機試驗顯示，與單獨訓練相比，肌酸加上重度阻力訓練可帶來更大的肌肉質量與等長肌力增長，統合分析也證實，在阻力運動期間補充肌酸的老年人，其肌肉質量與上半身肌力增長更大。肌酸還能減少蛋白質分解，並在限制能量的減重過程中保留肌肉質量，使其成為在整個生命歷程及臨床復健族群中維持肌肉的廣泛實用策略。

label: ADP
description: A transient rise in ADP (and AMP) during exercise or fasting signals a cellular energy deficit, activating AMPK, which then stimulates PGC-1α and mitochondrial biogenesis as part of mitohormetic adaptation.
description_zh_TW: 運動或禁食期間 ADP（與 AMP）的暫時上升代表細胞能量赤字，會活化 AMPK，後者再刺激 PGC-1α 與粒線體生合成，構成 mitohormetic 適應的一部分。

label: Atg15
description: Mammalian LIPA is the counterpart of yeast Atg15; deficiency causes Wolman disease and CESD. Homology maps vacuolar lipase to lysosomal lipase.
description_zh_TW: 哺乳動物 LIPA 是酵母 Atg15 的對應物；缺乏導致 Wolman 病與 CESD。同源將液泡脂肪酶對應到溶酶體脂肪酶。

label: Lipid Droplet
description: ATGL (adipose triglyceride lipase, PNPLA2) is the first and rate-limiting enzyme of catabolic lipolysis. It localizes to the surface of Lipid Droplet and hydrolyzes triacylglycerol into diacylglycerol and free fatty acids, providing substrate for Lipophagy and fatty acid oxidation. Its activity determines the rate of free fatty acid release from adipose tissue and therefore systemic lipid mobilization, and it is activated during Starvation and Fasting to mobilize energy reserves.
description_zh_TW: ATGL（adipose triglyceride lipase，PNPLA2）是分解性脂解的第一個也是速率限制酵素。它定位於 Lipid Droplet 表面，將三酸甘油酯水解為二酸甘油酯與游離脂肪酸，為 Lipophagy 與脂肪酸氧化提供受質。其活性決定 adipose 組織釋放游離脂肪酸的速率，因而決定全身脂質動員；並在 Starvation 與 Fasting 期間被活化以動員能量儲備。

label: HSL
description: HSL is the upstream diacylglycerol lipase that generates the monoacylglycerol substrate Monoacylglycerol Lipase then hydrolyses; together with ATGL it governs lipid mobilization from adipose tissue.
description_zh_TW: HSL 是上游的 diglyceride 脂肪酶，產生 Monoacylglycerol Lipase 隨後水解的 monoacylglycerol 基質；它與 ATGL 共同調控脂肪組織的脂質動員。

label: Reference standard
description: Leuco-adrenochrome is synthesized in high-purity laboratory settings to serve as a reference standard in pharmaceutical quality control. Analysts use HPLC or LC-MS to compare the peaks in a commercial epinephrine sample against this standard to ensure the medication is pure and safe for clinical use. Because epinephrine is chemically unstable and prone to oxidation when exposed to light, heat, or air, manufacturers must carefully monitor degradation products, and reference standards are essential for verifying that batches meet purity specifications and for quantifying impurities in forced-degradation studies.
description_zh_TW: Leuco-adrenochrome is synthesized in high-purity laboratory settings to serve as a reference standard in pharmaceutical quality control。Analysts use HPLC or LC-MS to compare the peaks in a commercial epinephrine sample against this standard to ensure the medication is pure and safe for clinical use。Because epinephrine is chemically unstable and prone to oxidation when exposed to light, heat, or air，manufacturers must carefully monitor degradation products，and reference standards are essential for verifying that batches meet purity specifications and for quantifying impurities in forced-degradation studies。

label: indoline-5,6-dione
description: Adrenochrome is chemically an indoline-5,6-dione, formally 3-hydroxy-1-methyl-2,3-dihydro-1H-indole-5,6-dione. The molecule features a fused bicyclic system in which a six-membered benzene ring (oxidized to a quinone at positions 5 and 6) is fused to a five-membered nitrogen-containing ring bearing a hydroxy substituent and an N-methyl group. This structure arises when oxidized epinephrine undergoes intramolecular cyclization, in which the side-chain nitrogen attacks the electrophilic o-quinone ring (a Michael addition), closing the second ring. The quinone moiety and its o-quinone character account for much of adrenochrome's reactivity, including its ability to undergo redox cycling and one-electron reduction to the semiquinone radical.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 在化學上是 indoline-5,6-dione，正式名稱為 3-hydroxy-1-methyl-2,3-dihydro-1H-indole-5,6-dione。該分子具有融合雙環系統，其中一個六元苯環（於第 5 與第 6 位氧化為醌）與一個帶有羥基取代基與 N-甲基的五元含氮環融合。此結構源於氧化後的 epinephrine 發生分子內環化，其中側鏈氮攻擊親電性的 o-quinone 環（一種 Michael 加成），閉合第二個環。醌部分及其 o-quinone 特性解釋了 adrenochrome 大部分的反應性，包括其進行氧化還原循環與單電子還原為半醌自由基的能力。

label: Semicarbazide
description: Semicarbazide reacts with the o-quinone structure of Adrenochrome to form Carbazochrome (adrenochrome monosemicarbazone). The semicarbazone adduct is markedly more stable than the parent quinone, and carbazochrome has medical applications as a hemostatic agent.
description_zh_TW: Semicarbazide 與 Adrenochrome 的 o-quinone 結構反應生成 Carbazochrome（adrenochrome monosemicarbazone）。此 semicarbazone 加合物比母體醌顯著穩定，而 carbazochrome 在醫學上具有止血劑的應用。

label: NUMTs
description: NUMTs (nuclear insertions of mitochondrial origin) are copies of mtDNA that integrated into the nuclear genome during evolution; roughly 755 such insertions are dispersed through the human nuclear genome, mostly under 500 bp, with a mean sequence identity to mtDNA of 79.2%. They are generally considered pseudogenes and molecular fossils of the endosymbiotic transfer of genetic material from mitochondria to the nucleus.
description_zh_TW: NUMTs（nuclear insertions of mitochondrial origin）是演化過程中整合進核基因體的 mtDNA 拷貝；人類核基因體中估計散布著 755 個此類插入片段，多數小於 500 bp，與 mtDNA 的平均序列一致性為 79.2%。它們一般被視為偽基因，也是粒線體向細胞核內共生轉移遺傳物質的分子化石。

label: IKKalpha
description: IKKα (IKK1, CHUK) functions in two NF-κB modes: within the IKKα/IKKβ/NEMO heterocomplex it contributes to IκBα phosphorylation and canonical NF-κB activation downstream of TNFα, IL-1, LPS, and DNA damage; released from NEMO it forms homodimers that — driven by NIK — phosphorylate p100 into p52, driving non-canonical NF-κB (RelB:p52) signaling for lymphoid development and B-cell survival. IKKα also has nuclear, NF-κB-independent roles such as histone H3 Ser10 phosphorylation in mitosis.
description_zh_TW: IKKα（IKK1，CHUK）在兩種 NF-κB 模式中運作：在 IKKα/IKKβ/NEMO 異源複合體中，它參與 IκBα 的磷酸化與 TNFα、IL-1、LPS 及 DNA 損傷下游的典型 NF-κB 活化；脫離 NEMO 後，它形成同源二聚體，在 NIK 驅動下將 p100 磷酸化為 p52，推動非典型 NF-κB（RelB:p52）訊號以支配淋巴器官發育與 B 細胞存活。IKKα 另有獨立於 NF-κB 的細胞核角色，例如有絲分裂中組蛋白 H3 Ser10 的磷酸化。

label: Opioids
description: Although most opioids act predominantly through μ, κ and δ opioid receptors, several — tramadol, meperidine, methadone and dextromethorphan — inhibit serotonin reuptake or release, raising synaptic Serotonin. When combined with SSRIs or Monoamine Oxidase Inhibitors such as Methylene blue, this serotonergic activity can precipitate Serotonin Syndrome, a potentially life-threatening toxidrome of hyperthermia, autonomic instability and neuromuscular hyperactivity.
description_zh_TW: 雖然多數類鴉片藥物主要透過 μ、κ、δ 類鴉片受體作用，但其中數種——tramadol、meperidine、methadone 與 dextromethorphan——會抑制血清素（Serotonin）的再攝取或釋放，提高突觸內 Serotonin 濃度。若與 SSRI 或諸如 Methylene blue 的單胺氧化酶抑制劑（Monoamine Oxidase Inhibitor）併用，這種血清素活性可能誘發血清素症候群（Serotonin Syndrome），一種以高體溫、自主神經不穩定與神經肌肉過度興奮構成、可致命的毒理症候群。

label: Tricyclic Antidepressant
description: Methylene blue acts as a monoamine oxidase inhibitor, so combining it with a Tricyclic Antidepressant — which blocks monoamine reuptake including serotonin and norepinephrine — risks serotonin syndrome, as does combination with SSRIs. This interaction explains why methylene blue dosing guidance warns against co-administration with tricyclics.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue 具有 monoamine oxidase inhibitor 的作用，因此與阻斷包括 serotonin 與 norepinephrine 在內的單胺再攝取的 Tricyclic Antidepressant 併用會有 serotonin syndrome 風險，與 SSRI 併用亦然。這項交互作用即是 methylene blue 劑量指引警告不可與三環類抗憂鬱藥共用的原因。

label: Glucose metabolism
description: Resveratrol improves glucose metabolism and reduces LDL while elevating HDL, improving the lipid profile in metabolic models. Directionally, resveratrol sits upstream of better glycemic and lipoprotein control. These effects are largely SIRT1/AMPK-dependent, reflecting improved insulin sensitivity, reduced hepatic lipogenesis, and enhanced lipid oxidation. Human outcomes, however, are limited by resveratrol's poor bioavailability and short half-life, so translating these metabolic benefits to patients requires formulations that achieve effective plasma concentrations.
description_zh_TW: Resveratrol 改善葡萄糖代謝並降低 LDL 同時升高 HDL，改善代謝模型中的血脂特徵。在方向性上，resveratrol 位於改善血糖和脂蛋白控制的上游。這些效應主要依賴 SIRT1/AMPK，反映胰島素敏感性改善、肝臟脂肪生成減少和脂質氧化增強。然而，由於 resveratrol 生物利用度低且半衰期短，人體結果有限，因此要將這些代謝益處轉化為患者需要能達到有效血漿濃度的製劑。

label: SERCA2a
description: SIRT1 modulates Ca2+ signaling by deacetylating Ca2+-handling proteins including IP3 receptors and SERCA2a. Deacetylation of IP3 receptors tunes endoplasmic reticulum Ca2+ leak, while SERCA2a deacetylation influences diastolic Ca2+ handling in cardiomyocytes, linking sirtuin activity to cardiac hypertrophy and neurodegeneration phenotypes.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 藉由將包括 IP3 受體與 SERCA2a 在內的 Ca2+ 處理蛋白去乙醯化來調節 Ca2+ 訊號。IP3 受體的去乙醯化可調整內質網的 Ca2+ 滲漏，而 SERCA2a 的去乙醯化影響心肌細胞舒張期的 Ca2+ 處理，將 sirtuin 活性與心臟肥大及神經退化表型連結起來。

label: Piceatannol
description: Piceatannol (3,3',4,5'-tetrahydroxystilbene) is a hydroxylated stilbenoid analogue of Resveratrol and a broad-spectrum sirtuin-activating compound. Table 6 of Zhao et al. (2020) lists it as an activator of SIRT1, SIRT3 and SIRT5, making it one of the few natural compounds reported to stimulate several mammalian sirtuins simultaneously.
description_zh_TW: Piceatannol（3,3',4,5'-tetrahydroxystilbene）是 Resveratrol 的羥基化 stilbenoid 類似物，屬廣效型的 sirtuin 活化化合物。Zhao 等人（2020）的表 6 將其列為 SIRT1、SIRT3 與 SIRT5 的活化劑，使其成為少數同時能刺激多種哺乳類 sirtuin 的天然化合物之一。

label: Parasympathetic Nervous System
description: The parasympathetic nervous system is the rest, digest, and repair branch of the autonomic nervous system, controlled heavily by the vagus nerve. When active, it signals the body to calm down, digest food, and repair cells, allowing for more fluctuation between heartbeats and thereby raising HRV. A high HRV indicates strong vagal tone, meaning the parasympathetic system can quickly hit the brakes on stress. HRV reflects the tug-of-war between the sympathetic and parasympathetic systems, and recovery after stressors allows the parasympathetic branch to rebound and push HRV back to or above baseline.
description_zh_TW: 副交感神經系統是自主神經系統的休息、消化和修復分支，主要受迷走神經控制。活躍時，它向身體發出信號以平靜下來、消化食物和修復細胞，允許心跳之間有更多波動，從而提高心率變異性（HRV）。高HRV表示迷走神經張力強，意味著副交感系統能快速對壓力踩剎車。HRV反映了交感和副交感系統之間的拉鋸戰，壓力後的恢復允許副交感分支反彈並將HRV推回或高於基線。

label: Arterial Aging
description: Autophagy prevents arterial aging by removing damaged mitochondria, misfolded proteins, and lipid aggregates that would otherwise promote endothelial dysfunction, inflammation, and vascular stiffening. Impaired autophagic flux in aged vessels permits oxidative stress and senescence to accumulate, driving the loss of nitric-oxide-mediated relaxation. Enhancing autophagy—pharmacologically or by caloric restriction—rescues the vascular phenotype and restores endothelial function in preclinical models. The pathway is thus a central defender of vascular youth.
description_zh_TW: 自噬透過移除受損粒線體、錯誤折疊蛋白和脂質聚集物來防止動脈老化，這些物質否則會促進內皮功能障礙、發炎和血管僵硬化。老化血管中自噬流受損會讓氧化壓力和衰老累積，驅動一氧化氮介導舒張能力的喪失。增強自噬——藥理學上或透過熱量限制——在臨床前模型中拯救血管表型並恢復內皮功能。因此此途徑是血管年輕的主要守護者。

label: HAT
description: HAT is the standard abbreviation for histone acetyltransferase, a family of enzymes that transfer acetyl groups from acetyl-CoA to lysine residues on histone tails. These enzymes are grouped into families such as the GNAT, MYST, and p300/CBP families, and their activity is central to epigenetic control of gene expression. HATs oppose the action of histone deacetylases and are frequently deregulated in cancer and aging, where changes in acetylation contribute to aberrant gene silencing and loss of transcriptional fidelity.
description_zh_TW: HAT 是組蛋白乙醯轉移酶的標準縮寫，該酶是將乙醯基從乙醯輔酶 A 轉移到組蛋白尾部賴氨酸殘基的酶家族。這些酵素分為 GNAT、MYST 和 p300/CBP 等家族，它們的活性對於 gene expression 的表觀遺傳控制至關重要。 HAT 對抗組蛋白去乙醯化酶的作用，並且在癌症和老化過程中經常失調，其中乙醯化的變化會導致異常基因沉默和轉錄保真度喪失。

label: Adaptive Immune Response
description: Autophagy facilitates adaptive immune cell activation and differentiation, and regulates antigen presentation, lymphocyte survival, and immune memory. Autophagy inducers such as Spermidine can rejuvenate B cell responses and enhance production of virus-specific memory CD8+ T cells.
description_zh_TW: Autophagy 促進適應性免疫細胞的活化與分化，並調控抗原呈現、淋巴球存活與免疫記憶。Spermidine 等 Autophagy inducer 可活化 B 細胞反應，並增強病毒特異性記憶型 CD8+ T cell 的產生。

label: Bafilomycin A1
description: Bafilomycin A1 is a V-ATPase inhibitor that blocks the proton translocation step of the pump. By preventing lysosomal acidification it halts the activity of acid hydrolases, so autophagic cargo that has been sequestered and delivered normally accumulates undegraded inside autolysosomes.
description_zh_TW: Bafilomycin A1 是 V-ATPase 抑制劑，會阻斷該幫浦的質子轉運步驟。它藉由阻止溶酶體酸化而使酸性水解酶停止作用，因此正常被隔離並運送的自噬貨物會在自噬溶酶體內累積而無法降解。

label: Ketogenic Diet
description: Ketogenesis is triggered by a Ketogenic Diet as well as by Caloric Restriction and Intermittent Fasting, because all three lower glucose availability and raise fatty acid delivery to the liver. Promoting Ketogenesis this way is investigated for Neurodegenerative Disease and for enhancing the tumoricidal properties of treatments in some Cancer contexts.
description_zh_TW: Ketogenesis 可由 Ketogenic Diet 觸發，與 Caloric Restriction、Intermittent Fasting 相同，因為三者都降低葡萄糖可得性並提高脂肪酸送抵肝臟。以此方式促進 Ketogenesis 正在被研究用於 Neurodegenerative Disease，以及在某些 Cancer 情境下增強治療的腫瘤殺傷特性。

label: Hesperetin
description: Hesperetin, a citrus flavanone polyphenol (the aglycone of hesperidin), exerts antifibrotic and senomorphic activity by restoring autophagic flux, reducing reactive oxygen species, and suppressing SASP-mediated fibroblast activation. It is therefore grouped with other polyphenol senotherapeutics that counteract the mitochondrial dysfunction/ROS/SASP axis sustaining fibrotic remodeling.
description_zh_TW: Hesperetin 是一種柑橘類黃烷酮多酚（hesperidin 的苷元），透過恢復自噬通量、降低活性氧並抑制 SASP 介導的纖維母細胞活化，發揮抗纖維化與 senomorphic 活性。因此它與其他對抗維持纖維化重塑之粒線體功能障礙／ROS／SASP 軸的多酚類 senotherapeutics 歸為同一群。

label: Pompe Disease
description: Pompe disease (glycogen storage disease type II) is a lysosomal storage disease caused by deficiency of acid alpha-glucosidase (GAA), leading to massive glycogen accumulation in lysosomes, particularly in cardiac and skeletal muscle.
description_zh_TW: 龐貝氏症（第二型肝醣儲積症）屬於溶小體儲積症，由酸性 α-葡萄糖苷酶（GAA）缺乏所致，造成溶小體（尤其在心肌與骨骼肌）大量肝醣累積。

label: PI3K-Akt Signaling
description: PTEN is a lipid phosphatase that dephosphorylates PIP3, thereby antagonizing PI3K/Akt signalling; its opposition to PI3K forms one branch of the incoherent bivalent motif centred on mTORC1.
description_zh_TW: PTEN 是脂質磷酸酶，可將 PIP3 去磷酸化，因而拮抗 PI3K/Akt 訊號；其與 PI3K 的對抗構成以 mTORC1 為中心的不一致雙價 motif 的一個分支。

label: TASCC
description: The TASCC is defined by spatial colocalization of active mTORC1 with autophagosomes and autolysosomes on the trans-Golgi network in senescent cells. Autophagy-derived amino acids feed mTORC1, which in turn directs cap-dependent translation - a feed-forward loop that resolves the paradox of high autophagy coexisting with vigorous secretion.
description_zh_TW: TASCC 的定義是衰老細胞中活化的 mTORC1 與自噬體、自噬溶體在高基氏體網絡上的空間共定位。自噬回收的胺基酸餵養 mTORC1，後者再引導帽依賴性轉譯——這個前饋迴圈化解了高自噬與旺盛分泌並存的悖論。

label: Pterostilbene
description: Pterostilbene is a calorie-restriction mimetic that directly activates SIRT1 and upstream energy sensors such as AMPK. It recapitulates the molecular signature of nutrient scarcity, enhancing fatty-acid oxidation and antioxidant defense.
description_zh_TW: 紫檀芪是熱量限制模擬劑，直接活化 SIRT1 與 AMPK 等上游能量感應器。它重現營養稀缺的分子特徵，增強脂肪酸氧化與抗氧化防禦。

label: mTOR Inhibitor
description: Suppressed mTOR relieves inhibition of autophagy and lysosomal biogenesis via TFEB, promoting cellular cleanup. mTOR inhibition is thus a canonical inducer of autophagy.
description_zh_TW: 抑制的 mTOR 解除對自噬與溶酶體生合成的抑制（經由 TFEB），促進細胞清理。因此 mTOR 抑制是自噬的典型誘導者。

label: Malonyl-CoA decarboxylase
description: In hepatocytes, SIRT4 represses PPARalpha signaling and inhibits malonyl-CoA decarboxylase, shifting liver metabolism away from mitochondrial fatty-acid utilization and toward anabolic lipid conservation. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of suppressed fatty acid oxidation. This metabolic brake counterbalances SIRT3, which promotes beta-oxidation, so the relative activity of the two mitochondrial sirtuins determines whether the liver oxidizes or stores fat. Under chronic nutrient surplus, sustained SIRT4 activity contributes to hepatic steatosis, whereas conditions that shift the SIRT3/SIRT4 balance toward SIRT3 favor fat burning.
description_zh_TW: 在肝細胞中，SIRT4抑制PPARalpha訊號並抑制丙二醯CoA脫羧酶，將肝臟代謝從粒線體脂肪酸利用轉向合成代謝的脂質保存。方向上，SIRT4位於脂肪酸氧化抑制的上游。這種代謝制動器平衡了促進β-氧化的SIRT3，因此這兩個粒線體sirtuin的相對活性決定了肝臟是氧化還是儲存脂肪。在慢性營養過剩下，持續的SIRT4活性促進肝脂肪變性，而將SIRT3/SIRT4平衡轉向SIRT3的條件則有利於脂肪燃燒。

label: fatty-acid metabolism
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT1 promotes fatty-acid metabolism by deacetylating and activating PGC-1alpha and PPARalpha to drive fatty-acid oxidation, represses lipogenesis via SREBP-1c, and mobilizes fat from white adipose tissue by repressing PPAR-gamma and aP2. This supports metabolic flexibility and the lean phenotype of caloric restriction.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 透過去乙醯化並活化 PGC-1alpha 和 PPARalpha 來促進脂肪酸氧化，透過 SREBP-1c 抑制脂肪生成，並透過抑制 PPAR-gamma 和 aP2 從白色脂肪組織中動員脂肪。這支持了代謝靈活性和熱量限制的精瘦表型。

label: GDH (Glutamate Dehydrogenase)
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: SIRT4 mono-ADP-ribosylates glutamate dehydrogenase (GDH), inhibiting its oxidative deamination of glutamate to α-ketoglutarate and thereby slowing anaplerotic carbon entry into the TCA cycle. This restrains amino-acid-derived ATP production and insulin secretion in pancreatic β-cells, limiting nutrient-driven hormonal output. Directionally, SIRT4 enzymatically inhibits GDH, acting as a mitochondrial brake on amino-acid catabolism. This opposes anabolic fueling of secretion, and because SIRT4 also inhibits MTPα, glutamine metabolism, and PPARα signaling, it broadly curbs mitochondrial oxidative capacity while promoting lipid conservation under nutrient-replete conditions.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 對穀氨酸脫氫酶（GDH）進行單 ADP-核糖基化，抑制其將穀氨酸氧化脫氨為 α-酮戊二酸，從而減緩回補性碳源進入 TCA 循環。這限制了胰腺 β 細胞中胺基酸衍生的 ATP 產生和胰島素分泌，抑制營養物驅動的荷爾蒙輸出。在方向性上，SIRT4 在酶學上抑制 GDH，充時代謝的制動器限制胺基酸分解代謝。這對抗了分泌的合成代謝燃料供應，且由於 SIRT4 也抑制 MTPα、穀氨酰胺代謝和 PPARα 信號，它在營養充足條件下廣泛抑制粒線體氧化能力同時促進脂質保存。

label: Mitochondrial Trifunctional Protein α
description: SIRT4 destabilizes Mitochondrial Trifunctional Protein α (MTPα, HADHB) in hepatocytes, shifting metabolism away from mitochondrial fatty-acid utilization toward anabolic lipid conservation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 在肝細胞中使 Mitochondrial Trifunctional Protein α（MTPα，HADHB）去穩定，使代謝由粒線體脂肪酸利用轉向合成型脂質保存。

label: Executive Function
description: The prefrontal cortex controls executive function, encompassing planning, decision-making, inhibition, and cognitive flexibility, through its extensive reciprocal connections with posterior cortex, striatum, and thalamus. Its operations depend critically on an optimal, COMT-genotype-sensitive level of dopamine, with both excess and deficiency degrading performance. Because prefrontal DAT is sparse, COMT and NET set the dopamine tone that governs these high-level functions. Dysregulation of prefrontal dopamine is implicated in numerous psychiatric and cognitive disorders.
description_zh_TW: 前額葉皮質透過與後皮質、紋狀體和丘腦的廣泛相互連結來控制 executive function，包括計畫、決策、抑制和認知靈活性。其運作關鍵取決於 COMT 基因型敏感的最佳多巴胺水平，過量和缺乏都會降低表現。由於前額葉 DAT 稀疏，COMT 和 NET 設定了控制這些高階功能的多巴胺基調。前額葉多巴胺的失調與許多精神和認知障礙有關。

label: ACC1
description: SIRT3 deacetylates ACC1 at multiple lysine residues and thereby increases its enzymatic activity, driving de novo lipogenesis. Because ACC1 is the rate-limiting enzyme of fatty acid synthesis, SIRT3-dependent activation is a pro-tumorigenic metabolic switch that supplies the lipid building blocks needed for membrane biogenesis, signalling and energy storage in rapidly proliferating tumour cells, and it operates orthogonally to the AMPK phosphorylation checkpoint.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 會在多個離胺酸殘基上將 ACC1 去乙醯化，進而提升其酵素活性並促進從頭脂質生成。由於 ACC1 是脂肪酸合成的限速酵素，SIRT3 依賴性的 ACC1 活化是一個促腫瘤的代謝轉換，為快速增殖的腫瘤細胞提供膜生成、訊號傳遞與能量儲存所需的脂質建構單元；此軸與 AMPK 磷酸化檢查點正交運作。

label: aak-2
description: aak-2 is the principal catalytic (alpha) subunit of the Caenorhabditis elegans AMP-activated protein kinase complex, the conserved energy sensor that monitors the AMP/ATP ratio. As the catalytic core, aak-2 transduces bioenergetic stress — raised AMP from low glucose, exercise, or mitochondrial dysfunction — into phosphorylation of anabolic and catabolic targets.
description_zh_TW: aak-2 是 Caenorhabditis elegans AMP 活化蛋白激酶複合體的主要催化（α）次單元，該複合體是監測 AMP/ATP 比例的保守能量感測器。作為催化核心，aak-2 將低葡萄糖、運動或粒線體功能障礙造成的 AMP 上升等生物能量壓力，轉換為對同化與分解代謝標的的磷酸化。

label: CANTOS Trial
description: CANTOS is cited as proof that reducing IL-1beta autoinflammatory signaling decreases cardiovascular events, validating autoinflammation as a treatable mechanism of atherosclerosis alongside the IL-1 blockade context established by anakinra.
description_zh_TW: CANTOS 被引用為降低 IL-1β 自發性發炎訊號可減少心血管事件的證據，驗證了 autoinflammation 為可治療的動脈粥狀硬化機制，並與 anakinra 所建立的 IL-1 阻斷脈絡相互呼應。

label: Senescent Cell Accumulation
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial dysfunction in cellular senescence a bridge to neurodegenerative disease.md
description: Aging causes senescent-cell accumulation as telomere shortening, cumulative DNA damage, and stem-cell stress increase senescent-cell formation, while declining immune clearance reduces their removal. The burden rises across multiple tissues, often described as exponential with age, and is a cardinal hallmark linking cellular senescence to organismal aging. The causal direction is reinforced by experiments showing that clearing these cells alleviates age-related dysfunction. Senescent-cell accumulation is therefore both a marker and a driver of the aging process.
description_zh_TW: 老化造成衰老細胞累積，因端粒縮短、累積 DNA 損傷與幹細胞壓力增加衰老細胞形成，而下降的免疫清除減少其移除。此負擔在多種組織上升，常被描述為隨年齡指數增加，且是連結細胞衰老與個體老化的關鍵特徵。因果方向被清除這些細胞可緩解年齡相關功能障礙的實驗強化。衰老細胞累積因此既是老化過程的標記也是驅動者。

label: Hannum Clock
description: The Hannum clock is a blood-based epigenetic age estimator whose blood-specific training makes it sensitive to immunosenescence and inflammatory states. Its age-acceleration correlates with aging and epigenetic alterations in the immune compartment.
description_zh_TW: Hannum 時鐘是基於血液的表觀遺傳年齡估算器，其血液特異訓練使其對免疫衰老與發炎狀態敏感。其年齡加速與免疫區室的衰老及表觀遺傳改變相關。

label: Connective Tissue Growth Factor
description: CTGF (CCN2), a ~36-38 kDa matricellular protein of the CCN family, is a major secreted component of the senescence-associated secretory phenotype. Senescent cells release it in response to DNA damage, and CTGF secreted by senescent fibroblasts in the tumor microenvironment promotes paracrine tumor progression and fibrosis (Coppé et al., 2010).
description_zh_TW: CTGF（CCN2）是 CCN 家族中約 36-38 kDa 的 matricellular 蛋白，也是 SASP 的主要分泌組成。衰老細胞在 DNA 損傷時會釋放 CTGF，而腫瘤微環境中衰老纖維母細胞分泌的 CTGF 會促進旁分泌型腫瘤進展與 Fibrosis（Coppé et al., 2010）。

label: PCSK9
description: SIRT6 deficiency accelerates Atherosclerosis through dysregulation of PCSK9 and consequent LDL accumulation, indicating that SIRT6 normally constrains PCSK9-driven plasma LDL elevation and vascular disease. PCSK9 itself is a secreted protease that drives LDL receptor degradation, so SIRT6 acts upstream to limit the atherogenic node.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 缺失會透過 PCSK9 的失調與隨之而來的 LDL 累積而加速 Atherosclerosis，表示 SIRT6 正常情況下會約束 PCSK9 驅動的血漿 LDL 升高與血管疾病。PCSK9 本身是促進 LDL 受體降解的分泌型蛋白酶，因此 SIRT6 在上游作用以限制這個致粥樣硬化節點。

label: Trimethylamine N-oxide
description: Trimethylamine N-oxide (TMAO) is a metabolite generated from dietary choline, phosphatidylcholine and L-carnitine: gut microbiota produce the trimethylamine precursor, which host hepatic flavin monooxygenase FMO3 oxidises to TMAO. TMAO is a recognised promoter of atherosclerosis and cardiovascular risk.
description_zh_TW: Trimethylamine N-oxide（TMAO）是由膳食膽鹼、磷脂醯膽鹼與 L-carnitine 生成的代謝物：腸道菌群產生三甲胺前驅物，再由宿主肝臟的黃素單加氧酶 FMO3 氧化為 TMAO。TMAO 是公認會促進 atherosclerosis 與心血管風險的因子。

label: MNNG
source_file: _document_ - Parthanatos Moura 2024 molecular mechanisms more questions than answers.md
description: MNNG is a methylating alkylating agent that generates a high load of DNA strand breaks, hyperactivating PARP1 and driving the parthanatos cascade; PARP inhibitors (DPQ, PJ-34) but not z-VAD block MNNG-induced death (Moura et al. 2024).
description_zh_TW: MNNG 是產生大量 DNA 斷裂的甲基化烷化劑，會過度活化 PARP1 並驅動 parthanatos 級聯；PARP 抑制劑（DPQ、PJ-34）而非 z-VAD 能阻斷 MNNG 誘導的死亡（Moura et al. 2024）。

label: PAANIB-1
description: PAANIB-1 is a brain-penetrant, selective inhibitor of the PD-D/E(X)K nuclease activity of MIF (PAAN, parthanatos-associated AIF nuclease). It spares MIF's tautomerase and cytokine functions and does not broadly inhibit other nucleases such as APE1, separating the parthanatotic nuclease arm from MIF's inflammatory roles.
description_zh_TW: PAANIB-1 是可穿透腦部、具選擇性的抑制劑，針對 MIF（PAAN，parthanatos 相關 AIF 核酸酶）的 PD-D/E(X)K 核酸酶活性。它保留 MIF 的互變異構酶與細胞激素功能，也不廣泛抑制 APE1 等其他核酸酶，將 parthanatotic 核酸酶臂與 MIF 的發炎功能區分開來。

label: PARP2
description: PARP2 lowers SIRT1 activity by two mechanisms: substrate competition, since both enzymes consume NAD+, and direct transcriptional repression via binding to the Sirt1 promoter. This places PARP2 at the intersection of genomic instability, NAD+ metabolism and the metabolic/longevity functions of SIRT1, and motivates NAD+-boosting strategies in aging research.
description_zh_TW: PARP2 透過兩種機制降低 SIRT1 活性：其一是受質競爭（兩種酵素都消耗 NAD+），其二是直接結合 Sirt1 啟動子進行轉錄抑制。這使 PARP2 處於基因體不穩定、NAD+ 代謝與 SIRT1 代謝／延壽功能的交會點，並為老化研究中的 NAD+ 補充策略提供理由。

label: TUNEL
description: TUNEL (terminal deoxynucleotidyl transferase dUTP nick-end labeling) enzymatically tags free 3′-OH DNA ends with labeled dUTP, visualizing the internucleosomal fragmentation of Apoptosis in tissue sections and fixed cells. It is the canonical histological counterpart to the DNA ladder on gels and cleaved Caspase-3 immunostaining.
description_zh_TW: TUNEL (terminal deoxynucleotidyl transferase dUTP nick-end labeling) 以酵素方式將游離的 3′-OH DNA 末端加上標記的 dUTP，使組織切片與固定細胞中 Apoptosis 的核小體間 DNA 片段化得以可視化。它是凝膠上 DNA ladder 與裂解型 Caspase-3 免疫染色的標準組織學對應物。

label: Allopurinol
description: Allopurinol inhibits xanthine oxidase, as allopurinol and its active metabolite oxypurinol competitively bind the molybdenum center and block purine oxidation. Clinically this lowers uric acid and also curbs XO-derived superoxide. The directionality is competitive inhibition to reduced urate and ROS. A caveat is that allopurinol inhibits the dehydrogenase and oxidase forms differently and can cause hypersensitivity in some patients, notably those with HLA-B*58:01. Beyond gout, allopurinol has been studied for cardiovascular protection, chronic kidney disease progression, and prevention of tumor lysis syndrome.
description_zh_TW: Allopurinol 抑制 xanthine oxidase，因为 allopurinol 及其活性代谢物奥昔嘌呤醇竞争性结合钼中心并阻止嘌呤氧化。临床上，这会降低 uric acid 并抑制 XO 衍生的超氧化物。方向性是对还原尿酸盐和ROS的竞争性抑制。需要注意的是，allopurinol 以不同的方式抑制脫氫酶和氧化酶的形成，並可能在某些患者中引起過敏，尤其是 HLA-B*58:01 患者。除了痛风之外，allopurinol 还被研究用于心血管保护、慢性肾病进展和预防肿瘤溶解综合征。

label: Amurensin G
description: Amurensin G is a resveratrol tetramer natural product reported among compounds that inhibit sirtuins at micromolar concentrations and endowed with anticancer activity. It belongs to a series that includes aristoforin, polyphenols, and tanikolide identified through general screens of structurally diverse natural products. Directionally, amurensin G suppresses sirtuin deacetylase activity. Its isoform selectivity and mechanism are incompletely characterized, and its anticancer effect may involve both sirtuin inhibition and additional natural-product bioactivities.
description_zh_TW: Amurensin G 是一種白藜蘆醇四聚體天然產物，據報導屬於在微摩爾濃度下抑制 sirtuin 的化合物，並具有抗癌活性。它屬於包括 aristoforin、多酚類和 tanikolide 在內的系列，透過對結構多樣化天然產物的廣泛篩選而鑑定。方向性上 amurensin G 抑制 sirtuin 去乙醯酶活性。其同工型選擇性和作用機制尚未完全表徵，其抗癌效果可能同時涉及 sirtuin 抑制和天然產物的其他生物活性。

label: Sirtuin Fluorimetric Activity
description: Sirtuin fluorimetric activity assays (e.g., the Fluor de Lys system) are the most commonly used methods to screen molecules as sirtuin inhibitors. Deacetylation of a fluorophore-decoupled substrate sensitizes it to a developer that releases a measurable fluorophore, and percent inhibition is calculated from fluorescence. These assays identified indoles (EX-527), tenovins, JGB1741, sirtinol analogues, and cambinol analogues. A key caveat is that the aminomethylcoumarin moiety of the fluorogenic substrates can affect binding of other small molecules to the enzyme, so confirmation with orthogonal assays is recommended.
description_zh_TW: Sirtuin 螢光活性測定（例如 Fluor de Lys 系統）是篩選分子作為 sirtuin 抑制劑最常用的方法。去乙醯化的螢光基團解偶聯受質經顯色劑處理後釋放出可量化的螢光基團，從螢光訊號計算抑制百分比。這些測定鑑定了吲哚類（EX-527）、tenovin、JGB1741、sirtinol 類似物和 cambinol 類似物。一個關鍵注意事項是螢光受質的氨基甲基香豆素部分可能影響其他小分子與酵素的結合，因此建議使用正交測定進行確認。

label: Rossmann fold
description: The Rossmann fold is a highly conserved structural motif found in many nucleotide-binding proteins, particularly those that bind NAD+/NADH. In the sirtuin family this large domain is the primary binding site for the NAD+ cofactor required for enzymatic activity.
description_zh_TW: Rossmann fold 是許多核苷酸結合蛋白中高度保守的結構模體，特別常見於結合 NAD+/NADH 的蛋白。在 sirtuin 家族中，這一大型結構域是酵素活性所需 NAD+ 輔因子的主要結合位。

label: Transition Metals
description: EDTA (ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid) is a chelating agent that binds transition metal ions such as iron and copper, making them inert and drastically slowing the autoxidation of epinephrine. Because these metals catalyze electron transfer from the catechol ring to oxygen, their removal suppresses the formation of the o-quinone intermediate that leads to adrenochrome. The strategy of metal chelation is therefore a key chemical defense against the oxidative conversion of adrenaline into its reactive oxidation product. EDTA exemplifies the broader class of chelating agents used to stabilize catecholamines in pharmaceutical and analytical settings, and it highlights the general principle that transition metal availability controls the rate at which the adrenochrome pathway can proceed in solution.
description_zh_TW: EDTA（乙二胺四乙酸）是一種螯合劑，可結合鐵、銅等過渡金屬離子，使其失去活性並大幅減緩 epinephrine 的自氧化。由於這些金屬催化電子從兒茶酚環轉移至氧氣，移除它們會抑制導致 adrenochrome 的鄰苯醌中間體的形成。因此，金屬螯合策略是對抗 adrenaline 氧化轉化為其反應性氧化產物的一項關鍵化學防線。EDTA 是藥用與分析環境中用於穩定兒茶酚胺的更廣泛螯合劑類的典型代表，並凸顯了過渡金屬可得性控制 adrenochrome 途徑在溶液中進行的速率這一普遍原則。

label: Adrenochrome sulfonate
description: Adrenochrome sulfonate is a degradation product formed when adrenochrome reacts with bisulfite antioxidants in the presence of light. Its formation reflects the photochemical instability of the adrenochrome chromophore.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome sulfonate 是 Adrenochrome 在光照下與 Bisulfite 抗氧化劑反應所形成的降解產物。其形成反映了 Adrenochrome 色基的光化學不穩定性。

label: EpiPen
description: Symjepi competes with the pen-style auto-injector and the nasal spray as an epinephrine delivery platform. Its formulation design is explicitly focused on oxidation stability against light, oxygen, and trace metals, so that adrenochrome and polymeric pigment accumulation — and the associated loss of potency — are minimized.
description_zh_TW: Symjepi 在 Epinephrine 給藥平台上與筆式自動注射器及鼻用噴劑競爭。其配方設計明確聚焦於對光、氧氣與微量金屬的氧化穩定性，使 adrenochrome 與聚合色素的累積（以及伴隨的效力喪失）降至最低。

label: Anaphylaxis
description: Symjepi is indicated for the emergency treatment of Anaphylaxis in adults and older children. Because epinephrine is a catecholamine highly susceptible to autoxidation in aqueous solution, container and formulation are engineered to preserve the reduced catechol, giving a 1-2 year room-temperature shelf life and ensuring potency during allergic emergencies.
description_zh_TW: Symjepi 的適應症為成人與較年長兒童的 Anaphylaxis 緊急治療。由於 Epinephrine 是水溶液中極易自氧化的兒茶酚胺，其容器與配方經工程設計以維持還原態的兒茶酚，因而具有 1–2 年的室溫保存期，確保過敏急症時的效力。

label: Stemness
description: IL-6 is a central driver of in vivo reprogramming toward pluripotency and stemness via JAK-STAT signaling and STAT3. Because IL-6 is a major Senescence-Associated Secretory Phenotype component, the senescent secretome can actively reprogram neighboring cells toward a stem-like state - a dual-edged consequence linking senescence to tissue repair and to cancer stemness and therapy resistance.
description_zh_TW: IL-6 是體內朝多能性與 stemness 重編程的核心驅動因子，透過 JAK-STAT Signaling 與 STAT3 作用。由於 IL-6 是 Senescence-Associated Secretory Phenotype 的主要成分，衰老分泌組能主動將鄰近細胞重編程為幹樣狀態——這是連結衰老與組織修復、以及與 cancer stemness 和治療抗性之間的雙刃結果。

label: CEBPα
description: C/EBPα is a bZIP transcription factor that, upon senescence entry, is induced and relocalizes to chromatin, occupying senescence-activated enhancers with C/EBPβ and NF-κB (p65/p50). This enhanceosome integrates p38 MAPK phosphorylation signals with NF-κB to drive robust, sustained transcription of IL-6, IL-8 and other SASP components.
description_zh_TW: C/EBPα 是 bZIP 轉錄因子，在進入衰老時被誘導並重新定位至染色體，與 C/EBPβ 及 NF-κB（p65/p50）共同占據衰老活化增強子。這個 enhanceosome 將 p38 MAPK 磷酸化訊號與 NF-κB 整合，驅動 IL-6、IL-8 與其他 SASP 成分強而持續的轉錄。

label: IFITM3
description: IFITM3 is an interferon-inducible endolysosomal membrane protein that restricts enveloped virus fusion by stiffening cholesterol-rich membranes. In aging it is packaged into circulating plasma exosomes/extracellular vesicles; upon uptake by neighboring cells this exosomal IFITM3 triggers senescence programs in the recipients, expanding the senescent cell burden beyond locally damaged tissue and establishing a systemic, IFN-linked senescence-spreading axis.
description_zh_TW: IFITM3 是可被干擾素誘導的內體溶酶體膜蛋白，藉由使富含膽固醇的膜僵硬化來限制有外套膜病毒的融合。在老化狀態下它被包裝進循環血漿的外泌體／細胞外囊泡；鄰近細胞攝入後，這些外泌體 IFITM3 會在受體細胞中啟動衰老程式，使衰老細胞負擔超出局部受損組織，形成全身性、與 IFN 相連的衰老傳播軸。

label: CPS1
description: CPS1 catalyzes the first and rate-limiting step of the urea cycle, combining ammonium, bicarbonate and two ATP molecules in the mitochondrial matrix to form carbamoyl phosphate, which then condenses with ornithine to form citrulline. By converting a highly toxic amino acid catabolite into urea, CPS1 makes ammonia clearance essential to cellular and systemic health.
description_zh_TW: CPS1 催化尿素循環的第一步也是限速步驟，在粒線體基質中將銨離子、碳酸氫根與兩個 ATP 分子結合形成 carbamoyl phosphate，後者再與 ornithine 縮合形成 citrulline。藉由把高度有毒的胺基酸分解副產物轉為尿素，CPS1 使氨的清除成為細胞與全身健康所必需。

label: Glutathione S-Transferase
description: NRF2, acting through the Antioxidant Response Element, upregulates the expression of glutathione S-transferases (GSTs), which are pivotal detoxifying enzymes intricately related to antioxidant capacity. This transcriptional program, stimulated in the setting of urolithin A treatment, enhances cellular autophagy and mitochondrial quality control. GSTs are therefore downstream effectors of NRF2 signaling that help protect cells against oxidative and electrophilic stress and that support the removal and turnover of damaged mitochondria.
description_zh_TW: NRF2 透過 Antioxidant Response Element 作用，上調 glutathione S-transferases (GSTs) 的表現，而 GSTs 是與抗氧化能力密切相關的關鍵解毒酶。此轉錄程序在 urolithin A 處理下被刺激，進而增強細胞自噬與粒線體品質控制。因此，GSTs 是 NRF2 訊號的下游效應分子，協助保護細胞對抗氧化與親電子壓力，並支持受損粒線體的移除與更新。

label: Ellagitannins
description: Urolithin A is a natural metabolite derived from ellagitannins, polyphenolic precursors found in pomegranate, walnut, almond, strawberry, and blueberry. During digestion, microbial enzymes in the colon convert ellagitannins through stepwise enzymatic and metabolic reactions to yield urolithin A. Because ellagitannin intake is a precondition for urolithin A formation, dietary consumption of ellagitannin-rich foods supplies an abundance of precursor molecules for intestinal microbial metabolism, facilitating the generation of urolithin A and increasing its systemic availability.
description_zh_TW: Urolithin A 是一種源自 ellagitannins（鞣花單寧）的天然代謝物，後者為存在於石榴、核桃、杏仁、草莓與藍莓中的多酚類前驅物。在消化期間，結腸中的微生物酵素透過逐步的酵素與代謝反應將 ellagitannins 轉化以產生 urolithin A。由於 ellagitannin 攝取是 urolithin A 形成的先決條件，飲食攝取富含 ellagitannin 的食物提供了豐富的前驅物分子供腸道微生物代謝，促進 urolithin A 的生成並增加其全身性可用性。

label: Cilengitide
description: Cilengitide is a cyclic RGD pentapeptide derivative.
description_zh_TW: Cilengitide 是環狀 RGD 五肽衍生物。

label: VEGF Family
description: The VEGF family canonically drives blood-vessel formation.
description_zh_TW: VEGF 家族典型驅動血管形成。

label: Vitronectin
description: Vitronectin is an abundant plasma and extracellular matrix glycoprotein whose central RGD (Arg-Gly-Asp) motif is the principal integrin-binding site, engaging αvβ3, αvβ5, αvβ6 and α5β1 integrins. Presenting RGD to αv-family integrins nucleates focal adhesions and activates FAK/Src signaling that drives motility and survival.
description_zh_TW: Vitronectin 是血浆與細胞外基質中含量豐富的醣蛋白，其中央的 RGD（Arg-Gly-Asp）序列為主要的 integrin 結合位點，可結合 αvβ3、αvβ5、αvβ6 與 α5β1 等 Integrins。向 αv 家族 integrins 呈現 RGD 會成核形成黏著斑，並啟動 FAK／Src 訊號以驅動運動與存活。

label: Galectin-9
description: Galectin-9 is a secreted beta-galactoside-binding lectin with two tandem carbohydrate recognition domains that is a component of the senescence-associated secretory phenotype. It was first reported as a SASP factor secreted by senescent melanoma cells, and its presence contributes to the immunosuppressive arm of the senescent secretome, potentially facilitating tumor immune evasion.
description_zh_TW: Galectin-9 是一種分泌型、具有兩個串聯醣類辨識結構域的 β-半乳糖苷結合凝集素，也是細胞衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）的組成成分。它最早被報告為衰老黑色素瘤細胞分泌的 SASP 因子，其存在促成了衰老分泌組的免疫抑制面向，可能協助腫瘤的免疫逃脫。

label: Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension
description: Pulmonary arterial hypertension involves excessive mitochondrial fission mediated by DRP1, contributing to pulmonary artery smooth muscle cell proliferation and vascular remodeling. DRP1-mediated fission has been implicated in PAH pathogenesis.
description_zh_TW: 肺動脈高壓涉及由 DRP1 介導的過度粒線體分裂，促成肺動脈平滑肌細胞增殖與血管重塑。DRP1 介導的分裂被認為與 PAH 致病機轉有關。

label: Lys68
description: SIRT3 directly deacetylates Lys68 of MnSOD/SOD2; deacetylated MnSOD shows dramatically enhanced dismutation of superoxide to hydrogen peroxide, reducing mitochondrial oxidative stress. This site is potentiated by SIRT3 activators such as honokiol and dihydromyricetin and serves as a canonical indicator of SIRT3 function.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 直接去乙醯化 MnSOD/SOD2 的 Lys68；去乙醯化後 MnSOD 將超氧化陰離子轉為過氧化氫的能力顯著提升，降低粒線體氧化壓力。此位點可被 honokiol 與 dihydromyricetin 等 SIRT3 活化劑增強，並作為 SIRT3 功能的典型指標。

label: CLEAR Element
description: TFEB binds to Coordinated Lysosomal Expression and Regulation (CLEAR) elements—a conserved 10-base-pair motif (GTCACGTGAC) present in the promoters of numerous lysosomal and autophagy genes. Through this binding, TFEB drives the coordinated transcriptional upregulation of the entire autophagy-lysosomal network. CLEAR-mediated regulation allows cells to mount a unified response that expands degradative capacity in tandem with autophagic initiation. The CLEAR network is the molecular basis for TFEB's role as a master regulator of cellular clearance.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 結合至協調溶酶體表達與調節（CLEAR）元件——存在於眾多溶酶體和自噬基因啟動子中的保守 10 個鹼基對基序（GTCACGTGAC）。透過此結合，TFEB 驅動整個自噬—溶酶體網絡的協調轉錄上調。CLEAR 介導的調節使細胞能夠啟動統一的反應，在自噬起始的同時擴展降解能力。CLEAR 網絡是 TFEB 作為細胞清除主調控因子角色的分子的基礎。

label: Trehalose
description: Trehalose acts as an autophagy inducer. Induction is mTORC1-independent.
description_zh_TW: 海藻糖作為自噬誘發因子。誘發不依賴 mTORC1。

label: MiT-TFE family
description: The microphthalmia (MiT/TFE) family of basic helix-loop-helix leucine zipper transcription factors comprises TFEB, TFE3, MITF and TFEC. These factors regulate autophagy and lysosomal genes by binding CLEAR elements, and their translocation or nuclear trapping activates the autophagic-lysosomal transcriptional program.
description_zh_TW: 微眼畸形（MiT/TFE）家族的基本螺旋環螺旋－白胺酸拉鍊轉錄因子包含 TFEB、TFE3、MITF 與 TFEC。這些因子藉由結合 CLEAR elements 來調控自噬與溶酶體基因，其轉位或核內滯留可活化自噬－溶酶體轉錄程序。

label: Steatohepatitis
description: Autophagy protects against steatohepatitis by clearing lipid droplets (Lipophagy), damaged mitochondria (Mitophagy) and protein aggregates. Steatohepatitis — nonalcoholic steatohepatitis characterized by hepatic steatosis, lobular inflammation and hepatocyte ballooning — progresses to fibrosis, cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma when this clearance fails.
description_zh_TW: 自噬藉由清除脂質滴（Lipophagy）、受損粒線體（Mitophagy）與蛋白聚集體來防止脂肪性肝炎。非酒精性脂肪性肝炎以肝脂肪變性、 小葉發炎與肝細胞氣球樣變為特徵，當這種清除失效時，疾病會進展為纖維化、肝硬化與肝細胞癌。

label: S-sulfhydration
description: S-sulfhydration (persulfidation) is the post-translational modification of cysteine thiols to persulfides (-SSH) by hydrogen sulfide. TFEB undergoes S-sulfhydration at C212, and the modification enhances TFEB activity by promoting its nuclear translocation, the switch that turns on lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy genes.
description_zh_TW: S-硫氫化（persulfidation）是硫化氫將半胱胺酸硫醇修飾為過硫化物（-SSH）的轉譯後修飾。TFEB 在 C212 發生 S-硫氫化，該修飾藉由促進其核轉位而增強 TFEB 活性，也就是打開溶酶體生成與自噬基因的開關。

label: TNKS2
description: TNKS2 (tankyrase 2, PARP5B) is one of two tankyrase isozymes that catalyze poly-ADP-ribosylation of substrate proteins. Its ankyrin repeat domain binds substrates such as axin, TRF1 and TFEB, and PARsylation of TFEB promotes its destabilisation and restricts its transcriptional program for lysosomal and autophagic genes.
description_zh_TW: TNKS2（tankyrase 2，PARP5B）是兩種 tankyrase 異構酶之一，催化受體蛋白的 poly-ADP-核糖基化。其 ankyrin repeat 結構域結合 axin、TRF1 與 TFEB 等受體，而 TFEB 的 PARsylation 會促進其去穩定化並限制其溶酶體與自噬基因的轉錄程序。

label: Tankyrases
description: Tankyrases (TNKS1 and TNKS2) are PARP5 poly(ADP-ribose) polymerases that interact with and parsylate TFEB, modulating its stability and nuclear-cytoplasmic shuttling. The PARP domain transfers ADP-ribose units from NAD+ onto glutamate, aspartate or lysine residues, building branched PAR chains that typically tag substrates for proteasomal degradation or altered localisation.
description_zh_TW: Tankyrases（TNKS1 與 TNKS2）是 PARP5 類的 poly(ADP-核糖)聚合酶，會與 TFEB 交互作用並對其進行 PARsylation，調節其穩定性與核－細胞質穿梭。其 PARP 結構域將 ADP-核糖單元從 NAD+ 轉移到麩胺酸、天門冬胺酸或離胺酸殘基上，形成分支的 PAR 鏈，通常將受體標記以供蛋白酶體降解或改變定位。

label: Dopamine Neuron
description: TFEB-mediated autophagy protects Dopamine Neuron from Alpha-synuclein toxicity. Dopamine neurons of the Substantia Nigra pars compacta are selectively vulnerable in Parkinson's Disease, and deleting TFEB (or Atg7) in mice triggers their degeneration together with protein aggregation.
description_zh_TW: 由 TFEB 介導的自噬可保護 Dopamine Neuron 免受 Alpha-synuclein 毒性傷害。Substantia Nigra pars compacta 的多巴胺神經元在 Parkinson's Disease 中具有選擇易感性，在小鼠中剔除 TFEB（或 Atg7）會誘發其退化與蛋白聚集。

label: UPRE
description: XBP1, a member of the CEB/P family of transcription factors, binds the UPRE (unfolded protein response element) in the promoters of its target genes. During ER Stress this direct promoter occupancy switches on the unfolded protein response program, and the same XBP1-UPRE axis also contributes to transcriptional regulation of TFEB.
description_zh_TW: XBP1 是 CEB/P 轉錄因子家族的成員，它會與目標基因啟動子上的 UPRE（unfolded protein response element）結合。在 ER Stress 期間，這種直接的啟動子佔位會啟動非折疊蛋白反應程式；同一條 XBP1-UPRE 軸也參與 TFEB 的轉錄調控。

label: MAPK Signaling
description: ERK2 (Extracellular Signal-Regulated Kinase 2) is a member of the MAPK family that transmits signals from cell surface receptors to the nucleus, influencing cell proliferation and survival. It is activated by MEK1/2 upstream of the canonical RAF-MEK-ERK cascade.
description_zh_TW: ERK2（Extracellular Signal-Regulated Kinase 2）是 MAPK 家族的成員，負責將訊號由細胞表面受體傳至細胞核，影響細胞增殖與存活；它在典型的 RAF-MEK-ERK 級聯上游由 MEK1/2 活化。

label: Cognitive Performance
description: COMT modulates cognitive performance through an inverted-U (or tonic-phasic) relationship in which intermediate dopamine levels in the prefrontal cortex optimize executive function, while both excessively high (slow COMT) and low (fast COMT) activity shift performance away from the optimum. Met-bearing (slow) genotypes favor stability and working memory under calm conditions, whereas Val-bearing (fast) genotypes favor rapid processing under stress. Thus COMT genotype is a major determinant of individual differences in cognition.
description_zh_TW: COMT 透過倒 U（或強直相位）關係調節 cognitive performance，其中前額葉皮質中的中間多巴胺水平優化 executive function，而過高（慢 COMT）和低（快 COMT）活動會使性能偏離最佳狀態。含有 Met 的（慢速）基因型有利於平靜條件下的穩定性和工作記憶，而含有 Val 的（快速）基因型則有利於在壓力下快速處理。因此，COMT genotype 是認知個體差異的主要決定因素。

label: high COMT activity
description: The Val/Val genotype produces high COMT enzyme activity, roughly three- to four-fold above Met/Met, due to the thermostable valine-containing enzyme with greater catalytic efficiency. This accelerates inactivation of dopamine, norepinephrine, and epinephrine, lowering their extracellular signaling duration, particularly in the prefrontal cortex. It defines the fast end of the COMT activity spectrum with broad cognitive and physiological consequences. It underlies the rapid catechol clearance seen in Val/Val carriers.
description_zh_TW: Val/Val 基因型產生高 COMT 酶活性，大約是 Met/Met 的三到四倍，因為熱穩定的含纈氨酸酶具有更高的催化效率。這加速了多巴胺、norepinephrine 和腎上腺素的失活，降低了它們的細胞外訊號傳導持續時間，特別是在前額葉皮質。它定義了 COMT activity 系列的快速端，具有廣泛的認知和生理後果。它是 Val/Val 攜帶者中兒茶酚快速清除的基礎。

label: Daratumumab
description: Daratumumab is a frontline anti-CD38 antibody therapy for multiple myeloma, where CD38 is highly expressed on malignant plasma cells. Its clinical efficacy stems from direct and immune-mediated elimination of these cells, including complement-dependent cytotoxicity, antibody-dependent cellular cytotoxicity, and antibody-dependent cellular phagocytosis. Directionally, daratumumab sits upstream of myeloma cell clearance. Beyond oncology, its CD38 inhibition has the secondary effect of sparing NAD+ pools that sirtuins depend on, and it depletes CD38+ regulatory immune cells, reshaping the tumor microenvironment to restore anti-tumor T-cell and NK-cell responses.
description_zh_TW: Daratumumab 是多發性骨髓瘤的一線抗 CD38 抗體療法，其中 CD38 在惡性漿細胞上高度表達。其臨床療效源於直接和免疫介導的這些細胞的消除，包括補體依賴性細胞毒性、抗體依賴性細胞毒性和抗體依賴性細胞吞噬作用。在方向性上，Daratumumab 位於骨髓瘤細胞清除的上游。除了腫瘤學之外，其 CD38 抑制的次級效應是節省 sirtuin 依賴的 NAD+ 池，並耗竭 CD38+ 調節性免疫細胞，重塑腫瘤微環境以恢復抗腫瘤 T 細胞和 NK 細胞反應。

label: CZ-48
description: CZ-48 (sulfo-ara-F-NMN) is a cell-permeant NMN analog that acts as an NMN mimetic binding the SARM1 ARM domain, relieving autoinhibition and driving NADase activation. Activated SARM1 produces cyclic ADP-ribose, depletes NAD+ and ATP, and induces non-apoptotic cell death. CZ-48 is the only known molecule with opposite effects on the two principal NAD+ glycohydrolases: it activates SARM1 while inhibiting CD38, pharmacologically separating two enzymes that share substrate and products.
description_zh_TW: CZ-48（sulfo-ara-F-NMN）是可穿透細胞膜的 NMN 類似物，作為 NMN 擬態結合 SARM1 的 ARM 結構域，解除其自體抑制並驅動 NADase 活化。活化的 SARM1 會產生環腺苷二磷酸核糖（cADPR），耗竭 NAD+ 與 ATP，並誘發非凋亡性細胞死亡。CZ-48 是已知唯一對兩種主要 NAD+ 糖苷水解酶作用相反的分子：它活化 SARM1 卻抑制 CD38， pharmacological 上將這兩個共享底物與產物的酵素區分開來。

label: GSK-428
description: GSK-428 is a quinazoline-scaffold small molecule that binds orthosterically within the TIR-domain NADase pocket of SARM1 with nanomolar IC50 potency, blocking NAD+ cleavage and preventing the axonal NAD+ catastrophe that drives Wallerian-type axon degeneration. It belongs to the next-generation non-covalent SARM1 inhibitor class alongside DSRM-3716, offering a higher selectivity and potency profile than the repurposed covalent inhibitor disulfiram, and is aimed at axon-degeneration indications such as chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy and traumatic brain injury.
description_zh_TW: GSK-428 是一個喹唑啉骨架的小分子，可正交結合於 SARM1 的 TIR 結構域 NADase 活性位點，IC50 達奈莫耳級，阻斷 NAD+ 切割並防止驅動華勒氏樣軸突退化的軸突 NAD+ 災難。它與 DSRM-3716 同屬新一代非共價 SARM1 抑制劑類別，相較於被重新定位的共價抑制劑 disulfiram 具有更高的選擇性與效力，目標適應症包含化療引起的神經病變與創傷性腦損傷。

label: NMNH
description: Adenosine kinase phosphorylates NRH to NMNH, and the resulting NMNH feeds the NAD+ salvage machinery, ultimately replenishing NAD+ through NMNAT and downstream adenylation steps. This makes the enzyme an alternative entry point into NAD+ Biosynthesis that is independent of NMRK1-dependent activation of NR.
description_zh_TW: Adenosine Kinase 將 NRH 磷酸化為 NMNH，所產生的 NMNH 送入 NAD+ 補救機制，最後經由 NMNAT 與後續腺苷化步驟補充 NAD+。這使該酵素成為 NAD+ 生合成的替代入口，且獨立於 NMRK1 依賴性的 NR 活化。

label: Adenosine Kinase
description: Beyond its classical role of phosphorylating adenosine to AMP in purine salvage, Adenosine kinase acts as an NRH kinase, phosphorylating the reduced nucleoside NRH (dihydronicotinamide riboside) to generate NMNH. Because NRH is more stable than Nicotinamide Riboside and more potently raises cellular NAD+, this reaction explains why NRH outcompetes NR as a precursor.
description_zh_TW: 除了在嘌呤補救途徑中將腺苷磷酸化為 AMP 的經典角色之外，Adenosine Kinase 還作為 NRH 激酶作用，將還原核苷 NRH（dihydronicotinamide riboside）磷酸化生成 NMNH。由於 NRH 比 Nicotinamide Riboside 更穩定、且更有效提升細胞 NAD+，此反應解釋了 NRH 作為前驅物為何優於 NR。

label: 1-Methylnicotinamide
description: NNMT is the enzyme that methylates Nicotinamide using S-adenosylmethionine to form 1-Methylnicotinamide (1-MNA). Because 1-MNA is the terminal, largely non-recyclable sink of nicotinamide, NNMT activity sets how much nicotinamide remains available for NAD+ resynthesis.
description_zh_TW: NNMT 是以 S-腺苷甲硫胺酸將 Nicotinamide 甲基化形成 1-Methylnicotinamide (1-MNA) 的酵素。由於 1-MNA 是菸醯胺終末且大致不可回收的匯，NNMT 活性決定了仍可供 NAD+ 再合成的菸醯胺量。

label: CLOCK
description: BMAL1 and CLOCK form the heterodimer at the centre of the Circadian Rhythm transcriptional-translational feedback loop. The pair drives clock-controlled genes including NAMPT, and their acetylation state set by SIRT1 links the ~24-hour oscillator to cellular energy state.
description_zh_TW: BMAL1 與 CLOCK 組成異二聚體，位於 Circadian Rhythm 轉錄—轉譯回饋迴路的核心。該二聚體驅動包括 NAMPT 在內的時鐘受控基因，而其由 SIRT1 設定的乙醯化狀態則將約 24 小時的振盪器與細胞能量狀態相連結。

label: RANKL
description: RANK (TNFRSF11A) is the cell-surface receptor whose ligand is RANKL. Ligand engagement of RANK recruits NF-kB and MAPK signalling machinery, driving osteoclast differentiation from monocyte/macrophage precursors and, downstream, MAPK-dependent phosphorylation and activation of TFE3 (Hershey & Fisher 2004).
description_zh_TW: RANK (TNFRSF11A) 是細胞表面受體，其配體為 RANKL。RANKL 結合 RANK 後招募 NF-κB 與 MAPK 訊息傳遞機制，驅動單核／巨噬細胞前驅細胞分化為 Osteoclast，並在下游經由 MAPK 依賴性的磷酸化活化 TFE3（Hershey & Fisher 2004）。

label: FLICA
description: FLICA (fluorescent labeled inhibitors of caspases) probes such as FAM-YVAD-FMK are cell-permeant, fluorescently tagged caspase inhibitors that covalently bind the active site of cleaved caspases. Because they report enzymatic activity rather than mere protein presence, caspase-1 FLICA is the standard live-cell readout of inflammasome-driven Caspase-1 activation, typically paired with Gasdermin D-N staining and IL-1β or LDH release.
description_zh_TW: FLICA（fluorescent labeled inhibitors of caspases）探針，例如 FAM-YVAD-FMK，是可穿透細胞膜的螢光標記 caspase 抑制劑，能共價結合已被切割之 caspase 的活性位。由於它反映的是酵素活性而非單純的蛋白表現量，caspase-1 FLICA 是偵測發炎小體驅動之 Caspase-1 活化之標準活細胞讀值方法，通常搭配 Gasdermin D-N 染色以及 IL-1β 或 LDH 釋放量測定。

label: S100A13
description: S100A13 is an EF-hand S100 family calcium/copper-binding protein required for the copper- and calcium-dependent nuclear translocation of cleaved IL-1α. Once in the nucleus, IL-1α acts as a transcriptional coactivator for NF-κB target genes, so S100A13 sits upstream of IL-1α rather than acting as a downstream effector.
description_zh_TW: S100A13 是 EF-hand 型 S100 家族的鈣／銅結合蛋白，負責切割後 IL-1α 依賴銅與鈣的核轉位。IL-1α 進入細胞核後作為 NF-κB 目標基因的轉錄輔激活因子，因此 S100A13 位於 IL-1α 上游而非下游效應端。

label: Metallic silver
description: Metallic silver is oxidized and may deposit in the tissues, causing argyria, a permanent blue-gray pigmentation of the skin, eyes, and mucous membranes. Argyria results when large doses of silver are absorbed into the circulatory system and deposited in body tissues; although disfiguring and usually permanent, the condition does not otherwise harm health, and mild forms are sometimes mistaken for cyanosis. The pigmentation reflects reduced elemental silver and silver sulfide granules lodged in the tissues.
description_zh_TW: 金屬銀被氧化並可能沉積在組織中，導致argyria，一種皮膚、眼睛和黏膜的永久性藍灰色色素沉著。當大劑量銀吸收進入循環系統並沉積在體組織中時，會導致argyria；雖然毀容且通常永久，但該病變對健康無其他損害，輕度形式有時被誤認為發紺。色素沉著反映了還原的元素銀和硫化銀顆粒滯留在組織中。

label: DAI
description: DAI (DNA-dependent activator of IRFs) is the original name of ZBP1 (Z-DNA binding protein 1); the molecules are identical, with ZBP1 now the canonical gene name.
description_zh_TW: DAI（IRF 的 DNA 依賴活化因子）為 ZBP1（Z-DNA 結合蛋白 1）的原名；兩者為同一分子，ZBP1 為現行規範基因名。

label: Inflammatory Bowel Disease
description: Conditional deletion of Caspase-8 or FADD in intestinal epithelium causes spontaneous necroptosis and IBD-like pathology, but crossing these mice onto a RIPK3-deficient background completely prevents the disease, demonstrating that the epithelial cell death underlying the phenotype is RIPK3-dependent.
description_zh_TW: 在腸道上皮中條件性刪除 Caspase-8 或 FADD 會引發自發性壞死性凋亡與類 IBD 的病理，但將這些小鼠交配到缺乏 RIPK3 的背景上可完全阻止該病徵，證明其上皮細胞死亡依賴 RIPK3。

label: PEX12
description: Biallelic PEX12 loss produces Zellweger spectrum disorders with essentially absent peroxisomal import. PEX12 is the third RING-finger subunit of the importomer, completing the PEX2/PEX10 RING complex; without it the PEX5 receptor cannot be recycled by ubiquitination, so peroxisomal matrix enzymes fail to reach the organelle.
description_zh_TW: PEX12 的雙等位基因缺失會造成 Zellweger 譜系疾病，過氧化體輸入幾乎完全消失。PEX12 是 importomer 的第三個 RING 指狀次單元，補足 PEX2/PEX10 RING 複合體；缺少它，PEX5 受體便無法藉由泛素化回收，過氧化體基質酵素因而無法送達胞器。

label: PEX10
description: Biallelic PEX10 variants cause Zellweger spectrum disorders. PEX10 supplies the RING-finger ubiquitin-ligase activity of the peroxisomal importomer that recycles the PEX5 receptor after cargo import; loss of this activity collapses peroxisomal matrix protein import and yields the severe Zellweger phenotype or milder variants depending on residual function.
description_zh_TW: PEX10 的雙等位基因變異會造成 Zellweger 譜系疾病。PEX10 提供過氧化體 importomer 的 RING 指狀泛素連接酶活性，負責在貨運輸入後回收 PEX5 受體；此活性喪失會使過氧化體基質蛋白輸入崩潰，依殘餘功能產生嚴重的 Zellweger 表型或較輕的變異。

label: PEX2
description: PEX2 encodes a RING-finger ubiquitin ligase of the peroxisomal importomer that, with PEX10 and PEX12, ubiquitinates the PEX5 import receptor to recycle it after cargo delivery. Biallelic loss of PEX2 abolishes this receptor-recycling step and produces the Zellweger spectrum disorder phenotype with defective peroxisomal matrix protein import; milder variants retain residual import capacity and present as infantile Refsum or Heimler syndrome. Zellweger spectrum disorders are autosomal-recessive peroxisome-biogenesis disorders caused by biallelic loss of PEX genes, and PEX2 is one of these causative genes. Its loss abolishes peroxisomal import, producing the severe Zellweger syndrome end of the spectrum (hypotonia, seizures, liver dysfunction, early lethality) or milder infantile Refsum and Heimler phenotypes when residual import function remains.
description_zh_TW: PEX2 編碼過氧化體體（importomer）的 RING 指狀泛素連接酶，與 PEX10、PEX12 共同將 PEX5 輸入受體泛素化，以便在貨運送達後回收受體。PEX2 的雙等位基因缺失會使此受體回收步驟失效，造成過氧化體基質蛋白輸入缺陷，並產生 Zellweger 譜系疾病的表型；較輕的變異仍保有部分輸入功能，表現為嬰兒型 Refsum 症候群或 Heimler 症候群。 Zellweger 譜系疾病是一類由 PEX 基因雙等位基因缺失造成的體染色體隱性過氧化體生物合成疾病，PEX2 正是其中的致病基因之一。其缺失會使過氧化體輸入喪失，造成譜系中嚴重端的 Zellweger 症候群（肌張力低下、抽搐、肝功能異常、早期死亡）；若仍保有部分輸入功能，則呈現較輕的嬰兒型 Refsum 與 Heimler 表型。

label: PEX13
description: Mutations in PEX13 cause PEX13-deficient Zellweger Spectrum Disorder, roughly 2-5% of cases; missense variants in the SH3-like domain partially impair PEX14 interaction and yield milder phenotypes, while truncating mutations abolish import and cause lethal disease.
description_zh_TW: PEX13 突變會造成 PEX13 缺乏型 Zellweger 光譜症候群，約佔所有病例的 2–5%；SH3 樣結構域的錯義變異會部分損害與 PEX14 的交互作用而表型較輕，截短突變則完全消除輸入功能並造成致死性疾病。

label: Clonal Hematopoiesis
description: Somatic mutations in the DNMT3A gene are among the most common drivers of clonal hematopoiesis of indeterminate potential (CHIP), a premalignant state in which a single hematopoietic stem cell clone expands in the blood. These mutations impair the enzyme's catalytic activity, altering DNA methylation at loci that regulate self-renewal and differentiation. Because DNMT3A-mutant clones persist and accumulate with age, they confer an elevated risk of hematologic malignancies such as acute myeloid leukemia, as well as cardiovascular disease.
description_zh_TW: DNMT3A 基因的體細胞突變是不確定潛能克隆造血 (CHIP) 的最常見驅動因素之一，這是一種單一造血幹細胞克隆在血液中擴增的癌前狀態。這些突變損害了酵素的催化活性，改變了調節自我更新和分化的位點的 DNA 甲基化。由於 DNMT3A 突變克隆會隨著年齡的增長而持續存在和積累，因此它們會增加急性髓性白血病等血液系統惡性腫瘤以及心血管疾病的風險。

label: Biological Age
description: An epigenetic clock is a statistical estimator of biological age built from DNA methylation measurements at a defined set of CpG sites across the genome. Trained on large cohorts, these clocks compute an epigenetic age that correlates with chronological age but can also deviate from it, reflecting accelerated or decelerated biological aging. Clock acceleration is associated with disease and mortality risk, making epigenetic clocks valuable biomarkers for aging research and for evaluating anti-aging interventions.
description_zh_TW: 表觀遺傳時鐘是生物年齡的統計估計器，是根據基因組中一組定義的 CpG 位點的 DNA 甲基化測量而建構的。這些時鐘經過對大群體的訓練，計算出與實際年齡相關的表觀遺傳年齡，但也可能偏離實際年齡，反映生物老化的加速或減慢。時鐘加速與疾病和死亡風險有關，這使得表觀遺傳時鐘成為老化研究和評估抗衰老幹預措施的寶貴生物標記。

label: Epigenetic Inheritance
description: DNA methylation is the primary carrier of mitotically heritable epigenetic states. Mechanism edge parallels the Epigenetics parent.
description_zh_TW: DNA 甲基化是有絲分裂可遺傳表觀遺傳狀態的主要載體。機制邊與 Epigenetics 母項平行。

label: UHRF1
description: UHRF1 directs maintenance fidelity of methylation through division. Maintenance mirrors the DNMT1 edge.
description_zh_TW: UHRF1 在分裂中指導甲基化的維持保真度。維持呼應 DNMT1 邊。

label: Common Pathway
description: Apoptosis converges at Common Pathway. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. The common execution phase of apoptosis is the point at which all initiation routes converge on effector caspases that proteolyze the cellular proteome. The relationship is directional, with Apoptosis acting as the operative agent upon Common Pathway rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Apoptosis 收斂於 Common Pathway。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。細胞凋亡的共同執行階段是所有起始途徑匯聚到效應器半胱天冬酶上的點，該效應器半胱天冬酶對細胞蛋白質組進行蛋白質分解。這種關係是有方向的，Apoptosis 充當 Common Pathway 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Lysosomal Membrane Permeabilization
description: Mild lysosomal membrane permeabilization releases cathepsins that cleave Bid and other apical caspases, engaging apoptosis. Extensive LMP floods the cytosol with hydrolases, causing necrosis-like death, while moderate LMP bridges to the apoptotic program.
description_zh_TW: 輕度溶酶體膜通透化釋放組織蛋白酶，剪切 Bid 與其他頂端 caspase 以啟動細胞凋亡。重度 LMP 以水解酶淹沒細胞質造成類壞死死亡，中度 LMP 則橋接至細胞凋亡程式。

label: Livin
description: Livin (BIRC7/ML-IAP), a member of the inhibitor of apoptosis family, contains a baculoviral IAP repeat (BIR) domain that directly binds and inhibits the effector caspases caspase-3, -7 and -9, plus a C-terminal RING finger conferring E3 ubiquitin-ligase activity that targets apoptotic proteins for proteasomal degradation.
description_zh_TW: Livin（BIRC7/ML-IAP）是細胞凋亡抑制蛋白（IAP）家族的成員，含 baculoviral IAP repeat（BIR）結構域，可直接結合並抑制效應型 Caspases（caspase-3、-7、-9）；其 C 端 RING finger 則賦予 E3 泛素連接酶活性，將凋亡相關蛋白標記送往 Proteasome 降解。

label: Flippase
description: Flippases maintain the resting asymmetry with phosphatidylserine inward, and scramblases reverse it. Scramblase and flippase are therefore functionally opposed executors of the same membrane decision: rising calcium switches scramblase on and flippase off, collapsing phosphatidylserine asymmetry within minutes to expose the eat-me signal.
description_zh_TW: Flippase 藉由將 phosphatidylserine 維持在內側來維持靜止時的不對稱性，而 scramblase 則將其反轉。因此 scramblase 與 flippase 是同一個膜決策的功能性對立執行者：鈣濃度上升會開啟 scramblase 並關閉 flippase，在數分鐘內使 phosphatidylserine 不對稱性崩解而暴露 eat-me 訊號。

label: diabetic complications
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Advanced glycation end products accumulate in tissues and organs during diabetes and contribute to the pathogenesis of diabetic complications. AGE formation and accumulation in diabetic patients results in vascular alterations leading to diabetic vasculopathy, and glycation is implicated in diabetic renal, retinal, and neural complications. Because the glycation reaction is accelerated by hyperglycemia and oxidative stress, poor glycemic control exacerbates AGE burden. AGE inhibitors such as aminoguanidine were shown to prevent diabetic complications by inhibiting AGE formation, supporting the causal role of glycation in diabetic pathology.
description_zh_TW: Advanced glycation end products 在 diabetes 期間堆積於組織與器官，並促成 diabetic complications 的 pathogenesis。Diabetic patients 中 AGE formation 與 accumulation 導致 vascular alterations，引發 diabetic vasculopathy，而 glycation 涉及 diabetic renal、retinal 與 neural complications。由於 glycation reaction 受 hyperglycemia 與 oxidative stress 加速，poor glycemic control 會加劇 AGE burden。Aminoguanidine 等 AGE inhibitors 已被證實能透過抑制 AGE formation 來預防 diabetic complications，支持了 glycation 在 diabetic pathology 中的因果角色。

label: Histamine Intolerance
description: Aminoguanidine is a strong inhibitor of diamine oxidase (DAO), the enzyme that breaks down histamine in the gut. By blocking intestinal DAO, oral aminoguanidine can dramatically increase sensitivity to dietary histamine, potentially triggering severe acute histamine intolerance; consuming normal amounts of histamine-rich foods - aged cheeses, cured meats, fermented foods - may cause headaches, flushing, hives, and tachycardia. This is a major safety consideration for oral aminoguanidine use in supplement or experimental settings.
description_zh_TW: 氨基胍是一種強大的二胺氧化酶 (DAO) 抑制劑，該酶在腸道中分解組胺。通過阻斷腸道 DAO，口服氨基胍可顯著增加對膳食組胺的敏感度，可能觸發嚴重的急性組胺不耐受症；食用正常量的富含組胺食物（如陳酪、 cured meats、發酵食品）可能導致頭痛、潮紅、蕁麻疹和心悸。這對於口服氨基胍在補充劑或實驗設定中使用來說是一個主要安全考量。

label: Hydrazines
description: Aminoguanidine is the principal nitrogen-nitrogen bond derivative used for adrenochrome stabilization. Membership marks the hydrazine pharmacophore.
description_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine 是用於 adrenochrome 穩定的主要氮氮鍵衍生物。成員關係標記肼藥效團。

label: Prodrug
description: Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine (AMM) may act as a Prodrug: although its hydrazine group is locked in a Guanylhydrazone bond and thus non-nucleophilic, the conjugate is stable enough for clinical use while remaining plausibly hydrolysable in vivo to release free Aminoguanidine slowly. That would make AMM a controlled-release form whose anti-glycation activity is indirect. Whether this prodrug model holds is unresolved; the alternatives are retained nucleophilicity through the remaining guanidine nitrogens or chelation of the transition metals that catalyze glycoxidation.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine（AMM）可能作為 Prodrug 發揮作用：雖然其 hydrazine 官能基被鎖在 Guanylhydrazone 鍵中而缺乏親核性，該共軛物仍穩定到足以供臨床使用，卻又可能於體內緩慢水解釋出游離的 Aminoguanidine。這將使 AMM 成為間接發揮抗糖化活性的控釋形式。此 prodrug 模型是否成立尚未定論；其他可能性是由殘餘 guanidine 氮保留親核性，或螯合催化 glycoxidation 的過渡金屬。

label: Hydrazine
description: Adrenochrome is very unstable because of its o-quinone, so it is conventionally stabilized by derivatization with hydrazine compounds such as Aminoguanidine, Semicarbazide, phenylhydrazine, o-nitrophenylhydrazine, p-nitrophenylhydrazine and 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine. The resulting stable adducts include Carbazochrome and Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine, the hemostatic drugs of the adrenochrome family.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 因具 o-quinone 而非常不穩定，因此傳統上以 hydrazine 類化合物（如 Aminoguanidine、Semicarbazide、phenylhydrazine、o-nitrophenylhydrazine、p-nitrophenylhydrazine 與 2,4-dinitrophenylhydrazine）進行衍生化以穩定之。所得的穩定加合物包括 Carbazochrome 與 Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine，即 adrenochrome 系列的止血藥。

label: ALKBH5
description: ALKBH5 is one of the erasers that remove m6A Modification from RNA, acting as a Fe(II)- and 2-oxoglutarate-dependent dioxygenase, together with FTO. By demethylating autophagy transcripts such as ULK1, Beclin1 and TFEB mRNA, ALKBH5 raises their stability and translation and therefore increases autophagy output.
description_zh_TW: ALKBH5 是移除 m6A Modification 的 eraser 之一，與 FTO 一同作為依賴 Fe(II) 與 2-酮戊二酸的雙加氧酶作用。它藉由對 ULK1、Beclin1 與 TFEB mRNA 等自噬轉錄本去甲基化，提高其穩定性與轉譯，因而提升自噬產出。

label: Inflammatory Pain
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Honokiol attenuates inflammatory pain, reducing formalin-induced paw-licking behavior in the inflammatory phase and thermal hyperalgesia in mice. It blocks nociceptive signaling evoked by NMDA, glutamate, substance P, and prostaglandin E2 (PGE2), and decreases formalin-induced c-Fos protein expression in superficial laminae (I-II) of the L4-L5 lumbar dorsal horn. Compared with magnolol, honokiol is more selective for NMDA-induced behavioral responses and hyperalgesia. Its analgesic effects are multifactorial, involving both the inflammatory cascade and glutamatergic/NMDA receptor pathways.
description_zh_TW: 厚朴酚可減輕發炎性疼痛，降低福馬林誘發之發炎期的舔足行為及小鼠的熱痛覺過敏。它能阻斷由 NMDA、麩胺酸、P 物質及前列腺素 E2（PGE2）引發的傷害性訊號傳遞，並降低福馬林誘發的 c-Fos 蛋白在 L4-L5 腰薦背角淺層（I-II 層）的表現。與和厚朴酚相比，厚朴酚對 NMDA 誘發的行為反應與痛覺過敏更具選擇性。其鎮痛作用是多重因素共同造成的，同時涉及發炎級聯反應及麩胺酸能/NMDA 受體路徑。

label: Frontotemporal Dementia
description: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis and frontotemporal dementia form a disease spectrum rather than fully separate disorders, since they share a common genetic basis and protein pathology. ALS is primarily a motor neuron disease, but the C9orf72 hexanucleotide repeat expansion and TDP-43 pathology that cause familial ALS are also the most common hereditary causes of FTD, producing overlapping FTD-ALS syndromes. Thus ALS can give rise to frontotemporal dementia when the neurodegenerative process extends into the frontal and temporal lobes.
description_zh_TW: 肌萎縮側索硬化症和額顳葉失智症形成了一個疾病譜，而不是完全獨立的疾病，因為它們具有共同的遺傳基礎和蛋白質病理學。 ALS 主要是一種運動神經元疾病，但導致家族性 ALS 的 C9orf72 六核苷酸重複擴增和 TDP-43 病理也是 FTD 最常見的遺傳原因，產生重疊的 FTD-ALS 綜合徵。因此，當神經退化過程延伸到額葉和顳葉時，ALS 可能會導致額顳葉失智症。

label: Retinal Pigment Epithelium
description: The retinal pigment epithelium is a target for cell therapy using iPSC-derived RPE, which is being tested in clinical trials for age-related macular degeneration and Stargardt disease. iPSC-derived RPE cells are transplanted subretinally to replace dysfunctional RPE, restoring phagocytosis of photoreceptor outer segments, the visual cycle, and the blood-retina barrier. Key release criteria for such grafts include polarized monolayer formation, phagocytic competence, and RPE65 expression, though immune rejection and graft integration remain challenges.
description_zh_TW: 視網膜色素上皮是使用 iPSC 衍生的 RPE 進行細胞治療的目標，該細胞療法正在針對老年黃斑部病變和 Stargardt 病的臨床試驗中進行測試。 iPSC 衍生的 RPE 細胞被移植到視網膜下以取代功能失調的 RPE，恢復感光器外節的吞噬作用、視覺週期和血液視網膜屏障。此類移植物的關鍵釋放標準包括極化單層形成、吞噬能力和 RPE65 表達，儘管免疫排斥和移植物整合仍然是挑戰。

label: Lipofuscin
description: Autophagy is the within-lifetime quality control that partially substitutes for turnover. By clearing damaged organelles, aggregates, and misfolded proteins it limits the build-up of lipofuscin and other aging junk inside long-lived cells. When turnover drops, that quality control is no longer backed by cell replacement and the junk simply piles up.
description_zh_TW: 自噬是單一細胞生命期內的品質管制，可部分替代細胞更新。它藉由清除受損胞器、聚集物與錯誤折疊蛋白，限制長壽命細胞內脂褐素等老化垃圾的堆積。當更新率下降時，這套品質管制便失去了細胞汰換的支援，垃圾便開始堆積。

label: BRG1
description: BRG1 is the catalytic ATPase subunit of the mammalian SWI/SNF (BAF) remodeling complexes, providing the energy that slides and evicts nucleosomes. The related BRM ATPase can substitute in specific complex variants, so BRG1 supplies the hydrolysis step that lets SWI-SNF reshape chromatin and expose regulatory DNA.
description_zh_TW: BRG1 是哺乳類 SWI/SNF（BAF）重塑複合體的催化 ATPase 次單元，提供滑動與驅逐核小體所需的能量。相關的 BRM ATPase 可在特定複合體變體中取代其角色，因此 BRG1 提供了讓 SWI-SNF 重塑染色質、暴露調控性 DNA 的水解步驟。

label: Alpha Diversity
description: Alpha Diversity measures the richness and evenness of species within a single community or sample, describing the internal diversity of the Gut Microbiome. It is the within-sample complement of Beta Diversity, which compares turnover between communities.
description_zh_TW: Alpha Diversity 衡量單一群落或樣本內物種的豐富度與均勻度，用來描述 Gut Microbiome 的內部多樣性。它是樣本內的度量，與比較群落間更替的 Beta Diversity 互補。

label: Disease-Associated Microglia
description: Disease-Associated Microglia (DAM) denotes a stereotyped transcriptional and functional microglial activation state that emerges in Neurodegenerative Disease and Neuroinflammation. DAM microglia show altered expression of homeostatic markers and engage phagocytic and lipid-metabolism programmes, representing the brain's attempt to contain proteotoxic burden; the signature is regulated by cues such as TREM2.
description_zh_TW: Disease-Associated Microglia（DAM）指在 Neurodegenerative Disease 與 Neuroinflammation 中出現的一種刻板化轉錄與功能性的微膠細胞活化狀態。DAM 微膠細胞的穩態標記表現改變，並啟動吞噬與脂質代謝程式，代表腦部試圖圍堵蛋白毒性負荷；其特徵受 TREM2 等訊號調控。

label: Micronuclei
description: Micronuclei are aberrant nuclear bodies that arise when chromosomes fail to segregate during mitosis and become enclosed in their own nuclear envelope — a visible manifestation of genomic instability. Because their envelope is often defective, micronuclei rupture and expose dsDNA to the cytoplasm, where cGAS localises to sense the DNA.
description_zh_TW: Micronuclei 是有絲分裂時染色體分離失敗並被獨立核膜包覆所形成的異常核體，是 genomic instability 的可見表現。由於其核膜常有缺陷，micronuclei 會破裂並將雙股 DNA 暴露於細胞質，使 cGAS 定位其中感知 DNA。

label: Spliceosome
description: Noncanonical nuclear cGAS recruits the spliceosome through its intrinsically disordered region, which mediates liquid-liquid phase separation with chromatin and RNA-processing machinery. Because cGAS binds spliceosome components directly, phase-separated cGAS condensates concentrate splicing factors and can influence alternative splicing decisions independently of canonical cGAS-STING Pathway interferon output.
description_zh_TW: 非典型核內 cGAS 透過其 intrinsically disordered region 招募 spliceosome，該區域藉由與染色質及 RNA 加工機器的 liquid-liquid phase separation 達成此作用。由於 cGAS 直接結合 spliceosome 組分，相分離形成的 cGAS 凝聚體可濃縮剪接因子並影響 alternative splicing 決定，且獨立於典型 cGAS-STING Pathway 的干擾素輸出。

label: EMT6
description: EMT6 serves as a model for Radiation Therapy research: it is a cloned BALB/c-derived mouse mammary tumor cell line used as monolayer cultures in vitro and as intradermal solid tumors in BALB/cRw mice in vivo, and it has been extensively characterized for radiation responses. In that model fenbendazole failed to sensitize tumors to radiation, altering neither tumor growth, radiation response nor metastatic pattern, which is why EMT6 is cited as a negative-result model in fenbendazole reviews.
description_zh_TW: EMT6 是 Radiation Therapy（放射治療）研究的模型：它是源自 BALB/c 小鼠的乳癌細胞株，體外以單層培養、體內以 BALB/cRw 小鼠皮內實體腫瘤兩種形式使用，並已被廣泛用於放射反應的表徵。在該模型中 fenbendazole 未能使腫瘤對輻射增敏，既未改變腫瘤生長、放射反應，也未改變轉移模式，因此 EMT6 在 fenbendazole 的文獻回顧中被引用為陰性結果模型。

label: Radiation Therapy
description: Despite structural resemblance to known radiosensitizers, fenbendazole did not alter the radiation dose-response curves of aerobic or hypoxic EMT6 cells, did not radiosensitize EMT6 tumors in vivo, and did not increase the number of lung metastases. It also failed to interact with docetaxel, producing strictly additive rather than synergistic toxicity.
description_zh_TW: 雖然結構類似已知 radiosensitizer，Fenbendazole 並未改變有氧或缺氧 EMT6 細胞的輻射劑量反應曲線，在體內也未使 EMT6 腫瘤增敏，且未增加肺轉移數目。它與 docetaxel 亦無交互作用，毒性僅為相加而非協同。

label: Cyclin B
description: Cyclin B is the G2/M cyclin whose binding activates CDK1, forming the Cyclin B-CDK1 (formerly MPF) complex that phosphorylates substrates required for nuclear envelope breakdown, chromosome condensation, and spindle assembly. Its abrupt APC/C-mediated destruction at anaphase enforces the G2/M checkpoint.
description_zh_TW: Cyclin B 是 G2/M cyclin，其結合可活化 CDK1，形成 Cyclin B-CDK1（舊稱 MPF）複合體，磷酸化核膜崩解、染色質濃縮與紡錘體組裝所需的受質。Cyclin B 在後期被 APC/C 迅速降解，使 G2/M 檢查點得以維持。

label: ASF1a
description: ASF1a is a core member of the HIRA chaperone complex required for formation of senescence-associated heterochromatin foci (SAHF). By delivering newly synthesized H3–H4 dimers to HIRA/UBN1, ASF1a supports the heterochromatic compaction that accompanies permanent growth arrest.
description_zh_TW: ASF1a 是形成衰老相關異染色質焦點（SAHF）所需之 HIRA 伴護蛋白複合體的核心成員。透過將新合成的 H3–H4 二聚體交給 HIRA/UBN1，ASF1a 支持伴隨永久生長停滯的異染色質壓縮。

label: H2A.X
description: DNA-SCARS are persistent nuclear foci of unresolved DNA damage that are enriched in phosphorylated gamma-H2A.X (H2A.X). They sustain the DNA-damage response that maintains senescence growth arrest and promotes SASP cytokine secretion.
description_zh_TW: DNA-SCARS 是未解決 DNA 損傷的持久性核焦點，富含磷酸化的 γ-H2A.X（H2A.X）。它們維持維持衰老生長停滯並促進 SASP 細胞激素分泌的 DNA 損傷反應。

label: UBN1
description: UBN1 is a dedicated subunit of the HIRA complex required for formation of senescence-associated heterochromatin foci (SAHF). It confers specificity to the HIRA complex for H3.3 deposition during senescence.
description_zh_TW: UBN1 是 HIRA 複合體的專屬亞基，為形成衰老相關異染色質焦點（SAHF）所需。它賦予 HIRA 複合體在衰老期間沉積 H3.3 的特異性。

label: Tazemetostat
description: Tazemetostat (EPZ-6438; trade name Tazverik) is a first-in-class, orally bioavailable, selective SAM-competitive inhibitor that binds the catalytic SET domain of EZH2, the enzymatic subunit of Polycomb Repressive Complex 2 (PRC2). It is approved by the FDA in 2020 for epithelioid sarcoma and EZH2-mutant follicular lymphoma.
description_zh_TW: Tazemetostat（EPZ-6438；商品名 Tazverik）是同類首創、口服生物可利用的選擇性 SAM 競爭性抑制劑，結合 Polycomb Repressive Complex 2 (PRC2) 的酵素次單元 EZH2 的催化 SET 結構域。它於 2020 年獲 FDA 核准用於上皮樣肉瘤與 EZH2 突變型濾泡性淋巴瘤。

label: Hepatocyte
description: Mature quiescent hepatocytes are the dominant regenerative source after hepatectomy.
description_zh_TW: 成熟靜止肝細胞是肝切除後的主要再生來源。

label: Farber disease
description: Farber disease is a rare autosomal recessive lysosomal storage disorder caused by loss-of-function mutations in ASAH1, leaving less than 5% residual acid ceramidase activity.
