Ceramide then accumulates in lysosomes of macrophages, joints, skin and CNS, producing the classic triad of painful joint deformities, subcutaneous lipomatous nodules and vocal hoarseness; severity inversely correlates with residual enzyme activity.
description_zh_TW: Farber disease 是一種罕見的體染色體隱性溶小體儲積症，由 ASAH1 的功能喪失突變造成，使 acid ceramidase 殘餘活性低於 5%。因此 ceramide 在巨噬細胞、關節、皮膚與中樞神經的溶小體中累積，形成疼痛性關節變形、皮下脂肪瘤樣結節與聲音嘶啞的典型三聯徵；嚴重度與殘餘酵素活性成反比。

label: Lands cycle
description: The Lands cycle (deacylation-reacylation cycle) is a phospholipid remodeling pathway in which free fatty acids are exchanged into the sn-2 position of membrane Phospholipid, thereby changing the fatty acid composition of the membrane pool.
description_zh_TW: Lands cycle（去醯化—再醯化循環）是一條磷脂重塑路徑，將游離脂肪酸交換進膜上 Phospholipid 的 sn-2 位置，藉此改變膜脂池的脂肪酸組成。

label: Phospholipid
description: The Lands cycle (deacylation-reacylation cycle) is a phospholipid remodeling pathway in which free fatty acids are exchanged into the sn-2 position of membrane Phospholipid, thereby changing the fatty acid composition of the membrane pool.
description_zh_TW: Lands cycle（去醯化—再醯化循環）是一條磷脂重塑路徑，將游離脂肪酸交換進膜上 Phospholipid 的 sn-2 位置，藉此改變膜脂池的脂肪酸組成。

label: Sphingolipid Metabolism
description: Sphingolipid metabolism acts upstream of ferroptosis: the ceramide ↔ sphingosine/S1P rheostat sets cell fate, and free fatty acids released by acid ceramidase feed phospholipid PUFA enrichment (Lands cycle), creating a pro-ferroptotic lipid profile.
description_zh_TW: Sphingolipid metabolism 作用於 ferroptosis 的上游：ceramide ↔ sphingosine/S1P 的調節平衡決定細胞命運，而 acid ceramidase 釋出的游離脂肪酸會餵入 phospholipid 的 PUFA  enrich（Lands cycle），形成促 ferroptosis 的脂質組型。

label: Saposin-D
description: Saposin-D (SapD) is a small lysosomal saposin that extracts ceramide from the lysosomal membrane and presents it to the active site of acid ceramidase. In its open V-shaped conformation SapD binds and solubilizes the membrane ceramide, solving the substrate-access problem that the crystal structure of acid ceramidase revealed as a hydrophobic membrane-attachment surface around the substrate channel.
description_zh_TW: Saposin-D（SapD）是溶酶體中的小型 saposin，能自溶酶體膜萃取 ceramide 並呈現給 acid ceramidase 的活性位點。在其開放的 V 形構形下，SapD 會結合並溶解膜上的 ceramide，解決 acid ceramidase 晶體結構所揭示的受質可及性問題——其受質通道周圍具有疏水性的膜附著表面。

label: Spinal muscular atrophy with progressive myoclonic epilepsy
description: Spinal muscular atrophy with progressive myoclonic epilepsy is caused by hypomorphic mutations in ASAH1 that retain roughly 5–30% residual Acid ceramidase activity. Because the gene retains substantial function, the disorder is milder than the null phenotype; the recurrent c.125C>T (p.Thr42Met) hotspot is a recognized mutation in ASAH1.
description_zh_TW: Spinal muscular atrophy with progressive myoclonic epilepsy 由 ASAH1 的低效突變引起，該突變仍保留約 5–30% 的殘餘 Acid ceramidase 活性。由於此基因保有相當功能，此疾病較同基因 null 表型溫和；反覆出現的 c.125C>T (p.Thr42Met) 熱點突變是 ASAH1 的已知突變。

label: iFSP1
description: Because many therapy-resistant cancers rely on FSP1 for ferroptosis resistance, iFSP1 is being explored to sensitize tumors (e.g., hepatocellular carcinoma) to ferroptosis-based therapy, often in combination with GPX4 or system Xc- inhibitors rather than as monotherapy, reflecting the two-pillar ferroptosis-defense model.
description_zh_TW: 由於許多治療抗性腫瘤依賴 FSP1 來抵抗鐵死亡，iFSP1 被探索用於使腫瘤（例如肝細胞癌）對鐵死亡療法增敏，通常與 GPX4 或 system Xc- 抑制劑合併使用而非單藥，這反映鐵死亡的雙支柱防禦模型。

label: Ifosfamide-induced Encephalopathy
description: Methylene blue is widely used off-label for the treatment of ifosfamide-induced encephalopathy, the neurotoxicity associated with ifosfamide administration. For this indication, methylene blue is typically administered intravenously at a dosage of 50 mg every 4 hours until symptom resolution. This regimen is supported by case series and institutional experience, though dosing is individualized based on clinical response, with symptom resolution often occurring within 10 minutes to 24 hours.
description_zh_TW: 亞甲基藍廣泛用於治療異環磷醯胺誘導的腦病變，即與異環磷醯胺給藥相關的神經毒性。對於此適應症，亞甲基藍通常以 50 mg 劑量靜脈注射，每 4 小時一次，直至症狀緩解。此方案由案例系列和機構經驗支持，但劑量根據臨床反應個體化，症狀緩解通常在 10 分鐘至 24 小時內發生。

label: Long COVID
description: Long COVID (post-acute sequelae of SARS-CoV-2 infection) is a chronic multisystem condition with persistent fatigue, cognitive disturbance, dyspnoea and autonomic dysfunction. Mitochondrial and energy-metabolism impairment is among the leading hypothesised mechanisms, which is why some clinicians trial Methylene blue for mitochondrial support.
description_zh_TW: Long COVID（SARS-CoV-2 感染後的後續症狀）是慢性的多系統疾病，表現為持續疲勞、認知障礙、呼吸困難與自主神經功能異常。粒線體與能量代謝障礙是最主要的假說機制之一，因此部分臨床醫師嘗試以 Methylene blue 作為粒線體支持。

label: CK2
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Casein kinase 2 (CK2) normally restrains NF-κB activation. CK2 phosphorylates the NF-κB inhibitor IκBα (e.g. Ser283), protecting it from stimulus-induced degradation, and also primes IKK and supports NEMO function, so that total CK2 activity sets the threshold for inflammatory transcription.
description_zh_TW: 酪蛋白激酶 2 (CK2) 平常會抑制 NF-κB 的活化。CK2 會磷酸化 NF-κB 抑制蛋白 IκBα（例如 Ser283），保護它不被刺激誘導的降解；同時也活化 IKK 並支持 NEMO 功能，因此 CK2 的總活性決定了發炎轉錄的起始門檻。

label: Endoplasmic Reticulum Stress
description: Endoplasmic Reticulum Stress and Proteostasis are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Endoplasmic Reticulum Stress and Proteostasis may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Endoplasmic Reticulum Stress 和 Proteostasis 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Endoplasmic Reticulum Stress 和 Proteostasis 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Enhancer-Promoter Looping
description: Enhancer-promoter looping is regulated within topologically associating domains, the megabase-scale compartments in which DNA sequences interact more frequently with each other than with sequences outside. Because TADs confine enhancer-promoter contacts, genes are typically regulated by enhancers located within the same domain, and three-dimensional looping brings these regulatory elements into proximity with their target promoters. This organization allows the SASP to be driven by hyper-connected enhancer-promoter networks whose interactions are restructured during senescence.
description_zh_TW: 增強子-啟動子環在拓撲關聯域（兆鹼基級的區室）內受到調節，其中DNA序列彼此之間的相互作用比與外部序列之間的相互作用更頻繁。由於 TAD 限制了增強子-啟動子接觸，因此基因通常受到位於同一結構域內的增強子的調節，並且三維環使這些調節元件與其目標啟動子接近。這種組織允許 SASP 由超連接的增強子-啟動子網路驅動，其相互作用在老化過程中被重組。

label: Scramblase
description: Elevated cytosolic calcium is the activating signal for scramblases: Ca2+ flips the membrane asymmetry balance — scramblase on, flippase off — and the activation is ATP-independent and bidirectional. Thus calcium signaling is the upstream trigger that scramblase translates into the eat-me signal read out by Annexin V.
description_zh_TW: 細胞質鈣濃度升高是 scramblase 的活化訊號：Ca2+ 會翻轉膜不對稱性的平衡——scramblase 開啟、flippase 關閉——且此活化不依賴 ATP 且為雙向性。因此 calcium signaling 是上游觸發因子，而 scramblase 將其轉譯為由 Annexin V 讀出的 eat-me 訊號。

label: Drosha
description: The Microprocessor is the nuclear ribonucleoprotein complex that initiates canonical microRNA biogenesis. One Drosha molecule associates with two DGCR8 molecules, DGCR8 recognizing the pri-miRNA hairpin junction as a molecular ruler and positioning Drosha's RNase III catalytic centre ~11 bp from the basal junction so Drosha makes a staggered cut yielding a 2-nt 3' overhang.
description_zh_TW: Microprocessor 是啟動典型 microRNA 生合成的核內核糖核蛋白複合體。一個 Drosha 分子與兩個 DGCR8 分子結合，DGCR8 以「分子尺」方式辨識 pri-miRNA 髮夾接合處，將 Drosha 的 RNase III 催化中心定位於距離基底接合處約 11 bp，使 Drosha 進行交錯切割並產生 2-nt 的 3' 突出端。

label: Chemical memory
description: Chemical memory and Synaptic plasticity are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Chemical memory and Synaptic plasticity may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Chemical memory 和 Synaptic plasticity 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Chemical memory 和 Synaptic plasticity 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Biomarker
description: Ki-67 is the standard immunohistochemical proliferation biomarker.
description_zh_TW: Ki-67 是標準的免疫組織化學增殖生物標記。

label: BCA3
description: BCA3 was originally discovered as a cytosolic binding partner of protein kinase A. It interacts with the catalytic subunit of PKA, facilitating PKA nuclear translocation and its activity toward substrates such as CREB, while the same protein shuttles between cytoplasm and nucleus to modulate inflammatory signalling and cell death in neoplastic tissue.
description_zh_TW: BCA3 最初是作為 protein kinase A 的細胞質結合伴護蛋白而被發現。它與 PKA 的催化次單元交互作用，促進 PKA 的核轉位及其對 CREB 等受質的活性；同時此蛋白在細胞質與細胞核之間穿梭，在腫瘤組織中調節發炎訊號與細胞死亡。

label: CHD4
description: CHD4 is the essential ATPase remodeling subunit of NuRD. Containment records the complex composition.
description_zh_TW: CHD4 是 NuRD 必要的 ATPase 重塑次單元。包含記錄複合體組成。

label: Hypobromous Acid
description: Eosinophil Peroxidase is the phagocyte enzyme that generates Hypobromous Acid: a cationic heme peroxidase of eosinophil specific granules that uses bromide together with Hydrogen Peroxide as co-substrate to oxidize halides into reactive brominating oxidants. The HOBr it produces brominates protein tyrosine residues, yielding bromotyrosine adducts that serve as specific markers of eosinophil-mediated oxidant damage in allergic airway disease.
description_zh_TW: Eosinophil Peroxidase 是產生 Hypobromous Acid 的吞噬細胞酵素：它是嗜酸性球特異顆粒中的陽離性含血基質過氧化酵素，以 bromide 與 Hydrogen Peroxide 為共同受質，將鹵離子氧化成具反應性的溴化氧化劑。其產生的 HOBr 會溴化蛋白質的 tyrosine 殘基，形成 bromotyrosine 加合物，可作為過敏性氣道疾病中嗜酸性球介導氧化損傷的特異性標記。

label: FSCV
description: Fast-scan cyclic voltammetry (FSCV) is an electrochemical technique that measures rapid, real-time changes in neurotransmitter concentration in living brain tissue. Using a carbon-fiber microelectrode and a fast triangular voltage ramp (typically 400 V/s, −0.4 to +1.3 V), FSCV oxidizes dopamine at a characteristic potential to produce a Faradaic current proportional to its concentration, resolving sub-second dopamine release in awake, behaving rodents.
description_zh_TW: 快掃描循環伏安法（FSCV）是一項電化學技術，可在活體腦組織中量測神經傳遞物質濃度的快速即時變化。FSCV 使用碳纖維微電極與快速的三角電壓掃描（典型為 400 V/s，−0.4 至 +1.3 V），在特征電位氧化 dopamine，產生與其濃度成正比的法拉第電流，可解析清醒行為大鼠中次秒級的 dopamine 釋放。

label: Multidrug Resistance
description: Multidrug Resistance is mediated by P-gp. Multidrug resistance is the cross-resistance of tumors to structurally unrelated drugs, most classically mediated by ATP-dependent efflux pumps. P-glycoprotein (ABCB1) is an ATP-binding-cassette efflux pump that expels cytotoxic drugs from cells and is a major mediator of multidrug resistance. The directionality runs from P-gp toward Multidrug Resistance, so P-gp is the active agent and Multidrug Resistance the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Multidrug Resistance是由P-gp介導的。 Multidrug Resistance是腫瘤對結構上不相關的藥物的交叉抗藥性，最經典的是由ATP依賴性外排泵介導的。 P-糖蛋白（ABCB1）是一種ATP結合盒外排泵，可將細胞毒性藥物從細胞中排出，是Multidrug Resistance的主要介質。方向性從 P-gp 朝向 Multidrug Resistance，因此 P-gp 是活性劑，Multidrug Resistance是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: PtdIns(3,5)P2
description: PIKfyve is a phosphoinositide kinase that converts phosphatidylinositol 3-phosphate (PI3P) into phosphatidylinositol 3,5-bisphosphate (PI(3,5)P2) on endolysosomal membranes. PI(3,5)P2 serves as a crucial lipid messenger that regulates membrane trafficking, vacuole homeostasis, and the activity of the lysosomal channel TRPML1. By generating PI(3,5)P2, PIKfyve controls lysosomal morphology and the calcium release that activates calcineurin-TFEB signaling. Its inhibition causes massive lysosomal vacuolation, underscoring its centrality to lysosomal function.
description_zh_TW: PIKfyve 是一種磷酸肌醇激酶，在內溶酶體膜上將磷脂醯肌醇 3-磷酸（PI3P）轉化為磷脂醯肌醇 3,5-二磷酸（PI(3,5)P2）。PI(3,5)P2 作為一種關鍵的脂質信使，調節膜運輸、液泡恆定性，以及溶酶體通道 TRPML1 的活性。透過生成 PI(3,5)P2，PIKfyve 控制溶酶體形態以及活化 calcineurin-TFEB 信號的鈣釋放。其抑制會導致大規模溶酶體液泡化，凸顯其對溶酶體功能的核心地位。

label: GATA4
description: NF-kB is activated by GATA4, which promotes the pro-inflammatory SASP via TRAF3IP2 (Act1) and by inhibiting autophagy that would otherwise limit damage signals. GATA4 accumulation in senescent cells makes it a specific upstream driver of NF-kB in the arrested state, coupling defective organelle turnover to inflammatory transcription. Unlike DNA-damage-induced activation, this route is selective for the senescence program. The GATA4-NF-kB link is a senescence-selective regulatory pathway that reinforces the inflammatory secretome.
description_zh_TW: NF-κB 被 GATA4 活化，GATA4 透過 TRAF3IP2（Act1）並抑制本可限制損傷訊號的自噬，促進促發炎性 SASP。GATA4 在衰老細胞中的累積使其成為停滯狀態中 NF-κB 的特異上游驅動者，將缺陷胞器更新耦合到發炎轉錄。不同於 DNA 損傷誘發的活化，此途徑對衰老程序具選擇性。GATA4-NF-κB 連結是衰老選擇性的調節路徑，強化發炎性分泌組。

label: Lysosomal Biogenesis
description: TFEB, together with TFE3 and MITF, binds CLEAR-box motifs in the promoters of lysosomal genes and is the master transcriptional regulator of lysosomal biogenesis; mTORC1 phosphorylates TFEB at S211 to retain it in the cytosol, while starvation triggers calcineurin-mediated dephosphorylation and nuclear translocation.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 與 TFE3、MITF 共同結合溶小體基因啟動子上的 CLEAR-box motif，是溶小體生成的主轉錄調控因子；mTORC1 在 S211 位點磷酸化 TFEB 使其滯留於細胞質，而飢餓則引發 calcineurin 媒介的去磷酸化與核轉位。

label: Melanins
description: Melanins arise from polymerization of the pigment intermediates dopaquinone and its downstream dopachrome and 5,6-dihydroxyindole species, which couple spontaneously to form the brown-black polymers. The same quinone-driven polymerization underlies neuromelanin deposition and adrenochrome conversion to melanin-like products, linking all three pigment routes through shared electrophilic catechol-quinone chemistry.
description_zh_TW: Melanins 由色素中間體 dopaquinone 及其下游的 dopachrome 與 5,6-dihydroxyindole 物種聚合而成，這些物種會自發偶聯形成棕黑色聚合物。同樣的醌類驅動聚合機轉 underlie 神經黑素的沉積與 adrenochrome 轉為類黑色素產物，將三條色素途徑以共享的親電性兒茶酚—醌化學連結起來。

label: TREX1
description: TREX1's C-terminal transmembrane domain anchors it to the endoplasmic reticulum (ER) membrane, where it co-localizes with cGAS and STING. The ER-targeting C-terminal domain is essential for TREX1 function in vivo, as forced cytoplasmic mislocalization impairs its ability to prevent innate immune activation. TREX1 forms homodimers via a hydrophobic interface, with back-to-back active sites enabling processive degradation of cytosolic DNA.
description_zh_TW: TREX1 的 C 端穿膜結構域將其錨定在內質網（ER）膜上，並在該處與 cGAS 及 STING 共定位。ER 定位的 C 端結構域對 TREX1 的體內功能至關重要，因為強迫其錯位至細胞質會損害其抑制先天免疫活化的能力。TREX1 透過疏水介面形成同源二聚體，其背靠背的活性位點可進行細胞質 DNA 的持續性降解。

label: Wnt-beta-catenin
description: Canonical Wnt/β-catenin signaling stabilizes β-catenin: Wnt ligand binding Frizzled/LRP receptors inhibits the β-catenin destruction complex, allowing β-catenin to accumulate and translocate to the nucleus, where TCF/LEF transcription factors turn it into a transcriptional activator. This stabilization sustains stemness, proliferation, and fate decisions in the responding cells.
description_zh_TW: 典型 Wnt/β-catenin 訊號可穩定 β-catenin：Wnt 配體結合 Frizzled/LRP 受體後抑制 β-catenin 破壞複合體，使 β-catenin 得以累積並轉位進入細胞核，由 TCF/LEF 轉錄因子將其轉化為轉錄活化因子。這種穩定化維持了受應細胞的幹性、增殖與命運決定。

label: Th2
description: Type 2 helper T cells (Th2) are a specialized subset of CD4+ T Cells that orchestrate humoral immunity, anti-helminth defense, and allergic inflammatory responses. Th2 cells are defined by their signature production of IL-4, IL-5, and IL-13, which collectively drive IgE production, eosinophil recruitment, and mucus hypersecretion.
description_zh_TW: 第二型輔助型 T 細胞 (Th2) 是 CD4+ T Cells 的一個特化亞群，負責協調體液免疫、抗蠕蟲防禦與過敏性發炎反應。Th2 細胞的定義特徵是產生 IL-4、IL-5 與 IL-13，這些細胞激素共同驅動 IgE 生成、嗜酸性球募集與黏液分泌過多。

label: Gastrulation
description: Gastrulation is the central germ-layer event included in embryonic development. Inclusion nests the phase in the program.
description_zh_TW: 原腸形成是包含於胚胎發育的中央胚層事件。包含將階段嵌套於程序。

label: Nanoemulsions
description: Fisetin-SNEDDS nanoemulsions showed neuroprotection in rotenone-induced Parkinson's Disease rats, reducing TNFα and IL-6 while raising Glutathione, Superoxide Dismutase and Catalase. By delivering the poorly soluble fisetin efficiently, the nanoemulsion converts an oral antioxidant into a bioavailable neuroprotective agent that restores antioxidant capacity in the injured brain.
description_zh_TW: Fisetin-SNEDDS nanoemulsions 在 rotenone 誘發的 Parkinson's Disease 大鼠中展現神經保護，降低 TNFα 與 IL-6，同時提升 Glutathione、Superoxide Dismutase 與 Catalase。藉由有效遞送難溶的 fisetin，nanoemulsion 把一種口服抗氧化劑轉化為具生體可用性的神經保護藥物，恢復受損腦部的抗氧化能力。

label: Sulfiredoxin
description: Sulfiredoxin (SRXN1) is an ATP-dependent repair enzyme that reverses the over-oxidation of typical 2-Cys peroxiredoxins, most notably peroxiredoxin 3 (PRDX3) in mitochondria. It reduces the sulfinic acid (Cys-SO2H) state back to the sulfenic/sulfhydryl state, recycling the peroxiredoxin and restoring peroxide-detoxifying capacity. Peroxiredoxin 3 (PRDX3) is reversibly inactivated when its peroxidatic cysteine is hyperoxidized to sulfinic acid during oxidative bursts. Sulfiredoxin (SRXN1) repairs this hyperoxidation in an ATP-dependent reaction, restoring PRDX3's peroxide-scavenging activity.
description_zh_TW: Sulfiredoxin（SRXN1）是 ATP 依賴的修復酵素，可逆轉典型 2-Cys 過氧化還原酶（尤其是粒線體中的過氧化還原酶 3，PRDX3）的過度氧化。它將亞磺酸（Cys-SO2H）狀態還原回亞磺烯基/硫氫基狀態，回收過氧化還原酶並恢復過氧化物解毒能力。 在氧化爆發期間，過氧化還原酶 3（PRDX3）的過氧化半胱氨酸被過度氧化為亞磺酸時會可逆地失活。Sulfiredoxin（SRXN1）以 ATP 依賴的反應修復此過度氧化，恢復 PRDX3 的過氧化氫清除活性。

label: DNA Methyltransferase
description: Decitabine is a nucleoside analog that inhibits DNA methyltransferases and is used as an epigenetic therapy in hematologic malignancies. After incorporation into DNA during replication, decitabine covalently traps DNMT enzymes, depleting them and causing passive loss of DNA methylation on newly synthesized strands. This demethylation reactivates genes silenced by promoter hypermethylation, such as tumor suppressors, which underlies its clinical efficacy in myelodysplastic syndromes and acute myeloid leukemia.
description_zh_TW: Decitabine 是一種核苷類似物，可抑制 DNA 甲基轉移酶，用作血液惡性腫瘤的表觀遺傳療法。在複製過程中摻入 DNA 後，地西他濱共價捕獲 DNMT 酶，耗盡它們並導致新合成鏈上 DNA 甲基化的被動喪失。這種去甲基化重新激活了因啟動子高甲基化而沉默的基因，例如腫瘤抑制基因，這是其在骨髓增生異常綜合徵和急性髓系白血病中的臨床功效的基礎。

label: eIF5A
description: Translation Initiation involves eIF5A in addition to the eIF4F subunits. eIF5A undergoes hypusination, a post-translational modification dependent on spermidine, and the modified form supports peptide bond formation at difficult motifs; it is also implicated in TFEB regulation, linking polyamine metabolism to autophagy control.
description_zh_TW: Translation Initiation 除了 eIF4F 次單元外還涉及 eIF5A。eIF5A 會進行 hypusination（一種依賴 spermidine 的轉譯後修飾），修飾後的形式可在困難的序列基序處支援肽鍵形成；它也參與 TFEB 的調控，將多胺代謝連結至自噬調控。

label: PGAM5
description: Upstream of the necroptotic program, RIPK3 upregulates PGAM5, which enhances Cyclophilin D phosphorylation, prolongs mitochondrial permeability transition pore opening, and drives endothelial necroptosis in cardiac microvascular ischemia-reperfusion. This makes CypD-mPTP the mitochondrial execution arm of necroptosis, complementary to the MLKL plasma-membrane pore arm.
description_zh_TW: 在 necroptosis 計畫的上游，RIPK3 上調 PGAM5，後者促進 Cyclophilin D 磷酸化、延長 Mitochondrial Permeability Transition Pore 開啟時間，並在心肌微血管缺血再灌流中驅動內皮 necroptosis。這使 CypD-mPTP 成為 necroptosis 的粒線體執行臂，與 MLKL 質膜孔道臂互補。

label: Ifosfamide
description: Ifosfamide-induced encephalopathy — confusion, hallucination and coma — is attributed to its chloroacetaldehyde metabolite and is effectively reversed by intravenous methylene blue (50 mg every 4-6 h), which restores the mitochondrial electron transport that the toxic metabolite inhibits. Prophylactic dosing is used in high-risk patients.
description_zh_TW: Ifosfamide 引發的腦病變——意識混亂、幻覺與昏迷——歸因於其代謝物 chloroacetaldehyde，並可被靜脈注射 methylene blue（每 4–6 小時 50 mg）有效逆轉；methylene blue 可恢復被該毒性代謝物抑制的粒線體電子傳遞。高風險患者會使用預防性給藥。

label: Gut-Brain Axis
description: The gut-brain axis is a bidirectional communication network connecting the central nervous system with the gastrointestinal tract and its resident gut microbiome. The vagus nerve provides rapid afferent and efferent signaling, while microbial metabolites such as short-chain fatty acids, cytokines, and the hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis relay hormonal and immune information.
description_zh_TW: Gut-brain axis 是連結中樞神經系統與 gastrointestinal tract 及其 resident gut microbiome 的雙向通訊網絡。Vagus nerve 提供快速的 afferent 與 efferent 訊號，微生物代謝物（如 short-chain fatty acids）、cytokines 與 hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis 則傳遞荷爾蒙與免疫訊息。

label: SLC19A1
description: SLC19A1 amplifies the cGAS-STING Pathway in a paracrine manner by importing extracellular cGAMP, allowing STING activation signals to be transferred between cells. Expression of SLC19A1 may therefore predict response to STING agonists, since import is the rate-limiting step in signal spread.
description_zh_TW: SLC19A1 藉由攝入細胞外 cGAMP，以旁分泌方式放大 cGAS-STING Pathway，使 STING 活化訊號能在細胞之間傳遞。因此 SLC19A1 的表現可能預測對 STING 致效劑的反應，因為攝入是訊號擴散的限速步驟。

label: CD86
description: CTLA-4 (CD152) is an inhibitory receptor upregulated after T-cell activation that outcompetes CD28 for CD80/CD86 binding, delivering off-signals that terminate T-cell responses. Germline haploinsufficiency of CTLA-4 causes autoimmunity, and its higher surface affinity for the shared ligands is what makes blockade effective immunotherapy.
description_zh_TW: CTLA-4 (CD152) 是 T 細胞活化後上調的抑制性受體，會在 CD80/CD86 結合上與 CD28 競爭，傳遞終止 T 細胞反應的抑制訊號。CTLA-4 的胚單倍型不足會造成自體免疫，而它對共用配體較高的表面親和力，正是阻斷 CTLA-4 能成為有效免疫療法的關鍵。

label: Interferon-gamma
description: IDO1 transcription is strongly induced by the pro-inflammatory cytokine Interferon-gamma through the JAK/STAT1 pathway, with TNF-α, IL-1β, LPS and glucocorticoids able to synergize in certain cellular contexts. Because IFNγ is a hallmark of the antitumor immune response, IFNγ-driven IDO1 induction in tumors and tumor-draining lymph nodes helps suppress antitumor immunity.
description_zh_TW: IDO1 的轉錄會被發炎性細胞激素 Interferon-gamma 透過 JAK/STAT1 路徑強烈誘導，在某些細胞情境下 TNF-α、IL-1β、LPS 與類固醇可協同作用。由於 IFNγ 是抗腫瘤免疫反應的標誌，腫瘤與腫瘤引流淋巴結中由 IFNγ 驅動的 IDO1 誘導有助於壓抑抗腫瘤免疫。

label: Polo kinase 3
description: Polo kinase 3 phosphorylates the anti-apoptotic protein Bcl-xL at Ser49 during cell cycle progression and at checkpoint states, altering Bcl-xL's capacity to restrain Apoptosis and tipping damaged cells toward mitochondrial death. The site is distinct from the Ser62 targeted by PLK1, marking Plk3 as a stress-coupled rather than mitotic-execution kinase.
description_zh_TW: Polo kinase 3 在細胞週期推進與檢查點狀態下於 Ser49 磷酸化抗凋亡蛋白 Bcl-xL，改變 Bcl-xL 抑制 Apoptosis 的能力，使受損細胞倒向線粒體死亡。此位點與 PLK1 所標的的 Ser62 不同，標示出 Plk3 是與壓力偶聯的激酶，而非執行有絲分裂者。

label: Homer1
description: Homer1 serves as a marker of excitatory synapse maturity and of Synaptic plasticity more broadly, because its abundance tracks spine density and the capacity for long-term potentiation. Interventions that raise PINK1–DRP1 signaling therefore improve synaptic plasticity by restoring Homer1-positive synapses.
description_zh_TW: Homer1 可作為興奮性突觸成熟度以及更廣義 Synaptic plasticity 的標記，因為其豐富程度與樹突棘密度及長期增強能力相符。因此提升 PINK1–DRP1 訊號的介入措施，可藉由恢復 Homer1 陽性突觸而改善突觸可塑性。

label: CRISPR
description: CRISPR-based genome editing is used in cellular reprogramming to delete or modify genes that limit the generation of induced pluripotent stem cells. In the classic example, CRISPR-Cas9-mediated knockout of the transcription factor Oct4 in reprogramming studies demonstrates how targeted gene disruption can probe the requirements of pluripotency. Beyond knockouts, CRISPRi and CRISPRa allow transient modulation of reprogramming factors and pathways, enabling more efficient and controllable iPSC generation and lineage conversion.
description_zh_TW: 基於 CRISPR 的基因組編輯用於細胞重編程，以刪除或修改限制誘導多能幹細胞生成的基因。在經典範例中，重編程研究中 CRISPR-Cas9 介導的轉錄因子 Oct4 敲除證明了標靶基因破壞如何能夠偵測多能性的要求。除了敲除之外，CRISPRi 和 CRISPRa 還可以瞬時調節重編程因子和途徑，從而實現更有效率、更可控的 iPSC 生成和譜系轉換。

label: UBL-5
description: UBL-5 is a ubiquitin-like protein in Caenorhabditis elegans that functions as an essential transcriptional cofactor for the mitochondrial unfolded protein response. Loss of ubl-5 function abolishes the UPRmt, causing accumulation of misfolded mitochondrial proteins, shortened lifespan, and hypersensitivity to mitochondrial toxins such as ethidium bromide.
description_zh_TW: UBL-5 是 Caenorhabditis elegans 中的類泛素蛋白，作為 Mitochondrial Unfolded Protein Response 不可或缺的轉錄輔因子。ubl-5 功能喪失會使 UPRmt 失效，造成錯誤摺疊粒線體蛋白累積、壽命縮短，以及對 ethidium bromide 等粒線體毒物的高度敏感。

label: Dicarbonyls
description: Besides the Maillard reaction, advanced glycation end products can be formed through alternative pathways. The autoxidation of glucose and the lipid peroxidation of lipids into dicarbonyl derivatives, driven by increases in oxidative stress, are well-studied routes. These dicarbonyl derivatives, known as alpha-oxaldehydes, include glyoxal, methylglyoxal, and 3-deoxyglucosone, which can interact with amino groups on macromolecules and form AGEs. This connection between lipid oxidation, oxidative stress, and protein glycation illustrates how glycation and oxidation damage are intertwined and why AGEs often coexist with markers of oxidative damage in aging tissues.
description_zh_TW: Besides the Maillard reaction，advanced glycation end products可through alternative pathways形成。由increases in oxidative stress所driven的glucose autoxidation，以及lipid peroxidation of lipids into dicarbonyl derivatives，是well-studied routes。這些known as alpha-oxaldehydes的dicarbonyl derivatives包括glyoxal、methylglyoxal與3-deoxyglucosone，它們可interact with amino groups on macromolecules並form AGEs。此connection between lipid oxidation、oxidative stress與protein glycation illustrates how glycation與oxidation damage are intertwined，以及為何AGEs常coexist with markers of oxidative damage in aging tissues。

label: Deacetylation
description: Sirtuin deacetylation consumes one NAD+ per event, hydrolyzing it to nicotinamide and O-acetyl-ADP-ribose. Because of this stoichiometry, deacetylation is activated by fasting, exercise and Caloric Restriction when NAD+ rises, and inhibited when the NAD+/NADH ratio is high and NAD+ is limiting — so declining NAD+ with age directly limits deacetylation.
description_zh_TW: sirtuin 去乙醯化每個事件消耗一個 NAD+，將其水解為 nicotinamide 與 O-acetyl-ADP-ribose。由於此化學計量，去乙醯化會在禁食、運動與熱量限制使 NAD+ 上升時被活化，並在 NAD+/NADH 比值高、NAD+ 受限時被抑制——因此隨年齡下降的 NAD+ 會直接限制去乙醯化。

label: Thymopoiesis
description: Age-associated thymic involution results in diminished thymopoiesis: reduction of the thymic epithelial space causes loss of T cell receptor gene rearrangement and decreased output of naive T cells to the periphery. Using single joint T cell receptor excision circle analysis (sjTREC), a molecular marker for active thymopoiesis, researchers measured a steady three-log decline in circulating naive T cells across an 80-year human lifespan. Similar decreases in sjTREC per milligram of thymus tissue were observed in aging BALB/c mice from 6 to 90 weeks. Thus involution reduces both the quantity and quality of T cells exported across the lifespan.
description_zh_TW: 與年齡相關的胸腺退化導致胸腺生成減弱：胸腺上皮空間的縮減導致 T 細胞受體基因重排喪失和初始 T 細胞向外周輸出的減少。研究人員使用單連結 T 細胞受體 excision circle 分析（sjTREC）——一種 active thymopoiesis 的分子標記——測量到在 80 年人類壽命中循環初始 T 細胞穩定下降三個數量級。在 6 至 90 週齡的老化 BALB/c 小鼠中也觀察到每毫克胸腺組織的 sjTREC 類似下降。因此，退化在整個壽命中降低了輸出 T 細胞的數量和質量。

label: Kaempferol
description: Kaempferol, a flavonol (3,5,7,4'-tetrahydroxyflavone) and sister compound to quercetin/apigenin, directly activates SIRT1 as a natural polyphenol STAC via K-type allosteric Km lowering, and is frequently co-studied for anti-aging and cancer-risk reduction.
description_zh_TW: Kaempferol 是一種黄酮醇（3,5,7,4'-四羥基黄酮），是 quercetin/apigenin 的姊妹化合物，作為天然多酚類 STAC 透過 K 型別構降低 Km 直接活化 SIRT1，常與抗老化和降低癌症風險的研究並提。

label: Hemolysis
description: Hemolysis may occur during the treatment of methemoglobinemia with methylene blue, mechanistically linked to its oxidative properties which can overwhelm erythrocyte antioxidant defenses, particularly in susceptible individuals. Laboratory findings can include Heinz bodies, elevated indirect bilirubin, decreased haptoglobin, and a negative direct antiglobulin test, with anemia developing one or more days after administration. The American Heart Association emphasizes that patients with G6PD deficiency are at markedly increased risk, as impaired NADPH generation limits glutathione regeneration, rendering red blood cells unable to counteract oxidative stress and predisposing to rapid hemolysis and worsening anemia.
description_zh_TW: 在治療methemoglobinemia時使用methylene blue可能發生溶血，這在機制上與其氧化特性有關，這些特性可能壓倒紅血球的抗氧化防禦，特別是在易感個體中。實驗室結果可能包括Heinz小體、間接膽紅素升高、結合珠蛋白降低和直接抗球蛋白試驗陰性，貧血在給藥後一天或更長時間後發生。美國心臟協會強調，G6PD缺乏症患者的風險顯著增加，因為NADPH生成受損限制了谷胱甘肽再生，使紅血球無法對抗氧化應激，從而易於快速溶血和貧血惡化。

label: Crown-like Structures
description: Crown-like structures (CLS) are histological formations in obese adipose tissue in which macrophages, predominantly of the pro-inflammatory M1 phenotype, form a ring around a single dead or dying adipocyte. CLS form after adipocyte hypertrophy and death, and their density in biopsies reports the inflammatory status of the tissue.
description_zh_TW: Crown-like Structures（CLS）是肥胖脂肪組織中的組織學構造，巨噬細胞（以促發炎 M1 表型為主）環繞單一死亡或瀕死 adipocyte 形成環狀排列。CLS 在 adipocyte肥大與死亡後形成，其在活檢中的密度可反映組織的發炎狀態。

label: Valine
description: Valine is one of the three Branched-Chain Amino Acids and, unlike leucine and isoleucine, is fully glucogenic: its carbon skeleton is routed exclusively to succinyl-CoA, which enters the TCA cycle to make ATP and support hepatic gluconeogenesis.
description_zh_TW: Valine 是三大 Branched-Chain Amino Acids 之一，且與 leucine、isoleucine 不同，屬完全生糖性：其碳骨架專一地流向 succinyl-CoA，後者進入 TCA cycle 產生 ATP 並支持肝臟的 gluconeogenesis。

label: cADPR
description: cADPR (cyclic ADP-ribose) is a cyclic nucleotide second messenger synthesized from NAD+ by ADP-ribosyl cyclases, representing roughly 2-3% of the total NAD+ consumed by CD38, the dominant mammalian enzyme responsible.
description_zh_TW: cADPR（環狀 ADP-核糖）是由 ADP-核糖基環化酶從 NAD+ 合成的環狀核苷酸第二訊使，約佔哺乳動物主要負責酵素 CD38 總 NAD+ 消耗量的 2-3%。

label: Diethylcarbamazine
description: Diethylcarbamazine (DEC) is a piperazine-derived synthetic antifilarial whose primary approved indication is Lymphatic Filariasis, where it is typically given as annual single-dose mass treatment with Ivermectin or Albendazole. DEC rapidly kills both microfilariae and adult worms, potentiating eosinophil- and macrophage-mediated killing while altering parasite membrane permeability and motility.
description_zh_TW: Diethylcarbamazine（DEC）是哌嗪衍生的合成抗絲蟲藥，主要核准適應症為 Lymphatic Filariasis（淋巴絲蟲病），通常與 Ivermectin 或 Albendazole 一起以每年單次劑量進行大規模投藥。DEC 能迅速殺死微絲蟲與成蟲，並藉增強嗜酸性球與巨噬細胞介導的殺傷、改变寄生蟲膜通透性與運動性而作用。

label: Non-Exercise Activity Thermogenesis
description: Non-Exercise Activity Thermogenesis (NEAT) is the energy spent on fidgeting, posture maintenance, standing, and walking rather than deliberate exercise; together with exercise costs it forms the activity component of daily Energy Expenditure and is its most variable component between individuals.
description_zh_TW: Non-Exercise Activity Thermogenesis (NEAT) 是坐立不安、姿勢維持、站立與步行等非刻意運動所消耗的能量；它與刻意運動的消耗共同構成每日 Energy Expenditure 的活動部分，也是個體間變異最大的組成。

label: Sirtuin-Caspase Crosstalk
description: AGK2 liberates caspase-2/3-dependent apoptosis in nucleated cells, engaging sirtuin-caspase crosstalk. In platelets it instead triggers caspase-independent calpain-mediated death.
description_zh_TW: AGK2 在有核細胞中釋放依賴 caspase-2/3 的細胞凋亡，啟動 sirtuin-caspase 交互作用；而在血小板中則改為觸發不依賴 caspase 的 calpain 介導細胞死亡。

label: Atrogin-1
description: Atrogin-1 (FBXO32) is a muscle-specific E3 ubiquitin ligase whose expression is transcriptionally controlled by FoxO family factors. FoxO activation, which occurs under fasting, denervation and other atrophic stimuli, drives Atrogin-1 transcription and thereby initiates the ubiquitin-proteasome program for myofibrillar protein disposal.
description_zh_TW: Atrogin-1 (FBXO32) 是肌肉特異性的 E3 泛素連接酶，其表現受 FoxO 家族轉錄因子調控。在禁食、失去神經支配及其他萎縮刺激下，FoxO 被活化並驅動 Atrogin-1 的轉錄，進而啟動肌原纖維蛋白的泛素－蛋白酶體分解程序。

label: MacroD2
description: MacroD2 is a ~47 kDa MacroD-type macrodomain ADP-ribosylation eraser in cytosol and nucleus. Using a substrate-assisted mechanism — the ADP-ribose alpha-phosphate activates a positioned catalytic water for nucleophilic attack at ribose C1'' — it hydrolyses mono-ADP-ribose linked to aspartate/glutamate, e.g. PARP10/PARP1 mono-marks, and deacetylates O-acetyl-ADP-ribose. It is inactive toward poly-ADP-ribose, acting only after PARG.
description_zh_TW: MacroD2 是約 47 kDa 的 MacroD 型巨結構域 ADP-核糖基化「擦除者」，位於細胞質與細胞核。它採用受質輔助的機制——ADP-核糖的 α-磷酸活化一個定位好的催化水分子，親核進攻核糖 C1''——水解與天門冬胺酸／麩胺酸酯鍵結的單一 ADP-核糖（例如 PARP10/PARP1 的單一標記），並去乙醯化 O-乙醯-ADP-核糖。它對 poly-ADP-核糖無活性，只在 PARG 之後作用。

label: Palbociclib
description: Palbociclib (125 mg/day, 21 days on / 7 days off) is standard first-line therapy for HR+/HER2- metastatic breast cancer, where it induces G1/S arrest by preventing Rb phosphorylation.
description_zh_TW: Palbociclib（125 mg/日，連用 21 天、停 7 天）是 HR+/HER2- 轉移性乳癌的標準一線治療，藉由阻止 Rb 磷酸化誘導 G1/S 期停滯。

label: Erastin
description: Erastin binds and inhibits the system Xc- cystine/glutamate antiporter, specifically its SLC7A11 light chain, blocking cystine import. The resulting cysteine shortage throttles glutathione synthesis, leaving GPX4 unable to reduce phospholipid hydroperoxides and allowing ROS-mediated lipid peroxidation to propagate — the core execution axis of ferroptosis.
description_zh_TW: Erastin 結合並抑制 system Xc- 半胱胺酸／麩胺酸對向運輸體，特別是其 SLC7A11 輕鏈，阻斷半胱胺酸輸入。隨之而來的半胱胺酸短缺抑制 glutathione 合成，使 GPX4 無法還原磷脂質過氧化物，讓 ROS 介導的脂質過氧化持續擴散——這正是 ferroptosis 的核心執行軸。

label: Pembrolizumab
description: Blocking antibodies against PD-1 such as nivolumab and pembrolizumab, and against PD-L1 such as atezolizumab and avelumab, reinvigorate exhausted CD8+ T Cell effectors and are approved across many malignancies. Response is strongest in tumors with neo-antigen burden and PD-L1 expression, and is limited by primary resistance and immune-related adverse events from loss of tolerance.
description_zh_TW: 針對 PD-1 的阻斷抗體如 nivolumab 與 pembrolizumab，以及針對 PD-L1 的 atezolizumab 與 avelumab，可重新活化耗竭的 CD8+ T Cell 效應細胞，並已於多種腫瘤獲得核准。反應在具有新抗原負載且表現 PD-L1 的腫瘤中最強，並受原發抗藥性與失去耐受性所致的免疫相關不良事件所限。

label: mTORC1-Lysosome Compartment
description: Ragulator is required for the mTORC1-Lysosome Compartment: loss of Ragulator disrupts nutrient-dependent mTORC1 signaling and de-represses autophagy. That double consequence makes Ragulator the lynchpin of lysosomal nutrient coupling, since it is needed both to switch mTORC1 off at the membrane and to prevent constitutive autophagy.
description_zh_TW: Ragulator 對 mTORC1-Lysosome Compartment 而言是必需的：Ragulator 缺失會破壞營養依賴性的 mTORC1 訊號並解除對自噬的抑制。這種雙重後果使 Ragulator 成為溶酶體營養耦合的關鍵，因為它既是關閉膜上 mTORC1 所必需，也是防止自噬持續活化所必需。

label: Mesenchymal Stem Cells
description: Healthy Mitochondria isolated from human umbilical cord–derived Mesenchymal Stem Cells, when transplanted into replicatively senescent cells, reverse mitochondrial dysfunction and reduce the senescence markers p16 and p21 along with SASP factors TNFα and IL-8. This mitochondrial transplantation is offered as strong causal evidence that mitochondrial dysfunction is a significant driver of Senescence.
description_zh_TW: 自人臍帶來源 Mesenchymal Stem Cells 取得的健康 Mitochondria，移植至複製性衰老細胞後，可逆轉粒線體功能障礙，並降低衰老標記 p16 與 p21 以及 SASP 因子 TNFα 與 IL-8。這項粒線體移植提供了強力的因果證據，顯示粒線體功能障礙是 Senescence 的重要驅動因子。

label: METTL14
description: METTL14 is the scaffolding partner of METTL3 in the writer complex for N6-methyladenosine, stabilising the methyltransferase and shaping which adenosines are modified. In senescence the METTL3–METTL14 complex also redistributes genome-wide and accumulates at enhancers of SASP genes, an activity-independent structural role.
description_zh_TW: METTL14 是 N6-methyladenosine writer 複合體中 METTL3 的支架夥伴，負責穩定甲基轉移酶並決定哪些腺苷被修飾。在 senescence 中，METTL3–METTL14 複合體還會全基因組重新分布並累積於 SASP 基因的增強子，屬於不依賴催化活性的結構性角色。

label: insulin-degrading enzyme (IDE)
description: Insulin-degrading enzyme (IDE, insulysin) is a zinc metalloprotease best known for cleaving insulin and other small peptides and thereby regulating insulin clearance, limiting hyperinsulinaemia.
description_zh_TW: Insulin-degrading enzyme（IDE，insulysin）是一種鋅金屬蛋白酶，最著名的是切割胰島素與其他小胜肽，藉此調節胰島素清除、限制高胰島素血症。

label: Triiodothyronine
description: Triiodothyronine (T3) is the principal active thyroid hormone, produced largely by peripheral 5'-deiodination of thyroxine in liver, kidney and skeletal muscle. It binds nuclear thyroid-hormone receptors to regulate transcription of metabolic genes, and is a major endocrine determinant of basal metabolic rate: hypothyroidism lowers resting metabolic rate while hyperthyroidism raises it.
description_zh_TW: Triiodothyronine（T3）是主要的活性甲狀腺荷爾蒙，主要由肝臟、腎臟與骨骼肌的周邊 5'-去碘化作用將 thyroxine 轉換而來。它結合核內甲狀腺荷爾蒙受體以調控代謝相關基因的轉錄，是基礎代謝率的主要內分泌決定因子：甲狀腺功能低下會降低 Resting Metabolic Rate，功能亢進則使其上升。

label: Human Endogenous Retrovirus
source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence orchestrating SASP expression.md
description: The human subset of endogenous retroviruses is termed HERV. Present across vertebrates, HERVs are normally epigenetically silenced by DNA methylation and repressive histone marks and constitute about 8% of the human genome.
description_zh_TW: 內源性反轉錄病毒在人類的子群稱為 HERV。ERV 存在於所有脊椎動物中，平時受 DNA 甲基化與抑制性組蛋白標記的表觀遺傳沉默，約占人類基因體的 8%。

label: Melanocyte
description: The distant Metastatic colonization step that melanocyte-derived Melanoma must achieve is limited by Oxidative Stress in the metastatic niche. This is why melanoma cells co-opt Selenocysteine-dependent translation: sustaining antioxidant selenoproteins is what allows them to survive the oxidative burden of a distant site.
description_zh_TW: 由 Melanocyte 衍生出的 Melanoma 必須完成的遠端 Metastatic colonization 步驟，受到轉移微環境中 Oxidative Stress 的限制。這也是黑色素瘤細胞為何會挪用 Selenocysteine 依賴性的轉譯：維持抗氧化性的 selenoprotein，正是讓它們得以在遠端微環境的氧化負荷下存活的原因。

label: Ribosome Biogenesis
description: RNA polymerase I transcribes the 18S, 5.8S and 28S rRNA genes in the nucleolus, and each ribosome requires a single 45S precursor rRNA transcript. Pol I output is therefore the rate-limiting step of ribosome biogenesis and sets the ceiling on protein synthesis.
description_zh_TW: RNA 聚合酶 I 在核仁中轉錄 18S、5.8S 與 28S rRNA 基因，而每個核糖體都需要一條 45S 前驅 rRNA 轉錄本。因此 Pol I 的產出是核糖體生成的限速步驟，並為蛋白質合成設定上限。

label: Hallmarks of Cancer
description: Resisting cell death, and apoptosis in particular, is enumerated as one of the original hallmarks of cancer. By disabling the apoptotic machinery, tumor cells tolerate genomic instability and survive therapies that depend on death execution. The relationship is directional: loss of apoptosis enables cancer rather than cancer instructing the loss. Most cytotoxic and targeted agents ultimately require restoration of apoptosis to succeed.
description_zh_TW: 抵抗細胞死亡，特別是細胞凋亡，被列為原始Hallmarks of Cancer之一。透過禁用凋亡機制，腫瘤細胞可以耐受基因組不穩定性並在依賴死亡執行的治療中存活下來。這種關係是方向性的：細胞凋亡的喪失會引發癌症，而不是癌症導致細胞凋亡。大多數細胞毒性藥物和標靶藥物最終需要恢復細胞凋亡才能成功。

label: Neutrophil Elastase
description: Neutrophil Elastase (ELANE) is an azurophil-granule serine protease released during neutrophil activation that translocates to the nucleus in NETosis, clips histones to aid chromatin decondensation via a PAD4-independent route, and decorates extruded NETs.
description_zh_TW: Neutrophil Elastase (ELANE) 是嗜天青顆粒中的絲胺酸蛋白酶，在中性球活化時釋放，並於 NETosis 過程中轉位至細胞核、切割組蛋白以經由 PAD4 非依賴途徑促進染色質去凝縮，同時裝飾被擠出的 NETs。

label: KDM6A
description: Unlike most X-linked genes, KDM6A escapes X-chromosome inactivation, so both X alleles in females are transcribed and roughly twice the protein of males is produced (the degree of escape varies by tissue and individual). This biallelic dosage advantage means females require two loss-of-function hits for complete inactivation while a single mutation suffices in males, a key reason for the female advantage in the EXITS tumor suppressor framework.
description_zh_TW: 與多數 X 連鎖基因不同，KDM6A 可逃脫 X 染色體失活，因此雌性的兩條 X 等位基因皆會被轉錄，產生的蛋白質約為雄性的兩倍（逃脫程度依組織與個體而異）。這種雙等位基因劑量優勢意味著雌性需要兩次功能喪失「擊中」才能完全失活，而雄性單次突變即足夠，這是 EXITS 腫瘤抑制因子框架中雌性優勢的重要原因。

label: OMA1
description: OMA1 is constitutively present but normally restrained; its activity is sharply upregulated in response to mitochondrial stress signals, particularly loss of Mitochondrial Membrane Potential (ΔΨm), perturbed protein import, or accumulation of unfolded proteins. Excess or prolonged OMA1 activation collapses cristae, sensitizes cells to apoptosis and cooperates with the PINK1/Parkin mitophagy machinery.
description_zh_TW: OMA1 平時持續存在但受到抑制；其活性會在粒線體壓力訊號出現時顯著上升，尤其是粒線體膜電位（Mitochondrial Membrane Potential, ΔΨm）喪失、蛋白輸入受擾或未折疊蛋白堆積時。過度或持續的 OMA1 活化會使嵴崩解、使細胞對凋亡敏感，並與 PINK1/Parkin 的 mitophagy 機制協同作用。

label: Sympathetic nerve endings
description: Sympathetic nerve endings provide dense innervation of the SA node, AV node, and ventricular myocardium of the heart. Sympathetic activation increases heart rate, conduction velocity, and contractile force. This innervation is a major determinant of cardiac chronotropy, dromotropy, and inotropy.
description_zh_TW: Sympathetic nerve endings 對心臟的 SA node、AV node 與心室 Myocardium 提供密集的神經支配。交感神經活化會增加心率、傳導速度與收縮力。這種神經支配是心臟變時性、變傳導性與變力性的主要決定因素。

label: Connective Tissue
description: Fascia is the body's continuous sheet-like connective-tissue continuum — a three-dimensional web of collagen, elastin and hydrated ground substance — that wraps, separates and connects muscles, bones, vessels, nerves and organs. Classified by the Fascia Nomenclature Committee into subcutaneous, deep, visceral and parietal layers, it forms a single tensegrity network rather than isolated sheets.
description_zh_TW: Fascia 是人體連續片狀的 connective tissue 連續體——由 collagen、elastin 與含水基質構成的三維網絡——包裹、分隔並連接肌肉、骨骼、血管、神經與器官。依 Fascia Nomenclature Committee 分為淺層、深層、臟器層與壁層，它構成的是單一的張力整體網絡而非彼此孤立的膜片。

label: Pyruvate Dehydrogenase
description: DLD is the E3 flavoprotein subunit shared by Pyruvate Dehydrogenase, α-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase and branched-chain ketoacid dehydrogenase. It reoxidizes the dihydrolipoyl groups generated during decarboxylation, regenerating the lipoamide cofactor and transferring electrons to NAD+, so DLD activity is required for the complexes that feed carbon into the TCA cycle.
description_zh_TW: DLD 是 Pyruvate Dehydrogenase、α-酮戊二酸去氫酶與支鏈酮酸去氫酶共用的 E3 黃素蛋白次單元。它將脫羧過程產生的 dihydrolipoyl 基團再氧化，重新生成 lipoamide 輔基並將電子轉移給 NAD+，因此 DLD 活性是將碳送入 TCA 循環的這些複合體所必需。

label: Tissue Plasminogen Activator
description: Tissue plasminogen activator (tPA) is a serine protease that cleaves plasminogen at Arg561-Val562 to generate plasmin, the active protease that degrades cross-linked fibrin. Plasmin in turn cleaves single-chain tPA to the more active two-chain form, creating a positive feedback loop that amplifies fibrinolysis at the clot surface.
description_zh_TW: Tissue plasminogen activator（tPA）是一種絲胺酸蛋白酶，於 Arg561-Val562 處切割 plasminogen 生成 plasmin；plasmin 進而切割單鏈 tPA 生成活性更高的雙鏈形式，形成在血塊表面放大 fibrinolysis 的正回饋迴路。

label: Biphasic Dose-Response Curve
description: For a network to produce a biphasic dose-response curve, the probability is highly increased if one of the bivalent interactions of the inhibited target operates in the saturated enzymatic regime, i.e., a Michaelis-Menten interaction with high affinity towards its substrate whose reaction speed does not depend on substrate amount. Specifically, the Michaelis-Menten constant K21 of the backward interaction from Target to Input must be significantly low. Fixing K21 to a low value raises the percentage of hormetic parameter sets from about 6% to 80%, a roughly ten-fold increase in the probability of observing hormesis.
description_zh_TW: 若要讓網路產生雙相劑量反應曲線，若被抑制標靶的其中一個雙價交互作用運作於飽和酵素動力學區間——亦即對其受質具有高親和力、且反應速率不依賴受質濃度的Michaelis-Menten交互作用——則出現雙相曲線的機率會大幅提高。具體而言，從Target到Input之反向交互作用的Michaelis-Menten常數K21必須顯著偏低。將K21固定於低值，可使具毒物興奮效應（hormesis）的參數組比例從約6%提升至80%，觀察到毒物興奮效應的機率約增加十倍。

label: E2F1
description: Retinoblastoma Protein inhibits proliferation by binding to and inactivating E2F1, a key transcriptional activator of cell cycle and cell division genes. E2F1 itself plays a dual role, acting as a master regulator of cell cycle progression at the G1/S transition and as a potent driver of apoptosis in response to severe DNA damage or oncogenic stress.
description_zh_TW: Retinoblastoma Protein 藉由結合並使 E2F1 失活來抑制增殖；E2F1 是 cell cycle 與細胞分裂基因的關鍵轉錄活化因子。E2F1 本身具有雙重角色：既是 G1/S transition 的 cell cycle 進展主導調節因子，也是嚴重 DNA 損傷或致癌壓力下的強效凋亡驅動者。

label: Lipopolysaccharide
description: Lipopolysaccharide (LPS), the principal endotoxin of Gram-negative bacteria, is a glycolipid anchored in the bacterial outer membrane. On release by cell lysis or gut leak it is a potent danger signal that engages TLR4 on immune and epithelial cells and initiates Inflammation via MyD88 and TRIF adapters.
description_zh_TW: Lipopolysaccharide（LPS）是革蘭氏陰性菌的主要內毒素，為錨定於細菌外膜的糖脂質。在菌體裂解或腸道滲漏釋出後，LPS 是強烈的危險訊號，與免疫及上皮細胞上的 TLR4 結合，經由 MyD88 與 TRIF 轉接因子啟動 Inflammation。

label: ATFS-1
description: Under mitochondrial proteotoxic stress HAF-1, an inner-membrane ABC transporter, exports peptides generated by mitochondrial proteases from the matrix into the cytosol. These peptides act as retrograde signals that activate the transcription factor ATFS-1 and thus the mitochondrial unfolded protein response.
description_zh_TW: 在粒線體蛋白毒性壓力下，內膜 ABC transporter HAF-1 將粒線體蛋白酶產生的胜肽由 matrix 輸出至細胞質。這些胜肽作為 retrograde 訊號活化轉錄因子 ATFS-1，進而啟動 mitochondrial unfolded protein response。

label: Necrostatin-1
description: Necrostatin-1 (Nec-1) is a selective small-molecule inhibitor that allosterically blocks RIPK1 kinase activity, preventing phosphorylation and translocation of RIPK1 and therefore the formation of the RIPK1-RIPK3-MLKL necrosome. It is the most widely used tool compound for dissecting necroptosis from other forms of regulated cell death.
description_zh_TW: Necrostatin-1（Nec-1）是選擇性小分子抑制劑，以異位（allosteric）方式阻斷 RIPK1 激酶活性，阻止 RIPK1 的磷酸化與轉位，因而無法形成 RIPK1-RIPK3-MLKL 壞死小體。它是區分 necroptosis 與其他受調控細胞死亡形式最廣泛使用的工具化合物。

label: TRF2
description: Progressive telomere attrition with cell division (the end-replication problem) causes loss of the protective TRF2-occupied shelterin cap, activating persistent DDR signaling that triggers Replicative Senescence. Deletion or dysfunction of TRF2 leads to telomere end-to-end fusions and genomic instability, counteracting Telomere Attrition-driven aging.
description_zh_TW: 隨細胞分裂而逐步發生的端粒耗損（末端複製問題）會造成具保護作用的 TRF2-占据 shelterin 帽流失，啟動持續的 DNA 損傷反應訊號，進而觸發 Replicative Senescence。TRF2 的缺失或功能失常會導致端粒端對端融合與基因體不穩定，對抗 Telomere Attrition 驅動的老化。

label: Retinoic-acid-inducible protein I-like receptor
description: Retinoic-acid-inducible protein I-like receptors (RLRs) detect unique RNA structures generated during viral infection and then activate MAVS on the outer mitochondrial membrane. MAVS acts as the signaling platform that converts that detection event into prion-like aggregate formation and downstream interferon production, making the organelle an internal sensor of external danger.
description_zh_TW: Retinoic-acid-inducible protein I-like receptors（RLRs）偵測病毒感染過程中產生的特殊 RNA 結構，隨後在粒線體外膜上活化 MAVS。MAVS 作為訊號平台，將此偵測事件轉換為類普里昂聚集體形成與下游 interferon 生成，使胞器成為對外來危險的內部感測器。

label: NAPRT
description: NAPRT is the first committed enzyme of the Preiss-Handler Pathway. It catalyses the rate-limiting conversion of nicotinic acid to nicotinic acid mononucleotide (NaMN), the key step in using dietary Niacin (vitamin B3) for NAD+ production; NMNAT then converts NaMN to NaAD, and NAD+ synthase closes the route to NAD+.
description_zh_TW: NAPRT 是 Preiss-Handler Pathway 的第一個承諾酵素。它催化限速的 nicotinic acid 轉為 nicotinic acid mononucleotide (NaMN) 反應，是利用膳食 Niacin（vitamin B3）製造 NAD+ 的關鍵步驟；之後由 NMNAT 將 NaMN 轉為 NaAD，再由 NAD+ synthase 將途徑收斂到 NAD+。

label: Cell Migration
description: Non-muscle myosin II generates the contractile forces needed for Cell Migration: it drives protrusion retraction, rear-end detachment, and adhesion turnover at the trailing edge, all on Cytoskeleton-resident Actin tracks.
description_zh_TW: 非肌肉型 myosin II 產生 Cell Migration（細胞遷移）所需的收縮力：驅動前緣的伸縮、尾端分離，以及後緣的黏附周轉—all 皆在 Cytoskeleton（細胞骨架）中的 Actin 軌道上進行。

label: Tryptophan
description: The kynurenine pathway is the major catabolic route for tryptophan, accounting for about 95% of tryptophan metabolism outside protein synthesis and serotonin production. IDO1 or TDO catalyses the rate-limiting first step, oxidative cleavage of the indole ring to produce N-formylkynurenine, which kynurenine formamidase deacylates to kynurenine. Three branch points then generate kynurenic acid, 3-hydroxykynurenine/quinolinic acid, or anthranilic acid.
description_zh_TW: Kynurenine 路徑是色胺酸（Tryptophan）的主要分解代謝途徑，約佔蛋白質合成與血清素生成之外色胺酸代謝的 95%。IDO1 或 TDO 催化限速的第一步驟，切割吲哚環產生 N-formylkynurenine，再由 kynurenine formamidase 去醯化生成 kynurenine。之後三個分支點分別產生 kynurenic acid、3-hydroxykynurenine／quinolinic acid，或 anthranilic acid。

label: DNASE2
description: In senescent cells, DNASE2 is transcriptionally downregulated together with the cytosolic exonuclease TREX1. Persistent DNA damage therefore no longer resolves, the resulting cytosolic DNA activates cGAS-STING, and a type-I interferon plus NF-kB response emerges that is a major engine of the SASP - making DNASE2 loss a senescence-intrinsic mechanism rather than an extrinsic trigger.
description_zh_TW: 在 senescent cells 中，DNASE2 與細胞質外切核酸酶 TREX1 一同被轉錄性下調。因此持續存在的 DNA 損傷不再被解決，產生的細胞質 DNA 活化 cGAS-STING，並引發 type-I interferon 與 NF-κB 反應，成為 SASP 的主要動力來源；這使 DNASE2 的喪失成為一種 senescent 內在機制而非外在觸發因素。

label: Tyrosine
description: Tyrosine Hydroxylase is the rate-limiting enzyme of catecholamine biosynthesis, catalysing the hydroxylation of the amino acid Tyrosine to L-DOPA, the precursor of dopamine, norepinephrine and epinephrine. Its expression is the standard histological marker for dopaminergic neurons, and neurons lose TH expression before they die in Parkinson's Disease.
description_zh_TW: Tyrosine Hydroxylase 是 Catecholamine 生合成的速率限制酵素，催化胺基酸 Tyrosine 羥化為 L-DOPA，而 L-DOPA 是 dopamine、norepinephrine 與 epinephrine 的前驅物。其表現是 dopaminergic neuron 的標準組織學標記，且在 Parkinson's Disease 中神經元會在死亡前先失去 TH 表現。

label: Allosteric Activator
description: An allosteric activator is a molecule that binds a protein site topographically distinct from the orthosteric active site, inducing a conformational change that increases the protein's catalytic or functional activity. Unlike orthosteric agonists, it does not compete with the endogenous substrate, which confers higher selectivity and a saturable ceiling effect that limits overactivation.
description_zh_TW: 異位活化劑是結合在蛋白上與正位活性位在拓撲上相異之位置的分子，誘導構形改變以提升該蛋白的催化或功能活性。與正位激動劑不同，它不與內源性受質競爭，因此具有較高選擇性，並具可飽和的天花板效應，可限制過度活化。

label: Energy Balance
description: Because stored fat is the difference between metabolizable energy intake and energy expenditure, chronic positive energy balance produces weight gain and drives the obesity epidemic, whereas negative balance produces weight loss. If Western food intake has been stable or declining, reduced physical activity (PAL ~1.66) must have tipped the budget positive.
description_zh_TW: 由於儲存的脂肪即代謝可利用能量攝取與能量消耗之間的差值，慢性正能量平衡會造成體重增加並驅動肥胖流行；負平衡則造成體重減輕。若西方飲食攝取量穩定或下降，則身體活動量降低（PAL 約 1.66）必然使能量預算轉正。

label: Extracellular Acidification Rate
description: Extracellular Acidification Rate is a real-time readout of proton efflux from living cells, detected by a pH-sensitive biosensor such as the Seahorse XF Analyzer. Because Glycolysis converts glucose to lactate with net proton production, ECAR serves as a proxy for glycolytic flux and lactate export, complementing the Oxygen Consumption Rate measurement of mitochondrial respiration. The ECAR/OCR ratio classifies cells as glycolytic or oxidative-phosphorylation-dependent, and mild respiratory-chain stress such as that engaged by Mitohormesis raises ECAR.
description_zh_TW: Extracellular Acidification Rate 是活細胞釋放質子的即時讀值，由 Seahorse XF Analyzer 等 pH 敏感生物感測器偵測。由於 Glycolysis 將葡萄糖轉為乳酸並淨產生質子，ECAR 可作為糖解通量與乳酸輸出的代理指標，與量測粒線體呼吸的 Oxygen Consumption Rate 互補。ECAR/OCR 比值可區分細胞屬糖酵解型或氧化磷酸化依賴型，而 Mitohormesis 所涉及的輕度呼吸鏈壓力會使 ECAR 上升。

label: Calcium Signaling
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md
description: Mitochondria-ER contacts (MERCs) act as regulatory hubs for calcium signaling, lipid exchange, mitochondrial dynamics, and stress adaptation. Impaired ER-to-mitochondria Ca2+ transfer through the IP3R-GRP75-VDAC1 axis can produce either insufficient mitochondrial Ca2+ (blunting ATP production) or pathological Ca2+ overload (sensitizing to permeability transition), both amplifying ROS and destabilizing membrane integrity. MERC disruption amplifies proteostatic and redox failure by coupling ER stress to mitochondrial decay, promoting chronic UPRER activation.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondria-ER contacts (MERCs) 作為 calcium signaling、lipid exchange、mitochondrial dynamics 和 stress adaptation 的 regulatory hubs。Impaired ER-to-mitochondria Ca2+ transfer through the IP3R-GRP75-VDAC1 axis 可導致 either insufficient mitochondrial Ca2+（blunting ATP production）或 pathological Ca2+ overload（sensitizing to permeability transition），兩者都 amplifying ROS 和 destabilizing membrane integrity。MERC disruption amplifies proteostatic 和 redox failure by coupling ER stress to mitochondrial decay，promoting chronic UPRER activation。

label: Nitrotyrosine
description: Tyrosine nitration yields nitrotyrosine as a stable end-product biomarker, making nitrated protein accumulation a useful sentinel of combined oxidative and nitrosative injury in cardiovascular and neurodegenerative contexts — exactly where adrenochrome and neuromelanin oxidative pathways are active.
description_zh_TW: Tyrosine Nitration 會產生 Nitrotyrosine 作為穩定的終產物生物標記，使硝化蛋白的累積成為心血管與神經退行性情境下合併性氧化與亞硝基損傷的實用哨兵——而這些正是 adrenochrome 與 neuromelanin 氧化途徑活躍之處。

label: eIF4E
description: eIF4E is the rate-limiting, cap-binding component of cap-dependent translation: it recognizes the 5' cap of the mRNA and is therefore the initiation factor whose availability sets how much translation happens. Under mTORC1 inhibition eIF4E is sequestered and cap-dependent translation shuts down.
description_zh_TW: eIF4E 是依賴帽轉譯中具速率限制性、負責結合帽的成分：它辨識 mRNA 的 5' 帽，因此其可用性決定了有多少轉譯發生。在 mTORC1 受抑制時，eIF4E 被隔離而依賴帽的轉譯隨之關閉。

label: Acute Kidney Injury
description: SIRT3 is a pivotal coordinator of renal bioenergetics maintaining mitochondrial homeostasis, enhancing antioxidant defenses, and modulating ECM dynamics; its expression is reduced across nephropathies and negatively correlated with histological injury severity. SIRT3 overexpression alleviates AKI and CKD progression in multiple preclinical models, via Nrf2 pathway upregulation, NF-kappaB suppression through IkappaBalpha stabilization, and inhibition of NLRP3 inflammasome activation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 是腎臟生物能學的關鍵協調者，維護粒線體恆定、增強抗氧化防禦並調節 ECM 動態；其表現在腎病變中降低，且與組織學損傷嚴重程度呈負相關。SIRT3 的過量表現在多個臨床前模型中緩解 AKI 和 CKD 進展，透過 Nrf2 途徑上調、NF-kappaB 抑制（經由 IkappaBalpha 穩定化）和 NLRP3 炎症小體活化的抑制。

label: Bortezomib
description: Bortezomib blocks NF-kappaB by inhibiting the proteasome, preventing degradation of IkappaB and thus trapping NF-kappaB in the cytoplasm. This therapeutic strategy exploits the dependence of many cancers on NF-kappaB survival signaling. The directionality is proteasome inhibition to transcriptional blockade. A caveat is that bortezomib also inhibits degradation of many other proteins, causing toxicity such as peripheral neuropathy. The drug is used in multiple myeloma and mantle-cell lymphoma, where its NF-kappaB blockade and proteotoxic stress together induce myeloma cell death.
description_zh_TW: Bortezomib 透過抑制蛋白酶體來阻斷 NF-kappaB，防止 IkappaB 降解，從而將 NF-kappaB 捕獲在細胞質中。這種治療策略利用了許多 cancer 對 NF-kappaB 生存訊號的依賴。方向性是蛋白酶體抑制轉錄阻斷。需要注意的是，bortezomib 也會抑制許多其他 proteins 的降解，進而導致周邊神經病變等毒性。該藥物用於治療多發性骨髓瘤和套細胞淋巴瘤，其 NF-kappaB 阻斷和蛋白毒性壓力共同誘導骨髓瘤細胞死亡。

label: ERK2
description: ERK2 (Extracellular Signal-Regulated Kinase 2) is a member of the MAPK family that transmits signals from cell surface receptors to the nucleus, influencing cell proliferation and survival. It is activated by MEK1/2 upstream of the canonical RAF-MEK-ERK cascade.
description_zh_TW: ERK2（Extracellular Signal-Regulated Kinase 2）是 MAPK 家族的成員，負責將訊號由細胞表面受體傳至細胞核，影響細胞增殖與存活；它在典型的 RAF-MEK-ERK 級聯上游由 MEK1/2 活化。

label: Ki-67
description: Ki-67 is expressed in all active phases of the cell cycle and absent in quiescent cells, making it a robust immunohistochemical readout of proliferation. A high Ki-67 labeling index correlates with aggressive biology and, in some tumors, informs adjuvant therapy decisions. The relationship is directional as a biomarker: proliferation evidences the tumor's growth fraction rather than causing it. It is particularly integrated into grading of breast and neuroendocrine neoplasms.
description_zh_TW: Ki-67 在細胞週期的所有活躍階段表達，但在靜止細胞中不存在，使其成為增殖的可靠免疫組織化學讀數。高 Ki-67 標記指數與侵襲性生物學相關，並且在某些腫瘤中可以為輔助治療決策提供資訊。作為生物標記，這種關係是有方向性的：增殖證明瞭腫瘤的生長分數，而不是導致腫瘤生長的原因。它特別被納入乳腺和神經內分泌腫瘤的分級。

label: Cardiac arrest
description: Epinephrine 1 mg IV/IO every 3-5 minutes is standard therapy in cardiac arrest resuscitation. Its alpha-adrenergic vasoconstrictor effect augments aortic diastolic pressure and improves coronary and cerebral perfusion during chest compressions, raising ROSC rates — but despite this, no controlled trial has demonstrated improved survival with favourable neurological outcome, and beta-adrenergic effects may worsen myocardial stunning.
description_zh_TW: Cardiac arrest 復甦中，每 3–5 分鐘靜脈或骨內給予 Epinephrine 1 mg 是標準治療。其 α-腎上腺素性血管收縮作用提高主動脈舒張壓，在胸外按壓期間改善冠狀動脈與腦部灌流，提升 ROSC 率——但儘管如此，沒有任何對照試驗證明可改善具良好神經結局的存活率，且 β-腎上腺素作用可能加重心肌 stunning。

label: Proton Leak
description: Mitochondrial proton leak, the passive return of protons across the inner mitochondrial membrane that bypasses ATP synthase, is a significant component of resting metabolic rate and of the energy expenditure of skeletal muscle. Because proton leak uncouples oxygen consumption from ATP production, it dissipates a portion of the proton gradient as heat and is estimated to account for roughly 20 percent of resting oxygen consumption in mammals. Speakman discusses how variations in proton leak, partly set by the expression of uncoupling proteins such as UCP3 in muscle, contribute to inter-individual differences in metabolic rate and, potentially, to differences in exercise-induced energy expenditure.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體質子漏，即質子被動返回穿過粒線體內膜並繞過ATP合成酶，是靜息代謝率和骨骼肌能量消耗的重要組成部分。由於質子漏將氧氣消耗與ATP產生解偶聯，它將一部分質子梯度以熱的形式消散，估計佔哺乳動物靜息氧氣消耗的約20%。Speakman討論了質子漏的變化如何部分由肌肉中解偶聯蛋白如UCP3的表達設定，導致代謝率個體間差異，以及可能導致運動誘導能量消耗的差異。

label: Vitamin A
description: Retinoic Acid is the active metabolite of Vitamin A and a potent inducer of cellular differentiation. In embryonic stem cell research it is applied to monolayer cultures without LIF to drive mesenchymal differentiation and test the silencing of pluripotency.
description_zh_TW: Retinoic Acid 是 Vitamin A 的活性代謝物，也是強效的細胞分化誘導劑。在胚胎幹細胞研究中，它在不含 LIF 的單層培養中被施加以驅動間質分化並檢測多能性的沉默。

label: Beta-Oxidation
description: While mitochondria handle the bulk of beta-oxidation for short and medium-chain fatty acids, the Peroxisome is the primary site for the preliminary beta-oxidation of very long-chain fatty acids, shortening these large lipids before they can enter mitochondria for complete oxidation.
description_zh_TW: 雖然短鏈與中鏈脂肪酸的 beta-oxidation 主要由粒線體處理，但 Peroxisome 是 very long-chain fatty acids 初步 beta-oxidation 的主要場所，先將這些大型脂質縮短，之後才能進入粒線體進行完全氧化。

label: Cholesterol Metabolism
description: Cholesterol Metabolism comprises biosynthesis via the Mevalonate pathway, uptake via the LDL Receptor, esterification by ACAT1, and efflux through ABCA1 and ABCG1. ACAT1 also acts outside lipid handling, regulating TFEB activity through acetylation.
description_zh_TW: Cholesterol Metabolism 包含經由 Mevalonate pathway 的生合成、經 LDL Receptor 的攝取、由 ACAT1 催化的酯化，以及經 ABCA1 與 ABCG1 的外排。ACAT1 也參與脂質處理以外的調節，透過乙醯化調控 TFEB 活性。

label: Lipid peroxyl radical
description: Lipid peroxyl radical hydrogen abstraction from polyunsaturated fatty acids yields lipid hydroperoxide plus a new lipid radical; the rate-determining propagation step. Abstraction sustains the peroxidation chain.
description_zh_TW: 脂質過氧自由基從多元不飽和脂肪酸提取氫，產生脂質氫過氧化物加新脂質自由基；是速率決定傳播步驟。提取維持過氧化鏈。

label: Decitabine
description: Decitabine is a nucleoside analog that inhibits DNA methyltransferases and is used as an epigenetic therapy in hematologic malignancies. After incorporation into DNA during replication, decitabine covalently traps DNMT enzymes, depleting them and causing passive loss of DNA methylation on newly synthesized strands. This demethylation reactivates genes silenced by promoter hypermethylation, such as tumor suppressors, which underlies its clinical efficacy in myelodysplastic syndromes and acute myeloid leukemia.
description_zh_TW: Decitabine 是一種核苷類似物，可抑制 DNA 甲基轉移酶，用作血液惡性腫瘤的表觀遺傳療法。在複製過程中摻入 DNA 後，地西他濱共價捕獲 DNMT 酶，耗盡它們並導致新合成鏈上 DNA 甲基化的被動喪失。這種去甲基化重新激活了因啟動子高甲基化而沉默的基因，例如腫瘤抑制基因，這是其在骨髓增生異常綜合徵和急性髓系白血病中的臨床功效的基礎。

label: Prostacyclin
description: Prostacyclin and Thromboxane A2 are made from the same Prostaglandin H2 pool and act on opposing receptors - IP (Gs-coupled, raising cAMP, inhibiting platelet activation and relaxing smooth muscle) versus TP (promoting aggregation and vasoconstriction). The PGI2/TXA2 ratio at the vessel wall is therefore the key determinant of thrombotic tendency. In pulmonary arterial hypertension prostacyclin deficiency is central to pathogenesis, which is why prostacyclin analogues are mainstay therapy.
description_zh_TW: Prostacyclin 與 Thromboxane A2 由同一個 Prostaglandin H2 池生成，卻作用於相反的受體——IP（Gs 偶聯、升高 cAMP、抑制血小板活化並放鬆平滑肌）對上 TP（促進聚集與血管收縮）。因此血管壁的 PGI2/TXA2 比值是血栓傾向的關鍵決定因素。在肺動脈高壓中，prostacyclin 缺乏是致病機制的核心，因此 prostacyclin 類似物為主線治療。

label: Pancreatitis
description: Acute Pancreatitis is the sudden, severe form of Pancreatitis in which premature activation of digestive enzymes triggers acinar autodigestion, mitochondrial dysfunction, oxidative damage and a systemic inflammatory response. Severity ranges from mild self-limiting disease to necrotizing pancreatitis with multi-organ failure, and gallstones and alcohol are the most common triggers.
description_zh_TW: Acute Pancreatitis（急性胰臟炎）是 Pancreatitis（胰臟炎）中最驟急嚴重的形式，消化酵素過早活化造成腺泡細胞自我消化，導致粒線體功能障礙、氧化性傷害與全身性發炎反應。嚴重程度可由輕微自限性疾病到壞死性胰臟炎伴隨多重器官衰竭，以膽結石與酒精為最常見誘因。

label: Progeria
description: Progeria (Hutchinson-Gilford progeria syndrome) is caused by a mutation in the LMNA Gene that produces progerin, a toxic lamin A variant. Progerin accumulation drives premature aging features including cardiovascular disease, osteoporosis and frailty, making progeria a model of natural aging mechanisms.
description_zh_TW: Progeria（Hutchinson-Gilford 早老症）由 LMNA Gene 的突變所造成，該突變產生 progerin——一種具毒性的 lamin A 變體。Progerin 累積驅動提早老化表徵，包括心血管疾病、骨質疏鬆與虛弱，使 progeria 成為研究天然老化機制的模型。

label: Mebendazole
description: Mebendazole exerts preclinical antileukemic effects through tubulin depolymerization and mitotic arrest.
description_zh_TW: Mebendazole 透過微管蛋白解聚和有絲分裂停滯發揮臨牀前抗白血病作用。

label: NMNAT2
description: NMNAT2 is a protective NAD+ synthase whose loss from the distal axon after injury is the proximal event that triggers Axon Degeneration; because SARM1 consumes the NAD+ that NMNAT2 supplies, SARM1 inhibitors such as Disulfiram block the execution step.
description_zh_TW: NMNAT2 是具保護性的 NAD+ 合成酵素，損傷後自遠端軸突喪失是觸發 Axon Degeneration 的近端事件；由於 SARM1 消耗的正是 NMNAT2 供應的 NAD+，因此如 Disulfiram 等 SARM1 抑制劑可阻斷此執行步驟。

label: BOK
description: BOK (BCL-2-related ovarian killer protein) is a pro-apoptotic member of the Bcl-2 family that has emerged as a key regulator of mitophagy flux. Unlike the classical effectors, its death signaling is closely tied to mitochondrial quality control, particularly in Alzheimer's disease.
description_zh_TW: BOK（BCL-2-related ovarian killer protein）是 Bcl-2 家族的促凋亡成員，已成為粒線體自噬通量的關鍵調控者。與典型的效應蛋白不同，其死亡訊號與粒線體品質管制密不可分，在 Alzheimer's disease 中尤其如此。

label: Ammonium Persulfate
description: Ammonium persulfate is used as a convenient two-electron chemical oxidant to convert epinephrine to adrenochrome in vitro, proceeding through the o-quinone intermediate adrenaline-quinone followed by intramolecular Michael-type cyclization; the reaction is monitored by the 480 nm absorbance maximum of the adrenochrome chromophore.
description_zh_TW: Ammonium Persulfate 被用作便利的雙電子化學氧化劑，在體外將 Epinephrine 轉為 Adrenochrome，反應經由 o-quinone 中間體 Adrenaline-quinone 再進行分子內 Michael 型環化；可藉 Adrenochrome 色基在 480 nm 的吸收極大來監測。

label: Propionate
description: Propionate is the three-carbon (C3) member of the Short-chain Fatty Acids, generated when gut bacteria ferment dietary fiber and resistant starch. Unlike acetate and butyrate it is produced largely by Bacteroidetes via succinate and acrylate pathways, and is absorbed into the portal vein for extensive first-pass hepatic extraction.
description_zh_TW: Propionate 是 Short-chain Fatty Acids 中三碳（C3）的成員，由腸道細菌發酵膳食纖維與抗性澱粉產生。與 acetate 和 butyrate 不同，它主要由 Bacteroidetes 經 succinate 與 acrylate 路徑產生，並被吸收入門脈靜脈，經肝臟大量首過萃取。

label: Hamartoma
description: Benign tumors are dual-natured: OIS-type arrested lesions (nevi) are longevity-positive cancer barriers, whereas growth-signal-driven benign growths such as TSC1/TSC2-loss mTORC1 hamartomas are themselves disease (Tuberous Sclerosis, angiomyolipoma, epilepsy). Arrested growth is good; ongoing growth is bad.
description_zh_TW: 良性腫瘤具有雙重本質：OIS 型停滯病灶（痣）是長壽正向的癌症屏障，而由生長訊號驅動的良性生長（如 TSC1/TSC2 缺失 mTORC1 錯構瘤）本身即是疾病（結節性硬化症、血管肌脂肪瘤、癲癇）。停滯的生長是好的；持續的生長是壞的。

label: TIMP3
description: TIMP3 is an endogenous ~24 kDa secreted inhibitor of matrix metalloproteinases; its N-terminal inhibitory domain inserts into the catalytic cleft of targets such as MMP-9 and MMP-2 in a 1:1 complex, and unlike TIMP1/2/4 it stays tethered to the extracellular matrix via heparan sulfate proteoglycans.
description_zh_TW: TIMP3 是內生性約 24 kDa 的分泌型基質金屬蛋白酶抑制劑；其 N 端抑制結構域以 1:1 複合體插入 MMP-9、MMP-2 等標的酵素的催化裂縫，且與 TIMP1/2/4 不同，它透過硫酸乙醯肝素蛋白聚醣固定在細胞外基質上。

label: Brain
description: In creatine synthesis or transport deficiency, tissue creatine and phosphocreatine fall, most severely in the brain. Because the creatine phosphate shuttle underpins neuronal energy buffering, the cerebral deficit manifests as intellectual disability, speech and language delay, epilepsy, autism-like features, and movement disorders with myopathic weakness.
description_zh_TW: 在 creatine 合成或運輸缺陷中，組織的 creatine 與 phosphocreatine 下降，以 Brain 最為嚴重。由於 Creatine Phosphate Shuttle 是神經元能量緩衝的基礎，腦部缺陷表現為智能障礙、語言發育延遲、epilepsy、自閉症樣特徵，以及伴隨肌無力的動作障礙。

label: Inner Mitochondrial Membrane
description: Cristae are the infoldings of the inner mitochondrial membrane that greatly increase its surface area and provide the confined compartment housing the respiratory chain complexes I-IV, ATP synthase, and TCA-cycle intermediates. They are the primary site of ATP synthesis and also contribute to calcium sequestration.
description_zh_TW: Cristae 是粒線體內膜的內褶，極大增加其表面積，並提供容納呼吸鏈複合體 I-IV、ATP synthase 與 TCA 循環中間產物的受限空間。它們是 ATP 合成的主要場所，也參與鈣的封存。

label: Fatty Acid Synthase
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: CMS121 is a fatty-acid-synthase (FASN) inhibitor developed by Pamela Maher's lab, discovered through the same phenotypic ferroptosis-based screening platform that yielded its sister compound J147. By inhibiting FASN it reduces pathological lipid accumulation and oxidative stress in neurons, and both compounds completed Phase 1 clinical trials for Alzheimer's disease.
description_zh_TW: CMS121 是 Pamela Maher 實驗室開發的脂肪酸合成酶（FASN）抑制劑，與其姊妹化合物 J147 同樣來自以鐵死亡為基礎的表型篩選平台。藉由抑制 FASN，它減少神經元中病理性脂質堆積與氧化壓力，兩者皆已完成阿茲海默病的第一期臨床試驗。

label: Assembloids
description: Assembloids recapitulate migration, circuits and tumor-immune pathophysiology.
description_zh_TW: Assembloid 重現遷移、迴路與腫瘤免疫病理生理。

label: NPC1
description: NPC1 acts as a checkpoint that restrains cGAS-STING signaling under homeostatic conditions. NPC1 deficiency disrupts endolysosomal trafficking, impairs STING degradation and prolongs signaling at the ER and nuclear envelope, producing constitutive STING overactivation and sustained Type I Interferon production — a cGAS-independent route by which organelle stress alone can drive interferon signaling.
description_zh_TW: NPC1 是在穩態下抑制 cGAS-STING 訊號的檢查點。NPC1 缺失會破壞內體溶酶體運輸、損害 STING 降解並延長其在 ER 與核膜的訊號傳遞，造成 STING 過度活化與持續的 Type I Interferon 生成——這是一條不依賴 cGAS、單靠胞器壓力即可驅動干擾素訊號的途徑。

label: MLH1
description: MLH1 is a tumor suppressor of the repair-pathway class: germline loss causes Lynch syndrome, while somatic MLH1 promoter methylation produces microsatellite instability in sporadic colorectal and endometrial cancers.
description_zh_TW: MLH1 屬於修復途徑類的腫瘤抑制基因：生殖系突變流失會造成 Lynch 症候群（遺傳性非息肉病大腸癌），而體細胞性 MLH1 啟動子甲基化則在散發性大腸癌與子宮內膜癌中產生微衛星不穩定。

label: Protein Turnover
description: Protein Turnover is the dynamic steady state between protein synthesis and degradation that maintains Proteostasis across the body. Because each peptide bond consumes ATP equivalents, the aggregate rate of whole-body protein turnover is a meaningful component of resting energy metabolism.
description_zh_TW: Protein Turnover 是蛋白合成與分解之間的動態平衡，維持全身的 Proteostasis。由於每個肽鍵都消耗 ATP 當量，全體蛋白周轉的總速率是靜止能量代謝中一個有意義的組成部分。

label: 24(S)-Hydroxycholesterol
description: 24(S)-Hydroxycholesterol (24S-OHC) is the brain's principal cholesterol-clearance oxysterol and an endogenous ligand of the liver X receptors, driving reverse-cholesterol-transport genes such as ABCA1, ABCG1 and ApoE across the blood–brain barrier.
description_zh_TW: 24(S)-Hydroxycholesterol (24S-OHC) 是腦部主要的膽固醇清除 oxysterol，也是肝 X 受體的內源性配體，可誘發 ABCA1、ABCG1 與 ApoE 等逆向膽固醇運輸基因，作用可跨越血腦障壁。

label: Axon Degeneration
description: Axon Degeneration runs through a SARM1-dependent execution pathway: axonal injury causes NMNAT2 loss, the NMN/NAD+ ratio rises, SARM1 activates, NAD+ is catastrophically depleted, and energy failure produces fragmentation. Non-SARM1 routes such as Apoptosis or Autophagy-mediated pruning contribute in developmental and disease contexts.
description_zh_TW: Axon Degeneration 主要透過依賴 SARM1 的執行途徑進行：軸突損傷導致 NMNAT2 喪失，NMN／NAD+ 比值上升，SARM1 活化造成 NAD+ 災難性耗竭，導致能量衰竭與片段化。Apoptosis 或 Autophagy 介導的修剪等非 SARM1 途徑，則在發育與疾病情境中有所貢獻。

label: Chlorpromazine
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Chlorpromazine, the first antipsychotic phenothiazine, acts primarily as a D2 receptor antagonist, blocking central dopamine D2 signaling; at higher receptor occupancy it also blocks histamine H1, muscarinic, and alpha-adrenergic receptors, producing antipsychotic, sedating, and antiemetic effects plus mild MAO inhibition.
description_zh_TW: Chlorpromazine（首個抗精神病藥 phenothiazine）主要作為 D2 receptor 拮抗劑，阻斷中樞 dopamine D2 訊號；在較高受體佔有率下亦阻斷 histamine H1、muscarinic 與 alpha-腎上腺素受體，產生抗精神病、鎮靜、止吐作用及輕微的 MAO 抑制。

label: CCL2
description: MMP-12 processes the CC chemokines CCL2, CCL7, CCL8 and CCL13 into CCR antagonists, which dampens monocyte recruitment and makes this chemokine-processing activity central to MMP-12's role in resolving inflammation.
description_zh_TW: MMP-12 將 CC 趨化因子 CCL2、CCL7、CCL8 與 CCL13 加工成 CCR 拮抗劑，因而抑制單核細胞招募，使此趨化因子加工活性成為 MMP-12 在發炎消退中角色的核心。

label: BubR1
description: BUBR1 KEN-box sequesters CDC20 in the mitotic checkpoint complex.
description_zh_TW: BUBR1 KEN-box 在有絲分裂檢查點複合體隔離 CDC20。

label: JAK-STAT Signaling
description: SOCS3 is a classic negative-feedback regulator of cytokine signaling. It is itself induced downstream of JAK/STAT3 activity and then feeds back to inhibit JAK/STAT signaling, including potent attenuation of interferon-gamma and IL-6 responses, acting through its central SH2 domain on phosphorylated receptor tyrosines.
description_zh_TW: SOCS3 是細胞激素訊息傳遞的典型負回饋調節因子。它本身由 JAK/STAT3 活性下游誘導，接著回頭抑制 JAK/STAT 訊息傳遞，包括對 interferon-gamma 與 IL-6 反應的強烈削弱；其作用經由中央 SH2 結構域辨識受體上的磷酸化酪胺酸殘基。

label: Metabolic Flexibility
description: SIRT1 is the primary driver of Metabolic Flexibility: it deacetylates PGC-1α to drive mitochondrial biogenesis and oxidative capacity, promotes fatty acid oxidation via PGC-1α and PPARα, and suppresses lipogenesis via SREBP-1c. During energy deprivation this shifts cells from glucose utilization toward increased fatty acid oxidation and mitochondrial respiration.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 是推動 Metabolic Flexibility 的主要因子：它使 PGC-1α 去乙醯化以驅動粒線體生成與氧化能力，經由 PGC-1α 與 PPARα 促進脂肪酸氧化，並透過 SREBP-1c 抑制脂肪生成。在能量不足時，這會使細胞由利用葡萄糖轉向提高脂肪酸氧化與粒線體呼吸。

label: Taurine
description: Taurine directly scavenges Hypochlorous Acid (HOCl), forming the more stable taurine chloramine — a relatively long-lived mediator that modulates macrophage function and limits oxidative tissue damage during Inflammation. It also buffers hypochlorous acid generated by Myeloperoxidase in the Respiratory Burst, protecting proteins, lipids, and DNA.
description_zh_TW: Taurine 可直接清除 Hypochlorous Acid (HOCl)，形成較穩定的 taurine chloramine——一種相對長壽命的介導物，可調節巨噬細胞功能並在 Inflammation 期間限制氧化性組織損傷。它也能緩衝 Myeloperoxidase 在 Respiratory Burst 中生成的次氯酸，保護蛋白質、脂質與 DNA。

label: Insulin Secretion
description: In pancreatic beta-cells, GDH activity is a central regulator of amino-acid-stimulated insulin secretion, providing an amino-acid-sensing branch independent of glucose. Its inhibition by SIRT4 mono-ADP-ribosylation suppresses this insulin output, linking mitochondrial sirtuin signaling to glucose handling.
description_zh_TW: 在胰腺 β 細胞中，GDH 活性是胺基酸刺激的胰島素分泌的核心調節者，提供獨立於葡萄糖的胺基酸感應分支。SIRT4 的單 ADP-核糖基化對其的抑制會抑制此胰島素輸出，將粒線體 sirtuin 信號與葡萄糖處理聯繫起來。

label: ELK1
description: ELK1 is the founding member of the ternary complex factor subfamily of ETS-domain transcription factors, alongside ELK3 and ELK4 (SAP-1), and is a major nuclear target of the RAS-MAPK/ERK cascade that controls immediate-early gene expression. In the context of sirtuin biology it serves as the canonical reference for the ETS-TCF family whose member ELK4 stabilizes SIRT7 at target promoters. Directionally, ELK1's ETS DNA-binding domain and SRF-coupling architecture are shared by the TCF family, informing how ELK4 anchors SIRT7 to chromatin for H3K18 deacetylation.
description_zh_TW: ELK1 是 ETS 結構域轉錄因子三元複合物因子亞家族的創始成員，與 ELK3 和 ELK4（SAP-1）並列，是 RAS-MAPK/ERK 細胞階級傳導路徑的主要細胞核靶標，控制即早基因表達。在 sirtuin 生物學的背景下，它作為 ETS-TCF 家族的標準參考，其成員 ELK4 將 SIRT7 穩定於靶啟動子處。方向性上 ELK1 的 ETS DNA 結合結構域和 SRF 偶聯架構為 TCF 家族所共享，闡明了 ELK4 如何將 SIRT7 錨定到染色質上進行 H3K18 去乙醯化。

label: Stress-Induced Premature Senescence
description: SIPS is the acute stress-triggered subtype of senescence. Classification separates it from telomere-driven replicative senescence.
description_zh_TW: SIPS 是急性壓力觸發的衰老亞型。歸類將它與端粒驅動的複製性衰老分開。

label: Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor
description: The Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor (AhR) is a bHLH-PAS ligand-activated transcription factor that acts as a cytosolic sensor; Kynurenine, the Tryptophan metabolite generated by IDO1 and TDO, is its principal endogenous ligand. Ligand binding releases AhR from its HSP90/p23/XAP2 complex, drives nuclear translocation and heterodimerization with ARNT, and activates xenobiotic response element (XRE) transcription.
description_zh_TW: Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor (AhR) 是一種配體活化的 bHLH-PAS 轉錄因子，作為細胞質內的感測器；Kynurenine 是由 IDO1 與 TDO 產生的 Tryptophan 代謝物，也是其主要的內源性配體。配體結合使 AhR 從 HSP90/p23/XAP2 複合體釋放，驱动核轉位並與 ARNT 形成異二聚體，進而活化 XRE 相關的轉錄。

label: PDGFR
description: Alongside VEGFR and c-KIT, Sunitinib targets PDGFR as part of its multi-kinase profile. This breadth is what distinguishes it from single-target agents and underlies its use in GIST, where the driving mutation (typically KIT or PDGFRA) varies between tumours and a single-receptor inhibitor would leave many patients untreated.
description_zh_TW: 與 VEGFR 和 c-KIT 並列，Sunitinib 將 PDGFR 納入其多激酶標靶範圍。這種廣度正是它有別於單標靶藥物的特徵，也支撐其在 GIST 的用途——GIST 的驅動突變（通常為 KIT 或 PDGFRA）在腫瘤間各異，單一受體抑制劑將讓許多患者無藥可治。

label: OCP
description: The OCP was launched in 1974 by four United Nations agencies including the World Bank and was commanded by the World Health Organization. Its decades of safety and pharmacokinetic experience, together with successor programmes APOC and ONCHO, underpin contemporary investigations of ivermectin as an anti-cancer agent, and it demonstrated that community-directed treatment with ivermectin is logistically and economically viable.
description_zh_TW: OCP 於 1974 年由包括 World Bank 在內的四個聯合國機構發起，並由 World Health Organization 指揮。其數十年累積的安全與藥代動力學經驗，加上後繼的 APOC 與 ONCHO 計畫，構成了當代將 ivermectin 作為抗癌藥物研究的基礎；該計畫也證明了以 ivermectin 進行 community-directed treatment 在物流與經濟上可行。

label: Sepsis
description: SIRS criteria define the systemic inflammatory state that, when accompanied by infection, constitutes sepsis; sterile necroptotic DAMP release produces the same clinical syndrome.
description_zh_TW: SIRS 標準定義全身性發炎狀態，若伴隨感染即構成敗血症（sepsis）；無菌性 necroptotic DAMP 釋放可產生相同臨床症候群。

label: ribonucleotide reductase
description: Ribonucleotide reductase (RNR) is the only enzyme that catalyzes the de novo conversion of ribonucleoside diphosphates (NDPs) into deoxyribonucleoside diphosphates (dNDPs), the immediate precursors of the dNTPs required for DNA replication and repair. It is the rate-limiting, allosterically regulated committed step of de novo dNTP synthesis. dNTPs (dATP, dGTP, dCTP, dTTP) are the four deoxyribose building blocks of DNA, produced de novo by ribonucleotide reductase via reduction of NDPs to dNDPs followed by phosphorylation. RNR is the rate-limiting, allosterically committed step of this synthesis.
description_zh_TW: 核醣核苷酸還原酶（RNR）是唯一能催化核醣核苷二磷酸（NDP）de novo 轉化為去氧核醣核苷二磷酸（dNDP）的酵素，dNDP 是 DNA 複製與修復所需 dNTP 的直接前驅物。它是 de novo dNTP 合成中受別構調控、速率限制的承諾步驟。 dNTP（dATP、dGTP、dCTP、dTTP）是 DNA 的四種去氧核糖建構單元，由核醣核苷酸還原酶將 NDP 還原為 dNDP 再經磷酸化而 de novo 合成。RNR 是此合成中速率限制、別構承諾的步驟。

label: Neurogenesis
description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) enhances neurogenesis while reducing neurodegenerative pathology in Alzheimer's disease models. NR treatment increased neurogenesis by almost 20% and simultaneously reduced neuroinflammation, apoptosis of hippocampal neurons, phosphorylated Tau, and DNA damage. These effects protect cognitive function, synaptic plasticity, learning, memory, and motor function in animal models. The mechanisms are attributed to NR raising NAD+ levels, which sustains sirtuin activity and mitochondrial gene expression, and reducing the beta-amyloid burden. This positions NR as a promising NAD+ precursor for counteracting the neuronal loss and cognitive decline associated with aging and Alzheimer's disease.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）在阿茲海默症模型中促進神經發生，同時減少神經退化性病理變化。NR 治療使神經發生增加近 20%，並同時減少神經發炎、海馬神經元凋亡、磷酸化 Tau 以及 DNA 損傷。這些效應在動物模型中保護認知功能、突觸可塑性、學習、記憶與運動功能。其機制歸因於 NR 提升 NAD+ 濃度，進而維持 sirtuin 活性與粒線體基因表現，並減少 beta-amyloid 負擔。這使 NR 成為一種具潛力的 NAD+ 前體，可用於對抗與老化及阿茲海默症相關的神經元喪失與認知衰退。

label: HIF-2α
description: HIF-2α is deacetylated by SIRT1, which modulates the oxygen-regulated transcription factor's output under hypoxia.
