Alongside HIF-1α, HIF-2α (EPAS1) controls hypoxic gene programs, and its SIRT1-dependent deacetylation extends the sirtuin network's transcriptional reach beyond the better-characterized HIF-1α axis.
description_zh_TW: HIF-2α 被 SIRT1 去乙醯化，進而調節這個受氧調控的轉錄因子在缺氧下的輸出。HIF-2α（EPAS1）與 HIF-1α 一同控制缺氧基因程式，其依賴 SIRT1 的去乙醯化使 sirtuin 網路的轉錄調控範圍超越較被深入研究的 HIF-1α 軸。

label: Arterial Stiffness
description: Arterial stiffness is the loss of elastic compliance in large conduit arteries, chiefly the aorta and carotid, and is a hallmark of vascular aging: aortic pulse wave velocity roughly doubles between ages 20 and 70, with acceleration after 50-60. It is an independent predictor of cardiovascular events, all-cause mortality and heart failure with preserved ejection fraction, and increased pulsatile microvascular stress contributes to cognitive decline, kidney disease and hypertension.
description_zh_TW: Arterial stiffness 是大型導管動脈（主要是主動脈與頸動脈）彈性顺应性的喪失，是血管老化的特徵：主動脈脈搏波速度在 20 至 70 歲之間約增加一倍，並在 50–60 歲後加速。它是心血管事件、全因死亡與保留射血分數心衰竭的獨立預測因子，而微血管脈衝壓力增加則促成認知衰退、腎臟疾病與高血壓。

label: Platelet aggregation
description: Resveratrol inhibits platelet aggregation, reducing thrombotic risk and complementing its vascular benefits. Directionally, resveratrol sits upstream of suppressed platelet activation. This also creates a bleeding-risk caveat when combined with anticoagulants such as heparin or warfarin, since the anti-platelet effect adds to the anticoagulant's action. It is one of several anti-atherothrombotic actions of the compound, alongside its vasodilatory and anti-inflammatory effects. Clinicians therefore advise caution in anticoagulated patients, and the platelet effect is considered when assessing resveratrol's overall cardiovascular profile.
description_zh_TW: Resveratrol 抑制血小板聚集，降低血栓形成風險並補充其血管益處。在方向性上，resveratrol 位於抑制血小板活化的上游。這在與肝素或華法林等抗凝血劑合用時也產生出血風險的警告，因為抗血小板效應會增添抗凝血劑的作用。這是該化合物的多種抗動脈粥樣硬化血栓作用之一，與其血管舒張和抗發炎效應並存。因此，臨床醫師建議在抗凝患者中謹慎使用，在評估 resveratrol 整體心血管特徵時會考慮血小板效應。

label: TDR
description: TDR is a component_of the World Health Organization system: it was established in 1975 and is co-sponsored by WHO together with UNICEF, UNDP, the World Bank and formerly the Rockefeller Foundation, with the mandate of building an evidence base for control, elimination and eradication of neglected tropical diseases.
description_zh_TW: TDR 是 World Health Organization 體系的一環：它成立於 1975 年，由 WHO 與 UNICEF、UNDP、世界銀行及（前）洛克菲勒基金會共同資助，使命是為熱帶疾病的控制、消除與根除建立證據基礎。

label: Sodium Potassium ATPase
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: The Na+/K+ pump hydrolyzes one ATP per cycle to transport three Na+ out and two K+ into the cell, maintaining the electrochemical gradient across the plasma membrane that underlies resting membrane potential, action potential propagation and secondary active transport.
description_zh_TW: Na+/K+ 幫浦每個循環水解一個 ATP，將三個 Na+ 運出細胞、兩個 K+ 運入細胞，藉此維持細胞膜上的電化學梯度，而此梯度正是靜止膜電位、動作電位傳導與次級主動運輸的基礎。

label: Bcl-w
description: Bad binds Bcl-w. Bad is a BH3-only protein whose survival-factor-responsive phosphorylation controls its binding to Bcl-xL/Bcl-w and thereby the death threshold. Bcl-w is an anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family member overexpressed in several carcinomas and hematologic malignancies where it blunts chemotherapy-induced death. The relationship is directional, with Bad acting as the operative agent upon Bcl-w rather than the reverse. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
description_zh_TW: Bad 綁定 Bcl-w。 Bad 是一種僅含有 BH3 的蛋白質，其生存因子反應性磷酸化控制其與 Bcl-xL/Bcl-w 的結合，從而控制死亡閾值。 Bcl-w 是一種抗凋亡 Bcl-2 family 成員，在多種癌症和血液惡性腫瘤中過度表達，可減少化療引起的死亡。這種關係是有方向的，Bad 充當 Bcl-w 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

label: SA-beta-gal
description: Lysosomal beta-galactosidase at pH 6.0 is the standard biomarker reporting replicative senescent burden. Characterization, not causation.
description_zh_TW: pH 6.0 的溶酶體 beta-galactosidase 是報告複製性衰老負擔的標準生物標記。是特徵描述而非因果。

label: Iduna
description: Iduna (RNF146) is a PAR-dependent E3 ubiquitin ligase whose WWE domain binds the iso-ADP-ribose linkage of PAR; it ubiquitinates the PARylated linker histone H1.2, tagging this PAR carrier for proteasomal degradation and blocking poly(ADP-ribose) nuclear export (Andrabi 2011; Kang 2011).
description_zh_TW: Iduna（RNF146）是依賴 PAR 的 E3 泛素連接酶，其 WWE 結構域結合 PAR 的 iso-ADP-ribose 連結；它泛素化受 PAR 修飾的連結組蛋白 H1.2，將此 PAR 載體標記以進行蛋白酶體降解，並阻斷聚(ADP-核糖)的核輸出（Andrabi 2011；Kang 2011）。

label: mitoZFNs
description: mitoZFNs (mitochondria-targeted zinc finger nucleases) were the first mtDNA-editing platform demonstrated in mammalian cells. Each monomer fuses tandem Cys2-His2 zinc fingers (recognizing 3-6 bp each) with the FokI cleavage domain, giving single-nucleotide discrimination: pathogenic mutations create allele-specific recognition sites so the mutant molecule is preferentially cleaved and degraded while wild-type mtDNA survives and repopulates the organelle.
description_zh_TW: mitoZFNs（粒線體定位的鋅指核酸酶）是首個在哺乳類細胞中證明的 mtDNA 編輯平台。每個單體將串聯的 Cys2-His2 鋅指（每個辨識 3–6 bp）與 FokI 切割域融合，達成單一核苷酸的鑑別：致病突變會創造等位專一的辨識位點，使突變分子被偏好切割與降解，而野生型 mtDNA 則存活並重新填充胞器。

label: Superoxide
description: High-output nitric oxide from iNOS reacts with superoxide to form peroxynitrite, causing collateral nitrative tissue damage. This is a functional trade-off of innate immune defense: the same NO burst that kills intracellular pathogens also generates a reactive secondary species that injures host tissue when NO output is excessive.
description_zh_TW: iNOS 產生的高產量 nitric oxide 會與 superoxide 反應形成 peroxynitrite，造成附帶的硝基化組織損傷。這是先天免疫防禦的功能性代價：殺死細胞內病原體的同一 NO 爆發，在 NO 輸出過量時也會產生傷害宿主組織的活性次級產物。

label: Multiple Myeloma
description: Multiple Myeloma is a malignancy of terminally differentiated B lymphocytes (plasma cells) that accumulate in the bone marrow, produce a monoclonal immunoglobulin M-protein and cause end-organ damage (CRAB criteria), making it the second most common hematologic malignancy.
description_zh_TW: Multiple Myeloma 是終末分化 B 淋巴球（漿細胞）的惡性腫瘤，腫瘤細胞在骨髓累積、產生單株免疫球蛋白（M-protein）並造成 CRAB 標準所列的臟器損傷，是第二常見的血液腫瘤。

label: Polyol Pathway
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: The two-enzyme glucose to sorbitol to fructose route produces fructose, setting the advanced glycation feed rate. Sorbitol dehydrogenase closes the pathway output.
description_zh_TW: 葡萄糖到山梨醇到果糖的雙酶路徑產生果糖，設定晚期糖化供養速率。山梨醇脫氫酶關閉路徑輸出。

label: Secondary Necrosis
description: Secondary Necrosis is a variant of Necrosis in which the plasma membrane ruptures only after the apoptotic program has already run to completion, in cells or Apoptotic Bodies that were never cleared by phagocytic efferocytosis — the standard outcome in cell culture lacking phagocytes. Because the resulting DAMP release and sterile inflammation are indistinguishable from primary necrosis, late timepoints of a 'apoptosis' assay frequently report secondary necrosis rather than the intended outcome.
description_zh_TW: Secondary Necrosis 是 Necrosis 的一種變體：細胞凋亡程序已經完成後，未被吞噬清除的細胞或 Apoptotic Bodies 才喪失細胞膜完整性——這是在缺乏吞噬細胞的細胞培養中的標準結果。由於其釋放 DAMP 與引發無菌性發炎的表現與原發性壞死無法區分，凋亡實驗的晚期時間點經常測到的是 secondary necrosis 而非預期結果。

label: Histone Modification
description: Histone Methylation is a Histone Modification in which methyl groups are added to lysine or arginine residues on histone tails. Unlike acetylation it does not change histone charge; instead it creates docking sites for 'reader' proteins, and its transcriptional consequence depends on the residue and the number of methyl groups (mono-, di-, tri-methylation).
description_zh_TW: Histone Methylation 是一類 Histone Modification，將甲基加到組蛋白尾端的離胺酸或精胺酸殘基上。與乙醯化不同，它不改變組蛋白的電荷，而是創造讓「讀取者」蛋白質停靠的位點；其對轉錄的影響取決於殘基種類與甲基數目（單甲基、二甲基、三甲基）。

label: Prostaglandins
description: Prostaglandins are 20-carbon lipid autacoids derived from Arachidonic acid released from membrane phospholipids by cytosolic phospholipase A2, then oxidized in two steps by COX-1 or COX-2 to Prostaglandin G2 and the reduced endoperoxide Prostaglandin H2. PGH2 is the common precursor converted by terminal synthases into PGE2, PGD2, PGF2alpha, Prostacyclin and Thromboxane A2, giving the family its roles in pain, fever, vascular tone, gastric protection and platelet function.
description_zh_TW: Prostaglandins 是 20 碳脂質 autacoids，源自由 cytosolic phospholipase A2 從膜磷脂釋出的 Arachidonic acid，再由 COX-1 或 COX-2 兩步氧化成 Prostaglandin G2 與還原後的 endoperoxide Prostaglandin H2。PGH2 是共同前驅物，經末端合成酶轉為 PGE2、PGD2、PGF2alpha、Prostacyclin 與 Thromboxane A2，使這一族在疼痛、發燒、血管張力、胃黏膜保護與血小板功能中扮演角色。

label: Hutchinson-Gilford Progeria Syndrome
description: Hutchinson-Gilford Progeria Syndrome is caused by a sporadic de novo mutation in the LMNA gene, which alters the protein Lamin A to produce progerin. Progerin remains permanently attached to the nuclear membrane, causing the nucleus to become misshapen and disorganized — the primary driver of the disease's accelerated-aging phenotype.
description_zh_TW: Hutchinson-Gilford Progeria Syndrome 由 LMNA 基因的偶發性新生突變引起，該突變使蛋白 Lamin A 改變而產生 progerin。Progerin 永久附著於核膜，使細胞核變形且構造混亂——這是此病加速衰老表型的主要驅動因素。

label: DNA Damage Response
description: Senescence in adult tissues can be triggered by a persistent DNA damage response (DDR) induced by various internal and external factors, including oncogenic activation, oxidative and genotoxic stress, mitochondrial dysfunction, irradiation, and chemotherapy. A sustained DDR enforces a permanent proliferation arrest and drives the senescence-associated secretory phenotype. This link between DNA damage signaling and senescence makes the DDR a central mechanism by which genotoxic stress contributes to aging.
description_zh_TW: 成人組織中的 Senescence 可由各種內部和外部因素誘導的持續 DNA 損傷反應 (DDR) 觸發，包括致癌活化、氧化和基因毒性壓力、粒線體功能障礙、輻射和化療。持續的 DDR 會強制永久抑制增殖並驅動老化相關的分泌表型。 DNA 損傷訊號傳導與老化之間的這種連結使 DDR 成為基因毒性壓力導致老化的核心機制。

label: KDM5C
description: KDM5C (JARID1C) is an X-linked JmjC-domain histone demethylase whose catalytic domain removes the trimethyl and dimethyl marks on histone H3 lysine 4, converting H3K4me3 to H3K4me2 to H3K4me1. By erasing this activating mark at target promoters it represses transcription, and its PHD3 zinc finger reads H3K4me3 to create an auto-inhibitory feedback loop. Loss of KDM5C causes aberrant H3K4me3 accumulation at oncogene and developmental gene promoters.
description_zh_TW: KDM5C（JARID1C）是一種 X 連鎖的 JmjC 結構域組蛋白去甲基化酶，其催化結構域可移除組蛋白 H3 離胺酸 4 上的三甲基與二甲基標記，將 H3K4me3 轉為 H3K4me2 再轉為 H3K4me1。透過擦除目標啟動子上的活化性標記，它抑制轉錄；其 PHD3 鋅指可讀取 H3K4me3，形成自我抑制的回饋迴路。KDM5C 缺失會造成致癌基因與發育相關基因啟動子上 H3K4me3 異常累積。

label: UCP2
description: UCP2 is a ~33 kDa inner mitochondrial membrane carrier that transports protons back into the matrix, dissipating the electrochemical gradient; by lowering the proton-motive force it reduces electron leakage and ROS production at complex I and III, at the cost of reduced ATP yield.
description_zh_TW: UCP2 是約 33 kDa 的粒線體內膜載體，將質子運回基質並消散電化學梯度；藉由降低質子動力勢，它減少 complex I 與 III 的電子洩漏與 ROS 產生，代價則是 ATP 產量下降。

label: α-tubulin
description: SIRT2 is the predominantly cytoplasmic sirtuin and the major deacetylase of alpha-tubulin. By removing acetyl groups it tunes microtubule dynamics, cytoskeleton organization and mitotic fidelity, with activity peaking at the G2/M transition to support chromosome condensation and segregation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 是主要位於細胞質的 sirtuin，也是 α-tubulin 的主要去乙醯化酶。藉由移除乙醯基，它調節微管動態、細胞骨架組織與有絲分裂的準確性，其活性在 G2/M 轉換期達到高峰，以支持染色質濃縮與正確分離。

label: Antigen Presentation
description: Antigen Presentation and Major histocompatibility complex class I are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Antigen Presentation and Major histocompatibility complex class I may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Antigen Presentation 和 Major histocompatibility complex class I 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Antigen Presentation 和 Major histocompatibility complex class I 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Racemization
description: Because Lens Crystallins are effectively permanent, their residues spontaneously racemize over decades. This non-enzymatic Racemization is a pure chemical clock on protein age that is independent of any enzymatic turnover.
description_zh_TW: 由於 Lens Crystallins（水晶蛋白）實質上是永久性的，其殘基會在數十年內自發地發生外消旋。這種非酵素性的 Racemization（外消旋）是獨立於任何酵素周轉的純化學蛋白年齡時鐘。

label: Actin
description: Caspase-3 cleaves actin networks during Apoptosis, dismantling the cytoskeleton and contributing to the characteristic morphological collapse of the dying cell. Actin fragmentation by caspase-3 is a late but central execution step of apoptosis.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-3 在 Apoptosis 過程中切割 actin 網絡，拆解細胞骨架並促成死亡細胞特有的形態崩解。actin 遭 caspase-3 碎裂是凋亡後期但關鍵的執行步驟。

label: Adrenochrome Pathway
description: COMT inhibition promotes the adrenochrome pathway by allowing epinephrine (and its oxidation product adrenochrome) to accumulate when O-methylation is impaired, shifting catecholamine disposition away from metanephrine formation. Adrenochrome is an auto-oxidation and cyclization product of epinephrine that has been speculated to contribute to psychoactive and neurotoxic effects, though human relevance remains debated. The association is plausible mechanistically but less well established than the rise in epinephrine itself.
description_zh_TW: 當 O-甲基化受損時，COMT 抑製作用允許腎上腺素（及其氧化產物腎上腺素紅）積累，從而促進腎上腺素紅途徑，從而使兒茶酚胺的配置遠離變腎上腺素的形成。 Adrenochrome 是腎上腺素的自動氧化和環化產物，據推測會導致精神活性和神經毒性作用，但與人類的相關性仍存在爭議。這種關聯在機制上是合理的，但不如腎上腺素本身的增加那麼明確。

label: Cytochrome P450
description: Hepatic cytochrome P450 enzymes contribute to resveratrol catabolism, alongside phase-II conjugation, determining its metabolic fate. Directionally, CYP enzymes sit upstream of resveratrol clearance. This hepatic handling caps bioavailability, and it is relevant to drug-drug interactions and dosing, since resveratrol both is metabolized by and inhibits cytochrome P450 activity. The combination of rapid conjugation and CYP-mediated oxidation explains resveratrol's short half-life. Because resveratrol can both be metabolized by and inhibit CYP enzymes, co-administered drugs may see altered clearance, a clinically important consideration for supplementation.
description_zh_TW: 肝臟細胞色素 P450 酶參與 resveratrol 的分解代謝，與第二相結合作用共同決定其代謝命運。在方向性上，CYP 酶位於 resveratrol 清除的上游。這種肝臟處理限制了生物利用度，與藥物-藥物相互作用和劑量相關，因為 resveratrol 既被細胞色素 P450 代謝也抑制其活性。快速結合作用與 CYP 介導的氧化的結合解釋了 resveratrol 的短半衰期。由於 resveratrol 可以既被 CYP 酶代謝又抑制其活性，合併用藥可能看到清除率改變，這是補充劑使用中臨床重要的考量。

label: CEBPβ
description: C/EBPbeta is one of the two principal transcription factors driving the inflammatory SASP, cooperating with NF-kB to activate CXCR2-ligand genes including IL-8. Loss of C/EBPbeta together with NF-kB reduces IL-8 and other chemokine receptor ligands and also impairs the growth arrest that defines oncogene-induced senescence, indicating that this transcription factor sits at the intersection of the arrest and secretory programmes. In the SASP-induction scheme C/EBPbeta occupies the transcription-factor tier alongside NF-kB, STAT and GATA4, and it is the target through which Notch modulates the late SASP.
description_zh_TW: C/EBPbeta 是驅動發炎型 SASP 的兩大主要轉錄因子之一，與 NF-kB 協同活化包括 IL-8 在內的 CXCR2 配體基因。C/EBPbeta 與 NF-kB 同時缺失會降低 IL-8 及其他趨化激素受體配體，並損害定義癌基因誘導衰老的生長停滯，顯示此轉錄因子位於停滯與分泌程序的交會處。在 SASP 誘導架構圖中，C/EBPbeta 與 NF-kB、STAT、GATA4 同處轉錄因子層，也是 Notch 調節晚期 SASP 的作用靶點。

label: Luteoloside
description: Luteoloside lowers oxidative stress by reducing ROS, opposing the mitochondrial dysfunction/ROS/SASP axis implicated in idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis.
description_zh_TW: Luteoloside 藉由降低 ROS 減少氧化壓力，從而對抗參與特發性肺纖維化的粒線體功能失調／ROS／SASP 軸。

label: IL-12
description: IL-12 is the primary cytokine driving Th1 differentiation: it activates STAT4 in naive CD4+ T cells, induces the master Th1 transcription factor T-bet, and simultaneously suppresses Th2 and Th17 polarization.
description_zh_TW: IL-12 是驅動 Th1 分化最主要的細胞激素：它在初始 CD4+ T 細胞中活化 STAT4、誘導 Th1 譜系的主轉錄因子 T-bet，並同時抑制 Th2 與 Th17 極化。

label: RANK
description: RANK (TNFRSF11A) is the cell-surface receptor whose ligand is RANKL. Ligand engagement of RANK recruits NF-kB and MAPK signalling machinery, driving osteoclast differentiation from monocyte/macrophage precursors and, downstream, MAPK-dependent phosphorylation and activation of TFE3 (Hershey & Fisher 2004).
description_zh_TW: RANK (TNFRSF11A) 是細胞表面受體，其配體為 RANKL。RANKL 結合 RANK 後招募 NF-κB 與 MAPK 訊息傳遞機制，驅動單核／巨噬細胞前驅細胞分化為 Osteoclast，並在下游經由 MAPK 依賴性的磷酸化活化 TFE3（Hershey & Fisher 2004）。

label: Osteoporosis
description: In bone, senescent cells secrete Interleukin-11 to activate STAT3 in osteoblasts, suppressing bone formation and shifting the osteoblast/osteoclast balance toward resorption — the senescence-associated osteokine loop that drives age-related bone loss.
description_zh_TW: 在骨骼中，衰老細胞分泌 Interleukin-11 以活化骨母細胞中的 STAT3，抑制骨形成並將骨母細胞／破骨細胞平衡轉向骨吸收，即造成年齡相關骨流失的衰老相關骨細胞激素迴路。

label: Camptothecin
description: Camptothecin traps the Topo I-DNA cleavage complex as the class mechanism. Complements the existing FL118-Topo-I edge.
description_zh_TW: Camptothecin 捕獲 Topo I-DNA 切割複合體作為類別機制。補充既有的 FL118-Topo-I 邊。

label: Free Radicals
description: Cigarette smoke contains free radicals, including semiquinone radicals, hydroxyl radicals, and nitric oxide, plus a large burden of gaseous and particulate oxidants. These directly and indirectly raise lung oxidant load. The directionality is smoke-derived radicals to tissue oxidation. A caveat is that the tar-phase semiquinones can redox-cycle and generate sustained ROS long after exposure, so the effect outlasts the inhaled puff. Both the gas phase and tar phase carry oxidants, and the balance between oxidant load and lung antioxidant capacity determines tissue damage.
description_zh_TW: Cigarette smoke 包含 free radicals，包括半醌自由基、hydroxyl radicals 和 nitric oxide，以及大量氣態和顆粒氧化劑。這些直接和間接地增加了肺的氧化負荷。方向性是煙霧衍生的自由基對組織的氧化。需要注意的是，焦油相半醌在暴露後很長一段時間內可以進行氧化還原循環並產生持續的 ROS，因此其效果比吸入的煙霧更持久。氣相和焦油相均攜帶氧化劑，氧化劑負荷與肺抗氧化能力之間的平衡決定了組織損傷。

label: NOX2
description: NOX2 deficiency causes chronic granulomatous disease, a group of genetic defects in NOX2 (gp91phox) subunits that abolish the phagocyte respiratory burst. Patients suffer recurrent, life-threatening bacterial and fungal infections due to failure to generate microbicidal ROS. The directionality is enzyme defect to immunodeficiency. A caveat is that the disease severity varies with the specific mutation and residual oxidase activity, and some organisms evade even normal ROS killing. X-linked CGD from CYBB mutations is most common, and patients show granuloma formation, colitis-like inflammation, and susceptibility to catalase-positive organisms.
description_zh_TW: NOX2 缺陷會導致 chronic granulomatous disease，這是 NOX2 (gp91phox) 亞基中的一組遺傳缺陷，可消除吞噬細胞 respiratory burst。由於無法產生殺菌劑 ROS，患者會重複遭受危及生命的細菌和真菌感染。方向性是酵素缺陷到免疫缺陷。需要注意的是，疾病的嚴重程度會隨著特定突變和殘留氧化酶活性的不同而變化，有些生物體甚至會逃避正常的 ROS 殺滅。 CYBB 突變導致的 X 連鎖 CGD 最為常見，患者表現出肉芽腫形成、結腸炎樣發炎以及對 catalase 陽性微生物的易感性。

label: FTSJ1
description: FTSJ1 installs the Um34 modification on tRNA[Ser]Sec, and this modification is necessary and sufficient for Metastatic colonization of Melanoma in vivo. By enabling efficient Selenocysteine insertion it sustains antioxidant selenoproteins such as GPX4 and thioredoxin reductase that buffer Reactive Oxygen Species, which identifies FTSJ1/Um34 as a metastasis-selective therapeutic target.
description_zh_TW: FTSJ1 在 tRNA[Ser]Sec 上加上 Um34 修飾，而此修飾在體內對 Melanoma 的 Metastatic colonization 而言既充分又必要。透過促進高效的 Selenocysteine 插入，它維持 GPX4 與 thioredoxin reductase 等抗氧化 selenoprotein 以緩衝 Reactive Oxygen Species，因此 FTSJ1/Um34 被視為轉移選擇性的治療標的。

label: Dysbiosis
description: In the human Gut Microbiome, Proteobacteria normally occupy a minor niche, but their relative abundance expands during Dysbiosis — a state linked to antibiotic use, inflammation and metabolic disruption. Centenarians and healthy-aging cohorts instead show lower Proteobacteria loads and richer beneficial taxa, making the phylum a useful dysbiosis marker.
description_zh_TW: 在人類 Gut Microbiome 中，Proteobacteria 正常情況下佔minor生態位，但其相對豐度會在 Dysbiosis 期間擴增——此狀態與抗生素使用、發炎及代謝失衡相關。相對地，百歲老人與健康老化群體呈現較低的 Proteobacteria 負荷與較豐富的有益菌群，使該菌門成為有用的失調指標。

label: LPS
description: LPS activates the NLRP3 inflammasome, which processes pro-IL-1beta into its mature form via caspase-1 cleavage, adding a second layer of innate immune activation critical to the hyperinflammatory state of sepsis. Together with MyD88-dependent and TRIF-dependent TLR4 signalling to NF-κB and IRF3, this drives release of TNFα, IL-1beta, IL-6 and inducible COX-2 and iNOS.
description_zh_TW: LPS 會活化 NLRP3 inflammasome，透過 caspase-1 切割將 pro-IL-1β 加工為成熟形式，提供了對敗血症高發炎狀態至關重要的第二層先天免疫活化。此作用與經 MyD88 依賴性及 TRIF 依賴性 TLR4 訊號傳至 NF-κB 與 IRF3 共同驅動 TNFα、IL-1β、IL-6 以及誘導型 COX-2 與 iNOS 的釋放。

label: Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway
description: Apoptosis has the pathway Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. The endoplasmic-reticulum stress pathway of apoptosis is initiated by unfolded-protein accumulation and engages CHOP and caspase-12. The relationship is directional, with Apoptosis acting as the operative agent upon Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway rather than the reverse. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: Apoptosis 有路徑 Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。細胞凋亡的內質網壓力途徑由未折疊蛋白累積啟動，並參與 CHOP 和 caspase-12。這種關係是有方向的，Apoptosis 充當 Endoplasmic Reticulum Pathway 的操作主體，而不是相反。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: p43-FLIP
description: p43-FLIP is the 43 kDa N-terminal fragment generated when caspase-8 cleaves FLIP_L at Asp376 (Asp377 in mouse) during the first, interdimer processing step at the DISC. It retains both DEDs plus the large pseudo-caspase subunit but lacks any catalytic cysteine, so it cannot cut procaspase-8's DED2-p18 linker - which is why the heterodimer never completes intradimer processing.
description_zh_TW: p43-FLIP 是在 DISC 上第一個分子間加工步驟中，caspase-8 切割 FLIP_L 於 Asp376（小鼠為 Asp377）時產生的 43 kDa N 端片段。它保留兩個 DED 加上大型偽 caspase 次單元，但缺乏任何催化性半胱胺酸，因此無法切割 procaspase-8 的 DED2–p18 連接段——這正是該異源二聚體永遠無法完成分子內加工的原因。

label: Peroxiredoxin
description: Peroxiredoxins are thiol-dependent peroxidases that detoxify hydrogen peroxide, peroxynitrite, and a range of organic hydroperoxides, reducing them to water. They are among the most abundant antioxidant proteins in the cell and act as primary H2O2 sinks and refined regulators of redox signaling.
description_zh_TW: 過氧化還原酶是依賴硫醇的過氧化酶，可將過氧化氫、過氧亞硝酸鹽及多種有機氫過氧化物解毒並還原為水。它們是細胞中最豐富的抗氧化蛋白之一，既是主要的 H2O2 匯集處，也是氧化還原訊息傳遞的精細調節者。

label: Sister Chromatids
description: The cohesin ring complex holds sister chromatids together from replication to anaphase. Maintenance is the canonical ring function; canonical filename used.
description_zh_TW: cohesin 環複合體從複製到後期將姐妹染色單體繫在一起。維持是典型的環功能；使用典型檔名。

label: NMRK2
description: NMRK2 (nicotinamide ribose kinase 2) converts nicotinamide riboside (NR) to nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) using only a single molecule of ATP, whereas synthesis of NMN from nicotinamide by NAMPT requires more than three ATP equivalents. This makes the NMRK2 pathway an energy-sparing mechanism that may be favored in the failing heart, where the shift from NAMPT to NMRK2 for NAD+ synthesis represents a common adaptive response. NR is expressed and active mainly in cardiac and skeletal muscle, which may explain the better ability of these tissues to respond to NR. NR supplementation is therefore regarded as a powerful approach to preserve cardiac function in heart failure.
description_zh_TW: NMRK2（nicotinamide ribose kinase 2，菸鹼醯胺核糖激酶 2）僅需單一分子的 ATP 即可將 nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）轉化為 nicotinamide mononucleotide（NMN，菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸），而 NAMPT 由菸鹼醯胺合成 NMN 則需要超過三個 ATP 當量。這使得 NMRK2 路徑成為一種節能機制，可能在衰竭的心臟中受到偏好，因為在該處由 NAMPT 轉向 NMRK2 進行 NAD+ 合成代表一種常見的適應性反應。NR 主要在心肌與骨骼肌中表現並具活性，這或許解釋了這些組織對 NR 較佳的反應能力。因此，NR 補充被視為維持心衰竭中心臟功能的有力方法。

label: GLUT4
description: Impaired GLUT4 translocation or expression — driven by obesity, ectopic lipid accumulation and inflammation — produces insulin resistance and type 2 diabetes, making GLUT4 trafficking a cornerstone target of metabolic therapy.
description_zh_TW: GLUT4 轉位或表現受損——由肥胖、異位脂肪累積與發炎所驅動——會造成 insulin resistance 與第二型糖尿病，因此 GLUT4 的運輸是代謝治療的核心標的。

label: Myddosome
description: Through IRAK1/TRAF6/TAK1 and IKK, the myddosome drives NF-kB nuclear translocation and SASP gene transcription. This output links IL-1α sensing to the inflammatory secretome in senescence.
description_zh_TW: 經由 IRAK1/TRAF6/TAK1 與 IKK，myddosome 驅動 NF-κB 核轉位與 SASP 基因轉錄。此輸出將 IL-1α 感知連結到衰老中的發炎分泌組。

label: Isoleucine
description: Isoleucine is one of the three branched-chain amino acids and an essential amino acid that must be obtained from the diet; its catabolism yields acetyl-CoA and succinyl-CoA, which enter the TCA cycle.
description_zh_TW: Isoleucine 是三種支鏈胺基酸之一，也是必須由飲食取得的必需胺基酸；其分解代謝產生 acetyl-CoA 與 succinyl-CoA，進入 TCA cycle。

label: T Cell Receptor
description: The T Cell Receptor recognizes antigenic peptides only in the context of MHC molecules: TCR complementarity-determining regions engage peptide-MHC, Lck then phosphorylates CD3 ITAMs, and ZAP-70 with NF-AT, AP-1 and NF-κB downstream drive proliferation, cytokine production and effector differentiation.
description_zh_TW: T Cell Receptor 只能在 MHC 分子的脈絡中辨識抗原胜肽：TCR 的互補決定區與胜肽-MHC 結合後，Lck 磷酸化 CD3 的 ITAM，接著 ZAP-70 與下游的 NF-AT、AP-1、NF-κB 驅動增殖、細胞激素生成與效應分化。

label: Torin1
description: Torin1 is a potent, ATP-competitive and selective inhibitor of mTORC1 and mTORC2 used as a research tool for studying mTOR signaling. By blocking mTORC1 kinase activity it relieves the mTORC1-dependent suppression of autophagy, which is why Torin1 is widely used to probe mTOR-dependent autophagy and the CLEAR network.
description_zh_TW: Torin1 是一種強效、具 ATP 競爭性且選擇性的 mTORC1 與 mTORC2 抑制劑，作為研究 mTOR 訊號的工具藥。藉由阻斷 mTORC1 的激酶活性，它解除 mTORC1 對自噬的抑制，因此 Torin1 被廣泛用於研究 mTOR 依賴性自噬與 CLEAR 網絡。

label: Spinal Cord Injury (SCI)
description: Beyond the primary traumatic or ischemic insult, Spinal Cord Injury (SCI) triggers a secondary injury cascade in which oxidative stress, inflammation and neuronal/glial apoptosis act together below the lesion. This secondary wave of damage, rather than the initial trauma, drives much of the progressive functional loss seen after Spinal Cord Injury (SCI).
description_zh_TW: 除了原發的創傷或缺血傷害之外，Spinal Cord Injury (SCI) 還會觸發續發性損傷級聯反應，在病灶以下由 oxidative stress、inflammation 與神經元/膠細胞 apoptosis 共同作用。造成 Spinal Cord Injury (SCI) 後大部分進行性功能喪失的，正是這波續發性損傷，而非初始創傷。

label: MEF
description: Mouse embryonic fibroblasts (MEFs) are derived from knockout embryos and serve as an in vitro validation platform for knockout mouse phenotypes. Cultured from the same embryos, MEFs permit mechanistic follow-up of in vivo findings — for example testing whether a knocked-out gene's role in mitochondrial stress response or apoptosis is cell-autonomous.
description_zh_TW: 小鼠胚胎纖維母細胞（MEF）由敲除鼠胚胎取得，可作為敲除小鼠表型的體外驗證平台。由於與活體實驗取自相同胚胎，MEF 可對體內發現進行機制後續驗證，例如測試被敲除基因在粒線體壓力反應或凋亡中的角色是否為細胞自主性。

label: Starvation
description: NHR-49 is critical for the metabolic adaptation of C. elegans to starvation, driving the transcriptional program for fatty acid oxidation that supplies energy when nutrient intake ceases.
description_zh_TW: NHR-49 對 C. elegans 對 Starvation 的代謝適應至關重要，它驅動脂肪酸氧化的轉錄程序，在營養攝取停止時供應能量。

label: Brown Adipose Tissue
description: SIRT6 supports thermogenesis in brown and beige adipose tissue, which is induced under cold exposure, thereby contributing to energy expenditure and protection from obesity. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of thermogenic gene programs in brown adipose tissue. This pro-thermogenic role opposes SIRT7, which suppresses brown-adipose function, illustrating opposing actions within the sirtuin family on energy expenditure. By maintaining the capacity of brown and beige fat to burn calories, SIRT6 helps the body dissipate energy as heat rather than store it. Supporting SIRT6 activity is therefore considered a potential approach for counteracting weight gain and metabolic disease.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6支持棕色和米色脂肪組織中的生熱作用，該作用在冷暴露下被誘導，從而有助於能量消耗和對抗肥胖。方向上，SIRT6位於棕色脂肪組織中生熱基因程序的上游。此促生熱作用與抑制棕色脂肪功能的SIRT7相對抗，說明了sirtuin家族在能量消耗方面的對立作用。透過維持棕色和米色脂肪燃燒卡路里的能力，SIRT6幫助身體將能量以熱量形式散失而非儲存。因此支持SIRT6活性被認為是對抗體重增加和代謝疾病的潛在方法。

label: Epigenetic Alterations
description: The Horvath clock estimates chronological age from DNA methylation at 353 CpG sites with pan-tissue applicability. Its residuals reveal accelerated epigenetic aging in diseased tissues and associate with aging and epigenetic alterations.
description_zh_TW: Horvath 時鐘從 353 個 CpG 位點的 DNA 甲基化估算時間年齡，具有跨組織適用性。其殘差揭示疾病組織中的加速表觀遺傳老化，並與衰老及表觀遺傳改變相關。

label: Onchocerciasis
description: Onchocerca volvulus is the filarial nematode that causes onchocerciasis (river blindness), infecting about 21 million people with 99% of cases in 31 African countries. Adults coil in subcutaneous nodules (onchocercomata) while the first-stage larvae migrate through skin and eye tissues, and the parasite depends on obligate Wolbachia endosymbionts for survival, embryogenesis and fecundity.
description_zh_TW: Onchocerca volvulus 是造成 onchocerciasis（river blindness）的絲蟲線形蟲，全球約有 2100 萬人感染，其中 99% 集中於 31 個非洲國家。成蟲捲曲於皮下結節（onchocercoma）中，第一期幼蟲則在皮膚與眼部組織移行；此外此寄生蟲仰賴專性 Wolbachia 內共生菌才能存活、胚胎發育與繁殖。

label: CXCL11
description: CXCL11 (I-TAC) is an ELR- C-X-C chemokine and the most potent agonist of CXCR3, also binding CXCR7 as an atypical scavenger/decoy receptor. CXCR3 coupling to Galphai activates PI3K/Akt, p38 MAPK/ERK and Ca2+ signalling to drive chemotaxis of Th1/CD8+ T cells and NK cells, with expression induced via JAK/STAT1 downstream of interferons.
description_zh_TW: CXCL11（I-TAC）是 ELR− 的 C-X-C 趨化因子，也是 CXCR3 最強效的致效劑，並以非典型清除／誘餌受體的方式結合 CXCR7。CXCR3 耦合 Gαi 後活化 PI3K/Akt、p38 MAPK/ERK 與 Ca2+ 訊號以驅動 Th1/CD8+ T 細胞與 NK 細胞的趨化，其表現則由干擾素下游的 JAK/STAT1 誘導。

label: Aminooxyacetate
description: Aminooxyacetate is an inhibitor of aminotransferases (notably aspartate aminotransferase, GOT1/GOT2) that blocks the Malate-Aspartate Shuttle, the principal system transferring glycolytic NADH into mitochondria. By inhibiting the transamination steps of the shuttle it prevents cytosolic NADH oxidation via mitochondrial Oxidative Phosphorylation.
description_zh_TW: Aminooxyacetate 是胺基轉移酶（尤其 aspartate aminotransferase、GOT1／GOT2）的抑制劑，可阻斷 Malate-Aspartate Shuttle——將糖解產生的 NADH 轉送入粒線體的主要系統。藉由抑制該穿梭的轉胺步驟，它阻止細胞質 NADH 經由粒線體 Oxidative Phosphorylation 被氧化。

label: c-Jun N-terminal kinase
description: c-Jun N-terminal kinase is a MAPK family member activated by the MAP kinase kinases MKK4 and MKK7 in response to cytokines, UV, osmotic shock, and — most relevant here — oxidative stress and mitochondrial dysfunction. Once active, it phosphorylates c-Jun and other substrates on Ser/Thr residues.
description_zh_TW: c-Jun N-terminal kinase 是 MAPK 家族的成員，會被 MAP 激酶激酶 MKK4 與 MKK7 活化，以回應細胞激素、UV、滲透壓衝擊，以及——在此最相關的——Oxidative Stress 與粒線體功能障礙。活化後它在絲胺酸／蘇胺酸殘基上磷酸化 c-Jun 及其他標的。

label: BRAF
description: BRAF, particularly the oncogenic BRAF V600E mutant, induces oncogene-induced senescence when expressed at high levels in normal cells. Hyperactive BRAF signaling drives aberrant proliferation and DNA damage, which activates the DNA damage response and p53, triggering a permanent growth arrest that protects against malignant transformation. Cells in BRAF-induced senescence display the full senescence phenotype, including senescence-associated heterochromatin foci and the SASP, making this a key experimental model.
description_zh_TW: BRAF，特別是致癌 BRAF V600E 突變體，當在正常細胞中高水平表達時，會誘導癌基因誘導的衰老。過度活躍的 BRAF 訊號傳導會驅動異常增殖和 DNA 損傷，進而活化 DNA 損傷反應和 p53，引發永久性生長停滯，從而防止惡性轉化。 BRAF 誘導的衰老細胞表現出完整的衰老表型，包括衰老相關的異染色質灶和 SASP，使其成為關鍵的實驗模型。

label: Fat Oxidation
description: Fat oxidation is the breakdown of fatty acids to acetyl-CoA via beta-oxidation in the mitochondrial matrix, with acetyl-CoA entering the TCA cycle and mitochondrial electron transport chain to generate ATP. It is the dominant fuel during low-intensity prolonged exercise and in the post-absorptive state, with low-to-moderate intensity favouring fat oxidation and high intensity shifting toward carbohydrate.
description_zh_TW: Fat oxidation 是脂肪酸經粒線體基質中的 beta-oxidation 分解為 acetyl-CoA，acetyl-CoA 再進入 TCA cycle 與粒線體電子傳遞鏈以生成 ATP。它是低強度長時間運動與消化後狀態下的主要燃料；低至中等強度有利於 fat oxidation，而高強度則轉向碳水化合物氧化。

label: Rilonacept
description: Rilonacept (Arcalyst) is a soluble decoy receptor fusion protein — an IL-1 trap — built from the extracellular domains of IL-1R1 and IL-1RAcP fused to the human IgG1 Fc region. It captures IL-1β in the extracellular space with high affinity, preventing the cytokine from engaging the cell-surface IL-1 Receptor.
description_zh_TW: Rilonacept（Arcalyst）是一種可溶性誘餌受體融合蛋白 —— 即 IL-1 trap —— 由 IL-1R1 與 IL-1RAcP 的胞外區融合至人類 IgG1 Fc 區而成。它在細胞外以高親和力捕捉 IL-1β，阻止該細胞激素與細胞表面的 IL-1 Receptor 結合。

label: CDK1
description: Cyclin B is the G2/M cyclin whose binding activates CDK1, forming the Cyclin B-CDK1 (formerly MPF) complex that phosphorylates substrates required for nuclear envelope breakdown, chromosome condensation, and spindle assembly. Its abrupt APC/C-mediated destruction at anaphase enforces the G2/M checkpoint.
description_zh_TW: Cyclin B 是 G2/M cyclin，其結合可活化 CDK1，形成 Cyclin B-CDK1（舊稱 MPF）複合體，磷酸化核膜崩解、染色質濃縮與紡錘體組裝所需的受質。Cyclin B 在後期被 APC/C 迅速降解，使 G2/M 檢查點得以維持。

label: p16
source_file: _document_ - Cellular senescence and SASP in tumor progression and therapeutic opportunities.md
description: p16INK4a inhibits cyclin-dependent kinase 4 (CDK4) by binding the cyclin D-CDK4 complex, preventing Rb phosphorylation and maintaining the growth-suppressive, hypophosphorylated state of Rb. This is a primary mechanism by which p16 enforces the durable, p53-independent phase of senescence, and loss of p16 is a common event in cancer, underscoring its tumor-suppressive role. The inhibition is direct and well established, and its expression rises with age and senescent burden. p16 is therefore both a cell-cycle brake and a senescence biomarker.
description_zh_TW: p16INK4a 抑制 cyclin-dependent kinase 4（CDK4），透過結合 cyclin D-CDK4 複合體，防止 Rb 磷酸化並維持 Rb 的生長抑制、低磷酸化狀態。這是 p16 執行衰老持久、獨立於 p53 階段的主要機制，且 p16 缺失是癌症常見事件，凸顯其腫瘤抑制角色。此抑制直接且確立牢固，且其表現隨年齡與衰老負擔上升。p16 因此既是細胞週期煞車也是衰老生物標記。

label: Creatine Supplementation
description: Oral creatine monohydrate — typically 3-5 g/day maintenance or 20 g/day loading — raises total muscle and brain creatine stores by roughly 20-40%, enlarging the phosphocreatine buffer that the creatine phosphate shuttle uses to spatially buffer ATP. The largest responses occur in individuals with low baseline stores (vegetarians, low meat intake), and the ergogenic and neuroprotective effects follow from the widened energy buffer rather than from any direct receptor action.
description_zh_TW: 口服肌酸單水合物——通常每日 3-5 克維持劑量或每日 20 克負荷期——可使肌肉與腦部的總肌酸儲量提升約 20-40%，擴大肌酸磷酸穿梭用以空間性緩衝 ATP 的磷肌酸緩衝庫。基線儲量較低者（素食者、少肉飲食）反應最大，而其增補運動表現與神經保護的效應正是來自加寬的能量緩衝，而非任何直接的受體作用。

label: Opicapone
description: Opicapone is an approved once-daily adjunct to levodopa for Parkinson's disease that reduces motor fluctuations and off time. Peripheral COMT blockade prolongs levodopa availability without central inhibition.
description_zh_TW: Opicapone 是帕金森氏症核准的每日一次左旋多巴輔助藥物，減少運動波動與關閉期。周邊 COMT 阻斷延長左旋多巴可用性而不中樞抑制。

label: Tolcapone
description: Tolcapone is used as an adjunct to levodopa/carbidopa in Parkinson's disease. Its clinical value is offset by a black-box warning for hepatotoxicity — rare but fatal acute liver failure — which necessitates regular liver function monitoring and limits its use relative to entacapone and opicapone.
description_zh_TW: Tolcapone 作為 levodopa/carbidopa 的輔助用於 Parkinson's disease。其臨床價值受到肝毒性黑框警告的限制——罕見但致命的急性肝衰竭——因此必須定期檢測肝功能，且相較 entacapone 與 opicapone 的使用受限。

label: Resolvins
description: Docosahexaenoic acid is the parent lipid of the D-series resolvins (RvD1-RvD6) and of the structurally related protectins/neuroprotectins and maresins, which are often grouped with resolvins under the specialized pro-resolving mediator umbrella. The D-series arise through 17S-HDHA and 5/12-lipoxygenase, and neuroprotectin D1 is specifically reduced in Alzheimer's Disease brain, where it protects retinal and neural tissue against oxidative injury.
description_zh_TW: Docosahexaenoic acid 是 D 系列 resolvins（RvD1-RvD6）以及結構相關的 protectins/neuroprotectins 與 maresins 的母體脂質，後者常與 resolvins 一同歸入 specialized pro-resolving mediator 的傘下。D 系列經由 17S-HDHA 與 5/12-lipoxygenase 生成；而 neuroprotectin D1 在 Alzheimer's Disease 腦中特別減少，在該處它保護視網膜與神經組織免受氧化傷害。

label: Scabies
description: Ivermectin treats Scabies orally at 200 micrograms/kg repeated after 7-14 days, and is the cornerstone of crusted (Norwegian) scabies, where combination therapy uses ivermectin on days 1, 2, 8, 9 and 15 together with topical permethrin and keratolytics to strip hyperkeratotic crusts and reduce mite burden.
description_zh_TW: Ivermectin 以每公斤 200 微克口服、7 至 14 天後重複的方式治療 Scabies，並是結痂型（Norwegian）scabies 的核心用藥；此型以聯合療法處理，在第 1、2、8、9、15 天給予 ivermectin，並搭配外用 permethrin 與角質溶解劑以去除角化過度結痂、降低蟎數。

label: Protein Carbonylation
description: Hydroxyl radicals cause protein carbonylation, an irreversible oxidative modification introduced when the radical attacks susceptible amino-acid side chains (notably Lys, Arg, Pro, Thr) or when lipid-peroxidation products adduct to proteins. Carbonylated proteins lose function and are targeted for degradation by the 20S proteasome. The directionality is from radical insult to stable, diagnostically useful protein modification. A caveat is that carbonylation is a downstream and cumulative marker rather than an acute, quantitative readout of hydroxyl-radical flux.
description_zh_TW: Hydroxyl radicals 導致 protein carbonylation，這是一種不可逆的氧化修飾，當自由基攻擊易受影響的氨基酸側鏈（特別是 Lys、Arg、Pro、Thr）或脂質過氧化產物加成 proteins 時引入。 Carbonylated proteins 失去功能，成為 20S proteasome 降級的目標。方向性是從徹底的損傷到穩定的、診斷上有用的蛋白質修飾。需要注意的是，羰基化是下游和累積標記，而不是羥基自由基通量的精確定量讀數。

label: Aminochrome
description: Aminochrome binds to Alpha-synuclein through physicochemical affinity, forming a complex that modulates the local concentration or activity of the bound species. Mechanistically, Aminochrome acts as the ligand or matrix and Alpha-synuclein as the binding partner, with the interaction often driven by catechol, quinone, or charge complementarity. This binding is significant because it can sequester toxins or metals, buffer neurotransmitters, or localize damage within pigmented neurons. A caveat is that the physiological magnitude, reversibility, and functional sequelae of the binding in vivo are not always fully quantified and may differ between intracellular and extracellular contexts.
description_zh_TW: Aminochrome 透過物理化學親和力與 Alpha-synuclein 結合，形成複合物，調節結合物質的局部濃度或活性。從機制上講，Aminochrome 作為配體或基質，Alpha-synuclein 作為結合伴侶，相互作用通常由兒茶酚、醌或電荷互補性驅動。這種結合很重要，因為它可以隔離毒素或金屬、緩衝 neurotransmitters 或定位色素神經元內的損傷。需要注意的是，體內結合的生理程度、可逆性和功能後遺症並不總是完全量化的，並且在細胞內和細胞外環境之間可能有所不同。

label: Atg
description: Single-cell omics maps which ATG Genes are required in specific contexts: perturbation atlases combining CRISPR screens with scRNA-seq identify the autophagy machinery genes needed in a given cell state, while lineage tracing coupled to scRNA-seq reveals how Mitophagy and Selective Autophagy programs shift during differentiation.
description_zh_TW: Single-cell omics 可繪出在特定情境下哪些 Atg 基因為必要：結合 CRISPR 篩選與 scRNA-seq 的擾動圖譜能鑑定特定細胞狀態所需的自噬機制基因，而與 scRNA-seq 結合的細胞譜系追蹤則揭示 Mitophagy 與 Selective Autophagy 程序在分化過程中如何變化。

label: Alpha-Lipoic Acid
description: Alpha-lipoic acid improves endothelial dysfunction, as confirmed in meta-analyses showing improved flow-mediated dilation and markers of oxidative stress in diabetic and metabolic patients. By restoring GSH and reducing NF-kappaB, it ameliorates NO bioavailability. The directionality is antioxidant supplementation to vascular benefit. A caveat is that trial results are heterogeneous and benefits are most consistent in established endothelial dysfunction rather than primary prevention. Lipoic acid also chelates redox-active metals, which may reduce the metal-catalyzed generation of hydroxyl radicals in the vascular wall.
description_zh_TW: 統合分析證實，Alpha-lipoic acid 改善了 endothelial dysfunction，顯示糖尿病和代謝患者中血流介導的擴張和 oxidative stress 標記得到改善。透過恢復 GSH 和減少 NF-κB，它可以改善 NO 的生物利用度。方向性是補充抗氧化劑對血管有益。需要注意的是，試驗結果有差異，在已建立的 endothelial dysfunction 而非一級預防中，效果最一致。硫辛酸也螯合 redox-active metals，這可能會減少血管壁中金屬催化的 hydroxyl radicals 的生成。

label: Smac DIABLO
description: Smac DIABLO is a pro-apoptotic mitochondrial protein whose principal function is to neutralize Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins. Released from the mitochondrial intermembrane space into the cytosol during apoptosis, it binds the BIR3 domain of XIAP, cIAP1 and cIAP2 through its exposed N-terminal AVPI IAP-binding motif, displacing Caspase-9 and Caspase-3/Caspase-7 from IAP inhibition and allowing the caspase cascade to run to completion.
description_zh_TW: Smac DIABLO 是一個促凋亡的粒線體蛋白，其主要功能是中和 Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins。凋亡時它由粒線體膜間腔釋放至細胞質，透過暴露的 N 端 AVPI IAP-binding motif 結合 XIAP、cIAP1 與 cIAP2 的 BIR3 結構域，將 Caspase-9 與 Caspase-3/Caspase-7 從 IAP 抑制中置換出來，使 caspase 级聯得以完整進行。

label: PAD4
description: PAD4 (peptidylarginine deiminase 4) deiminates arginine residues on histone H3, generating citrullinated histone H3 (cit-H3, H3Cit). Loss of the positive charge unravels chromatin structure, which is required for the chromatin decondensation and extrusion underlying NET formation.
description_zh_TW: PAD4（肽基精氨酸脫亞胺酶 4）將組蛋白 H3 上的精胺酸殘基去亞胺化，生成瓜胺酸化的組蛋白 H3（cit-H3，H3Cit）。正電荷的流失使染色質鬆解，而這正是 NET 形成過程中染色質去凝縮與外排所需的條件。

label: Oncogene Activation
description: Activated oncogenes such as RAS, BRAF, and MYC drive hyperproliferation and replication stress, which in turn elicit oncogene-induced senescence (OIS) as an intrinsic tumor-suppressive failsafe. The unscheduled S-phase entry generates DNA replication stress and DNA damage that stabilize p53 and derepress the CDKN2A/p16INK4a locus, locking cells in arrest. OIS is observed in benign lesions such as melanocytic nevi and is a major barrier to tumor progression. The paradox is that OIS cells secrete a SASP that, while recruiting immune clearance, can also promote tumorigenesis in neighboring cells.
description_zh_TW: 活化的致癌基因如 RAS、BRAF 與 MYC 驅動過度增殖與複製壓力，進而引發致癌基因誘發衰老（OIS），作為一種內在的腫瘤抑制失效安全機制。非預期的 S 期進入產生 DNA 複製壓力與 DNA 損傷，穩定 p53 並去抑制 CDKN2A/p16INK4a 位點，將細胞鎖定於停滯。OIS 見於如黑色素細胞痣等良性病灶，是腫瘤進展的主要屏障。其矛盾之處在於，OIS 細胞分泌 SASP，雖能招募免疫清除，也可能促進鄰近細胞的腫瘤發生。

label: CDKN1A
description: CDKN1A-encoded p21 inhibits cyclin-CDK enzymes, notably CDK2, enforcing G1/S blockade. This direct inhibition is shared with the Cip/Kip family mechanism.
description_zh_TW: CDKN1A 編碼的 p21 抑制 cyclin-CDK 酶（特別是 CDK2），執行 G1/S 封鎖。此直接抑制與 Cip/Kip 家族機制共享。

label: COPD
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) pathogenesis involves mitochondrial dynamic imbalance manifested as enhanced fission and reduced fusion. Cigarette smoke extract induces mitochondrial fragmentation by decreasing MFN2 and increasing DRP1 in A549 alveolar epithelial cells, and promotes DRP1 Ser616 phosphorylation, mitochondrial translocation and tetramerization while downregulating MFN2 in pulmonary microvascular endothelial cells. Similar profiles of reduced fusion and enhanced fission occur in asthma, pulmonary fibrosis and acute lung injury, making restoration of dynamic equilibrium a therapeutic target in lung disease.
description_zh_TW: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) pathogenesis involves mitochondrial dynamic imbalance manifested as enhanced fission and reduced fusion。Cigarette smoke extract induces mitochondrial fragmentation by decreasing MFN2 and increasing DRP1 in A549 alveolar epithelial cells，and promotes DRP1 Ser616 phosphorylation, mitochondrial translocation and tetramerization while downregulating MFN2 in pulmonary microvascular endothelial cells。Similar profiles of reduced fusion and enhanced fission occur in asthma, pulmonary fibrosis and acute lung injury，making restoration of dynamic equilibrium a therapeutic target in lung disease。

label: Benzothiazine
description: Benzothiazine rings are more redox-labile and more prone to generate Oxidative Stress than the indolic units of eumelanin. Pheomelanin-type structures are poorer antioxidants and can, under UV or oxidative challenge, produce damaging radicals. This pro-oxidant behavior is relevant to both skin and brain pigment biology.
description_zh_TW: 與 eumelanin 的吲哚類單元相比，benzothiazine 環更易發生氧化還原不穩定，且更容易產生 Oxidative Stress。Pheomelanin 型結構是較差的抗氧化劑，在 UV 或氧化挑戰下可能產生有害自由基。這種促氧化行為與皮膚和大腦的色素生物學都相關。

label: B2M
description: B2M is the invariant light chain that forms all MHC class I molecules and, in particular, stabilizes HLA-E surface expression; HLA-E/B2M on senescent and tumor cells engages NKG2A/CD94 on Natural Killer Cells and CD8 T cells, blunting cytotoxic killing and enabling Immune Evasion.
description_zh_TW: B2M 是構成所有 MHC 第一類分子的不變輕鏈，特別能穩定 HLA-E 的表面表現；衰老細胞與腫瘤細胞上的 HLA-E/B2M 會接合 Natural Killer Cells 與 CD8 T cells 上的 NKG2A/CD94，削弱細胞毒殺殺傷並促成 Immune Evasion。

label: Olaparib
description: Pancreatic cancer is one of olaparib's approved indications, alongside BRCA-mutated breast, ovarian, and prostate cancers, on the basis of olaparib's exploitation of synthetic lethality in homologous-recombination-deficient tumors. ATM-deficient tumors are selectively vulnerable to PARP inhibitors including olaparib, and show heightened vulnerability when PARP inhibition is combined with ATR inhibition.
description_zh_TW: 胰臟癌是 olaparib 的核准適應症之一，與 BRCA 突變的乳癌、卵巢癌及攝護腺癌並列，其依據是 olaparib 對同源重組缺陷腫瘤之合成致命性的利用。ATM 缺失的腫瘤對包括 olaparib 在內的 PARP 抑制劑具有選擇性脆弱性，且在 PARP 抑制合併 ATR 抑制時更為明顯。

label: Mubritinib
description: Mubritinib (TAK-165) is a ubiquinone-binding-site (Q-site) dependent inhibitor of mitochondrial Complex I, with an aromatic ring chain topology critical for Q-site binding. Originally developed as a receptor tyrosine kinase inhibitor, it blocks electron transfer from NADH to ubiquinone, which inhibits NAD+ regeneration from NADH, raises the NADH:NAD+ ratio and deplete ATP.
description_zh_TW: Mubritinib（TAK-165）是粒線體 Complex I 的 ubiquinone 結合位點（Q-site）依賴型抑制劑，其芳香環鏈拓撲對 Q-site 結合至關重要。它最初是作為受體酪胺酸激酶抑制劑開發，而會阻斷 NADH 到 ubiquinone 的電子傳遞，抑制 NADH 再生為 NAD+、提高 NADH:NAD+ 比值並耗竭 ATP。

label: Crohn's Disease
description: The T300A variant of Atg16L1 is a risk factor for Crohn's Disease, linking impaired Atg12-Atg5-Atg16L1-dependent LC3 lipidation to intestinal inflammatory disease.
description_zh_TW: Atg16L1 的 T300A 變異是 Crohn's Disease 的風險因子，將 Atg12-Atg5-Atg16L1 依賴的 LC3 脂化受損與腸道發炎性疾病連結起來。

label: ACLY
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: ACLY (ATP-citrate lyase) catalyzes the downstream conversion of mitochondria-derived citrate exported to the cytosol into acetyl-CoA, the principal substrate for cytosolic acetyl-CoA production and histone acetylation. ACLY expression is increased across multiple senescence models, and its silencing reduces both H3K27ac levels and SASP gene expression in irradiation-induced and replicative senescence. Conversely, citrate supplementation increases histone acetylation and induces pro-inflammatory gene expression in proliferating cells, confirming that increasing citrate availability is sufficient to drive the acetylation-dependent inflammatory programme.
description_zh_TW: ACLY（ATP-西妥環酶）催化由線粒體釋放至細胞質的檸檬酸下游轉化為乙酰-CoA，這是細胞質內乙酰-CoA的主要底物，以及組蛋白乙酰化。ACLY的表達在多個衰老模型中均增加，並且抑制其會降低H3K27ac的水平和輻射誘導和代數衰老引起的SASP基因表達。相反，檸檬酸補充會增加組蛋白乙酰化並誘導增生細胞中的促炎基因表達，這證實增加檸檬酸的供應足夠驅動乙酰化依賴的炎症程序。

label: PEX19
description: All reported PEX19 mutations cause severe Zellweger syndrome (<1% of ZSD cases); biallelic knockout in mice is embryonic lethal with no detectable peroxisomes in any tissue.
description_zh_TW: 所有已報導的 PEX19 突變皆造成嚴重的 Zellweger 症候群（佔 ZSD 病例 <1%）；小鼠雙等位基因敲除在胚胎期即致死，任何組織皆檢測不到過氧化體。

label: Liver X Receptor
description: Liver X receptors (LXRα/NR1H3 and LXRβ/NR1H2) are nuclear receptors that regulate cholesterol, fatty acid and lipid homeostasis. SIRT1 modulates over 40 known substrates including LXR, deacetylating and regulating its activity, thereby coupling sirtuin activity to cholesterol and lipid metabolism.
description_zh_TW: Liver X Receptor（LXRα/NR1H3 與 LXRβ/NR1H2）是調節膽固醇、脂肪酸與脂質恆定的核受體。SIRT1 可調節超過 40 種已知受質（包含 LXR），藉由去乙醯化並調節其活性，將 sirtuin 活性與膽固醇及脂質代謝連結起來。

label: Lens Crystallins
description: Lens Crystallins have negligible turnover, so glycation adducts accumulate over decades. This makes them one of the canonical long-lived proteins carrying old AGE modifications, and the resulting opacity reads out whole-body long-lived-protein aging.
description_zh_TW: Lens Crystallins（水晶蛋白）的周轉率極低，因此糖化加合物會在數十年內累積。這使它們成為帶有陳年 AGE 修飾的典型長壽蛋白，其 resulting 混濁可作為全身長壽蛋白老化的讀值。

label: erlotinib
source_file: _document_ - Ivermectin, a potential anticancer drug derived from an antiparasitic drug.md
description: Lung Cancer is treated by erlotinib. Lung cancer, especially non-small-cell lung cancer, is the leading cause of cancer death and is frequently driven by EGFR or KRAS alterations. Erlotinib is a first-generation EGFR tyrosine-kinase inhibitor used in EGFR-mutant non-small-cell lung cancer. The directionality runs from erlotinib toward Lung Cancer, so erlotinib is the active agent and Lung Cancer the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
description_zh_TW: Lung Cancer 用 erlotinib 處理。 Lung Cancer，尤其是非小細胞Lung Cancer，是癌症死亡的主要原因，並且經常由EGFR或KRAS改變驅動。厄洛替尼是第一代EGFR酪胺酸激酶抑制劑，用於EGFR突變的非小細胞Lung Cancer。方向性從 erlotinib 朝向 Lung Cancer，因此 erlotinib 是活性劑，Lung Cancer 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

label: Astrocytes
description: Astrocytes are the most abundant glial cell type of the Central Nervous System, providing metabolic, structural and homeostatic support to Neuron and contributing to formation and maintenance of the Blood-Brain Barrier.
description_zh_TW: Astrocytes 是 Central Nervous System 中最豐富的神經膠細胞類型，為 Neuron 提供代謝、結構與恆定維持上的支持，並參與 Blood-Brain Barrier 的形成與維持。

label: XBP1
description: XBP1s is the spliced, transcriptionally competent isoform of XBP1, produced by IRE1-mediated splicing during the unfolded protein response; it directs endoplasmic reticulum stress adaptation by upregulating ER chaperones and folding machinery.
description_zh_TW: XBP1s 是 XBP1 經剪接後具轉錄活性的異構體，由未摺疊蛋白反應期間的 IRE1 媒介剪接產生；它藉由上調內質網分子伴護蛋白與摺疊機制來主導內質網壓力的適應。

label: Epithelial cells
description: Alveolar Type II Cells are the surfactant-producing epithelial cells of the distal lung alveolus and serve as the facultative progenitor population that regenerates the flattened alveolar type I Epithelial cells after injury. They synthesize and secrete pulmonary surfactant via lamellar bodies and participate in ion and water transport to maintain airspace stability.
description_zh_TW: Alveolar Type II Cells 是遠端肺泡產生表面活性物質的上皮細胞，並作為兼性前驅細胞群，在損傷後再生扁平化的第一型肺泡 Epithelial cells。它們藉由 lamellar body 合成並分泌肺表面活性物質，並參與離子與水分運輸以維持氣腔穩定。

label: LAMP1
description: LAMP1 is the most abundant protein on the lysosomal membrane and serves as the standard marker for Lysosome and Autolysosome. Heavily glycosylated, it protects the membrane from luminal hydrolases and maintains lysosomal stability and integrity.
description_zh_TW: LAMP1 是 lysosome 膜上最豐富的蛋白質，也是 Lysosome 與 Autolysosome 的標準標記。高度醣基化的 LAMP1 保護膜免受腔內水解酶作用，並維持 lysosome 的穩定性與完整性。

label: Takotsubo Cardiomyopathy
description: Takotsubo cardiomyopathy (stress cardiomyopathy, broken-heart syndrome) is an acute, reversible left ventricular systolic dysfunction that mimics acute myocardial infarction but occurs in the absence of obstructive coronary artery disease. It is classically triggered by intense emotional or physical stress and is driven by a surge of Catecholamines — particularly Epinephrine and Norepinephrine — that directly injures the myocardium.
description_zh_TW: Takotsubo cardiomyopathy（壓力性心肌病變、碎心症候群）是急性、可逆的左心室收縮功能障礙，會模仿急性心肌梗塞卻不伴隨阻塞性冠狀動脈疾病。它典型地由強烈的情緒或生理壓力觸發，並由 Catecholamines——尤其是 Epinephrine 與 Norepinephrine——的驟升所驅動，直接損傷心肌。

label: Dasatinib
description: Senolytic therapy uses dasatinib as part of the foundational D+Q combination (Zhu et al., Nat Med 2015) for clearing senescent cells. Dasatinib's kinase-inhibitory activity lowers the apoptotic threshold of senescent cells and synergizes with quercetin, and its established clinical safety profile in leukemia facilitates repurposing in senolytic trials. The combination has shown efficacy across multiple senescent cell types and in vivo models, and D+Q has been tested in pilot clinical trials for idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis and diabetic kidney disease.
description_zh_TW: Senolytic 療法使用 dasatinib，作為清除衰老細胞的基礎 D+Q 組合（Zhu 等人，Nat Med 2015）的一部分。Dasatinib 的激酶抑制活性降低衰老細胞的凋亡閾值並與 quercetin 協同，其在白血病中既有的臨床安全特性有助於在 senolytic 試驗中重新定位。此組合已在多種衰老細胞類型與體內模型展現療效，且 D+Q 已在特發性肺纖維化與糖尿病腎病的試驗性臨床試驗中測試。

label: Peroxiredoxin 3
description: Peroxiredoxin 3 (PRDX3) is reduced back to its active form by thioredoxin-2 (Trx2), which donates electrons to re-reduce the disulfide formed at its peroxidatic cysteine. Trx2 is in turn regenerated by mitochondrial thioredoxin reductase using NADPH, sustaining the matrix peroxide-removal cycle.
description_zh_TW: 過氧化還原酶 3（PRDX3）由硫氧還蛋白-2 (Trx2) 還原回其活化形式，Trx2 提供電子以重新還原其過氧化半胱氨酸處形成的雙硫鍵。Trx2 再由粒線體硫氧還蛋白還原酶利用 NADPH 再生成，以維持基質過氧化氫清除循環。

label: Dicer
description: Besides MicroRNA, Dicer processes long double-stranded RNA into siRNA duplexes, so Dicer-null cells lack siRNAs as well as mature miRNAs. Unlike a DGCR8/Drosha knockout, this produces a more severe, partly miRNA-independent block to differentiation, which is why DGCR8 knockout is the cleaner tool for studying miRNA-specific function.
description_zh_TW: 除了 MicroRNA 之外，Dicer 也將長雙股 RNA 加工成 siRNA 雙股，因此 Dicer 缺失的細胞同時缺乏 siRNA 與成熟 miRNA。相較於 DGCR8/Drosha 的 knockout，這會造成更嚴重且部分不依賴 miRNA 的分化阻斷，因此研究 miRNA 專一功能時，DGCR8 knockout 是更乾淨的工具。

label: Human Growth Hormone
description: Human Growth Hormone signaling activates the mTOR pathway downstream of IGF-1/AKT, promoting anabolic growth. Because chronically elevated GH/IGF-1 signaling is associated with increased cancer risk and shortened lifespan, exogenous HGH is regarded as a pro-aging rather than anti-aging intervention — the opposite of Rapamycin-mediated mTOR inhibition.
description_zh_TW: Human Growth Hormone 的訊號經由 IGF-1/AKT 下游活化 mTOR 途徑，促進合成性生長。由於 GH/IGF-1 訊號長期偏高與癌症風險上升及壽命縮短相關，外源性 HGH 被視為促衰老而非抗衰老的介入手段——恰與 Rapamycin 介導的 mTOR 抑制相反。

label: Ghrelin
description: Ghrelin is a 28-amino acid peptide produced primarily by the stomach that acts through the growth hormone secretagogue receptor GHS-R1a, with octanoylation at Ser3 required for biological activity. It stimulates growth hormone release from the pituitary, regulates food intake via hypothalamic feeding centers, and rises during fasting; its receptor is expressed in stomach, hypothalamus, and immune cells.
description_zh_TW: Ghrelin 是主要由胃部產生的 28 胺基酸胜肽，透過生長激素促泌素受體 GHS-R1a 作用，且 Ser3 的辛醯化修飾為其生物活性所必需。它刺激腦下垂體釋放生長激素，經由下視丘攝食中樞調節食物攝取，並在禁食期間上升；其受體表現在胃、下視丘與免疫細胞。

label: NNMT
description: NNMT is the enzyme that methylates Nicotinamide using S-adenosylmethionine to form 1-Methylnicotinamide (1-MNA). Because 1-MNA is the terminal, largely non-recyclable sink of nicotinamide, NNMT activity sets how much nicotinamide remains available for NAD+ resynthesis.
description_zh_TW: NNMT 是以 S-腺苷甲硫胺酸將 Nicotinamide 甲基化形成 1-Methylnicotinamide (1-MNA) 的酵素。由於 1-MNA 是菸醯胺終末且大致不可回收的匯，NNMT 活性決定了仍可供 NAD+ 再合成的菸醯胺量。

label: M₁dG
description: M₁dG is the best-characterized DNA lesion of Lipid Peroxidation and serves as its biomarker: it records cumulative oxidative lipid damage in the genome, and steady-state levels in human leukocyte DNA typically run 1–50 adducts per 10⁸ nucleotides, rising with smoking, inflammation, and diets rich in oxidized lipid. Accumulation of the adduct with age also parallels the decline in repair capacity, making it a molecular clock of oxidative lipid exposure.
description_zh_TW: M₁dG 是 Lipid Peroxidation 最具代表性的 DNA 損傷，並作為其生物標記：它記錄了基因組中累積的氧化性脂質損傷，人類白血球 DNA 的穩態含量通常為每 10⁸ 個核苷酸 1–50 個加合物，並隨抽菸、發炎與富含氧化脂質的飲食而升高。該加合物隨年齡的累積也與修復能力下降平行，因此可視為氧化性脂質暴露的分子時鐘。

label: Mdivi-1
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Mdivi-1 (mitochondrial division inhibitor 1), a quinazolinone derivative that specifically inhibits DRP1, attenuates cardiac dysfunction in diverse mouse cardiomyopathy models, likely by promoting mitochondrial elongation or reducing autophagy. It also attenuates neuronal cell death through mitochondrial elongation and inhibition of complex I activity and ROS generation in neurodegenerative disease models including Parkinson's and Alzheimer's disease. However, treatment of myocardial infarction in pigs with Mdivi-1 did not reduce infarct size or preserve cardiac function, and Mdivi-1 has off-target effects such as cleaving L-OPA1 and altering OXPHOS complex protein expression.
description_zh_TW: Mdivi-1（粒線體分裂抑制劑 1）是一種喹唑啉酮衍生物，可特異性抑制 DRP1，在多種小鼠心肌病模型中減輕心臟功能障礙，可能透過促進粒線體延長或減少自噬。它在帕金森氏症與阿茲海默症等神經退化性疾病模型中，也透過粒線體延長以及抑制複合體 I 活性與 ROS 生成來減輕神經元細胞死亡。然而，以 Mdivi-1 治療豬的心肌梗塞並未減少梗塞面積或保存心臟功能，且 Mdivi-1 具有脫靶效應，例如切割 L-OPA1 與改變 OXPHOS 複合體蛋白質表現。

label: TDP-43
description: TDP-43 is the canonical example of a mislocalized RNA-binding protein. Under stress it redistributes out of the nucleus into cytoplasmic aggregates and stress granules, losing nuclear function and gaining toxicity in ALS and frontotemporal dementia; more generally, RBP mislocalization or aggregation, including sequestration by tau or polyQ condensates, drives neurodegeneration by disrupting RNA metabolism.
description_zh_TW: TDP-43 是錯定位 RNA-binding protein 的典型例子。在壓力下它從細胞核重新分布到細胞質聚集体與壓力顆粒，失去核內功能並在 ALS 與額顳葉失智症中獲得毒性；更一般地說，RBP 的錯定位或聚集（包括被 tau 或 polyQ 凝聚體隔離）會破壞 RNA 代謝而驅動神經退化。

label: Somatic Cell Nuclear Transfer
description: Oocyte cytoplasm reprograms donor nuclei in SCNT. Enablement is the maternal-factor mechanism.
description_zh_TW: 卵母細胞質在 SCNT 重編程供體核。賦能是母系因子機制。

label: EP300
source_file: _document_ - Natural Bioactive Compounds Spermidine Fisetin Berberine Urolithin A.md
description: EP300 (E1A binding protein p300) is a histone acetyltransferase and transcriptional coactivator encoded by the EP300 gene. It acetylates H3K9ac-marked chromatin and is recruited by p53, NF-kB, and nuclear receptors to activate transcription.
description_zh_TW: EP300（E1A 結合蛋白 p300）是由 EP300 基因編碼的 Histone Acetyltransferase（組蛋白乙醯化轉移酶）與轉錄共同活化因子。它乙醯化帶有 H3K9ac 標記的染色質，並由 p53、NF-kB 與核受體招募以活化轉錄。

label: FOXO Transcription Factors
description: Akt phosphorylates FOXO, excluding it from the nucleus and silencing Bim/Puma transcription.
description_zh_TW: Akt 磷酸化 FOXO 將其排除於核外，沉默 Bim/Puma 轉錄。

label: CREB
description: Ca2+ and cAMP signaling intersect to regulate CREB-dependent transcription: Ca2+ activates CaMKIV, while cAMP activates PKA, and both phosphorylate CREB at Ser133. Ca2+-permeable channels such as TRPM2, activated by ADP-ribose and OAADPr, further couple NAD+ metabolism to Ca2+ influx, so calcium signalling and sirtuin energy sensing converge on the same transcription factor.
description_zh_TW: Ca2+ 與 cAMP 訊號在調控 CREB 依賴的轉錄上交會：Ca2+ 活化 CaMKIV，cAMP 活化 PKA，兩者皆在 Ser133 磷酸化 CREB。TRPM2 等 Ca2+ 可通透通道可被 ADP-ribose 與 OAADPr 活化，進一步把 NAD+ 代謝與 Ca2+ 內流偶聯起來，使鈣離子訊號與 sirtuin 能量感測匯流於同一轉錄因子。

label: TLR2
description: TLR2 is the primary pattern recognition receptor for lipoteichoic acid, functioning as a complex with TLR6 and the co-receptor CD36. Binding of LTA to the TLR2/TLR6/CD36 complex activates MyD88-dependent NF-κB and MAPK signalling, inducing TNF-α, IL-6, IL-8 and IL-1β production.
description_zh_TW: TLR2 是 lipoteichoic acid 的主要模式辨識受體，與 TLR6 及共同受體 CD36 形成複合體。LTA 與 TLR2/TLR6/CD36 複合體結合後，會活化 MyD88 相關的 NF-κB 與 MAPK 訊號，誘導 TNF-α、IL-6、IL-8 與 IL-1β 的產生。

label: Isourolithin A
source_file: _document_ - Natural Bioactive Compounds Spermidine Fisetin Berberine Urolithin A.md
description: Isourolithin A, the gut-microbial isomer of urolithin A, can stimulate mitophagy, the selective clearance of damaged mitochondria. By improving mitochondrial quality control it is of interest for muscle health and healthspan, though its potency is generally somewhat lower than that of urolithin A.
description_zh_TW: Isourolithin A 是 urolithin A 的腸道菌叢異構體，可刺激 Mitophagy，即可選擇性清除受損粒線體。藉由改善粒線體品質管制，它對肌肉健康與 healthspan 具意義，但效價通常略低於 urolithin A。

label: FOXO3
description: FOXO3 is a longevity-associated forkhead transcription factor regulated by acetylation. Note-canonical spelling kept; cross-file FOXO3a variance noted.
description_zh_TW: FOXO3 是受乙醯化調節的長壽相關叉頭轉錄因子。保留筆記典型拼寫；跨檔案 FOXO3a 差異已註記。

label: Autoimmune Disease
description: Loss of the negative immune regulators that hold T Cell in a quiescent state makes T cells hypersensitive to activation signals, decreasing self-tolerance and thereby increasing Autoimmune Disease; quiescence is thus an active brake on autoimmunity rather than passive inactivity.
description_zh_TW: 喪失使 T Cell 維持在靜止狀態的負向免疫調節因子，會讓 T 細胞對活化訊號過度敏感，降低自身耐受性並因而增加 Autoimmune Disease；因此靜止狀態是抑制自體免疫的主動煞車，而非被動的不活動。

label: Caspase-10
description: Caspase-10 is a type of Caspase. Caspase-10 is an initiator caspase related to caspase-8 that amplifies death-receptor signaling and is frequently silenced in tumors. Caspases are cysteine aspartate-specific proteases that orchestrate inflammation or, in the apoptotic class, the proteolytic execution of cell death. The directionality runs from Caspase toward Caspase-10, so Caspase is the active agent and Caspase-10 the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-10 是 Caspase 的一種。 Caspase-10 是一種與 caspase-8 相關的起始 caspase，可放大死亡受體訊號傳導，並且在腫瘤中經常被沉默。它們是半胱氨酸天冬胺酸特異性蛋白酶，可協調炎症，或在細胞凋亡類別中，透過蛋白水解執行細胞死亡。方向性從 Caspase 朝向 Caspase-10，因此 Caspase 是活性劑，Caspase-10 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: MMP-2
description: MMP-2 (gelatinase A) was among the first matrix-degrading enzymes catalogued in the senescence secretome. It is a secreted component of the SASP that remodels the extracellular matrix around senescent cells, releasing matrix-sequestered growth factors and by degrading basement membranes and activating latent TGF-β, amplifying paracrine senescence and fibrogenic signalling.
description_zh_TW: MMP-2（gelatinase A）是最早被列入衰老分泌組的基質降解酶之一。它是 SASP 的分泌成分，會重塑衰老細胞周圍的細胞外基質，釋放被基質囚禁的生長因子；並藉由降解基底膜與活化潛伏的 TGF-β，放大旁分泌衰老與促纖維化訊號。

label: p22phox
description: Loss-of-function mutations in CYBA cause an autosomal form of Chronic Granulomatous Disease. The mechanism is loss of oxidase activity rather than loss of an antioxidant: without a stable cytochrome b558, the phagocyte respiratory burst fails and catalase-positive organisms survive, so the disease is a state of deficient antimicrobial Oxidative Stress generation. It is functionally indistinguishable from the p47phox form, which is why CGD is diagnosed by respiratory-burst assay rather than by subunit.
description_zh_TW: CYBA 的無效突變會造成體染色體型的 Chronic Granulomatous Disease。其機制是氧化酶活性喪失而非抗氧劑喪失：缺少穩定的 cytochrome b558，吞噬細胞的呼吸爆發便告失敗，過氧化氫酶陽性微生物得以存活，因此此疾病是抗微生物 Oxidative Stress 生成不足的狀態。它與 p47phox 型在功能上無法區分，這也是 CGD 靠呼吸爆發檢驗而非靠次單元來診斷的原因。

label: COX-2
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Apigenin suppresses cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2), the enzyme that converts arachidonic acid into prostaglandins and whose overexpression drives carcinogenesis. It inhibits UVB-induced increases in COX-2 protein and mRNA in mouse and human keratinocytes, reduces COX-2 expression in colon and gastric cancer models, and downregulates inducible COX-2 in HCEC colon cells more potently than quercetin or tricin. In non-melanoma skin cancer models, COX-2 inhibition by apigenin prevents tumor development, and apigenin also suppresses UVB-induced cutaneous angiogenesis by maintaining endogenous TSP1 levels.
description_zh_TW: 阿皮ゲ寧抑制環氧合酶-2 (COX-2)，該酶將 arachidonic 酸轉化為前列腺素，且其過表達促進癌變。它抑制了在小鼠和人類表皮細胞中 UVB 誘導的 COX-2 蛋白和 mRNA 升高，在結直腸癌和胃癌模型中降低 COX-2 表現，並且比槲皮苷或槲青素更強效地 downregulation  inducible COX-2 在 HCEC 結直腸細胞中，在非黑色素瘤皮膚癌模型中，阿皮ゲ寧通過抑制 COX-2 預防腫瘤發育，阿皮ゲ寧還通過維持內源性 TSP1 水平抑制 UVB 誘導的表皮血管生成。

label: Ubiquitination
description: Ubiquitination is a definitional post-translational protein modification.
description_zh_TW: 泛素化是定義性的轉譯後蛋白修飾。

label: Thermogenesis
description: Heat production during Thermogenesis depends on Mitochondrial Uncoupling: proton leak and the uncoupling proteins UCP1, UCP2 and UCP3 dissipate the proton-motive force as heat, uncoupling oxygen consumption from ATP synthesis. This is the dominant mechanism of non-shivering Thermogenesis in brown adipose tissue.
description_zh_TW: Thermogenesis 中的產熱仰賴 Mitochondrial Uncoupling：質子漏與解偶聯蛋白 UCP1、UCP2、UCP3 將質子動力勢以熱的形式耗散，使氧消耗與 ATP 合成脫鉤。這是棕色脂肪組織中非顫抖性 Thermogenesis 的主要機制。

label: Glutamine
description: Alpha-ketoglutarate is generated from Glutamine via Glutaminase and subsequent glutamate conversion, making it the primary entry point for glutamine-derived carbon into the TCA cycle. Metabolic 13C tracing shows that in MYC-high cancer cells glutamine is the primary carbon source for alpha-ketoglutarate.
description_zh_TW: α-酮戊二酸由 Glutamine 經 Glutaminase 及後續的麩胺酸轉換而生成，因此它是麩醯胺胺衍生碳進入 TCA cycle 的主要入口。代謝性 ¹³C 追蹤顯示，在 MYC 高表現的癌細胞中，Glutamine 是 α-酮戊二酸的主要碳來源。

label: Elastokines
description: Elastokine signalling through the elastin-binding protein (EBP) receptor activates ERK1/2 and p38 MAPK and NF-kappaB, upregulating transcription of MMP-2, MMP-9 and MMP-12. This creates the positive feedback loop elastin degradation to elastokine generation to EBP signalling to MMP upregulation to further elastin degradation, which accelerates tissue deterioration in ageing, COPD, atherosclerosis and photoageing.
description_zh_TW: Elastokine 經由彈性蛋白結合蛋白（EBP）受體的訊號會活化 ERK1/2、p38 MAPK 與 NF-κB，並上調 MMP-2、MMP-9 與 MMP-12 的轉錄。這形成彈性蛋白降解→elastokine 生成→EBP 訊號→MMP 上調→更多彈性蛋白降解的正向迴路，在老化、COPD、動脈粥狀硬化與光老化中加速組織劣化。

label: RAF
description: RAF is a family of serine/threonine kinases (ARAF, BRAF, CRAF/RAF1) that transmit signals from RAS to MEK in the canonical RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK MAPK cascade. RAF kinases are recruited to the membrane upon RAS-GTP activation, where they phosphorylate MEK1/2, which activates ERK1/2 and drives proliferation and survival; BRAF V600E is a common oncogenic mutation.
description_zh_TW: RAF 是一族絲胺酸／蘇胺酸激酶 (ARAF、BRAF、CRAF/RAF1)，在典型的 RAS–RAF–MEK–ERK MAPK 級聯中將訊號由 RAS 傳至 MEK。當 RAS-GTP 活化時，RAF 激酶被招募至膜上並磷酸化 MEK1/2，後者活化 ERK1/2 以驅動增殖與存活；BRAF V600E 是常見的致癌突變。

label: TRIM2
description: TRIM2 ubiquitinates the pro-apoptotic BH3-only protein Bim: its RING domain recruits an E2 ubiquitin-conjugating enzyme while coiled-coil and NHL repeat domains confer substrate specificity, attaching ubiquitin chains to Bim lysines that mark it for 26S proteasome destruction. This degradative route is a post-translational safeguard against Apoptosis, distinct from ERK/RSK-mediated transcriptional suppression of Bim.
description_zh_TW: TRIM2 會對促凋亡的 BH3-only 蛋白 Bim 進行泛素化：其 RING 結構域招募 E2 泛素連接酵素，coiled-coil 與 NHL repeat 結構域賦予受質專一性，把泛素鏈接到 Bim 的離胺酸上，使其被標記並由 26S 蛋白酶體分解。這條降解途徑是對抗 Apoptosis 的轉譯後防線，與 ERK/RSK 對 Bim 的轉錄抑制不同。

label: Glucocorticoids
description: Glucocorticoids bind the intracellular glucocorticoid receptor, and the hormone-receptor complex translocates to the nucleus where it transactivates anti-inflammatory genes and transrepresses pro-inflammatory transcription: it recruits histone deacetylases, competes with NF-κB and AP-1 for coactivators, and directly inhibits NF-κB transcriptional activity.
description_zh_TW: Glucocorticoids 與細胞內的糖皮質激素受體結合，荷爾蒙－受體複合體轉位至細胞核，在其中進行抗發炎基因的轉活化與促發炎轉錄的轉抑制：它招募組蛋白去乙醯化酶、與 NF-κB 及 AP-1 競爭共同活化因子，並直接抑制 NF-κB 的轉錄活性。

label: Estrogen Receptor
description: Estrogen receptor drives luminal breast cancer and its expression guides endocrine therapy. Flavonoids such as apigenin show biphasic estrogenic/anti-estrogenic activity via ER-binding-dependent and -independent mechanisms, with apigenin exerting anti-estrogenic effects in breast cancer cells.
description_zh_TW: 雌激素受體驅動管腔型乳癌，其表現指引內分泌治療。諸如 apigenin 等黃酮類透過 ER 結合依賴與非依賴機制表現雙相雌激素/抗雌激素活性，apigenin 在乳癌細胞中發揮抗雌激素作用。

label: Major histocompatibility complex class I
description: Antigen Presentation and Major histocompatibility complex class I are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Antigen Presentation and Major histocompatibility complex class I may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Antigen Presentation 和 Major histocompatibility complex class I 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Antigen Presentation 和 Major histocompatibility complex class I 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Microtubule
description: Tubulin is the target of microtubule-interfering agents including benzimidazoles, taxanes and vinca alkaloids.
description_zh_TW: 微管蛋白是微管干擾藥物的靶標，包括苯並咪唑、紫杉烷和長春花生物鹼。

label: 3-Hydroxykynurenine
description: 3-Hydroxykynurenine (3-HK) is generated from Kynurenine by the enzyme kynurenine 3-monooxygenase (KMO) within the Kynurenine Pathway, and is further metabolized to Quinolinic Acid via 3-hydroxyanthranilic acid.
description_zh_TW: 3-Hydroxykynurenine (3-HK) 在 Kynurenine Pathway 中由酵素 kynurenine 3-monooxygenase (KMO) 以 Kynurenine 為前驅物生成，並經 3-羥基鄰氨基苯甲酸進一步代謝為 Quinolinic Acid。

label: BET inhibitors
description: BET inhibitors targets BRD4. BET inhibitors displace bromodomain proteins such as BRD4 from acetylated chromatin, silencing MYC and inflammatory transcription programs. BRD4 is a bromodomain-and-extra-terminal protein that binds acetylated histones at super-enhancers to sustain oncogenic transcription. The relationship is directional, with BET inhibitors acting as the operative agent upon BRD4 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: BET inhibitors目標BRD4。 BET inhibitors 取代乙醯化染色質中的溴結構域蛋白，例如 BRD4，沉默 MYC 和發炎轉錄程序。 BRD4 是一種溴結構域和額外末端蛋白，可在超級增強子處結合乙醯化組蛋白以維持致癌轉錄。這種關係是有方向的，BET inhibitors 充當 BRD4 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Hydroxychloroquine
description: Hydroxychloroquine is a 4-aminoquinoline derivative of chloroquine used clinically for malaria prophylaxis and treatment, for systemic lupus erythematosus, and as a disease-modifying antirheumatic drug in Rheumatoid Arthritis. Its immunomodulation works partly by interfering with antigen processing and endosomal Toll-like Receptor (TLR7/9) signaling. Chronic high-dose use risks irreversible retinopathy and rarely Cardiomyopathy.
description_zh_TW: Hydroxychloroquine 是 chloroquine 的 4-胺基quinoline 衍生物，臨床上用於瘧疾的預防與治療、Systemic Lupus Erythematosus，以及作為 Rheumatoid Arthritis 的抗發炎性修飾藥物。其免疫調節作用部分來自干擾抗原處理與內體 Toll-like Receptor（TLR7/9）訊號。長期高劑量使用可能造成不可逆的視網膜病變，罕見情況下會引起 Cardiomyopathy。

label: Vasoplegic Shock
description: Methylene blue is widely used off-label as adjunctive therapy for refractory vasoplegic shock, including septic and anaphylactic shock, to increase systemic vascular resistance in cases refractory to standard vasopressors, particularly in the setting of cardiac surgery such as coronary artery bypass grafting. It is commonly administered as a single intravenous bolus of 2 mg/kg over 20 to 30 minutes, with some protocols incorporating a bolus followed by continuous infusion. Evidence supporting routine preoperative or postoperative prophylactic use to reduce mortality remains limited, and this practice is not considered standard of care.
description_zh_TW: 亞甲基藍廣泛用於治療 refractory 血管舒張性休克，包括敗血性和過敏性休克，以增加系統性血管阻力，適用於對標準血管加壓素 refractory 的病例，特別是在心臟手術如冠狀動脈繞道移植術中。通常以 2 mg/kg 劑量靜脈注射推注，持續 20 至 30 分鐘，有些方案包括推注後持續輸注。支持常規術前或術後預防性使用以降低死亡率的證據仍然有限，此實踐不被視為 standard of care。

label: APC-C
description: APC-C degrades CYCLIN B1 post-metaphase, the canonical mitotic-exit step.
description_zh_TW: APC-C 在中期後降解 CYCLIN B1，是典型的有絲分裂退出步驟。

label: Triapine
description: Triapine (3-AP) is an investigational alpha-N-heterocyclic thiosemicarbazone iron chelator that inhibits ribonucleotide reductase by chelating the iron of the RRM2/RRM2B small subunits. This strips the tyrosyl-radical cofactor, inactivating RNR and collapsing de novo dNTP synthesis.
description_zh_TW: Triapine（3-AP）是研究性的 alpha-N-雜環硫代半卡巴腙鐵螯合劑，透過螯合 RRM2/RRM2B 小次單元的鐵來抑制核醣核苷酸還原酶。這剝離酪胺醯自由基輔因子，使 RNR 失活並使 de novo dNTP 合成崩潰。

label: Diazepam
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Diazepam increases GABA-A chloride-channel opening frequency, potentiating fast inhibitory neurotransmission. Modulation is the allosteric enhancement relationship.
description_zh_TW: Diazepam 提高 GABA-A 氯通道開放頻率，增強快速抑制性神經傳導。調節是變構增強關係。

label: Mitochondrial Electron Transport Chain
description: The Mitochondrial Electron Transport Chain pumps protons across the inner membrane, building the electrochemical gradient ΔΨm that defines the Mitochondrial Membrane Potential and drives ATP synthesis; its collapse is an early event in oxidative neuronal injury.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial Electron Transport Chain 將質子泵送過內膜，建立定義 Mitochondrial Membrane Potential 的電化學梯度 ΔΨm 並驅動 ATP 合成；其崩解是氧化性神經損傷的早期事件。

label: MPC
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: The mitochondrial pyruvate carrier (MPC) is a heterodimeric MPC1/MPC2 complex in the inner mitochondrial membrane that imports cytosolic pyruvate, derived from glycolysis, into the matrix. There pyruvate is converted to acetyl-CoA by the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex, so MPC links glycolysis to mitochondrial oxidative metabolism and is the rate-limiting entry point for glucose-derived carbon into the TCA cycle.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體丙酮酸載體（MPC）是由 MPC1/MPC2 組成的異二聚體複合體，位於粒線體內膜，將源自糖解作用的細胞質丙酮酸輸入基質。在基質中，丙酮酸由丙酮酸去氫酶複合體轉為乙醯輔酶 A，因此 MPC 連結了糖解作用與粒線體氧化代謝，是葡萄糖來源碳進入 TCA 循環的限速入口。

label: Melanocytes
description: Melanocytes and Cutaneous Melanoma are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Melanocytes and Cutaneous Melanoma may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Melanocytes 和 Cutaneous Melanoma 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Melanocytes 和 Cutaneous Melanoma 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Andy Crump
description: Andy Crump is a scientist and science communicator who has documented the discovery and global health impact of Ivermectin, authoring books and heavily cited historical accounts that trace the drug from the soil bacterium Streptomyces avermectinius to a Nobel-recognized therapy. His writing situates Ivermectin within the broader history of Avermectin research and the Merck & Co. Inc donation programme.
description_zh_TW: Andy Crump 是記錄 Ivermectin 發現史與全球健康影響的科學家與科學傳播者，他撰寫專書與大量引用文獻，將此藥從土壤細菌 Streptomyces avermectinius 追溯到獲諾貝爾認可的治療。他的著作將 Ivermectin 置於更廣泛的 Avermectin 研究史與 Merck & Co. Inc 捐贈計畫的脈絡中。

label: Mitochondrial Matrix
description: The Mitochondrial Matrix is the site of the Citric Acid Cycle, where acetyl-CoA is oxidized to generate the NADH and FADH2 that feed the mitochondrial electron transport chain.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial Matrix 是 Citric Acid Cycle 進行的場所，acetyl-CoA 在此被氧化，產生供應粒線體電子傳遞鏈的 NADH 與 FADH2。

label: translational-level regulation
description: Autophagy is controlled by translational-level regulation through four distinct mechanisms: eIF2α phosphorylation, 4E-BP1/eIF4E control, PDCD4/eIF4A inhibition and m6A Modification of autophagy gene mRNAs. Having several independent handles means the cell can tune autophagic machinery output without changing the transcription of the genes themselves.
description_zh_TW: Autophagy 透過四種不同機制受到 translational-level regulation 調控：eIF2α 磷酸化、4E-BP1/eIF4E 調控、PDCD4/eIF4A 抑制，以及自噬基因 mRNA 的 m6A Modification。擁有多個彼此獨立的著力點，代表細胞可在不改變基因轉錄的情況下調整自噬機組的產出。

label: NRH
description: Beyond its classical role of phosphorylating adenosine to AMP in purine salvage, Adenosine kinase acts as an NRH kinase, phosphorylating the reduced nucleoside NRH (dihydronicotinamide riboside) to generate NMNH. Because NRH is more stable than Nicotinamide Riboside and more potently raises cellular NAD+, this reaction explains why NRH outcompetes NR as a precursor.
description_zh_TW: 除了在嘌呤補救途徑中將腺苷磷酸化為 AMP 的經典角色之外，Adenosine Kinase 還作為 NRH 激酶作用，將還原核苷 NRH（dihydronicotinamide riboside）磷酸化生成 NMNH。由於 NRH 比 Nicotinamide Riboside 更穩定、且更有效提升細胞 NAD+，此反應解釋了 NRH 作為前驅物為何優於 NR。

label: Mitomycin C
description: Mitomycin C is a prototypical intra- plus interstrand crosslinker. Classification defines the drug.
description_zh_TW: Mitomycin C 是原型的鏈內加鏈間交聯劑。歸類定義藥物。

label: AP2
description: AP2 is recruited to autolysosomal microdomains enriched in PtdIns(4,5)P2 during Autophagic Lysosome Reformation, where it nucleates clathrin coats that drive the membrane tubulation producing proto-lysosomes. Depletion of AP2 subunits impairs tubule formation and lysosome reformation.
description_zh_TW: 在 Autophagic Lysosome Reformation 過程中，AP2 會被招募到富含 PtdIns(4,5)P2 的自噬溶酶體微區，並在該處成核形成 clathrin 衣被以驅動產生 proto-lysosome 的膜管形成。AP2 次單元耗竭會損害膜管形成與溶酶體再形成。

label: Beta-Adrenergic Receptor
description: Beta-adrenergic receptors are G protein-coupled receptors activated by the catecholamines norepinephrine and epinephrine; the beta1 subtype predominates in the heart and beta2 in smooth and skeletal muscle, mediating sympathetic control of heart rate, contractility and metabolism.
description_zh_TW: Beta-adrenergic receptor 是由兒茶酚胺 norepinephrine 與 epinephrine 活化的 G 蛋白偶聯受體；beta1 亞型主要存在於心臟，beta2 存在於平滑肌與骨骼肌，介導交感神經對心率、收縮力與代謝的調控。

label: Astrocyte Senescence
description: Sustained cGAS-STING Pathway activation downstream of proteotoxic and mitochondrial stress drives Astrocyte Senescence, a stable growth-arrested, pro-inflammatory state with a SASP secretome that amplifies Neuroinflammation and neurodegeneration.
