description_zh_TW: 在蛋白毒性與粒線體壓力之下持續活化的 cGAS-STING Pathway 會驅動 Astrocyte Senescence——一種穩定停滯生長、促發炎且具有 SASP 分泌表型的狀態，進而放大 Neuroinflammation 與神經退化。

label: Silver sulfide albuminates
description: Silver sulfide albuminates are the circulating transport form that delivers Silver from the blood to peripheral tissues. This protein-bound sulfide is the mechanistic bridge between systemic silver exposure and the tissue granules responsible for the pigmentation seen in Argyria, because it keeps silver soluble in plasma until it reaches and precipitates in the dermis.
description_zh_TW: Silver sulfide albuminates 是將 Silver 由血液運送至周邊組織的循環運輸形式。這種蛋白結合態的硫化物是全身性 silver 曝露與造成 Argyria 色素沉著之組織顆粒之間的機制橋樑：它讓 silver 在血漿中保持可溶狀態，直到抵達真皮並沉澱為顆粒。

label: Dopaminochrome
description: Multiple lines of evidence implicate Dopaminochrome in the selective vulnerability of substantia nigra pars compacta neurons in Parkinson's Disease: postmortem PD brains show 3–5-fold elevations of dopamine oxidation products, PARK2 (Parkin) mutations impair mitophagy and enhance dopaminochrome accumulation, PARK7 (DJ-1) deficiency reduces buffering against dopamine quinones, and Dopaminochrome modification accelerates SNCA alpha-synuclein crosslinking and aggregation.
description_zh_TW: 多項證據指出 Dopaminochrome 參與 substantia nigra pars compacta 神經元在 Parkinson's Disease 中的選擇性脆弱性：屍檢 PD 腦中的 dopamine 氧化產物升高 3–5 倍，PARK2（Parkin）突變損害 mitophagy 並加劇 dopaminochrome 累積，PARK7（DJ-1）缺乏降低對 dopamine quinone 的緩衝能力，而 Dopaminochrome 修飾會加速 SNCA alpha-synuclein 的交聯與聚集。

label: NRK2
description: NRK2 (Nmrk2/Itgb1bp3/Mibp) is a muscle-specific NAD+ biosynthetic enzyme that phosphorylates nicotinamide riboside (NR) to nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN), the rate-limiting entry step of the salvage pathway: NR → (NRK2) → NMN → (NMNAT) → NAD+. It provides a stress-responsive supplementary route alongside NAMPT and becomes critical during muscle regeneration and metabolic stress.
description_zh_TW: NRK2（Nmrk2/Itgb1bp3/Mibp）是肌肉專一性的 NAD+ 生合成酵素，可將 nicotinamide riboside (NR) 磷酸化為 nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN)，此為 salvage pathway 的限速入口步驟：NR → (NRK2) → NMN → (NMNAT) → NAD+。它與 NAMPT 並行提供一條壓力反應的補充途徑，在肌肉再生與代謝壓力期間變得關鍵。

label: Immune System
source_file: _document_ - The Mechanistic Target of Rapamycin (mTOR) Pathway as a Target of Anti-aging Therapies The Role of Rapamycin and Its Analogs in the Regulation of Cellular Processes and Their Impact on Longevity.md
description: Cancer evades Immune System. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. The immune system surveys and eliminates nascent malignancies, a process tumors must subvert to establish and progress. The relationship is directional, with Cancer acting as the operative agent upon Immune System rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Cancer 迴避 Immune System。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。 Immune System 研究並消除新生的惡性腫瘤，這是腫瘤形成和發展必須顛覆的過程。這種關係是有方向的，Cancer 充當 Immune System 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: IDH2
description: SIRT5 activates IDH2 through desuccinylation, enhancing its NADPH-producing activity and thereby supporting glutathione reduction and ROS scavenging. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of IDH2-dependent redox buffering. This complements SOD1 activation in antioxidant defense, and it shows SIRT5's desuccinylation broadly strengthens reductive capacity. By boosting NADPH production, SIRT5 ensures sufficient reducing equivalents for glutathione and thioredoxin systems. This regulation links SIRT5 to both energy metabolism and redox homeostasis, particularly during fasting when oxidative stress rises.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過去琥珀醯化活化 IDH2，增強其 NADPH 產生活性，從而支持穀胱甘肽還原和 ROS 清除。在方向性上，SIRT5 位於 IDH2 依賴性紅氧緩衝的上游。這與 SOD1 活化在抗氧化防禦中互補，並表明 SIRT5 的去琥珀醯化廣泛增強還原能力。透過增強 NADPH 產生，SIRT5 確保穀胱甘肽和硫氧還蛋白系統有足夠的還原當量。此調控將 SIRT5 與能量代謝和紅氧恆定性聯繫起來，特別是在禁食期間氧化壓力升高時。

label: PD-L1
description: PD-1, a type I transmembrane inhibitory receptor of the CD28 family with ITIM and ITSM motifs, is engaged by PD-L1 (B7-H1/CD274) and PD-L2. Ligand engagement recruits the SHP-1 and SHP-2 phosphatases to the ITSM, dephosphorylating downstream CD28/PI3K/AKT and RAS-MEK-ERK components and suppressing T-cell proliferation, cytokine production, and cytotoxicity.
description_zh_TW: PD-1 是 CD28 家族具 ITIM 與 ITSM 模體的 I 型跨膜抑制性受體，由 PD-L1（B7-H1/CD274）與 PD-L2 結合。配體結合會將 SHP-1 與 SHP-2 磷酸酶招募至 ITSM，使下游 CD28/PI3K/AKT 與 RAS-MEK-ERK 成分去磷酸化，抑制 T 細胞增殖、細胞激素生成與細胞毒性。

label: SAHA
description: SAHA (suberoylanilide hydroxamic acid, INN vorinostat) is the prototypical hydroxamic-acid pan-HDAC inhibitor: its zinc-chelating hydroxamate group occupies the catalytic pocket of Zn2+-dependent HDACs, blocking class I and class II deacetylases. It became the first HDAC inhibitor approved by the FDA in 2006, for cutaneous T-cell lymphoma.
description_zh_TW: SAHA（suberoylanilide hydroxamic acid，INN 名 vorinostat）是羥肟酸類廣效 HDAC 抑制劑的原型：其螯鋅羥肟酸基團占據 Zn2+ 依賴型 HDAC 的催化口袋，阻斷第一類與第二類去乙醯化酶。2006 年 SAHA 成為首個獲 FDA 核准的 HDAC 抑制劑，用於皮膚型 T 細胞淋巴瘤。

label: Myosin
description: Non-muscle myosin II generates the contractile forces needed for Cell Migration: it drives protrusion retraction, rear-end detachment, and adhesion turnover at the trailing edge, all on Cytoskeleton-resident Actin tracks.
description_zh_TW: 非肌肉型 myosin II 產生 Cell Migration（細胞遷移）所需的收縮力：驅動前緣的伸縮、尾端分離，以及後緣的黏附周轉—all 皆在 Cytoskeleton（細胞骨架）中的 Actin 軌道上進行。

label: HMGA1
description: HMGA1 is a non-histone chromatin architectural protein induced during senescence, where it cooperates with the RB1 pathway to promote formation of repressive heterochromatin at E2F target genes and at senescence-associated heterochromatin foci (SAHF).
description_zh_TW: HMGA1 是在衰老期間被誘導的非組蛋白染色質架構蛋白，與 RB1 途徑合作，在 E2F 目標基因及衰老相關異染色質焦點（SAHF）處促進抑制性異染色質的形成。

label: Tocopherols
description: Tocopherols are the four naturally occurring forms of Vitamin E - alpha, beta, gamma and delta - sharing the chroman-6-ol core but carrying a saturated 16-carbon phytyl tail, and differing only in chromanol ring methylation. Along with the unsaturated Tocotrienols they make up the eight vitamers of vitamin E. The phenolic hydroxyl is the hydrogen donor that terminates Lipid Peroxidation, while the lipophilic tail anchors the molecule in the lipid bilayer or lipoprotein core.
description_zh_TW: Tocopherols 是 Vitamin E 的四種天然存在形式——alpha、beta、gamma 與 delta——共用 chroman-6-ol 核心，但帶有飽和的 16 碳 phytyl 尾，差異僅在 chromanol 環的甲基化。它們與不飽和的 Tocotrienols 合計構成 vitamin E 的八種 vitamer。酚羥基是終止 Lipid Peroxidation 的氫原子提供者，而親脂性尾部則把分子錨定在脂質雙層或脂蛋白核心中。

label: eIF4A
description: Translation Initiation depends on eIF4A, the ATP-dependent DEAD-box RNA helicase that unwinds secondary structure in 5' UTRs so the ribosome can scan to the AUG start codon. eIF4A acts within the eIF4F complex together with eIF4E and eIF4G, and its activity on TFEB mRNA is a node at which autophagy gene expression can be controlled.
description_zh_TW: Translation Initiation 依賴 eIF4A，即 ATP 依賴型 DEAD-box RNA 解旋酶；它解开 5' UTR 的二級結構，使核糖體得以掃描至 AUG 起始密碼子。eIF4A 與 eIF4E、eIF4G 一起在 eIF4F 複合體中作用，其對 TFEB mRNA 的活性是調控自噬基因表現的關節點。

label: Lipid Synthesis
description: SREBP-1c is the master transcriptional regulator of de novo lipogenesis. Synthesized as an inactive precursor anchored to the endoplasmic reticulum, it is processed and released by S1P/S2P proteases after SCAP-mediated transport to the Golgi at low sterol, and the active N-terminal domain translocates to the nucleus to drive fatty acid and triglyceride biosynthesis.
description_zh_TW: SREBP-1c 是 de novo lipogenesis（從新生脂質合成）的核心轉錄調節因子。它先以失活前驅物形式錨定於 endoplasmic reticulum，在低固醇時經 SCAP 運送至 Golgi apparatus 後由 S1P/S2P 蛋白酶切割，其活性 N 端區段轉位至細胞核，驅動脂肪酸與三酸甘油酯的生合成。

label: Intrinsic Pathway
description: Doxorubicin (Adriamycin), an anthracycline chemotherapy drug, exerts anticancer effects by intercalating between DNA base pairs, inhibiting topoisomerase II-mediated DNA repair, and generating free radicals that induce Oxidative Stress. These actions collectively trigger the Intrinsic Pathway of Apoptosis.
description_zh_TW: Doxorubicin（Adriamycin）是一種 anthracycline 類化療藥物，其抗癌作用來自插入 DNA 鹼基對之間、抑制 topoisomerase II 媒介的 DNA 修補，以及產生自由基而誘發 Oxidative Stress。這些作用共同啟動 Apoptosis 的 Intrinsic Pathway。

label: Atg14L
description: Atg14L promotes the fusion of mature autophagosomes with the lysosome by binding the tethering factor Syntaxin 17, completing autophagic flux. This positions Atg14L not only in initiation but also in the lysosomal degradation step of autophagy.
description_zh_TW: Atg14L 透過結合繫鏈因子 Syntaxin 17 促進成熟自噬體與溶酶體的融合，完成自噬流。這使 Atg14L 不僅參與起始，也參與自噬的溶酶體降解步驟。

label: ECM
description: Advanced glycation end products accumulate within the extracellular matrix (ECM), such as in collagen and elastic fibers, and cross-link with ECM components. This accumulation and cross-linking cause a decrease in connective tissue elasticity, alter ECM structure and function, and impair vascular function, facilitating plaque formation and basement membrane hyperplasia. AGE accumulation in the ECM is one of the three major mechanisms by which AGEs contribute to aging, alongside intracellular glycation and RAGE-mediated signaling. ECM glycation is strongly implicated in arterial stiffening, skin aging, and age-related stiffness of tendons and cartilage.
description_zh_TW: Advanced glycation end products 堆積於 extracellular matrix（ECM，如 collagen 與 elastic fibers）內，並與 ECM components 交聯。此 accumulation 與 cross-linking 導致 connective tissue 彈性下降、改變 ECM structure 與 function，並損害 vascular function，促進 plaque formation 與 basement membrane hyperplasia。ECM 中的 AGE accumulation 是 AGEs 促成 aging 的三大主要機制之一，另外兩者為 intracellular glycation 與 RAGE-mediated signaling。ECM glycation 與 arterial stiffening、skin aging 以及 tendons 與 cartilage 的年齡相關 stiffness 密切相關。

label: Sirtuin Activators
description: Sirtuin activators are compounds and interventions that increase the catalytic efficiency or expression of sirtuins; the best-studied class are the sirtuin-activating compounds (STACs) exemplified by resveratrol, which lower the KM of SIRT1 for its peptide and NAD+ substrates.
description_zh_TW: Sirtuin 活化劑是提高 sirtuin 催化效率或表現量的化合物與介入手段；研究最充分的一類是以 resveratrol 為代表的 sirtuin 活化化合物（STACs），它們降低 SIRT1 對其胜肽與 NAD+ 受質的 KM。

label: ovarian cancer
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: BRCA predisposes to ovarian cancer. BRCA1 and BRCA2 are tumor suppressors that orchestrate homology-directed repair of DNA double-strand breaks and genome stability. High-grade serous ovarian cancer is characterized by frequent BRCA1/2 dysfunction and exquisite sensitivity to platinum and PARP inhibition. The relationship is directional, with BRCA acting as the operative agent upon ovarian cancer rather than the reverse. Such relationships underscore how inherited or intrinsic factors shape cancer susceptibility and inform risk-stratified screening and prevention.
description_zh_TW: BRCA 傾向於ovarian cancer。 BRCA1 和 BRCA2 負責協調 DNA 雙股斷裂的同源定向修復和基因組穩定性。高等級漿液性ovarian cancer的特徵是頻繁的BRCA1/2功能障礙以及對鉑和PARP抑制的高度敏感性。這種關係是有方向的，BRCA 充當 ovarian cancer 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種關係強調了遺傳或內在因素如何影響癌症易感性，並為風險分層篩檢和預防提供資訊。

label: p27
description: The CDK inhibitor p27 is co-induced with p21 to enforce cell cycle arrest. p27 inhibits G1 cyclin-CDK complexes, maintaining cells in a non-proliferative state. Together with p21 it represents a key effector of growth arrest.
description_zh_TW: CDK 抑制劑 p27 與 p21 共同被誘導以強制實施細胞週期停滯。p27 抑制 G1 cyclin–CDK 複合體，使細胞維持在非增殖狀態。它與 p21 共同構成生長停滯的關鍵效應因子。

label: AceCS2
description: AceCS2 is the mitochondrial matrix acetyl-CoA synthetase that catalyzes the ATP-dependent two-step adenylation of acetate and CoA into acetyl-CoA, via an acetyl-AMP intermediate. By reclaiming acetate — often viewed as a waste product — as usable carbon, it feeds acetyl-CoA into the TCA cycle for ATP generation and buffers supply when pyruvate-derived acetyl-CoA is limiting.
description_zh_TW: AceCS2 是粒線體基質的乙醯輔酶 A 合成酶，經由乙醯 AMP 中間物，催化醋酸與 CoA 依賴 ATP 的兩步腺苷酸化反應生成 acetyl-CoA。它回收常被視為廢物的醋酸作為可用碳源，將 acetyl-CoA 送入 TCA 循環以產生 ATP，並在丙酮酸衍生的 acetyl-CoA 不足時提供緩衝。

label: Cell Division
description: Cell Division, in which a parent cell yields two or more daughter cells, is tightly governed by the Cell Cycle, with checkpoints ensuring accuracy of DNA replication and chromosome segregation. Key regulators include cyclin/CDK complexes, Rb/E2F, p53, and checkpoint kinases; dysregulated division is a hallmark of cancer.
description_zh_TW: Cell Division（細胞分裂，親代細胞產生兩個或更多子細胞）受到 Cell Cycle 的嚴密調控，並由檢查點確保 DNA 複製與染色體分離的正確性。主要調控因子包括 cyclin/CDK 複合體、Rb/E2F、p53 與檢查點激酶；失調的細胞分裂是 cancer 的特徵之一。

label: Ellagic acid
source_file: _document_ - Natural Bioactive Compounds Spermidine Fisetin Berberine Urolithin A.md
description: Dietary ellagitannins hydrolyze to Ellagic Acid, which colonic Gordonibacter urolithinfaciens and Ellagibacter isourolithinifaciens convert through urolithin M6/C to terminal Urolithin A; only Metabotype A individuals (25-55%) convert efficiently, so direct UA supplementation bypasses microbiome dependency.
description_zh_TW: 飲食 ellagitannins 水解為 Ellagic Acid，再由結腸 Gordonibacter urolithinfaciens 與 Ellagibacter isourolithinifaciens 經 urolithin M6/C 轉為終端 Urolithin A；僅 Metabotype A 個體（25–55%）能有效轉換，故直接補充 UA 可繞過菌相依賴。

label: GLO1
description: GLO1 (glyoxalase 1, lactoylglutathione lyase) is the rate-limiting enzyme of the cellular Glyoxalase System. It catalyzes conversion of hemithioacetals, which form spontaneously between the reactive dicarbonyl Methylglyoxal and Glutathione, into S-D-lactoylglutathione, committing the dicarbonyl to detoxification rather than further reaction.
description_zh_TW: GLO1（glyoxalase 1，lactoylglutathione lyase）是細胞 Glyoxalase System 的限速酵素。它催化將反應性二碳醣基 Methylglyoxal 與 Glutathione 自發形成的 hemithioacetal 轉為 S-D-lactoylglutathione，使該二碳醣基被導向去毒途徑而非進一步反應。

label: Xanthine Oxidase
description: Uric acid (UA) is the terminal end-product of human purine catabolism. Xanthine Oxidase catalyzes the final two oxidations of the pathway, converting hypoxanthine to xanthine and xanthine to urate, which is why inhibiting this enzyme with allopurinol is the standard way to lower uric acid in gout.
description_zh_TW: Uric acid (UA) 是人類嘌呤分解代謝的最終產物。Xanthine Oxidase 催化途徑中最後兩次氧化，將 hypoxanthine 氧化為 xanthine，再將 xanthine 氧化為 urate；因此以 allopurinol 抑制此酵素是降低 gout 中 uric acid 的標準作法。

label: Histone Methyltransferase
description: Histone Methyltransferase enzymes are the 'writers' of Histone Methylation, using S-adenosylmethionine (SAM) as the universal methyl donor. Lysine methyltransferases such as SUV39H1, EZH2 and DOT1L, and arginine PRMTs, show high residue specificity, which is what allows repressive and activating marks to occupy distinct sites.
description_zh_TW: Histone Methyltransferase 酵素是 Histone Methylation 的「寫入者」，以 S-adenosylmethionine（SAM）作為通用的甲基供體。SUV39H1、EZH2、DOT1L 等離胺酸甲基轉移酶，以及精胺酸 PRMT，對殘基具有高度專一性，正因如此抑制性與活化性標記才能占據不同位點。

label: MELAS
description: MELAS is a maternally inherited mitochondrial disorder caused most commonly by the A3243G mutation in the mitochondrial DNA tRNA-Leu(UUR) gene, which disrupts translation of the 13 protein-coding genes and leads to energy failure in high-demand tissues.
description_zh_TW: MELAS 是母系遺傳的粒線體疾病，最常由粒線體 DNA 的 tRNA-Leu(UUR) 基因 A3243G 突變引起，該突變破壞 13 個蛋白質編碼基因的轉譯，導致高需求組織發生能量衰竭。

label: H3K18ac
description: H3K18ac is an acetylation associated with active enhancers and is one of the acetyl marks enriched at senescence-activated super-enhancers. It contributes to the open, transcriptionally competent state of SASP enhancers and cooperates with the AP-1 pioneer factor.
description_zh_TW: H3K18ac 是與活性增強子相關的乙醯化，是衰老活化超級增強子富集的乙醯標記之一。它促成 SASP 增強子的開放、轉錄勝任狀態，並與 AP-1 先驅因子合作。

label: Human Serum Albumin
description: Human Serum Albumin is the most abundant plasma protein (35–50 g/L; 66.5 kDa, 585 residues) and the body's major transport protein for fatty acids, Bilirubin, hormones, metal ions and a wide range of drugs. It also maintains plasma colloid oncotic pressure and buffers pH, and its free Cys34 thiol scavenges Reactive Oxygen Species and nitrogen species extracellularly.
description_zh_TW: Human Serum Albumin 是血漿中最豐富的蛋白質（35–50 g/L；66.5 kDa、585 個殘基），也是脂肪酸、Bilirubin、荷爾蒙、金屬離子與廣泛藥物的全身主要運輸蛋白。它同時維持血漿膠體滲透壓並緩衝 pH，其游離的 Cys34 硫醇還能在細胞外清除 Reactive Oxygen Species 與含氮物種。

label: SRT1460
description: SRT1460 belongs to the imidazothiazole class of synthetic sirtuin-activating compounds (STACs), structurally unrelated to the polyphenolic first-generation STAC resveratrol, and is discussed alongside SRT1720 and SRT2183 as second-generation activators found by high-throughput screening of SIRT1 activity.
description_zh_TW: SRT1460 屬於咪唑並噻唑類的合成 sirtuin 活化劑（STAC），與多酚類第一代 STAC resveratrol 結構無關；它與 SRT1720、SRT2183 一同被視為透過 SIRT1 活性高 throughput 篩檢發現的第二代活化劑。

label: Myostatin
description: Myostatin is the principal negative regulator of Muscle Hypertrophy. Binding activin type IIB receptors and recruiting ALK4/5 to phosphorylate SMAD2/3, it represses myogenic genes, blocks myoblast proliferation and differentiation, and antagonizes Akt/mTORC1 anabolic signalling — the brake that loss-of-function 'double-muscling' mutations remove.
description_zh_TW: Myostatin 是 Muscle Hypertrophy 的主要負向調節因子。它結合 activin type IIB 受體並招募 ALK4/5 去磷酸化 SMAD2/3，抑制肌源性基因、阻斷 myoblast 的增殖與分化，並拮抗 Akt/mTORC1 的合成代謝訊號——這正是功能喪失型「double-muscling」突變所解除的煞車。

label: Ubiquitin
description: Ubiquitin is a conserved 76-amino-acid protein that, through an E1/E2/E3 cascade, is covalently attached to lysines of target proteins. The resulting K48-linked chains are the canonical degradation signal recognized by the Ubiquitin-Proteasome System, while K63-linked chains instead mediate signaling, endocytosis and DNA repair, and deubiquitinases reverse the mark.
description_zh_TW: Ubiquitin 是一種高度保守的 76 胺基酸蛋白質，經由 E1/E2/E3 級聯反應共價連接到目標蛋白的離胺酸殘基。所形成的 K48 鏈是 26S proteasome 辨識的典型降解訊號，而 K63 鏈則參與訊號傳遞、胞吞與 DNA 修復，去泛素化酵素則可逆轉此標記。

label: Cysteinyldopa
description: Because cysteinyldopa formation diverts dopaquinone away from redox polymerization toward a stable thioether adduct, it mitigates quinone-driven ROS generation. It therefore represents the thiol-capture arm of the same ortho-quinone management problem that the adrenochrome/aminochrome pathway illustrates in the adrenergic setting.
description_zh_TW: 由於 Cysteinyldopa 的形成把 Dopaquinone 從 redox 聚合導向穩定的硫醚加合物，它減輕了醌類所驅動的 ROS 生成。因此它代表著與 adrenochrome/aminochrome 路徑在腎上腺素能情境中所闡明者，同一鄰醌管理問題的硫醇捕捉一環。

label: Rag proteins
description: Rag GTPases (RagA/B and RagC/D) function as heterodimers that bind the mTORC1 subunit Raptor and promote relocalization of mTORC1 to the lysosomal surface, where its activator Rheb resides. Amino-acid sufficiency favors the active Rag conformation and positions mTORC1 for activation.
description_zh_TW: Rag GTP 酶（RagA/B 與 RagC/D）以異二聚體形式結合 mTORC1 次單元 Raptor，並促進 mTORC1 重定位到溶酶體表面，也就是其活化因子 Rheb 所在之處。胺基酸充足會偏向 Rag 的活化構形，使 mTORC1 就位以接受活化。

label: Apaf-1
description: Following mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP), often mediated by Bax and Bak, Cytochrome c is released from the mitochondrial intermembrane space into the cytoplasm, where it binds Apaf-1 and pro-Caspase-9 in the presence of dATP/ATP. This nucleates Apoptosome assembly, which activates the initiator Caspase-9 in the Intrinsic Pathway of Apoptosis.
description_zh_TW: 在粒線體外膜通透化（MOMP）之後（常由 Bax 與 Bak 介導），Cytochrome c（細胞色素 c）由粒線體膜間腔釋放至細胞質，並在 dATP／ATP 存在下結合 Apaf-1 與 pro-Caspase-9，啟動 Apoptosome（凋亡小體）的組裝，進而活化起始型 Caspase-9，完成 Apoptosis（細胞凋亡）內在途徑的啟動。

label: Muscle
description: Myosin motors walk along Actin filaments and convert ATP hydrolysis into mechanical force. Sarcomeric myosin II drives Muscle contraction in Cardiomyocytes, and myosin light-chain phosphorylation tunes contractility in smooth muscle and endothelium.
description_zh_TW: Myosin 馬達蛋白沿著 Actin（肌動蛋白）絲移動，將 ATP 水解轉換為機械力。肌節型 myosin II 驅動 Cardiomyocytes（心肌細胞）中的 Muscle（肌肉）收縮，而 myosin 輕鏈磷酸化則調節平滑肌與內皮細胞的收縮力。

label: Cataract
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: Cataract is the opacification of the eye's crystalline lens, and its formation is driven by cumulative oxidative damage: thiol oxidation, protein carbonylation, and AGE-mediated glycation unfold and cross-link Lens Crystallins, which then aggregate and scatter light. Because the lens has minimal protein turnover, the damage accumulates irreversibly.
description_zh_TW: Cataract（白內障）是眼睛晶狀體的混濁，其形成由累積的氧化性傷害驅動：硫醇氧化、protein carbonylation（蛋白質羰基化）與 AGE 介導的糖化使 Lens Crystallins（晶狀體晶 crystallin 蛋白）展開並交聯，隨後聚集並散射光線。由於晶狀體的蛋白質周轉率極低，傷害會不可逆地累積。

label: Sodium hydrogencarbonate
description: Sodium hydrogencarbonate (NaHCO3) serves as the preferred buffer during the oxidation of Epinephrine, maintaining the reaction medium within the pH 4-8 range required for adrenochrome formation. It is one of several buffer options (sodium dihydrogenphosphate, disodium hydrogenphosphate, potassium acetate, sodium acetate) in industrial adrenochrome processes.
description_zh_TW: Sodium hydrogencarbonate（NaHCO3）在 Epinephrine 的 Oxidation 過程中作為首選緩衝液，將反應介質維持在形成 Adrenochrome 所需的 pH 4–8 範圍內。它是工業 Adrenochrome 製程中數種緩衝選項之一（磷酸二氫鈉、磷酸氫二鈉、醋酸鉀、醋酸鈉）。

label: NF-kB signaling
description: Luteolin exerts anti-inflammatory effects primarily through inhibition of pro-inflammatory signaling cascades, including NF-kB activation, MAPK phosphorylation, and the NLRP3 inflammasome. This broad suppression of inflammatory signaling underlies its benefits in atopic diseases and neuroinflammation. It is a key mechanism distinct from its COMT interactions.
description_zh_TW: Luteolin 主要透過抑制促發炎訊號級聯（包括 NF-kB 活化、MAPK 磷酸化和 NLRP3 發炎小體）來發揮抗發炎作用。這種對發炎訊號的廣泛抑制是其對異位性疾病和神經發炎益處的基礎。這是與其 COMT 交互作用不同的關鍵機制。

label: Polyunsaturated fatty acids
description: Docosahexaenoic acid (DHA, 22:6(n-3)) is an omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acid with six cis double bonds, making it one of the most oxidatively labile lipids in biology. It is the major n-3 PUFA (against Arachidonic acid as the major n-6 PUFA) and is highly enriched in neuronal membranes, retinal photoreceptors, and spermatozoa.
description_zh_TW: Docosahexaenoic acid（DHA，22:6(n-3)）是具有六個 cis 雙鍵的 omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acid，使其成為生物學上最易被氧化的脂質之一。它是主要的 n-3 PUFA（相對地，Arachidonic acid 為主要的 n-6 PUFA），並高度富集於神經元膜、視網膜光受器與精子中。

label: Methionine
description: Dietary Methionine restriction extends the lifespan of many species and recapitulates many benefits of Protein Restriction. The response is partially dependent on FGF21 and also inhibits mTORC1; most methionine restriction studies additionally require Cysteine depletion, since cysteine can be synthesized from methionine via transsulfuration. Methionine is therefore one of the primary drivers of protein restriction benefits alongside the branched-chain amino acids.
description_zh_TW: 飲食性的 Methionine restriction 可延長多種動物的壽命，並重現 Protein Restriction 的多項效益。此反應部分依賴 FGF21，也會抑制 mTORC1；多數甲硫胺酸限制研究另需搭配 Cysteine 耗竭，因為半胱胺酸可經轉硫作用由甲硫胺酸合成。因此 Methionine 是蛋白質限制效益的主要驅動者之一，與支鏈胺基酸並列。

label: MacroD1
description: MacroD1 (LRP16) is a MacroD-type macrodomain ADP-ribosylation eraser, predominantly in the mitochondrial matrix with nuclear splice forms. It hydrolyses mono-ADP-ribose ester-linked to aspartate/glutamate to counteract writers such as PARP10/PARP7, and after PARG pre-trimming it also counteracts PARP1 mono-modification. It is inactive toward PAR polymers, which are left to PARG/ARH3.
description_zh_TW: MacroD1（LRP16）是 MacroD 型巨結構域的 ADP-核糖基化「擦除者」，主要位於粒線體基質，並有核內剪接 isoform。它水解與天門冬胺酸／麩胺酸酯鍵結的單一 ADP-核糖，以抵銷 PARP10/PARP7 等「寫入者」；在 PARG 預先修剪鏈之後，它也能抵銷 PARP1 的單一修飾。它對 PAR 聚合物無活性，後者交由 PARG/ARH3 處理。

label: GATOR2
description: CASTOR1 acts as a GATOR2-interacting inhibitor of mTORC1 signaling: in the absence of arginine it sequesters GATOR2, and arginine binding dissociates CASTOR1 from GATOR2, releasing GATOR2 to inhibit GATOR1 and activate Rag GTPases.
description_zh_TW: CASTOR1 是與 GATOR2 交互作用、抑制 mTORC1 訊號的蛋白：缺乏 Arginine 時它隔離 GATOR2；Arginine 結合則使 CASTOR1 與 GATOR2 解離，釋放 GATOR2 去抑制 GATOR1 並活化 Rag GTPase。

label: Wnt4
description: BMP and Wnt4 synergize in osteoblast differentiation and neural crest programs. Crosstalk integrates two morphogen axes.
description_zh_TW: BMP 與 Wnt4 在造骨細胞分化與神經脊程序協同。交互作用整合兩個形態發生素軸。

label: DNA Replication Stress
description: Gemcitabine induces DNA replication stress through two converging mechanisms: masked chain termination after incorporation of the triphosphate into nascent DNA, and dNTP pool depletion via ribonucleotide reductase inhibition. Together these stall replication forks and destabilize ongoing DNA synthesis.
description_zh_TW: Gemcitabine 透過兩個匯聚機制誘導 DNA 複製壓力：三磷酸嵌入新生 DNA 後的隱蔽式鏈終止，以及透過抑制 ribonucleotide reductase 造成的 dNTP 池耗竭。這兩者共同使複製叉停滯並破壞正在進行的 DNA 合成。

label: Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization
description: Displacement of BAK's anti-apoptotic restraints by BH3-only activators (Bim, Bid, Puma, Noxa) liberates BAK to assemble large beta-barrel pores in the outer mitochondrial membrane. This permeabilization releases cytochrome c and Smac DIABLO, initiates the caspase cascade, amplifies reactive oxygen species and can trigger Parkin-dependent mitophagy.
description_zh_TW: 當 BH3-only 活化蛋白（Bim、Bid、Puma、Noxa）排除 BAK 的抗凋亡制約後，BAK 便在粒線體外膜組裝大型 β-桶狀孔洞。這次通透化釋放 cytochrome c 與 Smac DIABLO，啟動 caspase 級聯、放大活性氧，並可觸發 Parkin 依賴性的粒線體自噬。

label: MPP+
description: MPP+ causes Mitochondrial Dysfunction by acting as the upstream trigger whose downstream consequence is the second entity's appearance or dysfunction. The mechanism typically involves oxidative, mitochondrial, or proteotoxic injury in the case of neurotoxins and pigments, or receptor blockade and cell loss in pharmacological and degenerative contexts. This causal relationship is clinically significant because it models or explains features of Parkinson's disease pathology and guides therapeutic targeting. A caveat is that in many of these links the causal claim is experimental, partial, or operates within a broader network of cofactors rather than as an isolated linear event.
description_zh_TW: MPP+ 透過充當上游觸發器來導致 Mitochondrial Dysfunction，其下游結果是第二個實體的出現或功能障礙。此機制通常涉及氧化、mitochondria1或neurotoxin和色素情況下的蛋白毒性損傷，或藥理學和退化環境中的受體阻斷和細胞損失。這種因果關係具有臨床意義，因為它模擬或解釋了 Parkinson's disease 病理特徵並指導治療目標。需要注意的是，在許多這些連結中，因果關係的主張是實驗性的、部分的，或是在更廣泛的輔助因子網絡中運作的，而不是作為一個孤立的線性事件。

label: RB1
description: RB1 is the Knudson two-hit archetype tumor suppressor. Classification is historical and textbook.
description_zh_TW: RB1 是 Knudson 二擊原型腫瘤抑制基因。歸類具歷史與教科書地位。

label: Dietary Restriction
description: Dietary restriction (DR) and its variants are among the most potent physiological activators of autophagy, engaging the pathway in most cultured cells and across many organs in vivo. By lowering circulating nutrients and insulin while raising AMP/ATP ratios, DR relieves mTORC1 inhibition and activates AMPK, thereby de-repressing the ULK1 complex and TFEB-dependent lysosomal programs. In model organisms such as C. elegans, DR induces autophagy through coordinated transcriptional changes mediated by orthologs like HLH-30/TFEB. The health- and lifespan-extending effects of DR are widely attributed in substantial part to this induction of adaptive autophagy.
description_zh_TW: 飲食限制（DR）及其變體是最強效的自噬生理活化因子之一，在大多數培養細胞和體內許多器官中啟動該途徑。透過降低循環營養素和胰島素，同時提高AMP/ATP比值，DR解除mTORC1的抑制並活化AMPK，從而解除對ULK1複合體和TFEB依賴性溶酶體程序的抑制。在如C. elegans等模式生物中，DR透過HLH-30/TFEB等同源蛋白介導的協調轉錄變化誘導自噬。DR促進健康和延長壽命的效應，在很大程度上被歸因於此適應性自噬的誘導。

label: DNA Replication
description: dNTPs are consumed stoichiometrically by DNA polymerases during DNA replication and repair, and their supply is rate-limiting. Balanced dNTP pools are essential for high-fidelity replication; both depletion and imbalance drive replication stress, mutagenesis, and genomic instability.
description_zh_TW: dNTP 在 DNA 複製與修復期間被 DNA 聚合酶以化學計量方式消耗，其供應具有速率限制。平衡的 dNTP 池對高保真複製至關重要；耗竭與失衡皆會驅動複製壓力、突變與基因體不穩定性。

label: MLL1
description: MLL1, also known as KMT2A or mixed-lineage leukemia 1, is a histone-lysine N-methyltransferase whose catalytic SET domain transfers methyl groups from SAM to histone H3 lysine 4. It acts in multiprotein complexes (WDR5, RBBP5, ASH2L, DPY30) that are required for full catalytic activity.
description_zh_TW: MLL1 又稱 KMT2A 或 mixed-lineage leukemia 1，是一個組蛋白離胺酸 N-甲基轉移酶，其催化性的 SET 結構域將 SAM 的甲基轉移到組蛋白 H3 的離胺酸 4 上。它以多蛋白複合體（WDR5、RBBP5、ASH2L、DPY30）形式作用，這些複合體對完整的催化活性是必要的。

label: ALS
description: OPTN mutations have been identified as pathogenic in ALS, and because mitophagy critically depends on OPTN and its kinase TBK1, loss of OPTN function impairs both mitochondrial clearance and axonal transport. Loss of function in this pathway therefore couples defective selective autophagy to motor neuron degeneration.
description_zh_TW: OPTN 突變已被確認在 ALS（肌萎縮性側索硬化症）中具有致病性；由於 mitophagy 高度依賴 OPTN 及其激酶 TBK1，OPTN 功能喪失會同時損害粒線體清除與軸突運輸。因此此路徑的功能喪失會把選擇性自噬缺陷與運動神經元退化連結起來。

label: SUV39H1
description: SUV39H1 deposits H3K9me3 as a family member enzyme.
description_zh_TW: SUV39H1 作為家族成員酶沉積 H3K9me3。

label: PANoptosis
description: Reperfusion injury combines a ROS burst with mtDNA release and calcium overload, and the resulting death is mixed rather than assignable to one executor, so PANoptosis is the default assumption. The confirmatory test is PANoptosome assembly (ASC, Caspase-8, and RIPK3 colocalization) rather than any single marker, because blocking one arm fails to stop the process. In the flowchart, TAK1 loss additionally drives RIPK1 kinase death independently of Caspase-8, which is the canonical route into this composite modality.
description_zh_TW: 再灌流傷害同時結合 ROS 爆發、mtDNA 釋放與鈣離子過載，其後的死亡是混合型而無法歸給單一執行者，因此以 PANoptosis 為預設假設。確認測試是 PANoptosome 的組裝（ASC、Caspase-8 與 RIPK3 共定位），而非任何單一標記，因為阻斷單一臂無法終止此過程。在流程圖中，TAK1 喪失亦可獨立於 Caspase-8 驅動 RIPK1 kinase death，這是進入此複合 modality 的典型路徑。

label: Clofarabine
description: Clofarabine's diphosphate inhibits ribonucleotide reductase (IC50 about 65 nM), depleting dNTP pools and further starving DNA synthesis. This direct RNR inhibition is complemented by DNA polymerase inhibition and chain termination by the incorporated triphosphate.
description_zh_TW: Clofarabine 的二磷酸形式抑制核醣核苷酸還原酶（IC50 約 65 nM），耗竭 dNTP 池並進一步使 DNA 合成匱乏。此直接的 RNR 抑制與嵌入的三磷酸所造成的 DNA 聚合酶抑制及鏈終止相互補。

label: Hepatocyte Growth Factor
description: HGF is the sole high-affinity ligand activating the c-Met receptor. Ligand-receptor exclusivity defines the module.
description_zh_TW: HGF 是活化 c-Met 受體的唯一高親和力配體。配體—受體專一性定義模組。

label: Atg13
description: FIP200 scaffolds the ULK1-Atg13-Atg101 kinase complex: without the FIP200 scaffold the Atg13 and Atg101 subunits cannot assemble productively with ULK1, and Autophagosome formation fails. mTORC1 controls Autophagy chiefly through this ULK1/Atg13/FIP200 complex.
description_zh_TW: FIP200 作為支架連結 ULK1-Atg13-Atg101 kinase 複合體：沒有 FIP200 支架，Atg13 與 Atg101 次單元便無法與 ULK1 有效組裝，Autophagosome 形成隨之失敗。mTORC1 主要透過此 ULK1/Atg13/FIP200 複合體調控 Autophagy。

label: Alu element
description: Alu elements are approximately 300-bp short interspersed nuclear elements (SINEs) derived from the 7SL RNA gene. With about 1.1 million copies they make up roughly 11% of the human genome, making them the most abundant Transposable Elements family; they are transcribed by RNA polymerase III and mobilize in copy-and-paste fashion through a LINE-1 ORF2 RNA intermediate.
description_zh_TW: Alu element 是約 300 bp、源自 7SL RNA 基因的短散在核元件（SINE）。約有 110 萬份拷貝，約占人類基因組的 11%，是數量最多的 Transposable Elements 家族；它們由 RNA polymerase III 轉錄，並透過 LINE-1 ORF2 蛋白的 RNA 中間物以「複製貼上」方式移動。

label: METTL3
description: METTL3 is the catalytic subunit of the writer complex that deposits N6-methyladenosine on mRNA co-transcriptionally, working with METTL14 and accessory proteins such as WTAP and VIRMA. It methylates roughly 0.1–0.4% of adenosines, preferentially in the DRACH consensus motif near stop codons, 3′ UTRs and long internal exons.
description_zh_TW: METTL3 是催化次單元，與 METTL14 及 WTAP、VIRMA 等輔助蛋白共同組成 writer 複合體，於轉錄時在 mRNA 上沉積 N6-methyladenosine。它甲基化約 0.1–0.4% 的腺苷，偏好位於終止密碼子、3′ UTR 與長內含子附近的 DRACH 共識序列。

label: Ragulator
description: The Ragulator is a multiprotein scaffold anchored at the lysosomal membrane that interacts with Rag GTPases to recruit mTORC1 to the lysosomal surface in response to amino acids. By tethering the Rag-mTORC1 complex at the lysosome, Ragulator enables amino-acid sensing to converge with Rheb-mediated activation. Loss of Ragulator disrupts nutrient-dependent mTORC1 signaling and de-represses autophagy. The complex is therefore the lynchpin coupling lysosomal amino-acid detection to mTORC1 and autophagy control.
description_zh_TW: Ragulator 是錨定於溶酶體膜上的多蛋白支架，與 Rag GTPases 交互作用，以回應胺基酸將 mTORC1 招募至溶酶體表面。透過將 Rag-mTORC1 複合物栓繫於溶酶體，Ragulator 使得胺基酸感知能與 Rheb 介導的活化匯聚。Ragulator 的缺失會破壞依賴營養的 mTORC1 信號並解除對自噬的抑制。因此該複合物是將溶酶體胺基酸偵測連結至 mTORC1 與自噬控制的關鍵樞紐。

label: uPA
description: PAI-1 is the principal physiological inhibitor of the plasminogen activators uPA and tissue-type plasminogen activator, blocking plasmin generation and therefore fibrinolysis and extracellular matrix remodelling. By suppressing plasmin it also modulates integrin and latent-growth-factor activation, feeding fibrotic and proliferative loops.
description_zh_TW: PAI-1 是 uPA 與組織型纖維蛋白溶解酶原活化素的主要生理抑制劑，阻斷 plasmin 生成，因而抑制纖維蛋白溶解與細胞外基質重塑。透過抑制 plasmin，它也調節 integrin 與潛在生長因子的活化，feeding 纖維化與增殖性回饋迴圈。

label: Bismuth
description: Water-soluble salts of bismuth, such as bismuth nitrate, bismuth oxynitrate, bismuth oxycarbonate, and bismuth citrate, accelerate the persulfate oxidation of adrenaline into adrenochrome, producing high-quality adrenochrome in high yields in a short period of time (about 30 to 45 minutes). Bismuth salts are used in amounts of 0.001 to 0.01 mole per mole of adrenaline; amounts below this do not significantly increase the reaction rate, while amounts above 0.01 mole may cause excessive oxidation and decompose the adrenochrome into tar-like by-products.
description_zh_TW: 水溶性鉍鹽，如硝酸鉍、鹼式硝酸鉍、鹼式碳酸鉍和檸檬酸鉍，可加速過硫酸鹽將腎上腺素氧化為腎上腺紅的反應，在短時間內（約30至45分鐘）以高產率生產高品質的腎上腺紅。鉍鹽的使用量為每莫耳腎上腺素0.001至0.01莫耳；低於此量不會顯著提高反應速率，而高於0.01莫耳則可能導致過度氧化並使腎上腺紅分解為焦油狀副產物。

label: Reverse Cholesterol Transport
description: Cholesterol Efflux is the first and rate-limiting step of Reverse Cholesterol Transport: cells, especially Macrophages, export excess free Cholesterol to extracellular lipid acceptors such as Apolipoprotein A1 and HDL. Because the process is the rate-limiting gateway of the whole reverse transport cascade, its impairment promotes foam cell formation and Atherosclerosis.
description_zh_TW: Cholesterol Efflux 是 Reverse Cholesterol Transport 的第一步且為速率限制步驟：細胞（尤其是 Macrophages）將過量的游離 Cholesterol 輸出至細胞外脂質受體，例如 Apolipoprotein A1 與 HDL。由於此步驟是整個逆向運輸級聯反應的速率限制關口，其功能受損會促進泡沫細胞形成與 Atherosclerosis。

label: Auranofin
description: Auranofin is a potent, irreversible covalent inhibitor of both cytosolic (TXNRD1) and mitochondrial (TXNRD2) thioredoxin reductase. Its gold(I) cation coordinates the catalytic C-terminal selenocysteine, blocking thioredoxin regeneration and converting the redox-balancing machinery into a source of lethal ROS.
description_zh_TW: Auranofin 是細胞質（TXNRD1）與粒線體（TXNRD2）硫氧還蛋白還原酶的強效、不可逆共價抑制劑。其金(I)陽離子配位催化所需的 C 端硒半胱氨酸，阻斷硫氧還蛋白再生成，並將氧化還原平衡機制轉變為致命 ROS 的來源。

label: Traumatic Brain Injury
description: Traumatic brain injury (TBI) is acquired brain injury from external mechanical force, and its primary insult is followed by a secondary cascade of energy failure and ATP depletion, glutamate-driven excitotoxicity, oxidative stress, inflammation, mitochondrial dysfunction and edema. The metabolic crisis outlasts the mechanical event, leaving the brain vulnerable for hours to days after impact.
description_zh_TW: Traumatic brain injury（TBI）是由外部機械力造成的後天腦損傷，其原發傷害之後會接續次級級聯：能量衰竭與 ATP 耗竭、glutamate 驅動的 excitotoxicity、oxidative stress、inflammation、mitochondrial dysfunction 與水腫。這場代謝危機比機械性事件持續更久，使腦部在受撞後數小時至數日內仍處於脆弱狀態。

label: Selective Serotonin Reuptake Inhibitors
source_file: _document_ - Methylene Blue Dosage What Actually Works (And What's Too Much).md
description: Methylene blue interacts dangerously with SSRIs and other serotonergic medications. As a monoamine oxidase inhibitor, methylene blue raises synaptic serotonin, and combining it with SSRIs (or SNRIs, tricyclic antidepressants, or other serotonergic drugs) can increase serotonin to dangerous levels, potentially causing serotonin syndrome. This interaction is a documented, case-report-level concern, and the article is emphatic that anyone on an antidepressant or serotonergic drug should not self-dose with methylene blue. If a person is on such medications, physician involvement is required before any dose, and the serotonin interaction screening is cited as a key reason to pursue a supervised protocol.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue與SSRIs和其他血清素能藥物危險地相互作用。作為單胺氧化酶抑制劑，methylene blue提高突觸血清素，將其與SSRIs（或SNRIs、三環類抗抑鬱藥或其他血清素能藥物）結合使用可能將血清素提升至危險水平，可能導致血清素症候群。這種相互作用是已記錄的、病例報告級別的關注點，文章強調任何服用抗抑鬱藥或血清素能藥物的人都不應自行服用methylene blue。如果一個人正在服用此類藥物，在任何劑量之前都需要醫師參與，並且血清素相互作用篩查被引用為追求監督方案的關鍵原因。

label: BRCA
description: BRCA predisposes to Breast Cancer. BRCA1 and BRCA2 are tumor suppressors that orchestrate homology-directed repair of DNA double-strand breaks and genome stability. Breast cancer is a heterogeneous malignancy in which molecular subtypes (luminal, HER2-enriched, basal/triple-negative) dictate targeted therapy choice. The relationship is directional, with BRCA acting as the operative agent upon Breast Cancer rather than the reverse. Such relationships underscore how inherited or intrinsic factors shape cancer susceptibility and inform risk-stratified screening and prevention.
description_zh_TW: BRCA 傾向於Breast Cancer。 BRCA1 和 BRCA2 負責協調 DNA 雙股斷裂的同源定向修復和基因組穩定性。 Breast Cancer 是一種異質性惡性腫瘤，其分子亞型（管腔型、HER2富集型、基礎/三陰性）決定了標靶治療的選擇。這種關係是有方向的，BRCA 充當 Breast Cancer 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種關係強調了遺傳或內在因素如何影響癌症易感性，並為風險分層篩檢和預防提供資訊。

label: GCN2
description: GCN2 (EIF2AK4) is one of four mammalian eIF2alpha kinases, activated by uncharged tRNA accumulating during amino acid starvation. It phosphorylates eIF2alpha at Ser51, which attenuates global protein synthesis while promoting translation of stress-responsive mRNAs such as ATF4, mounting the integrated stress response.
description_zh_TW: GCN2（EIF2AK4）是哺乳動物四種 eIF2α kinase 之一，由胺基酸飢餓期間累積的未攜帶胺基酸的 tRNA 活化。它在 Ser51 位點磷酸化 eIF2α，使全域蛋白質合成降低，同時促進 ATF4 等壓力反應 mRNA 的轉譯，啟動 integrated stress response。

label: SetA
description: SetA is an effector protein from Legionella pneumophila that glucosylates TFEB at multiple sites, leading to its nuclear enrichment by interfering with 14-3-3 protein binding. Because 14-3-3 binding normally retains TFEB in the cytosol, the glucosylation event hijacks the host's own regulatory mechanism to drive TFEB into the nucleus.
description_zh_TW: SetA 是來自嗜肺性退伍軍人菌的效應蛋白，會在多個位點對 TFEB 進行葡萄糖基化，藉由干擾 14-3-3 protein 的結合而使 TFEB 在核內富集。由於與 14-3-3 的結合通常將 TFEB 侷限於細胞質，這個葡萄糖基化事件劫持了宿主自身的調控機制，把 TFEB 驅入細胞核。

label: 5-Azacytidine
description: 5-Azacytidine inhibits DNMT1, the maintenance DNA methyltransferase that copies methylation patterns onto daughter strands during DNA replication. As a cytidine analog, 5-azacytidine is incorporated into DNA, where it covalently traps DNMT1 and depletes the enzyme, causing passive loss of methylation on newly synthesized strands. This demethylation reactivates silenced genes, including tumor suppressors, and underlies its clinical use in myelodysplastic syndromes and acute myeloid leukemia. It is also studied for its capacity to modulate senescence and reactivate silenced developmental programs.
description_zh_TW: 5-Azacytidine 抑制 DNMT1，這是一種維持 DNA 甲基轉移酶，在 DNA 複製過程中將甲基化模式複製到子鏈上。作為胞苷類似物，5-氮雜胞苷摻入 DNA 中，共價捕獲 DNMT1 並耗盡該酶，導致新合成鏈上的甲基化被動喪失。这种去甲基化重新激活了沉默的基因，包括肿瘤抑制基因，这是其在骨髓增生异常综合征和急性髓系白血病中的临床应用的基础。人們也研究了它調節衰老和重新激活沉默的發育程序的能力。

label: Progerin
description: Progerin is a toxic, truncated isoform of Lamin A produced when a silent point mutation in the LMNA gene (c.1824C>T) activates a cryptic splice site. Because it retains a permanently farnesylated C-terminus it cannot be de-farnesylated, and it accumulates at the nuclear membrane.
description_zh_TW: Progerin 是 Lamin A 的毒性截短型異構物，由 LMNA gene 上的一個沉默點突變（c.1824C>T）活化隱藏剪接位點而產生。由於其保留永久性的法尼基化 C 端而無法被去法尼基化，它會在核膜處累積。

label: MEF2C
description: Chronic microglial cGAS-STING signalling restrains the protective MEF2C neuronal gene program in a non-cell-autonomous manner: microglial cGAS deletion reverses neuronal MEF2C downregulation in tauopathy (Udeochu et al., Nat Neurosci 2023), making the cGAS axis a therapeutic target for preserving neuronal resilience.
description_zh_TW: 慢性的小膠質細胞 cGAS–STING 訊號以非細胞自體的方式抑制具保護性的 MEF2C 神經元基因程式：小膠質細胞 cGAS 缺失可逆轉 tauopathy 中神經元 MEF2C 的下调（Udeochu et al., Nat Neurosci 2023），使 cGAS 軸成為維持神經元韌性的治療標的。

label: Lactobacillus
description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) can selectively stimulate the growth of beneficial gut bacteria such as Bifidobacterium and Lactobacillus. These bacteria are associated with improved gut health, including prevention of diarrhea, improved gut barrier function, reduced inflammation, and immune support. NR also modulates gut microbiota in ways protective against high-fat diet-induced weight gain: mice fed 60% HFD with 0.4% NR for 168 days had nearly 16% less weight gain and lower fasting blood glucose, and fecal transfer from NR-treated donors reproduced the protective effect with a microbiota enriched in butyrate-producing Firmicutes. NR thus reshapes the microbiome to favor metabolically beneficial bacteria.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺核糖（NR）能選擇性地刺激有益腸道細菌如 Bifidobacterium 和 Lactobacillus 的生長。這些細菌與改善腸道健康相關，包括預防腹瀉、改善腸道屏障功能、減少發炎以及免疫支持。NR 也以對抗高脂飲食誘發體重增加的方式調節腸道菌叢：以含 0.4% NR 的 60% HFD 餵食 168 天的小鼠，體重增加減少近 16% 且空腹血糖較低，而來自 NR 處理供體的糞便移植重現了此保護效應，其菌叢富含產丁酸的 Firmicutes。NR 因此重塑微生物組以偏好代謝有益的細菌。

label: Ribociclib
description: Ribociclib is a selective CDK4/6 inhibitor blocking G1 progression. Same pharmacological class logic as palbociclib.
description_zh_TW: Ribociclib 是阻斷 G1 進展的選擇性 CDK4/6 抑制劑。與 palbociclib 相同的藥理類別邏輯。

label: CYP2J2
description: CYP2J2 epoxidizes Arachidonic acid at carbons 8, 9, 11 and 14 to form the corresponding epoxyeicosatrienoic acids (8,9-, 11,12-, 14,15-EET). These EETs activate soluble epoxide hydrolase-regulated signalling that promotes vasodilation, inhibits Inflammation, modulates ion channels and endothelial function, and in cancer models has been reported to suppress proliferation and limit Oxidative Stress.
description_zh_TW: CYP2J2 將 Arachidonic acid（花生四烯酸）在第 8、9、11、14 號碳位環氧化，形成相應的 epoxyeicosatrienoic acids（EET，環氧二十碳三烯酸）。這些 EET 活化可溶性環氧乙烷水解酶調節的訊號，促進血管擴張、抑制 Inflammation（發炎）、調節離子通道與內皮功能；在癌症模型中據報可抑制增殖並限制 Oxidative Stress（氧化壓力）。

label: Snail
description: Snail (SNAI1) is a core zinc-finger driver of EMT. Driving is the defining transcription program.
description_zh_TW: Snail（SNAI1）是 EMT 的核心鋅指驅動者。驅動是定義性轉錄程序。

label: Checkpoint Inhibitor
description: Checkpoint Inhibitors are the core modality of Immunotherapy: they release CTLA-4 and PD-1/PD-L1 brake signaling that suppresses antitumor T-cell activity, converting a chronically inflamed but immune-excluded tumor into one the immune system can clear.
description_zh_TW: Checkpoint Inhibitor（檢查點抑制劑）是 Immunotherapy（免疫療法）的核心手段：它們解除抑制抗腫瘤 T 細胞活性的 CTLA-4 與 PD-1/PD-L1 煞車訊號，使長期發炎但免疫排斥的腫瘤轉為免疫系統可清除的腫瘤。

label: Lymphocyte
description: T-lineage activation requires major histocompatibility complex presentation.
description_zh_TW: T 譜系活化需要主要組織相容複合體呈現。

label: Immune Evasion
description: PD-L1 enables Immune Evasion. PD-L1 is an immune-checkpoint ligand expressed by tumor and stromal cells that engages PD-1 on T cells to suppress antitumor immunity. Immune evasion is a recognized hallmark whereby tumors disarm or exclude cytotoxic lymphocytes through checkpoints and immunosuppressive microenvironments. The relationship is directional, with PD-L1 acting as the operative agent upon Immune Evasion rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: PD-L1 啟用 Immune Evasion。 PD-L1 是一種由腫瘤和基質細胞表達的免疫檢查點配體，可與 T 細胞上的 PD-1 結合以抑制抗腫瘤免疫。 Immune Evasion是一個公認的標誌，腫瘤透過檢查點和免疫抑制微環境解除或排除細胞毒性淋巴細胞。這種關係是有方向的，PD-L1 充當 Immune Evasion 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Onchocerca volvulus
description: Onchocerca volvulus is the filarial nematode that causes onchocerciasis (river blindness), infecting about 21 million people with 99% of cases in 31 African countries. Adults coil in subcutaneous nodules (onchocercomata) while the first-stage larvae migrate through skin and eye tissues, and the parasite depends on obligate Wolbachia endosymbionts for survival, embryogenesis and fecundity.
description_zh_TW: Onchocerca volvulus 是造成 onchocerciasis（river blindness）的絲蟲線形蟲，全球約有 2100 萬人感染，其中 99% 集中於 31 個非洲國家。成蟲捲曲於皮下結節（onchocercoma）中，第一期幼蟲則在皮膚與眼部組織移行；此外此寄生蟲仰賴專性 Wolbachia 內共生菌才能存活、胚胎發育與繁殖。

label: Selenium
description: Selenium is an essential constituent of glutathione peroxidases and thioredoxin reductases that detoxify hydrogen peroxide and lipid hydroperoxides. Zinc complements this by stabilizing membranes, inhibiting NADPH oxidase, and serving as a structural element of superoxide dismutase (SOD). Dysregulation of these trace elements in Parkinson's disease exacerbates oxidative stress and neuronal injury.
description_zh_TW: Selenium 是穀胱甘肽過氧化物酶與硫氧還蛋白還原酶的必要組成，負責解毒過氧化氫與脂質過氧化物。Zinc 則透過穩定細胞膜、抑制 NADPH oxidase，並作為超氧化物歧化酶 (SOD) 的結構元素來 допол此防禦。在 Parkinson's disease 中，這些微量元素的失調會加劇氧化壓力與神經損傷。

label: CYP3A4
source_file: _document_ - Rapamycin for longevity the pros, the cons, and future perspectives.md
description: Piperine raises the Bioavailability of co-administered compounds by inhibiting intestinal and hepatic CYP3A4 and other cytochrome P450 enzymes, the efflux transporter P-glycoprotein, and phase-II conjugation by UDP-glucuronosyltransferases. The classic demonstration is a roughly 20-fold increase in Curcumin bioavailability, with similar enhancement explored for Fisetin and other poorly absorbed polyphenols.
description_zh_TW: Piperine 藉由抑制腸道與肝臟的 CYP3A4 及其他 cytochrome P450 酵素、外排轉運蛋白 P-glycoprotein，以及 UDP-glucuronosyltransferase 的第二期結合反應，提高併用化合物的 Bioavailability。經典例子是使 Curcumin 的生體可用度提升約 20 倍；類似的增強效果也在 Fisetin 與其他吸收不良的 polyphenols 上被研究。

label: MC1R
description: MC1R and Cutaneous Melanoma are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically MC1R and Cutaneous Melanoma may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: MC1R 和 Cutaneous Melanoma 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，MC1R 和 Cutaneous Melanoma 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: IRF3
description: In the nucleus IRF3 cooperates with NF-κB and AP-1 at promoter enhancers such as the IFN-β enhanceosome, inducing type I interferons and interferon-stimulated genes. IRF3 is thus the terminal effector of cytosolic DNA/RNA sensing and a key arm of sterile inflammatory responses.
description_zh_TW: 在細胞核內，IRF3 於 IFN-β enhanceosome 等啟動子增強元件上與 NF-κB 及 AP-1 協作，誘導第一型干擾素與干擾素刺激基因的表現。因此 IRF3 是細胞質 DNA/RNA 感知的末端效應因子，也是無菌性發炎反應的重要支臂。

label: Erythrocytes
description: Erythrocytes are the principal oxygen-delivering blood cells and are unusually exposed to Oxidative Stress, being subject both to autoxidation of Hemoglobin and to circulating catecholamine metabolites such as Adrenochrome. Because mature red cells lack nuclei and mitochondria they cannot repair oxidized protein, so this oxidative burden drives Hemolysis and Methemoglobinemia, with the latter evident as cyanosis.
description_zh_TW: Erythrocytes 是主要的運送氧氣的血球，特別暴露於 Oxidative Stress：既承受 Hemoglobin 的自氧化，也接觸 Adrenochrome 等循環中的兒茶酚胺代謝物。由於成熟紅血球缺乏細胞核與粒線體，無法修復被氧化的蛋白質，這份氧化負擔會導致 Hemolysis 與 Methemoglobinemia，後者表現為發紺。

label: UVRAG
description: Vps34 binds UVRAG in an alternative complex that acts on endosomes instead of autophagosomes. Because the same catalytic subunit is shared between an autophagy complex with Atg14 and an endocytic complex with UVRAG, Vps34 is a branch point where the cell decides between degradative fates for a given membrane.
description_zh_TW: Vps34 會與 UVRAG 結合形成作用於內體而非自噬體的另一個複合體。由於同一催化次單元被含 Atg14 的自噬複合體與含 UVRAG 的胞吞複合體共用，Vps34 構成分支點，由細胞決定某段膜的降解命運。

label: H4K16
description: Sas2p acetylates histone H4 at lysine 16, opening telomeric chromatin.
description_zh_TW: Sas2p 乙醯化組蛋白 H4 離胺酸 16，打開端粒染色質。

label: Metabotypes
source_file: _document_ - Natural Bioactive Compounds Spermidine Fisetin Berberine Urolithin A.md
description: Urolithin A is only produced by individuals carrying the metabotype-A gut microbial signature (Gordonibacter urolithinfaciens), roughly 12-40% of people depending on cohort. Metabotype-B carriers make isourolithin A instead and metabotype-0 carriers make no detectable urolithin, so dietary ellagitannins silently do nothing for them while direct Urolithin A supplementation is required.
description_zh_TW: Urolithin A 只有在帶有 metabotype-A 腸道菌群特徵（Gordonibacter urolithinfaciens）的人才會生成，依族群不同約占 12–40%。metabotype-B 帶因者生成的是 isourolithin A，metabotype-0 帶因者則測不到任何 urolithin，因此對這兩類人而言膳食型 ellagitannin 完全無效，必須直接補充 Urolithin A。

label: MCU
description: MCU-mediated calcium uptake is driven by the negative mitochondrial membrane potential (ΔΨm); in senescence the resulting loss of ΔΨm also elevates ROS production.
description_zh_TW: MCU 介導的鈣離子攝入由負的粒線體膜電位（ΔΨm）驅動；在衰老時由此造成的 ΔΨm 下降也會提高 ROS 產生。

label: Oculocutaneous Albinism
description: All forms of Oculocutaneous Albinism result from defects in melanosome biogenesis, tyrosinase function, or downstream melanin synthesis enzymes, disrupting Melanogenesis. This leads to variable degrees of hypopigmentation of the skin, hair, and eyes. OCA is a group of autosomal recessive disorders affecting melanin biosynthesis.
description_zh_TW: 所有形式的 Oculocutaneous Albinism 都由 melanosome 生物發生、tyrosinase 功能或下游黑色素合成酶的缺陷引起，從而破壞 Melanogenesis。這導致皮膚、頭髮和眼睛不同程度的色素減退。OCA 是一組影響黑色素生物合成的體染色體隱性遺傳疾病。

label: Th1
description: IL-12 is the primary cytokine driving Th1 differentiation: it activates STAT4 in naive CD4+ T cells, induces the master Th1 transcription factor T-bet, and simultaneously suppresses Th2 and Th17 polarization.
description_zh_TW: IL-12 是驅動 Th1 分化最主要的細胞激素：它在初始 CD4+ T 細胞中活化 STAT4、誘導 Th1 譜系的主轉錄因子 T-bet，並同時抑制 Th2 與 Th17 極化。

label: HMGB2
description: HMGB2 is a chromatin architectural factor whose loss triggers a shift in heterochromatin organization in senescence. It is progressively depleted in senescent cells, influencing the formation and stability of senescence-associated heterochromatin foci.
description_zh_TW: HMGB2 是染色質架構因子，其喪失會在衰老中觸發異染色質組織的轉變。它在衰老細胞中逐漸耗竭，影響衰老相關異染色質焦點的形成與穩定。

label: PAMP
description: PAMP are conserved microbial motifs absent from host cells; their engagement of pattern recognition receptors such as TLRs, NOD-like receptors and RLRs is what activates the Innate Immune System and triggers an inflammatory response.
description_zh_TW: PAMP 是微生物特有、宿主細胞不具的保守分子基序；它們與 TLR、NOD-like receptors、RLR 等模式辨識受體結合，正是啟動 Innate Immune System 並引發發炎反應的原因。

label: Hypothalamus
description: Orexin (hypocretin) is produced by a small cluster of neurons in the lateral and perifornical Hypothalamus, where prepro-orexin is cleaved into orexin-A and orexin-B and the neurons project widely to cortex, brainstem and limbic system. These glucose-sensing neurons promote arousal-associated energy expenditure and physical activity, linking sleep–wake regulation to metabolic health.
description_zh_TW: Orexin（hypocretin）由外側與圍室核下視丘（Hypothalamus）的一小群神經元產生，這些神經元將前驅 orexin 切割成 orexin-A 與 orexin-B，並廣泛投射至皮質、腦幹與邊緣系統。這些具葡萄糖感測能力的神經元促進覺醒相關的能量消耗與身體活動，把睡眠—清醒調節與代謝健康連結起來。

label: Cardiotoxicity
description: Cardiotoxicity is a key safety endpoint alongside drug-induced liver injury.
description_zh_TW: 心臟毒性是與藥物性肝損傷並列的關鍵安全終點。

label: Peroxisome Biogenesis Network
description: PEX3 encodes a peroxisomal membrane protein required for correct folding and transport of many other peroxins into the peroxisome membrane, acting as an essential building block of the Peroxisome Biogenesis Network. Loss of function leaves misfolded proteins that accumulate and disrupt membrane integrity.
description_zh_TW: PEX3 編碼過氧化體膜蛋白，負責許多其他 peroxin 正確摺疊並運送至過氧化體膜，是 Peroxisome Biogenesis Network 的必要組成。功能喪失會留下累積的錯誤摺疊蛋白，破壞膜完整性。

label: PERK
description: PERK (EIF2AK3) is a type I transmembrane ER-resident kinase that senses unfolded proteins via its luminal domain. Upon ER stress it dimerizes and autophosphorylates, then phosphorylates eIF2alpha at Ser51, attenuating global translation while selectively upregulating ATF4 translation.
description_zh_TW: PERK（EIF2AK3）是 I 型跨膜內質網駐留激酶，透過其腔內區域感知未折疊蛋白。當 ER stress 發生時，PERK 二聚化並自體磷酸化，接著在 Ser51 位點磷酸化 eIF2α，抑制全域轉譯的同時選擇性提升 ATF4 的轉譯。

label: PAK2
description: PAK2 directly binds and phosphorylates Caspase-7 at three residues. Ser30 phosphorylation in the prodomain blocks interaction with Caspase-9 and prevents activation, Thr173 favors an inhibitory conformation, and Ser239 near the active site sterically hinders substrate binding — a two-pronged strategy that neutralizes both pro-caspase-7 and already-active enzyme.
description_zh_TW: PAK2 直接結合並在三個殘基上磷酸化 Caspase-7。prodomain 上的 Ser30 磷酸化阻斷與 Caspase-9 的交互作用而阻止活化，Thr173 促成抑制性構形，而活性位點附近的 Ser239 則以立體障礙妨礙受質結合——這是一種雙管齊下的策略，同時中和前驅物 Caspase-7 與已活化的酵素。

label: Damage-Associated Molecular Patterns
description: DAMPs released from necroptotic cells are heavy triggers of innate and adaptive immunity and plausibly drive allograft rejection — the rationale for necroptosis inhibition in solid-organ transplantation.
description_zh_TW: 由 necroptosis 細胞釋出之 DAMPs 是先天與適應性免疫之強力觸發物，很可能驅動移植物排斥——此為實體器官移植中抑制 necroptosis 之理論依據。

label: Mitochondrial Quality Control
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Fusion and Fission The fine-tune balance for cellular homeostasis.md
description: Mitophagy, the autophagic degradation of damaged mitochondria, is a core arm of Mitochondrial Quality Control; it is driven by the PINK1/Parkin/p62 axis and is reduced in senescent cells.
description_zh_TW: Mitophagy（受損粒線體的自噬降解）是 Mitochondrial Quality Control 的核心環節，由 PINK1/Parkin/p62 軸驅動，並在衰老細胞中減少。

label: Lamin A
description: Hutchinson-Gilford Progeria Syndrome is caused by a sporadic de novo mutation in the LMNA gene, which alters the protein Lamin A to produce progerin. Progerin remains permanently attached to the nuclear membrane, causing the nucleus to become misshapen and disorganized — the primary driver of the disease's accelerated-aging phenotype.
description_zh_TW: Hutchinson-Gilford Progeria Syndrome 由 LMNA 基因的偶發性新生突變引起，該突變使蛋白 Lamin A 改變而產生 progerin。Progerin 永久附著於核膜，使細胞核變形且構造混亂——這是此病加速衰老表型的主要驅動因素。

label: AMP
description: Nudix Hydrolases cleave free ADP-ribose into AMP plus ribose-5-phosphate, an AMP/salvage arm of the parthanatos cascade. AMP can inhibit the mitochondrial adenine nucleotide translocator and activate AMPK–mTORC1 signalling, and ribose-5-phosphate feeds NAD+ salvage.
description_zh_TW: Nudix Hydrolases 將游離 ADP-ribose 切割成 AMP 與核糖-5-磷酸，構成 parthanatos 級聯中的 AMP/回收分支。AMP 可抑制粒線體腺嘌呤核苷轉位酶並活化 AMPK–mTORC1 訊號，核糖-5-磷酸則供應 NAD+ 回收途徑。

label: Gasdermin D
description: Caspase-4 is a human inflammatory (non-canonical) caspase that senses cytosolic Gram-negative bacterial LPS through its CARD, inducing oligomerization and auto-cleavage. Once active it cleaves Gasdermin D at the linker, freeing the N-terminal pore-forming domain that oligomerizes in the plasma membrane to form pyroptotic pores.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-4 是人類發炎性（非典型）caspase，透過其 CARD 感測細胞質中的革蘭氏陰性菌 LPS，誘發寡聚化與自我切割。一旦活化即在連接區切割 Gasdermin D，釋出 N 端成孔區，該區在細胞膜上寡聚形成 pyroptosis 孔洞。

label: Base Excision Repair
description: APE1 (apurinic/apyrimidinic endonuclease 1) cleaves the DNA backbone 5' to abasic (AP) sites generated by spontaneous base loss or by DNA glycosylases such as OGG1, initiating base excision repair. It also removes 3'-blocking groups, making it a rate-limiting hub in the repair of oxidative DNA damage.
description_zh_TW: APE1（無嘌呤/無嘧啶核酸內切酶 1）在自發性鹼基缺失或 OGG1 等 DNA 糖苷酶所產生的無鹼基（AP）位點 5' 端切割 DNA 主鏈，啟動鹼基切除修復。它也移除 3' 阻斷基團，使其成為氧化性 DNA 損傷修復中的速率限制樞紐。

label: Pyruvate
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: Pyruvate is converted to Acetyl-CoA by Pyruvate Dehydrogenase in the rate-limiting, committed step that links glycolysis to aerobic respiration. Because acetyl-CoA is what fuels the TCA cycle, blocking this step removes the reducing equivalents whose downstream leak produces the mitochondrial ROS that RIPK3 needs in order to reinforce necrosome assembly.
description_zh_TW: Pyruvate 經由 Pyruvate Dehydrogenase 轉變為 Acetyl-CoA，這是連結糖解作用與有氧呼吸的限速且不可逆步驟。由於 acetyl-CoA 是 TCA cycle 的燃料，阻斷此步驟便移除了產生還原力的來源，而其下游滲漏正是形成粒線體 ROS 的途徑——而 RIPK3 需要這些 ROS 才能強化 necrosome 組裝。

label: Genome stability
description: SIRT6 deacetylates H3K9 on telomeric chromatin and suppresses LINE-1 retrotransposon activity, maintaining genome stability and telomere function; SIRT6-deficient cells show genomic instability, telomere defects, and cellular senescence (Michishita et al., 2008; Van Meter et al., 2014).
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 去乙醯化端粒染色質上的 H3K9，並抑制 LINE-1 反轉錄轉座子活性，維持基因組穩定性和端粒功能；SIRT6 缺乏的細胞表現出基因組不穩定、端粒缺陷及細胞衰老（Michishita et al., 2008; Van Meter et al., 2014）。

label: ZBP1
description: ZBP1 (also known as DAI) is the prototypical Z-nucleic-acid sensor: it detects the left-handed Z-DNA and Z-RNA structures that form transiently at alternating purine-pyrimidine repeats and at sites of active transcription or topological stress, triggering cell death programs including PANoptosis, frequently in coordination with STING and MAVS. In viral encephalitis such as HSV-1 infection, ZBP1-mediated sensing drives RIPK3-dependent cell death.
description_zh_TW: ZBP1（又稱 DAI）是典型的 Z 核酸感測器：它偵測在交替嘌呤–嘧啶重複序列以及活躍轉錄或拓撲壓力位點瞬間形成的左手 Z-DNA 與 Z-RNA 結構，觸發包括 PANoptosis 在內的細胞死亡程式，且常與 STING 及 MAVS 協同。在 HSV-1 等病毒性腦炎中，ZBP1 介導的感測驅動 RIPK3 依賴性的細胞死亡。

label: Ripoptosome
description: By removing cIAPs, Smac mimetics license Ripoptosome assembly. With cIAPs gone, cytosolic RIPK1 accumulates, exposes its death domain, recruits FADD and Caspase-8, and nucleates the ~2 MDa ripoptosome. This is precisely the experimental paradigm (IAP antagonist plus poly I:C/TLR3 stimulation, Feoktistova et al. 2011) in which the complex was originally defined.
description_zh_TW: 藉由移除 cIAPs，Smac mimetics 為 Ripoptosome 的組裝解除抑制。當 cIAPs 消失後，細胞質中的 RIPK1 累積、暴露其 death domain、招募 FADD 與 Caspase-8，並成核形成約 2 MDa 的 ripoptosome。這正是最初定義此複合體的實驗範式（IAP 拮抗劑加上 poly I:C/TLR3 刺激，Feoktistova et al. 2011）。

label: Keshan disease
description: Selenium deficiency causes Keshan disease, an endemic cardiomyopathy found in selenium-poor regions, driven by insufficient cardiac glutathione peroxidase activity and consequent oxidant damage to myocardium. Affected hearts show necrosis and fibrosis with reduced antiviral and antioxidant defenses. The directionality is nutrient lack to enzyme failure to tissue injury. A caveat is that coxsackievirus infection interacts with the deficiency, so Keshan disease is not purely a selenium-deficiency disorder.
description_zh_TW: Selenium deficiency 會導致 Keshan disease，這是一種在 selenium 貧乏地區發現的地方性心肌病變，其原因是心臟 glutathione peroxidase 活性不足以及隨之而來的心肌氧化損傷。受影響的心臟顯示 necrosis 和 fibrosis 的抗病毒和抗氧化防禦能力降低。方向性是營養缺乏、酵素衰竭、組織損傷。需要注意的是，柯薩奇病毒感染與缺乏症相互作用，因此 Keshan disease 並不純粹是 selenium 缺乏症。

label: Redox Battery
description: The Redox Battery is a conceptual construct in the adrenochrome handling protocol representing the reservable store of cellular reducing equivalents that absorbs the oxidative load generated during catecholamine autoxidation. Adrenochrome and its quinone derivatives (Aminochrome, o-quinone) discharge the battery by draining electrons through redox cycling; a collapsed battery converts transient oxidation into persistent oxidative damage, protein alkylation, NLRP3 Inflammasome activation, and Senescence.
description_zh_TW: Redox Battery 是 Adrenochrome 處理.protocol 中的概念性建構，代表細胞還原等量物的儲備池，用以吸收兒茶酚胺自氧化產生的氧化負荷。Adrenochrome 及其醌衍生物（Aminochrome、o-quinone）透過氧化還原循環抽走電子而「放電」；電池崩潰會把短暫的氧化轉為持續性氧化損傷、蛋白質烷基化、NLRP3 Inflammasome 活化與 Senescence。

label: HER2
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: HER2 drives Breast Cancer. HER2 (ERBB2) is a receptor tyrosine kinase that, when amplified, drives aggressive breast cancer and is the target of trastuzumab. Breast cancer is a heterogeneous malignancy in which molecular subtypes (luminal, HER2-enriched, basal/triple-negative) dictate targeted therapy choice. The relationship is directional, with HER2 acting as the operative agent upon Breast Cancer rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: HER2 驅動 Breast Cancer。 HER2 (ERBB2) 是一種受體酪胺酸激酶，在擴增時會驅動攻擊性 Breast Cancer，並且是 trastuzumab 的目標。 Breast Cancer 是一種異質性惡性腫瘤，其分子亞型（管腔型、HER2富集型、基礎/三陰性）決定了標靶治療的選擇。這種關係是有方向的，HER2 充當 Breast Cancer 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: NPAT
description: NPAT is gated by cell-cycle kinases: cyclin E/CDK2 phosphorylation at the G1/S transition licenses NPAT to drive replication-dependent histone gene transcription. In quiescence or senescence cyclin E/CDK2 activity falls, NPAT is dephosphorylated, and the replication-dependent histone genes are silenced — which is why NPAT disengagement is a principal cause of the canonical histone collapse seen in senescent cells.
description_zh_TW: NPAT 受細胞週期激酶調控：在 G1/S 轉換時 cyclin E/CDK2 的磷酸化授權 NPAT 驅動複製依賴型組蛋白基因的轉錄。在靜止或衰老時 cyclin E/CDK2 活性下降，NPAT 被去磷酸化，複製依賴型組蛋白基因因而沉默——這正是 NPAT 失去作用成為衰老細胞典型組蛋白崩潰主因的原因。

label: Magnolol
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Magnolol shares honokiol's positive allosteric modulation of GABA_A receptors, generally slightly less potent, and is used as a neolignan modulator of inhibitory neurotransmission alongside honokiol.
description_zh_TW: Magnolol 與 honokiol 共享對 GABA_A receptor 的正向別構調節作用，效力通常略低，並與 honokiol 一同作為抑制性神經傳遞的 neolignan 調節劑。

label: Exercise Hormesis
description: Exercise Hormesis is the canonical whole-organism hormetic stressor: transient exercise ROS, calcium, AMP/ATP and lactate pulses act as the stress input that elicits the adaptive response.
description_zh_TW: Exercise Hormesis 是全身層級典型的 hormetic 壓力源：運動期間短暫的 ROS、鈣離子、AMP/ATP 與乳酸脈衝即為誘發適應反應的壓力輸入。

label: Yamanaka Factors
description: The Yamanaka factors are also known as the OSKM cassette, named after the initials of its four constituent transcription factors: Oct4, Sox2, Klf4, and c-Myc. This quartet was identified by Shinya Yamanaka as sufficient to reprogram differentiated somatic cells into induced pluripotent stem cells, a discovery that earned the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine in 2012. The OSKM designation is used throughout the reprogramming and rejuvenation literature, including in partial reprogramming protocols that express the factors transiently to reverse aging.
description_zh_TW: Yamanaka 因子也稱為 OSKM 盒，以其四個組成轉錄因子的縮寫命名：Oct4、Sox2、Klf4 和 c-Myc。 Shinya Yamanaka 鑑定出這個四重體足以將分化的體細胞重編程為誘導多能幹細胞，這一發現贏得了 2012 年諾貝爾生理學或醫學獎。 OSKM 名稱在整個重編程和復興文獻中使用，包括在短暫表達因子以逆轉衰老的部分重編程方案中。

label: Wnt signaling
description: Beta-catenin orchestrates the canonical Wnt signaling pathway as a transcriptional coactivator of TCF/LEF factors. Without Wnt ligands a destruction complex (APC, Axin, GSK-3beta, CK1) phosphorylates it for proteasomal degradation; Wnt binding stabilizes beta-catenin, which translocates to the nucleus and activates proliferation-driving target genes.
description_zh_TW: β-Catenin 作為 TCF/LEF 因子的轉錄共活化因子，主導標準型 Wnt signaling 途徑。缺乏 Wnt 配體時，降解複合體（APC、Axin、GSK-3β、CK1）會將其磷酸化並標記供蛋白酶體降解；Wnt 結合則穩定 β-catenin，使其轉位入核並活化驅動增殖的目標基因。

label: Roscovitine
description: Roscovitine is a pan-CDK pharmacological inhibitor. Broad-spectrum CDK blockade is its defining action.
description_zh_TW: Roscovitine 是泛 CDK 藥理抑制劑。廣譜 CDK 封鎖是其定義性作用。

label: Cyclin D1
description: Cyclin D1 belongs to the D-type cyclin family governing G1 CDK4/6 activation.
description_zh_TW: Cyclin D1 屬於掌管 G1 CDK4/6 活化的 D 型 cyclin 家族。

label: CXCL10
description: The cGAS-STING DNA-sensing pathway is an upstream driver of CXCL10 release, connecting genotoxic stress to the interferon-responsive branch of the SASP. Because CXCL10 recruits NK and T cells, its upregulation helps resolve senescence acutely, while persistent expression in aged tissue sustains inflammaging and autoimmune pathology.
description_zh_TW: cGAS–STING DNA 感知路徑是 CXCL10 釋放的上游驅動因子，將基因毒性壓力連結到 SASP 的干擾素反應分支。由於 CXCL10 會募集 NK 與 T 細胞，其上調有助於急性解決衰老；但在老化組織中持續表現則會維持 inflammaging 與自體免疫病態。

label: Acetate
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: Acetate is the two-carbon short-chain fatty acid (CH3COO-) and the most abundant SCFA produced by gut fermentation, generated by anaerobic bacteria such as Bifidobacterium and Bacteroides and by acetogens from dietary fiber. It is absorbed into portal blood and distributed systemically, crossing membranes as the protonated acid or via monocarboxylate transporters to reach the liver, brain and periphery. SCFA profiles including acetate are altered in aging and are modulated by diet, Caloric Restriction and NAD+ precursors such as Nicotinamide Riboside.
description_zh_TW: Acetate 是二碳短鏈脂肪酸（CH3COO-），也是腸道發酵產量最豐富的 SCFA，由 Bifidobacterium、Bacteroides 等厭氧菌與產乙酸菌從膳食纖維產生。它被吸收進入門脈血液並分布全身，以質子化酸形式或經單羧酸運輸蛋白跨越細胞膜，抵達肝臟、腦與周邊組織。包含 acetate 在內的 SCFA 譜會隨老化改變，並受飲食、Caloric Restriction 與 Nicotinamide Riboside 等 NAD+ 前驅物調控。

label: Smoking
description: Cigarette, cigar, and wood smoke contain enormous amounts of free radicals and oxidants (cigarette smoke alone carries on the order of 10^17 oxidant molecules per puff). These external oxidants directly increase reactive oxygen species, deplete antioxidants such as vitamin C and glutathione, and cause systemic oxidative stress. Smoke also activates sympathetic nervous system responses and inflammation, further raising endogenous ROS production. This oxidative environment promotes the oxidation of adrenaline to adrenochrome and supports the redox cycle by which adrenochrome generates more superoxide, linking smoking to increased catecholamine oxidation and oxidative damage.
description_zh_TW: 香菸、雪茄與木柴煙霧含有大量自由基與氧化劑（單是香菸煙霧每口就帶有約 10^17 個氧化劑分子）。這些外部氧化劑直接增加活性氧物種、耗竭維生素 C 與麩胱甘肽等抗氧化劑，並造成全身性氧化壓力。煙霧也活化交感神經系統反應與發炎，進一步升高內源性 ROS 生成。此氧化環境促進 adrenaline 氧化為 adrenochrome，並支持 adrenochrome 藉以產生更多超氧陰離子的氧化還原循環，將吸菸與增加的兒茶酚胺氧化及氧化損傷連結起來。

label: Dopamine Transporter
description: The Dopamine Transporter (DAT) is a membrane protein responsible for reuptake of Dopamine from the synaptic cleft back into the presynaptic neuron, terminating the dopaminergic signal and recycling the neurotransmitter. DAT is highly abundant in the Sirtuins, where rapid uptake into dopaminergic terminals is the primary way dopamine signalling ends.
description_zh_TW: Dopamine Transporter（DAT）是一種膜蛋白，負責將 Dopamine 從突觸間隙回收至突觸前神經元，終止多巴胺訊號並回收神經傳遞物質。DAT 在 Sirtuins 中高度豐富，在該區快速攝入多巴胺神經末梢是 dopamine 訊號終止的主要方式。

label: Down Syndrome
description: Down Syndrome is trisomy 21, a numerical chromosomal abnormality produced when meiotic nondisjunction adds a third copy of Chromosome 21. The extra gene dosage, not any point mutation, underlies the phenotype.
description_zh_TW: Down Syndrome（唐氏症）是三染色體 21，一種數目性的染色體異常，由減數分裂時的不分離（nondisjunction）加入第三份 Chromosome（染色體）21 所造成。其表型基礎是基因劑量增加，而非任何點突變。

label: Navitoclax
description: Senescent Cells resist apoptosis through upregulated senescent-cell anti-apoptotic pathways (SCAPs), notably BCL-xL; inhibiting BCL-xL with Navitoclax therefore selectively kills many senescent cells and reduces the Senescence-Associated Secretory Phenotype.
description_zh_TW: Senescent Cells 會透過上升的衰老細胞抗凋亡路徑（SCAPs，尤其是 BCL-xL）抵抗凋亡；因此以 Navitoclax 抑制 BCL-xL 可選擇性殺死許多衰老細胞並降低 Senescence-Associated Secretory Phenotype。

label: Axonal Degeneration
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Among three tested NAD+ precursors (nicotinic acid, nicotinamide, and nicotinamide riboside) including NAD+ itself, only NR could prevent axonal degeneration by altering the local NR metabolism within the axon. Axonal degeneration is an early event in acute cerebral injury and in chronic neurodegenerative diseases including Alzheimer's and Parkinson's diseases, and it is caused by excitotoxicity, which induces strong NAD+ depletion in neurons. NR prevented nuclear condensation and axonal degeneration in neurons of Nmrk2-KO mice by inducing Nmrk1, suggesting that Nmrk1 is a key mediator of the neuroprotective activity of NR.
description_zh_TW: 在測試的三種 NAD+ 前驅物（nicotinic acid、nicotinamide 與 nicotinamide riboside）以及 NAD+ 本身之中，唯有 NR 能透過改變軸突內局部的 NR 代謝來預防軸突退化。軸突退化是急性腦損傷以及包括阿茲海默症與帕金森氏症在內的慢性神經退化性疾病的早期事件，且由興奮毒性所引起，後者會誘發神經元中強烈的 NAD+ 耗竭。NR 透過誘導 Nmrk1 預防了 Nmrk2-KO 小鼠神經元的核濃縮與軸突退化，顯示 Nmrk1 是 NR 神經保護活性的關鍵介導者。

label: Muscle Atrophy
description: Myostatin promotes Muscle Atrophy. In addition to repressing myogenic transcription, it drives protein catabolism and antagonizes Akt/mTORC1 signalling, so the net effect of myostatin signalling is loss of contractile mass — the reason it is a therapeutic target in Sarcopenia, Cachexia and muscular dystrophy.
description_zh_TW: Myostatin 會促進 Muscle Atrophy。除了抑制肌源性轉錄外，它還促進蛋白質分解代謝並拮抗 Akt/mTORC1 訊號，因此 myostatin 訊號的淨效應就是收縮性肌量的流失——這也是它在 Sarcopenia、Cachexia 與肌營養不良症中成為治療標的原因。

label: Liquid-Liquid Phase Separation
description: Intrinsically disordered regions lack a fixed three-dimensional fold yet drive liquid–liquid phase separation, forming membraneless organelles and condensates, and they are enriched in sites for phosphorylation, acetylation and other post-translational modifications.
description_zh_TW: 內在無序區缺乏固定的三維摺疊，卻能驅動液–液相分離，形成無膜胞器與凝聚體；它們也富含磷酸化、乙醯化等轉譯後修飾位點。

label: Fibroblasts
description: Fibroblasts are the principal ECM-producing cells depositing collagens and matrix. Canonical plural filename used. Production is their tissue function.
description_zh_TW: Fibroblasts 是沉積膠原與基質的主要 ECM 產生細胞。使用典型複數檔名。產生是其組織功能。

label: LeucoMB
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: LeucoMB is the reduced (leuco) form of the tricyclic phenothiazine Methylene blue. In MB's catalytic redox cycle the dye accepts electrons from complex I of the mitochondrion to become LeucoMB, so LeucoMB is the reduced intermediate of that electron-shuttling cycle.
description_zh_TW: LeucoMB 是三環吩噻嗪類 Methylene blue 的還原型（leuco 型）。在 MB 的催化氧化還原循環中，染料自粒線體複合體 I 接受電子而成為 LeucoMB，因此 LeucoMB 是該電子穿梭循環中的還原中間體。

label: Rtg3
description: Rtg3 carries the bHLH/ZIP DNA-binding domain and, together with Rtg1, drives the Retrograde Response in S. cerevisiae. In healthy cells it is phosphorylated via the Mks1–Ptc1 axis and held in the cytoplasm bound to 14-3-3 proteins; when mitochondrial respiration is impaired the retention signal is lost and the Rtg1–Rtg3 heterodimer enters the nucleus to activate nuclear-encoded genes, prominently the citrate–isocitrate shuttle enzymes CIT2, ACO1, and IDH1/IDH2.
description_zh_TW: Rtg3 帶有 bHLH/ZIP DNA 結合區域，並與 Rtg1 一起驅動 *S. cerevisiae* 的 Retrograde Response。在健康細胞中它經由 Mks1–Ptc1 軸被磷酸化，並與 14-3-3 蛋白結合而留在細胞質；當粒線體呼吸受損時滞留訊號喪失，Rtg1–Rtg3 異二聚體進入細胞核，活化核編碼基因，尤以檸檬酸－異檸檬酸穿梭酵素 CIT2、ACO1 與 IDH1/IDH2 為主。

label: Zeb1
description: Zeb1 is a core E-box-binding driver of EMT. Driving defines its transition role.
description_zh_TW: Zeb1 是 EMT 的核心 E-box 結合驅動者。驅動定義其轉換角色。

label: CXCR2
description: IL-8 (CXCL8) signals through CXCR1/CXCR2 to expand cancer stem-cell pools and promote tumoursphere formation. CXCR2 blockade abrogates this stemness effect, establishing the receptor axis of SASP-driven reprogramming.
description_zh_TW: IL-8（CXCL8）經 CXCR1/CXCR2 訊號擴張癌症幹細胞池並促進腫瘤球形成。阻斷 CXCR2 消除此幹性效應，確立 SASP 驅動重編程的受體軸。

label: Vasopressin
description: Vasopressin (antidiuretic hormone, AVP) is a posterior-pituitary nonapeptide that acts on Gq-coupled V1a receptors to mobilize calcium and activate MAPK and PKC, producing vasoconstriction; via Gs-coupled V2 receptors it instead raises cAMP and inserts aquaporins to conserve water.
description_zh_TW: Vasopressin（antidiuretic hormone，AVP）是腦下垂體後葉的九胜肽，透過 Gq-coupled V1a 受體動員 calcium 並活化 MAPK 與 PKC 而產生 vasoconstriction；經 Gs-coupled V2 受體則提高 cAMP 並插入 aquaporin 以保存水分。

label: MTHFD2
description: MTHFD2 sits immediately downstream of SHMT2, which converts serine to glycine plus 5,10-methylene-THF in the mitochondrial folate cycle — the dominant source of one-carbon units and mitochondrial NADPH in proliferating and cancer cells. Because it generates NADPH while feeding folate/one-carbon flux into 10-formyl-THF for purine and nucleotide synthesis, MTHFD2 is a junction where carbon metabolism and redox defence converge.
description_zh_TW: MTHFD2 位於 SHMT2 的下游；SHMT2 在粒線體葉酸循環中將 serine 轉為 glycine 與 5,10-亞甲基 THF，而此循環是增殖細胞與癌細胞中一碳單位與粒線體 NADPH 的主要來源。由於 MTHFD2 一方面產生 NADPH，另一方面將葉酸／一碳通量送入 10-甲醯 THF 以供嘌呤與核苷酸合成，它是碳代謝與氧化還原防禦交會的節點。

label: Calcium
description: The mitochondrial calcium uniporter is a highly selective pore-forming channel of the inner mitochondrial membrane, the central subunit of a holocomplex including MCUb, EMRE and the calcium-sensing gatekeepers MICU1 and MICU2. Under basal cytosolic calcium MICU1/2 keep the pore closed; when local calcium rises at endoplasmic-reticulum-mitochondria contact sites they relieve inhibition, permitting cooperative high-capacity influx that shapes cytosolic calcium transients.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial calcium uniporter 是粒線體內膜上高度選擇性的成孔通道，為包含 MCUb、EMRE 與鈣感受性守門者 MICU1、MICU2 的整體複合體之核心次單元。在基礎細胞質鈣濃度下 MICU1/2 使孔道關閉；當內質網—粒線體接觸處局部鈣上升時，它們解除抑制，允許協同的高容量內流，藉以塑形細胞質鈣的暫態變化。

label: Gene Silencing
description: High levels of DNA methylation in promoter regions, often concentrated in CpG islands, are strongly associated with gene silencing. Methylated promoters recruit methyl-CpG-binding domain (MBD) proteins and inhibit the binding of transcription factors, converting active promoters into transcriptionally inert chromatin. This repressive mechanism is used physiologically for imprinting and for silencing transposable elements, and its aberrant targeting of tumor suppressor gene promoters is a hallmark of cancer.
description_zh_TW: 啟動子區域的高水平 DNA 甲基化（通常集中在 CpG 島）與基因沉默密切相關。甲基化啟動子招募甲基 CpG 結合域 (MBD) 蛋白並抑制轉錄因子的結合，將活性啟動子轉化為轉錄惰性染色質。這種抑制機制在生理學上用於印記和沈默轉座元件，其對腫瘤抑制基因啟動子的異常靶向性是癌症的標誌。

label: Exosomes
description: Exosomal vesicle communication shapes TME composition.
description_zh_TW: 外泌體囊泡通訊塑造 TME 組成。

label: GAPDH
description: GAPDH catalyzes the NAD+-dependent conversion of Glyceraldehyde 3-Phosphate to the high-energy glycolytic intermediate 1,3-Bisphosphoglycerate, generating NADH in the process. Because the step consumes NAD+, senescent cells with a lowered NAD+/NADH ratio form less 1,3-Bisphosphoglycerate, which curtails glycolytic ATP production.
description_zh_TW: GAPDH 以 NAD+ 依賴的方式將 Glyceraldehyde 3-Phosphate 轉換成高能糖解中間產物 1,3-Bisphosphoglycerate，並同時生成 NADH。由於此步驟需要 NAD+，NAD+/NADH 比值下降的衰老細胞生成的 1,3-Bisphosphoglycerate 較少，因而抑制糖解產 ATP。

label: TRIF
description: TRIF is a cytoplasmic adaptor central to toll-like receptor signaling, serving as the exclusive adaptor for TLR3. Urolithin A, with its anti-inflammatory activity, is studied for modulation of the TRIF-dependent TLR signaling branch.
description_zh_TW: TRIF 是 toll 樣受體訊號中心的細胞質銜接蛋白，是 TLR3 的專屬銜接蛋白。Urolithin A 具有抗發炎活性，被研究對 TRIF 依賴 TLR 訊號分支的調控。

label: GABA
description: Glutamic acid decarboxylase (GAD) catalyzes the decarboxylation of glutamate to synthesize GABA, the principal inhibitory neurotransmitter in the brain. It exists as two isoforms, GAD65 and GAD67; GAD67 is constitutively active and maintains basal GABA levels, whereas GAD65 supplies GABA for regulated release.
description_zh_TW: Glutamic acid decarboxylase（GAD）催化 glutamate 的去羧化反應以合成 GABA——腦部主要的抑制性神經傳遞物質。GAD 有兩種同功型 GAD65 與 GAD67；GAD67 為組成性活性、維持基礎 GABA 濃度，GAD65 則供應受調控釋放所需的 GABA。

label: MMP-9
description: TIMP3 is an endogenous ~24 kDa secreted inhibitor of matrix metalloproteinases; its N-terminal inhibitory domain inserts into the catalytic cleft of targets such as MMP-9 and MMP-2 in a 1:1 complex, and unlike TIMP1/2/4 it stays tethered to the extracellular matrix via heparan sulfate proteoglycans.
description_zh_TW: TIMP3 是內生性約 24 kDa 的分泌型基質金屬蛋白酶抑制劑；其 N 端抑制結構域以 1:1 複合體插入 MMP-9、MMP-2 等標的酵素的催化裂縫，且與 TIMP1/2/4 不同，它透過硫酸乙醯肝素蛋白聚醣固定在細胞外基質上。

label: SRT2183
description: SRT2183 belongs to the sirtuin-activating compounds (STACs), the concrete chemical entities that enhance sirtuin activity; it was reported together with SRT1720 and SRT1460 as part of the potent second-generation synthetic STAC series developed after the polyphenolic activators.
description_zh_TW: SRT2183 屬於 sirtuin 活化化合物（STACs），即能增強 sirtuin 活性的具體化學實體；它與 SRT1720、SRT1460 一起被報導為多酚類活化劑之後開發的強效第二代合成 STAC 系列。

label: HO-1
description: HO-1 is among the most highly inducible antioxidant enzymes because NRF2 binds the antioxidant response element (ARE) in its promoter. NRF2-dependent HO-1 induction is engaged by SIRT1-activating resveratrol and by pharmacological NRF2 activators such as sulforaphane, and it protects cells against oxidative stress, apoptosis, and inflammation.
description_zh_TW: HO-1 是可誘導性最高的抗氧化酵素之一，因為 NRF2 會結合其啟動子上的抗氧化反應元件（ARE）。由 SIRT1 活化的 resveratrol 與 sulforaphane 等藥理型 NRF2 活化劑可誘發 NRF2 相依的 HO-1 表現，進而保護細胞免受氧化壓力、細胞凋亡與發炎傷害。

label: alpha-1 Antitrypsin
description: Hypochlorous acid inactivates alpha-1 antitrypsin by oxidizing critical residues, especially methionine, abolishing its ability to inhibit neutrophil elastase. In COPD and similar conditions this unleashes unopposed proteolysis that destroys lung matrix. The directionality is HOCl to serpin inactivation to tissue damage. A caveat is that cigarette smoke and other oxidants also inactivate alpha-1 antitrypsin, so HOCl is one of several mechanisms. The same oxidative inactivation contributes to emphysema in cigarette smokers, where neutrophil-derived HOCl meets a poorly protected lung interstitium.
description_zh_TW: Hypochlorous acid 透過氧化關鍵殘基（尤其是蛋胺酸）使 alpha-1 antitrypsin 失去活性，從而消除其抑制嗜中性球彈性蛋白酶的能力。在慢性阻塞性肺病和類似的情況下，這會釋放出不受對抗的蛋白質分解作用，從而破壞肺基質。方向性是 HOCl 至絲胺酸蛋白酶抑制劑失活至組織損傷。需要注意的是，cigarette smoke 和其他氧化劑也會使 alpha-1 antitrypsin 失活，因此 HOCl 是多種機制之一。同樣的氧化失活會導致 cigarette smokers 中的肺氣腫，其中中性粒細胞衍生的次氯酸與保護不良的肺間質相遇。

label: Purkinje cell
description: Purkinje cells are the principal output neurons of the cerebellar cortex integrating sensory-motor input to deep nuclei. Containment records the defining cellular composition of the cerebellum.
description_zh_TW: Purkinje 細胞是小腦皮質的主要輸出神經元，整合感覺運動輸入至深部核。包含記錄小腦的定義性細胞組成。

label: Vps15
description: Vps34 (PIK3C3), the class III phosphoinositide 3-kinase, requires Vps15 (PIK3R4) as its p150 regulatory subunit. Vps15 recruits Vps34 to membranes and stabilizes its active site, so loss of Vps15 cripples the production of PtdIns3P and everything downstream of it.
description_zh_TW: Vps34（PIK3C3）這項第三類磷脂肌醇 3-激酶，需要 Vps15（PIK3R4）作為其 p150 調節次單元。Vps15 將 Vps34 招募至膜上並穩定其活性位點，因此 Vps15 缺失會使 PtdIns3P 的產生及其下游所有事件癱瘓。

label: Kitasato Institute
