source_file: _document_ - Ivermectin, ‘Wonder drug’ from Japan the human use perspective.md
description: Satoshi Omura performed the soil-microbe screening that isolated Streptomyces avermectinius at the Kitasato Institute, Tokyo.
description_zh_TW: Satoshi Omura 在東京 Kitasato Institute 進行了土壤微生物篩選並分離出 Streptomyces avermectinius。

label: CD4+ T Cells
description: Regulatory T cells (Tregs) are a CD4+ T-lymphocyte subset that suppresses excessive immune activation and maintains self-tolerance, countering chronic inflammation and autoimmunity.
description_zh_TW: Regulatory T cells（Tregs）是 CD4+ T 淋巴球的一個次群，可抑制過度的免疫活化並維持自身耐受性，對抗慢性發炎與自體免疫。

label: Singlet Oxygen
description: Carotenoids quench singlet oxygen by physical energy transfer from the triplet state of the sensitizer, a capacity that requires at least nine conjugated double bonds - which excludes phytoene and phytofluene. This is a non-radical antioxidant route distinct from radical trapping: carotenoids do not donate hydrogen to lipid peroxyl radicals the way tocopherols do, they physically deactivate an excited sensitizer. Within membrane lipid domains, beta-carotene, alpha-carotene and lycopene in the orange pericarp of Queen Palm and the mesocarp of Red Palm Oil act as direct singlet-oxygen quenchers.
description_zh_TW: Carotenoids 透過從敏化劑三重態進行物理能量轉移來 quench Singlet Oxygen，此能力需要至少九個共軛雙鍵，因此 phytoene 與 phytofluene 不具此能力。這是一條與自由基捕捉不同的非自由基抗氧路徑：類胡蘿蔔素不像 tocopherols 那樣把氫原子 donate 給脂質過氧自由基，而是物理性地去活化一個受激的敏化劑。在膜脂質區域中，Queen Palm 的橙色果皮與 Red Palm Oil 的中果皮所含的 beta-carotene、alpha-carotene 與 lycopene 都是直接的 singlet-oxygen quenchers。

label: VEGF
description: VEGF is a hallmark of Hallmarks of Cancer. Vascular endothelial growth factor is the dominant angiogenic cytokine that promotes endothelial proliferation, survival, and vascular permeability. The Hallmarks of Cancer are the enabling biological capabilities acquired during tumorigenesis, including sustained proliferation, evasion of death, and metastasis. The directionality runs from Hallmarks of Cancer toward VEGF, so Hallmarks of Cancer is the active agent and VEGF the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: VEGF 是 Hallmarks of Cancer 的標誌。血管內皮生長因子是主要的血管生成細胞因子，可促進內皮增生、存活和血管通透性。 Hallmarks of Cancer是腫瘤發生過程中所獲得的生物學能力，包括持續增生、逃避死亡和轉移。方向性從 Hallmarks of Cancer 向 VEGF，因此 Hallmarks of Cancer 是活性劑，VEGF 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: Enterocloster
source_file: _document_ - Natural Bioactive Compounds Spermidine Fisetin Berberine Urolithin A.md
description: Enterocloster is a genus of anaerobic gut bacteria and thus a member of the Gut Microbiome. Which species are present determines which ellagitannin-to-urolithin conversion steps can occur, underpinning metabotype A, B, and 0 variability.
description_zh_TW: Enterocloster 是厭氧腸道菌的一個屬，因此是 Gut Microbiome（腸道菌群）的成員。存在哪些菌種決定了哪些 ellagitannin 轉為 urolithin 的步驟能夠發生，構成 metabotype A、B 與 0 變異的基礎。

label: Macrophage Polarization
description: SIRT2 decreases atherosclerotic plaque formation in LDL receptor-deficient mice by regulating macrophage polarization. Directionally, SIRT2 sits upstream of anti-atherogenic macrophage phenotypes. By steering macrophages toward less inflammatory states, SIRT2 reduces the foam-cell accumulation and chronic inflammation that drive plaque development. This links SIRT2 to innate immune modulation in vascular disease, complementing the anti-inflammatory actions of other sirtuins. Because macrophages are central to atherosclerosis, interventions that preserve SIRT2 activity in these cells could help limit plaque burden and stabilize existing lesions, reducing the risk of cardiovascular events.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2在LDL受體缺陷小鼠中透過調節巨噬細胞極化來減少動脈粥樣硬化斑塊的形成。方向上，SIRT2位於抗動脈粥樣硬化的巨噬細胞表型的上游。透過將巨噬細胞引導至較不發炎的狀態，SIRT2減少了驅動斑塊發展的泡沫細胞積累和慢性發炎。這將SIRT2與血管疾病中的先天免疫調節聯繫起來，補充了其他sirtuin的抗發炎作用。由於巨噬細胞是動脈粥樣硬化的核心，維持這些細胞中SIRT2活性的介入措施可能有助於限制斑塊負荷並穩定現有病變，降低心血管事件的風險。

label: O-GlcNAcylation
description: O-GlcNAcylation of DRP1 increases its fission activity: O-GlcNAc transferase drives DRP1 translocation from the Cytosol to the mitochondria, enhancing Mitochondrial Fission in parallel with the stimulatory effect of S-nitrosylation on the same GTPase. Because excessive fission is associated with aging and mitochondrial dysfunction, DRP1 O-GlcNAcylation links dietary glucose load to mitochondrial fragmentation.
description_zh_TW: DRP1 的 O-GlcNA 醣基化（O-GlcNAcylation）會提高其分裂活性：O-GlcNAc 轉移酶驅動 DRP1 由細胞質（Cytosol）轉位至粒線體，增強粒線體分裂（Mitochondrial Fission），與 S-硝基化對同一 GTPase 的刺激作用平行。因過度分裂與老化及粒線體功能障礙相關，DRP1 的 O-GlcNAcylation 將飲食葡萄糖負荷與粒線體碎裂連結起來。

label: Monoamine Oxidase Inhibitor
source_file: _document_ - Methylene Blue Dosage What Actually Works (And What's Too Much).md
description: Methylene blue acts as a monoamine oxidase inhibitor (MAOI), and this activity underlies its mood effects. MAO enzymes break down serotonin, dopamine, and norepinephrine, so inhibiting them leaves more of these neurotransmitters in the synapse - the same mechanism used by antidepressants like phenelzine. Because MAOI activity is potent, methylene blue carries real drug-interaction risks: combining it with SSRIs, SNRIs, tricyclic antidepressants, or other serotonergic medications can raise serotonin to dangerous levels and potentially trigger serotonin syndrome. This interaction is a documented, case-report-level concern and a key contraindication for self-dosing with methylene blue.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue作為單胺氧化酶抑制劑（MAOI）發揮作用，這種活性是其情緒效應的基礎。MAO酶分解血清素、多巴胺和去甲腎上腺素，因此抑制它們會使更多這些神經遞質留在突觸中——這與phenelzine等抗抑鬱藥的作用機制相同。由於MAOI活性很強，methylene blue帶有真正的藥物相互作用風險：將其與SSRIs、SNRIs、三環類抗抑鬱藥或其他血清素能藥物結合使用可能將血清素提升至危險水平，並可能引發血清素症候群。這種相互作用是已記錄的、病例報告級別的關注點，也是自行服用methylene blue的關鍵禁忌症。

label: mitoTALENs
description: mitoTALENs (mitochondria-targeted transcription activator-like effector nucleases) are engineered nucleases that selectively cleave mutant mtDNA inside mitochondria. A TALE repeat array programmed to span the pathogenic mutation discriminates mutant from wild-type mtDNA at the single-nucleotide level, and the obligately dimeric FokI nuclease requires two monomers bound at adjacent half-sites, enhancing specificity.
description_zh_TW: mitoTALENs（粒線體定位的轉錄活化因子樣效應器核酸酶）是經工程設計的核酸酶，可在粒線體內選擇性切割突變型 mtDNA。跨越致病突變點設計的 TALE repeat 陣列可在單一核苷酸層級區分突變型與野生型 mtDNA；而二聚化屬絕對必要的 FokI 核酸酶域要求兩個單體結合於相鄰半位點，進一步提升專一性。

label: NADH
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Methylene blue (MB) functions as an alternative mitochondrial electron-transfer carrier. It accepts electrons from NADH, likely via mitochondrial complex I, and is reduced to the leuco form (leuco-MB). It then donates those electrons onward to cytochrome c, bypassing the intermediate electron-transport chain complexes. This NADH-dependent reduction is what makes MB's mitochondrial antioxidant activity mitochondria-specific: in cell-free assays MB only reduces oxidative stress when both NADH and mitochondrial lysate are present, whereas classical chain-breaking antioxidants act independently of the electron transport chain.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue (MB)作為粒線體電子轉運的替代載體發揮作用。它從NADH接受電子，可能通過粒線體複合物I，並還原為無色形式（leuco-MB）。然後它將這些電子傳遞給細胞色素c，繞過中間的電子傳遞鏈複合物。這種NADH依賴性還原使得MB的粒線體抗氧化活性具有粒線體特異性：在無細胞測定中，只有當NADH和粒線體裂解液同時存在時，MB才能減少氧化應激，而經典的鏈斷裂抗氧化劑則獨立於電子傳遞鏈發揮作用。

label: Mitochondrial Integrity
description: Fusion complements damaged mitochondrial components by mixing mtDNA, proteins, and metabolites between organelles and equalizes membrane potential across the network, thereby maintaining Mitochondrial Integrity alongside fission-mediated quality control.
description_zh_TW: 融合藉由在胞器間混合 mtDNA、蛋白質與代謝物來補償受損的粒線體成分，並使網絡內的膜電位趨於一致，因而與分裂介導的品質管制共同維持 Mitochondrial Integrity。

label: Retrograde Response
description: Retinoid X receptor α (RXRA, NR2B1) is a key effector of the mammalian Retrograde Response. Mitochondrial stress — electron transport chain impairment, Mitochondrial ROS accumulation, loss of membrane potential — converges on RXRα via calcium-dependent calcineurin, which dephosphorylates and activates the receptor, promoting nuclear translocation and transcription of metabolic adaptation, antioxidant defense, Mitochondrial Biogenesis, and Mitochondrial Dynamics genes.
description_zh_TW: Retinoid X receptor α（RXRA、NR2B1）是哺乳類 Retrograde Response 的關鍵效應者。粒線體壓力——電子傳遞鏈受損、Mitochondrial ROS 累積、膜電位喪失——經由鈣離子依賴的 calcineurin 匯聚於 RXRα；calcineurin 使其去磷酸化並活化，促進核轉位與代謝適應、抗氧化防禦、Mitochondrial Biogenesis 與 Mitochondrial Dynamics 等基因的轉錄。

label: SLC25A51
description: SLC25A51 (MCART1) is a six-transmembrane-helix SLC25 carrier in the mitochondrial inner membrane that mediates uptake of intact NAD+ into the matrix, driven in part by membrane potential. Mitochondria cannot synthesize NAD+ de novo and the inner membrane is impermeable to pyridine nucleotides, so this importer supplies the matrix pool; the near-identical paralog SLC25A52 can substitute when overexpressed but is barely expressed in most tissues, leaving SLC25A51 as the dominant physiological route.
description_zh_TW: SLC25A51（MCART1）是位於粒線體內膜、具六次跨膜螺旋的 SLC25 載體，在膜電位的部分驅動下介導完整 NAD+ 進入基質的攝取。粒線體無法從頭合成 NAD+，且內膜對吡啶核苷酸不通透，因此必須由此進口蛋白供應基質 NAD+ 池；近乎相同的旁系同源物 SLC25A52 在過量表現時可替代，但在多數組織中幾乎不表現，使 SLC25A51 成為主要的生理途徑。

label: Reprogramming
description: Transient OSKM expression erases cell identity and yields induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs). iPSCs enable patient-specific disease modeling, drug discovery, and regenerative applications, including the first iPSC clinical trial for macular degeneration.
description_zh_TW: 短暫的 OSKM 表現會抹除細胞身分並產生誘導多能幹細胞（iPSC）。iPSC 促成患者特異性的疾病建模、藥物發現和再生應用，包括第一個黃斑部退化 iPSC 臨床試驗。

label: DNMT3b
description: DNMT3b works alongside DNMT3a as a de novo methyltransferase to establish new DNA methylation patterns during early development. It preferentially methylates repetitive elements, including pericentromeric satellite repeats, where its activity is essential for heterochromatin formation and genomic stability. Loss-of-function mutations in DNMT3B cause ICF syndrome, characterized by immunodeficiency, centromeric instability, and facial anomalies, while its overexpression is common in cancers, where it contributes to aberrant hypermethylation and tumor suppressor silencing.
description_zh_TW: DNMT3b 與 DNMT3a 一起作為從頭甲基轉移酶，在早期開發過程中建立新的 DNA 甲基化模式。它優先甲基化重複元件，包括著絲粒周圍衛星重複序列，其活性對於異染色質形成和基因組穩定性至關重要。 DNMT3B 的功能缺失突變會導致 ICF 綜合徵，其特徵是免疫缺陷、著絲粒不穩定和麵部異常，而其過度表達在癌症中很常見，會導致異常高甲基化和腫瘤抑制基因沉默。

label: SLC25A1
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: In senescent cells, SLC25A1 expression is significantly increased at both mRNA and protein levels across multiple senescence contexts — irradiation-induced, doxorubicin-induced and replicative. The upregulation sustains the cytosolic acetyl-CoA supply needed for histone H3K27 acetylation at SASP gene loci, linking mitochondrial carbon flux to the senescence-associated secretory phenotype.
description_zh_TW: 在衰老細胞中，SLC25A1 的 mRNA 與蛋白質表現在多種衰老情境——輻射誘發、阿霉素誘發與複製性衰老——皆顯著上升。此上調維持了 SASP 基因位點上組蛋白 H3K27 乙醯化所需的細胞質乙醯輔酶 A 供應，將粒線體碳流與衰老相關分泌表型連結起來。

label: Ketogenesis
description: Ketogenesis is induced whenever glucose availability falls, as under Caloric Restriction, Intermittent Fasting or a Ketogenic Diet. During fasting the inhibition of mTORC1 (rising AMP/ATP) promotes Ketogenesis while inhibiting glycolysis and glutaminolysis in tumor cells.
description_zh_TW: 只要葡萄糖可得性下降就會誘導 Ketogenesis，例如在 Caloric Restriction、Intermittent Fasting 或 Ketogenic Diet 之下。禁食期間 mTORC1 的抑制（AMP/ATP 上升）會促進 Ketogenesis，同時在腫瘤細胞中抑制糖解與麩醯胺分解。

label: Cyclin-Dependent Kinase
description: CDKN1A-encoded p21 inhibits cyclin-CDK enzymes, notably CDK2, enforcing G1/S blockade. This direct inhibition is shared with the Cip/Kip family mechanism.
description_zh_TW: CDKN1A 編碼的 p21 抑制 cyclin-CDK 酶（特別是 CDK2），執行 G1/S 封鎖。此直接抑制與 Cip/Kip 家族機制共享。

label: CD157
description: CD157, also called bone marrow stromal cell antigen 1 (BST1), is a glycohydrolase that participates in NAD+ precursor metabolism. It hydrolyzes nicotinamide riboside (NR) into nicotinamide (NAM), which is then further metabolized by gut microbiota into nicotinic acid and routed through the Preiss-Handler pathway to NAD+. In addition, CD157 displays base-exchange activity against both NR and niacin riboside (NAR), interconverting amidated and deamidated precursor pathways. This dual activity means CD157 not only diverts NR toward the deamidated route but also links the two branches of NAD+ biosynthesis, providing alternative substrates that maintain intracellular NAD+ levels depending on tissue and dietary context.
description_zh_TW: CD157，又稱骨髓基質細胞抗原1（BST1），是一種參與NAD+前體代謝的糖水解酶。它將菸鹼醯胺核糖苷（NR）水解為菸鹼醯胺（NAM），隨後由腸道微生物群進一步代謝為菸鹼酸，並經由Preiss-Handler途徑進入NAD+。此外，CD157對NR與菸鹼酸核糖苷（NAR）均展現鹼基交換活性，使醯胺化與去醯胺化的前體途徑相互轉換。這種雙重活性意味著CD157不僅將NR導向去醯胺化路線，也連結NAD+生合成的兩個分支，提供替代受質，依組織與飲食背景維持細胞內NAD+水平。

label: JNK
description: JNK-mediated Bcl-2 phosphorylation releases Beclin1 for VPS34 nucleation. Phosphorylation is the stress-release mechanism.
description_zh_TW: JNK 介導的 Bcl-2 磷酸化釋放 Beclin1 以供 VPS34 成核。磷酸化是壓力釋放機制。

label: Quinolinic Acid
description: The kynurenine pathway leads to metabolites including kynurenic acid, 3-hydroxykynurenine, quinolinic acid (a neurotoxin and NAD+ precursor), and ultimately NAD+. Because the pathway accounts for approximately 95% of tryptophan degradation outside protein synthesis and serotonin production, its flux through IDO1 and TDO substantially shapes systemic NAD+ levels and neuroactive metabolite balance. KP dysregulation is implicated in neurodegeneration, depression, chronic inflammation, and infections (e.g., HIV modulates IDO1), in part because of the neuroactive and excitotoxic properties of kynurenine and quinolinic acid. This links IDO1 activity to both metabolic and neurological outcomes.
description_zh_TW: 犬尿胺酸途徑產生包括犬尿烯酸、3-羥基犬尿胺酸、喹啉酸（一種神經毒素與 NAD+ 前驅物）以及最終 NAD+ 在內的多種代謝物。由於該途徑佔蛋白質合成與血清素生成以外約 95% 的色胺酸分解，其經由 IDO1 與 TDO 的流量大幅塑造全身 NAD+ 濃度與神經活性代謝物平衡。KP 失調被認為與神經退化、憂鬱症、慢性發炎及感染（例如 HIV 調節 IDO1）有關，部分原因是犬尿胺酸與喹啉酸的神經活性與興奮毒性特性。這將 IDO1 活性同時連結至代謝與神經學結果。

label: VEGFR
description: The VEGFR family (VEGFR-1/2/3) comprises receptor tyrosine kinases activated by VEGF ligands. Among them VEGFR-2 is the principal driver of tumor Angiogenesis, which is why the pathway is a standard antiangiogenic target.
description_zh_TW: VEGFR 家族（VEGFR-1/2/3）為由 VEGF ligand 活化的受體酪胺酸激酶。其中 VEGFR-2 是腫瘤 Angiogenesis 的主要驅動因子，因此此途徑是標準的抗血管新生標的。

label: Osteoclast
description: V-ATPase acidifies the resorption lacuna near pH 4.5 for matrix degradation. Requirement is the acidification dependency.
description_zh_TW: V-ATPase 酸化吸收陷窩至約 pH 4.5 以降解基質。必要性是酸化依賴。

label: Homeostasis
description: Apoptosis is the dominant homeostatic execution mode whose rate largely sets how fast a tissue turns over. Whole-body figures of roughly 150 x 10^9 apoptotic cells per day imply a full cellular churn of about 248 days (~8 months). Tissues then diverge over orders of magnitude, from gut epithelium renewing every 3-5 days to neurons lasting a lifetime.
description_zh_TW: 細胞凋亡是主導性的恆定態執行模式，其速率在很大程度上決定組織的更新速度。全身每天約 150 x 10^9 個細胞凋亡，對應整體細胞更替週期約 248 天（約 8 個月）。之後各組織的更新速率相差數個數量級，從腸上皮每 3-5 天更新一次，到神經元可延續終身。

label: SUMOylation
description: SUMOylation is a reversible post-translational modification in which Small Ubiquitin-like Modifier proteins are covalently attached to lysine residues of target proteins. SUMOylation of TFEB at K316 attenuates its transcriptional activity, dampening expression of lysosomal and autophagy genes; like ubiquitylation it proceeds through an E1 activating enzyme (SAE1/SAE2), the E2 UBC9 and E3 ligases, but it modulates protein interactions, localization and stability rather than directing degradation.
description_zh_TW: SUMOylation 是一種可逆的轉譯後修飾，Sumo 類泛素修飾蛋白被共價連接到目標蛋白的離胺酸殘基上。TFEB 在 K316 的 SUMOylation 會削弱其轉錄活性，壓低溶酶體與自噬基因的表現；與泛素化相同，它經由 E1 活化酶（SAE1/SAE2）、E2 UBC9 與 E3 連接酶進行，但它調節的是蛋白質交互作用、定位與穩定性，而非導向降解。

label: Warburg Effect
description: Metabolic Reprogramming includes Warburg Effect. Metabolic reprogramming is the rewiring of nutrient uptake and bioenergetics that supplies building blocks and redox balance to proliferating tumors. The Warburg effect is the preference of many cancer cells for aerobic glycolysis with lactate fermentation even in the presence of oxygen, supporting anabolic growth. The relationship is directional, with Metabolic Reprogramming acting as the operative agent upon Warburg Effect rather than the reverse. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: Metabolic Reprogramming 包括Warburg Effect。 Metabolic Reprogramming 是營養吸收和生物能的重新佈線，為增殖的腫瘤提供建構模組和氧化還原平衡。許多癌細胞即使在有氧的情況下也偏好進行有氧糖解和乳酸發酵，以支持合成代謝生長。這種關係是有方向的，Metabolic Reprogramming 充當Warburg Effect 的操作主體，而不是相反。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: Akkermansia
description: Akkermansia muciniphila is the principal gut-dwelling species of the genus Akkermansia (phylum Verrucomicrobia). It colonizes the intestinal mucus layer and degrades host mucin glycoproteins, and is consistently associated with gut barrier integrity and metabolic homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: Akkermansia muciniphila 是 Akkermansia 屬（Verrucomicrobia 門）主要的腸道物種。它定殖於腸道黏液層並分解宿主黏蛋白醣蛋白，且與腸道屏障完整性及代謝恆定穩定相關。

label: PAR
description: In Parthanatos, free PAR chains bind Hexokinase-1 through its PAR-binding motif and inhibit catalysis, driving VDAC dissociation and cytosolic translocation with loss of activity. Purified PAR directly inhibits hexokinase in neuronal and glioblastoma lysates whereas PARG-predigested PAR does not, and PBM-mutant HK1 resists PAR inhibition — decisive evidence for a direct binding model.
description_zh_TW: 在 Parthanatos 中，游離的 PAR 鏈透過 PAR 結合基序與 Hexokinase-1 結合並抑制其催化活性，導致 VDAC 解離、轉位至細胞質並伴隨活性喪失。純化的 PAR 可直接抑制神經元與膠質母細胞瘤裂解液中的己糖激酶，而經 PARG 預消解的 PAR 則無此效果；帶有 PBM 突變的 HK1 能抵抗 PAR 抑制——這是直接結合模型最具決定性的證據。

label: cAMP
description: High intracellular cAMP activates Epac1 (Exchange Protein directly Activated by cAMP), a guanine-nucleotide-exchange factor that triggers downstream signaling independent of PKA. Directionally, cAMP sits upstream of Epac1 activation. Epac1 then stimulates calcium release from the endoplasmic reticulum, linking cAMP to Ca2+-dependent kinases and propagating a metabolic signal. This step is pivotal in resveratrol's indirect SIRT1-activation cascade, bridging the PDE4/cAMP arm to AMPK and NAD+ metabolism. The pathway illustrates how a polyphenol can activate sirtuins through classical second-messenger signaling rather than direct enzyme binding alone.
description_zh_TW: 高濃度的細胞內 cAMP 活化 Epac1（直接被 cAMP 活化的交換蛋白），這是一種鳥嘌呤核苷酸交換因子，觸發不依賴 PKA 的下游信號。在方向性上，cAMP 位於 Epac1 活化的上游。Epac1 然後刺激內質網的鈣離子釋放，將 cAMP 與 Ca2+ 依賴性激酶聯繫起來並傳播代謝信號。這一步是白藜蘆醇間接 SIRT1 活化級聯中的關鍵樞紐，將 PDE4/cAMP 臂橋接到 AMPK 和 NAD+ 代謝。此通路說明了一種多酚如何通過經典的第二信使信號而非僅靠直接酶結合來活化 sirtuin。

label: PAI-1
description: PAI-1 is the principal physiological inhibitor of the plasminogen activators uPA and tissue-type plasminogen activator, blocking plasmin generation and therefore fibrinolysis and extracellular matrix remodelling. By suppressing plasmin it also modulates integrin and latent-growth-factor activation, feeding fibrotic and proliferative loops.
description_zh_TW: PAI-1 是 uPA 與組織型纖維蛋白溶解酶原活化素的主要生理抑制劑，阻斷 plasmin 生成，因而抑制纖維蛋白溶解與細胞外基質重塑。透過抑制 plasmin，它也調節 integrin 與潛在生長因子的活化，feeding 纖維化與增殖性回饋迴圈。

label: TLR9
description: TLR9 (Toll-Like Receptor 9) is an endosomal Toll-like receptor that senses unmethylated CpG-rich DNA within the lumen of endosomes and lysosomes. Unlike the cytosolic DNA sensor cGAS, TLR9 is confined to the endolysosomal compartment, where it detects pathogen-derived DNA and, in some contexts, endogenous self-DNA delivered to these vesicles.
description_zh_TW: TLR9 (Toll-Like Receptor 9) 是一種內體型 Toll 樣受體，在內體與溶酶體腔內偵測未甲基化的 CpG 富含 DNA。與細胞質 DNA 感測器 cGAS 不同，TLR9 受限於內溶體區室，在該處辨識病原體來源的 DNA，並在某些情境下辨識被運送至此囊泡的內源性自體 DNA。

label: CDK Inhibitor
description: CDK inhibitors as a class block cyclin-dependent kinase activity to gate cell-cycle transitions. This definitional class-target edge covers INK4 and Cip/Kip members plus drugs.
description_zh_TW: CDK 抑制因子作為一類阻斷週期蛋白依賴激酶活性以守衛細胞週期轉換。此定義性類別—標的邊涵蓋 INK4 與 Cip/Kip 成員及藥物。

label: NASH
description: NASH is the inflammatory, potentially progressive form of Non-alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease. Where simple steatosis is fat accumulation alone, NASH adds hepatocyte injury, Inflammation and variable fibrosis, and it can progress to cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma.
description_zh_TW: NASH 是 Non-alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease 中具發炎性且可能進展的形式。單純脂肪肝僅有脂肪堆積，而 NASH 額外加上肝細胞損傷、Inflammation 與程度不一的纖維化，並可進展為肝硬化與肝細胞癌。

label: Kynurenine Pathway
description: IDO1 catalyzes the first, rate-limiting step in tryptophan catabolism, inserting both oxygen atoms of O2 into the indole ring to yield N-formylkynurenine and thereby initiating the Kynurenine Pathway. Downstream metabolism produces Quinolinic Acid and ultimately NAD+, so IDO1 activity links tryptophan availability to the cellular NAD+ pool as well as to T-cell immunity and tumor immune tolerance.
description_zh_TW: IDO1 催化色胺酸分解代謝的第一步也是限速步驟，將 O2 的兩個氧原子插入 indole 環以生成 N-formylkynurenine，據此啟動 Kynurenine Pathway。下游代謝產生 Quinolinic Acid 並最終生成 NAD+，因此 IDO1 活性同時連結色胺酸可得性與細胞 NAD+ 池，以及 T 細胞免疫與腫瘤免疫耐受。

label: Muscle Stem Cell
description: Satellite cells are the tissue-resident muscle stem cells of skeletal muscle, located between the basal lamina and the sarcolemma of mature muscle fibers. They are essential for postnatal muscle growth, regeneration after injury, and maintenance of muscle mass throughout life, and they are held in a quiescent G0 state marked by Pax7 until activation.
description_zh_TW: Satellite cell 是 skeletal muscle 的組織常駐 muscle stem cell，位於成熟肌纖維的 basal lamina 與 sarcolemma 之間。它們對出生後的肌肉生長、受傷後的再生，以及終生的肌肉量維持不可或缺，並在以 Pax7 為標記的 G0 靜止狀態中維持，直到被活化為止。

label: Bim
description: Bcl-2 family includes Bim. The Bcl-2 protein family comprises pro-apoptotic effectors (Bax, Bak) and BH3-only activators balanced against anti-apoptotic guardians (Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, Mcl-1, Bcl-w) that set the mitochondrial death threshold. Bim is a sentinel BH3-only protein sequestered at microtubules that is released by stress to directly activate Bax/Bak. The relationship is directional, with Bcl-2 family acting as the operative agent upon Bim rather than the reverse. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: Bcl-2 family 包括Bim。 Bcl-2 蛋白家族包括促凋亡效應子 (Bax、Bak) 和僅 BH3 活化劑，與設定粒線體死亡閾值的抗凋亡衛士 (Bcl-2、Bcl-xL、Mcl-1、Bcl-w) 保持平衡。 Bim 是一種隔離在微管中的前哨 BH3 蛋白，壓力釋放時可直接活化 Bax/Bak。這種關係是有方向的，Bcl-2 family 充當Bim 的操作主體，而不是相反。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: miR-217
description: miR-217 is a senescence-associated microRNA whose canonical validated target is SIRT1. It binds the SIRT1 3'-UTR and suppresses translation, reducing NAD+-dependent deacetylase activity (Menghini et al., Circulation 2009; PMID 19188522).
description_zh_TW: miR-217 是一種與衰老相關的微 RNA，其經實驗驗證的經典靶標是 SIRT1。它結合 SIRT1 的 3'-UTR 並抑制轉譯，降低 NAD+ 依賴的去乙醯化酶活性（Menghini 等人，Circulation 2009；PMID 19188522）。

label: HDACs
description: Trichostatin A is a hydroxamate HDAC inhibitor used alongside SAHA to demonstrate that deacetylation restrains autophagy. Its inhibition of HDACs de-represses TFEB and FOXO targets, raising Autophagy activity.
description_zh_TW: Trichostatin A 是羥胺酸類的 HDAC 抑制劑，常與 SAHA 併用以證明去乙醯化會壓抑自噬。其對 HDACs 的抑制會解除 TFEB 與 FOXO 標的基因的壓抑，提高 Autophagy 活性。

label: Cyclophosphamide
description: Cyclophosphamide is the prototypical alkylator producing phosphoramide-mustard crosslinks. Classification defines the drug class.
description_zh_TW: Cyclophosphamide 是產生磷醯胺芥交聯的原型烷化劑。歸類定義藥物類別。

label: Thioredoxin reductase
description: Auranofin is a potent, irreversible covalent inhibitor of both cytosolic (TXNRD1) and mitochondrial (TXNRD2) thioredoxin reductase. Its gold(I) cation coordinates the catalytic C-terminal selenocysteine, blocking thioredoxin regeneration and converting the redox-balancing machinery into a source of lethal ROS.
description_zh_TW: Auranofin 是細胞質（TXNRD1）與粒線體（TXNRD2）硫氧還蛋白還原酶的強效、不可逆共價抑制劑。其金(I)陽離子配位催化所需的 C 端硒半胱氨酸，阻斷硫氧還蛋白再生成，並將氧化還原平衡機制轉變為致命 ROS 的來源。

label: GW5074
description: GW5074 is an indolinone compound originally developed as a c-Raf kinase inhibitor; like the bisindolylmaleimide Ro31-8220, it was repurposed as a sirtuin inhibitor after screening known kinase inhibitors against SIRT2 based on the shared adenosine-binding site between sirtuins and kinases. GW5074 shows SIRT1/SIRT2 inhibitory activity in the low micromolar range. Directionally, its identity as a kinase-inhibitor scaffold enables engagement of the sirtuin NAD+ pocket. Its continued kinase activity complicates interpretation in cells, highlighting the need for selectivity optimization in dual kinase/sirtuin inhibitor design.
description_zh_TW: GW5074 是一種最初作為 c-Raf 激酶抑制劑開發的吲哚啉酮化合物；與雙吲哚基馬來酰亞胺 Ro31-8220 類似，它在基於 sirtuin 和蛋白激酶共享腺嘌呤結合位點的原理篩選已知激酶抑制劑對 SIRT2 的活性後被重新定位為 sirtuin 抑制劑。GW5074 在低微摩爾範圍內表現出 SIRT1/SIRT2 抑制活性。方向性上其作為激酶抑制劑骨架的身份使其能夠與 sirtuin NAD+ 口袋結合。其持續的激酶活性使細胞內的詮釋複雜化，凸顯了在雙重激酶/sirtuin 抑制劑設計中選擇性優化的必要性。

label: Ro31-8220
description: Ro31-8220 is a bisindolylmaleimide compound originally developed as a protein kinase C inhibitor; its adenosine-binding scaffold allowed it to be repurposed as an inhibitor of SIRT1 and SIRT2 in the low micromolar range. It belongs to the kinase-inhibitor scaffolds identified by screening known kinase inhibitors against sirtuins, sharing this property with the indolinone GW5074. Directionally, Ro31-8220's identity as a kinase-inhibitor scaffold underlies its cross-reactivity with sirtuins through the shared adenosine-binding site. Because it retains potent kinase activity, cellular effects cannot be attributed solely to sirtuin inhibition.
description_zh_TW: Ro31-8220 是一種最初作為蛋白激酶 C 抑制劑開發的雙吲哚基馬來酰亞胺化合物；其腺嘌呤結合骨架使其被重新定位為低微摩爾範圍內的 SIRT1 和 SIRT2 抑制劑。它屬於透過篩選已知激酶抑制劑對 sirtuin 活性而鑑定的激酶抑制劑骨架，與吲哚啉酮 GW5074 共享此特性。方向性上 Ro31-8220 作為激酶抑制劑骨架的身份奠定了其透過共享腺嘌呤結合位點對 sirtuin 的交叉反應性。由於其保留強效激酶活性，細胞效應不能僅歸因於 sirtuin 抑制。

label: PhenoAge
description: The Horvath clock is the pan-tissue reference against which later clocks including PhenoAge are compared. PhenoAge complements the Horvath clock by tracking mortality-linked phenotypic age rather than chronological age.
description_zh_TW: Horvath 時鐘是後續時鐘（包括 PhenoAge）進行比較的跨組織參考。PhenoAge 透過追蹤與死亡率相關的表現型年齡而非時間年齡，與 Horvath 時鐘互補。

label: TH17
description: IL-22, a member of the IL-10 gene family, is produced mainly by T helper 17 cells and innate lymphoid cell subsets. It mediates mucosal barrier maintenance through antimicrobial peptides and epithelial proliferation after tissue injury.
description_zh_TW: IL-22 屬於 IL-10 基因家族，主要由輔助型 T 細胞 17（TH17）與先天淋巴細胞亞群產生。它透過抗菌胜肽與上皮細胞增殖，在組織受損後維持黏膜屏障並促進修復。

label: PAK1
source_file: _document_ - Ivermectin, a potential anticancer drug derived from an antiparasitic drug.md
description: Cancer Stem Cells are regulated by PAK1. Cancer stem cells are self-renewing subpopulations that seed tumors, resist therapy, and are enriched by EMT and inflammatory signaling. PAK1 is a p21-activated kinase downstream of Rac/Cdc42 that promotes survival, invasion, and cancer-stem-cell signaling and is inhibited by ivermectin. The directionality runs from PAK1 toward Cancer Stem Cells, so PAK1 is the active agent and Cancer Stem Cells the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Cancer Stem Cells 受 PAK1 調節。 Cancer 幹細胞是自我更新的亞羣，它們會產生腫瘤、抵抗治療，並透過 EMT 和發炎訊號傳導而豐富。 PAK1 是 Rac/Cdc42 下游的 p21 活化激酶，可促進存活、侵襲和癌症幹細胞訊號傳導，並被伊維菌素抑制。方向性從 PAK1 朝向 Cancer Stem Cells，因此 PAK1 是主動主體，Cancer Stem Cells 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Metabolic Reprogramming
description: Cancer undergoes Metabolic Reprogramming. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. Metabolic reprogramming is the rewiring of nutrient uptake and bioenergetics that supplies building blocks and redox balance to proliferating tumors. The relationship is directional, with Cancer acting as the operative agent upon Metabolic Reprogramming rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Cancer經歷Metabolic Reprogramming。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。 Metabolic Reprogramming 是營養吸收和生物能的重新佈線，為增殖的腫瘤提供建構模組和氧化還原平衡。這種關係是有方向的，Cancer 充當 Metabolic Reprogramming 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Immunotherapy
description: Checkpoint Inhibitors are the core modality of Immunotherapy: they release CTLA-4 and PD-1/PD-L1 brake signaling that suppresses antitumor T-cell activity, converting a chronically inflamed but immune-excluded tumor into one the immune system can clear.
description_zh_TW: Checkpoint Inhibitor（檢查點抑制劑）是 Immunotherapy（免疫療法）的核心手段：它們解除抑制抗腫瘤 T 細胞活性的 CTLA-4 與 PD-1/PD-L1 煞車訊號，使長期發炎但免疫排斥的腫瘤轉為免疫系統可清除的腫瘤。

label: Age-Related Diseases
description: Aging is the sum of all age-related diseases, pre-diseases and pre-pre-diseases, which limit lifespan, and since humans die from age-related diseases rather than from healthy aging, a drug indicated for all age-related diseases must be an anti-aging drug in that it targets the common driver of these diseases, namely aging itself. Standard medicine extends lifespan mostly by preventing death from overt diseases, extending the unhealthy phase of life, whereas anti-aging medicine increases both healthspan and lifespan and is most effective at the stage of pre-diseases before complications and organ damage occur.
description_zh_TW:
衰老是所有與年齡相關的疾病、亞疾病和前亞疾病的總和，這些疾病限制壽命。由於人類通常死於與年齡相關的疾病，而不是健康衰老，因此針對所有與年齡相關疾病的藥物必須是一種抗衰老藥物，因為它標靶這些疾病的共同驅動因素，即衰老本身。標準醫學主要通過預防明顯疾病來延長壽命，延長不健康的生活階段，而抗衰老醫學則同時增加健康壽命和壽命，並在亞疾病階段（在出現併發症和器官損傷之前）最有效。”} 자바스크립트에서 실행할 수 있는 코드를 생성하는 데 도움이 될 수 있습니다. 예를 들어, 다음 코드는 간단한 웹 페이지를 생성합니다. My First Heading

My First Heading

This is my first paragraph.

이 코드를 실행하면 제목이

label: Rab7
description: Lysosomal positioning and perinuclear clustering are regulated by Rab7 effectors, with FYCO1-type machinery driving plus-end transport and the RILP-ORP1L dynein adaptor driving minus-end movement. Perinuclear lysosomal clustering in turn facilitates Autophagy.
description_zh_TW: 溶酶體的定位與核周聚集由 Rab7 效應蛋白調控，其中 FYCO1 類機器驅動向正端運輸，RILP-ORP1L 動力蛋白銜接蛋白驅动向負端移動。而核周溶酶體聚集反過來有助於 Autophagy。

label: Myocardial Ischemia-Reperfusion Injury
description: SIRT1 protects against Myocardial Ischemia-Reperfusion Injury. Cardiac-specific SIRT1 knockout enlarges infarct size, whereas overexpression upregulates the FoxO1/MnSOD antioxidant pathway and downregulates the pro-apoptotic caspase-3/Bax axis. Upstream, miR-132 inhibition and lncRNA Oip5-as1 converge on a SIRT1/AMPK/PGC-1α module.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 可保護心臟免受 Myocardial Ischemia-Reperfusion Injury。心肌特異性 SIRT1 剔除會擴大梗死面積，而過量表現則會上調 FoxO1/MnSOD 抗氧化路徑並下調促凋亡的 caspase-3/Bax 軸。上游方面，miR-132 抑制與 lncRNA Oip5-as1 都收斂到 SIRT1/AMPK/PGC-1α 模組。

label: Mitochondrial Membrane Potential
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: The Mitochondrial Electron Transport Chain pumps protons across the inner membrane, building the electrochemical gradient ΔΨm that defines the Mitochondrial Membrane Potential and drives ATP synthesis; its collapse is an early event in oxidative neuronal injury.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial Electron Transport Chain 將質子泵送過內膜，建立定義 Mitochondrial Membrane Potential 的電化學梯度 ΔΨm 並驅動 ATP 合成；其崩解是氧化性神經損傷的早期事件。

label: Muscle Hypertrophy
description: mTORC1 is the central anabolic driver of Muscle Hypertrophy. Mechanical tension and metabolic stress during resistance exercise activate the PI3K/Akt pathway and leucine sensing upstream of mTORC1, which raises translation initiation and boosts myofibrillar protein accretion. Sustained mTORC1 signalling is what makes a muscle grow rather than merely adapt.
description_zh_TW: mTORC1 是 Muscle Hypertrophy 的核心合成代謝驅動因子。阻力運動期間的機械張力與代謝壓力會經由 PI3K/Akt 路徑與 leucine 感測在 mTORC1 上游活化它，進而提升轉譯起始並促進肌原纖維蛋白的累積。持續的 mTORC1 訊號正是肌肉生長而非僅止於適應的關鍵。

label: SMAD2
description: TGFBR1 phosphorylates receptor-SMAD SMAD2 as the primary transducer. Body text confirms this canonical activation.
description_zh_TW: TGFBR1 磷酸化受體 SMAD SMAD2 作為主要傳導器。內文確認此典型活化。

label: Acute Lung Injury
description: Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome is the more severe end of the acute lung injury spectrum: a syndrome of acute diffuse lung injury producing increased pulmonary vascular permeability, edema, and refractory hypoxemic respiratory failure, triggered by insults such as sepsis, pneumonia, aspiration, trauma, pancreatitis, and severe COVID-19 rather than a single disease entity.
description_zh_TW: Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome 是急性肺損傷光譜中較嚴重的一端：一種急性瀰漫性肺損傷症候群，造成肺血管通透性增加、水腫與難以緩解的低血氧呼吸衰竭，可由敗血症、肺炎、誤吸、創傷、胰臟炎與嚴重 COVID-19 等誘因引起，並非單一疾病。

label: H3K27me3
description: By blocking EZH2-mediated trimethylation of histone H3 at lysine 27, Tazemetostat reduces the repressive H3K27me3 mark. Loss of aberrant H3K27me3 derepresses silenced tumor-suppressor genes, restoring differentiation and cell-cycle control in cancers addicted to EZH2 activity, and exemplifies targeting the 'writer' enzymes of the epigenome.
description_zh_TW: 藉由阻斷 EZH2 對組蛋白 H3 第 27 號離胺酸的三甲基化，Tazemetostat 可降低抑制性的 H3K27me3 標記。異常 H3K27me3 的流失會解除被沉默的腫瘤抑制基因之抑制，在對 EZH2 活性成癮的癌症中恢復分化與細胞週期控制，並 exemplifies 針對表觀基因組「寫入者」酵素的策略。

label: IgE
description: IL-4 is indispensable for IgE class switching in B cells; IL-4-deficient mice fail to produce IgE and have impaired anti-helminth immunity. This is why dupilumab, an anti-IL-4Rα antibody blocking both IL-4 and IL-13, is approved for type 2 inflammatory disease.
description_zh_TW: IL-4 對 B 細胞的 IgE 類別轉換不可或缺；IL-4 缺乏小鼠無法產生 IgE，且抗蠕蟲免疫受損。這也是為何阻斷 IL-4 與 IL-13 的抗 IL-4Rα 抗體 dupilumab 獲准用於第二型發炎性疾病。

label: Macromolecular Crowding
description: Neuromelanin and Macromolecular Crowding are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Neuromelanin and Macromolecular Crowding may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Neuromelanin 和 Macromolecular Crowding 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Neuromelanin 和 Macromolecular Crowding 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: TRAF2
description: TRAF2 is a key component of the signaling complex recruited by TNFR1, where it helps activate the NF-κB pathway to promote cell survival. In TNFR1 complex I, TRAF2 recruits cIAPs to ubiquitinate RIPK1 (survival mode), and is itself a CYLD deubiquitination substrate at the complex I → complex II handoff. Because of this survival signaling, TRAF2 overactivity can contribute to tumor growth and resistance to apoptosis-inducing therapies.
description_zh_TW: TRAF2 是 TNFR1 所招募訊號複合體的關鍵成分，在其中協助活化 NF-κB 途徑以促進細胞存活。在 TNFR1 complex I 中，TRAF2 招募 cIAPs 對 RIPK1 進行泛素化（存活模式），其本身在 complex I → complex II 的交接處是 CYLD 去泛素化的受質。由於此存活訊號作用，TRAF2 的過度活化可能促成腫瘤生長與對誘導凋亡療法的抗性。

label: N-Myc
description: N-Myc is a MYC-family oncogenic transcription factor.
description_zh_TW: N-Myc 是 MYC 家族致癌轉錄因子。

label: Extrinsic Pathway
description: Apoptosis has the pathway Extrinsic Pathway. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. The extrinsic (death-receptor) apoptotic pathway is triggered by extracellular ligands engaging cell-surface death receptors and proceeds through the DISC. The relationship is directional, with Apoptosis acting as the operative agent upon Extrinsic Pathway rather than the reverse. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: Apoptosis 有路徑Extrinsic Pathway。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。外在（死亡受體）細胞凋亡途徑由與細胞表面死亡受體結合的細胞外配體觸發，並透過 DISC 進行。這種關係是有方向的，Apoptosis 充當 Extrinsic Pathway 的操作主體，而不是相反。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: CXCL12
description: CXCL12 was identified as the most highly upregulated SASP factor in endothelial cells with aging, and add-back of CXCL12 to old fisetin plasma recapitulated age-related endothelial dysfunction (-22% peak endothelium-dependent dilation), while CXCL12 neutralization with LIT-927 rescued function. CXCL12 also impairs NO production, raises mitochondrial superoxide and drives endothelial-to-mesenchymal transition, establishing it as a causal circulating driver of vascular aging.
description_zh_TW: CXCL12 被確認為內皮細胞隨老化上調最多的 SASP 因子；將 CXCL12 加回老年小鼠經 fisetin 處理的血漿可重現與年齡相關的內皮功能障礙（內皮依賴性擴張峰值下降 22%），而以 LIT-927 中和 CXCL12 則可挽救功能。CXCL12 還會損害 NO 產生、提高粒線體超氧陰離子並促進內皮間質轉化，確立它是血管老化的因果性循環因子。

label: GlyNAC
description: The NAC component of GlyNAC is deacetylated to cysteine, supplying the rate-limiting amino acid for glutathione synthesis.
description_zh_TW: GlyNAC 中的 NAC 成分會去乙醯化為半胱胺酸，提供穀胱甘肽合成中限速的胺基酸來源。

label: Cathepsin B
description: Silica-induced lysosomal membrane permeabilization spills lysosomal proteases including Cathepsin B into the cytosol; cytosolic Cathepsin B acts as a danger signal that triggers NLRP3 activation and downstream IL-1β maturation.
description_zh_TW: Silica 造成的溶酶體膜通透化會使包括 Cathepsin B 在內的溶酶體蛋白酶外漏至細胞質；細胞質中的 Cathepsin B 作為危險訊號，誘發 NLRP3 活化與下游 IL-1β 成熟。

label: Testosterone
description: Androgen-receptor binding promotes protein synthesis, resistance to Muscle Atrophy, and prevention of Osteoporosis. Testosterone deficiency associates with sarcopenia, adiposity, and inflammaging, whereas balanced androgen tone within a Mitohormesis-like optimum favors Healthspan; supraphysiological dosing instead raises redox and thrombotic risk.
description_zh_TW: 雄性素受體的結合促進蛋白質合成、提高對 Muscle Atrophy 的抵抗力並預防 Osteoporosis。Testosterone 缺乏與肌少症、脂肪堆積及 inflammaging 相關；而在類似 Mitohormesis 的最佳範圍內維持平衡的雄性素張力則有利於 Healthspan；超生理劑量的給藥反而會提高氧化還原與血栓風險。

label: Malate-Aspartate Shuttle
description: Aminooxyacetate is an inhibitor of aminotransferases (notably aspartate aminotransferase, GOT1/GOT2) that blocks the Malate-Aspartate Shuttle, the principal system transferring glycolytic NADH into mitochondria. By inhibiting the transamination steps of the shuttle it prevents cytosolic NADH oxidation via mitochondrial Oxidative Phosphorylation.
description_zh_TW: Aminooxyacetate 是胺基轉移酶（尤其 aspartate aminotransferase、GOT1／GOT2）的抑制劑，可阻斷 Malate-Aspartate Shuttle——將糖解產生的 NADH 轉送入粒線體的主要系統。藉由抑制該穿梭的轉胺步驟，它阻止細胞質 NADH 經由粒線體 Oxidative Phosphorylation 被氧化。

label: Bifidobacterium
description: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) can selectively stimulate the growth of beneficial gut bacteria such as Bifidobacterium and Lactobacillus. These genera are associated with improved gut health, including prevention of diarrhea, improved gut barrier function, reduced inflammation, and immune system support. NAD+ precursors modulate gut microbiota by providing an energy source for beneficial bacteria, activating sirtuins, and improving gut barrier function. NMN and NR thereby reverse gut dysbiosis and promote beneficial effects at both intestinal and extraintestinal levels, linking dietary NAD+ precursor intake to a healthier gut microbial community.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）能選擇性地刺激有益腸道細菌如 Bifidobacterium 和 Lactobacillus 的生長。這些屬與改善腸道健康相關，包括預防腹瀉、改善腸道屏障功能、減少發炎以及支持免疫系統。NAD+ 前驅物透過提供有益細菌的能量來源、活化去乙醯酶以及改善腸道屏障功能來調節腸道菌叢。NMN 和 NR 因此逆轉腸道失調，並在腸內與腸外層面促進有益效應，將膳食性 NAD+ 前驅物攝取與更健康的腸道微生物群落連結起來。

label: TBK1
description: TRAF3 binds and activates the TBK1–IKKε kinase complex that phosphorylates IRF3, driving IFN-β transcription and type I interferon production. This makes TRAF3 a central relay of antiviral innate immunity; dysregulated TRAF3 affects antiviral defense, autoimmunity, and lymphomagenesis.
description_zh_TW: TRAF3 結合並活化 TBK1–IKKε 激酶複合體，後者磷酸化 IRF3，驅動 IFN-β 的轉錄與第一型干擾素的產生。這使 TRAF3 成為抗病毒先天免疫的中繼站；TRAF3 的失調會影響抗病毒防禦、自體免疫與淋巴瘤生成。

label: Immune Checkpoint
description: Immune Checkpoint is co-opted by Cancer. Immune checkpoints are physiological brakes on lymphocyte responses that cancers hijack to avoid immune destruction. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. The directionality runs from Cancer toward Immune Checkpoint, so Cancer is the active agent and Immune Checkpoint the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Immune Checkpoint 被 Cancer 增選。這是對淋巴細胞反應的生理制動，癌症劫持淋巴細胞反應以避免免疫破壞。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。方向性從 Cancer 向 Immune Checkpoint，因此 Cancer 是活性劑，Immune Checkpoint 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: ASK1
description: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) is the canonical high-affinity redox-dependent inhibitor of the stress kinase ASK1. In its reduced state Trx1 binds ASK1's N-terminal thioredoxin-binding domain and keeps the kinase inactive, targeting it for degradation; on oxidative stress Trx1 is oxidized and dissociates, de-repressing ASK1 to drive JNK/p38 MAPK apoptosis and senescence signaling.
description_zh_TW: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) 是壓力激酶 ASK1 的典型高親和力、依賴氧化還原狀態的抑制劑。在還原態下，Trx1 結合 ASK1 的 N 端硫氧還蛋白結合域並使激酶保持不活化，並使其被降解；在氧化壓力下，Trx1 被氧化並解離，解除對 ASK1 的抑制，驅動 JNK/p38 MAPK 的細胞凋亡與衰老訊息傳遞。

label: Chromaffin cells
description: Chromaffin cells of the adrenal medulla produce and store epinephrine (adrenaline), the hormone whose oxidation generates adrenochrome. This is the classic biological source of adrenochrome, noted since the 19th century when extracts from suprarenal (adrenal) glands turned reddish due to oxidation of the catecholamine upon exposure to air or oxidants. Oxidation of epinephrine can form adrenochrome in these cells upon release or exposure to oxidants, and the same chemistry occurs wherever epinephrine is present and oxidized, including sympathetic nerve endings, endothelial cells, and inflamed tissues.
description_zh_TW: Chromaffin cells of the adrenal medulla produce and store epinephrine (adrenaline), the hormone whose oxidation generates adrenochrome。This is the classic biological source of adrenochrome, noted since the 19th century when extracts from suprarenal (adrenal) glands turned reddish due to oxidation of the catecholamine upon exposure to air or oxidants。Oxidation of epinephrine can form adrenochrome in these cells upon release or exposure to oxidants, and the same chemistry occurs wherever epinephrine is present and oxidized, including sympathetic nerve endings, endothelial cells, and inflamed tissues。

label: Nanoparticles
description: Human Serum Albumin is an ideal nanocarrier because it is endogenous, non-immunogenic, biodegradable and binds hydrophobic drugs, improving Bioavailability of poorly soluble compounds. Albumin-bound nanoparticle technology is clinically validated (e.g. nab-paclitaxel) and exploits gp60/SPARC albumin uptake pathways enriched in tumors.
description_zh_TW: Human Serum Albumin 是理想的奈米載體，因為它是內源性、非免疫原性、可生物降解且能結合疏水性藥物，可改善難溶化合物的 Bioavailability。白蛋白結合型奈米粒子技術已獲臨床驗證（如 nab-paclitaxel），並利用在腫瘤中富集的 gp60/SPARC 白蛋白攝取途徑。

label: IκBα
description: The IKK complex is the core signaling component of canonical NF-κB activation. IKKβ phosphorylates IkappaBalpha at Ser32/Ser36, creating a phosphodegron recognized by the SCF/β-TrCP E3 ligase and causing K48-linked ubiquitination and rapid proteasomal degradation. Freed NF-κB then translocates to the nucleus and activates target genes; NEMO is essential for signal-dependent assembly and activation of the complex.
description_zh_TW: IKK complex 是典型 NF-κB 活化的核心訊號元件。IKKβ 在 Ser32/Ser36 磷酸化 IkappaBalpha，形成由 SCF/β-TrCP E3 連接酶辨識的磷酸降解子，造成 K48 連結泛素化與快速的蛋白酶體降解。獲得自由的 NF-κB 隨後轉位入核並活化標的基因；NEMO 對此複合體的訊號依賴性組裝與活化是必要的。

label: MDH1
description: Cytosolic MDH1 catalyzes the reversible conversion of malate to oxaloacetate coupled to NAD+ reduction to NADH; together with mitochondrial MDH2 it forms the cytosolic arm of the malate-aspartate shuttle.
description_zh_TW: 細胞質的 MDH1 催化蘋果酸可逆轉為草醯乙酸，並將 NAD⁺ 還原為 NADH；它與粒線體的 MDH2 共同構成蘋果酸－天門冬胺酸穿梭的細胞質一側。

label: N-Acetylcysteine
description: N-Acetylcysteine raises intracellular Glutathione. Cysteine is the rate-limiting residue of GSH synthesis, and NAC supplies bioavailable cysteine after deacetylation; replenishing the GSH pool is the principal mechanism behind NAC's reduction of Oxidative Stress and its clinical use in acetaminophen poisoning, where it restores hepatic GSH and prevents NAPQI adduction.
description_zh_TW: N-Acetylcysteine 會提升細胞內 Glutathione。Cysteine 是 GSH 合成的限速殘基，而 NAC 在去乙醯化後供應可利用的 cysteine；補充 GSH 池正是 NAC 降低 Oxidative Stress 的主要機制，也是其在乙醯胺酚中毒的臨床用途——恢復肝臟 GSH 並阻止 NAPQI 加合。

label: Lipid Metabolism
description: Lipid metabolism is a major output of SIRT1 deacetylase activity, which modulates transcription factors such as PGC-1alpha, LXR, FOXO, and CREB to govern lipid handling. SIRT1 deficiency is linked to metabolic and lipid disorders.
description_zh_TW: 脂質代謝是 SIRT1 去乙醯化酶活性的主要輸出，SIRT1 調控 PGC-1α、LXR、FOXO 與 CREB 等轉錄因子以掌握脂質處理。SIRT1 缺乏與代謝及脂質疾病相關。

label: Wnt
description: Wnt/Frizzled inhibits the destruction complex so beta-catenin accumulates; core canonical mechanism.
description_zh_TW: Wnt/Frizzled 抑制破壞複合體使 β-catenin 累積；核心典型機制。

label: Transposable Elements
description: Alu elements are approximately 300-bp short interspersed nuclear elements (SINEs) derived from the 7SL RNA gene. With about 1.1 million copies they make up roughly 11% of the human genome, making them the most abundant Transposable Elements family; they are transcribed by RNA polymerase III and mobilize in copy-and-paste fashion through a LINE-1 ORF2 RNA intermediate.
description_zh_TW: Alu element 是約 300 bp、源自 7SL RNA 基因的短散在核元件（SINE）。約有 110 萬份拷貝，約占人類基因組的 11%，是數量最多的 Transposable Elements 家族；它們由 RNA polymerase III 轉錄，並透過 LINE-1 ORF2 蛋白的 RNA 中間物以「複製貼上」方式移動。

label: MOMP
description: BH3 mimetics relates to MOMP through the relation induce. BH3 mimetics are small molecules that occupy the hydrophobic groove of anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 proteins, freeing Bax/Bak to kill tumor cells. Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is the committed, largely irreversible step of intrinsic apoptosis that releases intermembrane-space proteins. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
description_zh_TW: BH3 mimetics 透過關係式與 MOMP 相關。 BH3 mimetics 是佔據抗凋亡 Bcl-2 蛋白疏水溝的小分子，釋放 Bax/Bak 來殺死腫瘤細胞。粒線體外膜透化 (MOMP) 是釋放膜間空間蛋白的內在細胞凋亡中關鍵的、基本上不可逆的步驟。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

label: FL118
description: FL118 is a second-generation camptothecin analog that traps the covalent TOP1-DNA cleavage complex, preventing religation of single-strand breaks. Collision of the trapped complex with replicating DNA polymerases converts these breaks into lethal double-strand breaks.
description_zh_TW: FL118 是第二代喜樹鹼類似物，會捕獲共價的 TOP1-DNA 切割複合體，阻止單股斷裂的重新連結。被捕獲複合體與複製中的 DNA 聚合酶碰撞，會將這些斷裂轉化為致命的雙股斷裂。

label: GDF15
description: GDF15 is a TGFbeta-family SASP ligand whose blockade with antibodies partially rescues paracrine arrest in Acosta 2013. It acts alongside Activin A and TGF-beta1 as a non-redundant arrest-transmitting signal.
description_zh_TW: GDF15 是 TGFbeta 家族 SASP 配體，Acosta 2013 中抗體阻斷部分拯救旁分泌停滯。它與 Activin A 和 TGF-beta1 並列，作為非冗餘的停滯傳遞訊號。

label: SHMT2
description: 5-Fluorouracil-resistant colorectal cancer cells show strong serine dependency, upregulating SHMT2 to compartmentalize one-carbon metabolism in mitochondria, supporting purine biosynthesis and DNA damage repair. SHMT2-driven mitochondrial one-carbon metabolism is therefore both a driver of CRC progression and a mechanism of chemoresistance to 5-FU; targeting serine availability or SHMT2 activity can revert 5-FU resistance in preclinical models.
description_zh_TW: 對 5-氟尿嘧啶抗藥的大腸直腸癌細胞呈現強烈的絲胺酸依賴性，並上調 SHMT2 以將一碳代謝區隔於粒線體中，藉此支援嘌呤生合成與 DNA 損傷修復。因此 SHMT2 驅動的粒線體一碳代謝既是大腸直腸癌進展的驅動因子，也是對 5-FU 的抗藥性機制；在前臨床模型中，抑制絲胺酸供應或 SHMT2 活性可逆轉 5-FU 抗藥性。

label: L-DOPA
description: Dopamine is a catecholamine neurotransmitter synthesized from tyrosine in two steps: Tyrosine Hydroxylase catalyzes tyrosine to L-DOPA, and aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase converts L-DOPA to dopamine. In the substantia nigra pars compacta the dopamine is then packaged into synaptic vesicles by Vesicular Monoamine Transporter 2.
description_zh_TW: Dopamine 是由酪胺素合成的兒茶酚胺神經傳遞物質，分兩步：Tyrosine Hydroxylase 催化酪胺素生成 L-DOPA，再由芳香族 L-胺基酸脫羧酶將 L-DOPA 轉為 dopamine。在 substantia nigra pars compacta 中，dopamine 隨後由 Vesicular Monoamine Transporter 2 包裝進突觸小泡。

label: Alternative Splicing
description: PTBP1 is a principal repressor of alternative pre-mRNA splicing: binding polypyrimidine-rich sequences near splice sites occludes U2AF65 recruitment, biases exon skipping, and looping the pre-mRNA can hide the splice site; its effects are position- and context-dependent.
description_zh_TW: PTBP1 是前驅 mRNA 選擇性剪接的主要抑制因子：結合剪接位點附近的聚嘧啶豐富序列會阻擋 U2AF65 的招募、偏向外顯子跳過，並可藉由環化前驅 mRNA 隱藏剪接位點；其效果依位置與脈絡而定。

label: Statins
description: Statins are pharmacological inhibitors of HMG-CoA reductase; lowering cholesterol through this target is their primary therapeutic action in cardiovascular disease. The same inhibition is exploited experimentally to sensitize cells and tumors to ferroptosis in combination with GPX4 inhibition.
description_zh_TW: Statins 是 HMG-CoA reductase 的藥理抑制劑；經由此標的降低膽固醇是它在心血管疾病中的主要治療作用。同一種抑制作用也被實驗性地用來與 GPX4 抑制劑併用，使細胞與腫瘤對 ferroptosis 更加敏感。

label: Uric Acid
description: Gout is an inflammatory arthritis driven by persistent hyperuricemia, which supersaturates urate and promotes crystallization of monosodium urate in joints, cartilage, and soft tissue. Hyperuricemia arises from increased purine turnover, overproduction via Xanthine Oxidase, or reduced renal excretion.
description_zh_TW: Gout 是由持續性高尿酸血症驅動的發炎性關節炎，尿酸過飽和促使 monosodium urate 在關節、軟骨與軟組織結晶。高尿酸血症來自 purine turnover 增加、經 Xanthine Oxidase 的生成過多，或腎臟排泄減少。

label: Atg5
description: Atg5 is essential for T Cell survival and proliferation. Atg5-deficient T cells are incapable of autophagy initiation, which abrogates the differentiation towards a regulatory Foxp3+ phenotype induced by Spermidine.
description_zh_TW: Atg5 對 T Cell 的存活與增殖不可或缺。缺乏 Atg5 的 T cell 無法起始自噬，因而阻斷 Spermidine 誘導的調控型 Foxp3+ 表現型分化。

label: NAD+ Salvage Pathway
description: The NAD+ Salvage Pathway produces NAD+ as the dominant biosynthetic route in most mammalian tissues. It recycles nicotinamide released by NAD+-consuming enzymes back into NAD+ in two steps: NAMPT generates NMN, then NMNAT converts NMN to NAD+, so salvage efficiency sets the co-substrate supply for sirtuins, PARPs and CD38.
description_zh_TW: NAD+ Salvage Pathway 產生 NAD+，是大多數哺乳動物組織中的主導生合成途徑。它以兩步把 NAD+ 消耗酵素所釋出的 nicotinamide 回收成 NAD+：先由 NAMPT 生成 NMN，再由 NMNAT 將 NMN 轉為 NAD+；因此 salvage 效率決定了 sirtuins、PARPs 與 CD38 的共同受質供應。

label: EX-527
description: EX-527 (selisistat) is an indole-derived, cell-permeable small molecule that blocks SIRT1 with high selectivity (IC50 ~0.098 μM versus ~20 μM for SIRT2 and ~50 μM for SIRT3). It occupies the nicotinamide-binding pocket as a nicotinamide analog, halting NAD+-dependent deacetylation and making it a standard probe of SIRT1 function.
description_zh_TW: EX-527（selisistat）是吲哚衍生、可穿透細胞的小分子化合物，能高度選擇性地抑制 SIRT1（IC50 約 0.098 μM，相較 SIRT2 約 20 μM、SIRT3 約 50 μM）。它以菸醯胺類似物身分占據菸醯胺結合位，阻斷 NAD+ 依賴性的去乙醯化，是研究 SIRT1 功能的標準工具。

label: APE1
description: APE1 (apurinic/apyrimidinic endonuclease 1) cleaves the DNA backbone 5' to abasic (AP) sites generated by spontaneous base loss or by DNA glycosylases such as OGG1, initiating base excision repair. It also removes 3'-blocking groups, making it a rate-limiting hub in the repair of oxidative DNA damage.
description_zh_TW: APE1（無嘌呤/無嘧啶核酸內切酶 1）在自發性鹼基缺失或 OGG1 等 DNA 糖苷酶所產生的無鹼基（AP）位點 5' 端切割 DNA 主鏈，啟動鹼基切除修復。它也移除 3' 阻斷基團，使其成為氧化性 DNA 損傷修復中的速率限制樞紐。

label: Toll-like Receptor
description: TLR9 (Toll-Like Receptor 9) is an endosomal Toll-like receptor that senses unmethylated CpG-rich DNA within the lumen of endosomes and lysosomes. Unlike the cytosolic DNA sensor cGAS, TLR9 is confined to the endolysosomal compartment, where it detects pathogen-derived DNA and, in some contexts, endogenous self-DNA delivered to these vesicles.
description_zh_TW: TLR9 (Toll-Like Receptor 9) 是一種內體型 Toll 樣受體，在內體與溶酶體腔內偵測未甲基化的 CpG 富含 DNA。與細胞質 DNA 感測器 cGAS 不同，TLR9 受限於內溶體區室，在該處辨識病原體來源的 DNA，並在某些情境下辨識被運送至此囊泡的內源性自體 DNA。

label: macroH2A
description: Senescence-associated heterochromatin foci contain macroH2A, along with HP1, H3K9me3, and HMGA proteins, which together form compacted chromatin domains in the nuclei of senescent cells. The accumulation of macroH2A in these foci promotes transcriptional silencing of proliferation-associated genes and helps stabilize the senescent state. Although not essential for growth arrest, the incorporation of macroH2A into SAHFs is a hallmark of senescence-associated chromatin reorganization. The enrichment of macroH2A distinguishes SAHFs from ordinary heterochromatin domains.
description_zh_TW: Senescence 相關的異染色質灶包含 macroH2A 以及 HP1、H3K9me3 和 HMGA 蛋白，它們一起在老化細胞的細胞核中形成壓縮的染色質結構域。 macroH2A 在這些病灶中的累積促進了增殖相關基因的轉錄沉默，並有助於穩定老化狀態。儘管 macroH2A 摻入 SAHF 對生長停滯不是必需的，但它是衰老相關染色質重組的標誌。 macroH2A 的富集將 SAHF 與普通異染色質結構域區分開來。

label: Immunosenescence
description: Immunosenescence impairs T-cell immunity, featuring perturbed memory responses, thymic involution, reduced naive T-cell generation, and accumulation of differentiated, often dysfunctional memory and effector subsets such as EMRA CD8+ T cells. This limits responses to infection and vaccination in the elderly and weakens T-cell-mediated immune surveillance, including the clearance of senescent and premalignant cells. The impairment is a hallmark of adaptive immune aging. It directly contributes to the decline in senescence surveillance with age.
description_zh_TW: 免疫衰老損害 T 細胞免疫，特徵為記憶反應紊亂、胸腺退化、初始 T 細胞生成減少，以及分化、常功能障礙的記憶與效應子集（如 EMRA CD8+ T 細胞）累積。這限制老年人對感染與疫苗的回應，並削弱 T 細胞介導的免疫監視，包括清除衰老與癌前細胞。此損害是適應性免疫老化的特徵，直接促成隨年齡的衰老監視下降。

label: TOM1
description: TOM1 acts as a negative regulator of innate immune signaling. TOM1 recruitment to ubiquitinated Toll-like Receptor 4 and IL-1 receptor complexes accelerates their clearance, damping pro-inflammatory NF-κB and cytokine output; TOM1 knockdown enhances TLR- and IL-1β-driven inflammation. By routing ubiquitinated receptors to lysosomes, TOM1 limits receptor half-life and keeps inflammatory signaling balanced.
description_zh_TW: TOM1 作為先天免疫訊號的負向調節因子。TOM1 被招募至泛素化的 Toll-like Receptor 4 與 IL-1 受體複合體後加速其清除，抑制促發炎的 NF-κB 與細胞激素輸出；TOM1 敲低會增強 TLR 與 IL-1β 驅動的發炎反應。藉由將泛素化受體運送至 lysosome，TOM1 限制受體半衰期，使發炎訊號維持平衡。

label: Lysosome Biogenesis
description: The CLEAR network is a master transcriptional program orchestrated by the MiT/TFE factors TFEB and TFE3, which bind CLEAR elements (GTCACGTGAC) in promoters of lysosomal hydrolases, v-ATPase and autophagic genes. CLEAR therefore drives Lysosome Biogenesis so that lysosomal capacity scales with autophagic demand; diminished TFEB/CLEAR activity with age contributes to lysosomal storage and aggregation disease.
description_zh_TW: CLEAR 網絡是由 MiT/TFE 因子（主要為 TFEB 與 TFE3）統籌的主控轉錄程式，這些因子結合於溶小體水解酵素、v-ATPase 與自噬基因啟動子上的 CLEAR 元素（GTCACGTGAC）。因此 CLEAR 驅動 Lysosome Biogenesis，使溶小體容量隨自噬需求擴張；隨年齡下降的 TFEB/CLEAR 活性則促成溶小體儲積與聚集疾病。

label: ADAM10
description: ADAM10 activity attenuates Amyloid Beta production by cleaving APP non-amyloidogenically; inhibiting or losing this α-secretase shifts APP toward BACE1 and increases plaque burden, which is why ADAM10 is framed as an anti-amyloid gatekeeper.
description_zh_TW: ADAM10 的活性透過非類澱粉樣方式切斷 APP 而降低 Amyloid Beta 生成；抑制或喪失此 α-secretase 會使 APP 轉向 BACE1 並增加斑塊負擔，因此 ADAM10 被視為抗類澱粉樣的關卡守門者。

label: cIAPs
description: Smac mimetics deplete cIAPs by forcing them into their own destruction. Bivalent compounds such as birinapant dimerize the cIAP RING domains, triggering K48 auto-ubiquitination and proteasomal self-destruction within minutes; monovalent compounds such as LCL161 and xevinapant/AT-406 act more gradually but reach the same endpoint, the loss of RIPK1 ubiquitination in TNFR1 complex I.
description_zh_TW: Smac mimetics 藉由迫使 cIAPs 自我毀滅而使其耗竭。雙價化合物如 birinapant 會使 cIAP 的 RING 結構域二聚化，在數分鐘內觸發 K48 自我泛素化與蛋白酶體自體毀滅；單價化合物如 LCL161 與 xevinapant/AT-406 作用較慢，但達到相同終點——TNFR1 complex I 中 RIPK1 泛素化的喪失。

label: DJ-1
description: Oxidative Stress and DJ-1 are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Oxidative Stress and DJ-1 may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Oxidative Stress 和 DJ-1 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Oxidative Stress 和 DJ-1 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Hypertension
description: Hypertension is the persistent elevation of arterial blood pressure (≥140/90 mmHg), affecting roughly 1.39 billion people and standing as a major risk factor for Cardiovascular Disease, Stroke, Chronic Kidney Disease and Heart Failure. It both causes and results from Endothelial Dysfunction, and chronic pressure overload drives cardiac remodeling toward heart failure.
description_zh_TW: Hypertension 是動脈血壓持續升高（≥140/90 mmHg）的狀態，影響約 13.9 億人，是 Cardiovascular Disease、Stroke、Chronic Kidney Disease 與 Heart Failure 的主要危險因子。它既是 Endothelial Dysfunction 的成因也是結果，長期壓力過載會驅動心臟重塑而走向心衰竭。

label: XIAP
description: Intrinsic Pathway is inhibited by XIAP. The intrinsic (mitochondrial) apoptotic pathway is initiated by intracellular damage and is gated at the outer mitochondrial membrane by the Bcl-2 family. XIAP is the most potent mammalian IAP, directly inhibiting caspases-9, -3, and -7 and stabilized by survival kinases. The directionality runs from XIAP toward Intrinsic Pathway, so XIAP is the active agent and Intrinsic Pathway the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
description_zh_TW: Intrinsic Pathway 被XIAP 抑制。內在（粒線體）凋亡途徑由細胞內損傷啟動，並由 Bcl-2 family 在粒線體外膜上進行門控。 XIAP 是最有效的哺乳動物 IAP，直接抑制 caspase-9、-3 和 -7，並透過生存激酶穩定。方向性從 XIAP 朝向 Intrinsic Pathway，因此 XIAP 是活性劑，Intrinsic Pathway 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: c-Myc
description: The Yamanaka factors are the four transcription factors used to reprogram somatic cells into induced pluripotent stem cells, and they include the oncogene c-Myc. c-Myc opens chromatin by binding methylated regions and promotes the proliferation and metabolic changes that accompany reprogramming initiation. However, c-Myc is a potent oncogene that increases the risk of tumorigenesis in iPSC-derived cells, motivating efforts to exclude or replace it with safer alternatives. Its dual role as reprogramming enhancer and oncogene highlights the safety concerns of iPSC therapy.
description_zh_TW: 山中因子是用於將體細胞重編程為誘導多能幹細胞的四種轉錄因子，其中包括癌基因 c-Myc。 c-Myc 透過結合甲基化區域打開染色質，並促進伴隨重編程啟動的增殖和代謝變化。然而，c-Myc 是一種強效致癌基因，會增加 iPSC 衍生細胞發生腫瘤的風險，促使人們努力排除它或用更安全的替代品取代它。它作為重編程增強子和癌基因的雙重作用凸顯了 iPSC 治療的安全性問題。

label: Cathepsin D
description: Lysosomal proteases are responsible for degrading glycated proteins intracellularly. Cathepsin D, an aspartic protease, and Cathepsin B, a cysteine protease, are major enzymes that break down AGE-modified proteins after they are directed to lysosomes for degradation. A decrease in Cathepsin D expression or activity, which occurs during aging and UV exposure, directly correlates with the accumulation of AGEs such as N-epsilon-carboxymethyl-lysine (CML). Cathepsin-dependent lysosomal degradation therefore represents the third line of defense against AGE accumulation, removing established glycated proteins that prevention and repair enzymes cannot handle.
description_zh_TW: 溶酶體蛋白酶負責在細胞內降解糖化蛋白。組織蛋白酶 D（Cathepsin D，一種天冬胺酸蛋白酶）與組織蛋白酶 B（Cathepsin B，一種半胱氨酸蛋白酶）是將 AGE 修飾蛋白在導向溶酶體降解後分解的主要酵素。組織蛋白酶 D 表現或活性在老化與紫外線暴露期間下降，直接與 N-epsilon-carboxymethyl-lysine（CML）等 AGE 的堆積相關。因此，依賴組織蛋白酶的溶酶體降解代表對抗 AGE 堆積的第三道防線，移除預防與修復酵素無法處理的已建立糖化蛋白。

label: DDX3X
description: DDX3X activates Wnt signaling by promoting the nuclear accumulation of beta-catenin. Because nuclear beta-catenin is the transcriptional effector of the canonical Wnt pathway, DDX3X sits upstream of beta-catenin-dependent transcription, linking an RNA helicase to proliferative and developmental gene programs.
description_zh_TW: DDX3X 藉由促進 beta-catenin 在細胞核內累積而活化 Wnt 訊號。由於核內的 beta-catenin 是典型 Wnt 路徑的轉錄效應因子，DDX3X 位於 beta-catenin 依賴性轉錄的上游，將一個 RNA helicase 與增殖及發育相關的基因程式連結起來。

label: HLA Haplobank
description: A haplobank curates HLA-homozygous induced pluripotent stem cell master lines.
description_zh_TW: 單倍庫策展 HLA 純合誘導多能幹細胞主系。

label: P300
description: Transactivation domains recruit P300/CBP coactivator complexes, documented for p53-P300. Recruitment couples TFs to acetylation machinery.
description_zh_TW: 轉活化結構域招募 P300/CBP 協同活化複合體，p53-P300 已記載。招募將轉錄因子耦合到乙醯化機器。

label: CD8+ T Cell
description: CD8+ T Cells (cytotoxic T lymphocytes) are a subset of T cells that play a critical role in the Adaptive Immune Response by killing infected or cancerous cells.
description_zh_TW: CD8+ T Cell（細胞毒性 T 淋巴球）是 T Cell 的一個次群，藉由殺死受感染或癌化的細胞，在 Adaptive Immune Response 中扮演關鍵角色。

label: Mectizan
description: Established in 1987, the Mectizan Donation Program manages Merck & Co. Inc's donation of Mectizan (brand-name ivermectin) free of charge, handling logistics, distribution and pharmacovigilance with endemic-country ministries of health, the World Health Organization and non-governmental partners. It became the template for large-scale philanthropic drug donation and a cornerstone of neglected-tropical-disease elimination.
description_zh_TW: Mectizan Donation Program 成立於 1987 年，負責管理 Merck & Co. Inc 免費捐贈的 Mectizan（ivermectin 的商品名），並與流行國衛生部門、World Health Organization 及非政府夥伴共同處理後勤、分發與藥物警戒。它成為大規模慈善藥品捐贈的典範，也是 neglected tropical disease 根除計畫的基石。

label: mitoTAD
description: mitoTAD operates on the mitochondrial import translocons themselves: when a mitochondrial precursor protein stalls during passage through the TOM/TIM complexes, mitoTAD mediates its extraction from the channel and subsequent proteasomal degradation, clearing the gate so that import can resume. It therefore acts constitutively, whereas the broader mitoCPR is a stress-inducible response.
description_zh_TW: mitoTAD 作用的對象正是粒線體輸入轉位子本身：當粒線體前驅蛋白在通過 TOM/TIM 複合體時卡滯，mitoTAD 媒介其自通道抽出與隨後的蛋白酶體降解，清理通道使輸入得以恢復。因此它是構成性作用，而較廣義的 mitoCPR 則是壓力誘發的反應。

label: Acrolein
description: Acrolein (CH2=CH-CHO, 2-propenal) is the simplest alpha,beta-unsaturated aldehyde and one of the most electrophilic products of Lipid Peroxidation. It arises from beta-scission of PUFA hydroperoxides, notably omega-3 species such as Docosahexaenoic acid, whose chain length and double-bond placement favor release of a three-carbon fragment. Because its vinyl group flanks a carbonyl, it is a potent Michael acceptor that modifies protein cysteine, histidine and lysine residues and forms DNA adducts at concentrations well below those required for Malondialdehyde or 4-Hydroxynonenal.
description_zh_TW: Acrolein（CH2=CH-CHO，2-propenal）是最簡單的 α,β-不飽和醛，也是 Lipid Peroxidation 最具親電性的產物之一。它來自 PUFA 過氧化物的 β-scission，尤其是 Docosahexaenoic acid 等 omega-3 脂肪酸，其鏈長與雙鍵位置有利於釋出三碳片段。由於其乙烯基緊鄰羰基，它是強效的 Michael 受體，可在遠低於 Malondialdehyde 或 4-Hydroxynonenal 所需的濃度下修飾蛋白質的 cysteine、histidine 與 lysine 殘基並形成 DNA 加合物。

label: Cytosol
description: Stress granules are membrane-less organelles that assemble within the cytosol. The cytosol is a crowded, structured medium rather than a static fluid, and liquid-liquid phase separation in it drives the formation of stress granules and processing bodies that sequester untranslated mRNAs during stress.
description_zh_TW: Stress granules 是在 cytosol 中組裝形成的無膜胞器。Cytosol 並非靜態流體，而是擁擠且具結構的介質，其中的 liquid-liquid phase separation 驅動 stress granules 與 processing bodies 的形成，在壓力下隔離未轉譯的 mRNA。

label: SLC6A8
description: The creatine transporter gene SLC6A8 is markedly upregulated in tumor-infiltrating immune cells, and creatine uptake through it is required for effective CD8 T cell antitumor function (Di Biase et al., 2019). This links the creatine transport system to cancer immunotherapy.
description_zh_TW: creatine transporter 基因 SLC6A8 在腫瘤浸潤免疫細胞中顯著上调，透過它攝取 creatine 對 CD8 T cells 有效的抗腫瘤功能是必要的（Di Biase et al., 2019）。這將 creatine 運輸系統與癌症免疫治療連結起來。

label: Eryptosis
description: Eryptosis is triggered by convergence on cytosolic calcium elevation from oxidative stress, osmotic shock, energy depletion that impairs calcium extrusion, and ceramide accumulation. Calcium then activates calpain proteases and phospholipid scramblases while inhibiting flippases, externalizing phosphatidylserine as the Annexin V-positive eat-me signal, with cell shrinkage and membrane blebbing.
description_zh_TW: Eryptosis 的誘發因子包括 oxidative stress、滲透壓衝擊、耗損 ATP 導致鈣外排能力下降，以及 Ceramide 累積，它們都匯聚於細胞質鈣離子上升。鈣離子接著活化 calpain 蛋白酶與 phospholipid scramblase 並抑制 flipase，將 phosphatidylserine 外翻形成 Annexin V 陽性的 eat-me 訊號，並伴隨細胞縮小與膜起泡。

label: Retinoic Acid
description: Retinoic Acid is the active metabolite of Vitamin A and a potent inducer of cellular differentiation. In embryonic stem cell research it is applied to monolayer cultures without LIF to drive mesenchymal differentiation and test the silencing of pluripotency.
description_zh_TW: Retinoic Acid 是 Vitamin A 的活性代謝物，也是強效的細胞分化誘導劑。在胚胎幹細胞研究中，它在不含 LIF 的單層培養中被施加以驅動間質分化並檢測多能性的沉默。

label: Glutaredoxin
description: Glutaredoxin donates electrons to ribonucleotide reductase (RNR), providing a glutathione-routed backup to thioredoxin for de novo dNTP synthesis. Glutaredoxin was discovered through its ability to reduce RNR, and both systems can sustain ribonucleotide reduction.
description_zh_TW: Glutaredoxin 提供電子給核醣核苷酸還原酶（RNR），為 de novo dNTP 合成提供一條經由麩胱甘肽路線、與硫氧還蛋白並行的備援途徑。Glutaredoxin 正是因其還原 RNR 的能力而被發現，兩者皆能維持核醣核苷酸還原作用。

label: Lamin B1
description: Downregulation of the nuclear lamina protein Lamin B1 is one of the most conserved, cell-autonomous markers of Senescence, holding across replicative, oncogene-induced and therapy-induced senescence in human and mouse cells. Because the loss is cell-autonomous, LMNB1 negativity is used to quantify senescent-cell burden in vivo.
description_zh_TW: 核纖層蛋白 Lamin B1 的下調是最保守且細胞自主的 Senescence 標誌之一，在複製性、致癌基因誘導與治療誘導的衰老中皆成立，且適用於人與小鼠細胞。由於這種流失是細胞自主的，LMNB1 陰性可用於在體內量化衰老細胞負荷。

label: Type I Interferon
description: Interferon-stimulated genes are the aggregated transcriptional output of type I interferon signaling: IFN-I binding IFNAR1 activates JAK-STAT pathways that induce hundreds of ISGs whose products establish an antiviral and inflammatory cellular state.
description_zh_TW: 干擾素刺激基因是第一型干擾素訊息傳遞的聚合轉錄輸出：IFN-I 結合 IFNAR1 後活化 JAK-STAT 途徑，誘導數百個 ISG，其蛋白產物建立抗病毒與發炎性的細胞狀態。

label: Fibroblast
description: TGF-β signalling through SMAD2/3 drives fibroblast-to-myofibroblast differentiation and extracellular matrix deposition. Activated myofibroblasts are contractile, α-smooth-muscle-actin-positive cells that close wounds but, when persistently activated, drive fibrosis — which is why fibroblast-targeted therapies such as TGF-β or lysyl oxidase inhibition aim to limit pathological scarring.
description_zh_TW: TGF-β 經由 SMAD2/3 的訊號傳遞驅動 fibroblast 向 myofibroblast 分化與 extracellular matrix 沉積。被活化的 myofibroblast 是具收縮性、α-smooth-muscle-actin 陽性的細胞，可閉合傷口，但持續活化時會驅動 fibrosis——因此針對 fibroblast 的治療（如抑制 TGF-β 或 lysyl oxidase）旨在限制病理性瘢痕。

label: Endocytic Lysosome Reformation
description: Endocytic Lysosome Reformation (ELR) is an ATP-dependent pathway that rebuilds Lysosome from endolysosomes after endocytic cargo has been degraded. It is distinct from Autophagic Lysosome Reformation, which regenerates lysosomes from autolysosomes after autophagic turnover.
description_zh_TW: Endocytic Lysosome Reformation (ELR) 是一條 ATP 依賴途徑，在內吞負載物被分解後由 endolysosome 重建 Lysosome。它與 Autophagic Lysosome Reformation 不同，後者是在自噬周轉之後由 autolysosome 再生 lysosome。

label: Lysosomal Acid Lipase
source_file: _document_ - MXL-3 and HLH-30 transcriptionally link lipolysis and autophagy to nutrient availability.md
description: Lysosomal acid lipase hydrolyzes cholesteryl esters and triglycerides delivered via lipophagy. Mediation is the enzymatic execution.
description_zh_TW: 溶酶體酸性脂肪酶水解經由脂噬遞送的膽固醇酯與甘油三酯。媒介是酶促執行。

label: MDA-LDL
description: MDA-LDL is one of the two major immunologically defined forms of oxidatively modified LDL, the other being Oxidized LDL, but it is the narrower entity. Oxidized LDL denotes the full spectrum of oxidatively modified particles - lipid peroxides, oxidized phospholipids, fragmented apoB - detected by antibodies against oxidized phospholipid epitopes such as E06, whereas MDA-LDL reports only the aldehyde-adducted fraction. The two correlate but are not interchangeable, and their relative abundance shifts with the type of oxidative insult.
description_zh_TW: MDA-LDL 是氧化修飾 LDL 的兩大免疫學定義形式之一，另一者是 Oxidized LDL，但 MDA-LDL 範圍更窄。Oxidized LDL 指的是所有氧化修飾顆粒的完整光譜——脂質過氧化物、氧化磷脂、碎裂的 apoB——以針對氧化磷脂表位（如 E06）的抗體偵測；MDA-LDL 則僅回報醛類加合的部分。兩者相關但不可互換，且其相對比例會隨氧化傷害的類型而改變。

label: MFN1
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Mitochondrial fusion is orchestrated by three main dynamin-related GTPases: mitofusin 1 (MFN1), mitofusin 2 (MFN2) and OPA1. MFN1 and MFN2 are outer mitochondrial membrane transmembrane GTPases required for outer membrane fusion, while OPA1 mostly mediates inner membrane fusion. When MFN1 binds and hydrolyzes GTP, conformational changes in its GTPase domains lead to oligomerization, promoting clustering of the two opposing outer membranes and subsequent fusion. MFN1 and MFN2 are highly homologous with redundant functions; low MFN1 expression can be compensated by MFN2, and knockout of either in mice leads to embryonic lethality.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體融合由三個主要的 dynamin 相關 GTP 酶協調：mitofusin 1（MFN1）、mitofusin 2（MFN2）和 OPA1。MFN1 和 MFN2 是位於粒線體外膜的跨膜 GTP 酶，是外膜融合所必需的，而 OPA1 主要介導內膜融合。當 MFN1 結合和水解 GTP 時，其 GTP 酶結構域的構象變化導致寡聚化，促進兩個對向外膜的聚集及後續融合。MFN1 和 MFN2 具有高度同源性和功能冗餘；低 MFN1 表達可由 MFN2 補償，而小鼠中任一基因的敲除會導致胚胎致死。

label: T Cell
description: CD8+ T Cells (cytotoxic T lymphocytes) are a subset of T cells that play a critical role in the Adaptive Immune Response by killing infected or cancerous cells.
description_zh_TW: CD8+ T Cell（細胞毒性 T 淋巴球）是 T Cell 的一個次群，藉由殺死受感染或癌化的細胞，在 Adaptive Immune Response 中扮演關鍵角色。

label: Substantia Nigra
description: The striatum receives dopamine from the substantia nigra pars compacta via the nigrostriatal pathway, the loss of which characterizes Parkinson's disease. This dopaminergic input is terminated mainly by DAT reuptake and shaped by COMT, especially in lower-DAT compartments, and is essential for normal striatal and motor function. The integrity of this projection is required for coordinated movement and reward processing. Its degeneration produces the cardinal motor symptoms of Parkinson's disease.
description_zh_TW: 紋狀體透過黑質紋狀體途徑從黑質緻密部接收多巴胺，多巴胺的喪失是帕金森氏症的特徵。這種多巴胺能輸入主要由 DAT 再攝取終止，並由 COMT 塑造，特別是在低 DAT 區室中，對於正常紋狀體和運動功能至關重要。協調 movement 和 reward 處理需要此投影的完整性。它的退化產生了帕金森氏症的主要運動症狀。

label: p62
description: p62 (SQSTM1) also directly degrades p21, the second CDK inhibitor cleared in Myxomatous Mitral Valve Disease. Because both p16 and p21 impose the senescence arrest, their combined p62-mediated removal explains how restoring Autophagy flux can reverse the senescent phenotype in aVICs.
description_zh_TW: p62 (SQSTM1) 也直接降解 p21，即在 Myxomatous Mitral Valve Disease 中被清除的第二個 CDK 抑制因子。由於 p16 與 p21 共同造成 senescence 停滯，兩者經 p62 媒介的清除，便解釋了恢復 Autophagy flux 為何能逆轉 aVIC 的 senescent 表型。

label: ATF4
description: Phosphorylation of eIF2α at Ser51 attenuates global cap-dependent translation while paradoxically promoting translation of selected stress-responsive mRNAs such as ATF4. Phosphorylated eIF2α sequesters the guanine nucleotide exchange factor eIF2B, preventing eIF2 complex recycling; ATF4 then drives transcription of adaptive genes.
description_zh_TW: eIF2α 在 Ser51 的磷酸化會抑制整體帽依賴性轉譯，卻反而促進 ATF4 等選擇性壓力反應 mRNA 的轉譯。磷酸化的 eIF2α 隔離鳥嘌呤核苷酸交換因子 eIF2B，阻斷 eIF2 複合體的再循環；ATF4 隨後驅動適應性基因的轉錄。

label: CDC20
description: APC/C bound to CDC20 drives the metaphase-to-anaphase transition with defined specificity.
description_zh_TW: 與 CDC20 結合的 APC/C 以既定特異性驅動中期到後期轉換。

label: Mass Spectrometry
description: The Metabolome — the complete set of small-molecule chemicals present in a sample, cell, or organism at a given moment — is profiled by untargeted or targeted metabolomics using Mass Spectrometry and nuclear magnetic resonance. The resulting fingerprints are highly dynamic, shifting over seconds to hours with feeding, exercise, circadian rhythm, and stress, and serve as sensitive Biomarkers of physiological state and disease risk.
description_zh_TW: Metabolome——在特定時刻存在於樣本、細胞或生物體中的全部小分子化學物集合——是透過以 Mass Spectrometry 與核磁共振進行的非標定或標定式代謝組學來描繪的。所得的指紋變動極快，會隨進食、運動、晝夜節律與壓力在數秒至數小時間尺度上改變，並可作為生理狀態與疾病風險的敏感 Biomarkers。

label: Entacapone
description: Entacapone belongs to the COMT inhibitor drug class, alongside tolcapone and opicapone. Its clinical role is as an adjunct to levodopa/carbidopa therapy in Parkinson's disease, where prolonging levodopa half-life reduces off time.
description_zh_TW: Entacapone 屬於 COMT 抑制劑這一藥物類別，與 tolcapone、opicapone 同類。其臨床角色是作為 Parkinson's disease 中 levodopa/carbidopa 治療的輔助用藥，藉由延長 levodopa 半衰期減少 off time。

label: Mitochondrial Respiration
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: The Mitochondrial Electron Transport Chain (Complexes I–IV) receives electrons from NADH and FADH2 generated by the TCA cycle; the resulting proton pumping builds the gradient whose dissipation through ATP Synthase defines Mitochondrial Respiration.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial Electron Transport Chain（Complexes I–IV）接受 TCA cycle 產生的 NADH 與 FADH2 的電子；由此驅動的質子泵送建立梯度，其經 ATP Synthase 的消散即定義了 Mitochondrial Respiration。

label: Endothelial Cells
description: EndoMT is the transdifferentiation of endothelial cells, which lose their characteristic endothelial markers and acquire mesenchymal, contractile and matrix-producing properties. It is a key mechanism in cardiovascular pathology, vascular ageing and fibrosis.
description_zh_TW: EndoMT 是內皮細胞的轉分化：其失去特有的內皮標記並獲得間質性、收縮性與基質生成特性。它是心血管病理、血管老化與纖維化中的關鍵機制。

label: Atg16L1
description: The T300A variant of Atg16L1 is a risk factor for Crohn's Disease, linking impaired Atg12-Atg5-Atg16L1-dependent LC3 lipidation to intestinal inflammatory disease.
description_zh_TW: Atg16L1 的 T300A 變異是 Crohn's Disease 的風險因子，將 Atg12-Atg5-Atg16L1 依賴的 LC3 脂化受損與腸道發炎性疾病連結起來。

label: RGD peptide
description: RGD peptide is the minimal, most widespread cell-adhesion motif recognized by a subset of Integrins (alpha-v-beta-3, alpha-v-beta-5, alpha-5-beta-1). It adopts a loop conformation that fits the integrin ligand-binding pocket, mediating cell-ECM adhesion, cytoskeletal organization, survival and migration.
description_zh_TW: RGD peptide 是被部分 Integrins（αvβ3、αvβ5、α5β1）辨識的最小且最普遍的細胞黏附基序。它採取能嵌入 integrin 配體結合口袋的環狀構形，介導細胞－細胞外基質黏附、細胞骨架組織、存活與移行。

label: Hematopoiesis
description: All blood cell lineages are generated by hematopoiesis, a lifelong process carried out in the bone marrow by hematopoietic stem cells that self-renew and differentiate along myeloid and lymphoid paths under transcription factors, cytokines, and epigenetic control, plus metabolic tuning by mTOR and AMPK nutrient sensing. Hematopoiesis thereby sustains oxygen carriage, immunity, and hemostasis.
description_zh_TW: 所有血球譜系都由 hematopoiesis 產生；這是一生持續進行、發生於骨髓的過程，由能自我更新並在轉錄因子、細胞激素與表觀遺傳調控下分化成髓系與淋巴系路徑的造血幹細胞執行，並受到 mTOR 與 AMPK 營養感知的代謝調節。Hematopoiesis 藉此維持氧氣運送、免疫與止血功能。

label: Saccharomyces cerevisiae
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Budding yeast is a premier eukaryotic model organism.
description_zh_TW: 芽殖酵母是首屈一指的真核模式生物。

label: N-(carboxymethyl)-lysine
description: N-(carboxymethyl)-lysine (CML) is a well-characterized and abundant member of the Advanced Glycation End Products (AGEs) class, formed by oxidative degradation of Amadori products or by reaction of glyoxal with lysine residues.
description_zh_TW: N-(carboxymethyl)-lysine（CML）是被充分刻畫且含量豐富的晚期糖基化終產物（AGEs）類成員，由 Amadori 產物的氧化降解或乙二醛與離胺酸殘基反應而形成。

label: Respiratory Chain Complex I
description: Respiratory Chain Complex I (NADH:ubiquinone oxidoreductase) is the first and largest enzyme of the mitochondrial Electron Transport Chain, an L-shaped ~45-subunit assembly embedded in the inner mitochondrial membrane that oxidizes NADH at an FMN site and passes electrons through iron–sulfur clusters to reduce ubiquinone.
description_zh_TW: Respiratory Chain Complex I（NADH:ubiquinone oxidoreductase）是粒線體 Electron Transport Chain 中第一個也是最大的酵素，為嵌於內膜、約 45 次單元的 L 型組裝體，於 FMN 位點氧化 NADH，並經由鐵硫簇傳遞電子以還原 ubiquinone。

label: Zellweger Spectrum Disorders
description: Mutations in PEX13 cause PEX13-deficient Zellweger Spectrum Disorder, roughly 2-5% of cases; missense variants in the SH3-like domain partially impair PEX14 interaction and yield milder phenotypes, while truncating mutations abolish import and cause lethal disease.
description_zh_TW: PEX13 突變會造成 PEX13 缺乏型 Zellweger 光譜症候群，約佔所有病例的 2–5%；SH3 樣結構域的錯義變異會部分損害與 PEX14 的交互作用而表型較輕，截短突變則完全消除輸入功能並造成致死性疾病。

label: Cholesterol Efflux
description: Cholesterol Efflux is the first and rate-limiting step of Reverse Cholesterol Transport: cells, especially Macrophages, export excess free Cholesterol to extracellular lipid acceptors such as Apolipoprotein A1 and HDL. Because the process is the rate-limiting gateway of the whole reverse transport cascade, its impairment promotes foam cell formation and Atherosclerosis.
description_zh_TW: Cholesterol Efflux 是 Reverse Cholesterol Transport 的第一步且為速率限制步驟：細胞（尤其是 Macrophages）將過量的游離 Cholesterol 輸出至細胞外脂質受體，例如 Apolipoprotein A1 與 HDL。由於此步驟是整個逆向運輸級聯反應的速率限制關口，其功能受損會促進泡沫細胞形成與 Atherosclerosis。

label: Mitochondrial Permeability Transition
