description: MPT is an independent regulated-necrosis program: cyclophilin D-dependent opening of the permeability transition pore; cyclophilin D-deficient mice are partially protected from organ ischemia-reperfusion injury.
description_zh_TW: MPT 是獨立的 regulated necrosis 程序：由 Cyclophilin D 依賴性之通透性轉換孔開啟所介導；Cyclophilin D 缺失小鼠在器官缺血–再灌注損傷中獲得部分保護。

label: 3-deoxyglucosone
description: 3-deoxyglucosone is a highly reactive dicarbonyl (α-oxaldehyde) intermediate generated endogenously by non-enzymatic sugar degradation and lipid peroxidation. It reacts with amino groups to form advanced glycation end products, making it a potent glycation precursor.
description_zh_TW: 3-deoxyglucosone 是高度反應性的二羰基（α-oxaldehyde）中間體，由非酵素性糖降解與 Lipid Peroxidation 內源性生成。它與胺基反應形成 Advanced Glycation End Products，因此是強效的 glycation 前驅物。

label: SAM
description: SAM is the universal methyl donor for DNMT1-mediated 5mC synthesis. Classification defines its metabolic role.
description_zh_TW: SAM 是 DNMT1 介導 5mC 合成的通用甲基供體。歸類定義其代謝角色。

label: Integrated Stress Response
description: A major advance in mitohormesis research was the discovery that diverse mitochondrial stressors activate the ISR. The pathway is initiated when mitochondrial stress activates the OMA1 protease, which cleaves DELE1 to generate a cytosolic fragment (DELE1-S) that binds and activates HRI, one of the four eIF2alpha kinases. HRI then phosphorylates the translation initiation factor eIF2alpha, reducing global protein synthesis while allowing preferential translation of ATF4. This mitochondrial-ISR connection establishes a defined signaling axis by which mild mitochondrial dysfunction produces a protective transcriptional and metabolic response characteristic of mitohormesis.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體促效應研究的一個重大進展是發現多種粒線體壓力源會活化整合壓力反應（ISR）。該途徑在粒線體壓力活化 OMA1 蛋白酶時啟動，OMA1 切割 DELE1 產生細胞質片段（DELE1-S），後者結合並活化 HRI（四個 eIF2alpha 激酶之一）。HRI 隨後磷酸化翻譯起始因子 eIF2alpha，減少整體蛋白質合成，同時允許 ATF4 的優先翻譯。這種粒線體-ISR 連結建立了一個明確的訊號軸，透過該軸，輕度粒線體功能障礙產生具有粒線體促效應特徵的保護性轉錄和代謝反應。

label: docetaxel
description: Docetaxel is a backbone TNBC regimen with melittin-combo data.
description_zh_TW: docetaxel 是 TNBC 主幹方案，具 melittin 合併數據。

label: RIG-I
description: RIG-I (DDX58) is a cytosolic DExH-box RNA helicase pattern-recognition receptor that detects short double-stranded RNA with a 5'-triphosphate or 5'-diphosphate end. Ligand binding plus K63-linked polyubiquitination releases its N-terminal CARDs, which nucleate filaments that drive MAVS (IPS-1) oligomerisation on the mitochondrial outer membrane, MAMs and peroxisomes, converting RIG-I recognition into downstream signalling.
description_zh_TW: RIG-I (DDX58) 是細胞質的 DExH-box RNA 解旋酶型模式辨識受體，可偵測帶 5′-三磷酸或 5′-二磷酸末端 的短雙股 RNA。配體結合加上 K63 連結的泛素化會釋出其 N 端 CARD，CARD 核化成絲狀體並驅動 MAVS (IPS-1) 在粒線體外膜、MAM 與過氧化體上聚集，將 RIG-I 的辨識轉為下游訊息傳遞。

label: Cell Proliferation
description: mTORC2 is the downstream readout of the rapamycin model since it drives cell cycle progression and survival via AKT, and also regulates mitochondrial physiology, metabolism and integrity. mTORC2 activity has been shown to increase with age, and its elimination has been shown to alleviate aging progression. In the simulations, the typical dose-response curve shows a clear decrease in mTORC2 activity at intermediate rapamycin concentrations, followed by reduced sensitivity at higher doses, while short-term rapamycin exposure increases mTORC2 activity and long-term exposure obstructs its assembly.
description_zh_TW: mTORC2是雷帕霉素模型的下游讀出，因為它透過AKT驅動細胞週期進展和存活，同時也調節粒線體生理、代謝和完整性。mTORC2活性已被證明隨年齡增長而增加，且其消除可減緩衰老進展。在模擬中，典型的劑量反應曲線顯示在中等雷帕霉素濃度下mTORC2活性明顯降低，隨後在更高劑量下敏感性降低，而短期雷帕霉素暴露增加mTORC2活性，長期暴露則阻碍其組裝。

label: Superoxide Dismutase
description: Superoxide Dismutase catalyses the dismutation of the superoxide radical (O2•−) into ordinary molecular oxygen (O2) and Hydrogen Peroxide (H2O2). As a core enzymatic component of the antioxidant defence system, it protects cells from ROS-induced damage by clearing superoxide before it can oxidise other substrates.
description_zh_TW: Superoxide Dismutase 催化 superoxide radical（O2•−）的歧化反應，生成一般分子氧（O2）與 Hydrogen Peroxide（H2O2）。作為抗氧化防禦系統的核心酵素組分，它在 superoxide 能氧化其他受質之前將其清除，藉此保護細胞免受 ROS 造成的損傷。

label: KDM4
description: Genetic or pharmacological inhibition of KDM4 lowers IL-6, IL-8 and MMP secretion without necessarily abolishing growth arrest, marking KDM4 as a senomorphic target; loss of H3K9me3 at SASP loci reduces linker-histone compaction and permits NF-κB and BRD4 access.
description_zh_TW: 對 KDM4 的遺傳或藥理學抑制可降低 IL-6、IL-8 與 MMP 的分泌而不必然廢除生長停滯，使 KDM4 成為 senomorphic 標的；SASP 位點上 H3K9me3 的流失減少連接組蛋白介導的壓縮，讓 NF-κB 與 BRD4 能接觸染色質。

label: FasL
description: FasL binding to Fas recruits FADD and Caspase-8 to the DISC, triggering Caspase-8 auto-activation; active Caspase-8 then cleaves executioner caspases (Caspase-3, Caspase-7) or Bid for mitochondrial amplification. FasL is thus a primary initiator of the extrinsic apoptotic pathway and, with TRAIL, one of the two best-characterized death ligands.
description_zh_TW: FasL 與 Fas 結合會將 FADD 與 Caspase-8 招募至 DISC，觸發 Caspase-8 自我活化；活化的 Caspase-8 接著切割執行者 caspase（Caspase-3、Caspase-7）或 Bid 以進行粒線體放大。因此 FasL 是外在性凋亡路徑的主要起始者，並與 TRAIL 並列為兩個最深入的死亡配體。

label: XIST
source_file: _document_ - Epigenetic changes during aging and their reprogramming potential.md
description: XIST is a long non-coding RNA coating the inactive X chromosome.
description_zh_TW: XIST 是包被不活化 X 染色體的長非編碼 RNA。

label: Curcumin
description: Curcumin modulates inflammatory pathways by inhibiting NF-kB signaling. Because turmeric contains only about 3% curcumin with low bioavailability, its in vivo efficacy often requires high doses or formulation strategies such as co-administration with piperine from black pepper.
description_zh_TW: Curcumin 透過抑制 NF-kB 訊號調控發炎路徑。由於薑黃僅含約 3% 的 Curcumin 且生物可利用率低，其在體內的功效常需高劑量或配方策略，例如與黑胡椒中的 piperine 併用。

label: Knockout mouse
description: C57BL/6 ("B6") is the dominant inbred background for engineered mouse lines: because background strongly influences phenotype, most engineered alleles are backcrossed onto this strain to control confounders, and its >20 generations of brother-sister mating give high reproducibility.
description_zh_TW: C57BL/6（「B6」）是基因改造小鼠品系最主要的近交背景：由於背景品系會強烈影響表型，多數改造等位基因都會回交到本品系以控制混雜因子；其超過 20 代的兄弟姊妹交配也帶來高度可重複性。

label: TCA cycle
description: Glutaminolysis feeds the TCA cycle with anaplerotic carbon at the alpha-ketoglutarate node. It is the dominant anaplerotic route in rapidly proliferating cancer cells, and blocking it together with Complex I collapses the glutamine-fueled cycle in MYC-high breast cancer cells.
description_zh_TW: Glutaminolysis 在 alpha-ketoglutarate 節點以 anaplerotic 碳供應 TCA cycle。在快速增殖的癌細胞中它是主要的 anaplerotic 途徑；在 MYC-high 乳癌細胞中，與 Complex I 一起阻斷即可瓦解 glutamine 驅動的 cycle。

label: Redox Homeostasis
description: SIRT3 buffers mitochondrial ROS by deacetylating MnSOD and IDH2, letting SIRT3-rich tumor-associated macrophages tolerate the oxidative metabolism that supports their M2 program. This ties mitochondrial sirtuin redox control directly to immune polarization and to the redox homeostasis of the Tumor Microenvironment.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 藉由去乙醯化 MnSOD 與 IDH2 緩衝粒線體 ROS，使 SIRT3 豐富的 Tumor-Associated Macrophage 能耐受支持其 M2 程序的氧化代謝。這將粒線體 sirtuin 的氧化還原調控直接連結到免疫極化，以及 Tumor Microenvironment 的 Redox Homeostasis。

label: Fructosamine
description: Fructosamine-3-kinase (FN3K) is an intracellular enzyme that initiates protein deglycation by phosphorylating fructosamine, the Amadori residues on glycated proteins, converting them into fructosamine-3-phosphate. This phosphorylated compound is highly unstable and spontaneously decomposes, regenerating the original, undamaged amino acid and releasing 3-deoxyglucosone, which is then neutralized by detoxifying enzymes. By repairing early glycation intermediates before they progress to irreversible AGEs, FN3K provides the repair arm of the enzymatic defense against AGE accumulation, complementary to prevention by dicarbonyl detoxification.
description_zh_TW: 果糖胺-3-激酶（Fructosamine-3-kinase, FN3K）是一種細胞內酵素，透過磷酸化果糖胺（即糖化蛋白上的阿馬多里殘基）來啟動蛋白質去糖化，將其轉化為果糖胺-3-磷酸（fructosamine-3-phosphate）。此磷酸化化合物高度不穩定並自發分解，再生原始的未受損胺基酸並釋出 3-deoxyglucosone，隨後被解毒酵素中和。透過在不可逆 AGE 形成之前修復早期糖化中間產物，FN3K 提供了對抗 AGE 堆積之酵素防禦的修復臂，補充二羰基解毒的預防作用。

label: DELE1
description: DELE1 couples detection of mitochondrial dysfunction at the inner membrane to activation of the cytosolic integrated stress response. Depending on the intensity and duration of stress, the outcome of this OMA1-DELE1-HRI signaling ranges from adaptive recovery to induction of apoptosis, and the pathway is implicated in neurodegeneration, cardiomyopathy and metabolic disease.
description_zh_TW: DELE1 將內膜對粒線體功能失調的偵測與細胞質 integrated stress response 的活化耦合起來。此 OMA1-DELE1-HRI 訊號的結果依壓力的強度與持續時間而定，可從適應性恢復一路延伸至 apoptosis 的誘導；該途徑與神經退化、心肌病變及代謝疾病皆有關聯。

label: Caenorhabditis elegans
source_file: _document_ - MXL-3 and HLH-30 transcriptionally link lipolysis and autophagy to nutrient availability.md
description: The nematode worm is a premier animal model organism.
description_zh_TW: 線蟲是首屈一指的動物模式生物。

label: William C. Campbell
description: Campbell shared the 2015 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine for developing avermectin into ivermectin.
description_zh_TW: 坎貝爾分享了2015年將阿維菌素發展成伊維菌素的歷程。

label: MyoD
description: The positive histone acetyltransferases PCAF and GCN5 acetylate the myogenic transcription factor MyoD, enhancing its DNA-binding and recruitment of transcriptional machinery. Directionally, PCAF/GCN5 sits upstream of MyoD activation. This promotes muscle differentiation, and SIRT1 opposes this by deacetylating both PCAF and MyoD. By acetylating MyoD, these HATs support the expression of muscle-specific genes during differentiation. The balance between PCAF/GCN5 acetylation and sirtuin deacetylation determines the timing and extent of myogenic commitment.
description_zh_TW: 正向組蛋白乙醯基轉移酶 PCAF 和 GCN5 乙醯化肌源性轉錄因子 MyoD，增強其 DNA 結合和轉錄機器的招募。在方向性上，PCAF/GCN5 位於 MyoD 活化的上游。這促進肌肉分化，而 SIRT1 透過去乙醯化 PCAF 和 MyoD 兩者來對抗。透過乙醯化 MyoD，這些 HAT 在分化期間支持肌肉特異性基因的表達。PCAF/GCN5 乙醯化和 sirtuin 去乙醯化之間的平衡決定了肌源性承諾的時間和程度。

label: TRIM28
source_file: _document_ - Post-translational Modification in Control of SIRT1 Stability during DNA Damage Response.md
description: Cleaved SIRT1 binds TRIM28 more strongly, accelerating its own destruction. The DeltaC703 cleavage-mimic shows the highest ubiquitination of all constructs and enhanced TRIM28 binding, while D707A shows reduced binding, so the two PTMs are mutually reinforcing.
description_zh_TW: 被裂解的 SIRT1 與 TRIM28 結合更強，加速其自身的破壞。裂解模擬物 ΔC703 在所有構建體中顯示最高的泛素化並增強 TRIM28 結合，而 D707A 顯示結合減少，因此這兩種翻譯後修飾相互強化。

label: Ferroptosis in IDD
description: Nucleus pulposus cells decline in intervertebral disc degeneration, exacerbated by SIRT3 knockdown under oxidative stress. Lactate downregulates SIRT3, increasing ACSL4 lactylation and promoting ferroptosis that accelerates NPC functional decline; SIRT3 overexpression alleviates IDD severity in vivo.
description_zh_TW: 髓核細胞在椎間盤退化中衰退，在氧化壓力下被 SIRT3 敲減加劇。乳酸下調 SIRT3，增加 ACSL4 乳醯化並促進鐵死亡，加速 NPC 功能衰退；SIRT3 的過量表現在體內緩解 IDD 嚴重程度。

label: Epicatechin
description: Epicatechin, a flavanol, demonstrates potent AGE-breaking properties in vitro and in vivo. It destroyed preformed glycated serum albumin in vitro and decreased AGE accumulation in retinal tissues of rats injected with exogenous AGE. Mechanistically, side chains attached to the pyrrole ring carbons of AGE structures are susceptible to nucleophilic attack, and because C6 and C8 on the A-ring of epicatechin are nucleophilic, epicatechin can attack and destroy AGE cross-links. These findings position epicatechin as a naturally occurring AGE breaker with potential for preventing AGE-mediated tissue damage.
description_zh_TW: Epicatechin 是一種 flavanol，在體外與體內展現 potent AGE-breaking properties。它在體外 destroyed preformed glycated serum albumin，並降低了注射 exogenous AGE 的 rats retinal tissues 中的 AGE accumulation。在機制上，連接於 AGE structures pyrrole ring carbons 上的 side chains 易受 nucleophilic attack，而由於 epicatechin A-ring 上的 C6 與 C8 具有 nucleophilic，epicatechin 可 attack 並 destroy AGE cross-links。這些 findings 將 epicatechin 定位為一種 naturally occurring AGE breaker，具有預防 AGE-mediated tissue damage 的潛力。

label: Apolipoprotein B
description: Apolipoprotein B is the primary apolipoprotein of chylomicrons and LDL particles and serves as the ligand for the LDL receptor, making it essential for lipoprotein assembly and metabolism. LDL oxidation alters the apoB protein moiety through fragmentation and cross-linking of reactive aldehydes and oxysterols; resveratrol reduces this radical-induced alteration and chelates copper bound to apoB. Elevated apoB-containing lipoproteins drive plaque formation.
description_zh_TW: Apolipoprotein B 是乳糜微粒與 LDL 顆粒的主要載脂蛋白，並作為 LDL receptor 的配體，因此對脂蛋白組裝與代謝至關重要。LDL 氧化會透過活性醛與氧化膽固醇的斷裂與交聯改變 apoB 蛋白部分；resveratrol 可減少此自由基誘發的變化並螯合結合於 apoB 的銅。含 apoB 的脂蛋白濃度升高會驅動斑塊形成。

label: nootropic
description: A nootropic is by definition a cognitive-enhancing agent targeting alertness, attention or executive function. Classification covers prescription repurposing like modafinil as well as supplements.
description_zh_TW: nootropic 依定義是針對警覺、注意或執行功能的認知增強劑。歸類涵蓋如 modafinil 的處方再利用與補充劑。

label: Retinal Ganglion Cells
description: Neuronal STING activity is activated within Retinal Ganglion Cells and the adjacent retinal pigment epithelium during disease, driving Retinal Ganglion Cell death and vision loss in glaucoma; because STING activation is deleterious, pharmacological inhibition of the cGAS-STING axis is being investigated to preserve Retinal Ganglion Cell viability.
description_zh_TW: 在疾病過程中，Retinal Ganglion Cells 與鄰近的視網膜色素上皮內神經元 STING 活性被活化，驅動 Retinal Ganglion Cells 死亡並造成青光眼的視力喪失；由於 STING 活化具有損害性，藥理抑制 cGAS-STING 軸正被研究以保存 Retinal Ganglion Cells 的存活。

label: 5,6-indolequinone
description: 5,6-indolequinone is biochemically converted into Neuromelanin through a defined reaction step in catecholamine pigment or neurotransmitter metabolism. Mechanistically, 5,6-indolequinone acts as the substrate and Neuromelanin as the product, often via oxidation, cyclization, or enzymatic decarboxylation. This conversion is biologically significant because it channels labile intermediates into stable products or active transmitters, with implications for neuromelanin accumulation and neuronal health. A caveat is that the precise stoichiometry and subcellular conditions governing the step are not fully resolved and may depend on local iron, pH, and antioxidant capacity.
description_zh_TW: 5,6-indolequinone 透過兒茶酚胺色素或神經傳導物質代謝中的特定反應步驟生化轉化為 Neuromelanin。從機制上講，5,6-indolequinone 作為底物，Neuromelanin 作為產物，通常透過 oxidation、環化或酶促脫羧作用。這種轉化具有重要的生物學意義，因為它將不穩定的中間體轉化為穩定的產物或活性遞質，對 neuromelanin 累積和神經元健康產生影響。需要注意的是，控制該步驟的精確化學計量和亞細胞條件尚未完全解決，可能取決於局部 iron、pH 和抗氧化能力。

label: Neurotoxicity
description: Direct SIRT2 activation is generally avoided therapeutically because overactivity is linked to neurotoxicity in neurodegenerative contexts, where excessive deacetylation may impair microtubule and protein-homeostasis defenses. Directionally, SIRT2 overactivity is associated with neuronal damage. Consequently, SIRT2 inhibitors are pursued for Parkinsons and Huntingtons disease, where preserving α-tubulin acetylation protects neurons from aggregation toxicity. This therapeutic direction contrasts with SIRT2s tumor-suppressive functions in other tissues, illustrating how the same enzyme can be targeted in opposite directions depending on disease context.
description_zh_TW: 直接活化 SIRT2 通常在治療上被避免，因為其過度活性與神經退行性疾病背景下的神經毒性相關，過度去乙醯化可能損害微管和蛋白質穩態防禦。在方向性上，SIRT2 過度活性與神經元損傷相關。因此，SIRT2 抑制劑正在帕金森症和亨丁頓症的研究中被追求，保持 α-tubulin 乙醯化可以保護神經元免受聚集毒性。這種治療方向與 SIRT2 在其他組織中的腫瘤抑制功能形成對比，說明同一酶如何根據疾病情境被朝相反方向靶向。

label: Stanniocalcin-1
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: Stanniocalcin-1, a glycoprotein hormone, orchestrates a hormetic AMPK/SIRT3 axis that mitigates oxidative stress and apoptosis, and inhibits BNIP3 expression through the AMPK/SIRT3 pathway to ameliorate renal injury in diabetic murine models. The hormetic description reflects STC1's pattern of effect: mild mitochondrial stress engages AMPK, supporting SIRT3-dependent mitochondrial quality control.
description_zh_TW: Stanniocalcin-1 是一種糖蛋白激素，編排了一個激效性 AMPK/SIRT3 軸線以減輕氧化壓力和凋亡，並透過 AMPK/SIRT3 途徑抑制 BNIP3 表現以改善糖尿病小鼠模型中的腎損傷。激效性描述反映了 STC1 的作用模式：輕度粒線體壓力啟動 AMPK，支持 SIRT3 依賴的粒線體品質控制。

label: LIR Motif
description: The LIR motif mediates direct binding to ATG8-family proteins, including LC3 and GABARAP, on the surface of the phagophore and mature autophagosome. This couples ubiquitylation to selective autophagy, enabling mitophagy and aggrephagy.
description_zh_TW: LIR 模體介導與 ATG8 家族蛋白（包括 LC3 與 GABARAP）在吞噬泡與成熟自噬體表面的直接結合。這將泛素化與選擇性自噬相耦合，使 mitophagy 與聚集體自噬成為可能。

label: Oral squamous cell carcinoma
description: In oral squamous cell carcinomas, SIRT3 is overexpressed, and its downregulation has antiproliferative activity and sensitizes carcinoma cells to radiation and to cisplatin. This contrasts with SIRT3's broader tumor-suppressive role in mouse models, showing that sirtuin function is context-dependent. Directionally, elevated SIRT3 supports tumor growth and therapy resistance in this cancer type, while SIRT3 loss restores sensitivity. The finding highlights that a single sirtuin can be either protective or oncogenic depending on tumor type and molecular background.
description_zh_TW: 在口腔鱗狀細胞癌中，SIRT3 過量表現，其下調具有抗增殖活性並使癌細胞對放射治療和 Cisplatin 敏感。這與 SIRT3 在小鼠模型中更廣泛的腫瘤抑制作用形成對比，顯示 sirtuin 功能具有情境依賴性。方向性上，SIRT3 升高在此癌種中支持腫瘤生長和治療抗性，而 SIRT3 缺失恢復敏感性。此發現凸顯了單一 sirtuin 根據腫瘤類型和分子背景可能具有保護性或致癌性。

label: Intermedin
description: Intermedin (adrenomedullin 2) enhances mitochondrial bioenergetic capacity via AMPK/SIRT3-mediated cristae remodeling in vascular calcification models, opposing the calcific phenotype driven by mitochondrial dysfunction in advanced chronic kidney disease.
description_zh_TW: Intermedin（腎上腺髓質素 2）在血管鈣化模型中透過 AMPK/SIRT3 介導的嵴重塑增強粒線體生物能容量，對抗進階慢性腎臟病中粒線體功能障礙驅動的鈣化表型。

label: Liquiritigenin
description: Liquiritigenin is a licorice-derived flavanone that induces Nrf2 translocation, thereby potentiating SIRT3 activity and facilitating mitochondrial biogenesis while suppressing apoptosis in acute kidney injury models, mitigating oxidative stress injury and cell death.
description_zh_TW: Liquiritigenin 是源自甘草的黃烷酮，誘導 Nrf2 轉位，從而增強 SIRT3 活性並促進粒線體生成，同時在急性腎損傷模型中抑制凋亡，減輕氧化壓力損傷和細胞死亡。

label: Shingles Vaccine
description: Postherpetic neuralgia is persistent neuropathic pain in the dermatome of a resolved herpes zoster rash, the most common complication of shingles. The shingles vaccine lowers the risk of herpes zoster and consequently of postherpetic neuralgia.
description_zh_TW: 帶狀皰疹後神經痛是帶狀皰疹皮疹消退後皮節區的持續神經病理性疼痛，是帶狀皰疹最常見的併發症。帶狀皰疹疫苗降低帶狀皰疹及其後神經痛的風險。

label: Biological Aging
description: The Health and Retirement Study (HRS) is a longitudinal panel study of U.S. adults aged 50+ that collects health, economic, and biomarker data, enabling population-level analyses of biological aging. It was used to show shingles vaccination associates with slower biological aging.
description_zh_TW: 健康與退休研究（HRS）是針對 50 歲以上美國成人的縱向追蹤研究，收集健康、經濟與生物標記數據，使生物老化的族群層級分析成為可能。它被用於顯示帶狀皰疹疫苗接種與較慢的生物老化相關。

label: Meteorin-like protein
description: Meteorin-like (Metrnl) activates the PGC-1alpha/SIRT3 axis, stimulating AMPK at Thr172 and increasing UCP1-dependent proton leak, preserving mitochondrial ultrastructural integrity and regulating energy metabolism in diabetic nephropathy.
description_zh_TW: Meteorin-like（Metrnl）活化 PGC-1alpha/SIRT3 軸線，在 Thr172 處刺激 AMPK 並增加 UCP1 依賴的質子漏，在糖尿病腎病變中維護粒線體超微結構完整性並調節能量代謝。

label: Dyskinesia
description: Delayed antipsychotic-induced persistent orofacial dyskinesia defines the tardive form.
description_zh_TW: 延遲的抗精神病藥誘發持續口顏面運動障礙定義遲發形式。

label: Hemoglobin M
description: Hemoglobin M (HbM) disease is a rare congenital form of Methemoglobinemia caused by autosomal dominant mutations in the globin genes (α, β or γ chains). These mutations stabilize the iron in the ferric Fe³⁺ state within Hemoglobin, so the affected heme groups cannot bind oxygen, producing lifelong Cyanosis; patients are otherwise typically asymptomatic or only mildly affected.
description_zh_TW: Hemoglobin M（HbM）疾病是 Methemoglobinemia 的一種罕見先天型態，由 globin 基因（α、β 或 γ 鏈）的體染色體顯性突變造成。這些突變使 Hemoglobin 中的鐵穩定於 ferric Fe³⁺ 態，使受影響的 heme 無法結合氧氣，造成終身 Cyanosis；患者通常無其他症狀或僅有輕微表現。

label: soluble epoxide hydrolase
source_file: _document_ - Roles of SIRT3 in aging and aging-related diseases.md
description: A regulatory axis exists in which soluble epoxide hydrolase (sEH) modulates SIRT3 turnover via proteolytic degradation, with sEH deficiency preserving SIRT3 bioavailability to fulfill bioenergetic demands and impede renal vascular calcification progression. sEH inhibition or deficiency therefore acts as an indirect SIRT3-stabilizing strategy in advanced CKD-associated vascular calcification.
description_zh_TW: 存在一個調控軸線，其中可溶性環氧化物水解酶（sEH）透過蛋白水解降解調節 SIRT3 的周轉，sEH 缺乏保留 SIRT3 的可用性以滿足生物能需求並阻礙腎血管鈣化的進展。因此 sEH 抑制或缺乏作為進階 CKD 相關血管鈣化中間接穩定 SIRT3 的策略。

label: ETS
description: ETS is a large family of eukaryotic transcription factors sharing a conserved winged helix-turn-helix DNA-binding ETS domain that recognizes purine-rich GGAA/T core motifs and regulates proliferation, differentiation, and oncogenesis. The ETS-family member ELK4 plays a central role in sirtuin biology by stabilizing SIRT7 at target gene promoters, enabling H3K18 deacetylation and repression of tumor suppressor genes. Directionally, the ETS family provides the DNA-binding and promoter-targeting mechanisms that members such as ELK4 use to recruit chromatin-modifying enzymes such as SIRT7.
description_zh_TW: ETS 是一個大型真核轉錄因子家族，共享一個保守的翼狀螺旋-轉-螺旋 DNA 結合 ETS 結構域，識別富含嘌呤的 GGAA/T 核心基序並調節增殖、分化和腫瘤發生。ETS 家族成員 ELK4 在 sirtuin 生物學中扮演核心角色，透過將 SIRT7 穩定於靶基因啟動子處，使 H3K18 去乙醯化和腫瘤抑制基因的抑制成為可能。方向性上 ETS 家族提供了 DNA 結合和啟動子靶向機制，使 ELK4 等成員能招募 SIRT7 等染色質修飾酶。

label: Imatinib
description: Imatinib is the prototype tyrosine-kinase inhibitor targeting BCR-ABL, c-KIT and PDGFR. Its inhibition of c-KIT is the basis of its activity in KIT-mutant gastrointestinal stromal tumors, and it is the classic single-target KIT inhibitor against which multi-targeted agents such as pazopanib are contrasted.
description_zh_TW: Imatinib 是標靶 BCR-ABL、c-KIT 與 PDGFR 的原型酪胺酸激酶抑制劑。其對 c-KIT 的抑制是它在 KIT 突變型胃腸道間質腫瘤中的活性基礎，也是與 pazopanib 等多標的藥物對照時的典型單一標的 KIT 抑制劑。

label: NCOA4
description: NCOA4 mediates ferritinophagy, turning over ferritin to feed redox-active Fe2+ into Fenton chemistry. This iron-supply mechanism complements the lipid-substrate arm of ACSL4.
description_zh_TW: NCOA4 介導 ferritinophagy，周轉 ferritin 以供應具氧化還原活性 Fe2+ 進入 Fenton 化學。此鐵供應機制補充 ACSL4 的脂質受質臂。

label: Iron Regulatory Protein 1
description: Apo-aconitase is Iron Regulatory Protein 1, which binds the ferritin iron-responsive element repressing translation. Cluster loss switches enzyme to RNA regulator.
description_zh_TW: 脫輔基 aconitase 即 Iron Regulatory Protein 1，結合 ferritin 鐵反應元件抑制轉譯。簇缺失將酶切換為 RNA 調節因子。

label: Betaine
description: Betaine (trimethylglycine) converts homocysteine to methionine via the enzyme betaine-homocysteine methyltransferase (BHMT), providing one of its three methyl groups in a folate-independent remethylation pathway. This reaction lowers circulating homocysteine, a cardiovascular and neurotoxic risk factor, and supports methionine and subsequently SAMe availability for methyltransferases including COMT. Because it bypasses the folate cycle and MTHFR, betaine is a useful remethylation option when folate-dependent remethylation is impaired. However, its methyl-donating nature means it adds to the methyl load and must be used cautiously in slow COMT individuals.
description_zh_TW: Betaine（三甲基甘氨酸）透過甜菜鹼-同型半胱氨酸甲基轉移酶 (BHMT) 轉化 homocysteine to methionine，在獨立於 folate 的再甲基化途徑中提供其三個 methyl groups 之一。此反應降低了循環同型半胱氨酸（一種心血管和神經毒性危險因子），並支持蛋氨酸以及隨後的 SAMe 對甲基轉移酶（包括 COMT）的可用性。由於甜菜鹼繞過了 folate 循環和 MTHFR，因此當 folate 依賴性再甲基化受損時，甜菜鹼是一種有用的再甲基化選項。然而，其提供甲基的性質意味著它會增加甲基負荷，因此在緩慢的 COMT 個體中必須謹慎使用。

label: Heparin
description: Heparin is a glycosaminoglycan anticoagulant that binds antithrombin III and induces a conformational change that accelerates antithrombin-mediated inactivation of thrombin (factor IIa) and factor Xa by roughly 1000-fold. Unfractionated heparin inhibits both thrombin and Xa, whereas low molecular weight heparin such as enoxaparin and dalteparin primarily targets Xa.
description_zh_TW: Heparin 是一種醣胺聚醣類抗凝血劑，可與 antithrombin III 結合並誘導構形改變，使 antithrombin 對 thrombin（factor IIa）與 factor Xa 的抑制加速約 1000 倍。未分級肝素同時抑制 thrombin 與 Xa，而 enoxaparin、dalteparin 等低分子量肝素則主要作用於 Xa。

label: Christensenellaceae
description: Christensenellaceae are saccharolytic anaerobic bacteria of the Firmicutes whose fermentation yields Short-chain Fatty Acids, particularly acetate and butyrate. These metabolites fuel colonocytes and support an anti-inflammatory tone, giving the family a direct metabolic role in host energy balance.
description_zh_TW: Christensenellaceae 是屬於 Firmicutes 的產糖厭氧菌，其發酵產生 Short-chain Fatty Acids，尤其是乙酸與丁酸。這些代謝物為結腸細胞供能並維持抗發炎基調，使此菌科在宿主能量平衡中具有直接代謝作用。

label: PON1
description: PON1 hydrolyzes oxidized phospholipids on HDL, preventing their transfer to LDL and thereby protecting against lipoprotein oxidation. This paraoxonase activity is a key anti-atherogenic function of HDL. The directionality is enzyme to lipid-peroxide detoxification. A caveat is that PON1 activity is highly polymorphic in humans and is also reduced by oxidative stress, creating a variable defensive capacity. PON1 also hydrolyzes lactones and specific organophosphates, and its activity is used as an index of HDL antioxidant capacity.
description_zh_TW: PON1 水解 HDL 上的 oxidized phospholipids，防止轉移為 LDL，從而防止脂蛋白氧化。這種對氧磷酶活性是 HDL 的關鍵抗動脈粥狀硬化功能。方向性是酵素到脂質過氧化物解毒。需要注意的是，PON1 活性在人類中具有高度多態性，並且也會被 oxidative stress 降低，從而產生可變的防禦能力。 PON1也能水解內酯和特定的有機磷酸酯，其活性被用作HDL抗氧化能力的指標。

label: DNA Ligase IV
description: DNA ligase IV (LIG4) catalyzes the final phosphodiester-bond sealing step of non-homologous end joining with XRCC4/XLF. SIRT3 promotes NHEJ efficiency via 53BP1 recruitment and H3K56 deacetylation and interacts with DNA repair proteins including DNA ligase 4 to repair mtDNA damage.
description_zh_TW: DNA ligase IV（LIG4）催化非同源末端接合與 XRCC4/XLF 一起的最終磷酸二酯鍵封口步驟。SIRT3 透過 53BP1 招募和 H3K56 去乙醯化促進 NHEJ 效率，並與 DNA 修復蛋白（包括 DNA ligase 4）互動以修復 mtDNA 損傷。

label: Sirtuin deacetylation reaction
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Sirtuin-catalyzed deacetylation couples the cleavage of NAD+ to the removal of acetyl groups from lysine residues. Each round of deacetylation converts one molecule of NAD+ into nicotinamide (NAM) and O-acetyl-ADP-ribose. NAM then acts as an end-product inhibitor of sirtuins by binding to a conserved pocket adjacent to the NAD+ site, thereby blocking further NAD+ hydrolysis. This product-based feedback links cellular NAD+ status and NAM levels directly to sirtuin enzymatic output.
description_zh_TW: Sirtuin催化的去乙醯化反應將NAD+的裂解與賴氨酸殘基上乙醯基的移除耦合。每輪去乙醯化將一分子NAD+轉化為菸鹼醯胺（NAM）和O-乙醯-ADP-核糖。NAM隨後作為sirtuin的末端產物抑制劑，結合到與NAD+位點相鄰的保守口袋，從而阻斷進一步的NAD+水解。這種基於產物的反饋直接將細胞NAD+狀態和NAM水平與sirtuin酵素輸出聯繫起來。

label: Mst1
description: Mst1 (STK4) is a Hippo-pathway kinase that promotes apoptosis and suppresses protective autophagy. In diabetic cardiomyopathy, melatonin counteracts adverse left-ventricle remodeling by inhibiting Mst1 phosphorylation and upregulating SIRT3, promoting autophagy, reducing apoptosis, and mitigating mitochondrial dysfunction.
description_zh_TW: Mst1（STK4）是一種 Hippo 途徑激酶，促進凋亡並抑制保護性自噬。在糖尿病心肌病變中，melatonin 透過抑制 Mst1 磷酸化和上調 SIRT3 對抗不良的左心室重塑，促進自噬、減少凋亡並減輕粒線體功能障礙。

label: SOD1
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins, a promising target in slowing down the ageing process.md
description: SIRT5 activates superoxide dismutase 1 (SOD1) through desuccinylation, enhancing NADPH production and glutathione recycling for ROS detoxification. Directionally, SIRT5 enzymatically activates SOD1. This bolsters cytosolic antioxidant capacity, and it extends SIRT5's protective actions beyond the mitochondria's own enzymes. By promoting NADPH generation and glutathione recycling, SOD1 activation supports the detoxification of superoxide and the maintenance of redox balance. This antioxidant function complements SIRT5's metabolic roles and contributes to cellular protection against oxidative stress.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 透過去琥珀醯化活化超氧化物歧化酶 1（SOD1），增強 NADPH 產生和穀胱甘肽回收以進行 ROS 解毒。在方向性上，SIRT5 以酶性方式活化 SOD1。這增強了細胞質抗氧化能力，並將 SIRT5 的保護作用延伸到粒線體自身酶之外。透過促進 NADPH 產生和穀胱甘肽回收，SOD1 活化支持超氧陰離子的解毒和紅氧平衡的維護。這種抗氧化功能與 SIRT5 的代謝角色互補，並有助於細胞對抗氧化壓力的保護。

label: MuRF1
description: MuRF1 (Muscle RING Finger 1, also known as TRIM63) is a muscle-specific E3 ubiquitin ligase whose expression rises during muscle wasting and atrophy; it tags sarcomeric proteins so they can be degraded through the ubiquitin-proteasome system.
description_zh_TW: MuRF1（Muscle RING Finger 1，又稱 TRIM63）是一種肌肉特異性的 E3 泛素連接酶，在肌肉消耗與萎縮時表現上升；它標記肌節蛋白，使其經由泛素-蛋白酶體系統被降解。

label: STUB1
description: STUB1 (CHIP), an E3 ubiquitin ligase, recognizes and ubiquitinates phosphorylated TFEB, targeting the transcription factor for proteasomal degradation. This mechanism ensures that TFEB levels are coupled to its phosphorylation state, providing a negative-feedback brake on sustained activation. By eliminating phosphorylated, cytosolically retained TFEB, STUB1 limits the accumulation of inactive protein and fine-tunes the amplitude of the autophagic response. The pathway connects TFEB turnover to the ubiquitin-proteasome system rather than to lysosomal degradation.
description_zh_TW: STUB1（CHIP）是一種 E3 泛素連接酶，辨識並泛素化磷酸化的 TFEB，將此轉錄因子標定為蛋白酶體降解。此機制確保 TFEB 水平與其磷酸化狀態耦合，提供對持續活化的負回饋制動。透過清除磷酸化、細胞質保留的 TFEB，STUB1 限制非活性蛋白的累積並微調自噬反應的幅度。此途徑將 TFEB 更新連結到泛素—蛋白酶體系統，而非溶酶體降解。

label: ACAT1
description: Acetyl-CoA acetyltransferase 1 (ACAT1) acetylates TFEB at multiple lysines (K91, K103, K116, K430), an enzymatic activity that, in this context, promotes TFEB nuclear translocation and DNA binding. These acetylations counteract repressive deacetylation cycles and enhance TFEB's ability to engage CLEAR elements, thereby boosting autophagy-lysosomal transcription. The observation that ACAT1-mediated acetylation can be activatory contrasts with the repressive acetylation by GCN5 at other sites. The net effect depends on the specific lysine and cellular context, underscoring the complexity of TFEB acetylation.
description_zh_TW: 乙醯輔酶 A 乙醯轉移酶 1（ACAT1）在多個離胺酸（K91、K103、K116、K430）乙醯化 TFEB，在此脈絡下此酵素活性促進 TFEB 核轉運和 DNA 結合。這些乙醯化對抗抑制性的去乙醯化循環，並增強 TFEB 接合 CLEAR 元件的能力，從而提升自噬—溶酶體轉錄。ACAT1 介導的乙醯化可為活化性的此一觀察，與 GCN5 在其他位點的抑制性乙醯化形成對比。淨效應取決於特定離胺酸和細胞背景，凸顯了 TFEB 乙醯化的複雜性。

label: I-PpoI
description: I-PpoI recognizes and cleaves a specific 15-20 base-pair sequence within rRNA gene repeats, generating sequence-specific double-strand breaks. Directionally, I-PpoI sits upstream of targeted double-strand-break formation. Its specificity makes it ideal for the ICE Mouse's controlled damage, and this enables reproducible epigenetic-aging studies. Because I-PpoI cleaves at a defined sequence, researchers can induce breaks at known genomic loci in a controlled manner. This precision distinguishes the ICE Mouse from treatments that cause random DNA damage, allowing the isolation of repair-driven effects.
description_zh_TW: I-PpoI 識別並切割 rRNA 基因重複序列中的特定 15-20 基鹼對序列，產生序列特異性的雙鏈斷裂。在方向性上，I-PpoI 位於靶向雙鏈斷裂形成的上游。其特異性使其成為 ICE 小鼠受控損傷的理想工具，實現可重複的表觀遺傳衰老研究。由於 I-PpoI 在確定的序列處切割，研究人員可以在已知的基因組位點以受控方式誘導斷裂。這種精確性區別了 ICE 小鼠與造成隨機 DNA 損傷的處理，允許分離修復驅動的效應。

label: Antagonistic Pleiotropy
description: RCM likely evolved as a beneficial short-term response: relocalizing modifiers to damage sites helps cells survive acute threats by prioritizing repair and survival over normal gene regulation. In youth this is advantageous, but over a lifetime the cumulative failure to reset becomes detrimental, contributing to aging. This trade-off, where a trait that benefits early survival becomes harmful later in life, is the classic signature of antagonistic pleiotropy.
description_zh_TW: RCM 可能作為有益的短期反應演化而來：將修飾因子再定位到損傷位點有助於細胞透過優先進行修復和存活來應對急性威脅，而非維持正常的基因調控。在年輕時這是有利的，但在一生中累積的重置失敗會變得有害，從而促成衰老。這種在早期生存有益但在晚年有害的權衡特徵，正是拮抗多效性的經典標誌。

label: SIRT1 inhibition
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: SIRT1 inhibition increases the sensitivity of glioma cells to temozolomide through facilitation of intracellular reactive oxygen species generation. Directionally, SIRT1 inhibition sits upstream of elevated ROS and enhanced drug-induced cell death in glioma. By blocking SIRT1's protective anti-oxidant activity, glioma cells accumulate ROS that sensitize them to temozolomide, the standard chemotherapy for glioblastoma. Combining SIRT1 inhibition with temozolomide may therefore improve treatment efficacy in malignant glioma.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1抑制透過促進細胞內活性氧的產生來增加膠質瘤細胞對替莫唑胺的敏感性。方向上，SIRT1抑制位於膠質瘤中ROS升高和藥物誘導的細胞死亡增強的上游。透過阻斷SIRT1的保護性抗氧化活性，膠質瘤細胞積累ROS，使其對替莫唑胺（膠質母細胞瘤的標準化療藥物）敏感。因此將SIRT1抑制與替莫唑胺結合可能改善惡性膠質瘤的治療效果。

label: Radiosensitizer
description: Nitroimidazoles are investigated as hypoxic cell radiosensitizers that replace oxygen in the chemical reactions producing radiation-induced DNA damage. They increase cytotoxicity in hypoxic cells while having no effect on already-aerobic (maximally radiosensitive) cells.
description_zh_TW: 硝基咪唑被研究作為低氧細胞放射增敏劑，在產生輻射誘導 DNA 損傷的化學反應中取代氧氣。它們增加低氧細胞的細胞毒性，同時對已充氧（最大放射敏感）細胞無影響。

label: Beta-hydroxybutyrate
description: After 12–36 h fasting the brain switches from glucose to beta-hydroxybutyrate (BHB) as fuel; BHB induces BDNF expression via histone deacetylase inhibition, enhancing hippocampal neurogenesis and synaptic plasticity (Seidler & Barrow, 2022) — a neurotrophic arm of fasting hormesis.
description_zh_TW: 禁食 12–36 小時後大腦從葡萄糖切換至 β-羥基丁酸（BHB）作為燃料；BHB 透過抑制組蛋白去乙醯酶誘導 BDNF 表現，增強海馬神經新生與突觸可塑性（Seidler & Barrow, 2022）——這是禁食荷爾蒙的神經營養臂。

label: p65
description: p65 (RELA) is one of the two subunits of the most prevalent NF-kappaB species, the p65/p50 heterodimer. Its transcriptional activity is acetylation-sensitive: increased SIRT1 protein expression reduces acetylation of the NF-kappaB p65 subunit, which suppresses TNF-alpha-induced NF-kappaB transcriptional activation and reduces TNF-alpha secretion in a SIRT1-dependent manner.
description_zh_TW: p65（RELA）是最普遍的 NF-κB 型態——p65/p50 異源二聚體——的兩個次單元之一。其轉錄活性對乙醯化敏感：SIRT1 蛋白表現增加會降低 NF-κB p65 次單元的乙醯化程度，進而以 SIRT1 依賴的方式抑制 TNFα 誘發的 NF-κB 轉錄活化並減少 TNFα 分泌。

label: Orlistat
description: Beyond inhibiting fat absorption, orlistat decreases intestinal absorption of dietary Advanced Glycation End Products; in women with PCOS it lowered postprandial serum AGEs after a high-AGE meal compared with controls.
description_zh_TW: 除了抑制脂肪吸收外，[[Orlistat]] 還能減少飲食性 [[Advanced Glycation End Products]] 的腸道吸收；在 PCOS 女性中，相較對照組可降低高 AGE 餐後的血清 AGE 濃度。

label: Acatalasemia
source_file: _document_ - Oxidative Stress Harms and Benefits for Human Health.md
description: Glutathione peroxidase and peroxiredoxin redundancy compensates catalase loss, explaining asymptomatic acatalasemia cases through alternative peroxide detoxification. Backup enzymes mask the deficiency.
description_zh_TW: Glutathione peroxidase 與過氧化還原蛋白冗餘補償 catalase 缺失，經由替代過氧化物解毒解釋無症狀 acatalasemia 病例。備援酶掩蓋缺陷。

label: Humphry Osmond
description: Hoffer met Osmond at Saskatchewan Hospital in Weyburn in 1950, and the two systematically studied catecholamines and their oxidized metabolites in psychiatric patients, ran controlled LSD trials, and co-authored the monographs that elaborated the adrenochrome model.
description_zh_TW: Hoffer 於 1950 年在 Weyburn 的 Saskatchewan Hospital 認識 Osmond，兩人系統性研究精神科病人的 Catecholamines 及其氧化代謝物、進行受控的 LSD 試驗，並共同撰寫闡述 adrenochrome 模型的專著。

label: Butein
description: Butein is a chalcone polyphenol that belongs to the first generation of natural sirtuin-activating compounds (STACs), reported to activate SIRT1 together with resveratrol, piceatannol, quercetin, and myricetin. These polyphenolic activators established the concept of pharmacological SIRT1 activation and served as the basis for later, more potent synthetic STACs such as SRT1460, SRT1720, and SRT2183. Directionally, butein's identification as a polyphenol STAC initiated the activator chemistry that progressed to synthetic scaffolds, though the direct activation mechanism remains controversial due to fluorescent-substrate artifacts.
description_zh_TW: Butein 是一種查爾酮多酚，屬於第一代天然 sirtuin 活化化合物（STAC），據報導與 resveratrol、piceatannol、quercetin 和 myricetin 一起活化 SIRT1。這些多酚類活化劑確立了藥理學 SIRT1 活化的概念，並作為後續更強效合成 STAC 如 SRT1460、SRT1720 和 SRT2183 的基礎。方向性上 Butein 作為多酚類 STAC 的鑑定啟動了從活化劑化學到合成骨架的發展，儘管由於螢光受質假象，直接活化機制仍存在爭議。

label: L-arginine
description: Arginase competes with NOS for L-arginine, hydrolyzing arginine to ornithine and urea and thereby lowering substrate available for NO synthesis. In vascular and immune contexts this shifts the arginine pool away from NO toward polyamine and proline synthesis. The directionality is metabolic competition to reduced NO. A caveat is that arginase and NOS also compete for the same intracellular compartment, so local colocalization strongly influences the outcome. Arginase is induced by inflammatory cytokines and oxidants, so vascular arginase upregulation is a recognized mechanism of endothelial dysfunction.
description_zh_TW: Arginase 與 NOS 競爭 L-arginine，將精氨酸水解為鳥氨酸和尿素，從而降低可用於 NO 合成的底物。在血管和免疫環境中，這會將精胺酸池從一氧化氮轉向多胺和脯胺酸合成。方向性是代謝競爭以減少NO。需要注意的是，arginase 和 NOS 也會競爭相同的細胞內區室，因此局部共定位會強烈影響結果。 Arginase 是由發炎細胞因子和氧化劑誘導的，因此血管 arginase 上調是 endothelial dysfunction 的公認機制。

label: NF675
description: NF675 is a suramin-derived small molecule that is the most potent and selective compound in its scaffold series, showing a 20-fold selectivity ratio for SIRT1 over SIRT2. It was obtained through optimization of the suramin scaffold, which itself is a nanomolar inhibitor of SIRT1/SIRT2. Directionally, NF675's identity as a suramin-derived, SIRT1-selective inhibitor illustrates scaffold engineering for isoform selectivity within the sirtuin inhibitor field. Its modest drug-likeness, stemming from high molecular weight and anionic character, limits therapeutic application despite good potency and selectivity.
description_zh_TW: NF675 是一種 Suramin 衍生的小分子，是其骨架系列中最具活性和選擇性的化合物，對 SIRT1 相較 SIRT2 顯示出 20 倍的選擇性比率。它透過優化 Suramin 骨架而獲得，Suramin 本身是 SIRT1/SIRT2 的奈摩爾級抑制劑。方向性上 NF675 作為 Suramin 衍生的 SIRT1 選擇性抑制劑的身份說明了 sirtuin 抑制劑領域中針對同工型選擇性的骨架工程。其由於高分子量和陰離子特性導致的中等類藥性限制了治療應用，儘管具有良好的活性和選擇性。

label: Lys122
description: SIRT3, the major mitochondrial deacetylase, directly removes the acetyl group from Lys122 of MnSOD/SOD2; deacetylated MnSOD shows dramatically increased dismutation activity, lowering mitochondrial oxidative stress. Lys122 is thus a canonical readout of SIRT3 function, and its acetylation status is used as a surrogate marker of SIRT3 activity.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3（主要的粒線體去乙醯化酶）會直接移除 MnSOD/SOD2 上 Lys122 的乙醯基；去乙醯化後的 MnSOD 歧化活性顯著提升，降低粒線體氧化壓力。因此 Lys122 是 SIRT3 功能的典型讀出指標，其乙醯化狀態也被用作 SIRT3 活性的替代標記。

label: ZCCHC11
description: ZCCHC11 uridylates pre-let-7 downstream of Lin28 recruitment, destabilizing it. Consolidated inhibits form; downregulates variant dropped.
description_zh_TW: ZCCHC11 在 Lin28 招募下游使 pre-let-7 尿苷化使其不穩定。合併的 inhibits 形式；downregulates 變體捨棄。

label: Dihydromyricetin
description: Vine tea (Ampelopsis grossedentata) leaves contain 20-30% dihydromyricetin (DHM) by weight, so 1-1.5 g of dry leaf suffices for roughly a 300 mg therapeutic dose. Directionally, the botanical source sits upstream of DHM availability. DHM is a potent SIRT3 and AMPK activator, and this makes vine tea a practical natural source of the compound. The high DHM content distinguishes vine tea from most other botanical sources and supports its traditional use as a metabolic tonic. This abundance is a key practical advantage for studying and using DHM clinically.
description_zh_TW: 藤茶（Ampelopsis grossedentata）葉片含有 20-30% 的二氫楊梅素（DHM），因此 1-1.5 克乾葉即可提供約 300 mg 的治療劑量。在方向性上，植物來源位於 DHM 可用性的上游。DHM 是強效的 SIRT3 和 AMPK 活化劑，使藤茶成為該化合物的實用天然來源。高 DHM 含量使藤茶有別於大多數其他植物來源，並支持其作為代謝滋補品的傳統用途。這種豐度是研究和臨床使用 DHM 的關鍵實際優勢。

label: Paracrine Reprogramming
description: Paracrine reprogramming is the biological process by which SASP factors alter the differentiation status and fate of neighbouring cells, pushing them toward stemness, EMT, or altered lineage commitment. Distinct from paracrine senescence, which induces growth arrest, it remodels recipient identity and is dose- and time-dependent, with acute exposure promoting plasticity and chronic exposure driving fibrosis and cancer stemness. The process is mediated by cytokines such as IL-6, TGFbeta, and VEGF family members. It expands the non-cell-autonomous influence of senescent cells beyond growth arrest.
description_zh_TW: 旁分泌重編程是 SASP 因子改變鄰近細胞分化狀態與命運、將其推向幹性、EMT 或改變譜系承諾的生物學過程。不同於誘發生長停滯的旁分泌衰老，它重塑受體身分而非使其停滯。此過程將衰老分泌組定位為組織重塑的形態發生素來源，且其與旁分泌衰老的並存說明 SASP 具多重非細胞自主性後果。它是衰老相關組織重塑的核心機制。

label: Cadherin
description: Differential cadherin adhesion drives developmental cell sorting. Driving records the morphogenetic output.
description_zh_TW: 差異 cadherin 黏附驅動發育細胞分選。驅動記錄形態發生輸出。

label: Adrenocortical carcinomas
description: Mitotane (o,p'-DDD; Lysodren) is the adrenolytic agent used in Adrenocortical carcinomas as adjuvant therapy after resection and for advanced disease; it accumulates in adrenocortical tissue, damaging mitochondria, inhibiting steroidogenesis via CYP11A1/CYP11B1 and killing tumour cells.
description_zh_TW: Mitotane（o,p'-DDD；Lysodren）是治療 Adrenocortical carcinomas 的腎上腺皮質溶解劑，作為切除後的輔助療法與晚期疾病用藥；它累積於腎上腺皮質組織，損傷粒線體、經 CYP11A1/CYP11B1 抑制類固醇生成並殺傷腫瘤細胞。

label: HPP+
description: Haloperidol is metabolically converted into the pyridinium neurotoxin HPP+, a charged MPP+ analog taken up by dopaminergic neurons where it inhibits mitochondrial complex I. This conversion underlies haloperidol-associated parkinsonism, which mimics but is distinct from Parkinson's Disease.
description_zh_TW: Haloperidol 在代謝上轉化為吡啶鎓神經毒素 HPP+，一種帶電荷的 MPP+ 類似物，被多巴胺神經元攝取並抑制粒線體複合體 I。此轉化是 haloperidol 相關帕金森症的基礎，其模仿但不同於 Parkinson's Disease。

label: Microgliosis
description: Microglia and Microgliosis are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Microglia and Microgliosis may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Microglia 和 Microgliosis 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Microglia 和 Microgliosis 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: SADS
description: SADS (senescence-associated distal satellite) is a form of heterochromatin decompaction in senescent cells, specifically the relaxation of constitutive pericentromeric and pericentrosomal satellite heterochromatin. Unlike SAHF (which compacts facultative heterochromatin), SADS decompacts constitutive repeats. This structural change alters the nuclear architecture and chromatin accessibility of repetitive regions. SADS represents a distinct, counterintuitive chromatin reorganization during senescence.
description_zh_TW: SADS（senescence-associated distal satellite，衰老相關遠端衛星）是衰老細胞中異染色質去緻密化的一種形式，具體為組成性著絲粒周與中心體周衛星異染色質的鬆弛。不同於 SAHF（緻密化兼性異染色質），SADS 去緻密化組成性重複序列。此結構改變改變重複區域的核架構與染色質可及性。SADS 代表衰老期間一種獨特、違反直覺的染色質重組。

label: GATOR1
description: The DEPDC5-containing GATOR1 complex is the GAP converting RagA/B-GTP to GDP. Inhibition is the amino-acid-off switch.
description_zh_TW: 含 DEPDC5 的 GATOR1 複合體是將 RagA/B-GTP 轉 GDP 的 GAP。抑制是胺基酸關閉開關。

label: World Health Organization
description: The African Programme for Onchocerciasis Control was coordinated by the World Health Organization, which partnered with endemic African countries and with Merck & Co. Inc as donor of Ivermectin. The community-directed treatment with ivermectin (CDTI) model it pioneered became the global template for neglected tropical disease control and is now proposed for equitable cancer prevention in low-resource settings.
description_zh_TW: African Programme for Onchocerciasis Control 由 World Health Organization 協調，與非洲流行國家及 Ivermectin 捐贈者 Merck & Co. Inc 合作。該計畫開創的社區導向 ivermectin 治療（CDTI）模式成為被忽略熱帶疾病防治的全球範本，現今也被提出用於低資源地區的癌症防治公平性。

label: Macrophage
description: Interferon-gamma is the classical M1 macrophage activator, inducing respiratory burst, MHC class II expression, and production of reactive oxygen species and nitric oxide in macrophages.
description_zh_TW: Interferon-gamma 是典型的 M1 macrophage 活化因子，誘導呼吸爆發、MHC 第二類分子表現，以及巨噬細胞產生活性氧與一氧化氮。

label: Epac1
description: Epac1 activation induces calcium release from the endoplasmic reticulum into the cytoplasm, raising cytosolic Ca2+ that serves as a second messenger. Directionally, Epac1 sits upstream of cytoplasmic Ca2+ elevation. The Ca2+ surge then activates calmodulin-dependent protein kinase kinase β (CaMKKβ), bridging cAMP signaling to AMPK activation. This couples resveratrol's PDE4 inhibition to metabolic kinase activation, and it is the key branching point that converts a rise in cyclic AMP into a change in cellular energy sensing. Disrupting any step in this cascade attenuates resveratrol's indirect activation of SIRT1.
description_zh_TW: Epac1 活化誘導鈣離子從內質網釋放到細胞質中，提高作為第二信使的細胞質 Ca2+。在方向性上，Epac1 位於細胞質 Ca2+ 升高的上游。Ca2+ 激增然後活化鈣調蛋白依賴性蛋白激酶激酶 β（CaMKKβ），將 cAMP 信號橋接到 AMPK 活化。這將白藜蘆醇的 PDE4 抑制與代謝激酶活化偶聯起來，是將環磷酸腺苷升高轉化為細胞能量感知變化的關鍵分支點。破壞此級聯中的任何一步都會減弱白藜蘆醇的間接 SIRT1 活化。

label: MDL-800
description: MDL-800 is a bis-benzenesulfonamide prodrug and potent, selective SIRT6 activator, with an EC50 of 10.3 μM, that stimulates SIRT6 deacetylase activity. Directionally, MDL-800 allosterically activates SIRT6. It mirrors UBCS039 but with greater potency and cell permeability, mitigating kidney fibrosis and tumor glycolysis in preclinical models. It is a lead chemical tool for SIRT6 biology, and its improved potency and selectivity make it well suited for in vivo studies of SIRT6 activation, supporting the therapeutic potential of pharmacologic SIRT6 engagement.
description_zh_TW: MDL-800 是一種雙苯磺酰胺前藥和強效選擇性 SIRT6 活化因子，EC50 為 10.3 μM，刺激 SIRT6 去乙醯酶活性。在方向性上，MDL-800 變構活化 SIRT6。它類似於 UBCS039 但具有更高的效力和細胞滲透性，在臨床前模型中減輕腎纖維化和腫瘤糖解。它是 SIRT6 生物學的先導化學工具，其改善的效力和選擇性使其非常適合 SIRT6 活化的體內研究，支持藥理性 SIRT6 參與的治療潛力。

label: Pulmonary Fibrosis
description: Pirfenidone is approved for the treatment of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, acting as an antifibrotic and anti-inflammatory agent. Despite this indication it showed no significant senolytic activity at 5 uM in the fisetin screen, so it is a senotherapeutic candidate rather than an established senolytic.
description_zh_TW: Pirfenidone 獲核准用於治療 Pulmonary Fibrosis，作為抗纖維化與抗發炎藥物。儘管有此適應症，它在 fisetin 篩選試驗中於 5 µM 並未顯示顯著 senolytic 活性，因此屬於 senotherapeutic 候選，而非已確立的 senolytic。

label: PKCζ
description: PKCζ is an atypical protein kinase C isoform.
description_zh_TW: PKCζ 是非典型蛋白激酶 C 亞型。

label: Atg12
description: Atg12 is conjugated to Atg5 by Atg7, with Atg10 acting as the E2-like enzyme, and the resulting Atg5-Atg12 conjugate interacts noncovalently with Atg16. The Atg5-Atg12-Atg16 complex associates with phagophores but dissociates from completed autophagosomes, which is why Atg5-Atg12 is used as a specific marker of the autophagosome-precursor stage.
description_zh_TW: Atg12 由 Atg7 接合到 Atg5，Atg10 扮演 E2 類酵素，所形成的 Atg5-Atg12 接合物再以非共價方式與 Atg16 交互作用。Atg5-Atg12-Atg16 複合體與吞噬膜相結合，卻從已完成的自噬體上解離，因此 Atg5-Atg12 被用作自噬體前驅階段的特異標記。

label: Fructosamine-3-kinase
description: Fructosamine-3-kinase (FN3K) phosphorylates fructosamine/Amadori residues on proteins to Fructosamine-3-phosphate, which spontaneously decomposes — in the process releasing 3-deoxyglucosone — to regenerate undamaged protein and reverse early glycation intracellularly.
description_zh_TW: Fructosamine-3-kinase（FN3K）將蛋白上的 fructosamine／Amadori 殘基磷酸化為 Fructosamine-3-phosphate，後者自發分解（過程中釋出 3-deoxyglucosone），再生未受損的蛋白，在細胞內逆轉早期 glycation。

label: HP1alpha
description: SIRT6-mediated mono-ADP-ribosylation of KAP1 recruits HP1α to package LINE-1 retrotransposons into heterochromatin, silencing their expression. Directionally, SIRT6/KAP1 sits upstream of HP1α tethering. This protects genome stability by containing mobile elements, and it explains how SIRT6 loss derepresses LINE-1. By maintaining heterochromatic silencing of retrotransposons, SIRT6 prevents the insertional mutations and genomic instability caused by active LINE-1 elements. The KAP1-HP1α axis is thus a critical effector of SIRT6's genome-protective function, and its disruption contributes to the instability seen in SIRT6-deficient cells.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 介導的 KAP1 單 ADP-核糖基化招募 HP1α 將 LINE-1 逆轉座子包裝成異染色質，沉默其表達。在方向性上，SIRT6/KAP1 位於 HP1α 拴繫的上游。這透過限制可動元件保護基因組穩定性，並解釋了 SIRT6 缺失如何解除 LINE-1 的抑制。透過維護逆轉座子的異染色質沉默，SIRT6 防止了活性 LINE-1 元件引起的插入突變和基因組不穩定性。KAP1-HP1α 軸線因此是 SIRT6 基因組保護功能的關鍵效應器，其破壞導致 SIRT6 缺陷細胞中所見的不穩定性。

label: Diamine Oxidase
description: Diamine Oxidase (DAO), also called histaminase, is the primary enzyme that breaks down Histamine from ingested food and is expressed mainly in the intestinal mucosa. Adequate DAO activity therefore protects against dietary histamine load.
description_zh_TW: Diamine Oxidase（DAO，又稱 histaminase）是分解食物中 Histamine 的主要酵素，主要表現於腸道黏膜。足夠的 DAO 活性因此能防止飲食性 histamine 負荷造成不適。

label: USP9X
description: USP9X removes Mcl-1 polyubiquitin chains, blocking proteasomal degradation.
description_zh_TW: USP9X 移除 Mcl-1 多泛素鏈，阻斷蛋白酶體降解。

label: SAH
description: SAH (S-adenosylhomocysteine) is the hydrolysis product formed when SAM donates its methyl group, and it is a potent competitive inhibitor of nearly all methyltransferases. Accumulation of SAH globally suppresses methylation, including histone methylation, perturbing epigenetic homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: SAH（S-腺苷同型半胱氨酸）是 SAM 捐出甲基時形成的水解產物，是幾乎所有甲基轉移酶的強效競爭性抑制劑。SAH 累積會全面抑制甲基化（包括組蛋白甲基化），擾亂表觀遺傳恆定。

label: Chronic Kidney Disease
description: Diabetic Kidney Disease (DKD, diabetic nephropathy) is a progressive complication of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus and a leading cause of Chronic Kidney Disease. It is characterized by glomerular and tubular injury driven by chronic hyperglycemia, inflammation and extracellular matrix remodeling, culminating in loss of renal function.
description_zh_TW: Diabetic Kidney Disease（DKD，糖尿病腎病）是 Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus 的進行性併發症，也是 Chronic Kidney Disease 的主要成因之一。其特徵為慢性 hyperglycemia、inflammation 與細胞外基質重塑所驅動的腎小球與腎小管損傷，最終導致腎功能喪失。

label: HTT
description: Huntington's disease is caused by expansion of a CAG repeat to 36 or more repeats in exon 1 of HTT, which inserts a polyglutamine tract into huntingtin's N-terminus. The resulting mutant protein misfolds and aggregates, and the disease is therefore defined by a single gene's repeat expansion.
description_zh_TW: Huntington's disease 是由 HTT 外顯子 1 的 CAG 重複擴增至 36 次以上所造成，該擴增會在 huntingtin 的 N 端插入一段多麩醯胺酸序列。由此產生的突變蛋白錯誤摺疊並聚集，因此此疾病由單一基因的重複擴增所定義。

label: CxxC Motif
description: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) contains the CxxC active-site motif (Cys-Gly-Pro-Cys, residues Cys32-Cys35), which forms the catalytic core of its oxidoreductase activity. The N-terminal Cys32 attacks substrate disulfides while Cys35 resolves the mixed disulfide.
description_zh_TW: Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) 含有 CxxC 活性位點基序（Cys-Gly-Pro-Cys，殘基 Cys32-Cys35），構成其氧化還原酶活性的催化核心。N 端的 Cys32 攻擊受質雙硫鍵，而 Cys35 則解析混合雙硫鍵。

label: ATR
description: RPA-coated single-stranded DNA at stalled forks activates the ATR-CHK1 checkpoint. This is the canonical replication-stress sensor.
description_zh_TW: 停滯叉上 RPA 包被的單股 DNA 活化 ATR-CHK1 檢查點。這是典型的複製壓力感受器。

label: MAVS
description: RIG-I (DDX58) is a cytosolic DExH-box RNA helicase pattern-recognition receptor that detects short double-stranded RNA with a 5'-triphosphate or 5'-diphosphate end. Ligand binding plus K63-linked polyubiquitination releases its N-terminal CARDs, which nucleate filaments that drive MAVS (IPS-1) oligomerisation on the mitochondrial outer membrane, MAMs and peroxisomes, converting RIG-I recognition into downstream signalling.
description_zh_TW: RIG-I (DDX58) 是細胞質的 DExH-box RNA 解旋酶型模式辨識受體，可偵測帶 5′-三磷酸或 5′-二磷酸末端 的短雙股 RNA。配體結合加上 K63 連結的泛素化會釋出其 N 端 CARD，CARD 核化成絲狀體並驅動 MAVS (IPS-1) 在粒線體外膜、MAM 與過氧化體上聚集，將 RIG-I 的辨識轉為下游訊息傳遞。

label: GADD45
description: FOXO4 deacetylation by SIRT1 enhances expression of GADD45 and suppresses caspase-3/7 activity, promoting DNA repair over apoptosis. Directionally, SIRT1 activates FOXO4, which induces GADD45. This biases cells toward damage repair rather than death, and it is a further example of SIRT1 steering stress responses toward survival and genome maintenance. By inducing GADD45, FOXO4 supports nucleotide-excision repair and cell-cycle arrest, giving cells time to repair damage. This survival-oriented program is central to SIRT1's cytoprotective functions.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1對FOXO4的去乙醯化增強了GADD45的表達並抑制caspase-3/7活性，促進DNA修復而非細胞凋亡。方向上，SIRT1活化FOXO4，後者誘導GADD45。這使細胞傾向於損傷修復而非死亡，是SIRT1將壓力反應引導至存活和基因組維護的又一例證。透過誘導GADD45，FOXO4支持核苷酸切除修復和細胞週期停滯，為細胞提供修復損傷的時間。這種以存活為導向的程序是SIRT1細胞保護功能的核心。

label: necrosome
description: TNF-α binding to TNFR1 assembles complex I (RIPK1, TRADD, TRAF2, LUBAC, cIAP1, CYLD, NEMO). When NF-κB activation is suppressed, RIPK1 deubiquitinates and assembles complex IIa (ripoptosome) with FADD, TRADD, and pro-caspase-8 for apoptosis; with cIAP1 inhibited, complex IIb forms. Only when caspase-8 is absent or inhibited does RIPK1 recruit RIPK3 and MLKL into the necrosome — making TNF signaling a three-way fate decision in which the necrosome is the final, caspase-suppressed branch.
description_zh_TW: TNF-α 與 TNFR1 結合會組裝 complex I（RIPK1、TRADD、TRAF2、LUBAC、cIAP1、CYLD、NEMO）。當 NF-κB 活化受抑制時，RIPK1 去泛素化並與 FADD、TRADD 及 pro-Caspase-8 組裝出 complex IIa（ripoptosome）以進行細胞凋亡；當 cIAP1 受抑制時則形成 complex IIb。只有當 caspase-8 缺席或受抑制時，RIPK1 才會招募 RIPK3 與 MLKL 組成 necrosome——使 TNF 訊號成為三向的命運決定，而 necrosome 是 caspase 受壓制後的最終分支。

label: 1,3-Bisphosphoglycerate
description: GAPDH catalyzes the NAD+-dependent conversion of Glyceraldehyde 3-Phosphate to the high-energy glycolytic intermediate 1,3-Bisphosphoglycerate, generating NADH in the process. Because the step consumes NAD+, senescent cells with a lowered NAD+/NADH ratio form less 1,3-Bisphosphoglycerate, which curtails glycolytic ATP production.
description_zh_TW: GAPDH 以 NAD+ 依賴的方式將 Glyceraldehyde 3-Phosphate 轉換成高能糖解中間產物 1,3-Bisphosphoglycerate，並同時生成 NADH。由於此步驟需要 NAD+，NAD+/NADH 比值下降的衰老細胞生成的 1,3-Bisphosphoglycerate 較少，因而抑制糖解產 ATP。

label: KPNB1
description: Importin-beta1 KPNB1 mediates NLS-dependent nuclear import as its primary function.
description_zh_TW: Importin-β1 KPNB1 以 NLS 依賴核輸入為主要功能。

label: DNAmGrimAge
description: DNAmGrimAge is a second-generation epigenetic clock trained to predict morbidity, mortality, and physiological decline rather than simply chronological age. It incorporates DNA methylation surrogates for plasma proteins and smoking exposure, producing a DNAm-based age estimate that is a robust predictor of lifespan and healthspan. As a stronger predictor of time-to-death than first-generation clocks such as the Horvath and Hannum clocks, GrimAge is widely used as an endpoint in aging and rejuvenation studies.
description_zh_TW: DNAmGrimAge 是第二代表觀遺傳時鐘，經過訓練可以預測發病率、死亡率和生理衰退，而不僅僅是實際年齡。它結合了血漿蛋白和吸煙暴露的 DNA 甲基化替代物，產生基於 DNAm 的年齡估計，這是壽命和健康壽命的強大預測因子。作為比第一代時鐘（例如 Horvath 和 Hannum 時鐘）更強大的死亡時間預測器，GrimAge 被廣泛用作衰老和復興研究的終點。

label: Phosphorylation
description: Phosphorylation is a definitional post-translational protein modification.
description_zh_TW: 磷酸化是定義性的轉譯後蛋白修飾。

label: Respiratory Burst
description: The Respiratory Burst is the rapid, coordinated release of Reactive Oxygen Species — superoxide and Hydrogen Peroxide — by cells such as Neutrophils and macrophages as part of the innate immune response, and it is one of the major endogenous sources of Reactive Oxygen Species during inflammation.
description_zh_TW: Respiratory Burst 是 Neutrophils 與巨噬細胞等細胞在先天免疫反應中快速大量釋放 Reactive Oxygen Species（超氧陰離子與 Hydrogen Peroxide）的過程，也是發炎時 Reactive Oxygen Species 的主要內源性來源之一。

label: Viral Replication
description: PARP-mediated MARylation of viral proteins is required for inhibition of viral replication. As the innate immune response activates during infection, extensive DNA Damage and IFN-induced mono-ADP-ribosylation activate PARPs; the antiviral effect is then reversed by the ADP-ribosylhydrolase macrodomain of the viral nonstructural protein nsp3, whose de-MARylation activity is required for SARS-CoV-2 virulence.
description_zh_TW: 藉由 PARP 媒介對病毒蛋白的 MARylation 是抑制 viral replication 所必需的。感染期間先天免疫反應活化時，廣泛的 DNA Damage 與 IFN 誘發的單 ADP 核糖基化活化 PARP；隨後此抗病毒效應會被病毒非結構蛋白 nsp3 的 ADP-核糖基水解酶 macrodomain 反轉，其去 MARylation 活性為 SARS-CoV-2 毒力所必需。

label: MEK
description: RAF kinases phosphorylate MEK1/2 once recruited to the membrane by RAS-GTP, and MEK in turn activates ERK1/2. RAF/MEK is also the axis behind RAS-RAF-MEK-dependent oxidative cell death described by Yagoda et al. involving VDAC, the iron-dependent death that preceded the formal naming of ferroptosis, and Raf/MEK is a ferroptosis-modulating route in hepatocellular carcinoma.
description_zh_TW: RAF 激酶在被 RAS-GTP 招募至膜上後磷酸化 MEK1/2，MEK 再活化 ERK1/2。RAF/MEK 也是 Yagoda 等人所描述的 RAS-RAF-MEK 依賴性氧化細胞死亡（涉及 VDAC）的軸線，那種鐵依賴性死亡早於 ferroptosis 的正式命名；而在肝細胞癌中，Raf/MEK 是調節 ferroptosis 的路徑。

label: CDKN1C
description: CDKN1C (p57) is expressed from the maternal allele only under KvDMR1 imprinting control. This parent-of-origin regulation links cell-cycle control to epigenetic inheritance.
description_zh_TW: CDKN1C（p57）僅在 KvDMR1 銘印控制下從母系等位基因表現。此親源調節將細胞週期控制連結到表觀遺傳繼承。

label: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
description: Hydroxychloroquine is first-line systemic therapy for Systemic Lupus Erythematosus: it reduces flare frequency and disease activity, and mechanistically it interferes with TLR7/9-dependent nucleic acid sensing that drives the type I interferon loop of the disease.
description_zh_TW: Hydroxychloroquine 是 Systemic Lupus Erythematosus 的一線全身性治療：可降低發作頻率與疾病活性，機制上則是干擾 TLR7/9 依賴的核酸辨識，而此路徑正是該病第一型干擾素迴圈的驅動力。

label: Alpha-Synuclein Aggregation
description: Alpha-synuclein is biochemically converted into Alpha-Synuclein Aggregation through a defined reaction step in catecholamine pigment or neurotransmitter metabolism. Mechanistically, Alpha-synuclein acts as the substrate and Alpha-Synuclein Aggregation as the product, often via oxidation, cyclization, or enzymatic decarboxylation. This conversion is biologically significant because it channels labile intermediates into stable products or active transmitters, with implications for neuromelanin accumulation and neuronal health. A caveat is that the precise stoichiometry and subcellular conditions governing the step are not fully resolved and may depend on local iron, pH, and antioxidant capacity.
description_zh_TW: Alpha-synuclein 透過兒茶酚胺色素或神經傳導物質代謝中的特定反應步驟生化轉化為 Alpha-Synuclein Aggregation。從機制上講，Alpha-synuclein 作為底物，Alpha-Synuclein Aggregation 作為產物，通常透過 oxidation、環化或酶促脫羧作用。這種轉化具有重要的生物學意義，因為它將不穩定的中間體轉化為穩定的產物或活性遞質，對 neuromelanin 累積和神經元健康產生影響。需要注意的是，控制該步驟的精確化學計量和亞細胞條件尚未完全解決，可能取決於局部 iron、pH 和抗氧化能力。

label: Skeletal Muscle
description: Approximately 95 percent of the body's creatine is stored in skeletal muscle, where it exists partly as free creatine and partly as creatine phosphate. The muscle creatine pool is maintained by both endogenous synthesis and dietary intake, and it is depleted by high-intensity activity and resynthesized during recovery. Muscle total creatine concentrations can be increased by supplementation, typically by 10-20 percent, and this elevated store extends the time for which high-intensity exercise can be sustained. The predominance of skeletal muscle as a creatine depot explains why most creatine research has focused on muscle function, strength, and performance.
description_zh_TW: 人體約 95% 的肌酸儲存於骨骼肌，其中一部分以游離肌酸形式存在，一部分以磷酸肌酸形式存在。肌肉肌酸池由內源性合成與飲食攝取共同維持，會因高強度活動而耗竭，並在恢復期間重新合成。補充可使肌肉總肌酸濃度增加，通常為 10–20%，而提高的儲備可延長高強度運動得以持續的時間。骨骼肌作為肌酸儲存庫的主導地位，說明了為何大多數肌酸研究都聚焦於肌肉功能、肌力與運動表現。

label: ICAD
description: Caspase-3 cleaves ICAD. Caspase-3 is the principal executioner caspase that cleaves hundreds of substrates to produce the apoptotic phenotype. ICAD is the inhibitor of caspase-activated DNase that, upon caspase-3 cleavage, releases CAD to fragment nuclear DNA. The relationship is directional, with Caspase-3 acting as the operative agent upon ICAD rather than the reverse. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-3 分裂 ICAD。 Caspase-3 是主要的劊子手半胱天冬酶，可切割數百個底物以產生凋亡表型。 ICAD 是 caspase 活化的 DNase 抑制劑，在 caspase-3 裂解時，釋放 CAD 以片段化核 DNA。這種關係是有方向的，Caspase-3 充當 ICAD 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

label: SARS-CoV-2
description: SARS-CoV-2 is a positive-sense single-stranded RNA virus of the Coronaviridae family (genus Betacoronavirus) and the causative agent of COVID-19, a respiratory disease that emerged as a global pandemic in 2020. It enters cells when its club-shaped spike protein binds the host angiotensin-converting enzyme 2, with spike priming by host proteases; after membrane fusion the viral RNA is released into the cytosol, translated and replicated.
description_zh_TW: SARS-CoV-2 是冠狀病毒科（Betacoronavirus 屬）的正股單股 RNA 病毒，也是 COVID-19 的致病因子——一種於 2020 年成為全球大流行的呼吸道疾病。當其棒狀的棘蛋白與宿主的血管張力素轉換酶 2 結合時病毒進入細胞，棘蛋白需先經宿主蛋白酶切割加工；膜融合後病毒 RNA 釋放至細胞質並被轉譯、複製。

label: TGF-β Signaling
description: SIRT7 inactivation reduces breast cancer metastasis by blocking TGF-β signalling. SIRT7 deacetylase activity inhibits metastasis of breast cancer by antagonising transforming growth factor-β signalling. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of TGF-β-driven metastasis in breast cancer. By promoting TGF-β signalling, SIRT7 supports the metastatic spread of breast cancer cells, and its inactivation curbs this process regardless of changes in original tumour development.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7失活透過阻斷TGF-β訊號來減少乳腺癌轉移。SIRT7去乙醯酶活性透過拮抗轉化生長因子-β訊號來抑制乳腺癌轉移。方向上，SIRT7位於乳腺癌中TGF-β驅動的轉移的上游。透過促進TGF-β訊號，SIRT7支持乳腺癌細胞的轉移性擴散，其失活無論原始腫瘤發展的變化如何都限制了此過程。

label: Cell Cycle
description: Cell Division, in which a parent cell yields two or more daughter cells, is tightly governed by the Cell Cycle, with checkpoints ensuring accuracy of DNA replication and chromosome segregation. Key regulators include cyclin/CDK complexes, Rb/E2F, p53, and checkpoint kinases; dysregulated division is a hallmark of cancer.
description_zh_TW: Cell Division（細胞分裂，親代細胞產生兩個或更多子細胞）受到 Cell Cycle 的嚴密調控，並由檢查點確保 DNA 複製與染色體分離的正確性。主要調控因子包括 cyclin/CDK 複合體、Rb/E2F、p53 與檢查點激酶；失調的細胞分裂是 cancer 的特徵之一。

label: PML
description: PML-IV overexpression is sufficient to induce p53-dependent premature senescence, and loss of PML accelerates tumorigenesis, establishing PML as a tumor suppressor. Directionally, PML sits upstream of senescence. This process engages SIRT1 and p53 at PML nuclear bodies, and it contextualizes SIRT1's role in proliferation arrest. By activating p53-dependent senescence, PML restricts uncontrolled proliferation and prevents tumor formation. The PML-SIRT1-p53 axis illustrates how a nuclear body can coordinate the decision between senescence, apoptosis, and proliferation.
description_zh_TW: PML-IV 過度表達足以誘導 p53 依賴性過早衰老，而 PML 的缺失加速腫瘤發生，確立 PML 為腫瘤抑制因子。在方向性上，PML 位於衰老的上游。此過程在 PML 核體中涉及 SIRT1 和 p53，並將 SIRT1 在增殖停滯中的角色置於背景中。透過活化 p53 依賴性衰老，PML 限制不受控制的增殖並防止腫瘤形成。PML-SIRT1-p53 軸線說明了核體如何協調衰老、凋亡和增殖之間的決定。

label: Mitochondrial Function
description: Mitochondrial function is the integrated physiological capacity of mitochondria to perform oxidative phosphorylation (ATP production via the electron transport chain), metabolite and ion homeostasis, redox balance, dynamics, quality control and stress signalling. Respiratory capacity is the primary readout of that function.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial function 是粒線體執行 oxidative phosphorylation（經電子傳遞鏈產生 ATP）、代謝物與離子恆定、氧化還原平衡、動態、品質管制與壓力訊號的整合生理能力。呼吸能力是衡量此功能的 主要讀值。

label: Dextromethorphan
description: The most important safety concern for dextromethorphan is its interaction with serotonergic drugs. Combined use with a Monoamine Oxidase Inhibitor (such as Methylene blue, phenelzine, or selegiline) can precipitate serotonin syndrome — a life-threatening condition of hyperthermia, clonus, agitation, and autonomic instability — so the combination is contraindicated.
description_zh_TW: Dextromethorphan 最重要的安全問題是與血清素活化藥物的交互作用。與 Monoamine Oxidase Inhibitor（如 Methylene blue、phenelzine、selegiline）併用可能誘發 serotonin syndrome — 一種高熱、陣攣、焦躁與自律神經不穩定的致命狀況，因此此組合屬禁忌。

label: NMNAT
description: NMNAT (nicotinamide mononucleotide adenylyltransferase) catalyzes the final committed step in NAD+ biosynthesis, transferring an AMP moiety from ATP onto NMN (or NaMN) to yield NAD+ (or NAAD). All three mammalian NAD+ routes — de novo from Tryptophan, the NAMPT-driven salvage pathway, and the Preiss-Handler pathway — converge on this single NMNAT-catalyzed step.
description_zh_TW: NMNAT（nicotinamide mononucleotide adenylyltransferase）催化 NAD+ 生合成的最後定案步驟，將 ATP 的 AMP 基團轉移至 NMN（或 NaMN）上以生成 NAD+（或 NAAD）。哺乳類三條 NAD+ 途徑——由 Tryptophan 起始的 de novo 合成、NAMPT 驅動的 salvage pathway，以及 Preiss-Handler pathway——全都收斂於這一個 NMNAT 催化的步驟。

label: Mice
description: Only mitochondria-targeted catalase (mCAT) extends median lifespan ~20% (Schriner 2005); cytosolic catalase is null (Perez 2009). Qualified subject replaces the overstated generic edge.
description_zh_TW: 僅粒線體標靶 catalase（mCAT）延長中位壽命約 20%（Schriner 2005）；胞質 catalase 無效（Perez 2009）。限定主詞取代誇大的通用邊。

label: Heat Shock Proteins
description: Heat shock proteins are a conserved family of molecular chaperones induced by proteotoxic, thermal, oxidative, and exercise stress. Their expression is coordinated transcriptionally by heat shock factor HSF1, which binds heat-shock elements to drive HSP induction.
description_zh_TW: 熱休克蛋白是保守的分子伴護蛋白家族，由蛋白毒性、熱、氧化與運動壓力誘導。其表現由熱休克因子 HSF1 在轉錄層面協調，HSF1 結合熱休克元件驅動 HSP 誘導。

label: narcolepsy
description: Narcolepsy is a chronic neurological sleep disorder of excessive daytime sleepiness with disrupted nocturnal sleep. Classification anchors it in sleep medicine rather than psychiatry.
description_zh_TW: narcolepsy 是以日間過度嗜睡與夜間睡眠中斷為特徵的慢性神經性睡眠疾患。歸類將它錨定於睡眠醫學而非精神科。

label: LipA
description: LIPL-1 is a lysosomal lipase in C. elegans that co-localizes with the lysosomal marker PGP-2, confirming its residence within the lysosomal lumen where it hydrolyzes stored triglycerides. Its expression is induced by HLH-30 during fasting, supporting lipophagy-mediated lipid mobilization. LIPL-1 is part of a family of lysosomal lipases (lipl-1 through lipl-5) that together govern organismal lipid turnover. Loss or reduction of these lipases impairs the ability to survive nutrient scarcity.
description_zh_TW: LIPL-1 是線蟲中的一種溶酶體脂肪酶，與溶酶體標記 PGP-2 共定位，確認其位於溶酶體腔內，在此水解儲存的甘油三酯。其表現在禁食期間受 HLH-30 誘發，支持脂噬介導的脂質動員。LIPL-1 是溶酶體脂肪酶家族（lipl-1 至 lipl-5）的一員，共同掌管生物體的脂質週轉。這些脂肪酶的缺失或減少會損害在營養匱乏中存活的能力。

label: PGP-2
description: PGP-2 is a C. elegans ABC (ATP-binding cassette) transporter localized to lysosome-related organelle (LRO) membranes that is essential for their biogenesis; these LROs — the gut granules — serve as fat storage sites. Its absence results in loss of gut granules and altered lipid storage, and it co-localizes with the lysosomal lipases LIPL-1 and LIPL-3.
description_zh_TW: PGP-2 是 C. elegans 的 ABC（ATP 結合盒）轉運蛋白，定位於溶酶體相關胞器（LRO）膜上，對其生成不可或缺；這些 LRO（即腸顆粒）是脂肪儲存場所。PGP-2 缺失會造成腸顆粒消失與脂質儲存改變，且它與溶酶體脂肪酶 LIPL-1 與 LIPL-3 共定位。

label: Vasoconstriction
description: Basal endothelial Nitric Oxide (NO) opposes vasoconstriction via the NO → Soluble Guanylyl Cyclase → cGMP relaxation pathway. When this cascade is blocked — as with methylene blue in vasoplegia — net vasoconstriction and a rise in blood pressure result.
description_zh_TW: 基礎狀態下的內皮 Nitric Oxide（NO）經由 NO → Soluble Guanylyl Cyclase → cGMP 的放鬆途徑對抗 vasoconstriction。當此級聯被阻斷（例如 vasoplegia 中使用 methylene blue），便會造成淨 vasoconstriction 與血壓上升。

label: Messenger RNA
description: Messenger RNA is a single-stranded RNA molecule transcribed from DNA by RNA polymerase II that carries the coding sequence for a protein, serving as the template for translation at the ribosome. In this way mRNA is the central effector that links genotype to phenotype and is the final substrate on which gene expression acts.
description_zh_TW: Messenger RNA 是由 RNA 聚合酶 II 從 DNA 轉錄出的單股 RNA 分子，攜帶蛋白質的編碼序列，並作為核糖體上轉譯的模板。mRNA 因此是連接基因型與表型的核心效應分子，也是基因表現最終作用其上的作用對象。

label: 5-Fluorouracil
description: Thymidylate synthase is the principal target of 5-fluorouracil: its active metabolite FdUMP forms a lethal ternary complex with the enzyme and folate, depleting thymidine pools, triggering DNA repair stress and apoptosis in dividing cells. Fenbendazole overcomes 5-FU-resistant colorectal cells by interfering with glycolysis rather than inhibiting thymidylate synthase.
description_zh_TW: Thymidylate synthase 是 5-Fluorouracil 的主要標的：其活性代謝物 FdUMP 與酵素及葉酸形成致死的三元複合體，耗竭胸腺嘧啶核苷池，在分裂細胞中引發 DNA 修復壓力與細胞凋亡。Fenbendazole 對抗 5-FU 抗藥性的結直腸癌細胞，是藉由干擾糖解作用而非抑制 thymidylate synthase。

label: Pro-inflammatory Cytokines
description: By deacetylating NF-κB, SIRT1 reduces transcription of TNF-α, IL-1β, and IL-6, dampening the inflammatory transcriptome. Directionally, SIRT1 deacetylation of NF-κB leads to lower cytokine output. This is mechanistically important in atherosclerosis, neurodegeneration, and metabolic inflammation, where sustained cytokine signaling drives tissue damage. Resveratrol leverages this axis to curb chronic low-grade inflammation, and SIRT6, SIRT2, and SIRT7 also restrain NF-κB through distinct mechanisms, making suppression of NF-κB-dependent cytokine production one of the most consistent anti-inflammatory actions across the sirtuin family.
description_zh_TW: 通過去乙醯化 NF-κB，SIRT1 降低 TNF-α、IL-1β 和 IL-6 的轉錄，抑制發炎轉錄組。在方向性上，SIRT1 對 NF-κB 的去乙醯化導致較低的細胞因子輸出。這在動脈粥樣硬化、神經退行性疾病和代謝性發炎中具有機制重要性，在這些疾病中持續的細胞因子信號驅動組織損傷。白藜蘆醇利用此軸來抑制慢性低度發炎，SIRT6、SIRT2 和 SIRT7 也通過不同機制限制 NF-κB，使抑制 NF-κB 依賴性細胞因子產生成為 sirtuin 家族中最一致的抗發炎作用之一。

label: CeTOR
source_file: _document_ - MXL-3 and HLH-30 transcriptionally link lipolysis and autophagy to nutrient availability.md
description: CeTOR, the C. elegans ortholog of mTOR, controls HLH-30 at the transcriptional level; inactivation of CeTOR induces hlh-30 expression, increasing the abundance of the master degradative transcription factor. This upstream control parallels mammalian mTORC1's post-translational repression of TFEB, adding a transcriptional layer in worms. By inducing HLH-30, CeTOR inhibition engages the full lysosomal-autophagic and lipolytic program. The relationship confirms mTOR as an evolutionarily conserved suppressor of the TFEB/HLH-30 axis.
description_zh_TW: CeTOR（線蟲的 mTOR 同源物）在轉錄層次控制 HLH-30；CeTOR 失活會誘發 hlh-30 表現，增加這個主降解轉錄因子的豐度。此上游控制類似於哺乳動物 mTORC1 對 TFEB 的轉譯後抑制，在線蟲中增添了轉錄層次。透過誘發 HLH-30，CeTOR 抑制啟動了完整的溶酶體—自噬性和脂解性程序。此關係確認了 mTOR 是 TFEB/HLH-30 軸演化上保守的抑制者。

label: Proteinuria
description: Long-term consumption of dietary advanced glycation end products (AGEs) in rats leads to a dose-dependent increase in proteinuria that over time could induce renal damage. Chronic dietary AGE excess reproduces in animals some of the renal and metabolic features seen in aging and diabetes, supporting the toxicity of a high-AGE diet to the kidney.
description_zh_TW: 大鼠長期攝取膳食 advanced glycation end products（AGEs）會造成劑量依賴性的 proteinuria 增加，長期下來可能誘發腎臟損傷。慢性膳食 AGE 過量在動物身上重現了 aging 與 diabetes 中部分腎臟與代謝特徵，支持高 AGE 飲食對腎臟的毒性。

label: Vincristine
description: Vincristine is the microtubule-targeting constituent of R-CHOP, a vinca alkaloid that disrupts the mitotic spindle in dividing cells. Its inclusion links the regimen to the same microtubule-disrupting logic exploited by microtubule-targeted repurposing candidates such as Fenbendazole.
description_zh_TW: Vincristine 是 R-CHOP 中作用於微管的成分，屬於 vinca alkaloid 類，能破壞分裂細胞的有絲分裂紡錘體。其納入使該方案與 Fenbendazole 等作用於微管再定位候選藥所利用的同一套微管破壞邏輯相連結。

label: PtdIns3P
description: PIKfyve phosphorylates PtdIns3P at the 5-position to produce PtdIns(3,5)P2 on endolysosomal membranes. This conversion is essential for endosomal maturation and for resolving autophagic cargo into the lysosome, and the early-endosome switch from Rab5/PtdIns3P to Rab7/PtdIns(3,5)P2 defines the early-to-late endosome transition.
description_zh_TW: PIKfyve 將 PtdIns3P 在 5 位磷酸化，生成內溶體膜上的 PtdIns(3,5)P2。此轉換對內體成熟與將自噬貨物送往溶酶體至關重要，而早期內體由 Rab5/PtdIns3P 轉換為 Rab7/PtdIns(3,5)P2，正定義了早到晚期內體的轉變。

label: Mesenchymal Stromal Cells
description: MSCs contribute to repair via trophic and differentiation effects. Contribution covers paracrine plus lineage mechanisms.
description_zh_TW: MSC 經由營養與分化效應貢獻修復。貢獻涵蓋旁分泌加譜系機制。

label: Epigenetic Modifiers
description: 5-Azacytidine is classified as an epigenetic modifier, specifically a DNA methyltransferase (DNMT) inhibitor, and it is among the first epigenetic drugs used in the clinic. As a cytidine analog, it is incorporated into DNA during replication, where it covalently traps DNMT enzymes and causes passive loss of DNA methylation, reactivating silenced genes such as tumor suppressors. This mechanism underlies its use in myelodysplastic syndromes and leukemia and its application in research on gene silencing, development, and aging.
description_zh_TW: 5-Azacytidine被歸類為表觀遺傳修飾劑，特別是DNA甲基轉移酶（DNMT）抑制劑，是第一批應用於臨床的表觀遺傳藥物之一。作為胞苷類似物，它在複製過程中摻入 DNA，共價捕獲 DNMT 酶並導致 DNA 甲基化被動丟失，從而重新激活腫瘤抑制基因等沉默基因。這種機制是其在骨髓增生異常綜合症和白血病中的應用及其在基因沉默、發育和老化研究中的應用的基礎。

label: CobB
description: The first bacterial sirtuin was found in Salmonella enterica and was named CobB due to its involvement in cobalamin biosynthesis and propionic catabolism. CobB demonstrates that sirtuins are not restricted to eukaryotes but are also present in prokaryotes, where they regulate various metabolic pathways. In bacteria one or two sirtuins are typically found, and CobB serves as the founding example of prokaryotic sirtuin biology.
description_zh_TW: 第一個細菌sirtuin在腸炎沙門氏菌中被發現，由於其參與鈷胺素生物合成和丙酸分解代謝而被命名為CobB。CobB證明了sirtuin並非僅限於真核生物，也存在於原核生物中，在那裡它們調節各種代謝途徑。在細菌中通常發現一到兩個sirtuin，CobB作為原核sirtuin生物學的奠基範例。

label: Ubiquitin-dependent 20S proteasome
description: Glycated proteins are normally removed from cells via ubiquitin-dependent 20S proteasome-mediated proteolysis, an important quality control pathway for damaged proteins. AGE modifications can disturb this proteolytic degradation, contributing to a further increase in the cellular content of glycated proteins. The resulting accumulation of glycated proteins is a hallmark of aging and is associated with loss of cellular function. Proteasomal degradation of glycated proteins is thus a key cellular defense against glycation stress, and its impairment creates a feed-forward loop of AGE accumulation.
description_zh_TW: Glycated proteins 通常經由 ubiquitin-dependent 20S proteasome-mediated proteolysis 從細胞中移除，這是 damaged proteins 的重要 quality control pathway。AGE modifications 會 disturb 此 proteolytic degradation，導致細胞內 glycated proteins 含量進一步增加。由此產生的 glycated proteins accumulation 是 aging 的標誌，並與 loss of cellular function 相關。因此，glycated proteins 的 proteasomal degradation 是對抗 glycation stress 的關鍵細胞防禦，而其 impairment 會創造 AGE accumulation 的 feed-forward loop。

label: Genomic Imprinting
description: DNMT1 is the maintenance methyltransferase that copies parental-origin methylation at imprinting control regions through mitosis, preserving Genomic Imprinting marks in every daughter cell.
description_zh_TW: DNMT1 是維持型甲基轉移酶，透過有絲分裂複製親代來源在 imprinting 控制區（ICR）的甲基化，在每個子細胞中保存 Genomic Imprinting（基因組印記）標記。

label: Kidney Fibrosis
description: Kidney fibrosis — pathological extracellular matrix accumulation in the renal tubulointerstitium and glomeruli with myofibroblast activation driven by TGF-beta, oxidative stress and metabolic dysfunction — is the final common pathway of nearly all progressive kidney diseases and the key determinant of progression to end-stage kidney disease. Fibrosis replaces functional nephrons with scar tissue, progressively losing filtration.
description_zh_TW: 腎臟纖維化——腎小管間質與腎小球中細胞外基質的病理性累積，伴隨由 TGF-beta、氧化壓力與代謝失調所驅動的肌成纖維細胞活化——是幾乎所有進展性腎病的最終共同途徑，也是進展至末期腎病的關鍵決定因子。纖維化以疤痕組織取代具功能的腎元，使濾過功能逐步喪失。

label: Ionizing Radiation
description: Ionizing radiation activates ATM kinase by causing DNA double-strand breaks that recruit and autophosphorylate ATM, which then phosphorylates Chk2, p53, and BRCA1 to coordinate the damage response. This initiates cell-cycle arrest and repair. The directionality is DNA break to kinase signaling cascade. A caveat is that ATM also responds to oxidative stress and replication stress, so its activation is not uniquely radiation-driven. ATM is considered the master coordinator of the DNA-damage response to double-strand breaks, integrating cell-cycle arrest, repair, and apoptosis decisions.
description_zh_TW: Ionizing radiation 透過引起 DNA 雙股斷裂來活化 ATM kinase，從而募集 ATM 並使其自磷酸化，然後 ATM 磷酸化 Chk2、p53 和 BRCA1 以協調損傷反應。這啟動了細胞週期停滯和修復。方向性是 DNA 斷裂至激酶訊號級聯。需要注意的是，ATM 也會對 oxidative stress 和複製壓力做出反應，因此它的活化並不是唯一由輻射驅動的。 ATM 被認為是對雙股斷裂的 DNA 損傷反應的主協調員，整合了細胞週期停滯、修復和 apoptosis 決策。

label: slow COMT
description: In slow COMT variants, catechol clearance is reduced so endogenous catecholamines may accumulate, enhancing stress reactivity. Exogenous catechols can further inhibit the already sluggish enzyme and add methyl-group demand on the methylation cycle. This underlies the stress sensitivity and supplement intolerance often reported by slow COMT individuals.
description_zh_TW: 在緩慢的 COMT 變異中，兒茶酚清除減少，因此內源性 catecholamines 可能累積，增強壓力反應性。外源性兒茶酚可進一步抑制本已遲緩的酶，並增加對 methylation cycle 的甲基需求。這正是緩慢 COMT 個體常回報的壓力敏感性和補充劑不耐受的基礎。

label: Cardiomyopathy
description: Keshan disease is an endemic nutritional cardiomyopathy by definition. Classification places the selenium-deficiency disorder among myocardial diseases.
description_zh_TW: Keshan disease 依定義是地方性營養性心肌病。歸類將硒缺乏症置於心肌疾病之中。

label: Tangier disease
description: Tangier disease is a rare autosomal-recessive disorder caused by loss-of-function mutations in ABCA1, the cholesterol transporter central to cholesterol efflux. The resulting block of cholesterol transfer to apolipoprotein A-I produces the hallmark extremely low HDL and tissue cholesteryl ester accumulation, with enlarged orange tonsils and peripheral neuropathy.
description_zh_TW: Tangier disease 是一種罕見的體染色體隱性遺傳疾病，由 cholesterol efflux 核心運輸蛋白 ABCA1 的失功能突變所造成。Cholesterol 無法轉移給 apolipoprotein A-I，因而產生典型的 HDL 極低與組織膽固醇酯堆積，並出現扁桃體橘黃色增大與周邊神經病變。

label: ADP-ribose
description: Free ADP-ribose released by PARG/ARH3 hydrolysis of PAR binds the NUDT9-homology domain of TRPM2 and opens the channel to Ca2+, linking PARP1 hyperactivation in Parthanatos to calcium influx and downstream Calpain and mitochondrial permeability transition.
description_zh_TW: 由 PARG/ARH3 水解 PAR 釋出的游離 ADP-ribose 會結合 TRPM2 的 NUDT9 同源結構域並開啟通道讓 Ca2+ 通過，將 Parthanatos 中的 PARP1 過度活化連結到鈣離子流入及下游的 Calpain 與粒線體通透性轉換。

label: Indole-3-propionic acid
description: Clostridium sporogenes is an anaerobic, spore-forming gut commensal and the best-characterized producer of Indole-3-propionic acid, reducing Tryptophan through indole-pyruvate to indole-3-lactate and then IPA. IPA is a circulating radical-scavenging metabolite acting on host Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor and Pregnane X Receptor signalling.
description_zh_TW: Clostridium sporogenes 是厭氧、能形成芽孢的腸道共生菌，也是 Indole-3-propionic acid 最具表征的產生菌，經由 indole-pyruvate 將 Tryptophan 還原為 indole-3-lactate 再生成 IPA。IPA 是循環中的自由基清除代謝物，作用於宿主 Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor 與 Pregnane X Receptor 的訊息傳遞。

label: Rifampicin
description: Rifampicin activates the pregnane X receptor (PXR) in the liver, upregulating cytochrome P450 enzymes including CYP3A4 together with conjugating and transporting enzymes.
