Increased activity of these metabolic enzymes shortens the half-life and systemic exposure of co-administered drugs, making rifampicin a model perpetrator of drug-drug interactions.
description_zh_TW: Rifampicin 在肝臟活化 pregnane X receptor（PXR），上调細胞色素 P450 酵素（包含 CYP3A4）以及接合與運輸酵素。這些代謝酵素活性上升會縮短併用藥物的半衰期並降低全身暴露量，使 rifampicin 成為典型的藥物交互作用元凶。

label: acute promyelocytic leukaemia
description: APL is the M3 subtype of acute myeloid leukemia.
description_zh_TW: APL 是急性骨髓性白血病的 M3 亞型。

label: Adenosine Triphosphate
description: Creatine kinase (CK) is the enzyme at the core of the creatine/phosphocreatine energy system. It catalyzes the reversible transfer of a phosphate group between creatine and ADP, using the free energy released from phosphocreatine breakdown (approximately 10.3 kcal) to resynthesize ATP from ADP and inorganic phosphate. This provides a rapid means of replenishing depleted ATP during high-energy-demand states such as intense exercise or conditions where energy production is impaired (ischemia, hypoxia) or insufficient due to increased demand (mental fatigue, disease states). Cytosolic, glycolytic, and mitochondrial CK isoforms cooperate to buffer ATP/ADP ratios and shuttle high-energy phosphate from mitochondria to sites of ATP consumption.
description_zh_TW: 肌酸激酶（CK）是肌酸/磷酸肌酸能量系統核心的酶。它催化磷酸基團在肌酸與 ADP 之間的可逆轉移，利用磷酸肌酸分解所釋放的自由能（約 10.3 千卡），從 ADP 與無機磷酸再合成 ATP。這提供了在高能量需求狀態下快速補充耗竭 ATP 的手段，例如劇烈運動，或能量產生受損（缺血、缺氧）或因需求增加而不足（精神疲勞、疾病狀態）的情況。細胞質、糖解與粒線體 CK 異構型協同作用，以緩衝 ATP/ADP 比值，並將高能磷酸從粒線體穿梭至 ATP 消耗的位置。

label: Warfarin
description: Warfarin is an oral anticoagulant that inhibits vitamin K epoxide reductase (VKORC1), blocking the recycling of oxidized vitamin K to its reduced form and thereby preventing the gamma-carboxylation and activation of clotting factors II, VII, IX and X along with the regulatory proteins protein C and protein S.
description_zh_TW: Warfarin 是一种口服抗凝血劑，抑制維生素 K 環氧化物還原酶（VKORC1），阻斷氧化態維生素 K 還原為其還原態，因而阻止凝血因子 II、VII、IX、X 以及調節性蛋白質 protein C 與 protein S 的 γ-羧化與活化。

label: Enzalutamide
description: Enzalutamide (Xtandi) is a second-generation androgen receptor (AR) antagonist that blocks AR nuclear translocation.
description_zh_TW: Enzalutamide (Xtandi) 是一種第二代雄激素受體 (AR) 拮抗劑，阻斷 AR 核轉位。

label: Biphasic Dose Response
description: Varying hypoxia intensity or duration produces inverted-U or J-shaped responses in antioxidant enzymes, e.g. scallop SOD rising 15-50% at 12 h then falling 40-60% over days. Pacific white shrimp SOD and GPX show similar inverted-U curves, meeting quantitative hormesis criteria.
description_zh_TW: 改變 Hypoxia 強度或持續時間會在抗氧化酵素中產生倒 U 形或 J 形反應，例如扇貝 SOD 在 12 小時上升 15-50%，數天後下降 40-60%。太平洋白蝦的 SOD 與 GPX 也呈現類似倒 U 形曲線，符合定量的 hormesis 標準。

label: Thymidine
description: Excess thymidine induces potent replication stress via dNTP pool imbalance. Imbalance stalls forks as effectively as polymerase inhibition.
description_zh_TW: 過量 thymidine 經由 dNTP 池失衡誘發強效複製壓力。失衡使複製叉停滯，效力等同聚合酶抑制。

label: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease
description: Emphysema is a subtype of COPD defined by permanent enlargement of the airspaces distal to the terminal bronchioles with destruction of their walls and no obvious fibrosis. Cigarette smoking is the dominant risk factor, with occupational dusts, air pollution and alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency also predisposing.
description_zh_TW: 肺氣腫是 COPD 的一個型態，其定義為終末細支氣管遠端氣腔永久性擴大且其壁被破壞，並無明顯纖維化。吸菸是主要危險因子，職業粉塵、空氣污染與 alpha-1 antitrypsin 缺乏亦為易感因素。

label: Lymphatic Filariasis
description: Brugia malayi is a filarial nematode and one of the three causative agents of Lymphatic Filariasis, alongside Wuchereria bancrofti and Brugia timori. Adult worms reside in lymphatic vessels and lymph nodes, viviparous females release sheathed microfilariae with nocturnal periodicity into the bloodstream, and chronic infection produces lymphangitis, lymphedema, elephantiasis and tropical pulmonary eosinophilia.
description_zh_TW: Brugia malayi 是絲蟲類線蟲，與 Wuchereria bancrofti、Brugia timori 並列為 Lymphatic Filariasis（淋巴絲蟲病）三大致病原之一。成蟲寄生於淋巴管與淋巴結，胎生的雌蟲釋出具鞘微絲蟲並呈夜間週期性出現在血流中；慢性感染會造成淋巴管炎、淋巴水腫、象皮病與熱帶肺嗜酸性粒細胞症。

label: Liver
description: The urea cycle is a liver mitochondrial and cytosolic pathway that converts toxic ammonia from amino-acid catabolism into urea for excretion via five enzymes, notably carbamoyl phosphate synthetase 1, ornithine transcarbamylase, argininosuccinate synthetase, argininosuccinate lyase and arginase.
description_zh_TW: 尿素循環是肝臟中粒線體與胞質的途徑，由五種酵素（尤其是 carbamoyl phosphate synthetase 1、ornithine transcarbamylase、argininosuccinate synthetase、argininosuccinate lyase 與 arginase）將胺基酸分解產生的有毒氨轉為尿素以排出體外。

label: Cell-to-Cell Fusion-Induced Senescence
description: CFIS produces a stable senescent phenotype withdrawn from the cycle. Classification places fusion arrest in the senescence family.
description_zh_TW: CFIS 產生退出週期的穩定衰老表型。歸類將融合停滯置於衰老家族。

label: Vitamin B6
description: Its active form, pyridoxal 5'-phosphate (PLP), is a cofactor for over 140 enzymatic reactions. As cofactor of Aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase it enables synthesis of Dopamine, Serotonin and Norepinephrine; it is also required for homocysteine metabolism via cystathionine beta-synthase and serves as a cofactor for serine hydroxymethyltransferase in the methylation cycle.
description_zh_TW: 其活性形式 pyridoxal 5'-phosphate（PLP）是超過 140 種酵素反應的輔因子。作為 Aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase 的輔因子，它使 Dopamine、Serotonin 與 Norepinephrine 的合成得以進行；同時也透過 cystathionine beta-synthase 參與 homocysteine 代謝，並在 methylation 循環中作為 serine hydroxymethyltransferase 的輔因子。

label: Macular Degeneration
description: Age is the dominant risk factor for macular degenerative blindness.
description_zh_TW: 年齡是黃斑部退化失明的主要危險因子。

label: Calpain
description: Ca2+ overload is the sustained rise of cytosolic free calcium from ~100 nM toward micromolar levels after ATP-dependent extrusion fails, via reverse-mode Na+/Ca2+ exchange, voltage-gated channels and ER release. It is a point-of-no-return intermediate in necrosis: calcium activates calpain cysteine proteases, opens the mitochondrial permeability transition pore, stimulates phospholipases and loads mitochondria until membrane potential collapses. Calcium chelation protects renal ischemia-reperfusion and H2O2 models but not MNNG parthanatos, making the step context-obligatory rather than universal.
description_zh_TW: Ca2+ overload 是 ATP 依賴性排出失效後，經由 Na+/Ca2+ 交換體反向模式、電壓閘控通道與內質網釋放，使胞質游離鈣由約 100 nM 上升至微莫耳濃度。它是壞死過程中無法回頭的中間步驟：鈣會活化 calpain 半胱胺酸蛋白酶、開啟粒線體通透性轉換孔、刺激磷脂酶並使粒線體負載鈣，直至膜電位崩潰。鈣螯合可保護腎臟缺血再灌流與 H2O2 模型，但無法保護 MNNG 引發的 parthanatos，顯示此步驟依情境而定並非普遍必要。

label: Caspase-7
description: Caspase-7 (CMH-1, ICE-LAP3) is an executioner (effector) protease, synthesized as an inactive procaspase-7 with p20 and p10 catalytic subunits. It is functionally redundant with Caspase-3 but has distinct substrate preferences and upstream regulation, playing a non-redundant role in endoplasmic reticulum stress and certain tissue contexts.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-7（CMH-1、ICE-LAP3）是執行者（效應）蛋白酶，以含 p20 與 p10 催化次單元的不活化 procaspase-7 形式合成。它與 Caspase-3 功能冗餘，但具有不同的受質偏好與上游調控，並在內質網壓力與特定組織情境中扮演不可替代的角色。

label: Lipotoxicity
description: Lipotoxicity is cellular and tissue injury arising when lipid intermediates accumulate ectopically in non-adipose tissues. Excess fatty-acid delivery or incomplete oxidation produces diacylglycerol, ceramides and long-chain acyl-CoAs that activate protein kinase C and mTOR and inhibit insulin signalling, making lipotoxicity a key mechanism linking obesity and ectopic fat to insulin resistance and type 2 diabetes.
description_zh_TW: Lipotoxicity 是脂質中間產物在非脂肪組織異位累積所造成的細胞與組織損傷。過量脂肪酸輸送或氧化不完全會產生 diacylglycerol、ceramides 與長鏈 acyl-CoA，活化 protein kinase C 與 mTOR 並抑制胰島素訊號，因此 lipotoxicity 是連結肥胖、異位脂肪與胰島素阻抗及第二型糖尿病的關鍵機制。

label: APP
description: APP is a type I transmembrane glycoprotein whose sequential proteolysis generates the Amyloid Beta Peptide. In the amyloidogenic pathway, Beta-Secretase 1 cleaves full-length APP at Asp671 on endosomal luminal surfaces to release sAPPβ and the membrane-tethered CTFβ/C99, which the Gamma-Secretase complex then cleaves intramembranously to liberate Aβ40 or the more aggregation-prone Aβ42. The Aβ42/Aβ40 ratio is a critical determinant of Amyloid Plaque formation in Alzheimer's Disease.
description_zh_TW: APP 是第一型跨膜醣蛋白，其依序的蛋白水解會產生 Amyloid Beta Peptide。在類澱粉樣路徑中，Beta-Secretase 1 在內體腔面切割 Asp671 位置的完整長度 APP，釋出 sAPPβ 與膜錨定的 CTFβ/C99，隨後由 Gamma-Secretase 複合體在膜內切割，釋放 Aβ40 或更易聚集的 Aβ42。Aβ42/Aβ40 比例是 Alzheimer's Disease 中 Amyloid Plaque 形成的關鍵決定因素。

label: Nitric Oxide Synthase
description: L-arginine is converted by nitric oxide synthase in a two-step monooxygenase reaction requiring NADPH, FAD, FMN, tetrahydrobiopterin, and heme. The enzyme first forms N-hydroxyarginine and then releases NO and citrulline. The directionality is enzyme-catalyzed oxidation of arginine to NO. A caveat is that uncoupled NOS, lacking BH4 or arginine, diverts the reaction to superoxide instead of NO. When BH4 or L-arginine is limiting, NOS becomes uncoupled and produces superoxide instead of NO, so substrate availability also shapes the enzyme's redox output.
description_zh_TW: L-arginine 在需要 NADPH、FAD、FMN、tetrahydrobiopterin 和血紅素的兩步驟單加氧酶反應中由 nitric oxide synthase 轉化。此酵素首先形成 N-羥基精氨酸，然後釋放 NO 和瓜氨酸。方向性是酵素催化精胺酸氧化成NO。需要注意的是，未偶聯的 NOS，缺乏 BH4 或精氨酸，會將反應轉向超氧化物而不是 NO。當 BH4 或 L-arginine 受到限制時，NOS 會解偶聯並產生超氧化物而不是 NO，因此底物可用性也會影響酵素的氧化還原輸出。

label: Major Histocompatibility Complex
description: The T Cell Receptor recognizes antigenic peptides only in the context of MHC molecules: TCR complementarity-determining regions engage peptide-MHC, Lck then phosphorylates CD3 ITAMs, and ZAP-70 with NF-AT, AP-1 and NF-κB downstream drive proliferation, cytokine production and effector differentiation.
description_zh_TW: T Cell Receptor 只能在 MHC 分子的脈絡中辨識抗原胜肽：TCR 的互補決定區與胜肽-MHC 結合後，Lck 磷酸化 CD3 的 ITAM，接著 ZAP-70 與下游的 NF-AT、AP-1、NF-κB 驅動增殖、細胞激素生成與效應分化。

label: Satellite Cells
description: Muscle stem cells and satellite cells name the same Pax7+ population positionally. Single alias pair kept; mirror dropped on dedup.
description_zh_TW: 肌肉幹細胞與衛星細胞按位置命名同一 Pax7+ 群體。僅保留單一別名對；鏡像在去重中捨棄。

label: GM-CSF
description: GM-CSF activates the ERK2 pathway, which phosphorylates BAX at Thr167. This creates a recognition motif for Pin1, which locks BAX in an inactive state, preventing its mitochondrial translocation and protecting cells such as eosinophils from apoptosis.
description_zh_TW: GM-CSF 活化 ERK2 路徑，使 BAX 在 Thr167 被磷酸化。這形成 Pin1 的辨識基序，讓 Pin1 將 BAX 鎖定在不活化狀態，阻止其轉位至粒線體，保護嗜酸性球等細胞免於 apoptosis。

label: Excess Post-Exercise Oxygen Consumption
description: Excess post-exercise oxygen consumption (EPOC), also known as the afterburn effect, is the elevated oxygen consumption that persists after an exercise session and represents the energy expended in excess of resting values during recovery. EPOC accounts for a portion of the total energy cost of exercise beyond the exercise itself, typically contributing an additional 7-15 percent of the exercise energy cost depending on intensity and duration. Because EPOC elevates the metabolic rate for hours after training, it is often cited to justify high-intensity training for weight management, although Speakman's analysis argues that the quantitative contribution to total daily expenditure is smaller than commonly claimed.
description_zh_TW: 運動後過量耗氧（EPOC），又稱後燃效應（afterburn effect），是指運動結束後持續存在的升高耗氧量，代表恢復期間超過靜止值的能量消耗。EPOC佔運動總能量成本中運動本身之外的一部分，依強度與持續時間不同，通常額外貢獻運動能量成本的7–15%。由於EPOC在訓練後數小時內會提升代謝率，常被引用來支持以高強度訓練進行體重管理，儘管Speakman的分析主張其對每日總能量消耗的量化貢獻比常見宣稱來得小。

label: PARP inhibitors
description: PARP inhibitors exploit synthetic lethality: in cells deficient in BRCA1 or BRCA2 the loss of PARP1-mediated repair eliminates the last major break-fixing pathway, so olaparib, rucaparib, niraparib and talazoparib cause lethal double-strand break accumulation selectively in BRCA-mutant tumors. Talazoparib's potent PARP-trapping activity adds cytotoxicity but also a distinct toxicity profile.
description_zh_TW: PARP 抑制劑利用合成致死：在 BRCA1 或 BRCA2 缺陷的細胞中，失去 PARP1 介導的修復會剝除最後一條主要的斷裂修復途徑，因此 olaparib、rucaparib、niraparib 與 talazoparib 會選擇性地在 BRCA 突變腫瘤中造成致命的雙股斷裂累積。Talazoparib 強大的 PARP 捕捉活性增加了細胞毒性，也帶來不同的毒性輪廓。

label: TNFR1
description: TNFα binding to TNFR1 nucleates Complex I (TRADD/RIPK1/TRAF2/cIAPs/NEMO-IKK) for NF-κB survival signaling; when NF-κB output is blocked and caspase-8 inhibited the same receptor licenses the necrosome.
description_zh_TW: TNFα 結合 TNFR1 組裝 Complex I（TRADD/RIPK1/TRAF2/cIAPs/NEMO-IKK）啟動 NF-κB 生存訊號；當 NF-κB 受阻且 caspase-8 被抑制時，同一受體轉而准許 necrosome 形成。

label: Cytochrome b5 reductase
description: Cytochrome b5 reductase, also called NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase, is the enzyme that returns spontaneously formed methemoglobin (normally under 1-2% of total hemoglobin) to its functional ferrous Fe2+ state. By keeping hemoglobin in the ferrous state, this enzyme is what makes hemoglobin able to carry oxygen.
description_zh_TW: Cytochrome b5 reductase（又稱 NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase）是將自發形成的 methemoglobin（正常情況下佔總 hemoglobin 的 1–2% 以下）還原回具功能的 Fe2+ 狀態的酵素。藉由讓 hemoglobin 維持於 ferrous 狀態，此酵素使 hemoglobin 能夠攜帶氧氣。

label: Alpha-tocopherol
description: Alpha-tocopherol is the 5,7,8-trimethyl vitamer of Tocopherols and the reference form for vitamin E activity, supplying about 90% of plasma vitamin E. Its selective retention is kinetic rather than nutritional: alpha-tocopherol transfer protein binds the alpha form and resecretes it in VLDL while other vitamers are preferentially omega-hydroxylated by CYP4F2 and excreted in bile. Because the more highly methylated ring raises electron density on the phenolic oxygen and speeds H-atom transfer to a lipid peroxyl radical, alpha-tocopherol is both the most potent radical trap and the best alpha-TTP ligand.
description_zh_TW: Alpha-tocopherol 是 Tocopherols 中 5,7,8-三甲基的 vitamer，也是 vitamin E 活性的參考形式，約供應血漿中 90% 的 vitamin E。其選擇性保留是動力學而非營養學現象：alpha-tocopherol transfer protein 專一結合 alpha 型並以 VLDL 重新分泌，其他 vitamer 則主要被 CYP4F2 ω-羥化後經膽汁排出。由於環上甲基化程度越高，酚羥基氧的電子密度越大、對脂質過氧自由基的氫原子轉移越快，alpha-tocopherol 既是最強的自由基捕捉者，也是最好的 alpha-TTP 配體。

label: FUNDC1
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Activating FUNDC1-mediated autophagy clears damaged mitochondria, significantly reducing neuronal apoptosis and infarct volume after ischemia/hypoxia-reperfusion injury. The converse is also true: FUNDC1 knockout significantly worsens neural damage, making the hypoxia-inducible FUNDC1 axis a neuroprotective target in stroke and reperfusion injury.
description_zh_TW: 活化 FUNDC1 介導的自噬可清除受損粒線體，在缺血／缺氧再灌 injury 後顯著降低神經元 apoptosis 與梗死體積。反之亦然：FUNDC1 敲除會顯著加重神經損傷，使缺氧誘導的 FUNDC1 軸成為中風與再灌損傷中的神經保護標的。

label: Histone Methylation
description: Histone Methylation is a Histone Modification in which methyl groups are added to lysine or arginine residues on histone tails. Unlike acetylation it does not change histone charge; instead it creates docking sites for 'reader' proteins, and its transcriptional consequence depends on the residue and the number of methyl groups (mono-, di-, tri-methylation).
description_zh_TW: Histone Methylation 是一類 Histone Modification，將甲基加到組蛋白尾端的離胺酸或精胺酸殘基上。與乙醯化不同，它不改變組蛋白的電荷，而是創造讓「讀取者」蛋白質停靠的位點；其對轉錄的影響取決於殘基種類與甲基數目（單甲基、二甲基、三甲基）。

label: Basal Lamina
description: Basal lamina is a specialized sheet form of extracellular matrix. Classification nests it in ECM.
description_zh_TW: 基底膜是細胞外基質的特化片狀形式。歸類將它嵌套於 ECM。

label: Glyoxalase System
description: The Glyoxalase System is the primary cellular defense pathway against dicarbonyl stress and the accumulation of Advanced Glycation End Products. It detoxifies reactive dicarbonyl intermediates generated during Glycolysis and Lipid Peroxidation by sequentially acting GLO1 and GLO2 enzymes, and maintaining its activity is a primary target for reducing endogenous AGE accumulation and mitigating diabetic complications. Because the pathway requires Glutathione as a co-substrate, it becomes compromised under Oxidative Stress when GSH is depleted.
description_zh_TW: Glyoxalase System 是細胞對抗 dicarbonyl stress 與 Advanced Glycation End Products 累積的主要防禦途徑。它透過依序作用的 GLO1 與 GLO2 酵素，分解在 Glycolysis 與 Lipid Peroxidation 過程中產生的活性 dicarbonyl 中間體；維持此途徑活性是降低內源性 AGE 累積、減輕糖尿病併發症的主要著力點。由於該途徑需以 Glutathione 為共同受質，因此在 GSH 被耗竭的 Oxidative Stress 狀態下功能會受損。

label: TRAIL
source_file: Type I vs Type II Cells.md
description: Extrinsic Pathway is initiated by TRAIL. The extrinsic (death-receptor) apoptotic pathway is triggered by extracellular ligands engaging cell-surface death receptors and proceeds through the DISC. TRAIL (TNFSF10) is a death ligand that engages DR4 and DR5 to initiate extrinsic apoptosis with relative selectivity for malignant cells. The directionality runs from TRAIL toward Extrinsic Pathway, so TRAIL is the active agent and Extrinsic Pathway the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Extrinsic Pathway 由 TRAIL 發起。外在（死亡受體）細胞凋亡途徑由與細胞表面死亡受體結合的細胞外配體觸發，並透過 DISC 進行。 TRAIL (TNFSF10) 是一種死亡配體，它與 DR4 和 DR5 結合以啟動外源性細胞凋亡，對惡性細胞具有相對選擇性。方向性從 TRAIL 朝向 Extrinsic Pathway，因此 TRAIL 是活性劑，Extrinsic Pathway 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Hesperidin
description: Hesperidin contributes antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activity as a citrus flavanone, consistent with the flavonoid class pattern. Its COMT neutrality makes it usable where catechol flavonoids are not.
description_zh_TW: Hesperidin 作為柑橘黃烷酮貢獻抗氧化與抗發炎活性，符合類黃酮類別模式。其 COMT 中性使其在兒茶酚類黃酮不適用處可用。

label: KAP1
description: KAP1 (TRIM28/TIF1beta) is the universal corepressor for KRAB-zinc-finger transcription factors, recruiting SETDB1, HDACs and HP1alpha to build H3K9me3-dominated silent chromatin; SIRT6 mono-ADP-ribosylation promotes KAP1–HP1alpha interaction to package LINE-1 elements into repressive heterochromatin.
description_zh_TW: KAP1（TRIM28/TIF1β）是 KRAB 鋅指轉錄因子的通用共抑制因子，招募 SETDB1、HDAC 與 HP1α 建立以 H3K9me3 為主的沉默染色質；SIRT6 的單 ADP 核糖基化促進 KAP1–HP1α 交互作用，將 LINE-1 元素包裝進抑制性異染色質。

label: Eustress
description: Low-dose NaCl at 25 mM acts as eustress in hydroponically grown sunflower microgreens, stimulating rather than suppressing growth. Shoot fresh yield rose 58.7%, leaf area 81.4%, and root length 25.7% versus control. This stimulatory low-dose effect is the defining feature of eustress/hormesis.
description_zh_TW: 25 mM 低劑量 NaCl 在水耕向日葵苗菜中發揮 Eustress 作用，促進而非抑制生長。地上部鮮重增加 58.7%、葉面積增加 81.4%、根長增加 25.7%。這種低劑量刺激效應正是 eustress／hormesis 的定義特徵。

label: Senolytic Therapy
description: Tumor Microenvironment is targeted by Senolytic Therapy. The tumor microenvironment is the constellation of stromal, immune, vascular, and extracellular elements that nurture or restrain the malignant clone. Senolytic therapy selectively eliminates senescent cells to remove their SASP and has been explored to blunt therapy-induced relapse. The directionality runs from Senolytic Therapy toward Tumor Microenvironment, so Senolytic Therapy is the active agent and Tumor Microenvironment the recipient of the effect. Clinically, this positions the object as a therapeutic modality against the subject, though efficacy is shaped by biomarker selection and the eventual emergence of resistance.
description_zh_TW: Tumor Microenvironment 的目標是 Senolytic Therapy。 Tumor Microenvironment 是培育或抑制惡性克隆的基質、免疫、血管和細胞外元素的集合。 Senolytic 療法選擇性地消除衰老細胞以消除其SASP，並已被探索用於抑制治療引起的復發。方向性從 Senolytic Therapy 朝向 Tumor Microenvironment，因此 Senolytic Therapy 是活性劑，Tumor Microenvironment 是效果的接受者。在臨牀上，這將物體定位為針對受試者的治療方式，儘管功效是由生物標記的選擇和最終出現的抗藥性決定的。

label: Information Theory of Aging
description: Sinclair proposed the information-theory-of-aging framework, positing that aging results from loss of epigenetic information (the software) rather than mere damage accumulation. Directionally, the theory explains aging as reversible information loss. Sirtuins such as SIRT1 are central because they relocalize during repair, driving epigenetic drift, and it is a unifying hypothesis motivating NAD+/sirtuin restoration. By framing aging as a software failure, the theory suggests that restoring youthful epigenetic states could reverse age-related decline. This framework has driven considerable research into epigenetic clocks, NAD+ biology, and cellular reprogramming.
description_zh_TW: Sinclair 提出衰老資訊理論框架，假定衰老源於表觀遺傳資訊（軟體）的喪失而非僅僅損傷的積累。在方向性上，該理論將衰老解釋為可逆的資訊喪失。Sirtuin 如 SIRT1 至關重要，因為它們在修復期間重新定位，驅動表觀遺傳漂變，是一個統一的假說，推動 NAD+/sirtuin 恢復。透過將衰老框架定義為軟體故障，該理論表明恢復年輕的表觀遺傳狀態可能逆轉年齡相關退化。此框架推動了大量關於表觀遺傳時鐘、NAD+ 生物學和細胞重編程的研究。

label: Adrenal gland
description: The Adrenal gland is a paired endocrine organ whose inner Adrenal medulla, composed of Chromaffin cells, synthesizes the Catecholamines Epinephrine (about 80%) and Norepinephrine (about 20%). Synthesis runs Tyrosine to L-DOPA via Tyrosine Hydroxylase, then dopamine, Norepinephrine, and finally Epinephrine via PNMT.
description_zh_TW: Adrenal gland 是一對內分泌器官，其內層由 Chromaffin cells 組成的 Adrenal medulla 合成 Catecholamines，即約 80% 的 Epinephrine 與約 20% 的 Norepinephrine。合成途徑由 Tyrosine 經 Tyrosine Hydroxylase 轉為 L-DOPA，再經 dopamine、Norepinephrine，最後由 PNMT 催化生成 Epinephrine。

label: Proteostasis
source_file: _document_ - The Mechanistic Target of Rapamycin (mTOR) Pathway as a Target of Anti-aging Therapies The Role of Rapamycin and Its Analogs in the Regulation of Cellular Processes and Their Impact on Longevity.md
description: Endoplasmic Reticulum Stress and Proteostasis are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Endoplasmic Reticulum Stress and Proteostasis may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Endoplasmic Reticulum Stress 和 Proteostasis 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Endoplasmic Reticulum Stress 和 Proteostasis 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: single nucleotide variation
description: A single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) is a variation at a single nucleotide position in the genome, the most common type of genetic variation, occurring roughly every few hundred bases. SNPs such as COMT Val158Met (rs4680) can alter protein function, gene expression, or drug response, making them the primary markers used in pharmacogenetic and behavioral genetics studies. Most SNPs are neutral, but functional variants can have substantial biological effects. They are the foundation of modern association studies.
description_zh_TW: 單核苷酸多態性 (SNP) 是基因組中單一核苷酸位置的變異，是最常見的遺傳變異類型，大約每幾百個鹼基就會發生一次。 SNPs（例如 COMT Val158Met (rs4680)）可以改變蛋白質功能，gene expression 或 drug response，使它們成為藥物遺傳學和行為遺傳學研究中使用的主要標記。大多數 SNPs 是中性的，但功能變異可以產生顯著的生物效應。它們是現代聯想研究的基礎。

label: Methionine sulfoxide reductases
description: Methionine sulfoxide reductases repair oxidized methionine by reducing methionine sulfoxide back to methionine using the thioredoxin system. This restores protein function and acts as an antioxidant defense because methionine oxidation can be a benign, reversible sink for oxidants. The directionality is MsrA/MsrB-catalyzed reduction to repaired protein. A caveat is that repeated oxidation and repair of the same residue has a kinetic cost and is not unlimited, so chronic stress still accrues damage.
description_zh_TW: Methionine sulfoxide reductases 透過使用硫氧還蛋白系統將甲硫胺酸亞砜還原回甲硫胺酸來修復 oxidized methionine。這可以恢復蛋白質功能並起到抗氧化防禦作用，因為蛋氨酸氧化可以成為氧化劑的良性、可逆的吸收池。方向性是 MsrA/MsrB 催化還原為修復蛋白。需要注意的是，相同殘留物的重複氧化和修復會產生動力成本，而且不是無限的，因此慢性壓力仍然會造成損害。

label: Atg4B
description: SIRT2, a cytosolic NAD+-dependent deacetylase, deacetylates ATG4B in response to starvation, modulating the activity of this cysteine protease that processes and delipidates the autophagosome marker LC3/GABARAP. Deacetylation of ATG4B influences the dynamics of LC3 conjugation and autophagosome maturation, fine-tuning autophagic flux. Because SIRT2 activity rises when NAD+ is elevated during CR and exercise, this modification links energy status to autophagosome biogenesis. The SIRT2-ATG4B axis adds an acetylation layer to core autophagy machinery regulation.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 是一種胞質 NAD+ 依賴的去乙醯酶，在回應飢餓時去乙醯化 ATG4B——該半胱氨酸蛋白酶負責處理並去脂化自噬體標記 LC3/GABARAP。ATG4B 的去乙醯化影響 LC3 共軛和自噬體成熟的動力學，精細調諧自噬流。由於 SIRT2 活性在熱量限制和運動期間 NAD+ 升高時上升，此修飾將能量狀態與自噬體生物發生連結起來。SIRT2-ATG4B 軸為核心自噬機械的調節增添了乙醯化層次。

label: Autoxidation
description: Chelators such as EDTA suppress epinephrine autoxidation by sequestering the catalytic transition metals, chiefly Fe2+ and Cu+, that drive Fenton-type hydroperoxide decomposition. Blocking these metal ions removes the most efficient initiators of the radical chain, and chelators such as these are therefore standard additives in epinephrine formulations alongside antioxidants.
description_zh_TW: EDTA 等螯合劑藉由隔離主要催化鏈反應的過渡金屬（尤其是 Fe2+ 與 Cu+）來抑制 Epinephrine 的 autoxidation；這些金屬以 Fenton 型化學分解過氧化氫物。阻斷這些金屬離子即移除了自由基鏈最有效的起始機制，因此這類螯合劑與抗氧化劑同為 Epinephrine 處方中的標準添加物。

label: Senomorphic Therapy
description: Ruxolitinib is a prototypic Senomorphic Therapy: rather than eliminating senescent cells it suppresses their inflammatory output via JAK–STAT blockade, abrogating secretion of IL-6 and IL-8 and blunting the pro-fibrotic secretome without killing the cells.
description_zh_TW: Ruxolitinib 是典型的 Senomorphic Therapy：它並不清除衰老細胞，而是透過阻斷 JAK–STAT 抑制其發炎輸出，在不殺死細胞的情況下取消 IL-6 與 IL-8 的分泌，並削弱促纖維化分泌體。

label: Gluconeogenesis
description: In hepatocytes propionate is activated to propionyl-CoA, carboxylated, epimerized and rearranged to succinyl-CoA by the Vitamin B12-dependent enzyme methylmalonyl-CoA mutase, feeding the gluconeogenic and TCA cycles — making propionate a meaningful precursor for endogenous glucose production during fasting.
description_zh_TW: 在肝細胞中，propionate 被活化為 propionyl-CoA，經羧化、差向異構後，由 Vitamin B12 依賴的酵素 methylmalonyl-CoA mutase 重排為 succinyl-CoA，供應糖質新生與 TCA 循環——使 propionate 成为禁食期間內源性葡萄糖生成的重要前驅物。

label: Malondialdehyde
description: Lipid peroxidation produces malondialdehyde (MDA), a three-carbon dialdehyde arising from cyclization and fragmentation of peroxidized polyunsaturated fatty acids such as arachidonic acid. MDA is reactive and forms adducts with proteins and DNA, contributing to downstream toxicity. The directionality is membrane damage yielding a diffusible, immunogenic byproduct. A caveat is that MDA is one of many aldehyde products, so its measurement captures only part of the peroxidation burden. MDA forms under both physiological and pathological conditions and is the most commonly measured TBARS-based endpoint in redox research.
description_zh_TW: Lipid peroxidation 產生 malondialdehyde (MDA)，一種三碳二醛，由過氧化 polyunsaturated fatty acids（例如花生四烯酸）環化和裂解產生。 MDA 具有反應性，可與 proteins 和 DNA 形成加合物，導致下游毒性。方向性是膜損傷，產生可擴散的免疫原性副產物。需要注意的是，MDA 是眾多醛類產品之一，因此其測量僅捕獲部分過氧化負擔。 MDA 在生理和病理條件下形成，是氧化還原研究中最常測量的基於 TBARS 的終點。

label: Hepatic Steatosis
description: Through the AMPK/SIRT1/PGC-1α pathway, resveratrol reduces hepatic steatosis in diet-induced obesity models by enhancing fatty-acid oxidation and mitochondrial function while limiting lipogenesis. Directionally, SIRT1 activation sits upstream of reduced liver fat accumulation. This demonstrates a translational metabolic benefit of sirtuin activation and is consistent with SIRT1s repression of lipogenic transcription factors such as SREBP-1c and PPAR-γ in the liver. By both increasing lipid catabolism and suppressing de novo lipogenesis, the pathway corrects the imbalance that drives non-alcoholic fatty liver disease.
description_zh_TW: 通過 AMPK/SIRT1/PGC-1α 通路，白藜蘆醇在飲食誘導肥胖模型中通過增強脂肪酸氧化和粒線體功能同時限制脂肪生成來減少肝脂肪變性。在方向性上，SIRT1 活化位於減少肝臟脂肪堆積的上游。這展示了 sirtuin 活化的轉化代謝益處，與 SIRT1 在肝臟中抑制 SREBP-1c 和 PPAR-γ 等脂肪生成轉錄因子一致。通過同時增加脂質分解代謝並抑制新生脂肪合成，該通路糾正了驅動非酒精性脂肪肝病的不平衡。

label: Arginine
description: Protein citrullination is definitionally arginine deimination to citrulline residues. Substrate identity anchors the modification.
description_zh_TW: 蛋白瓜氨酸化定義上即精胺酸脫亞胺為瓜氨酸殘基。底物身份錨定修飾。

label: Genistein
source_file: _document_ - The role of glycation in the pathogenesis of aging and its prevention through herbal products and physical exercise.md
description: Genistein inhibits NADPH oxidase, reducing superoxide production in endothelial cells by interfering with NOX assembly and signaling. This contributes to its vasculoprotective profile. The directionality is isoflavone to lowered NOX-derived ROS. A caveat is that genistein's effects on NOX are cell-type specific and can be modulated by its estrogen-receptor activity. By limiting superoxide, genistein also spares nitric oxide from rapid inactivation, improving endothelial function and vascular tone. These effects, combined with suppression of adhesion-molecule expression, underpin its atheroprotective properties in experimental and epidemiological studies.
description_zh_TW: Genistein 抑制 NADPH oxidase，透過幹擾 NOX 組裝和訊號傳導來減少內皮細胞中超氧化物的產生。這有助於其血管保護作用。方向性是異黃酮至降低NOX衍生的ROS。需要注意的是，genistein 對 NOX 的影響是細胞類型特異性的，並且可以透過其雌激素受體活性進行調節。透過限制超氧化物，genistein 還可以防止 nitric oxide 快速失活，從而改善內皮功能和血管張力。這些作用與黏附分子表現的抑制相結合，在實驗和流行病學研究中鞏固了其動脈粥狀硬化保護特性。

label: Cytoplasmic Chromatin Fragments
description: Cytoplasmic chromatin fragments are the primary endogenous ligand that activates cGAS-STING signaling in senescent cells. cGAS binds the fragments in a sequence-independent manner, recognizing DNA longer than 20 bp, and synthesizes 2'3'-cGAMP, which activates STING and the downstream TBK1-IRF3-NF-kB cascade.
description_zh_TW: Cytoplasmic chromatin fragments 是 senescent cells 中活化 cGAS-STING 訊號的主要內源性配體。cGAS 以不依賴序列的方式結合這些片段，辨識長度超過 20 bp 的 DNA，並合成 2'3'-cGAMP，進而活化 STING 與下游的 TBK1-IRF3-NF-κB 級聯反應。

label: Hallmarks of Aging
description: Geroprotectors are interventions that slow the rate of aging by modulating the conserved hallmarks of aging rather than treating a single disease. This geroscience strategy aims to compress morbidity and extend healthspan.
description_zh_TW: 延緩衰老劑（geroprotectors）是透過調控保守的衰老標誌而非治療單一疾病來減緩衰老速率的介入措施。此老年科學（geroscience）策略旨在壓縮疾病期並延長健康壽命。

label: IKK
description: IKK activates NFκB. IKK is the kinase complex that phosphorylates I-kappaB to free NF-kappaB, linking upstream inflammatory signals to survival transcription. NF-kappaB is a pleiotropic transcription factor that, when constitutively active, drives proliferation, survival, inflammation, and therapy resistance. The relationship is directional, with IKK acting as the operative agent upon NFκB rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: IKK 活化 NFκB。 IKK 是將 I-kappaB 磷酸化為遊離 NF-kappaB 的激酶複合物，將上游發炎訊號與生存轉錄聯繫起來。 NF-kappaB 是一種多效性轉錄因子，當其持續活躍時，可驅動增殖、存活、發炎和治療抵抗。這種關係是定向的，IKK 充當 NFκB 的操作劑，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Lewy Bodies
description: Lewy bodies and pale bodies in Parkinson's Disease are immunopositive for ubiquitin, marking a failure of Proteostasis: the neuron has attempted, and failed, to clear aggregated alpha-synuclein and oxidized substrates through the Ubiquitin-Proteasome System. Neuromelanin burden in the Substantia Nigra Pars Compacta compounds this proteostatic stress.
description_zh_TW: Parkinson's Disease 中的 Lewy Bodies 與 Pale Bodies 對 ubiquitin 呈免疫陽性，標記出 Proteostasis 的失效：該神經元曾試圖、卻未能經由 Ubiquitin-Proteasome System 清除聚集的 alpha-synuclein 與氧化受質。Substantia Nigra Pars Compacta 中的 neuromelanin 負擔進一步加重此蛋白穩態壓力。

label: irinotecan
description: SN-38 traps the topoisomerase I cleavage complex, causing fork-collision breaks.
description_zh_TW: SN-38 捕獲拓樸異構酶 I 切割複合體，導致複製叉碰撞斷裂。

label: Prostaglandin E2
description: Prostaglandin E2 is one of the inflammatory mediators that sensitize nociceptor terminals at sites of tissue injury, together with bradykinin and cytokines. Sensitized nociceptors fire spontaneously and respond to normally innocuous stimuli, producing spontaneous pain, hyperalgesia and allodynia that together define inflammatory pain.
description_zh_TW: Prostaglandin E2 是使 nociceptor 末梢在組織損傷處敏感化的發炎介質之一，與 bradykinin 及細胞激素共同作用。敏感化的 nociceptor 會自發性放電並對原本無害的刺激產生反應，造成自發性疼痛、痛覺過敏與異痛症，三者共同構成 inflammatory pain。

label: Survivin
description: Smac-DIABLO antagonizes Survivin. Smac/DIABLO is released from mitochondria during MOMP and unleashes caspases by binding the BIR domains of IAPs. Survivin (BIRC5) is a bifunctional IAP that inhibits apoptosis and is required for chromosomal passenger complex function in mitosis, making it a tumor-selective antigen. The relationship is directional, with Smac-DIABLO acting as the operative agent upon Survivin rather than the reverse. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
description_zh_TW: Smac-DIABLO 對抗 Survivin。 Smac/DIABLO 在 MOMP 期間從粒線體釋放，並透過結合 IAP 的 BIR 結構域釋放半胱天冬酶。 Survivin (BIRC5) 是一種雙功能 IAP，可抑制細胞凋亡，是有絲分裂中染色體過客複合體功能所必需的，使其成為腫瘤選擇性抗原。這種關係是定向的，Smac-DIABLO 充當 Survivin 的操作劑，而不是相反。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: PKC
description: Protein kinase C (PKC) activation induces TFEB nuclear translocation through an mTORC1-independent route, primarily by inactivating GSK3β, which otherwise phosphorylates TFEB at cytosolic-retention sites. This alternative regulatory input allows TFEB to be engaged by diacylglycerol and calcium signaling without requiring nutrient deprivation. The pathway diversifies the contexts—such as immune cell activation—in which the autophagy-lysosomal program can be turned on. It demonstrates that TFEB is controlled by parallel kinase networks rather than solely by mTOR.
description_zh_TW: 蛋白激酶 C（PKC）的活化透過不依賴 mTORC1 的途徑誘導 TFEB 核轉運，主要是透過使 GSK3β 失去活性，而後者本會在細胞質保留位點磷酸化 TFEB。這種替代性調節輸入使得 TFEB 能夠在不需要營養匱乏的情況下，被二醯甘油和鈣信號所啟動。此途徑使自噬—溶酶體程序可被開啟的脈絡多元化——例如免疫細胞活化。它證明了 TFEB 受平行激酶網絡而非僅由 mTOR 所控制。

label: Phagocytic Lysosome Reformation
description: Phosphoinositide signaling drives phagocytic lysosome reformation membrane remodeling. Regulation parallels the ALR edge.
description_zh_TW: 磷酸肌醇訊號驅動吞噬性溶酶體重組膜重塑。調節與 ALR 邊平行。

label: Rheumatoid Arthritis
description: Auranofin (Ridaura) was FDA-approved in 1985 for adult rheumatoid arthritis as a second-line gold DMARD after NSAID failure, at an oral dose of 6 mg/day. Its mechanism in RA is incompletely understood but involves suppression of phagocytosis and inflammatory mediator release.
description_zh_TW: Auranofin（Ridaura）於 1985 年獲 FDA 核准用於成人類風濕性關節炎，作為 NSAID 治療失敗後的二線金製劑 DMARD，口服劑量為每日 6 mg。其在 RA 中的機制尚未完全明瞭，但涉及抑制吞噬作用與發炎介質釋放。

label: Leishmaniasis
description: In leishmaniasis, metacyclic promastigotes injected by the sandfly are rapidly phagocytosed by resident macrophages, inside which they transform into round, non-flagellated amastigotes within a parasitophorous vacuole. Amastigotes then multiply by binary fission until the host cell ruptures and infects neighbouring macrophages, making the macrophage the primary host cell and replicative niche of the parasite.
description_zh_TW: 在 leishmaniasis 中，沙蠅注入的 metacyclic promastigote 會迅速被 resident macrophages 吞噬，並在 parasitophorous vacuole 內轉變為圓形、無鞭毛的 amastigote。Amastigote 接著以二分裂增殖，直到宿主細胞破裂並感染鄰近的 macrophages，因此 macrophage 是此寄生蟲的主要宿主細胞與增殖棲位。

label: Cholesterol
description: Cholesterol is oxidized by reactive oxygen species through non-enzymatic chemistry that yields more than 30 oxysterol species. These oxidized products have distinct biological activities compared with native cholesterol. The directionality is ROS to sterol oxidation. A caveat is that many oxysterols are also formed enzymatically by cytochrome P450s, so not all oxysterols indicate oxidative stress. Examples include 7-ketocholesterol and 7beta-hydroxycholesterol, which are cytotoxic and pro-inflammatory and accumulate in atherosclerotic plaques and oxidized LDL.
description_zh_TW: Cholesterol 被 reactive oxygen species 經由非酵素化學氧化，產生 30 多種氧甾醇。這些氧化產物與天然cholesterol相比具有明顯的生物活性。方向性是ROS至甾醇氧化。需要注意的是，許多 oxysterols 也是由細胞色素 P450 酶促形成的，因此並非所有 oxysterols 都表示 oxidative stress。例子包括7-ketocholesterol和7β-羥基cholesterol，它們具有細胞毒性和促炎性，並在atheros硬化斑塊和oxidized LDL中積聚。

label: Ubiquitin-Proteasome System
description: Ubiquitin is a conserved 76-amino-acid protein that, through an E1/E2/E3 cascade, is covalently attached to lysines of target proteins. The resulting K48-linked chains are the canonical degradation signal recognized by the Ubiquitin-Proteasome System, while K63-linked chains instead mediate signaling, endocytosis and DNA repair, and deubiquitinases reverse the mark.
description_zh_TW: Ubiquitin 是一種高度保守的 76 胺基酸蛋白質，經由 E1/E2/E3 級聯反應共價連接到目標蛋白的離胺酸殘基。所形成的 K48 鏈是 26S proteasome 辨識的典型降解訊號，而 K63 鏈則參與訊號傳遞、胞吞與 DNA 修復，去泛素化酵素則可逆轉此標記。

label: Aurora Kinase
description: Aurora Kinase isozymes — Aurora-A, Aurora-B and Aurora-C — coordinate mitotic spindle assembly, chromosome alignment and segregation, and cytokinesis; Aurora-A acts at centrosomes and spindle poles, while Aurora-B is a chromosomal passenger complex component regulating kinetochore-microtubule attachments and the spindle assembly checkpoint.
description_zh_TW: Aurora Kinase 異構酶——Aurora-A、Aurora-B 與 Aurora-C——共同協調有絲分裂紡錘體的組裝、染色體的對齊與分離，以及胞質分裂；Aurora-A 作用於中心體與紡錘體極，Aurora-B 則是染色體乘客複合體成分，調控動粒—微管附著與紡錘體組裝檢查點。

label: Histone Acetyltransferase
description: Sas2p is a MYST-family histone acetyltransferase.
description_zh_TW: Sas2p 是 MYST 家族組蛋白乙醯轉移酶。

label: Pentosidine
description: Pentosidine is a well-known fluorescent cross-link of the Advanced Glycation End Products family, formed by reaction of ribose, glucose or other sugars with lysine and arginine residues, and used to measure the extent of protein glycation and cross-linking in tissues.
description_zh_TW: Pentosidine 是 [[Advanced Glycation End Products]] 家族中著名的螢光性交聯產物，由核糖、葡萄糖等糖類與 [[Lysine]]、[[Arginine]] 殘基反應形成，用於衡量組織中蛋白質的糖化與交聯程度。

label: GLO2
description: D-lactate is a D-enantiomer of lactate generated as the terminal end product of the Glyoxalase System. Within that system GLO2 hydrolyzes the intermediate S-D-lactoylglutathione, releasing D-lactate while simultaneously regenerating the cellular antioxidant Glutathione, so the D-isomer marks the point at which methylglyoxal/glyoxal dicarbonyl stress has been resolved.
description_zh_TW: D-lactate 是乳酸的 D-對映異構物，為 Glyoxalase System 的最終產物。在該系統中，GLO2 水解中間產物 S-D-lactoylglutathione，釋出 D-lactate 的同時再生細胞抗氧化劑 Glutathione，因此 D-型標記著 methylglyoxal/glyoxal 二碳醣基壓力已被處理的終點。

label: Mitochondrial Dysfunction-Associated Senescence
description: MiDAS is a distinct form of cellular senescence triggered by mitochondrial perturbation rather than canonical genotoxic stressors, first characterised by Wiley et al. (2016). Unlike replicative or stress-induced senescence, it engages cell-cycle arrest through AMPK and p53 without the classic DNA damage response.
description_zh_TW: MiDAS 是一種由粒線體擾動而非典型基因毒性壓力觸發的獨特 cellular senescence 形式，由 Wiley 等人（2016）首先描述。與 replicative 或 stress-induced senescence 不同，它透過 AMPK 與 p53 引發細胞週期停滯，而不涉及典型的 DNA damage 反應。

label: Oxfendazole
description: The FMO family are FAD-dependent monooxygenases catalysing NADPH- and O2-dependent oxidation of soft nucleophiles such as sulfur, nitrogen and phosphorus centres. Together with CYP3A4, FMO mediates the rapid hepatic sulfoxidation of fenbendazole to oxfendazole (fenbendazole sulfoxide); this first-pass sulfoxidation is the gateway to fenbendazole's pharmacologically active metabolite, with FMO3 the dominant hepatic form in adults.
description_zh_TW: FMO 家族是依賴 FAD 的單加氧酶，催化 NADPH 與 O2 相依的軟親核體（如硫、氮、磷中心）氧化。FMO 與 CYP3A4 共同介導 fenbendazole 在肝臟中快速硫氧化為 oxfendazole（fenbendazole sulfoxide）；這個首過硫氧化是形成 fenbendazole 藥理活性代謝物的關口，成人肝臟以 FMO3 為主。

label: VTA
description: VTA dopaminergic neurons project to the Nucleus Accumbens via the mesolimbic pathway, where they mediate reward, motivation and reinforcement. This projection is the principal route by which phasic VTA dopamine encodes reward prediction error.
description_zh_TW: VTA 的多巴胺神經元經 mesolimbic 途徑投射至 Nucleus Accumbens，在該處中介 reward、motivation 與 reinforcement。這條投射是 phasic VTA dopamine 編碼 reward prediction error 的主要路徑。

label: Depression
description: Dysfunction of the Nucleus Accumbens reward circuitry contributes to Depression, manifesting as anhedonia and reduced motivation. Because the same hub links emotion, cognition and movement, it is a target for interventions ranging from deep-brain stimulation to pharmacotherapy in affective disease.
description_zh_TW: 伏隔核（Nucleus Accumbens）獎賞迴路的功能失常會促成憂鬱症（Depression），表現為快感缺失與動機降低。由於同一個樞紐連結情緒、認知與運動，它也是情感疾病中從深部腦刺激到藥物治療的介入標的。

label: Magnesium
description: Magnesium is a required cofactor for COMT, with the enzyme's catalytic activity depending on divalent cations, magnesium prominently, to coordinate SAMe and the catechol substrate during methyl transfer. Magnesium deficiency can reduce COMT efficiency and impair catecholamine clearance, compounding the effects of genetically slow COMT variants. Ensuring magnesium adequacy is a common recommendation for supporting healthy COMT activity in personalized protocols. It is a nutritional lever that directly affects enzyme catalysis.
description_zh_TW: Magnesium 是必需的 cofactor for COMT，該酶的催化活性取決於二價陽離子（主要是鎂），以在甲基轉移過程中協調 SAMe 和兒茶酚底物。 Magnesium 缺乏會降低 COMT 效率並損害兒茶酚胺清除率，加劇了遺傳性緩慢的 COMT variants 的影響。確保鎂充足是在個人化方案中支援健康 COMT activity 的常見建議。它是直接影響酵素催化作用的營養槓桿。

label: iNOS
description: iNOS produces high-output NO for innate immune defense, generating micromolar NO in activated macrophages and other innate cells to kill intracellular pathogens. This sustained output is transcriptionally induced by cytokines and microbial products. The directionality is immune activation to bactericidal NO burst. A caveat is that the same high NO combines with superoxide to form peroxynitrite, causing collateral nitrative tissue damage. Because its expression is transcriptionally controlled, iNOS is absent from resting cells but appears within hours of cytokine or pathogen exposure.
description_zh_TW: iNOS為innate immune defense產生高輸出NO，在活化的巨噬細胞和其他先天細胞中產生微摩爾NO以殺死細胞內病原體。這種持續的輸出是由細胞激素和微生物產物轉錄誘導的。方向性是對殺菌性NO爆發的免疫活化。需要注意的是，同樣高的 NO 與超氧化物結合形成 peroxynitrite，導致附帶的硝化組織損傷。因為其表現受轉錄控制，所以 iNOS 在靜止細胞中不存在，但在細胞激素或病原體暴露後數小時內出現。

label: Argyria
description: Silver compounds are the source materials whose ingested or inhaled silver is absorbed into the circulation and ultimately deposited as elemental silver or silver sulfide granules in tissue, producing the irreversible blue-gray discoloration of Argyria. Insoluble Silver salts are converted along the way into soluble, protein-bound species that can cross into tissue.
description_zh_TW: Silver compounds 是被吸收 silver 的來源材料，經攝入或吸入後進入循環系統，最後以金屬 silver 或 silver sulfide 顆粒沉積於組織，造成 Argyria 不可逆的青灰色色素沉著。過程中不溶性的 Silver salts 會轉變為可溶的蛋白結合態物種後進入組織。

label: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
description: Metabolic Syndrome is a cluster of interconnected abnormalities — central obesity, insulin resistance, hypertension, and dyslipidemia — that collectively increase the risk of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus, Cardiovascular Disease, and Non-alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease. It arises from visceral adiposity and dysregulated lipid and glucose metabolism, creating systemic low-grade Inflammation and Oxidative Stress.
description_zh_TW: Metabolic Syndrome 是一群互相關聯的異常——中央型肥胖、胰島素阻抗、高血壓與血脂異常——的集合，會共同提高 Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus、Cardiovascular Disease 與 Non-alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease 的風險。它源自內臟脂肪堆積與脂質、葡萄糖代謝失調，形成全身性低度發炎與 Oxidative Stress。

label: Trained Immunity
description: PI3K/Akt/mTOR/HIF-1alpha signaling installs the aerobic-glycolysis (Warburg) program with increased glucose uptake and lactate that supports heightened cytokine output on rechallenge. Genetic or pharmacologic blockade of AKT, mTOR, or HIF-1alpha abrogates both the metabolic shift and trained cytokines in vitro and in vivo. BCG vaccination data corroborate elevated glycolytic flux under mTOR control.
description_zh_TW: PI3K/Akt/mTOR/HIF-1alpha signaling 建立 aerobic-glycolysis（Warburg）程式，增加 glucose uptake 與 lactate，以支持再刺激時增強的細胞激素輸出。在 in vitro 與 in vivo 以基因或藥物阻斷 AKT、mTOR 或 HIF-1alpha，均可消除代謝轉換與訓練後的細胞激素。BCG vaccination 數據也證實在 mTOR 控制下 glycolytic flux 升高。

label: Methionine Restriction
description: The metabolic response to Methionine restriction is partially dependent on FGF21, consistent with MR acting through the same endocrine axis as Protein Restriction; in humans, sulfur amino acid restriction increased FGF21, reduced leptin, and reduced body weight. MR also inhibits mTORC1 signaling, coupling amino acid scarcity to reduced anabolic signaling, and most MR studies require cysteine depletion for the benefits to appear.
description_zh_TW: Methionine restriction 的代謝反應部分仰賴 FGF21，這與 MR 經由和 Protein Restriction 相同的內分泌軸作用一致；在人類中，限制含硫胺基酸會提高 FGF21、降低瘦素並減少體重。MR 也會抑制 mTORC1 訊號，將胺基酸匱乏與合成訊號降低連結起來，且多數 MR 研究都需搭配半胱胺酸耗竭才能觀察到效益。

label: trastuzumab
description: Trastuzumab is the standard anti-HER2 antibody for this subtype.
description_zh_TW: trastuzumab 是此亞型的標準抗 HER2 抗體。

label: TSC2
description: Germline TSC2 loss causes the TSC hamartoma syndrome. Causation is the genetic etiology.
description_zh_TW: 生殖系 TSC2 缺失導致 TSC 錯構瘤症候群。因果是遺傳病因。

label: Fenton Reaction
description: The Fenton reaction produces hydroxyl radicals according to Fe2+ + H2O2 to Fe3+ + OH* + OH-, a one-electron reduction of hydrogen peroxide by ferrous iron. This reaction is the principal mechanism by which relatively inert H2O2 is converted into the supremely reactive hydroxyl radical at sites of free iron. The directionality is metal-catalyzed conversion of a diffusible oxidant into a locally devastating radical. A caveat is that the ferric product can be recycled back to Fe2+ by reductants, sustaining chain production of hydroxyl radicals as long as iron and peroxide coexist.
description_zh_TW: Fenton reaction 根據 Fe2+ + H2O2 產生 hydroxyl radicals 至 Fe3+ + OH* + OH-，這是亞鐵 iron 對 hydrogen peroxide 的單電子還原。此反應是相對惰性的 H2O2 在 free iron 位點轉化為活性極高的羥基自由基的主要機制。方向性是擴散氧化劑在金屬催化下轉化為局部破壞性自由基。需要注意的是，只要 iron 和過氧化物共存，三價鐵產品就可以透過還原劑回收 Fe2+，從而維持 hydroxyl radicals 的鍊式生產。

label: DOT1L
description: DOT1L (KMT4), the sole H3K79 methyltransferase, is required for SASP emergence: knockdown prevents the senescence-associated secretory phenotype while leaving the senescence growth arrest intact. H3K79 methylation is thought to keep chromatin at SASP loci open and permissive, so DOT1L is a senomorphic target rather than a senolytic one.
description_zh_TW: DOT1L (KMT4) 是唯一的 H3K79 methyltransferase，為 SASP 的出現所必需：其 knockdown 可阻止 senescence-associated secretory phenotype，卻不影響 senescence 的生長停滯。H3K79 甲基化被認為能使 SASP 位點的染色質維持開放且具轉錄允許性，因此 DOT1L 是 senomorphic 而非 senolytic 標的。

label: H3K56ac
description: Pharmacological SIRT6 activation with UBCS039, MDL-800, MDL-801, or Cyanidin rapidly lowers both H3K9ac and H3K56ac, compacting chromatin and facilitating DNA double-strand break repair. MDL-800-induced reduction of H3K9ac/H3K56ac has been reported in tumor cell lines.
description_zh_TW: 以 UBCS039、MDL-800、MDL-801 或 Cyanidin 進行藥理性的 SIRT6 活化，可迅速降低 H3K9ac 與 H3K56ac，使染色質凝聚並促進 DNA 雙股斷裂修復。MDL-800 降低 H3K9ac／H3K56ac 的效果已在腫瘤細胞系中被報導。

label: GCN5
description: GCN5, a lysine acetyltransferase, acetylates TFEB at lysines 274 and 279 within its DNA-binding domain, an modification that hinders TFEB dimerization and its ability to bind CLEAR elements. Acetylation at these sites therefore represses TFEB transcriptional activity independently of its localization. This post-translational modification expands the regulatory vocabulary of TFEB beyond phosphorylation to include acetylation-dependent control of DNA engagement. The finding situates TFEB within the broader acetylome that governs transcription factor function.
description_zh_TW: GCN5 是一種離胺酸乙醯轉移酶，於 lysine 274 和 279 乙醯化 TFEB，這些位點位於其 DNA 結合域內，此修飾阻礙 TFEB 二聚化及其結合 CLEAR 元件的能力。因此這些位點的乙醯化獨立於其定位而抑制 TFEB 轉錄活性。此轉譯後修飾將 TFEB 的調節詞彙從磷酸化擴展到包含依賴乙醯化的 DNA 接合控制。此發現將 TFEB 置於控制轉錄因子功能的更廣泛乙醯體中。

label: Muscular Dystrophies (MD)
description: Dystrophin defects are the classic cause of Muscular Dystrophies (MD). Loss of functional dystrophin breaks the sarcolemmal linkage to the cytoskeleton, so contractions tear the muscle membrane and drive repeated fibre necrosis — the lesion underlying Duchenne and Becker dystrophy.
description_zh_TW: Dystrophin 缺陷是 Muscular Dystrophies (MD) 的典型病因。功能性 dystrophin 流失會破壞肌膜與細胞骨架的連結，使收縮時撕裂肌膜並引發反覆的肌纖維壞死——這正是 Duchenne 與 Becker 肌營養不良症的病灶基礎。

label: Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis
description: IPF is a paradigm of senescence-driven pathology. Aged lung fibroblasts accumulate senescence markers and secrete a pro-fibrotic SASP including IL-11, leukotrienes and TGFβ, which recruits immune cells and sustains a fibrogenic loop that resists normal repair. SIRT1 downregulation in IPF de-represses IL-11 transcription.
description_zh_TW: IPF 是衰老驅動病理的典範。老化的肺纖維母細胞累積衰老標記並分泌促纖維化的 SASP（包含 IL-11、白三烯與 TGFβ），招募免疫細胞並維持抗拒正常修復的纖維生成迴路。IPF 中 SIRT1 的下调使 IL-11 轉錄去抑制。

label: DNA Polymerase
description: BrdU is a thymidine analog that competes with endogenous thymidine for incorporation by DNA Polymerase during replicative synthesis. Because it is only incorporated into actively dividing cells, it is the basis of proliferation labeling.
description_zh_TW: BrdU 是胸腺嘧啶核苷類似物，在複製合成過程中與內源性胸腺嘧啶核苷競爭 DNA Polymerase（DNA 聚合酶）的Incorporation（摻入）。由於它只會被摻入正在分裂的細胞，因此成為細胞增殖標定的基礎。

label: HDAC4
description: HDAC4 buffers AP-1 activity in young cells and is degraded on senescence entry, licensing AP-1-driven SASP. Loss of the brake explains senescence-specific AP-1 activation.
description_zh_TW: HDAC4 在年輕細胞緩衝 AP-1 活性，並在衰老進入時降解，許可 AP-1 驅動的 SASP。煞車喪失解釋衰老特異的 AP-1 活化。

label: Contact Inhibition
description: Mechanical density cues act through Hippo to sequester YAP and TAZ.
description_zh_TW: 機械密度線索經 Hippo 隔離 YAP 與 TAZ。

label: Bcl-2 family
description: BAK (Bcl-2 homologous antagonist/killer, gene BCL2L7) is a pro-apoptotic effector of the Bcl-2 family. Unlike the mostly cytosolic BAX, BAK is constitutively embedded in the outer mitochondrial membrane of healthy cells, holding BH1–BH3 domains that are restrained by anti-apoptotic partners such as Bcl-2 and Mcl-1.
description_zh_TW: BAK（Bcl-2 homologous antagonist/killer，基因 BCL2L7）是 Bcl-2 家族的促凋亡效應蛋白。與主要存在於細胞質的 BAX 不同，BAK 在健康細胞中組成型地嵌入粒線體外膜，具有 BH1–BH3 結構域，並受 Bcl-2、Mcl-1 等抗凋亡蛋白制約。

label: Benzimidazole
description: Some bis-benzimidazole compounds bind the minor groove of DNA at specific sequences and inhibit DNA helicase activity, thereby blocking cell proliferation. This mechanism is relevant to fenbendazole-family benzimidazoles as potential anticancer agents.
description_zh_TW: 某些雙苯並咪唑化合物結合 DNA 小溝的特定序列並抑制 DNA 解旋酶活性，從而阻斷細胞增殖。此機制與 fenbendazole 家族苯並咪唑作為潛在抗癌藥有關。

label: Phytochemicals
description: Phytochemicals directly inhibit histone methyltransferase activity.
description_zh_TW: 植物化學物直接抑制組蛋白甲基轉移酶活性。

label: Interferon
description: MLKL-driven DAMP release and TRIF-RIPK3 co-activation couple the IFN arm to IL-6/TNF programs and necroptotic inflammation.
description_zh_TW: MLKL-driven DAMP release and TRIF-RIPK3 co-activation couple the IFN arm to IL-6/TNF programs and necroptotic inflammation.

label: Senescence Surveillance
description: Therapy-Induced Senescence is cleared by Senescence Surveillance. Therapy-induced senescence is the durable arrest imposed on tumor cells by genotoxic treatments, with both tumor-suppressive and relapse-promoting consequences. Senescence surveillance is the immune-mediated clearance of senescent cells orchestrated by their SASP chemokine and cytokine output. The directionality runs from Senescence Surveillance toward Therapy-Induced Senescence, so Senescence Surveillance is the active agent and Therapy-Induced Senescence the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Therapy-Induced Senescence 由Senescence Surveillance 清除。 Therapy-Induced Senescence是基因毒性治療對腫瘤細胞的持久抑制，具有抑制腫瘤和促進復發的後果。監視是由衰老細胞的趨化因子和細胞激素輸出協調的免疫介導的清除。方向性從 Senescence Surveillance 向 Therapy-Induced Senescence，因此 Senescence Surveillance 是活性劑，Therapy-Induced Senescence 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Metabolic Syndrome
description: Metabolic Syndrome is a cluster of interconnected abnormalities — central obesity, insulin resistance, hypertension, and dyslipidemia — that collectively increase the risk of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus, Cardiovascular Disease, and Non-alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease. It arises from visceral adiposity and dysregulated lipid and glucose metabolism, creating systemic low-grade Inflammation and Oxidative Stress.
description_zh_TW: Metabolic Syndrome 是一群互相關聯的異常——中央型肥胖、胰島素阻抗、高血壓與血脂異常——的集合，會共同提高 Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus、Cardiovascular Disease 與 Non-alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease 的風險。它源自內臟脂肪堆積與脂質、葡萄糖代謝失調，形成全身性低度發炎與 Oxidative Stress。

label: HAF-1
description: Under mitochondrial proteotoxic stress HAF-1, an inner-membrane ABC transporter, exports peptides generated by mitochondrial proteases from the matrix into the cytosol. These peptides act as retrograde signals that activate the transcription factor ATFS-1 and thus the mitochondrial unfolded protein response.
description_zh_TW: 在粒線體蛋白毒性壓力下，內膜 ABC transporter HAF-1 將粒線體蛋白酶產生的胜肽由 matrix 輸出至細胞質。這些胜肽作為 retrograde 訊號活化轉錄因子 ATFS-1，進而啟動 mitochondrial unfolded protein response。

label: Cyanidin-3-glucoside
description: Black elderberries provide roughly 350-450 mg cyanidin-3-glucoside per 100 g of fresh fruit, with about 70-85 g reaching a 300 mg therapeutic dose. Directionally, berry content sits upstream of anthocyanin intake. Cyanidin is a powerful natural SIRT6 activator, and this positions elderberry as a dietary SIRT6-modulating food. The high anthocyanin content makes elderberry one of the richest natural sources of cyanidin, and its traditional use for immune support is consistent with the bioactivity of these compounds. Understanding the dose achievable from food is essential for interpreting dietary studies.
description_zh_TW: 黑接骨木莓每 100 克新鮮果實含有約 350-450 mg 花青素-3-葡萄糖苷，約 70-85 克即可達到 300 mg 的治療劑量。在方向性上，莓果含量位於花青素攝入量的上游。花青素是強效的天然 SIRT6 活化劑，這使接骨木莓成為飲食中的 SIRT6 調節食物。高花青素含量使接骨木莓成為花青素最豐富的天然來源之一，其傳統用於免疫支持與這些化合物的生物活性一致。理解從食物可達的劑量對於詮釋飲食研究至關重要。

label: Locus Coeruleus
description: Locus Coeruleus degenerates in Parkinson's Disease, reflecting the selective loss of these neurons as the disease progresses. Mechanistically, degeneration follows the spread of alpha-synuclein pathology and the failure of protective systems in vulnerable circuits. This is significant because the lost population underlies the non-motor and motor features attributed to the affected region. A caveat is that the same neurons also decline in normal aging and other disorders, so magnitude and pattern must be interpreted in full context.
description_zh_TW: Locus Coeruleus 在 Parkinson's Disease 中退化，反映出隨著疾病的進展這些神經元選擇性缺失。從機制上講，退化是隨著 alpha-synuclein 病理學的傳播和脆弱電路中保護系統的失效而發生的。這很重要，因為人口的流失是受影響地區非運動和運動特徵的基礎。需要注意的是，在正常 aging 和其他疾病中，相同的神經元也會下降，因此必須在完整的背景下解釋幅度和模式。

label: H3K9me3
description: Senescence-associated heterochromatin foci (SAHFs) are characterized by increased binding of HP1, H3K9me3 marks, macroH2A, and HMGA proteins. These foci are large domains of condensed heterochromatin that form in the nuclei of senescent cells and are believed to contribute to silencing of proliferation-associated genes. SAHF formation requires chromatin regulators including HIRA, ASF1a, and UBN1, and although not essential for growth arrest, their disruption correlates with reduced SASP expression.
description_zh_TW: Senescence 相關異染色質灶 (SAHF) 的特徵是 HP1、H3K9me3 標記、macroH2A 和 HMGA 蛋白的結合增加。這些病灶是在老化細胞的細胞核中形成的濃縮異染色質的大結構域，被認為有助於增殖相關基因的沉默。 SAHF 的形成需要染色質調節因子，包括 HIRA、ASF1a 和 UBN1，雖然對於生長停滯不是必需的，但它們的破壞與 SASP 表達的減少有關。

label: OPTN
description: TRAK1 (Trafficking kinesin-binding protein 1) is a mitochondrial transport adaptor protein that forms a complex with Optineurin (OPTN) and KIF5B for proper anterograde axonal mitochondrial transport. OPTN directly interacts with TRAK1 and KIF5B in a C-terminal-dependent manner to stabilize them, and the OPTN/TRAK1/KIF5B complex is critical for axonal mitochondrial distribution.
description_zh_TW: TRAK1 (Trafficking kinesin-binding protein 1) 是粒線體運輸轉接蛋白，與 Optineurin (OPTN) 及 KIF5B 形成複合體，以進行正確的軸突順向粒線體運輸。OPTN 以依賴 C 端的方式直接與 TRAK1 及 KIF5B 互動並使其穩定，而 OPTN/TRAK1/KIF5B 複合體對軸突粒線體分布至關重要。

label: Cardiolipin
description: Cardiolipin is an obligate cofactor for inner-membrane fusion: L-OPA1 binds cardiolipin on liposomes and GTP hydrolysis by OPA1 drives fusion, and removing cardiolipin abolishes fusion even when L-OPA1 is present on both membranes. Cardiolipin also interacts with DRP1 to stimulate its oligomerization and GTPase activity, promoting fission, so the same lipid bidirectionally regulates mitochondrial dynamics. It is additionally required for mitophagy receptor recruitment.
description_zh_TW: Cardiolipin 是內膜融合的必需輔因子：L-OPA1 在脂質體上結合 cardiolipin，OPA1 的 GTP 水解驅動融合；即使兩側膜上都有 L-OPA1，只要移除 cardiolipin 融合即被廢除。Cardiolipin 也與 DRP1 互動以促進其寡聚化與 GTPase 活性而促進分裂，因此同一種脂質對粒線體動態學具有雙向調控作用。它同時也是 mitophagy 受體招募所必需。

label: Aminoguanidine HCL
description: Aminoguanidine hydrochloride is the prototype therapeutic AGE inhibitor: as a nucleophilic carbonyl trap it reacts rapidly with reactive alpha,beta-dicarbonyl intermediates (Methylglyoxal, Glyoxal, 3-deoxyglucosone) to form stable, non-toxic 3-amino-1,2,4-triazine adducts, intercepting them before they cross-link proteins and thus preventing the AGE accumulation that drives vascular stiffening, basement membrane thickening, and tissue damage in Aging and Diabetes Mellitus.
description_zh_TW: Aminoguanidine hydrochloride 是原型的 AGE 抑制療效藥：作為親核性羰基捕集劑，它能快速與活性 α,β-二羰基中間物（Methylglyoxal、Glyoxal、3-deoxyglucosone）反應，形成穩定且無毒的 3-amino-1,2,4-triazine 加合物，在其與蛋白質交聯前先行攔截，因而避免造成血管僵硬、基底膜增厚與 Aging 及 Diabetes Mellitus 中組織損傷的 AGE 累積。

label: Doxorubicin
description: Doxorubicin (Adriamycin), an anthracycline chemotherapy drug, exerts anticancer effects by intercalating between DNA base pairs, inhibiting topoisomerase II-mediated DNA repair, and generating free radicals that induce Oxidative Stress. These actions collectively trigger the Intrinsic Pathway of Apoptosis.
description_zh_TW: Doxorubicin（Adriamycin）是一種 anthracycline 類化療藥物，其抗癌作用來自插入 DNA 鹼基對之間、抑制 topoisomerase II 媒介的 DNA 修補，以及產生自由基而誘發 Oxidative Stress。這些作用共同啟動 Apoptosis 的 Intrinsic Pathway。

label: Emphysema
description: Emphysema is a subtype of COPD defined by permanent enlargement of the airspaces distal to the terminal bronchioles with destruction of their walls and no obvious fibrosis. Cigarette smoking is the dominant risk factor, with occupational dusts, air pollution and alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency also predisposing.
description_zh_TW: 肺氣腫是 COPD 的一個型態，其定義為終末細支氣管遠端氣腔永久性擴大且其壁被破壞，並無明顯纖維化。吸菸是主要危險因子，職業粉塵、空氣污染與 alpha-1 antitrypsin 缺乏亦為易感因素。

label: HSPA8
description: HSPA8 (HSC70) is the constitutive HSP70-family chaperone that delivers KFERQ-motif client proteins to LAMP-2A at the lysosome in chaperone-mediated autophagy. Because deficient CMA degradation compromises proteostasis and activates signaling that culminates in cellular senescence, HSPA8 is central to both proteostasis and senescence control.
description_zh_TW: HSPA8（HSC70）是恆定表現的 HSP70 家族伴護蛋白，負責在伴護素媒介自噬中將帶有 KFERQ 序列的受質蛋白運送至溶酶體的 LAMP-2A。由於 CMA 降解不足會破壞蛋白恆定性並啟動最終導致細胞衰老的訊號傳遞，HSPA8 同時是蛋白恆定與衰老調控的核心。

label: Strongyloidiasis
description: CTLA-4 checkpoint blockade, including anti-PD-1 combinations, is a recognized trigger of disseminated Strongyloidiasis in carriers of latent infection. The mechanism is the same as for steroids: relief of the Th2/eosinophil brake allows autoinfective larvae to amplify, so steroid-refractory or atypical presentations should raise suspicion.
description_zh_TW: CTLA-4 檢查點阻斷（含與 anti-PD-1 的聯合）是潛伏感染者發生播散性 Strongyloidiasis 的公認誘發因素。其機轉與糖皮質激素相同：解除 Th2／嗜酸性球煞車後，自傳染性幼蟲得以大量增殖，因此對類固醇無反應或表現不典型時應提高懷疑。

label: Maillard Reaction
description: Advanced glycation end products (AGEs) are a heterogeneous, complex group of compounds formed mainly via the Maillard reaction, in which a reducing sugar reacts non-enzymatically with amino groups in proteins, lipids, or DNA. The Maillard reaction has long been exploited by the food industry for the color and taste it imparts, but its products have gained attention in biomedicine because AGEs are associated with chronic diseases of aging such as diabetes mellitus, cardiovascular disease, and Alzheimer's disease. AGEs form in three phases, and the final brownish, often fluorescent products are very stable and accumulate in tissues, where they interfere with protein function.
description_zh_TW: Advanced glycation end products（AGEs）是一群heterogeneous、complex的compounds，主要經由Maillard reaction形成，其中a reducing sugar與proteins、lipids或DNA中的amino groups進行non-enzymatic reaction。Maillard reaction長期以來被food industry利用以imparts color與taste，但其products在biomedicine中受到attention，因為AGEs與diabetes mellitus、cardiovascular disease及Alzheimer's disease等aging chronic diseases相關。AGEs form in three phases，最終的brownish、often fluorescent products非常stable並accumulate in tissues，干擾protein function。

label: Ubiquinone
description: Ubiquinone/CoQ10 is a non-sterol product of the mevalonate pathway. Because FSP1 depends on this ubiquinone supply, interventions that suppress mevalonate flux toward cholesterol (statins / HMG-CoA reductase inhibition, or squalene-synthase engagement by FIN56) deplete the CoQ10 pool and converge on FSP1, predicting ferroptosis sensitivity.
description_zh_TW: 泛醌/CoQ10 是甲羥戊酸路徑的非固醇產物。由於 FSP1 依賴此泛醌供應，抑制甲羥戊酸流向膽固醇的介入（statins / 抑制 HMG-CoA reductase，或 FIN56 啟動角鯊烯合酶）會耗竭 CoQ10 池並在 FSP1 處交會，預示鐵死亡敏感性。

label: Oxygen Consumption Rate
description: Oxygen Consumption Rate is measured in real time with a Seahorse XF Analyzer, whose transient micro-chamber clamps track O2 flux while titrating oligomycin, FCCP and rotenone/antimycin A to resolve basal, ATP-linked, proton-leak and spare respiratory capacity.
description_zh_TW: Oxygen Consumption Rate 以 [[Seahorse XF Analyzer]] 即時測定；儀器利用瞬間微腔夾制追蹤 O₂ 通量，並以 [[Oligomycin]]、[[FCCP]] 與 rotenone/antimycin A 滴定，解析基礎呼吸、ATP 連結呼吸、質子漏與呼吸剩餘容量。

label: Fatty acid oxidation
description: PPARα is a nuclear receptor transcription factor whose activation induces fatty acid oxidation, ketogenesis and lipid metabolism programs, lowering triglycerides and improving the lipid profile.
description_zh_TW: PPARα 是核受體轉錄因子，其活化會誘導脂肪酸氧化、生酮與脂質代謝程式，降低三酸甘油酯並改善脂質剖面。

label: GSK3β
description: Glycogen synthase kinase 3 beta (GSK3β) phosphorylates TFEB at serines 134 and 138, residues that influence its subcellular localization and association with lysosomal membranes. These phosphorylations contribute to the regulated shuttling of TFEB and modulate its activity in response to Wnt and growth-factor signaling contexts. Because GSK3β activity is itself controlled by Akt and by nutrient state, this modification embeds TFEB within the broader insulin/PI3K signaling network. The sites complement the better-characterized S211 mark in fine-tuning TFEB localization.
description_zh_TW: 糖原合成酶激酶 3 beta（GSK3β）於 serine 134 和 138 磷酸化 TFEB，這些殘基影響其亞細胞定位和與溶酶體膜的關聯。這些磷酸化有助於 TFEB 的調節性穿梭，並在 Wnt 和生長因子信號背景下調節其活性。由於 GSK3β 活性本身受 Akt 和營養狀態控制，此修飾將 TFEB 嵌入更廣泛的胰島素／PI3K 信號網絡。這些位點補充了特徵更清楚的 S211 標記，以微調 TFEB 定位。

label: MHC type II
description: The alpha2 and beta2 membrane-proximal Ig-like domains of MHC class II form the docking site for the CD4 co-receptor on T helper cells, which is how peptide-MHC II complexes engage CD4+ T cells.
description_zh_TW: MHC 第二類分子的 α2 與 β2 膜近端類免疫球結構域構成輔助受體 CD4 在 T 幫助細胞上的停靠位點，peptide–MHC II 複合體正是藉此接合 CD4+ T 細胞。

label: Silver nanoparticles
description: Silver nanoparticles are a definitional nanoscale subtype of silver compounds. Classification nests the particulate form.
description_zh_TW: 銀奈米顆粒是銀化合物的定義性奈米亞型。歸類嵌套顆粒形式。

label: Sarcopenia
description: Sarcopenia, the progressive and generalized loss of skeletal muscle mass and strength, is a serious problem among older populations and is associated with increased Oxidative Stress and Inflammation. It may be exacerbated by the accumulation of Advanced Glycation End Products in muscle tissue, linking it to dietary and endogenous AGE exposure.
description_zh_TW: Sarcopenia（骨骼肌量與肌力逐漸普遍性的流失）是老年族群中的嚴重問題，並與升高的 Oxidative Stress 及 Inflammation 相關；肌肉組織中 Advanced Glycation End Products 的累積可能使其惡化，將它與飲食性及內源性 AGE 暴露連結起來。

label: Mitochondrial Complex I
description: NDUFA10 is a structural subunit of Mitochondrial Complex I (NADH:ubiquinone oxidoreductase), the first and largest complex of the oxidative phosphorylation electron transport chain. Complex I transfers electrons from NADH to ubiquinone while pumping protons across the inner mitochondrial membrane to build the gradient that drives ATP synthesis.
description_zh_TW: NDUFA10 是 Mitochondrial Complex I（NADH:ubiquinone oxidoreductase）的結構次單元，而 Complex I 是 oxidative phosphorylation 電子傳遞鏈中第一且最大的複合體。Complex I 將電子由 NADH 傳遞給 ubiquinone，同時在粒線體內膜泵出質子以建立驅動 ATP 合成的電化學梯度。

label: Intrinsically Disordered Region
description: Intrinsically disordered regions lack a fixed three-dimensional fold yet drive liquid–liquid phase separation, forming membraneless organelles and condensates, and they are enriched in sites for phosphorylation, acetylation and other post-translational modifications.
description_zh_TW: 內在無序區缺乏固定的三維摺疊，卻能驅動液–液相分離，形成無膜胞器與凝聚體；它們也富含磷酸化、乙醯化等轉譯後修飾位點。

label: Glomerular Filtration Rate
description: Serum creatinine is freely filtered by the glomeruli and is the cornerstone of routine renal function assessment, used to estimate GFR via Cockcroft-Gault, MDRD, and CKD-EPI equations. Its main limitation is dependence on muscle mass, protein intake, and drugs such as cimetidine or trimethoprim that inhibit tubular secretion.
description_zh_TW: Serum creatinine 由腎小球自由濾過，是常規腎功能評估的基石，用於透過 Cockcroft-Gault、MDRD 與 CKD-EPI 公式估算 GFR。其主要限制是受肌肉量、蛋白質攝取，以及 cimetidine 或 trimethoprim 等抑制腎小管分泌的藥物影響。

label: Histone Acetylation
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: Acetyl-CoA is the obligate donor for protein acetylation, including histone acetylation, a modification associated with chromatin relaxation and increased accessibility to transcriptional machinery. In senescent cells, acetyl-CoA availability determines H3K27ac deposition at SASP gene loci: enhancing acetyl-CoA levels promotes SASP gene expression while depleting it limits the programme. Acetate supplementation, converted intracellularly into acetyl-CoA by ACSS2, increases nuclear acetylation and induces pro-inflammatory genes IL6, IL8, IL1B and CCL2 without affecting cell cycle regulators, linking mitochondrial metabolism to the epigenetic regulation of inflammatory genes.
description_zh_TW: 乙醯輔酶A（acetyl-CoA）是蛋白質乙醯化（包括組蛋白乙醯化）的必然供體；此修飾與染色質鬆弛及轉錄機制可及性增加有關。在衰老細胞中，乙醯輔酶A的可用性決定了 SASP 基因座位的 H3K27ac 沉積：提高乙醯輔酶A濃度可促進 SASP 基因表現，而耗竭乙醯輔酶A則會限制此程序。補充乙酸（在細胞內由 ACSS2 轉化為乙醯輔酶A）可增加細胞核乙醯化，並誘導 IL6、IL8、IL1B 與 CCL2 等促發炎基因表現，但不影響細胞週期調節因子，將粒線體代謝與發炎基因的表觀遺傳調控連結起來。

label: Arterial Stiffening
description: In preclinical and early clinical studies, alagebrium improved arterial compliance, reduced arterial stiffening and enhanced left-ventricular diastolic function, effects attributed to reversal of AGE-mediated matrix rigidification.
description_zh_TW: 在臨床前與早期臨床研究中，Alagebrium 改善動脈順應性、降低 Arterial Stiffening 並提升左心室舒張功能，這些效果歸因於逆轉 AGE 所致基質僵硬。

label: Histone H3
description: Histone H3 is one of the core histones that form the Nucleosome: together with Histone H4 it makes an (H3-H4)2 tetramer that organizes the central 120–130 bp of DNA wrapped around the particle. H3 is among the most highly conserved proteins across eukaryotes and carries a dense array of post-translational modifications on its ~40-residue N-terminal tail.
description_zh_TW: Histone H3 是構成 Nucleosome 的核心組蛋白之一：它與 Histone H4 共同形成 (H3-H4)2 四聚體，組織纏繞在核小體上的中央 120–130 bp DNA。H3 是真核生物中序列最保守的蛋白質之一，其約 40 個殘基的 N 端尾帶上帶有密集的轉譯後修飾。

label: Intermittent Fasting
description: Intermittent fasting (IF) is a dietary intervention that periodically restricts caloric intake, producing the nutrient deprivation signals that robustly induce autophagy in many tissues. In preclinical cancer models, cycles of IF combined with chemotherapy have been shown to slow tumor growth and improve therapeutic index by exploiting the differential stress resistance of normal versus malignant cells. The protective effect of autophagy during fasting helps normal cells tolerate chemotherapy, while many tumors remain reliant on constitutive autophagy for survival. These findings position IF as a translational strategy to modulate autophagic tone for anti-cancer and pro-longevity benefits.
description_zh_TW: 間歇性斷食（IF）是一種週期性限制熱量攝取的飲食介入，產生營養剝奪訊號，在許多組織中強力誘導自噬。在臨床前癌症模型中，IF週期與化療相結合已被證明可減緩腫瘤生長並改善治療指數，這是透過利用正常細胞與惡性細胞的差異性壓力抵抗。斷食期間自噬的保護作用幫助正常細胞耐受化療，而許多腫瘤仍依賴組成型自噬以存活。這些發現將IF定位為一種轉譯策略，用於調節自噬張力以獲得抗癌和促長壽的益處。

label: Acute Myeloid Leukemia
description: Acute myeloid leukemia is the most common acute leukemia in adults and belongs to the broader disease category of leukemia. It is characterized by clonal expansion of immature myeloid blasts that fail to differentiate. AML is a distinct subtype within the leukemia family.
description_zh_TW: 急性骨髓性白血病是成人中最常見的急性白血病，屬於更廣泛的白血病疾病類別。其特徵是不成熟骨髓母細胞的克隆擴張且未能分化。AML 是白血病家族中的一個獨特亞型。

label: One-Carbon Metabolism
description: MTHFD2 sits immediately downstream of SHMT2, which converts serine to glycine plus 5,10-methylene-THF in the mitochondrial folate cycle — the dominant source of one-carbon units and mitochondrial NADPH in proliferating and cancer cells. Because it generates NADPH while feeding folate/one-carbon flux into 10-formyl-THF for purine and nucleotide synthesis, MTHFD2 is a junction where carbon metabolism and redox defence converge.
description_zh_TW: MTHFD2 位於 SHMT2 的下游；SHMT2 在粒線體葉酸循環中將 serine 轉為 glycine 與 5,10-亞甲基 THF，而此循環是增殖細胞與癌細胞中一碳單位與粒線體 NADPH 的主要來源。由於 MTHFD2 一方面產生 NADPH，另一方面將葉酸／一碳通量送入 10-甲醯 THF 以供嘌呤與核苷酸合成，它是碳代謝與氧化還原防禦交會的節點。

label: Epigenetic Remodeling
description: Cellular reprogramming is fundamentally an epigenetic remodeling process that erases somatic memory and installs a new cellular identity. Reprogramming requires global erasure of somatic DNA methylation, reconfiguration of histone marks, and resetting of the chromatin landscape at pluripotency loci, driven by pioneer factors and chromatin remodelers. The process proceeds through defined phases, including a mesenchymal-to-epithelial transition, and culminates in the establishment of a stable pluripotent state in induced pluripotent stem cells.
description_zh_TW: 細胞重編程從根本上來說是一種表觀遺傳重塑過程，它會消除體細胞記憶並安裝新的細胞身份。重編程需要在先鋒因子和染色質重塑因子的驅動下，全面消除體細胞 DNA 甲基化、重新配置組蛋白標記以及重置多能性位點的染色質景觀。這個過程經歷確定的階段，包括間質到上皮的轉變，並最終在誘導多能幹細胞中建立穩定的多能狀態。

description: SIRT1 deacetylates the scaffold protein 14-3-3ζ (lysine 49), identified by a biotin-switch proteomics screen for cytoplasmic SIRT1 substrates. Deacetylated 14-3-3ζ maintains its phosphorylation-dependent binding to caspase-2, shielding caspase-2 Ser135 (phosphorylated by CaMKII) from dephosphorylation. When SIRT1 activity drops, 14-3-3ζ becomes acetylated and dissociates from caspase-2, allowing the apical caspase to activate. This is the first demonstration of cytoplasmic 14-3-3 acetylation as a death-regulatory modification.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 會去乙醯化支架蛋白 14-3-3ζ（離胺酸 49），此為針對細胞質 SIRT1 受質之 biotin-switch 蛋白質體學篩選的發現。去乙醯化的 14-3-3ζ 維持其與 caspase-2 之磷酸化依賴性結合，保護 Caspase-2 Ser135（由 CaMKII 磷酸化）不被去磷酸化。當 SIRT1 活性下降時，14-3-3ζ 被乙醯化並與 caspase-2 解離，使這個頂端 caspase 得以活化。這是首次證明細胞質 14-3-3 乙醯化具有死亡調控功能。

label: RAS
description: Activated RAS (e.g., HRASG12V) is a prototypical OIS-inducing oncogene, driving hyperproliferation and replication stress that triggers senescence as a tumor-suppressive failsafe. RAS signaling pushes cells into S-phase at excessive frequency, generating DNA damage that stabilizes p53 and derepresses p16, enforcing durable arrest. The relationship is a foundational model of OIS, first described by Serrano in 1997, and is extensively validated across cell and animal systems. It underlies the concept of oncogene-induced tumor-suppressive barriers.
description_zh_TW: 活化的 RAS（如 HRASG12V）是典型 OIS 誘發致癌基因，驅動過度增殖與複製壓力，觸發衰老作為腫瘤抑制失效安全。RAS 訊號以過高頻率將細胞推入 S 期，產生 DNA 損傷並激活 DDR 以強制停滯。此誘發是致癌基因誘發衰老的原型，並將癌基因活化直接耦合到生長停止。它是理解 OIS 作為腫瘤抑制屏障的基礎。

label: Bladder Cancer
description: Bladder Cancer is treated with BCG. BCG (Bacillus Calmette–Guérin) is a live attenuated mycobacterium delivered as intravesical immunotherapy for non-muscle-invasive bladder cancer, reducing recurrence and progression; it activates immune-mediated cytotoxicity against urothelial tumor cells.
description_zh_TW: 膀胱癌（Bladder Cancer）以 BCG 治療。BCG（卡介苗）是一種活的減毒分枝桿菌，以膀胱內灌注免疫療法用於非肌肉侵犯性膀胱癌，可降低復發與進展；它會啟動針對尿路上皮腫瘤細胞的免疫介導細胞毒性。

label: Hexokinase 2
description: Metabolic Reprogramming relates to Hexokinase 2 through the relation involves. Metabolic reprogramming is the rewiring of nutrient uptake and bioenergetics that supplies building blocks and redox balance to proliferating tumors. Hexokinase 2 is the glycolytic first-step enzyme most strongly induced in cancer, where it often tethers to mitochondria to couple glycolysis to survival. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
description_zh_TW: Metabolic Reprogramming 透過關係涉及 Hexokinase 2 與 Hexokinase 2 相關。 Metabolic Reprogramming 是營養吸收和生物能的重新佈線，為增殖的腫瘤提供建構模組和氧化還原平衡。 Hexokinase 2 是癌症中最強烈誘導的糖解第一步酶，它經常與粒線體結合，將糖解與生存結合。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

label: Vps34
description: BEC-1 is part of the Class III PI3K complex containing Vps34, through which it acts as a key regulator of Autophagy and is essential for nucleation of the Autophagosome in C. elegans.
description_zh_TW: BEC-1 是含有 Vps34 的 Class III PI3K 複合體的組成，藉此作為 Autophagy 的關鍵調節因子，並對 C. elegans 中 Autophagosome 的成核不可或缺。

label: BAK
description: BAK (Bcl-2 homologous antagonist/killer, gene BCL2L7) is a pro-apoptotic effector of the Bcl-2 family. Unlike the mostly cytosolic BAX, BAK is constitutively embedded in the outer mitochondrial membrane of healthy cells, holding BH1–BH3 domains that are restrained by anti-apoptotic partners such as Bcl-2 and Mcl-1.
description_zh_TW: BAK（Bcl-2 homologous antagonist/killer，基因 BCL2L7）是 Bcl-2 家族的促凋亡效應蛋白。與主要存在於細胞質的 BAX 不同，BAK 在健康細胞中組成型地嵌入粒線體外膜，具有 BH1–BH3 結構域，並受 Bcl-2、Mcl-1 等抗凋亡蛋白制約。

label: Slug
description: Slug (SNAI2) is a core zinc-finger driver of EMT. Parallel driver to Snail.
description_zh_TW: Slug（SNAI2）是 EMT 的核心鋅指驅動者。與 Snail 平行的驅動者。

label: Niacin
description: Nicotinic acid (niacin) at pharmacological doses reduces serum cholesterol levels in humans, but its clinical use is limited by a side effect of skin flushing accompanied by an unpleasant warmth sensation and often itching. Niacin, together with tryptophan and nicotinamide, is one of the classic NAD+ biosynthesis precursors historically used to prevent and treat pellagra, a disease characterized by dermatitis, diarrhea, and dementia. Tryptophan alone is not sufficient to sustain cellular NAD+ levels because it participates in other metabolic pathways such as serotonin, melatonin, and picolinic acid synthesis, making nicotinic acid an important dietary NAD+ precursor with distinct pharmacological actions.
description_zh_TW: Nicotinic acid (niacin) 在藥理劑量下可降低人類的血清膽固醇水平，但其臨床使用受限於皮膚潮紅的副作用，伴隨令人不適的溫熱感，且常伴隨搔癢。Niacin 與 tryptophan 及 nicotinamide 同為歷來用於預防和治療 pellagra 的經典 NAD+ 生合成前驅物，該疾病以皮膚炎、腹瀉和癡呆為特徵。單靠 tryptophan 不足以維持細胞內 NAD+ 水平，因為它參與其他代謝途徑，如 serotonin、melatonin 和 picolinic acid 的合成，使得 nicotinic acid 成為一種具有獨特藥理作用的重要膳食 NAD+ 前驅物。

label: Ascaris
description: Trichuris is classified together with Ascaris and hookworms as a soil-transmitted helminth, and long-term ivermectin treatment for onchocerciasis is associated with reduced prevalence of co-infections by these soil-transmitted helminths, which together infect over one billion people.
description_zh_TW: Trichuris 與 Ascaris 及鉤蟲同屬土壤傳播蠕蟲；以 Ivermectin 長期治療河盲症，也與這些土壤傳播蠕蟲共同感染的盛行率下降相關，而它們合計感染逾十億人。

label: Irisin
description: Skeletal muscle acts as a major endocrine organ, releasing myokines — most studied is Irisin, the cleaved ectodomain of FNDC5 — that travel via circulation to adipose tissue, bone, brain and vasculature, linking physical activity to systemic health.
description_zh_TW: 骨骼肌扮演主要內分泌器官的角色，釋放 myokine；其中研究最深入的是 Irisin，也就是 FNDC5 被切割後的外域片段。它經血液循環作用於脂肪組織、骨骼、腦與血管，將身體活動與全身健康連結起來。

label: PDGFAA
description: Senescent Cells transiently accumulate at the wound edge during cutaneous injury and secrete PDGFAA alongside osteopontin. The secreted growth factor is what recruits and differentiates fibroblasts into myofibroblasts, so the senescent cell is not merely a bystander but a required temporary signal source for optimal tissue repair.
description_zh_TW: 在皮膚損傷期間，Senescent Cells 會於傷口邊緣短暫累積，並與 osteopontin 一同分泌 PDGFAA。所分泌的這個生長因子正是招募並分化纖維細胞為肌成纖維細胞的訊號，因此衰老細胞並非單純旁觀者，而是最佳組織修復所必需的暫時訊號來源。

label: Tumor Suppressor
description: Beclin 1 is a core autophagy protein and a haploinsufficient tumor suppressor whose monoallelic deletion is frequently observed in human ovarian, breast, and prostate cancers. Loss of one BECN1 allele reduces autophagic flux, increasing susceptibility to oxidative damage, genomic instability, and inflammation that favor tumor initiation. Mechanistically, Beclin 1 functions as the scaffold of the PI3K III nucleation complex, and its interaction with Bcl-2 family members further couples autophagy to apoptotic regulation. Its frequent deletion in epithelial cancers established autophagy as a genuine tumor-suppression pathway.
description_zh_TW: Beclin 1是一種核心自噬蛋白和單倍體不足型腫瘤抑制因子，其單等位基因缺失常見於人類卵巢癌、乳腺癌和前列腺癌。失去一個BECN1等位基因會降低自噬流，增加對氧化損傷、基因組不穩定和發炎的易感性，有利於腫瘤起始。在機制上，Beclin 1作為PI3K III成核複合體的支架，其與Bcl-2家族成員的交互作用進一步將自噬與凋亡調控耦合。它在上皮癌中的頻繁缺失確立了自噬作為一條真正的腫瘤抑制途徑。

label: Natural Killer Cells
description: Natural Killer Cells are a major source of Interferon-gamma (IFN-gamma), which activates macrophages, upregulates MHC expression, and promotes Th1 responses; IFN-gamma production declines with age as part of immunosenescence.
description_zh_TW: Natural Killer Cells 是 Interferon-gamma (IFN-γ) 的主要來源，該細胞激素可活化巨噬細胞、上調 MHC 表現並促進 Th1 反應；隨年齡增長，IFN-γ 的產量會因免疫老化而下降。

label: Protein Synthesis
description: mTORC1 promotes cap-dependent protein synthesis by phosphorylating the eukaryotic initiation factor 4E-binding protein 1 (4E-BP1), releasing eIF4E to initiate translation, and by phosphorylating S6 kinase 1 (S6K1), which enhances ribosome biogenesis and translational capacity. These outputs prioritize anabolic processes when nutrients and growth factors are plentiful. The stimulation of protein synthesis is a major consumer of cellular energy and amino acids, balanced against the catabolic program of autophagy. Dysregulated mTORC1-driven translation contributes to hypertrophy and malignancy.
description_zh_TW: mTORC1 透過磷酸化真核起始因子 4E 結合蛋白 1（4E-BP1）促進帽依賴性蛋白質合成，釋放 eIF4E 以起始轉譯，並透過磷酸化 S6 激酶 1（S6K1）增強核醣體生物發生和轉譯能力。這些輸出在營養和生長因子充裕時優先安排合成代謝過程。蛋白質合成的刺激是細胞能量和胺基酸的主要消耗者，需與自噬的分解代謝程序取得平衡。失調的 mTORC1 驅動轉譯促成肥大和惡性腫瘤。

label: Cardiac Hypertrophy
description: Through SIRT3 activation, honokiol reverses pathological cardiac hypertrophy and protects against doxorubicin-induced cardiotoxicity in preclinical models. Directionally, honokiol activates SIRT3 to engage antihypertrophic and antioxidant programs.
