By activating mitochondrial defenses, it counters the oxidative and energetic deficits of failing myocardium and suppresses the ROS-driven signaling that sustains hypertrophic growth. This positions SIRT3 as a therapeutic node in heart failure, consistent with the observations that SIRT3-deficient mice develop severe hypertrophy and fibrosis while SIRT3-overexpressing mice are resistant to hypertrophy-inducing stimuli.
description_zh_TW: 通過 SIRT3 活化，厚朴酚在臨床前模型中逆轉病理性心臟肥大並保護對抗 doxorubicin 誘導的心臟毒性。在方向性上，厚朴酚活化 SIRT3 以啟動抗肥大和抗氧化程序。通過活化粒線體防禦，它對抗衰竭心肌的氧化和能量缺陷，並抑制維持肥大生長的 ROS 驅動信號。這將 SIRT3 定位為心臟衰竭的治療節點，與 SIRT3 缺乏小鼠發展嚴重肥大和纖維化而 SIRT3 過量表達小鼠對肥大誘導刺激具有抗性的觀察一致。

label: Myelin
description: Multiple Sclerosis impairs Myelin through an autoimmune, T cell-mediated attack on myelin antigens such as MBP, PLP and MOG. Stripping the sheath in the central nervous system disrupts saltatory conduction and removes the trophic signals myelin provides to axons, so demyelination converts an inflammatory lesion into irreversible axonal degeneration.
description_zh_TW: Multiple Sclerosis 透過針對 MBP、PLP 與 MOG 等髓鞘抗原的自體免疫性 T 細胞攻擊損害 Myelin。在中樞神經系統剝除髓鞘會破壞跳躍式傳導，並移除髓鞘提供給軸突的營養訊號，因此脫髓鞘會把發炎性病灶轉為不可逆的軸突變性。

label: Asthma
description: Asthma is associated with glutathione depletion, as the GSH/GSSG ratio is markedly decreased in asthmatic airways, weakening local antioxidant defense. This sensitizes the airway to oxidant triggers and allergen-induced inflammation. The directionality is disease to lowered thiol buffer. A caveat is that glutathione changes vary by asthma phenotype and severity, and some patients show different redox patterns. Replenishing airway GSH with N-acetylcysteine has been explored as an adjunctive strategy to restore antioxidant capacity in asthmatic airways.
description_zh_TW: Asthma 與 glutathione depletion 相關，因為 asthmatic 氣道中的 GSH/GSSG 比率顯著降低，削弱了局部抗氧化防禦。這會使氣道對氧化劑觸發物和過敏原引起的發炎變得敏感。方向性是降低硫醇緩衝液的疾病。需要注意的是，glutathione 的變化因 asthma 表型和嚴重程度而異，並且一些患者表現出不同的氧化還原模式。人們已經探索以 N-乙醯半胱氨酸補充氣道 GSH 作為恢復 asthmatic 氣道抗氧化能力的輔助策略。

label: Propolis
description: Propolis inhibits NF-κB, with its caffeic acid phenethyl ester (CAPE) acting as a potent inhibitor of NF-κB and of COX-2. This transcription-factor suppression is the shared mechanistic basis for both the anti-inflammatory and the anti-cancer activity attributed to propolis extracts.
description_zh_TW: Propolis 抑制 NF-κB，其中咖啡酸苯乙酯（CAPE）是 NF-κB 與 COX-2 的強效抑制劑。這種轉錄因子抑制，是 propolis 萃取物同時具有抗發炎與抗癌活性的共同機轉基礎。

label: Dopachrome tautomerase
description: Dopachrome tautomerase (DDT) is the historical enzyme name for Tyrosinase-related protein-2 (TRP-2), also known as DCT. Both names refer to the same melanosomal enzyme. It is a type I membrane glycoprotein related to Tyrosinase and TRP-1.
description_zh_TW: Dopachrome tautomerase（DDT）是 Tyrosinase-related protein-2（TRP-2，也稱為 DCT）的歷史性酶名稱。兩個名稱指的是同一種 melanosomal 酶。它是一種與 Tyrosinase 和 TRP-1 相關的 I 型膜醣蛋白。

label: Myeloid-Derived Suppressor Cells
description: Myeloid-derived suppressor cells (MDSCs) are the most functionally important population of immature myeloid cells: rather than representing a single lineage, their classification reflects an arrested differentiation state with polymorphonuclear and monocytic subsets. They are scarce at steady state but expand dramatically under pathological stress, and are recruited into the tumor microenvironment where they suppress T-cell and NK-cell function through arginine depletion, reactive oxygen species and induction of regulatory T cells.
description_zh_TW: Myeloid-derived suppressor cells (MDSCs) 是 immature myeloid cells 中功能上最重要的族群：其分類反映的是一種分化停滯狀態（具有 polymorphonuclear 與 monocytic 亞群），而非單一譜系。她們在穩態下稀少，但在病理壓力下大幅擴張，並被招募進 tumor microenvironment，透過消耗 arginine、產生 reactive oxygen species 及誘導 regulatory T cells 來抑制 T 細胞與 NK 細胞功能。

label: Mitoxantrone
description: Mitoxantrone inhibits topoisomerase II as its primary target, mirroring the FL118-Topo-I pattern. Target defines the drug.
description_zh_TW: Mitoxantrone 以拓樸異構酶 II 為主要標靶，呼應 FL118-Topo-I 模式。標靶定義藥物。

label: Noncanonical Inflammasome
description: Human caspase-4 is a cytosolic-LPS sensor and noncanonical effector alongside caspase-5, paralleling murine caspase-11. It cleaves gasdermin D and IL-1α to drive SASP and pyroptotic signaling.
description_zh_TW: 人類 caspase-4 是胞質 LPS 感受器與非典型效應因子，與 caspase-5 並列，對應小鼠 caspase-11。它切割 gasdermin D 與 IL-1α 以驅動 SASP 與 pyroptotic 訊號。

label: PTEN
description: PTEN is a lipid phosphatase that dephosphorylates PIP3, thereby antagonizing PI3K/Akt signalling; its opposition to PI3K forms one branch of the incoherent bivalent motif centred on mTORC1.
description_zh_TW: PTEN 是脂質磷酸酶，可將 PIP3 去磷酸化，因而拮抗 PI3K/Akt 訊號；其與 PI3K 的對抗構成以 mTORC1 為中心的不一致雙價 motif 的一個分支。

label: Telomere
description: Telomeres protect chromosome ends from being recognized as double-strand breaks, and telomere dysfunction deprotects chromosome ends contributing to genomic instability. Shortened or dysfunctional telomeres drive DNA-damage signaling and instability.
description_zh_TW: 端粒保護染色體末端不被辨識為雙股斷裂，而端粒功能障礙會去保護染色體末端，促成基因體不穩定。縮短或功能障礙的端粒驅動 DNA 損傷訊號與不穩定。

label: E2F
description: Hypophosphorylated RB1 binds and represses E2F transcription factors in G1. This suppression withholds S-phase genes until CDK phosphorylation releases them.
description_zh_TW: 低磷酸化 RB1 在 G1 結合並抑制 E2F 轉錄因子。此抑制扣留 S 期基因，直到 CDK 磷酸化釋放它們。

label: Nicotinic acid
description: Nicotinic acid (niacin) enters the Preiss-Handler Pathway, where NAPRT forms NaMN, NMNAT adenylates it to NaAD, and NAD+ synthetase amidates NaAD to NAD+. This route bypasses NAMPT, the rate-limiting and NAD+-sensitive step of the salvage pathway.
description_zh_TW: [[Nicotinic acid]]（niacin）經由 Preiss-Handler Pathway 進入 [[NAD+]] 合成：NAPRT 形成 NaMN，[[NMNAT]] 將其腺苷酸化為 NaAD，再由 NAD+ 合成酶醯胺化生成 [[NAD+]]。此途徑繞過補救途徑中的限速步驟 [[NAMPT]]。

label: Autophagic Flux
description: Autophagic flux—the complete rate of cargo delivery to and degradation within lysosomes—declines progressively with age in many tissues. This decline stems from impaired initiation, reduced lysosomal proteolytic capacity, and accumulated lipofuscin that compromises lysosomal function, producing a state of proteostatic insufficiency. The resulting accumulation of damaged organelles and protein aggregates contributes centrally to the aging phenotype and to age-related diseases such as neurodegeneration and sarcopenia. Restoration of autophagic flux is therefore a major hypothesized mechanism through which longevity interventions exert their benefits.
description_zh_TW: 自噬流——即貨物遞送至溶酶體及在溶酶體內降解的完整速率——在許多組織中隨年齡漸進下降。此下降源於起始受損、溶酶體蛋白水解能力降低，以及累積的脂褐質損害溶酶體功能，產生蛋白質穩態不足的狀態。由此導致的受損胞器和蛋白聚集物累積，對老化表型和神經退化、肌肉減少症等與年齡相關疾病有核心貢獻。因此，恢復自噬流是長壽介入發揮其益處的一個主要假設機制。

label: IGF1
description: Intermittent fasting lowers circulating insulin-like growth factor 1 (IGF-1), a potent mitogenic and pro-survival hormone whose signaling converges on the PI3K-Akt-mTOR axis to inhibit autophagy. In a breast cancer model, a 48-hour fasting period reduced IGF-1 levels by approximately 70%, dampening pro-tumorigenic IGF-1 receptor signaling. The resulting reduction in mTORC1 activity contributes to the fasting-induced activation of autophagy and the enhanced stress resistance of normal tissues. Lower IGF-1 during fasting is therefore a key endocrine mechanism linking IF to both tumor suppression and longevity.
description_zh_TW: 間歇性斷食降低循環的類胰島素生長因子1（IGF-1），這是一種強效的促有絲分裂和促存活激素，其訊號匯聚於PI3K-Akt-mTOR軸以抑制自噬。在乳腺癌模型中，48小時斷食使IGF-1水平降低約70%，減弱促腫瘤生成的IGF-1受體訊號。由此產生的mTORC1活性降低有助於斷食誘導的自噬活化和正常組織增強的壓力抵抗。因此，斷食期間較低的IGF-1是將IF與腫瘤抑制和長壽連結的關鍵內分泌機制。

label: Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus
source_file: Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus.md
description: Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus and Parkinson's Disease are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus and Parkinson's Disease may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus 和 Parkinson's Disease 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus 和 Parkinson's Disease 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Orexin
description: Narcolepsy type 1 is driven by loss of orexin-producing hypothalamic neurons destabilizing sleep-wake boundaries. The association is the causal core of the disorder's pathophysiology.
description_zh_TW: 第一型 narcolepsy 由喪失下視丘食慾素神經元、破壞睡眠覺醒邊界所驅動。此關聯是疾病病理生理的因果核心。

label: Senescence-Associated Distension of Satellites
description: Senescence-Associated Distension of Satellites (SADS) is the striking decompaction of constitutive pericentromeric/pericentrosomal satellite heterochromatin that occurs in many senescent cell models. Unlike the facultative heterochromatin of SAHF, SADS affects constitutive heterochromatin and occurs regardless of SAHF presence, reflecting a global loosening of repressive chromatin in senescence.
description_zh_TW: Senescence-Associated Distension of Satellites（SADS）是許多衰老細胞模型中構成性 pericentromeric/pericentrosomal 衛星異染色質的顯著解壓縮。與 SAHF 的兼性異染色質不同，SADS 影響的是構成性異染色質且不論是否形成 SAHF 都會發生，反映衰老中抑制性染色質的整體鬆動。

label: GSK3
description: GSK3 builds the S155/S159/T163 phosphodegron routing Mcl-1 to SCF degradation.
description_zh_TW: GSK3 建立 S155/S159/T163 磷酸降解子，將 Mcl-1 送往 SCF 降解。

label: Hydroxyl Radicals
description: Amifostine (WR-2721) is a phosphorothioate prodrug dephosphorylated at the cell membrane by alkaline phosphatase to the free-thiol metabolite WR-1065, which accumulates selectively in normal tissues. WR-1065 donates hydrogen atoms to neutralize hydroxyl radicals (HO•) generated by ionizing radiation, protecting DNA and proteins from radiation-induced damage.
description_zh_TW: Amifostine（WR-2721）是磷硫代前藥，在細胞膜上被鹼性磷酸酶去磷酸化為游離硫醇代謝物 WR-1065，並選擇性地累積於正常組織。WR-1065 提供氫原子以中和電離輻射產生的氫自由基（HO•），保護 DNA 與蛋白質免受輻射誘發的損傷。

label: Cigarette Smoke
description: Cigarette smoke contains free radicals, including semiquinone radicals, hydroxyl radicals, and nitric oxide, plus a large burden of gaseous and particulate oxidants. These directly and indirectly raise lung oxidant load. The directionality is smoke-derived radicals to tissue oxidation. A caveat is that the tar-phase semiquinones can redox-cycle and generate sustained ROS long after exposure, so the effect outlasts the inhaled puff. Both the gas phase and tar phase carry oxidants, and the balance between oxidant load and lung antioxidant capacity determines tissue damage.
description_zh_TW: Cigarette smoke 包含 free radicals，包括半醌自由基、hydroxyl radicals 和 nitric oxide，以及大量氣態和顆粒氧化劑。這些直接和間接地增加了肺的氧化負荷。方向性是煙霧衍生的自由基對組織的氧化。需要注意的是，焦油相半醌在暴露後很長一段時間內可以進行氧化還原循環並產生持續的 ROS，因此其效果比吸入的煙霧更持久。氣相和焦油相均攜帶氧化劑，氧化劑負荷與肺抗氧化能力之間的平衡決定了組織損傷。

label: MERCS
description: MERCS localize fusion/fission machinery such as DRP1, so their altered abundance in senescence or neurodegeneration reshapes mitochondrial morphology; in the R6/1 Huntington's disease model, increased DRP1-mediated fission reduces MERCS and impairs mitochondrial calcium handling.
description_zh_TW: MERCS 會定位融合／分裂機制（如 DRP1），因此在衰老或神經退化時其數量改變會重塑粒線體形態；在 R6/1 亨丁頓症模型中，DRP1 媒介的分裂增加會減少 MERCS 並損害粒線體的鈣離子處理。

label: 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine
description: 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine is the most abundant oxidative lesion in DNA, with roughly 10^3 to 10^6 lesions per cell per day arising from normal metabolism and extrinsic insults. Its prevalence reflects both high formation rate and efficient but imperfect repair. The directionality is oxidation of guanine to the dominant adduct. A caveat is that the steady-state level integrates formation and repair, so it is an indirect rather than instantaneous measure of ROS flux. The steady-state 8-oxodG level is influenced by both the rate of oxidation and the efficiency of OGG1-mediated repair, so it reflects the balance between insult and defense.
description_zh_TW: 8-oxo-2'-deoxyguanosine 是 DNA 中最豐富的氧化損傷，每個細胞每天約有 10^3 至 10^6 個損傷，這些損傷是由正常代謝和外在損傷引起的。它的流行反映了高形成率和有效但不完善的修復。方向性是鳥嘌呤氧化成主要加合物。需要注意的是，穩態水平整合了形成和修復，因此它是 ROS 通量的間接而非瞬時測量。穩態8-oxodG水平受到氧化速率和OGG1介導的修復效率的影響，因此它反映了損傷和防禦之間的平衡。

label: Pentose Phosphate Pathway
description: The Pentose Phosphate Pathway reduces NADP+ to NADPH. This oxidative branch is the main source of cellular reducing power; NADPH then regenerates reduced Glutathione and drives reductive biosynthesis, so the pathway sits upstream of glutathione-dependent antioxidant defense.
description_zh_TW: Pentose Phosphate Pathway 將 NADP+ 還原成 NADPH。這條氧化支路是細胞還原力的主要來源；所產生的 NADPH 接著再生還原態的 Glutathione 並驅動還原性生合成，因此該路徑位於穀胱甘肽依賴型抗氧化防禦的上游。

label: E-cadherin
description: CDH1 encodes the E-cadherin protein product. Gene-to-protein definitional edge.
description_zh_TW: CDH1 編碼 E-cadherin 蛋白產物。基因到蛋白的定義邊。

label: IL-8
description: IL-8 (CXCL8) is a prototypical SASP chemokine secreted by senescent cells, essential for neutrophil recruitment and, in tumors, cancer stemness via CXCR2 signaling. It is co-induced with IL-6 downstream of NF-kB and IL-1a and is frequently measured alongside IL-6 as a SASP readout. IL-8's roles in both inflammation and tumor promotion underscore the dual nature of the secretome, supporting wound-healing neutrophil influx acutely while contributing to chronic inflammation and therapy resistance. It is a canonical component of the senescent secretome.
description_zh_TW: 介白素-8（IL-8）與 IL-6 同為衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）中最知名的細胞激素之一。IL-8 由衰老細胞分泌，重塑局部組織微環境並對鄰近細胞發揮旁分泌效應。在本研究中，重組 IL-8（以 1:2 比例與 IL-6 合併）在增生細胞中誘導酸性神經醯胺酶表現，此現象可由衰老細胞共培養重現，導致脂質過氧化升高並使旁觀細胞對鐵死亡敏感。

label: Sox2
description: Sox2 maintains neural stem cells by preserving their self-renewal and multipotency, the ability to generate neurons, astrocytes, and oligodendrocytes. Sox2 is expressed in neural stem cells of the developing and adult brain, where it is a central determinant of neural identity and is often necessary and sometimes sufficient for direct neural conversion. In reprogramming to induced neural stem cells, forced expression of Sox2 remodels the somatic epigenome toward a neural fate. Sox2 is thus a linchpin connecting pluripotency regulation to neurogenesis and neural repair.
description_zh_TW: Sox2 透過保留神經幹細胞的自我更新和多能性、生成神經元、星狀膠質細胞和少突膠質細胞的能力來維持神經幹細胞。 Sox2 在發育中和成年 brain 的神經幹細胞中表達，它是神經身份的核心決定因素，對於直接神經轉換通常是必要的，有時是充分的。在對誘導神經幹細胞進行重編程時，Sox2 的強製表達將體細胞表觀基因組重塑為神經命運。因此，Sox2 是將多能性調節與神經生成和神經修復聯繫起來的關鍵。

label: CDK2
source_file: _document_ - Cellular senescence and SASP in tumor progression and therapeutic opportunities.md
description: Cyclin A is an S/G2-phase cyclin whose complex with CDK2 initiates and executes S phase, with Cyclin A-CDK1 later contributing to mitotic entry. Cyclin A is then degraded via the APC/C at the metaphase-anaphase transition, enforcing irreversible cell-cycle progression.
description_zh_TW: Cyclin A 是 S/G2 期的 cyclin，與 CDK2 形成的複合體啟動並執行 S 期，之後 Cyclin A-CDK1 參與有絲分裂進入。Cyclin A 隨後在中期-後期轉換時經 APC/C 降解，使細胞週期進展不可逆。

label: TNF-alpha
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNF-alpha) is a cell signaling protein (cytokine) involved in systemic Inflammation and one of the cytokines that make up the acute phase reaction. It is a potent activator of the NF-κB pathway, and low-level ROS promote the phosphorylation and degradation of IkappaBalpha by the IKK complex, allowing p65/p50 nuclear translocation. NF-κB then transcriptionally upregulates antioxidant genes (MnSOD, FTH1, HMOX1, glutathione peroxidases, catalase) that form a negative feedback loop limiting TNF-alpha-induced tissue damage.
description_zh_TW: 腫瘤壞死因子 alpha (TNF-alpha) 是參與全身性 Inflammation 的細胞訊號蛋白（細胞激素），也是構成急性期反應的細胞激素之一。它是 NF-κB 途徑的強效活化劑；低濃度的 ROS 促進 IKK 複合體對 IkappaBalpha 的磷酸化與降解，使 p65/p50 得以轉位入核。NF-κB 隨後在轉錄層面上調抗氧化基因（MnSOD、FTH1、HMOX1、穀胱甘肽過氧化酶、catalase），形成限制 TNF-alpha 所致組織損傷的負回饋迴路。

label: Acetyl-CoA
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: Acetyl-CoA is the obligate donor for protein acetylation, including histone acetylation, a modification associated with chromatin relaxation and increased accessibility to transcriptional machinery. In senescent cells, acetyl-CoA availability determines H3K27ac deposition at SASP gene loci: enhancing acetyl-CoA levels promotes SASP gene expression while depleting it limits the programme. Acetate supplementation, converted intracellularly into acetyl-CoA by ACSS2, increases nuclear acetylation and induces pro-inflammatory genes IL6, IL8, IL1B and CCL2 without affecting cell cycle regulators, linking mitochondrial metabolism to the epigenetic regulation of inflammatory genes.
description_zh_TW: 乙醯輔酶A（acetyl-CoA）是蛋白質乙醯化（包括組蛋白乙醯化）的必然供體；此修飾與染色質鬆弛及轉錄機制可及性增加有關。在衰老細胞中，乙醯輔酶A的可用性決定了 SASP 基因座位的 H3K27ac 沉積：提高乙醯輔酶A濃度可促進 SASP 基因表現，而耗竭乙醯輔酶A則會限制此程序。補充乙酸（在細胞內由 ACSS2 轉化為乙醯輔酶A）可增加細胞核乙醯化，並誘導 IL6、IL8、IL1B 與 CCL2 等促發炎基因表現，但不影響細胞週期調節因子，將粒線體代謝與發炎基因的表觀遺傳調控連結起來。

label: DNMT3a
description: Recurrent mutations in DNMT3A, notably the R882H hotspot mutation, are found in approximately 20% of acute myeloid leukemia (AML) cases. These mutations reduce the methyltransferase activity of DNMT3a, disrupting DNA methylation at regulatory regions that control hematopoietic stem cell behavior. The resulting epigenetic dysregulation cooperates with other mutations to drive leukemogenesis, and DNMT3A-mutant clones are frequently detectable in preleukemic states, linking age-associated clonal hematopoiesis to overt AML.
description_zh_TW: 在約 20% 的急性髓性白血病 (AML) 病例中發現了 DNMT3A 的複發突變，尤其是 R882H 熱點突變。這些突變降低了 DNMT3a 的甲基轉移酶活性，破壞了控製造血幹細胞行為的調節區域的 DNA 甲基化。由此產生的表觀遺傳失調與其他突變共同驅動白血病發生，並且在白血病前期狀態中經常可以檢測到 DNMT3A 突變克隆，將年齡相關的克隆造血與明顯的 AML 聯繫起來。

label: Chaperone-Mediated Autophagy
description: Chaperone-Mediated Autophagy (CMA) is one of the three canonical types of Autophagy (alongside Macroautophagy and Microautophagy). Unlike the other routes it does not require vesicle formation: cytosolic proteins carrying a KFERQ-like motif are delivered directly into the lysosome for enzymatic degradation.
description_zh_TW: Chaperone-Mediated Autophagy (CMA) 是 Autophagy 的三種典型類型之一（與 Macroautophagy、Microautophagy 並列）。與其他途徑不同，它不需要囊泡形成：帶有 KFERQ 類基序的細胞質蛋白質直接被運送進 lysosome 進行酵素分解。

label: ARH3
description: ARH3 is the only known hydrolase that removes serine-linked mono-ADP-ribose written by the PARP1/HPF1 complex, completing the ADP-ribosylation cycle after PARG removes bulk polymer. ARH3-KO cells accumulate serine-MAR while HPF1-KO cells lose it.
description_zh_TW: ARH3 是目前已知唯一可移除由 PARP1/HPF1 複合體寫入的絲氨酸單 ADP-核糖修飾的水解酶，在 PARG 移除大量聚合物後完成 ADP-ribosylation 循環。ARH3-KO 細胞堆積 serine-MAR，而 HPF1-KO 細胞則減少。

label: Replicative Senescence
description: WI-38 is a diploid human fetal lung fibroblast cell line derived by Leonard Hayflick in 1962. It has a finite replicative lifespan and enters replicative senescence after roughly 50 population doublings (reaching PDL55-60 by serial passage), which makes it a classical model system for cellular aging research.
description_zh_TW: WI-38 是 Leonard Hayflick 於 1962 年建立的二倍體人類胎兒肺纖維母細胞株。它具有有限的複製壽命，在約 50 次族群倍增後進入 replicative senescence（連續傳代約於 PDL55–60 達到），因此是細胞老化研究的經典模型系統。

label: ADP-ribosylation
description: ARH3 is the only known hydrolase that removes serine-linked mono-ADP-ribose written by the PARP1/HPF1 complex, completing the ADP-ribosylation cycle after PARG removes bulk polymer. ARH3-KO cells accumulate serine-MAR while HPF1-KO cells lose it.
description_zh_TW: ARH3 是目前已知唯一可移除由 PARP1/HPF1 複合體寫入的絲氨酸單 ADP-核糖修飾的水解酶，在 PARG 移除大量聚合物後完成 ADP-ribosylation 循環。ARH3-KO 細胞堆積 serine-MAR，而 HPF1-KO 細胞則減少。

label: ACSL4
description: Acid ceramidase (ACase) inhibition reduces PL-PUFA levels and lipid peroxidation without altering expression of ACSL4, the acyl-CoA synthetase that canonically drives PUFA incorporation into phospholipids during ferroptosis. After ACase knockdown, ACSL4 protein remained high, indicating that the decrease in PL-PUFAs is driven by reduced supply of saturated/monounsaturated fatty acids for Lands-cycle exchange (due to decreased ceramide lipolysis) rather than by changes in ACSL4. Both ACase and ACSL4 knockdown protect senescent cells against RSL3, but through supply-side versus incorporation-side mechanisms respectively.
description_zh_TW: 酸性膽鹼酯酶 (ACase) 抑制降低 PL-PUFA 水平和脂質過氧化而不改變 ACSL4 的表達，ACSᒪ4 是一種 canonically 驅動 PUFA 整合到磷脂中的 acyl-CoA  합성 효소。在 ACase 下調後，ACSL4 蛋白仍然很高，表明 PL-PUFAs 的減少是由飽和/單不飽和脂肪酸的供應減少（由於肌醇酯水解減少）所驅動，而不是由 ACSᒪ4 的變化所引起。ACase 和 ACSᒪ4 下調均能保護衰老細胞免受 RSL3 的影響，但分別通過供應側和整合側機制。

label: Neuropilin-1
description: Cleaved CendR engages Neuropilin-1 for tumor penetration as step two.
description_zh_TW: 切割的 CendR 接合 Neuropilin-1 以腫瘤穿透作為第二步。

label: Hemoglobin
description: Amyl nitrite intentionally oxidizes hemoglobin iron from Fe²⁺ to Fe³⁺, creating methemoglobin that scavenges cyanide as cyanmethemoglobin and spares mitochondrial cytochrome oxidase — the mechanism behind its historical use in cyanide poisoning. The same oxidation causes methemoglobinemia, cyanosis and hypoxia on overuse.
description_zh_TW: Amyl nitrite 會將 Hemoglobin 的鐵由 Fe²⁺ 氧化為 Fe³⁺，形成 Methemoglobin，以 cyanmethemoglobin 形式螯合氰化物並保護粒線體 cytochrome oxidase——這是其在氰化物中毒中歷史性用途的機制。相同的氧化在過量使用時會造成 Methemoglobinemia、Cyanosis 與 Hypoxia。

label: G1 Phase
description: The G1 Phase (Gap 1) is the first gap phase of the cell cycle in eukaryotic cell division, following mitosis or exit from quiescence and preceding S phase. During G1 the cell grows, synthesizes RNAs and proteins, and monitors its environment before committing to DNA replication.
description_zh_TW: G1 期（第一間隙期）是真核細胞分裂中細胞週期的第一個間隙期，緊接有絲分裂或退出靜止期，並先於 S 期。在 G1 期，細胞生長、合成 RNA 和蛋白質，並在決定進行 DNA 複製前監測其環境。

label: Incoherent Bivalent Motif
description: Atypical dose-response curves where a drug's effect does not follow a monotonic shape are referred to as hormetic or biphasic. This computational study shows that all hormetic networks share a similar core structure: an incoherent bivalent network motif centered on the target of the drug, in which the two interactions emanating from the target have net opposite (direct or indirect) effects over the downstream output. Around 18% of all three-node network topologies contain this motif, and topologies with an incoherent bivalent motif show a roughly five-fold increased probability of exhibiting hormesis compared with all topologies.
description_zh_TW: 藥物效應不呈單調形狀的非典型劑量反應曲線稱為荷爾米希（hormetic）或雙相反應。這項計算研究顯示，所有荷爾米希網路共享相似的核心結構：以藥物靶點為中心的不一致雙價網路模體（incoherent bivalent network motif），其中由靶點發出的兩條交互作用對下游輸出具有淨相反（直接或間接）的效應。約 18% 的三節點網路拓撲含有此模體，而含有不一致雙價模體的拓撲展現荷爾米希反應的機率約為所有拓撲的五倍。

label: PP2A
description: Protein phosphatase 2A (PP2A) dephosphorylates TFEB at serines 122, 109, and 114, removing repressive mTORC1 and other kinase marks to permit TFEB nuclear translocation. By counteracting the multiple N-terminal phosphorylations that enforce cytosolic retention, PP2A acts as a key permissive switch for TFEB activation. Its activity is regulated by nutrient state and by regulatory subunits that target it to TFEB. Through this dephosphorylation, PP2A enables the rapid engagement of lysosomal biogenesis when mTORC1 is inhibited.
description_zh_TW: 蛋白磷酸酶 2A（PP2A）在 serine 122、109 和 114 去磷酸化 TFEB，移除抑制性的 mTORC1 及其他激酶標記，以許可 TFEB 核轉運。透過對抗強制細胞質保留的多重 N 端磷酸化，PP2A 充當 TFEB 活化的關鍵許可開關。其活性受營養狀態以及將其標靶至 TFEB 的調節次單元所控制。透過此去磷酸化，PP2A 使得在 mTORC1 受抑制時能快速啟動溶酶體生物發生。

label: Ceramide
description: Acid ceramidase (ACase, encoded by ASAH1) is the lysosomal enzyme that breaks down ceramide into sphingosine and free fatty acids. By controlling ceramide levels, ACase affects the abundance of many lipid species relevant to cell fate decisions, including sphingomyelin, ceramide-1-phosphate, and free fatty acids. In the context of replicative senescence, this ceramide catabolism releases free saturated and monounsaturated fatty acids that feed polyunsaturated fatty acid (PUFA) and PUFA-phospholipid synthesis, remodeling the membrane lipid profile. Acid ceramidase breaks down ceramides into sphingosine and free fatty acids, reshaping membrane lipid composition. In senescent cells, progressively higher expression of this enzyme drives a pro-ferroptotic lipid profile rich in polyunsaturated fatty acids - the preferred substrates for lipid peroxidation. Salk Institute researchers studying human lung cells discovered that elevated acid ceramidase makes senescent cells more susceptible to ferroptosis and that removal of the enzyme protects both young and old cells from ferroptosis-induced death. Because acid ceramidase inhibitors already exist for other therapeutic purposes, the enzyme represents a druggable target for clearing senescent cells and supporting healthy aging.
description_zh_TW: 酸甘油酯酶 (ACase, 编码基因 ASAH1) 是一种溶酶体酶，它将甘油酯分解为神经因子和游离脂肪酸。通过控制甘油酯水平，ACase 影响了许多与细胞命运决策相关的脂质物种的丰度，包括神经因子-1-磷酸酯和游离脂肪酸。在复制性衰老的情况下，这种甘油酯分解释放出饱和和单不饱和脂肪酸，这些脂肪酸为不饱和脂肪酸 (PUFA) 和 PUFA-磷脂合成提供营养，从而重塑膜脂质谱。 酸陶瓷酶將絲胺類分解成腎上腺素和自由脂肪酸，重塑膜脂類組成。在老化的細胞中，這種酶的表達水平隨著時間推移而升高，導致富含不飽和脂肪酸的促進焦蛋白死亡的脂類型態 - 這是脂質過氧化反應的理想底物。沙鹿研究所研究員在研究人類肺細胞時發現，升高後的酸陶瓷酶使老化的細胞更容易受到焦蛋白死亡的影響，並且去除這種酶可以保護年輕和年老的細胞免受焦蛋白誘導的死亡。因為酸陶瓷酶抑制劑已經存在於其他治療用途中，因此這種酶是一個可藥物標靶的目標，可以用於清除老化的細胞並支持健康老齡化。

label: Hydroxyeicosatetraenoic acids
description: Hydroxyeicosatetraenoic acids are monohydroxylated metabolites of Arachidonic acid, formed by addition of a single hydroxyl group at defined positions along the carbon chain. They are the hydroxy counterparts of the hydroperoxy intermediates (HPETEs) generated during Lipid Peroxidation and by lipoxygenase catalysis. Of the family, 5-HETE is the committed precursor of Leukotrienes, 15-HETE feeds lipoxin A4, and 20-HETE is a CYP4A/CYP4F product that constricts renal and cerebral arterioles.
description_zh_TW: Hydroxyeicosatetraenoic acids 是 Arachidonic acid 的單羥化代謝物，由在碳鏈上特定位置加上一個羥基而形成。它們是 Lipid Peroxidation 與 lipoxygenase 催化過程中所產生過氧中間物（HPETEs）的羥基對應物。在這一族中，5-HETE 是 Leukotrienes 的承诺前驅物，15-HETE 通往 lipoxin A4，而 20-HETE 則為 CYP4A/CYP4F 產物，可收縮腎臟與腦動脈小動脈。

label: SMAD3
description: SMAD3 is the co-primary R-SMAD complexing with SMAD4 for nuclear action. Parallel edge to the SMAD2 activation.
description_zh_TW: SMAD3 是與 SMAD4 形成複合體入核作用的共同主要 R-SMAD。與 SMAD2 活化平行的邊。

label: 4-Hydroxynonenal
description: 4-hydroxynonenal promotes tau oligomerization by forming covalent Michael adducts with tau cysteine and lysine residues, altering its conformation and seeding oligomers. As a major lipid-peroxidation aldehyde, 4-HNE thus couples membrane oxidation to protein misfolding. The directionality is aldehyde adduct to tau aggregation propensity. A caveat is that 4-HNE at low levels can also induce adaptive responses, and other aldehydes (MDA, acrolein) modify tau similarly. Elevated 4-HNE and tau adducts colocalize in Alzheimer's disease brain, linking lipid peroxidation to neurofibrillary pathology.
description_zh_TW: 4-hydroxynonenal 透過與 tau 半胱胺酸和離胺酸殘基形成共價邁克爾加合物，改變其構象並播種寡聚物來促進 tau oligomerization。作为一种主要的脂质过氧化醛，4-HNE 将膜氧化与蛋白质错误折叠结合起来。方向性是醛加合物對tau聚集的傾向。需要注意的是，低水平的 4-HNE 也可以誘導適應性反應，其他醛（MDA、丙烯醛）也會類似地修飾 tau。升高的 4-HNE 和 tau 加合物共定位於阿茲海默症大腦中，將 lipid peroxidation 與神經纖維病理聯繫起來。

label: Vimentin
description: The N308K substitution selectively reduces SIRT6-vimentin interaction, which normally promotes SIRT6 degradation, thereby increasing SIRT6 protein levels. Directionally, N308K sits upstream of weakened vimentin binding. This stabilizes SIRT6 and enhances its functional output, and it is the molecular explanation for the centenarian variant phenotype. Because vimentin normally targets SIRT6 for proteasomal degradation, the N308K variant escapes this turnover. This post-translational stabilization, rather than transcriptional upregulation, underlies the increased SIRT6 abundance seen in carriers of the longevity-associated variant.
description_zh_TW: N308K 取代選擇性地減少 SIRT6-vimentin 的相互作用——後者通常促進 SIRT6 降解——從而增加 SIRT6 蛋白水平。在方向性上，N308K 位於 vimentin 結合弱化的上游。這穩定 SIRT6 並增強其功能輸出，是百歲人瑞變異體表型的分子解釋。由於 vimentin 通常靶向 SIRT6 進行蛋白酶體降解，N308K 變異體逃避了這種周轉。這種轉錄後穩定化（而非轉錄上調）構成了長壽相關變異體攜帶者中 SIRT6 豐度增加的基礎。

label: Diabetic nephropathy
description: Albuminuria is the abnormal excretion of plasma albumin into the urine, marking increased glomerular permeability. It is among the earliest detectable manifestations of Diabetic nephropathy, tracks with worsening glomerular injury, and predicts progression to end-stage renal disease.
description_zh_TW: Albuminuria 是血漿白蛋白異常排入尿液的情形，標記腎小球通透性增加。它是 Diabetic nephropathy 最早可偵測的表現之一，與腎小球損傷惡化相關，並可預測疾病進展至末期腎病。

label: Serotonin Syndrome
description: Serotonin syndrome has been reported following administration of methylene blue, particularly when used concomitantly with medications that increase serotonergic activity, including selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors, serotonin-norepinephrine reuptake inhibitors, and monoamine oxidase inhibitors, certain opioids, and dextromethorphan. The FDA labeling carries a boxed warning that methylene blue may cause serious or fatal serotonin syndrome when combined with serotonergic drugs and opioids, and recommends avoiding concomitant use entirely. Clinical manifestations include altered mental status, autonomic instability, neuromuscular abnormalities, seizures, and gastrointestinal symptoms.
description_zh_TW: 在施用methylene blue後已有血清素症候群的報告，特別是當與增加血清素能活性的藥物同時使用時，包括選擇性血清素再吸收抑制劑、血清素-去甲腎上腺素再吸收抑制劑和單胺氧化酶抑制劑、某些鴉片類藥物和dextromethorphan。FDA標籤帶有方框警告，指出methylene blue與血清素能藥物和鴉片類藥物結合使用可能導致嚴重或致命的血清素症候群，並建議完全避免同時使用。臨床表現包括精神狀態改變、自主神經不穩定、神經肌肉異常、癲癇發作和胃腸道症狀。

label: HIRA
description: H3.3 is a replication-independent histone variant deposited by dedicated chaperones, principally HIRA at gene bodies and enhancers. Because senescent cells have exited the cell cycle, H3.3 deposition becomes increasingly reliant on the HIRA complex.
description_zh_TW: H3.3 是非複製依賴的組蛋白變異體，由專屬伴護蛋白（主要是在基因體與增強子處的 HIRA）沉積。由於衰老細胞已退出細胞週期，H3.3 沉積日益依賴 HIRA 複合體。

label: Cysteine
description: N-acetylcysteine is deacetylated to cysteine, whose availability governs the activity of glutamate-cysteine ligase, the rate-limiting enzyme of glutathione synthesis.
description_zh_TW: N-乙醯半胱胺酸去乙醯化為半胱胺酸，其可用性決定穀胱甘肽合成限速酶麩胺酸-半胱胺酸連接酶的活性。

label: Gene Expression
description: RNA-seq (RNA sequencing) is a high-throughput sequencing method that profiles the complete set of RNA transcripts in a biological sample and quantifies gene expression. The workflow runs RNA extraction, poly-A selection or ribosomal RNA depletion, reverse transcription to cDNA, adapter ligation and PCR library preparation, sequencing, then bioinformatics read alignment and quantification with tools such as DESeq2 for differential expression.
description_zh_TW: RNA-seq（RNA 定序）是一種高通量定序方法，可剖析生物樣本中完整的 RNA 轉錄本集合並量化基因表現。工作流程包含 RNA 萃取、poly-A 篩選或核糖體 RNA 去除、逆转錄成 cDNA、接头連接與 PCR 文庫製備、定序，最後以 DESeq2 等工具進行讀段比對與差異表現量化。

label: BH3 mimetics
description: Apoptosis is restored by BH3 mimetics. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. BH3 mimetics are small molecules that occupy the hydrophobic groove of anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 proteins, freeing Bax/Bak to kill tumor cells. The directionality runs from BH3 mimetics toward Apoptosis, so BH3 mimetics is the active agent and Apoptosis the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Apoptosis 由 BH3 mimetics 恢復。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。 BH3 mimetics 是佔據抗凋亡 Bcl-2 蛋白疏水溝的小分子，釋放 Bax/Bak 來殺死腫瘤細胞。方向性從 BH3 mimetics 朝向 Apoptosis，因此 BH3 mimetics 是活性劑，Apoptosis 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: BRCA1
description: BRCA1 is recruited to DNA double-strand breaks by the MRN complex, promotes end resection, and facilitates RAD51 loading via PALB2 and BRCA2 to execute homologous recombination repair. Directionally, BRCA1 sits upstream of high-fidelity double-strand-break repair. Loss of BRCA1 cripples homologous recombination, increasing mutation and cancer risk, particularly in breast and ovarian tissue. Sirtuins such as SIRT2 support BRCA1 localization to damage sites, linking sirtuin activity to genome stability. The BRCA1 pathway is also the basis for synthetic lethality with PARP inhibitors in BRCA-deficient cancers.
description_zh_TW: BRCA1 被 MRN 複合物招募到 DNA 雙鏈斷裂處，促進末端切除，並透過 PALB2 和 BRCA2 協助 RAD51 裝載以執行同源重組修復。在方向性上，BRCA1 位於高保真雙鏈斷裂修復的上游。BRCA1 的缺失損害同源重組，增加突變和癌症風險，特別是在乳腺和卵巢組織中。如 SIRT2 等 sirtuin 支持 BRCA1 定位到損傷位點，將 sirtuin 活性與基因組穩定性聯繫起來。BRCA1 途徑也是 BRCA 缺陷癌症中與 PARP 抑制劑合成致死的基礎。

label: Embryonic Stem Cells
description: Leukemia inhibitory factor (LIF) is an IL-6-family cytokine that maintains Embryonic Stem Cells in pluripotency and self-renewal via STAT3 signalling. In differentiation assays LIF is withheld, or cells are plated without feeders, so lineage commitment can proceed and embryoid bodies form.
description_zh_TW: Leukemia inhibitory factor（LIF）是 IL-6 家族細胞激素，透過 STAT3 訊號維持 Embryonic Stem Cells 的多能性與自我更新。在分化實驗中會撤除 LIF（或將細胞以無飼養層方式培養），以允許譜系決定並形成類胚體。

label: Glioblastoma
description: Glioblastoma stem-like cells (GSCs) drive therapy resistance and recurrence.
description_zh_TW: 膠質母細胞瘤幹細胞樣細胞 (GSCs) 驅動治療抵抗和復發。

label: Substantia Nigra Pars Compacta
description: The Striatum receives dopaminergic input from the Substantia Nigra Pars Compacta via the Nigrostriatal System, and degeneration of this pathway is the central pathological event in Parkinson's Disease — dopamine depletion in the putamen produces bradykinesia, rigidity and tremor. The Striatum also receives Prefrontal Cortex input forming cortico-basal ganglia loops essential for executive control.
description_zh_TW: Striatum 經由 Nigrostriatal System 接收來自 Substantia Nigra Pars Compacta 的 dopaminergic 輸入，而此路徑的退化正是 Parkinson's Disease 的核心病理事件——putamen 的 dopamine 耗竭造成 bradykinesia、rigidity 與 tremor。Striatum 亦接收 Prefrontal Cortex 輸入，形成執行控制所必需的皮質-basal ganglia 迴路。

label: PARK7
description: PARK7 mutations (L166P, M26I) cause early-onset autosomal recessive Parkinson's disease. DJ-1-deficient neurons show fragmented mitochondria, Complex I impairment, and accelerated α-synuclein aggregation.
description_zh_TW: PARK7 突變（L166P、M26I）造成早發性體染色體隱性遺傳帕金森氏症。DJ-1 缺失的神經元呈現粒線體碎片化、Complex I 功能受損與 α-synuclein 聚集加速。

label: Integrins
description: RGD peptide is the minimal, most widespread cell-adhesion motif recognized by a subset of Integrins (alpha-v-beta-3, alpha-v-beta-5, alpha-5-beta-1). It adopts a loop conformation that fits the integrin ligand-binding pocket, mediating cell-ECM adhesion, cytoskeletal organization, survival and migration.
description_zh_TW: RGD peptide 是被部分 Integrins（αvβ3、αvβ5、α5β1）辨識的最小且最普遍的細胞黏附基序。它採取能嵌入 integrin 配體結合口袋的環狀構形，介導細胞－細胞外基質黏附、細胞骨架組織、存活與移行。

label: Non-alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease
description: NASH is the inflammatory, potentially progressive form of Non-alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease. Where simple steatosis is fat accumulation alone, NASH adds hepatocyte injury, Inflammation and variable fibrosis, and it can progress to cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma.
description_zh_TW: NASH 是 Non-alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease 中具發炎性且可能進展的形式。單純脂肪肝僅有脂肪堆積，而 NASH 額外加上肝細胞損傷、Inflammation 與程度不一的纖維化，並可進展為肝硬化與肝細胞癌。

label: Central Nervous System
description: Astrocytes are the most abundant glial cell type of the Central Nervous System, providing metabolic, structural and homeostatic support to Neuron and contributing to formation and maintenance of the Blood-Brain Barrier.
description_zh_TW: Astrocytes 是 Central Nervous System 中最豐富的神經膠細胞類型，為 Neuron 提供代謝、結構與恆定維持上的支持，並參與 Blood-Brain Barrier 的形成與維持。

label: MPTP
description: Monoamine oxidase B and MPTP are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Monoamine oxidase B and MPTP may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Monoamine oxidase B 和 MPTP 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Monoamine oxidase B 和 MPTP 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Regulatory T Cell
description: TGF-beta1 is the canonical inducer of FoxP3+ regulatory T cell differentiation. In combination with IL-2 it drives the TGF-beta1 pathway's Smad/FoxP3 program toward a suppressive phenotype, which is why regulatory T cells are classed with TGF-beta1 as central to maintaining self-tolerance — and why tumors and senescent niches actively recruit them to evade immune attack.
description_zh_TW: TGF-beta1 是 FoxP3+ 調節性 T 細胞分化的標準誘導因子。它與 IL-2 協同推動 TGF-beta1 途徑的 Smad/FoxP3 程式走向抑制性表型，因此調節性 T 細胞與 TGF-beta1 同為維持自身耐受的核心；這也是腫瘤與老化 niche 會主動招募它們以逃避免疫攻擊的原因。

label: Mitochondrial Dynamics
description: Mitochondrial dynamics is the continuous remodeling of the cellular mitochondrial network through the two opposite but coordinated processes of fission and fusion, accompanied by mitophagy and ultrastructural reshaping of the inner and outer membranes. Fission divides a single mitochondrion into two daughter mitochondria and is driven by the dynamin-related GTPase DRP1 recruited to the outer mitochondrial membrane by adaptor proteins. The balance between fission and fusion is tightly regulated by conserved GTPase proteins and must be maintained to support normal mitochondrial and cellular function.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial dynamics 是通過 fission and fusion 兩個相反但 coordinated processes 進行的 continuous remodeling of the cellular mitochondrial network，accompanied by mitophagy and ultrastructural reshaping of the inner and outer membranes。Fission divides a single mitochondrion into two daughter mitochondria 並由 dynamin-related GTPase DRP1 driven，被 adaptor proteins recruited to the outer mitochondrial membrane。Fission and fusion 之間的 balance 由 conserved GTPase proteins tightly regulated 且 must be maintained to support normal mitochondrial and cellular function。

label: BRD4
description: BET inhibitors targets BRD4. BET inhibitors displace bromodomain proteins such as BRD4 from acetylated chromatin, silencing MYC and inflammatory transcription programs. BRD4 is a bromodomain-and-extra-terminal protein that binds acetylated histones at super-enhancers to sustain oncogenic transcription. The relationship is directional, with BET inhibitors acting as the operative agent upon BRD4 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: BET inhibitors目標BRD4。 BET inhibitors 取代乙醯化染色質中的溴結構域蛋白，例如 BRD4，沉默 MYC 和發炎轉錄程序。 BRD4 是一種溴結構域和額外末端蛋白，可在超級增強子處結合乙醯化組蛋白以維持致癌轉錄。這種關係是有方向的，BET inhibitors 充當 BRD4 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Cytochrome c
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Methylene blue (MB) accepts electrons from NADH via mitochondrial complex I and transfers them directly to cytochrome c, effectively bypassing respiratory chain Complexes I-III. In isolated-mitochondria complex I-III assays with NADH as electron donor, MB significantly increased the rate of cytochrome c reduction, while the negative-control antimycin A (a complex III inhibitor) blocked it. This electron shunt underlies MB's ability to maintain oxidative phosphorylation and ATP production when upstream complexes are inhibited, and it is the mechanistic basis for MB's enhancement of cellular oxygen consumption.
description_zh_TW: 亞甲基藍 (MB) 通過線粒體複合體 I 接受來自 NADH 的電子，並直接轉移到細胞色素 c，有效地繞過呼吸鏈複合體 I-III。在以 NADH 為電子供體的分離線粒體複合體 I-III 檢測中，MB 顯著增加了細胞色素 c 還原速率，而陰性對照抗黴素 A（一種複合體 III 抑制劑）則阻斷了它。這種電子旁路是 MB 在當上游複合體被抑制時仍能維持氧化磷酸化和 ATP 產生的基礎，也是 MB 增強細胞氧氣消耗的機制基礎。

label: Cyclophilin D
description: Cyclophilin D (PPIF) is a mitochondrial matrix peptidyl-prolyl isomerase and the primary positive regulator of the mitochondrial permeability transition pore. It binds the pore and promotes its opening in response to matrix calcium overload and reactive oxygen species, thereby gating cytochrome c release upstream of the caspase cascade and making CypD a senolytic target in senescent cells.
description_zh_TW: Cyclophilin D（PPIF）是粒線體基質的 peptidyl-prolyl isomerase，也是 Mitochondrial Permeability Transition Pore 的主要正向調節者。它結合孔道並在基質鈣過載與 Reactive Oxygen Species 作用下促進孔道開啟，藉此在 caspase 级聯上游控制 Cytochrome c 釋放，並使 CypD 成為衰老細胞的 senolytic 標的。

label: Metabolic Syndromes
description: HNF4α is an orphan nuclear receptor and master transcriptional regulator of hepatocyte differentiation, liver metabolism, and lipid homeostasis, governing gluconeogenesis, fatty acid oxidation, lipoprotein assembly, and bile acid synthesis. HNF4A mutations cause MODY1, underscoring its role in glucose-stimulated insulin secretion and hepatic glucose homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: HNF4α 是孤兒核受體，也是肝細胞分化、肝臟代謝與脂質恆定的主控轉錄調節因子，掌控糖質新生、脂肪酸氧化、脂蛋白組裝與膽汁酸合成。HNF4A 突變會造成 MODY1，凸顯其在葡萄糖刺激的胰島素分泌與肝臟葡萄糖恆定中的角色。

label: CDH1
description: CDH1 encodes the E-cadherin protein product. Gene-to-protein definitional edge.
description_zh_TW: CDH1 編碼 E-cadherin 蛋白產物。基因到蛋白的定義邊。

label: SAHF
description: SAHF are assembled by the HIRA-ASF1a histone chaperone complex, which deposits macroH2A and core histones to establish H3K9me3-marked heterochromatin at the foci. This chaperone-driven deposition is required for the formation of the DAPI-dense nuclear bodies that characterize senescent cells, and it is coordinated with hypophosphorylated Rb. The process links histone dynamics directly to senescence-specific chromatin reorganization. HIRA/ASF1a thus provide the assembly machinery for the repressive structures that lock in the arrested state.
description_zh_TW: SAHF 由 HIRA-ASF1a 組蛋白伴護蛋白複合體組裝，該複合體沉積 macroH2A 與核心組蛋白以在焦點建立 H3K9me3 標記的異染色質。此伴護蛋白驅動的沉積對形成定義衰老細胞的 DAPI 緻密核體為必要，且與低磷酸化 Rb 協調。此過程將組蛋白動態直接連結到衰老特異性染色質重組。HIRA/ASF1a 因此提供將停滯狀態鎖入的抑制性結構的組裝機器。

label: Cell Membranes
description: Aquaporins are a conserved family of integral membrane proteins forming selective channels for rapid passive water movement across biological membranes down osmotic gradients. Each monomer has six transmembrane helices around a narrow central pore and channels assemble as tetramers; NPA motifs and an ar/R constriction form the selectivity filter that permits single-file water transport while excluding protons and ions. Aquaglyceroporins (AQP3, AQP7, AQP9) also conduct glycerol.
description_zh_TW: Aquaporin 是一群保守的整合膜蛋白，形成選擇性通道，使水分沿滲透梯度快速被動通過生物膜。每個單體具有圍繞狹窄中央孔道的六段跨膜螺旋，通道以四聚體組裝；NPA 序列與 ar/R 收縮構成選擇性濾器，允許單列水分子通過並排除質子與離子。Aquaglyceroporin（AQP3、AQP7、AQP9）亦可運送 glycerol。

label: Oxidation
description: Oxidation in biological systems — both enzymatic and non-enzymatic — is a major source of Reactive Oxygen Species. Non-enzymatic autoxidation of catechols reduces molecular oxygen to Superoxide, which dismutates to Hydrogen Peroxide and perpetuates oxidative chain reactions, coupling oxidation chemistry directly to oxidative damage.
description_zh_TW: 生物體內的氧化（酵素性與非酵素性皆是）都是 Reactive Oxygen Species 的主要來源。非酵素性兒茶酚自氧化會將分子氧還原為 Superoxide，後者歧化為 Hydrogen Peroxide 並延續氧化鏈反應，將氧化化學直接連結至氧化傷害。

label: Serotonin
source_file: _document_ - Methylene Blue Dosage What Actually Works (And What's Too Much).md
description: Serotonin-Norepinephrine Reuptake Inhibitors block the serotonin transporter (and the norepinephrine transporter), raising synaptic Serotonin and Norepinephrine; this dual action is exploited in depression, generalized anxiety disorder, diabetic neuropathic pain and fibromyalgia.
description_zh_TW: Serotonin-Norepinephrine Reuptake Inhibitors 阻斷 serotonin 轉運蛋白（以及 norepinephrine 轉運蛋白），提高突觸內的 Serotonin 與 Norepinephrine；此雙重作用被應用於憂鬱症、廣泛性焦慮症、糖尿病神經病變疼痛與纖維肌痛。

label: D1 receptor
description: Medium spiny neurons express D1 receptors on the direct pathway, where D1 activation promotes movement facilitation by disinhibiting thalamocortical output. The D1/D2 dichotomy partitions striatal output into direct and indirect pathways with opposing effects on motor control, providing the framework for understanding dopamine action in the basal ganglia. Dopamine's action at D1 receptors is thus a key node modulated by the dopamine tone that COMT helps set in regions of lower DAT density. D1 signaling is also implicated in reward and incentive learning.
description_zh_TW: Medium spiny neurons 在直接途徑上表達 D1 受體，其中 D1 活化透過去抑制丘腦皮質輸出來促進 movement 的促進。 D1/D2 二分法將紋狀體輸出分為直接和間接途徑，對 motor control 有相反的影響，為理解 basal ganglia 中的多巴胺作用提供了框架。因此，Dopamine 對 D1 受體的作用是受多巴胺音調調節的關鍵節點，COMT 有助於在 DAT 密度較低的區域中設定多巴胺音調。 D1 訊號傳導也與 reward 和激勵學習有關。

label: mPOS
description: mPOS (mitochondrial precursor over-accumulation stress) arises when mitochondrial precursor proteins accumulate in the cytosol beyond the capacity of quality control pathways. Because roughly 1000 mitochondrial proteins are synthesized on cytosolic ribosomes before import, any impairment of the TOM/TIM translocons, loss of membrane potential, or saturation of the import machinery causes cytosolic accumulation. The accumulated precursors aggregate and sequester chaperones, disturbing proteostasis and triggering proteotoxicity.
description_zh_TW: 當粒線體前驅蛋白在細胞質中累積、超出品質管制路徑的處理能力時，即形成 mPOS（粒線體前驅蛋白過度累積壓力）。由於約 1000 種粒線體蛋白在細胞質核糖體上合成後才輸入，TOM/TIM 轉位子受損、膜電位喪失或輸入機制飽和都會造成細胞質累積。這些累積的前驅蛋白會聚集並滯留分子伴護蛋白，破壞蛋白恆定並引發蛋白毒性。

label: Natalizumab (Tysabri)
description: Natalizumab (Tysabri) blocks the VCAM-1/VLA-4 interaction by antagonizing alpha4 integrin, reducing T-cell trafficking across the blood-brain barrier in multiple sclerosis. This dampens CNS inflammation but leaves patients susceptible to progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy. The directionality is integrin blockade to reduced leukocyte entry. A caveat is that broad alpha4 inhibition also affects gut homing, causing PML and other risks that limit use. The drug's efficacy in MS validates the VCAM-1/VLA-4 pathway as a driver of neuroinflammation, though its safety profile demands careful monitoring.
description_zh_TW: Natalizumab (Tysabri) 透過拮抗 α4 整合素來阻斷 VCAM-1/VLA-4 interaction，從而減少 ros 中 multiple sclerosis 中血腦障壁的 T 細胞運輸。這可以抑制中樞神經系統炎症，但使患者容易患上進行性多灶性白質腦病變。方向性是整合素阻斷以減少白血球進入。需要注意的是，廣泛的 alpha4 抑制也會影響腸道歸巢，導致 PML 和其他限制使用的風險。該藥物對多發性硬化症的療效證實了 VCAM-1/VLA-4 路徑作為神經發炎的驅動因素，但其安全性需要仔細監測。

label: Frailty
description: The clinical frailty index operationalizes frailty as a continuous score over accumulated health deficits; the Whitehead index scores 31 parameters spanning body condition, locomotion and integumentary signs in mice and correlates with biological age.
description_zh_TW: 臨床 frailty index 將 frailty 操作化為累積健康缺損的連續分數；Whitehead 指數在小鼠中評分涵蓋身體狀況、運動與皮膚徵象的 31 項參數，並與生物學年齡相關。

label: Females
description: Women have higher NAD+/NADH redox ratios (1.33 vs 1.09) that narrow with biological age, and women's NAD+ levels fluctuate without the monotonic age decline seen in men. Estrogen stabilizes PARP-1 to spare NAD+, protecting sirtuin (SIRT1/SIRT3) activity into midlife; post-menopausal women face a 'double decline' as hormonal shifts compound age-related NAD+ changes.
description_zh_TW: 女性具較高的 NAD+/NADH 氧化還原比值（1.33 對 1.09），且隨生物年齡增寬而縮小；女性 NAD+ 水平波動，無男性那樣的單調年齡下降。雌激素使 PARP-1 穩定以節省 NAD+，將 sirtuin（SIRT1/SIRT3）活性保護至中年；停經後女性則面臨荷爾蒙變化與年齡相關 NAD+ 改變疊加的「雙重下降」。

label: PPARα
description: PPARα is a nuclear receptor transcription factor whose activation induces fatty acid oxidation, ketogenesis and lipid metabolism programs, lowering triglycerides and improving the lipid profile.
description_zh_TW: PPARα 是核受體轉錄因子，其活化會誘導脂肪酸氧化、生酮與脂質代謝程式，降低三酸甘油酯並改善脂質剖面。

label: Insulin Sensitivity
source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md
description: SIRT1 enhances insulin sensitivity by deacetylating and repressing PTP1B, a negative regulator of insulin signaling, and by activating PGC-1α-driven mitochondrial biogenesis. Because PTP1B removal relieves inhibition of the insulin receptor/IRS/PI3K/Akt cascade, GLUT4 translocation and glucose uptake rise.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 藉由去乙醯化並抑制胰島素訊號的負向調節因子 PTP1B，以及活化 PGC-1α 驅動的 Mitochondrial Biogenesis，來提升 Insulin Sensitivity。由於 PTP1B 被去除可解除對胰島素受體／IRS／PI3K/Akt 級聯的抑制，GLUT4 轉位與葡萄糖攝取因而上升。

label: Tyrosinase
description: Tyrosinase and Neuromelanin Synthesis are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Tyrosinase and Neuromelanin Synthesis may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Tyrosinase 和 Neuromelanin Synthesis 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Tyrosinase 和 Neuromelanin Synthesis 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: SLC7A11
description: SLC7A11 (xCT) is a 12-pass transmembrane SLC7 protein encoding the catalytic light chain of the system Xc- cystine/glutamate antiporter. It contains the substrate-binding pocket for cystine and glutamate and is covalently linked by a conserved disulfide bond to the heavy chain SLC3A2 (4F2hc/CD98); the SLC7A11–SLC3A2 heterodimer is the functional unit, and SLC7A11 alone is retained in the ER and cannot reach the plasma membrane.
description_zh_TW: SLC7A11（xCT）是 12 次跨膜的 SLC7 蛋白，編碼 system Xc- 胱胺／麩胺酸反向運輸體的催化輕鏈。它含有辨識胱胺與麩胺酸的受質結合口袋，並透過保守的二硫鍵與重鏈 SLC3A2（4F2hc／CD98）共價連結；SLC7A11–SLC3A2 異二聚體才是功能單元，单独的 SLC7A11 會滯留於內質網而無法到達質膜。

label: Oncogene-Induced Senescence
description: The senolytic paradox arises because oncogene-induced senescence (OIS) arrests BRAF/RAS/MYC-driven cells in a benign lesion as a cell-autonomous fail-safe enforced by p53, p16INK4A and RB1. Clearing those OIS cells removes a cancer barrier rather than a risk.
description_zh_TW: Senolytic paradox 之所以出現，是因為 oncogene-induced senescence (OIS) 以 p53、p16INK4A 與 RB1 為基礎，細胞自主地將帶有 BRAF/RAS/MYC 驅動突變的細胞阻滯在良性病灶中。清除這些 OIS 細胞等於移除一道癌症屏障，而非移除風險。

label: Cathepsins
description: Cathepsins B, L and S are frequently upregulated in malignant tumours, where they degrade extracellular matrix components to facilitate invasion and metastasis. Their secretion by cancer cells and tumour-associated macrophages creates pericellular proteolytic hotspots that drive tissue invasion and also promote angiogenesis and modulate immune surveillance.
description_zh_TW: Cathepsins B、L 與 S 在惡性腫瘤中常見表現上調，藉由降解 Extracellular Matrix 成分來促進侵犯與轉移。癌細胞與腫瘤相關巨噬細胞分泌這些蛋白酶，製造細胞周圍的蛋白水解熱點以驅動組織侵犯，並同時促進血管新生與調節免疫監視。

label: Transcription Factor
description: Transcription factors bind promoter/enhancer DNA to control gene output. Definitional regulator-to-process edge.
description_zh_TW: 轉錄因子結合啟動子/增強子 DNA 以控制基因輸出。定義性調節者到過程邊。

label: SAMD
description: SAMD (senescence-associated mitochondrial dysfunction) is a specific form of mitochondrial dysfunction that is a hallmark of senescent cells, encompassing reduced oxidative phosphorylation, altered mitochondrial dynamics, and elevated ROS production. It is distinct from generalized mitochondrial disease in being a programmed, senescence-associated feature that both results from and feeds back into the arrested state. SAMD drives the SASP through ROS and mtDNA release, coupling metabolic derangement to inflammation. Its classification as mitochondrial dysfunction situates it within the metabolic hallmarks of aging.
description_zh_TW: SAMD（senescence-associated mitochondrial dysfunction，衰老相關粒線體功能障礙）是粒線體功能障礙的一種特定形式，是衰老細胞的特徵，涵蓋氧化磷酸化降低、粒線體動態改變與 ROS 產生升高。它不同於一般性粒線體疾病之處，在於其為一種程序性、衰老相關的特徵，既由停滯狀態產生又回饋至停滯狀態。SAMD 透過 ROS 與 mtDNA 釋放驅動 SASP，將代謝失調耦合到發炎。其歸類為粒線體功能障礙，使其定位於老化的代謝特徵之中。

label: Lipophagy
description: MXL-3 represses lipophagy when food is available. As a Max-like bHLH-LZ transcription factor it occupies the CACGTG sites in the promoters of the lysosomal lipase genes lipl-1, lipl-2, lipl-3 and lipl-5, keeping the lipolytic program off; fasting drops mxl-3 mRNA and MXL-3 rapidly leaves the intestinal nuclei, relieving that repression.
description_zh_TW: 在食物可得時，MXL-3 抑制 lipophagy。這個 Max-like bHLH-LZ 轉錄因子佔據溶酶體脂肪酶基因 lipl-1、lipl-2、lipl-3 與 lipl-5 啟動子上的 CACGTG 位點，使脂肪分解程式維持關閉；禁食時 mxl-3 mRNA 下降，MXL-3 迅速離開腸道細胞核，因而解除此抑制。

label: mtDNA
description: mtDNA released by minority MOMP activates cGAS-STING, driving type-I interferon and NF-kB-dependent SASP without causing full cell death. The cytosolic mtDNA acts as a damage-associated molecular pattern recognized by cGAS, linking mitochondrial dysfunction (SAMD) directly to innate immune activation. This activation is a pivotal bridge between metabolism and senescence inflammation and also enhances immune surveillance of the arrested cell. It is a well-validated mechanism in multiple senescence models.
description_zh_TW: 少數 MOMP 釋放的 mtDNA 活化 cGAS-STING，驅動第一型干擾素與 NF-κB 依賴的 SASP 而不引起完全細胞死亡。胞質 mtDNA 作為 cGAS 辨識的損傷相關分子模式，將粒線體功能障礙（SAMD）直接連結到先天免疫活化。此活化是代謝與衰老發炎間的關鍵橋樑，也增強對停滯細胞的免疫監視。它在多種衰老模型中為良好驗證的機制。

label: Nucleosome Remodeling
description: Nucleosome remodeling capacity decreases with age, accompanied by the loss of core histones and nucleosome occupancy. In aging yeast, nucleosome occupancy decreases by up to 50 percent and half the core histone proteins are lost, and similar chromatin decompaction occurs in worms and human cells. Reduced histone abundance and nucleosome loss decompact chromatin, increasing DNA accessibility and transcriptional noise while contributing to genomic instability in aging cells. These findings support the view that chromatin decompaction is a fundamental driver of age-related dysfunction.
description_zh_TW: Nucleosome 重塑能力隨著年齡的增長而降低，伴隨著核心組蛋白和核小體佔據的損失。在老化的酵母菌中，核小體佔有率下降高達 50%，一半的核心組蛋白流失，蠕蟲和人類細胞中也會發生類似的染色質解壓縮。組蛋白豐度的減少和核小體的流失會使染色質解壓縮，增加 DNA 的可及性和轉錄噪音，同時導致老化細胞的基因組不穩定。這些發現支持這樣的觀點：染色質解壓縮是與年齡相關的功能障礙的根本驅動因素。

label: ATM Kinase
description: Ionizing radiation activates ATM kinase by causing DNA double-strand breaks that recruit and autophosphorylate ATM, which then phosphorylates Chk2, p53, and BRCA1 to coordinate the damage response. This initiates cell-cycle arrest and repair. The directionality is DNA break to kinase signaling cascade. A caveat is that ATM also responds to oxidative stress and replication stress, so its activation is not uniquely radiation-driven. ATM is considered the master coordinator of the DNA-damage response to double-strand breaks, integrating cell-cycle arrest, repair, and apoptosis decisions.
description_zh_TW: Ionizing radiation 透過引起 DNA 雙股斷裂來活化 ATM kinase，從而募集 ATM 並使其自磷酸化，然後 ATM 磷酸化 Chk2、p53 和 BRCA1 以協調損傷反應。這啟動了細胞週期停滯和修復。方向性是 DNA 斷裂至激酶訊號級聯。需要注意的是，ATM 也會對 oxidative stress 和複製壓力做出反應，因此它的活化並不是唯一由輻射驅動的。 ATM 被認為是對雙股斷裂的 DNA 損傷反應的主協調員，整合了細胞週期停滯、修復和 apoptosis 決策。

label: Epstein-Barr virus
description: EBV is the established etiologic driver of nasopharyngeal carcinoma oncogenesis.
description_zh_TW: EBV 是鼻咽癌致癌的既定病因驅動。

label: N-Formylkynurenine
description: N-formylkynurenine is the immediate product of IDO1's oxidative cleavage of the tryptophan indole ring at the 2,3-position; it is then rapidly converted to kynurenine (Kyn). Kynurenine is the central metabolite of the kynurenine pathway from which downstream neuroactive and NAD+-linked metabolites are derived. The kynurenine pathway leads to metabolites including kynurenic acid, 3-hydroxykynurenine, quinolinic acid (a neurotoxin and NAD+ precursor), and ultimately NAD+, and accounts for roughly 95% of tryptophan degradation outside protein synthesis and serotonin production.
description_zh_TW: N-甲酰犬尿氨酸是IDO1氧化裂解色氨酸吲哚環2,3位的直接產物；隨後快速轉化為犬尿氨酸（Kyn）。犬尿氨酸是犬尿氨酸通路的中心代謝物，下游神經活性和NAD+相關代謝物由此衍生。犬尿氨酸通路導致代謝物包括犬尿喹啉酸、3-羥基犬尿氨酸、喹啉酸（一種神經毒素和NAD+前體），最終產生NAD+，佔蛋白質合成和血清素產生以外約95%的色氨酸降解。

label: TGF-beta1
description: TGF-beta receptors are the prototypical receptors for the TGF-beta1 ligand. This ligand-receptor pairing defines the signaling module.
description_zh_TW: TGF-beta 受體是 TGF-beta1 配體的典型受體。此配體—受體配對定義訊號模組。

label: CD36
description: Thrombospondin-1 (TSP-1, THBS1) is a large matricellular glycoprotein secreted by platelets, endothelial cells and Macrophages that binds CD36. Binding of this ligand to the receptor is what initiates TSP-1 signalling, expanding CD36's role beyond lipid uptake to adhesion, survival and inflammation.
description_zh_TW: Thrombospondin-1（TSP-1、THBS1）是由血小板、內皮細胞與 Macrophages 分泌的大型基質細胞糖蛋白，可與 CD36 結合。正是這種配體與受體的結合啟動了 TSP-1 訊號，將 CD36 的角色從脂質攝取擴展到黏附、存活與發炎。

label: UCP1
description: UCP1 is a mitochondrial inner-membrane carrier expressed almost exclusively in brown adipose tissue. It transports protons from the intermembrane space back into the matrix, short-circuiting the proton gradient set up by the Electron Transport Chain so that energy is released as heat rather than captured as ATP.
description_zh_TW: UCP1 是幾乎專一表現於 Brown Adipose Tissue 的粒線體內膜載體。它將質子由膜間腔運回基質，使 Electron Transport Chain 建立的質子梯度短路，能量因此以熱的形式釋放，而非被捕捉成 ATP。

label: Thymic Epithelial Cells
description: Thymic epithelial cells (TECs) are the stromal cells of the thymus that form the three-dimensional network required for Thymopoiesis. Cortical TECs support early thymocyte development, present self-peptide/MHC for positive selection and provide chemokine gradients, while medullary TECs express tissue-restricted antigens via AIRE and mediate negative selection, establishing central self-tolerance.
description_zh_TW: Thymic epithelial cells（TECs）是胸腺的基質細胞，形成 Thymopoiesis 所必需的三維網絡。皮質 TECs 支持早期胸腺細胞發育、呈現自身胜肽/MHC 以進行正向選擇並提供趨化激素梯度；髓質 TECs 則透過 AIRE 表達組織限定抗原並介導負向選擇，建立中樞自我耐受。

label: Mitochondrial Uncoupling
description: Mitochondrial Uncoupling dissipates the proton motive force across the inner membrane without ATP synthesis, releasing the energy as heat and therefore lowering the Mitochondrial Membrane Potential.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial Uncoupling 讓內膜兩側的質子動力勢在未合成 ATP 的情況下消散，能量以熱的形式釋放，因而降低 Mitochondrial Membrane Potential。

label: PYCR1
description: PYCR1 requires NADH or NADPH as its obligate reducing cofactor (P5C + NAD(P)H + H+ → L-proline + NAD(P)+), and its consumption of mitochondrial NADH can shift the NAD+/NADH ratio and alter mitochondrial metabolism.
description_zh_TW: PYCR1 需要 NADH 或 NADPH 作為其必需的還原輔因子（P5C + NAD(P)H + H⁺ → L-脯胺酸 + NAD(P)⁺），其消耗粒線體 NADH 可改變 NAD+/NADH 比例並擾動粒線體代謝。

label: ELK4
description: ELK4 (SAP-1) belongs to the ETS-domain ternary complex factor (TCF) subfamily of transcription factors, defined by a conserved ETS DNA-binding domain. Within sirtuin biology, ELK4 is notable for interacting with SIRT7 and stabilizing the deacetylase at target gene promoters, where SIRT7 deacetylates lysine 18 of histone H3 and represses tumor suppressor genes. Directionally, ELK4's identity as an ETS factor underlies its promoter-targeting function. This links the ETS transcription factor family to the pro-oncogenic SIRT7-H3K18ac axis in cancer.
description_zh_TW: ELK4（SAP-1）屬於 ETS 結構域三元複合物因子（TCF）轉錄因子亞家族，其特徵是保守的 ETS DNA 結合結構域。在 sirtuin 生物學中，ELK4 因與 SIRT7 互動並將去乙醯酶穩定於靶基因啟動子處而引人注目，在那裡 SIRT7 去乙醯化組蛋白 H3 的第 18 位離胺酸並抑制腫瘤抑制基因。方向性上 ELK4 作為 ETS 因子的身份奠定了其啟動子靶向功能。這將 ETS 轉錄因子家族與癌症中的促致癌 SIRT7-H3K18ac 軸線聯繫起來。

label: Renal Cell Carcinoma
description: Renal cell carcinoma (RCC) is the most common malignant kidney tumor, usually clear-cell subtype.
description_zh_TW: 腎細胞癌 (RCC) 是最常見的惡性腎臟腫瘤，通常為透明細胞亞型。

label: Senolytic
source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md
description: Therapy-Induced Senescence is cleared by Senolytic. Therapy-induced senescence is the durable arrest imposed on tumor cells by genotoxic treatments, with both tumor-suppressive and relapse-promoting consequences. Senolytics are agents that preferentially kill senescent cells, often by disabling their anti-apoptotic SCAP survival networks. The directionality runs from Senolytic toward Therapy-Induced Senescence, so Senolytic is the active agent and Therapy-Induced Senescence the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Therapy-Induced Senescence 用 Senolytic 清除。 Therapy-Induced Senescence是基因毒性治療對腫瘤細胞的持久抑制，具有抑制腫瘤和促進復發的後果。它們是優先殺死衰老細胞的藥物，通常是透過禁用其抗凋亡 SCAP 生存網絡來實現的。方向性從 Senolytic 朝向 Therapy-Induced Senescence，因此 Senolytic 是主動主體，Therapy-Induced Senescence 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Silver compounds
description: Silver compounds are the source materials whose ingested or inhaled silver is absorbed into the circulation and ultimately deposited as elemental silver or silver sulfide granules in tissue, producing the irreversible blue-gray discoloration of Argyria. Insoluble Silver salts are converted along the way into soluble, protein-bound species that can cross into tissue.
description_zh_TW: Silver compounds 是被吸收 silver 的來源材料，經攝入或吸入後進入循環系統，最後以金屬 silver 或 silver sulfide 顆粒沉積於組織，造成 Argyria 不可逆的青灰色色素沉著。過程中不溶性的 Silver salts 會轉變為可溶的蛋白結合態物種後進入組織。

label: Metabolome
description: The Metabolome — the complete set of small-molecule chemicals present in a sample, cell, or organism at a given moment — is profiled by untargeted or targeted metabolomics using Mass Spectrometry and nuclear magnetic resonance. The resulting fingerprints are highly dynamic, shifting over seconds to hours with feeding, exercise, circadian rhythm, and stress, and serve as sensitive Biomarkers of physiological state and disease risk.
description_zh_TW: Metabolome——在特定時刻存在於樣本、細胞或生物體中的全部小分子化學物集合——是透過以 Mass Spectrometry 與核磁共振進行的非標定或標定式代謝組學來描繪的。所得的指紋變動極快，會隨進食、運動、晝夜節律與壓力在數秒至數小時間尺度上改變，並可作為生理狀態與疾病風險的敏感 Biomarkers。

label: Caspases
description: Caspase-10 is a type of Caspase. Caspase-10 is an initiator caspase related to caspase-8 that amplifies death-receptor signaling and is frequently silenced in tumors. Caspases are cysteine aspartate-specific proteases that orchestrate inflammation or, in the apoptotic class, the proteolytic execution of cell death. The directionality runs from Caspase toward Caspase-10, so Caspase is the active agent and Caspase-10 the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-10 是 Caspase 的一種。 Caspase-10 是一種與 caspase-8 相關的起始 caspase，可放大死亡受體訊號傳導，並且在腫瘤中經常被沉默。它們是半胱氨酸天冬胺酸特異性蛋白酶，可協調炎症，或在細胞凋亡類別中，透過蛋白水解執行細胞死亡。方向性從 Caspase 朝向 Caspase-10，因此 Caspase 是活性劑，Caspase-10 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: Superoxide anion
description: Superoxide anion is the upstream precursor of Hydrogen Peroxide: the enzyme Superoxide Dismutase dismutates superoxide into H2O2, and other enzymes such as NADPH Oxidase, Xanthine Oxidase and MAO generate H2O2 directly. In mitochondria MnSOD (SOD2) performs the same dismutation, feeding the peroxiredoxin/thioredoxin water arm.
description_zh_TW: Superoxide anion 是 Hydrogen Peroxide 的上游前驅物：酵素 Superoxide Dismutase 將超氧陰離子歧化為 H2O2，而 NADPH Oxidase、Xanthine Oxidase 與 MAO 等酵素則直接產生 H2O2。在粒線體中，MnSOD（SOD2）執行同樣的歧化反應，供應 peroxiredoxin/thioredoxin 水臂使用。

label: Glutathione Peroxidase
description: Glutathione peroxidase reduces free hydrogen peroxide to water and organic hydroperoxides to their corresponding alcohols, using reduced glutathione as a cofactor. It is one of the main enzymatic components of the cellular antioxidant defense against ROS-induced damage, and its activity is impaired by glycation, raising oxidative stress.
description_zh_TW: Glutathione peroxidase 以還原型 glutathione 為輔因子，將游離 hydrogen peroxide 還原為水，並將有機 hydroperoxide 還原為相應的醇。它是細胞對抗 ROS 損傷的抗氧化防禦主要酵素組件之一，其活性會因 glycation 而下降，導致 oxidative stress 上升。

label: Small-cell lung cancer
description: Small-cell lung cancer is treated with Chemotherapy. Platinum-based chemotherapy is the backbone of SCLC treatment: concurrent platinum plus etoposide with thoracic radiotherapy for limited-stage disease, and platinum-based chemotherapy combined with a PD-L1 inhibitor for extensive-stage disease.
description_zh_TW: 小細胞肺癌（Small-cell lung cancer）以化療（Chemotherapy）治療。含鉑化療是 SCLC 治療的骨幹：侷限期以含鉑加 etoposide 並合併胸部放射治療，廣泛期則以含鉑化療合併 PD-L1 抑制劑治療。

label: Atg1
description: Atg1 is a conserved serine/threonine kinase that plays a central role in the initiation of Autophagy in response to nutrient deprivation. It is ULK1 in mammals and nucleates the Autophagosome once mTORC1 dissociates during starvation.
description_zh_TW: Atg1 是保守的絲胺酸/蘇胺酸激酶，在營養缺乏時於 Autophagy 的起始扮演核心角色。它在哺乳類即為 ULK1，並在飢餓時 mTORC1 解離後成核形成 Autophagosome。

label: Epigenome
description: The epigenome comprises layers of information that switch genes on or off without changing the DNA sequence: chemical tags on DNA (chiefly DNA methylation), DNA-associated proteins such as histones and their histone modifications that alter chromatin structure, and regulatory RNAs such as non-coding RNA. Unlike the genome, it varies between cell types and changes across the life course.
description_zh_TW: Epigenome 由多層資訊構成，可在不改變 DNA 序列的情況下開關基因：DNA 上的化學標記（主要為 DNA methylation）、與 DNA 結合的蛋白質如 histone 及其改變 chromatin 結構的 histone modification，以及 non-coding RNA 等調控性 RNA。與 genome 不同，它在細胞型態間有差異，並隨生命歷程改變。

label: V-ATPase
description: The V-ATPase is a multi-subunit proton pump with V0 membrane and V1 cytosolic domains that maintains the acidic lysosomal lumen at about pH 4.5-5.5. This low pH is what activates more than 50 intralysosomal hydrolases, so V-ATPase is the enzyme that makes lysosomal degradation chemistry possible.
description_zh_TW: V-ATPase 是由 V0 膜區與 V1 細胞質區構成的多次單元質子幫浦，負責將溶酶體腔維持在約 pH 4.5–5.5 的酸性環境。這個低 pH 正是活化超過 50 種溶酶體內水解酶的條件，因此 V-ATPase 是使溶酶體降解化學反應得以進行的酵素。

label: Huntington's Disease
description: Huntington's disease is caused by expansion of a CAG repeat to 36 or more repeats in exon 1 of HTT, which inserts a polyglutamine tract into huntingtin's N-terminus. The resulting mutant protein misfolds and aggregates, and the disease is therefore defined by a single gene's repeat expansion.
description_zh_TW: Huntington's disease 是由 HTT 外顯子 1 的 CAG 重複擴增至 36 次以上所造成，該擴增會在 huntingtin 的 N 端插入一段多麩醯胺酸序列。由此產生的突變蛋白錯誤摺疊並聚集，因此此疾病由單一基因的重複擴增所定義。

label: Nigrostriatal System
description: Addiction and Nigrostriatal System are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Addiction and Nigrostriatal System may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Addiction 和 Nigrostriatal System 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Addiction 和 Nigrostriatal System 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Inflammasome
description: Canonical inflammasomes activate caspase-1, which processes pro-IL-1beta and pro-IL-18 into their mature secreted forms and cleaves gasdermin D to execute pyroptosis. This activation is the central effector step of the inflammasome pathway and requires assembly of sensor, ASC, and procaspase-1. In senescence, caspase-1 activity also feeds the SASP, particularly during oncogene-induced senescence where the canonical inflammasome is engaged. The relationship is a foundational inflammasome mechanism with direct relevance to senescence-associated inflammation and sterile immunity.
description_zh_TW: 典型發炎體活化 caspase-1，caspase-1 將 pro-IL-1beta 與 pro-IL-18 切割為成熟、分泌形式，驅動發炎。此切割是衰老細胞中促發炎性 IL-1beta 釋放的核心步驟，且構成 SASP 的 IL-1 臂。不同於 IL-1alpha（細胞內並經 calpain 切割），IL-1beta 嚴格依賴 caspase-1 活化，使發炎體成為 SASP 中此細胞激素的必要閘門。此活化連結 DAMP 感知到分泌組的發炎輸出。

label: HSP70
description: Hsp70 is the major transcriptional target of phenylbutyrate mediating cytoprotection and refolding. Upregulation is the chaperone output.
description_zh_TW: Hsp70 是 phenylbutyrate 介導細胞保護與重折疊的主要轉錄標的。上調是伴侶輸出。

label: Innate Immune System
description: PAMP are conserved microbial motifs absent from host cells; their engagement of pattern recognition receptors such as TLRs, NOD-like receptors and RLRs is what activates the Innate Immune System and triggers an inflammatory response.
description_zh_TW: PAMP 是微生物特有、宿主細胞不具的保守分子基序；它們與 TLR、NOD-like receptors、RLR 等模式辨識受體結合，正是啟動 Innate Immune System 並引發發炎反應的原因。

label: NAMPT
description: NAMPT is the rate-limiting enzyme of the NAD+ Salvage Pathway. It catalyses the condensation of nicotinamide with PRPP to form NMN, and because its expression declines with age, loss of this single step is sufficient to produce the age-related NAD+ decline that impairs sirtuin activity and DNA repair.
description_zh_TW: NAMPT 是 NAD+ Salvage Pathway 的限速酵素。它催化 nicotinamide 與 PRPP 縮合生成 NMN；由於其表現隨年齡衰退，單這一步的流失就足以造成與年齡相關的 NAD+ 下降，進而損害 sirtuin 活性與 DNA 修復。

label: TRAF6
description: TRAF6 builds Lys63-linked and linear ubiquitin chains via its RING domain with the Ubc13/Uev1A E2 complex; these chains act as scaffolds recruiting TAK1 and the IKK and TBK1 kinases, which activate NF-κB and MAP kinases. The resulting program drives inflammation, interferon responses, and osteoclastogenesis.
description_zh_TW: TRAF6 透過其 RING 區域與 Ubc13/Uev1A E2 複合體建立 Lys63 連接與線型泛素鏈；這些鏈作為支架招募 TAK1 與 IKK、TBK1 激酶，進而活化 NF-κB 與 MAP 激酶。由此啟動的程式驅動發炎、干擾素反應與破骨細胞生成。

label: BIG1
description: BIG1 is a protein that regulates the trafficking of proteins and lipids to and from the Plasma Membrane, and it is thought to help move vesicles between organelles such as the Golgi apparatus and the Plasma Membrane. Because BIG1 controls which surface receptors and lipids reach the Plasma Membrane, this trafficking determines the membrane's composition, supports cell-cell communication, and shapes how strongly and for how long a cell responds to extracellular signals.
description_zh_TW: BIG1 是一種調控蛋白質與脂質在細胞內運送（trafficking）往返於 Plasma Membrane 的蛋白質，並被認為參與囊泡在 Golgi apparatus 與 Plasma Membrane 等胞器之間的移動。由於 BIG1 決定哪些表面受體與脂質能被運送至 Plasma Membrane，這項運送調控了膜的組成、支撐細胞間的溝通，並塑造細胞對細胞外訊號反應的強度與持續時間。

label: EMT
description: EMT promotes Chemotherapy Resistance. Epithelial-mesenchymal transition is a developmental program co-opted by carcinomas to lose polarity, gain motility, and acquire stem-like properties for invasion. Chemotherapy resistance denotes the failure of cytotoxic drugs to kill tumor cells, arising through efflux, death-pathway suppression, and stem-cell states. The relationship is directional, with EMT acting as the operative agent upon Chemotherapy Resistance rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: EMT 促進 Chemotherapy Resistance。上皮-間質轉化是癌組織選擇的發育程序，可以失去極性、獲得運動性並獲得類似幹細胞的侵襲特性。抗藥性是指細胞毒性藥物無法殺死腫瘤細胞，這是由於外流、死亡途徑抑制和幹細胞狀態而產生的。這種關係是有方向的，EMT 充當 Chemotherapy Resistance 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Cell Cycle Arrest
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Cellular senescence is fundamentally defined as a state of stable, essentially irreversible cell-cycle arrest in which cells remain metabolically active but lose the capacity to proliferate, distinguishing it from quiescence and terminal differentiation. The arrest is actively enforced by tumor-suppressor networks -- the p53/p21 and p16/Rb axes -- that impose a durable G1-phase block and remain engaged even under strong mitogenic stimulation. Because the arrest is permanent, senescent cells can persist for the lifetime of the organism, accumulating in tissues with age. Importantly, senescence is not mere growth arrest but a comprehensive reprogramming entailing chromatin reorganization, metabolic shifts, and a distinctive secretory phenotype (SASP).
description_zh_TW: 細胞衰老在根本上被定義為一種穩定、本質上不可逆的細胞週期停滯狀態，細胞在此狀態下仍維持代謝活性，但喪失增殖能力，從而有別於靜止（quiescence）與終末分化。此停滯由腫瘤抑制網絡主動執行——即 p53/p21 與 p16/Rb 軸——它們施加持久的 G1 期阻斷，即便在強力促有絲分裂刺激下仍持續作用。由於停滯是永久性的，衰老細胞可在個體終生存留並隨年齡在組織中累積。重要的是，衰老不只是單純的生長停滯，而是一種包含染色質重組、代謝轉變以及獨特分泌表型（SASP）的全面重編程。

label: Hematopoietic Stem Cell
description: Adult stem cells such as hematopoietic stem cells spend most of their lives in quiescence to protect the genome and preserve self-renewal capacity. By remaining in a low-activity state, these cells limit DNA replication-associated damage and metabolic stress, maintaining their regenerative potential over a lifetime and resisting stem cell exhaustion. Quiescence therefore serves as a protective mechanism that balances stem cell maintenance with the need to respond rapidly to hematopoietic demand.
description_zh_TW: 成體幹細胞（例如造血幹細胞）一生的大部分時間都處於靜止狀態，以保護基因組並保持自我更新能力。透過維持低活性狀態，這些細胞限制了 DNA 複製相關的損傷和代謝應激，在一生中保持其再生潛力並抵抗幹細胞衰竭。因此，Quiescence 作為一種保護機制，平衡幹細胞維持與快速反應造血需求的需要。

label: cGAMP
description: The Meningeal Lymphatic System acts as a conduit for cGAS-STING–derived products such as cGAMP and cytokines, carrying them from the brain to peripheral lymphoid tissue. By exporting these danger signals it shapes both innate and Adaptive Immune System responses to neurodegeneration.
description_zh_TW: Meningeal Lymphatic System 扮演 cGAS-STING 衍生物（例如 cGAMP 與細胞激素）的傳送管道，將它們由腦部運送至周邊淋巴組織。藉由輸出這些危險訊號，它同時形塑了先天免疫與 Adaptive Immune System 對神經退行性病變的反應。

label: Integrin
description: Integrins are heterodimeric transmembrane receptors that mediate cell-ECM adhesion by binding matrix ligands such as fibronectin (alpha5beta1), vitronectin (alphavbeta3) and collagens. Ligand engagement induces conformational extension, clustering, and recruitment of focal adhesion machinery.
description_zh_TW: Integrin 是異二聚體跨膜受體，透過結合纖連蛋白（alpha5beta1）、玻連蛋白（alphavbeta3）和膠原蛋白等基質配體，介導細胞-ECM 黏附。配體接合誘導構形伸展、聚集和黏著斑機器的招募。

label: HUWE1
description: HUWE1 is the primary E3 ubiquitin ligase for Mcl-1 turnover.
description_zh_TW: HUWE1 是 Mcl-1 週轉的主要 E3 泛素連接酶。

label: Bid
description: Bid (BH3 interacting-domain death agonist) is a pro-apoptotic BH3-only member of the Bcl-2 family and a 22 kDa protein that exists in an inactive cytosolic conformation. It serves as the critical link between the extrinsic death-receptor and intrinsic mitochondrial pathways of apoptosis.
description_zh_TW: Bid（BH3 interacting-domain death agonist）是 Bcl-2 家族促凋亡的 BH3-only 成員，為 22 kDa 蛋白，以不活化的細胞質構形存在。它是凋亡中外在性死亡受體路徑與內在性粒線體路徑之間的關鍵橋樑。

label: PRDX6
description: Phospholipase A2 enzymes hydrolyze phospholipids to release arachidonic acid and lysophospholipids. Peroxiredoxin 6 uniquely carries an iPLA2 (calcium-independent PLA2) activity whose suppression underlies apigenin's senomorphic SASP suppression.
description_zh_TW: 磷脂酶 A2（PLA2）水解磷脂以釋放花生四烯酸與溶血磷脂。過氧化還原酶 6（PRDX6）獨特地帶有 iPLA2（鈣非依賴 PLA2）活性，其抑制是 apigenin 的 senomorphic SASP 壓制基礎。

label: Activin A
description: Activin A signals through the type I receptor ALK4 and type II receptors activin receptor RIIA/RIIB, which phosphorylate SMAD2 and SMAD3 to transmit signals to the nucleus. This receptor architecture is canonical for activin/nodal signaling within the TGFbeta superfamily and is required for Activin A's biological effects in senescence. The ALK4-SMAD2/3 axis links ligand binding directly to transcriptional reprogramming of recipient cells, including induction of cell-cycle inhibitor genes. Because ALK4 is shared with other TGFbeta-family ligands, its engagement integrates Activin A signaling into the broader paracrine senescence network.
description_zh_TW: Activin A 經第一型受體 ALK4 與第二型受體 activin receptor RIIA/RIIB 訊號，磷酸化 SMAD2 與 SMAD3 將訊號傳遞至核。此受體架構對 TGFbeta 超家族內的 activin/nodal 訊號為典型，且為 Activin A 在衰老中的生物效應必要。ALK4-SMAD2/3 軸將配體結合直接連結到受體細胞的轉錄重編程，包括細胞週期抑制因子的誘發。由於 ALK4 與其他 TGFbeta 家族配體共享，其參與將 Activin A 訊號整合到更廣的旁分泌衰老網絡。

label: Wound Healing
description: High levels of Advanced Glycation End Products impair wound healing by promoting inflammation, reducing nitric oxide activity, and causing vascular and neurological modifications. Because the effect operates through several mechanisms at once, AGE burden is a modifiable therapeutic target in diabetic and elderly patients with chronic wounds.
description_zh_TW: 高濃度的 Advanced Glycation End Products 會藉由促進發炎、降低一氧化氮活性，以及造成血管與神經修飾來損害傷口癒合。由於此作用同時透過多重機制進行，AGE 負擔是糖尿病與老年慢性傷口患者可調節的治療標的。

label: c-Met
description: The MET proto-oncogene encodes the receptor tyrosine kinase c-Met (hepatocyte growth factor receptor), synthesized as a precursor and cleaved into a disulfide-linked alpha/beta heterodimer. MET is the only known receptor gene for hepatocyte growth factor.
description_zh_TW: MET 原致癌基因編碼受體酪胺酸激酶 c-Met（肝細胞生長因子受體），先合成前體，再裂解為雙硫鍵連結的 alpha/beta 異二聚體。MET 是肝細胞生長因子唯一已知的受體基因。

label: Adrenochrome formation
description: Oxidative stress drives adrenochrome formation because high levels of superoxide and H2O2 favor oxidation and cyclization of adrenaline to the neurotoxic quinone adrenochrome. This pathway has been implicated in psychosis models and redox-linked neuronal injury. The directionality is catecholamine oxidation to adrenochrome. A caveat is that adrenochrome formation in vivo is contested, and adrenochrome can also be detoxified or further metabolized, so its pathological relevance remains debated. The pathway is also relevant to catecholamine-driven cardiotoxicity during stress and to hypotheses linking redox state to neuropsychiatric phenomena.
description_zh_TW: Oxidative stress 驅動 adrenochrome formation，因為高水平的超氧化物和 H2O2 有利於腎上腺素氧化和環化為神經毒性醌腎上腺素紅。此途徑與精神病模型和氧化還原相關的神經元損傷有關。方向性是兒茶酚胺氧化成腎上腺素紅。需要注意的是，体内的 adrenochrome formation 存在争议，并且肾上腺素红也可以被解毒或进一步代谢，因此其病理相关性仍然存在争议。该通路还与应激期间儿茶酚胺驱动的心脏毒性以及将氧化还原状态与神经精神现象联系起来的假设有关。

label: NMN
description: NMN is an endogenous nucleotide derived from vitamin B3 and the direct biosynthetic precursor of NAD+. It is converted to NAD+ by NMNAT in the salvage pathway, so raising NMN availability raises cellular NAD+ and, because every mammalian sirtuin requires NAD+ as an obligate co-substrate, potentiates the whole sirtuin family without NMN binding any sirtuin directly.
description_zh_TW: NMN 是源自維生素 B3 的內源性核苷酸，也是 NAD+ 的直接生合成前驅物。它在 salvage pathway 中由 NMNAT 轉換為 NAD+，因此提高 NMN 的可得性便會提高細胞 NAD+，而由於所有哺乳類 sirtuin 都以 NAD+ 為必要共同受質，這會在不直接結合任何 sirtuin 的情況下增強整個 sirtuin 家族的活性。

label: Autophagic Lysosome Reformation
description: Autophagic lysosome reformation (ALR) is the process by which spent autolysosomes tubulate and bud off new lysosomes to restore the lysosomal pool after autophagy. ALR requires the coordinated actions of phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate (PI(4,5)P2), clathrin, and adaptor proteins AP2 and AP4 to drive membrane scission and vesicle formation. This reformation step is essential to prevent lysosomal depletion during sustained autophagy. Defects in ALR cause accumulation of enlarged autolysosomes and impaired degradative capacity.
