description_zh_TW: 自噬性溶酶體重組（ALR）是耗損的自體溶酶體經由小管形成並出芽產生新溶酶體，以在自噬後恢復溶酶體庫的過程。ALR 需要磷脂醯肌醇 4,5-二磷酸（PI(4,5)P2）、clathrin 以及接頭蛋白 AP2 與 AP4 的協調作用，以驅動膜分裂和囊泡形成。此重組步驟對防止持續自噬期間溶酶體耗竭至為必要。ALR 的缺陷導致腫大的自體溶酶體累積以及降解能力受損。

label: Amadori products
description: Amadori products are stable early-stage intermediates of glycation that form when the initial unstable Schiff base between a reducing sugar and a protein amino group undergoes chemical rearrangement over days. They are therefore reversible targets before they become irreversible crosslinks.
description_zh_TW: Amadori products 是 glycation 早期階段的穩定中間體，由還原糖與蛋白胺基之間最初不穩定的 Schiff base 經數日的化學重排形成。因此在成為不可逆交聯之前，它們是可逆的處置標的。

label: Kinase
description: Protein kinases share an adenosine-binding site with sirtuins such as SIRT2, an overlap exploited by screening known kinase inhibitors against sirtuins as a drug-discovery strategy. This shared adenosine pocket allows scaffolds like the bisindolylmaleimide Ro31-8220 and the indolinone GW5074 to engage both families, inhibiting SIRT1 and SIRT2 in the low micromolar range while retaining kinase activity. Directionally, the enzyme superfamily of Kinase proteins and sirtuin deacetylases both rely on an adenosine-binding pocket, explaining the cross-reactivity between kinase-inhibitor scaffolds and sirtuins. This structural convergence frames interpretation of kinase-inhibitor effects in sirtuin biology.
description_zh_TW: 蛋白激酶與 SIRT2 等 sirtuin 共享一個腺嘌呤結合位點，這種重疊被利用來篩選已知激酶抑制劑對 sirtuin 的活性，作為一種藥物發現策略。這種共享的腺嘌呤口袋允許如雙吲哚基馬來酰亞胺 Ro31-8220 和吲哚啉酮 GW5074 等骨架與兩個家族結合，在低微摩爾範圍內抑制 SIRT1 和 SIRT2 的同時保留激酶活性。方向性上激酶蛋白的酶超家族和 sirtuin 去乙醯酶都依賴腺嘌呤結合口袋，解釋了激酶抑制劑骨架和 sirtuin 之間的交叉反應性。這種結構上的匯聚為詮釋激酶抑制劑在 sirtuin 生物學中的效應提供了框架。

label: NETosis
description: Citrullinated histone H3 (cit-H3) is the PAD4-generated immunodetection signature of NETosis, marking neutrophil extracellular trap formation. Together with extracellular DNA (Sytox Green) and MPO-DNA complexes it forms the diagnostic triad that distinguishes NETs from generic necrotic DNA release.
description_zh_TW: 瓜胺酸化組蛋白 H3（cit-H3）是 NETosis 的 PAD4 生成式免疫檢測標記，用以標示中性球細胞外捕捉網（NET）的形成。它與細胞外 DNA（Sytox Green）以及 MPO–DNA 複合體共同構成診斷三聯體，用以區分 NET 與一般壞死造成的 DNA 釋放。

label: Homologous Recombination
description: BRCA2 is the Tumor Suppressor protein that loads RAD51 onto single-stranded DNA at resected Double-Strand Breaks, enabling strand exchange during Homologous Recombination; with BRCA1 and PALB2 it forms a complex essential for genome maintenance through DNA Repair.
description_zh_TW: BRCA2 是將 RAD51 載 onto 切除後的 Double-Strand Breaks 所產生的單股 DNA 上的 Tumor Suppressor 蛋白，使 Homologous Recombination 過程中的股交換得以進行；它與 BRCA1 及 PALB2 共同形成對透過 DNA Repair 維持基因體完整性所必需的複合體。

label: LINE-1
source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence orchestrating SASP expression.md
description: KAP1 (TRIM28/TIF1beta) is the universal corepressor for KRAB-zinc-finger transcription factors, recruiting SETDB1, HDACs and HP1alpha to build H3K9me3-dominated silent chromatin; SIRT6 mono-ADP-ribosylation promotes KAP1–HP1alpha interaction to package LINE-1 elements into repressive heterochromatin.
description_zh_TW: KAP1（TRIM28/TIF1β）是 KRAB 鋅指轉錄因子的通用共抑制因子，招募 SETDB1、HDAC 與 HP1α 建立以 H3K9me3 為主的沉默染色質；SIRT6 的單 ADP 核糖基化促進 KAP1–HP1α 交互作用，將 LINE-1 元素包裝進抑制性異染色質。

label: CDK4 6
description: p16INK4a inhibits cyclin-dependent kinase 4 (CDK4) by binding the cyclin D-CDK4 complex, preventing Rb phosphorylation and maintaining the growth-suppressive, hypophosphorylated state of Rb. This is a primary mechanism by which p16 enforces the durable, p53-independent phase of senescence, and loss of p16 is a common event in cancer, underscoring its tumor-suppressive role. The inhibition is direct and well established, and its expression rises with age and senescent burden. p16 is therefore both a cell-cycle brake and a senescence biomarker.
description_zh_TW: p16INK4a 抑制 cyclin-dependent kinase 4（CDK4），透過結合 cyclin D-CDK4 複合體，防止 Rb 磷酸化並維持 Rb 的生長抑制、低磷酸化狀態。這是 p16 執行衰老持久、獨立於 p53 階段的主要機制，且 p16 缺失是癌症常見事件，凸顯其腫瘤抑制角色。此抑制直接且確立牢固，且其表現隨年齡與衰老負擔上升。p16 因此既是細胞週期煞車也是衰老生物標記。

label: Sulforaphane
description: Sulforaphane from broccoli acts as a well-characterized inhibitor of histone deacetylase enzymes. By altering histone acetylation and chromatin structure, it durably reprograms expression of genes involved in stress resistance, inflammation, and longevity.
description_zh_TW: 來自青花菜的 Sulforaphane 是明確的 Histone Deacetylases 抑制劑。透過改變組蛋白乙醯化與染色質結構，它能持久重編與壓力抗性、發炎及長壽相關基因的表現。

label: Gnathostomiasis
description: Peripheral blood eosinophilia — an expansion of circulating eosinophils — is a hallmark laboratory finding in both cutaneous and visceral gnathostomiasis, often exceeding 20% of the total leukocyte count, and CSF eosinophilic pleocytosis is characteristic of the eosinophilic meningitis form. Eosinophilia in a patient with migratory subcutaneous swellings and relevant travel history is highly suggestive of gnathostomiasis.
description_zh_TW: 周邊血液 eosinophilia（循環中 eosinophils 的擴增）是皮膚型與內臟型 gnathostomiasis 共同的典型實驗室表現，常超過總白血球計數的 20%；腦脊髓液中的嗜酸性球增多則是 eosinophilic meningitis 型的特徵。對於有移行性皮下腫脹及相關旅遊史的病人，eosinophilia 高度提示 gnathostomiasis。

label: Adrenoleukodystrophy
description: Mutations in ABCD1, an ATP-binding cassette transporter that exports very long chain fatty acids from peroxisomes, cause X-linked adrenoleukodystrophy. Defective VLCFA transport leads to lipid accumulation that primarily damages the brain and adrenal glands; gene therapy delivering functional ABCD1 via AAV9 vectors has shown early promise.
description_zh_TW: ABCD1 是將極長鏈脂肪酸自過氧化物體輸出的 ABC 轉運蛋白，其突變會導致 X 染色體連鎖腎上腺腦白質失養症。VLCFA 運輸缺陷造成脂質累積，主要傷害大腦與腎上腺；利用 AAV9 載體遞送功能性 ABCD1 的基因療法在早期試驗已展現潛力。

label: Lymphoma
description: DLBCL is an aggressive B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma subtype.
description_zh_TW: DLBCL 是侵襲性 B 細胞非何杰金淋巴瘤亞型。

label: Regulatory T cells
description: Regulatory T cells (Tregs) are a CD4+ T-lymphocyte subset that suppresses excessive immune activation and maintains self-tolerance, countering chronic inflammation and autoimmunity.
description_zh_TW: Regulatory T cells（Tregs）是 CD4+ T 淋巴球的一個次群，可抑制過度的免疫活化並維持自身耐受性，對抗慢性發炎與自體免疫。

label: Lactylation
description: Lysine lactylation is a lactate-derived post-translational modification coupling metabolic state to protein function. Lactate downregulates SIRT3, increasing ACSL4 lactylation, promoting ferroptosis and accelerating nucleus pulposus cell decline in intervertebral disc degeneration.
description_zh_TW: 離胺酸乳醯化是一種乳酸衍生的翻譯後修飾，將代謝狀態與蛋白功能偶聯。乳酸下調 SIRT3，增加 ACSL4 乳醯化，促進椎間盤退化中髓核細胞的鐵死亡和功能衰退。

label: Mitochondrial Free Radical Theory of Aging
description: In 1972 Denham Harman refined his free radical theory into the mitochondrial free radical theory of aging, specifically implicating mitochondria as the primary source and the primary target of reactive oxygen species. This localisation sharpened the earlier theory by assigning both origin and damage site to one organelle.
description_zh_TW: 1972 年，Denham Harman 將其 free radical theory 精煉為 mitochondrial free radical theory of aging，明確指出 mitochondria 是 reactive oxygen species 的主要來源與主要標的。此項定位為較早的理論增加了精確度，把起源與損傷部位同時指派給同一胞器。

label: ASAH1
description: Farber disease is a rare autosomal recessive lysosomal storage disorder caused by loss-of-function mutations in ASAH1, leaving less than 5% residual acid ceramidase activity. Ceramide then accumulates in lysosomes of macrophages, joints, skin and CNS, producing the classic triad of painful joint deformities, subcutaneous lipomatous nodules and vocal hoarseness; severity inversely correlates with residual enzyme activity.
description_zh_TW: Farber disease 是一種罕見的體染色體隱性溶小體儲積症，由 ASAH1 的功能喪失突變造成，使 acid ceramidase 殘餘活性低於 5%。因此 ceramide 在巨噬細胞、關節、皮膚與中樞神經的溶小體中累積，形成疼痛性關節變形、皮下脂肪瘤樣結節與聲音嘶啞的典型三聯徵；嚴重度與殘餘酵素活性成反比。

label: Atrial natriuretic peptide
description: Heart releases Atrial natriuretic peptide when atrial cardiomyocytes are stretched. ANP acts through cGMP signaling to unload volume, providing a hormonal counterweight to the sympathetic drive on the Heart.
description_zh_TW: 當心房心肌細胞受到牽張時，Heart（心臟）會釋放 Atrial natriuretic peptide（心房利鈉胜肽）。ANP 透過 cGMP 訊號卸除體液量，對心臟的交感神經驅動形成荷爾蒙層面的對沖。

label: Mediterranean Diet
description: The PREDIMED trial showed that a Mediterranean diet supplemented with olive oil or nuts significantly reduced major cardiovascular events. Directionally, the dietary pattern sits upstream of lower CVD incidence. Polyphenols including resveratrol may engage SIRT1, but the effect is multifactorial, and it is a clinically validated dietary intervention. The trial provides the strongest evidence that a Mediterranean dietary pattern reduces cardiovascular risk. Its success supports the concept that whole-diet approaches, engaging multiple pathways including sirtuins, are effective for cardiovascular prevention.
description_zh_TW: PREDIMED 試驗顯示，補充橄欖油或堅果的地中海飲食顯著降低了主要心血管事件。在方向性上，飲食模式位於降低心血管疾病發生率的上游。包括 resveratrol 在內的多酚可能作用於 SIRT1，但此效應是多因素的，是一種經過臨床驗證的飲食干預。該試驗提供了最強的證據表明地中海飲食模式降低心血管風險。其成功支持了全飲食方法（涉及 sirtuin 等多種途徑）對心血管預防有效的概念。

label: Fucoidan
description: SIRT6-activating fucoidan extends healthspan and lifespan in aged wild-type mice, confirming in vivo geroprotection. Directionally, fucoidan sits upstream of improved survival and function. This mirrors the longevity association of centenarian SIRT6 variants and positions fucoidan as a natural SIRT6-targeted intervention. The benefit in naturally aged mice suggests that SIRT6 activation can counteract age-related decline even when initiated late in life. Fucoidan's dual activation of SIRT6 protein and ADP-ribosyltransferase activity is thought to mediate its healthspan effects.
description_zh_TW: 活化 SIRT6 的 fucoidan 延長老年野生型小鼠的健康壽命和壽命，確認了體內抗衰老保護。在方向性上，fucoidan 位於改善存活和功能的上游。這反映了百歲人瑞 SIRT6 變異體的長壽關聯，將 fucoidan 定位為天然的 SIRT6 靶向干預措施。在自然衰老小鼠中的益處表明，即使在生命後期才開始 SIRT6 活化也能對抗年齡相關退化。Fucoidan 對 SIRT6 蛋白和 ADP-核糖基轉移酶活性的雙重活化被認為是其健康壽命效應的介導機制。

label: B18R
description: B18R is a vaccinia-encoded virulence factor secreted during infection.
description_zh_TW: B18R 是感染期間分泌的痘苗病毒編碼毒力因子。

label: Tenovins
description: By inhibiting SIRT1/SIRT2-mediated deacetylation, Tenovins promote p53 hyperacetylation and reactivation of p53-dependent transcriptional networks. Directionally, Tenovin-mediated sirtuin inhibition sits upstream of p53 activation. This restores p53 tumor-suppressive function in cells where sirtuins silence it, and it is the basis for Tenovins' anticancer activity. Because p53 is a central tumor suppressor, its reactivation by sirtuin inhibition represents a compelling strategy for p53-wild-type tumors. The hyperacetylation increases p53 stability and transcriptional potency, driving cell-cycle arrest and apoptosis.
description_zh_TW: 透過抑制 SIRT1/SIRT2 介導的去乙醯化，Tenovin 促進 p53 超乙醯化和 p53 依賴性轉錄網路的重新活化。在方向性上，Tenovin 介導的 sirtuin 抑制位於 p53 活化的上游。這在 sirtuin 沉默 p53 的細胞中恢復其腫瘤抑制功能，是 Tenovin 抗癌活性的基礎。由於 p53 是核心腫瘤抑制因子，透過 sirtuin 抑制重新活化它是 p53 野生型腫瘤的引人注目策略。超乙醯化增加 p53 穩定性和轉錄效力，驅動細胞週期阻滯和凋亡。

label: Cathepsin K
description: CTSK loss-of-function causes the osteosclerotic dysplasia pycnodysostosis. Causation is the genetic etiology.
description_zh_TW: CTSK 功能缺失導致骨硬化發育不良緻密骨發育不全。因果是遺傳病因。

label: CD38 inhibitor 78c
description: 78c is a highly potent, selective, orally bioavailable small-molecule inhibitor of CD38 NAD+-glycohydrolase activity. Directionally, 78c sits upstream of CD38 blockade. By stopping NAD+ consumption, it spares the co-substrate for sirtuins and other NAD+-dependent enzymes, and it is a leading age-reversal NAD+-preservation strategy. 78c's potency and oral bioavailability make it suitable for chronic in vivo studies, and its administration to aged mice restores NAD+ levels and sirtuin activity. These properties positioned 78c as the key pharmacological tool for validating CD38 as a longevity target.
description_zh_TW: 78c 是一種高效力、高選擇性、口服可利用的 CD38 NAD+ 糖水解酶活性小分子抑制劑。在方向性上，78c 位於 CD38 阻斷的上游。透過阻止 NAD+ 消耗，它節省了 sirtuin 和其他 NAD+ 依賴性酶的共同底物，是領先的衰老逆轉 NAD+ 保存策略。78c 的效力和口服可利用性使其適用於長期體內研究，其對老年小鼠的施用恢復了 NAD+ 水平和 sirtuin 活性。這些特性使 78c 成為驗證 CD38 作為長壽靶標的關鍵藥理學工具。

label: Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis
description: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis and frontotemporal dementia form a disease spectrum rather than fully separate disorders, since they share a common genetic basis and protein pathology. ALS is primarily a motor neuron disease, but the C9orf72 hexanucleotide repeat expansion and TDP-43 pathology that cause familial ALS are also the most common hereditary causes of FTD, producing overlapping FTD-ALS syndromes. Thus ALS can give rise to frontotemporal dementia when the neurodegenerative process extends into the frontal and temporal lobes.
description_zh_TW: 肌萎縮側索硬化症和額顳葉失智症形成了一個疾病譜，而不是完全獨立的疾病，因為它們具有共同的遺傳基礎和蛋白質病理學。 ALS 主要是一種運動神經元疾病，但導致家族性 ALS 的 C9orf72 六核苷酸重複擴增和 TDP-43 病理也是 FTD 最常見的遺傳原因，產生重疊的 FTD-ALS 綜合徵。因此，當神經退化過程延伸到額葉和顳葉時，ALS 可能會導致額顳葉失智症。

label: Glutamate-gated Cl- channels
description: Avermectins are allosteric potentiators/agonists of invertebrate glutamate-gated chloride channels (GluCls); Cl- influx hyperpolarizes and paralyzes parasites.
description_zh_TW: 是無脊椎動物穀氨酸門控氯離子通道 (GluCls) 的變構增強劑/激動劑； Cl-流入使寄生蟲超極化並麻痺。

label: BMP Signaling Pathway
description: BMP2/4/7 drive osteoblast differentiation as the defining skeletal function of the pathway. Loss of signaling causes skeletal dysplasia.
description_zh_TW: BMP2/4/7 驅動造骨細胞分化，作為此路徑定義性的骨骼功能。訊號缺失導致骨骼發育不良。

label: Endothelial Nitric Oxide Synthase
description: eNOS (NOS3) is the constitutive isoform of nitric oxide synthase expressed in vascular endothelium, continuously producing low-level nitric oxide for basal vascular tone and opposing vasoconstriction. It dimerizes to catalyze the NADPH-dependent oxidation of L-arginine to citrulline and NO, requiring the cofactors tetrahydrobiopterin (BH4), FAD and FMN.
description_zh_TW: eNOS（NOS3）是表現於血管內皮的一氧化氮合成酶組成型亞型，持續產生低量一氧化氮以維持基礎血管張力並對抗血管收縮。它以二聚體形式催化 NADPH 依賴的 L-精胺酸氧化生成瓜胺酸與 NO，需輔因子四氫生物蝶呤（BH4）、FAD 與 FMN。

label: Epigenetic Drift
description: Aging involves epigenetic drift, the progressive divergence of DNA methylation and chromatin marks from the youthful state that erodes the fidelity of gene expression. Drift occurs stochastically, increasing variation both between individuals and between cells of the same tissue, and it contributes to cellular dysfunction and age-related disease. Polycomb group protein target genes are particularly susceptible to age-associated methylation changes, linking drift to the loss of cellular identity.
description_zh_TW: Aging 涉及表觀遺傳漂移、DNA 甲基化和染色質標記與年輕狀態的逐漸分歧，從而侵蝕了 gene expression 的保真度。漂移是隨機發生的，增加了個體之間和同一組織細胞之間的變異，並導致細胞功能障礙和與年齡相關的疾病。多梳蛋白標靶基因特別容易受到與年齡相關的甲基化變化的影響，將漂移與細胞身份的喪失聯繫起來。

label: Dietary Hormesis
description: Dietary hormesis is framed as the cumulative, potentially synergistic adaptive response to a complex array of hormetins within whole-food matrices. This is distinguished from biphasic dose-responses of isolated compounds like resveratrol or curcumin studied in controlled laboratory settings.
description_zh_TW: Dietary Hormesis 被定義為對全食物基質中複雜 Hormetins 陣列產生的累積性、可能具協同作用的適應反應。這與在受控實驗室條件下研究的單一分離化合物（如 resveratrol 或 curcumin）的雙相劑量反應有所區別。

label: Glutamate
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Methylene blue (MB) provides potent neuroprotection against glutamate-induced oxidative toxicity in HT-22 hippocampal neurons, a model in which glutamate blocks the cystine/glutamate antiporter and depletes cellular glutathione. MB was protective in both MTT and Calcein AM viability assays with an EC50 of 17.81 nM and without altering total glutathione levels. This protection correlated with attenuation of glutamate-induced ROS production and mitochondrial membrane potential depolarization, establishing MB's action as upstream of ROS generation rather than as a direct antioxidant.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue (MB)在HT-22海馬神經元中提供對谷氨酸誘導的氧化毒性的強大神經保護作用，這是一種谷氨酸阻斷胱氨酸/谷氨酸反向轉運蛋白並耗盡細胞谷胱甘肽的模型。MB在MTT和Calcein AM活力測定中具有保護作用，EC50為17.81 nM，並且不改變總谷胱甘肽水平。這種保護作用與谷氨酸誘導的ROS產生和粒線體膜電位去極化的減弱相關，確立了MB的作用是在ROS產生的上游而不是作為直接抗氧化劑。

label: Neuron
source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md
description: Both glutamic acid decarboxylase isoforms are highly expressed in GABAergic neurons, which depend on the enzyme to maintain basal GABA levels and thus inhibitory tone. Reduced GAD activity is associated with epilepsy and anxiety disorders, and anti-GAD antibodies are diagnostic markers in stiff-person syndrome and type 1 diabetes.
description_zh_TW: Glutamic acid decarboxylase 的兩種同功型皆在 GABAergic 的 neuron 中高度表現，這些神經元仰賴該酵素維持基礎 GABA 濃度與抑制性張力。GAD 活性降低與 epilepsy 及焦慮疾患相關，而 anti-GAD 抗體則是 stiff-person syndrome 與 type 1 diabetes 的診斷標記。

label: ERK
description: ERK phosphorylation of Mcl-1 at T163 blocks the GSK3 phosphodegron cascade, stabilizing the protein.
description_zh_TW: ERK 在 T163 磷酸化 Mcl-1 阻斷 GSK3 磷酸降解決聯，穩定蛋白。

label: CCL20
description: CCL20 expression is driven by NF-kB and induced by IL-1alpha, IL-1beta, and TNF-alpha, placing it downstream of the apical SASP amplifiers. This positions CCL20 within the IL-1alpha-centered feed-forward loop of senescence inflammation, in which a single upstream cytokine orchestrates a broad chemokine response. Its induction integrates the master inflammatory cytokines with chemokine output, ensuring immune recruitment is coordinated with secretome activation. The relationship is mechanistically coherent and well documented across senescence and inflammatory models. IL-1β acts through the same IL-1R-NF-kB route as a parallel inducer in fibroblasts and epithelial cells.
description_zh_TW: CCL20 表現由 NF-κB 驅動，並被 IL-1alpha、IL-1beta 與 TNF-alpha 誘發，將其置於頂層 SASP 放大器的下游。這將 CCL20 定位於 IL-1alpha 中心的衰老發炎正向迴圈中，其中單一上游細胞激素協調廣泛趨化因子反應。其誘發整合主發炎細胞激素與趨化因子輸出，確保免疫招募與分泌組活化協調。此關係在機制上連貫，並跨衰老與發炎模型良好記載。 IL-1β 在纖維母細胞與上皮細胞經由相同的 IL-1R-NF-κB 途徑作為平行誘發因子。

label: PEX7
description: Mutations in PEX7 cause PEX7-related Zellweger Spectrum Disorder (~5-10% of cases), classically rhizomelic chondrodysplasia punctata type 1; the founder allele c.727G>A partially impairs PTS2 binding.
description_zh_TW: PEX7 突變會造成 PEX7 相關的 Zellweger 光譜症候群（約佔 5–10% 病例），典型表現為肢端軟骨點樣變化症第一型；創始等位基因 c.727G>A 會部分損害 PTS2 結合。

label: Oct4
description: During cellular reprogramming, Oct4 initiates the mesenchymal-to-epithelial transition (MET), a required early step in which fibroblast-like cells adopt an epithelial morphology. By suppressing mesenchymal genes and promoting epithelial ones, Oct4 helps reorganize the cytoskeleton and cell-adhesion program toward the epithelial identity characteristic of pluripotent cells. This MET is followed by erasure of somatic marks and establishment of the pluripotency network, and it is reinforced by the cooperation of Klf4.
description_zh_TW: 在細胞重編程過程中，Oct4 啟動間質到上皮的轉變 (MET)，這是纖維母細胞樣細胞採用上皮形態所需的早期步驟。透過抑制間質基因並促進上皮基因，Oct4 有助於重組細胞骨架和細胞黏附程序，以實現多能細胞的上皮身份特徵。該 MET 隨後是體細胞標記的擦除和多能性網絡的建立，並透過 Klf4 的合作得到加強。

label: Gemcitabine
description: Gemcitabine's diphosphate (dFdCDP) irreversibly inactivates the RRM1 subunit of ribonucleotide reductase and depletes dNTP pools, especially dCTP, self-potentiating its own incorporation into DNA. This makes RNR a central target of gemcitabine's anticancer action.
description_zh_TW: Gemcitabine 的二磷酸形式（dFdCDP）會不可逆地使核醣核苷酸還原酶的 RRM1 次單元失活，並耗竭 dNTP 池（尤其是 dCTP），自我增強其嵌入 DNA。這使 RNR 成為 Gemcitabine 抗癌作用的中心靶點。

label: Atg8
description: GATE-16 (GABARAPL2) is a Golgi-associated member of the Atg8 protein family, involved in intra-Golgi transport as well as Autophagy. It is conjugated to autophagosomal membranes similarly to LC3 and GABARAP.
description_zh_TW: GATE-16（GABARAPL2）是 Atg8 蛋白家族中與 Golgi 關聯的成員，參與 Golgi 內運輸以及 Autophagy。它與 LC3 及 GABARAP 類似地被接附到 autophagosome 膜上。

label: γ-H2AX
description: 53BP1 is recruited to DNA double-strand break sites through cooperative recognition of the histone marks H4K20me2 and H2AK15ub, a localization step that is stabilized by interaction with γ-H2AX via the MDC1 mediator. This makes 53BP1 a downstream chromatin scaffold that converts the γ-H2AX damage signal into a repair-pathway commitment.
description_zh_TW: 53BP1 透過協同辨識組蛋白標記 H4K20me2 與 H2AK15ub 被招募到 DNA 雙股斷裂（DSB）位點，此定位步驟再由 MDC1 媒介與 γ-H2AX 的交互作用加以穩定。這使 53BP1 成為下游的染色質支架，把 γ-H2AX 的損傷訊號轉為修復途徑的選擇。

label: TRPM2
description: Free ADP-ribose released by PARG/ARH3 hydrolysis of PAR binds the NUDT9-homology domain of TRPM2 and opens the channel to Ca2+, linking PARP1 hyperactivation in Parthanatos to calcium influx and downstream Calpain and mitochondrial permeability transition.
description_zh_TW: 由 PARG/ARH3 水解 PAR 釋出的游離 ADP-ribose 會結合 TRPM2 的 NUDT9 同源結構域並開啟通道讓 Ca2+ 通過，將 Parthanatos 中的 PARP1 過度活化連結到鈣離子流入及下游的 Calpain 與粒線體通透性轉換。

label: FoxO1
description: SIRT6 deficiency in macrophages increases acetylation and stability of FoxO1, leading to sustained FoxO1 protein and an inflammatory state. Directionally, SIRT6 loss leads to hyperacetylated, stabilized FoxO1. Because SIRT6 normally deacetylates FoxO1, its absence prolongs FoxO1 signaling and promotes inflammatory gene expression in macrophages. This reveals a macrophage-intrinsic mechanism linking SIRT6 to inflammation resolution, and it is relevant to atherosclerosis, where macrophage inflammation drives plaque progression. SIRT6's control of FoxO1 stability adds to its chromatin-based regulation of inflammatory genes.
description_zh_TW: 巨噬細胞中 SIRT6 的缺乏增加 FoxO1 的乙醯化和穩定性，導致持續的 FoxO1 蛋白和發炎狀態。在方向性上，SIRT6 的缺失導致超乙醯化的、穩定的 FoxO1。由於 SIRT6 通常去乙醯化 FoxO1，其缺失延長 FoxO1 信號並促進巨噬細胞中的發炎基因表達。這揭示了一種巨噬細胞固有機制，將 SIRT6 與發炎消退聯繫起來，與動脈粥樣硬化相關（其中巨噬細胞發炎驅動斑塊進展）。SIRT6 對 FoxO1 穩定性的控制增加了其基於染色質的發炎基因調節。

label: PODXL
description: PODXL is a canonical undifferentiated-state surface marker.
description_zh_TW: PODXL 是典型的未分化狀態表面標記。

label: EXITS
description: The EXITS framework (Dunford et al., Nature Genetics 2017) identifies X-chromosome tumor suppressor genes that escape X-inactivation and are therefore biallelically expressed in females, protecting them from single-hit loss. Across >4,100 cancers of 21 tumour types, exactly six of 783 non-pseudoautosomal X genes — ATRX, CNKSR2, DDX3X, KDM5C, KDM6A, MAGEC3 — showed significantly more male-biased loss-of-function mutation.
description_zh_TW: EXITS 架構（Dunford 等，Nature Genetics 2017）辨識出逃脫 X 染色體失活、在女性中呈雙等位表現的 X 染色體腫瘤抑制基因，使其免於單次突變的衝擊。在 21 種腫瘤逾 4,100 例癌症中，783 個非偽自動區 X 基因中恰有六個呈現顯著偏向男性的功能喪失突變：ATRX、CNKSR2、DDX3X、KDM5C、KDM6A、MAGEC3。

label: Peroxisome
description: At least 14 known PEX genes in humans encode peroxins required for Peroxisome biogenesis, assembly, and function. They execute three core processes: PTS1/PTS2 receptor cycling for matrix protein import, membrane assembly and de novo peroxisome formation from the Endoplasmic Reticulum via PEX3, PEX16, and PEX19, and proliferation through PEX11-mediated fission.
description_zh_TW: 人類至少有 14 個已知的 PEX 基因，其編碼的 peroxin 是 Peroxisome 生物生成、組裝與功能所必需。它們執行三項核心過程：PTS1/PTS2 受體循環以進行基質蛋白輸入、經由 PEX3、PEX16 與 PEX19 自 Endoplasmic Reticulum 進行膜組裝與新生過氧化體形成，以及透過 PEX11 介導的分裂進行增殖。

label: CDH2
description: CDH2 encodes the N-cadherin protein product. Gene-to-protein definitional edge.
description_zh_TW: CDH2 編碼 N-cadherin 蛋白產物。基因到蛋白的定義邊。

label: ICE Mouse
description: Double-strand-break induction in the ICE Mouse shifts the epigenetic (DNA-methylation) clock, consistent with chromatin modifiers such as SIRT1 relocalizing away from native sites during repair. Directionally, double-strand-break repair sits upstream of clock acceleration. This provides a quantitative readout of epigenetic drift, and it links the RCM model to measurable aging biomarkers. By demonstrating that DNA damage alone can advance the epigenetic clock, the ICE Mouse connects the loss of epigenetic information to the rate of aging. This finding supports the use of DNA-methylation clocks as indicators of biological age.
description_zh_TW: ICE 小鼠中的雙鏈斷裂誘導改變了表觀遺傳（DNA 甲基化）時鐘，與染色質修飾因子如 SIRT1 在修復期間從原始位點重新定位一致。在方向性上，雙鏈斷裂修復位於時鐘加速的上游。這提供了表觀遺傳漂變的量化讀數，並將 RCM 模型與可測量的衰老生物標誌物聯繫起來。透過證明僅 DNA 損傷就能推進表觀遺傳時鐘，ICE 小鼠將表觀遺傳資訊的喪失與衰老速率聯繫起來。此發現支持使用 DNA 甲基化時鐘作為生物年齡的指標。

label: Rectal Cancer
description: Rectal cancer is often grouped with colon cancer as colorectal cancer, but is managed distinctly due to pelvic anatomical constraints and differing treatment paradigms. Rectal cancer exhibits a higher propensity for locoregional recurrence while colon cancer more often recurs distantly. They are neighboring entities along the colorectal continuum with distinct biology.
description_zh_TW: 直腸癌常與結腸癌合稱為結直腸癌，但因骨盆解剖限制與不同的治療模式而治療方式不同。直腸癌具有較高的局部區域復發傾向，而結腸癌較常在遠端復發。它們是結直腸連續體上相鄰但生物學不同的實體。

label: Splitomicin
description: In ischemic-preconditioning models, Splitomicin reverses protective lysine deacetylation and abolishes preconditioning-induced cardioprotection. Directionally, Splitomicin-mediated sirtuin inhibition sits upstream of lost cardiac protection. This indicates that sirtuin deacetylase activity is required for ischemic tolerance, and it argues that sirtuin activation, not inhibition, protects the heart. The cardioprotective effect of preconditioning is thought to involve SIRT1-dependent stress adaptation, and its loss upon sirtuin inhibition confirms this mechanism. These findings support the development of sirtuin activators for ischemic heart disease.
description_zh_TW: 在缺血預適應模型中，Splitomicin 逆轉保護性的賴氨酸去乙醯化並廢除預適應誘導的心臟保護。在方向性上，Splitomicin 介導的 sirtuin 抑制位於心臟保護喪失的上游。這表明 sirtuin 去乙醯酶活性是缺血耐受所必需的，並主張 sirtuin 活化（而非抑制）才能保護心臟。預適應的心臟保護效應被認為涉及 SIRT1 依賴性的壓力適應，其在 sirtuin 抑制後的喪失確認了此機制。這些發現支持開發用於缺血性心臟病的 sirtuin 活化劑。

label: Hippo Signaling Pathway
description: Organ-size control is the core conserved Hippo pathway function.
description_zh_TW: 器官大小控制是核心保守的 Hippo 路徑功能。

label: LXRα
description: ABCA1 is regulated by LXRalpha, as the nuclear receptor directly drives ABCA1 transcription in response to oxysterol ligands, coordinating cholesterol efflux. This places ABCA1 downstream of LXR-controlled reverse-cholesterol-transport programs. The directionality is LXRalpha activation to ABCA1 expression. A caveat is that PPARgamma and other transcription factors also regulate ABCA1, so LXRalpha is a major but not exclusive controller. This LXR-ABCA1 axis is also redox-responsive, since oxidative modifications of LDL generate LXR ligands that upregulate the transporter as a protective response.
description_zh_TW: ABCA1 受 LXRalpha 調節，因為核受體響應氧甾醇配體直接驅動 ABCA1 轉錄，協調 cholesterol 流出。這將 ABCA1 置於 LXR 控制的反向 cholesterol 傳輸程式的下游。方向性是LXRalpha活化至ABCA1表達。需要注意的是，PPARgamma 和其他轉錄因子也調節 ABCA1，因此 LXRalpha 是主要但不是唯一的控制者。此 LXR-ABCA1 軸也具有氧化還原反應性，因為 LDL 的氧化修飾會產生 LXR 配體，從而上調轉運蛋白作為保護性反應。

label: Post-translational Modification
description: Ubiquitination is a definitional post-translational protein modification.
description_zh_TW: 泛素化是定義性的轉譯後蛋白修飾。

label: miR-378
description: miR-378 reduces SIRT1 activity and facilitates NF-κB-TNFα inflammatory signaling, in part by targeting the 5'-AMPK subunit gamma-2. Directionally, miR-378 inhibits SIRT1, which activates NF-κB. This links a metabolic microRNA to sirtuin-controlled inflammation, and it illustrates how microRNA networks gate sirtuin protective effects. Because AMPK and SIRT1 reinforce each other, miR-378's targeting of AMPK indirectly weakens SIRT1 as well, amplifying inflammatory signaling. These findings identify microRNAs as upstream regulators of the SIRT1/AMPK axis, with potential relevance to metabolic and inflammatory disease.
description_zh_TW: miR-378 降低 SIRT1 活性並促進 NF-κB-TNFα 發炎信號，部分通過靶向 5'-AMPK 亞基 gamma-2。在方向性上，miR-378 抑制 SIRT1，SIRT1 活化 NF-κB。這將一個代謝微小 RNA 與 sirtuin 控制的發炎聯繫起來，說明微小 RNA 網絡如何調控 sirtuin 的保護效應。由於 AMPK 和 SIRT1 相互強化，miR-378 對 AMPK 的靶向也間接削弱 SIRT1，放大發炎信號。這些發現將微小 RNA 鑑定為 SIRT1/AMPK 軸的上游調節因子，對代謝和發炎疾病具有潛在相關性。

label: Super-enhancer
description: Many SASP-associated genes are linked to super-enhancer-like regions that are particularly sensitive to changes in histone acetylation, and such loci probably require sustained acetyl-CoA availability to maintain high transcriptional output, rendering them especially vulnerable to interventions that limit acetyl-CoA supply. SLC25A1 inhibition reduces chromatin accessibility at these SASP loci both in vitro and in vivo, selectively suppressing inflammatory gene expression. This positions mitochondrial metabolism as an upstream determinant of chromatin accessibility in senescent cells, aligning with previous reports linking citrate metabolism to SASP regulation.
description_zh_TW: 許多與SASP相關的基因與超增強子樣區域相關，這些區域對組蛋白乙酰化變化特別敏感，並且這些位點可能需要持續的乙酰輔酶A可用性來維持高轉錄輸出，使其特別容易受到限制乙酰輔酶A供應的干預措施的影響。SLC25A1抑製在體外和體內都減少了這些SASP位點的染色質可及性，選擇性地抑制炎症基因表達。這將線粒體代謝定位為衰老細胞中染色質可及性的上游決定因素，與先前將枸櫞酸代謝與SASP調節相關聯的報告一致。

label: Physical Activity
description: Exercise is defined as planned, structured, and repetitive physical activity performed specifically to improve or maintain physical fitness, and it constitutes a subset of total physical activity, which also includes occupational activity, domestic activity, and non-exercise activity thermogenesis (NEAT). In the energy balance framework of the Speakman review, exercise is the most flexible and controllable component of total daily energy expenditure, and its contribution to daily energy use is quantified through doubly labelled water studies. Because exercise is a voluntary component, it is the primary target of public-health interventions aimed at raising daily energy expenditure.
description_zh_TW: 運動被定義為有計畫、有結構且重複的身體活動，專門為了改善或維持體能而進行；它是總身體活動的一部分，後者還包括職業活動、家務活動與非運動性活動產熱（NEAT）。在Speakman綜述的能量平衡架構中，運動是每日總能量消耗中最具彈性且最可控制的部分，其對每日能量使用的貢獻可透過雙標水研究加以量化。由於運動是自願性組成，它是旨在提高每日能量消耗的公共衛生介入的主要目標。

label: p16INK4A
description: p16INK4A binds CDK4 and prevents cyclin D association, blocking G1/S progression. This direct binding is the molecular basis of INK4-mediated arrest in senescence and quiescence.
description_zh_TW: p16INK4A 結合 CDK4 並阻止 cyclin D 結合，阻斷 G1/S 進展。此直接結合是衰老與靜止中 INK4 介導停滯的分子基礎。

label: MMP-12
description: MMP-12 (macrophage elastase) is the most potent elastinolytic MMP and the only one that can effectively degrade insoluble elastin at physiological concentrations, making it the principal elastase in macrophage-mediated tissue remodelling. MMP-12-deficient mice are protected from cigarette smoke-induced emphysema, and MMP-12-mediated elastin degradation is a central mechanism of both intrinsic and extrinsic skin ageing.
description_zh_TW: MMP-12（巨噬細胞彈性蛋白酶）是最強的彈性蛋白溶解 MMP，也是唯一能在生理濃度下有效降解不溶性彈性蛋白的 MMP，因此是巨噬細胞介導組織重塑中的主要彈性蛋白酶。MMP-12 缺失小鼠可免於菸草煙誘發的肺氣腫，而 MMP-12 介導的彈性蛋白降解也是內在與外在皮膚老化的核心機制。

label: Phenothiazine
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Methylene blue (MB) is the first lead chemical structure of the phenothiazine class, the parent heterocyclic scaffold from which many other drugs derive. Structure-activity analysis showed that MB's distinctive neuroprotective and bioenergetic phenotype requires two structural features of the phenothiazine nucleus: a free (unsubstituted) 10-nitrogen and the position-5 sulfur of the thiazine ring. Adding an amine side chain to the 10-nitrogen (as in chlorpromazine or promethazine) produced roughly a 1000-fold loss of potency and abolished the complex I-to-cytochrome c electron shunt.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue (MB)是吩噻嗪類的第一個先導化學結構，是許多其他藥物衍生的母體雜環骨架。結構-活性分析表明，MB獨特的神經保護和生物能量表型需要吩噻嗪核的兩個結構特徵：游離（未取代的）10-氮和噻嗪環的5位硫。將胺側鏈添加到10-氮（如chlorpromazine或promethazine中）導致效力損失約1000倍，並廢除了複合物I到細胞色素c的電子分流。

label: Colorectal Cancer
source_file: _document_ - The Mechanistic Target of Rapamycin (mTOR) Pathway as a Target of Anti-aging Therapies The Role of Rapamycin and Its Analogs in the Regulation of Cellular Processes and Their Impact on Longevity.md
description: Colon cancer is a malignancy of the large intestine (colon) and represents a major subset of colorectal cancer. It is the third most commonly diagnosed cancer worldwide. Colon cancer shares the colorectal continuum with rectal cancer but is managed distinctly.
description_zh_TW: 結腸癌是大腸（結腸）的惡性腫瘤，代表結直腸癌的一個主要亞群。它是全球第三大最常被診斷的癌症。結腸癌與直腸癌共享結直腸連續體，但治療方式不同。

label: Histone Deacetylase
description: HDAC stands for histone deacetylase, a family of enzymes that remove acetyl groups from lysine residues on histone tails, counteracting the activity of histone acetyltransferases. By deacetylating histones, HDACs promote chromatin compaction and generally repress transcription, and they also regulate numerous non-histone proteins. They are divided into classes I, II, III (sirtuins), and IV, and HDAC inhibitors are widely studied as tools to reactivate silenced genes and as candidate therapeutic agents in cancer, inflammation, and aging.
description_zh_TW: HDAC 代表組蛋白去乙醯化酶，這是一個酶家族，可去除組蛋白尾部賴氨酸殘基上的乙醯基，從而抵消組蛋白乙醯轉移酶的活性。透過組蛋白去乙醯化，HDAC 促進染色質壓縮並通常抑制轉錄，並且它們還調節許多非組蛋白。它們分為 I、II、III（sirtuins）和 IV 類，HDAC 抑制劑作為重新激活沉默基因的工具以及作為癌症、發炎和老化的候選治療劑而被廣泛研究。

label: Epigenetics
description: DNA methylation is one of the most extensively studied epigenetic mechanisms, operating alongside histone modification and non-coding RNA regulation. It involves the covalent addition of methyl groups to cytosines at CpG dinucleotides, repressing gene expression in promoter CpG islands by recruiting methyl-binding proteins and chromatin remodeling factors. Patterns are established de novo by DNMT3 enzymes and maintained by DNMT1 during replication, while methylation also silences transposable elements. Age-related global hypomethylation with focal hypermethylation defines the aging methylome, and selected CpG sites feed the epigenetic clocks that estimate biological age.
description_zh_TW: DNA 甲基化是研究最廣泛的表觀遺傳機制之一，與組蛋白修飾和非編碼 RNA 調控一起發揮作用。它涉及將 methyl groups 共價添加到 CpG 二核苷酸的胞嘧啶上，透過招募甲基結合蛋白和染色質重塑因子來抑制啟動子 CpG 島中的 gene expression。模式由 DNMT3 酶從頭建立，並在複製過程中由 DNMT1 維持，而甲基化也會沉默轉座元件。與年齡相關的整體低甲基化和局部高甲基化定義了衰老的甲基化組，並且選定的 CpG 位點為估計生物年齡的表觀遺傳時鐘提供了資訊。

label: Actin Cytoskeleton
description: Alpha-catenin mechanosensitively links the cadherin complex to actin filaments. Protein-level orphan edge, documented mechanism.
description_zh_TW: Alpha-catenin 以機械敏感方式將 cadherin 複合體連結到肌動蛋白絲。蛋白層級孤兒邊，機制有記載。

label: miR-543
description: miR-543 represses SIRT1 expression post-transcriptionally, and its downregulation reduces inflammation by strengthening the SIRT1/AMPK/NF-κB signaling pathway. Directionally, miR-543 sits upstream of SIRT1 suppression. This places miR-543 among the microRNAs that calibrate inflammatory tone by controlling sirtuin abundance, alongside miR-217 and miR-378. Modulating such microRNAs, through antagomirs or other strategies, is a potential anti-inflammatory approach, and understanding their regulation in aging and disease could reveal new therapeutic targets for restoring SIRT1-dependent protection against chronic inflammation.
description_zh_TW: miR-543 在轉錄後水平抑制 SIRT1 表達，其下調通過加強 SIRT1/AMPK/NF-κB 信號通路來減少發炎。在方向性上，miR-543 位於 SIRT1 抑制的上游。這使 miR-543 列入通過控制 sirtuin 表達量來校準發炎水平的微小 RNA 之中，與 miR-217 和 miR-378 並列。通過反義寡核苷酸或其他策略調節這些微小 RNA 是一種潛在的抗發炎方法，了解它們在衰老和疾病中的調節可能揭示恢復 SIRT1 依賴性保護對抗慢性發炎的新治療靶點。

label: Fasting
description: Short-term starvation or fasting combined with chemotherapy stimulates hormetic responses in normal cells, enhancing resilience, while cancer cells with mutations in Ras or Sch9/S6K cannot mount the same adaptation. This asymmetry is termed differential stress resistance (DSR) and protects normal but not cancer cells against high-dose chemotherapy. It exemplifies exploiting hormesis to widen the therapeutic window.
description_zh_TW: 短期飢餓或 Fasting 合併化療可在正常細胞中刺激 hormetic 反應並增強韌性，而帶有 Ras 或 Sch9/S6K 突變的癌細胞則無法產生相同適應。此不對稱現象稱為 Differential Stress Resistance，可保護正常細胞而不保護癌細胞免於高劑量化療損傷。這是利用 hormesis 擴大治療窗的典型例子。

label: OAADPr
description: During the sirtuin-catalyzed deacetylation of a lysine, NAD+ is cleaved between its nicotinamide and ADP-ribose moieties, and the acetyl group is transferred to the ADP-ribose to generate 2'-O-acetyl-ADP-ribose (OAADPr) plus free nicotinamide. OAADPr is a stoichiometric by-product, released in equimolar amounts with the deacetylated substrate on every catalytic cycle. This molecule is not merely waste: it binds and activates the TRPM2 cation channel, linking sirtuin activity to calcium signaling and cellular stress responses. A caveat is that OAADPr accumulation can itself feed back on cellular metabolism, and its levels reflect the integrated deacetylase flux of the cell.
description_zh_TW: 在 sirtuin 催化的離胺酸去乙醯化過程中，NAD+ 在菸鹼醯胺和 ADP-核糖基團之間被裂解，乙醯基被轉移到 ADP-核糖上，生成 2'-O-acetyl-ADP-ribose（OAADPr）和游離的菸鹼醯胺。OAADPr 是化學計量的副產物，在每個催化週期中以等摩爾量與去乙醯化的受質一起釋放。這個分子不僅僅是廢物：它能結合並活化 TRPM2 陽離子通道，將 sirtuin 活性與鈣離子訊號傳導和細胞壓力反應聯繫起來。需要注意的是，OAADPr 的積累本身可以反饋影響細胞代謝，其水平反映了細胞整體的去乙醯酶通量。

label: Methyl groups
description: Methylation is the biochemical transfer of a methyl group (-CH3) from a donor such as S-adenosylmethionine to an acceptor molecule, DNA, proteins, lipids, or small metabolites like catechols. This covalent modification alters the chemical properties, activity, or signaling of the target without changing its carbon skeleton, enabling regulation of gene expression, neurotransmitter inactivation, and detoxification. COMT-catalyzed catechol methylation is a classic example within neurotransmitter metabolism. Methylation is thus a universal regulatory and detoxifying mechanism.
description_zh_TW: Methylation 是甲基 (-CH3) 從 S-adenosylmethionine 等供體向受體分子、DNA、蛋白質、脂質或兒茶酚等小代謝物的生化轉移。這種共價修飾改變了標靶的化學性質、活性或訊號傳導，而不改變其碳骨架，從而能夠調節 gene expression、神經傳導物質失活和解毒。 COMT 催化的兒茶酚甲基化是神經傳導物質代謝的經典例子。因此，Methylation 是一種通用的調節和解毒機制。

label: H3K27ac
description: A super-enhancer is a large cluster of enhancers with high density of transcription-factor binding and histone-acetyl marks that drives high cell-type-specific transcription. Senescence-activated super-enhancers are enriched in H3K27ac and drive SASP gene expression.
description_zh_TW: 超級增強子是帶有高密度轉錄因子結合與組蛋白乙醯標記的增強子大簇，驅動高度細胞型特異轉錄。衰老活化的超級增強子富集 H3K27ac 並驅動 SASP 基因表現。

label: X-Chromosome Inactivation
description: XIST is a long non-coding RNA that is the primary driver of X chromosome inactivation, the process by which one X chromosome is transcriptionally silenced in female cells to ensure appropriate gene dosage. XIST coats the inactive X chromosome and recruits chromatin-modifying enzymes that establish repressive marks, compacting the chromosome into a transcriptionally silent Barr body. This silencing is heritable through cell divisions, making XIST a paradigm for long-range, RNA-mediated epigenetic gene silencing.
description_zh_TW: XIST 是一種長非編碼 RNA，是 X 染色體失活的主要驅動因素，在雌性細胞中，一條 X 染色體轉錄沉默，以確保適當的基因劑量。 XIST 覆蓋不活躍的 X 染色體，並招募染色質修飾酶來建立抑制標記，將染色體壓縮成轉錄沉默的巴爾體。這種沉默可透過細胞分裂遺傳，使 XIST 成為長程、RNA 介導的表觀遺傳基因沉默的範例。

label: JAK
description: GM-CSF binds a heterodimeric receptor of CD116 alpha chain and the common beta chain CD131 shared with IL-3 and IL-5; receptor engagement activates JAK2 (and to a lesser extent JAK1/TYK2), phosphorylating STAT5 and STAT3 plus MAPK and PI3K/Akt pathways to drive myeloid proliferation and differentiation.
description_zh_TW: GM-CSF 結合由 CD116 alpha 鏈與 IL-3、IL-5 共用的 common beta 鏈 CD131 組成的異二聚體受體；受體活化會啟動 JAK2（以及程度較低的 JAK1/TYK2），磷酸化 STAT5 與 STAT3，並連動 MAPK 與 PI3K/Akt 路徑，驅動髓系細胞的增殖與分化。

label: VCAM-1
description: VCAM-1 binds VLA-4 (alpha4beta1 integrin) on leukocytes, mediating firm adhesion and transendothelial migration during inflammation. This interaction is central to leukocyte trafficking into tissue. The directionality is endothelial ligand to leukocyte engagement. A caveat is that VCAM-1 also binds alpha4beta7 and other integrins, and competing ligands (e.g., fibronectin) modulate the interaction. This adhesion pathway is a validated drug target, with natalizumab blocking VLA-4 to reduce CNS inflammation in multiple sclerosis.
description_zh_TW: VCAM-1 結合 VLA-4 (alpha4beta1 integrin) on leukocytes，在發炎過程中介導牢固黏附和跨內皮遷移。這種相互作用對於白血球運輸到組織中至關重要。方向性是內皮配體與白血球的結合。需要注意的是，VCAM-1 還結合 alpha4beta7 和其他整合素，並且競爭性配體（例如纖維連接蛋白）調節相互作用。這種黏附途徑是經過驗證的藥物標靶，那他珠單抗可阻斷 VLA-4，從而減少 multiple sclerosis 的中樞神經系統發炎。

label: Superoxide Radicals
description: Superoxide Radicals (O2•−) are the primary reactive oxygen species generated by mitochondria or by enzymes such as NADPH Oxidase, and they belong to the broader class of Reactive Oxygen Species formed as byproducts of oxygen metabolism.
description_zh_TW: Superoxide Radicals（O2•−）是由粒線體或 NADPH Oxidase 等酵素產生的主要活性氧物種，屬於氧代謝副產物所構成的 Reactive Oxygen Species 類別。

label: let-7 microRNA
description: Lin28 blocks pri/pre-let-7 maturation, forming a bistable stemness switch with let-7. Inhibition derepresses pluripotency factors.
description_zh_TW: Lin28 阻斷 pri/pre-let-7 成熟，與 let-7 形成雙穩態幹性開關。抑制去抑制多能性因子。

label: PARG
description: PARG, together with ARH3, hydrolyzes PAR chains to free ADP-ribose. In parthanatos, PARG-dependent free-ADP-ribose generation is required for TRPM2 gating, whereas endoplasmic reticulum Ca2+ release was PARG-independent.
description_zh_TW: PARG 與 ARH3 一起將 PAR 鏈水解成游離 ADP-ribose。在 parthanatos 中，TRPM2 的開啟需要 PARG 依賴的游離 ADPR 生成，而內質網的 Ca2+ 釋放則不依賴 PARG。

label: Mitokines
description: Mitokines are soluble factors secreted by cells undergoing mitochondrial stress that trigger stress responses in distal tissues or organs. They represent a form of cell non-autonomous, inter-organ signaling that extends longevity effects across the organism.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體動素（mitokines）是承受粒線體壓力的細胞分泌的可溶性因子，可在遠端組織或器官觸發壓力反應。它們代表一種細胞非自主、器官間訊號形式，將長壽效應擴展至整個生物體。

label: Minority MOMP
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md
description: In senescent cells only fragmented mitochondria are BAX6A7-positive and release TFAM-bound mtDNA; DRP1-driven fission licenses this minority MOMP event, while hyperfusion protects by homogenizing Bcl-2 across the network.
description_zh_TW: 在衰老細胞中，只有片段化的粒線體呈 BAX6A7 陽性並釋放 TFAM 結合的 mtDNA；DRP1 驅動的分裂促使這種 minority MOMP，而高度融合則透過均質化 Bcl-2 來保護。

label: Non-homologous End Joining
description: 53BP1 directs DNA double-strand break repair toward Non-homologous End Joining (NHEJ) by blocking DNA end resection, partly through recruitment of the RIF1–Shieldin complex, which shields DNA ends from nucleolytic degradation. Loss or mislocalization of 53BP1 therefore impairs NHEJ and sensitizes cells to ionizing radiation.
description_zh_TW: 53BP1 藉由阻斷 DNA 末端切除（end resection），將雙股斷裂修復導向非同源末端接合（NHEJ），部分原因是招募 RIF1–Shieldin 複合體，保護 DNA 末端免受核酸酶降解。因此 53BP1 丧失或錯定位會損害 NHEJ，並使細胞對游離輻射敏感。

label: CYCLIN B1
description: The CDK1-CYCLIN B1 complex phosphorylates Caspase-2 at Ser308, a site that blocks caspase-2 maturation and thereby couples mitotic entry to apoptotic restraint: actively dividing cells keep Caspase-2 off, while loss of CYCLIN B1 at mitotic exit or under genotoxic arrest relieves the inhibition and permits Caspase-2-driven death.
description_zh_TW: CDK1–CYCLIN B1 複合體在 Ser308 位點磷酸化 Caspase-2，該位點可阻斷 caspase-2 的成熟，因而把進入有絲分裂與凋亡抑制相偶聯：正在分裂的細胞使 Caspase-2 保持關閉，而在有絲分裂退出或基因毒性停滯時 CYCLIN B1 流失會解除此抑制，允許 Caspase-2 驅動的死亡發生。

label: Electron Transport Chain
description: The Electron Transport Chain is a series of protein complexes (Complex I NADH dehydrogenase, Complex II succinate dehydrogenase, Complex III cytochrome bc1, Complex IV cytochrome c oxidase) plus the mobile carriers Coenzyme Q10 and cytochrome c, embedded in the inner mitochondrial membrane.
description_zh_TW: 電子傳遞鏈是一系列蛋白質複合體（複合體 I 的 NADH 去氫酶、複合體 II 的琥珀酸去氫酶、複合體 III 的細胞色素 bc1、複合體 IV 的細胞色素 c 氧化酶）加上可移動載體 Coenzyme Q10 與細胞色素 c，嵌於粒線體內膜中。

label: IKK complex
description: The IKK complex is the core signaling component of canonical NF-κB activation. IKKβ phosphorylates IkappaBalpha at Ser32/Ser36, creating a phosphodegron recognized by the SCF/β-TrCP E3 ligase and causing K48-linked ubiquitination and rapid proteasomal degradation. Freed NF-κB then translocates to the nucleus and activates target genes; NEMO is essential for signal-dependent assembly and activation of the complex.
description_zh_TW: IKK complex 是典型 NF-κB 活化的核心訊號元件。IKKβ 在 Ser32/Ser36 磷酸化 IkappaBalpha，形成由 SCF/β-TrCP E3 連接酶辨識的磷酸降解子，造成 K48 連結泛素化與快速的蛋白酶體降解。獲得自由的 NF-κB 隨後轉位入核並活化標的基因；NEMO 對此複合體的訊號依賴性組裝與活化是必要的。

label: Osteoarthritis
source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md
description: MMP-13 is a central driver of cartilage destruction in osteoarthritis, degrading type II collagen as well as types I and III, aggrecan, fibronectin and other ECM components. It is a major target for disease-modifying osteoarthritis drugs, and its induction by IL-1β, TNFα and IL-6 via NF-κB, AP-1 and p38 MAPK/ERK links it to the pro-inflammatory SASP programme.
description_zh_TW: MMP-13 是骨關節炎中軟骨破壞的核心驅動因素，可降解 II 型以及 I、III 型膠原、聚集蛋白聚醣、fibronectin 與其他 ECM 成分。它是修飾骨關節炎疾病的重要藥物標的；而其經由 NF-κB、AP-1 與 p38 MAPK/ERK 受 IL-1β、TNFα、IL-6 誘導的特性，又將它與促發炎的 SASP 計畫連結起來。

label: β-Catenin
description: Canonical Wnt/β-catenin signaling stabilizes β-catenin: Wnt ligand binding Frizzled/LRP receptors inhibits the β-catenin destruction complex, allowing β-catenin to accumulate and translocate to the nucleus, where TCF/LEF transcription factors turn it into a transcriptional activator. This stabilization sustains stemness, proliferation, and fate decisions in the responding cells.
description_zh_TW: 典型 Wnt/β-catenin 訊號可穩定 β-catenin：Wnt 配體結合 Frizzled/LRP 受體後抑制 β-catenin 破壞複合體，使 β-catenin 得以累積並轉位進入細胞核，由 TCF/LEF 轉錄因子將其轉化為轉錄活化因子。這種穩定化維持了受應細胞的幹性、增殖與命運決定。

label: Tumorigenicity
description: In stem-cell research, tumorigenicity is the principal safety risk of iPSCs: residual undifferentiated pluripotent cells can generate teratomas or, more rarely, malignant tumors. Rigorous purification and release testing are required before clinical use.
description_zh_TW: 在幹細胞研究中，致瘤性是 iPSC 的主要安全風險：殘留的未分化多能細胞可產生畸胎瘤，或更罕見地產生惡性腫瘤。臨床使用前需要嚴格的純化和放行檢測。

label: Stem Cells
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md
description: Restoring NAD+ with nicotinamide riboside (NR) reactivated mitochondrial metabolism, upregulated prohibitin proteins, and induced UPRmt, delaying stem cell senescence and extending lifespan in aged contexts. In aged muscle stem cells, neural stem cells and melanocyte stem cells, NAD+ depletion leads to senescence, loss of quiescence and diminished regenerative capacity, and NR treatment reverses this by restoring mitochondrial function. NR is a key NAD+ repletion strategy alongside NMN that restores sirtuin activity, enhances the mitochondrial unfolded protein response, and improves mitochondrial membrane potential, thereby supporting regeneration and resilience in aged stem cell c...
description_zh_TW: 使用煙醯胺核糖苷（NR）恢復NAD+重新激活粒線體代謝，上調prohibitin蛋白，並誘導UPRmt，延緩幹細胞衰老並延長老年環境中的壽命。在老年肌肉幹細胞、神經幹細胞和黑素細胞幹細胞中，NAD+耗竭導致衰老、靜止喪失和再生能力降低，NR治療透過恢復粒線體功能逆轉這一過程。NR是與NMN並列的關鍵NAD+補充策略，可恢復sirtuin活性，增強粒線體未折疊蛋白反應，並改善粒線體膜電位，從而支持老年幹細胞 compartment 的再生和恢復力。

label: Macroautophagy
description: Macroautophagy is essential for maintaining Cellular Homeostasis by removing damaged organelles and misfolded proteins. Its dysregulation is linked to neurodegenerative disease, cancer and aging, in each of which autophagic flux is inadequate or aberrant.
description_zh_TW: Macroautophagy 藉由清除受損胞器與錯誤摺疊蛋白質，對維持 Cellular Homeostasis 至關重要。其失調與神經退化性疾病、癌症與老化相關，這些疾病中自噬通量皆不足或異常。

label: Collagen
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: One proposed mechanism for AGE-mediated cardiovascular damage involves additional crosslinking of collagen, whose normal structure already contains crosslinks, by glycation of its free amino acids. The resulting collagen-AGE crosslinks produce stiffness of blood vessels, and a histological study of post-mortem aortas found a correlation between AGE accumulation and aortic stiffness. Crosslinked collagen is also more resistant to normal turnover, so the damage accumulates over decades. This crosslink-driven stiffening of extracellular matrix is central to the arterial stiffness, diastolic dysfunction, and myocardial relaxation abnormalities that AGEs impose on the aging cardiovascular system.
description_zh_TW: One proposed mechanism for AGE-mediated cardiovascular damage涉及collagen的additional crosslinking，其normal structure already contains crosslinks，by glycation of its free amino acids。由此resulting collagen-AGE crosslinks produce stiffness of blood vessels，而一項post-mortem aortas的histological study found a correlation between AGE accumulation與aortic stiffness。Crosslinked collagen亦more resistant to normal turnover，因此damage accumulates over decades。此crosslink-driven stiffening of extracellular matrix是AGEs impose on the aging cardiovascular system的arterial stiffness、diastolic dysfunction與myocardial relaxation abnormalities的核心。

label: Aminochromes
description: Aminochromes undergo redox cycling: they are reduced to semiquinone radicals, which then react with oxygen to generate Superoxide anion and thus a cycle of ROS production. This unstable, reactive quinone chemistry is what underlies their neurotoxicity and cardiotoxicity.
description_zh_TW: Aminochromes 會進行氧化還原循環：被還原成半醌自由基後，與氧反應產生 Superoxide anion，形成 ROS 生成的循環。這種不穩定且高反應性的醌類化學，正是其神經毒性與心臟毒性的基礎。

label: Protein Citrullination
description: Oxidative stress promotes protein citrullination by increasing intracellular calcium, which activates peptidylarginine deiminase (PAD) enzymes that convert arginine to citrulline. Citrullinated proteins become autoantigens in rheumatoid arthritis. The directionality is oxidant to calcium influx to PAD activation. A caveat is that PAD enzymes are also regulated by other factors (pH, NO), so ROS is a contributor rather than the only trigger of citrullination. Citrullinated peptides are recognized by anti-citrullinated protein antibodies, a hallmark of rheumatoid arthritis, linking oxidative stress to autoimmunity.
description_zh_TW: Oxidative stress 透過增加細胞內鈣來促進 protein citrullination，從而活化肽基精氨酸脫亞胺酶 (PAD)，將精氨酸轉化為瓜氨酸。瓜氨酸 proteins 成為類風濕性關節炎的自身抗原。方向性是氧化劑鈣流入 PAD 活化。需要注意的是，PAD 酶也受到其他因素（pH、NO）的調節，因此 ROS 是瓜氨酸化的一個貢獻者，而不是唯一的觸發因素。瓜氨酸肽可被抗瓜氨酸蛋白抗體識別，這是類風濕性關節炎的標誌，將 oxidative stress 與自體免疫聯繫起來。

label: Working Memory
description: The prefrontal cortex controls working memory by maintaining and manipulating information online through sustained firing of pyramidal networks, a process tightly gated by dopamine D1 receptor signaling. Because prefrontal DAT is sparse, COMT and NET set the dopamine tone that determines working memory capacity, making this region exquisitely sensitive to COMT genotype. Genotype-dependent COMT activity is therefore a major modulator of this function. The region is the primary substrate of working memory in humans.
description_zh_TW: 前額葉皮質透過錐體網路的持續放電來在線上維護和操作訊息，從而控制工作記憶，這個過程受到多巴胺 D1 receptor 訊號的嚴格控制。由於前額葉 DAT 稀疏，COMT 和 NET 設定了決定工作記憶容量的多巴胺基調，使該區域對 COMT genotype 極為敏感。因此，基因型依賴性 COMT activity 是此功能的主要調節劑。此區域是人類工作記憶的主要基質。

label: FOXO3a
description: Polymorphisms in FOXO3a, SIRT1, PGC-1α and NRF2 shift an individual's Hormetic Window in position and width, which explains the large inter-individual variability in responses to Exercise, Caloric Restriction and pharmacological interventions. The window is therefore as much a property of genotype as of dose.
description_zh_TW: FOXO3a、SIRT1、PGC-1α 與 NRF2 的多型性會改變個人 Hormetic Window 的位置與寬度，解釋了對 Exercise、Caloric Restriction 與藥理介入反應的巨大個體差異。因此視窗既是劑量的函數，也是基因型的函數。

label: Pluripotency
description: Retinoic Acid silences Pluripotency by driving differentiation of embryonic stem cells; however DGCR8-deficient ES cells treated with retinoic acid still failed to shut down pluripotency markers (Oct4, Rex1, Sox2, Nanog), showing that microRNA biogenesis is required for the differentiation response.
description_zh_TW: Retinoic Acid 藉由驅動胚胎幹細胞分化來沉默 Pluripotency；然而 DGCR8 缺陷的 ES 細胞即使接受 retinoic acid 處理，仍無法關閉多能性標記（Oct4、Rex1、Sox2、Nanog），顯示 microRNA 生合成是此分化反應所必需的。

label: FAK Signaling
description: Outside-in integrin signaling recruits focal adhesion kinase (FAK), paxillin, talin and kindlin, which organize actin stress fibers and activate RAS-MAPK and PI3K-AKT pathways. This pathway transduction governs cell migration, proliferation, and survival.
description_zh_TW: 由外而內的 integrin 訊號招募黏著斑激酶（FAK）、paxillin、talin 和 kindlin，組織肌動蛋白應力纖維並活化 RAS-MAPK 和 PI3K-AKT 途徑。這種途徑傳導調控細胞遷移、增殖和存活。

label: TAK1
description: 5Z-7-oxozeaenol is a selective inhibitor of TAK1 (MAP3K7) used to probe the ATM-TRAF6-TAK1 axis that orchestrates SASP development after DNA damage. By restraining TAK1 activity it suppresses downstream p38 MAPK and PI3K/Akt/mTOR engagement that supports persistent SASP signaling.
description_zh_TW: 5Z-7-oxozeaenol 是 TAK1（MAP3K7）的選擇性抑制劑，用於探討 DNA 損傷後調控 SASP 發展的 ATM-TRAF6-TAK1 軸。透過抑制 TAK1 活性，它可壓制支撐持續 SASP 訊號的下游 p38 MAPK 與 PI3K/Akt/mTOR 參與。

label: Sir2 (yeast)
description: In yeast, the replicative lifespan extension conferred by caloric restriction is abolished when the SIR2 gene is deleted, establishing Sir2 as a required mediator of the CR response. This dependence reflects the fact that CR raises the NAD+/nicotinamide ratio, which relieves nicotinamide feedback inhibition and boosts Sir2 deacetylase activity. The relationship is directional: CR acts upstream and Sir2 is the necessary downstream effector in this genetic pathway. A caveat is that in higher organisms the requirement is distributed across multiple sirtuins and redundant pathways, so SIR2/SIRT1 is necessary but not solely sufficient.
description_zh_TW: 在酵母中，熱量限制所賦予的複製性壽命延長在 SIR2 基因被刪除時被消除，確立了 Sir2 作為 CR 反應的必需介導因子。這種依賴性反映了 CR 提高 NAD+/菸鹼醯胺比值的事實，從而解除菸鹼醯胺的回饋抑制並增強 Sir2 去乙醯酶活性。這種關係是方向性的：CR 作用在上游，Sir2 是該遺傳通路中必要的下游效應因子。需要注意的是，在高等生物體中，這種需求分佈在多個 sirtuin 和冗餘通路中，因此 SIR2/SIRT1 是必要的但並非單獨充分的。

label: Hyperglycemia
description: Chronic hyperglycemia is the metabolic stressor that drives Diabetic Kidney Disease, inducing premature senescence of mesangial, tubular and endothelial cells. Senescent renal cells acquire the Senescence-Associated Secretory Phenotype and secrete pro-inflammatory cytokines and matrix-remodeling factors, propagating fibrotic signaling and renal dysfunction.
description_zh_TW: 慢性 hyperglycemia 是驅動 Diabetic Kidney Disease 的代謝壓力源，會誘導係膜細胞、腎小管細胞與內皮細胞的早熟衰老。衰老腎細胞獲得 Senescence-Associated Secretory Phenotype，分泌促發炎細胞激素與基質重塑因子，傳播纖維化訊號與腎功能障礙。

label: Retinoblastoma Protein
description: CDK4 and CDK6 are closely related cyclin-dependent kinases that form active complexes with Cyclin D (D1, D2, D3) to phosphorylate and inactivate pRb, releasing E2F transcription factors to drive S-phase gene expression. CDK4/6 is overactive in many cancers via cyclin D amplification, p16INK4A loss and pRb inactivation.
description_zh_TW: CDK4 與 CDK6 是高度相關的細胞週期蛋白依賴性激酶，與 Cyclin D（D1、D2、D3）形成活性複合體，磷酸化並失活 pRb，釋放 E2F 轉錄因子以驅動 S 期基因表現。CDK4/6 在許多癌症中過度活化，機制包括 cyclin D 擴增、p16INK4A 喪失與 pRb 失活。

label: Beta-amyloid
description: APP is the amyloid precursor protein whose processing yields Beta-amyloid. Because Down Syndrome carries a third APP copy, APP is overexpressed roughly 1.5-fold, producing lifelong Beta-amyloid overproduction and Alzheimer-type pathology by age 40.
description_zh_TW: APP 是類澱粉前驅蛋白，其切割會產生 Beta-amyloid（β-類澱粉蛋白）。由於 Down Syndrome 多一份 APP 副本，APP 的表現量約增加 1.5 倍，造成終生的 Beta-amyloid 過度生成，並在 40 歲前出現類阿茲海默病理。

label: CaMKKβ
description: CaMKKβ phosphorylates AMPK at Thr172 within its activation loop, potently stimulating AMPK kinase activity. Because activation depends on a Ca2+ surge rather than on adenine nucleotide ratios, this constitutes a Ca2+-dependent, AMP-independent AMPK activation route that lets calcium signalling drive energy sensing.
description_zh_TW: CaMKKβ 在 AMPK 活化環的 Thr172 位點將其磷酸化，強力提升 AMPK 激酶活性。由於此活化取決於 Ca2+ 激增而非腺嘌呤核苷酸比例，這構成一條 Ca2+ 依賴、AMP 獨立的 AMPK 活化路徑，讓鈣離子訊號得以驅動能量感測。

label: paclitaxel
description: In breast tumor cell lines where SIRT1 is primarily cytoplasmic, SIRT1 inhibition causes rapid caspase-2/14-3-3-zeta dissociation and markedly enhances paclitaxel sensitivity. This is therapeutically relevant during mitotic arrest when transcription is not ongoing.
description_zh_TW: 在 SIRT1 主要位於細胞質的乳腺腫瘤細胞系中，抑制 SIRT1 會導致快速的 caspase-2/14-3-3ζ 解離，並顯著增強對太平洋紫杉醇（paclitaxel）的敏感性。這在有絲分裂停滯、轉錄不進行時具有治療相關性。

label: Senescence-Associated Heterochromatin Foci
description: Senescence-associated heterochromatin foci (SAHFs) are characterized by increased binding of HP1, H3K9me3 marks, macroH2A, and HMGA proteins. These foci are large domains of condensed heterochromatin that form in the nuclei of senescent cells and are believed to contribute to silencing of proliferation-associated genes. SAHF formation requires chromatin regulators including HIRA, ASF1a, and UBN1, and although not essential for growth arrest, their disruption correlates with reduced SASP expression.
description_zh_TW: Senescence 相關異染色質灶 (SAHF) 的特徵是 HP1、H3K9me3 標記、macroH2A 和 HMGA 蛋白的結合增加。這些病灶是在老化細胞的細胞核中形成的濃縮異染色質的大結構域，被認為有助於增殖相關基因的沉默。 SAHF 的形成需要染色質調節因子，包括 HIRA、ASF1a 和 UBN1，雖然對於生長停滯不是必需的，但它們的破壞與 SASP 表達的減少有關。

label: ER Stress
description: ER stress arises when misfolded or unfolded proteins accumulate in the endoplasmic reticulum lumen, overwhelming the organelle's folding capacity. The three proximal sensors activated are PERK, IRE1 and ATF6.
description_zh_TW: 當錯誤摺疊或未摺疊蛋白質累積於內質網腔內、超過胞器的摺疊能力時，即引發 ER 壓力；被活化的三個近端感受器為 PERK、IRE1 與 ATF6。

label: ABCA1
description: Tangier disease is a rare autosomal-recessive disorder caused by loss-of-function mutations in ABCA1, the cholesterol transporter central to cholesterol efflux. The resulting block of cholesterol transfer to apolipoprotein A-I produces the hallmark extremely low HDL and tissue cholesteryl ester accumulation, with enlarged orange tonsils and peripheral neuropathy.
description_zh_TW: Tangier disease 是一種罕見的體染色體隱性遺傳疾病，由 cholesterol efflux 核心運輸蛋白 ABCA1 的失功能突變所造成。Cholesterol 無法轉移給 apolipoprotein A-I，因而產生典型的 HDL 極低與組織膽固醇酯堆積，並出現扁桃體橘黃色增大與周邊神經病變。

label: Tissue Repair
description: Muscle stem cells regenerate damaged skeletal muscle after injury. Promotion is their reparative output.
description_zh_TW: 肌肉幹細胞在損傷後再生受損骨骼肌。促進是其修復輸出。

label: AIM2
description: Bone marrow-derived macrophages (BMDMs) are a standard model for studying inflammasome signaling, including AIM2. In these cells DROSHA deficiency suppresses AIM2-dependent caspase-1 activation and IL-1beta/IL-18 release, linking Microprocessor activity to AIM2 inflammasome function.
description_zh_TW: 骨髓衍生巨噬細胞（BMDM）是研究發炎體訊號（包括 AIM2）的標準模型。在此類細胞中，DROSHA 缺乏會抑制 AIM2 依賴的 caspase-1 活化與 IL-1β/IL-18 釋放，將 Microprocessor 活性與 AIM2 發炎體功能相連結。

label: Catechols
description: Catechols contain a benzene ring bearing two adjacent (ortho) hydroxyl groups, a structural motif that is both chemically reactive and the specific recognition site for COMT. This vicinal diol is methylated at the meta position by COMT using SAMe, yielding O-methylated metabolites that are less reactive and more readily excreted. The presence of this group defines whether a molecule, endogenous or xenobiotic, is a COMT substrate or, at high concentrations, a competitive inhibitor. The motif also renders catechols prone to oxidation, linking them to reactive quinone chemistry.
description_zh_TW: Catechols 含有一個帶有兩個相鄰（鄰位）羥基的苯環，這是一種具有化學反應性的結構基序，也是 COMT 的特異性識別位點。這種鄰位二醇被 COMT 使用 SAMe 在間位甲基化，產生反應性較低且更容易排泄的 O-甲基化代謝物。該基團的存在決定了分子（內源性或外源性）是 COMT 底物還是高濃度的競爭性抑制劑。該基序也使兒茶酚易於氧化，將它們與反應性醌化學聯繫起來。

label: Oncogene
description: N-Myc is a MYC-family oncogenic transcription factor.
description_zh_TW: N-Myc 是 MYC 家族致癌轉錄因子。

label: PPAR-alpha
description: PPARalpha transcriptionally activates FSP1; PPARalpha agonists (fenofibrate, bezafibrate) raise FSP1 and ferroptosis resistance, while the MDM2/MDMX complex suppresses FSP1 by inhibiting PPARalpha — making FSP1 expression a regulated determinant of ferroptosis sensitivity.
description_zh_TW: PPARalpha 在轉錄層活化 FSP1；PPARalpha 促效劑（fenofibrate、bezafibrate）提高 FSP1 與鐵死亡抗性，而 MDM2/MDMX 複合物藉抑制 PPARalpha 抑制 FSP1——使 FSP1 表現成為鐵死亡敏感性的受調控決定因子。

label: NMDA receptor
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: The NMDA receptor is a heterotetrameric glutamate-gated ion channel built from GluN1, GluN2 and GluN3 subunits. It requires co-agonism by glutamate and glycine or D-serine plus postsynaptic depolarization to relieve its Mg2+ block; only then can the pore pass current, which is what gives the receptor its role in coincident detection and Hebbian plasticity.
description_zh_TW: NMDA receptor 是由 GluN1、GluN2 與 GluN3 次單元組成的異四聚體 glutamatergic 離子通道。它需要 glutamate 與 glycine 或 D-serine 共同作用，並需突觸後去極化以解除 Mg2+ 封阻；只有在這些條件下孔道才可通過電流，這正是該受體在 coincidence detection 與 Hebbian 可塑性中角色的來源。

label: Senomorphic
description: Senomorphics target NF-kB, the master transcriptional regulator of the SASP, as a key mechanism to suppress the inflammatory secretome. NF-kB inhibitors (e.g., glucocorticoids, some natural compounds) blunt expression of the bulk of SASP cytokines and chemokines, and NF-kB is activated by p38 MAPK, GATA4, cGAS-STING, and IL-1R/MyD88 signaling in senescent cells. Because NF-kB sits at the apex of SASP control and cooperates with C/EBPb at SASP enhancers, its inhibition is broadly effective. This makes NF-kB a prime senomorphic node whose blockade tempers the entire inflammatory arm of the secretome.
description_zh_TW: Senomorphics 標靶 NF-κB，即 SASP 的主要轉錄調節者，作為抑制發炎分泌組的關鍵機制。NF-κB 抑制劑（如糖皮質類固醇、某些天然化合物）減弱大部分 SASP 細胞激素與趨化因子的表現，且 NF-κB 在衰老細胞中被 p38 MAPK、GATA4、cGAS-STING 與 IL-1R/MyD88 訊號活化。由於 NF-κB 位於 SASP 控制的頂端並與 C/EBPb 在 SASP 增強子上協作，其抑制廣泛有效。這使 NF-κB 成為主要的 senomorphic 節點，其阻斷可減緩分泌組整個發炎臂。

label: COVID-19
description: SARS-CoV-2 is a positive-sense single-stranded RNA virus of the Coronaviridae family (genus Betacoronavirus) and the causative agent of COVID-19, a respiratory disease that emerged as a global pandemic in 2020. It enters cells when its club-shaped spike protein binds the host angiotensin-converting enzyme 2, with spike priming by host proteases; after membrane fusion the viral RNA is released into the cytosol, translated and replicated.
description_zh_TW: SARS-CoV-2 是冠狀病毒科（Betacoronavirus 屬）的正股單股 RNA 病毒，也是 COVID-19 的致病因子——一種於 2020 年成為全球大流行的呼吸道疾病。當其棒狀的棘蛋白與宿主的血管張力素轉換酶 2 結合時病毒進入細胞，棘蛋白需先經宿主蛋白酶切割加工；膜融合後病毒 RNA 釋放至細胞質並被轉譯、複製。

label: Avermectin
description: Avermectins are 16-membered macrocyclic lactones biosynthesized by the soil actinomycete Streptomyces avermectinius (formerly S. avermitilis).
description_zh_TW: 是由土壤放線菌（以前稱為除蟲鏈黴菌）生物合成的 16 元大環內酯。

label: SMAD Proteins
description: BMP signals transduce via SMAD1/5/8 plus SMAD4 central mediators. SMAD usage places BMP in the TGF-beta superfamily logic.
description_zh_TW: BMP 經由 SMAD1/5/8 加 SMAD4 中央介體傳訊。SMAD 使用將 BMP 置於 TGF-beta 超家族邏輯。

label: Alpha-synuclein
description: Alpha-synuclein aggregation into Lewy bodies is the defining proteinopathy of Parkinson disease. Involvement records the hallmark pathology.
description_zh_TW: Alpha-synuclein 聚集成路易小體是帕金森病的定義性蛋白病變。涉及記錄標誌病理。

label: FOXO
description: Atrogin-1 (FBXO32) is a muscle-specific E3 ubiquitin ligase whose expression is transcriptionally controlled by FoxO family factors. FoxO activation, which occurs under fasting, denervation and other atrophic stimuli, drives Atrogin-1 transcription and thereby initiates the ubiquitin-proteasome program for myofibrillar protein disposal.
description_zh_TW: Atrogin-1 (FBXO32) 是肌肉特異性的 E3 泛素連接酶，其表現受 FoxO 家族轉錄因子調控。在禁食、失去神經支配及其他萎縮刺激下，FoxO 被活化並驅動 Atrogin-1 的轉錄，進而啟動肌原纖維蛋白的泛素－蛋白酶體分解程序。

label: Teratoma
description: Induced pluripotent stem cells are validated by the teratoma assay, in which the cells are injected into immunodeficient mice and assessed for the formation of benign tumors containing all three germ layers. The presence of endoderm, mesoderm, and ectoderm derivatives confirms true pluripotency and multilineage differentiation potential. This gold-standard test distinguishes fully pluripotent cells from partially reprogrammed or multipotent populations before research or clinical use. However, the assay also highlights the tumorigenic risk that must be controlled before clinical use.
description_zh_TW: 誘導多能幹細胞透過畸胎瘤測定進行驗證，其中將細胞注射到免疫缺陷小鼠體內，並評估包含所有三個胚層的良性腫瘤的形成。內胚層、中胚層和外胚層衍生物的存在證實了真正的多能性和多譜系分化潛力。這種黃金標準測試可在研究或臨床使用之前將完全多能細胞與部分重編程或多能細胞群區分開來。然而，該測定也強調了臨床使用前必須控制的致瘤風險。

label: Multiple Sclerosis
description: Complex I and Complex IV have reduced activity in multiple sclerosis, and the resulting electron leakage increases superoxide generation in affected CNS tissue. This bioenergetic defect is observed in lesions and normal-appearing white matter. The directionality is enzyme deficiency to increased mitochondrial ROS. A caveat is that reduced activity may be secondary to inflammation and demyelination as well as a primary driver, so causality is bidirectional. These defects are most pronounced in chronically demyelinated tissue and correlate with axonal loss and disability progression.
description_zh_TW: Complex I and Complex IV 降低了 multiple sclerosis 的活性，由此产生的电子泄漏增加了受影响中枢神经系统组织中超氧化物的生成。这种生物能缺陷在病变和正常的白质中观察到。方向性是酵素缺乏導致mitochondrial ROS增加。需要注意的是，活动减少可能是炎症和脱髓鞘的继发因素，也是主要驱动因素，因此因果关系是双向的。这些缺陷在慢性脱髓鞘组织中最为明显，并与轴突损失和残疾进展相关。

label: Regulated Cell Death
source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md
description: Ferroptosis is a regulated, iron-dependent cell death pathway in which cells lose their ability to regulate fats and eventually die, as distinct from unregulated necrotic death or other programmed death programs like apoptosis. It was discovered and named (originally 'oxytosis') by Pam Maher in 2001. The hallmark mechanism is accumulation of lipid peroxides to toxic levels, normally kept in check by glutathione, and the pathway is increasingly linked to neurodegeneration and age-related diseases. Because ferroptosis is druggable and genetically regulatable, it has become a promising therapeutic target alongside cellular senescence for supporting healthy aging and clearing dysfunctional cells.
description_zh_TW: 鐵依賴性細胞死亡（ferroptosis）是一種受調控、依賴鐵的細胞死亡途徑，細胞在此途徑中失去調節脂肪的能力並最終死亡，有別於不受調控的壞死性死亡或其他如細胞凋亡（apoptosis）的程式性死亡。它由Pam Maher於2001年發現並命名（最初稱為「oxytosis」）。其標誌性機制是脂質過氧化物累積至毒性濃度，此過程通常由麩胱甘肽（glutathione）加以控制，且此途徑日益與神經退化及年齡相關疾病相關。由於ferroptosis可被藥物調控且在遺傳上可調節，它與細胞衰老（cellular senescence）一同成為支持健康老化與清除功能失常細胞的具前景治療標靶。

label: Mitochondrial-Derived Peptide
source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md
description: Humanin is the first small peptide of a putative set of mitochondrial-derived peptides (MDPs), a novel concept that challenges the traditional view of mitochondria as passive end-function organelles. It was discovered in 2001 by screening a cDNA library from the surviving fraction of an Alzheimer's disease patient brain for clones protecting neuronal cells from cell death induced by APP mutants, and identified as a 75bp open reading frame yielding a 24 amino acid peptide encoded within the mitochondrial 16S rRNA. Humanin is a harbinger of additional MDPs, as numerous putative ORFs are dispersed throughout the mitochondrial genome.
description_zh_TW: Humanin 是推定之粒線體衍生胜肽（MDPs）群組中的第一個小胜肽，此一新穎概念挑戰了粒線體是被動終端功能胞器的傳統觀點。它於 2001 年透過篩選阿茲海默症患者腦部存活部分的 cDNA 文庫而被發現，用以尋找可保護神經元細胞免受 APP 突變誘導細胞死亡的選殖株，並被鑑定為 75 bp 的開放閱讀框架，編碼出位於粒線體 16S rRNA 內、由 24 個胺基酸組成的胜肽。Humanin 是更多 MDPs 出現的先兆，因為大量推定的 ORFs 散布於粒線體基因組中。

label: VEGFc
description: VEGF-C is a lymphangiogenic member of the VEGF family.
description_zh_TW: VEGF-C 是 VEGF 家族的淋巴管生成成員。

label: LKB1
source_file: _document_ - Pharmacological Effects of Urolithin A and Its Role in Muscle Health and Performance Current Knowledge and Prospects.md
description: LKB1 requires binding to STRAD and MO25 to exit the nucleus and gain full kinase activity; without this scaffold it remains inactive. Directionally, STRAD and MO25 sit upstream of LKB1 activation. This gating is essential for LKB1's role as the master upstream AMPK kinase, and SIRT1 and AMPK deacetylate and phosphorylate LKB1 to modulate its localization. The STRAD/MO25 scaffold both stabilizes LKB1 and directs it to the cytoplasm where it can activate AMPK. Mutations in LKB1, as in Peutz-Jeghers syndrome, disrupt this pathway and predispose to cancer.
description_zh_TW: LKB1 需要與 STRAD 和 MO25 結合才能離開細胞核並獲得完整的激酶活性；沒有這個支架它保持不活化。在方向性上，STRAD 和 MO25 位於 LKB1 活化的上游。這種門控機制對 LKB1 作為核心上游 AMPK 激酶的角色至關重要，SIRT1 和 AMPK 去乙醯化和磷酸化 LKB1 以調控其定位。STRAD/MO25 支架既穩定 LKB1 又將其導向細胞質，在那裡它可以活化 AMPK。LKB1 的突變，如 Peutz-Jeghers 綜合症，會破壞此途徑並增加癌症易感性。

label: Tocotrienols
description: About 70% of red palm oil's total tocochromanol pool (717-863 ppm vitamin E) is tocotrienols rather than tocopherols - alpha-tocotrienol 29%, gamma-tocotrienol 41%, delta-tocotrienol 10% - with alpha-tocopherol supplying the remaining 19%. Because tocotrienols are an order of magnitude more potent than tocopherols at suppressing ferroptosis, this tocotrienol fraction is what places red palm oil at the top of the Tier-1 dietary lipophilic-defender ranking rather than mid-pack.
description_zh_TW: Red Palm Oil 的 tocochromanol 總量（717-863 ppm vitamin E）中約 70% 是 tocotrienol 而非 tocopherol——α-tocotrienol 29%、γ-tocotrienol 41%、δ-tocotrienol 10%，α-tocopherol 佔剩餘 19%。由於 tocotrienol 抑制 Ferroptosis 的效力比 tocopherol 高一個數量級，正是這個 tocotrienol 比例讓 red palm oil 排在 Tier-1 膳食脂溶性防禦者的首位，而不是中段。

label: Olivopontocerebellar Atrophy
description: Gait and limb ataxia is the cardinal manifestation of olivopontocerebellar atrophy.
description_zh_TW: 步態與肢體共濟失調是橄欖橋腦小腦萎縮的主要表現。

label: HDL
description: HDL is the central anti-atherogenic mediator of reverse cholesterol transport, accepting excess cholesterol from peripheral cells and macrophages via ABCA1 and ABCG1 and delivering it to the liver. Oxidized HDL3 loses this efflux capacity.
description_zh_TW: HDL 是 reverse cholesterol transport 的核心抗動脈粥狀硬化媒介，透過 ABCA1 與 ABCG1 從周邊細胞及 macrophages 接受過多 cholesterol 並運送至肝臟。氧化後的 HDL3 則喪失此 efflux 能力。

label: Endoplasmic Reticulum
description: ER stress arises when misfolded or unfolded proteins accumulate in the endoplasmic reticulum lumen, overwhelming the organelle's folding capacity. The three proximal sensors activated are PERK, IRE1 and ATF6.
description_zh_TW: 當錯誤摺疊或未摺疊蛋白質累積於內質網腔內、超過胞器的摺疊能力時，即引發 ER 壓力；被活化的三個近端感受器為 PERK、IRE1 與 ATF6。

label: DNA
description: Messenger RNA is a single-stranded RNA molecule transcribed from DNA by RNA polymerase II that carries the coding sequence for a protein, serving as the template for translation at the ribosome. In this way mRNA is the central effector that links genotype to phenotype and is the final substrate on which gene expression acts.
description_zh_TW: Messenger RNA 是由 RNA 聚合酶 II 從 DNA 轉錄出的單股 RNA 分子，攜帶蛋白質的編碼序列，並作為核糖體上轉譯的模板。mRNA 因此是連接基因型與表型的核心效應分子，也是基因表現最終作用其上的作用對象。

label: Citric Acid Cycle
description: Mitochondrial MDH2 catalyzes the final step of the TCA cycle, oxidizing malate to oxaloacetate in the matrix while reducing NAD+ to NADH for the electron transport chain.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體的 MDH2 催化 TCA 循環的最後一步，在基質中將蘋果酸氧化為草醯乙酸，並將 NAD⁺ 還原為供電子傳遞鏈使用的 NADH。

label: Bad
description: Bad is a member of Bcl-2 family. Bad is a BH3-only protein whose survival-factor-responsive phosphorylation controls its binding to Bcl-xL/Bcl-w and thereby the death threshold. The Bcl-2 protein family comprises pro-apoptotic effectors (Bax, Bak) and BH3-only activators balanced against anti-apoptotic guardians (Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, Mcl-1, Bcl-w) that set the mitochondrial death threshold. The directionality runs from Bcl-2 family toward Bad, so Bcl-2 family is the active agent and Bad the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: Bad 是 Bcl-2 family 的成員。 Bad 是一種僅含有 BH3 的蛋白質，其生存因子反應性磷酸化控制其與 Bcl-xL/Bcl-w 的結合，從而控制死亡閾值。 Bcl-2 蛋白家族包括促凋亡效應子 (Bax、Bak) 和僅 BH3 活化劑，與設定粒線體死亡閾值的抗凋亡衛士 (Bcl-2、Bcl-xL、Mcl-1、Bcl-w) 保持平衡。方向性從 Bcl-2 family 向 Bad，因此 Bcl-2 family 是活性劑，Bad 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: Aneuploidy
description: Overexpression or amplification of Aurora-A/Aurora-B is a hallmark of many solid tumors and predicts poor prognosis in breast, lung and pancreatic cancers; excess Aurora mitotic regulator activity in the setting of SIRT2 loss drives Aneuploidy and mitotic catastrophe.
description_zh_TW: Aurora-A／Aurora-B 的過度表現或擴增是許多實體腫瘤的特徵，並預測乳癌、肺癌與胰臟癌的不良預後；在 SIRT2 喪失的情境下，過量的 Aurora 有絲分裂調節因子活性會驅動 Aneuploidy 與有絲分裂災難。

label: Thioredoxin-1
description: Thioredoxin reductase (TXNRD1) is the NADPH-dependent enzyme that recycles oxidized thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) back to its active reduced form in the cytosol. The two form the functional thioredoxin system, sustaining peroxiredoxin regeneration, ribonucleotide reductase, and redox-sensitive signaling.
description_zh_TW: 硫氧還蛋白還原酶（TXNRD1）是 NADPH 依賴的酵素，在細胞質中將被氧化的硫氧還蛋白-1 (Trx1) 回收回其活化的還原態。兩者構成功能性硫氧還蛋白系統，維持過氧化還原酶的再生成、核醣核苷酸還原酶以及氧化還原敏感的訊息傳遞。

label: Apoptosis-Inducing Factor
description: AIF induces chromatin condensation. Apoptosis-inducing factor is a mitochondrial flavoprotein that, once released, executes a caspase-independent form of chromatin condensation and DNA fragmentation. Chromatin condensation is a terminal morphologic hallmark of death in which DNA is compacted, classically by caspase or AIF action. The relationship is directional, with AIF acting as the operative agent upon chromatin condensation rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: AIF 誘發chromatin condensation。 Apoptosis誘導因子是一種粒線體黃素蛋白，一旦釋放，就會執行不依賴半胱天冬酶的形式的chromatin condensation和DNA斷裂。 chromatin condensation 是死亡的終末形態學標誌，其中 DNA 被壓縮，通常是透過 caspase 或 AIF 作用實現的。這種關係是有方向的，AIF 充當 chromatin condensation 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: PEX5
description: Mutations in PEX5 cause PEX5-deficient Zellweger Spectrum Disorder (~5-10% of cases); loss of function blocks PTS1 import entirely, causing lethal accumulation of very-long-chain and branched-chain fatty acids and bile acid intermediates.
description_zh_TW: PEX5 突變會造成 PEX5 缺乏型 Zellweger 光譜症候群（約佔 5–10% 病例）；功能喪失會完全阻斷 PTS1 輸入，導致超長鏈與支鏈脂肪酸及膽酸中間產物致命性累積。

label: Glucosepane
description: Glucosepane is the most abundant and stubborn protein-protein AGE crosslink in human structural tissues, driving the systemic stiffening associated with aging and diabetes. Humans lack endogenous enzymes capable of directly breaking the glucosepane ring without destroying the surrounding collagen. Because of its abundance and stability, glucosepane is considered a major molecular target for anti-glycation therapies. Its crosslinks accumulate in long-lived proteins such as collagen and elastin, and are a principal cause of the extracellular matrix stiffening that contributes to arterial stiffening and age-related loss of tissue compliance.
description_zh_TW: Glucosepane 是人體結構組織中最豐富且頑固的蛋白-蛋白 AGE 交聯，驅動與衰老及糖尿病相關的全身性僵硬。人類缺乏能夠在不破壞周圍膠原蛋白的情況下直接切斷 glucosepane 環的內源性酶。由於其豐富性與穩定性，glucosepane 被視為抗糖化療法的主要分子標靶。其交聯累積於膠原蛋白與彈力蛋白等長壽蛋白中，是導致細胞外基質僵硬的主因，進而促成動脈僵硬與年齡相關的組織順應性喪失。

label: Neurodegeneration
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Neurodegeneration is driven by Oxidative Stress: the brain's high oxygen consumption, high lipid content prone to peroxidation, and relatively low antioxidant defenses make oxidative damage to proteins (causing aggregation) and mitochondria (causing energy failure) central drivers of neuronal loss.
description_zh_TW: Neurodegeneration 由 Oxidative Stress 驅動：腦部耗氧量高、脂質含量高且易過氧化、抗氧化防禦相對薄弱，使蛋白質的氧化損傷（導致聚集）與粒線體的氧化損傷（導致能量衰竭）成為神經元喪失的核心驅動因素。

label: IL-1α
description: Rilonacept neutralizes IL-1α as well as IL-1β, giving it broader scope than Canakinumab (selective for IL-1β); because both IL-1 ligands are major drivers of the SASP of senescent cells, rilonacept reduces overall IL-1 inflammatory signaling burden in inflammaging.
description_zh_TW: Rilonacept 同時中和 IL-1α 與 IL-1β，作用範圍比 Canakinumab（僅選擇性對抗 IL-1β）更廣；由於兩種 IL-1 配體都是衰老細胞 SASP 的主要驅動因子，Rilonacept 可降低 Inflammaging 中整體的 IL-1 發炎訊號負擔。

label: ERK1_2
description: MKP-3 inactivates ERK by hydrolyzing the phosphothreonine and phosphotyrosine residues of its activation loop. This provides a negative feedback brake on proliferative RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK signaling. ERK1/2 is the canonical MAPK substrate of MKP-3.
description_zh_TW: MKP-3 透過水解 ERK 激活環上的磷酸蘇氨酸與磷酸酪氨酸殘基，使 ERK 失活。這為增殖性 RAS–RAF–MEK–ERK 訊號傳導提供了負回饋煞車。ERK1/2 是 MKP-3 的經典 MAPK 受質。

label: Nanog
description: Nanog sustains indefinite stem-cell proliferation without differentiation. Maintenance separates renewal from lineage exit.
description_zh_TW: Nanog 在不分化下維持幹細胞無限增殖。維持將更新與譜系退出分開。

label: OX2R
description: NKX2-1 (Nk2 homeobox 1) is deacetylated by SIRT1 in hypothalamic DMH/LH neurons; deacetylated NKX2-1 activates transcription of OX2R, the orexin receptor whose increased signaling recapitulates calorie restriction and extends lifespan in BRASTO mice. Thus NKX2-1 is the direct transcriptional relay between SIRT1 and OX2R. By linking SIRT1 activity to orexin-receptor expression, NKX2-1 connects sirtuin signaling to the neural circuits controlling arousal, activity, and energy expenditure. This pathway illustrates how a single transcription factor can mediate the longevity effects of sirtuin activation in the brain.
description_zh_TW: NKX2-1（Nk2 homeobox 1）在下丘腦DMH/LH神經元中被SIRT1去乙醯化；去乙醯化的NKX2-1啟動OX2R的轉錄，OX2R是食慾素受體，其訊號增強模擬了熱量限制並在BRASTO小鼠中延長壽命。因此NKX2-1是SIRT1和OX2R之間的直接轉錄中繼。透過將SIRT1活性與食慾素受體表達聯繫起來，NKX2-1將sirtuin訊號與控制覺醒、活動和能量消耗的神經迴路連接。此通路說明了單一轉錄因子如何能介導sirtuin活化在大腦中的長壽效應。

label: Tumorigenesis
description: Tumorigenesis proceeds through the acquisition of genetic and epigenetic alterations that confer the Hallmarks of Cancer. These enabling biological capabilities include sustained proliferation, evasion of death, and metastasis. The Hallmarks of Cancer framework describes the capabilities acquired during tumorigenesis.
description_zh_TW: 腫瘤發生透過獲得賦予癌症標誌的遺傳與表觀遺傳改變而進行。這些賦能生物學能力包括持續增生、逃避死亡與轉移。癌症標誌架構描述了腫瘤發生過程中所獲得的能力。

label: ATM
description: γ-H2AX is the Ser139-phosphorylated form of the H2AX histone variant, generated within minutes of double-strand break induction by ATM, ATR and DNA-PK; ATM is the primary responder to double-strand breaks and ionizing radiation, while ATR responds to replication stress.
description_zh_TW: γ-H2AX 是組蛋白變異體 H2AX 在 Ser139 磷酸化後的形式，在雙股斷裂誘發後數分鐘內由 ATM、ATR 與 DNA-PK 產生；ATM 是雙股斷裂與游離輻射的主要反應者，而 ATR 則反應複製壓力。

label: Silver(I) Oxide
description: Silver(I) oxide is acutely toxic in animal studies, with a reported LD50 of 1027 mg/kg by the oral route in mice and 2820 mg/kg orally in rats; intraperitoneal LD50 values are 37 mg/kg in mice and 70 mg/kg in rats. The much lower intraperitoneal threshold reflects efficient absorption of silver ions directly into the circulation, whereas oral silver is less bioavailable. These data establish silver oxide as a moderate acute hazard requiring careful handling in laboratory, industrial, and battery-manufacturing settings.
description_zh_TW: 氧化銀(I)在動物研究中具有急性毒性，報導的小鼠口服LD50為1027 mg/kg，大鼠口服為2820 mg/kg；腹腔注射LD50值小鼠為37 mg/kg，大鼠為70 mg/kg。低得多的腹腔注射閾值反映了銀離子直接吸收進入循環的效率，而口服銀的生物利用度較低。這些數據將氧化銀確立為中等急性危害，需要在實驗室、工業和電池製造環境中謹慎處理。

label: Chemoresistance
description: RAD51 overexpression in cancer contributes to chemoresistance to DNA-damaging agents. RAD51-mediated repair of cisplatin adducts confers resistance to platinum-based drugs, and HR proficiency signalled by RAD51 confers resistance to PARP inhibitors. RAD51 inhibition is therefore explored as a strategy to sensitize HR-proficient cancers to DNA-damaging chemotherapy.
description_zh_TW: 癌症中的 RAD51 过表达會促成對 DNA 損傷性藥物的化學抗藥性。RAD51 介導對 cisplatin 加成物的修復賦予對鉑類藥物的抗藥性，而由 RAD51 訊號代表的同源重組能力則賦予對 PARP inhibitors 的抗藥性。因此 RAD51 抑制被研究作為使同源重組能力完整的癌症對 DNA 損傷性化療更敏感的策略。

label: Lung Cancer
description: Lung Cancer is a type of Cancer. Lung cancer, especially non-small-cell lung cancer, is the leading cause of cancer death and is frequently driven by EGFR or KRAS alterations. Cancer is a family of diseases driven by the stepwise acquisition of mutations and epimutations that confer proliferative autonomy, survival, and dissemination. The directionality runs from Cancer toward Lung Cancer, so Cancer is the active agent and Lung Cancer the recipient of the effect.
