Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: Lung Cancer 是 Cancer 的一種。 Lung Cancer，尤其是非小細胞Lung Cancer，是癌症死亡的主要原因，並且經常由EGFR或KRAS改變驅動。 Cancer 是由逐步獲得突變和表突變驅動的一系列疾病，這些突變和表突變賦予增殖自主性、生存和傳播。方向性從 Cancer 向 Lung Cancer 延伸，因此 Cancer 是活性劑，Lung Cancer 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: H3.3
description: As the H3.3-specific chaperone of the ATRX-DAXX complex, DAXX deposits the histone variant H3.3 at telomeres, pericentric heterochromatin and endogenous retroviruses. This targeted deposition is how the complex establishes and maintains heterochromatin at those repeat-rich loci.
description_zh_TW: 作為 ATRX-DAXX 複合體中專一於 H3.3 的 chaperone，DAXX 將 histone variant H3.3 沉積到 telomere、pericentric heterochromatin 與內源性反轉錄病毒上。這種標的性沉積正是該複合體在這些重複序列豐富的位點建立並維持異染色質的方式。

label: Short-chain Fatty Acids
description: Gut Bacteroidetes ferment dietary fiber, resistant starch and host glycans that host enzymes cannot digest into Short-chain Fatty Acids — principally acetate and propionate — plus succinate; these metabolites nourish colonocytes, modulate hepatic lipid metabolism, and engage enteroendocrine and immune cells.
description_zh_TW: 腸道 Bacteroidetes 會將宿主酵素無法消化的膳食纖維、抗性澱粉與宿主聚醣發酵成 Short-chain Fatty Acids（主要是乙酸與丙酸）以及琥珀酸；這些代謝物滋養結腸細胞、調節肝臟脂質代謝，並與腸泌神經細胞及免疫細胞互動。

label: Healthspan
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: Protein restriction extends both lifespan and healthspan across species and blunts age-associated increases in frailty, a state of vulnerability that raises the risk of dependency, falls, hospitalization, and mortality. PR reduces adiposity, increases energy expenditure, and improves glucose homeostasis even when initiated late in life (18-20 months of age in rodents). In Drosophila, PR increases resilience during aging, improving responses to starvation, bacterial infection, and heat stress. Randomized controlled trials in humans show low-protein diets reduce body weight, fat mass, and fasting blood glucose, improve insulin sensitivity, and reduce inflammation, supporting PR as a practical alternative to calorie restriction for healthy aging.
description_zh_TW: 蛋白質限制延長跨物種的壽命和健康span，並減弱與年齡相關的虛弱增加，虛弱是一種增加依賴、跌倒、住院和死亡風險的脆弱狀態。PR減少脂肪量，增加能量消耗，並改善葡萄糖恆定性，即使在生命晚期開始（囓齒動物18-20個月大）。在黑腹果蠅中，PR增加老化過程中的韌性，改善對飢餓、細菌感染和熱應激的反應。人類的隨機對照試驗顯示低蛋白飲食減少體重、脂肪量和空腹血糖，改善胰島素敏感性並減少發炎，支持PR作為健康老化的實用熱量限制替代方案。

label: Resting Metabolic Rate
description: Resting metabolic rate (RMR) is the rate at which the body consumes energy while at rest, and it is the single largest component of total daily energy expenditure (TEE), typically accounting for about 60-70 percent of daily energy use. It is measured under standardized conditions of rest, thermal neutrality, and a fasting state. Because RMR dominates total daily energy expenditure, any change in RMR, such as the transient elevation caused by exercise, has a disproportionate impact on overall energy balance and, over time, on body weight regulation. The review by Speakman focuses on how exercise-induced alterations in RMR influence energy balance.
description_zh_TW: 靜息代謝率（RMR）是身體在休息時消耗能量的速率，它是每日總能量消耗（TEE）中最大的單一組成部分，通常佔每日能量使用量的約60-70%。它在休息、熱中性和禁食狀態的標準化條件下測量。由於RMR主導每日總能量消耗，RMR的任何變化，如運動引起的短暫升高，都會對整體能量平衡產生不相稱的影響，並隨時間影響體重調節。Speakman的綜述專注於運動引起的RMR變化如何影響能量平衡。

label: NAD+ Biosynthesis
description: NAD+ Biosynthesis produces NAD+ through three routes: the salvage pathway (NAMPT converting nicotinamide to NMN, the dominant route), the Preiss-Handler route from Niacin/Vitamin B3, and a minor de novo route from tryptophan. Extracellular NR and NMN bypass NAMPT and are phosphorylated via NMRK1/NMRK2 and NMNAT.
description_zh_TW: NAD+ Biosynthesis 透過三條途徑產生 NAD+：salvage 路徑（NAMPT 將 nicotinamide 轉為 NMN，為主導途徑）、由 Niacin/Vitamin B3 出發的 Preiss-Handler 途徑，以及源自 tryptophan 的次要 de novo 途徑。細胞外的 NR 與 NMN 可繞過 NAMPT，並經 NMRK1/NMRK2 與 NMNAT 磷酸化。

label: AGK2
description: AGK2 confers neuroprotection under ischemic and hypoxic conditions by suppressing phospho-JNK and FOXO3a and preventing caspase-3 cleavage. Directionally, AGK2/SIRT2 inhibition sits upstream of reduced neuronal death. This broadens AGK2's neuroprotective utility beyond proteinopathy, and it reinforces the inverse therapeutic logic for SIRT2. By blunting JNK and FOXO3a death signaling and preventing effector-caspase activation, AGK2 protects neurons in ischemic stroke models. These findings support SIRT2 inhibition as a candidate strategy across diverse forms of acute and chronic neurodegeneration.
description_zh_TW: AGK2 在缺血和缺氧條件下賦予神經保護，透過抑制磷酸化 JNK 和 FOXO3a 並防止 caspase-3 切割。在方向性上，AGK2/SIRT2 抑制位於減少神經元死亡的上游。這擴展了 AGK2 超越蛋白質病變的神經保護效用，並強化了 SIRT2 的反向治療邏輯。透過削弱 JNK 和 FOXO3a 死亡訊號並防止效應型 caspase 活化，AGK2 在缺血性中風模型中保護神經元。這些發現支持 SIRT2 抑制作為跨多種急性和慢性神經退行性疾病的候選策略。

label: Suramin
description: Suramin is a potent inhibitor of many sirtuins like SIRT1, SIRT2 and SIRT5. The majority of known sirtuin inhibitors exclusively inhibit SIRT1 and/or SIRT2, however some also inhibit SIRT3 and SIRT5 with reduced affinity. Cambinol has the most effective efficacy against Burkitt lymphoma cell lines, and Salermide causes apoptosis in cancer cells without relying on p53, with both inhibiting SIRT1 and SIRT2.
description_zh_TW: 蘇拉明（Suramin）是多種 sirtuins 的強效抑制劑，包括 SIRT1、SIRT2 和 SIRT5。大多數已知的 sirtuin 抑制劑僅抑制 SIRT1 和/或 SIRT2，但也有部分抑制劑以較低親和力抑制 SIRT3 和 SIRT5。Cambinol 對 Burkitt 淋巴瘤細胞株具有最有效的抑制作用，而 Salermide 能在不依賴 p53 的情況下誘導癌細胞凋亡，兩者均可抑制 SIRT1 和 SIRT2。

label: Cyclopentenyl cytosine
description: Cyclopentenyl cytosine (CPEC) is a synthetic cyclopentenyl-derived cytidine analog whose active triphosphate metabolite (CPEC-TP) acts as a potent, mechanism-based inhibitor of CTP Synthetase. By blocking the ATP-dependent conversion of UTP to CTP, it collapses intracellular pyrimidine pools, especially CTP and dCTP, in rapidly dividing cells and pyrimidine-dependent viruses.
description_zh_TW: Cyclopentenyl cytosine（CPEC）是一種合成的環戊烯基胞苷類似物，其活性三磷酸代謝物（CPEC-TP）是 CTP Synthetase 的強效機制型抑制劑。透過阻斷 UTP 依賴 ATP 轉化為 CTP，它使快速分裂細胞和依賴嘧啶的病毒細胞內嘧啶池（尤其 CTP 和 dCTP）崩潰。

label: Silver ion
description: The silver ion is known to inhibit glutathione peroxidase and Na+,K+-ATPase activity, disrupting selenium-catalyzed sulfhydryl oxidation-reduction reactions and intracellular ion concentrations, respectively. Glutathione peroxidase is the selenoenzyme that detoxifies hydroperoxides, so its inhibition by silver impairs cellular antioxidant defense and promotes oxidative stress. This enzyme-inhibitory activity is a key mechanism linking silver exposure to toxicity and mirrors the redox disruption that makes silver compounds effective antimicrobials.
description_zh_TW: 已知銀離子抑制穀胱甘肽過氧化物酶和Na+,K+-ATPase活性，分別干擾硒催化的硫氫基氧化還原反應和細胞內離子濃度。穀胱甘肽過氧化物酶是解毒氫過氧化物的硒酶，因此其被銀抑制損害細胞抗氧化防禦並促進氧化應激。這種酶抑制活性是將銀暴露與毒性聯繫起來的關鍵機制，反映了使銀化合物成為有效抗菌劑的氧化還原干擾。

label: Ischemic Stroke
description: Ischemic stroke is acute brain injury from focal arterial occlusion in which hypoxia collapses oxidative phosphorylation, producing an irreversibly necrotic core surrounded by a hypoperfused but salvageable penumbra that is the target of reperfusion therapy.
description_zh_TW: 缺血性中風是局部動脈阻塞造成的急性腦損傷，缺氧使氧化磷酸化崩潰，形成不可逆壞死的核心，外圍則是低灌流但可挽救的半暗帶，為再灌流治療的目標。

label: Monocytes
description: Monocytes phagocytose pathogens and produce pro-inflammatory cytokines including TNFα, IL-1β and IL-6, and generate ROS via NADPH oxidase, forming a first line of defence against bacterial and fungal infection.
description_zh_TW: Monocytes 吞噬病原體並產生 TNFα、IL-1β、IL-6 等促發炎細胞激素，並透過 NADPH oxidase 產生 ROS，構成對抗細菌與真菌感染的第一線防禦。

label: Excitotoxicity
description: Calcium overload during excitotoxic stress drives massive reactive oxygen species generation within mitochondria, collapsing membrane potential and ATP synthesis. The oxidative crisis amplifies the excitotoxic cascade, which is why oxidative stress and excitotoxicity reinforce each other in neurodegeneration.
description_zh_TW: Excitotoxic 壓力下的鈣離子過載會在粒線體內大量產生 reactive oxygen species，使膜電位與 ATP 合成崩潰。此氧化危機會放大 excitotoxic 級聯反應，這也是 oxidative stress 與 excitotoxicity 在神經退化病程中互相強化的原因。

label: Selenoprotein
description: Because all selenoproteins require co-translational selenocysteine insertion at UGA codons, eEFSec is essential for synthesis of the entire selenoprotein family. Its function is complemented rather than replaced by the Um34 modification of tRNA[Ser]Sec, which fine-tunes recoding efficiency.
description_zh_TW: 由於所有硒蛋白都需要在 UGA 密碼子處進行共轉譯的硒半胱胺酸插入，eEFSec 對整個硒蛋白家族的合成是不可或缺的。它的功能是由 tRNA[Ser]Sec 的 Um34 修飾補充而非取代，後者微調再編碼效率。

label: Breast Cancer
description: TNBC is a breast cancer subtype defined by absent ER/PR/HER2 receptors.
description_zh_TW: TNBC 是以 ER/PR/HER2 受體缺失定義的乳癌亞型。

label: Gastric Cancer
description: Trastuzumab is approved for HER2-positive gastric cancer, the second indication.
description_zh_TW: trastuzumab 核准用於 HER2 陽性胃癌，為第二適應症。

label: Glutamate Dehydrogenase (GDH)
description: The oxidative deamination of glutamate by GDH yields alpha-ketoglutarate, which feeds the tricarboxylic acid cycle as an anaplerotic substrate. This conversion is central to coupling amino-acid catabolism to energy production in liver, kidney, and brain.
description_zh_TW: GDH 對穀氨酸的氧化脫氨產生 α-酮戊二酸，作為回補受質供應三羧酸循環。此轉化是將胺基酸分解代謝與肝、腎和腦中的能量產生偶聯的核心。

label: Monoamine oxidase
description: Monoamine Oxidase Inhibitor agents block Monoamine oxidase, the enzyme that catabolizes monoamine neurotransmitters, thereby raising synaptic serotonin, dopamine and norepinephrine and producing antidepressant and anxiolytic effects.
description_zh_TW: Monoamine Oxidase Inhibitor 類藥物抑制分解單胺神經傳遞物質的 Monoamine oxidase，因而提高突觸內的 serotonin、dopamine 與 norepinephrine，產生抗憂鬱與抗焦慮作用。

label: Therapy-Induced Senescence
description: Therapy-induced senescence imposes an initial durable arrest that can suppress tumor growth, yet the accompanying SASP can later stimulate proliferation of neighboring cells and foster relapse. This duality means senescence can be both a therapeutic success and a latent driver of recurrence. The relationship is bidirectional in outcome: acute suppression versus chronic promotion. Combinations with senolytics or senomorphics are therefore being tested to capture the benefit while removing the liability.
description_zh_TW: Therapy-Induced Senescence 施加最初的持久抑制，可以抑制腫瘤生長，但隨之而來的 SASP 可以隨後刺激鄰近細胞的增殖並促進復發。這種二元性意味著老化既可以是治療的成功，也是復發的潛在驅動因素。這種關係在結果上是雙向的：急性抑制與慢性促進。因此，正在測試與 senolytics 或 senomorphics 的組合，以獲得好處，同時消除責任。

label: TFE3
description: TFE3 is activated in response to endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress through a pathway that is mTORC1-independent but requires the ER stress sensor PERK. Under unfolded protein accumulation, PERK signaling promotes TFE3 nuclear translocation, engaging lysosomal and autophagic genes to alleviate proteotoxic burden. This distinct trigger allows TFE3 to contribute to the integrated stress response without relying on nutrient sensing. The mechanism expands the repertoire of stressors that can recruit the MiT/TFE degradative program.
description_zh_TW: TFE3 在回應內質網（ER）壓力時透過一條不依賴 mTORC1、但需要 ER 壓力感測器 PERK 的途徑被活化。在未折疊蛋白累積時，PERK 信號促進 TFE3 核轉位，啟動溶酶體和自噬基因以減輕蛋白毒性負擔。此獨特觸發因子使 TFE3 能在不依賴營養感知的情況下，貢獻於整合性壓力反應。此機制擴展了能夠招募 MiT/TFE 降解程序的壓力因子 repertoire。

label: Oxidized LDL
description: Brief oxLDL exposure trains human monocytes so that TLR2/TLR4 restimulation elicits amplified TNF-alpha and IL-6. This training depends on Akt/mTOR/HIF-1alpha signaling, since Torin1 or Raptor/Rictor silencing abolishes the trained cytokine response. It exemplifies DAMP-driven immunometabolic rewiring shared with beta-glucan training.
description_zh_TW: 短暫的 Oxidized LDL 暴露可訓練人類單核球，使 TLR2/TLR4 再刺激時產生放大的 TNF-alpha 與 IL-6。此訓練依賴 Akt/mTOR/HIF-1alpha signaling，因為 Torin1 或 Raptor/Rictor 沉默可消除訓練後的細胞激素反應。這是與 beta-glucan 訓練共用的 DAMP-driven immunometabolic rewiring 範例。

label: LDL
description: MDA-LDL is LDL whose apolipoprotein B-100 has been modified by malondialdehyde, the bifunctional dialdehyde end-product of Lipid Peroxidation, which cross-links lysine epsilon-amino groups into Schiff-base (imine) and more stable enamine adducts. The apoB-100 particle normally presents about 200 lysine residues whose positive charge mediates electrostatic binding to the LDL receptor; MDA neutralizes those charges, blocking receptor-mediated uptake, prolonging particle residence in the intima, and creating neo-epitopes recognized by scavenger receptors such as the CD36 Receptor and SR-A on Macrophages.
description_zh_TW: MDA-LDL 是 apolipoprotein B-100 被 malondialdehyde 修飾後的 LDL；malondialdehyde 是 Lipid Peroxidation 的雙功能二醛終產物，會將 lysine 的 ε-胺基基團交聯成 Schiff base（imine）與更穩定的 enamine 加合物。ApoB-100 顆粒正常呈現約 200 個 lysine 殘基，其正電荷負責與 LDL 受體的靜電結合；MDA 中和了這些電荷，因而阻斷受體媒介的攝取、延長顆粒在 intima 的停留，並創造出可被 Macrophages 上 CD36 Receptor 與 SR-A 等 scavenger receptor 辨識的新抗原決定位。

label: Catechol
description: Catechol (1,2-dihydroxybenzene) is the parent ortho-diphenol scaffold of the Catecholamines class, which includes dopamine, norepinephrine, and epinephrine; the same ring oxidation chemistry that converts catechol to o-benzoquinones also governs epinephrine oxidation to adrenochrome.
description_zh_TW: Catechol（兒茶酚，1,2-二羥基苯）是 Catecholamines（兒茶酚胺）類的母體鄰二酚骨架，該類包含 dopamine、norepinephrine 與 epinephrine；將 catechol 氧化為 o-benzoquinone 的同一環氧化化學，也主導 epinephrine 氧化為 adrenochrome。

label: Nicotinamide
description: Nicotinamide, a product of the sirtuin deacetylation reaction itself, is a micromolar non-competitive inhibitor of SIRT1 and SIRT2 that interacts with the C (nicotinamide) pocket of the catalytic site. It was one of the first endogenous compounds studied as a sirtuin inhibitor and inspired the search for NAD+ and nicotinamide analogs. SIRT1 inhibition with nicotinamide was reported to have anticancer activity in B-cell chronic lymphocytic leukemia and prostate cancer. Its limitations, and those of NAD+ analogs, lie in modest potency and limited therapeutic potential, which motivated development of more potent scaffolds.
description_zh_TW: 尼可醯胺是 sirtuin 去乙醯化反應本身的產物，是 SIRT1 和 SIRT2 的微摩爾級非競爭性抑制劑，與催化位點的 C（尼可醯胺）口袋相互作用。它是最早被研究作為 sirtuin 抑制劑的內源性化合物之一，並啟發了 NAD+ 和尼可醯胺類似物的搜索。利用尼可醯胺抑制 SIRT1 據報導在 B 細胞慢性淋巴性白血病和前列腺癌中具有抗癌活性。其局限性，以及 NAD+ 類似物的局限性，在於效能有限和治療潛力不足，這促進了更強效骨架結構的開發。

label: Innate Immunity
description: Antiviral response programs roadblock OSKM reprogramming; mirrors the p53-limits edge. Limitation is the immunity barrier.
description_zh_TW: 抗病毒反應程序阻礙 OSKM 重編程；呼應 p53 限制邊。限制是免疫屏障。

label: Ferritin
description: Ferritin sequesters free iron by storing up to roughly 4,500 Fe3+ atoms per molecule in a mineral core, keeping redox-active iron away from peroxide and the Fenton reaction. This buffering is a front-line antioxidant defense. The directionality is iron chelation to suppressed radical formation. A caveat is that ferritin can be released or degraded during inflammation and hemorrhage, liberating iron that then becomes pro-oxidant. Iron released from ferritin by ferritinophagy or by reduction is what fuels ferroptosis, so ferritin level is a determinant of ferroptosis sensitivity.
description_zh_TW: Ferritin 透過在礦物核心中每個分子儲存約 4,500 個 Fe3+ 原子來隔離 free iron，使具有氧化還原活性的 iron 遠離過氧化物和 Fenton reaction。這種緩衝是一種前線抗氧化防禦。方向性是iron螯合以抑制自由基的形成。需要注意的是，ferritin 在發炎和出血期間可能會釋放或降解，釋放出 iron，然後變成促氧化劑。透過ferritin自噬或還原從ferritin釋放的Iron是ferroptosis的燃料，因此ferritin水平是ferroptosis敏感性的決定因素。

label: Adenosylcobalamin
description: Adenosylcobalamin is one of two active coenzyme forms of vitamin B12 (cobalamin), alongside methylcobalamin, serving as an essential cofactor for mitochondrial enzymes in the methionine and methylmalonyl-CoA metabolic pathways. Unlike methylcobalamin, it does not donate a methyl group directly to the methylation cycle, so it does not contribute to the body's methyl burden. This distinction makes adenosylcobalamin particularly relevant for individuals with slow COMT activity, who may be sensitive to methyl-donating B12 forms.
description_zh_TW: Adenosylcobalamin 是維生素 B12（鈷胺素）的兩種活性輔酶形式之一，與甲鈷胺一起，作為蛋氨酸和甲基丙二酰輔酶 A 代謝途徑中線粒體酶的重要輔助因子。與甲鈷胺不同，它不會直接向 methylation cycle 提供甲基，因此不會增加人體的甲基負擔。這種區別使得腺苷鈷胺素對於 COMT activity 緩慢的個體特別重要，他們可能對甲基供體 B12 形式敏感。

label: COMT Val158 allele
source_file: _document_ - Genetic variation in COMT activity impacts learning and dopamine release capacity in the striatum.md
description: The COMT Val158 allele increases the thermostability of the enzyme, thereby increasing its level of activity compared to the 158 Met allele. This higher activity increases dopamine turnover in cortical synapses. A common polymorphism resulting in increased COMT activity has been associated with poorer cognitive performance and increased susceptibility to psychiatric disorders.
description_zh_TW: COMT Val158 等位基因增加酶的熱穩定性，從而相對於 158 Met 等位基因提高其活性水平。這種較高的活性增加皮質突觸的多巴胺代謝。導致 COMT activity 增加的常見多態性已與較差的認知表現和精神疾病易感性增加相關。

label: Albendazole
description: Albendazole is a benzimidazole anthelmintic that targets the intestinal microtubules of adult filarial worms and is co-administered with ivermectin as the backbone of lymphatic filariasis mass drug administration. In cancer research the same benzimidazole class is of interest because of its microtubule-destabilizing, antiproliferative activity.
description_zh_TW: Albendazole 是一種 benzimidazole 驅蟲藥，作用於絲蟲成蟲的腸道 microtubules，並與 ivermectin 併用，作為 lymphatic filariasis mass drug administration 的核心。在癌症研究中，同一 benzimidazole 類因其 destabilizing microtubule 的抗增殖活性而受到關注。

label: David Sinclair
description: The Sinclair lab developed the ICE Mouse to test the RCM hypothesis using mutation-free double-strand breaks. Directionally, the model enables tests of epigenetic aging. This provided key evidence for the Information Theory of Aging, and it is a methodological contribution alongside the theoretical framework. By engineering a system to induce faithful DNA breaks, Sinclair created a tool to separate epigenetic from genetic contributions to aging. The ICE Mouse's results have made it a centerpiece of the argument that aging results from loss of epigenetic information.
description_zh_TW: Sinclair 實驗室開發了 ICE 小鼠來使用無突變的雙鏈斷裂測試 RCM 假說。在方向性上，該模型使得表觀遺傳衰老的測試成為可能。這為衰老資訊理論提供了關鍵證據，是與理論框架並列的方法學貢獻。透過設計一個誘導忠實 DNA 斷裂的系統，Sinclair 創造了一個工具來分離表觀遺傳和遺傳對衰老的貢獻。ICE 小鼠的結果使其成為衰老源於表觀遺傳資訊喪失這一論點的核心。

label: Folinic acid
description: Folinic acid is also known as leucovorin, a chemically reduced and stable folate derivative that differs fundamentally from folic acid. It does not require the dihydrofolate reductase (DHFR) step needed by folic acid. It is clinically established as an antidote to folic-acid antagonist toxicity such as from methotrexate.
description_zh_TW: Folinic acid 也稱為 leucovorin，是一種化學還原且穩定的葉酸衍生物，與葉酸有根本上的不同。它不需要葉酸所需的二氫葉酸還原酶（DHFR）步驟。它在臨床上確立為葉酸拮抗劑（如 methotrexate）毒性的解毒劑。

label: Sodium Chloride
description: Low-dose NaCl at 25 mM acts as eustress in hydroponically grown sunflower microgreens, stimulating rather than suppressing growth. Shoot fresh yield rose 58.7%, leaf area 81.4%, and root length 25.7% versus control. This stimulatory low-dose effect is the defining feature of eustress/hormesis.
description_zh_TW: 25 mM 低劑量 NaCl 在水耕向日葵苗菜中發揮 Eustress 作用，促進而非抑制生長。地上部鮮重增加 58.7%、葉面積增加 81.4%、根長增加 25.7%。這種低劑量刺激效應正是 eustress／hormesis 的定義特徵。

label: Proline
description: Proline levels are reduced in aged organisms and in senescent cells, and proline supplementation decreases senescence of mesenchymal stem cells in culture while extending lifespan in yeast and C. elegans — plausibly through reactive oxygen species scavenging.
description_zh_TW: Proline 濃度在老化個體與衰老細胞中下降；補充 proline 可降低培養中間質幹細胞的衰老，並延長酵母與 C. elegans 的壽命——可能透過清除 reactive oxygen species 達成。

label: MTRR
description: MTRR (methionine synthase reductase) is a flavoprotein reductase that sustains the activity of methionine synthase by reducing its oxidized cobalt center back to the active Co1+ state. Without continuous reduction by MTRR, the cobalt center becomes oxidized to an inactive form, halting methyl transfer. This reductase step preserves methylation flux.
description_zh_TW: MTRR（methionine synthase reductase）是黃素蛋白還原酶，透過將其氧化的鈷中心還原回活性的 Co1+ 狀態來維持 methionine synthase 的活性。若沒有 MTRR 的持續還原，鈷中心會氧化為不活躍形式，停止甲基轉移。此還原步驟維持甲基化通量。

label: Pexophagy
description: Pexophagy is the peroxisome-specific form of selective autophagy, mirroring mitophagy classification. Classification nests the cargo program.
description_zh_TW: Pexophagy 是過氧化物酶體特異的選擇性自噬形式，呼應粒線體自噬歸類。歸類嵌套貨物程序。

label: Metabolism
description: AMPK acts as a cellular fuel gauge: when the AMP:ATP ratio rises during energy deficit it is activated and stimulates catabolic pathways such as fatty acid oxidation, glucose uptake, and autophagy while inhibiting anabolic processes including lipogenesis and protein synthesis. As a master energy sensor of Metabolism, AMPK is the target of metformin, which activates AMPK and inhibits hepatic gluconeogenesis.
description_zh_TW: AMPK 扮演細胞的燃料計量器：當能量不足使 AMP:ATP 比值上升時，AMPK 被活化並促進脂肪酸氧化、葡萄糖攝取與自噬等分解代謝途徑，同時抑制脂肪生成與蛋白質合成等合成代謝。作為 Metabolism 的主要能量感測器，AMPK 也是 metformin 的標的，後者藉由活化 AMPK 並抑制肝臟糖質新生發揮作用。

label: Methylation
description: Methylation is the biochemical transfer of a methyl group (-CH3) from a donor such as S-adenosylmethionine to an acceptor molecule, DNA, proteins, lipids, or small metabolites like catechols. This covalent modification alters the chemical properties, activity, or signaling of the target without changing its carbon skeleton, enabling regulation of gene expression, neurotransmitter inactivation, and detoxification. COMT-catalyzed catechol methylation is a classic example within neurotransmitter metabolism. Methylation is thus a universal regulatory and detoxifying mechanism.
description_zh_TW: Methylation 是甲基 (-CH3) 從 S-adenosylmethionine 等供體向受體分子、DNA、蛋白質、脂質或兒茶酚等小代謝物的生化轉移。這種共價修飾改變了標靶的化學性質、活性或訊號傳導，而不改變其碳骨架，從而能夠調節 gene expression、神經傳導物質失活和解毒。 COMT 催化的兒茶酚甲基化是神經傳導物質代謝的經典例子。因此，Methylation 是一種通用的調節和解毒機制。

label: Cerebellum
description: The cerebellum controls motor coordination, precision, timing, and motor learning through its integration of sensory and motor inputs, processed by Purkinje cell outputs to deep nuclei and downstream motor pathways. It fine-tunes ballistic and skilled movements rather than initiating them, and its integrity is essential for smooth, coordinated locomotion. Its role provides a useful anatomical contrast to forebrain structures in COMT-OE studies, where the CaMKIIalpha promoter leaves cerebellar function intact. This preserved function serves as a negative control for forebrain manipulations.
description_zh_TW: 小腦透過感覺和運動輸入的整合來控制 motor coordination 的精確度、計時和運動學習，這些輸入由浦肯野細胞輸出處理到深層核和下游運動路徑。它對彈道和熟練的運動進行微調，而不是啟動它們，其完整性對於平穩、協調的運動至關重要。它的作用為 COMT-OE 研究中的前腦結構提供了有用的解剖學對比，其中 CaMKIIalpha 啟動子使小腦功能保持完整。這種保留的功能可作為前腦操作的陰性對照。

label: Caspase-2
description: The CDK1-CYCLIN B1 complex phosphorylates Caspase-2 at Ser308, a site that blocks caspase-2 maturation and thereby couples mitotic entry to apoptotic restraint: actively dividing cells keep Caspase-2 off, while loss of CYCLIN B1 at mitotic exit or under genotoxic arrest relieves the inhibition and permits Caspase-2-driven death.
description_zh_TW: CDK1–CYCLIN B1 複合體在 Ser308 位點磷酸化 Caspase-2，該位點可阻斷 caspase-2 的成熟，因而把進入有絲分裂與凋亡抑制相偶聯：正在分裂的細胞使 Caspase-2 保持關閉，而在有絲分裂退出或基因毒性停滯時 CYCLIN B1 流失會解除此抑制，允許 Caspase-2 驅動的死亡發生。

label: Stimulus-response learning
description: Stimulus-response learning depends on dopamine signaling in the striatum, particularly within corticostriatal circuits where dopamine modulates the synaptic plasticity underlying habit formation. Both excessive and insufficient striatal dopamine, shaped by DAT, COMT, and receptor tone, disrupt S-R acquisition and procedural learning. COMT overexpression models demonstrate that altered dopamine clearance impairs this learning. This makes striatal dopamine a key determinant of habit and skill learning efficiency.
description_zh_TW: Stimulus-response learning 依賴紋狀體中的多巴胺訊號傳導，特別是在皮質紋狀體迴路中，其中多巴胺調節 habit formation 底層的 synaptic plasticity。由 DAT、COMT 和受體音調形成的紋狀體多巴胺過多和不足都會擾亂 S-R 獲取和程序性學習。 COMT 過度表現模型顯示多巴胺清除率的改變會損害這種學習。這使得紋狀體多巴胺成為習慣和技能學習效率的關鍵決定因素。

label: KRAS
description: Lung Cancer is driven by KRAS. Lung cancer, especially non-small-cell lung cancer, is the leading cause of cancer death and is frequently driven by EGFR or KRAS alterations. KRAS is a small GTPase and among the most commonly mutated oncogenes, constitutively driving MAPK and PI3K output when mutated. The directionality runs from KRAS toward Lung Cancer, so KRAS is the active agent and Lung Cancer the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Lung Cancer 由KRAS 驅動。 Lung Cancer，尤其是非小細胞Lung Cancer，是癌症死亡的主要原因，並且經常由EGFR或KRAS改變驅動。 KRAS 是一種小型 GTP 酶，是最常見突變的癌基因之一，突變時會持續驅動 MAPK 和 PI3K 輸出。方向性從 KRAS 朝向 Lung Cancer，因此 KRAS 是活性劑，Lung Cancer 是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: PPARγ
description: SIRT1 represses PPARγ-mediated transcription, inhibiting adipogenesis; SIRT1 overexpression or pharmacological activation by resveratrol therefore promotes fat mobilization by repressing PPARγ and aP2 genes.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 抑制 PPARγ 媒介的轉錄，因而抑制脂肪生成；SIRT1 过量表現或經 resveratrol 藥理活化後，藉由抑制 PPARγ 與 aP2 基因促進脂肪動員。

label: Rutin
description: Rutin is chemically quercetin-3-O-rutinoside, a glycosylated flavonol found in buckwheat, citrus peel, apples, and onions. It is used to support vascular integrity and is valued for antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. Its quercetin aglycone bears the catechol moiety that engages COMT.
description_zh_TW: Rutin 化學上為 quercetin-3-O-rutinoside，是一種糖基化黃酮醇，存在於蕎麥、柑橘皮、蘋果和洋蔥中。它用於支持血管完整性，並因其抗氧化和抗發炎特性而受重視。其槲皮素苷元帶有接合 COMT 的兒茶酚部分。

label: Cambinol
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins Shedding light on structure, function and regulation of human sirtuins a comprehensive review.md
description: Cambinol has the most effective efficacy against Burkitt lymphoma cell lines. Salermide causes apoptosis in cancer cells without relying on p53. Both Cambinol and Salermide have inhibitory effects on SIRT1 and SIRT2. Directionally, these sirtuin-inhibiting compounds sit upstream of suppressed cancer cell growth, with Cambinol showing particular potency against Burkitt lymphoma among the STIC class of sirtuin inhibitors.
description_zh_TW: Cambinol 對 Burkitt 淋巴瘤細胞株具有最有效的抑制作用。Salermide 能在不依賴 p53 的情況下誘導癌細胞凋亡。Cambinol 和 Salermide 均對 SIRT1 和 SIRT2 具有抑制作用。從作用方向而言，這些 sirtuin 抑制化合物位於抑制癌細胞生長的上游，其中 Cambinol 在 STIC 類 sirtuin 抑制劑中對 Burkitt 淋巴瘤表現出特別的效力。

label: Salermide
description: Salermide induces robust apoptosis in leukemia (MOLT4), breast (MDA-MB-231), and colon (RKO) cancer cells, validating broad antitumor activity. Directionally, Salermide treatment sits upstream of cancer-cell death. This is consistent with SIRT1/2 inhibition removing survival signaling, and it supports sirtuin blockers as anticancer agents. The activity across diverse cancer cell lines indicates that SIRT1/2 inhibition engages a general pro-apoptotic program rather than a tumor-type-specific mechanism. These results provided key evidence for the anticancer potential of sirtuin inhibitors.
description_zh_TW: Salermide 在白血病（MOLT4）、乳腺癌（MDA-MB-231）和結腸癌（RKO）細胞中誘導顯著凋亡，驗證了廣泛的抗腫瘤活性。在方向性上，Salermide 治療位於癌細胞死亡的上游。這與 SIRT1/2 抑制移除存活訊號一致，支持 sirtuin 阻斷劑作為抗癌藥物。在多種癌細胞系中的活性表明 SIRT1/2 抑制啟動的是一般性的促凋亡程式而非腫瘤類型特異性的機制。這些結果為 sirtuin 抑制劑的抗癌潛力提供了關鍵證據。

label: Sirtinol
description: In MCF-7 breast cancer cells, sirtinol triggers both apoptotic and autophagic programmed cell death, reflecting disrupted survival homeostasis. Directionally, Sirtinol sits upstream of dual cell-death activation. This is attributed to SIRT1/2 inhibition removing anti-apoptotic deacetylation, and it illustrates the pleiotropic anticancer potential of sirtuin blockers. The simultaneous engagement of apoptosis and autophagy suggests that sirtuin inhibition disrupts multiple survival pathways in cancer cells. This dual death response makes sirtinol an informative tool for studying how sirtuins support cancer-cell survival.
description_zh_TW: 在 MCF-7 乳腺癌細胞中，sirtinol 觸發凋亡和自噬兩種程序性細胞死亡，反映了存活恆定性的破壞。在方向性上，Sirtinol 位於雙重細胞死亡活化的上游。這歸因於 SIRT1/2 抑制移除了抗凋亡去乙醯化，並闡明了 sirtuin 阻斷劑的多效性抗癌潛力。凋亡和自噬的同時啟動表明 sirtuin 抑制破壞了癌細胞中的多條存活途徑。這種雙重死亡反應使 sirtinol 成為研究 sirtuin 如何支持癌細胞存活的有資訊價值的工具。

label: Ubiquitin Ligase
description: The APC/C is a massive multi-subunit E3 ubiquitin ligase ordering mitotic degradation.
description_zh_TW: APC/C 是編排有絲分裂降解的巨大多亞基 E3 泛素連接酶。

label: Double-Strand Break
description: Double-strand breaks are the principal trigger for the recruitment of chromatin modifiers away from their native genomic loci to damage sites. In the RCM Hypothesis, repeated cycles of DSB-induced relocalization are proposed to erode the epigenetic landscape over time.
description_zh_TW: 雙股斷裂是染色質修飾因子被招募離開原生基因座至損傷位點的主要觸發因素。在 RCM 假說中，反覆的 DSB 誘導易位被認為會隨時間侵蝕表觀遺傳景觀。

label: Methylglyoxal
description: The glyoxalase system, composed of GLO1 and GLO2, is the primary defense system against dicarbonyl stress. Methylglyoxal, glyoxal, and 3-deoxyglucosone are highly reactive dicarbonyl intermediates generated during glycolysis and lipid peroxidation, and if left unchecked they form irreversible AGE crosslinks on cysteine, lysine, and arginine residues. The glyoxalase system neutralizes these precursors, and maintaining GLO1 activity is a primary target for reducing endogenous AGE accumulation. Dysfunction of this system is therefore linked to increased dicarbonyl stress and accelerated protein glycation, with consequences for aging, diabetes, and cardiovascular disease.
description_zh_TW: 由 GLO1 與 GLO2 組成的乙二醛酶系統（glyoxalase system）是對抗二羰基壓力的主要防禦系統。甲基乙二醛（methylglyoxal）、乙二醛（glyoxal）與 3-deoxyglucosone 是糖解與脂質過氧化過程中產生的高度反應性二羰基中間產物，若不加控制，它們會在半胱氨酸、賴氨酸與精氨酸殘基上形成不可逆的 AGE 交聯。乙二醛酶系統中和這些前驅物，而維持 GLO1 活性是減少內生性 AGE 堆積的主要標的。因此，此系統的功能障礙與二羰基壓力增加及蛋白質糖化加速有關，對老化、糖尿病與心血管疾病產生影響。

label: p21 CIP1
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: DNA damage stabilizes p53, which transcriptionally induces the CDK inhibitor p21CIP1; p21 binds and inhibits cyclin-CDK complexes, notably CDK2, enforcing a G1/S arrest. This p53-to-p21 axis is a primary, rapid enforcement mechanism of senescence and quiescence, and the induction is dose-dependent and reversible in the short term but locks the arrest when sustained. It exemplifies tumor-suppressive cell-cycle control and is a core target of the DNA damage response. p21 also supports an early secretory phenotype during stress.
description_zh_TW: DNA 損傷穩定 p53，p53 轉錄誘發 CDK 抑制因子 p21CIP1；p21 結合並抑制 cyclin-CDK 複合體，特別是 CDK2，強制 G1/S 停滯。此 p53-to-p21 軸是衰老與靜止的主要、快速執行機制，且此誘發在短期內依劑量且可逆，但在持續時鎖定停滯。它例示腫瘤抑制性細胞週期控制，是 DNA 損傷反應的核心標靶。p21 也在壓力期間支持早期分泌表型。

label: MTHFD1
description: MTHFD1 is a trifunctional cytosolic enzyme that catalyzes NADP+-dependent reactions interconverting folate-bound one-carbon units, including dehydrogenation of 5,10-methylenetetrahydrofolate to 10-formyl-THF. 10-formyl-THF supplies carbons for de novo purine ring formation. A mitochondrial paralog, MTHFD2, performs analogous reactions during proliferation.
description_zh_TW: MTHFD1 是三功能細胞質酶，催化 NADP+ 依賴性反應，在葉酸結合的一碳單元之間進行互換，包括將 5,10-亞甲基四氫葉酸脫氫為 10-formyl-THF。10-formyl-THF 為 de novo 嘌呤環形成提供碳。粒線體旁系同源物 MTHFD2 在增殖期間執行類似的反應。

label: Caspase-9
description: During apoptosis the initiator caspase-9 directly cleaves SIRT1 (Sir2α), the NAD+-dependent deacetylase that normally restrains p53- and FOXO-driven death programs. Cleavage is caspase-dependent: dominant-negative caspase-9 blocks both the lower-molecular-weight SIRT1 band and its nuclear-to-cytoplasmic relocalization in TNF-α-treated HeLa cells. Because caspase-9 sits at the top of the intrinsic cascade, SIRT1 dismantling begins early in the apoptotic process rather than as a late cleanup event. This is the founding observation of the caspase-to-sirtuin feedback direction.
description_zh_TW: 在細胞凋亡過程中，起始半胱天冬酶-9（Caspase-9）會直接切割 SIRT1（Sir2α）——這個通常抑制 p53 與 FOXO 死亡程序的 NAD+ 依賴性去乙醯酶。切割是 caspase 依賴性的：顯性負向 Caspase-9 同時阻斷了 TNF-α 處理的 HeLa 細胞中較低分子量的 SIRT1 條帶及其由細胞核向細胞質的重新定位。由於 Caspase-9 位於內在級聯的頂端，SIRT1 的瓦解在細胞凋亡早期即已開始，而非晚期的清理事件。這是 caspase 至 sirtuin 回饋方向的奠基性觀察。

label: Extracellular Matrix
description: Integrins are heterodimeric transmembrane receptors that mediate cell-ECM adhesion by binding matrix ligands such as fibronectin (alpha5beta1), vitronectin (alphavbeta3) and collagens. Ligand engagement induces conformational extension, clustering, and recruitment of focal adhesion machinery.
description_zh_TW: Integrin 是異二聚體跨膜受體，透過結合纖連蛋白（alpha5beta1）、玻連蛋白（alphavbeta3）和膠原蛋白等基質配體，介導細胞-ECM 黏附。配體接合誘導構形伸展、聚集和黏著斑機器的招募。

label: AP-1
description: The transcription factor AP-1 acts as a pioneering factor that binds to enhancers associated with SASP and other senescence-related genes, initiating the opening of closed chromatin. By pioneering open chromatin at these enhancers, AP-1 enables subsequent recruitment of transcriptional machinery, the histone acetyltransferase p300, and activation of SASP gene expression. Depletion of the AP-1 family member c-Jun alone can partially reverse senescence-associated cell cycle arrest, underscoring AP-1's central regulatory role.
description_zh_TW: 轉錄因子 AP-1 作為先鋒因子，與 SASP 和其他老化相關基因相關的增強子結合，啟動封閉染色質的打開。透過在這些增強子上率先開放染色質，AP-1 能夠隨後招募轉錄機制、組蛋白乙醯轉移酶 p300，並活化 SASP gene expression。單獨消耗 AP-1 家族成員 c-Jun 可以部分逆轉老化相關的細胞週期停滯，強調了 AP-1 的核心調節作用。

label: Nitrative Stress
description: 3-nitrotyrosine is a biomarker for nitrative stress, reflecting peroxynitrite- or myeloperoxidase-mediated nitration of protein tyrosines. It is elevated across many inflammatory and neurodegenerative conditions. The directionality is nitrative insult to stable protein modification. A caveat is that 3-nitrotyrosine can arise from multiple nitrating pathways and can be repaired or degraded, so it indicates historical rather than instantaneous nitrative load. Quantification in plasma, CSF, and tissue by mass spectrometry or immunoassay has made 3-NT a standard endpoint in redox biomarker studies.
description_zh_TW: 3-nitrotyrosine 是 nitrative stress 的生物標記物，反映 peroxynitrite 或 myeloperoxidase 介導的蛋白質 tyrosines 硝化。它會導致許多發炎和神經退化性疾病。方向性是對穩定蛋白質修飾的硝化損害。需要注意的是，3-nitrotyrosine 可以由多種硝化途徑產生，並且可以修復或降解，因此它表示歷史硝化負荷而不是瞬時硝化負荷。透過質譜或免疫分析對血漿、腦脊髓液和組織進行定量，使 3-NT 成為氧化還原生物標記研究的標準終點。

label: Heart Rate Variability
description: HRV is directly controlled by the autonomic nervous system, which has two main branches with opposing effects. The sympathetic nervous system, the fight-flight-freeze system, releases adrenaline and cortisol that force the heart to beat faster and more rhythmically, lowering HRV. The parasympathetic nervous system, the rest-digest-and-repair system controlled heavily by the vagus nerve, allows more fluctuation between heartbeats, raising HRV. A high HRV therefore reflects strong vagal tone and a cardiovascular system that is highly responsive and flexible, while low HRV signals chronic stress, fatigue, or illness.
description_zh_TW: HRV 直接受自律神經系統控制，該系統有兩大作用相反的支系。交感神經系統（戰逃僵系統）會釋放腎上腺素與皮質醇，迫使心臟跳得更快且更規律，進而降低 HRV。副交感神經系統（休息消化修復系統）主要由迷走神經控制，允許心跳之間有較大的波動，進而提高 HRV。因此，高 HRV 反映強大的迷走神經張力，以及高度敏銳且具彈性的心血管系統；而低 HRV 則代表慢性壓力、疲勞或疾病。

label: PARP
description: Poly(ADP-ribose) polymerases (PARPs) are NAD+-consuming enzymes that transfer ADP-ribose units onto proteins and nucleic acids, playing critical roles in DNA repair and antiviral immunity. During aging, accumulated DNA damage activates PARPs, which depletes NAD+ and reduces SIRT1 activity. In SARS-CoV-2 infection, PARPs inhibit viral transcript translation through ADP-ribosylation, but viral macrodomain proteins hydrolyze these ADPR units, and the compensatory hyperactivation of PARPs consumes NAD+; restoring NAD+ may therefore support the antiviral functions of PARPs. PARPs also consume NAD+ during diabetes-associated DNA repair, contributing to the NAD+/NADH redox imbalance that drives diabetic complications.
description_zh_TW: 聚(ADP-核糖)聚合酶（PARPs）是消耗 NAD+ 的酵素，可將 ADP-ribose 單元轉移至蛋白質與核酸上，在 DNA 修復與抗病毒免疫中扮演關鍵角色。老化過程中，累積的 DNA 損傷會活化 PARPs，進而耗竭 NAD+ 並降低 SIRT1 活性。在 SARS-CoV-2 感染中，PARPs 透過 ADP-ribosylation 抑制病毒轉錄本的轉譯，但病毒的 macrodomain 蛋白會水解這些 ADPR 單元，而 PARPs 的代償性過度活化會消耗 NAD+；因此補充 NAD+ 可能有助於支持 PARPs 的抗病毒功能。PARPs 在糖尿病相關的 DNA 修復過程中也會消耗 NAD+，促成驅動糖尿病併發症的 NAD+/NADH 氧化還原失衡。

label: Translation
description: Translation is the final protein-synthesis step of gene expression.
description_zh_TW: 轉譯是基因表現最後的蛋白合成步驟。

label: Brosimine B
description: Brosimine B (2(S)-7,4'-dihydroxy-8-prenylflavan, C20H22O3) is a prenylated flavan from Brosimum acutifolium bark and a textbook Hormetin: low-dose stimulation with high-dose inhibition.
description_zh_TW: Brosimine B（2(S)-7,4'-dihydroxy-8-prenylflavan，C20H22O3）取自 Brosimum acutifolium 樹皮的異戊烯化黃烷，是典型的 Hormetin：低劑量刺激、高劑量抑制。

label: ME2
description: SIRT3 acts as a delactylase for malic enzyme 2, removing the K352 lactyl mark and thereby inhibiting ME2 activity. Lactylation at K352 normally enhances ME2 activity, NADPH production and mitochondrial respiration, so SIRT3-mediated delactylation is tumor-suppressive in colorectal cancer.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 作為蘋果酸酶 2 的去乳醯化酶，移除 K352 的乳醯化標記，因而抑制 ME2 活性。K352 的乳醯化原本會提升 ME2 活性、NADPH 生成與粒線體呼吸，因此 SIRT3 媒介的去乳醯化在結直腸癌中具有抑制腫瘤的作用。

label: Proteasome
description: Proteasome and Ubiquitin-Proteasome System are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Proteasome and Ubiquitin-Proteasome System may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Proteasome 和 Ubiquitin-Proteasome System 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Proteasome 和 Ubiquitin-Proteasome System 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: HLA-E
description: B2M is the invariant light chain that forms all MHC class I molecules and, in particular, stabilizes HLA-E surface expression; HLA-E/B2M on senescent and tumor cells engages NKG2A/CD94 on Natural Killer Cells and CD8 T cells, blunting cytotoxic killing and enabling Immune Evasion.
description_zh_TW: B2M 是構成所有 MHC 第一類分子的不變輕鏈，特別能穩定 HLA-E 的表面表現；衰老細胞與腫瘤細胞上的 HLA-E/B2M 會接合 Natural Killer Cells 與 CD8 T cells 上的 NKG2A/CD94，削弱細胞毒殺殺傷並促成 Immune Evasion。

label: Beclin1
description: Beclin 1 is a core autophagy protein and a haploinsufficient tumor suppressor whose monoallelic deletion is frequently observed in human ovarian, breast, and prostate cancers. Loss of one BECN1 allele reduces autophagic flux, increasing susceptibility to oxidative damage, genomic instability, and inflammation that favor tumor initiation. Mechanistically, Beclin 1 functions as the scaffold of the PI3K III nucleation complex, and its interaction with Bcl-2 family members further couples autophagy to apoptotic regulation. Its frequent deletion in epithelial cancers established autophagy as a genuine tumor-suppression pathway.
description_zh_TW: Beclin 1是一種核心自噬蛋白和單倍體不足型腫瘤抑制因子，其單等位基因缺失常見於人類卵巢癌、乳腺癌和前列腺癌。失去一個BECN1等位基因會降低自噬流，增加對氧化損傷、基因組不穩定和發炎的易感性，有利於腫瘤起始。在機制上，Beclin 1作為PI3K III成核複合體的支架，其與Bcl-2家族成員的交互作用進一步將自噬與凋亡調控耦合。它在上皮癌中的頻繁缺失確立了自噬作為一條真正的腫瘤抑制途徑。

label: SREBP-1c
description: SREBP-1c is the master transcriptional regulator of de novo lipogenesis. Synthesized as an inactive precursor anchored to the endoplasmic reticulum, it is processed and released by S1P/S2P proteases after SCAP-mediated transport to the Golgi at low sterol, and the active N-terminal domain translocates to the nucleus to drive fatty acid and triglyceride biosynthesis.
description_zh_TW: SREBP-1c 是 de novo lipogenesis（從新生脂質合成）的核心轉錄調節因子。它先以失活前驅物形式錨定於 endoplasmic reticulum，在低固醇時經 SCAP 運送至 Golgi apparatus 後由 S1P/S2P 蛋白酶切割，其活性 N 端區段轉位至細胞核，驅動脂肪酸與三酸甘油酯的生合成。

label: FGF21
description: FGF21 is the primary endocrine mediator of protein restriction's metabolic benefits. PR robustly elevates FGF21 in mice, rats, and humans, and FGF21 is required for many of PR's effects - increased food intake, reduced body weight, increased energy expenditure, and extended lifespan. Other geroprotective diets including calorie restriction, methionine restriction, BCAA restriction, and isoleucine restriction also induce FGF21. Mice overexpressing Fgf21 show ~30% (males) and ~40% (females) lifespan extension, while Fgf21-null mice do not live longer on PR. FGF21 also suppresses senescence and inflammation in white adipose tissue and reduces hepatic steatosis and fibrosis in obese models.
description_zh_TW: FGF21是蛋白質限制代謝益處的主要內分泌介質。PR在小鼠、大鼠和人類中強力提升FGF21，FGF21是PR許多效應所必需的——增加食物攝入、減少體重、增加能量消耗和延長壽命。其他抗老化飲食包括熱量限制、甲硫氨酸限制、BCAA限制和異亮氨酸限制也誘導FGF21。過表達Fgf21的小鼠顯示約30%（雄性）和約40%（雌性）的壽命延長，而Fgf21缺失小鼠在PR下壽命未延長。FGF21也抑制白色脂肪組織的衰老和發炎，並減少肥胖模型中的肝臟脂肪變性和纖維化。

label: OPA1
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Dominant optic atrophy (DOA) is directly caused by heterozygous mutations in the mitochondrial fusion-related gene OPA1, which encodes the inner mitochondrial membrane fusion GTPase optic atrophy 1. OPA1 mutations and improper OPA1 processing induce mitochondrial fragmentation, resulting in severe cardiomyopathy and ultimately heart failure in addition to optic atrophy. In a mouse DOA model, adeno-associated virus delivery of wild-type OPA1 alleviates retinal ganglion cell degeneration, demonstrating the therapeutic potential of restoring fusion capacity in OPA1-mutant disease.
description_zh_TW: 顯性視神經萎縮（DOA）直接由粒線體融合相關基因OPA1的雜合突變引起，該基因編碼內粒線體膜融合GTP酶視神經萎縮1。OPA1突變和不當的OPA1加工誘導粒線體碎片化，導致嚴重心肌病和最終心力衰竭以及視神經萎縮。在小鼠DOA模型中，腺相關病毒遞送野生型OPA1可緩解視網膜神經節細胞退化，證明了在OPA1突變疾病中恢復融合能力的治療潛力。

label: Selective Autophagy
description: Mitophagy is a specialized, evolutionarily conserved form of selective autophagy dedicated to the degradation of damaged or dysfunctional mitochondria. Under stress such as excessive ROS, nutrient deficiency, or cellular aging, mitochondria undergo depolarization and are selectively engulfed and eliminated. The process proceeds through recognition of damaged mitochondria, recruitment of adaptors or receptors, autophagosome formation, and fusion with lysosomes. This ensures mitochondrial quality control and cellular homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: Mitophagy 是選擇性自噬的一種特化、演化上保守的形式，專門降解受損或功能失常的粒線體。在過量 ROS、營養缺乏或細胞老化等壓力下，粒線體發生去極化並被選擇性吞噬和清除。此過程歷經辨識受損粒線體、招募接合蛋白或受體、自噬體形成，以及與溶酶體融合。這確保了粒線體品質控制和細胞恆定性。

label: IDO1
description: IDO1 catalyzes the first, rate-limiting step in tryptophan catabolism, inserting both oxygen atoms of O2 into the indole ring to yield N-formylkynurenine and thereby initiating the Kynurenine Pathway. Downstream metabolism produces Quinolinic Acid and ultimately NAD+, so IDO1 activity links tryptophan availability to the cellular NAD+ pool as well as to T-cell immunity and tumor immune tolerance.
description_zh_TW: IDO1 催化色胺酸分解代謝的第一步也是限速步驟，將 O2 的兩個氧原子插入 indole 環以生成 N-formylkynurenine，據此啟動 Kynurenine Pathway。下游代謝產生 Quinolinic Acid 並最終生成 NAD+，因此 IDO1 活性同時連結色胺酸可得性與細胞 NAD+ 池，以及 T 細胞免疫與腫瘤免疫耐受。

label: TRPML1
description: TRPML1 (mucolipin-1) is a lysosomal cation channel that releases Ca2+ from the lysosomal lumen into the cytosol in response to stimuli such as PI(3,5)P2 or lumenal cues. The resulting local calcium signal activates calcineurin, which dephosphorylates TFEB and promotes its nuclear translocation. Through this mechanism, TRPML1 functionally links lysosomal ion homeostasis to the transcriptional activation of lysosomal biogenesis and autophagy. Loss of TRPML1 underlies the lysosomal storage disorder mucolipidosis type IV.
description_zh_TW: TRPML1（mucolipin-1）是一種溶酶體陽離子通道，回應 PI(3,5)P2 或腔內信號等刺激，將 Ca2+ 從溶酶體腔釋放至細胞質。所產生的局部鈣信號活化 calcineurin，後者去磷酸化 TFEB 並促進其核轉運。透過此機制，TRPML1 在功能上將溶酶體離子恆定連結到溶酶體生物發生和自噬的轉錄活化。TRPML1 的缺失是溶酶體儲存障礙黏脂質儲積症第四型（mucolipidosis type IV）的基礎。

label: Autophagosome
description: The phagophore assembly site is the platform on which the phagophore is nucleated, elongated, and ultimately sealed into the mature autophagosome. The crescent-shaped isolation membrane formed at the PAS becomes the double-membraned autophagosome.
description_zh_TW: 吞噬泡組裝位點是吞噬泡形成、延伸並最終封閉為成熟自噬體的平台。在 PAS 形成的月牙形隔離膜成為雙膜自噬體。

label: Melatonin
description: Melatonin acts as a potent antioxidant, protecting the body from Oxidative Stress and free-radical damage. This antioxidant capacity, beyond its sleep–wake signalling role, is why melatonin has been profiled as a therapeutic in sepsis, contrast-induced acute kidney injury, and diabetic cardiomyopathy.
description_zh_TW: Melatonin 具備強效的抗氧化作用，能保護身體免受 Oxidative Stress 與自由基傷害。這項抗氧化能力（超越其睡眠—覺醒訊號的角色），正是褪黑激素曾被評估為敗血症、對比劑誘發急性腎損傷與糖尿病心肌病治療手段的原因。

label: Hypochlorous Acid
description: Hypochlorous acid chlorinates tyrosine to form 3-chlorotyrosine, a stable adduct that is a specific biomarker of myeloperoxidase activity in vivo. Its presence marks HOCl exposure in inflamed tissues. The directionality is HOCl to chlorinated protein residue. A caveat is that 3-chlorotyrosine reflects historical MPO activity and can be turned over with protein degradation, so it is an integrative rather than instantaneous marker. 3-chlorotyrosine levels rise in atherosclerotic plaques, pneumonia, and other inflammatory conditions, supporting its use as a clinical research biomarker.
description_zh_TW: Hypochlorous acid 氯化 tyrosine 形成 3-chlorotyrosine，這是一種穩定的加合物，是體內 myeloperoxidase 活性的特定生物標記。它的存在標誌著發炎組織中的次氯酸暴露。方向性是 HOCl 到氯化蛋白質殘基。需要注意的是，3-chlorotyrosine 反映了歷史 MPO 活性，並且可以隨著蛋白質降解而翻轉，因此它是一個綜合標記，而不是瞬時標記。 3-chlorotyrosine 水平在 atheros 硬化斑塊、肺炎和其他發炎性疾病中升高，支持其用作臨床研究生物標記。

label: MyD88
description: MyD88 is the archetypal adaptor protein: a non-enzymatic cytoplasmic scaffold that couples receptor engagement to downstream kinase cascades. Homotypic TIR-TIR interactions recruit it to activated Toll-like Receptor and IL-1 Receptor, and death-domain interactions then bring IRAK4 and IRAK1 into proximity for trans-autophosphorylation. Because MyD88 has no catalytic activity, its function is entirely architectural.
description_zh_TW: MyD88 是典型的 adaptor protein：一個無酵素活性的細胞質支架，將受體活化與下游激酶級聯反應連結起來。經由 TIR-TIR 同型交互作用，它被招募至活化的 Toll-like Receptor 與 IL-1 Receptor，再透過 death domain 交互作用將 IRAK4 與 IRAK1 拉近以進行交互磷酸化。由於 MyD88 不具催化活性，其功能完全是架構性的。

label: Complex I
description: BAY 87-2243 is a ubiquinone-binding site (Q-site) dependent inhibitor of mitochondrial Complex I (NADH:ubiquinone oxidoreductase), originally developed as a HIF-1 pathway inhibitor. It blocks electron transfer from NADH to ubiquinone, producing an increased NADH:NAD+ ratio, NAD+ and ATP depletion, AMPK activation and collapse of the TCA cycle in glutamine-dependent cells.
description_zh_TW: BAY 87-2243 是粒線體 Complex I（NADH:ubiquinone 氧化還原酶）的泛醌結合位點（Q-site）依賴型抑制劑，最初作為 HIF-1 途徑抑制劑開發。它阻斷 NADH 將電子傳遞給泛醌，造成 NADH:NAD+ 比值上升、NAD+ 與 ATP 耗竭、AMPK 活化，並使依賴麩醯胺酸的細胞 TCA cycle 崩潰。

label: Cognition
description: The Prefrontal Cortex mediates executive function and working memory, underpinning planning, inhibitory control, cognitive flexibility and abstract reasoning. It operates within an inverted-U dose-response curve for Dopamine signalling, so both excess and deficiency impair performance, and its volume declines with normal aging.
description_zh_TW: Prefrontal Cortex 中介執行功能與工作記憶，是計畫、抑制控制、認知彈性與抽象推理的基礎。其運作遵循 Dopamine 訊號的倒 U 型劑量反應曲線，過多與過少皆會損害表現，且其體積會隨正常老化而減少。

label: Adrenochrome Hypothesis
description: Canadian psychiatrist and biochemist Abram Hoffer, with Humphry Osmond, co-proposed the Adrenochrome Hypothesis in a series of papers beginning in the 1950s. Hoffer's own niacin trials in schizophrenia followed from the hypothesis and were later not confirmed by independent multicenter replication.
description_zh_TW: 加拿大精神科醫師與生化學家 Abram Hoffer 與 Humphry Osmond 自 1950 年代起在一系列論文中共同提出 Adrenochrome Hypothesis。Hoffer 針對 Schizophrenia 所做的 niacin 試驗源自此假說，但後續獨立多中心重複研究未能確認其結果。

label: ATGL
description: ATGL (adipose triglyceride lipase, PNPLA2) is the first and rate-limiting enzyme of catabolic lipolysis. It localizes to the surface of Lipid Droplet and hydrolyzes triacylglycerol into diacylglycerol and free fatty acids, providing substrate for Lipophagy and fatty acid oxidation. Its activity determines the rate of free fatty acid release from adipose tissue and therefore systemic lipid mobilization, and it is activated during Starvation and Fasting to mobilize energy reserves.
description_zh_TW: ATGL（adipose triglyceride lipase，PNPLA2）是分解性脂解的第一個也是速率限制酵素。它定位於 Lipid Droplet 表面，將三酸甘油酯水解為二酸甘油酯與游離脂肪酸，為 Lipophagy 與脂肪酸氧化提供受質。其活性決定 adipose 組織釋放游離脂肪酸的速率，因而決定全身脂質動員；並在 Starvation 與 Fasting 期間被活化以動員能量儲備。

label: Mitochondrial Permeability Transition Pore
description: Cyclophilin D (PPIF) is a mitochondrial matrix peptidyl-prolyl isomerase and the primary positive regulator of the mitochondrial permeability transition pore. It binds the pore and promotes its opening in response to matrix calcium overload and reactive oxygen species, thereby gating cytochrome c release upstream of the caspase cascade and making CypD a senolytic target in senescent cells.
description_zh_TW: Cyclophilin D（PPIF）是粒線體基質的 peptidyl-prolyl isomerase，也是 Mitochondrial Permeability Transition Pore 的主要正向調節者。它結合孔道並在基質鈣過載與 Reactive Oxygen Species 作用下促進孔道開啟，藉此在 caspase 级聯上游控制 Cytochrome c 釋放，並使 CypD 成為衰老細胞的 senolytic 標的。

label: Oleacein
description: Oleacein is a phenolic secoiridoid compound found in extra virgin olive oil, where it contributes to the oil's characteristic bitterness and health-promoting profile. As a dietary polyphenol it is metabolized in part by COMT, linking olive oil consumption to COMT-dependent polyphenol disposition. It exhibits antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties that underlie part of the Mediterranean diet's cardiovascular benefits. Its presence makes olive oil a significant dietary source of COMT-interacting phenolics.
description_zh_TW: Oleacein 是一種在 extra virgin olive oil 中發現的酚類環烯醚萜化合物，它賦予了油特有的苦味和促進健康的特性。作為一種膳食多酚，它部分由 COMT 代謝，將橄欖油消耗與 COMT 依賴性多酚處置聯繫起來。它所含的抗氧化劑和 anti-inflammatory properties 是地中海飲食對心血管的部分益處的基礎。它的存在使得橄欖油成為 COMT 相互作用酚類物質的重要飲食來源。

label: NADPH
description: Glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase is the rate-limiting enzyme of the pentose phosphate pathway, oxidizing glucose-6-phosphate to 6-phosphoglucono-delta-lactone while reducing NADP+ to NADPH. The NADPH produced is the principal driver of reduced glutathione regeneration, which neutralizes reactive oxygen species and is what erythrocytes depend on.
description_zh_TW: Glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase 是磷酸戊糖途徑的限速酵素，將葡萄糖-6-磷酸氧化為 6-磷酸葡萄糖酸-δ-內酯，同時把 NADP+ 還原為 NADPH。所產生的 NADPH 是還原型麩胱甘肽再生的主要動力，可中和活性氧，而這正是紅血球所依賴的機制。

label: Neuroprotection
description: Neuroprotection and Parkinson's Disease are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Neuroprotection and Parkinson's Disease may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Neuroprotection 和 Parkinson's Disease 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Neuroprotection 和 Parkinson's Disease 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: Parkin
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Parkin is a multidomain E3 ubiquitin ligase whose N-terminal Ubiquitin-like domain engages RING0 in the autoinhibited state, folding the enzyme closed so that RING2 is occluded. Displacement of the UBL — by PINK1-mediated phosphorylation and ubiquitin-dependent relief of repression — releases active Parkin, which then ubiquitinates mitochondrial substrates during Mitophagy.
description_zh_TW: Parkin 是多結構域的 E3 泛素連接酶，其 N 端 Ubiquitin-like domain 在自抑制狀態下與 RING0 結合，使酵素摺疊成封閉構形而遮蔽 RING2。UBL 的位移——由 PINK1 媒介的磷酸化與泛素依賴性的去抑制促成——會釋出活性 Parkin，後者在 Mitophagy 期間泛素化粒線體受質。

label: Striatum
description: Medium spiny neurons constitute roughly 90-95% of the neuronal population in the striatum (the caudate nucleus and putamen). They are the principal integrators of cortical, thalamic, and dopaminergic input within the basal ganglia. They form the major output pathways regulating voluntary movement and reward-based learning.
description_zh_TW: Medium spiny neurons 約占 striatum（尾狀核和殼核）神經元群的 90-95%。它們是基底神經節內皮質、丘腦和多巴胺能輸入的主要整合者。它們形成調節自主運動和獎賞學習的主要輸出途徑。

label: FSP1
description: FSP1 (ferroptosis suppressor protein 1, encoded by AIFM2) is a plasma-membrane flavoprotein NAD(P)H:ubiquinone oxidoreductase that constitutes the second major, glutathione-independent brake on ferroptosis, acting in parallel to GPX4. It was identified independently in 2019 by Doll et al. (Nature 575:693) and Bersuker et al. (Cell 177:1264) as a gene capable of rescuing cells from GPX4 loss.
description_zh_TW: FSP1（ferroptosis suppressor protein 1，由 AIFM2 編碼）是一種位於質膜的黃素蛋白 NAD(P)H:泛醌氧化還原酶，構成第二個主要的、不依賴谷胱甘肽的鐵死亡抑制系統，與 GPX4 平行運作。Doll et al.（Nature 575:693）與 Bersuker et al.（Cell 177:1264）於 2019 年各自獨立發現它是一個能在 GPX4 缺失時挽救細胞的基因的。

label: Coenzyme Q10
description: Ubiquinone (CoQ10, oxidized) is the direct electron acceptor for FSP1, a plasma-membrane flavoprotein that uses NAD(P)H to reduce CoQ10 to ubiquinol (CoQ10H2), a lipophilic radical-trapping antioxidant that terminates phospholipid peroxyl-radical chains and suppresses ferroptosis. This FSP1–CoQ10–NAD(P)H axis is glutathione-independent and acts in parallel to GPX4. Because CoQ10 is a non-sterol product of the mevalonate pathway, statin-mediated depletion starves FSP1 of substrate and sensitizes cells to ferroptosis.
description_zh_TW: 泛醌（CoQ10，氧化態）是 FSP1 的直接電子受體；FSP1 是一種質膜黃素蛋白，利用 NAD(P)H 將 CoQ10 還原為泛醇（CoQ10H2），後者是脂溶性自由基捕獲抗氧化劑，能終止磷脂過氧自由基鏈並抑制鐵死亡。這條 FSP1–CoQ10–NAD(P)H 軸不依賴谷胱甘肽，並與 GPX4 平行運作。由於 CoQ10 是甲羥戊酸路徑的非固醇產物，statin 介導的耗竭會使 FSP1 缺乏受質並使細胞對鐵死亡增敏。

label: Modafinil
description: Modafinil increases dopaminergic neurotransmission primarily by inhibiting the dopamine transporter (DAT), thereby elevating extracellular dopamine in the prefrontal cortex and striatum. It may also affect norepinephrine and orexin systems, contributing to its wakefulness-promoting effects. By raising dopamine tone, it interacts with the COMT-set baseline that differs by genotype, with fast COMT individuals showing greater improvement. It is approved for narcolepsy and used off-label for cognitive enhancement.
description_zh_TW: Modafinil 主要透過抑制多巴胺轉運蛋白 (DAT) 來增加 dopaminergic neurotransmission，從而提高前額葉皮質和紋狀體中的細胞外多巴胺。它還可能影響 norepinephrine 和食慾素系統，從而有助於其促進覺醒的作用。透過提高多巴胺張力，它與因基因型而異的 COMT 設定基線相互作用，快速的 COMT 個體表現出更大的改善。它被批准用於 narcolepsy 並用於標籤外認知增強。

label: DGCR8
description: Embryoid bodies are 3D aggregates formed when embryonic stem cells differentiate. DGCR8-deficient embryoid bodies failed to form cysts and showed abnormal lineage-marker expression, rescued by DGCR8 re-expression, confirming microRNAs are required for normal EB differentiation.
description_zh_TW: 類胚體（embryoid bodies）是胚胎幹細胞分化時形成的三維聚集體。缺乏 DGCR8 的類胚體無法形成囊泡並表現異常的譜系標記表現，可由 DGCR8 再表現挽救，證實 microRNA 為正常 EB 分化所需。

label: Obesity
description: Because stored fat is the difference between metabolizable energy intake and energy expenditure, chronic positive energy balance produces weight gain and drives the obesity epidemic, whereas negative balance produces weight loss. If Western food intake has been stable or declining, reduced physical activity (PAL ~1.66) must have tipped the budget positive.
description_zh_TW: 由於儲存的脂肪即代謝可利用能量攝取與能量消耗之間的差值，慢性正能量平衡會造成體重增加並驅動肥胖流行；負平衡則造成體重減輕。若西方飲食攝取量穩定或下降，則身體活動量降低（PAL 約 1.66）必然使能量預算轉正。

label: Cohesin
description: The cohesin ring complex holds sister chromatids together from replication to anaphase. Maintenance is the canonical ring function; canonical filename used.
description_zh_TW: cohesin 環複合體從複製到後期將姐妹染色單體繫在一起。維持是典型的環功能；使用典型檔名。

label: leukemia
description: Acute myeloid leukemia is the most common acute leukemia in adults and belongs to the broader disease category of leukemia. It is characterized by clonal expansion of immature myeloid blasts that fail to differentiate. AML is a distinct subtype within the leukemia family.
description_zh_TW: 急性骨髓性白血病是成人中最常見的急性白血病，屬於更廣泛的白血病疾病類別。其特徵是不成熟骨髓母細胞的克隆擴張且未能分化。AML 是白血病家族中的一個獨特亞型。

label: MethylB12
description: Methylcobalamin is an active coenzyme form of vitamin B12 that serves directly as a methyl donor, functioning as the cofactor for methionine synthase in homocysteine remethylation to methionine. By supplying methyl groups it supports SAMe generation and the methylation cycle, positioning it upstream of COMT's methyl donor supply. Its methyl-donating nature distinguishes it from adenosylcobalamin, which supports mitochondrial energy metabolism instead. It is a common supplement, though its methyl load requires caution in slow COMT individuals.
description_zh_TW: Methylcobalamin 是維生素 B12 的活性輔酶形式，直接充當 methyl donor，在同型半胱氨酸再甲基化為蛋氨酸過程中充當蛋氨酸合成酶的輔因子。透過供應 methyl groups，它支援 SAMe 世代和 methylation cycle，將其定位在 COMT 的 methyl donor 供應的上游。其提供甲基的性質使其與腺苷鈷胺素不同，腺苷鈷胺素支持粒線體能量代謝。它是一種常見的補充劑，但其甲基負荷對於緩慢的 COMT 個體需要謹慎。

label: Hydroxyurea
description: Hydroxyurea quenches the tyrosyl radical in the RRM2 small subunit of ribonucleotide reductase, inactivating the enzyme. It is used clinically in myeloproliferative neoplasms and is a canonical inducer of DNA replication stress and senescence.
description_zh_TW: Hydroxyurea 會淬滅核醣核苷酸還原酶 RRM2 小次單元中的酪胺醯自由基，使酵素失活。它在臨床上用於骨髓增生性腫瘤，並是 DNA 複製壓力與衰老的典型誘導劑。

label: MXL-3
description: The mammalian transcription factor MAX, a partner of MYC, is the functional homolog of C. elegans MXL-3, as expression of mouse MAX in worms rescued the mxl-3 mutant phenotype. This conservation indicates that the MYC/MAX network's repression of lysosomal and metabolic genes is an ancient feature retained from nematodes to mammals. The rescue experiment directly demonstrates mechanistic equivalence between the worm repressor and its mammalian counterpart. It strengthens the translational relevance of MXL-3 studies to human lipid and lysosomal regulation.
description_zh_TW: 哺乳動物轉錄因子 MAX（MYC 的夥伴）是線蟲 MXL-3 的功能性同源物，因為在線蟲中表現小鼠 MAX 能拯救 mxl-3 突變表型。這種保守性表明，MYC/MAX 網絡對溶酶體和代謝基因的抑制是從線蟲到哺乳動物都保留的古老特徵。拯救實驗直接證明了線蟲抑制因子與其哺乳動物對應物之間的機制等效性。它強化了 MXL-3 研究對人類脂質和溶酶體調節的轉譯相關性。

label: Oocyte
description: Oocyte cytoplasm reprograms donor nuclei in SCNT. Enablement is the maternal-factor mechanism.
description_zh_TW: 卵母細胞質在 SCNT 重編程供體核。賦能是母系因子機制。

label: Aspirin
description: Low-dose aspirin irreversibly acetylates COX-1 in platelets, suppressing Thromboxane A2 for the platelet's roughly 10-day lifespan. Endothelial Prostacyclin is largely spared because endothelium is nucleate and can resynthesize COX, and because low dose preferentially hits the platelet enzyme pool. This selectivity is the mechanistic basis of prophylaxis, and its loss with nonselective NSAIDs and COX-2 inhibitors is why those agents carry cardiovascular risk.
description_zh_TW: 低劑量 aspirin 不可逆地乙醯化血小板中的 COX-1，在血小板約 10 天的生命期中抑制 Thromboxane A2。內皮的 Prostacyclin 則大致被保留，因為內皮具有細胞核、可重新合成 COX，且低劑量優先作用於血小板的酵素儲備池。此選擇性是預防作用的機制基礎；而非選擇性 NSAID 與 COX-2 抑制劑喪失了這種選擇性，正是它們帶有心血管風險的原因。

label: Bcl-xL
source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md
description: Bcl-xL (B-cell lymphoma-extra large, BCL2L1) is a potent anti-apoptotic member of the Bcl-2 family, one of the four-BH-domain proteins (with Bcl-2, Bcl-w, A1-Bfl-1, Mcl-1) that counteract apoptosis by sequestering pro-apoptotic family members. It is a major regulator of the intrinsic mitochondrial apoptotic pathway.
description_zh_TW: Bcl-xL（B-cell lymphoma-extra large，BCL2L1）是 Bcl-2 家族作用強大的抗凋亡成員，屬於含四個 BH 結構域的蛋白群（與 Bcl-2、Bcl-w、A1-Bfl-1、Mcl-1 並列），藉由隔離促凋亡家族成員來抵銷凋亡。它是內在性粒線體凋亡路徑的主要調控者。

label: Luteolin
description: Luteolin has anti-inflammatory properties, inhibiting NF-kappaB and AP-1 signaling and suppressing pro-inflammatory cytokines such as TNF-alpha, IL-6, and IL-1beta. These actions contribute to its studied benefits in neuroinflammation, allergic responses, and metabolic inflammation. Its anti-inflammatory profile is independent of COMT, making it usable alongside COMT-sensitive individuals, though high doses can still interact with the enzyme via its catechol structure. It is a prominent flavonoid in anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective research.
description_zh_TW: Luteolin 具有 anti-inflammatory properties，抑制 NF-κB 和 AP-1 訊號傳導並抑制促發炎細胞因子，如 TNF-α、IL-6 和 IL-1β。這些作用有助於研究其在神經發炎、過敏反應和代謝發炎方面的益處。其抗發炎特性獨立於 COMT，使其可與 COMT 敏感個體一起使用，儘管高劑量仍可透過其兒茶酚結構與此酵素相互作用。它是抗發炎和神經保護研究中重要的黃酮類化合物。

label: MITF
description: MITF is the master bHLH-Zip transcription factor of melanocyte development and pigment production, driving expression of the melanin synthesis machinery including tyrosinase, TRP1 and DCT. These enzymes convert tyrosine into dopaquinone and downstream dopachrome and 5,6-dihydroxyindole intermediates that polymerize into melanins; because melanogenesis is redox-intensive and generates ortho-quinones and ROS, MITF indirectly governs the cell's capacity to buffer oxidative stress.
description_zh_TW: MITF 是黑色素細胞發育與色素產生的關鍵 bHLH-Zip 轉錄因子，驅動 tyrosinase、TRP1 與 DCT 等黑色素合成機制基因的表現。這些酵素將 tyrosine 轉為 dopaquinone，及其下游的 dopachrome 與 5,6-dihydroxyindole 中間體，再聚合為 melanins；由於黑色素生成屬氧化還原密集且會產生鄰醌與 ROS，MITF 間接支配細胞緩衝 oxidative stress 的能力。

label: Huntingtin
description: Huntington's Disease is an autosomal dominant neurodegenerative disorder caused by CAG trinucleotide repeat expansion in the HTT gene. Repeats of 36 or more produce full penetrance at ≥40 CAGs and juvenile-onset disease at ≥60, because the expanded polyglutamine tract makes mutant Huntingtin misfold and aggregate into amyloid-like fibrils whose N-terminal fragments are the most cytotoxic species.
description_zh_TW: Huntington's Disease 是一種由 HTT 基因 CAG 三核苷酸重複擴增所致的體染色體顯性神經退化疾病。重複數達 36 以上，≥40 CAG 為完全外顯率，≥60 則為幼年型，因為擴張的多麩醯胺酸束會使突變型 Huntingtin 錯誤折疊並聚集為類澱粉纖維，其中 N 端片段毒性最高。

label: Bioavailability
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Loading the senolytic flavonoid Fisetin into Human Serum Albumin nanoparticles (220 ± 8 nm, ~84% encapsulation, ~75% released over 72 h) overcomes the flavonoid's poor solubility and rapid clearance, and produced greater cytotoxicity against MCF-7 Breast Cancer cells than free Fisetin. Albumin encapsulation is thus a general strategy for delivering poorly bioavailable compounds.
description_zh_TW: 將衰老細胞毒殺類黃酮 Fisetin 裝載於 Human Serum Albumin 奈米粒子中（220 ± 8 nm、封裝率約 84%、72 小時釋放約 75%），可克服該類黃酮溶解度差與清除快的限制，對 MCF-7 Breast Cancer 細胞的毒性高於游離 Fisetin。因此白蛋白包封是提升難溶性化合物 Bioavailability 的一般策略。

label: ROS
description: OGD markedly increased intracellular superoxide/ROS production, peaking at 453% of control at 6 h. Brosimine B at 10 uM significantly lowered ROS only at the 3 h time point, with no effect at 6 or 24 h. The transient antioxidant effect parallels its early-window protection of viability.
description_zh_TW: OGD 顯著增加細胞內超氧陰離子／ROS 生成，在 6 小時達到對照組的 453%。10 uM Brosimine B 僅在缺氧後 3 小時顯著降低 ROS，6 小時與 24 小時無效。此短暫抗氧化效應與其早期存活率保護窗一致。

label: MYC
description: MYC antagonizes TFEB and TFE3 transcriptional activities at lysosomal gene promoters, thereby repressing lysosome biogenesis in proliferating cells. Through direct competition for CLEAR elements and broader chromatin effects, MYC suppresses the degradative capacity that would otherwise constrain growth. This repression aligns cellular resources toward biosynthesis rather than turnover during oncogenic drive. The MYC-lysosome antagonism is a key axis by which cancer cells reshape their degradative landscape.
description_zh_TW: MYC 在溶酶體基因啟動子處拮抗 TFEB 和 TFE3 的轉錄活性，從而在增殖細胞中抑制溶酶體生物發生。透過對 CLEAR 元件的直接競爭以及更廣泛的染色質效應，MYC 抑制了本會限制生長的降解能力。此抑制將細胞資源在致癌驅動下導向生物合成而非更新。MYC-溶酶體拮抗作用是癌細胞重塑其降解景觀的關鍵軸。

label: HMGB1
description: HMGB1 is a chromatin protein released as a damage-associated molecular pattern (DAMP) from dying or stressed cells.
description_zh_TW: HMGB1 是一種染色質蛋白，從死亡或受壓細胞中以損傷相關分子模式（DAMP）的形式釋放。

label: Cardiovascular Disease
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Impairment of mitochondrial dynamics contributes to various cardiovascular pathologies, including cardiac hypertrophy, heart failure, ischemia-reperfusion injury, and metabolic and genetic cardiomyopathy. In heart failure, mitochondrial fragmentation, vacuolar degeneration with decreased mitochondrial size and crista destruction are detected by electron microscopy alongside increased expression of DRP1, FIS1 and BNIP3 and decreased MFN1, MFN2 and OPA1. Excessive mitochondrial division with insufficient fusion is a common disease pattern, yet conflicting evidence exists, such as DRP1-knockout exacerbating myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury.
description_zh_TW: Impairment of mitochondrial dynamics contributes to various cardiovascular pathologies, including cardiac hypertrophy, heart failure, ischemia-reperfusion injury, and metabolic and genetic cardiomyopathy。In heart failure, mitochondrial fragmentation, vacuolar degeneration with decreased mitochondrial size and crista destruction are detected by electron microscopy alongside increased expression of DRP1, FIS1 and BNIP3 and decreased MFN1, MFN2 and OPA1。Excessive mitochondrial division with insufficient fusion is a common disease pattern, yet conflicting evidence exists, such as DRP1-knockout exacerbating myocardial ischemia-reperfusion injury。

label: Sirtris Pharmaceuticals
description: Sinclair co-founded Sirtris Pharmaceuticals (later acquired by GlaxoSmithKline) to develop STACs such as SRT1720 and SRT2104 as therapeutics. Directionally, the academic discovery was translated into a company. This drove clinical translation of sirtuin activators, and it illustrates the bench-to-bedside path of sirtuin research. By commercializing STACs, Sirtris aimed to develop drugs that reproduce the metabolic benefits of caloric restriction. Although clinical outcomes were mixed, the company's formation validated sirtuins as a druggable target class and stimulated industrial interest in longevity biology.
description_zh_TW: Sinclair 共同創辦了 Sirtris Pharmaceuticals（後被葛蘭素史克收購）以開發 SRT1720 和 SRT2104 等 STAC 作為治療藥物。在方向性上，學術發現被轉化為一家公司。這推動了 sirtuin 活化劑的臨床轉化，並說明了 sirtuin 研究從實驗室到床邊的路徑。透過商業化 STAC，Sirtris 旨在開發再現限制熱量代謝益處的藥物。儘管臨床結果不一，該公司的成立驗證了 sirtuin 作為可藥靶標類別的地位，並刺激了工業界對長壽生物學的興趣。

label: Pancreatic Cancer
description: PDA (pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma) accounts for approximately 85% of all pancreatic malignancies, arising from the ductal epithelium of the exocrine pancreas. It is among the most lethal cancers, with roughly 12% five-year survival across stages, and is projected to become the second leading cause of cancer death by 2030.
description_zh_TW: PDA（pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma）約佔所有胰臟惡性腫瘤的 85%，源自外分泌胰臟的導管上皮。它是最致命的癌症之一，各期合計五年存活率約 12%，並預計於 2030 年成為癌症死亡第二大原因。

label: D2 receptor
description: The D2 receptor modulates reward processing by inhibiting medium spiny neurons of the striatal indirect pathway, thereby shaping the salience and reinforcement of rewarding stimuli. Its activity integrates dopamine signals that govern motivated behavior, reward learning, and incentive motivation in the ventral striatum and nucleus accumbens. Dysregulation of D2 signaling, including reduced receptor availability, is implicated in addiction, obesity, and schizophrenia. Because dopamine availability is partly set by COMT, genotype can indirectly influence D2-mediated reward function.
description_zh_TW: D2 receptor 透過抑制紋狀體間接路徑的中型多棘神經元來調節 reward 處理，從而塑造獎勵刺激的顯著性和強化。其活性整合了控制動機行為的多巴胺訊號，reward learning，以及腹側紋狀體和伏隔核的激勵動機。 D2 訊號傳導失調，包括受體可用性降低，與成癮、肥胖和精神分裂症有關。由於多巴胺的可用性部分由 COMT 決定，因此基因型可以間接影響 D2 介導的 reward 功能。

label: Caspase-1
description: ASC polymerizes into specks that recruit pro-Caspase-1 via CARD interactions, enabling proximity-induced activation that cleaves Gasdermin D and pro-IL-1β/IL-18.
description_zh_TW: ASC 聚合成 specks，透過 CARD 相互作用招募 pro-Caspase-1，促成鄰近誘導活化，進而切割 Gasdermin D 與 pro-IL-1β/IL-18。

label: RAGE
description: Advanced glycation end products exert their biological effects through two mechanisms: a receptor-independent pathway involving direct protein damage and extracellular matrix disruption, and a receptor-mediated pathway engaging RAGE, the receptor for advanced glycation end products. Interaction of AGEs with RAGE triggers activation of the MAPK and PI3K pathways, leading to activation of the transcription factor NF-kB. Both endogenous and dietary AGEs act as RAGE ligands, and activation of RAGE signaling by dietary AGEs has been demonstrated in vitro, linking exogenous glycation load to pro-inflammatory intracellular signaling.
description_zh_TW: Advanced glycation end products exert their biological effects through two mechanisms：一為涉及direct protein damage與extracellular matrix disruption的receptor-independent pathway，另一為engaging RAGE（receptor for advanced glycation end products）的receptor-mediated pathway。AGEs與RAGE的interaction triggers activation of the MAPK與PI3K pathways，leading to activation of the transcription factor NF-kB。Both endogenous與dietary AGEs act as RAGE ligands，且dietary AGEs對RAGE signaling的activation已在in vitro被demonstrated，linking exogenous glycation load to pro-inflammatory intracellular signaling。

label: Microglia
description: Disease-Associated Microglia (DAM) denotes a stereotyped transcriptional and functional microglial activation state that emerges in Neurodegenerative Disease and Neuroinflammation. DAM microglia show altered expression of homeostatic markers and engage phagocytic and lipid-metabolism programmes, representing the brain's attempt to contain proteotoxic burden; the signature is regulated by cues such as TREM2.
description_zh_TW: Disease-Associated Microglia（DAM）指在 Neurodegenerative Disease 與 Neuroinflammation 中出現的一種刻板化轉錄與功能性的微膠細胞活化狀態。DAM 微膠細胞的穩態標記表現改變，並啟動吞噬與脂質代謝程式，代表腦部試圖圍堵蛋白毒性負荷；其特徵受 TREM2 等訊號調控。

label: Norepinephrine
description: The norepinephrine transporter is responsible for the reuptake of norepinephrine from the synaptic cleft into presynaptic terminals, terminating noradrenergic signaling and recycling the transmitter. As a member of the SLC6A family, NET is the primary determinant of noradrenergic tone in brain and periphery, and its blockade underlies many antidepressants and attention treatments. Its dopamine-reuptake capacity additionally links it to prefrontal dopamine regulation where DAT is sparse. It is a major target in psychopharmacology.
description_zh_TW: norepinephrine轉運蛋白負責將norepinephrine從突觸間隙重新攝取到突觸前末梢，終止去甲腎上腺素訊號傳導並回收發射器。作為 SLC6A 家族的一員，NET 是 brain 和周邊去甲腎上腺素能張力的主要決定因素，其阻斷是許多抗憂鬱藥物和注意力治療的基礎。它還具有多巴胺再攝取能力，與 DAT 稀疏的前額多巴胺調節有關。它是精神藥理學的一個主要目標。

label: Cellular Reprogramming
description: Cellular reprogramming erases somatic DNA methylation and other epigenetic marks to reset the cell to a pluripotent state. During iPSC generation, the Yamanaka factors promote active and passive demethylation of pluripotency gene promoters while somatic gene methylation is lost, and this global epigenetic reset is required for establishing the pluripotency gene network. The erasure of DNA methylation is a defining feature of the stochastic and deterministic phases of reprogramming. This epigenetic reset is what enables a differentiated cell to regain full developmental potential.
description_zh_TW: 細胞重編程會消除體細胞 DNA 甲基化和其他表觀遺傳標記，從而將細胞重置為多能狀態。在 iPSC 生成過程中，山中因子促進多能性基因啟動子主動和被動去甲基化，同時體細胞基因甲基化丟失，這種全局表觀遺傳重置是建立多能性基因網絡所必需的。 DNA 甲基化的消除是重編程隨機階段和確定性階段的決定性特徵。這種表觀遺傳重置使分化細胞能夠重新獲得全部發育潛力。

label: Colon Cancer
description: Colon cancer is a malignancy of the large intestine (colon) and represents a major subset of colorectal cancer. It is the third most commonly diagnosed cancer worldwide. Colon cancer shares the colorectal continuum with rectal cancer but is managed distinctly.
description_zh_TW: 結腸癌是大腸（結腸）的惡性腫瘤，代表結直腸癌的一個主要亞群。它是全球第三大最常被診斷的癌症。結腸癌與直腸癌共享結直腸連續體，但治療方式不同。

label: eNOS
description: eNOS (endothelial nitric oxide synthase, NOS3) is the constitutively expressed, calcium/calmodulin-dependent isoform of nitric oxide synthase in the vascular endothelium. It catalyses the conversion of L-arginine to low, pulsatile fluxes of nitric oxide, which diffuse to vascular smooth muscle and raise cGMP via soluble guanylyl cyclase to produce vasodilation.
description_zh_TW: eNOS（內皮型一氧化氮合成酶，NOS3）是血管內皮中構成性表現、依賴鈣離子/鈣調蛋白的 nitric oxide synthase 異構型。它催化 L-精胺酸轉化為低量脈動式的 nitric oxide；後者擴散至血管平滑肌，經可溶性鳥苷酸環化酶提高 cGMP，產生血管舒張。

label: Anaphase Promoting Complex-Cyclosome
description: The APC/C is a massive multi-subunit E3 ubiquitin ligase ordering mitotic degradation.
description_zh_TW: APC/C 是編排有絲分裂降解的巨大多亞基 E3 泛素連接酶。

label: EGCG
description: Green tea is the primary dietary source of EGCG, the dominant polyphenol of the beverage. EGCG is abundant in green tea, while its concentration is much lower in fermented teas such as black tea.
description_zh_TW: 綠茶是 EGCG 的主要膳食來源，EGCG 為綠茶中含量最高的多酚；在黑茶等發酵茶中，其濃度則大幅降低。

label: Caspase-8
description: Bid is activated by proteolytic cleavage, with caspase-8 the primary activating protease downstream of death-receptor engagement (caspase-2 and caspase-10 can also do so). Cleavage converts full-length Bid to tBid, which translocates to mitochondria; CK1/CK2 phosphorylation at Thr58/Ser61/Ser64 blocks the event.
description_zh_TW: Bid 經由蛋白水解切割而活化，其中 caspase-8 是死亡受體啟動後的主要活化酵素（caspase-2 與 caspase-10 亦可參與）。切割將全长 Bid 轉為 tBid，後者轉位至粒線體；CK1/CK2 在 Thr58/Ser61/Ser64 的磷酸化則阻斷此步驟。

label: SARM1
description: Axon Degeneration runs through a SARM1-dependent execution pathway: axonal injury causes NMNAT2 loss, the NMN/NAD+ ratio rises, SARM1 activates, NAD+ is catastrophically depleted, and energy failure produces fragmentation. Non-SARM1 routes such as Apoptosis or Autophagy-mediated pruning contribute in developmental and disease contexts.
description_zh_TW: Axon Degeneration 主要透過依賴 SARM1 的執行途徑進行：軸突損傷導致 NMNAT2 喪失，NMN／NAD+ 比值上升，SARM1 活化造成 NAD+ 災難性耗竭，導致能量衰竭與片段化。Apoptosis 或 Autophagy 介導的修剪等非 SARM1 途徑，則在發育與疾病情境中有所貢獻。

label: Cancer Stem Cells
description: Cancer Stem Cells drive Chemotherapy Resistance. Cancer stem cells are self-renewing subpopulations that seed tumors, resist therapy, and are enriched by EMT and inflammatory signaling. Chemotherapy resistance denotes the failure of cytotoxic drugs to kill tumor cells, arising through efflux, death-pathway suppression, and stem-cell states. The relationship is directional, with Cancer Stem Cells acting as the operative agent upon Chemotherapy Resistance rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Cancer Stem Cells 驅動Chemotherapy Resistance。 Cancer 幹細胞是自我更新的亞羣，它們會產生腫瘤、抵抗治療，並透過 EMT 和發炎訊號傳導而豐富。抗藥性是指細胞毒性藥物無法殺死腫瘤細胞，這是由於外流、死亡途徑抑制和幹細胞狀態而產生的。這種關係是有方向的，Cancer Stem Cells 充當 Chemotherapy Resistance 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: GPX4
description: GPX4 is the only enzyme that reduces phospholipid hydroperoxides inside the membrane, using its catalytic selenocysteine and two glutathione to convert LOOH to the inert lipid alcohol before the chain branches. Substituting cysteine for selenocysteine costs about 100-fold activity, and dietary Selenium loss removes the catalytic residue entirely, which is why selenium deficiency sensitizes tissue to ferroptosis.
description_zh_TW: GPX4 是唯一能在膜內還原磷脂質過氧化物的酵素，利用其催化的 selenocysteine 與兩個 glutathione 將 LOOH 轉為惰性的脂質醇，在鏈式反應分支之前完成。將 selenocysteine 換成 cysteine 會使活性下降約 100 倍，而飲食中 Selenium 流失則完全移除催化殘基，這也是 selenium 缺乏會讓組織易感鐵死亡的原因。

label: Cardiomyocytes
description: CPT2 is expressed at high levels in tissues with robust oxidative capacity - skeletal muscle, heart (cardiomyocytes), liver and kidney. Because the outer-membrane enzyme CPT1 is allosterically inhibited by malonyl-CoA while CPT2 is not, the CPT2 step of the carnitine shuttle is the rate-limiting entry point for long-chain fatty acid oxidation, supplying the matrix with acyl-CoA for beta-oxidation.
description_zh_TW: CPT2 在氧化能力強的組織中高度表現，包括骨骼肌、心臟（心肌細胞）、肝臟與腎臟。由於外膜酵素 CPT1 會被 malonyl-CoA 別構抑制，而 CPT2 不受此調控，肉鹼穿梭的第二步 CPT2 便是長鏈脂肪酸氧化的限速入口，負責在基質中提供 acyl-CoA 供 β-氧化使用。

label: Genomic Instability
description: Telomeres protect chromosome ends from being recognized as double-strand breaks, and telomere dysfunction deprotects chromosome ends contributing to genomic instability. Shortened or dysfunctional telomeres drive DNA-damage signaling and instability.
description_zh_TW: 端粒保護染色體末端不被辨識為雙股斷裂，而端粒功能障礙會去保護染色體末端，促成基因體不穩定。縮短或功能障礙的端粒驅動 DNA 損傷訊號與不穩定。

label: Heart
description: Heart releases Atrial natriuretic peptide when atrial cardiomyocytes are stretched. ANP acts through cGMP signaling to unload volume, providing a hormonal counterweight to the sympathetic drive on the Heart.
description_zh_TW: 當心房心肌細胞受到牽張時，Heart（心臟）會釋放 Atrial natriuretic peptide（心房利鈉胜肽）。ANP 透過 cGMP 訊號卸除體液量，對心臟的交感神經驅動形成荷爾蒙層面的對沖。

label: Neutrophils
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Neutrophils are white blood cells that generate large quantities of reactive oxygen species, primarily superoxide anion and hydroxyl radicals, during the respiratory burst that accompanies infection and inflammation. This burst is the basis of their microbicidal activity but also mediates non-specific oxidation reactions, including the conversion of epinephrine to adrenochrome both intracellularly and extracellularly. Neutrophil-derived oxidants also include hydrogen peroxide and products of myeloperoxidase. In the lungs and other tissues flooded by neutrophils during conditions such as pneumonia, ARDS, COPD exacerbations, and acute lung injury, this ROS production makes epinephrine-to-adrenochrome oxidation a prominent local reaction.
description_zh_TW: 中性球是在感染與發炎伴隨的呼吸爆發期間產生大量活性氧物種（主要為超氧陰離子與羥基自由基）的白血球。此爆發是其殺微生物活性的基礎，但也介導非特異性氧化反應，包括在細胞內與細胞外將 epinephrine 轉化為 adrenochrome。中性球衍生的氧化劑也包括過氧化氫與 myeloperoxidase 的產物。在肺炎、ARDS、COPD 急性惡化與急性肺損傷等情況下被中性球淹沒的肺部與其他組織中，此 ROS 產生使 epinephrine 至 adrenochrome 的氧化成為顯著的局部反應。

label: EZH2
source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence orchestrating SASP expression.md
description: EZH2 is the catalytic PRC2 subunit within the histone methyltransferase family.
description_zh_TW: EZH2 是組蛋白甲基轉移酶家族中的催化 PRC2 次單元。

label: Mitochondrial Biogenesis
description: In the AMPK-PGC-1α Pathway, energy stress raises AMPK activity, AMPK phosphorylates PGC-1α, and the coactivator partners with transcription factors such as NRFs and ERRα to induce nuclear-encoded mitochondrial genes, elevating mitochondrial number, capacity, ATP output and stress resistance.
description_zh_TW: 在 AMPK-PGC-1α Pathway 中，能量壓力提升 AMPK 活性，AMPK 磷酸化 PGC-1α，後者再與 NRF、ERRα 等轉錄因子合作誘導核編碼的粒線體基因，提升粒線體數量、容量、ATP 產出與抗逆境能力。

label: Preparation for Oxidative Stress
description: Oliveira et al. propose that Preparation for Oxidative Stress (POS) is an example of physiological conditioning hormesis. Mild hypoxia-driven oxidant production preconditions animals so they tolerate a stronger reoxygenation redox challenge, matching the biphasic preconditioning pattern of hormesis.
description_zh_TW: Oliveira 等人提出 Preparation for Oxidative Stress (POS) 是生理性制約 hormesis 的一個例子。輕度缺氧引發的氧化物產生可預先調節動物，使其耐受隨後更強的再氧合氧化還原挑戰，符合 hormesis 的雙相預處理模式。
