label: STACs
description: A matter of controversy is that sirtuin activation by resveratrol and the SRT compounds could frequently only be demonstrated with fluorescently tagged substrates, raising the possibility of assay artifacts. Alternative explanations invoke indirect activation: resveratrol activates SIRT1 in vivo through its effect on cAMP signaling, specifically the cAMP-Epac1-AMPK pathway, and other STACs may act similarly given their analogous metabolic effects. Directionally, the claimed direct SIRT1 activation by STACs is questioned, and their in vivo benefits may be mediated by other pathways. This controversy shaped the rigorous characterization of STAC chemistry and calls for non-fluorescent assay confirmation.
description_zh_TW: 一個爭議問題是 resveratrol 和 SRT 化合物對 sirtuin 的活化經常只能透過螢光標記的受質來驗證，引發了試驗假象的可能性。替代解釋涉及間接活化：resveratrol 透過其對 cAMP 訊號的影響（特別是 cAMP-Epac1-AMPK 途徑）在體內活化 SIRT1，而其他 STAC 由於相似的代謝效果可能以類似方式作用。方向性上 STAC 所聲稱的直接 SIRT1 活化受到質疑，其體內益處可能由其他途徑介導。此爭議塑造了對 STAC 化學的嚴謹表徵，並要求非螢光試驗確認。

label: Stroke
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Stroke is a medical emergency caused by interruption of blood supply to the brain, with ~87% of cases ischemic from thrombus or embolus. Its pathophysiology runs through the Ischemia-reperfusion Injury cascade, in which Oxidative Stress, Inflammation, Excitotoxicity and Apoptosis act together to produce tissue damage and neurological deficits.
description_zh_TW: Stroke 是腦部血流中斷所造成的醫療急症，約 87% 屬血栓或栓塞造成的 ischemic stroke。其病理生理經由 Ischemia-reperfusion Injury 級聯反應，過程中 Oxidative Stress、Inflammation、Excitotoxicity 與 Apoptosis 共同作用，造成組織損傷與神經功能缺損。

label: Antioxidant
description: Antioxidants inhibit or delay oxidative stress by neutralizing or scavenging reactive oxygen species and free radicals. Endogenous systems include superoxide dismutase (dismutates superoxide to hydrogen peroxide), catalase (converts hydrogen peroxide to water and oxygen), glutathione peroxidase and glutathione, while vitamin C and vitamin E act as exogenous lipid- and water-soluble scavengers. Loss of this capacity contributes to atherosclerosis, aging and neurodegeneration.
description_zh_TW: Antioxidant 藉由中和或清除活性氧與自由基來抑制或延緩氧化壓力。內源性系統包括 superoxide dismutase（將超氧陰離子歧化為過氧化氫）、catalase（將過氧化氫轉為水與氧）、glutathione peroxidase 與 glutathione，而 vitamin C 與 vitamin E 則作為外源性的脂溶性與水溶性清除劑。此防禦能力的喪失與動脈粥狀硬化、老化及神經退行性疾病有關。

label: Energy Expenditure
description: Doubly-labelled water (DLW), the criterion field method, tracks total daily CO2 production from isotopically labelled water (2H and 18O) over 1-3 weeks, giving a measure of free-living daily energy expenditure. Indirect calorimetry instead measures O2 consumption and CO2 production to compute expenditure during RMR measurement or exercise.
description_zh_TW: 雙標水（DLW）為公認的現場標準方法，以同位素標記水（2H 與 18O）在 1 至 3 週內追蹤每日總 CO2 產生量，得到自由生活狀態下的每日能量消耗。間接測熱法則測量 O2 消耗與 CO2 產生，以計算休息代謝率測定或運動期間的能量消耗。

label: Sirtuin Inhibitors
description: Sirtuin fluorimetric activity assays (e.g., the Fluor de Lys system) are the most commonly used methods to screen molecules as sirtuin inhibitors. Deacetylation of a fluorophore-decoupled substrate sensitizes it to a developer that releases a measurable fluorophore, and percent inhibition is calculated from fluorescence. These assays identified indoles (EX-527), tenovins, JGB1741, sirtinol analogues, and cambinol analogues. A key caveat is that the aminomethylcoumarin moiety of the fluorogenic substrates can affect binding of other small molecules to the enzyme, so confirmation with orthogonal assays is recommended.
description_zh_TW: Sirtuin 螢光活性測定（例如 Fluor de Lys 系統）是篩選分子作為 sirtuin 抑制劑最常用的方法。去乙醯化的螢光基團解偶聯受質經顯色劑處理後釋放出可量化的螢光基團，從螢光訊號計算抑制百分比。這些測定鑑定了吲哚類（EX-527）、tenovin、JGB1741、sirtinol 類似物和 cambinol 類似物。一個關鍵注意事項是螢光受質的氨基甲基香豆素部分可能影響其他小分子與酵素的結合，因此建議使用正交測定進行確認。

label: Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine
description: Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine (AMM) is a stabilized hybrid derivative formed by reaction of adrenochrome with aminoguanidine. It is more stable and less colored than the parent molecule, whose o-quinone structure is unstable, and like carbazochrome it is used as a hemostatic agent.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine（AMM）是 Adrenochrome 與 Aminoguanidine 反應形成的穩定化雜交衍生物。它比母體（具有不穩定的 o-quinone 結構）更穩定、顏色更淺，且與 Carbazochrome 同樣用作止血劑。

label: Senolytics
description: The combination of Dasatinib and Quercetin (D+Q) was the first rationally identified senolytic, targeting SCAPs such as Bcl-2 family members and PI3K-delta. Intermittent D+Q treatment improves frailty, osteoporosis, cardiovascular function, and pulmonary fibrosis in aged or progeroid mice, motivating the search for more potent single-agent flavonoids like Fisetin.
description_zh_TW: Dasatinib 與 Quercetin 的合併使用（D+Q）是首個以假說驅動方式發現的 senolytic，可攻擊 Bcl-2 家族成員及 PI3K-delta 等 SCAPs。間歇性 D+Q 治療能改善年老或早衰小鼠的衰弱、骨質疏鬆、心血管功能與肺纖維化，也因此促成尋找如 Fisetin 這類更強效單一成分類黃酮的研究。

label: Polyphenols
description: At low doses polyphenols stimulate endogenous antioxidant defenses, but at high concentrations such as concentrated supplements they act as potent pro-oxidants causing oxidative damage. Examples include liver damage from high-dose green tea catechins, illustrating the biphasic benefit-to-harm transition.
description_zh_TW: 低劑量 Polyphenols 可刺激內源性抗氧化防禦，但在高濃度（如濃縮補充劑）下則成為強效促氧化劑並造成氧化損傷。例如高劑量綠茶兒茶素可能導致肝損傷，說明了從有益到有害的雙相轉換。

label: Tumor Suppressor Gene
description: p53 is the definitional tumor suppressor gene of cancer biology. Classification is textbook.
description_zh_TW: p53 是癌症生物學定義性的腫瘤抑制基因。歸類為教科書等級。

label: PINK1
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: More than 50 pathogenic PINK1 mutations cause autosomal recessive early-onset Parkinson's disease, the second most common genetic cause after PRKN; mutations cluster in the kinase domain and impair catalytic activity.
description_zh_TW: 超過 50 個致病性 PINK1 突變會造成體染色體隱性早發型帕金森氏症，是僅次於 PRKN 的第二常見遺傳原因；突變集中於激酶結構域並損害催化活性。

label: TGFβ
description: BMP is a large subfamily of secreted growth factors within the TGFβ superfamily; synthesized as precursors and cleaved to mature C-terminal dimers stabilized by an intramolecular cystine knot, BMPs signal through type I/II serine-threonine kinase receptors to form morphogen gradients.
description_zh_TW: BMP 是 TGFβ 超家族中一大分泌型生長因子亞家族；它們先以前驅物合成，再被切割釋出由分子內 cystine knot 穩定的 C 端成熟二聚體，並透過第一型／第二型絲胺酸－蘇胺酸激酶受體傳訊，形成形態發生的濃度梯度。

label: Heart Failure
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Levels of Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) are significantly decreased in cardiomyocytes from individuals with advanced heart failure, along with MnSOD and Bcl-xL. This loss of the protective thioredoxin system is thought to reduce cardiac resistance to pathologic insults in end-stage disease.
description_zh_TW: 在晚期心臟衰竭患者的心肌細胞中，Thioredoxin-1 (Trx1) 的濃度會顯著下降，MnSOD 與 Bcl-xL 亦然。此保護性硫氧還蛋白系統的喪失被認為會降低末期疾病中心臟對病理傷害的抵抗能力。

label: Iron
description: Iron causes Oxidative Stress by acting as the upstream trigger whose downstream consequence is the second entity's appearance or dysfunction. The mechanism typically involves oxidative, mitochondrial, or proteotoxic injury in the case of neurotoxins and pigments, or receptor blockade and cell loss in pharmacological and degenerative contexts. This causal relationship is clinically significant because it models or explains features of Parkinson's disease pathology and guides therapeutic targeting. A caveat is that in many of these links the causal claim is experimental, partial, or operates within a broader network of cofactors rather than as an isolated linear event.
description_zh_TW: Iron 透過充當上游觸發器來導致 Oxidative Stress，其下游結果是第二個實體的出現或功能障礙。此機制通常涉及氧化、mitochondria1或neurotoxin和色素情況下的蛋白毒性損傷，或藥理學和退化環境中的受體阻斷和細胞損失。這種因果關係具有臨床意義，因為它模擬或解釋了 Parkinson's disease 病理特徵並指導治療目標。需要注意的是，在許多這些連結中，因果關係的主張是實驗性的、部分的，或是在更廣泛的輔助因子網絡中運作的，而不是作為一個孤立的線性事件。

label: Androgen Receptor
description: Enzalutamide (Xtandi) is a second-generation androgen receptor (AR) antagonist that blocks AR nuclear translocation.
description_zh_TW: Enzalutamide (Xtandi) 是一種第二代雄激素受體 (AR) 拮抗劑，阻斷 AR 核轉位。

label: Amyloid Beta
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Amyloid plaque pathology is central to Alzheimer disease. Involvement records the defining lesion.
description_zh_TW: 類澱粉斑塊病理是阿茲海默病的核心。涉及記錄定義性病灶。

label: EGFR
description: Lung Cancer is driven by EGFR. Lung cancer, especially non-small-cell lung cancer, is the leading cause of cancer death and is frequently driven by EGFR or KRAS alterations. EGFR is a receptor tyrosine kinase whose activating mutations and overexpression couple extracellular cues to proliferative and survival signaling. The directionality runs from EGFR toward Lung Cancer, so EGFR is the active agent and Lung Cancer the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Lung Cancer 由EGFR 驅動。 Lung Cancer，尤其是非小細胞Lung Cancer，是癌症死亡的主要原因，並且經常由EGFR或KRAS改變驅動。 EGFR 是一種受體酪胺酸激酶，其活化突變和過度表現將細胞外訊號與增殖和生存訊號傳導結合。方向性從EGFR向Lung Cancer延伸，因此EGFR是活性劑，Lung Cancer是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: HIV-1
description: HIV-1 is the causative agent of the global AIDS pandemic. Infection leads to progressive CD4+ T cell depletion through direct viral killing, bystander apoptosis, pyroptosis of abortively infected cells and chronic immune activation; once CD4 counts fall below 200 cells/µL the host becomes susceptible to opportunistic infections such as Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia, tuberculosis and toxoplasmosis.
description_zh_TW: HIV-1 是全球 AIDS 大流行的致病因子。感染會透過直接病毒殺傷、旁觀細胞 apoptosis、abortively infected 細胞的 pyroptosis 與慢性免疫活化，造成 CD4+ T 細胞逐步耗竭；當 CD4 數低於 200 cells/µL，宿主便容易出現 Pneumocystis jirovecii pneumonia、tuberculosis 與 toxoplasmosis 等伺機性感染。

label: IL-6
description: IL-6 is a prototypical SASP cytokine and one of the most consistently secreted factors in senescent cells, acting as an essential mediator of paracrine senescence and immune modulation. It signals through JAK/STAT3 to promote inflammation and, in some contexts, stemness, and it is widely used as a biomarker of the senescent secretome and of aging. IL-6 also contributes to the feed-forward loop sustaining the SASP and to inflammaging. Its prominence and reliability make it a canonical reference SASP component, frequently measured with IL-8.
description_zh_TW: 介白素-6（IL-6）與 IL-8 同為衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）中最知名的細胞激素之一。衰老細胞分泌 IL-6，重塑局部組織微環境並發揮旁分泌效應，甚至將衰老表型傳播給健康細胞。在本研究中，重組 IL-6（以 2:1 比例與 IL-8 合併）在增生細胞中誘導酸性神經醯胺酶表現並提高脂質過氧化，使旁觀細胞對鐵死亡敏感，並放大組織功能障礙。

label: Paracrine Senescence
description: Notch is essential for establishing Paracrine Senescence: senescent cells stimulate Notch signaling in neighboring cells, propagating the arrested, SASP-producing state, though the SASP of these secondary senescent cells is weaker and may limit runaway spread.
description_zh_TW: Notch 對建立 Paracrine Senescence 至關重要：衰老細胞會刺激鄰近細胞的 Notch 訊號，傳播停滯且產生 SASP 的狀態；不過次級衰老細胞的 SASP 較弱，可限制失控擴散。

label: Nucleus
description: In C. elegans, mitochondrial dysfunction caused by protein misfolding alters the subcellular localization of the transcription factor ATFS-1. In healthy mitochondria, ATFS-1 is imported into the organelle and degraded by the Lon protease. During stress, ATFS-1 instead traffics to the nucleus to drive transcription of genes involved in the coordinated UPRmt response. This import-versus-nuclear-translocation decision makes protein import a readout of mitochondrial health, a paradigm the review argues is extended in mammals by mechanisms involving DELE1 processing and PINK1 accumulation.
description_zh_TW: 在線蟲中，蛋白質錯誤摺疊引起的粒線體功能障礙會改變轉錄因子ATFS-1的亞細胞定位。在健康的粒線體中，ATFS-1被輸入胞器內並由Lon蛋白酶降解。在壓力期間，ATFS-1則改而運輸至細胞核，驅動協調性UPRmt反應相關基因的轉錄。這種「輸入粒線體」與「轉位至細胞核」的抉擇，使蛋白質輸入成為粒線體健康狀態的讀數；該綜述主張此範式在哺乳類中經由涉及DELE1加工與PINK1累積的機制獲得延伸。

label: MAPK
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: RAS/MAPK is a canonical c-Met effector arm for proliferation. Activation covers the mitogenic output.
description_zh_TW: RAS/MAPK 是 c-Met 增殖的典型效應臂。活化涵蓋促有絲分裂輸出。

label: Hippocampus
description: The hippocampus is critically involved in memory consolidation, the process by which newly acquired information is stabilized into long-term storage via hippocampal-neocortical dialogue and synaptic plasticity. COMT expressed in the hippocampus modulates the catecholamine tone that supports this plasticity, linking the enzyme to memory processes beyond the prefrontal cortex. Hippocampal integrity is therefore sensitive to COMT-dependent dopaminergic and noradrenergic signaling, and its dysfunction is central to amnesia and age-related cognitive decline. The region's plasticity mechanisms are fundamental to learning.
description_zh_TW: 海馬體在 memory consolidation 中發揮至關重要的作用，memory consolidation 是新獲得的資訊透過海馬體新皮質對話和 synaptic plasticity 穩定並長期儲存的過程。海馬體中表達的 COMT 調節支持這種可塑性的兒茶酚胺基調，將該酶與前額葉皮質以外的記憶過程聯繫起來。因此，海馬完整性對 COMT 依賴性多巴胺能和去甲腎上腺素能訊號傳導敏感，其功能障礙是健忘症和年齡相關認知能力下降的核心。該區域的可塑性機制是學習的基礎。

label: Methylfolate
description: Methylfolate (5-methyltetrahydrofolate) is the active, methylated circulating form of folate produced by MTHFR and absorbed directly from diet or supplements. It donates its methyl group to homocysteine via methionine synthase, supporting methionine and SAMe synthesis, the methyl donor supply for COMT. As the bioactive folate, it is central to the methylation cycle that feeds COMT and to homocysteine regulation. Its production is impaired by MTHFR variants, which is why supplementation is common.
description_zh_TW: Methylfolate（5-甲基四氫葉酸）是 folate 的活性甲基化循環形式，由 MTHFR 產生，可直接從飲食或補充劑中吸收。它透過蛋氨酸合成酶將其甲基提供給同型半胱氨酸，支持蛋氨酸和 SAMe 的合成，methyl donor 為 COMT 供應。作為生物活性 folate，它對於為 COMT 提供營養的 methylation cycle 和同型半胱氨酸調節至關重要。 MTHFR variants 會損害其生成，這就是為什麼補充很常見的原因。

label: MLKL
description: During phagocytosis, TAM kinases (Tyro3, Axl, Mer) activated by phosphatidylserine directly phosphorylate MLKL in inflammatory disease.
description_zh_TW: 吞噬作用期間，經磷脂醯絲胺酸活化的TAM激酶（Tyro3、Axl、Mer）可直接磷酸化MLKL，見於發炎相關疾病。

label: Insulin Resistance
description: When it is over-activated by nutrients and insulin, mTOR acts via S6K1 to inhibit insulin signaling, thereby causing insulin resistance. Acute treatment with rapamycin abrogates insulin resistance in cells and animals including humans, and one study shows chronic treatment with rapamycin may also prevent insulin resistance. However, in some rodent models chronic rapamycin treatment can cause glucose intolerance and insulin resistance, which is interpreted as a benevolent starvation pseudo-diabetes (SPD), a reversible condition that does not lead to complications and resembles the metabolic state of prolonged fasting.
description_zh_TW: 當被營養素和胰島素過度活化時，mTOR透過S6K1抑制胰島素信號，從而導致胰島素抵抗。急性雷帕霉素治療可消除細胞和動物（包括人類）的胰島素抵抗，一項研究顯示慢性雷帕霉素治療也可能預防胰島素抵抗。然而，在某些囓齒類模型中，慢性雷帕霉素治療可能導致葡萄糖不耐受和胰島素抵抗，這被解釋為一種良性飢餓假性糖尿病（SPD），一種可逆且不會導致併發症的狀態，類似於長期禁食的代謝狀態。

label: Neurodegenerative Diseases
source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md
description: Alzheimer disease is the most common dementia and neurodegenerative disorder. Classification nests it in the disease family.
description_zh_TW: 阿茲海默病是最常見的失智與神經退化疾病。歸類將它嵌套於疾病家族。

label: Schizophrenia
description: The Dopamine hypothesis models the symptoms of Schizophrenia as arising from disturbed, hyperactive dopaminergic signal transduction, with emphasis on neurotransmitter receptor activity. It superseded the earlier Adrenochrome Hypothesis, which had attributed schizophrenia to oxidative catecholamine metabolites such as adrenochrome, and thereby redirected research toward Dopamine receptor pharmacology.
description_zh_TW: Dopamine hypothesis 將 Schizophrenia 的症狀歸因於受干擾且過度活躍的多巴胺訊息傳遞，強調神經傳遞受體的活性。它取代了較早將精神分裂症歸因於 adrenochrome 等兒茶酚胺氧化代謝物的 Adrenochrome Hypothesis，將研究重心轉向 Dopamine 受體藥理學。

label: Methylation Cycle
description: Folinic acid supports the methylation cycle by contributing one-carbon units that enable remethylation of homocysteine to methionine and production of SAMe. Because it is not delivered as the fully methylated end product, it provides folate capacity without an immediate methyl hit. This makes it a gentler option than methylfolate for slow COMT individuals.
description_zh_TW: Folinic acid 透過提供一碳單位來支援 methylation cycle，這些一碳單位使同型半胱氨酸再甲基化為蛋氨酸並產生 SAMe。由於它並非以完全甲基化的終產物形式提供，因此能在沒有立即甲基衝擊的情況下提供葉酸能力。這使其成為緩慢 COMT 個體比 methylfolate 更溫和的選擇。

label: Hydroxocobalamin
description: Hydroxocobalamin is a precursor to the two active coenzyme forms of vitamin B12, methylcobalamin and adenosylcobalamin, being intracellularly reduced and alkylated to whichever coenzyme is required. This makes it a versatile B12 source that supports both the methylation cycle, via methylcobalamin for methionine synthase, and mitochondrial energy metabolism, via adenosylcobalamin for methylmalonyl-CoA mutase. Its precursor status distinguishes it from the directly active methyl-donating form, allowing physiological regulation of coenzyme production. This flexibility underlies its clinical use in B12 repletion.
description_zh_TW: Hydroxocobalamin 是兩種活性輔酶形式維生素 B12（甲基鈷胺素和腺苷鈷胺素）的前體，在細胞內還原並烷基化為所需的輔酶。這使其成為多功能 B12 來源，可透過甲硫胺酸合成酶的甲基鈷胺素支持 methylation cycle，並透過甲基丙二酸單醯輔酶 A 變位酶的腺苷鈷胺素支持粒線體能量代謝。其前驅狀態使其有別於直接活性的甲基供體形式，從而可以對輔酶產生進行生理調節。這種靈活性是其在補充 B12 方面的臨床應用的基礎。

label: Protein Restriction
description: FGF21 is the primary endocrine mediator of protein restriction's metabolic benefits. PR robustly elevates FGF21 in mice, rats, and humans, and FGF21 is required for many of PR's effects - increased food intake, reduced body weight, increased energy expenditure, and extended lifespan. Other geroprotective diets including calorie restriction, methionine restriction, BCAA restriction, and isoleucine restriction also induce FGF21. Mice overexpressing Fgf21 show ~30% (males) and ~40% (females) lifespan extension, while Fgf21-null mice do not live longer on PR. FGF21 also suppresses senescence and inflammation in white adipose tissue and reduces hepatic steatosis and fibrosis in obese models.
description_zh_TW: FGF21是蛋白質限制代謝益處的主要內分泌介質。PR在小鼠、大鼠和人類中強力提升FGF21，FGF21是PR許多效應所必需的——增加食物攝入、減少體重、增加能量消耗和延長壽命。其他抗老化飲食包括熱量限制、甲硫氨酸限制、BCAA限制和異亮氨酸限制也誘導FGF21。過表達Fgf21的小鼠顯示約30%（雄性）和約40%（雌性）的壽命延長，而Fgf21缺失小鼠在PR下壽命未延長。FGF21也抑制白色脂肪組織的衰老和發炎，並減少肥胖模型中的肝臟脂肪變性和纖維化。

label: Norepinephrine transporter
description: The norepinephrine transporter is responsible for the reuptake of norepinephrine from the synaptic cleft into presynaptic terminals, terminating noradrenergic signaling and recycling the transmitter. As a member of the SLC6A family, NET is the primary determinant of noradrenergic tone in brain and periphery, and its blockade underlies many antidepressants and attention treatments. Its dopamine-reuptake capacity additionally links it to prefrontal dopamine regulation where DAT is sparse. It is a major target in psychopharmacology.
description_zh_TW: norepinephrine轉運蛋白負責將norepinephrine從突觸間隙重新攝取到突觸前末梢，終止去甲腎上腺素訊號傳導並回收發射器。作為 SLC6A 家族的一員，NET 是 brain 和周邊去甲腎上腺素能張力的主要決定因素，其阻斷是許多抗憂鬱藥物和注意力治療的基礎。它還具有多巴胺再攝取能力，與 DAT 稀疏的前額多巴胺調節有關。它是精神藥理學的一個主要目標。

label: DNMT1
description: DNMT1 is the maintenance methyltransferase that copies parental-origin methylation at imprinting control regions through mitosis, preserving Genomic Imprinting marks in every daughter cell.
description_zh_TW: DNMT1 是維持型甲基轉移酶，透過有絲分裂複製親代來源在 imprinting 控制區（ICR）的甲基化，在每個子細胞中保存 Genomic Imprinting（基因組印記）標記。

label: IL-1β
description: Anakinra competitively blocks the binding of both IL-1α and IL-1β to IL-1R1, shutting off IL-1-mediated inflammatory signalling. By blocking IL-1β signalling it reduces senescence-associated secretory phenotype output from senescent cells and lowers the paracrine inflammatory burden that drives inflammaging, making it a prototype senomorphic agent.
description_zh_TW: Anakinra 競爭性阻斷 IL-1α 與 IL-1β 與 IL-1R1 的結合，關閉 IL-1 介導的發炎訊息傳遞。藉由阻斷 IL-1β 訊號，它可減少衰老細胞的衰老相關分泌表型輸出，降低驅動 inflammaging 的旁分泌發炎負擔，因此是典型的 senomorphic 藥物。

label: Heterochromatin
description: Heterochromatin keeps Transposable Elements such as LINE-1 transcriptionally silent, preventing them from being transcribed and reinserted elsewhere in the genome. When heterochromatin is lost or 'relaxes' toward Euchromatin, these elements become inappropriately activated, contributing to Genomic Instability and age-related cellular decline.
description_zh_TW: Heterochromatin 會使 LINE-1 等 Transposable Elements 維持轉錄靜默，阻止它們被轉錄並重新插入基因組其他位置。當異染色質流失、朝 Euchromatin「鬆弛」時，這些元件會被不適當地活化，促成 Genomic Instability 與年齡相關的細胞衰退。

label: Mitochondrial Fusion
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Mitochondrial dynamics is the continuous remodeling of the cellular mitochondrial network through fusion and fission, two opposing yet coordinated processes that determine mitochondrial number, shape and function. Fusion joins two organelles into a tubular network, enabling content exchange, dilution of mutated mtDNA and superoxide, and maintenance of genetic and biochemical homogeneity; it proceeds through membrane tethering, outer membrane fusion and inner membrane fusion. Fusion is orchestrated by the dynamin-related GTPases MFN1 and MFN2 for the outer membrane and OPA1 for the inner membrane, and must be balanced with fission to sustain mitochondrial homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial dynamics 是通過 fusion and fission 兩個 opposing yet coordinated processes 進行的 continuous remodeling of the cellular mitochondrial network，determining mitochondrial number, shape and function。Fusion joins two organelles into a tubular network，enabling content exchange, dilution of mutated mtDNA and superoxide，and maintenance of genetic and biochemical homogeneity；it proceeds through membrane tethering, outer membrane fusion and inner membrane fusion。Fusion is orchestrated by the dynamin-related GTPases MFN1 and MFN2 for the outer membrane and OPA1 for the inner membrane，and must be balanced with fission to sustain mitochondrial homeostasis。

label: TNFα
description: NF-kB is the primary downstream transcription factor of TNF receptor signaling. Activation is distinct from the TNF-Signaling convergence edge.
description_zh_TW: NF-κB 是 TNF 受體訊號的主要下游轉錄因子。活化不同於 TNF 訊號匯聚邊。

label: Blood-Brain Barrier
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Honokiol, a lipid-soluble lignan extracted from Magnolia species, readily crosses the blood-brain barrier to exert its effects in the central nervous system, including anti-tumorigenic and neuroprotective actions. Its lipid solubility allows it to pass lipid bilayers and act at multiple intracellular and membrane sites, a property shared with the structurally related anesthetic propofol and the analog magnolol. BBB penetration is a prerequisite for honokiol's anxiolytic, analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and anti-seizure activities in the brain.
description_zh_TW: 厚朴酚是從木蘭屬（Magnolia）植物中提取的脂溶性木脂素，能輕易穿越血腦屏障，在中樞神經系統中發揮作用，包括抗腫瘤生成與神經保護作用。其脂溶性使其能穿過脂質雙層，作用於多個細胞內與膜上的位點，此特性與結構相關的麻醉劑丙泊酚及類似物和厚朴酚共通。穿透血腦屏障是厚朴酚在大腦中發揮抗焦慮、鎮痛、抗發炎與抗癲癇活性的先決條件。

label: Chemotherapy
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: BH3 mimetics synergizes with Chemotherapy. BH3 mimetics are small molecules that occupy the hydrophobic groove of anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 proteins, freeing Bax/Bak to kill tumor cells. Chemotherapy uses cytotoxic agents to kill rapidly dividing cells, and its efficacy is limited by innate and acquired resistance mechanisms. The relationship is directional, with BH3 mimetics acting as the operative agent upon Chemotherapy rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: BH3 mimetics 與 Chemotherapy 具有協同作用。 BH3 mimetics 是佔據抗凋亡 Bcl-2 蛋白疏水溝的小分子，釋放 Bax/Bak 來殺死腫瘤細胞。 Chemotherapy 使用細胞毒性劑殺死快速分裂的細胞，其功效受到先天和後天抗藥性機制的限制。這種關係是有方向的，BH3 mimetics 充當Chemotherapy 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Chromatin
description: Histone acetylation opens chromatin by neutralizing the positive charge of lysine residues on histone tails, weakening their electrostatic interaction with the negatively charged DNA backbone. This relaxes nucleosome compaction and increases the accessibility of DNA to transcription factors and other regulatory proteins, promoting gene expression. Acetylation is dynamically deposited by histone acetyltransferases and removed by histone deacetylases, and the balance between these activities tunes chromatin structure across the genome.
description_zh_TW: Histone 乙醯化透過中和組蛋白尾部離胺酸殘基的正電荷來打開染色質，削弱它們與帶負電的 DNA 主鏈的靜電相互作用。這放鬆了核小體的壓縮並增加了 DNA 與轉錄因子和其他調節蛋白的可及性，從而促進了 gene expression。乙醯化由組蛋白乙醯轉移酶動態沉積並由組蛋白去乙醯酶去除，這些活性之間的平衡調節整個基因組的染色質結構。

label: NLRP3
description: Uric Acid Crystals activate NLRP3 in joints, making gout the prototypical acquired autoinflammatory disease; the same inflammasome is triggered by other endogenous danger signals such as Silica, oxidized Cardiolipin and mitochondrial DNA in sterile inflammation.
description_zh_TW: Uric Acid Crystals 會在關節中活化 NLRP3，使痛風成為典型的後天性自體發炎疾病；相同的發炎小體也可被其他內源性危險訊號（例如 Silica、氧化態的 Cardiolipin 與粒線體 DNA）在無菌發炎中觸發。

label: PI3K
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Growth factors bind receptor tyrosine kinases or G protein-coupled receptors and activate RAS/RAF/MEK/ERK and PI3K/Akt/mTORC1 as well as JAK/STAT cascades. These cascades increase cyclin levels or reduce CDK inhibitor abundance to drive cell proliferation; dysregulated growth factor signaling is a hallmark of cancer.
description_zh_TW: Growth factors 結合 receptor tyrosine kinases 或 G protein-coupled receptors，活化 RAS/RAF/MEK/ERK 與 PI3K/Akt/mTORC1 以及 JAK/STAT cascade。這些 cascade 增加 cyclin 濃度或降低 CDK inhibitor 豐度以驅動 cell proliferation；growth factor 訊號失調是 cancer 的特徵之一。

label: Partial Reprogramming
description: Signs of aging can be reversed by partial reprogramming, in which the Yamanaka factors are expressed transiently and cyclically rather than continuously. This approach restored youthful gene expression and extended lifespan in progeroid mice without the tumor formation seen with full reprogramming to pluripotency. By resetting age-related epigenetic marks, including DNA methylation and chromatin state, partial reprogramming demonstrates that aspects of biological aging are reversible. This has established partial reprogramming as a leading candidate rejuvenation strategy.
description_zh_TW: 老化跡象可以透過部分重編程來逆轉，其中山中因子短暫且週期性地表達，而不是連續表達。這種方法恢復了 gene expression 的年輕狀態，並延長了早衰小鼠的壽命，並且在完全重編程為多能性時沒有腫瘤形成。透過重置與年齡相關的表觀遺傳標記，包括 DNA 甲基化和染色質狀態，部分重編程表明生物老化的各個方面是可逆的。這使得部分重編程成為主要的候選者復興策略。

label: Leuco-adrenochrome
description: Leuco-adrenochrome, the reduced leuco-form of the aminochrome system, is further oxidized to form adrenochrome, a distinctly colored (red/pink/orange) compound whose color arises from its extended conjugated system. Adrenochrome is the classic oxidation product of epinephrine studied since the 19th century. Because leuco-adrenochrome is highly unstable in the presence of oxygen and acts as a ready electron donor, this oxidation to adrenochrome proceeds easily, which is why leuco-adrenochrome is difficult to isolate outside controlled laboratory environments and why pink-to-brown discoloration of epinephrine formulations is a recognized stability problem.
description_zh_TW: Leuco-adrenochrome，aminochrome system 的 reduced leuco-form，is further oxidized to form adrenochrome，一種 distinctly colored (red/pink/orange) compound，其 color arises from its extended conjugated system。Adrenochrome 是 classic oxidation product of epinephrine，自 19th century 以來被研究。由於 leuco-adrenochrome 在 oxygen presence 下 highly unstable 且 acts as a ready electron donor，this oxidation to adrenochrome proceeds easily，這就是為什麼 leuco-adrenochrome 在 controlled laboratory environments 外 difficult to isolate，以及 pink-to-brown discoloration of epinephrine formulations 是 recognized stability problem。

label: Silver
description: Silver is a metallic element with the chemical symbol Ag and atomic number 47. It occurs naturally in its pure, free form, as an alloy with gold and other metals, and in minerals such as argentite and chlorargyrite. Silver itself is generally not toxic to humans, although most silver salts are toxic, and chronic accumulation can deposit metallic silver in tissues, producing the permanent blue-gray condition known as argyria that is disfiguring but not otherwise harmful to health. The distinction between benign elemental silver and toxic ionic silver salts is fundamental to understanding silver exposure.
description_zh_TW: 銀是一種金屬元素，化學符號為Ag，原子序數47。它自然存在於純淨游離形式、與金及其他金屬的合金中，以及如argentite和chlorargyrite等礦物中。銀本身通常對人體無毒，但大多數銀鹽有毒，慢性積累可在組織中沉積金屬銀，導致稱為argyria的永久性藍灰色病變，雖毀容但對健康無其他損害。良性的元素銀與有毒的離子銀鹽之間的區別對理解銀暴露至關重要。

label: Pyroptosis
description: Gasdermin D pore formation is the execution step of pyroptotic cell death: the released N-terminal fragment oligomerizes and inserts into membranes to form ~10-20 nm pores, causing cellular swelling, loss of membrane integrity and lytic death. This pore-forming action is what makes pyroptosis inherently inflammatory, in contrast to the immunologically silent dismantling of apoptosis.
description_zh_TW: Gasdermin D 成孔是 pyroptosis 細胞死亡的執行步驟：釋出的 N 端片段寡聚並插入膜形成約 10–20 nm 的孔洞，造成細胞腫脹、膜完整性喪失與裂解性死亡。正是這種成孔作用使 pyroptosis 本質上具有發炎性，與免疫學上無聲的凋亡拆解形成對比。

label: Endothelial Dysfunction
description: CXCL12 was identified as the most highly upregulated SASP factor in endothelial cells with aging, and add-back of CXCL12 to old fisetin plasma recapitulated age-related endothelial dysfunction (-22% peak endothelium-dependent dilation), while CXCL12 neutralization with LIT-927 rescued function. CXCL12 also impairs NO production, raises mitochondrial superoxide and drives endothelial-to-mesenchymal transition, establishing it as a causal circulating driver of vascular aging.
description_zh_TW: CXCL12 被確認為內皮細胞隨老化上調最多的 SASP 因子；將 CXCL12 加回老年小鼠經 fisetin 處理的血漿可重現與年齡相關的內皮功能障礙（內皮依賴性擴張峰值下降 22%），而以 LIT-927 中和 CXCL12 則可挽救功能。CXCL12 還會損害 NO 產生、提高粒線體超氧陰離子並促進內皮間質轉化，確立它是血管老化的因果性循環因子。

label: Estrogen
description: Estrogen binding activates Erβ, which then dimerizes and regulates target gene transcription, mediating many physiological actions of estrogen in the brain, vasculature, and metabolic tissues. Erβ is expressed in the hippocampus, cortex, vascular endothelium, and reproductive tissues.
description_zh_TW: Estrogen 的結合會活化 Erβ，後者隨即二聚化並調控標的基因轉錄，介導 estrogen 在腦部、血管與代謝組織中的多項生理作用。Erβ 表現於 hippocampus、cortex、血管內皮與生殖組織。

label: Gut Microbiome
source_file: _document_ - Natural Bioactive Compounds Spermidine Fisetin Berberine Urolithin A.md
description: The gut microbiome ferments dietary fiber into short-chain fatty acids, notably butyrate, which act on enteroendocrine cells and the enteric nervous system. These anti-inflammatory microbial products also maintain barrier integrity and train the immune system.
description_zh_TW: Gut Microbiome 將 dietary fiber 發酵成 short-chain fatty acids，尤其是 butyrate，並作用於 enteroendocrine cells 與 enteric nervous system。這些抗發炎微生物產物也維持 barrier integrity 並訓練 immune system。

label: Glycation
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: Glycation is the product of the reaction between a sugar and the free amino group of proteins, referred to as cross-linking, and the accumulation of these glycation byproducts results in large, cross-linked molecules that inhibit the ability of the cell to function normally. Advanced glycation end products (AGEs) accumulate with age in tissues, contributing to arterial stiffening and cardiac enlargement. Levels of cross-linking products in diabetics are two to three times those of non-diabetics, and AGEs are believed to play an important role in the development of diabetic complications.
description_zh_TW: 糖化（glycation）是糖與蛋白質游離胺基之間反應的產物，又稱交叉連結（cross-linking），而這些糖化副產物的累積會形成大型、交叉連結的分子，抑制細胞正常運作的能力。晚期糖化終產物（AGEs）隨年齡在組織中累積，促成動脈硬化與心臟肥大。糖尿病患者的交叉連結產物水平是非糖尿病患者的兩到三倍，且AGEs被認為在糖尿病併發症的發展中扮演重要角色。

label: Myeloperoxidase
description: Hypochlorous acid is generated by myeloperoxidase, which uses H2O2 and chloride to produce HOCl in activated neutrophils and monocytes. This reaction concentrates a potent oxidant at infection and inflammatory sites. The directionality is MPO catalysis to HOCl formation. A caveat is that MPO can also use bromide and other halides, so related hypohalous acids are produced alongside HOCl. Because HOCl is produced only in proximity to MPO, the appearance of its chlorinated products such as 3-chlorotyrosine is a highly specific footprint of MPO activity in vivo.
description_zh_TW: Hypochlorous acid 由 myeloperoxidase 生成，myeloperoxidase 使用 H2O2 和氯化物在活化的嗜中性球和單核球產生 HOCl。此反應在感染和發炎部位濃縮了強效氧化劑。方向性是 MPO 催化 HOCl 的形成。要注意的是，MPO 還可以使用溴化物和其他鹵化物，因此相關的次鹵酸會與 HOCl 一起產生。由於 HOCl 僅在 MPO 附近產生，因此其氯化產物（例如 3-chlorotyrosine）的出現是 MPO 體內活性的高度特異性足跡。

label: Epigenetic Clock
description: Epigenetic clocks are built from DNA methylation measurements at defined sets of CpG sites whose methylation levels change predictably with chronological age. These statistical models convert methylome data into an estimate of biological age, and deviations between predicted and chronological age indicate accelerated or decelerated aging. Because methylation at these sites responds to interventions such as caloric restriction and partial reprogramming, clocks are used to track the effectiveness of rejuvenation strategies.
description_zh_TW: 表觀遺傳時鐘是根據一組定義的 CpG 位點的 DNA 甲基化測量構建的，這些位點的甲基化水平可預測地隨著實際年齡的變化而變化。這些統計模型將甲基化組數據轉換為生物年齡的估計值，預測年齡和實際年齡之間的偏差表示老化加速或減慢。由於這些位點的甲基化會對熱量限制和部分重編程等乾預措施做出反應，因此時鐘被用來追蹤恢復活力策略的有效性。

label: Tau
description: Neurofibrillary tangles are intraneuronal paired helical filament aggregates of hyperphosphorylated Tau protein, a defining pathological feature of Alzheimer's Disease and other tauopathies.
description_zh_TW: Neurofibrillary tangles 是過度磷酸化 Tau 蛋白在神經細胞內形成的配對螺旋纖維聚集體，為 Alzheimer's Disease 與其他 tauopathy 的定義性病理特徵。

label: Tubulin
description: Alpha-tubulin is one of the two subunits, with beta-tubulin, that form the alpha-beta tubulin heterodimer, the building block of microtubules and the mitotic spindle. Acetylation of alpha-tubulin, classically at Lys40, is a well-established mark of stabilized, long-lived microtubules.
description_zh_TW: α-tubulin 與 β-tubulin 共同組成 αβ 型的 Tubulin 異二聚體，該異二聚體是微管與有絲分裂紡錘體的組成單位。α-tubulin 的乙醯化（典型位於 Lys40）是穩定且長壽命微管的公認標記。

label: ULK1
description: ULK1 functions within a stable initiation complex containing ATG13, FIP200 (RB1CC1), and ATG101, which nucleates autophagosome formation in response to nutrient status. Directionally, the complex sits upstream of autophagy initiation. SIRT1 deacetylates and activates ULK1 within this complex, positioning sirtuins at the top of the autophagic machinery. The ULK1 complex integrates signals from AMPK and mTORC1, which either activate or inhibit it depending on energy and nutrient state. This makes the initiation complex the central decision point for whether autophagy proceeds.
description_zh_TW: ULK1 在一個包含 ATG13、FIP200（RB1CC1）和 ATG101 的穩定啟動複合物中發揮功能，該複合物在回應營養狀態時 nucleate 自噬體形成。在方向性上，該複合物位於自噬啟動的上游。SIRT1 去乙醯化並活化此複合物中的 ULK1，將 sirtuin 置於自噬機制的頂端。ULK1 複合物整合來自 AMPK 和 mTORC1 的訊號，根據能量和營養狀態啟動或抑制自噬。這使啟動複合物成為自噬是否進行的決策核心。

label: p38 MAPK
description: p38 MAPK phosphorylates MK2 (MAPKAPK2) at Thr222 in humans, activating the kinase and relieving an intramolecular inhibitory interaction, making MK2 the principal effector through which p38 controls labile inflammatory mRNA stability.
description_zh_TW: p38 MAPK 在人類磷酸化 MK2（MAPKAPK2）的 Thr222 位點，活化該激酶並解除其分子內抑制性交互作用，使 MK2 成為 p38 調控不穩定發炎 mRNA 穩定性的主要執行者。

label: STAT3
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: IL-6 to JAK to STAT3 forms the autocrine amplification loop of SASP signaling. Activation sustains chronic inflammatory transcription.
description_zh_TW: IL-6 到 JAK 到 STAT3 形成 SASP 訊號的自分泌放大迴圈。活化維持慢性發炎轉錄。

label: Glutaminase
description: Two major glutaminase isoforms exist: kidney-type GLS1 (encoded by GLS, with alternatively spliced variants KGA and GAC) and liver-type GLS2 (encoded by GLS2). GLS1 is the predominant isoform in most proliferating cells and is allosterically activated by phosphate and glutamate. The tumor suppressor p53 transcriptionally induces GLS2. Both isoforms are mitochondrial matrix enzymes.
description_zh_TW: 存在兩種主要的 glutaminase 同型異構物：腎型 GLS1（由 GLS 編碼，具選擇性剪接變異 KGA 和 GAC）和肝型 GLS2（由 GLS2 編碼）。GLS1 是大多數增殖細胞中的主要同型異構物，受磷酸和麩胺酸異位性活化。腫瘤抑制因子 p53 轉錄誘導 GLS2。兩種同型異構物都是粒線體基質酵素。

label: Berberine
source_file: _document_ - Natural Bioactive Compounds Spermidine Fisetin Berberine Urolithin A.md
description: Berberine exerts potent anti-inflammatory effects through multiple molecular pathways, including inhibition of NF-kappaB signaling, downregulation of pro-inflammatory cytokines such as TNF-alpha and IL-6, and activation of AMPK that improves metabolic and inflammatory status. These actions contribute to its benefits in metabolic syndrome, insulin resistance, type 2 diabetes, and gastrointestinal inflammation, and extend to modulation of the gut microbiota. Because its anti-inflammatory activity is independent of the methylation cycle, it does not add methyl burden or inhibit COMT. This makes it a versatile and relatively safe adjunct in inflammation management.
description_zh_TW: Berberine 透過多種分子途徑發揮有效的 anti-inflammatory effects 作用，包括抑制 NF-kappaB 訊號傳導、下調促發炎細胞因子（如 TNF-α 和 IL-6）以及活化 AMPK，進而改善代謝和發炎狀態。這些作用有助於其治療代謝症候群、胰島素抗性、2 型糖尿病和胃腸道炎症，並延伸至腸道微生物群的調節。由於其抗發炎活性獨立於 methylation cycle，因此不會增加甲基負荷或抑制 COMT。這使其成為發炎管理中多功能且相對安全的輔助手段。

label: ATP
description: Complex V synthesizes ATP using the proton motive force at roughly 32 to 34 ATP per glucose. Synthesis is the oxidative-phosphorylation output.
description_zh_TW: 複合體 V 利用質子動力以每葡萄糖約 32 至 34 ATP 合成 ATP。合成是氧化磷酸化輸出。

label: Thymic Involution
description: Age-associated thymic involution results in diminished thymopoiesis: reduction of the thymic epithelial space causes loss of T cell receptor gene rearrangement and decreased output of naive T cells to the periphery. Using single joint T cell receptor excision circle analysis (sjTREC), a molecular marker for active thymopoiesis, researchers measured a steady three-log decline in circulating naive T cells across an 80-year human lifespan. Similar decreases in sjTREC per milligram of thymus tissue were observed in aging BALB/c mice from 6 to 90 weeks. Thus involution reduces both the quantity and quality of T cells exported across the lifespan.
description_zh_TW: 與年齡相關的胸腺退化導致胸腺生成減弱：胸腺上皮空間的縮減導致 T 細胞受體基因重排喪失和初始 T 細胞向外周輸出的減少。研究人員使用單連結 T 細胞受體 excision circle 分析（sjTREC）——一種 active thymopoiesis 的分子標記——測量到在 80 年人類壽命中循環初始 T 細胞穩定下降三個數量級。在 6 至 90 週齡的老化 BALB/c 小鼠中也觀察到每毫克胸腺組織的 sjTREC 類似下降。因此，退化在整個壽命中降低了輸出 T 細胞的數量和質量。

label: DNA Repair
description: MLH1 pairs with PMS2 as the MutLα mismatch-repair complex, excising base mismatches and insertion/deletion loops left by DNA Polymerase during replication. Its loss disables the DNA Repair branch that corrects these errors.
description_zh_TW: MLH1 與 PMS2 組成 MutLα 錯配修復複合體，切除複製過程中由 DNA Polymerase 留下的鹼基錯配與插入／缺失環。MLH1 流失會使負責修正這些錯誤的 DNA Repair 分支失效。

label: Necrosis
description: Secondary Necrosis is a variant of Necrosis in which the plasma membrane ruptures only after the apoptotic program has already run to completion, in cells or Apoptotic Bodies that were never cleared by phagocytic efferocytosis — the standard outcome in cell culture lacking phagocytes. Because the resulting DAMP release and sterile inflammation are indistinguishable from primary necrosis, late timepoints of a 'apoptosis' assay frequently report secondary necrosis rather than the intended outcome.
description_zh_TW: Secondary Necrosis 是 Necrosis 的一種變體：細胞凋亡程序已經完成後，未被吞噬清除的細胞或 Apoptotic Bodies 才喪失細胞膜完整性——這是在缺乏吞噬細胞的細胞培養中的標準結果。由於其釋放 DAMP 與引發無菌性發炎的表現與原發性壞死無法區分，凋亡實驗的晚期時間點經常測到的是 secondary necrosis 而非預期結果。

label: Mitosis
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Aurora Kinase isozymes — Aurora-A, Aurora-B and Aurora-C — coordinate mitotic spindle assembly, chromosome alignment and segregation, and cytokinesis; Aurora-A acts at centrosomes and spindle poles, while Aurora-B is a chromosomal passenger complex component regulating kinetochore-microtubule attachments and the spindle assembly checkpoint.
description_zh_TW: Aurora Kinase 異構酶——Aurora-A、Aurora-B 與 Aurora-C——共同協調有絲分裂紡錘體的組裝、染色體的對齊與分離，以及胞質分裂；Aurora-A 作用於中心體與紡錘體極，Aurora-B 則是染色體乘客複合體成分，調控動粒—微管附著與紡錘體組裝檢查點。

label: Mcl-1
description: Resistance to ABT-737 is commonly driven by Mcl-1, a pro-survival Bcl-2 family protein that ABT-737 does not inhibit. Because Mcl-1 remains available to bind and sequester pro-apoptotic effectors, MOMP is not fully engaged. The relationship is directional and defines a specific, targetable vulnerability rather than a general failure. Co-targeting Mcl-1 restores the apoptotic commitment that ABT-737 alone cannot achieve.
description_zh_TW: 對 ABT-737 的抗性通常由 Mcl-1 驅動，這是 ABT-737 不抑制的一種促生存 Bcl-2 family 蛋白。由於 Mcl-1 仍可結合和隔離促凋亡效應子，因此 MOMP 並未完全發揮作用。這種關係是定向的，定義了特定的、可針對的漏洞，而不是一般的故障。共同靶向 Mcl-1 恢復了單獨 ABT-737 無法實現的凋亡承諾。

label: Lifespan
description: AGE-1 is the C. elegans class-I PI3K catalytic subunit downstream of the DAF-2 insulin/IGF-1 receptor; reduced AGE-1 signalling derepresses DAF-16/FOXO and extends Lifespan. The age-1(hx546) mutant was among the first single-gene longevity mutants.
description_zh_TW: AGE-1 是 C. elegans 的第一類 PI3K 催化次單元，位於 DAF-2 胰島素/IGF-1 受體下游；AGE-1 訊號下降會解除對 DAF-16/FOXO 的抑制並延長 Lifespan。age-1(hx546) 突變株是最早的單基因長壽突變株之一。

label: Diabetes Mellitus
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: Diabetes Mellitus is a group of metabolic diseases characterized by chronic hyperglycemia. Chronic hyperglycemia increases Reactive Oxygen Species production in the Mitochondria, producing systemic Oxidative Stress together with micro- and macrovascular complications.
description_zh_TW: Diabetes Mellitus 是一群以長期高血糖為特徵的代謝疾病。慢性高血糖使 Mitochondria 產生更多 Reactive Oxygen Species，造成全身性的 Oxidative Stress，並伴隨微血管與大血管併發症。

label: Cisplatin
description: Cisplatin is a platinum-based chemotherapeutic whose efficacy is augmented when combined with intermittent fasting in both cellular and animal models. Fasting generates a differential stress resistance in which normal cells enter a protective, autophagy-dependent quiescent state while many tumor cells remain vulnerable to platinum-DNA adduct formation. The improved therapeutic window reduces chemotherapy-associated toxicity while slowing tumor growth, suggesting a combinatorial strategy. These findings support IF as an adjunct to sensitize tumors and protect host tissue during cisplatin-based regimens.
description_zh_TW: Cisplatin是一種鉑類化療藥，在細胞和動物模型中與間歇性斷食合併使用時其療效增強。斷食產生一種差異性壓力抵抗，其中正常細胞進入保護性的、依賴自噬的靜止狀態，而許多腫瘤細胞仍易受鉑—DNA加合物形成的影響。改善的治療窗口在減緩腫瘤生長的同時降低化療相關毒性，提示一種組合策略。這些發現支持將IF作為輔助手段，在以cisplatin為基礎的療程中增敏腫瘤並保護宿主組織。

label: CamKIIα
description: CaMKIIalpha (calcium/calmodulin-dependent protein kinase II alpha) is a serine/threonine protein kinase central to neuronal signaling, activated by the Ca2+-calmodulin complex downstream of NMDA receptor activation and voltage-gated calcium influx. It is highly abundant in postsynaptic densities, where it phosphorylates numerous substrates including AMPA receptors to encode synaptic strength and plasticity. Its autophosphorylation produces persistent, calcium-independent activity that sustains long-term potentiation. It is therefore a key molecular substrate of activity-dependent plasticity and memory.
description_zh_TW: CaMKIIalpha (calcium/calmodulin-dependent protein kinase II alpha) 是一種對神經元訊號傳導至關重要的絲胺酸/蘇胺酸蛋白激酶，由 NMDA 受體活化和電壓門控鈣流入下游的 Ca2+-鈣調蛋白複合物活化。它在突觸後密度中高度豐富，可磷酸化包括 AMPA 受體在內的多種底物，以編碼突觸強度和可塑性。其自身磷酸化產生持久的、不依賴鈣的活性，維持長期增強作用。因此，它是活動依賴性可塑性和記憶的關鍵分子底物。

label: RIPK1
description: Necrostatin-1 (Nec-1) is a selective small-molecule inhibitor that allosterically blocks RIPK1 kinase activity, preventing phosphorylation and translocation of RIPK1 and therefore the formation of the RIPK1-RIPK3-MLKL necrosome. It is the most widely used tool compound for dissecting necroptosis from other forms of regulated cell death.
description_zh_TW: Necrostatin-1（Nec-1）是選擇性小分子抑制劑，以異位（allosteric）方式阻斷 RIPK1 激酶活性，阻止 RIPK1 的磷酸化與轉位，因而無法形成 RIPK1-RIPK3-MLKL 壞死小體。它是區分 necroptosis 與其他受調控細胞死亡形式最廣泛使用的工具化合物。

label: STING
description: STING inhibitors (H151, SN-011, amlexanox, c-176) are experimental small molecules that block signaling downstream of the cGAS-STING pathway by interfering with STING activation, trafficking, or downstream kinase recruitment. Targeting STING itself interrupts both canonical cGAS-dependent and noncanonical, cGAS-independent activation such as that triggered by NPC1 deficiency or C9orf72 loss.
description_zh_TW: STING inhibitors（H151、SN-011、amlexanox、c-176）是實驗性小分子，透過干擾 STING 的活化、運輸或下游激酶招募，阻斷 cGAS-STING Pathway 下游的訊息傳遞。由於直接針對 STING，因此可同時阻斷典型的 cGAS 依賴性與非典型 cGAS 非依賴性活化，例如由 NPC1 缺乏或 C9orf72 喪失所觸發者。

label: HIF-1α
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Under hypoxic or ischemic stress, HIF-1α transcriptionally activates BNIP3 in neurons; BNIP3 then inserts into the mitochondrial membrane, causing loss of mitochondrial membrane potential and opening of the Mitochondrial Permeability Transition Pore, producing delayed neuronal death that BNIP3 knockout rescues.
description_zh_TW: 在缺氧或缺血壓力下，HIF-1α 於神經元中轉錄活化 BNIP3；BNIP3 隨後嵌入粒線體膜，造成粒線體膜電位喪失與 Mitochondrial Permeability Transition Pore 開啟，引發延遲性神經元死亡，而 BNIP3 敲除可挽救此現象。

label: PGC-1α
description: PGC-1α acts as the master regulator of mitochondrial biogenesis, co-activating NRF1, NRF2, PPARα, PPARγ, ERRalpha and YY1 to control expression of over 1,000 nuclear-encoded mitochondrial genes via the NRF1/NRF2 → TFAM axis.
description_zh_TW: PGC-1α 是粒線體生成的總調控因子，藉由共同活化 NRF1、NRF2、PPARα、PPARγ、ERRalpha 與 YY1，經 NRF1/NRF2 → TFAM 路徑調控超過一千個核編碼粒線體基因的表現。

label: Flavonoids
source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md
description: Flavonoids inhibit NADPH oxidase by blocking p47phox translocation to the membrane, reducing superoxide production in endothelial and phagocytic cells. This interrupts a major enzymatic ROS source. The directionality is flavonoid to NOX assembly inhibition. A caveat is that different flavonoids preferentially target different NOX isoforms, and effects vary with structure and bioavailability. This inhibition is shared by many dietary flavonoids and contributes to their vasculo- and cardioprotective effects, addressing the source rather than only the products of oxidant generation.
description_zh_TW: Flavonoids 透過阻斷 p47phox 易位至膜來抑制 NADPH oxidase，從而減少內皮細胞和吞噬細胞中超氧化物的產生。這會中斷 ROS 的主要酵素源。方向性是類黃酮對 NOX 組裝的抑制。需要注意的是，不同的 flavonoids 優先針對不同的 NOX 同工型，且效果因結構和生物利用度而異。許多飲食中的 flavonoids 都具有這種抑製作用，有助於其血管和心臟保護作用，解決氧化劑生成的根源而不僅僅是產物。

label: Synaptic plasticity
description: CaMKIIalpha is essential for synaptic plasticity, including long-term potentiation (LTP) and long-term depression (LTD), by phosphorylating AMPA receptor subunits and structural proteins that consolidate changes in synaptic efficacy. Inhibition or knockout of CaMKIIalpha abolishes LTP at many synapses, confirming its necessity. Its autophosphorylation at threonine 286 generates calcium-independent activity that maintains potentiated transmission over time. It thus serves as a molecular switch converting transient calcium signals into lasting synaptic memory.
description_zh_TW: CaMKIIalpha 對於 synaptic plasticity 至關重要，包括長時程增強 (LTP) 和長時程抑制 (LTD)，透過磷酸化 AMPA 受體亞基和結構蛋白來鞏固突觸功效的變化。抑製或敲除 CaMKIIalpha 可消除許多突觸的 LTP，證實了其必要性。其蘇氨酸 286 處的自磷酸化產生不依賴鈣的活性，可隨著時間的推移維持增強的傳輸。因此，它充當分子開關，將瞬態鈣訊號轉換為持久的突觸記憶。

label: melittin
description: Honeybee venom is a complex mixture whose major peptide component is melittin (~50% of dry weight), the principal anticancer effector.
description_zh_TW: Honeybee venom 是複雜混合物，其主要胜肽成分為 melittin（約佔乾重 50%），是主要的抗癌效應物。

label: Differentiation
description: Retinoic Acid induces differentiation in monolayer cultures of embryonic stem cells cultured without Leukemia inhibitory factor, providing a standard in vitro model for testing lineage commitment and self-renewal silencing.
description_zh_TW: Retinoic Acid 在未添加 Leukemia inhibitory factor 的胚胎幹細胞單層培養中誘導 Differentiation，提供了測試譜系命定與自我更新沉默的標準體外模型。

label: Selenocysteine
description: Thioredoxin reductase (TXNRD) is a selenoprotein whose catalytic activity depends on a C-terminal selenocysteine (Sec) residue encoded by a recoded UGA codon. This selenium dependence makes TXNRD exquisitely sensitive to electrophilic inhibitors that react with selenols, including auranofin.
description_zh_TW: 硫氧還蛋白還原酶（TXNRD）是一種硒蛋白，其催化活性依賴由重編碼 UGA 密碼子編碼的 C 端硒半胱氨酸（Sec）殘基。此硒依賴性使 TXNRD 對能與硒醇反應的親電子抑制劑（包括 auranofin）極為敏感。

label: Medium spiny neurons
description: Medium spiny neurons constitute roughly 90-95% of the neuronal population in the striatum (the caudate nucleus and putamen). They are the principal integrators of cortical, thalamic, and dopaminergic input within the basal ganglia. They form the major output pathways regulating voluntary movement and reward-based learning.
description_zh_TW: Medium spiny neurons 約占 striatum（尾狀核和殼核）神經元群的 90-95%。它們是基底神經節內皮質、丘腦和多巴胺能輸入的主要整合者。它們形成調節自主運動和獎賞學習的主要輸出途徑。

label: PEX14
description: Mutations in PEX14 cause PEX14-deficient Zellweger Spectrum Disorder (~1-2% of cases); missense variants in the acidic docking domain partially impair PEX5 binding and give milder disease, while truncating mutations are lethal.
description_zh_TW: PEX14 突變會造成 PEX14 缺乏型 Zellweger 光譜症候群（約佔 1–2% 病例）；酸性對接結構域的錯義變異會部分損害 PEX5 結合而疾病較輕，截短突變則致死。

label: Catecholamines
description: The Adrenal gland is a paired endocrine organ whose inner Adrenal medulla, composed of Chromaffin cells, synthesizes the Catecholamines Epinephrine (about 80%) and Norepinephrine (about 20%). Synthesis runs Tyrosine to L-DOPA via Tyrosine Hydroxylase, then dopamine, Norepinephrine, and finally Epinephrine via PNMT.
description_zh_TW: Adrenal gland 是一對內分泌器官，其內層由 Chromaffin cells 組成的 Adrenal medulla 合成 Catecholamines，即約 80% 的 Epinephrine 與約 20% 的 Norepinephrine。合成途徑由 Tyrosine 經 Tyrosine Hydroxylase 轉為 L-DOPA，再經 dopamine、Norepinephrine，最後由 PNMT 催化生成 Epinephrine。

label: Hormetic Window
description: Methylene blue follows a hormetic dose-response curve: the same mechanism that is beneficial at low doses works against the organism at high ones. The therapeutic window is real and narrow - 1-4 mg is where the benefits are, and above 7-10 mg the risks start - while doses above approximately 2 mg/kg can flip the redox-cycling mechanism from antioxidant to pro-oxidant, generating oxidative stress instead of reducing it. Too little and you do not get the benefits; too much and the redox cycling starts producing oxidative stress. This hormetic behavior explains why more is not better for methylene blue and why micro-to-low-physiological dosing (0.5-4 mg) is the evidence-supported sweet spot for wellness applications.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue遵循hormetic劑量反應曲線：在低劑量有益的機制在高劑量下對生物體有害。治療窗口是真實且狹窄的——1-4毫克是益處所在，超過7-10毫克風險開始——而劑量超過約2 mg/kg可能使氧化還原循環機制從抗氧化劑轉變為促氧化劑，產生氧化應激而不是減少它。太少你得不到益處；太多氧化還原循環開始產生氧化應激。這種hormetic行為解釋了為什麼對methylene blue來說越多越好不成立，以及為什麼微至低生理劑量（0.5-4毫克）是健康應用的證據支持最佳範圍。

label: Ischemia-reperfusion Injury
description: Reperfusion introduces molecular oxygen into metabolically compromised tissue and triggers a burst of reactive oxygen species from xanthine oxidase, the mitochondrial electron transport chain, NADPH oxidase and activated neutrophils, causing lipid peroxidation, protein oxidation and DNA damage.
description_zh_TW: 再灌流將分子氧帶入代謝受損的組織，觸發來自黃嘌呤氧化酶、粒線體電子傳遞鏈、NADPH oxidase 與活化嗜中性球的活性氧爆發，造成脂質過氧化、蛋白質氧化與 DNA 損傷。

label: RIPK3
description: Conditional deletion of Caspase-8 or FADD in intestinal epithelium causes spontaneous necroptosis and IBD-like pathology, but crossing these mice onto a RIPK3-deficient background completely prevents the disease, demonstrating that the epithelial cell death underlying the phenotype is RIPK3-dependent.
description_zh_TW: 在腸道上皮中條件性刪除 Caspase-8 或 FADD 會引發自發性壞死性凋亡與類 IBD 的病理，但將這些小鼠交配到缺乏 RIPK3 的背景上可完全阻止該病徵，證明其上皮細胞死亡依賴 RIPK3。

label: BDNF
description: In dose-response comparisons across low, moderate, and high exercise intensities, all intensities improved cognition and motor outcomes, but high-intensity exercise produced the greatest BDNF upregulation alongside the strongest behavioral gains. This intensity-dependent neurotrophic response supports prescribing higher-intensity modalities such as HIIT when tolerated to maximize BDNF-TrkB signaling in neurodegenerative models.
description_zh_TW: 在低、中、高運動強度的劑量反應比較中，所有強度均改善認知與運動結果，但 High-Intensity Exercise 產生最大的 BDNF 上調並伴隨最強的行為改善。此強度依賴的神經營養反應支持在可耐受時優先採用 HIIT 等高強度模式，以最大化神經退化模型中的 BDNF-TrkB 訊號。

label: Hepatocellular Carcinoma
description: Sorafenib is an orally active multi-kinase inhibitor targeting RAF, VEGFR and PDGFR, approved as first-line therapy for advanced hepatocellular carcinoma (and certain renal and thyroid cancers) where it dampens RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK signaling and angiogenesis.
description_zh_TW: Sorafenib 是可口服的多激酶抑制劑，標的為 RAF、VEGFR 與 PDGFR，獲准作為晚期 hepatocellular carcinoma（以及部分腎癌與甲狀腺癌）的第一線治療，用以抑制 RAS-RAF-MEK-ERK 訊號與血管新生。

label: Angiogenesis
description: The tumour microenvironment is a heterogeneous ecosystem of malignant cells, cancer-associated fibroblasts, immune and endothelial cells, extracellular matrix and a cytokine soup of growth factors including VEGF and EGF. Tumors secrete VEGF to recruit new blood vessels, ensuring a steady supply of nutrients and oxygen, and hypoxia, low pH and raised interstitial pressure drive drug resistance and immune evasion.
description_zh_TW: 腫瘤微環境（tumour microenvironment）是由惡性細胞、癌相關纖維母細胞、免疫與內皮細胞、細胞外基質，以及含 VEGF、EGF 等生長因子的「細胞激素湯」所構成的異質性生態系。腫瘤分泌 VEGF 以招募新血管，確保營養與氧氣的穩定供應；而低氧、低 pH 與升高的間質壓力則促成藥物抗性與免疫逃脫。

label: Mitochondrial DNA
source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md
description: In senescence and ageing, mitochondrial dysfunction promotes the cytosolic release of mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA), which activates cGAS-STING signalling and drives inflammatory responses and the SASP. Cytosolic mtDNA levels were unchanged in senescent MRC5 and IMR90 fibroblasts following SLC25A1 inhibition, indicating that metabolic regulation of histone acetylation restrains SASP independently of mtDNA release. STING inhibition with SN011 suppresses SASP gene expression without affecting histone acetylation, showing that mtDNA-driven innate immune signalling and mitochondrial control of histone acetylation are independent but complementary inputs that converge to enable full SASP expression.
description_zh_TW: In senescence and ageing，mitochondrial dysfunction promotes cytosolic release of mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA)，which activates cGAS-STING signalling 並 drives inflammatory responses 和 SASP。Cytosolic mtDNA levels 在 senescent MRC5 和 IMR90 fibroblasts following SLC25A1 inhibition 時 unchanged，indicating that metabolic regulation of histone acetylation restrains SASP independently of mtDNA release。STING inhibition with SN011 suppresses SASP gene expression without affecting histone acetylation，showing that mtDNA-driven innate immune signalling 和 mitochondrial control of histone acetylation are independent but complementary inputs converging to enable full SASP expression。

label: Longevity
description: Dietary protein restriction (PR) is a robust geroprotective regimen that extends lifespan in yeast, flies, and rodents and improves healthspan. Rodent studies demonstrate lifespan extension across many strains (for example, 34.9% in male C57BL/6J mice on a 21% vs 7% protein diet, and large extensions in flies), while restriction of specific essential amino acids - particularly methionine, isoleucine, and valine - recapitulates many of PR's benefits. FGF21-null mice do not live longer on PR, identifying FGF21 as essential for the longevity benefits. The Okinawan population's ~9% protein diet is cited as a human parallel to PR's lifespan effects.
description_zh_TW: 飲食蛋白質限制（PR）是一種強健的抗老化方案，在酵母、果蠅和囓齒動物中延長壽命並改善健康span。囓齒動物研究顯示多種品系的壽命延長（例如，21%對7%蛋白質飲食的雄性C57BL/6J小鼠延長34.9%，果蠅中也有大幅延長），而特定必需胺基酸——特別是甲硫氨酸、異亮氨酸和纈氨酸——的限制重現了PR的許多益處。FGF21缺失小鼠在PR下壽命未延長，確定了FGF21對壽命益處的必要性。沖繩人口約9%蛋白質飲食被引用為人類中與PR壽命效應平行的例子。

label: NADPH Oxidase
description: p47phox (NCF1) is the cytosolic organizer of the NOX2 NADPH Oxidase: upon phosphorylation it translocates to the membrane together with p67phox and p40phox to join cytochrome b558 (p22phox/gp91phox), triggering the respiratory burst. Its role is organizational rather than catalytic - p47phox is a scaffold that brings the cytosolic subunits into contact with the membrane catalytic subunit, which is why its loss abolishes oxidase activation and why NCF1 mutations are the commonest autosomal-recessive cause of Chronic Granulomatous Disease.
description_zh_TW: p47phox（NCF1）是 NOX2 NADPH Oxidase 的細胞質組織次單元：磷酸化後，它與 p67phox 及 p40phox 一同轉位至膜，與 cytochrome b558（p22phox/gp91phox）結合，觸發呼吸爆發。其角色是組織性而非催化性——p47phox 是將細胞質次單元帶到膜上催化次單元附近的支架，因此其喪失會使氧化酶活化消失，而 NCF1 突變是 Chronic Granulomatous Disease 最常見的體染色體隱性病因。

label: Tumor Microenvironment
description: MMP remodels Tumor Microenvironment. Matrix metalloproteinases degrade extracellular-matrix components and thereby enable invasion, angiogenesis, and microenvironment remodeling. The tumor microenvironment is the constellation of stromal, immune, vascular, and extracellular elements that nurture or restrain the malignant clone. The relationship is directional, with MMP acting as the operative agent upon Tumor Microenvironment rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: MMP改造Tumor Microenvironment。基質金屬蛋白酶降解細胞外基質成分，從而實現侵襲、血管生成和微環境重塑。 Tumor Microenvironment 是培育或抑制惡性克隆的基質、免疫、血管和細胞外元素的集合。這種關係是有方向的，MMP 充當 Tumor Microenvironment 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: mTORC2
description: mTORC2 phosphorylates Akt at serine 473 within its hydrophobic motif, a modification required for full Akt catalytic activation alongside PDK1-mediated phosphorylation at Thr308. Active Akt then drives survival, growth, and mTORC1 activation, establishing an mTORC2-to-Akt-to-mTORC1 signaling cascade. This relationship makes mTORC2 an upstream regulator of the same anabolic and autophagy-suppressing programs executed by mTORC1. mTORC2's role in Akt activation is central to its pro-survival and metabolic functions.
description_zh_TW: mTORC2 在其疏水性基序內的 serine 473 磷酸化 Akt，此修飾與 PDK1 在 Thr308 的磷酸化共同為 Akt 催化活化所需。活化態的 Akt 隨後驅動存活、生長和 mTORC1 活化，建立起 mTORC2 至 Akt 至 mTORC1 的信號級聯。此關係使 mTORC2 成為由 mTORC1 執行的同一合成代謝與自噬抑制程序的上游調節者。mTORC2 在 Akt 活化中的角色對其促存活與代謝功能至關重要。

label: Metastasis
description: Epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition underlies carcinoma invasion and metastasis and contributes to resistance to chemotherapy and targeted therapy. SASP factors from senescent fibroblasts and epithelial cells enhance invasiveness, stemness and therapy resistance in adjacent tumor cells, so even a small senescent-cell burden can promote pre-neoplastic progression and dissemination.
description_zh_TW: Epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition 是 carcinoma 侵襲與 metastasis 的基礎，也促成對化學治療與標靶治療的抗藥性。來自衰老纖維母細胞與上皮細胞的 SASP 因子會增強鄰近腫瘤細胞的侵襲性、幹性與治療抗藥性，因此即使衰老細胞數量很少也能促進癌前進展與散布。

label: Peroxynitrite
description: Peroxynitrite (ONOO-) is the most powerful oxidant driving tyrosine nitration, converting a tyrosine residue to 3-nitrotyrosine either directly or via intermediate radicals (tyrosyl radical plus nitrogen dioxide). Peroxynitrite itself forms where nitric oxide and superoxide coincide, so nitration marks sites of combined nitric oxide and superoxide generation.
description_zh_TW: Peroxynitrite（ONOO-）是推動 Tyrosine Nitration 最強的氧化劑，可直接或經由中間自由基（tyrosyl radical 加 nitrogen dioxide）將酪胺酸殘基轉換為 3-nitrotyrosine。Peroxynitrite 本身在一氧化氮與超氧陰離子交會處形成，因此硝化標記出的是一氧化氮與超氧陰離子共同生成的位點。

label: Prefrontal Cortex
description: COMT (catechol-O-methyltransferase) dominates dopamine clearance in the prefrontal cortex because this brain region is sparsely populated with the dopamine transporter (DAT), forcing reliance on extracellular enzymatic degradation rather than rapid reuptake. By methylating dopamine into inactive 3-methoxytyramine using SAMe as cofactor, COMT sets the extracellular dopamine tone that governs prefrontal cognition, working memory, and executive control. The norepinephrine transporter contributes secondarily to this clearance. Because the Val158Met polymorphism changes COMT activity three- to four-fold, genetic variation in COMT has an outsized impact on prefrontal dopamine signaling.
description_zh_TW: COMT（兒茶酚-O-甲基轉移酶）主導前額葉皮質中的多巴胺清除，因為該 brain 區域稀疏地分佈有多巴胺轉運蛋白（DAT），迫使其依賴細胞外酶促降解而不是快速再攝取。透過使用 SAMe 作為輔因子將多巴胺甲基化為不活躍的 3-methoxytyramine，COMT 設定了控制前額認知、工作記憶和執行控制的細胞外多巴胺基調。 norepinephrine 運輸車對這項清除起到了次要的作用。由於 Val158Met 多態性使 COMT activity 發生三到四倍的變化，COMT 的遺傳變異對前額葉多巴胺訊號傳導產生巨大影響。

label: Neuroinflammation
description: Alpha-Synuclein Aggregation causes Neuroinflammation by acting as the upstream trigger whose downstream consequence is the second entity's appearance or dysfunction. The mechanism typically involves oxidative, mitochondrial, or proteotoxic injury in the case of neurotoxins and pigments, or receptor blockade and cell loss in pharmacological and degenerative contexts. This causal relationship is clinically significant because it models or explains features of Parkinson's disease pathology and guides therapeutic targeting. A caveat is that in many of these links the causal claim is experimental, partial, or operates within a broader network of cofactors rather than as an isolated linear event.
description_zh_TW: Alpha-Synuclein Aggregation 透過充當上游觸發器來導致 Neuroinflammation，其下游結果是第二個實體的出現或功能障礙。此機制通常涉及氧化、mitochondria1或neurotoxin和色素情況下的蛋白毒性損傷，或藥理學和退化環境中的受體阻斷和細胞損失。這種因果關係具有臨床意義，因為它模擬或解釋了 Parkinson's disease 病理特徵並指導治療目標。需要注意的是，在許多這些連結中，因果關係的主張是實驗性的、部分的，或是在更廣泛的輔助因子網絡中運作的，而不是作為一個孤立的線性事件。

label: Vitamin E
description: Red palm oil delivers 717-863 ppm of Vitamin E, roughly 10 mg per tablespoon, which is the same order as the 15 mg adult RDA. Unlike fully bleached and deodorized palm olein, low-temperature molecular distillation preserves about 80% of the crude oil's carotenoids and vitamin E. Heavy refining destroys 50-80% of the tocopherols and essentially all carotenoids, so minimally refined red palm oil is the nutritionally meaningful form and refined palm olein is not a comparable source.
description_zh_TW: Red palm oil 提供 717-863 ppm 的 Vitamin E，每一大匙約 10 mg，與成人 RDA 15 mg 屬同一量級。與完全漂白、脫臭的 palm olein 不同，低溫分子蒸餾可保留原油中約 80% 的類胡蘿蔔素與 vitamin E。重度精煉會破壞 50-80% 的 tocopherols，並幾乎摧毁所有類胡蘿蔔素，因此 minimally refined 的 red palm oil 才是有營養意義的形式，refined palm olein 並非等效來源。

label: Caspase-3
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: The executioner caspase-3 also directly cleaves SIRT1 during apoptosis. Because both the initiator caspase-9 and executioner caspase-3 process Sir2α, cleavage and the accompanying nuclear-to-cytoplasmic dislocation occur throughout the apoptotic process, not at a single checkpoint. In Ara-C-treated embryonic mouse brain, over 130 of 150 cells with cytoplasmic Sir2α had pyknotic nuclei, confirming in vivo that the caspase-3-era SIRT1 fragments mark terminally dying cells. Cleavage therefore converts an anti-apoptotic survival factor into processed fragments precisely when the death program becomes irreversible.
description_zh_TW: 執行者半胱天冬酶-3（Caspase-3）在細胞凋亡期間同樣會直接切割 SIRT1。由於起始 Caspase-9 與執行者 Caspase-3 都會處理 Sir2α，切割與伴隨的核質易位發生在整個細胞凋亡過程中，而非單一檢查點。在 Ara-C 處理的胚胎小鼠腦中，150 個細胞質型 Sir2α 細胞裡有超過 130 個呈現核固縮，證實在體內帶 caspase-3 特徵的 SIRT1 片段標記著走向終末的死亡細胞。當死亡程序變得不可逆時，切割便將抗凋亡的存活因子轉化為處理後的片段。

label: Hydrogen Peroxide
description: Peroxiredoxins are thiol-dependent peroxidases that detoxify hydrogen peroxide, peroxynitrite, and a range of organic hydroperoxides, reducing them to water. They are among the most abundant antioxidant proteins in the cell and act as primary H2O2 sinks and refined regulators of redox signaling.
description_zh_TW: 過氧化還原酶是依賴硫醇的過氧化酶，可將過氧化氫、過氧亞硝酸鹽及多種有機氫過氧化物解毒並還原為水。它們是細胞中最豐富的抗氧化蛋白之一，既是主要的 H2O2 匯集處，也是氧化還原訊息傳遞的精細調節者。

label: Mitochondrial Unfolded Protein Response
description: ATF5 is the mammalian transcription factor that mediates the mitochondrial unfolded protein response. Like C. elegans ATFS-1, ATF5 partitions between the nucleus and mitochondria, and under mitochondrial stress it localizes to the nucleus to induce chaperones and proteases that restore mitochondrial proteostasis.
description_zh_TW: ATF5 是介導 Mitochondrial Unfolded Protein Response 的哺乳類轉錄因子。與 C. elegans 的 ATFS-1 相同，ATF5 在細胞核與粒線體之間分配；在粒線體壓力下它定位至細胞核，誘導 chaperone 與 protease 以恢復粒線體蛋白恆定。

label: Hypoxia
description: Ischemic stroke is acute brain injury from focal arterial occlusion in which hypoxia collapses oxidative phosphorylation, producing an irreversibly necrotic core surrounded by a hypoperfused but salvageable penumbra that is the target of reperfusion therapy.
description_zh_TW: 缺血性中風是局部動脈阻塞造成的急性腦損傷，缺氧使氧化磷酸化崩潰，形成不可逆壞死的核心，外圍則是低灌流但可挽救的半暗帶，為再灌流治療的目標。

label: Macrophages
description: Crown-like structures (CLS) are histological formations in obese adipose tissue in which macrophages, predominantly of the pro-inflammatory M1 phenotype, form a ring around a single dead or dying adipocyte. CLS form after adipocyte hypertrophy and death, and their density in biopsies reports the inflammatory status of the tissue.
description_zh_TW: Crown-like Structures（CLS）是肥胖脂肪組織中的組織學構造，巨噬細胞（以促發炎 M1 表型為主）環繞單一死亡或瀕死 adipocyte 形成環狀排列。CLS 在 adipocyte肥大與死亡後形成，其在活檢中的密度可反映組織的發炎狀態。

label: MFN2
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Classical Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2A (CMT2A), a peripheral neuropathy, is directly caused by heterozygous mutations in the mitochondrial fusion-related gene MFN2, which encodes the outer mitochondrial membrane GTPase mitofusin 2. Mutations or deletions in MFN2 slow axonal transport in both directions and impair mitochondrial dynamics in peripheral nerves. MFN2 also participates in mitochondrial transport by interacting with mitochondrial Rho small GTPase, and MFN2 knockout in dopaminergic neurons reduces dopamine nerve terminals and striatal dopamine levels.
description_zh_TW: Classical Charcot-Marie-Tooth 病 type 2A (CMT2A)，一種 peripheral neuropathy，直接由 mitochondrial fusion-related gene MFN2 的 heterozygous mutations 引起，MFN2 編碼外線粒體膜 GTPase mitofusin 2。MFN2 的突變或缺失減慢 axonal transport in both directions 並 impair mitochondrial dynamics in peripheral nerves。MFN2 也通過與 mitochondrial Rho small GTPase 互動參與 mitochondrial transport，且 MFN2 knockout in dopaminergic neurons 減少 dopamine nerve terminals 和 striatal dopamine levels。

label: Fibrosis
description: TGF-beta drives organ fibrosis through collagen synthesis and MMP suppression. It is the dominant profibrotic cascade in lung, liver and kidney.
description_zh_TW: TGF-beta 經由膠原合成與 MMP 抑制驅動器官纖維化。它是肺、肝與腎的主要促纖維化級聯。

label: PARP1
description: PARP1 is one of four major NAD+-consuming enzyme families — with CD38, SARM1 and the sirtuins — that compete for a shared intracellular pool. PARP1 polymerizes ADP-ribose from NAD+ onto target proteins for DNA repair signaling, and hyperactivation can exhaust the pool, which is why combined CD38 plus PARP1 inhibition fully rescues NAD+ where single agents fail.
description_zh_TW: PARP1 是四大 NAD+ 消耗酵素家族之一——與 CD38、SARM1 及 sirtuins 競爭同一細胞內池。PARP1 將 NAD+ 的 ADP-核糖聚合到受質蛋白上以傳遞 DNA 修復訊號，而過度活化可能耗盡此池；這也是 CD38 與 PARP1 合併抑制能完全救援 NAD+、單一藥物卻做不到的原因。

label: BAX
source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md
description: BH3-only proteins activate BAX and dislodge BAK from anti-apoptotic restraint, allowing BAX/BAK oligomerization into lipidic pores; full synchronized pore formation is the pivotal commitment event of intrinsic apoptosis.
description_zh_TW: BH3-only 蛋白會活化 BAX 並將 BAK 從抗凋亡的抑制中釋放，使 BAX/BAK 寡聚化形成脂質孔道；全面同步的成孔即為內在性凋亡的關鍵承諾事件。

label: Methemoglobin
description: Cytochrome b5 reductase, also called NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase, is the enzyme that returns spontaneously formed methemoglobin (normally under 1-2% of total hemoglobin) to its functional ferrous Fe2+ state. By keeping hemoglobin in the ferrous state, this enzyme is what makes hemoglobin able to carry oxygen.
description_zh_TW: Cytochrome b5 reductase（又稱 NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase）是將自發形成的 methemoglobin（正常情況下佔總 hemoglobin 的 1–2% 以下）還原回具功能的 Fe2+ 狀態的酵素。藉由讓 hemoglobin 維持於 ferrous 狀態，此酵素使 hemoglobin 能夠攜帶氧氣。

label: DRP1
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: DRP1 (dynamin-related protein 1) is the key mediator of mitochondrial fission and belongs to the GTP-hydrolyzing enzyme family. Under stress, cytosolic DRP1 monomers are recruited to the outer mitochondrial membrane, where GTP binding promotes DRP1 linear oligomerization and subsequent GTP hydrolysis shortens and curls the oligomers into helical rings that constrict and sever both the outer and inner mitochondrial membranes. DRP1 activity is regulated by post-translational modifications including phosphorylation, S-nitrosylation, SUMOylation, O-GlcNAcylation and ubiquitination, with opposing phosphorylation sites (e.g., Ser616 stimulating and Ser637/656 inhibiting fission in most contexts).
description_zh_TW: DRP1 (dynamin-related protein 1) is the key mediator of mitochondrial fission and belongs to the GTP-hydrolyzing enzyme family。Under stress, cytosolic DRP1 monomers are recruited to the outer mitochondrial membrane, where GTP binding promotes DRP1 linear oligomerization and subsequent GTP hydrolysis shortens and curls the oligomers into helical rings that constrict and sever both the outer and inner mitochondrial membranes。DRP1 activity is regulated by post-translational modifications including phosphorylation, S-nitrosylation, SUMOylation, O-GlcNAcylation and ubiquitination, with opposing phosphorylation sites (e.g., Ser616 stimulating and Ser637/656 inhibiting fission in most contexts)。

label: Nicotinamide Mononucleotide
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md
description: Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) is the direct biosynthetic precursor of NAD+, a key intermediate that can be adenylylated by NMNAT to generate the coenzyme; as an NAD+ booster it enables activation of PGC-1a and sirtuin-mediated pathways.
description_zh_TW: Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) 是 NAD+ 的直接生合成前驅物，屬關鍵中間產物，可經 NMNAT 腺苷酸化生成該輔酶；作為 NAD+ 促進劑，NMN 能使 PGC-1α 與 sirtuin 媒介的路徑得以活化。

label: Parthanatos
description: Parthanatos is a regulated cell death program defined by PARP1 hyperactivation, PAR signaling, and AIF/MIF-dependent large-scale DNA fragmentation, distinct from caspase-dependent apoptosis and accidental necrosis.
description_zh_TW: Parthanatos 是一種受調控的細胞死亡程序，由 PARP1 過度活化、PAR 訊號傳遞以及 AIF/MIF 依賴的大尺度 DNA 片段化所定義，不同於 caspase 依賴的 apoptosis 與意外的 necrosis。

label: Relocalization of Chromatin Modifiers (RCM) Hypothesis
description: The Relocalization of Chromatin Modifiers (RCM) Hypothesis is a key framework in aging biology, primarily developed by David Sinclair and colleagues. It proposes that aging in eukaryotes results largely from the progressive loss of epigenetic information due to the repeated relocalization of chromatin-modifying proteins during DNA repair. Chromatin modifiers normally sit at specific genomic loci to maintain gene expression patterns that define cell identity, but are recruited to damage sites during repair, temporarily disrupting their original positions and altering local gene expression.
description_zh_TW: 染色質修飾因子再定位（RCM）假說是衰老生物學中的關鍵框架，主要由 David Sinclair 及其同事發展。該假說提出，真核生物的衰老主要源於表觀遺傳資訊的漸進性喪失，這是因為在 DNA 修復過程中染色質修飾蛋白質反覆再定位所致。染色質修飾因子通常定位於特定的基因組位點，以維持定義細胞身分的基因表達模式，但在修復期間被招募到損傷位點，暫時破壞其原始位置並改變局部基因表達。

label: Nitric Oxide
description: Volatile, lipophilic amyl nitrite releases nitric oxide and nitrite in vivo; liberated nitric oxide activates soluble guanylyl cyclase, raising cGMP and relaxing vascular smooth muscle — the basis of its anti-anginal and vasodilator effects.
description_zh_TW: 揮發性、亲脂性的 Amyl nitrite 在體內釋放 Nitric Oxide 與 nitrite；釋出的 Nitric Oxide 活化 Soluble Guanylyl Cyclase，使 cGMP 上升並放鬆血管平滑肌，這是其抗心絞痛與血管擴張作用的基礎。

label: Metformin
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: The TAME Trial (Targeting Aging with Metformin) is a FDA-approved clinical study testing whether Metformin delays aging-related multimorbidity. It enrolled 3000 participants aged 65 to 79 and examines whether metformin can attenuate the hallmarks of Aging and delay the onset of age-related diseases, using a framework of blood-based Biomarkers to monitor the intervention's effects.
description_zh_TW: TAME Trial（Targeting Aging with Metformin）是一項經 FDA 核准的臨床研究，測試 Metformin 能否延緩與老化相關的多病共存。它納入了 3000 名 65 至 79 歲的受試者，檢視 metformin 能否減弱老化的特徵並延後年齡相關疾病的發生，並以血液生物標記的框架監測介入的效應。

label: Spermidine
source_file: _document_ - Natural Bioactive Compounds Spermidine Fisetin Berberine Urolithin A.md
description: Spermidine reverses features of arterial aging, including large elastic artery stiffening, and restores nitric-oxide-mediated endothelial function in aged vessels. These vascular benefits are linked to spermidine-induced autophagy, which clears damaged mitochondria and reduces vascular oxidative stress and inflammation. By improving endothelial-dependent vasodilation, spermidine counteracts the stiffening that drives systolic hypertension and cardiovascular risk with age. The findings support spermidine as a candidate intervention for vascular rejuvenation.
description_zh_TW: 精胺逆轉動脈老化的特徵，包括大彈性動脈僵硬化，並恢復老化血管中一氧化氮介導的內皮功能。這些血管益處與精胺誘發的自噬相關，後者清除受損粒線體並減少血管氧化壓力和發炎。透過改善內皮依賴性血管舒張，精胺抵消了隨年齡驅動收縮期高血壓和心血管風險的僵硬化。這些發現支持精胺作為血管回春的候選介入。

label: Mitochondrial Fission
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Mitochondrial dynamics is the continuous remodeling of the cellular mitochondrial network through the two opposite but coordinated processes of fission and fusion, accompanied by mitophagy and ultrastructural reshaping of the inner and outer membranes. Fission divides a single mitochondrion into two daughter mitochondria and is driven by the dynamin-related GTPase DRP1 recruited to the outer mitochondrial membrane by adaptor proteins. The balance between fission and fusion is tightly regulated by conserved GTPase proteins and must be maintained to support normal mitochondrial and cellular function.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial dynamics 是通過 fission and fusion 兩個相反但 coordinated processes 進行的 continuous remodeling of the cellular mitochondrial network，accompanied by mitophagy and ultrastructural reshaping of the inner and outer membranes。Fission divides a single mitochondrion into two daughter mitochondria 並由 dynamin-related GTPase DRP1 driven，被 adaptor proteins recruited to the outer mitochondrial membrane。Fission and fusion 之間的 balance 由 conserved GTPase proteins tightly regulated 且 must be maintained to support normal mitochondrial and cellular function。

label: LC3
description: The LIR motif mediates direct binding to ATG8-family proteins, including LC3 and GABARAP, on the surface of the phagophore and mature autophagosome. This couples ubiquitylation to selective autophagy, enabling mitophagy and aggrephagy.
description_zh_TW: LIR 模體介導與 ATG8 家族蛋白（包括 LC3 與 GABARAP）在吞噬泡與成熟自噬體表面的直接結合。這將泛素化與選擇性自噬相耦合，使 mitophagy 與聚集體自噬成為可能。

label: CD38
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md
description: Malignant plasma cells in Multiple Myeloma express extremely high levels of CD38, which makes CD38 the premier therapeutic target in the disease; loss of CD38 from the surface by trogocytosis is a key resistance mechanism to anti-CD38 antibodies.
description_zh_TW: Multiple Myeloma 的惡性漿細胞極度高表達 CD38，使 CD38 成為該疾病最主要的治療標的；而透過 trogocytosis 自細胞表面剝除 CD38 則是對抗 anti-CD38 抗體的關鍵抗藥機制。

label: cGAS
description: cGAS synthesizes the endogenous cyclic dinucleotide messenger 2'3'-cGAMP from ATP and GTP upon sensing cytosolic DNA. cGAMP then binds STING in the endoplasmic reticulum, triggering STING translocation to the ERGIC and recruitment of TBK1 and IRF3 to drive type I interferon and ISG expression.
description_zh_TW: cGAS 在偵測到細胞質 DNA 後，以 ATP 與 GTP 合成內源性 Cyclic Dinucleotide 訊息傳遞者 2'3'-cGAMP。cGAMP 接著在內質網中結合 STING，促使 STING 易位至 ERGIC 並招募 TBK1 與 IRF3，進而驅動第一型干擾素與 ISG 的表現。

label: NLRP3 Inflammasome
description: ASC-speck proximity induces caspase-1 activation as the canonical inflammasome output. Activation executes pyroptotic and cytokine processing.
description_zh_TW: ASC 斑點鄰近誘發 caspase-1 活化作為典型發炎體輸出。活化執行焦亡與細胞激素處理。

label: MnSOD
description: The dismutation of superoxide by MnSOD yields hydrogen peroxide as its enzymatic product, which is then detoxified by catalase and peroxiredoxins/glutathione peroxidases. This product feeds the mitochondrial peroxide-relay, linking MnSOD to the thioredoxin/peroxiredoxin water-evolving arm of the redox system.
description_zh_TW: MnSOD 對超氧陰離子的歧化作用產生過氧化氫作為其酶產物，隨後由過氧化氫酶和過氧化還原酶/麩胱甘肽過氧化酶加以解毒。此產物供應粒線體過氧化物傳遞鏈，將 MnSOD 與硫氧還蛋白/過氧化還原酶的水生成還原分支聯繫起來。

label: Humanin
source_file: _document_ - Humanin a harbinger of mitochondrial-derived peptides?.md
description: Humanin is the first small peptide of a putative set of mitochondrial-derived peptides (MDPs), a novel concept that challenges the traditional view of mitochondria as passive end-function organelles. It was discovered in 2001 by screening a cDNA library from the surviving fraction of an Alzheimer's disease patient brain for clones protecting neuronal cells from cell death induced by APP mutants, and identified as a 75bp open reading frame yielding a 24 amino acid peptide encoded within the mitochondrial 16S rRNA. Humanin is a harbinger of additional MDPs, as numerous putative ORFs are dispersed throughout the mitochondrial genome.
description_zh_TW: Humanin 是推定之粒線體衍生胜肽（MDPs）群組中的第一個小胜肽，此一新穎概念挑戰了粒線體是被動終端功能胞器的傳統觀點。它於 2001 年透過篩選阿茲海默症患者腦部存活部分的 cDNA 文庫而被發現，用以尋找可保護神經元細胞免受 APP 突變誘導細胞死亡的選殖株，並被鑑定為 75 bp 的開放閱讀框架，編碼出位於粒線體 16S rRNA 內、由 24 個胺基酸組成的胜肽。Humanin 是更多 MDPs 出現的先兆，因為大量推定的 ORFs 散布於粒線體基因組中。

label: Epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition
source_file: _document_ - Cellular senescence and SASP in tumor progression and therapeutic opportunities.md
description: The Senescence-Associated Secretory Phenotype of senescent cells can induce epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition in neighbouring cancer cells, coupling chronic senescence to tumor aggressiveness. SASP factors act through several channels: TGF-beta directly activates EMT transcription factors, IL-6 and IL-8 engage STAT3 and NF-kappaB, and MMPs such as MMP-2 and MMP-9 cleave junctional and basement-membrane proteins to liberate latent TGF-beta and growth factors.
description_zh_TW: 衰老細胞的 Senescence-Associated Secretory Phenotype 可在鄰近癌細胞中誘發 epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition，將慢性衰老與腫瘤侵襲性連結起來。SASP 因子透過數個管道作用：TGF-beta 直接活化 EMT 轉錄因子，IL-6 與 IL-8 啟動 STAT3 與 NF-kappaB，而 MMP-2、MMP-9 等 MMP 則切割連接蛋白與 basement membrane 蛋白，釋出潛伏的 TGF-beta 與生長因子。

label: Mitochondrial ROS
description: Mitochondrial ROS are required for JNK activation downstream of TNFR1, representing an obligatory event in sustained JNK signaling that drives apoptosis and inflammation. The oxidants act as upstream amplifiers of the kinase cascade. The directionality is mtROS to JNK activation.
