A caveat is that JNK can also be activated by non-mitochondrial ROS and by MAPKKK upstream of mitochondria, so the requirement is context-dependent. Persistent JNK activation downstream of mitochondrial ROS promotes apoptosis and is implicated in stress-induced tissue injury.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial ROS 是 TNFR1 的 JNK activation 下游所必需的，代表驅動 apoptosis 和發炎的持續 JNK 訊號傳導中的必然事件。氧化剂充当激酶级联的上游放大器。方向性是mtROS 到JNK activation。需要注意的是，JNK 也可以由非 mitochondrial ROS 和 mitochondria 上游的 MAPKKK 激活，因此該要求取決於上下文。 mitochondrial ROS 下游持續存在的 JNK activation 會促進 apoptosis，並參與壓力誘發的組織損傷。

label: Acid ceramidase
description: Acid ceramidase (ACase, encoded by ASAH1) is the lysosomal enzyme that breaks down ceramide into sphingosine and free fatty acids. By controlling ceramide levels, ACase affects the abundance of many lipid species relevant to cell fate decisions, including sphingomyelin, ceramide-1-phosphate, and free fatty acids. In the context of replicative senescence, this ceramide catabolism releases free saturated and monounsaturated fatty acids that feed polyunsaturated fatty acid (PUFA) and PUFA-phospholipid synthesis, remodeling the membrane lipid profile. Acid ceramidase breaks down ceramides into sphingosine and free fatty acids, reshaping membrane lipid composition. In senescent cells, progressively higher expression of this enzyme drives a pro-ferroptotic lipid profile rich in polyunsaturated fatty acids - the preferred substrates for lipid peroxidation. Salk Institute researchers studying human lung cells discovered that elevated acid ceramidase makes senescent cells more susceptible to ferroptosis and that removal of the enzyme protects both young and old cells from ferroptosis-induced death. Because acid ceramidase inhibitors already exist for other therapeutic purposes, the enzyme represents a druggable target for clearing senescent cells and supporting healthy aging.
description_zh_TW: 酸甘油酯酶 (ACase, 编码基因 ASAH1) 是一种溶酶体酶，它将甘油酯分解为神经因子和游离脂肪酸。通过控制甘油酯水平，ACase 影响了许多与细胞命运决策相关的脂质物种的丰度，包括神经因子-1-磷酸酯和游离脂肪酸。在复制性衰老的情况下，这种甘油酯分解释放出饱和和单不饱和脂肪酸，这些脂肪酸为不饱和脂肪酸 (PUFA) 和 PUFA-磷脂合成提供营养，从而重塑膜脂质谱。 酸陶瓷酶將絲胺類分解成腎上腺素和自由脂肪酸，重塑膜脂類組成。在老化的細胞中，這種酶的表達水平隨著時間推移而升高，導致富含不飽和脂肪酸的促進焦蛋白死亡的脂類型態 - 這是脂質過氧化反應的理想底物。沙鹿研究所研究員在研究人類肺細胞時發現，升高後的酸陶瓷酶使老化的細胞更容易受到焦蛋白死亡的影響，並且去除這種酶可以保護年輕和年老的細胞免受焦蛋白誘導的死亡。因為酸陶瓷酶抑制劑已經存在於其他治療用途中，因此這種酶是一個可藥物標靶的目標，可以用於清除老化的細胞並支持健康老齡化。

label: Senescent Cells
description: Senescent cells are the producers of the SASP, the ensemble of secreted factors that mediates most of their non-cell-autonomous effects on neighboring cells and the systemic milieu. The SASP is actively synthesized and released by the arrested cell rather than leaking passively, and its composition reflects the upstream inducing pathway and tissue context. This production enables paracrine senescence, immune recruitment, and inflammaging, converting a single arrested cell into a source of broad tissue influence. The senescent cell is thus the source and the SASP its principal effector output.
description_zh_TW: 衰老細胞是 SASP 的產生者，SASP 是介導其對鄰近細胞與全身微環境大多數非細胞自主性效應的分泌因子集合。SASP 由停滯細胞主動合成與釋放，而非被動滲漏，其組成反映上游誘發路徑與組織脈絡。此產生促成旁分泌衰老、免疫招募與 inflammaging，將單一停滯細胞轉化為廣泛組織影響的來源。因此衰老細胞是來源，而 SASP 是其主要指效輸出。

label: Mitochondrial Dysfunction
description: Mitohormesis is triggered by mild mitochondrial stress, which can arise from a variety of insults including genetic or pharmacological disruption of the electron transport chain, incorrect folding of mitochondrial matrix proteins, or stalling of mitochondrial ribosomes. These perturbations are relayed from the mitochondria to the cytosol and nucleus through retrograde signaling mechanisms, including mitochondrial ROS release and peptide export. Rather than being harmful, this coordinated response induces cytoprotective programs that reduce subsequent stress susceptibility.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體促效應由輕度粒線體壓力觸發，這種壓力可能源自多種損傷，包括電子傳遞鏈的基因或藥物破壞、粒線體基質蛋白的錯誤折疊，或粒線體核糖體的停滯。這些擾動透過逆行訊號機制從粒線體傳遞到細胞質和細胞核，包括粒線體 ROS 釋放和肽段輸出。這種協調反應並非有害，而是誘導細胞保護程式，降低後續的壓力易感性。

label: Quiescence
description: Quiescence is a state of reversible proliferative arrest in which cells exit the cell cycle but retain the capacity to re-enter upon appropriate stimuli. It is enforced at the restriction point by the retinoblastoma protein (pRb), which sequesters E2F transcription factors and blocks S-phase gene expression until mitogenic signals release the block. Unlike senescence, quiescence is reversible and lacks a senescence-associated secretory phenotype, and it is a key protective state for adult stem cells.
description_zh_TW: Quiescence 是一種可逆的增殖停滯狀態，其中細胞退出細胞週期，但保留在適當刺激下重新進入細胞週期的能力。它在限制點由視網膜母細胞瘤蛋白 (pRb) 強制執行，該蛋白隔離 E2F 轉錄因子並阻斷 S 期 gene expression，直到有絲分裂信號釋放阻斷。與老化不同，靜止是可逆的，並且缺乏與老化相關的分泌表型，它是成體幹細胞的關鍵保護狀態。

label: HLH-30
description: HLH-30 prevents aging and extends lifespan in C. elegans; hlh-30 mutants are short-lived, and loss of hlh-30 suppresses the longevity conferred by mxl-3 deletion. By driving autophagy, lysosomal biogenesis, and lipid mobilization, HLH-30 preserves proteostasis and metabolic homeostasis that decline with age. Its activity embodies the conserved mechanism by which enhanced clearance promotes longevity across species. The epistasis with mxl-3 places HLH-30 downstream as the effector of the pro-longevity program.
description_zh_TW: HLH-30 在線蟲中防止老化並延長壽命；hlh-30 突變體壽命短，且 hlh-30 的缺失抑制了 mxl-3 缺失所賦予的長壽。透過驅動自噬、溶酶體生物發生和脂質動員，HLH-30 維持了隨年齡衰退的蛋白質穩態和代謝恆定性。其活性體現了增強清除能跨越物種促進長壽的保守機制。與 mxl-3 的遺傳上位性將 HLH-30 置於下游，作為促長壽程序的效應物。

label: Vitamin C
description: Ascorbate is the water-phase reductant that regenerates the α-tocopheroxyl radical at the membrane-water interface, which is why one tocopherol molecule can trap many peroxyl radicals before it is lost. Vitamin E is therefore catalytic rather than stoichiometric, and its functional reserve is set by the ascorbate, glutathione and NADPH pool rather than by tocopherol concentration.
description_zh_TW: Ascorbate 是水相還原劑，在膜－水介面上將 α-tocopheroxyl 自由基再生，因此單一 tocopherol 分子在被消耗前可捕捉許多過氧自由基。Vitamin E 因此是催化性而非化學計量性的，其功能儲備由 ascorbate、glutathione 與 NADPH 的儲備決定，而非由 tocopherol 濃度決定。

label: Methemoglobinemia
description: Methylene blue is an established treatment for methemoglobinemia, a condition in which red blood cells cannot carry oxygen properly. It has been a first-line treatment for this indication since the early 20th century and remains on the World Health Organization's list of essential medicines. The clinical treatment dose for methemoglobinemia is 0.5-4 mg/kg (roughly 35-280 mg for a 70 kg adult), which is well above the micro-doses used in longevity and cognitive protocols. This medical use is distinct from wellness applications; at the very high doses used in medical settings methylene blue can paradoxically induce methemoglobin formation in some contexts.
description_zh_TW: 亞甲基藍是治療高鐵血紅蛋白血症的 established 方法，這是一種紅血球無法正常攜帶氧氣的疾病。自 20 世紀初以來，它一直是此適應症的一線治療，並仍在世界衛生組織基本藥物清單上。高鐵血紅蛋白血症的臨床治療劑量為 0.5-4 mg/kg（約 35-280 mg，適用於 70 kg 成人），遠高於 longevity 和認知方案中使用的 micro-doses。這種醫療用途與 wellness 應用不同；在醫療環境中使用的非常高劑量下，亞甲基藍在某些情況下可能 paradoxically 誘導高鐵血紅蛋白形成。

label: Bcl-2
description: ABT-263 inhibits Bcl-2. ABT-263 (navitoclax) is the orally bioavailable successor to ABT-737 whose Bcl-xL inhibition causes on-target thrombocytopenia. Bcl-2 is the founding anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 family member that preserves mitochondrial outer-membrane integrity and was the first apoptosis regulator linked to cancer. The relationship is directional, with ABT-263 acting as the operative agent upon Bcl-2 rather than the reverse. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
description_zh_TW: ABT-263 抑制 Bcl-2。 ABT-263 (navitoclax) 是 ABT-737 的口服生物利用型後繼者，其 Bcl-xL 抑製作用會導致標靶血小板減少症。 Bcl-2 是第一個抗凋亡Bcl-2 family 成員，可保護粒線體外膜的完整性，並且是第一個與癌症相關的細胞凋亡調節因子。這種關係是有方向的，ABT-263 充當 Bcl-2 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: Glycolysis
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: 2-deoxy-D-glucose is phosphorylated by hexokinase to 2-deoxyglucose-6-phosphate, which accumulates and competitively inhibits hexokinase and phosphoglucose isomerase, blocking the glycolytic flux. Its blockade of glycolysis produces a transient ATP drop that mimics caloric restriction and shifts cells toward mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation.
description_zh_TW: 2-deoxy-D-glucose 經 hexokinase 磷酸化為 2-deoxyglucose-6-phosphate 後累積，並競爭性抑制 hexokinase 與 phosphoglucose isomerase，因而阻斷 glycolysis。其對 glycolysis 的阻斷造成暫時性 ATP 下降，模擬 Caloric Restriction，並使細胞轉向粒線體的 Oxidative Phosphorylation。

label: Melanoma
description: Individuals with Oculocutaneous Albinism are exquisitely sensitive to UV radiation and have a substantially elevated lifetime risk of Melanoma and non-melanoma skin cancer. Chronic sun damage leads to solar elastosis, lentigines, and actinic keratoses. Lifelong dermatologic surveillance is required.
description_zh_TW: 患有 Oculocutaneous Albinism 的人對 UV 輻射極為敏感，一生中發生 Melanoma 和非黑色素瘤皮膚癌的風險大幅升高。慢性日曬損傷會導致日光性彈性變性、雀斑樣痣和光化性角化病。需要終生的皮膚科監測。

label: Akt
description: Akt phosphorylates TFEB at serine 467, a C-terminal residue within the regulatory cluster that contributes to cytoplasmic retention of the transcription factor downstream of insulin and growth-factor signaling. By adding to the phosphorylation state of TFEB, Akt reinforces the anabolic, autophagy-suppressed state promoted by PI3K-Akt-mTOR signaling. This modification complements mTORC1-mediated marks and integrates proliferative cues with repression of degradative transcription. The Akt-TFEB link embeds TFEB within the canonical survival signaling network.
description_zh_TW: Akt 在 serine 467 磷酸化 TFEB，此 C 端殘基位於調節簇內，在胰島素和生長因子信號下游促進該轉錄因子的細胞質保留。透過增加 TFEB 的磷酸化狀態，Akt 強化了 PI3K-Akt-mTOR 信號所促進的合成代謝、自噬受抑制狀態。此修飾補充了 mTORC1 介導的標記，並將增生線索與降解轉錄的抑制整合起來。Akt-TFEB 連結將 TFEB 嵌入典型的存活信號網絡中。

label: Quercetin
description: Quercetin is a catechol flavonoid, a flavonol whose B-ring bears two adjacent hydroxyl groups, classifying it as a dietary catechol and a COMT substrate. Its catechol structure also enables competitive COMT inhibition at higher doses, influencing both its own pharmacokinetics and those of co-ingested catechols like EGCG. It is among the most abundant flavonoids in the human diet, found in onions, apples, and tea, where it contributes to antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects. Its metabolism by COMT links dietary intake to genotype-dependent disposition.
description_zh_TW: Quercetin 是 catechol flavonoid 的黃酮醇，其 B 環帶有兩個相鄰的羥基，將其歸類為膳食兒茶酚和 COMT 底物。其兒茶酚結構也能夠在較高劑量下實現競爭性 COMT 抑制，從而影響其自身的藥物動力學以及共同攝入的兒茶酚（如 EGCG）的藥物動力學。它是人類飲食中最豐富的類黃酮之一，存在於洋蔥、蘋果和茶中，有助於抗氧化和 anti-inflammatory effects。 COMT 的代謝將飲食攝取與基因型依賴性處置聯繫起來。

label: MicroRNA
description: MicroRNAs bind Messenger RNA to control its stability, localization, and translation, together with other RNA-binding proteins and non-coding RNAs. Locked Nucleic Acid–based inhibitors exploit the same axis to repress mRNA translation or promote its degradation, which is why nucleic-acid senolytic and antisense strategies treat mRNA as their substrate.
description_zh_TW: MicroRNA 會與 Messenger RNA 結合，控制其穩定性、定位與轉譯，並與其他 RNA 結合蛋白及非編碼 RNA 協同作用。以 Locked Nucleic Acid 為基礎的抑制劑利用同一條軸線來抑制 mRNA 轉譯或促進其降解，因此核酸類 senolytic 與反義策略都把 mRNA 當作作用受質。

label: Catalase
description: Catalase, constitutively present in the peroxisomal matrix, decomposes hydrogen peroxide — a toxic byproduct of peroxisomal oxidase reactions — into water and oxygen (2 H2O2 -> 2 H2O + O2). This makes peroxisomes central to cellular detoxification of reactive oxygen species.
description_zh_TW: Catalase 恆定存在於過氧化體基質中，可將過氧化氫（過氧化物體氧化酶反應產生的毒性副產物）分解為水與氧（2 H2O2 -> 2 H2O + O2）。這使過氧化物體成為細胞解毒活性氧族群的核心場所。

label: Oxidative Phosphorylation
source_file: _document_ - The Mechanistic Target of Rapamycin (mTOR) Pathway as a Target of Anti-aging Therapies The Role of Rapamycin and Its Analogs in the Regulation of Cellular Processes and Their Impact on Longevity.md
description: Adenosine Triphosphate (ATP) is the universal energy currency of the cell, coupling exergonic and endergonic reactions through phosphate-bond hydrolysis. It is produced mainly by Oxidative Phosphorylation at the Inner Mitochondrial Membrane, with glycolysis contributing under anaerobic conditions.
description_zh_TW: Adenosine Triphosphate（ATP）是細胞的通用能量貨幣，透過磷酸鍵水解連結放能與吸能反應。它主要由 Inner Mitochondrial Membrane 上的 Oxidative Phosphorylation 產生，無氧條件下則有糖解作用參與貢獻。

label: Lipid Peroxidation
source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md
description: Acrolein (CH2=CH-CHO, 2-propenal) is the simplest alpha,beta-unsaturated aldehyde and one of the most electrophilic products of Lipid Peroxidation. It arises from beta-scission of PUFA hydroperoxides, notably omega-3 species such as Docosahexaenoic acid, whose chain length and double-bond placement favor release of a three-carbon fragment. Because its vinyl group flanks a carbonyl, it is a potent Michael acceptor that modifies protein cysteine, histidine and lysine residues and forms DNA adducts at concentrations well below those required for Malondialdehyde or 4-Hydroxynonenal.
description_zh_TW: Acrolein（CH2=CH-CHO，2-propenal）是最簡單的 α,β-不飽和醛，也是 Lipid Peroxidation 最具親電性的產物之一。它來自 PUFA 過氧化物的 β-scission，尤其是 Docosahexaenoic acid 等 omega-3 脂肪酸，其鏈長與雙鍵位置有利於釋出三碳片段。由於其乙烯基緊鄰羰基，它是強效的 Michael 受體，可在遠低於 Malondialdehyde 或 4-Hydroxynonenal 所需的濃度下修飾蛋白質的 cysteine、histidine 與 lysine 殘基並形成 DNA 加合物。

label: Induced Pluripotent Stem Cells
description: Disease modeling uses induced pluripotent stem cells to recreate genetic diseases in vitro by reprogramming patient somatic cells and differentiating them into the affected cell types. iPSC-derived models recapitulate disease phenotypes, such as TDP-43 mislocalization in frontotemporal dementia neurons, enabling mechanistic dissection of pathology and identification of therapeutic targets. Because the cells carry the patient's actual genome, they also support drug screening and personalized medicine approaches.
description_zh_TW: 疾病建模使用誘導多能幹細胞，透過對患者體細胞進行重新編程並將其分化為受影響的細胞類型，在體外重現遺傳疾病。 iPSC 衍生模型概括了疾病表型，例如額顳葉失智症神經元中的 TDP-43 錯誤定位，從而能夠對病理進行機械剖析並識別治療標靶。由於細胞攜帶患者的實際基因組，因此它們也支持藥物篩選和個人化醫療方法。

label: Honokiol
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Honokiol, a lipid-soluble lignan extracted from Magnolia species, readily crosses the blood-brain barrier to exert its effects in the central nervous system, including anti-tumorigenic and neuroprotective actions. Its lipid solubility allows it to pass lipid bilayers and act at multiple intracellular and membrane sites, a property shared with the structurally related anesthetic propofol and the analog magnolol. BBB penetration is a prerequisite for honokiol's anxiolytic, analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and anti-seizure activities in the brain.
description_zh_TW: 厚朴酚是從木蘭屬（Magnolia）植物中提取的脂溶性木脂素，能輕易穿越血腦屏障，在中樞神經系統中發揮作用，包括抗腫瘤生成與神經保護作用。其脂溶性使其能穿過脂質雙層，作用於多個細胞內與膜上的位點，此特性與結構相關的麻醉劑丙泊酚及類似物和厚朴酚共通。穿透血腦屏障是厚朴酚在大腦中發揮抗焦慮、鎮痛、抗發炎與抗癲癇活性的先決條件。

label: DNA Damage
description: DNA damage, particularly persistent double-strand breaks, is a potent inducer of senescence through activation of the DNA damage response (DDR). The ATM/ATR kinases phosphorylate and stabilize the transcription factor p53, which transcribes p21CIP1 to inhibit cyclin-CDK complexes and enforce arrest. Damage-induced senescence acts as a barrier to malignant transformation by halting proliferation of genomically unstable cells. A caveat is that the same DDR can also drive a pro-inflammatory SASP, so DNA damage both suppresses and, chronically, may promote pathology.
description_zh_TW: DNA 損傷，特別是持續性的雙股斷裂，透過活化 DNA 損傷反應（DDR）而成為強效的衰老誘發因子。ATM/ATR 激酶磷酸化並穩定轉錄因子 p53，後者轉錄 p21CIP1 以抑制 cyclin-CDK 複合體並強制停滯。損傷誘發的衰老透過阻斷基因組不穩定細胞的增殖，作為惡性轉化的屏障。但需注意，同一 DDR 也能驅動促發炎的 SASP，因此 DNA 損傷一方面抑制、在慢性情況下卻也可能促進病理。

label: Aminoguanidine
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: Aminoguanidine, also developed as pimagedine by Alteon/Synvista Therapeutics, is the first identified inhibitor of advanced glycation end products (AGEs). By trapping reactive carbonyl species, it prevents the cross-linking of tissue proteins that is proposed to drive many features of aging. Most anti-aging research has been carried out using a hydrochloride (HCL) derivative, which is more soluble and less irritating than the bicarbonate form, and aminoguanidine has a half-life of only 4 hours, so dosages of 150-300 mg per day are best administered in split doses.
description_zh_TW: 氨基胍丁 (Aminoguanidine)，也由 Alteon/Synvista Therapeutics 开发为皮马地宁 (pimagadidine)，是先进糖基化终产物 (AGEs) 的首个抑制剂。通过捕获反应性羰基物种，它能阻止组织蛋白的交联，这被认为是导致衰老许多特征的原因。大部分抗衰老研究都使用盐酸盐 (HCL) 衍生物进行，该衍生物比碳酸氢盐形式更可溶且刺激性更小，而氨基胍丁的半衰期仅为 4 小时，因此，每日 150-300 毫克分剂量给药效果最佳。

label: Apigenin
description: Apigenin halts cell cycle progression in cancer cells at either the G1 or G2/M phase depending on the cell type. In breast, colon, bladder, and lung cancer cells it induces G2/M arrest associated with decreased cyclin B1 and CDK1 (cdc2) expression and kinase activity, whereas in prostate and cervical cells it produces G1 arrest with reduced cyclin D, E and CDK2/4/6 levels. These blocks are linked to induction of the CDK inhibitors p21/Waf1 and p27/Kip1, inhibition of Rb phosphorylation, and can occur through both p53-dependent and p53-independent pathways.
description_zh_TW: 阿皮ゲ寧會阻止癌細胞在 G1 或 G2/M 期進程，具體取決於細胞類型。在乳癌、大腸癌、膀胱癌和肺癌細胞中，它會誘導 G2/M 期停育，與細胞週期蛋白 B1 和 Cdk1 (cdc2) 的表達和激酶活性降低有關；而在前列腺癌和子宮頸細胞中，則會產生 G1 期停育，降低細胞週期蛋白 D、E 和 Cdk2/4/6 的水平。這些阻礙與 P21/Waf1 和 P27/Kip1 的誘導、Rb 磷酸化抑制以及通過 P53 依賴性和非依賴性途徑發生的情況有關。

label: Epinephrine
description: Adrenaline-quinone is the first major intermediate of the epinephrine 'side pathway': under oxidative stress or alkaline conditions the catechol ring of epinephrine loses two electrons to become this highly electrophilic o-quinone. A one-electron oxidation of the same ring first yields the adrenaline semiquinone radical.
description_zh_TW: Adrenaline-quinone 是 epinephrine「旁路」的第一個主要中間體：在 Oxidative Stress 或鹼性條件下，Epinephrine 的 Catechol 環失去兩個電子而形成這個高度親電的 o-quinone；同一環先經單電子氧化則生成 adrenaline semiquinone 自由基。

label: Glutathione
description: System Xc- (SLC7A11/SLC3A2 cystine/glutamate antiporter) imports cystine in exchange for glutamate; intracellular cystine is reduced to cysteine, the rate-limiting precursor for Glutathione synthesis. Its inhibition (e.g., by erastin) depletes GSH and is the classic trigger of GPX4-dependent ferroptosis, defining the upstream node of the parallel GPX4 axis.
description_zh_TW: System Xc-（SLC7A11/SLC3A2 胱氨酸/麩氨酸逆向轉運體）以麩氨酸交換導入胱氨酸；細胞內胱氨酸被還原為半胱氨酸，即 Glutathione 合成的速率限制前驅物。其抑制（例如被 erastin）會耗竭 GSH，是 GPX4 依賴性鐵死亡的典型觸發因子，界定了平行 GPX4 軸的上游節點。

label: DNA Methylation
description: Genomic Imprinting silences one parental allele through germline DNA Methylation at imprinting control regions, producing parent-of-origin-specific expression from IGF2/H19 and 15q11-q13 clusters.
description_zh_TW: Genomic Imprinting（基因組印記）透過在 imprinting 控制區（ICR）進行生殖系 DNA Methylation（DNA 甲基化）來沉默其中一個親代等位基因，使 IGF2/H19 與 15q11-q13 叢集呈現親代來源特異性的表現。

label: Hormesis
description: Atypical dose-response curves where a drug's effect does not follow a monotonic shape are referred to as hormetic or biphasic. This computational study shows that all hormetic networks share a similar core structure: an incoherent bivalent network motif centered on the target of the drug, in which the two interactions emanating from the target have net opposite (direct or indirect) effects over the downstream output. Around 18% of all three-node network topologies contain this motif, and topologies with an incoherent bivalent motif show a roughly five-fold increased probability of exhibiting hormesis compared with all topologies.
description_zh_TW: 藥物效應不呈單調形狀的非典型劑量反應曲線稱為荷爾米希（hormetic）或雙相反應。這項計算研究顯示，所有荷爾米希網路共享相似的核心結構：以藥物靶點為中心的不一致雙價網路模體（incoherent bivalent network motif），其中由靶點發出的兩條交互作用對下游輸出具有淨相反（直接或間接）的效應。約 18% 的三節點網路拓撲含有此模體，而含有不一致雙價模體的拓撲展現荷爾米希反應的機率約為所有拓撲的五倍。

label: Cellular Senescence
source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md
description: Cellular senescence is a key response to various cellular stresses characterized by a permanent cell cycle arrest and the secretion of a pro-inflammatory cocktail of factors known as the senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP). Senescence serves protective roles in embryonic development, tumour suppression and tissue repair, but persistent SASP activation leads to chronic inflammation contributing to tissue dysfunction, ageing and a broad spectrum of age-related diseases including cancer. This dual nature makes SASP a focal point for understanding both the protective and detrimental effects of senescence.
description_zh_TW: 細胞衰老是對各種細胞應激的關鍵反應，其特徵是永久性細胞週期停滯和分泌一組促炎因子混合物，稱為衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）。衰老在胚胎發育、腫瘤抑制和組織修復中起保護作用，但持續的SASP激活導致慢性炎症，從而導致組織功能障礙、老化和包括癌症在內的廣泛年齡相關疾病。這種雙重性質使SASP成為理解衰老的保護性和有害性效應的焦點。

label: Alzheimer's Disease
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Alzheimer disease is the most common dementia and neurodegenerative disorder. Classification nests it in the disease family.
description_zh_TW: 阿茲海默病是最常見的失智與神經退化疾病。歸類將它嵌套於疾病家族。

label: Lysosome
description: The V-ATPase is a multi-subunit proton pump with V0 membrane and V1 cytosolic domains that maintains the acidic lysosomal lumen at about pH 4.5-5.5. This low pH is what activates more than 50 intralysosomal hydrolases, so V-ATPase is the enzyme that makes lysosomal degradation chemistry possible.
description_zh_TW: V-ATPase 是由 V0 膜區與 V1 細胞質區構成的多次單元質子幫浦，負責將溶酶體腔維持在約 pH 4.5–5.5 的酸性環境。這個低 pH 正是活化超過 50 種溶酶體內水解酶的條件，因此 V-ATPase 是使溶酶體降解化學反應得以進行的酵素。

label: mTOR
description: When it is over-activated by nutrients and insulin, mTOR acts via S6K1 to inhibit insulin signaling, thereby causing insulin resistance. Acute treatment with rapamycin abrogates insulin resistance in cells and animals including humans, and one study shows chronic treatment with rapamycin may also prevent insulin resistance. However, in some rodent models chronic rapamycin treatment can cause glucose intolerance and insulin resistance, which is interpreted as a benevolent starvation pseudo-diabetes (SPD), a reversible condition that does not lead to complications and resembles the metabolic state of prolonged fasting.
description_zh_TW: 當被營養素和胰島素過度活化時，mTOR透過S6K1抑制胰島素信號，從而導致胰島素抵抗。急性雷帕霉素治療可消除細胞和動物（包括人類）的胰島素抵抗，一項研究顯示慢性雷帕霉素治療也可能預防胰島素抵抗。然而，在某些囓齒類模型中，慢性雷帕霉素治療可能導致葡萄糖不耐受和胰島素抵抗，這被解釋為一種良性飢餓假性糖尿病（SPD），一種可逆且不會導致併發症的狀態，類似於長期禁食的代謝狀態。

label: Atherosclerosis
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: Atherosclerosis is the underlying cause of most cardiovascular disease. Contribution records the etiologic direction.
description_zh_TW: 動脈粥狀硬化是多數心血管疾病的根本原因。貢獻記錄病因方向。

label: Fenbendazole
description: Drug repositioning includes fenbendazole, an established benzimidazole anthelmintic now studied for its interference with microtubules, glycolysis, and p53 in tumors. The approach aims to convert a safe veterinary/human agent into a cancer therapeutic. The relationship is directional and reflects the logic of repurposing known drugs. Clinical validation for fenbendazole in oncology is still lacking.
description_zh_TW: Drug Repositioning 包括芬苯達唑，一種成熟的苯並咪唑驅蟲藥，目前正在研究其對腫瘤微管、糖酵解和 p53 的幹擾。該方法旨在將安全的獸醫/人類藥物轉化為癌症治療劑。這種關係是方向性的，反映了重新利用已知藥物的邏輯。芬苯達唑在腫瘤學的臨牀驗證仍缺乏。

label: Exercise
description: Regular physical exercise reduces AGE accumulation in tissues. In rats, 12 weeks of moderate exercise reduced CML and RAGE in aortic vessels, and treadmill exercise from late middle age to 35 months reduced cardiac AGE levels. Life-long trained athletes had 21% lower AGE cross-link content in the patellar tendon than age-matched untrained subjects, and regular exercise prevented renal AGE deposition in D-galactose-induced aging rats. Physical exercise is therefore proposed as a powerful weapon against AGE formation and AGE-related aging processes.
description_zh_TW: 規律的身體運動可減少組織中的 AGE 堆積。在大鼠中，12 週的中度運動減少了主動脈血管的 CML 與 RAGE，而從中晚年持續到 35 個月的跑步機運動減少了心臟 AGE 濃度。終身訓練的運動員其髕腱中的 AGE 交聯含量比年齡匹配的未訓練者低 21%，且規律運動預防了 D-半乳糖誘發老化大鼠的腎臟 AGE 沉積。因此，身體運動被提議為對抗 AGE 形成與 AGE 相關老化過程的有力武器。

label: SIRT7
description: SIRT7 has deacetylase activity and plays a critical role in ageing and lifespan of hematopoietic cells in humans. SIRT7 is an influence factor in healthy aging and the development of age-dependent myeloid stem-cell disorders. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of haematopoietic stem cell maintenance and healthy aging, with dysregulation linked to age-dependent blood disorders.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7具有去乙醯酶活性，在人類造血細胞的老化和壽命中發揮關鍵作用。SIRT7是健康老化和年齡依賴性骨髓幹細胞疾病發展的影響因子。方向上，SIRT7位於造血幹細胞維護和健康老化的上游，其失調與年齡依賴性血液疾病相關。

label: Inflammaging
description: The senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP) is the ensemble of pro-inflammatory cytokines, chemokines, and matrix-remodeling enzymes secreted by senescent cells. Accumulation of senescent cells with age creates a chronic, low-grade inflammatory milieu that drives inflammaging—the sterile inflammation implicated in nearly all age-related diseases. SASP factors recruit immune cells, promote fibrosis, and induce paracrine senescence in neighboring cells, establishing feed-forward tissue deterioration. Targeting senescent cells or their SASP is a major therapeutic avenue to reduce inflammaging.
description_zh_TW: 衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）是衰老細胞分泌的促發炎細胞激素、趨化因子和基質重塑酵素之集合。衰老細胞隨年齡累積，創造出慢性、低度的發炎環境，驅動 inflammaging——一種與幾乎所有與年齡相關疾病有關的無菌性發炎。SASP 因子招募免疫細胞、促進纖維化，並誘發鄰近細胞的旁分泌性衰老，建立前饋式的組織惡化。標靶衰老細胞或其 SASP 是減少 inflammaging 的一個主要治療途徑。

label: SIRT4
description: In pancreatic islets of calorically restricted mice, SIRT4 expression is reduced, shifting the mitochondrial sirtuin balance toward the protective, oxidative-phosphorylation-promoting actions of SIRT3. Because SIRT4 normally restrains amino-acid-stimulated insulin secretion and mitochondrial fat oxidation, its downregulation supports improved β-cell metabolic flexibility. The directionality is that CR suppresses SIRT4 transcription, altering the SIRT3/SIRT4 ratio. Aging shows the opposite pattern—rising SIRT4 and falling SIRT3—so CR counters the age-related drift in this ratio.
description_zh_TW: 在熱量限制小鼠的胰腺胰島中，SIRT4 表達降低，使粒線體 sirtuin 平衡向 SIRT3 的保護性、促進氧化磷酸化的作用傾斜。由於 SIRT4 通常抑制胺基酸刺激的胰島素分泌和粒線體脂肪氧化，其下調支持改善的 β 細胞代謝靈活性。其方向性為 CR 抑制 SIRT4 轉錄，改變 SIRT3/SIRT4 比值。衰老呈現相反的模式——SIRT4 上升而 SIRT3 下降——因此 CR 抵消了這種比值的年齡相關漂移。

label: Necroptosis
description: c-FLIP, structurally related to but catalytically inactive as a homodimer partner, pairs with Caspase-8 to block apoptosis; when Caspase-8 or c-FLIP is lost or its activation interrupted, RIPK1 complexes with RIPK3 to assemble the necrosome — the FADD–caspase-8–c-FLIP complex acts as the rheostat that suppresses RIPK3-mediated death.
description_zh_TW: c-FLIP 與 Caspase-8 結構相近但具催化惰性，與 Caspase-8 配對以阻斷凋亡；當 Caspase-8 或 c-FLIP 缺失、或其中斷活化時，RIPK1 與 RIPK3 複合組裝成 necrosome——FADD–caspase-8–c-FLIP 複合物即為抑制 RIPK3 媒介死亡的調節器。

label: cGAS-STING Pathway
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: In senescence and ageing, mitochondrial dysfunction promotes the cytosolic release of mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA), which activates cGAS-STING signalling and drives inflammatory responses and the SASP. Cytosolic mtDNA levels were unchanged in senescent MRC5 and IMR90 fibroblasts following SLC25A1 inhibition, indicating that metabolic regulation of histone acetylation restrains SASP independently of mtDNA release. STING inhibition with SN011 suppresses SASP gene expression without affecting histone acetylation, showing that mtDNA-driven innate immune signalling and mitochondrial control of histone acetylation are independent but complementary inputs that converge to enable full SASP expression.
description_zh_TW: In senescence and ageing，mitochondrial dysfunction promotes cytosolic release of mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA)，which activates cGAS-STING signalling 並 drives inflammatory responses 和 SASP。Cytosolic mtDNA levels 在 senescent MRC5 和 IMR90 fibroblasts following SLC25A1 inhibition 時 unchanged，indicating that metabolic regulation of histone acetylation restrains SASP independently of mtDNA release。STING inhibition with SN011 suppresses SASP gene expression without affecting histone acetylation，showing that mtDNA-driven innate immune signalling 和 mitochondrial control of histone acetylation are independent but complementary inputs converging to enable full SASP expression。

label: Sirtuins
description: Sirtuin activators are compounds and interventions that increase the catalytic efficiency or expression of sirtuins; the best-studied class are the sirtuin-activating compounds (STACs) exemplified by resveratrol, which lower the KM of SIRT1 for its peptide and NAD+ substrates.
description_zh_TW: Sirtuin 活化劑是提高 sirtuin 催化效率或表現量的化合物與介入手段；研究最充分的一類是以 resveratrol 為代表的 sirtuin 活化化合物（STACs），它們降低 SIRT1 對其胜肽與 NAD+ 受質的 KM。

label: SIRT5
description: SIRT5 prevents tumor immune evasion and suppresses the development of hepatocellular carcinoma by orchestrating bile acid metabolism. Directionally, SIRT5 sits upstream of anti-tumor immunity and restrained HCC growth. By shaping the bile acid milieu, SIRT5 influences the immune microenvironment of the liver tumor, reducing the ability of HCC to evade immune destruction. This tumor-suppressive metabolic function contrasts with SIRT5's glycolysis-reprogramming role that can promote HCC growth, reflecting SIRT5's context-dependent effects in liver cancer.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5透過協調膽汁酸代謝來預防腫瘤免疫逃逸並抑制肝細胞癌的發展。方向上，SIRT5位於抗腫瘤免疫和HCC生長抑制的上游。透過塑造膽汁酸環境，SIRT5影響肝腫瘤的免疫微環境，降低HCC逃避免疫破壞的能力。此腫瘤抑制性代謝功能與SIRT5促進HCC生長的糖解重編程角色形成對比，反映了SIRT5在肝癌中的環境依賴性效果。

label: Neuromelanin
description: 5,6-indolequinone is biochemically converted into Neuromelanin through a defined reaction step in catecholamine pigment or neurotransmitter metabolism. Mechanistically, 5,6-indolequinone acts as the substrate and Neuromelanin as the product, often via oxidation, cyclization, or enzymatic decarboxylation. This conversion is biologically significant because it channels labile intermediates into stable products or active transmitters, with implications for neuromelanin accumulation and neuronal health. A caveat is that the precise stoichiometry and subcellular conditions governing the step are not fully resolved and may depend on local iron, pH, and antioxidant capacity.
description_zh_TW: 5,6-indolequinone 透過兒茶酚胺色素或神經傳導物質代謝中的特定反應步驟生化轉化為 Neuromelanin。從機制上講，5,6-indolequinone 作為底物，Neuromelanin 作為產物，通常透過 oxidation、環化或酶促脫羧作用。這種轉化具有重要的生物學意義，因為它將不穩定的中間體轉化為穩定的產物或活性遞質，對 neuromelanin 累積和神經元健康產生影響。需要注意的是，控制該步驟的精確化學計量和亞細胞條件尚未完全解決，可能取決於局部 iron、pH 和抗氧化能力。

label: Creatine
description: Creatine supplementation is one of the most effective and best-documented ergogenic aids for improving performance in high-intensity, short-duration activities. By increasing muscle phosphocreatine stores, creatine enhances the capacity to regenerate ATP during repeated bouts of maximal exercise, increasing power output, strength gains during resistance training, and work performed in repeated sprint protocols. Meta-analyses consistently show moderate improvements in measures such as maximal strength, sprint performance, and lean body mass, with benefit most pronounced in activities relying on the phosphocreatine energy system. These well-established performance effects are the context in which the trace asks whether creatine also influences cancer outcomes.
description_zh_TW: 補充肌酸是改善高強度、短時間運動表現最有效且文獻記載最完整的增能劑之一。透過增加肌肉磷酸肌酸儲備，肌酸可提升反覆最大強度運動期間再生 ATP 的能力，進而增加功率輸出、阻力訓練中的肌力增長，以及反覆衝刺訓練中的做功量。統合分析一致顯示，肌酸在最大肌力、衝刺表現與去脂體重等指標上帶來中等程度的改善，其效益在依賴磷酸肌酸能量系統的活動中最為顯著。這些確立已久的表現效益，正是該追蹤探討肌酸是否也影響癌症結果的背景脈絡。

label: Dopamine
description: The Dopamine Transporter (DAT) is a membrane protein responsible for reuptake of Dopamine from the synaptic cleft back into the presynaptic neuron, terminating the dopaminergic signal and recycling the neurotransmitter. DAT is highly abundant in the Sirtuins, where rapid uptake into dopaminergic terminals is the primary way dopamine signalling ends.
description_zh_TW: Dopamine Transporter（DAT）是一種膜蛋白，負責將 Dopamine 從突觸間隙回收至突觸前神經元，終止多巴胺訊號並回收神經傳遞物質。DAT 在 Sirtuins 中高度豐富，在該區快速攝入多巴胺神經末梢是 dopamine 訊號終止的主要方式。

label: Val158Met
description: Val158Met modulates the effect of vitamin E (alpha-tocopherol) supplementation on cancer prevention, such that slow COMT individuals derive protective benefit whereas fast COMT individuals may experience increased cancer risk. The proposed mechanism involves COMT-dependent metabolism of vitamin E-related catecholic intermediates and interactions with catecholestrogen handling, which differ by enzyme activity. This gene-nutrient interaction has emerged from genotype-stratified analyses of supplementation trials. It highlights the need for genotype-aware antioxidant recommendations.
description_zh_TW: Val158Met 調節維生素 E（α-生育醇）補充劑對癌症預防的作用，使得行動緩慢的 COMT 個體獲得保護性益處，而行動快速的 COMT 個體可能會經歷更高的癌症風險。所提出的機制涉及維生素 E 相關兒茶酚中間體的 COMT 依賴性代謝以及與兒茶酚雌激素處理的相互作用，其因酶活性而異。這種基因與營養素的相互作用是從補充劑試驗的基因型分層分析中得出的。它強調了對基因型敏感的抗氧化劑建議的需求。

label: NRF2
description: The antioxidant response element (ARE) is a cis-acting regulatory sequence in the promoter region of many genes encoding antioxidant and phase II detoxifying enzymes, primarily regulated by the transcription factor NRF2. A hormetic oxidative pulse activates the NRF2/ARE axis and upregulates GST expression, enhancing autophagy and mitochondrial quality control.
description_zh_TW: Antioxidant Response Element（ARE）存在於許多編碼抗氧化與第二期解毒酵素基因的啟動子區域，是順式作用調控序列，主要由轉錄因子 NRF2 調控。hormetic 氧化脈衝活化 NRF2/ARE 軸並上調 GST 表現，增強 Autophagy 與粒線體品質管制。

label: Mitochondria
description: In senescent cells the mitochondrial pyruvate-citrate-acetyl-CoA axis is upregulated, increasing the availability of acetyl-CoA to support histone acetylation at SASP gene loci. Although acetyl-CoA can be generated from alternative sources such as acetate, fatty acid oxidation and amino acid metabolism, in senescent cells mitochondria constitute a dominant source of acetyl-CoA for chromatin modification, creating a dependence on mitochondrial acetyl-CoA to sustain epigenetic activation of inflammatory gene programmes. Pathways controlling cytosolic acetyl-CoA production, including mitochondrial citrate export and its conversion by ATP-citrate lyase, are upregulated during senescence.
description_zh_TW: In senescent cells，mitochondrial pyruvate-citrate-acetyl-CoA axis 被 upregulated，增加 acetyl-CoA 可用性以支持 SASP gene loci 的 histone acetylation。雖然 acetyl-CoA 可從 alternative sources 如 acetate、fatty acid oxidation 和 amino acid metabolism 產生，但在 senescent cells 中 mitochondria 構成 dominant source of acetyl-CoA for chromatin modification，創造對 mitochondrial acetyl-CoA 的依賴以維持 inflammatory gene programmes 的 epigenetic activation。控制 cytosolic acetyl-CoA production 的 pathways，包括 mitochondrial citrate export 和其 conversion by ATP-citrate lyase，在 senescence 期間 upregulated。

label: Nicotinamide Riboside
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md
description: NRK2 (Nmrk2/Itgb1bp3/Mibp) is a muscle-specific NAD+ biosynthetic enzyme that phosphorylates nicotinamide riboside (NR) to nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN), the rate-limiting entry step of the salvage pathway: NR → (NRK2) → NMN → (NMNAT) → NAD+. It provides a stress-responsive supplementary route alongside NAMPT and becomes critical during muscle regeneration and metabolic stress.
description_zh_TW: NRK2（Nmrk2/Itgb1bp3/Mibp）是肌肉專一性的 NAD+ 生合成酵素，可將 nicotinamide riboside (NR) 磷酸化為 nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN)，此為 salvage pathway 的限速入口步驟：NR → (NRK2) → NMN → (NMNAT) → NAD+。它與 NAMPT 並行提供一條壓力反應的補充途徑，在肌肉再生與代謝壓力期間變得關鍵。

label: Methylene blue
description: Methylene blue is an established treatment for methemoglobinemia, a condition in which red blood cells cannot carry oxygen properly. It has been a first-line treatment for this indication since the early 20th century and remains on the World Health Organization's list of essential medicines. The clinical treatment dose for methemoglobinemia is 0.5-4 mg/kg (roughly 35-280 mg for a 70 kg adult), which is well above the micro-doses used in longevity and cognitive protocols. This medical use is distinct from wellness applications; at the very high doses used in medical settings methylene blue can paradoxically induce methemoglobin formation in some contexts.
description_zh_TW: 亞甲基藍是治療高鐵血紅蛋白血症的 established 方法，這是一種紅血球無法正常攜帶氧氣的疾病。自 20 世紀初以來，它一直是此適應症的一線治療，並仍在世界衛生組織基本藥物清單上。高鐵血紅蛋白血症的臨床治療劑量為 0.5-4 mg/kg（約 35-280 mg，適用於 70 kg 成人），遠高於 longevity 和認知方案中使用的 micro-doses。這種醫療用途與 wellness 應用不同；在醫療環境中使用的非常高劑量下，亞甲基藍在某些情況下可能 paradoxically 誘導高鐵血紅蛋白形成。

label: Urolithin A
description: Urolithin A is the most potent known natural mitophagy inducer. By depolarizing the Mitochondrial Membrane Potential it stabilizes PINK1 on the outer mitochondrial membrane; PINK1 recruits the E3 ligase Parkin, which ubiquitinates MFN1/MFN2/VDAC1 and targets the organelle for autophagic degradation via the LC3–p62 machinery.
description_zh_TW: Urolithin A 是已知最強的天然 mitophagy 誘導劑。它藉由去極化 Mitochondrial Membrane Potential 使 PINK1 穩定於粒線體外膜；PINK1 招募 E3 ligase Parkin，Parkin 泛素化 MFN1/MFN2/VDAC1，並經由 LC3–p62 機制將該胞器標記進行自噬降解。

label: Mitohormesis
description: A major advance in mitohormesis research was the discovery that diverse mitochondrial stressors activate the ISR. The pathway is initiated when mitochondrial stress activates the OMA1 protease, which cleaves DELE1 to generate a cytosolic fragment (DELE1-S) that binds and activates HRI, one of the four eIF2alpha kinases. HRI then phosphorylates the translation initiation factor eIF2alpha, reducing global protein synthesis while allowing preferential translation of ATF4. This mitochondrial-ISR connection establishes a defined signaling axis by which mild mitochondrial dysfunction produces a protective transcriptional and metabolic response characteristic of mitohormesis.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體促效應研究的一個重大進展是發現多種粒線體壓力源會活化整合壓力反應（ISR）。該途徑在粒線體壓力活化 OMA1 蛋白酶時啟動，OMA1 切割 DELE1 產生細胞質片段（DELE1-S），後者結合並活化 HRI（四個 eIF2alpha 激酶之一）。HRI 隨後磷酸化翻譯起始因子 eIF2alpha，減少整體蛋白質合成，同時允許 ATF4 的優先翻譯。這種粒線體-ISR 連結建立了一個明確的訊號軸，透過該軸，輕度粒線體功能障礙產生具有粒線體促效應特徵的保護性轉錄和代謝反應。

label: Caloric Restriction
description: Autophagy is required for the anti-aging effects of Caloric Restriction: CR is the most physiological inducer of autophagy, and inhibition of autophagy by mutation of essential Atg genes prevents the gain of longevity in every species tested, including the loss of longevity in eat-2, daf-2 and cnb-1 C. elegans models after bec-1 and atg7 RNAi. CR works through AMPK, SIRT1 and inhibition of insulin/IGF signaling, all of which converge on TOR inhibition and autophagy induction.
description_zh_TW: Autophagy 對 Caloric Restriction 的抗老化效應而言是必需的：CR 是最生理性的自噬誘導因子，而以必要 Atg 基因突變抑制自噬，在所有受測物種中都阻斷了壽命延長，包含 eat-2、daf-2 與 cnb-1 的 C. elegans 模型在 bec-1 與 atg7 RNAi 後壽命效益消失。CR 透過 AMPK、SIRT1 與抑制胰島素／IGF 訊號作用，這些途徑都收斂於 TOR 抑制與自噬誘導。

label: Mitophagy
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Because autophagosomes in mammalian cells are approximately 500-1500 nm, a large interconnected mitochondrial network must be broken up by fission before mitophagy can occur, and the degradation of fusion- or fission-related factors is required for mitophagy. DRP1-mediated fission promotes mitophagy: inhibition of DRP1 reduces Parkin-mediated mitophagy, and asymmetric fission produces a small dysfunctional fragment that is prevented from fusing and subsequently engulfed and degraded. However, DRP1 is not always necessary for mitophagy, since some reports show that cardiac-specific DRP1 knockout mice maintain mitophagy and that FIS1 can mediate mitophagy independently.
description_zh_TW: 由於哺乳動物細胞中的自噬體直徑約為500-1500奈米，大型互連的線粒體網絡必須先透過分裂破碎，線粒體自噬才能發生，且融合或分裂相關因子的降解也是線粒體自噬所必需的。DRP1介導的分裂促進線粒體自噬：抑制DRP1會減少Parkin介導的線粒體自噬，而不對稱分裂會產生一個功能異常的小片段，該片段無法融合隨後被吞噬和降解。然而，DRP1並非線粒體自噬所必需，因為一些報告顯示心臟特異性DRP1基因敲除小鼠仍能維持線粒體自噬，且FIS1可以獨立介導線粒體自噬。

label: Reactive Oxygen Species
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Electron leakage from Complex I and Complex III of the ETC generates superoxide, the primary source of reactive oxygen species. Quiescent cells can limit this by lowering overall metabolism and favouring glycolysis over oxidative phosphorylation.
description_zh_TW: 電子傳遞鏈中複合體 I 與複合體 III 的電子漏溢會產生超氧陰離子，這是活性氧物種的主要來源。靜止期細胞可藉由降低整體代謝並偏好糖解作用而非氧化磷酸化來減少此產生量。

label: Advanced Glycation End Products
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: Aminoguanidine, also developed as pimagedine by Alteon/Synvista Therapeutics, is the first identified inhibitor of advanced glycation end products (AGEs). By trapping reactive carbonyl species, it prevents the cross-linking of tissue proteins that is proposed to drive many features of aging. Most anti-aging research has been carried out using a hydrochloride (HCL) derivative, which is more soluble and less irritating than the bicarbonate form, and aminoguanidine has a half-life of only 4 hours, so dosages of 150-300 mg per day are best administered in split doses.
description_zh_TW: 氨基胍丁 (Aminoguanidine)，也由 Alteon/Synvista Therapeutics 开发为皮马地宁 (pimagadidine)，是先进糖基化终产物 (AGEs) 的首个抑制剂。通过捕获反应性羰基物种，它能阻止组织蛋白的交联，这被认为是导致衰老许多特征的原因。大部分抗衰老研究都使用盐酸盐 (HCL) 衍生物进行，该衍生物比碳酸氢盐形式更可溶且刺激性更小，而氨基胍丁的半衰期仅为 4 小时，因此，每日 150-300 毫克分剂量给药效果最佳。

label: NAD+
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Drivers Stem Cell Aging Inflammaging Bautista 2026.md
description: PARP1 is one of four major NAD+-consuming enzyme families — with CD38, SARM1 and the sirtuins — that compete for a shared intracellular pool. PARP1 polymerizes ADP-ribose from NAD+ onto target proteins for DNA repair signaling, and hyperactivation can exhaust the pool, which is why combined CD38 plus PARP1 inhibition fully rescues NAD+ where single agents fail.
description_zh_TW: PARP1 是四大 NAD+ 消耗酵素家族之一——與 CD38、SARM1 及 sirtuins 競爭同一細胞內池。PARP1 將 NAD+ 的 ADP-核糖聚合到受質蛋白上以傳遞 DNA 修復訊號，而過度活化可能耗盡此池；這也是 CD38 與 PARP1 合併抑制能完全救援 NAD+、單一藥物卻做不到的原因。

label: Rapamycin
description: Rapamycin delays immune aging by inhibiting mTORC1, an intervention shown to restore hematopoietic stem cell function and enhance the generation and persistence of memory CD8+ T cells in aged subjects. Mechanistically, mTORC1 inhibition shifts lymphocytes toward a more naïve, less exhausted state and promotes autophagy-mediated quality control within immune cells. In preclinical and clinical studies, transient rapamycin treatment improved immune responses to vaccination in the elderly. These effects illustrate how targeting the mTOR-autophagy axis can functionally rejuvenate the aging immune system.
description_zh_TW: Rapamycin透過抑制mTORC1來延緩免疫老化，此介入已被證明可恢復造血幹細胞功能並增強老年個體中記憶性CD8+ T細胞的生成與持續。在機制上，mTORC1抑制將淋巴細胞推向更初始、較不耗竭的狀態，並促進免疫細胞內自噬介導的品質控制。在臨床前和臨床研究中，短暫的rapamycin治療改善了老年人對疫苗的免疫反應。這些效應說明了標靶mTOR—自噬軸如何能在功能上使老化的免疫系統恢復年輕。

label: AMPK
description: CaMKKβ phosphorylates AMPK at Thr172 within its activation loop, potently stimulating AMPK kinase activity. Because activation depends on a Ca2+ surge rather than on adenine nucleotide ratios, this constitutes a Ca2+-dependent, AMP-independent AMPK activation route that lets calcium signalling drive energy sensing.
description_zh_TW: CaMKKβ 在 AMPK 活化環的 Thr172 位點將其磷酸化，強力提升 AMPK 激酶活性。由於此活化取決於 Ca2+ 激增而非腺嘌呤核苷酸比例，這構成一條 Ca2+ 依賴、AMP 獨立的 AMPK 活化路徑，讓鈣離子訊號得以驅動能量感測。

label: Fisetin
source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md
description: Senescent cells resist apoptosis by upregulating Senescent-Cell Anti-Apoptotic Pathways (SCAPs). Like Quercetin, Fisetin targets SCAP members including the PI3K/Akt pro-survival axis, inducing selective death of some senescent cell types — e.g., caspase3/7-mediated apoptosis in senescent HUVECs.
description_zh_TW: 衰老細胞透過上調 Senescent-Cell Anti-Apoptotic Pathways（SCAPs）抵抗凋亡。Fisetin 如同 Quercetin，會攻擊包括 PI3K/Akt 存活軸在內的 SCAP 成員，選擇性地殺死部分衰老細胞類型——例如在衰老的 HUVECs 中誘發 caspase3/7 介導的細胞凋亡。

label: mTORC1
description: Protein restriction inhibits the master nutrient sensor mTORC1 in the liver, heart, muscle, adipose tissue, and brain, and this inhibition is required for PR's benefits - without it, the benefits are lost. mTORC1 inhibition suppresses protein synthesis by reducing phosphorylation of S6K1 (whose genetic ablation extends lifespan) and of 4E-BP1, blocking eIF4E from initiating translation, while simultaneously promoting autophagy via ULK1 initiation of autophagosome formation. Normal aging is characterized by constitutive mTORC1 activation in many tissues, whereas pharmacological or genetic inhibition of mTORC1 extends lifespan in many species. Amino acid scarcity is sensed in part through leucine signaling to mTORC1 in specific neurons via a voltage-gated calcium channel (Cav3.1).
description_zh_TW: 蛋白質限制抑制肝臟、心臟、肌肉、脂肪組織和腦中的主營養感知器mTORC1，這種抑制是PR益處所必需的——沒有它，益處就會喪失。mTORC1抑制透過減少S6K1（其基因缺失延長壽命）和4E-BP1的磷酸化來抑制蛋白質合成，阻斷eIF4E啟動翻譯，同時透過ULK1啟動自噬體形成促進自噬。正常老化以許多組織中組成型mTORC1活化為特徵，而mTORC1的藥理學或基因抑制在許多物種中延長壽命。胺基酸稀缺部分透過亮氨酸透過電壓依賴性鈣通道（Cav3.1）向特定神經元中的mTORC1訊號傳導來感知。

label: Inflammation
description: DAMPs released from necroptotic cells are heavy triggers of innate and adaptive immunity and plausibly drive allograft rejection — the rationale for necroptosis inhibition in solid-organ transplantation.
description_zh_TW: 由 necroptosis 細胞釋出之 DAMPs 是先天與適應性免疫之強力觸發物，很可能驅動移植物排斥——此為實體器官移植中抑制 necroptosis 之理論依據。

label: Ivermectin
description: Ivermectin was developed from avermectin by William C. Campbell and colleagues at Merck.
description_zh_TW: Ivermectin 是由 William C. Campbell 和默克公司的同事從阿維菌素中開發出來的。

label: Resveratrol
description: Resveratrol, a naturally occurring stilbenoid from grapes and red wine, is the prototype sirtuin-activating compound and the basis of the French Paradox hypothesis; it binds a hydrophobic pocket on SIRT1, lowering the enzyme's KM for peptide substrate and NAD+ and accelerating deacetylation.
description_zh_TW: Resveratrol 是來自葡萄與紅酒的天然 stilbenoid，是 sirtuin 活化化合物的原型，也是「法國悖論」假說的基礎；它結合 SIRT1 上的疏水口袋，降低酵素對胜肽受質與 NAD+ 的 KM 並加速去乙醯化。

label: SIRT2
description: SIRT2 deacetylates HNF4α at multiple lysines in its hinge and ligand-binding domains, enhancing its protein stability and transcriptional output. The deacetylated nuclear receptor then drives expression of genes controlling fatty acid beta-oxidation; loss of SIRT2 or hyperacetylation of HNF4α leads to lipid droplet accumulation and a metabolic shift toward lipotoxicity.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 會在 HNF4α 的鉸鏈區與配體結合區多個離胺酸上進行去乙醯化，提升其蛋白穩定性與轉錄輸出。去乙醯化後的核受體進而驅動調控脂肪酸 β-氧化基因的表現；SIRT2 缺失或 HNF4α 過度乙醯化會導致脂滴堆積與朝 lipotoxicity 轉移的代謝變化。

label: Parkinson's Disease
description: Alpha-synuclein aggregation into Lewy bodies is the defining proteinopathy of Parkinson disease. Involvement records the hallmark pathology.
description_zh_TW: Alpha-synuclein 聚集成路易小體是帕金森病的定義性蛋白病變。涉及記錄標誌病理。

label: p53
description: p53 is the definitional tumor suppressor gene of cancer biology. Classification is textbook.
description_zh_TW: p53 是癌症生物學定義性的腫瘤抑制基因。歸類為教科書等級。

label: Ferroptosis
source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md
description: Ferroptosis is a regulated, iron-dependent cell death pathway in which cells lose their ability to regulate fats and eventually die, as distinct from unregulated necrotic death or other programmed death programs like apoptosis. It was discovered and named (originally 'oxytosis') by Pam Maher in 2001. The hallmark mechanism is accumulation of lipid peroxides to toxic levels, normally kept in check by glutathione, and the pathway is increasingly linked to neurodegeneration and age-related diseases. Because ferroptosis is druggable and genetically regulatable, it has become a promising therapeutic target alongside cellular senescence for supporting healthy aging and clearing dysfunctional cells.
description_zh_TW: 鐵依賴性細胞死亡（ferroptosis）是一種受調控、依賴鐵的細胞死亡途徑，細胞在此途徑中失去調節脂肪的能力並最終死亡，有別於不受調控的壞死性死亡或其他如細胞凋亡（apoptosis）的程式性死亡。它由Pam Maher於2001年發現並命名（最初稱為「oxytosis」）。其標誌性機制是脂質過氧化物累積至毒性濃度，此過程通常由麩胱甘肽（glutathione）加以控制，且此途徑日益與神經退化及年齡相關疾病相關。由於ferroptosis可被藥物調控且在遺傳上可調節，它與細胞衰老（cellular senescence）一同成為支持健康老化與清除功能失常細胞的具前景治療標靶。

label: Senescence
description: Progressive telomere shortening with each cell division eventually exposes chromosome ends that are recognized as DNA double-strand breaks, triggering replicative senescence at the Hayflick limit. Critically short or dysfunctional telomeres activate the ATM/p53 and ATR/p21 DDR cascades, halting proliferation to prevent chromosomal instability. This mechanism is the canonical explanation for the finite replicative capacity of primary human cells in culture. The directionality is one-way in normal cells, though telomerase reactivation can bypass the arrest -- a hallmark of cancer.
description_zh_TW: 每一次細胞分裂伴隨的漸進性端粒縮短，最終會暴露出被辨識為 DNA 雙股斷裂的染色體端點，在 Hayflick 極限觸發複製性衰老。過短或功能異常的端粒會活化 ATM/p53 與 ATR/p21 的 DDR 級聯，停止增殖以預防染色體不穩定。此機制是原代人類細胞在培養中有限複製能力的標準解釋。在正常細胞中此方向是單向的，但端粒酶再活化可繞過停滯——這是癌症的特徵。

label: TFEB
description: The microphthalmia (MiT/TFE) family of basic helix-loop-helix leucine zipper transcription factors comprises TFEB, TFE3, MITF and TFEC. These factors regulate autophagy and lysosomal genes by binding CLEAR elements, and their translocation or nuclear trapping activates the autophagic-lysosomal transcriptional program.
description_zh_TW: 微眼畸形（MiT/TFE）家族的基本螺旋環螺旋－白胺酸拉鍊轉錄因子包含 TFEB、TFE3、MITF 與 TFEC。這些因子藉由結合 CLEAR elements 來調控自噬與溶酶體基因，其轉位或核內滯留可活化自噬－溶酶體轉錄程序。

label: COMT
description: The COMT gene is located on chromosome 22 at band q11.21, a locus also associated with the 22q11.2 deletion syndrome, which presents with cardiac, craniofacial, and psychiatric features. Its genomic position places it within a region subject to copy-number variation that can affect COMT dosage and enzyme levels, with hemizygosity influencing catecholamine metabolism in deletion carriers. The well-characterized Val158Met polymorphism (rs4680) at this locus is among the most studied functional variants in neuropsychiatry and pharmacogenetics. The locus therefore links structural chromosomal variation to catecholamine physiology.
description_zh_TW: COMT 基因位於 22 號染色體 q11.21 條帶上，該位點也與 22q11.2 缺失症候群相關，該症候群表現為心臟、顱顏和精神特徵。它的基因組位置將其置於一個受拷貝數變異影響的區域內，該變異可以影響 COMT 劑量和酶水平，其半合性影響缺失載體中的兒茶酚胺代謝。該位點的充分錶徵的 Val158Met 多態性 (rs4680) 是神經精神病學和藥物遺傳學中研究最多的功能變異之一。因此，該基因座將結構染色體變異與兒茶酚胺生理學連結起來。

label: NF-κB
description: NF-kB is the master transcription factor regulating SASP gene expression, controlling the bulk of pro-inflammatory cytokines, chemokines, and growth factors in senescent cells. It is activated by p38 MAPK, GATA4, cGAS-STING, and IL-1R/MyD88 signaling and cooperates with C/EBPb at SASP enhancers to coordinate the secretome. Inhibition of NF-kB robustly suppresses the SASP across models, making it a prime senomorphic target. Its regulatory role is central, though it operates with other axes such as mTOR and AP-1 for full secretome output.
description_zh_TW: NF-κB 是調節 SASP 基因表現的主轉錄因子，控制衰老細胞中大部分促發炎細胞激素、趨化因子與生長因子。它被 p38 MAPK、GATA4、cGAS-STING 與 IL-1R/MyD88 訊號活化，並在 SASP 增強子上與 C/EBPb 協作協調分泌組。抑制 NF-κB 在多種模型中強力抑制 SASP，使其成為主要 senomorphic 標靶。其調節角色為中心，但與 mTOR 與 AP-1 等其他軸共同運作以達完整分泌組輸出。

label: SIRT6
description: In response to DNA damage signaling, SIRT6 moves away from gene promoters and repetitive loci to sites of DNA breaks, where it recruits DNA repair factors and modifies local chromatin. At damage sites, SIRT6 promotes the deacetylation of H3K56 and other substrates, facilitating efficient double-strand break repair. This mobilization from LINE-1 loci to damage sites simultaneously couples the DNA damage response to derepression of retrotransposons during aging, linking genomic stress to innate immune activation.
description_zh_TW: 為了回應 DNA 損傷訊號，SIRT6 從基因啟動子和重複基因座移至 DNA 斷裂位點，在那裡招募 DNA 修復因子並修飾局部染色質。在損傷部位，SIRT6 促進 H3K56 和其他底物的去乙醯化，促進有效的雙股斷裂修復。這種從 LINE-1 位點到損傷位點的動員同時將 DNA 損傷反應與老化過程中逆轉錄轉座子的去抑制結合起來，將基因組壓力與先天免疫活化聯繫起來。

label: Oxidative Stress
description: c-Jun N-terminal kinase is a MAPK family member activated by the MAP kinase kinases MKK4 and MKK7 in response to cytokines, UV, osmotic shock, and — most relevant here — oxidative stress and mitochondrial dysfunction. Once active, it phosphorylates c-Jun and other substrates on Ser/Thr residues.
description_zh_TW: c-Jun N-terminal kinase 是 MAPK 家族的成員，會被 MAP 激酶激酶 MKK4 與 MKK7 活化，以回應細胞激素、UV、滲透壓衝擊，以及——在此最相關的——Oxidative Stress 與粒線體功能障礙。活化後它在絲胺酸／蘇胺酸殘基上磷酸化 c-Jun 及其他標的。

label: Aging
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: Aging causes drastic architectural changes in the thymus that result in profound tissue involution, dramatic reduction in T cell export, and reduced overall peripheral immunity. Mechanisms are not fully appreciated, and no evolutionary explanation has been confirmed, though hypotheses include energy rechanneling to reproduction once a diverse T cell repertoire is established (Shanley et al.) and promotion of peripheral selection of a well-adapted repertoire (Dowling and Hodgkin). Mouse aging models confirm decreased thymus weight and cellularity with age, with thymocyte number declining steadily across the lifespan.
description_zh_TW: 衰老會造成胸腺（thymus）顯著的結構性改變，導致嚴重的組織退化、T細胞輸出大幅減少，以及整體周邊免疫力的下降。其機制尚未被充分了解，也未有演化學解釋獲得證實；目前假說包括：一旦多樣化的T細胞庫建立完成，能量即重新分配至生殖（Shanley等人），以及促進適應良好T細胞庫的周邊選擇（Dowling與Hodgkin）。小鼠衰老模型證實胸腺重量與細胞密度隨年齡下降，胸腺細胞數量在整個生命週期中持續遞減。

label: Adrenochrome
description: The Adrenochrome Hypothesis proposed that adrenochrome, a metabolite of epinephrine formed endogenously in the brain, might be a psychotomimetic agent, and that an imbalance in its production or clearance could be a primary cause of schizophrenia. It motivated substantial research into catecholamine metabolism.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome Hypothesis 主張 Adrenochrome（Epinephrine 在腦中內源性形成的代謝物）可能是類精神病（psychotomimetic）藥物，而其生成或清除的失衡可能是 Schizophrenia 的主要病因。該假說推動了大量 Catecholamines 代謝研究。

label: Cancer
description: Renal cell carcinoma (RCC) is the most common malignant kidney tumor, usually clear-cell subtype.
description_zh_TW: 腎細胞癌 (RCC) 是最常見的惡性腎臟腫瘤，通常為透明細胞亞型。

label: Apoptosis
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: Mitochondrial fission is an early and required step in many forms of apoptosis. In the intrinsic pathway, pro-apoptotic signals promote DRP1-dependent fragmentation of the mitochondrial network, and Bax and Bak accumulate at mitochondrial scission sites where they form pores that release cytochrome c and other pro-apoptotic factors into the cytosol. DRP1-mediated constriction at ER-mitochondria contact sites facilitates Bax/Bak oligomerization and outer membrane permeabilization. Inhibition of DRP1 function or of fission prevents mitochondrial fragmentation, delays cytochrome c release, and protects cells from apoptotic death in multiple models, establishing fission as a functional component of the cell death program.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial fission is an early and required step in many forms of apoptosis。In the intrinsic pathway, pro-apoptotic signals promote DRP1-dependent fragmentation of the mitochondrial network, and Bax and Bak accumulate at mitochondrial scission sites where they form pores that release cytochrome c and other pro-apoptotic factors into the cytosol。DRP1-mediated constriction at ER-mitochondria contact sites facilitates Bax/Bak oligomerization and outer membrane permeabilization。Inhibition of DRP1 function or of fission prevents mitochondrial fragmentation, delays cytochrome c release, and protects cells from apoptotic death in multiple models, establishing fission as a functional component of the cell death program。

label: Autophagy
source_file: _document_ - Plant flavone apigenin An emerging anticancer agent.md
description: 3-Methyladenine inhibits class-III PI3K (Vps34) in the Beclin1 nucleation complex, preventing phagophore formation and blocking canonical autophagy at initiation.
description_zh_TW: 3-Methyladenine 抑制 Beclin1 啟動複合體中的 class-III PI3K（Vps34），阻止 phagophore 形成，在起始步驟阻斷典型自噬。

label: SASP
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial metabolism and epigenetic crosstalk drive SASP.md
description: Cellular senescence is a key response to various cellular stresses characterized by a permanent cell cycle arrest and the secretion of a pro-inflammatory cocktail of factors known as the senescence-associated secretory phenotype (SASP). Senescence serves protective roles in embryonic development, tumour suppression and tissue repair, but persistent SASP activation leads to chronic inflammation contributing to tissue dysfunction, ageing and a broad spectrum of age-related diseases including cancer. This dual nature makes SASP a focal point for understanding both the protective and detrimental effects of senescence.
description_zh_TW: 細胞衰老是對各種細胞應激的關鍵反應，其特徵是永久性細胞週期停滯和分泌一組促炎因子混合物，稱為衰老相關分泌表型（SASP）。衰老在胚胎發育、腫瘤抑制和組織修復中起保護作用，但持續的SASP激活導致慢性炎症，從而導致組織功能障礙、老化和包括癌症在內的廣泛年齡相關疾病。這種雙重性質使SASP成為理解衰老的保護性和有害性效應的焦點。

label: SIRT3
description: SIRT3 deacetylates Cyclophilin D, diminishing its peptidyl-prolyl isomerase activity and dissociating it from the adenine nucleotide translocase, which raises the threshold for mitochondrial permeability transition pore opening and delays cytochrome c release. SIRT3 activation therefore attenuates apoptosis, and Sirt3-null cardiomyocytes show age-dependent swelling from spontaneous pore opening.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 去乙醯化 Cyclophilin D，降低其 peptidyl-prolyl isomerase 活性並使其與腺嘌呤核苷酸轉位酶分離，因而提高 Mitochondrial Permeability Transition Pore 開啟的門檻並延後 Cytochrome c 釋放。SIRT3 活化因此抑制 Apoptosis，而 Sirt3 缺失的心肌細胞會因自發性孔道開啟而出現與年齡相關的膨脹。

label: SIRT1
description: The executioner caspase-3 also directly cleaves SIRT1 during apoptosis. Because both the initiator caspase-9 and executioner caspase-3 process Sir2α, cleavage and the accompanying nuclear-to-cytoplasmic dislocation occur throughout the apoptotic process, not at a single checkpoint. In Ara-C-treated embryonic mouse brain, over 130 of 150 cells with cytoplasmic Sir2α had pyknotic nuclei, confirming in vivo that the caspase-3-era SIRT1 fragments mark terminally dying cells. Cleavage therefore converts an anti-apoptotic survival factor into processed fragments precisely when the death program becomes irreversible.
description_zh_TW: 執行者半胱天冬酶-3（Caspase-3）在細胞凋亡期間同樣會直接切割 SIRT1。由於起始 Caspase-9 與執行者 Caspase-3 都會處理 Sir2α，切割與伴隨的核質易位發生在整個細胞凋亡過程中，而非單一檢查點。在 Ara-C 處理的胚胎小鼠腦中，150 個細胞質型 Sir2α 細胞裡有超過 130 個呈現核固縮，證實在體內帶 caspase-3 特徵的 SIRT1 片段標記著走向終末的死亡細胞。當死亡程序變得不可逆時，切割便將抗凋亡的存活因子轉化為處理後的片段。

label: Gut Microbiota
description: Flavonoids are metabolized by gut bacteria into protective phenolic acids, while seaweed-derived components shift Firmicutes/Bacteroidetes ratios and enrich Bacteroides and Lactobacillus. These dose-sensitive microbiota-host interactions link dietary hormetins to systemic physiology.
description_zh_TW: Flavonoids 經腸道菌代謝為具保護作用的酚酸，而海藻來源成分可改變 Firmicutes/Bacteroidetes 比例並增加 Bacteroides 和 Lactobacillus。這些劑量敏感的菌群-宿主交互作用將膳食 Hormetins 與全身生理連結起來。

label: IRS-2
description: SIRT1 deacetylates insulin receptor substrate-2 (IRS-2), a key adaptor in insulin and insulin-like growth factor signaling. This deacetylation enables efficient tyrosine phosphorylation of IRS-2 and downstream activation of the PI3K-Akt cascade, improving insulin signal transduction in peripheral tissues. Directionally, SIRT1 enzymatic activity sits upstream of enhanced insulin signaling. By reinforcing this pathway, SIRT1 helps counter insulin resistance and hyperglycemia in type 2 diabetes. The regulation illustrates how a single sirtuin can tune insulin sensitivity, and it positions SIRT1 activators as potential metabolic therapeutics alongside lifestyle interventions that raise NAD+.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1去乙醯化胰島素受體底物-2（IRS-2），這是胰島素和類胰島素生長因子訊號中的關鍵接頭蛋白。此去乙醯化使得IRS-2的高效酪氨酸磷酸化和下游PI3K-Akt級聯反應活化成為可能，改善周邊組織中的胰島素訊號轉導。方向上，SIRT1酵素活性位於增強胰島素訊號的上游。透過加強此通路，SIRT1有助於對抗第二型糖尿病中的胰島素阻抗和高血糖。此調節說明了一個sirtuin如何能調節胰島素敏感性，並將SIRT1活化劑定位為與提高NAD+的生活方式介入並列的潛在代謝治療藥物。

label: SMAD
description: SMAD2 (Mothers Against Decapentaplegic Homolog 2) is a member of the SMAD family of signal-transducing proteins that relay TGF-β/BMP superfamily receptor signaling into the nucleus. Like other SMADs, it contains conserved structural motifs that mediate interactions with binding partners, nucleic acids and lipid membranes, and its activity and localization are dynamically regulated by phosphorylation and ubiquitination.
description_zh_TW: SMAD2（Mothers Against Decapentaplegic Homolog 2）是 SMAD 家族的成員之一，負責將 TGF-β／BMP 超家族受體訊息傳遞至細胞核。與其他 SMAD 相同，它含有與結合伴護蛋白、核酸及脂質膜互動的保守結構基序，其活性與定位則由磷酸化與泛素化動態調控。

label: cGAS Inhibitors
description: cGAS inhibitors are experimental small molecules — RU.521, TDI, PF-06928215, G150, and SU-cH — that block the nucleotidyltransferase activity of cGAS, preventing synthesis of cGAMP and thereby suppressing downstream STING activation and type I interferon production. By inhibiting the proximal sensor they interrupt the cGAS-STING pathway at its upstream enzymatic step, reducing ISG expression, NF-κB-driven cytokines, and maladaptive glial activation.
description_zh_TW: cGAS 抑制劑是一類實驗性小分子——RU.521、TDI、PF-06928215、G150 與 SU-cH——可阻斷 cGAS 的核苷酸轉移酶活性，抑制 cGAMP 的合成，因而抑制下游 STING 活化與第一型干擾素的產生。藉由抑制最上游的感測器，它們在 cGAS-STING pathway 的上游酵素步驟加以截斷，降低 ISG 表現、NF-κB 驅動的細胞激素與不良的膠細胞活化。

label: Cholesterol Influx
description: Cholesterol Influx is the receptor-mediated movement of Cholesterol from the extracellular environment into Macrophages, mainly via scavenger receptors taking up Oxidized LDL. When influx exceeds the opposing Cholesterol Efflux, macrophages accumulate lipid and become Foam Cells, the hallmark lesion of Atherosclerosis.
description_zh_TW: Cholesterol Influx 是 Cholesterol 由細胞外環境經受體介導而進入 Macrophages 的過程，主要透過清除受體攝取 Oxidized LDL 達成。當 influx 超過相反的 Cholesterol Efflux 時，巨噬細胞累積脂質而成為 Foam Cells，即 Atherosclerosis 的標誌性病灶。

label: DNM2
description: DNM2 is a dynamin-like GTPase recruited to the DRP1-constricted mitochondrion to assemble and complete the final membrane scission event of mitochondrial fission. While DRP1 initiates constriction at the outer mitochondrial membrane, DNM2 contributes to maturation and severing of the division furrow, so it is an accessory rather than essential fission GTPase.
description_zh_TW: DNM2 是一個 dynamin-like GTPase，會被招募至被 DRP1 收縮的粒線體上，組裝並完成 mitochondrial fission 最後的膜切割步驟。DRP1 在 outer mitochondrial membrane 啟動收縮，而 DNM2 協助分裂溝的成熟與切斷，因此它是輔助而非必要的 fission GTPase。

label: FCCP
description: FCCP (carbonyl cyanide-4-trifluoromethoxyphenylhydrazone) is a protonophore that collapses the mitochondrial proton gradient, uncoupling oxidative phosphorylation. This maximally stimulates mitochondrial electron transport chain electron flux and oxygen consumption, which is why it is injected after oligomycin in Seahorse bioenergetic assays to reveal maximal respiration.
description_zh_TW: FCCP（carbonyl cyanide-4-trifluoromethoxyphenylhydrazone）是質子載體，會崩解粒線體的質子梯度，使 oxidative phosphorylation 解偶聯。此作用可最大程度刺激 mitochondrial electron transport chain 的電子流與耗氧，因此在 Seahorse 生體能量分析中會在 oligomycin 之後注入，以顯示最大呼吸能力。

label: TransitID
description: After time-gated labeling, TransitID cells are lysed and proteins enriched by streptavidin pulldown, with Mass Spectrometry and specialised LC-MS/MS workflows used to identify proteins biotinylated first by TurboID in the source compartment and then captured by BirA in the destination compartment — the signature of active transit between compartments.
description_zh_TW: 時間閘控標記後，TransitID 會將細胞裂解、以 streptavidin pulldown 富集蛋白，再透過 Mass Spectrometry 與專用的 LC-MS/MS 流程，辨識先由來源胞器的 TurboID 標記、再被目標胞器的 BirA 捕捉的蛋白質——這正是胞器間實際轉位的訊號特徵。

label: Amyloid Precursor Protein
description: Amyloid Precursor Protein (APP) is a type I transmembrane glycoprotein whose sequential proteolytic cleavage determines whether amyloid-beta peptides are made. Non-amyloidogenic α-secretase cleavage within the Aβ domain prevents Aβ formation, whereas the amyloidogenic β-secretase (BACE1) followed by γ-secretase route produces Aβ40 and Aβ42, the peptides that form plaques in Alzheimer's Disease. Familial APP or presenilin mutations raise the Aβ42/Aβ40 ratio.
description_zh_TW: Amyloid Precursor Protein（APP）是第一型跨膜糖蛋白，其連續蛋白水解切割決定是否產生類澱粉β胜肽。非類澱粉生成途徑中 α-secretase 在 Aβ 區段內切割可避免 Aβ 形成；類澱粉生成途徑則由 β-secretase（BACE1）後接 γ-secretase 產生 Aβ40 與 Aβ42，即 Alzheimer's Disease 中形成斑塊的胜肽。家族性 APP 或 presenilin 突變會提高 Aβ42/Aβ40 比值。

label: Ferroportin
description: Ferroportin counteracts iron-overload toxicity in ischemia-reperfusion injury and neurodegeneration by exporting Fe²⁺ from injured tissue and limiting Fenton chemistry. In cancer, low ferroportin (high iron retention) predicts ferroptosis sensitivity, so modulating the hepcidin/ferroportin axis could tune therapeutic ferroptosis induction.
description_zh_TW: Ferroportin 藉由將 Fe²⁺ 排出受損組織並限制 Fenton 化學反應，對抗缺血再灌損傷與神經退化中的鐵過載毒性。在癌症方面，較低的 ferroportin（較高的鐵滯留）可預測 ferroptosis 敏感性，因此調節 hepcidin/ferroportin 軸可望調整治療性的 ferroptosis 誘發。

label: ALIX
description: ALIX regulates PD-L1. ALIX is an ESCRT-associated protein that controls exosome biogenesis and the surface presentation of PD-L1 and EGFR. PD-L1 is an immune-checkpoint ligand expressed by tumor and stromal cells that engages PD-1 on T cells to suppress antitumor immunity. The relationship is directional, with ALIX acting as the operative agent upon PD-L1 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: ALIX 調節 PD-L1。 ALIX 是一種 ESCRT 相關蛋白，控制外泌體生物發生以及 PD-L1 和 EGFR 的表面呈現。 PD-L1 是一種由腫瘤和基質細胞表達的免疫檢查點配體，可與 T 細胞上的 PD-1 結合以抑制抗腫瘤免疫。這種關係是有方向的，ALIX 充當 PD-L1 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: CPEO
description: CPEO (chronic progressive external ophthalmoplegia) is a mitochondrial myopathy caused by mitochondrial DNA abnormalities - most often large-scale single deletions, but also point mutations in tRNA genes or multiple deletions from nuclear mutations such as POLG and TWINKLE. These lesions impair oxidative phosphorylation and electron transport chain function, producing progressive ptosis, ophthalmoplegia, proximal myopathy and exercise intolerance.
description_zh_TW: CPEO（慢性進行性外眼肌麻痺）是一種粒線體肌病，由粒線體 DNA 異常造成——最常見的是大規模單一缺失，也包括 tRNA 基因點突變或 POLG、TWINKLE 等核基因突變所致的多次缺失。這些病灶會損害氧化磷酸化與電子傳遞鏈功能，造成進行性上瞼下垂、眼肌麻痺、近端肌病與運動不耐受。

label: ACTA2
description: ACTA2 (α-SMA) is upregulated 5.4-fold during CXCL12-driven Endothelial-to-Mesenchymal Transition, alongside TGFB1, while CDH5 and PECAM1 fall — the reciprocal switch marks acquisition of a contractile mesenchymal/myofibroblast identity.
description_zh_TW: 在 CXCL12 驅動的 Endothelial-to-Mesenchymal Transition 中，ACTA2 (α-SMA) 上升 5.4 倍、TGFB1 同步上升，而 CDH5 與 PECAM1 下降——這種反向轉換標誌著收縮性間質/肌成纖維細胞身分的獲得。

label: Sigma-1 receptor
description: S1R is an ER/mitochondrial-membrane chaperone encoded by SIGMAR1 that modulates ER stress and lipid metabolism; inhibiting S1R promotes ferroptosis in hepatocellular carcinoma cells, positioning it as a brake on the lipid-peroxidation cascade.
description_zh_TW: S1R 是由 SIGMAR1 編碼、位於內質網／粒線體接觸膜的伴護蛋白，可調節內質網壓力與脂質代謝；抑制 S1R 會在 hepatocellular carcinoma 細胞中促進 ferroptosis，使其成為脂質過氧化級聯反應的煞車。

label: ISG15
description: ISG15 is an interferon-inducible ubiquitin-like modifier that, in senescence, is induced by p16 overexpression and marks a distinct p53-dependent SASP profile enriched for interferon-stimulated genes. Its ISGylation and secreted cytokine activities reinforce a type I interferon state and promote paracrine senescence and immune surveillance.
description_zh_TW: ISG15 是干擾素誘導的類泛素修飾蛋白，在細胞衰老中由 p16 過度表現所誘導，標記出一種依賴 p53、富含干擾素刺激基因的獨特 SASP 圖譜。其 ISG 化與分泌型細胞激素活性強化第一型干擾素狀態，並促進旁分泌衰老與免疫監視。

label: Alveolar Type II Cells
description: Alveolar Type II Cells are the surfactant-producing epithelial cells of the distal lung alveolus and serve as the facultative progenitor population that regenerates the flattened alveolar type I Epithelial cells after injury. They synthesize and secrete pulmonary surfactant via lamellar bodies and participate in ion and water transport to maintain airspace stability.
description_zh_TW: Alveolar Type II Cells 是遠端肺泡產生表面活性物質的上皮細胞，並作為兼性前驅細胞群，在損傷後再生扁平化的第一型肺泡 Epithelial cells。它們藉由 lamellar body 合成並分泌肺表面活性物質，並參與離子與水分運輸以維持氣腔穩定。

label: MBOAT1
description: Estrogen receptor signaling drives MBOAT1 transcription; MBOAT1 remodels phospholipids toward PE-MUFA, suppressing ferroptosis independently of GPX4/FSP1 — the female remodeling gate.
description_zh_TW: Estrogen receptor 訊號驅動 MBOAT1 轉錄；MBOAT1 將磷脂重塑為 PE-MUFA，以 GPX4/FSP1 非依賴方式抑制 ferroptosis——即雌性重塑閘門。

label: VER155008
description: VER155008 is a selective small-molecule inhibitor of HSPA8 (HSC70), the constitutive member of the HSP70 family. Disrupting HSPA8 is sufficient to suppress the senomorphic output in senescent cells, independent of senolysis.
description_zh_TW: VER155008 是 HSPA8（HSC70）的選擇性小分子抑制劑，HSC70 為 HSP70 家族的組成型表現成員。破壞 HSPA8 足以抑制衰老細胞的 senomorphic 效應，且此作用獨立於 senolysis。

label: Pheomelanin
description: Benzothiazine-derived units are the hallmark structural motifs of Pheomelanin, the sulfur-containing yellow-to-red melanin. The 1,4-benzothiazine system contains nitrogen and sulfur heteroatoms that confer redox activity and metal-binding capability. Pheomelanin is chemically defined by its benzothiazine units, which distinguish it from the indolic eumelanin.
description_zh_TW: Benzothiazine 衍生的單元是 Pheomelanin 的標誌性結構基序，Pheomelanin 是含硫的黃至紅色黑色素。1,4-benzothiazine 系統含有賦予氧化還原活性和金屬結合能力的氮和硫雜原子。Pheomelanin 在化學上由其 benzothiazine 單元所定義，這使它有別於吲哚類型的 eumelanin。

label: PTP1B
description: PTP1B is a 50 kDa ER-associated non-receptor tyrosine phosphatase that dephosphorylates and inactivates the insulin receptor and IRS proteins, terminating the insulin signal. Its position next to the ER — where internalized receptor localizes — lets it dephosphorylate the receptor en route to degradation.
description_zh_TW: PTP1B 是 50 kDa、附著於內質網的非受體酪胺酸磷酸酶，藉由去磷酸化並使胰島素受體與 IRS 蛋白失活來終止胰島素訊號。由於它緊鄰內質網（內吞後的受體所在位置），可在受體被降解的途徑上將其去磷酸化。

label: ICF Syndrome
description: ICF syndrome (Immunodeficiency, Centromere instability, and Facial anomalies) is a rare autosomal recessive disorder caused by mutations in the DNMT3B gene. Loss of DNMT3b activity leads to hypomethylation of pericentromeric satellite repeats and juxtacentromeric regions, resulting in centromeric decondensation, chromosome instability, and characteristic chromosomal abnormalities in stimulated lymphocytes. The disease manifests as combined immunodeficiency with reduced immunoglobulin levels, facial dysmorphism, and developmental delay.
description_zh_TW: ICF 症候群（免疫缺陷、著絲粒不穩定和臉部異常）是一種罕見的體染色體隱性遺傳疾病，由 DNMT3B 基因突變引起。 DNMT3b 活性的喪失會導致著絲粒周圍衛星重複序列和近著絲粒區域的低甲基化，從而導致著絲粒脫縮、染色體不穩定以及受刺激的淋巴細胞中的特徵性染色體異常。此疾病表現為聯合免疫缺陷，伴隨免疫球蛋白水平降低、臉部畸形和發育遲緩。

label: Neutral Red
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Neutral Red is the phenazine (S5-to-N) analog of the Phenothiazine scaffold: replacing the position-5 sulfur with nitrogen removes the structural feature required for methylene-blue-like electron-carrier activity, which is why Neutral Red shows the weakest neuroprotection in the series.
description_zh_TW: Neutral Red 是 Phenothiazine 骨架的 phenazine（S5→N）類似物：將第 5 號位置的硫原子換成氮會移除 methylene blue 類電子載體活性所需的結構特徵，因此 Neutral Red 在整個系列中神經保護作用最弱。

label: Glucagon
description: Glucagon is a 29-amino acid peptide hormone secreted by pancreatic alpha cells and encoded by the GCG gene, serving as the principal counter-regulatory hormone to insulin. The glucagon-to-insulin ratio sets the net direction of hepatic glucose output: a high ratio favors glucose production, a low ratio favors storage, which is why alpha-cell dysfunction and relative glucagon excess drive fasting hyperglycemia in metabolic syndrome and obesity.
description_zh_TW: Glucagon 是由胰臟 α 細胞分泌、由 GCG 基因編碼的 29 胺基酸胜肽激素，作為胰島素的主要反向調節激素。胰高血糖素與胰島素的比值決定肝臟葡萄糖輸出的淨方向：比值高有利於葡萄糖生成，比值低有利於儲存；正因如此，在代謝症候群與肥胖中，α 細胞功能失調與相對的 glucagon 過多會造成空腹高血糖。

label: non-small-cell lung cancer
description: Small-cell lung cancer and non-small-cell lung cancer are the two major histologic categories of lung cancer, with distinct biology and treatment paradigms. SCLC is treated predominantly with chemotherapy and radiotherapy, whereas NSCLC encompasses diverse subtypes. They are distinguished on the basis of histology and clinical behavior.
description_zh_TW: Small-cell lung cancer 與 non-small-cell lung cancer 是肺癌的兩大組織學類別，具有不同的生物學與治療模式。SCLC 主要以化療與放療治療，而 NSCLC 涵蓋多種亞型。它們依據組織學與臨床行為加以區分。

label: BMAL1
description: SLC25A51 is a fasting-induced, circadian gene and a direct BMAL1 target (Fu et al., Metabolism 2022). Hepatic expression rises with fasting, oscillates diurnally and is disrupted in liver-specific Bmal1 knockouts; reduced expression lowers mitochondrial NAD+ and SIRT3 activity and reduces oxygen consumption in intact hepatocytes. Its induction parallels PGC-1α–SIRT3 activation and the fasting switch to fatty-acid oxidation.
description_zh_TW: SLC25A51 是禁食誘導的晝夜節律基因，也是 BMAL1 的直接標的（Fu et al., Metabolism 2022）。肝臟表現隨禁食上升、呈日夜震盪，並在肝細胞專一性 Bmal1 敲除小鼠中失調；表現降低會使粒線體 NAD+ 與 SIRT3 活性下降，並降低完整肝細胞中的氧消耗。其誘導與 PGC-1α–SIRT3 的活化及禁食時轉向脂肪酸氧化平行。

label: Hormesis Vocabulary Bridge
description: The Hormesis Vocabulary Bridge organizes the aliases under which Hormesis travels in the literature: searching PubMed for hormesis or hormetic misses 80-90% of relevant studies because each discipline renames the same biphasic dose-response.
description_zh_TW: Hormesis Vocabulary Bridge 整理了 Hormesis 在文獻中使用的別名：在 PubMed 搜尋 hormesis 或 hormetic 會遺漏 80-90% 相關研究，因為各學科對同一個雙相劑量反應現象各有命名。

label: PARylation
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: Increased PARylation is a hallmark of Alzheimer's disease, and it could be decreased in AD mice with nicotinamide riboside (NR) supplementation. Increased PARylation has also been detected in several other neurodegenerative disorders that involve DNA repair defects, including Cockayne syndrome, xeroderma pigmentosum, and ataxia-telangiectasia, where PARP-mediated NAD+ depletion plays a major role in pathogenesis. Despite the underlying DNA repair deficiencies, NR dramatically improved the phenotype of each of these conditions in mouse models, prolonging survival by more than three times in ataxic mice.
description_zh_TW: PARylation（聚 ADP-核糖基化）增加是阿茲海默症的標記，且可透過 nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）補充在 AD 小鼠中降低。PARylation 增加亦在數種涉及 DNA 修復缺陷的其他神經退化性疾病中被偵測到，包括 Cockayne 症候群、xeroderma pigmentosum（著色性乾皮症）與 ataxia-telangiectasia（共濟失調毛細血管擴張症），其中 PARP 介導的 NAD+ 耗竭在致病機轉中扮演主要角色。儘管存在潛在的 DNA 修復缺陷，NR 在小鼠模型中顯著改善了這些疾病的每一種表型，在共濟失調小鼠中將存活期延長超過三倍。

label: Drug Discovery
description: Drug discovery increasingly uses induced pluripotent stem cells as a renewable, patient-derived platform for high-throughput compound screening. Because iPSCs can be generated from individuals with specific genetic diseases and differentiated into disease-relevant cell types, they allow researchers to test drug candidates on cells carrying the actual disease mutation. This approach improves the translatability of preclinical findings, supports personalized medicine, and reduces reliance on animal models and fetal tissue for mechanistic drug studies.
description_zh_TW: 藥物發現越來越多地使用誘導多能幹細胞作為可再生的、源自患者的平台，用於高通量化合物篩選。由於 iPSC 可以從患有特定遺傳疾病的個體中產生，並分化為與疾病相關的細胞類型，因此研究人員可以利用它們在攜帶實際疾病突變的細胞上測試候選藥物。這種方法提高了臨床前研究結果的可轉化性，支持個人化醫療，並減少機械藥物研究對動物模型和胎兒組織的依賴。

label: NDUFA10
description: NDUFA10 is a structural subunit of Mitochondrial Complex I (NADH:ubiquinone oxidoreductase), the first and largest complex of the oxidative phosphorylation electron transport chain. Complex I transfers electrons from NADH to ubiquinone while pumping protons across the inner mitochondrial membrane to build the gradient that drives ATP synthesis.
description_zh_TW: NDUFA10 是 Mitochondrial Complex I（NADH:ubiquinone oxidoreductase）的結構次單元，而 Complex I 是 oxidative phosphorylation 電子傳遞鏈中第一且最大的複合體。Complex I 將電子由 NADH 傳遞給 ubiquinone，同時在粒線體內膜泵出質子以建立驅動 ATP 合成的電化學梯度。

label: MMP-3
description: A landmark finding is that MMP-3 (stromelysin-1) can itself induce EMT in mammary epithelial cells by cleaving E-cadherin and triggering mesenchymal reprogramming. Because senescent fibroblasts and epithelial cells secrete MMP-3 as part of the SASP, senescent-cell-derived MMP-3 fosters a pre-neoplastic, invasive phenotype in neighbouring epithelium.
description_zh_TW: 一項里程碑式的發現是，MMP-3（stromelysin-1）本身就能藉由切割 E-cadherin 觸發間質重編程，誘導乳腺上皮細胞發生 EMT。由於衰老的纖維母細胞與上皮細胞會將 MMP-3 作為 SASP 的一部分分泌，來自衰老細胞的 MMP-3 會在鄰近上皮中促成癌前、侵襲性的表型。

label: Leptin
description: Adipose Tissue is a major endocrine organ, and its adipocytes secrete Leptin to signal satiety and energy stores to the brain, alongside Adiponectin, free fatty acids, and numerous cytokines. Leptin secretion rises with fat mass and is a key feedback signal in energy-balance regulation.
description_zh_TW: Adipose Tissue 是重要的內分泌器官，其脂肪細胞分泌 Leptin 向腦部傳遞飽足感與能量儲存的訊號，並同時分泌 Adiponectin、游離脂肪酸與多種細胞激素。Leptin 的分泌隨脂肪量上升，是能量平衡調節中的關鍵回饋訊號。

label: Moxidectin
description: Like ivermectin, moxidectin is an agonist at invertebrate glutamate- and GABA-gated chloride channels, causing sustained chloride influx, paralysis and death of nematodes and arthropods. It is a 23-methoxime milbemycin that shares the 16-membered macrocyclic lactone ring of the avermectins but lacks the disaccharide substituents, which increases lipophilicity and produces a much longer half-life than ivermectin.
description_zh_TW: 與 ivermectin 相同，moxidectin 是無脊椎動物 glutamate- 與 GABA-gated chloride channels 的致效劑，造成持續的 chloride 內流、麻痺與線蟲及節肢動物死亡。它是 23-甲肟基的 milbemycin，與 avermectins 共用 16 員環的 macrocyclic lactone 骨架，但缺少雙醣取代基，因而提高脂溶性並產生比 ivermectin 長得多的半衰期。

label: Plasmin
description: Pro-MMP-12 is activated extracellularly by serine proteases such as plasmin, and also by other MMPs (MMP-3, MMP-7) or by membrane-type MMPs at the cell surface. The relationship with plasmin is reciprocal: plasmin activates pro-MMP-12, while MMP-12 in turn cleaves plasminogen to release angiostatin.
description_zh_TW: Pro-MMP-12 在胞外由血清蛋白酶（如 plasmin）活化，也可由其他 MMP（MMP-3、MMP-7）或細胞表面的膜型 MMP 參與活化。與 plasmin 的關係是雙向的：plasmin 活化 pro-MMP-12，而 MMP-12 反過來切割 plasminogen 以釋放 angiostatin。

label: Pyruvate Kinase M2
description: Metabolic Reprogramming relates to Pyruvate Kinase M2 through the relation involves. Metabolic reprogramming is the rewiring of nutrient uptake and bioenergetics that supplies building blocks and redox balance to proliferating tumors. Pyruvate kinase M2 is the embryonic/warburg isoform that diverts glycolytic flux toward biosynthetic precursors rather than efficient ATP production. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
description_zh_TW: Metabolic Reprogramming 透過關係涉及 與 Pyruvate Kinase M2 相關。 Metabolic Reprogramming 是營養吸收和生物能的重新佈線，為增殖的腫瘤提供建構模組和氧化還原平衡。 Pyruvate Kinase M2 是胚胎/warburg 亞型，它將糖解通量轉向生物合成前體而不是有效的 ATP 生產。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

label: DunedinPACE
description: Because DunedinPACE captures the rate of aging, it is suited to testing whether interventions slow the aging process itself, linking directly to healthspan. It predicts later physical and cognitive functioning and incidence of multiple age-related diseases from a single blood sample.
description_zh_TW: 由於 DunedinPACE 捕捉老化速率，它適合測試介入措施是否減緩老化過程本身，直接與健康壽命（healthspan）相連結。它可從單一血液樣本預測後續身體與認知功能及多種年齡相關疾病的發生。

label: SECISBP2
