description: SECISBP2 (SBP2) is the RNA-binding protein that recognizes the SECIS stem-loop in the 3′UTR of selenoprotein mRNAs. Upon ribosome encounter of an in-frame UGA, SECISBP2 binds the SECIS element and contacts 40S protein RPS27A/eS31 to prevent premature termination, then recruits the Sec-specific elongation factor eEFSec with tRNA[Ser]Sec and GTP to deliver selenocysteine to the ribosomal A site. It thereby reassigns UGA from a stop codon to a Sec codon.
description_zh_TW: SECISBP2（SBP2）是辨識 selenoprotein mRNA 3′UTR 中 SECIS 莖環結構的 RNA 結合蛋白。當核糖體遇到同讀框的 UGA 時，SECISBP2 結合 SECIS 元素並與 40S 蛋白 RPS27A／eS31 接觸以避免提早終止，隨後招募 Sec 專一性延長因子 eEFSec 與 tRNA[Ser]Sec 及 GTP，將 selenocysteine 送入核糖體 A 位。SECISBP2 因此將 UGA 由終止密碼子重新指定為 Sec 密碼子。

label: Dopaquinone
description: Dopaquinone is the ortho-quinone produced by tyrosinase-catalyzed oxidation of L-DOPA and is the first stable quinone intermediate of the melanogenic cascade. As an ortho-quinone it undergoes one-electron redox cycling: the resulting semiquinone radical reduces oxygen to Superoxide anion, propagating Oxidative Stress, whereas two-electron reduction by NQO1 or Glutathione-dependent systems short-circuits the cycle.
description_zh_TW: Dopaquinone 是 L-DOPA 經 tyrosinase 催化的氧化所產生的 ortho-quinone，也是黑色素生成級聯中第一個穩定的 quinone 中間產物。作為 ortho-quinone，它會經歷單電子 redox cycling：生成的半醌自由基將氧還原為 Superoxide anion，傳播 Oxidative Stress；相對地，NQO1 或 Glutathione 依賴系統的雙電子還原則會短路此循環。

label: miR-24
description: XIAP is downregulated by miR-24. XIAP is the most potent mammalian IAP, directly inhibiting caspases-9, -3, and -7 and stabilized by survival kinases. miR-24 is a microRNA that targets several anti-apoptotic and cell-cycle mRNAs, including XIAP, to lower the death threshold. The directionality runs from miR-24 toward XIAP, so miR-24 is the active agent and XIAP the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
description_zh_TW: XIAP 被 miR-24 下調。 XIAP 是最有效的哺乳動物 IAP，直接抑制 caspase-9、-3 和 -7，並透過生存激酶穩定。 miR-24 是一種 microRNA，可針對多種抗凋亡和細胞週期 mRNA（包括 XIAP），以降低死亡閾值。方向性從 miR-24 向 XIAP，因此 miR-24 是主動主體，XIAP 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: CUT&Tag
description: CUT&Tag (Cleavage Under Targets and Tagmentation) maps histone modifications genome-wide using a primary antibody against the target epigenetic mark plus a secondary antibody linked to a Protein A-Tn5 transposase fusion. Ca2+-dependent Tn5 activation then cleaves and tags DNA adjacent to the antibody binding site, giving high-resolution profiles from as few as 100-10,000 cells with lower background than ChIP-seq.
description_zh_TW: CUT&Tag（Cleavage Under Targets and Tagmentation）以針對目標表觀遺傳標記的一級抗體，加上連接 Protein A–Tn5 轉位酶融合蛋白的二級抗體，全基因體地測繪組蛋白修飾。隨後由鈣離子依賴的 Tn5 活化，在抗體結合位點附近切割並標記 DNA，僅需 100–10,000 個細胞即可得到高解析度輪廓，背景比 ChIP-seq 更低。

label: Trisomy
description: Down Syndrome is trisomy 21, a numerical chromosomal abnormality produced when meiotic nondisjunction adds a third copy of Chromosome 21. The extra gene dosage, not any point mutation, underlies the phenotype.
description_zh_TW: Down Syndrome（唐氏症）是三染色體 21，一種數目性的染色體異常，由減數分裂時的不分離（nondisjunction）加入第三份 Chromosome（染色體）21 所造成。其表型基礎是基因劑量增加，而非任何點突變。

label: dNTP
description: Ribonucleotide reductase (RNR) is the only enzyme that catalyzes the de novo conversion of ribonucleoside diphosphates (NDPs) into deoxyribonucleoside diphosphates (dNDPs), the immediate precursors of the dNTPs required for DNA replication and repair. It is the rate-limiting, allosterically regulated committed step of de novo dNTP synthesis. dNTPs (dATP, dGTP, dCTP, dTTP) are the four deoxyribose building blocks of DNA, produced de novo by ribonucleotide reductase via reduction of NDPs to dNDPs followed by phosphorylation. RNR is the rate-limiting, allosterically committed step of this synthesis.
description_zh_TW: 核醣核苷酸還原酶（RNR）是唯一能催化核醣核苷二磷酸（NDP）de novo 轉化為去氧核醣核苷二磷酸（dNDP）的酵素，dNDP 是 DNA 複製與修復所需 dNTP 的直接前驅物。它是 de novo dNTP 合成中受別構調控、速率限制的承諾步驟。 dNTP（dATP、dGTP、dCTP、dTTP）是 DNA 的四種去氧核糖建構單元，由核醣核苷酸還原酶將 NDP 還原為 dNDP 再經磷酸化而 de novo 合成。RNR 是此合成中速率限制、別構承諾的步驟。

label: Dopamine o-quinone
description: Dopamine is biochemically converted into Dopamine o-quinone through a defined reaction step in catecholamine pigment or neurotransmitter metabolism. Mechanistically, Dopamine acts as the substrate and Dopamine o-quinone as the product, often via oxidation, cyclization, or enzymatic decarboxylation. This conversion is biologically significant because it channels labile intermediates into stable products or active transmitters, with implications for neuromelanin accumulation and neuronal health. A caveat is that the precise stoichiometry and subcellular conditions governing the step are not fully resolved and may depend on local iron, pH, and antioxidant capacity.
description_zh_TW: Dopamine 透過兒茶酚胺色素或神經傳導物質代謝中的特定反應步驟生化轉化為 Dopamine o-quinone。從機制上講，Dopamine 作為底物，Dopamine o-quinone 作為產物，通常透過 oxidation、環化或酶促脫羧作用。這種轉化具有重要的生物學意義，因為它將不穩定的中間體轉化為穩定的產物或活性遞質，對 neuromelanin 累積和神經元健康產生影響。需要注意的是，控制該步驟的精確化學計量和亞細胞條件尚未完全解決，可能取決於局部 iron、pH 和抗氧化能力。

label: Notch Signaling
description: Hes1 and Hey2 are downstream effectors of Notch signaling. Hes proteins bind E-box (CACNAG) motifs and recruit Groucho/TLE corepressors and histone deacetylases to silence proneural targets, while Hey proteins are activated via the Notch intracellular domain and RBPJκ. Hes1 is expressed in oscillatory waves that pattern the nervous system, whereas Hey2 is constitutive in myocardium and vasculature.
description_zh_TW: Hes1 與 Hey2 是 Notch signaling 的下游效應因子。Hes 蛋白結合 E-box（CACNAG）模體，並招募 Groucho/TLE 共抑制子與 histone deacetylase 以靜默神經前驅相關標的；Hey 蛋白則經由 Notch 細胞內區域與 RBPJκ 被活化。Hes1 以振盪波形式表現以塑造神經系統，Hey2 則在心臟與血管中恆常表現。

label: TFAM
description: Inhibition of mTOR by rapamycin raises TFAM together with PGC-1alpha, promoting mitochondrial biogenesis, renewal of the mitochondrial population and improved fatty-acid metabolism in senescent tissues such as myocardium and brown adipose tissue. Rapamycin additionally boosts TFAM via cap-independent translation and ATF4/H2S-mediated stress resistance.
description_zh_TW: Rapamycin 抑制 mTOR 會使 TFAM 與 PGC-1alpha 一起上升，促進 mitochondrial biogenesis、粒線體族群的更新，以及心肌與褐色脂肪等衰老組織中的脂肪酸代謝改善。Rapamycin 也透過帽非依賴性轉譯與 ATF4/H2S 媒介的壓力抗性進一步提升 TFAM。

label: ATP Synthase
description: Complex V synthesizes ATP using the proton motive force at roughly 32 to 34 ATP per glucose. Synthesis is the oxidative-phosphorylation output.
description_zh_TW: 複合體 V 利用質子動力以每葡萄糖約 32 至 34 ATP 合成 ATP。合成是氧化磷酸化輸出。

label: Adrenochrome Semiquinone Radical
description: Adrenochrome undergoes one-electron reduction to the adrenochrome semiquinone radical, a highly reactive intermediate species. Common cellular reducers that drive this reaction include mitochondrial Complex I using NADH, NADPH-cytochrome P450 reductase, and non-enzymatic reductants such as ascorbate and adrenaline itself. The semiquinone radical is central to adrenochrome redox cycling, as it rapidly auto-oxidizes to regenerate adrenochrome while producing superoxide anion at a fast rate. This radical-mediated redox loop means that adrenochrome can catalytically amplify reactive oxygen species and oxidative damage, and it has been studied in cardiac tissue where high catecholamine exposure and mitochondrial density make the cycle particularly relevant.
description_zh_TW: Adrenochrome 經受單電子還原成為高度反應性的中間物種 adrenochrome 半醌自由基。驅動此反應的常見細胞還原劑包括使用 NADH 的粒線體 Complex I、NADPH-cytochrome P450 reductase，以及抗壞血酸與 adrenaline 本身等非酶性還原劑。半醌自由基是 adrenochrome 氧化還原循環的核心，因為它迅速自氧化以再生 adrenochrome，同時以快速速率產生超氧陰離子。此自由基介導的氧化還原迴圈意味著 adrenochrome 能催化放大活性氧物種與氧化損傷，且已在兒茶酚胺暴露高與粒線體密度高的心臟組織中被研究，使此循環特別相關。

label: Senotherapy
description: Senotherapy encompasses senolytics, the cell-elimination arm that selectively induces apoptosis in senescent cells by disabling SCAPs. This is one of the two principal divisions of senotherapy, the other being senomorphics, and the term captures the spectrum of interventions aimed at the senescent cell. Encompassing senolytics underscores the elimination-based strategy's centrality to the field, given its strong preclinical and early clinical evidence. Senolytic agents range from navitoclax to the D+Q combination and fisetin.
description_zh_TW: Senotherapy 涵蓋 senolytics，即透過失能 SCAPs 選擇性誘發衰老細胞凋亡的細胞消除臂。這是 senotherapy 兩個主要分支之一，另一為 senomorphics，且此詞涵蓋針對衰老細胞的介入光譜。涵蓋 senolytics 強調消除為本策略對該領域的中心性，考量其強健的臨床前與早期臨床證據。Senolytic 藥劑從 navitoclax 到 D+Q 組合與 fisetin 皆有。

label: TNFR1 complex I
description: TNFR1 complex I contains RIPK1 as its central signaling subunit, recruited via a death-domain (DD) interaction with TRADD. Its ubiquitination state is the branch-point switch for the whole TNF decision: cIAPs attached via TRAF2/5 decorate RIPK1 with K63 and LUBAC-derived linear M1 chains to build a scaffold, while CYLD-mediated deubiquitination of the same protein dissolves the scaffold and births complex II.
description_zh_TW: TNFR1 complex I 以 RIPK1 為核心訊號次單元，RIPK1 透過 death domain（DD）與 TRADD 交互作用而被招募進來。其泛素化狀態是整個 TNF 決定的分支點開關：cIAPs 經由 TRAF2/5 為 RIPK1 加上 K63 與 LUBAC 產生的線性 M1 鏈以搭建支架，而同一蛋白的 CYLD 媒介去泛素化則溶解支架並催生 complex II。

label: Cyclic Dinucleotide
description: cGAS synthesizes the endogenous cyclic dinucleotide messenger 2'3'-cGAMP from ATP and GTP upon sensing cytosolic DNA. cGAMP then binds STING in the endoplasmic reticulum, triggering STING translocation to the ERGIC and recruitment of TBK1 and IRF3 to drive type I interferon and ISG expression.
description_zh_TW: cGAS 在偵測到細胞質 DNA 後，以 ATP 與 GTP 合成內源性 Cyclic Dinucleotide 訊息傳遞者 2'3'-cGAMP。cGAMP 接著在內質網中結合 STING，促使 STING 易位至 ERGIC 並招募 TBK1 與 IRF3，進而驅動第一型干擾素與 ISG 的表現。

label: Gasdermin E
description: Caspase-3 cleaves gasdermin E (GSDME), releasing its N-terminal pore-forming domain and converting apoptosis into pyroptosis. The outcome is dictated by GSDME expression level: in GSDME-high cancer cells, chemotherapy-activated caspase-3 drives pyroptotic lysis; in GSDME-low settings, GSDME instead acts upstream of caspase-3, reinforcing classical apoptosis. This caspase-3/GSDME switch is the clearest demonstration that the caspase substrate — not the caspase itself — determines the death modality.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-3 會切割 gasdermin E（GSDME），釋出其成孔的 N 端片段，使細胞凋亡轉為焦亡。結果由 GSDME 的表達量決定：在 GSDME 高表達的癌細胞中，化療活化的 Caspase-3 驅動焦亡裂解；在 GSDME 低表達的情境下，GSDME 反而作為 Caspase-3 的上游活化因子，強化典型細胞凋亡。Caspase-3/GSDME 開關最清楚地表現出：決定死亡型態的是 caspase 的受質，而非 caspase 本身。

label: BEC-1
description: BEC-1 is the C. elegans orthologue of the mammalian Beclin1 (and the yeast Atg6). It is a key regulator of Autophagy, part of the Class III Vps34 complex, and is required for autophagosome nucleation and for longevity extension by dietary restriction.
description_zh_TW: BEC-1 是 C. elegans 中哺乳類 Beclin1（以及酵母 Atg6）的同源基因。它是 Autophagy 的關鍵調節因子，屬於 Class III Vps34 複合體，並為自噬體成核與飲食限制延長壽命所必需。

label: Disease Modeling
description: Disease modeling uses induced pluripotent stem cells to recreate genetic diseases in vitro by reprogramming patient somatic cells and differentiating them into the affected cell types. iPSC-derived models recapitulate disease phenotypes, such as TDP-43 mislocalization in frontotemporal dementia neurons, enabling mechanistic dissection of pathology and identification of therapeutic targets. Because the cells carry the patient's actual genome, they also support drug screening and personalized medicine approaches.
description_zh_TW: 疾病建模使用誘導多能幹細胞，透過對患者體細胞進行重新編程並將其分化為受影響的細胞類型，在體外重現遺傳疾病。 iPSC 衍生模型概括了疾病表型，例如額顳葉失智症神經元中的 TDP-43 錯誤定位，從而能夠對病理進行機械剖析並識別治療標靶。由於細胞攜帶患者的實際基因組，因此它們也支持藥物篩選和個人化醫療方法。

label: PECAM1
description: PECAM1 (CD31) is a 130-kDa immunoglobulin-superfamily transmembrane glycoprotein constitutively expressed on endothelial cells, platelets, and subsets of leukocytes. Its homophilic binding organizes cell-cell adhesion at junctions, so constitutive expression is a practical marker of endothelial identity in immunohistochemistry and flow cytometry.
description_zh_TW: PECAM1（CD31）是 130 kDa 的免疫球蛋白超家族跨膜糖蛋白，組成型表現於 Endothelial Cells、Platelets 與部分白血球。其同型結合在連接處組織細胞間黏附，因此組成型表現是免疫組織化學與流式細胞術中判定內皮身分的重要標記。

label: Z-DNA
description: cGAS can recognize the noncanonical left-handed Z-DNA conformation (and Z-RNA) at chromatin, a function spatially and mechanistically separable from its canonical role of synthesizing cGAMP from cytosolic dsDNA. Structural and mutational studies show that cGAS Z-DNA-binding mutants decouple chromatin binding from DNA-sensing activity: the protein still localizes to chromatin but fails to mount a productive cGAS-STING response, revealing that chromatin tethering and enzyme activation are governed by distinct molecular interfaces.
description_zh_TW: cGAS 能辨識染色質上的非典型左手 Z-DNA 構形（以及 Z-RNA），此功能在空間與機制上都與其由細胞質雙股 DNA 合成 cGAMP 的典型角色分離。結構與突變研究顯示，cGAS 的 Z-DNA 結合突變體可將染色質結合與 DNA 感測功能解耦：蛋白質仍定位於染色質，卻無法啟動有效的 cGAS-STING 反應，顯示染色質繫留與酵素活化由不同的分子介面調控。

label: SMURF2
description: Ubiquitination-mediated SIRT1 degradation by SMURF2 suppresses colorectal cancer cell proliferation and tumorigenesis. This places SMURF2 on the tumor-suppressive side of the SIRT1-in-cancer debate: since SIRT1 supports survival of transformed epithelial cells, an E3 ligase that lowers SIRT1 abundance acts as a brake on tumor growth. It complements the DNA-damage arm (TRIM28) and the p53-axis arm (MDM2), giving three context-specific E3 ligases that control SIRT1 stability.
description_zh_TW: SMURF2 對 SIRT1 的泛素化降解會抑制大腸直腸癌細胞的增殖與腫瘤生成。這使 SMURF2 站在「SIRT1 與癌症」辯論中腫瘤抑制的一方：由於 SIRT1 支持轉化上皮細胞的存活，能降低 SIRT1 豐度的 E3 連接酶便成為腫瘤生長的煞車。它與 DNA 損傷臂（TRIM28）及 p53 軸線臂（MDM2）互補，共同構成三個依情境控制 SIRT1 穩定性的 E3 連接酶。

label: Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS)
description: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder marked by selective degeneration of upper and lower motor neurons, causing muscle wasting, weakness, paralysis and respiratory failure. Most cases are sporadic; roughly 10% are familial, involving SOD1, C9orf72, TARDBP or FUS mutations. Mechanisms include excitotoxicity, oxidative stress, mitochondrial dysfunction, defective autophagy and neuroinflammation.
description_zh_TW: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis 屬於進行性神經退行性疾病，特徵為上、下運動神經元的選擇性退化，造成肌肉萎縮無力、癱瘓與呼吸衰竭。多數病例為散發性，約 10% 為家族性，涉及 SOD1、C9orf72、TARDBP 或 FUS 突變。致病機制包括興奮性毒性、氧化壓力、粒線體功能障礙、自噬缺陷與神經發炎。

label: Lysosomal Storage Diseases
description: Pompe disease (glycogen storage disease type II) is a lysosomal storage disease caused by deficiency of acid alpha-glucosidase (GAA), leading to massive glycogen accumulation in lysosomes, particularly in cardiac and skeletal muscle.
description_zh_TW: 龐貝氏症（第二型肝醣儲積症）屬於溶小體儲積症，由酸性 α-葡萄糖苷酶（GAA）缺乏所致，造成溶小體（尤其在心肌與骨骼肌）大量肝醣累積。

label: CENP-A
description: Centromeres are epigenetically specified by CENP-A chromatin rather than by DNA sequence in most eukaryotes. The centromere is the specialized chromosome region where the kinetochore assembles and spindle microtubules attach during mitosis and meiosis, flanked by pericentric heterochromatin enriched in H3K9me3; its dysfunction causes aneuploidy and cancer.
description_zh_TW: 在多數真核生物中，centromere 是由 CENP-A 染色質而非 DNA 序列表觀指定的。它是染色體上 kinetochore 組裝且紡錘絲微管在有絲分裂與減數分裂時附著的特化區域，兩側為富含 H3K9me3 的著絲粒周邊異染色質；其功能障礙會導致 aneuploidy 與 cancer。

label: Amifostine
description: Amifostine (WR-2721) is a phosphorothioate prodrug dephosphorylated at the cell membrane by alkaline phosphatase to the free-thiol metabolite WR-1065, which accumulates selectively in normal tissues. WR-1065 donates hydrogen atoms to neutralize hydroxyl radicals (HO•) generated by ionizing radiation, protecting DNA and proteins from radiation-induced damage.
description_zh_TW: Amifostine（WR-2721）是磷硫代前藥，在細胞膜上被鹼性磷酸酶去磷酸化為游離硫醇代謝物 WR-1065，並選擇性地累積於正常組織。WR-1065 提供氫原子以中和電離輻射產生的氫自由基（HO•），保護 DNA 與蛋白質免受輻射誘發的損傷。

label: Thermic Effect of Food
description: The Thermic Effect of Food (TEF, diet-induced thermogenesis) is the post-ingestive rise in energy expenditure above Resting Metabolic Rate that reflects the energetic cost of digesting, absorbing, transporting and storing nutrients. Together with resting metabolism and physical activity, TEF is one of the three canonical components of the daily energy budget, and its magnitude is proportional to the size and protein content of the meal.
description_zh_TW: 食物熱效應（TEF，飲食誘導產熱）是進食後能量消耗高於 Resting Metabolic Rate 的增幅，反映消化、吸收、運輸與儲存營養素所需的能量代價。TEF 與休息代謝及身體活動並列為每日能量預算的三大組成部分，其大小與餐食份量及蛋白質含量成正比。

label: MMP
description: MMP remodels Tumor Microenvironment. Matrix metalloproteinases degrade extracellular-matrix components and thereby enable invasion, angiogenesis, and microenvironment remodeling. The tumor microenvironment is the constellation of stromal, immune, vascular, and extracellular elements that nurture or restrain the malignant clone. The relationship is directional, with MMP acting as the operative agent upon Tumor Microenvironment rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: MMP改造Tumor Microenvironment。基質金屬蛋白酶降解細胞外基質成分，從而實現侵襲、血管生成和微環境重塑。 Tumor Microenvironment 是培育或抑制惡性克隆的基質、免疫、血管和細胞外元素的集合。這種關係是有方向的，MMP 充當 Tumor Microenvironment 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: CMS121
description: CMS121 is a fatty-acid-synthase (FASN) inhibitor developed by Pamela Maher's lab, discovered through the same phenotypic ferroptosis-based screening platform that yielded its sister compound J147. By inhibiting FASN it reduces pathological lipid accumulation and oxidative stress in neurons, and both compounds completed Phase 1 clinical trials for Alzheimer's disease.
description_zh_TW: CMS121 是 Pamela Maher 實驗室開發的脂肪酸合成酶（FASN）抑制劑，與其姊妹化合物 J147 同樣來自以鐵死亡為基礎的表型篩選平台。藉由抑制 FASN，它減少神經元中病理性脂質堆積與氧化壓力，兩者皆已完成阿茲海默病的第一期臨床試驗。

label: Citrulline
description: Nitric oxide radical is synthesised by nitric oxide synthase through the oxidation of arginine to citrulline, making citrulline the obligatory by-product of NO generation. This places citrulline at two distinct fates: an enzymatic by-product of NO signalling and a chemical by-product of glucosepane breakdown.
description_zh_TW: 一氧化氮自由基由 Nitric Oxide Synthase 經由 Arginine 氧化為 Citrulline 而合成，使 Citrulline 成為 NO 生成不可避免的副產物。這使 Citrulline 具有兩種不同的命運：作為 NO 訊號的酵素副產物，以及作為 Glucosepane 降解的化學副產物。

label: CD4
description: HIV-1 enters cells when the envelope glycoprotein gp120 binds the CD4 receptor together with a CCR5 or CXCR4 coreceptor, with gp41 then mediating membrane fusion. CD4+ T cell depletion driven by this entry step is the immunological basis of HIV-1 immunodeficiency, and it is also exploited therapeutically by post-attachment CD4-directed antibodies such as ibalizumab.
description_zh_TW: HIV-1 入侵細胞時，envelope 醣蛋白 gp120 會與 CD4 受體及 CCR5 或 CXCR4 共同受體結合，接著由 gp41 介導膜融合。由這個入侵步驟造成的 CD4+ T 細胞耗竭，是 HIV-1 免疫缺陷的免疫學基礎；治療上也被 ibalizumab 等 post-attachment CD4 導向抗體所利用。

label: DAF-7
description: DAF-7 is the C. elegans TGFβ ortholog, expressed mainly in sensory neurons. Unlike the insulin/insulin-receptor pathway, DAF-7 responds to environmental cues such as food availability and pheromones and acts on a different transcriptional output, notably not through the metabolic repressor MXL-3.
description_zh_TW: DAF-7 是 C. elegans 的 TGFβ 直系同源物，主要在感覺神經元表現。與 insulin/insulin receptor 路徑不同，DAF-7 會對食物可得性與費洛蒙等環境線索作出反應，且作用於不同的轉錄輸出，尤其並非透過代謝抑制因子 MXL-3。

label: Cyclic Guanosine Monophosphate
description: Guanylate cyclase enzymes convert GTP to the second messenger cGMP, which activates protein kinase G and regulates smooth-muscle tone, platelet aggregation, and neuronal signaling. The soluble isoform is the principal receptor for nitric oxide, while particulate isoforms respond to natriuretic peptides.
description_zh_TW: Guanylate cyclase 將 GTP 轉換為第二信使 cGMP，後者活化 protein kinase G 並調節平滑肌張力、血小板聚集與神經訊號。可溶性型是 nitric oxide 的主要受體，顆粒型則對 natriuretic peptide 反應。

label: Pan-sirtuin Activator
description: Caloric restriction is the canonical endogenous pan-sirtuin activator: it raises the NAD+/nicotinamide ratio, relieving nicotinamide feedback inhibition and boosting sirtuin activity across the family. In yeast the CR lifespan benefit requires SIR2, the genetic template later extrapolated to mammalian SIRT1.
description_zh_TW: 熱量限制是典型的內源性廣泛 sirtuin 活化劑：它提高 NAD+/菸醯胺比值，解除菸醯胺的負回饋抑制，整體提升 sirtuin 活性。在酵母中，熱量限制的壽命效益需要 SIR2，這是後來外推至哺乳類 SIRT1 的遺傳範本。

label: Myricetin
description: Myricetin is a Flavonol within the wider Flavonoids class, a polyphenol found across many fruits, vegetables and medicinal herbs. Its reported antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activity follows the general structure-activity pattern of flavonols, and it was screened alongside Fisetin, Quercetin and Luteolin.
description_zh_TW: Myricetin 是更廣泛 Flavonoids 類別中的 Flavonol，為存在於多種水果、蔬菜與藥草的多酚。其已知的抗氧化與抗發炎活性符合 flavonol 一般的結構—活性型態，並與 Fisetin、Quercetin、Luteolin 一同接受篩選。

label: IGFBP5
description: IGFBP5 binds circulating and tissue IGF1 with high affinity through conserved cysteine-rich N- and C-terminal domains, regulating IGF access to IGF1R. By sequestering IGFs it can dampen pro-survival PI3K/Akt signaling, reinforcing senescence-associated growth arrest, and it also acts in autocrine/paracrine fashion to promote and propagate the senescent state during development and in adult tissue.
description_zh_TW: IGFBP5 透過保守的富含半胱胺酸 N 端與 C 端結構域，以高親和力結合循環與組織中的 IGF1，調控 IGF 與 IGF1R 接觸的機會。藉由封存 IGF，它可減弱促存活的 PI3K/Akt 訊號，強化與衰老相關的生長停滯；並以自分泌／旁分泌方式在胚胎發育與成人組織中促進並傳播衰老狀態。

label: Senescence-Messaging Secretome
source_file: _document_ - Could this enzyme help remove "zombie" cells from our tissues?.md
description: The Senescence-Messaging Secretome is an alternative name for the SASP that frames it as a sophisticated intercellular communication network rather than a mere collection of secreted factors.
description_zh_TW: Senescence-Messaging Secretome 是 SASP 的另一種名稱，強調它並非只是一群分泌因子，而是一套精密的細胞間通訊網路。

label: SNEDDS
description: Self-nanoemulsifying drug delivery systems are anhydrous preconcentrates of drug, oil, surfactant and co-surfactant that spontaneously form an oil-in-water nanoemulsion upon aqueous dilution, as occurs in the stomach. The nanometer droplets drastically increase surface area for absorption; the fisetin-SNEDDS formulation reported 154 nm droplets with 100% drug loading.
description_zh_TW: 自奈米乳化藥物傳遞系統（SNEDDS）是由藥物、油、界面活性劑與助表面活性劑組成的無水預濃縮物，遇水稀釋（如在胃中）時會自發形成水包油型奈米乳液。奈米尺度的液滴可大幅增加吸收表面積；文獻報導的 fisetin-SNEDDS 配方液滴大小為 154 nm，藥物負載率達 100%。

label: ATAC-seq
description: ATAC-seq (Assay for Transposase-Accessible Chromatin using sequencing) maps Chromatin Accessibility genome-wide by using hyperactive Tn5 Transposase to fragment and tag open chromatin with sequencing adapters, followed by high-throughput sequencing on DNA Sequencing platforms. Tn5 preferentially integrates into nucleosome-depleted regions such as Enhancers and Transcription Factor Binding Sites, so aligned tag fragments identify accessible loci. It also reports Nucleosome Positioning from fragment length distribution and Transcription Factor footprinting from insertion patterns.
description_zh_TW: ATAC-seq（Assay for Transposase-Accessible Chromatin using sequencing）以超活性 Tn5 Transposase 對開放染色質進行片段化並加上加上定序接子，再以 DNA Sequencing 平台進行高通量定序，藉此在全基因體尺度測量 Chromatin Accessibility。Tn5 偏好整合進 Promoter、Enhancer 與 Transcription Factor Binding Sites 等核小體缺失區域，因此比對上的 tag 片段即可界定可及位點。ATAC-seq 亦可由片段長度分布判讀 Nucleosome Positioning，並由插入模式推斷 Transcription Factor 的 footprint。

label: Addiction
description: Addiction and Nigrostriatal System are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Addiction and Nigrostriatal System may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Addiction 和 Nigrostriatal System 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Addiction 和 Nigrostriatal System 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase
description: Cytochrome b5 reductase and NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase are two names for the same NADH- cytochrome b5 oxidoreductase. Mutations in the CYB5R gene therefore reduce the activity of this same enzyme and cause congenital methemoglobinemia.
description_zh_TW: Cytochrome b5 reductase 與 NADH-dependent methemoglobin reductase 是同一個 NADH-cytochrome b5 oxidoreductase 的兩種名稱。因此 CYB5R 基因突變會降低此同一酵素的活性，並造成先天性 methemoglobinemia。

label: DYRK1A
description: DYRK1A phosphorylates caspase-9 at Thr125, inhibiting the initiator.
description_zh_TW: DYRK1A 在 Thr125 磷酸化 caspase-9，抑制起始者。

label: LGG-1
source_file: _document_ - MXL-3 and HLH-30 transcriptionally link lipolysis and autophagy to nutrient availability.md
description: LGG-1, one of the LC3 homologues, is required for Lipophagy: post-developmental dual inactivation of lgg-1 and lgg-2 leads to increased fat accumulation. That lipophagy depends on core autophagy genes indicates it is a conserved mechanism across metazoans rather than a lysosome-specific process, and that the lysosomal lipases act within the same pathway.
description_zh_TW: LGG-1（LC3 同源基因之一）對 Lipophagy 而言是必需的：發育後同時使 lgg-1 與 lgg-2 失活會導致脂肪累積增加。lipophagy 依賴核心自噬基因，顯示它是跨後生動物保守的機制而非溶酶體專有過程，也表示溶酶體脂肪酶是在同一路徑內作用。

label: c-CBL
description: c-CBL is a RING-type E3 ubiquitin ligase and negative regulator of receptor tyrosine kinase signaling. Its TKB domain recognizes doubly phosphorylated tyrosines on activated receptors such as EGFR, c-KIT and the PDGF receptor, and it attaches ubiquitin chains that sort the receptor into multivesicular bodies for lysosomal or proteasomal degradation, terminating proliferative and survival signals.
description_zh_TW: c-CBL 是 RING 型 E3 泛素連接酶，也是受體酪胺酸激酶訊號的負向調控者。其 TKB 結構域辨識 EGFR、c-KIT 與 PDGF 受體等已活化受體上雙重磷酸化的酪胺酸，並接上泛素鏈使受體被分選進入多囊泡體，進行溶酶體或蛋白酶體降解，終止增殖與存活訊號。

label: miRNA
description: Paracrine miRNA traffic instigates paracrine senescence and shapes the tissue microenvironment: senescent cells export miRNAs in extracellular vesicles that reprogramme neighbours. This is why circulating senescence-associated miRNAs serve as non-invasive biomarkers of biological age and inflammaging, and why exosomal miRNAs are explored as engineered senomorphic delivery vehicles.
description_zh_TW: 旁分泌的 miRNA 運輸會啟動 paracrine senescence 並塑造組織微環境：senescent cells 將 miRNA 以細胞外囊泡形式輸出，重新設定鄰近細胞。這也是為何循環中的 senescence 相關 miRNA 可作為生物年齡與 inflammaging 的非侵入性生物標記，以及為何 exosomal miRNA 被探索作為工程化的 senomorphic 遞送載體。

label: Albuminuria
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: Albuminuria is the abnormal excretion of plasma albumin into the urine, marking increased glomerular permeability. It is among the earliest detectable manifestations of Diabetic nephropathy, tracks with worsening glomerular injury, and predicts progression to end-stage renal disease.
description_zh_TW: Albuminuria 是血漿白蛋白異常排入尿液的情形，標記腎小球通透性增加。它是 Diabetic nephropathy 最早可偵測的表現之一，與腎小球損傷惡化相關，並可預測疾病進展至末期腎病。

label: LYN
description: LYN is a Src-family tyrosine kinase.
description_zh_TW: LYN 是 Src 家族酪胺酸激酶。

label: Autonomic Nervous System
description: HRV is directly controlled by the autonomic nervous system, which has two main branches with opposing effects. The sympathetic nervous system, the fight-flight-freeze system, releases adrenaline and cortisol that force the heart to beat faster and more rhythmically, lowering HRV. The parasympathetic nervous system, the rest-digest-and-repair system controlled heavily by the vagus nerve, allows more fluctuation between heartbeats, raising HRV. A high HRV therefore reflects strong vagal tone and a cardiovascular system that is highly responsive and flexible, while low HRV signals chronic stress, fatigue, or illness.
description_zh_TW: HRV 直接受自律神經系統控制，該系統有兩大作用相反的支系。交感神經系統（戰逃僵系統）會釋放腎上腺素與皮質醇，迫使心臟跳得更快且更規律，進而降低 HRV。副交感神經系統（休息消化修復系統）主要由迷走神經控制，允許心跳之間有較大的波動，進而提高 HRV。因此，高 HRV 反映強大的迷走神經張力，以及高度敏銳且具彈性的心血管系統；而低 HRV 則代表慢性壓力、疲勞或疾病。

label: SepSecS
description: SepSecS is the final selenium-incorporating step of selenocysteine biosynthesis; its loss abolishes Selenoprotein synthesis and is lethal in mice.
description_zh_TW: SepSecS 是 selenocysteine 生物合成中最後一個納入硒的步驟；其缺失會完全中止 Selenoprotein 的合成，並在老鼠中造成致命。

label: HIV
description: HIV-1 is the pandemic form of HIV: it is a lentivirus of the Retroviridae family and, with Group M subtypes A–K and circulating recombinant forms, accounts for more than 95% of infections worldwide. HIV-2, in contrast, is largely confined to West Africa, is less transmissible and progresses to AIDS more slowly.
description_zh_TW: HIV-1 是 HIV 的 pandemic 型態：屬 Retroviridae 科的 lentivirus，以 Group M 的 A–K 亞型與循環重組型（CRF）佔全球感染逾 95%。相對地，HIV-2 主要侷限於西非，傳播力較低且進展為 AIDS 的速度較慢。

label: IP3R2
description: ITPR2 is the gene encoding inositol 1,4,5-trisphosphate receptor type 2 (IP3R2), an isoform of the IP3 receptor family that mediates calcium release from the endoplasmic reticulum into the cytosol.
description_zh_TW: ITPR2 是編碼肌醇 1,4,5-三磷酸受體第 2 型（IP3R2）的基因，屬於 IP3 受體家族的異構型，負責將鈣離子由內質網釋放至細胞質。

label: Redox Potential
description: Toluidine Blue O has the most negative redox potential (E1/2 = −0.012 V vs NHE) of the methylene blue derivatives studied, and this negative Redox Potential enables electron shuttling that enhances cellular oxygen consumption.
description_zh_TW: Toluidine Blue O 在受測的 Methylene blue 衍生物中具有最負的還原電位（E1/2 = −0.012 V vs NHE），這種負的 Redox Potential 使其能作為電子載體穿梭，進而提升細胞的耗氧量。

label: Oligomycin
description: Oligomycin is a macrolide antibiotic that inhibits the F_O subunit of mitochondrial ATP synthase (Complex V), blocking Oxidative Phosphorylation and causing a characteristic drop in oxygen consumption with a compensatory rise in glycolysis. It is injected before FCCP in Seahorse assays to isolate ATP-synthase-linked respiration from maximal electron-transport capacity.
description_zh_TW: Oligomycin 是一種巨環抗生素，抑制粒線體 ATP 合成酶（Complex V）的 F_O 次單元，使氧化磷酸化（Oxidative Phosphorylation）受阻，造成耗氧量典型性下降與糖解代償性上升。在 Seahorse 試驗中，它會在 FCCP 之前注入，以將 ATP 合成酶連結的呼吸與最大電子傳遞容量區分開來。

label: Silver salts
description: Insoluble silver salts transform into soluble protein-bound transport species, the gateway step of systemic handling. Transformation enables circulation.
description_zh_TW: 不溶性銀鹽轉化為可溶性蛋白結合運輸物種，是全身處理的門戶步驟。轉化促成循環。

label: Saturated Enzymatic Regime
description: For a network to produce a biphasic dose-response curve, the probability is highly increased if one of the bivalent interactions of the inhibited target operates in the saturated enzymatic regime, i.e., a Michaelis-Menten interaction with high affinity towards its substrate whose reaction speed does not depend on substrate amount. Specifically, the Michaelis-Menten constant K21 of the backward interaction from Target to Input must be significantly low. Fixing K21 to a low value raises the percentage of hormetic parameter sets from about 6% to 80%, a roughly ten-fold increase in the probability of observing hormesis.
description_zh_TW: 若要讓網路產生雙相劑量反應曲線，若被抑制標靶的其中一個雙價交互作用運作於飽和酵素動力學區間——亦即對其受質具有高親和力、且反應速率不依賴受質濃度的Michaelis-Menten交互作用——則出現雙相曲線的機率會大幅提高。具體而言，從Target到Input之反向交互作用的Michaelis-Menten常數K21必須顯著偏低。將K21固定於低值，可使具毒物興奮效應（hormesis）的參數組比例從約6%提升至80%，觀察到毒物興奮效應的機率約增加十倍。

label: Guanidinoacetate (GAA)
description: Guanidinoacetate (glycocyamine) is the direct precursor of creatine, formed in the kidney from arginine and glycine by AGAT and then methylated by GAMT using S-adenosylmethionine to yield creatine in the liver. In GAMT deficiency GAA accumulates to toxic levels and causes neurological damage.
description_zh_TW: Guanidinoacetate（glycocyamine）是 creatine 的直接前驅物，在腎臟由 arginine 與 glycine 經 AGAT 形成，再由 GAMT 以 S-adenosylmethionine 為甲基供體在肝臟甲基化為 creatine。GAMT 缺乏時 GAA 累積至毒性濃度並造成神經損傷。

label: Thioredoxin
description: Thioredoxin proteins are recycled to their active reduced state by thioredoxin reductase in an NADPH-consuming cycle. Together with the glutathione system, thioredoxin and thioredoxin reductase constitute the bulk of cellular antioxidant capacity.
description_zh_TW: 硫氧還蛋白透過硫氧還蛋白還原酶在耗用 NADPH 的循環中被回收至活化的還原態。與麩胱甘肽系統一起，硫氧還蛋白與硫氧還蛋白還原酶構成了細胞抗氧化能力的主要部分。

label: Kynurenic Acid
description: Kynurenic acid (KynA) is a neuroactive metabolite of the kynurenine pathway produced from kynurenine by kynurenine aminotransferases. It is an endogenous broad-spectrum antagonist acting at the glycine co-agonist site of the NMDA receptor, which makes it neuroprotective against glutamate-mediated excitotoxicity. It also antagonizes alpha-7 nicotinic acetylcholine receptors, modulating cognition and inflammation.
description_zh_TW: Kynurenic acid（KynA）是犬尿胺酸（kynurenine）路徑的神經活性代謝物，由 kynurenine aminotransferase 自 kynurenine 產生。它是作用於 NMDA 受體甘胺酸共同作用位點的內生性廣效拮抗劑，因此能對抗麩胺酸介導的興奮毒性而具神經保護作用。它亦拮抗 α7 尼古丁型乙醯膽鹼受體，調節認知與發炎。

label: 2-Chlorophenothiazine
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: 2-Chlorophenothiazine is a chlorinated phenothiazine nucleus: it keeps the free 10-nitrogen and position-5 sulfur of the Phenothiazine scaffold but has no amine side chains at positions 3 and 7, which is why it lacks the electron-carrier activity of Methylene blue.
description_zh_TW: 2-Chlorophenothiazine 是氯化的 phenothiazine 核：保留 Phenothiazine 骨架的自由 10-氮與第 5 號硫，但在 3 與 7 位置沒有胺基側鏈，因此缺乏 Methylene blue 的電子載體活性。

label: Branched-Chain Amino Acids
description: Isoleucine is one of the three branched-chain amino acids and an essential amino acid that must be obtained from the diet; its catabolism yields acetyl-CoA and succinyl-CoA, which enter the TCA cycle.
description_zh_TW: Isoleucine 是三種支鏈胺基酸之一，也是必須由飲食取得的必需胺基酸；其分解代謝產生 acetyl-CoA 與 succinyl-CoA，進入 TCA cycle。

label: PDE
description: Phosphodiesterases (PDE1-PDE11) are metallophosphohydrolases that degrade the second messengers cAMP and cGMP to inactive 5′-nucleoside monophosphates. By terminating cyclic-nucleotide signals they set the amplitude, duration and localization of PKA/PKG activation, thereby influencing metabolism, cardiovascular tone and inflammation.
description_zh_TW: 磷酸二酯酶（PDE1–PDE11）是一類金屬磷酸酶，將第二訊使 cAMP 與 cGMP 水解為不具活性的 5′-核苷單磷酸。藉由終止環核苷酸訊號，它們決定 PKA/PKG 活化的幅度、持續時間與定位，進而影響代謝、血管張力與發炎。

label: Cyclooxygenase
description: Prostaglandin G₂ (PGG₂) is the 15-hydroperoxy endoperoxide produced by the bis-dioxygenation of arachidonic acid at the cyclooxygenase site of COX-1/COX-2 — two O₂ additions forming the bicyclic endoperoxide — making it the first committed intermediate of the prostanoid pathway and the site of aspirin's irreversible Ser530 acetylation.
description_zh_TW: Prostaglandin G₂（PGG₂）是在 COX-1/COX-2 的環氧化酶位點由花生四烯酸雙加氧而產生的 15-過氧基內過氧化物——兩次 O₂ 加成形成雙環內過氧化物——使其成為前列腺素路徑的第一個承諾中間產物，也是 aspirin 不可逆乙醯化 Ser530 的作用位點。

label: Phosphocreatine (PCr)
description: Creatine kinase reversibly phosphorylates creatine with ATP to produce phosphocreatine, the muscle phosphagen store. This reaction is the mechanistic hub of the creatine-PCr energy buffer.
description_zh_TW: Creatine kinase 以 ATP 可逆磷酸化肌酸以產生磷酸肌酸，即肌肉磷酸原儲庫。此反應是肌酸-PCr 能量緩衝的機制樞紐。

label: Vagus Nerve
description: Vagus Nerve and Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Vagus Nerve and Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Vagus Nerve 和 Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Vagus Nerve 和 Dorsal Motor Nucleus of the Vagus 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: DNA-PK
description: DNA-PK, together with ATM and ATR, phosphorylates histone H2AX to form gamma-H2AX foci at DNA double-strand breaks. Gamma-H2AX is therefore the experimental readout of DNA-PK kinase activity and of double-strand break damage, which is why gamma-H2AX elevation after fenbendazole treatment in A375 cells is interpreted as evidence of induced DNA damage.
description_zh_TW: DNA-PK 與 ATM、ATR 一起磷酸化 histone H2AX，在 DNA 雙股斷裂處形成 gamma-H2AX 焦點。因此 gamma-H2AX 是 DNA-PK kinase 活性與雙股斷裂損傷的實驗判讀指標；這也是 A375 細胞在 fenbendazole 處理後 gamma-H2AX 升高會被解讀為 DNA 損傷被誘發的證據的原因。

label: ABT-737
description: ABT-263 (navitoclax) is the orally bioavailable successor of ABT-737, developed to overcome poor solubility. Both inhibit Bcl-2, Bcl-xL and Bcl-w; Bcl-xL inhibition causes on-target thrombocytopenia.
description_zh_TW: ABT-263 (navitoclax) 是 ABT-737 的口服生物可利用後繼藥物，旨在克服溶解度差的問題。兩者皆抑制 Bcl-2、Bcl-xL 和 Bcl-w；Bcl-xL 抑制會導致標靶性血小板減少。

label: FKBP12
description: Rapalogs inhibit mTORC1 by binding the FKBP12-FRB interface of the mTOR kinase. FKBP12 is therefore the essential cofactor through which rapamycin-family drugs engage and suppress mTORC1 signaling.
description_zh_TW: Rapalog 透過結合 mTOR 激酶的 FKBP12-FRB 介面來抑制 mTORC1。因此 FKBP12 是 rapamycin 家族藥物參與並抑制 mTORC1 訊號所需的必需輔因子。

label: NMRK1
description: NMRK1 (nicotinamide ribose kinase 1), together with its isoform NMRK2, directly phosphorylates nicotinamide riboside (NR) to nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN), bypassing the rate-limiting enzyme NAMPT. This route also circumvents the requirement for energetically costly PRPP (phosphoribosyl pyrophosphate) and the feedback inhibition by NAD+. NMRK1 is expressed ubiquitously across tissues, whereas NMRK2 expression is concentrated in cardiac and skeletal muscle, which helps explain why these tissues respond well to NR supplementation. NR is an orally available NAD+ precursor that increases NAD+ levels and sirtuin activity in multiple tissues.
description_zh_TW: NMRK1（nicotinamide ribose kinase 1）與其同工型 NMRK2 直接將 nicotinamide riboside（NR）磷酸化為 nicotinamide mononucleotide（NMN），繞過限速酶 NAMPT。此途徑亦規避了對耗能的 PRPP（phosphoribosyl pyrophosphate）之需求，以及 NAD+ 的回饋抑制。NMRK1 於各組織中廣泛表現，而 NMRK2 的表現則集中於心臟與骨骼肌，這有助於解釋這些組織為何對 NR 補充反應良好。NR 是一種口服可用的 NAD+ 前驅物，可提升多種組織中的 NAD+ 濃度與 sirtuin 活性。

label: PIDDosome
description: PIDDosome activates Caspase-2. The PIDDosome is a DNA-damage-responsive multiprotein complex that activates caspase-2 and can also feed NF-kB survival signaling. Caspase-2 is an ancient initiator caspase activated by the PIDDosome in response to DNA damage and mitotic catastrophe. The relationship is directional, with PIDDosome acting as the operative agent upon Caspase-2 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: PIDDosome 啟動 Caspase-2。 PIDDosome 是一種 DNA 損傷響應性多蛋白複合物，可活化 caspase-2，還可提供 NF-kB 生存訊號傳導。 Caspase-2 是一種古老的起始半胱天冬酶，由 PIDDosome 響應 DNA Damage 和有絲分裂災難而激活。這種關係是有方向的，PIDDosome 充當 Caspase-2 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: TSC
source_file: _document_ - Rapamycin for longevity the pros, the cons, and future perspectives.md
description: Tuberous sclerosis complex is the prototypical mTORopathy, caused by loss of TSC1/TSC2, and it is defined by hamartomas such as cortical tubers, angiomyolipoma and SEGA. Phospho-ribosomal protein S6 serves as a pharmacodynamic biomarker of pathway activation in these patients.
description_zh_TW: 結節性硬化症（TSC）是最典型的 mTORopathy，由 TSC1/TSC2 缺失造成，並以 hamartoma（如皮質結節、血管平滑肌脂肪瘤與 SEGA）為其定義特徵。磷酸化 ribosomal protein S6 在這些病人中可作為路徑活化的藥效學生物標記。

label: ETS transcription factor
source_file: _document_ - Rejuvenating Sirtuins The Rise of a New Family of Cancer Drug Targets.md
description: ELK1 is the founding member of the ternary complex factor subfamily of ETS-domain transcription factors, alongside ELK3 and ELK4 (SAP-1), and is a major nuclear target of the RAS-MAPK/ERK cascade that controls immediate-early gene expression. In the context of sirtuin biology it serves as the canonical reference for the ETS-TCF family whose member ELK4 stabilizes SIRT7 at target promoters. Directionally, ELK1's ETS DNA-binding domain and SRF-coupling architecture are shared by the TCF family, informing how ELK4 anchors SIRT7 to chromatin for H3K18 deacetylation.
description_zh_TW: ELK1 是 ETS 結構域轉錄因子三元複合物因子亞家族的創始成員，與 ELK3 和 ELK4（SAP-1）並列，是 RAS-MAPK/ERK 細胞階級傳導路徑的主要細胞核靶標，控制即早基因表達。在 sirtuin 生物學的背景下，它作為 ETS-TCF 家族的標準參考，其成員 ELK4 將 SIRT7 穩定於靶啟動子處。方向性上 ELK1 的 ETS DNA 結合結構域和 SRF 偶聯架構為 TCF 家族所共享，闡明了 ELK4 如何將 SIRT7 錨定到染色質上進行 H3K18 去乙醯化。

label: Caspase-8-c-FLIP Rheostat
description: TNFR1 complex II is governed by the Caspase-8-c-FLIP Rheostat. Because complex I upregulates FLIP_L transcriptionally, the strength and duration of the initial survival signal set the apoptotic threshold of the complex that follows — the rheostat's transcriptional arm. FLIP_L heterodimers cleave RIPK1 locally and disarm the complex (survival), procaspase-8 homodimers execute apoptosis, and FLIP_S heterodimers leave RIPK1 intact for necroptosis.
description_zh_TW: TNFR1 complex II 受 Caspase-8-c-FLIP Rheostat 調控。由於 complex I 會在轉錄層面上調 FLIP_L，初始存活訊號的強度與持續時間便設定了後續複合體的凋亡門檻——這就是 rheostat 的轉錄臂。FLIP_L 異二聚體在局部切割 RIPK1 並解除複合體武裝（存活），procaspase-8 同二聚體執行凋亡，而 FLIP_S 異二聚體則讓 RIPK1 保持完整以供壞死性凋亡使用。

label: Amiodarone
description: Amiodarone is a class III antiarrhythmic (with additional class I, II and IV activity) that blocks potassium, sodium and calcium channels as well as beta-adrenergic receptors. It is used for refractory ventricular arrhythmias and is positioned in advanced life-support resuscitation protocols for cardiac arrest. Its large iodine load and lipophilicity produce chronic thyroid dysfunction, pulmonary fibrosis, corneal deposits and hepatotoxicity.
description_zh_TW: Amiodarone 是第三類抗心律不整藥（兼具第一、二、四類活性），可阻斷鉀離子、鈉離子與鈣離子通道以及 β-腎上腺素受體。它用於難治性心室心律不整，並被納入心臟驟停進階生命支持急救方案。其高碘負荷與脂溶性導致慢性甲狀腺功能異常、肺纖維化、角膜沉積與肝毒性。

label: HIIT
description: High-intensity interval training (HIIT) is a cornerstone mitohormetic stimulus: brief maximal efforts generate an acute ROS spike and lactate accumulation that trigger PGC-1alpha, the master regulator of mitochondrial biogenesis.
description_zh_TW: 高強度間歇訓練（HIIT）是核心的毒物興奮（mitohormetic）刺激：短暫的最大努力產生急性 ROS 峰值與乳酸累積，觸發粒線體生合成的總管 PGC-1α。

label: CTLA-4
description: CTLA-4 is one of the two checkpoint targets used by Immunotherapy. Antibody blockade of CTLA-4 removes inhibitory signaling from activated T cells at priming, and alongside PD-1/PD-L1 blockade it defines current checkpoint inhibitor therapy.
description_zh_TW: CTLA-4 是 Immunotherapy（免疫療法）所使用的兩個檢查點標的之一。以抗體阻斷 CTLA-4 可移除活化的 T 細胞在活化階段的抑制訊號，並與 PD-1/PD-L1 阻斷共同構成現行檢查點抑制劑療法的基礎。

label: Zellweger syndrome
description: Mutations in PEX genes, which encode peroxisomal membrane proteins required for biogenesis, account for over 80% of autosomal recessive peroxisomal biogenesis disorders. Loss of PEX1, essential for assembly of the peroxisomal membrane and import of other PEX proteins, results in a complete absence of peroxisomes — the most severe Zellweger spectrum presentation with profound neurological impairment.
description_zh_TW: 編碼過氧化物體膜蛋白（生物生成所需）的 PEX 基因突變，佔體染色體隱性過氧化物體生成疾病的 80% 以上。PEX1 對過氧化物體膜組裝與其他 PEX 蛋白的輸入至關重要，其缺失會導致過氧化物體完全缺失，造成最嚴重、伴隨深度神經損傷的 Zellweger 光譜疾病表現。

label: Pheochromocytoma
description: Pheochromocytoma is a Catecholamines-secreting tumor arising from Chromaffin cells of the Adrenal medulla, producing paroxysmal hypertension, palpitations, headache, and diaphoresis. About 10% are extra-adrenal paragangliomas, 10% bilateral, 10% malignant, and 10% hereditary (MEN2, VHL disease, NF1).
description_zh_TW: Pheochromocytoma 是源自 Adrenal medulla 之 Chromaffin cells 的 Catecholamines 分泌腫瘤，會造成陣發性高血壓、心悸、頭痛與大量出汗。約 10% 為腎上腺外 paraganglioma、10% 為雙側、10% 為惡性、10% 為遺傳性（與 MEN2、VHL disease、NF1 相關）。

label: Notch
description: Notch is essential for establishing Paracrine Senescence: senescent cells stimulate Notch signaling in neighboring cells, propagating the arrested, SASP-producing state, though the SASP of these secondary senescent cells is weaker and may limit runaway spread.
description_zh_TW: Notch 對建立 Paracrine Senescence 至關重要：衰老細胞會刺激鄰近細胞的 Notch 訊號，傳播停滯且產生 SASP 的狀態；不過次級衰老細胞的 SASP 較弱，可限制失控擴散。

label: Single-cell Omics
description: Single-cell omics comprises technologies such as scRNA-seq, scATAC-seq, single-cell proteomics and spatial transcriptomics that profile individual cells, circumventing the averaging inherent in bulk measurements. In Autophagy research these methods reveal pronounced cell-to-cell heterogeneity in autophagic flux, lysosomal capacity and nutrient sensing, showing how mTORC1 and TFEB programs differ between cells within the same tissue.
description_zh_TW: Single-cell omics 包含 scRNA-seq、scATAC-seq、單細胞蛋白組學與空間轉錄組等技術，可分析個別細胞，避開大量測量的平均化缺陷。在自噬研究中，這些方法揭示了自噬流、溶酶體容量與營養感測的顯著細胞間異質性，顯示同一組織內不同細胞的 mTORC1 與 TFEB 程序如何有所差異。

label: Dyspnea
description: In symptomatic methemoglobinemia, Methylene blue reduces methemoglobin back to functional Hemoglobin, relieving Dyspnea and Cyanosis; management otherwise targets the underlying cause. Dyspnea can also be acute (pulmonary embolism, asthma, pneumonia, Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome) or chronic (COPD, heart failure).
description_zh_TW: 在有症狀的 methemoglobinemia 中，Methylene blue 將 methemoglobin 還原為具功能的 Hemoglobin，緩解 Dyspnea 與 Cyanosis；其他處置則針對潛在病因。Dyspnea 可為急性（肺栓塞、氣喘、肺炎、Acute Respiratory Distress Syndrome）或慢性（COPD、心衰竭）。

label: L-Tyrosine
description: L-Tyrosine is biochemically converted into L-DOPA through a defined reaction step in catecholamine pigment or neurotransmitter metabolism. Mechanistically, L-Tyrosine acts as the substrate and L-DOPA as the product, often via oxidation, cyclization, or enzymatic decarboxylation. This conversion is biologically significant because it channels labile intermediates into stable products or active transmitters, with implications for neuromelanin accumulation and neuronal health. A caveat is that the precise stoichiometry and subcellular conditions governing the step are not fully resolved and may depend on local iron, pH, and antioxidant capacity.
description_zh_TW: L-Tyrosine 透過兒茶酚胺色素或神經傳導物質代謝中的特定反應步驟生化轉化為 L-DOPA。從機制上講，L-Tyrosine 作為底物，L-DOPA 作為產物，通常透過 oxidation、環化或酶促脫羧作用。這種轉化具有重要的生物學意義，因為它將不穩定的中間體轉化為穩定的產物或活性遞質，對 neuromelanin 累積和神經元健康產生影響。需要注意的是，控制該步驟的精確化學計量和亞細胞條件尚未完全解決，可能取決於局部 iron、pH 和抗氧化能力。

label: Erythropoietin
description: Erythropoietin is the kidney-derived cytokine induced by hypoxia-inducible factors that drives red cell production via the EPO receptor/JAK2/STAT5 axis. In chronic kidney disease, EPO deficiency and accelerated eryptosis coincide, producing anaemia; sepsis alters EPO responsiveness.
description_zh_TW: Erythropoietin 是由 hypoxia-inducible factors 誘導、腎臟來源的細胞激素，透過 EPO receptor/JAK2/STAT5 軸驅動紅血球生成。在 chronic kidney disease 中，EPO 缺乏與加速的 eryptosis 同時出現而造成貧血；sepsis 則會改變 EPO 的反應性。

label: Myocardium
description: Sympathetic nerve endings provide dense innervation of the SA node, AV node, and ventricular myocardium of the heart. Sympathetic activation increases heart rate, conduction velocity, and contractile force. This innervation is a major determinant of cardiac chronotropy, dromotropy, and inotropy.
description_zh_TW: Sympathetic nerve endings 對心臟的 SA node、AV node 與心室 Myocardium 提供密集的神經支配。交感神經活化會增加心率、傳導速度與收縮力。這種神經支配是心臟變時性、變傳導性與變力性的主要決定因素。

label: Left Ventricular Hypertrophy
description: Left Ventricular Hypertrophy, the thickening or enlargement of the left ventricular wall in response to pressure overload, is accompanied by increased expression of the fission protein DRP1 and reduced levels of the fusion protein MFN2, so mitochondrial dynamics themselves are a biomarker of cardiac remodelling.
description_zh_TW: Left Ventricular Hypertrophy 是壓力超負荷引起的左心室壁增厚或擴大，常伴隨分裂蛋白 DRP1 上升與融合蛋白 MFN2 下降，因此粒線體動態本身即為心臟重塑的生物標誌。

label: Basal Ganglia
description: The striatum is part of the basal ganglia, forming the principal input station that receives excitatory cortical and thalamic afferents and dopaminergic input from the substantia nigra pars compacta. Its output via the direct and indirect pathways regulates thalamocortical motor and associative loops, making it central to movement, habit, and reward. COMT and DAT modulate the dopamine that shapes this circuitry, with DAT dominating striatal clearance. This anatomical position underlies its broad functional significance in the brain.
description_zh_TW: 紋狀體是 basal ganglia 的一部分，形成主要輸入站，接收興奮性皮質和丘腦傳入神經以及來自黑質緻密部的多巴胺能輸入。它透過直接和間接途徑的輸出調節丘腦皮質運動和聯想環路，使其成為 movement、習慣和 reward 的核心。 COMT 和 DAT 調節形成此電路的多巴胺，其中 DAT 控制紋狀體間隙。這種解剖位置是其在 brain 中廣泛功能意義的基礎。

label: TIMP2
description: TIMP2 binds the catalytic site of MMP-2 (gelatinase A) in a 1:1 complex to inhibit it, but at low concentrations it also acts as a facilitator rather than an inhibitor: TIMP2 bridges MT1-MMP and pro-MMP-2 on the cell surface into a ternary complex, letting adjacent uninhibited MT1-MMP cleave the pro-peptide and generate active 62 kDa MMP-2. This makes TIMP2 a concentration-dependent molecular switch.
description_zh_TW: TIMP2 以 1:1 複合體結合 MMP-2（gelatinase A）的催化位而抑制它；但在低濃度下它反而是促進因子：TIMP2 在細胞表面把 MT1-MMP 與 pro-MMP-2 架橋成三元複合體，使鄰近且未被抑制的 MT1-MMP 剪除前驅物胜肽，生成具活性的 62 kDa MMP-2。這使 TIMP2 成為濃度依賴的分子開關。

label: OSKM
description: The Yamanaka factors are also known as the OSKM cassette, named after the initials of its four constituent transcription factors: Oct4, Sox2, Klf4, and c-Myc. This quartet was identified by Shinya Yamanaka as sufficient to reprogram differentiated somatic cells into induced pluripotent stem cells, a discovery that earned the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine in 2012. The OSKM designation is used throughout the reprogramming and rejuvenation literature, including in partial reprogramming protocols that express the factors transiently to reverse aging.
description_zh_TW: Yamanaka 因子也稱為 OSKM 盒，以其四個組成轉錄因子的縮寫命名：Oct4、Sox2、Klf4 和 c-Myc。 Shinya Yamanaka 鑑定出這個四重體足以將分化的體細胞重編程為誘導多能幹細胞，這一發現贏得了 2012 年諾貝爾生理學或醫學獎。 OSKM 名稱在整個重編程和復興文獻中使用，包括在短暫表達因子以逆轉衰老的部分重編程方案中。

label: PQBP1
description: Activating cGAS via the tau-PQBP1 axis triggers cGAS-STING signalling, driving type I interferon and ISG programmes, microglial inflammatory states and neurodegeneration.
description_zh_TW: 透過 tau–PQBP1 軸活化 cGAS 會啟動 cGAS-STING 訊號，驅動第一型干擾素與 ISG 程式、小膠細胞發炎狀態與神經退化。

label: Dopaminergic Neurons
description: Dopaminergic Neurons are the primary source of Dopamine in the mammalian central nervous system, controlling metabolic processes, executive functions, and motor control. They are abundant in the Substantia Nigra (pars compacta) and are essential for motor control, reward-motivated behaviour, and executive function.
description_zh_TW: Dopaminergic Neurons 是哺乳類中樞神經系統內 Dopamine 的主要來源，控制代謝過程、執行功能與運動控制。它們在 Substantia Nigra（pars compacta）豐富分布，對運動控制、獎賞驅動行為與執行功能至關重要。

label: TAT
description: TAT (Transactivator of transcription) is encoded by the tat gene of HIV-1. In virology it is essential for replication, binding the TAR RNA element in nascent transcripts and recruiting host P-TEFb to boost transcription elongation; the 11-residue basic domain YGRKKRRQRRR is what makes it useful as a cell-penetrating peptide.
description_zh_TW: TAT（transactivator of transcription）由 HIV-1 的 tat 基因編碼。在病毒學上它對複製不可或缺，會結合新生轉錄本中的 TAR RNA 元素並招募宿主 P-TEFb 以促進轉錄延長；正是這 11 殘基的鹼性區 YGRKKRRQRRR 使它可作為穿透細胞的胜肽使用。

label: H3K4me3
description: Trained Immunity is marked by H3K4me3 at promoters together with H3K4me1/H3K27ac at enhancers and latent enhancers, plus the lncRNA UMLILO; G9a inhibition augments training, and miR-9-5p opposes it while miR-146a supports tolerance.
description_zh_TW: Trained Immunity 在啟動子帶有 H3K4me3，並在 enhancer 與 latent enhancer 帶有 H3K4me1/H3K27ac，同時涉及 lncRNA UMLILO；抑制 G9a 可增強 training，miR-9-5p 與之相抗而 miR-146a 則支持 tolerance。

label: Kidney
description: Urolithin A and its metabolites can be excreted from the body through the kidneys and intestines. Renal function can influence the rate of urolithin A elimination, since a portion of the compound and its conjugated forms is cleared in the urine, while additional urolithin A is further metabolized into other compounds within the intestines before being eliminated through feces. Renal function, intestinal permeability, and individual characteristics are therefore among the physiological factors that shape the bioavailability, metabolism, and distribution of urolithin A.
description_zh_TW: Urolithin A 及其代謝物可經由腎臟與腸道排出體外。腎功能會影響 urolithin A 的排除速率，因為部分化合物及其結合形式經尿液清除，而另有部分 urolithin A 在腸道內進一步代謝為其他化合物後再經糞便排出。因此，腎功能、腸道通透性與個體特徵，是形塑 urolithin A 生體可用率、代謝與分布的生理因素之一。

label: Ribosomal Protein S6
source_file: _document_ - Rapamycin for longevity the pros, the cons, and future perspectives.md
description: S6K1, itself activated by mTORC1, phosphorylates Ribosomal Protein S6 (rpS6) at multiple serine residues; because of this, phosphorylated S6 is widely used as the canonical surrogate readout of mTORC1 activity in resected tissues and preclinical models.
description_zh_TW: S6K1（本身由 mTORC1 活化）在多個絲胺酸殘基上磷酸化 Ribosomal Protein S6（rpS6）；因此磷酸化 S6 被廣泛用作切檢組織與前臨床模型中 mTORC1 活性的標準替代性讀值。

label: MALAT1
description: MALAT1 modulates Autophagy by sponging miR-101, which upregulates STUB1 expression, and by interacting with TFEB to influence lysosomal gene transcription and by regulating mTORC1 signaling under hypoxic stress. The same mechanism has been reported to upregulate SIRT1.
description_zh_TW: MALAT1 透過「海綿」miR-101 來調節 Autophagy，進而提升 STUB1 的表達；它也與 TFEB 互動以影響溶酶體基因轉錄，並在缺氧壓力下調節 mTORC1 訊號。同一機制亦被報導可上調 SIRT1。

label: Lactate
description: Warburg Effect produces Lactate. The Warburg effect is the preference of many cancer cells for aerobic glycolysis with lactate fermentation even in the presence of oxygen, supporting anabolic growth. Lactate is the end product of aerobic glycolysis whose export acidifies the tumor microenvironment and fosters invasion and immune suppression. The relationship is directional, with Warburg Effect acting as the operative agent upon Lactate rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Warburg Effect 產生 Lactate。許多癌細胞即使在有氧的情況下也偏好進行有氧糖解和乳酸發酵，以支持合成代謝生長。 Lactate 是有氧糖解的最終產物，其輸出酸化 Tumor Microenvironment 並促進入侵和免疫抑制。這種關係是有方向的，Warburg Effect 充當 Lactate 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Plasminogen
description: Tissue plasminogen activator (tPA) is a serine protease that cleaves plasminogen at Arg561-Val562 to generate plasmin, the active protease that degrades cross-linked fibrin. Plasmin in turn cleaves single-chain tPA to the more active two-chain form, creating a positive feedback loop that amplifies fibrinolysis at the clot surface.
description_zh_TW: Tissue plasminogen activator（tPA）是一種絲胺酸蛋白酶，於 Arg561-Val562 處切割 plasminogen 生成 plasmin；plasmin 進而切割單鏈 tPA 生成活性更高的雙鏈形式，形成在血塊表面放大 fibrinolysis 的正回饋迴路。

label: TDO
description: TDO also produces N-Formylkynurenine, but in a tissue-restricted way: hepatic tryptophan dioxygenase runs the same oxidative deamination. Having IDO1 and TDO generate the identical intermediate means tryptophan catabolism can be targeted at either entry point, and that N-Formylkynurenine is not a marker of one specific enzyme's activity.
description_zh_TW: TDO 也會產生 N-Formylkynurenine，但侷限於特定組織：肝臟的 tryptophan dioxygenase 執行相同的氧化脫胺反應。由於 IDO1 與 TDO 生成相同的中間產物，表示 tryptophan 分解可在任一入口被標定，也表示 N-Formylkynurenine 並非某一特定酵素活性的專一標記。

label: Actinobacteria
description: Bifidobacterium is a genus of Gram-positive, non-motile, often Y- or V-shaped branched anaerobic bacteria belonging to the phylum Actinobacteria; it is among the first colonizers of the infant gut and remains prevalent in the adult gut microbiome.
description_zh_TW: Bifidobacterium 是屬於 Actinobacteria 門的革蘭氏陽性、不具運動性、常呈 Y 形或 V 形分枝的厭氧菌屬；它是嬰兒腸道最早的定殖菌之一，並在成人 gut microbiome 中持續普遍存在。

label: Rejuvenation
description: Rejuvenation can be achieved by cellular reprogramming, which resets age-related epigenetic changes to restore a youthful state. Full reprogramming to pluripotency erases somatic epigenetic marks and restores youthful gene expression, and partial reprogramming achieves rejuvenation without full dedifferentiation. Because aging is associated with reversible epigenetic alterations, resetting DNA methylation and chromatin marks through reprogramming can restore cellular and organismal function. The field now aims to translate these resetting effects into therapies that slow human aging.
description_zh_TW: Rejuvenation可以透過細胞重編程來實現，細胞重編程會重置與年齡相關的表觀遺傳學變化，以恢復年輕狀態。完全重編程為多能性會消除體細胞表觀遺傳標記並恢復年輕的gene expression，而部分重編程則無需完全去分化即可實現返老還童。由於老化與可逆的表觀遺傳改變有關，因此透過重編程重置 DNA 甲基化和染色質標記可以恢復細胞和有機體功能。該領域現在的目標是將這些重置效應轉化為減緩人類老化的療法。

label: Sunitinib
description: Sunitinib is a multi-targeted receptor tyrosine-kinase inhibitor of VEGFR, PDGFR and c-KIT, approved for renal cell carcinoma, GIST and pancreatic neuroendocrine tumours. As a representative VEGFR-targeted antiangiogenic TKI it is cited alongside Pazopanib, blocking the VEGF signalling that tumour endothelium depends on for growth.
description_zh_TW: Sunitinib 是 VEGFR、PDGFR 與 c-KIT 的多標靶受體酪胺酸激酶抑制劑，已核准用於 renal cell carcinoma、GIST 與 pancreatic neuroendocrine tumour。作為具代表性的 VEGFR 標靶抗血管生成 TKI，它與 Pazopanib 並列被引用，藉阻斷腫瘤內皮生長所依賴的 VEGF 訊息而作用。

label: Aldose reductase
description: Aldose reductase catalyzes the first rate-limiting glucose to sorbitol step opening the pathway. Initiation gates all downstream flux.
description_zh_TW: Aldose reductase 催化首個速率限制的葡萄糖到山梨醇步驟，開啟路徑。啟動守衛所有下游通量。

label: Cytoskeleton
description: Ambra-1 links autophagy to the Cytoskeleton via interactions with dynein and myosin, and it is phosphorylated by ULK1 during starvation, which releases it from the dynein complex to enable Beclin1 activation.
description_zh_TW: Ambra-1 透過與 dynein、myosin 的交互作用把自噬與 Cytoskeleton 連結起來；在飢餓時它受 ULK1 磷酸化，因而從 dynein 複合體釋放，使 Beclin1得以活化。

label: E3 ligase
description: HUWE1 is a HECT-domain E3 ubiquitin ligase.
description_zh_TW: HUWE1 是 HECT 結構域 E3 泛素連接酶。

label: Sodium Metabisulfite
description: Sodium metabisulfite is a reducing agent commonly added to pharmaceutical epinephrine solutions as a sacrificial antioxidant. Because epinephrine slowly oxidizes in the presence of air, the sulfite compound donates electrons to any quinone intermediate that forms, converting it back to stable epinephrine and preventing the pink-red adrenochrome discoloration that indicates oxidation. This is why many injectable epinephrine formulations used in emergency devices such as autoinjectors contain sodium metabisulfite: it extends the shelf life of the catecholamine by intercepting the very first oxidation step of the adrenochrome pathway. The practice illustrates how chemical formulation, not just biology, exploits the catechol-quinone redox equilibrium to suppress adrenochrome formation and preserve drug potency.
description_zh_TW: Sodium metabisulfite 是一種還原劑，常被加入腎上腺素（epinephrine）藥劑中作為犧牲性抗氧化劑。因為腎上腺素在空氣中會緩慢氧化，sulfite 化合物會向形成的任何醌類中間體提供電子，將其轉回穩定的腎上腺素，並防止呈粉紅紅色的 adrenochrome 變色，這是氧化的指標。因此，許多用於自動注射器等緊急裝置的注射型腎上腺素製劑都含有 sodium metabisulfite：它透過攔截 adrenochrome 途徑的第一個氧化步驟，延長了兒茶酚胺的保存期限。此做法說明了化學配方（而不僅是生物學）如何利用兒茶酚-醌氧化還原平衡來抑制 adrenochrome 的形成並保持藥效。

label: UPRam
description: UPRam (unfolded protein response activated by mistargeting of proteins) is a stress pathway triggered when Mitochondria-directed precursor proteins are misdirected to other organelles or accumulate in the cytosol because import is impaired. The cell responds by upregulating chaperones and proteasomal components, with HSF1 and NRF1 coordinating the response and RPN4 a key downstream effector in yeast.
description_zh_TW: UPRam（unfolded protein response activated by mistargeting of proteins）是在粒線體前驅蛋白因輸入受損而被誤送至其他胞器、或於細胞質累積時觸發的壓力途徑。細胞藉由上調 chaperone 與 proteasome 元件因應，由 HSF1 與 NRF1 協調，RPN4 則是酵母中的關鍵下游效應器。

label: apitherapy
description: Apitherapy is a branch of complementary and alternative medicine that uses products derived from honeybees — honey, pollen, propolis, royal jelly and bee venom (apitoxin) — for therapeutic purposes. In oncology it is studied chiefly for the antitumor properties of venom and its major peptide melittin.
description_zh_TW: Apitherapy 是 Complementary and alternative medicine 的一支，使用源自 Honeybee 的產品——蜂蜜、花粉、蜂膠、蜂王漿與蜂毒（apitoxin）——作為治療用途。在腫瘤學上，其研究重點為蜂毒及其主要胜肽 melittin 的抗腫瘤性質。

label: Cerulein-Induced Pancreatitis
description: Acinar necrosis in cerulein-induced pancreatitis is driven in large part by necroptosis: supramaximal cerulein hyperstimulation activates RIPK3, whose phosphorylation of MLKL ruptures acinar membranes; RIPK3 or MLKL deletion attenuates severity.
description_zh_TW: cerulein 誘導胰臟炎的腺泡壞死主要由 necroptosis 驅動：超最大量 cerulein 過度刺激活化 RIPK3，其磷酸化 MLKL 使腺泡膜破裂；RIPK3 或 MLKL 缺失可減輕嚴重度。

label: ESCRT
description: ESCRT machinery (complexes 0-III) performs the membrane scission that lets Selective Autophagy capture damaged organelles. After a defective peroxisome is tagged with ubiquitin and sensed by PERO1, ESCRT is recruited and engages LC3 to initiate engulfment into an autophagosome.
description_zh_TW: ESCRT 機制（0-III 複合體）執行膜切割，使 Selective Autophagy 能夠包圍受損胞器。當缺陷的 peroxisome 被泛素標記並由 PERO1 辨識後，ESCRT 被招募並與 LC3 互動，啟動包裹進 autophagosome 的過程。

label: INF2
description: INF2 is an endoplasmic-reticulum-bound inverted formin that acts at ER-mitochondria contact sites, coupling cytoskeletal remodeling at membrane contact sites to organelle division and thereby underpinning mitochondrial integrity.
description_zh_TW: INF2 是結合於內質網的 inverted formin，在內質網—粒線體接觸位點作用，將膜接觸位點的細胞骨架重塑與胞器分裂耦合，進而支撐粒線體完整性。

label: H3K36me3
description: H3K36me3 occupies the perichromatin space of facultative heterochromatin structures such as senescence-associated heterochromatin foci (SAHF). It marks the transcriptionally active surfaces flanking senescent heterochromatin, distinct from the repressive interior.
description_zh_TW: H3K36me3 佔據衰老相關異染色質焦點（SAHF）等兼性異染色質結構的染色質外周空間。它標記衰老異染色質旁側的轉錄活性表面，與抑制性的內部相區別。

label: CCN1
description: CCN1 (CYR61) binds integrin α6β1 and heparan sulfate proteoglycans, and engagement triggers ROS accumulation that activates p53 and the p16/RB pathways, inducing senescence in activated myofibroblasts (Jun & Lau 2010). CCN1 thus acts as a feedback brake that limits fibrosis during wound healing.
description_zh_TW: CCN1（CYR61）結合 integrin α6β1 與硫酸乙醯肝素蛋白聚醣，其結合會引發 ROS 累積並活化 p53 與 p16/RB 路徑，誘導活化的肌成纖維細胞進入衰老（Jun & Lau 2010）。因此 CCN1 扮演回饋煞車，在傷口癒合期間限制纖維化。

label: HMG-CoA reductase
description: Statins are pharmacological inhibitors of HMG-CoA reductase; lowering cholesterol through this target is their primary therapeutic action in cardiovascular disease. The same inhibition is exploited experimentally to sensitize cells and tumors to ferroptosis in combination with GPX4 inhibition.
description_zh_TW: Statins 是 HMG-CoA reductase 的藥理抑制劑；經由此標的降低膽固醇是它在心血管疾病中的主要治療作用。同一種抑制作用也被實驗性地用來與 GPX4 抑制劑併用，使細胞與腫瘤對 ferroptosis 更加敏感。

label: Hydroxyfenbendazole
description: Hydroxyfenbendazole is a phase-I hydroxylated metabolite of fenbendazole generated by the cytochrome P450 enzyme CYP2J2 (with CYP2C19). After intravenous dosing in cattle more than 50% of the fenbendazole dose was recovered as hydroxyfenbendazole in excreta, making it the major excretory metabolite of the parent drug.
description_zh_TW: Hydroxyfenbendazole 是 fenbendazole 的 phase-I 羥基化代謝物，由細胞色素 P450 酵素 CYP2J2（與 CYP2C19）生成。在牛靜脈給藥後，超過 50% 的 fenbendazole 劑量以 hydroxyfenbendazole 形式由排泄物回收，使其成為母藥的主要排泄代謝物。

label: c-FLIP
description: p22-FLIP is the 22 kDa N-terminal fragment produced when caspase-8 cleaves c-FLIP (FLIP_L or FLIP_S) at Asp198 (Asp196 in some isoforms) in cytosolic, FADD-independent heterodimers. Retaining only DED1-DED2, it is generated off the DISC, unlike Asp376 processing, and its production is human-specific.
description_zh_TW: p22-FLIP 是在細胞質中、不依賴 FADD 的異源二聚體裡，caspase-8 切割 c-FLIP（FLIP_L 或 FLIP_S）於 Asp198（部分異構型為 Asp196）時產生的 22 kDa N 端片段。它僅保留 DED1–DED2，於 DISC 之外生成（不同於 Asp376 的加工），且其生成為人類專一。

label: RNA-seq
description: RNA-seq (RNA sequencing) is a high-throughput sequencing method that profiles the complete set of RNA transcripts in a biological sample and quantifies gene expression. The workflow runs RNA extraction, poly-A selection or ribosomal RNA depletion, reverse transcription to cDNA, adapter ligation and PCR library preparation, sequencing, then bioinformatics read alignment and quantification with tools such as DESeq2 for differential expression.
description_zh_TW: RNA-seq（RNA 定序）是一種高通量定序方法，可剖析生物樣本中完整的 RNA 轉錄本集合並量化基因表現。工作流程包含 RNA 萃取、poly-A 篩選或核糖體 RNA 去除、逆转錄成 cDNA、接头連接與 PCR 文庫製備、定序，最後以 DESeq2 等工具進行讀段比對與差異表現量化。

label: SIRT3-SIRT4 Ratio
description: The SIRT3/SIRT4 ratio determines the hormetic window: a high ratio (SIRT3-dominant) favors the adaptive branch, while a low ratio tilts toward the toxic branch of mitohormesis.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3/SIRT4 比例決定激素性窗口：比例高（SIRT3 主導）傾向適應分支，比例低則傾向粒線體激素性的毒性分支。

label: Drug Repositioning
description: Drug repositioning includes fenbendazole, an established benzimidazole anthelmintic now studied for its interference with microtubules, glycolysis, and p53 in tumors. The approach aims to convert a safe veterinary/human agent into a cancer therapeutic. The relationship is directional and reflects the logic of repurposing known drugs. Clinical validation for fenbendazole in oncology is still lacking.
description_zh_TW: Drug Repositioning 包括芬苯達唑，一種成熟的苯並咪唑驅蟲藥，目前正在研究其對腫瘤微管、糖酵解和 p53 的幹擾。該方法旨在將安全的獸醫/人類藥物轉化為癌症治療劑。這種關係是方向性的，反映了重新利用已知藥物的邏輯。芬苯達唑在腫瘤學的臨牀驗證仍缺乏。

label: JNK1
description: JNK1 phosphorylates Bcl-2 at Thr69/Ser70/Ser87, inactivating the guardian.
description_zh_TW: JNK1 在 Thr69/Ser70/Ser87 磷酸化 Bcl-2，使守護者失活。

label: SCF Complex
description: FBW7 confers substrate specificity on the SCF ubiquitin ligase.
description_zh_TW: FBW7 賦予 SCF 泛素連接酶受質特異性。

label: Malate
description: Malate dehydrogenase (MDH) catalyzes the reversible, NAD+-dependent interconversion of oxaloacetate and malate (oxaloacetate + NADH + H+ ⇌ malate + NAD+). Cytosolic MDH1 reduces oxaloacetate to malate using cytosolic NADH, feeding the malate-aspartate shuttle, while mitochondrial MDH2 oxidizes malate back to oxaloacetate, regenerating NADH in the matrix for OXPHOS.
description_zh_TW: Malate dehydrogenase（MDH）催化草醯乙酸與蘋果酸之間可逆的、依賴 NAD+ 的相互轉換（草醯乙酸 + NADH + H+ ⇌ 蘋果酸 + NAD+）。細胞質中的 MDH1 利用細胞質 NADH 將草醯乙酸還原為蘋果酸以餵入蘋果酸－天門冬胺酸穿梭，而粒線體中的 MDH2 則將蘋果酸氧化回草醯乙酸，在基質中為 OXPHOS 再生 NADH。

label: Indirect Calorimetry
description: Indirect calorimetry estimates energy expenditure from respiratory gas exchange — the rate of O2 consumption and CO2 production — converted to energy via the respiratory quotient. Under standardized post-absorptive, rest-supine, thermoneutral conditions it is the standard method for resting metabolic rate, with typical precision around 3%.
description_zh_TW: 間接量熱法藉由呼吸氣體交換（O2 消耗與 CO2 產生速率）並以呼吸商換算為能量，來估算能量消耗。在標準化的事後吸收狀態、靜臥與熱中性條件下，它是測量靜止代謝率的標準方法，典型精度約為 3%。

label: HDAC inhibitors
description: SAHA (suberoylanilide hydroxamic acid, INN vorinostat) is the prototypical hydroxamic-acid pan-HDAC inhibitor: its zinc-chelating hydroxamate group occupies the catalytic pocket of Zn2+-dependent HDACs, blocking class I and class II deacetylases. It became the first HDAC inhibitor approved by the FDA in 2006, for cutaneous T-cell lymphoma.
description_zh_TW: SAHA（suberoylanilide hydroxamic acid，INN 名 vorinostat）是羥肟酸類廣效 HDAC 抑制劑的原型：其螯鋅羥肟酸基團占據 Zn2+ 依賴型 HDAC 的催化口袋，阻斷第一類與第二類去乙醯化酶。2006 年 SAHA 成為首個獲 FDA 核准的 HDAC 抑制劑，用於皮膚型 T 細胞淋巴瘤。

label: cap-dependent translation
description: eIF4E is the rate-limiting, cap-binding component of cap-dependent translation: it recognizes the 5' cap of the mRNA and is therefore the initiation factor whose availability sets how much translation happens. Under mTORC1 inhibition eIF4E is sequestered and cap-dependent translation shuts down.
description_zh_TW: eIF4E 是依賴帽轉譯中具速率限制性、負責結合帽的成分：它辨識 mRNA 的 5' 帽，因此其可用性決定了有多少轉譯發生。在 mTORC1 受抑制時，eIF4E 被隔離而依賴帽的轉譯隨之關閉。

label: Translocase of the Outer Mitochondrial Membrane
source_file: Translocase of the Outer Mitochondrial Membrane.md
description: The TOM complex is the principal entry gate for nuclear-encoded mitochondrial proteins: it recognises mitochondrial targeting sequences and conducts precursors across the outer mitochondrial membrane into the intermembrane space, then hands them to the Translocase of the Inner Mitochondrial Membrane for further import into the matrix.
description_zh_TW: TOM 複合體是核編碼粒線體蛋白的主要入口：它辨識粒線體定位序列，將前驅蛋白質導引通過粒線體外膜進入膜間腔，再交由 Translocase of the Inner Mitochondrial Membrane 進一步輸入基質。

label: HRI
description: eIF2α is a key regulatory hub of the integrated stress response, phosphorylated at Ser51 by four stress-activated kinases. HRI (EIF2AK1) is the mitochondrial stress-responsive kinase, activated by DELE1 and heme deficiency, alongside PERK (ER stress), GCN2 (amino acid starvation), and PKR (double-stranded RNA).
description_zh_TW: eIF2α 是整合性壓力反應的關鍵調節樞紐，在 Ser51 上被四種壓力活化激酶磷酸化。HRI（EIF2AK1）是粒線體壓力反應的激酶，由 DELE1 與血基質缺乏活化，其他三者分別為 PERK（ER 壓力）、GCN2（胺基酸缺乏）與 PKR（雙股 RNA）。

label: NKG2A
description: NKG2A is an inhibitory C-type lectin-like receptor encoded by KLRC1 that pairs with CD94 on NK cells and a subset of CD8+ T cells to recognize HLA-E, the non-classical MHC class Ib molecule presenting leader peptides from classical HLA-A/B/C. Because HLA-E is stabilized by peptides from other HLA molecules, its surface level reports the overall HLA-I expression of a target cell, so missing-self cells escape NKG2A inhibition.
description_zh_TW: NKG2A 是由 KLRC1 編碼的抑制性 C 型凝集素類受體，與 CD94 形成異源二聚體表現在 NK 細胞與部分 CD8+ T 細胞上，負責辨識 HLA-E——即呈現源自典型 HLA-A/B/C leader peptide 的非典型 MHC class Ib 分子。由於 HLA-E 由其他 HLA 分子的 peptide 穩定，其表面量等同於回報標的細胞的整體 HLA-I 表現，因此「missing-self」的細胞便能逃過 NKG2A 的抑制。

label: Mitochondrial Targeting Sequence
description: Mitochondrial Processing Peptidase is the matrix-localized metalloprotease that removes N-terminal Mitochondrial Targeting Sequences from newly imported nuclear-encoded proteins shortly after they traverse the inner membrane, enabling proper folding and function.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial Processing Peptidase 是位於基質的金屬蛋白酶，在新輸入的核基因編碼蛋白穿過內膜後不久，即切除其 N 端 Mitochondrial Targeting Sequence，使其得以正確摺疊並發揮功能。

label: anti-inflammatory properties
description: Luteolin has anti-inflammatory properties, inhibiting NF-kappaB and AP-1 signaling and suppressing pro-inflammatory cytokines such as TNF-alpha, IL-6, and IL-1beta. These actions contribute to its studied benefits in neuroinflammation, allergic responses, and metabolic inflammation. Its anti-inflammatory profile is independent of COMT, making it usable alongside COMT-sensitive individuals, though high doses can still interact with the enzyme via its catechol structure. It is a prominent flavonoid in anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective research.
description_zh_TW: Luteolin 具有 anti-inflammatory properties，抑制 NF-κB 和 AP-1 訊號傳導並抑制促發炎細胞因子，如 TNF-α、IL-6 和 IL-1β。這些作用有助於研究其在神經發炎、過敏反應和代謝發炎方面的益處。其抗發炎特性獨立於 COMT，使其可與 COMT 敏感個體一起使用，儘管高劑量仍可透過其兒茶酚結構與此酵素相互作用。它是抗發炎和神經保護研究中重要的黃酮類化合物。

label: IkappaB
description: IκB proteins are a family of cytoplasmic inhibitors that sequester NF-κB dimers in the cytosol via their ankyrin-repeat binding of the nuclear localization signal, preventing nuclear import. IκBα is the primary member for canonical signalling; IκBζ is nuclear and regulates IL-6 transcription.
description_zh_TW: IκB 蛋白是一系列細胞質抑制蛋白，透過其 ankyrin repeat 結構結合 NF-κB 二聚體的核定位訊號，將其隔離在細胞質中，阻止核輸入。IκBα 是典型訊號傳遞的主要成員；IκBζ 位於細胞核內並調控 IL-6 的轉錄。

label: Somatic Cells
description: The Yamanaka factors (Oct4, Sox2, Klf4, and c-Myc, abbreviated OSKM) are a set of four transcription factors used to induce pluripotency in differentiated somatic cells. When introduced into fibroblasts or other somatic cells, they initiate a cascade of transcriptional and epigenetic changes that reset the cell toward an embryonic-stem-cell-like state, erasing somatic memory and installing the pluripotency network. This demonstration, pioneered by Shinya Yamanaka in 2006, established that cellular identity is not fixed but can be reprogrammed.
description_zh_TW: 山中因子（Oct4、Sox2、Klf4 和 c-Myc，縮寫為 OSKM）是一組四個轉錄因子，用於誘導分化體細胞的多能性。當引入成纖維細胞或其他體細胞時，它們會啟動一系列轉錄和表觀遺傳學變化，將細胞重置為胚胎幹細胞樣狀態，消除體細胞記憶並安裝多能性網路。此演示由 Shinya Yamanaka 於 2006 年首創，證實細胞身份不是固定的，而是可以重新編程的。

label: Apis mellifera
description: Apis mellifera, the Western or European honeybee, is a hymenopteran insect of major ecological and economic importance as a pollinator. Within this knowledge base it is included principally as the natural source of venom and its principal cytotoxic peptide melittin, both studied for anticancer activity, alongside honey, pollen, propolis and royal jelly as the basis of apitherapy.
description_zh_TW: Apis mellifera（西方蜜蜂／歐洲蜜蜂）是膜翅目昆蟲，作為授粉者具有極大的生態與經濟重要性。在本知識庫中，收錄它的主要原因是它是蜂毒及其主要細胞毒性胜肽 melittin 的天然來源，兩者都被研究用於抗癌活性，並與蜂蜜、花粉、蜂膠與蜂王漿共同構成 apitherapy（蜂療）的基礎。

label: HERV
source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence_orchestrating SASP expression.md
description: Human endogenous retroviruses activate the cGAS-STING pathway when their expression is derepressed during aging and senescence. Age-related loss of DNA methylation and heterochromatin permits HERV transcription, and the resulting HERV RNA is reverse transcribed into cDNA that is sensed by cGAS, triggering STING-dependent upregulation of type I interferons and SASP factors. HERV-driven innate immune signaling contributes to inflammaging and the paracrine spread of senescence. Suppressing HERV expression or reverse transcription therefore reduces this senescence-driving inflammatory signal.
description_zh_TW: 當人類內源性逆轉錄病毒的表達在老化和老化過程中被抑制時，它們會活化 cGAS-STING 路徑。與年齡相關的 DNA 甲基化和異染色質缺失允許 HERV 轉錄，並且所得的 HERV RNA 被逆轉錄為 cGAS 感知的 cDNA，觸發 I 型乾擾素和 SASP 因子的 STING 依賴性上調。 HERV 驅動的先天免疫訊號傳導有助於發炎和老化的旁分泌擴散。因此，抑制 HERV 表達或逆轉錄可以減少這種老化驅動的發炎訊號。

label: Endogenous Retrovirus
description: Endogenous retroviruses are retroviral sequences that infected the germline of ancestors and became permanently integrated into host genomes, propagating vertically as inherited elements. They resemble proviruses with gag, pol and env genes but are typically defective and cannot complete replication, comprising roughly 8% of the human genome as HERVs.
description_zh_TW: 內源性反轉錄病毒是感染祖先生殖系並永久整合進宿主基因體的反轉錄病毒序列，以垂直方式作為遺傳元件傳遞。它們類似帶有 gag、pol 與 env 基因的前病毒，但通常已缺陷化而無法完成複製，在人類基因體中以 HERV 形式約占 8%。

label: STAT6
description: IL-13 binds the IL-4Rα/IL-13Rα1 receptor complex, activating JAK1 and TYK2, which phosphorylate STAT6. Dimerized STAT6 translocates to the nucleus and drives transcription of mucus, tissue-remodeling and alternatively-activated macrophage genes. IL-13 shares both the IL-4Rα subunit and STAT6 signaling with IL-4.
description_zh_TW: IL-13 與 IL-4Rα/IL-13Rα1 受體複合體結合後活化 JAK1 與 TYK2，進而使 STAT6 磷酸化。二聚化的 STAT6 轉位至細胞核，驅動黏液、組織重塑以及 alternative 活化巨噬細胞相關基因的轉錄。IL-13 與 IL-4 共用 IL-4Rα 次單元與 STAT6 訊號傳遞。

label: Bilirubin
description: Human Serum Albumin is the most abundant plasma protein (35–50 g/L; 66.5 kDa, 585 residues) and the body's major transport protein for fatty acids, Bilirubin, hormones, metal ions and a wide range of drugs. It also maintains plasma colloid oncotic pressure and buffers pH, and its free Cys34 thiol scavenges Reactive Oxygen Species and nitrogen species extracellularly.
description_zh_TW: Human Serum Albumin 是血漿中最豐富的蛋白質（35–50 g/L；66.5 kDa、585 個殘基），也是脂肪酸、Bilirubin、荷爾蒙、金屬離子與廣泛藥物的全身主要運輸蛋白。它同時維持血漿膠體滲透壓並緩衝 pH，其游離的 Cys34 硫醇還能在細胞外清除 Reactive Oxygen Species 與含氮物種。

label: Piperine
description: Piperine raises the Bioavailability of co-administered compounds by inhibiting intestinal and hepatic CYP3A4 and other cytochrome P450 enzymes, the efflux transporter P-glycoprotein, and phase-II conjugation by UDP-glucuronosyltransferases. The classic demonstration is a roughly 20-fold increase in Curcumin bioavailability, with similar enhancement explored for Fisetin and other poorly absorbed polyphenols.
description_zh_TW: Piperine 藉由抑制腸道與肝臟的 CYP3A4 及其他 cytochrome P450 酵素、外排轉運蛋白 P-glycoprotein，以及 UDP-glucuronosyltransferase 的第二期結合反應，提高併用化合物的 Bioavailability。經典例子是使 Curcumin 的生體可用度提升約 20 倍；類似的增強效果也在 Fisetin 與其他吸收不良的 polyphenols 上被研究。

label: C11-BODIPY
description: C11-BODIPY is a fluorescent fatty acid analogue that inserts into membranes and shifts emission from red (~590 nm) to green (~510 nm) when oxidized by lipid peroxyl radicals; the green/red ratio gives a ratiometric readout of lipid peroxidation independent of probe loading and cell number.
description_zh_TW: C11-BODIPY 是一種螢光脂肪酸類似物，可嵌入細胞膜，並在被 lipid peroxyl radical 氧化時使發光由紅光（約 590 nm）移至綠光（約 510 nm）；綠／紅比值可提供不受探針載量與細胞數影響的 lipid peroxidation 比率型讀值。

label: Hepatic Stellate Cells
description: Roughly 50-80% of the body's vitamin A sits in hepatic stellate cells as retinyl esters, which is why loss of these cells in hepatic injury can precipitate deficiency. The liver monitors supply, converting retinol to retinyl esters via lecithin:retinol acyltransferase when supply is ample and mobilizing them when needed. Because retinoids do not circulate appreciably in free form - retinol travels bound to retinol-binding protein 4 with transthyretin - tissue delivery is tightly buffered rather than responsive to acute intake.
description_zh_TW: 體內約 50-80% 的 vitamin A 以 retinyl esters 形式儲存在 Hepatic Stellate Cells，這也是肝臟損傷造成這些細胞喪失時可能引發缺乏的原因。肝臟負責監測供應，供應充足時經 lecithin:retinol acyltransferase 將 retinol 轉為 retinyl esters，需要時再動員。由於類維生素 A 在游離型態下循環量極低——retinol 與 retinol-binding protein 4 及 transthyretin 結合運送——組織供應是受到嚴格緩衝，而非對急性攝取迅速反應。

label: DNA-PKcs
description: SIRT6 promotes DNA-PKcs mobilization/stability at DSBs, enhancing repair (McCord 2009 PMID 20157594).
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 促進 DNA-PKcs 在雙股斷裂處的動員/穩定性，增強修復（McCord 2009 PMID 20157594）。

label: Serum
description: Serum is the most widely used sample type in clinical laboratory medicine, chosen over plasma for chemistry panels because it is prepared simply by allowing blood to clot and centrifuging. Key analytes include Glucose (fasting, postprandial, HbA1c) for diagnosing Diabetes Mellitus, Creatinine and urea for renal function, and transaminases for hepatocellular injury.
description_zh_TW: Serum 是臨床實驗醫學中最常用的樣本類型，因為製備簡單——只需讓血液凝固後離心——故在化學檢驗套組中優於血漿。主要檢測包括用於診斷 Diabetes Mellitus 的 Glucose（空腹、餐後、HbA1c）、評估腎功能的 Creatinine 與尿素，以及評估肝細胞損傷的轉氨酶。

label: Oxaloacetate
description: Within the Citric Acid Cycle, Malate Dehydrogenase catalyses the reversible conversion of Oxaloacetate to Malate, interconverting NAD+ and NADH as it does so. This malate–oxaloacetate node also feeds the Malate-Aspartate Shuttle, coupling cytosolic and mitochondrial redox state.
description_zh_TW: 在 Citric Acid Cycle 內，Malate Dehydrogenase 催化 Oxaloacetate 與 Malate 之間的可逆轉換，並在此過程中轉換 NAD+ 與 NADH。這個 malate–oxaloacetate 節點同時供應 Malate-Aspartate Shuttle，將細胞質與粒線體的氧化還原狀態偶聯起來。

label: Alkylating agent
description: Cyclophosphamide is the prototypical alkylator producing phosphoramide-mustard crosslinks. Classification defines the drug class.
description_zh_TW: Cyclophosphamide 是產生磷醯胺芥交聯的原型烷化劑。歸類定義藥物類別。

label: ROCK1
description: Caspase-3 removes the inhibitory C-terminal fragment of ROCK1, activating it.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-3 移除 ROCK1 抑制性 C 端片段以活化之。

label: Optineurin
