description: Beyond cargo recognition, Optineurin acts as a negative regulator of inflammatory signalling: it negatively regulates NF-κB signaling by interacting with RIP1 and other pathway components. As a cytoplasmic selective autophagy receptor that also participates in Mitophagy alongside NBR1, NDP52 and p62, Optineurin therefore links aggregate and mitochondria clearance to control of inflammatory tone.
description_zh_TW: 除了辨識受質之外，Optineurin 還是發炎訊號的負向調節者：它藉由與 RIP1 及其他途徑成分交互作用，負向調節 NF-κB 訊號傳遞。Optineurin 作為細胞質選擇性自噬受體，與 NBR1、NDP52、p62 一同參與 Mitophagy，因此把聚合物與粒線體的清除連結到發炎張力的調控。

label: ERRalpha
description: ERRalpha transcriptionally activates mitochondrial biogenesis genes, coactivated by PGC-1alpha, and regulates NRF1, NRF2 (GABPA) and TFAM to drive mitochondrial DNA replication and transcription. Metabolic stress such as exercise, caloric restriction and cold exposure upregulates ERRalpha via PGC-1alpha.
description_zh_TW: ERRalpha 在 PGC-1α 共活化下轉錄活化粒線體生物發生相關基因，並調控 NRF1、NRF2（GABPA）與 TFAM，以驅動粒線體 DNA 的複製與轉錄。運動、熱量限制與寒冷暴露等代謝壓力可經由 PGC-1α 上調 ERRalpha。

label: Guanidinoacetate N-methyltransferase
description: GAMT is the terminal methyltransferase of creatine biosynthesis, irreversibly methylating guanidinoacetate to form creatine using S-adenosylmethionine as the methyl donor and producing SAH. It is expressed mainly in liver, kidney, and pancreas, so most guanidinoacetate made in the kidney travels to the liver for methylation.
description_zh_TW: GAMT 是 creatine 生合成的末端 methyltransferase，以 S-adenosylmethionine 為甲基供體、生成 SAH，不可逆地將 guanidinoacetate 甲基化為 creatine。它主要表現於肝臟、腎臟與胰臟，因此腎臟產生的大部分 guanidinoacetate 會運送至肝臟進行甲基化。

label: Urolithins
description: Urolithin A (UA) is a naturally occurring compound classified within the urolithins, a family of gut-microbiota-derived metabolites that form when dietary polyphenols are processed in the gastrointestinal tract. The review describes urolithins as compounds present in pomegranates and certain other fruits and nuts such as strawberries, walnut kernels, and peanuts, with ellagitannins serving as their precursors. As a member of this family, Urolithin A has attracted considerable research attention due to its pharmacological effects, encompassing anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, anti-tumor, and anti-aging properties, and it is a primary focus of research into muscle health and performance.
description_zh_TW: Urolithin A（UA）是一種天然存在的化合物，歸類於 urolithins（尿石素）家族，這是一類當膳食多酚在胃腸道中被處理時所形成的腸道菌叢衍生代謝物。該綜述將 urolithins 描述為存在於石榴與某些其他水果和堅果（如草莓、核桃仁與花生）中的化合物，以 ellagitannins（鞣花單寧）作為其前驅物。作為此家族的一員，Urolithin A 因其藥理作用（涵蓋抗發炎、抗氧化、抗腫瘤與抗衰老特性）而吸引了相當多的研究關注，且它是肌肉健康與表現研究的主要焦點。

label: Docosahexaenoic acid
description: Docosahexaenoic acid (DHA, 22:6(n-3)) is an omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acid with six cis double bonds, making it one of the most oxidatively labile lipids in biology. It is the major n-3 PUFA (against Arachidonic acid as the major n-6 PUFA) and is highly enriched in neuronal membranes, retinal photoreceptors, and spermatozoa.
description_zh_TW: Docosahexaenoic acid（DHA，22:6(n-3)）是具有六個 cis 雙鍵的 omega-3 polyunsaturated fatty acid，使其成為生物學上最易被氧化的脂質之一。它是主要的 n-3 PUFA（相對地，Arachidonic acid 為主要的 n-6 PUFA），並高度富集於神經元膜、視網膜光受器與精子中。

label: LIPL-2
description: HLH-30 induces LIPL-2 during fasting, while MXL-3 represses it under well-fed conditions. The reciprocal transcriptional switch is the mechanism by which C. elegans couples nutrient status to Lipophagy, matching the ~12-fold rise in lipl-2 mRNA after six hours of fasting.
description_zh_TW: HLH-30 在禁食期間誘導 LIPL-2，而 MXL-3 在營養充足條件下抑制它。這種互補的轉錄開關是 C. elegans 將營養狀態與 Lipophagy 耦合的機制，對應禁食六小時後 lipl-2 mRNA 約 12 倍的上升。

label: Epigenetic Aging
description: Down Syndrome is a natural model of segmental progeria: alongside early Senescence and immune dysregulation, epigenetic age acceleration is well documented, driven by the same Aβ burden that produces its Alzheimer pathology.
description_zh_TW: Down Syndrome（唐氏症）是節段性早老症（segmental progeria）的天然模型：除了提早出現 Senescence（細胞衰老）與免疫失調之外，其表觀遺傳年齡加速亦已有充分文獻支持，並由與其阿茲海默病理相同的 Aβ 負擔所驅動。

label: Synaptic Vesicles
description: Dopamine is located in Synaptic Vesicles, establishing the anatomical or subcellular compartment where the entity exerts its function. Mechanistically, this localization reflects biosynthesis, vesicular storage, or the selective vulnerability of that region's neurons. It is significant because the site of localization determines which circuits and symptoms are affected, particularly in Parkinson's disease. A caveat is that localization is often regionally predominant rather than exclusive, and other brain areas may contain smaller amounts of the same entity.
description_zh_TW: Dopamine 位於 Synaptic Vesicles 中，建立實體發揮其功能的解剖或亞細胞區室。從機制上講，這種定位反映了該區域神經元的生物合成、囊泡儲存或選擇性脆弱性。這很重要，因為本地化的位置決定了哪些電路和症狀受到影響，特別是在 Parkinson's disease 中。需要注意的是，定位通常是區域性的，而不是排他性的，而其他大腦區域可能包含少量的相同實體。

label: TGFβ Superfamily
description: Activin A is a homodimer of inhibin beta-A (INHBA) subunits and a member of the TGFbeta superfamily of cytokines. Like other family members, it signals through serine/threonine kinase receptors to regulate cell fate, proliferation, and inflammation. Its classification within the TGFbeta superfamily situates it among the SASP factors with paracrine arrest-inducing capacity, alongside TGF-beta1, BMP2, and GDF15. Activin A is a structurally defined ligand that is distinct from TGF-beta1 but shares functional overlap, particularly in inducing cell-cycle inhibitors in receiving cells during paracrine senescence.
description_zh_TW: Activin A 是 inhibin beta-A（INHBA）次單元的同源二聚體，且是 TGFbeta 細胞激素超家族的成員。如同其他家族成員，它經絲胺酸/蘇胺酸激酶受體訊號調節細胞命運、增殖與發炎。其歸類於 TGFbeta 超家族將它置於具旁分泌停滯誘發能力的 SASP 因子中，與 TGF-beta1、BMP2 與 GDF15 並列。Activin A 是結構上確立的配體，不同於 TGF-beta1 但具功能重疊，特別在旁分泌衰老中誘發受體細胞的細胞週期抑制因子。

label: LC-MS
description: LC-MS combines the physical separation of liquid chromatography with mass analysis to identify catecholamine metabolites and impurities such as leuco-adrenochrome with high sensitivity and specificity. Adrenochrome analytics rely on it both to verify the purity of commercial epinephrine against a reference standard and to quantify trace degradation products in biological or pharmaceutical samples.
description_zh_TW: LC-MS 結合液相層析的物理分離能力與質譜分析能力，可高專一性地鑑別兒茶酚胺代謝物與 leuco-adrenochrome 等雜質。Adrenochrome 的分析同時倚賴它，藉以比對商業 epinephrine 樣品與參考標準以確認純度，並定量生物或藥物樣品中的微量降解產物。

label: DAXX
description: As the H3.3-specific chaperone of the ATRX-DAXX complex, DAXX deposits the histone variant H3.3 at telomeres, pericentric heterochromatin and endogenous retroviruses. This targeted deposition is how the complex establishes and maintains heterochromatin at those repeat-rich loci.
description_zh_TW: 作為 ATRX-DAXX 複合體中專一於 H3.3 的 chaperone，DAXX 將 histone variant H3.3 沉積到 telomere、pericentric heterochromatin 與內源性反轉錄病毒上。這種標的性沉積正是該複合體在這些重複序列豐富的位點建立並維持異染色質的方式。

label: Red Palm Oil
description: Red Palm Oil is the richest common food matrix for lipophilic carotenoids, carrying roughly 600-750 ppm total (about 665 ppm average), of which ~41% is beta-carotene and ~41% alpha-carotene plus lycopene, phytoene and phytofluene. One tablespoon (~13 g) delivers ~8.7 mg total carotenoids, roughly 400-500 ug RAE of provitamin A. The oil's lipid vehicle solubilizes the carotenoids into mixed micelles, which is why carotenoid absorption from red palm oil far exceeds that from fat-free vegetables, and the serum-retinol response saturates at <=8 g/day.
description_zh_TW: Red Palm Oil 是脂溶性類胡蘿蔔素最豐富的常見食物基質，總含量約 600-750 ppm（平均約 665 ppm），其中約 41% 為 β-carotene、約 41% 為 α-carotene，並含有 lycopene、phytoene 與 phytofluene。一大匙（約 13 g）可提供約 8.7 mg 總類胡蘿蔔素，約合 400-500 ug RAE 的 provitamin A。油脂載體可將類胡蘿蔔素溶入混合微膠粒，因此其吸收率遠高於無脂蔬菜；而血清 retinol 反應在每日 ≤8 g 時即達飽和。

label: Necrosulfonamide
description: NSA also blocks Gasdermin D pore formation, so NSA rescue alone cannot separate necroptosis from pyroptosis. This off-target activity is the canonical example of the selectivity problem in the necroptosis drug field, and the reason NSA must be paired with Necrostatin-1/GSK872 versus caspase-1/NLRP3 inhibitors in a death-dissection panel.
description_zh_TW: NSA 也會阻斷 Gasdermin D 成孔，因此單靠 NSA 救援無法區分 necroptosis 與 pyroptosis。這項離靶活性是 necroptosis 藥物領域選擇性問題的典型例證，也是 NSA 必須在死亡機制鑑別組合中與 Necrostatin-1／GSK872 以及 caspase-1／NLRP3 抑制劑配對使用的原因。

label: HDAC
description: HDAC stands for histone deacetylase, a family of enzymes that remove acetyl groups from lysine residues on histone tails, counteracting the activity of histone acetyltransferases. By deacetylating histones, HDACs promote chromatin compaction and generally repress transcription, and they also regulate numerous non-histone proteins. They are divided into classes I, II, III (sirtuins), and IV, and HDAC inhibitors are widely studied as tools to reactivate silenced genes and as candidate therapeutic agents in cancer, inflammation, and aging.
description_zh_TW: HDAC 代表組蛋白去乙醯化酶，這是一個酶家族，可去除組蛋白尾部賴氨酸殘基上的乙醯基，從而抵消組蛋白乙醯轉移酶的活性。透過組蛋白去乙醯化，HDAC 促進染色質壓縮並通常抑制轉錄，並且它們還調節許多非組蛋白。它們分為 I、II、III（sirtuins）和 IV 類，HDAC 抑制劑作為重新激活沉默基因的工具以及作為癌症、發炎和老化的候選治療劑而被廣泛研究。

label: Monoacylglycerol Lipase
description: Monoacylglycerol Lipase hydrolyses monoacylglycerol to glycerol and free fatty acid, completing adipose triglyceride catabolism and therefore acting as the final-step lipase of Lipid Metabolism.
description_zh_TW: Monoacylglycerol Lipase 將 monoacylglycerol 水解為 glycerol 與游離脂肪酸，完成脂肪組織三酸甘油酯的分解，因此是 Lipid Metabolism 的最後一步脂肪酶。

label: IL-22
description: IL-22 signals through IL-22R on thymic epithelial cells to drive their proliferation and survival, raising thymic cellularity after total body irradiation (Dudakov et al., 2012). IL-22-deficient mice show impaired immune recovery, and loss of CD4/CD8 double-positive thymocytes triggers IL-23-driven ILC production of IL-22 that feeds back into thymic regeneration.
description_zh_TW: IL-22 透過胸腺上皮細胞上的 IL-22R 訊號促進其增殖與存活，在全身輻射後提高胸腺細胞數（Dudakov et al., 2012）。IL-22 缺乏小鼠的免疫恢復受損；CD4/CD8 雙陽性胸腺細胞的流失會觸發 IL-23 驅動的 ILC 產生 IL-22，再回頭促進胸腺再生。

label: Angiostatin
description: MMP-12 is the most potent matrix metalloproteinase for generating angiostatin from plasminogen, positioning it as a dual-function enzyme: pro-inflammatory via chemokine processing yet anti-angiogenic via angiostatin generation. MMP-3, MMP-7 and MMP-9 can also generate angiostatin, and TIMP1/TIMP3 restrain its production. The pro- versus anti-angiogenic balance of MMP-12 is context-dependent in cancer.
description_zh_TW: MMP-12 是由 plasminogen 生成 angiostatin 最具效力的基質金屬蛋白酶，使其成為雙功能酵素：經由趨化素加工具促發炎作用，經由 angiostatin 生成則具抗血管新生作用。MMP-3、MMP-7 與 MMP-9 亦能生成 angiostatin，而 TIMP1/TIMP3 會抑制其生成。MMP-12 促血管新生與抗血管新生的平衡在癌症中具情境依賴性。

label: Translation Initiation
description: Translation Initiation depends on eIF4A, the ATP-dependent DEAD-box RNA helicase that unwinds secondary structure in 5' UTRs so the ribosome can scan to the AUG start codon. eIF4A acts within the eIF4F complex together with eIF4E and eIF4G, and its activity on TFEB mRNA is a node at which autophagy gene expression can be controlled.
description_zh_TW: Translation Initiation 依賴 eIF4A，即 ATP 依賴型 DEAD-box RNA 解旋酶；它解开 5' UTR 的二級結構，使核糖體得以掃描至 AUG 起始密碼子。eIF4A 與 eIF4E、eIF4G 一起在 eIF4F 複合體中作用，其對 TFEB mRNA 的活性是調控自噬基因表現的關節點。

label: CCR2
description: CCL2 (MCP-1) signals chiefly through CCR2, a Gαi-coupled GPCR, with minor activity at CCR4. Engagement activates PI3K/Akt, p38 MAPK/ERK and Ca2+ flux to drive chemotaxis and adhesion of monocytes, making the CCL2–CCR2 axis the principal monocyte and macrophage recruitment route in the SASP.
description_zh_TW: CCL2（MCP-1）主要透過 CCR2（屬 Gαi 偶聯的 GPCR）傳遞訊號，並在 CCR4 有較弱的活性。其結合會活化 PI3K/Akt、p38 MAPK/ERK 與 Ca2+ 通量，驅動單核球趨化與黏附，使 CCL2–CCR2 軸成為 SASP 中招募單核球與巨噬細胞的主要途徑。

label: Omi-HtrA2
description: Omi/HtrA2 promotes Apoptosis. Omi/HtrA2 is a mitochondrial serine protease released at MOMP that both antagonizes IAPs and degrades substrates to promote death. Apoptosis is a genetically programmed, caspase-dependent form of cell death that dismantles cells without provoking inflammation. The relationship is directional, with Omi/HtrA2 acting as the operative agent upon Apoptosis rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Omi/HtrA2 促進 Apoptosis。 Omi/HtrA2 是一種在 MOMP 釋放的粒線體絲胺酸蛋白酶，它既可以拮抗 IAP，又可以降解底物以促進死亡。 Apoptosis 是一種基因編程的半胱天冬酶依賴性細胞死亡形式，可以分解細胞而不引發發炎。這種關係是有方向的，Omi/HtrA2 充當 Apoptosis 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Thymus
description: The thymus exhibits profound age-associated involution, a striking paradoxical feature of this critical lymphoid tissue. Thymic function begins to decrease from the first year of life; the lymphoid component of the thymic epithelial space involutes roughly 3% per year through middle age (35-45 years) and about 1% per year thereafter, while the perivascular space expands with adipocytes and peripheral lymphocytes. By age 70, the TES falls below 10% of total thymus tissue. Although thymic decline is of minimal consequence to healthy individuals, the reduced efficacy of the aging immune system has direct etiological links with opportunistic infections, autoimmunity, and cancer burden.
description_zh_TW: 胸腺表現出顯著的年齡相關退化，這是這一關鍵淋巴組織的一個突出矛盾特徵。胸腺功能從生命第一年開始下降；胸腺上皮空間的淋巴成分以每年約 3% 的速度退化至中年（35-45 歲），此後每年約 1%，而血管周圍空間隨脂肪細胞和外周淋巴細胞擴增。到 70 歲時，TES 降至總胸腺組織的 10% 以下。儘管胸腺衰退對健康個體影響極小，但老化免疫系統效力降低與機會性感染、自身免疫和癌症負擔有直接的病因學聯繫。

label: Non-coding RNA
description: XIST is a long non-coding RNA coating the inactive X chromosome.
description_zh_TW: XIST 是包被不活化 X 染色體的長非編碼 RNA。

label: Methemoglobin Reductase
description: In the treatment of methemoglobinemia, methylene blue is reduced by NADPH-dependent methemoglobin reductase to leucomethylene blue, which then reduces Fe3+ in methemoglobin back to the ferrous state Fe2+, restoring normal hemoglobin function. This nonenzymatic redox conversion is the primary mechanism by which methylene blue reverses methemoglobinemia. Because the pathway depends on NADPH, patients with glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase deficiency, who have impaired NADPH generation, are at markedly increased risk of hemolysis and the drug is contraindicated in this population.
description_zh_TW: 在治療methemoglobinemia時，methylene blue被NADPH依賴性methemoglobin還原酶還原為leucomethylene blue，後者然後將methemoglobin中的Fe3+還原回亞鐵狀態Fe2+，恢復正常的血紅蛋白功能。這種非酶促氧化還原轉化是methylene blue逆轉methemoglobin的主要機制。由於該途徑依賴於NADPH，NADPH生成受損的葡萄糖-6-磷酸脫氫酶缺乏症患者溶血風險顯著增加，該藥物在該人群中是禁忌的。

label: Flavones
description: Flavones are one of the subclasses of flavonoids, characterized by a 2-phenylchromen-4-one backbone without a 3-hydroxyl group and shared by the dietary flavones apigenin, luteolin and chrysin.
description_zh_TW: Flavones 是 flavonoids 的亞類之一，其特徵為具有 2-苯基色烯-4-酮骨架且不含 3-羥基，飲食中的 apigenin、luteolin 與 chrysin 均屬此類。

label: MAPKAPK2
description: p38 MAPK phosphorylates MK2 (MAPKAPK2) at Thr222 in humans, activating the kinase and relieving an intramolecular inhibitory interaction, making MK2 the principal effector through which p38 controls labile inflammatory mRNA stability.
description_zh_TW: p38 MAPK 在人類磷酸化 MK2（MAPKAPK2）的 Thr222 位點，活化該激酶並解除其分子內抑制性交互作用，使 MK2 成為 p38 調控不穩定發炎 mRNA 穩定性的主要執行者。

label: IRS1
description: IRS1 is a signaling adaptor in insulin signaling whose phosphorylation by S6K provides negative feedback that dampens PI3K-Akt signaling. In the incoherent bivalent motif network model, such negative-feedback nodes underlie hormetic dose responses of pathway inhibitors.
description_zh_TW: IRS1 是胰島素訊號中的訊號銜接蛋白，其被 S6K 磷酸化提供抑制 PI3K-Akt 訊號的負回饋。在不一致雙價模體（incoherent bivalent motif）網路模型中，此類負回饋節點是途徑抑制劑毒物興奮劑量反應的基礎。

label: Platelet-Derived Growth Factor
description: Platelet-Derived Growth Factor signalling through PDGF receptor tyrosine kinases activates vascular smooth muscle cells and is associated with decreased MFN2 levels and increased mitochondrial fragmentation. Inhibition of fission with Mdivi-1 counteracts PDGF-induced fragmentation and reduces VSMC proliferation, so PDGF shifts the mitochondrial network toward fission to support pathological vascular remodelling in Atherosclerosis.
description_zh_TW: Platelet-Derived Growth Factor 經由 PDGF 受體酪胺酸激酶作用，活化血管平滑肌細胞，並與 MFN2 濃度下降及粒線體碎裂增加相關。以 Mdivi-1 抑制分裂可抵銷 PDGF 引起的碎裂並降低 VSMC 增殖，顯示 PDGF 將粒線體網絡推向分裂，以支持 Atherosclerosis 中的病理性血管重塑。

label: Nanotechnology
description: Nanoparticles are the core engineered carrier class within pharmaceutical nanotechnology, alongside liposomes, nanoemulsions, nanocrystals, and cyclodextrin inclusion complexes used to overcome poor solubility and rapid metabolism of bioactive compounds such as Fisetin.
description_zh_TW: 奈米顆粒是藥物奈米科技中的核心工程載體類別，與微脂體、奈米乳化液、奈米晶體及環糊精包含複合體並列，用以克服 Fisetin 等活性成分的水溶性差與快速代謝問題。

label: MiTF TFE family
description: TFEB belongs to the MiT/TFE family of basic helix-loop-helix leucine zipper transcription factors, which also includes TFE3, MITF, and TFEC. Members of this family share conserved DNA-binding and dimerization domains and regulate overlapping sets of lysosomal and autophagic target genes. The family's defining feature is responsiveness to nutrient and stress signals that control nuclear-cytoplasmic shuttling. TFEB and TFE3 are the principal mediators of the coordinated lysosomal expression and regulation (CLEAR) network.
description_zh_TW: TFEB 屬於 MiT/TFE 家族的基礎螺旋-環-螺旋亮胺酸拉鍊轉錄因子，該家族也包括 TFE3、MITF 和 TFEC。此家族成員共享保守的 DNA 結合和二聚化結構域，並調節重疊的一組溶酶體和自噬標的基因的轉錄。該家族的定義特徵是對控制核質穿梭的營養和壓力信號的反應性。TFEB 和 TFE3 是協調溶酶體表達與調節（CLEAR）網絡的主要介導者。

label: Bmf
description: Bmf is a member of Bcl-2 family. Bmf is a cytoskeleton-sequestered BH3-only protein that enforces anoikis and restrains dissemination of detached cells. The Bcl-2 protein family comprises pro-apoptotic effectors (Bax, Bak) and BH3-only activators balanced against anti-apoptotic guardians (Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, Mcl-1, Bcl-w) that set the mitochondrial death threshold. The directionality runs from Bcl-2 family toward Bmf, so Bcl-2 family is the active agent and Bmf the recipient of the effect. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: Bmf 是Bcl-2 family 的成員。 Bmf 是一種細胞骨架隔離的 BH3 蛋白，可增強失巢凋亡並抑制脫落細胞的傳播。 Bcl-2 蛋白家族包括促凋亡效應子 (Bax、Bak) 和僅 BH3 活化劑，與設定粒線體死亡閾值的抗凋亡衛士 (Bcl-2、Bcl-xL、Mcl-1、Bcl-w) 保持平衡。方向性從 Bcl-2 family 向 Bmf，因此 Bcl-2 family 是活性劑，Bmf 是效果的接受者。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: Arachidonic acid
description: Prostaglandins are 20-carbon lipid autacoids derived from Arachidonic acid released from membrane phospholipids by cytosolic phospholipase A2, then oxidized in two steps by COX-1 or COX-2 to Prostaglandin G2 and the reduced endoperoxide Prostaglandin H2. PGH2 is the common precursor converted by terminal synthases into PGE2, PGD2, PGF2alpha, Prostacyclin and Thromboxane A2, giving the family its roles in pain, fever, vascular tone, gastric protection and platelet function.
description_zh_TW: Prostaglandins 是 20 碳脂質 autacoids，源自由 cytosolic phospholipase A2 從膜磷脂釋出的 Arachidonic acid，再由 COX-1 或 COX-2 兩步氧化成 Prostaglandin G2 與還原後的 endoperoxide Prostaglandin H2。PGH2 是共同前驅物，經末端合成酶轉為 PGE2、PGD2、PGF2alpha、Prostacyclin 與 Thromboxane A2，使這一族在疼痛、發燒、血管張力、胃黏膜保護與血小板功能中扮演角色。

label: SN011
description: SN011 is used to interrogate the relationship between cGAS–STING signaling and the SASP. Because blocking STING with SN011 neither blocks H3K27ac loss nor SASP suppression driven by SLC25A1, the two axes are mechanistically independent: the mitochondrial citrate–acetyl-CoA route to SASP does not require the mtDNA–cGAS–STING arm.
description_zh_TW: SN011 被用來釐清 cGAS–STING 訊息傳遞與 SASP 之間的關係。由於以 SN011 阻斷 STING 既無法阻止 H3K27ac 的下降，也無法阻止 SLC25A1 所驅動的 SASP 抑制，兩條軸在機制上是彼此獨立的：粒線體的 citrate–acetyl-CoA 途徑並不需要 mtDNA–cGAS–STING 這一支。

label: FYN
description: FYN is a Src-family tyrosine kinase alongside SRC and LYN.
description_zh_TW: FYN 是與 SRC 和 LYN 並列的 Src 家族酪胺酸激酶。

label: Streptomyces avermectinius
description: Avermectins are 16-membered macrocyclic lactones biosynthesized by the soil actinomycete Streptomyces avermectinius (formerly S. avermitilis).
description_zh_TW: 是由土壤放線菌（以前稱為除蟲鏈黴菌）生物合成的 16 元大環內酯。

label: Retrotransposon
description: Endogenous retroviruses are retroviral sequences that infected the germline of ancestors and became permanently integrated into host genomes, propagating vertically as inherited elements. They resemble proviruses with gag, pol and env genes but are typically defective and cannot complete replication, comprising roughly 8% of the human genome as HERVs.
description_zh_TW: 內源性反轉錄病毒是感染祖先生殖系並永久整合進宿主基因體的反轉錄病毒序列，以垂直方式作為遺傳元件傳遞。它們類似帶有 gag、pol 與 env 基因的前病毒，但通常已缺陷化而無法完成複製，在人類基因體中以 HERV 形式約占 8%。

label: C57BL-6
description: C57BL/6 ("B6") is the dominant inbred background for engineered mouse lines: because background strongly influences phenotype, most engineered alleles are backcrossed onto this strain to control confounders, and its >20 generations of brother-sister mating give high reproducibility.
description_zh_TW: C57BL/6（「B6」）是基因改造小鼠品系最主要的近交背景：由於背景品系會強烈影響表型，多數改造等位基因都會回交到本品系以控制混雜因子；其超過 20 代的兄弟姊妹交配也帶來高度可重複性。

label: LPCAT3
description: LPCAT3 is an ER and nuclear-envelope MBOAT-family enzyme that remodels phospholipids by acylating lysophospholipid acceptors with polyunsaturated fatty acids, especially arachidonate and adrenate, at the sn-2 position. It thereby builds the oxidizable PUFA-containing phosphatidylethanolamine (PE) pool that lipoxygenases and Fenton-reaction radicals peroxidize. Knockdown of LPCAT3 or ACSL4 reduces PUFA-PE and protects cells from ferroptosis; overexpression sensitizes them.
description_zh_TW: LPCAT3 是位於內質網與核膜的 MBOAT 家族酵素，透過在 sn-2 位置以多不飽和脂肪酸（尤其是花生四烯酸與腎上腺酸）醯化溶血磷脂受質來重塑磷脂。它藉此建立起可被脂氧合酶與 Fenton reaction 自由基過氧化的、含 PUFA 的磷脂醯乙醇胺（PE）池。LPCAT3 或 ACSL4 的敲除會減少 PUFA-PE 並保護細胞免於 ferroptosis；其過表現則使細胞更敏感。

label: cit-H3
description: PAD4 (peptidylarginine deiminase 4) deiminates arginine residues on histone H3, generating citrullinated histone H3 (cit-H3, H3Cit). Loss of the positive charge unravels chromatin structure, which is required for the chromatin decondensation and extrusion underlying NET formation.
description_zh_TW: PAD4（肽基精氨酸脫亞胺酶 4）將組蛋白 H3 上的精胺酸殘基去亞胺化，生成瓜胺酸化的組蛋白 H3（cit-H3，H3Cit）。正電荷的流失使染色質鬆解，而這正是 NET 形成過程中染色質去凝縮與外排所需的條件。

label: Adiponectin
description: Adipocytes within Adipose Tissue secrete Adiponectin, an insulin-sensitizing hormone that enhances insulin sensitivity and fatty-acid oxidation. Its production falls in obesity and insulin resistance, linking adipose secretory failure to metabolic disease.
description_zh_TW: Adipose Tissue 內的脂肪細胞分泌 Adiponectin，一種增進胰島素敏感性与脂肪酸氧化的促胰島素作用激素。其分泌量在肥胖與胰島素阻抗時下降，將脂肪分泌功能失調與代謝疾病連結起來。

label: Chromosome
description: Cell Division checkpoints verify DNA Replication and Chromosome alignment before anaphase, with control through Cyclin/CDK, Rb/E2F and p53. When this surveillance fails, mis-segregation produces aneuploidy such as Trisomy 21 (Down Syndrome) via meiotic nondisjunction.
description_zh_TW: Cell Division 的檢查點在後期之前驗證 DNA Replication 與 Chromosome 對位，並透過 Cyclin/CDK、Rb/E2F 與 p53 加以控制。當此監控失效時，分離錯誤會透過減數分裂不分離產生非整倍體，例如 Trisomy 21（Down Syndrome）。

label: Kinase Inhibitor
description: Kinases constitute the largest enzyme superfamily in eukaryotes, catalysing transfer of the gamma-phosphate of ATP to protein, lipid or sugar substrates and thereby regulating proliferation, differentiation, metabolism, apoptosis and the cell cycle. Because deregulated kinase activity (mutation, amplification, translocation) drives many cancers, kinase inhibitors are among the most successful targeted cancer therapeutics and remain a major drug class.
description_zh_TW: 激酶是真核生物中最大的酵素超家族，催化 ATP 的 γ-磷酸基轉移至蛋白質、脂質或糖受質上，藉此調控增殖、分化、代謝、凋亡與細胞週期。由於激酶活性失調（突變、擴增、轉位）會驅動多種癌症，激酶抑制劑已成為最成功的標靶癌症治療手段之一，仍是主要藥物類別。

label: NBR1
description: NBR1 mediates Mitophagy as a cytoplasmic selective autophagy receptor. Its ubiquitin-binding domains recognize ubiquitinated damaged mitochondria, and its LIR Motif binds LC3 on the autophagosomal membrane, tethering cargo for delivery into the autophagosome.
description_zh_TW: NBR1 作為細胞質內的選擇性自噬受體，媒介 Mitophagy。它的泛素結合區辨識被泛素化的受損粒線體，並透過 LIR Motif 與 autophagosome 膜上的 LC3 結合，將貨物質拴住並送入 autophagosome。

label: Glyoxal
description: Glyoxal is a highly reactive dicarbonyl intermediate generated during cellular metabolism, Glycolysis and Lipid Peroxidation. It is a potent inducer of dicarbonyl stress, reacting non-enzymatically with cellular macromolecules to form Advanced Glycation End Products. It is detoxified by enzymatic defense networks including the Glyoxalase System and PARK7 (DJ-1), which catalyzes its glutathione-independent conversion to Glycolic acid and thereby protects cellular proteins from covalent modification.
description_zh_TW: Glyoxal 是在細胞代謝、Glycolysis 與 Lipid Peroxidation 過程中產生的高反應性 dicarbonyl 中間體。它是 dicarbonyl stress 的強效誘發因子，會與細胞大分子進行非酵素性反應形成 Advanced Glycation End Products。它可被包括 Glyoxalase System 與 PARK7（DJ-1）在內的酵素防禦網絡解毒；PARK7 催化其不依賴 glutathione 的轉化為 Glycolic acid，藉此保護細胞蛋白免於共價修飾。

label: Retinal Photoreceptors
source_file: _document_ - Nicotinamide Riboside—The Current State of Research and Therapeutic Uses.md
description: SIRT3 and SIRT5 are both critical for the health of retinal photoreceptors, and SIRT3 activity is sensitive to the reduction of NAD+ content detected in multiple disorders with retinal degeneration, including age-associated dysfunction, diabetic retinopathy, and light-induced degeneration in mice. SIRT3 is a mitochondrial NAD+-dependent deacetylase that supports ATP homeostasis, ROS detoxification, and neuroprotection, and increasing mitochondrial NAD+ to support SIRT3 is one proposed mechanism of nicotinamide riboside's neuroprotective effects. This suggests a potential therapeutic treatment with NR for a variety of disorders that include photoreceptor degeneration.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 與 SIRT5 對視網膜感光細胞的健康均至關重要，且 SIRT3 活性對多種伴隨視網膜退化的疾病中所偵測到的 NAD+ 含量降低相當敏感，包括年齡相關功能障礙、diabetic retinopathy（糖尿病視網膜病變）與小鼠中的光誘發退化。SIRT3 是一種粒線體 NAD+ 依賴性去乙醯酶，支持 ATP 恆定、ROS（活性氧）解毒與神經保護，而提升粒線體 NAD+ 以支持 SIRT3 是 nicotinamide riboside 神經保護效應的其中一種被提出的機制。這暗示了以 NR 治療包含感光細胞退化在內的各種疾病的潛在療法。

label: Atg101
description: Atg101 binds the Atg13 N-terminus and protects it against proteasomal turnover. Regulation is the stabilization mechanism.
description_zh_TW: Atg101 結合 Atg13 N 端並保護其免於蛋白酶體更新。調節是穩定機制。

label: Fascia
description: Fascia is the body's continuous sheet-like connective-tissue continuum — a three-dimensional web of collagen, elastin and hydrated ground substance — that wraps, separates and connects muscles, bones, vessels, nerves and organs. Classified by the Fascia Nomenclature Committee into subcutaneous, deep, visceral and parietal layers, it forms a single tensegrity network rather than isolated sheets.
description_zh_TW: Fascia 是人體連續片狀的 connective tissue 連續體——由 collagen、elastin 與含水基質構成的三維網絡——包裹、分隔並連接肌肉、骨骼、血管、神經與器官。依 Fascia Nomenclature Committee 分為淺層、深層、臟器層與壁層，它構成的是單一的張力整體網絡而非彼此孤立的膜片。

label: Melanogenesis
description: All forms of Oculocutaneous Albinism result from defects in melanosome biogenesis, tyrosinase function, or downstream melanin synthesis enzymes, disrupting Melanogenesis. This leads to variable degrees of hypopigmentation of the skin, hair, and eyes. OCA is a group of autosomal recessive disorders affecting melanin biosynthesis.
description_zh_TW: 所有形式的 Oculocutaneous Albinism 都由 melanosome 生物發生、tyrosinase 功能或下游黑色素合成酶的缺陷引起，從而破壞 Melanogenesis。這導致皮膚、頭髮和眼睛不同程度的色素減退。OCA 是一組影響黑色素生物合成的體染色體隱性遺傳疾病。

label: FNDC5
description: FNDC5 transcription is transcriptionally driven by PGC-1α, with co-activation through ERRalpha and PPARγ. Exercise, cold exposure, AMPK activation and p38 MAPK signalling all raise FNDC5 expression through this axis, so the PGC-1α–FNDC5–irisin cascade links mechanical and metabolic stress to secretion of the myokine irisin.
description_zh_TW: FNDC5 的轉錄由 PGC-1α 驅動，並透過 ERRalpha 與 PPARγ 的共活化增強。運動、寒冷暴露、AMPK 活化與 p38 MAPK 訊號都經由此軸提升 FNDC5 表現，因此 PGC-1α–FNDC5–irisin 級聯將機械與代謝壓力連結至 myokine irisin 的分泌。

label: MAML1
description: As the obligatory co-activator of the Notch-CSL complex, MAML1 is the effector through which Notch signalling establishes paracrine senescence in neighbouring cells.
description_zh_TW: 作為 Notch–CSL 複合體不可或缺的共同活化因子，MAML1 是 Notch 訊號在鄰近細胞中建立旁分泌性衰老（paracrine senescence）的執行者。

label: Honeybee venom
description: Honeybee venom is a complex mixture whose major peptide component is melittin (~50% of dry weight), the principal anticancer effector.
description_zh_TW: Honeybee venom 是複雜混合物，其主要胜肽成分為 melittin（約佔乾重 50%），是主要的抗癌效應物。

label: Lamins
description: Caspase-3 cleaves Lamins. Caspase-3 is the principal executioner caspase that cleaves hundreds of substrates to produce the apoptotic phenotype. Lamins are the intermediate-filament proteins of the nuclear lamina whose cleavage by caspases drives nuclear collapse during apoptosis. The relationship is directional, with Caspase-3 acting as the operative agent upon Lamins rather than the reverse. The directness of this molecular event makes it a precise, often druggable point of control whose perturbation can decisively shift cell fate in cancer.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-3 劈開 Lamins。 Caspase-3 是主要的劊子手半胱天冬酶，可切割數百個底物以產生凋亡表型。 Lamins 是核纖層的中間絲蛋白，在細胞凋亡過程中被半胱天冬酶裂解驅動核塌陷。這種關係是有方向的，Caspase-3 充當 Lamins 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種分子事件的直接性使其成為精確的、通常可藥物控制的控制點，其擾動可以決定性地改變癌症中的細胞命運。

label: BIRC2
description: Smac mimetics bind the BIR2/BIR3 domains of cIAP1, dimerize RING domains and flip ligase activity onto cIAP1 itself, collapsing its half-life from hours to minutes; cIAP1 degradation is the proximal pharmacodynamic readout in every Smac-mimetic trial and licenses Ripoptosome assembly.
description_zh_TW: Smac mimetics 結合 cIAP1 的 BIR2/BIR3 結構域、使 RING 結構域二聚化，並將連接酶活性轉 onto cIAP1 自身，使其半衰期由數小時縮短至數分鐘；cIAP1 降解是所有 Smac-mimetic 試驗最接近的藥效學讀值，並使 Ripoptosome 得以組裝。

label: ARH1
description: ARH1 (ADPRH) is the founding ARH-family eraser of ADP-ribosylation: a ~39 kDa, binuclear Mg2+-dependent hydrolase that cleaves alpha-anomeric ADP-ribose-arginine bonds written by cholera-toxin-like ARTs such as mammalian ARTC1. It is the Arg-specific counterpart to ARH3 (Ser) and MacroD1/MacroD2/TARG1 (Asp/Glu), shows less than 1% of ARH3 PAR activity, and restoring Arg residues for a new MARylation cycle explains why Arh1-knockout mice are hypersensitive to cholera toxin.
description_zh_TW: ARH1（ADPRH）是 ADP-ribosylation 的 ARH 家族首個「擦除者」：一個約 39 kDa、具雙核 Mg2+ 依賴性的水解酶，可切斷由霍亂毒素樣 ART（例如哺乳類 ARTC1）寫入的 alpha-異構 ADP-ribose-精胺酸鍵。它是 ARH3（Ser）與 MacroD1/MacroD2/TARG1（Asp/Glu）的精胺酸專一對應物，對 PAR 的活性不到 ARH3 的 1%；它將精胺酸殘基還原以進入新的 MARylation 循環，也解釋了 Arh1 敲除小鼠對霍亂毒素的高度敏感。

label: ERGIC
description: The ER-Golgi intermediate compartment (ERGIC) is a tubulovesicular membrane system situated between the endoplasmic reticulum and the Golgi apparatus, serving as a sorting and trafficking hub for newly synthesized secretory and membrane proteins. Because it originates from the ER, it also sits at the interface of ER stress and autophagic clearance.
description_zh_TW: 內質網—高基氏體中間區室（ERGIC）是位於內質網與高基氏體之間的管囊狀膜系統，作為新生分泌蛋白與膜蛋白的分選與運輸樞紐；由於源自內質網，它也位於 ER 壓力與自噬清除的交界面上。

label: HMGCS2
description: SIRT5 desuccinylates and activates HMGCS2 (3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl-CoA synthase 2), the rate-limiting enzyme of ketone-body synthesis, supporting energy production during fasting. Directionally, SIRT5 enzymatically activates HMGCS2. This promotes ketogenesis when carbohydrate is scarce, and it is a fasting-adaptive function of SIRT5. By enabling ketone-body production from acetyl-CoA, SIRT5 supports the brain and other tissues during prolonged fasting. This regulation complements SIRT5's activation of urea-cycle and fatty-acid-oxidation enzymes, positioning SIRT5 as a coordinator of catabolic metabolism.
description_zh_TW: SIRT5 去琥珀醯化並活化 HMGCS2（3-羥基-3-甲基戊二醯-CoA 合酶 2）——酮體合成的限速酶——在禁食期間支持能量產生。在方向性上，SIRT5 以酶性方式活化 HMGCS2。這在碳水化合物稀缺時促進酮體生成，是 SIRT5 的禁食適應性功能。透過使酮體能從乙醯-CoA 產生，SIRT5 在長期禁食期間支持大腦和其他組織。此調控與 SIRT5 對尿素循環和脂肪酸氧化酶的活化互補，將 SIRT5 定位為分解代謝的協調者。

label: Anaplerosis
description: Anaplerosis comprises the biochemical reactions that refill TCA cycle intermediates withdrawn for biosynthesis. In rapidly proliferating cells, intermediates are diverted into amino acid, fatty acid, sterol and nucleotide synthesis, so anaplerotic input becomes essential for continued cycle flux. Glutamine is the dominant anaplerotic substrate in cancer cells, converted to glutamate by glutaminase and then to α-ketoglutarate, which re-enters the cycle.
description_zh_TW: Anaplerosis 指的是補回因生物合成而被抽用的 TCA cycle 中間產物的生化反應。在快速增殖細胞中，中間產物被分流至胺基酸、脂肪酸、固醇與核苷酸合成，因此補充性輸入對維持循環流量至關重要。在癌細胞中，glutamine 是主要的補充性受質，經 glutaminase 轉為 glutamate，再轉為 α-Ketoglutarate 重新進入循環。

label: Proto-lysosomal Tubules
description: Proto-lysosomal tubules are dynamic membrane extensions arising from endolysosomes during lysosome reformation. They represent an intermediate stage in recycling lysosomal membrane and content, ultimately giving rise to new proto-lysosomes that mature into functional lysosomes.
description_zh_TW: 原溶酶體小管（proto-lysosomal tubules）是溶酶體再形成期間由內吞溶酶體產生的動態膜延伸。它們是回收溶酶體膜與內容物的中間階段，最終產生成熟為功能性溶酶體的新原溶酶體。

label: CLEAR Network
description: The CLEAR network drives a coordinated lysosomal-autophagic transcriptional program that expands lysosomal capacity and autophagic throughput during stress. By upregulating lysosomal hydrolases and biogenesis genes it supports proteostasis and clearance of damaged organelles.
description_zh_TW: CLEAR 網路驅動協調的溶酶體-自噬轉錄程式，在壓力期間擴增溶酶體容量與自噬通量。透過上調溶酶體水解酶與生合成基因，它支持蛋白質恆定與受損胞器的清除。

label: IGF-Akt Signaling
description: SIRT6 blocks IGF-Akt signaling and thereby cardiac hypertrophy development by targeting c-Jun, interrupting a pro-hypertrophic survival pathway. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of IGF-Akt repression. This protects the heart from maladaptive growth, and SIRT6 knockout mice develop cardiac hypertrophy that is abrogated when IGF signaling is inhibited in vivo. It complements SIRT6's anti-fibrotic actions in cardiovascular tissue and illustrates the importance of restraining growth-factor signaling in the heart. SIRT6's co-repression of c-Jun-dependent transcription at the chromatin level links epigenetic control to cardiac remodeling.
description_zh_TW: SIRT6 通過靶向 c-Jun 阻斷 IGF-Akt 信號從而阻止心臟肥大的發展，中斷一個促肥大的存活通路。在方向性上，SIRT6 位於 IGF-Akt 抑制的上游。這保護心臟免受適應不良生長，SIRT6 敲除小鼠發展心臟肥大，在體內抑制 IGF 信號時被消除。它與 SIRT6 在心血管組織中的抗纖維化作用互補，說明了限制心臟中生長因子信號的重要性。SIRT6 在染色質水平對 c-Jun 依賴性轉錄的共抑制將表觀遺傳控制與心臟重塑聯繫起來。

label: CD36 Receptor
description: CD36 receptor mediates uptake of oxidized LDL as the principal scavenger receptor on macrophages, delivering oxLDL-derived lipid to form foam cells. This non-downregulated pathway drives cholesterol accumulation in the artery wall. The directionality is receptor to pathological lipid internalization. A caveat is that CD36 also handles fatty acids and other ligands, and other scavenger receptors (SR-A, LOX-1) contribute to oxLDL uptake. CD36 also recognizes oxidized phospholipids on oxLDL and, in combination with TLR signaling, links lipid uptake to sterile inflammation.
description_zh_TW: CD36 receptor 介導 oxidized LDL 作為巨噬細胞上主要清道夫受體的攝取，遞送 oxLDL 衍生的脂質以形成泡沫細胞。這種非下調途徑驅動 cholesterol 在動脈壁積聚。方向性是病理性脂質內化的受體。需要注意的是，CD36 也處理脂肪酸和其他配體，而其他清道夫受體（SR-A、LOX-1）有助於 oxLDL 的攝取。 CD36 也能辨識 oxLDL 上的 oxidized phospholipids，並與 TLR 訊號傳導結合，將脂質攝取與無菌發炎聯繫起來。

label: Gap Junction
description: Gap junctions are clusters of connexin-formed intercellular channels that pass ions and small molecules below roughly 1 kDa. This size limit accommodates cGAMP, so cGAMP made by cGAS in one cell can diffuse directly into a neighboring cell through channels such as CX36 and engage STING there without that cell having sensed DNA itself.
description_zh_TW: 間隙連接是由連接蛋白（connexin）構成的細胞間通道群，允許離子與分子量約 1 kDa 以下的小分子通過。此大小上限足以容納 cGAMP，因此某一細胞中由 cGAS 製造的 cGAMP 可經由 CX36 等通道直接擴散至鄰近細胞並在該處活化 STING，而無須該細胞自身感知到 DNA。

label: Bmi-1
description: Bmi-1 is essential for the self-renewal and maintenance of Cancer Stem Cells, a stemness function that helps explain its oncogenic role: as a core Polycomb Repressive Complex 1 component it silences genes, and its overexpression in breast cancer, lung cancer and leukemia is well documented. Targeting Bmi-1 is therefore a route to deplete the stem-cell compartment.
description_zh_TW: Bmi-1 對 Cancer Stem Cells（癌幹細胞）的自我更新與維持至關重要，此幹性功能有助解釋其致癌角色：作為 Polycomb Repressive Complex 1 的核心成分，它負責沉默基因，而它在乳癌、肺癌與白血病中的過度表現已有充分記錄。因此標定 Bmi-1 是清除幹細胞群的一条途徑。

label: Embryonic Development
description: Gastrulation is the central germ-layer event included in embryonic development. Inclusion nests the phase in the program.
description_zh_TW: 原腸形成是包含於胚胎發育的中央胚層事件。包含將階段嵌套於程序。

label: PIKfyve
description: PIKfyve is a phosphoinositide kinase that converts phosphatidylinositol 3-phosphate (PI3P) into phosphatidylinositol 3,5-bisphosphate (PI(3,5)P2) on endolysosomal membranes. PI(3,5)P2 serves as a crucial lipid messenger that regulates membrane trafficking, vacuole homeostasis, and the activity of the lysosomal channel TRPML1. By generating PI(3,5)P2, PIKfyve controls lysosomal morphology and the calcium release that activates calcineurin-TFEB signaling. Its inhibition causes massive lysosomal vacuolation, underscoring its centrality to lysosomal function.
description_zh_TW: PIKfyve 是一種磷酸肌醇激酶，在內溶酶體膜上將磷脂醯肌醇 3-磷酸（PI3P）轉化為磷脂醯肌醇 3,5-二磷酸（PI(3,5)P2）。PI(3,5)P2 作為一種關鍵的脂質信使，調節膜運輸、液泡恆定性，以及溶酶體通道 TRPML1 的活性。透過生成 PI(3,5)P2，PIKfyve 控制溶酶體形態以及活化 calcineurin-TFEB 信號的鈣釋放。其抑制會導致大規模溶酶體液泡化，凸顯其對溶酶體功能的核心地位。

label: Cardiovascular System
description: In a study of 24 middle-aged companion dogs, echocardiography showed improvements in both diastolic and systolic measures of age-related cardiac function (E/A ratio, fractional shortening, and ejection fraction) in dogs treated with rapamycin. Rapamycin also stimulates the breakdown of damaged cytoplasmic elements, reduces oxidative stress, and supports tissue regeneration in cardiac tissue, and induces production of growth factors IGF1 and VEGF while reducing IL-1beta and TNF-alpha to support cardiac regeneration after infarction. Cardiovascular diseases are the main cause of death in the elderly, making mTOR inhibitors a promising direction for cardioprotective research.
description_zh_TW: 在一項24隻中年伴侶犬的研究中，心臟超音波顯示rapamycin治療的犬隻在年齡相關心臟功能的舒張和收縮指標（E/A比、短縮分數和射血分數）方面有所改善。Rapamycin還刺激受損細胞質成分的分解，減少氧化壓力，並支持心臟組織的組織再生，並誘導生長因子IGF1和VEGF的產生，同時減少IL-1beta和TNF-alpha以支持梗塞後的心臟再生。心血管疾病是老年人的主要死因，使得mTOR抑制劑成為心臟保護研究的一個有前途的方向。

label: FBXO7
description: Loss of FBXO7 function reduces Parkin recruitment efficiency, leading to accumulation of damaged mitochondria and increased susceptibility to oxidative stress in dopaminergic neurons. Mutations in PARK15, the gene encoding FBXO7, cause autosomal recessive early-onset Parkinson's disease, directly linking FBXO7 dysfunction to impaired mitophagy.
description_zh_TW: FBXO7 功能喪失會降低 Parkin 的招募效率，造成受損粒線體累積，並使多巴胺神經元更易受到 oxidative stress 影響。編碼 FBXO7 的 PARK15 基因突變會造成體染色體隱性遺傳的早發型 Parkinson's disease，直接將 FBXO7 功能障礙與受損的 mitophagy 連結起來。

label: flavanone
description: Flavanone is the saturated C-ring flavonoid subclass lacking the catechol motif. Classification nests it in the flavonoid family.
description_zh_TW: flavanone 是飽和 C 環的類黃酮亞類，缺乏兒茶酚基序。歸類將其嵌套於類黃酮家族。

label: SEPHS2
description: SEPHS2 (selenophosphate synthetase 2) is the entry point of selenium into the amino acid: it converts selenide, derived from dietary selenium, plus ATP into monoselenophosphate, the activated selenium donor used by SepSecS to convert O-phosphoseryl-tRNA[Ser]Sec into Sec-tRNA[Ser]Sec. SEPHS2 sits upstream of PSTK and SepSecS, and its output gates the whole selenoprotein family — so selenium availability tunes selenoproteome capacity, a link relevant to aging and redox decline.
description_zh_TW: SEPHS2（selenophosphate synthetase 2）是硒進入胺基酸的入口：它將源自飲食硒的 selenide 與 ATP 轉為單硒磷酸（monoselenophosphate），即 SepSecS 將 O-磷酸絲胺醯-tRNA[Ser]Sec 轉成 Sec-tRNA[Ser]Sec 時所用的活化硒供體。SEPHS2 位於 PSTK 與 SepSecS 上游，其產物控管整個 selenoprotein 家族，因此硒的可利用性可調整 selenoproteome 容量，這與老化及氧化還原衰退相關。

label: Ruxolitinib
description: Ruxolitinib is a prototypic Senomorphic Therapy: rather than eliminating senescent cells it suppresses their inflammatory output via JAK–STAT blockade, abrogating secretion of IL-6 and IL-8 and blunting the pro-fibrotic secretome without killing the cells.
description_zh_TW: Ruxolitinib 是典型的 Senomorphic Therapy：它並不清除衰老細胞，而是透過阻斷 JAK–STAT 抑制其發炎輸出，在不殺死細胞的情況下取消 IL-6 與 IL-8 的分泌，並削弱促纖維化分泌體。

label: LRRK2
description: Mutations in LRRK2, particularly G2019S, are among the most common genetic causes of familial Parkinson's disease. LRRK2 is a large multi-domain kinase that regulates mitophagy, lysosomal function and vesicle sorting, and pathogenic LRRK2 activity impairs mitophagy — the LRRK2 kinase inhibitor GSK3357679A restores mitophagy defects in LRRK2 G2019S mice, showing that targeting LRRK2 can rescue mitophagy damage in vivo.
description_zh_TW: LRRK2 的突異（尤其是 G2019S）是家族性 Parkinson's disease 最常見的遺傳病因之一。LRRK2 是一種大型多結構域激酶，調節 mitophagy、溶小體功能與囊泡分選，而致病型 LRRK2 活性會損害 mitophagy——LRRK2 激酶抑制劑 GSK3357679A 可在 LRRK2 G2019S 小鼠中恢復 mitophagy 缺損，顯示針對 LRRK2 的標靶可在體內救援 mitophagy 損傷。

label: PTPN family
description: PTPN2 (TC-PTP) is a ubiquitously expressed non-receptor protein tyrosine phosphatase belonging to the PTPN family, distinguished by an N-terminal catalytic domain with the conserved HCxxR motif and a C-terminal tail that directs nuclear/cytoplasmic localization and substrate engagement.
description_zh_TW: PTPN2（TC-PTP）是廣泛表現的非受體型蛋白酪胺酸磷酸酶，屬於 PTPN family，其特徵為帶有保守 HCxxR 基序的 N 端催化區，以及負責核質定位與受質招募的 C 端尾部。

label: Adherens Junction
description: E-cadherin is the primary epithelial transmembrane protein of adherens junctions. Containment records the junction composition.
description_zh_TW: E-cadherin 是黏附連接的主要上皮跨膜蛋白。包含記錄連接組成。

label: ITPR2
description: The ER calcium release channel ITPR2 is localized at MERCS, where it supplies the calcium that MCU takes up; enhanced ITPR2-mediated release during senescence drives matrix calcium accumulation.
description_zh_TW: 內質網鈣離子釋放通道 ITPR2 定位於 MERCS，在該處供應 MCU 所攝取的鈣離子；衰老期間 ITPR2 媒介的釋放增強，驅動基質鈣累積。

label: Photobiomodulation
description: Photobiomodulation uses red and near-infrared light (roughly 600-1000 nm) whose photons are absorbed by cytochrome c oxidase (Complex IV) in the mitochondria. This accelerates electron transfer and the proton gradient, boosting ATP production and transiently modulating ROS signalling in a hormetic direction, which is why PBM is listed among environmental mitohormetic exposures alongside cold, heat and exercise.
description_zh_TW: Photobiomodulation 使用紅光與近紅外光（約 600–1000 nm），其光子由粒線體中的 cytochrome c oxidase（Complex IV）吸收。這會加速電子傳遞與質子梯度，提升 ATP 產生，並以 hormesis 方向短暫調節 ROS 訊號；因此 PBM 與寒冷、高溫、運動並列為環境性的 mitohormetic 曝露。

label: Autolysosome
description: After degradation, autolysosomes undergo Autophagic Lysosome Reformation, a process that regenerates functional lysosomes from the hybrid organelle. ALR depends on AMPK, mTORC1 reactivation, and clathrin-mediated budding.
description_zh_TW: 降解完成後，autolysosome 會進行 Autophagic Lysosome Reformation，由該混合胞器再生出可運作的溶酶體。ALR 依賴 AMPK、mTORC1 再活化與 clathrin 媒介的出芽。

label: Toren Finkel
description: Toren Finkel is best known for co-developing the mitohormesis concept with Jeanho Yun, published as a landmark 2014 Cell Metabolism review. The work established that low-level mitochondrial perturbation triggers compensatory transcriptional and metabolic programs operating through the mitochondrial unfolded protein response and SKN-1/NRF2 signaling, shifting the paradigm from viewing mitochondrial dysfunction solely as pathogenic.
description_zh_TW: Toren Finkel 最廣為人知的是與 Jeanho Yun 共同提出 mitohormesis 概念，成果發表為 2014 年《Cell Metabolism》的里程碑式回顧論文。該研究確立低程度的粒線體擾動會經由 Mitochondrial Unfolded Protein Response 與 SKN-1/NRF2 訊號啟動代償性轉錄與代謝程式，扭轉了將粒線體功能障礙僅視為致病因素的典範。

label: Nudix Hydrolases
description: Nudix Hydrolases (NUDT family, e.g. NUDT5/NUDT9-type ADPR pyrophosphatases) cleave the phosphodiester bond of free ADP-ribose, producing AMP and ribose-5-phosphate (R5P). In Parthanatos they sit downstream of PARG and ARH3, converting the PAR-catabolism product ADP-ribose into both a metabolic signal (AMP) and salvage substrates (R5P).
description_zh_TW: Nudix 水解酶（Nudix Hydrolases，NUDT 家族，例如 NUDT5/NUDT9 型 ADPR 焦磷酸酶）切割游離 ADP-ribose 的磷酸二酯鍵，產生 AMP 與核糖-5-磷酸（R5P）。在 parthanatos 中，它們位於 PARG 與 ARH3 下游，將 PAR 分解產物 ADP-ribose 同時轉成代謝訊號（AMP）與補救合成受質（R5P）。

label: Lamivudine
description: Lamivudine (3TC) is a cytidine nucleoside analogue that, after phosphorylation to its triphosphate form, competes with dCTP and terminates cDNA chain elongation. The same inhibitory principle applies to the endogenous reverse transcriptase encoded by autonomous LINE-1 retroelements, which is why lamivudine acts as a senomorphic agent.
description_zh_TW: Lamivudine（3TC）是胞苷核苷類似物，磷酸化為三磷酸型後與 dCTP 競爭並終止 cDNA 鏈延長。相同的抑制原理也適用於自主性 LINE-1 反轉錄子所編碼的內源性反轉錄酶，因此 lamivudine 可作為 senomorphic 藥物。

label: Tauopathy
description: Pathogenic tau activates microglial NF-κB signaling, inducing a transcriptional program that alters tau handling and promotes release of seed-competent tau species. Genetic inhibition of microglial NF-κB traps tau intracellularly and markedly reduces extracellular tau seeding and in vivo propagation, establishing NF-κB as a key regulator of microglial tau export.
description_zh_TW: 致病性 tau 會活化微膠細胞的 NF-κB 訊號，誘導一套轉錄程式，改變 tau 的處理方式並促進具播種能力的 tau 物種釋放。對微膠細胞 NF-κB 的遺傳性抑制會將 tau 困在細胞內，顯著降低細胞外 tau 的播種與體內傳播，確立 NF-κB 為微膠細胞 tau 輸出的關鍵調節因子。

label: Dietary AGE Restriction
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: Intervention studies in mice show that reduced dietary AGEs attenuate insulin resistance, increase prevention of diabetes, and, in diabetic mice, reduce diabetic vascular and renal complications and improve impaired wound healing. The positive outcomes of caloric restriction in mice may be explained in part by a decrease in AGE intake and a concomitant decrease in oxidative stress. These findings indicate that the glycation load of the diet is not merely a bystander but can modulate insulin sensitivity and metabolic health, reinforcing the idea that dietary AGE restriction is a viable intervention against metabolic dysfunction.
description_zh_TW: 小鼠的介入研究顯示，減少飲食性 AGE 可減緩胰島素抗性、增加糖尿病預防，且在糖尿病小鼠中減少糖尿病血管與腎臟併發症並改善受損傷口癒合。小鼠中熱量限制（caloric restriction）的正面結果可能部分可由 AGE 攝取減少與伴隨的氧化壓力下降來解釋。這些發現指出，飲食的糖化負載不只是旁觀者，而是能調節胰島素敏感度與代謝健康，強化了飲食 AGE 限制是對抗代謝功能障礙之可行介入手段的觀念。

label: Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine
description: Omura shared the 2015 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine with William C. Campbell for the discovery of avermectin/ivermectin.
description_zh_TW: 大村與William C. Campbell分享了2015年的阿維菌素/伊維菌素的發現。

label: Fas
description: FasL (Fas ligand, CD95L/CD178, TNFSF6) is a type II transmembrane protein of the TNF superfamily that binds the Fas receptor (CD95/APO-1). Trimerization upon receptor binding clusters Fas and recruits the adaptor FADD and procaspase-8 to form the DISC.
description_zh_TW: FasL（Fas ligand，CD95L／CD178，TNFSF6）是 TNF 超家族的第二型跨膜蛋白，與 Fas 受體（CD95／APO-1）結合。受體結合後 FasL 三聚化使 Fas 聚集，並招募轉接蛋白 FADD 與 procaspase-8 形成 DISC。

label: NRTI
source_file: _document_ - The role of the dynamic epigenetic landscape in senescence_orchestrating SASP expression.md
description: Nucleoside reverse transcriptase inhibitors, developed as antiretroviral drugs for HIV, also inhibit LINE-1 retrotransposition. NRTIs act as chain-terminating nucleoside analogs that are incorporated into nascent DNA by reverse transcriptase, halting the synthesis of the L1 cDNA copies that would otherwise be generated from L1 RNA in the cytoplasm. By blocking LINE-1 reverse transcription, NRTIs reduce the cGAS-STING-dependent inflammation and SASP that arise from retrotransposon derepression during aging, and they are being explored as anti-aging interventions.
description_zh_TW: 核苷逆轉錄酶抑制劑是作為 HIV 抗逆轉錄病毒藥物而開發的，也能抑制 LINE-1 逆轉錄轉座。 NRTI 充當鏈終止核苷類似物，透過逆轉錄酶將其摻入新生 DNA 中，從而停止 L1 cDNA 副本的合成，否則這些副本將由細胞質中的 L1 RNA 產生。透過阻斷 LINE-1 逆轉錄，NRTI 可以減少 cGAS-STING 依賴性發炎和老化過程中逆轉錄轉座子去抑制引起的 SASP，並且它們正在被探索作為抗衰老幹預措施。

label: Esophageal Cancer
description: The metaplasia-dysplasia-carcinoma cascade from Barrett's esophagus to adenocarcinoma is textbook.
description_zh_TW: Barrett 食道至腺癌的化生—異生—癌級聯是教科書等級。

label: Bipolar II Disorder
description: Bipolar II Disorder is characterized by the occurrence of at least one hypomanic episode and at least one major depressive episode, with hypomania representing a less severe form of mania that does not cause marked functional impairment or psychosis and does not require hospitalization. The depressive phases typically predominate in duration and disability, making depression the major source of impairment. Genetic variants including COMT and MTHFR have been explored as contributors to susceptibility through effects on catecholamine and methyl metabolism, though the associations are modest. The disorder is distinguished from Bipolar I by the absence of full manic episodes.
description_zh_TW: Bipolar II Disorder的特徵是發生至少一次輕躁症發作和至少一次重度憂鬱發作，輕躁症代表一種不太嚴重的躁狂形式，不會引起明顯的功能障礙或精神病，並且不需要住院治療。憂鬱階段通常在持續時間和殘疾方面占主導地位，這使得憂鬱症成為損害的主要來源。包括 COMT 和 MTHFR 在內的遺傳變異已被探索為透過影響兒茶酚胺和甲基代謝而導致易感性的因素，儘管這種關聯性不大。此疾病與 I 型雙極性情感疾患的差異在於不存在完全的躁症發作。

label: elevated homocysteine
description: Several MTHFD1 polymorphisms, such as the G1958A/R653Q missense variant, have been associated with altered enzyme kinetics and biomarkers of impaired folate metabolism. These variants are linked to elevated homocysteine and modified risk for neural tube defects and certain cancers. As with MTHFR, they can reduce the efficiency of methyl-group provision.
description_zh_TW: 若干 MTHFD1 多態性，例如 G1958A/R653Q 錯義變異，已與改變的酶動力學和葉酸代謝受損的生物標記相關。這些變異與 elevated homocysteine 以及神經管缺陷和某些癌症的風險改變有關。與 MTHFR 一樣，它們會降低甲基供給的效率。

label: Heme
description: Heme triggers a characteristic TRIM response with H3K27ac remodeling through SYK-dependent ROS generation rather than oxidative chemistry alone. Unlike oxLDL or HMGB1 training, heme training is mTOR-independent: rapamycin has no effect, while SYK inhibition with R406 blocks training. It defines an alternative DAMP-to-chromatin route.
description_zh_TW: Heme 透過 SYK-dependent ROS generation 而非僅靠氧化化學性質，觸發帶有 H3K27ac 重塑的典型 TRIM 反應。與 Oxidized LDL 或 HMGB1 訓練不同，Heme 訓練是 mTOR-independent：rapamycin 無效，而以 R406 抑制 SYK 可阻斷訓練。它定義了一條替代性的 DAMP-to-chromatin 路徑。

label: SIRT2 inhibition
source_file: _document_ - sirtuins in health and disease s41392-022-01257-8.md
description: Inhibition of SIRT2 suppresses the in vitro growth and in vivo engraftment of T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia cells through diminished deacetylation of LIM domain only 2 (LMO2). Directionally, SIRT2 inhibition sits upstream of LMO2-dependent leukemia suppression. LMO2 is a key oncogenic transcription factor in T-ALL, and its activity depends on deacetylation by SIRT2. Blocking SIRT2 reduces LMO2 function, impairing both the expansion of leukemic cells in culture and their ability to engraft in vivo. This identifies SIRT2 inhibition as a promising approach for T-ALL therapy, targeting a central oncogenic driver in this disease.
description_zh_TW: 抑制SIRT2透過減少LIM domain only 2（LMO2）的去乙醯化來抑制T細胞急性淋巴性白血病細胞的體外生長和體內植入。方向上，SIRT2抑制位於LMO2依賴性白血病抑制的上游。LMO2是T-ALL中的關鍵致癌轉錄因子，其活性依賴SIRT2的去乙醯化。阻斷SIRT2降低LMO2功能，損害白血病細胞在培養中的擴增和在體內的植入能力。這將SIRT2抑制確定為T-ALL治療的有前景方法，靶向此疾病中的核心致癌驅動因子。

label: Trichuris
description: Trichuriasis (whipworm infection) is a soil-transmitted helminth infection of the large intestine caused by the nematode Trichuris trichiura. Adult worms anchor their thin anterior ends in the colonic mucosa, and heavy burdens in children produce Trichuris dysentery syndrome with bloody diarrhea, growth stunting and rectal prolapse.
description_zh_TW: 鞭蟲病（ whipworm infection ）是由線蟲 Trichuris trichiura 所引起的大腸土壤傳播蠕蟲感染。成蟲以細長的前端固定於結腸黏膜，重度感染（多見於兒童）會造成鞭蟲痢疾症候群，表現為血性腹瀉、生長遲緩與直腸脫垂。

label: Milton
description: Disruption of the MFN2-Miro-Milton-kinesin axis, as occurs with MFN2 mutations causing Charcot-Marie-Tooth disease type 2A, impairs axonal mitochondrial transport and underlies the resulting peripheral neuropathy and axonal degeneration.
description_zh_TW: MFN2 突變造成 Charcot-Marie-Tooth Disease Type 2A 時，MFN2-Miro-Milton-kinesin 軸受破壞，軸突粒線體運輸受損，並構成周邊神經病變與軸突退化的基礎。

label: isp-1
description: isp-1 (Iron-Sulfur Protein 1) is a Caenorhabditis elegans gene encoding a subunit of mitochondrial complex III (ubiquinol-cytochrome c oxidoreductase), the iron-sulfur containing core of the electron transport chain. Its reduction of mitochondrial respiration is the initiating lesion behind the gene's lifespan phenotype.
description_zh_TW: isp-1（Iron-Sulfur Protein 1）是 Caenorhabditis elegans 的一個基因，編碼粒線體 Complex III（ubiquinol-cytochrome c oxidoreductase）的次單元，該複合體是電子傳遞鏈含鐵硫的核心。其對粒線體呼吸的抑制是該基因壽命表型背後的起始病變。

label: Serotonin-Norepinephrine Reuptake Inhibitors
description: Serotonin-Norepinephrine Reuptake Inhibitors block the serotonin transporter (and the norepinephrine transporter), raising synaptic Serotonin and Norepinephrine; this dual action is exploited in depression, generalized anxiety disorder, diabetic neuropathic pain and fibromyalgia.
description_zh_TW: Serotonin-Norepinephrine Reuptake Inhibitors 阻斷 serotonin 轉運蛋白（以及 norepinephrine 轉運蛋白），提高突觸內的 Serotonin 與 Norepinephrine；此雙重作用被應用於憂鬱症、廣泛性焦慮症、糖尿病神經病變疼痛與纖維肌痛。

label: HSP90β
description: HSP90β functions as an Apaf-1 inhibitor: it binds Apaf-1 and suppresses its nucleotide-dependent oligomerization, holding Apaf-1 in an inactive monomeric state. In BCR-ABL-driven tyrosine kinase leukemias this anti-death role restrains apoptosome formation, and it explains why HSP90 inhibition can unleash mitochondrial apoptosis selectively in malignant cells.
description_zh_TW: HSP90β 扮演 Apaf-1 抑制劑的角色：它與 Apaf-1 結合並抑制其依核苷酸的寡聚化，使 Apaf-1 維持在不活化的單體狀態。在 BCR-ABL 驅動的 tyrosine kinase 白血病中，這種抗死亡作用限制了 apoptosome 的形成，也解釋了為何 HSP90 抑制能選擇性地在惡性細胞中釋放粒線體 apoptosis。

label: Sodium nitrite
description: Sodium nitrite is the proximal methemoglobin-forming agent in the nitrate/nitrite family, oxidizing the ferrous (Fe2+) heme iron of Hemoglobin to the ferric (Fe3+) state. Ingested nitrate is first reduced by oral and gut microbiota to nitrite, which is then absorbed and delivers the oxidative hit to the heme carrier.
description_zh_TW: Sodium nitrite 是硝酸鹽／亞硝酸鹽家族中最直接造成methemoglobin形成的物質，將 Hemoglobin 血基質中的亞鐵（Fe2+）氧化為三價鐵（Fe3+）。摄入的硝酸鹽先經口腔與腸道菌群還原為亞硝酸鹽，後者被吸收後對血基質載體造成氧化傷害。

label: Focal Adhesion
description: Integrins are the transmembrane ECM receptors of focal adhesions. Containment records the adhesion composition.
description_zh_TW: Integrin 是黏著斑的跨膜 ECM 受體。包含記錄黏附組成。

label: SWI-SNF
description: SWI/SNF (mammalian BAF) complexes perform ATP-dependent nucleosome remodeling using their BRG1/BRM ATPase subunits. The ATPase hydrolyzes energy to slide, reposition, or evict nucleosomes, opening promoters and enhancers to control access of transcriptional machinery — making SWI-SNF the catalytic engine of nucleosome remodeling rather than merely a structural component.
description_zh_TW: SWI/SNF（哺乳類 BAF）複合體以其 BRG1/BRM ATPase 次單元執行 ATP 依賴性的核小體重塑。ATPase 水解能量以滑動、重新定位或驅逐核小體，開放 promoter 與 enhancer，控制轉錄機器的可及性——因此 SWI-SNF 是核小體重塑的催化引擎，而不只是結構性成分。

label: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
description: R-CHOP is the standard first-line regimen for Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, combining the anti-CD20 antibody rituximab with cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, Vincristine and prednisone. It serves as the conventional comparator against which alternative or repurposed approaches are framed.
description_zh_TW: R-CHOP 是 Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma 的標準一線治療方案，將抗 CD20 抗體 rituximab 與 cyclophosphamide、doxorubicin、Vincristine 及 prednisone 合併。它也是評估替代或再定位療法時的常規對照基準。

label: TRADD
description: TRADD nucleates FADD/Complex II assembly leading to caspase-8 activation.
description_zh_TW: TRADD 使 FADD/Complex II 組裝成核，導致 caspase-8 活化。

label: MTHFR
description: Folinic acid (5-formyltetrahydrofolate) bypasses the MTHFR enzyme because it enters folate metabolism downstream of the MTHFR-catalyzed reduction step, requiring conversion by other enzymes to 5-methyl-THF without direct MTHFR dependence. This makes it useful for individuals with MTHFR variants who cannot efficiently generate methylfolate from folic acid or 5,10-methylene-THF. It provides methyl groups for the cycle without relying on the impaired enzymatic step. It is a common alternative in personalized methylation support protocols.
description_zh_TW: Folinic acid（5-甲醯四氫葉酸）繞過 MTHFR 酶，因為它進入 MTHFR 催化還原步驟下游的 folate 代謝，需要其他酶轉化為 5-甲基-THF，而不直接依賴 MTHFR。這使得它對於患有 MTHFR variants 且無法有效地從葉酸或 5,10-亞甲基-THF 生成甲基葉酸的個體非常有用。它為循環提供 methyl groups，而不依賴受損的酶促步驟。它是個人化甲基化支持方案中的常見替代方案。

label: Benzocaine
description: Benzocaine is an ester-type local anaesthetic used in over-the-counter teething gels, topical sprays and sunburn remedies, and it is a well-recognized cause of acquired methemoglobinemia. Even modest systemic absorption — especially in infants, with mucosal application or at high doses — can produce cyanosis, chocolate-coloured blood and hypoxia.
description_zh_TW: Benzocaine 是非處方牙膠、外用噴劑與防曬製劑中常用的酯類局部麻醉藥，也是後天性 Methemoglobinemia 的公認病因。即使只有有限的全身吸收——在嬰兒、黏膜給藥或高劑量時尤其明顯——也可能造成發紺、巧克力色血液與低血氧。

label: Isobutyl nitrite
description: Isobutyl nitrite is a volatile alkyl nitrite ('poppers') whose nitrite species oxidize the ferrous (Fe2+) iron of hemoglobin to the ferric (Fe3+) state. The resulting methemoglobin cannot bind or transport oxygen, so nitrite-driven one-electron oxidation of heme iron is the shared chemical basis for isobutyl nitrite toxicity and, in parallel, for the redox/autoxidation chemistry of catecholamine quinones.
description_zh_TW: Isobutyl nitrite 是一種易揮發的烷基亞硝酸酯（「poppers」），其亞硝酸鹽物種可將血基質的鐵由二價鐵（Fe2+）氧化為三價鐵（Fe3+）。所形成的 methemoglobin 無法結合或運送氧氣，因此亞硝酸鹽驅動的單電子血基質氧化，正是 isobutyl nitrite 毒性的化學基礎，也與兒茶酚胺醌類的氧化／自氧化化學平行。

label: Amyl nitrite
description: Amyl nitrite intentionally oxidizes hemoglobin iron from Fe²⁺ to Fe³⁺, creating methemoglobin that scavenges cyanide as cyanmethemoglobin and spares mitochondrial cytochrome oxidase — the mechanism behind its historical use in cyanide poisoning. The same oxidation causes methemoglobinemia, cyanosis and hypoxia on overuse.
description_zh_TW: Amyl nitrite 會將 Hemoglobin 的鐵由 Fe²⁺ 氧化為 Fe³⁺，形成 Methemoglobin，以 cyanmethemoglobin 形式螯合氰化物並保護粒線體 cytochrome oxidase——這是其在氰化物中毒中歷史性用途的機制。相同的氧化在過量使用時會造成 Methemoglobinemia、Cyanosis 與 Hypoxia。

label: Beta-TrCP
description: Beta-TrCP ubiquitinates IkappaBalpha, whose destruction activates NF-kB.
description_zh_TW: Beta-TrCP 泛素化 IkappaBalpha，其破壞活化 NF-κB。

label: miR-29b
description: miR-29b directly targets pro-survival Mcl-1.
description_zh_TW: miR-29b 直接標靶促存活 Mcl-1。

label: Redox Optimization
description: Redox Optimization is the active maintenance side of the Redox Battery concept: the deliberate upkeep of cellular reducing potential while processing redox-active indolequinones. It targets the NAD+/NADH and Glutathione (GSH/GSSG) buffering capacity, monitoring the GSH/GSSG ratio and NAD+/NADH balance and adjusting them as catecholamine load and quinone flux change, keeping the reservable reducing-equivalent reserve charged.
description_zh_TW: Redox Optimization 是 Redox Battery 概念中「維持」的一面：在處理氧化還原活性 indolequinone 時主動維持細胞還原勢能。它以 NAD+/NADH 與 Glutathione（GSH/GSSG）的緩衝容量為目標，依兒茶酚胺負荷與醌通量的變化監測 GSH/GSSG 比值與 NAD+/NADH 平衡，使可儲備的還原等量物儲備維持在「充電」狀態。

label: catechol flavonoid
source_file: _document_ - COMT How to Optimize Your Supplements for Your COMT Genotype.md
description: Fisetin is a catechol-containing flavonoid, a flavonol found in fruits and vegetables such as strawberries and apples, and its catechol ring makes it both a substrate for and a potential inhibitor of COMT. As a dietary catechol, it is O-methylated by COMT during metabolism, linking its pharmacokinetics to COMT genotype. At high supplemental doses it can compete with endogenous catechols for the enzyme, though physiological dietary intake is generally modest. It is studied for its antioxidant, senolytic, and neuroprotective properties.
description_zh_TW: Fisetin 是一種含兒茶酚的黃酮類化合物，是一種存在於草莓和蘋果等水果和蔬菜中的黃酮醇，其兒茶酚環使其既是 COMT 的底物，又是 COMT 的潛在抑制劑。作為一種膳食兒茶酚，它在代謝過程中被 COMT O-甲基化，從而將其藥物動力學與 COMT genotype 聯繫起來。在高補充劑量下，它可以與內源性兒茶酚競爭酶，儘管生理飲食攝取量通常是適度的。人們對其抗氧化劑、senolytic 和 neuroprotective properties 進行了研究。

label: Glucose Oxidase
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Methylene blue (MB) provides no protection against direct extracellular oxidative stress generated by glucose oxidase, which produces hydrogen peroxide in the culture medium. In HT-22 cells, glucose oxidase induced 80% cell death within 3 hours that was not attenuated by MB at any concentration tested, whereas the conventional antioxidant pyruvate (4 mM) provided robust protection. This distinguishes MB from classical chain-breaking antioxidants: MB acts upstream on mitochondrial electron flow rather than as a direct scavenger of extracellular hydrogen peroxide.
description_zh_TW: Methylene blue (MB)對葡萄糖氧化酶產生的直接細胞外氧化應激沒有提供保護作用，葡萄糖氧化酶在培養基中產生過氧化氫。在HT-22細胞中，葡萄糖氧化酶在3小時內誘導80%的細胞死亡，這在任何測試濃度下都沒有被MB減弱，而傳統抗氧化劑丙酮酸（4 mM）提供了強大的保護作用。這將MB與經典的鏈斷裂抗氧化劑區分開來：MB在粒線體電子流的上游起作用，而不是作為細胞外過氧化氫的直接清除劑。

label: Mitochondrial Translation
description: Human mtDNA encodes 13 Oxidative Phosphorylation subunits among 22 tRNAs and 2 rRNAs; because these subunits are needed to assemble the respiratory chain, organelle-autonomous Mitochondrial Translation is a rate-limiting step for bioenergetic function.
description_zh_TW: 人類 mtDNA 在 22 個 tRNA 與 2 個 rRNA 之外還編碼 13 個 Oxidative Phosphorylation 次單元；由於這些次單元是組裝呼吸鏈所必需，胞器自主的 Mitochondrial Translation 是生物能量功能的速率限制步驟。

label: MitoStores
description: MitoStores are cytosolic granules that act as temporary storage depots for mitochondrial precursor proteins when import into mitochondria is impaired or saturated, part of the triage system for mPOS (mitochondrial precursor over-accumulation stress). Chaperone-bound precursors are held in an import-competent state, preventing their aggregation and cytosolic proteotoxicity until import capacity is restored.
description_zh_TW: MitoStores 是細胞質顆粒，在粒線體 precursor protein 的輸入受損或飽和時作為暫時儲存庫，屬於 mPOS（粒線體 precursor 過度累積壓力）的分流系統。Chaperone 結合的 precursor 以可輸入狀態被保存，避免聚集與細胞質 proteotoxicity，待輸入能力恢復後再釋放至粒線體。

label: Drug Resistance
description: Drug Resistance in oncology describes diminished efficacy of cytotoxic or targeted agents over time, driven by efflux pumps, DNA-repair upregulation, metabolic reprogramming, and microenvironmental factors. A key contributor is the acidic, lactate-rich Tumor Microenvironment produced by Glycolysis, which promotes resistance.
description_zh_TW: 腫瘤學中的 Drug Resistance 指細胞毒性或標靶藥物效能在時間推移下降低，由幫浦外排、DNA 修補上調、代謝重編程與微環境因素共同驅動。關鍵促成因子是由 Glycolysis 產生的酸性、乳酸-rich 的 Tumor Microenvironment，它會促進抗藥性。

label: Nuclear Pore Complex
description: Lamin A, together with lamin C and the B-type lamins, forms the nuclear lamina meshwork underlying the inner nuclear membrane. By anchoring the Nuclear Pore Complex it provides mechanical support to the nucleus and helps organize Chromatin into lamina-associated domains.
description_zh_TW: Lamin A 與 lamin C 及 B 型 lamin 共同構成內核膜下的核纖層網狀結構。它藉由錨定 Nuclear Pore Complex 為細胞核提供機械支撐，並將 Chromatin 組織成核纖層相關結構域（LADs）。

label: GLUT1
description: Metabolic Reprogramming relates to GLUT1 through the relation involves. Metabolic reprogramming is the rewiring of nutrient uptake and bioenergetics that supplies building blocks and redox balance to proliferating tumors. GLUT1 is a high-capacity glucose transporter markedly upregulated on the tumor-cell surface to feed the glycolytic phenotype. The interaction is specific and directional within the cancer context. Understanding this link contributes to the broader map of tumor biology and potential intervention points.
description_zh_TW: Metabolic Reprogramming 透過關係涉及 與 GLUT1 相關。 Metabolic Reprogramming 是營養吸收和生物能的重新佈線，為增殖的腫瘤提供建構模組和氧化還原平衡。 GLUT1 是一種高容量葡萄糖轉運蛋白，在腫瘤細胞表面顯著上調以供給糖解表型。在癌症背景下，這種相互作用是特定的和有方向的。瞭解這種關聯有助於更廣泛地瞭解腫瘤生物學和潛在的幹預點。

label: JNK2
description: JNK2 phosphorylates Bcl-xL at Ser62, inactivating it during G2 arrest.
description_zh_TW: JNK2 在 Ser62 磷酸化 Bcl-xL，在 G2 停滯使其失活。

label: PTPN23
description: PTPN23 (HD-PTP) is a PTPN family member distinguished from other members by an N-terminal Bro1 domain that links it to CHMP proteins of the ESCRT-III complex and to ubiquitinated cargo, allowing the phosphatase domain to couple death signalling to endosomal sorting.
description_zh_TW: PTPN23（HD-PTP）是 PTPN family 的成員，與其他成員不同的是它帶有 N 端 Bro1 結構域，可連結 ESCRT-III 複合體的 CHMP 蛋白與泛素化貨載，使磷酸酶區域能把死亡訊號與內體分選串接起來。

label: ABCD1
description: Genetic defects in the transporter ABCD1 impair peroxisomal beta-oxidation, leading to toxic accumulation of very long-chain fatty acids and severe metabolic diseases such as Zellweger syndrome and Adrenoleukodystrophy.
description_zh_TW: 運輸蛋白 ABCD1 的基因缺陷會損害過氧化體的 beta-oxidation，導致 very long-chain fatty acids 毒性累積，並造成 Zellweger syndrome 與 Adrenoleukodystrophy 等嚴重代謝疾病。

label: Interleukin 1β
description: Caspase-1 is the effector protease of the inflammasome pathway: when activated by the NLRP3 inflammasome (or by the AIM2 inflammasome via ASC specks), it proteolytically cleaves Interleukin 1β from its inactive precursor into its mature, secreted, active form.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-1 是發炎小體路徑的效應蛋白酶：當它被 NLRP3 Inflammasome（或經由 ASC 斑塊的 AIM2 Inflammasome）活化時，會將 Interleukin 1β 由不活性前驅物蛋白水解切割成成熟、可分泌的活性形式。

label: Type 2 Diabetes
source_file: _document_ - Natural Bioactive Compounds Spermidine Fisetin Berberine Urolithin A.md
description: SIRT3 is consistently downregulated in clinical diabetic tissues, with deficiency correlating with insulin resistance and disturbed systemic energy homeostasis. In skeletal muscle, SIRT3 deficiency impairs insulin-stimulated glucose translocation, aggravating peripheral insulin resistance and contributing to type 2 diabetes pathophysiology.
description_zh_TW: SIRT3 在臨床糖尿病組織中持續被下調，其缺乏與胰島素阻抗和全身能量代謝失調相關。在骨骼肌中，SIRT3 缺乏損害胰島素刺激的葡萄糖轉運，加重周邊胰島素阻抗並促進第 2 型糖尿病的病理生理學。

label: PEX3
description: PEX3 encodes a peroxisomal membrane protein required for correct folding and transport of many other peroxins into the peroxisome membrane, acting as an essential building block of the Peroxisome Biogenesis Network. Loss of function leaves misfolded proteins that accumulate and disrupt membrane integrity.
description_zh_TW: PEX3 編碼過氧化體膜蛋白，負責許多其他 peroxin 正確摺疊並運送至過氧化體膜，是 Peroxisome Biogenesis Network 的必要組成。功能喪失會留下累積的錯誤摺疊蛋白，破壞膜完整性。

label: 53BP1
description: 53BP1 is recruited to DNA double-strand break sites through cooperative recognition of the histone marks H4K20me2 and H2AK15ub, a localization step that is stabilized by interaction with γ-H2AX via the MDC1 mediator. This makes 53BP1 a downstream chromatin scaffold that converts the γ-H2AX damage signal into a repair-pathway commitment.
description_zh_TW: 53BP1 透過協同辨識組蛋白標記 H4K20me2 與 H2AK15ub 被招募到 DNA 雙股斷裂（DSB）位點，此定位步驟再由 MDC1 媒介與 γ-H2AX 的交互作用加以穩定。這使 53BP1 成為下游的染色質支架，把 γ-H2AX 的損傷訊號轉為修復途徑的選擇。

label: TRIM21
description: TRIM21 directly interacts with RIPK1 and ubiquitinates it through its RING domain, regulating antiviral immunity and autoimmunity.
description_zh_TW: TRIM21直接與RIPK1交互作用，並透過其RING結構域泛素化RIPK1，調控抗病毒免疫與自體免疫。

label: Circadian Rhythm
description: NAMPT is the rate-limiting NAD+ salvage enzyme and a transcriptional target of BMAL1/CLOCK. By generating rhythmic NAD+ oscillations it closes the SIRT1 circadian loop, gating SIRT1 activity and thereby setting the timing of downstream clock-controlled output.
description_zh_TW: NAMPT 是 NAD+ salvage 途徑的速率限制酵素，同時是 BMAL1/CLOCK 的轉錄標的。藉由產生節律性的 NAD+ 振盪，它閉合了 SIRT1 的晝夜迴路，門控 SIRT1 活性並因而設定下游時鐘受控輸出的時序。

label: Coordinated Lysosomal Expression and Regulation
description: The CLEAR network is a master transcriptional program orchestrated by the MiT/TFE factors TFEB and TFE3, which bind CLEAR elements (GTCACGTGAC) in promoters of lysosomal hydrolases, v-ATPase and autophagic genes. CLEAR therefore drives Lysosome Biogenesis so that lysosomal capacity scales with autophagic demand; diminished TFEB/CLEAR activity with age contributes to lysosomal storage and aggregation disease.
description_zh_TW: CLEAR 網絡是由 MiT/TFE 因子（主要為 TFEB 與 TFE3）統籌的主控轉錄程式，這些因子結合於溶小體水解酵素、v-ATPase 與自噬基因啟動子上的 CLEAR 元素（GTCACGTGAC）。因此 CLEAR 驅動 Lysosome Biogenesis，使溶小體容量隨自噬需求擴張；隨年齡下降的 TFEB/CLEAR 活性則促成溶小體儲積與聚集疾病。

label: Puma
description: Bcl-2 family includes Puma. The Bcl-2 protein family comprises pro-apoptotic effectors (Bax, Bak) and BH3-only activators balanced against anti-apoptotic guardians (Bcl-2, Bcl-xL, Mcl-1, Bcl-w) that set the mitochondrial death threshold. Puma is a p53-inducible BH3-only protein that binds and neutralizes essentially all anti-apoptotic Bcl-2 relatives to license mitochondrial death. The relationship is directional, with Bcl-2 family acting as the operative agent upon Puma rather than the reverse. Together these facts situate the relationship within the broader architecture of cancer biology, clarifying how the two entities connect as part of the hallmark or taxonomic framework.
description_zh_TW: Bcl-2 family 包括 Puma。 Bcl-2 蛋白家族包括促凋亡效應子 (Bax、Bak) 和僅 BH3 活化劑，與設定粒線體死亡閾值的抗凋亡衛士 (Bcl-2、Bcl-xL、Mcl-1、Bcl-w) 保持平衡。 Puma 是一種 p53 誘導型 BH3 蛋白，可結合並中和幾乎所有抗凋亡 Bcl-2 相關蛋白，從而允許粒線體死亡。這種關係是有方向的，Bcl-2 family 充當 Puma 的操作主體，而不是相反。這些事實將這種關係​​置於更廣泛的癌症生物學架構中，闡明瞭這兩個實體如何作為標誌或分類框架的一部分連結。

label: PP1α
description: PP1α is the alpha catalytic isoform of PP1, encoded by PPP1CA. Like all PP1 isoforms it carries the conserved PP1 catalytic fold with a beta12-alphaC loop binding two Mn2+/Fe2+ ions, but its substrate specificity comes from associated regulatory proteins recognizing RVxF motifs rather than from the catalytic core itself.
description_zh_TW: PP1α 是 PP1 的 alpha 催化異型，由 PPP1CA 編碼。與所有 PP1 異型相同，它帶有保守的 PP1 催化摺疊，其 beta12-alphaC 迴圈結合兩個 Mn2+/Fe2+ 離子；但其受質專一性來自辨識 RVxF 基序的結合調節蛋白，而非催化核心本身。

label: Oxyhemoglobin
description: Oxyhemoglobin is one of the hemoglobin fractions directly resolved by multiwavelength co-oximetry. Because specimens should be analysed promptly or kept cold and protected from air, artifactual changes in the oxy/methemoglobin ratio can otherwise confound the reported result.
description_zh_TW: Oxyhemoglobin 是多波長 Co-oximetry 直接解析的 Hemoglobin 分部之一。由於檢體應儘速分析或冷藏並避免接觸空氣，否則 oxy／methemoglobin 比例的人為變化會混淆報告結果。

label: RAW264.7
description: RAW264.7 is an immortalized mouse macrophage cell line derived from an ascitic tumor induced by Abelson murine leukemia virus in a male BALB/c mouse, established in 1978. It carries v-Abl transformant sequences and retains many primary macrophage functions, including Fc receptor-mediated phagocytosis, cytokine secretion and nitric oxide production upon LPS/IFN-gamma stimulation, and can be polarized toward M1 or M2 phenotypes.
description_zh_TW: RAW264.7 是源自雄性 BALB/c 小鼠中 Abelson 鼠白血病病毒誘發的腹水腫瘤之永生化小鼠巨噬細胞株，建立於 1978 年。它帶有 v-Abl 轉位序列，並保留許多原代巨噬細胞功能，包括 Fc 受體媒介的吞噬作用、細胞激素分泌，以及在 LPS／IFN-γ 刺激下的一氧化氮生成，且可被極化為 M1 或 M2 表型。

label: SKN-1
description: SKN-1 is the Caenorhabditis elegans ortholog of mammalian NRF2, a cap'n'collar basic leucine zipper transcription factor governing the conserved antioxidant and detoxification response. Under basal conditions SKN-1 is retained in the cytoplasm by the BTB–Kelch repressor WDR-23, the homolog of Keap1; upon oxidative or electrophilic insult the repressor is inactivated and SKN-1 translocates to the nucleus.
description_zh_TW: SKN-1 是哺乳類 NRF2 在 *Caenorhabditis elegans* 的直系同源物，屬於 cap'n'collar 型基本白胺酸拉鍊轉錄因子，調控保守的抗氧化與解毒反應。在基礎狀態下 SKN-1 受 BTB–Kelch 抑制蛋白 WDR-23（Keap1 的同源物）扣留於細胞質；遭遇氧化或親電性攻擊時抑制蛋白失活，SKN-1 轉位至細胞核。

label: UTY
description: UTY (KDM6C) is the Y-chromosome homolog of the X-linked H3K27 demethylase KDM6A (UTX). Unlike KDM6A it has no catalytic H3K27 demethylase activity, yet retains non-catalytic tumor-suppressor function and partially compensates for KDM6A loss in males — males with KDM6A LOF plus mosaic chrY loss lose that backup.
description_zh_TW: UTY（KDM6C）是 X 聯結的 H3K27 去甲基化酵素 KDM6A（UTX）的 Y 染色體同源物。與 KDM6A 不同，UTY 不具催化性 H3K27 去甲基化活性，但保有非催化性的腫瘤抑制功能，並在男性中部分補償 KDM6A 缺失——KDM6A 功能喪失合併嵌合性 Y 染色體流失的男性即失去此備援。

label: Barrier-to-Autointegration Factor 1
description: Barrier-to-Autointegration Factor 1 (BAF1, encoded by BANF1) is a small, highly conserved chromatin-associated protein that binds DNA, histones and components of the nuclear envelope, helping maintain nuclear architecture and envelope integrity.
description_zh_TW: Barrier-to-Autointegration Factor 1（BAF1，由 BANF1 編碼）是一種小型且高度保守的染色質相關蛋白，可結合 DNA、組蛋白與核膜的組成成分，協助維持核架構與核膜完整性。

label: Glutathione Reductase
description: Glutathione reductase regenerates the reduced glutathione pool by reducing GSSG to two GSH at the expense of NADPH, coupling glutathione peroxidase activity to the pentose phosphate pathway. Without it the GPx/GSSG cycle cannot be sustained, and glycation impairs its function.
description_zh_TW: Glutathione reductase 以 NADPH 為代價將 GSSG 還原為兩個 GSH，再生還原型 glutathione 庫，將 glutathione peroxidase 活性與 pentose phosphate pathway 耦合。若缺乏此酵素，GPx/GSSG cycle 無法持續，且 glycation 會損害其功能。

label: S6K1/2
description: S6K1/2 are primary downstream effectors of mTORC1, and rapamycin's inhibition of mTORC1 suppresses S6K1/2 activity. This places S6K1/2 on the rapamycin-sensitive axis regulating protein synthesis.
description_zh_TW: S6K1/2 是 mTORC1 的主要下游效應器，rapamycin 抑制 mTORC1 會壓制 S6K1/2 活性。這使 S6K1/2 位於調控蛋白質合成的 rapamycin 敏感軸上。

label: Eosinophils
description: Peripheral blood eosinophilia — an expansion of circulating eosinophils — is a hallmark laboratory finding in both cutaneous and visceral gnathostomiasis, often exceeding 20% of the total leukocyte count, and CSF eosinophilic pleocytosis is characteristic of the eosinophilic meningitis form. Eosinophilia in a patient with migratory subcutaneous swellings and relevant travel history is highly suggestive of gnathostomiasis.
description_zh_TW: 周邊血液 eosinophilia（循環中 eosinophils 的擴增）是皮膚型與內臟型 gnathostomiasis 共同的典型實驗室表現，常超過總白血球計數的 20%；腦脊髓液中的嗜酸性球增多則是 eosinophilic meningitis 型的特徵。對於有移行性皮下腫脹及相關旅遊史的病人，eosinophilia 高度提示 gnathostomiasis。

label: Aerobic Capacity
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: Nicotinamide mononucleotide (NMN) enhances aerobic capacity, as demonstrated in a randomized, double-blind study in amateur runners. NMN also improves mitochondrial function and energy metabolism: long-term administration in drinking water at 100 or 300 mg/kg/day for 12 months increased mitochondrial respiratory ability in skeletal muscle and reversed age-associated gene expression changes in a tissue-specific manner in aged mice. These mitochondrial and aerobic benefits are attributed to NMN raising NAD+ levels, which activates sirtuins and supports oxidative metabolism, energy expenditure, and oxygen consumption, positioning NMN as a performance- and healthspan-enhancing NAD+ precursor.
description_zh_TW: 菸鹼醯胺單核苷酸（NMN）增強有氧能力，此點已在一項針對業餘跑者的隨機雙盲研究中獲證實。NMN 也改善粒線體功能與能量代謝：在飲用水中以 100 或 300 mg/kg/天長期給藥 12 個月，增加了骨骼肌的粒線體呼吸能力，並以組織特異性方式逆轉老化小鼠中與年齡相關的基因表現變化。這些粒線體與有氧益處歸因於 NMN 提升 NAD+ 水平，進而活化去乙醯酶並支持氧化代謝、能量消耗與氧氣消耗，使 NMN 成為增進表現與健康壽命的 NAD+ 前驅物。

label: Topologically Associating Domain
description: Enhancer-promoter looping is regulated within topologically associating domains, the megabase-scale compartments in which DNA sequences interact more frequently with each other than with sequences outside. Because TADs confine enhancer-promoter contacts, genes are typically regulated by enhancers located within the same domain, and three-dimensional looping brings these regulatory elements into proximity with their target promoters. This organization allows the SASP to be driven by hyper-connected enhancer-promoter networks whose interactions are restructured during senescence.
description_zh_TW: 增強子-啟動子環在拓撲關聯域（兆鹼基級的區室）內受到調節，其中DNA序列彼此之間的相互作用比與外部序列之間的相互作用更頻繁。由於 TAD 限制了增強子-啟動子接觸，因此基因通常受到位於同一結構域內的增強子的調節，並且三維環使這些調節元件與其目標啟動子接近。這種組織允許 SASP 由超連接的增強子-啟動子網路驅動，其相互作用在老化過程中被重組。

label: CDKN1B
description: The CDK inhibitor p27 (CDKN1B) binds and inhibits Cyclin E-CDK2 to enforce G1 arrest and quiescence, preventing premature firing of replication origins. Cyclin E activity is otherwise induced downstream of Cyclin D-CDK4/6 signaling.
description_zh_TW: CDK 抑制劑 p27（CDKN1B）結合並抑制 Cyclin E-CDK2，以維持 G1 停滯與 quiescence，防止複製起始點被提早啟動。Cyclin E 的活性則在 Cyclin D-CDK4/6 訊號下游被誘導。

label: SOCS3
description: SOCS3 is a classic negative-feedback regulator of cytokine signaling. It is itself induced downstream of JAK/STAT3 activity and then feeds back to inhibit JAK/STAT signaling, including potent attenuation of interferon-gamma and IL-6 responses, acting through its central SH2 domain on phosphorylated receptor tyrosines.
description_zh_TW: SOCS3 是細胞激素訊息傳遞的典型負回饋調節因子。它本身由 JAK/STAT3 活性下游誘導，接著回頭抑制 JAK/STAT 訊息傳遞，包括對 interferon-gamma 與 IL-6 反應的強烈削弱；其作用經由中央 SH2 結構域辨識受體上的磷酸化酪胺酸殘基。

label: BAFF
description: BAFF binds three TNF-receptor superfamily members — BAFF-R, BCMA and TACI — with distinct affinities; BAFF-R engages TRAF3→NIK to activate the non-canonical NF-κB pathway plus canonical NF-κB, MAPK and PI3K/Akt, promoting B-cell survival, maturation and immunoglobulin class-switching.
description_zh_TW: BAFF 會以不同親和力結合三個 TNF 受體超家族成員——BAFF-R、BCMA 與 TACI；BAFF-R 透過 TRAF3→NIK 活化非典型 NF-κB 途徑，並同時涉及典型 NF-κB、MAPK 與 PI3K/Akt，促進 B 細胞存活、成熟與免疫球蛋白類別轉換。

label: Cyclin E
description: Cyclin E binds CDK2 to drive the G1-to-S transition: Cyclin E-CDK2 phosphorylates retinoblastoma protein, completes E2F release, and fires replication origins. Cyclin E is degraded after S-phase entry by SCF-Fbw7 ubiquitination, and impaired turnover causes replication stress and genomic instability; CCNE1 amplification in ovarian, endometrial and triple-negative breast cancer confers CDK2 dependence.
description_zh_TW: Cyclin E 與 CDK2 結合以驅動 G1 到 S 的轉換：Cyclin E-CDK2 磷酸化 Retinoblastoma Protein、完成 E2F 釋放並啟動複製起始點。Cyclin E 在 S 期進入後由 SCF-Fbw7 泛素化降解，降解受阻會造成複製壓力與基因體不穩定；CCNE1 在卵巢癌、子宮內膜癌與三陰性乳癌中的放大使腫瘤依賴 CDK2。

label: G3BP1
description: G3BP1 is the principal stress-granule scaffold and acts as a cofactor for cGAS: in senescent cells it binds DNA-coated cytoplasmic chromatin fragments and promotes cGAS oligomerization and stable engagement with double-stranded DNA, lowering the activation threshold for cGAS-STING signaling and hence the type-I interferon and NF-kB arms of the SASP.
description_zh_TW: G3BP1 是主要的 stress granule 支架蛋白，並作為 cGAS 的輔因子：在衰老細胞中，它結合被 DNA 包覆的細胞質染色質碎片，促進 cGAS 寡聚化並與雙股 DNA 穩定結合，降低 cGAS-STING 訊號的活化門檻，進而影響 SASP 的第一型干擾素與 NF-κB 分支。

label: SK61_2
description: S6K1/2 (SK61_2), activated by mTORC1 phosphorylation, inactivates IRS1 by phosphorylating it, forming the negative feedback loop that is central to the incoherent bivalent motif underlying rapamycin hormesis. This feedback arm is the backward reaction from the inhibited target (mTORC1) toward the Input node (IRS1, controlled by S6K1/2), and its low Michaelis-Menten constant in the saturated regime strongly increases the probability of biphasic dose-responses. S6K1/2 also deactivates mTORC2, and a significant negative correlation exists between the inhibition of the IRS1-insulin complex and mTORC2 deactivation by the same enzyme S6K1.
description_zh_TW: S6K1/2（SK61_2）被mTORC1磷酸化激活，通過磷酸化使IRS1失活，形成rapamycin hormesis基礎的incoherent bivalent motif核心的負反饋迴路。這個反饋臂是從被抑製的靶點（mTORC1）向輸入節點（IRS1，由S6K1/2控制）的backward reaction，並且其低Michaelis-Menten常數在飽和條件下強烈增加了雙相劑量反應的可能性。S6K1/2還使mTORC2失活，並且在IRS1-胰島素复合物的抑製和同一酶S6K1對mTORC2的失活之間存在顯著的負相關。

label: Epacadostat
description: By blocking IDO1-mediated tryptophan catabolism, epacadostat suppresses kynurenine production and relieves IDO1-driven immunosuppression in the tumor microenvironment. Compensatory upregulation of TDO and IDO2 can drive resistance to this blockade.
