This transition is a necessary early event that reorganizes cell adhesion and signaling before the full pluripotency program is established.
description_zh_TW: 重編程透過確定的階段進行，包括間質到上皮的轉變（MET），其中體細胞成纖維細胞在此過程的早期採用上皮形態。 MET 是由 Oct4 和 Klf4 等因子驅動的，這些因子抑制間質基因並增強上皮基因，這是必需的，因為成纖維細胞是間質的，而 iPSC 是上皮細胞。這種轉變是一個必要的早期事件，在建立完整的多能性程序之前重組細胞黏附和信號傳導。

label: Thromboxane A₂
description: Prostacyclin and Thromboxane A2 are made from the same Prostaglandin H2 pool and act on opposing receptors - IP (Gs-coupled, raising cAMP, inhibiting platelet activation and relaxing smooth muscle) versus TP (promoting aggregation and vasoconstriction). The PGI2/TXA2 ratio at the vessel wall is therefore the key determinant of thrombotic tendency. In pulmonary arterial hypertension prostacyclin deficiency is central to pathogenesis, which is why prostacyclin analogues are mainstay therapy.
description_zh_TW: Prostacyclin 與 Thromboxane A2 由同一個 Prostaglandin H2 池生成，卻作用於相反的受體——IP（Gs 偶聯、升高 cAMP、抑制血小板活化並放鬆平滑肌）對上 TP（促進聚集與血管收縮）。因此血管壁的 PGI2/TXA2 比值是血栓傾向的關鍵決定因素。在肺動脈高壓中，prostacyclin 缺乏是致病機制的核心，因此 prostacyclin 類似物為主線治療。

label: Potassium Persulfate
description: Persulfates is the chemical class containing the peroxydisulfate anion; its common members include potassium persulfate, ammonium persulfate and sodium persulfate, all strong oxidizers used in polymerization and catecholamine oxidation chemistry.
description_zh_TW: Persulfates 為含過二硫酸根陰離子的化學類別；其常見成員包括 [[Potassium Persulfate]]、[[Ammonium Persulfate]] 與 [[Sodium Persulfate]]，皆為用於聚合與兒茶酚胺氧化化學的強氧化劑。

label: Annexin V
description: Propidium Iodide is paired with Annexin V in the standard viability panel: PI is a membrane-impermeant intercalating dye excluded by intact membranes, so Annexin V+/PI− defines early apoptosis while Annexin V+/PI+ marks lytic programs (parthanatos, necrosis, necroptosis, pyroptosis) and late secondary necrosis of uncleared apoptotic bodies.
description_zh_TW: Propidium Iodide 在標準細胞存活面板中與 Annexin V 搭配使用：PI 為膜不通透的嵌入型染劑，完整細胞膜會將其排除，因此 Annexin V+/PI− 定義早期 apoptosis，而 Annexin V+/PI+ 則標記裂解型程序（parthanatos、necrosis、necroptosis、pyroptosis）以及未被清除凋亡小體的晚期次級壞死。

label: Creatine Transporters (CRTR)
description: SLC6A8-encoded Creatine Transporters (CRTR) imports Creatine into Muscle, Heart, and brain against steep concentration gradients, making carrier-mediated uptake the rate-limiting step for tissue Creatine loading.
description_zh_TW: 由 SLC6A8 編碼的 Creatine Transporters (CRTR) 逆著陡峭的濃度梯度將 Creatine（肌酸）輸入 Muscle（肌肉）、Heart（心臟）與腦部，使載體介導的攝取成為組織 Creatine 載入的限速步驟。

label: Endothelial-to-Mesenchymal Transition
description: EndoMT is the transdifferentiation of endothelial cells, which lose their characteristic endothelial markers and acquire mesenchymal, contractile and matrix-producing properties. It is a key mechanism in cardiovascular pathology, vascular ageing and fibrosis.
description_zh_TW: EndoMT 是內皮細胞的轉分化：其失去特有的內皮標記並獲得間質性、收縮性與基質生成特性。它是心血管病理、血管老化與纖維化中的關鍵機制。

label: Allosteric Regulation
description: An allosteric activator is a molecule that binds a protein site topographically distinct from the orthosteric active site, inducing a conformational change that increases the protein's catalytic or functional activity. Unlike orthosteric agonists, it does not compete with the endogenous substrate, which confers higher selectivity and a saturable ceiling effect that limits overactivation.
description_zh_TW: 異位活化劑是結合在蛋白上與正位活性位在拓撲上相異之位置的分子，誘導構形改變以提升該蛋白的催化或功能活性。與正位激動劑不同，它不與內源性受質競爭，因此具有較高選擇性，並具可飽和的天花板效應，可限制過度活化。

label: Rac1
description: Studies suggest that mTORC2 controls the actin cytoskeleton by promoting PKC-alpha phosphorylation, phosphorylation and relocalization of paxillin to focal adhesions, and the GTP loading of RhoA and Rac1. Rac1 is thus downstream of mTORC2 in cytoskeletal control, linking the mTOR pathway to the actin cytoskeleton and focal adhesion dynamics.
description_zh_TW: 研究顯示 mTORC2 藉由促進 PKCα 磷酸化、paxillin 的磷酸化及其向 focal adhesion 的重新定位，以及 RhoA 與 Rac1 的 GTP 載入來控制 actin cytoskeleton。因此 Rac1 在細胞骨架調控中位於 mTORC2 下游，把 mTOR 途徑與 actin cytoskeleton 及 focal adhesion 動態連結起來。

label: Diaziquone
description: Diaziquone is an aziridinylbenzoquinone crosslinker in the alkylator class. Classification by mechanism.
description_zh_TW: Diaziquone 是烷化劑類別中的 aziridinylbenzoquinone 交聯劑。依機制歸類。

label: Translocase of the Inner Mitochondrial Membrane
source_file: Translocase of the Inner Mitochondrial Membrane.md
description: The TIM complex translocates imported precursor proteins bearing mitochondrial targeting sequences across the inner mitochondrial membrane into the matrix, working downstream of the TOM complex. PINK1 passes through TIM during import; successful completion of translocation allows processing by mitochondrial processing peptidase and PARL, which degrades PINK1 and suppresses mitophagy.
description_zh_TW: TIM 複合體在 TOM 複合體下游，將帶有粒線體定位序列的先驅蛋白質跨內膜轉位進入基質。PINK1 在輸入過程中通過 TIM；轉位成功完成後即可被 mitochondrial processing peptidase 與 PARL 加工，導致 PINK1 降解並抑制 mitophagy。

label: DISC
description: DISC activates Caspase-8. The death-inducing signaling complex assembles on ligand-bound death receptors and converts procaspase-8/10 into active initiator caspases. Caspase-8 is the initiator caspase of the extrinsic pathway and also gates the intrinsic pathway through Bid cleavage. The relationship is directional, with DISC acting as the operative agent upon Caspase-8 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: DISC 啟動 Caspase-8。死亡誘導訊號複合物在配體結合的死亡受體上組裝，並將 procaspase-8/10 轉化為活性起始 caspase。 Caspase-8 是 Extrinsic Pathway 的起始半胱天冬酶，也透過 Bid 裂解對 Intrinsic Pathway 進行門控。這種關係是有方向的，DISC 充當 Caspase-8 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Dendritic cells
description: IDO1 is highly expressed in the placenta, lymph nodes, lungs, small intestine, and certain immune cells including dendritic cells, macrophages and monocytes, and it is inducible in many tissues during inflammation. In antigen-presenting cells such as dendritic cells, IDO1 modulates T cell responses peripherally through local tryptophan depletion and kynurenine production, creating an immunosuppressive environment. This expression pattern underlies IDO1's roles in maternal-fetal tolerance (high placental expression), antimicrobial defense, regulation of inflammation and autoimmunity, and tumor immune escape.
description_zh_TW: IDO1 在胎盤、淋巴結、肺、小腸以及樹突細胞、巨噬細胞與單核球等特定免疫細胞中高度表現，並可在發炎期間於許多組織中被誘導。在樹突細胞等抗原呈現細胞中，IDO1 透過局部色胺酸耗竭與犬尿胺酸生成在外周調節 T 細胞反應，創造免疫抑制環境。此表現模式構成 IDO1 在母胎耐受（胎盤高表現）、抗菌防禦、發炎與自體免疫調節以及腫瘤免疫逃逸中所扮演角色的基礎。

label: Lysosomal Storage Disorders
description: Lysosomal storage disorders are ~70 inherited metabolic diseases caused by defects in lysosomal enzymes, membrane proteins or transporters, which lead to intralysosomal accumulation of undegraded macromolecules. Because the lysosome is the terminal degradative compartment shared with Autophagy, LSDs secondarily block Autophagic Flux and cause Oxidative Stress.
description_zh_TW: 溶酶體儲積症是約 70 種遺傳性代謝疾病，由溶酶體酵素、膜蛋白或轉運蛋白缺陷引起，造成未降解大分子在溶酶體內累積。由於溶酶體是與 Autophagy 共用的終末降解胞器，溶酶體儲積症會次級阻斷 Autophagic Flux 並引發 Oxidative Stress。

label: Geroprotectors
description: Geroprotectors are interventions that slow the rate of aging by modulating the conserved hallmarks of aging rather than treating a single disease. This geroscience strategy aims to compress morbidity and extend healthspan.
description_zh_TW: 延緩衰老劑（geroprotectors）是透過調控保守的衰老標誌而非治療單一疾病來減緩衰老速率的介入措施。此老年科學（geroscience）策略旨在壓縮疾病期並延長健康壽命。

label: Itaconate
description: Itaconate is a competitive succinate dehydrogenase inhibitor limiting succinate oxidation and mitochondrial ROS. Inhibition rewires the tricarboxylic acid cycle of inflammatory macrophages.
description_zh_TW: Itaconate 是競爭性 succinate dehydrogenase 抑制劑，限制琥珀酸氧化與粒線體 ROS。抑制重接發炎巨噬細胞的三羧酸循環。

label: QPRT
description: QPRT (quinolinate phosphoribosyltransferase) is a key enzyme in de novo NAD+ biosynthesis, catalyzing the reaction quinolinic acid + PRPP -> nicotinic acid mononucleotide (NaMN) + CO2 + PPi. It requires Mg2+ and PRPP, is highly expressed in liver, kidney and brain, and sits at the junction of tryptophan catabolism and NAD+ production, preventing accumulation of neurotoxic quinolinic acid.
description_zh_TW: QPRT（quinolinate phosphoribosyltransferase）是從頭 NAD+ 生合成的關鍵酵素，催化 quinolinic acid + PRPP → nicotinic acid mononucleotide (NaMN) + CO2 + PPi。它需要 Mg2+ 與 PRPP，在肝、腎與腦高度表現，位於色胺酸分解與 NAD+ 生成交界處，並防止神經毒性的 quinolinic acid 累積。

label: Satoshi Ōmura
description: Omura shared the 2015 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine with William C. Campbell for the discovery of avermectin/ivermectin.
description_zh_TW: 大村與William C. Campbell分享了2015年的阿維菌素/伊維菌素的發現。

label: SLC25A22
description: SLC25A22 (GC1) is a mitochondrial inner-membrane transporter that exchanges cytosolic glutamate for matrix aspartate, importing glutamate into the matrix where it feeds glutathione synthesis and the malate–aspartate shuttle. Mitochondrial glutamate is a limiting precursor for glutathione biosynthesis, so SLC25A22 sustains GSH supply and, by sustaining glutamate flux, activates AMPK which upregulates stearoyl-CoA desaturase and biases membranes toward monounsaturated fatty acids — depriving ferroptosis of its oxidation-prone lipid targets.
description_zh_TW: SLC25A22（GC1）是粒線體內膜轉運蛋白，以細胞質的麩胺酸交換基質中的天門冬胺酸，將麩胺酸輸入基質以供應麩胱甘肽合成與蘋果酸–天門冬胺酸穿梭。粒線體麩胺酸是麩胱甘肽生合成的限量前驅物，因此 SLC25A22 維持 GSH 供應；並藉由維持麩胺酸流活化 AMPK，上調硬脂醯輔酶 A 去飽和酶，使膜脂質偏向單不飽和脂肪酸——剝奪鐵死亡的氧化易感脂質標的。

label: Mitochondrial Intermembrane Space
description: The Mitochondrial Intermembrane Space is the narrow compartment enclosed between the outer and inner mitochondrial membranes, containing a distinct proteome that includes cytochrome c and the IMS-facing domains of the fusion GTPases.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondrial Intermembrane Space 是外膜與內膜之間狹窄的區室，含有獨特的蛋白質組，包括 cytochrome c 以及融合 GTP 酶朝向 IMS 的結構域。

label: Phenylbutyrate
description: Phenylbutyrate inhibits class I/IIA HDACs at stress-response promoters. Same inhibitor class as butyrate and valproate.
description_zh_TW: Phenylbutyrate 在壓力反應啟動子抑制 I/IIA 類 HDAC。與 butyrate 和 valproate 相同的抑制劑類別。

label: MDM2
description: Nutlin 3a is a cis-imidazoline small molecule that binds the p53-binding pocket of the E3 ubiquitin ligase MDM2, disrupting the MDM2–p53 interaction and preventing p53 ubiquitination and degradation (Vassilev et al., 2004). Clinical derivatives RG7112 and idasanutlin have advanced in trials for MDM2-amplified cancers such as AML and liposarcoma.
description_zh_TW: Nutlin 3a 是一順式咪唑啉類小分子，會結合 E3 泛素連接酶 MDM2 的 p53 結合口袋，破壞 MDM2–p53 交互作用，阻止 p53 被泛素化與降解（Vassilev 等人，2004）。其臨床衍生物 RG7112 與 idasanutlin 已進入 AML 與脂肪肉瘤等 MDM2 擴增癌症的臨床試驗。

label: Prostaglandin G₂
description: Prostaglandin G₂ (PGG₂) is the 15-hydroperoxy endoperoxide produced by the bis-dioxygenation of arachidonic acid at the cyclooxygenase site of COX-1/COX-2 — two O₂ additions forming the bicyclic endoperoxide — making it the first committed intermediate of the prostanoid pathway and the site of aspirin's irreversible Ser530 acetylation.
description_zh_TW: Prostaglandin G₂（PGG₂）是在 COX-1/COX-2 的環氧化酶位點由花生四烯酸雙加氧而產生的 15-過氧基內過氧化物——兩次 O₂ 加成形成雙環內過氧化物——使其成為前列腺素路徑的第一個承諾中間產物，也是 aspirin 不可逆乙醯化 Ser530 的作用位點。

label: Aldehyde Dehydrogenases
description: Aldehyde dehydrogenases catalyze NAD(P)+-dependent oxidation of aldehydes such as 3-deoxyglucosone and methylglyoxal to their corresponding, less reactive carboxylic acids, reducing the rate of advanced glycation end product formation.
description_zh_TW: Aldehyde Dehydrogenases 催化 NAD(P)+ 依賴的醛類氧化，將 3-deoxyglucosone、Methylglyoxal 等轉為反應性較低的羧酸，降低 Advanced Glycation End Products 的形成速率。

label: Aldo-Keto Reductases
description: Aldo-keto reductases are NAD(P)H-dependent oxidoreductases that reduce the reactive dicarbonyl 3-deoxyglucosone to the corresponding, less toxic alcohol, removing it before it can cross-link proteins.
description_zh_TW: Aldo-Keto Reductases 是 NAD(P)H 依賴的氧化還原酶，將反應性二羰基 3-deoxyglucosone 還原為毒性較低的醇，在其交聯蛋白之前予以清除。

label: LIPL-1
description: LIPL-1 is a lysosomal lipase in C. elegans that co-localizes with the lysosomal marker PGP-2, confirming its residence within the lysosomal lumen where it hydrolyzes stored triglycerides. Its expression is induced by HLH-30 during fasting, supporting lipophagy-mediated lipid mobilization. LIPL-1 is part of a family of lysosomal lipases (lipl-1 through lipl-5) that together govern organismal lipid turnover. Loss or reduction of these lipases impairs the ability to survive nutrient scarcity.
description_zh_TW: LIPL-1 是線蟲中的一種溶酶體脂肪酶，與溶酶體標記 PGP-2 共定位，確認其位於溶酶體腔內，在此水解儲存的甘油三酯。其表現在禁食期間受 HLH-30 誘發，支持脂噬介導的脂質動員。LIPL-1 是溶酶體脂肪酶家族（lipl-1 至 lipl-5）的一員，共同掌管生物體的脂質週轉。這些脂肪酶的缺失或減少會損害在營養匱乏中存活的能力。

label: Non-REM Sleep
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Honokiol promotes non-rapid eye movement (NREM) sleep and shortens sleep latency. In mouse studies, honokiol at 10 and 20 mg/kg significantly decreased sleep latency and increased the amount of NREM sleep without affecting REM sleep or EEG power density, and it excited sleep-promoting neurons in the ventrolateral preoptic area. These effects occur through the benzodiazepine site of the GABA-A receptor. The combined sleep-promoting and anxiolytic actions suggest a potential role for honokiol as an anesthetic adjunct.
description_zh_TW: 厚朴酚可促進非快速動眼（NREM）睡眠並縮短入睡潛伏期。在小鼠研究中，厚朴酚在 10 及 20 mg/kg 劑量下顯著縮短入睡潛伏期並增加 NREM 睡眠量，但不影響 REM 睡眠或 EEG 功率密度，且會興奮腹外側視前區的促睡眠神經元。這些效應經由 GABA-A 受體的苯二氮平位點產生。促睡眠與抗焦慮作用的結合，顯示厚朴酚可能作為麻醉輔助劑的潛力。

label: MIF
description: Nuclear-translocated Apoptosis-Inducing Factor recruits MIF (PAAN nuclease), which executes large-scale (~50-kbp) chromatinolysis independently of caspases.
description_zh_TW: 轉位入核的 Apoptosis-Inducing Factor 招募 MIF（PAAN 核酸酶），以後者執行 caspase 非依賴的大尺度（~50-kbp）染色質降解。

label: HSF1
description: Heat shock proteins are a conserved family of molecular chaperones induced by proteotoxic, thermal, oxidative, and exercise stress. Their expression is coordinated transcriptionally by heat shock factor HSF1, which binds heat-shock elements to drive HSP induction.
description_zh_TW: 熱休克蛋白是保守的分子伴護蛋白家族，由蛋白毒性、熱、氧化與運動壓力誘導。其表現由熱休克因子 HSF1 在轉錄層面協調，HSF1 結合熱休克元件驅動 HSP 誘導。

label: Assay
description: In adrenochrome research, assays are used to quantify the superoxide anion radical generated during the conversion of epinephrine to adrenochrome. These assays typically exploit the co-oxidation of a detector compound such as oxyhemoglobin, making superoxide production a measurable proxy for catecholamine oxidation rate.
description_zh_TW: 在 adrenochrome 研究中，分析方法用於定量 Epinephrine 轉變為 Adrenochrome 過程中產生的 superoxide anion 自由基。此類分析通常利用 Oxyhemoglobin 等偵測物的共氧化作用，使 superoxide 的生成量成為兒茶酚胺氧化速率的可測代理指標。

label: Sirtuin activating compounds
description: Resveratrol, a naturally occurring stilbenoid from grapes and red wine, is the prototype sirtuin-activating compound and the basis of the French Paradox hypothesis; it binds a hydrophobic pocket on SIRT1, lowering the enzyme's KM for peptide substrate and NAD+ and accelerating deacetylation.
description_zh_TW: Resveratrol 是來自葡萄與紅酒的天然 stilbenoid，是 sirtuin 活化化合物的原型，也是「法國悖論」假說的基礎；它結合 SIRT1 上的疏水口袋，降低酵素對胜肽受質與 NAD+ 的 KM 並加速去乙醯化。

label: Radical-trapping Antioxidant
description: A radical-trapping antioxidant (RTA) halts free-radical chain reactions by donating a hydrogen atom to a chain-propagating lipid peroxyl radical (LOO.), yielding a comparatively stable radical that does not abstract further hydrogen from neighbouring polyunsaturated fatty acids. This chain-breaking action is the chemical basis of suppressing lipid peroxidation and of ferroptosis prevention, and it complements rather than duplicates GPX4, which repairs existing phospholipid hydroperoxides using glutathione.
description_zh_TW: 自由基捕捉型抗氧化劑 (RTA) 藉由向傳遞鏈反應的脂質過氧自由基 (LOO.) 提供一個氫原子來中止自由基鏈反應，產生相對穩定、不再向鄰近多不飽和脂肪酸奪取氫的自由基。這種鏈中斷作用是抑制 lipid peroxidation 與預防 ferroptosis 的化學基礎，與 GPX4 功能互補而非重複：GPX4 是利用 glutathione 修復既有的磷脂過氧化物。

label: Sex Steroid Ablation
description: Sex steroid ablation (SSA), accomplished surgically or with LHRH analogue administration, is a long-standing strategy for thymic rejuvenation. Mice castrated before puberty show delayed thymic atrophy; removal of sex steroids after puberty restores thymic architecture, increases thymic cellularity and enhances thymopoiesis in aged mice and humans. The number of early thymic progenitors, which decrease with age, is normalized after surgical castration. Thymic regeneration following castration is reversed in a dose-dependent manner by administration of testosterone or estrogen, indicating that sex steroids are primary drivers of thymic involution.
description_zh_TW: 性類固醇消融（SSA），通過手術或LHRH類似物給藥實現，是胸腺rejuvenation的長期策略。青春期前閹割的小鼠顯示胸腺萎縮延遲；青春期後移除性類固醇可恢復胸腺結構，增加胸腺細胞密度，並增強老年小鼠和人類的胸腺生成。隨著年齡增長而減少的早期胸腺祖細胞的數量在手術閹割後恢復正常。閹割後的胸腺再生以劑量依賴性的方式被睾酮或雌激素給藥逆轉，表明性類固醇是胸腺退化的主要驅動因素。

label: Gut Dysbiosis
description: In a dextran sodium sulfate colitis mouse model, NMN given by gavage (1 mg/g body weight) reversed gut dysbiosis by increasing microbial abundance and diversity and reshaping community composition. Long-term treatment enriched butyric-acid-producing bacteria such as Ruminococcaceae UCG-014, Prevotellaceae NK3B31 and Akkermansia muciniphila while decreasing potentially harmful taxa including Bilophila and Oscillibacter.
description_zh_TW: 在 dextran sodium sulfate 結腸炎小鼠模型中，經由灌胃給予 NMN（1 mg/g 體重）可逆轉 gut dysbiosis，增加微生物豐富度與多樣性並重塑群落組成。長期處理會富集產生丁酸的細菌（如 Ruminococcaceae UCG-014、Prevotellaceae NK3B31 與 Akkermansia muciniphila），並減少 Bilophila 與 Oscillibacter 等潛在有害類群。

label: Reverse Electron Transport
description: Complex II (succinate dehydrogenase) oxidizes succinate and reduces ubiquinone; its product ubiquinol is the fuel that drives reverse electron transport when the membrane is highly polarized. Succinate accumulation during ischemia makes Complex II a key upstream driver of RET-derived ROS.
description_zh_TW: Complex II（琥珀酸脫氫酶）氧化琥珀酸並還原泛醌；其產物泛醇是膜高度極化時驅動反向電子傳遞（RET）的燃料。缺血期間的琥珀酸累積使 Complex II 成為 RET 來源 ROS 的關鍵上游驅動者。

label: Rigidity
description: Rigidity is a cardinal motor sign of Parkinson's disease, alongside bradykinesia and rest tremor. It is velocity-independent resistance to passive movement — lead-pipe rigidity, becoming cogwheel rigidity when tremor superimposes — and it responds to dopaminergic therapy and deep brain stimulation, distinguishing it from spasticity as a velocity-dependent, upper-motor-neuron phenomenon.
description_zh_TW: Rigidity 是 Parkinson's disease 的主要運動徵狀之一，與 bradykinesia 及靜止性震顫並列。它是與速度無關的被動運動阻力——lead-pipe rigidity，當震顫疊加其上時則成為 cogwheel rigidity——並可對多巴胺能治療與深部腦刺激產生反應，此點使它有別於屬於上運動神經元、與速度相關的 spasticity。

label: TXNIP
description: In pancreatic beta-cells, SIRT6 preserves glucose-stimulated insulin secretion (GSIS) and cell survival by repressing expression of TXNIP, a pro-oxidant and pro-apoptotic protein. This repression is achieved through histone deacetylation, with SIRT6 removing acetylation marks at H3K9 and H3K56 in the TXNIP regulatory region. Directionally, SIRT6 sits upstream of TXNIP suppression via chromatin modification. By keeping TXNIP low, SIRT6 protects beta-cells from glucotoxic damage and maintains their capacity to secrete insulin in response to glucose. This links SIRT6's epigenetic function directly to pancreatic beta-cell health and the preservation of glucose homeostasis.
description_zh_TW: 在胰島β細胞中，SIRT6透過抑制TXNIP的表達來維持葡萄糖刺激的胰島素分泌（GSIS）和細胞存活，TXNIP是一種促氧化和促凋亡蛋白。此抑制透過組蛋白去乙醯化實現，SIRT6在TXNIP調控區域移除H3K9和H3K56的乙醯化標記。方向上，SIRT6透過染色質修飾位於TXNIP抑制的上游。透過保持TXNIP低水平，SIRT6保護β細胞免受葡萄糖毒性的損傷，並維持其對葡萄糖反應分泌胰島素的能力。這將SIRT6的表觀遺傳功能直接與胰島β細胞健康和葡萄糖恆定的維持聯繫起來。

label: Senolytic Drugs
description: Senolytic drugs are agents designed to selectively eliminate senescent cells, the damaged cells that accumulate with age and drive age-related pathology through their pro-inflammatory secretome. Because senescent cells are resistant to apoptosis, senolytics typically target the anti-apoptotic pathways that keep them alive, such as the BCL-2 family members, enabling their clearance while sparing proliferating healthy cells. Clearing senescent cells in animal models delays the onset of age-related diseases, and several senolytics are now being tested in human clinical trials.
description_zh_TW: 老化藥物是一種旨在選擇性消除衰老細胞的藥物，衰老細胞是隨著年齡的增長而積累的受損細胞，並通過促炎分泌組驅動與年齡相關的病理。由於衰老細胞對細胞凋亡具有抵抗力，因此 senolytics 通常針對使它們保持活力的抗細胞凋亡途徑（例如 BCL-2 家族成員），從而在不傷害增殖的健康細胞的同時清除它們。在動物模型中清除衰老細胞可以延緩與年齡相關的疾病的發生，並且有幾種衰老藥物目前正在人體臨床試驗中進行測試。

label: CDKN2B
description: CDKN2B is frequently silenced by promoter methylation in leukaemias, lymphomas, and gliomas, abolishing p15INK4b expression and removing a brake on CDK4/6. This epigenetic inactivation contributes to uncontrolled proliferation in cancer and is often assessed as a prognostic marker in myeloid malignancies. The silencing contrasts with its inducible activation during senescence, highlighting the context-dependent regulation of the locus. Demethylating agents such as decitabine and 5-azacytidine can re-express silenced CDKN2B and restore growth arrest, supporting the locus as a therapeutic target.
description_zh_TW: CDKN2B 在白血病、淋巴瘤與神經膠質瘤中常被啟動子甲基化靜默，廢除 p15INK4b 表現並移除對 CDK4/6 的煞車。此表觀遺傳失活貢獻癌症中不受控的增殖，且常作為骨髓性惡性腫瘤的預後標記評估。此靜默不同於其在衰老期間可誘發的活化，凸顯此基因座依脈絡的調節。去甲基化藥劑如 decitabine 與 5-azacytidine 可重新表現靜默的 CDKN2B 並恢復生長停滯，支持此基因座作為治療標靶。

label: Paraquat
description: Paraquat is a toxic herbicide whose redox cycling generates reactive oxygen species, inducing cellular oxidative stress.
description_zh_TW: Paraquat 是一種毒性除草劑，透過氧化還原循環產生活性氧，誘發細胞氧化壓力。

label: SCAPs
description: Therapy-Induced Senescence is resisted by SCAPs. Therapy-induced senescence is the durable arrest imposed on tumor cells by genotoxic treatments, with both tumor-suppressive and relapse-promoting consequences. Senescent-cell anti-apoptotic pathways are networks (Bcl-2 family, PI3K/Akt) that senescent cells upregulate to resist death and persist. The directionality runs from SCAPs toward Therapy-Induced Senescence, so SCAPs is the active agent and Therapy-Induced Senescence the recipient of the effect. This restraint is biologically significant because it modulates the threshold at which the affected process engages, and when co-opted by tumors it fosters survival and treatment resistance that must be overcome therapeutically.
description_zh_TW: Therapy-Induced Senescence 受到 SCAPs 的抵抗。 Therapy-Induced Senescence是基因毒性治療對腫瘤細胞的持久抑制，具有抑制腫瘤和促進復發的後果。衰老細胞抗凋亡途徑是衰老細胞上調以抵抗死亡並持續存在的網絡（Bcl-2 family、PI3K/Akt）。方向性從 SCAPs 朝向 Therapy-Induced Senescence，因此 SCAPs 是活性劑，Therapy-Induced Senescence 是效果的接受者。這種限制具有生物學意義，因為它調節受影響過程參與的閾值，並且當被腫瘤選擇時，它會促進生存和必須在治療上克服的治療抗藥性。

label: Carbazochrome sulfonic acid
description: Carbazochrome sulfonic acid is a highly water-soluble sulfonate derivative of carbazochrome. The sulfonation greatly improves aqueous solubility and is what makes carbazochrome clinically usable as an injectable haemostatic agent.
description_zh_TW: Carbazochrome sulfonic acid 是 Carbazochrome 的高水溶性磺酸衍生物。此磺化大幅提升水溶性，也正是使 Carbazochrome 能作為可注射止血藥物在臨床上使用的原因。

label: Regenerative Medicine
description: Regenerative medicine uses induced pluripotent stem cells as a source of patient-matched cells for replacing damaged or lost tissue. Because iPSCs can be derived from a patient's own somatic cells and directed to differentiate into any cell type of the three germ layers, they offer the prospect of personalized grafts that avoid immune rejection. Clinical applications include iPSC-derived retinal pigment epithelium for macular degeneration, dopaminergic neurons for Parkinson's disease, and cardiac and neural cells for other degenerative conditions.
description_zh_TW: 再生醫學使用誘導多能幹細胞作為患者匹配細胞的來源，以取代受損或流失的組織。由於 iPSC 可以源自患者自身的體細胞，並可定向分化為三個胚層的任何細胞類型，因此它們為避免免疫排斥的個人化移植提供了前景。臨床應用包括用於治療黃斑部病變的 iPSC 衍生的視網膜色素上皮、用於治療帕金森氏症的多巴胺能神經元以及用於其他退化性疾病的心臟和神經細胞。

label: tumour microenvironment
description: The tumour microenvironment is a heterogeneous ecosystem of malignant cells, cancer-associated fibroblasts, immune and endothelial cells, extracellular matrix and a cytokine soup of growth factors including VEGF and EGF. Tumors secrete VEGF to recruit new blood vessels, ensuring a steady supply of nutrients and oxygen, and hypoxia, low pH and raised interstitial pressure drive drug resistance and immune evasion.
description_zh_TW: 腫瘤微環境（tumour microenvironment）是由惡性細胞、癌相關纖維母細胞、免疫與內皮細胞、細胞外基質，以及含 VEGF、EGF 等生長因子的「細胞激素湯」所構成的異質性生態系。腫瘤分泌 VEGF 以招募新血管，確保營養與氧氣的穩定供應；而低氧、低 pH 與升高的間質壓力則促成藥物抗性與免疫逃脫。

label: YAP1
source_file: _document_ - Ivermectin, a potential anticancer drug derived from an antiparasitic drug.md
description: Activation of the YAP1/TAZ pathway is a molecular driver of hepatocellular carcinoma, and YAP1 is the target of ivermectin's anti-HCC activity. Targeting YAP1/TAZ and downstream metabolic rewiring remains a priority. YAP1 is therefore relevant to both HCC pathogenesis and therapy.
description_zh_TW: YAP1/TAZ 途徑的激活是肝細胞癌的分子驅動因子，而 YAP1 是 ivermectin 抗 HCC 活性的靶點。靶向 YAP1/TAZ 及其下游代謝重編程仍是優先事項。因此 YAP1 與 HCC 的發病機制和治療均相關。

label: SGK1
description: Serum- and glucocorticoid-induced protein kinase 1 (SGK1) is an AGC family kinase that is activated by mTORC2. mTORC2 phosphorylates SGK1 at S422 and PDK1 at T256, and unlike Akt — which retains basal activity when mTORC2 is inhibited — SGK1 activity is totally abrogated under those conditions, making SGK1 a faithful readout of mTORC2 signalling.
description_zh_TW: 血清與糖皮質激素誘導蛋白激酶 1（SGK1）是 AGC 激酶家族成員，由 mTORC2 活化。mTORC2 在 S422 磷酸化 SGK1，PDK1 在 T256 磷酸化；與在 mTORC2 受抑制時仍保有基礎活性的 Akt 不同，SGK1 的活性在此條件下會完全消失，因此 SGK1 是 mTORC2 訊號的忠实讀出。

label: Febuxostat
description: Febuxostat inhibits xanthine oxidase as a non-purine, selective inhibitor that blocks both the oxidized and reduced forms of the enzyme. Compared with allopurinol it achieves more complete suppression of urate production. The directionality is enzyme inhibition to lower urate and less XO-derived ROS. A caveat is that febuxostat carries cardiovascular black-box warnings in some populations and, like allopurinol, does not address pre-existing urate crystal deposits immediately. Febuxostat is primarily metabolized by the liver, allowing use in some renally impaired patients, although cardiovascular safety warnings limit broad adoption.
description_zh_TW: Febuxostat 作為一種非嘌呤選擇性抑制劑抑制 xanthine oxidase，可阻斷此酵素的氧化形式和還原形式。與allopurinol相比，實現了更徹底的尿酸鹽生成抑制。方向性是酵素抑制，以降低尿酸和減少 XO 衍生的 ROS。需要注意的是，febuxostat 在某些人群中帶有心血管黑盒警告，並且與 allopurinol 一樣，不能立即解決預先存在的尿酸鹽晶體沉積物。 Febuxostat 主要由肝臟代謝，允許在一些腎功能不全的患者中使用，儘管心血管安全警告限制了廣泛採用。

label: FKBP38
description: FKBP38 (also called FKBP8) is an outer mitochondrial membrane protein that induces mitophagy independently of the canonical PINK1/Parkin pathway. It acts as a mitophagy receptor that directly tethers mitochondria to autophagosomes without requiring ubiquitination, providing an alternative route for mitochondrial clearance when the PINK1/Parkin pathway is compromised. FKBP38 triggers mitophagy by aggregating LC3 (specifically LC3A) at mitochondria through its LIR motif.
description_zh_TW: FKBP38（又稱 FKBP8）是粒線體外膜蛋白，可不依賴典型的 PINK1/Parkin 途徑誘導 mitophagy。它作為 mitophagy 受體，直接將粒線體與自噬體相連接，無需泛素化，因此當 PINK1/Parkin 途徑受損時提供另一種清除粒線體的方式。FKBP38 透過其 LIR motif 聚集 LC3（尤其是 LC3A）於粒線體上以啟動 mitophagy。

label: Psoriasis
description: TNF-alpha is both a driver and a therapeutic target in Psoriasis: together with IL-17 and IL-6 it drives keratinocyte hyperproliferation, and biologics targeting TNF-alpha (along with IL-17 and IL-23) are highly effective in moderate-to-severe disease, above systemic agents such as methotrexate and ciclosporin.
description_zh_TW: TNF-alpha 在 Psoriasis 中既是驅動因子也是治療標的：它與 IL-17、IL-6 共同驅動角質形成細胞過度增殖，而針對 TNF-alpha（以及 IL-17、IL-23）的生物製劑在中重度疾病中療效顯著，優於 methotrexate、ciclosporin 等全身性藥物。

label: Arterial Thrombosis
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Arterial thrombosis is the pathological formation of a platelet-rich thrombus within an artery, typically over ruptured or eroded atherosclerotic plaques, and is a leading cause of ischemic stroke. Arterial thrombi are dominated by platelets and fibrin rather than the red-cell-rich clots of venous thromboembolism.
description_zh_TW: 動脈血栓是動脈內富含血小板的血栓形成，通常發生在破裂或侵蝕的動脈粥狀硬化斑塊之上，是缺血性中風的主要原因之一。動脈血栓以血小板與纖維蛋白為主，不同於靜脈血栓栓塞的紅血球豐富型血塊。

label: TFEC
description: Transcription Factor EC (TFEC) is one of four members of the MiTF TFE family, alongside TFEB, TFE3 and MITF. TFEC contains the conserved basic helix-loop-helix leucine zipper (bHLH-LZ) domain characteristic of the family, enabling DNA binding to E-box and CLEAR-box motifs.
description_zh_TW: 轉錄因子 EC（TFEC）是 MiTF TFE 家族四個成員之一，其他成員為 TFEB、TFE3 與 MITF。TFEC 含有該家族典型的保守性鹼性螺旋－環－螺旋－白胺酸拉鍊（bHLH-LZ）結構域，可與 E-box 及 CLEAR-box 序列結合。

label: Homocysteine
description: Elevated homocysteine, an intermediate of the methylation cycle whose clearance depends on the transsulfuration pathway, is an established risk factor for cardiovascular disease; dysregulated methylation-cycle flux also links to neural tube defects, cancer and neurodegeneration.
description_zh_TW: homocysteine 是甲基化循環的中間產物，其清除依賴轉硫路徑；homocysteine 升高是心血管疾病已確立的風險因子，而甲基化循環通量失調也與神經管缺陷、癌症與神經退化相關。

label: PI3K/Akt
source_file: _document_ - Fisetin—In Search of Better Bioavailability—From Macro to Nano Modifications A Review.md
description: PI3K/Akt survival kinase signaling is a major pro-growth, anti-apoptotic cascade within SCAPs that promotes senescent-cell persistence. Akt phosphorylates substrates that inhibit pro-apoptotic proteins and sustain metabolic fitness, contributing to the raised death threshold of arrested cells. Its inhibition (e.g., by quercetin or other senolytic agents) lowers the apoptotic threshold of senescent cells and sensitizes them to killing. PI3K/Akt thus represents both a survival pillar of senescence and a pharmacologically tractable senolytic target.
description_zh_TW: PI3K/Akt 存活激酶訊號是 SCAPs 內主要的促生長、抗凋亡級聯，促進衰老細胞存留。Akt 磷酸化抑制促凋亡蛋白並維持代謝適能性的受質，貢獻停滯細胞升高的死亡閾值。其抑制（如透過 quercetin 或其他 senolytic 藥劑）降低衰老細胞的凋亡閾值並使其對殺死敏感。PI3K/Akt 因此既代表衰老的存活支柱，也是可藥物化的 senolytic 標靶。

label: Glucose
description: Hexokinase 2 catalyzes the first rate-limiting glycolytic step, glucose to glucose-6-phosphate.
description_zh_TW: Hexokinase 2 催化第一個速率限制糖解步驟，葡萄糖至葡萄糖-6-磷酸。

label: Toxicity Testing
description: Toxicity testing is the pipeline stage that de-risks drug candidates.
description_zh_TW: 毒性測試是為候選藥物去風險的管線階段。

label: SAMe production
description: By remethylating homocysteine to methionine, MethylB12 supports the production of methionine, the precursor of SAMe, the universal methyl donor consumed by COMT. MethylB12 therefore indirectly influences the rate of COMT-mediated methylation of catecholamines. Its status is coupled to overall methyl-group supply.
description_zh_TW: 透過將同型半胱氨酸再甲基化為蛋氨酸，MethylB12 支持蛋氨酸的產生，蛋氨酸是 COMT 消耗的通用 methyl donor SAMe 的前驅物。因此 MethylB12 間接影響 COMT 介導的兒茶酚胺甲基化速率。其狀態與整體甲基供應相關。

label: tRNA
description: The selenocysteine-specific isoacceptor tRNA[Ser]Sec is the physical carrier of the 21st amino acid: it is first charged with Serine and then converted on the tRNA to Selenocysteine by PSTK and SepSecS. Delivering Selenocysteine through this route determines Selenoprotein output and hence cellular redox resilience.
description_zh_TW: 硒半胱胺酸專一性的同受體 tRNA[Ser]Sec 是第 21 種胺基酸的實際載體：它先被 charge 上 Serine，接著在 tRNA 上由 PSTK 與 SepSecS 轉換為 Selenocysteine。經由此途徑遞送 Selenocysteine 決定了 Selenoprotein 的產量，進而影響細胞的氧化還原韌性。

label: BNIP3
source_file: _document_ - The role of mitochondrial dynamics in disease.md
description: Under hypoxic or ischemic stress, HIF-1α transcriptionally activates BNIP3 in neurons; BNIP3 then inserts into the mitochondrial membrane, causing loss of mitochondrial membrane potential and opening of the Mitochondrial Permeability Transition Pore, producing delayed neuronal death that BNIP3 knockout rescues.
description_zh_TW: 在缺氧或缺血壓力下，HIF-1α 於神經元中轉錄活化 BNIP3；BNIP3 隨後嵌入粒線體膜，造成粒線體膜電位喪失與 Mitochondrial Permeability Transition Pore 開啟，引發延遲性神經元死亡，而 BNIP3 敲除可挽救此現象。

label: CCCP
description: CCCP is a protonophore mitochondrial uncoupler that collapses the mitochondrial membrane potential (ΔΨm) and shuttles protons across the inner membrane, decoupling respiration from ATP synthesis. Sustained uncoupling marks mitochondria for degradation, so CCCP induces Parkin-mediated Mitophagy and effectively depletes the cell of functional mitochondria rather than merely inhibiting their metabolism.
description_zh_TW: CCCP 是一種質子載體型的粒線體解偶聯劑，會崩潰粒線體膜電位（ΔΨm），將質子運送穿過內膜，使呼吸鏈與 ATP 合成脫鉤。持續的解偶聯會將粒線體標記為待分解，因此 CCCP 會誘發 Parkin 媒介的 Mitophagy，實際上是清空細胞內的功能性粒線體，而不只是抑制其代謝。

label: APOE3 Christchurch
description: APOE3 Christchurch is a rare apolipoprotein E3 variant carrying the R136S substitution that confers remarkable resilience against Alzheimer's Disease and dementia, even in individuals with autosomal-dominant AD mutations and abundant Amyloid Beta pathology. Because cognition is preserved despite plaques and tangles, R136S appears to interrupt the downstream toxic signalling that normally converts protein pathology into neuronal dysfunction, making it an unusually informative natural experiment for separating protection from pathology.
description_zh_TW: APOE3 Christchurch 是帶有 R136S 取代的罕見 apolipoprotein E3 變異，即使在帶有體染色體顯性 AD 突變且 Amyloid Beta 病理負荷高的個體中，仍對 Alzheimer's Disease 與失智具有顯著保護力。由於在斑塊與纖維纏結存在的情況下認知功能仍獲保留，R136S 似乎阻斷了將蛋白病理轉為神經元功能障礙的下游毒性訊號，使其成為區分保護機制與病理本身的重要自然實驗。

label: Apoptosome
description: Intrinsic Pathway activates Apoptosome. The intrinsic (mitochondrial) apoptotic pathway is initiated by intracellular damage and is gated at the outer mitochondrial membrane by the Bcl-2 family. The apoptosome is a heptamer of Apaf-1, cytochrome c, and dATP that recruits and activates initiator caspase-9. The relationship is directional, with Intrinsic Pathway acting as the operative agent upon Apoptosome rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Intrinsic Pathway 啟動Apoptosome。內在（粒線體）凋亡途徑由細胞內損傷啟動，並由 Bcl-2 family 在粒線體外膜上進行門控。凋亡體是 Apaf-1、Cytochrome c 和 dATP 的七聚體，可招募並活化起始 caspase-9。這種關係是有方向的，Intrinsic Pathway 充當Apoptosome 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Foam Cells
description: Foam cells are lipid-laden macrophages that have accumulated cholesterol and cholesteryl esters in the cytoplasm, giving them a vacuolated 'foamy' morphology. They are the predominant cell type of fatty streaks, the earliest atherosclerotic lesions.
description_zh_TW: Foam cells 是載滿脂質的 macrophages，其細胞質內累積了膽固醇與膽固醇酯，因而呈現空泡狀的「泡沫」外觀。它們是脂肪條紋（最早的動脈粥狀硬化病灶）中的主要細胞類型。

label: Threonine
description: Threonine is one of the nine essential amino acids that humans cannot synthesize de novo and must obtain from the diet. Beyond its role as a protein-building block, it supports gut mucin barrier integrity and is catabolized by threonine dehydrogenase to glycine and acetyl-CoA, feeding one-carbon metabolism.
description_zh_TW: Threonine（蘇胺酸）是人類無法自行從頭合成、必須由飲食取得的九種必需胺基酸之一。除了作為蛋白質的建構單元外，它還支持腸道黏液屏障的完整性，並由 threonine dehydrogenase 分解為 glycine 與 acetyl-CoA，供應一碳代謝。

label: BMP
description: BMP is a large subfamily of secreted growth factors within the TGFβ superfamily; synthesized as precursors and cleaved to mature C-terminal dimers stabilized by an intramolecular cystine knot, BMPs signal through type I/II serine-threonine kinase receptors to form morphogen gradients.
description_zh_TW: BMP 是 TGFβ 超家族中一大分泌型生長因子亞家族；它們先以前驅物合成，再被切割釋出由分子內 cystine knot 穩定的 C 端成熟二聚體，並透過第一型／第二型絲胺酸－蘇胺酸激酶受體傳訊，形成形態發生的濃度梯度。

label: GABA_A receptor
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Honokiol is a positive allosteric modulator of both synaptic and extrasynaptic GABA-A receptors, a known target of benzodiazepines and other anxiolytics. It shows markedly higher efficacy at receptors containing the delta subunit (900-1100% response) compared with alpha-beta-gamma-only receptors (300-500%), and it allosterically increases the affinity of low-affinity sites, increasing [3H]muscimol binding about three-fold. This GABA-A modulation underpins honokiol's anxiolytic, hypnotic, and anticonvulsant properties and is the basis of its sleep-promoting effects via the benzodiazepine site.
description_zh_TW: 厚朴酚是突觸型與突觸外 GABA-A 受體（苯二氮平類及其他抗焦慮藥物的已知靶點）的正向異位調節劑。在含 delta 亞基的受體上，其效力明顯更高（反應為 900-1100%），相較於僅含 alpha-beta-gamma 的受體（300-500%）；它並以異位方式提高低親和力位點的親和力，使 [3H]muscimol 結合增加約三倍。這種 GABA-A 調節構成了厚朴酚抗焦慮、催眠與抗驚厥特性的基礎，也是其經由苯二氮平作用位點產生促睡眠效果的機制。

label: Ventricular arrhythmias
description: Resveratrol reduces ventricular arrhythmias in preclinical models, likely via antioxidant, ion-channel, and eNOS-modulating actions. Directionally, resveratrol sits upstream of reduced arrhythmogenesis. This adds an electrophysiological benefit to its cardiovascular profile, and it is observed in animal studies with uncertain human translation. The anti-arrhythmic effect may reflect stabilization of cardiac ion channels, reduced oxidative stress, and improved NO signaling in the myocardium. These findings support resveratrol's reputation as a cardioprotective compound, though the relevance to human arrhythmia remains to be established in clinical settings.
description_zh_TW: Resveratrol 在臨床前模型中減少心室心律不整，可能透過抗氧化、離子通道和 eNOS 調節作用。在方向性上，resveratrol 位於減少心律失常的上游。這為其心血管特徵增添了電生理學益處，但在動物研究中觀察到的結果其人類轉化尚不確定。抗心律不整效應可能反映了心臟離子通道的穩定化、氧化壓力的降低以及心肌中 NO 訊號的改善。這些發現支持 resveratrol 作為心臟保護化合物的聲譽，但其與人類心律不整的相關性仍需在臨床環境中確立。

label: Isogenic Pair
description: Isogenic pairs are the gold standard for monogenic causal attribution.
description_zh_TW: 同基因對是單基因因果歸因的黃金標準。

label: EPR spectroscopy
description: Electron paramagnetic resonance (EPR) spectroscopy, also called electron spin resonance (ESR), is a technique that detects species bearing unpaired electrons — paramagnetic species including free radicals, transition metal ions and reactive oxygen species. It measures resonant absorption of microwave radiation by unpaired electrons in an external magnetic field.
description_zh_TW: 電子順磁共振（EPR）光譜，又稱電子自旋共振（ESR），是一種偵測帶有未成對電子的物種（順磁性物種）的技術，包括自由基、過渡金屬離子與活性氧物種；其原理是測量未成對電子在外加磁場中對微波輻射的共振吸收。

label: FOLFOX
description: FOLFOX (5-fluorouracil, leucovorin, oxaliplatin) is the standard adjuvant chemotherapy regimen for stage III and high-risk stage II colon cancer, and a backbone for metastatic disease. FOLFOX and FOLFIRI are interchangeable as first-line chemotherapy in metastatic colon cancer. It is a cornerstone of colon cancer treatment.
description_zh_TW: FOLFOX（5-氟尿嘧啶、亞葉酸、奧沙利鉑）是第三期與高風險第二期結腸癌的標準輔助化療方案，也是轉移性疾病的主幹。FOLFOX 和 FOLFIRI 在轉移性結腸癌中可互換作為一線化療。它是結腸癌治療的基石。

label: Interleukin 11
description: Interleukin-11 binds IL-11Ralpha, which complexes with the shared subunit gp130 to activate JAK (primarily JAK1/TYK2) and STAT3, plus MAPK and PI3K/Akt cascades; IL-11 also engages MAPK and PI3K/Akt signaling to drive fibroblast activation and matrix deposition.
description_zh_TW: Interleukin-11 結合 IL-11Rα，後者與共用次單元 gp130 複合以活化 JAK（主要為 JAK1/TYK2）與 STAT3，並同時啟動 MAPK 與 PI3K/Akt 級聯；IL-11 亦經由 MAPK 與 PI3K/Akt 訊息促成纖維母細胞活化與基質沉積。

label: Trichostatin A
description: Trichostatin A is a potent, broadly acting histone deacetylase inhibitor used extensively in epigenetics and senescence research. By blocking HDAC enzymes, trichostatin A increases histone acetylation, opening chromatin and reactivating genes silenced by deacetylation across the genome. In senescence studies it serves as a tool compound to probe how the balance between histone acetyltransferase and deacetylase activities influences the senescence phenotype, SASP regulation, and chromatin state. It is one of the most widely used tool compounds for manipulating the acetylome experimentally.
description_zh_TW: Trichostatin A 是一種有效、廣泛作用的組蛋白去乙醯化酶抑制劑，廣泛用於表觀遺傳學和老化研究。透過阻斷 HDAC 酶，曲古抑菌素 A 增加組蛋白乙醯化，打開染色質並重新活化整個基因組中因去乙醯化而沉默的基因。在老化研究中，它作為工具化合物來探討組蛋白乙醯轉移酶和去乙醯化酶活性之間的平衡如何影響老化表型、SASP 調節和染色質狀態。它是用於實驗操縱乙醯基組的最廣泛使用的工具化合物之一。

label: Pattern Recognition Receptors
description: cGAS occupies a distinctive position among pattern recognition receptors: it detects double-stranded DNA directly and sequence-independently in both the cytosol and the nucleus, then activates the cGAS-STING Pathway to drive type I interferon production via STING and IRF3. Unlike other PRRs, it also acts in the nucleus as a chromatin- and splicing-associated scaffold.
description_zh_TW: cGAS 在 pattern recognition receptors 中佔有獨特地位：它能直接在細胞質與細胞核中以不依賴序列的方式偵測雙股 DNA，隨後活化 cGAS-STING Pathway，經由 STING 與 IRF3 促進 type I interferon 的產生。與其他 PRR 不同，cGAS 也能在細胞核中作為染色質與剪接相關的支架發揮功能。

label: Histone Demethylase
description: KDM6A belongs to the KDM6 family of histone demethylases, whose JmjC domain uses Fe(II) and alpha-ketoglutarate as cofactors. It is the autosomal-paralog counterpart to JMJD3 (KDM6B), sharing catalytic H3K27me3 demethylase activity but differing in regulatory role: KDM6A is X-linked, escapes inactivation, and drives developmental gene regulation, whereas JMJD3 is autosomal and is a key driver of stress and inflammatory SASP signalling.
description_zh_TW: KDM6A 屬於 KDM6 家族的組蛋白去甲基化酶，其 JmjC 結構域以 Fe(II) 與 α-酮戊二酸作為輔因子。它是 JMJD3（KDM6B）的常染色體旁系同源對應物，兩者共享 H3K27me3 去甲基化活性但調控角色不同：KDM6A 為 X 連鎖、可逃脫失活，主要驅動發育基因的調控；JMJD3 則位於常染色體，是壓力與發炎性 SASP 訊號的關鍵驅動因子。

label: Mitochondrial Superoxide
source_file: _document_ - Neuroprotective Actions of Methylene Blue and Its Derivatives.md
description: Methylene blue (MB) attenuates mitochondrial superoxide production by acting as an alternative electron-transfer carrier that bypasses Complexes I-III, preventing electron backflow and premature electron leak to oxygen at these upstream sites. In HT-22 hippocampal neurons challenged with glutamate, MB dose-dependently suppressed the rise in mitochondrial ROS (EC50 ~20.37 nM), as measured by H2DCFDA, flow cytometry, and fluorescent microscopy. The reduced form leuco-MB can also directly scavenge superoxide and recycle back to oxidized MB, making MB a regenerable, mitochondria-specific antioxidant.
description_zh_TW: 亞甲基藍 (MB) 通過作為替代電子傳遞載體，繞過複合體 I-III，減少線粒體超氧化物的產生，防止電子回流和提前洩漏到這些上游位點的氧氣。在 HT-22 海馬神經元中挑戰穀氨酸，MB 以劑量依賴方式抑制線粒體 ROS 的上升（EC50 ~20.37 nM），通過 H2DCFDA、流式細胞術和螢光顯微鏡測量。還原型 leuco-MB 也能直接清除超氧化物並回收為氧化型 MB，使 MB 成為可再生的、線粒體特異性抗氧化劑。

label: Pregnane X Receptor
description: Indole-3-propionic acid (IPA), the principal microbiota-derived tryptophan metabolite, activates the Pregnane X Receptor (PXR/NR1I2). PXR activation upregulates the barrier gene B3galt5, reinforces mucus and tight-junction defenses, inhibits NF-κB, and suppresses CD4⁺/CD25⁺/Th1 responses, making IPA–PXR signaling relevant to inflammatory bowel disease and barrier integrity.
description_zh_TW: Indole-3-propionic acid（IPA，主要的菌群衍生色胺酸代謝物）會活化 Pregnane X Receptor（PXR/NR1I2）。PXR 活化會上調屏障基因 B3galt5、強化黏液與緊密連結防禦、抑制 NF-κB，並抑制 CD4⁺/CD25⁺/Th1 反應，使 IPA–PXR 訊號與發炎性腸病及屏障完整性相關。

label: Q-VD-OPh
description: Q-VD-OPh is a cell-permeant, irreversible pan-caspase inhibitor used to test caspase dependence in vivo. By blocking caspase-3 and caspase-8 it blocks the caspase-dependent apoptosis program, and in murine ischemia models it protects females only - consistent with the XX preference for caspase-dependent apoptosis over the caspase-independent parthanatos program. It also rescues PARP-1-deficient female cells shunted into cytochrome-c/caspase death.
description_zh_TW: Q-VD-OPh 是一種可穿透細胞、不可逆的泛 caspase 抑制劑，用於在體內檢驗 caspase 依賴性。藉由阻斷 Caspase-3 與 Caspase-8，它阻斷 caspase 依賴性的 Apoptosis 程式；在小鼠缺血模型中它僅保護雌性，與 XX 染色體較偏好 caspase 依賴性 Apoptosis 而非 caspase 非依賴性 parthanatos 的現象一致。它也能挽救被轉入細胞色素 c／caspase 死亡途徑的 PARP-1 缺失雌性細胞。

label: Tau Pathology
description: Tau pathology — abnormal post-translational modification, misfolding and progressive accumulation of the microtubule-associated protein tau within neurons — is a defining feature of Alzheimer's disease and related tauopathies such as progressive supranuclear palsy and frontotemporal dementia. Pathologic tau transitions from physiological microtubule binding into hyperphosphorylated fibrillar species that form Neurofibrillary tangles, impairing axonal transport and synaptic function.
description_zh_TW: Tau 病理——神經元內微管相關蛋白 tau 的異常轉譯後修飾、錯誤摺疊與逐步累積——是阿茲海默症與相關 tau 病（如進行性核上性麻痺與額顳葉失智症）的定義性特徵。病理性 tau 由生理性的微管結合轉為過度磷酸化的纖維狀物種，形成神經纖維糾結，損害軸突運輸與突觸功能。

label: COMT Inhibitors
description: Entacapone belongs to the COMT inhibitor drug class, alongside tolcapone and opicapone. Its clinical role is as an adjunct to levodopa/carbidopa therapy in Parkinson's disease, where prolonging levodopa half-life reduces off time.
description_zh_TW: Entacapone 屬於 COMT 抑制劑這一藥物類別，與 tolcapone、opicapone 同類。其臨床角色是作為 Parkinson's disease 中 levodopa/carbidopa 治療的輔助用藥，藉由延長 levodopa 半衰期減少 off time。

label: Aristoforin
description: Aristoforin belongs to the compound class of sirtuin inhibitors, natural products that suppress sirtuin deacetylase activity to interrogate sirtuin dependence in cancer models. Its micromolar potency and limited selectivity make it a research tool in sirtuin inhibition studies and natural product drug discovery rather than a clinical candidate.
description_zh_TW: Aristoforin 屬於 sirtuin 抑制劑這一化合物類別，即在癌症模型中用於檢驗 sirtuin 依賴性的天然產物，可抑制 sirtuin 去乙醯化活性。由於其僅具微莫耳效力且選擇性有限，它較適合作為 sirtuin 抑制研究與天然產物藥物開發的研究工具，而非臨床候選藥物。

label: Tanikolide
description: Tanikolide, a pentadecanolide-type natural product, is grouped with aristoforin and amurensin G among the natural products that inhibit sirtuins at micromolar concentrations, forming one of several chemical classes catalogued as sirtuin inhibitors.
description_zh_TW: Tanikolide（一種十五烷醇內酯型天然產物）與 aristoforin、amurensin G 一併被歸類於在微莫耳濃度下抑制 sirtuin 的天然產物，構成 sirtuin 抑制劑數個化學類別之一。

label: CRTC2
description: CRTC2 (TORC2) is a CREB-regulated transcriptional coactivator that drives hepatic gluconeogenesis. SIRT1 deacetylates CRTC2 as part of the dynamic regulation of fasting glucose production, complementing its deacetylation of FOXO1 and PGC-1α, so SIRT1 controls gluconeogenesis at several transcriptional coactivator and transcription factor nodes.
description_zh_TW: CRTC2 (TORC2) 是 CREB 調控的轉錄共活化因子，驅動肝臟糖質新生。SIRT1 會去乙醯化 CRTC2，作為禁食時肝臟葡萄糖產量動態調控的一部分，與其對 FOXO1 與 PGC-1α 的去乙醯化互補，因此 SIRT1 在多個轉錄共活化因子與轉錄因子節點上控制糖質新生。

label: Dyslipidemia
description: Nicotinic acid (NA, niacin) shows lowering effects on blood lipid levels, and it is used to treat dyslipidemia, although it is implicated with flushing at doses higher than 50 mg/day. In contrast, nicotinamide (NAM) does not affect lipid blood levels, yet it can exhibit sirtuin-inhibiting effects at higher doses, while nicotinamide riboside (NR) does not cause flushing because it does not activate GPR109A. The distinct physiological responses of the NAD+ precursors NA, NAM, and NR, despite all three raising NAD+ and NADP+ levels, are important for selecting the appropriate precursor for specific therapeutic indications.
description_zh_TW: nicotinic acid（NA，niacin/菸鹼酸）展現降低血脂水平的效果，並被用於治療血脂異常，儘管其在每日劑量高於 50 mg 時與潮紅相關。相對地，nicotinamide（NAM）不影響血脂水平，但其在較高劑量下可展現抑制 sirtuin 的效果，而 nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）因不活化 GPR109A 而不會造成潮紅。NAD+ 前驅物 NA、NAM 與 NR 儘管三者皆提升 NAD+ 與 NADP+ 水平，其截然不同的生理反應對於選擇適當前驅物以用於特定治療適應症相當重要。

label: Liver Regeneration
description: HGF drives the canonical liver repair response after injury. Promotion is its eponymous regenerative function.
description_zh_TW: HGF 在損傷後驅動典型的肝臟修復反應。促進是其名符其實的再生功能。

label: IFN-β
description: Senescent cells accumulate cytosolic DNA — leaked mtDNA and chromatin fragments — that activates cGAS, which produces cGAMP to engage STING. STING recruits TBK1, which phosphorylates IRF3 (and IRF7) and drives transcription of IFN-β, making IFN-β the primary readout of cytosolic DNA–cGAS-STING activation and a component of the interferon arm of the SASP.
description_zh_TW: 衰老細胞會累積細胞質 DNA（漏出的 mtDNA 與染色質片段），活化 cGAS；cGAS 產生 cGAMP 與 STING 結合。STING 招募 TBK1，後者磷酸化 IRF3（及 IRF7）並驅動 IFN-β 的轉錄，使 IFN-β 成為細胞質 DNA–cGAS-STING 活化最主要的讀值，也是 SASP 干擾素分支的組成成分。

label: P-gp
description: Multidrug Resistance is mediated by P-gp. Multidrug resistance is the cross-resistance of tumors to structurally unrelated drugs, most classically mediated by ATP-dependent efflux pumps. P-glycoprotein (ABCB1) is an ATP-binding-cassette efflux pump that expels cytotoxic drugs from cells and is a major mediator of multidrug resistance. The directionality runs from P-gp toward Multidrug Resistance, so P-gp is the active agent and Multidrug Resistance the recipient of the effect. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: Multidrug Resistance是由P-gp介導的。 Multidrug Resistance是腫瘤對結構上不相關的藥物的交叉抗藥性，最經典的是由ATP依賴性外排泵介導的。 P-糖蛋白（ABCB1）是一種ATP結合盒外排泵，可將細胞毒性藥物從細胞中排出，是Multidrug Resistance的主要介質。方向性從 P-gp 朝向 Multidrug Resistance，因此 P-gp 是活性劑，Multidrug Resistance是效果的接受者。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: Tyrosinase-related protein-2
description: Dopachrome tautomerase (DDT) is the historical enzyme name for Tyrosinase-related protein-2 (TRP-2), also known as DCT. Both names refer to the same melanosomal enzyme. It is a type I membrane glycoprotein related to Tyrosinase and TRP-1.
description_zh_TW: Dopachrome tautomerase（DDT）是 Tyrosinase-related protein-2（TRP-2，也稱為 DCT）的歷史性酶名稱。兩個名稱指的是同一種 melanosomal 酶。它是一種與 Tyrosinase 和 TRP-1 相關的 I 型膜醣蛋白。

label: Cholangiocarcinoma
description: Cholangiocarcinoma harbors cancer stem-like cells that drive recurrence and chemoresistance.
description_zh_TW: Cholangiocarcinoma 含有促進復發和化療抗藥性的癌症幹細胞樣細胞。

label: CCL18
description: CCL18 (PARC) is a CC chemokine produced constitutively by dendritic cells and by alternatively activated (M2-like) macrophages, with plasmacytoid/dendritic cells as additional sources. In aging it appears in the secretome of senescent stromal and immune cells, and its induction is driven by IL-4/IL-13 rather than a single senescence master transcription factor.
description_zh_TW: CCL18（PARC）是由樹突細胞與交替活化（M2 型）巨噬細胞持續分泌的 CC 趨化因子，漿細胞樣樹突細胞亦是來源。在老化時它出現在衰老基質與免疫細胞的分泌組中，其誘導主要由 IL-4/IL-13 驅動，而非單一衰老主控轉錄因子。

label: SNCA
description: SNCA is the gene encoding α-synuclein, a small intrinsically disordered presynaptic protein involved in synaptic vesicle trafficking and neurotransmitter release. SNCA point mutations (A53T, A30P, E46K) and gene multiplications are the cause of familial Parkinson's disease, making SNCA both the naming source and the genetic driver of the disease named after the protein.
description_zh_TW: SNCA 是編碼 α-synuclein 的基因；α-synuclein 是一種小型、內在無序的突觸前蛋白，參與突觸小泡運輸與神經傳遞物質釋放。SNCA 的點突變（A53T、A30P、E46K）與基因多複製即造成家族性 Parkinson's disease，使 SNCA 成為該蛋白的命名來源與疾病的遺傳驅動因子。

label: H3K79me2
description: DOT1L modulates the SASP through epigenetic regulation of IL-1alpha: DOT1L controls IL-1alpha expression, a key upstream cytokine of the SASP. Depletion or inhibition of DOT1L reduces SASP while sparing the growth arrest.
description_zh_TW: DOT1L 透過對 IL-1α 的表觀遺傳調控來調節 SASP：DOT1L 控制 IL-1α 的表現，IL-1α 是 SASP 的關鍵上游細胞激素。DOT1L 的耗竭或抑制會減少 SASP，同時保留生長停滯。

label: Endosymbiosis
source_file: _document_ - Mitochondrial Fusion and Fission The fine-tune balance for cellular homeostasis.md
description: Mitochondrial DNA as a circular genome, together with the outer and inner mitochondrial membranes, bacterial-style ribosomes and replication, is among the strongest molecular evidence for endosymbiotic origin of the mitochondrion.
description_zh_TW: 粒線體 DNA 呈環狀，加上粒線體的內外膜、細菌式的核糖體與複製方式，是粒線體內共生起源最強的分子證據之一。

label: Lysosomal Lipolysis
description: Lysosomal acid lipase hydrolyzes cholesteryl esters and triglycerides delivered via lipophagy. Mediation is the enzymatic execution.
description_zh_TW: 溶酶體酸性脂肪酶水解經由脂噬遞送的膽固醇酯與甘油三酯。媒介是酶促執行。

label: MYCN
description: MYCN bridges its transcriptional program to NuRD chromatin remodeling. Interaction couples oncogene output to epigenetic machinery.
description_zh_TW: MYCN 將其轉錄程序橋接至 NuRD 染色質重塑。交互作用將致癌基因輸出耦合到表觀遺傳機器。

label: Celastrol
description: Celastrol is a pentacyclic triterpenoid that is a potent Hsp90 inhibitor and induces Autophagy, while enhancing TFEB-mediated autophagy and mitigating Tau pathology, showing potential for Alzheimer's disease therapy.
description_zh_TW: Celastrol 是五環三萜類化合物，是強效的 Hsp90 抑制劑並誘導 Autophagy，同時增強 TFEB 媒介的自噬並減緩 Tau 病理，對阿茲海默病治療具有潛力。

label: SOX gene family
description: Sox2 is the prototypical pluripotency member of the SOX HMG-box family. Membership anchors the family to reprogramming.
description_zh_TW: Sox2 是 SOX HMG-box 家族典型的多能性成員。成員關係將家族錨定到重編程。

label: Proteinopathy
description: Proteinopathy describes a family of neurodegenerative diseases driven by the misfolding, accumulation and aggregation of specific proteins — Aβ and tau in Alzheimer's disease, α-synuclein in Parkinson's disease, mutant TDP-43 in ALS/FTD, mutant huntingtin in Huntington's disease, and mutant SOD1. Although the offending proteins differ, many proteinopathies generate cytosolic dsDNA that activates cGAS.
description_zh_TW: Proteinopathy 描述一族由特定蛋白錯誤摺疊、累積與聚集所驅動的 neurodegenerative disease——Alzheimer’s disease 的 Aβ 與 tau、Parkinson’s disease 的 α-synuclein、ALS/FTD 的突變型 TDP-43、Huntington’s disease 的突變型 huntingtin，以及突變型 SOD1。雖致病蛋白不同，許多 proteinopathy 會產生可活化 cGAS 的細胞質雙股 DNA。

label: HFF1
description: HFF1 fibroblasts convert efficiently under defined Yamanaka factors.
description_zh_TW: HFF1 纖維母細胞在既定山中因子下有效轉化。

label: Muscle Wasting
description: Nicotinamide riboside (NR) reversed the progressive wasting syndrome in skeletal muscle in mice lacking Nampt while restoring endurance in as little as 1 week of treatment. Decreased NAD+ levels and Nampt expression were also observed in Duchenne's muscular dystrophy (DMD), a condition histologically and transcriptionally similar to progressive wasting syndrome and characterized by increased PARP activity, fibrosis, and muscular degeneration. NR was found to improve muscular function and heart pathology in mdx mouse models of DMD and to decrease PARylation, inflammation, and fibrosis. These findings support NR as an effective approach to managing muscular dystrophy and degeneration.
description_zh_TW: nicotinamide riboside（NR，菸鹼醯胺核糖）逆轉了缺乏 Nampt 小鼠骨骼肌中的漸進性消耗症候群，同時在僅 1 週的治療內恢復耐力。在 Duchenne 肌肉營養不良（DMD）中也觀察到 NAD+ 水平與 Nampt 表現降低，此疾病在組織學與轉錄組學上類似於漸進性消耗症候群，並以 PARP 活性增加、纖維化與肌肉退化為特徵。NR 被發現能改善 DMD 的 mdx 小鼠模型中的肌肉功能與心臟病理，並降低 PARylation、發炎與纖維化。這些發現支持 NR 作為管理肌肉營養不良與退化的有效方法。

label: Erβ
description: Erβ (estrogen receptor β, encoded by ESR2) signaling upregulates SIRT1 expression and activity, coupling estrogen signaling to NAD+-dependent deacetylation, mitochondrial function, and neuroprotection. Estrogen-replacement models show increased SIRT1 levels and reduced oxidative damage.
description_zh_TW: Erβ（estrogen receptor β，由 ESR2 編碼）的訊號傳遞會上調 SIRT1 的表現與活性，將 estrogen 訊號與 NAD+ 依賴型的去乙醯化、粒線體功能及神經保護相連結。Estrogen 替代模型顯示 SIRT1 濃度上升與氧化傷害減少。

label: Rheb
description: Tuberin TSC2 is the catalytic GAP for Rheb. Inhibition is the GTPase-off switch.
description_zh_TW: Tuberin TSC2 是 Rheb 的催化 GAP。抑制是 GTPase 關閉開關。

label: TSC1
description: Tuberous sclerosis complex 1 (TSC1), also known as hamartin, forms a heterodimer with TSC2 to function as a negative regulator of mTORC1 signaling. The TSC1–TSC2 complex acts as a GTPase-activating protein (GAP) for Rheb, driving Rheb into its GDP-bound inactive state and thereby shutting off the kinase that activates mTORC1.
description_zh_TW: 結節性硬化症複合體 1（TSC1，又稱 hamartin）與 TSC2 形成異二聚體，作為 mTORC1 訊號的負向調節因子。TSC1–TSC2 複合體作為 Rheb 的 GTP 酶活化蛋白（GAP），將 Rheb 驅入 GDP 結合的失活狀態，進而關閉活化 mTORC1 的激酶。

label: Hemostatics
description: Adrenochrome monoaminoguanidine is a hemostatic agent formed by reacting aminoguanidine with adrenochrome, an unstable ortho-quinoid intermediate. Along with carbazochrome, it is one of the hydrazine derivatives of adrenochrome that serve as useful medicines with hemostatic activity. In the patented process, stabilization with aminoguanidine is carried out at pH 2 to 5, and the purified compound shows characteristic ultraviolet absorption maxima at 348 nm and 445 nm that confirm its identity. The product is isolated by filtration, washed and dried to a powder, and may be further purified by active carbon treatment and recrystallization.
description_zh_TW: 腎上腺紅單胺基胍是由胺基胍與腎上腺紅（一種不穩定的鄰醌式中間體）反應形成的止血劑。與carbazochrome一起，它是腎上腺紅的肼衍生物之一，可作為具有止血活性的實用藥物。在該專利方法中，以胺基胍進行穩定化的操作在pH 2至5下進行，純化後的化合物呈現348 nm和445 nm的特徵紫外線吸收極大值，確認其身份。產物經過濾分離、洗滌並乾燥成粉末，並可進一步經活性碳處理和重結晶純化。

label: Polymerization
description: Beyond adrenochrome chemistry, ammonium persulfate serves as a free radical initiator for acrylamide gel polymerization, reacting with TEMED to generate persulfate free radicals that crosslink acrylamide monomers into a polyacrylamide matrix for SDS-PAGE.
description_zh_TW: 除了 adrenochrome 化學之外，Ammonium Persulfate 也用作 acrylamide 凝膠 Polymerization 的自由基起始劑，與 TEMED 反應產生 persulfate 自由基，將 acrylamide 單體交聯成 SDS-PAGE 用的 polyacrylamide 矩陣。

label: RSK
description: RSK phosphorylates APAF-1 at Ser268, causing inhibition in prostate cancer cells.
description_zh_TW: RSK 在 Ser268 磷酸化 APAF-1，在攝護腺癌細胞中造成抑制。

label: CCNDBP1
description: CCNDBP1 (GCIP) is named for its binding of Cyclin D, which connects it to control of Cell Cycle progression, differentiation and cellular stress responses. Because SIRT6 suppresses proliferation in part through CCNDBP1, loss of SIRT6 or failure of CCNDBP1 deacetylation may release cell-cycle brakes — relevant to cancer and age-related proliferative dysregulation.
description_zh_TW: CCNDBP1（GCIP）因其與 Cyclin D 結合而得名，這使它與 Cell Cycle 進程、分化及細胞壓力反應的調控相連。由於 SIRT6 部分藉由 CCNDBP1 抑制增殖，SIRT6 的喪失或 CCNDBP1 去乙醯化失敗，都可能釋放細胞週期的煞車，與癌症及年齡相關的增殖失調相關。

label: Sodium Valproate
description: Sodium valproate is an anticonvulsant and mood-stabilizing drug that also acts as a histone deacetylase inhibitor at therapeutic concentrations. By inhibiting class I HDACs, valproate increases histone acetylation and alters the expression of many genes, which contributes to its clinical effects and underlies its use as an experimental epigenetic modulator. Valproate is also used in research to enhance reprogramming, promote differentiation, and study the role of acetylation in gene regulation and aging.
description_zh_TW: 丙戊酸鈉是一種抗驚厥藥和情緒穩定藥，在治療濃度下也可用作組蛋白去乙醯化酶抑制劑。透過抑制 I 類 HDAC，丙戊酸增加組蛋白乙醯化並改變許多基因的表達，這有助於其臨床效果並奠定其作為實驗性表觀遺傳調節劑的基礎。丙戊酸也用於增強重編程、促進分化以及研究乙醯化在基因調控和老化中的作用的研究。

label: Aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase
description: Aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase and L-DOPA are reciprocally linked entities in the neuromelanin knowledge graph, reflecting their frequent co-occurrence and shared relevance to catecholamine biology or Parkinson's disease. Directionally, the graph relation is symmetric, although biologically Aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase and L-DOPA may occupy distinct mechanistic roles. Their association is significant because both contribute to the chemical and pathological network that defines vulnerability of pigmented neurons. A caveat is that a bidirectional link denotes an association rather than a proven direct causal mechanism between the two entities.
description_zh_TW: Aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase 和 L-DOPA 是 neuromelanin 知識圖譜中相互連結的實體，反映了它們的頻繁共現以及與兒茶酚胺生物學或 Parkinson's disease 的共享相關性。從方向上看，圖關係是對稱的，儘管從生物學角度來看，Aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase 和 L-DOPA 可能佔據不同的機制角色。它們的關聯很重要，因為兩者都有助於定義色素神經元脆弱性的化學和病理網絡。需要注意的是，雙向連結表示兩個實體之間的關聯，而不是經過驗證的直接因果機制。

label: NEMO
description: NEMO (NF-κB essential modulator) is the regulatory subunit of the IKK complex; without NEMO the canonical IKKα/IKKβ activation that degrades IκB and liberates NF-κB cannot proceed.
description_zh_TW: NEMO（NF-κB 必需調控因子）為 IKK 複合體的調節亞基；缺乏 NEMO 時，降解 IκB 並釋放 NF-κB 的典型 IKKα/IKKβ 活化無法進行。

label: FokI
description: FokI is a type IIS restriction endonuclease that binds a non-palindromic GGATG recognition site but cleaves DNA nonspecifically 9–13 bp downstream, which is why it is fused to programmable DNA-binding modules to cut mutant mtDNA selectively and shift heteroplasmy toward wild-type genomes.
description_zh_TW: FokI 是一種 type IIS 限制性內切酶，辨識非回文的 GGATG 序列，但在其下游 9–13 bp 處非專一性地切割 DNA；因此它被與可程式化 DNA 結合模組融合，以專一性切割突變 mtDNA 並將 heteroplasmy 轉向野生型基因組。

label: Cyclin A
description: Cyclin A is an S/G2-phase cyclin whose complex with CDK2 initiates and executes S phase, with Cyclin A-CDK1 later contributing to mitotic entry. Cyclin A is then degraded via the APC/C at the metaphase-anaphase transition, enforcing irreversible cell-cycle progression.
description_zh_TW: Cyclin A 是 S/G2 期的 cyclin，與 CDK2 形成的複合體啟動並執行 S 期，之後 Cyclin A-CDK1 參與有絲分裂進入。Cyclin A 隨後在中期-後期轉換時經 APC/C 降解，使細胞週期進展不可逆。

label: Septic Shock
description: Norepinephrine, an α1-adrenergic agonist raising vascular tone with modest β1-mediated inotropy, is the prototypical first-line vasopressor for Septic Shock and most distributive shocks. Dopamine is now reserved for selected cases because of arrhythmogenic risk; Epinephrine is preferred in refractory hypotension and anaphylactic shock; Angiotensin II acts via the renin–angiotensin system as a rescue agent.
description_zh_TW: Norepinephrine 為 α1-adrenergic agonist，兼具提升血管張力與溫和的 β1 正性肌力作用，是 Septic Shock 與多數 distributive shock 的典型第一線 Vasopressor。Dopamine 因心律不整風險現僅保留於特定情境；Epinephrine 則用於 refractory hypotension 與過敏性休克；Angiotensin II 經 renin–angiotensin system 作用，作為救援藥物。

label: ALOX15
description: Phosphatidylethanolamine esterified with arachidonic or adrenic acid at the sn-2 position is the key peroxidation substrate on which Ferroptosis is executed. Lipoxygenases such as ALOX15 directly oxygenate PUFA-PE, and the resulting PE-OOH is the proximal lethal species whose accumulation disrupts membrane integrity; its peroxidation is more lethal than that of phosphatidylcholine.
description_zh_TW: 在 sn-2 位置以 arachidonic acid 或 adrenic acid 酯化的 Phosphatidylethanolamine 是 Ferroptosis 執行的關鍵過氧化底物。ALOX15 等 Lipoxygenase 可直接氧化 PUFA-PE，產生的 PE-OOH 是造成細胞死亡的近端致死物種，其累積會破壞膜完整性；PE 的過氧化致死性高於 phosphatidylcholine。

label: Condensin
description: Condensin is a structural maintenance of chromosomes complex built around an SMC2-SMC4 heterodimer. ATP-dependent conformational changes at the hinge and head let it extrude DNA loops, compact chromosomes during mitosis and shape interphase chromatin architecture, organizing topologically associating domains.
description_zh_TW: Condensin 是以 SMC2-SMC4 異二聚體為核心的染色體結構維持複合體。hinge 與 head 的 ATP 依賴性構形變化使其能擠出 DNA 迴圈、在有絲分裂期間凝縮染色體，並塑造間期染色質架構以組織拓撲關聯結構域。

label: GABPβ1
description: SIRT7 deacetylates GA-binding protein beta1 (GABPbeta1), a subunit of the GABP transcription factor complex that controls expression of nuclear-encoded mitochondrial genes. Deacetylation facilitates GABP complex formation and transcriptional activation of these genes, supporting mitochondrial biogenesis and function. Directionally, SIRT7 sits upstream of GABP-dependent mitochondrial gene expression. SIRT7 deficiency accordingly causes systemic mitochondrial dysfunction, manifesting as lactate accumulation and cardiac abnormalities.
description_zh_TW: SIRT7去乙醯化GA結合蛋白beta1（GABPbeta1），這是控制核編碼粒線體基因表達的GABP轉錄因子複合物的一個亞基。去乙醯化促進GABP複合物的形成和這些基因的轉錄活化，支持粒線體生成和功能。方向上，SIRT7位於GABP依賴性粒線體基因表達的上游。因此SIRT7缺乏會導致全身粒線體功能障礙，表現為乳酸積累和心臟異常。

label: Progenitor Cell
description: Neural stem cells yield radial-glial and intermediate progenitors. Generation is the lineage output of the stem pool.
description_zh_TW: 神經幹細胞產生放射狀膠質與中間祖細胞。產生是幹細胞池的譜系輸出。

label: CBP
description: CBP (CREB-binding protein, CREBBP) is a transcriptional coactivator that regulates CREB-dependent gene expression, participates in macromolecular complexes governing cell behaviour, and is regulated post-translationally by phosphorylation and ubiquitination.
description_zh_TW: CBP（CREB-binding protein，CREBBP）是轉錄共同活化因子，可調控 CREB 依賴性的基因表現，參與支配細胞行為的大分子複合體，並受磷酸化與泛素化等轉譯後修飾調控。

label: CXCL1
description: CXCL1 (GROalpha/NAP-3) is an ELR+ C-X-C chemokine that signals with high affinity through CXCR2 and, at lower affinity, CXCR1. Receptor activation couples to Galphai, triggering PLCbeta-IP3/DAG-Ca2+ flux, PI3K/Akt, and MAPK/ERK and p38 MAPK cascades, driving neutrophil degranulation, ROS production and transendothelial migration that amplify local inflammation.
description_zh_TW: CXCL1（GROα/NAP-3）是 ELR+ 的 C-X-C 趨化因子，以高親和力經由 CXCR2 訊號傳遞，並以較低親和力作用於 CXCR1。受體活化後耦合 Gαi，觸發 PLCβ–IP3/DAG–Ca2+ flux、PI3K/Akt 以及 MAPK/ERK 與 p38 MAPK 級聯反應，促使中性球脫顆粒、產生 ROS 並進行跨內皮移行，放大局部發炎。

label: Heteroplasmy
description: Wild-type and mutant mitochondrial genomes coexist below the clinical threshold because Mitochondrial Fusion mixes organelle contents and lets wild-type mtDNA complement mutant molecules, maintaining sufficient respiratory output. Fragmentation impairs this buffering, which is why the high mutant load of Heteroplasmy only becomes symptomatic above roughly 60–80%.
description_zh_TW: 野生型與突變型粒線體基因組之所以能在臨床閾值以下共存，是因為 Mitochondrial Fusion 會混合胞器內容物，讓野生型 mtDNA 互補突變分子，維持足夠的呼吸輸出。碎裂則會破壞這種緩衝能力，因此 Heteroplasmy 的突變負荷通常要超過約 60–80% 才會出現症狀。

label: Mdl1
description: Mdl1 is a type I ABC exporter in the budding yeast inner mitochondrial membrane that transports 6-20 amino acid peptides generated by matrix proteases such as ClpXP and Lon out of the matrix. Loss-of-function mdl1 mutants show blunted induction of UPRmt target genes upon mitochondrial proteotoxic stress, indicating that peptide egress is an early, necessary step in relaying organelle folding status to the nucleus.
description_zh_TW: Mdl1 是出芽酵母粒線體內膜上的 type I ABC 輸出器，將由 ClpXP 與 Lon 等基質蛋白酶產生的 6–20 胺基酸胜肽運出基質。mdl1 失功能突變株在粒線體蛋白毒性壓力下呈現 UPRmt 目標基因誘導鈍化，顯示胜肽外排是將胞器摺疊狀態傳遞至細胞核的早期且必要步驟。

label: Pancreatic Ductal Adenocarcinoma
source_file: _document_ - NAD+ Precursors Nicotinamide Mononucleotide (NMN) and Nicotinamide Riboside (NR) Potential Dietary Contribution to Health.md
description: In pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDA), TFEB remains constitutively nuclear-localized and active independent of nutrient status, supporting the tumor's high demand for lysosomal degradation and metabolic flexibility. This aberrant activation promotes expression of glutaminase and other catabolic genes that fuel PDA growth under the harsh tumor microenvironment. The nutrient-independent nuclear TFEB state distinguishes PDA from normal epithelial regulation and contributes to therapy resistance. Targeting TFEB or its effectors is being explored as a therapeutic strategy in this lethal cancer.
description_zh_TW: 在胰腺導管腺癌（PDA）中，TFEB 持續性地核定位並維持活化，獨立於營養狀態，支持腫瘤對溶酶體降解和代謝靈活性的高需求。此異常活化促進了 glutaminase 和其他分解代謝基因的表現，在嚴苛的腫瘤微環境中供給 PDA 生長。此不依賴營養的核 TFEB 狀態將 PDA 與正常上皮調節區分開來，並促成治療抗性或耐藥。標靶 TFEB 或其效應物正被探索作為此致命癌症的治療策略。

label: Insulin
description: Insulin-degrading enzyme (IDE, insulysin) is a zinc metalloprotease best known for cleaving insulin and other small peptides and thereby regulating insulin clearance, limiting hyperinsulinaemia.
description_zh_TW: Insulin-degrading enzyme（IDE，insulysin）是一種鋅金屬蛋白酶，最著名的是切割胰島素與其他小胜肽，藉此調節胰島素清除、限制高胰島素血症。

label: RRM2
description: Mammalian ribonucleotide reductase assembles as an alpha2beta2 heterotetramer in which RRM2 provides the small (beta) subunit housing the diferric-tyrosyl radical cofactor. RRM2 is S-phase restricted and the primary target of hydroxyurea and triapine. RRM2 encodes the small (beta) subunit of human ribonucleotide reductase that houses the diferric-tyrosyl radical cofactor driving catalysis. The radical is relayed about 32-40 A to the RRM1 active site through a proton-coupled electron-transfer pathway to form the catalytic thiyl radical.
description_zh_TW: 哺乳類核醣核苷酸還原酶組裝為 alpha2beta2 異四聚體，其中 RRM2 提供容納雙鐵-酪胺醯自由基輔因子的（beta）小次單元。RRM2 局限於 S 期表現，並是 hydroxyurea 與 triapine 的主要靶點。 RRM2 編碼人類核醣核苷酸還原酶的小型（beta）次單元，容納驅動催化作用的雙鐵-酪胺醯自由基輔因子。該自由基經質子耦合電子轉移途徑被中繼約 32-40 A 至 RRM1 活性位點，以形成催化性硫基自由基。

label: Cardiac Fibrosis
description: SIRT4 contributes to cardiac fibrosis; global SIRT4 knockout in mice confers resistance to angiotensin-II infusion by suppressing fibrotic deposition. Directionally, SIRT4 sits upstream of profibrotic signaling. This aligns with SIRT4's general tendency to promote pathological remodeling, contrasting with the antifibrotic SIRT1/SIRT3/SIRT6 members. SIRT4's profibrotic action likely reflects its inhibition of mitochondrial oxidative metabolism and promotion of oxidative stress. The opposing roles of SIRT4 versus the protective sirtuins in cardiac fibrosis illustrate the functional antagonism within the sirtuin family and the importance of the SIRT3/SIRT4 balance.
description_zh_TW: SIRT4 促進心臟纖維化；SIRT4 的全身敲除通過抑制纖維化沉積賦予對血管張力素 II 輸注的抗性。在方向性上，SIRT4 位於促纖維化信號的上游。這與 SIRT4 促進病理性重塑的總體趨勢一致，與抗纖維化的 SIRT1/SIRT3/SIRT6 成員形成對比。SIRT4 的促纖維化作用可能反映其對粒線體氧化代謝的抑制和對氧化壓力的促進。SIRT4 與保護性 sirtuin 在心臟纖維化中的對立角色說明了 sirtuin 家族內的功能拮抗以及 SIRT3/SIRT4 平衡的重要性。

label: GDH
source_file: _document_ - Sirtuins and their Biological Relevance in Aging and Age-Related Diseases.md
description: GDH is the primary substrate through which SIRT4 suppresses glutamine metabolism, yet GDH is also listed among negative regulators in Table 3: high GDH activity can outpace SIRT4 ADP-ribosylation under energetic stress, switching cells toward glutaminolysis/fuel oxidation and away from SIRT4-mediated restraint.
description_zh_TW: GDH 是 SIRT4 抑制穀胺酸代謝的主要底物，但 GDH 也被列為表 3 中的負向調節因子：在能量壓力下，高 GDH 活性可能超過 SIRT4 的 ADP-核糖基化，使細胞轉向穀氨醯胺分解/燃料氧化，脫離 SIRT4 介導的限制。

label: Histone H4
description: SIRT2 deacetylates Lys16 on histone H4 (H4K16ac), a modification linked to chromatin condensation during the G2/M transition of mitosis. Removing H4K16ac promotes a more compact mitotic chromatin state compatible with chromosome segregation and mitotic fidelity. Enzymatically, SIRT2 directly deacetylates H4K16 to remodel chromatin at division, complementing its actions on α-tubulin and mitotic regulators. This chromatin function, together with SIRT2's peak expression at G2/M, couples deacetylation to cell-cycle control, and its loss is associated with mitotic defects, genomic instability, and, in some cancers, tumor progression.
description_zh_TW: SIRT2 去乙醯化組蛋白 H4 上的 Lys16（H4K16ac），這種修飾與有絲分裂 G2/M 轉變期間的染色質凝縮相關。移除 H4K16ac 促進更緊密的有絲分裂染色質狀態，適合染色體分離和有絲分裂忠實度。在酶學上，SIRT2 直接去乙醯化 H4K16 以在分裂時重塑染色質，與其對 α-tubulin 和有絲分裂調節因子的作用互補。這種染色質功能與 SIRT2 在 G2/M 期的表達高峰相結合，將去乙醯化與細胞週期控制偶聯，其缺失與有絲分裂缺陷、基因組不穩定性以及某些癌症中的腫瘤進展相關。

label: 5,6-Dihydroxyindole
description: 5,6-Dihydroxyindole (DHI) is the reducing indole monomer released by spontaneous decarboxylation and reduction of Dopachrome during melanogenesis; its carboxylic acid analog DHICA arises via dopachrome tautomerase. DHI is the prototypical eumelanin monomer.
description_zh_TW: 5,6-Dihydroxyindole（DHI）是在 melanogenesis 過程中 Dopachrome 自發脫羧與還原所釋出的還原性 indole 單體；其羧酸類似物 DHICA 則由 dopachrome tautomerase 產生。DHI 是 eumelanin 的典型單體。

label: Polycomb Group Proteins
description: XIST recruits Polycomb chromatin modifiers to the inactive X.
description_zh_TW: XIST 將 Polycomb 染色質修飾因子招募至不活化 X。

label: Interleukin 33
description: Interleukin-33 released from senescent hepatic stellate cells activates group 2 innate lymphoid cells, eosinophils and regulatory T cells, reshaping the tumor microenvironment toward immune suppression and promoting hepatocellular carcinoma development.
description_zh_TW: 由衰老肝星狀細胞釋放的 Interleukin-33 活化第 2 型先天淋巴球細胞（ILC2s）、嗜伊紅性球與調節型 T 細胞，使腫瘤微環境轉向免疫抑制並促進肝細胞癌的發展。

label: Stem Cell Research
description: Gene editing is widely used in stem-cell models and isogenic lines.
description_zh_TW: 基因編輯廣泛用於幹細胞模型與同基因系。

label: Diabetic Retinopathy
description: SIRT1 overexpression prevents capillary pericyte and endothelial cell apoptosis and degenerative capillary formation in diabetic retinopathy, reducing retinal inflammation and improving visual function. SIRT1 activation is a retinal-protective strategy targeting the microvascular complications of diabetes.
description_zh_TW: SIRT1 過度表現可預防糖尿病視網膜病變中的微血管周細胞與內皮細胞凋亡及退化性微血管形成，減少視網膜發炎並改善視覺功能。SIRT1 活化是針對糖尿病微血管併發症的視網膜保護策略。

label: Insulin Signaling
description: PTP1B is a 50 kDa ER-associated non-receptor tyrosine phosphatase that dephosphorylates and inactivates the insulin receptor and IRS proteins, terminating the insulin signal. Its position next to the ER — where internalized receptor localizes — lets it dephosphorylate the receptor en route to degradation.
description_zh_TW: PTP1B 是 50 kDa、附著於內質網的非受體酪胺酸磷酸酶，藉由去磷酸化並使胰島素受體與 IRS 蛋白失活來終止胰島素訊號。由於它緊鄰內質網（內吞後的受體所在位置），可在受體被降解的途徑上將其去磷酸化。

label: SMAD4
description: Phosphorylated SMAD2/3 obligatorily complex with the co-SMAD SMAD4 to regulate target-gene transcription downstream of Activin A-ALK4. This SMAD4-dependent step couples ligand binding to induction of cell-cycle inhibitors in recipient cells.
description_zh_TW: 磷酸化 SMAD2/3 必須與共 SMAD SMAD4 形成複合體，才能調節 Activin A-ALK4 下游的標的基因轉錄。此 SMAD4 依賴步驟將配體結合耦合到受體細胞中細胞週期抑制因子的誘發。

label: DAMP
description: Damage-Associated Molecular Patterns include cytosolic chromatin fragments and mitochondrial DNA, which act as DAMPs that activate cGAS-STING signalling. In senescent cells this cGAS activation drives STING-dependent expression of the SASP, and HMGB1 release from senescent cells further amplifies the inflammatory signalling, linking senescence to Inflammation.
description_zh_TW: DAMP（損傷相關分子模式）包含細胞質中的染色質碎片與粒線體 DNA，它們作為 DAMPs 活化 cGAS-STING 訊號。在衰老細胞中，此 cGAS 活化驅動 SASP（衰老相關分泌表型）的 STING 依賴性表現，而衰老細胞釋放 HMGB1 進一步放大發炎訊號，將衰老與 Inflammation（發炎）相連結。

label: Simian Virus 40
description: SV40 large T antigen binds and inactivates p53 — an interaction that in fact enabled p53's discovery through co-immunoprecipitation — and also inactivates the pRb family, leading to cellular transformation.
description_zh_TW: SV40 large T antigen 會結合並使 p53 失活；正是這種交互作用（透過共同免疫沉澱）促成了 p53 的發現。此外它也會使 pRb 家族失活，導致細胞轉化。

label: Tel1p
description: Tel1p contributes to the establishment of telomeric and subtelomeric silencing by promoting recruitment and proper localization of the Sir2/Sir4 complex. At subtelomeric regions Sir2 deacetylates histone H4 lysine 16, facilitating the spread of repressed heterochromatin in a process that requires Tel1p function for efficient silencing.
description_zh_TW: Tel1p 藉由促進 Sir2/Sir4 複合體的招募與正確定位，參與建立端粒與亞端粒沉默。在亞端粒區域，Sir2 去乙醯化組蛋白 H4 的離胺酸 16，促進抑制性異染色質的擴散；此過程需要 Tel1p 功能才能有效沉默。

label: Interferon-Stimulated Genes
description: Interferon-stimulated genes are the aggregated transcriptional output of type I interferon signaling: IFN-I binding IFNAR1 activates JAK-STAT pathways that induce hundreds of ISGs whose products establish an antiviral and inflammatory cellular state.
description_zh_TW: 干擾素刺激基因是第一型干擾素訊息傳遞的聚合轉錄輸出：IFN-I 結合 IFNAR1 後活化 JAK-STAT 途徑，誘導數百個 ISG，其蛋白產物建立抗病毒與發炎性的細胞狀態。

label: Lysine
source_file: _document_ - Aminoguanidine An AGE Product Inhibitor  Antiaging Systems Articles.md
description: Lysine is one of the primary amino acids that reacts with reducing sugars in the Maillard Reaction. Glucose first attaches non-enzymatically to a free lysine (or arginine) residue of a protein, lipid or DNA to form a Schiff base, which progresses to advanced glycation end products such as pyrraline. Because lysine residues are abundant and surface-exposed, they are the dominant glycation sites in long-lived matrix proteins.
description_zh_TW: Lysine 是與還原糖在 Maillard Reaction 中反應的主要胺基酸之一。葡萄糖先以非酵素方式附著於蛋白質、脂質或 DNA 上游離的 lysine（或 arginine）殘基形成 Schiff base，進而生成 pyrraline 等 advanced glycation end products。由於 lysine 殘基數量多且易暴露於表面，它們是長壽命基質蛋白的主要醣化位點。

label: Lipoxygenase
description: 5-, 12- and 15-Lipoxygenase insert molecular oxygen at C5, C12 or C15 of Arachidonic acid to yield the corresponding HPETEs, which peroxidases then reduce to 5-, 12- and 15-HETE. This route is stereospecific: LOX-derived HETEs are predominantly the S enantiomer, for example 15S-HETE from 15-lipoxygenase. Chiral lipidomics can therefore separate enzyme-derived 15S-HETE from the 15R-HETE plus racemate produced by free radicals, which is what makes the class a fingerprint of enzymatic versus radical oxidation.
description_zh_TW: 5-、12- 與 15-Lipoxygenase 在 Arachidonic acid 的 C5、C12 或 C15 位置插入分子氧，生成相應的 HPETEs，再由 peroxidases 還原為 5-、12- 與 15-HETE。此途徑具立體專一性：LOX 衍生的 HETE 以 S 對映體為主，例如來自 15-lipoxygenase 的 15S-HETE。因此手性脂質體學可將酵素衍生的 15S-HETE 與自由基產生的 15R-HETE 加外消旋體分開，這正是這一族能作為酵素性氧化與自由基氧化指紋的原因。

label: Wuchereria bancrofti
description: Lymphatic filariasis (elephantiasis) is a mosquito-borne neglected tropical disease caused by thread-like filarial nematodes: Wuchereria bancrofti accounts for roughly 90% of cases, with Brugia malayi and Brugia timori responsible for the remainder. Adult worms in lymphatic vessels release microfilariae, and chronic infection elicits inflammation and fibrosis of lymphatic endothelium, causing lymphedema, hydrocele and recurrent acute dermatolymphangioadenopathy.
description_zh_TW: Lymphatic filariasis（elephantiasis）是一種由蚊媒傳播的 neglected tropical disease，由絲狀線形蟲引起：Wuchereria bancrofti 約佔 90% 病例，其餘由 Brugia malayi 與 Brugia timori 造成。淋巴管中的成蟲釋出微絲蟲，慢性感染引發淋巴內皮的 inflammation 與纖維化，造成 lymphedema、hydrocele 與反覆的急性 dermatolymphangioadenopathy。

label: PIDD
description: PIDD activates Caspase-2. PIDD (p53-induced protein with death domain) nucleates the PIDDosome and is transcriptionally induced by p53 after genotoxic stress. Caspase-2 is an ancient initiator caspase activated by the PIDDosome in response to DNA damage and mitotic catastrophe. The relationship is directional, with PIDD acting as the operative agent upon Caspase-2 rather than the reverse. This directional link makes the interaction a meaningful node in tumor biology, with implications for understanding disease progression and for identifying therapeutic or biomarker opportunities.
description_zh_TW: PIDD 啟動 Caspase-2。 PIDD（具有死亡結構域的p53誘導蛋白）使 PIDDosome 成核，並在基因毒性壓力後由 p53 進行轉錄誘導。 Caspase-2 是一種古老的起始半胱天冬酶，由 PIDDosome 響應 DNA Damage 和有絲分裂災難而激活。這種關係是有方向的，PIDD 充當 Caspase-2 的操作主體，而不是相反。這種定向聯繫使相互作用成為腫瘤生物學中有意義的節點，對於理解疾病進展和識別治療或生物標記機會具有重要意義。

label: UV Light
description: Ultraviolet light generates reactive oxygen species (ROS) that drive the oxidation of catecholamines such as epinephrine. Because ROS can steal electrons from the catechol hydroxyls, producing the o-quinone intermediate, light exposure accelerates the pathway that converts adrenaline into adrenochrome. This photochemical sensitivity is why pharmaceutical epinephrine is stored in amber vials away from light: preventing light-induced ROS formation slows the oxidation and cyclization reactions that degrade the drug. The same principle applies more broadly to catecholamine biochemistry, where photo-oxidation can convert adrenaline solutions pink. Temperature and light, as factors governing kinetic energy and radical generation, are therefore environmental controls that determine whether epinephrine remains stable or proceeds toward adrenochrome and its toxic downstream chemistry.
description_zh_TW: 紫外線產生活性氧（ROS），驅動兒茶酚胺如腎上腺素的氧化。因為ROS可以從兒茶酚羥基中夺取電子，產生鄰醌中間體，光照暴露加速了將腎上腺素轉化為腎上腺素紅的途徑。這種光化學敏感性是為什麼藥用腎上腺素儲存在避光的琥珀色玻璃瓶中：防止光照誘導的ROS形成可以減緩降解藥物的氧化和環化反應。相同原理更廣泛地應用於兒茶酚胺生物化學，其中光氧化可以使腎上腺素溶液變粉紅。溫度和光照作為控制動能和自由基生成的因素，因此是決定腎上腺素是保持穩定還是走向腎上腺素紅及其有毒下游化學的環境控制。

label: Telomere Attrition
description: Progressive telomere shortening with each cell division eventually exposes chromosome ends that are recognized as DNA double-strand breaks, triggering replicative senescence at the Hayflick limit. Critically short or dysfunctional telomeres activate the ATM/p53 and ATR/p21 DDR cascades, halting proliferation to prevent chromosomal instability. This mechanism is the canonical explanation for the finite replicative capacity of primary human cells in culture. The directionality is one-way in normal cells, though telomerase reactivation can bypass the arrest -- a hallmark of cancer.
description_zh_TW: 每一次細胞分裂伴隨的漸進性端粒縮短，最終會暴露出被辨識為 DNA 雙股斷裂的染色體端點，在 Hayflick 極限觸發複製性衰老。過短或功能異常的端粒會活化 ATM/p53 與 ATR/p21 的 DDR 級聯，停止增殖以預防染色體不穩定。此機制是原代人類細胞在培養中有限複製能力的標準解釋。在正常細胞中此方向是單向的，但端粒酶再活化可繞過停滯——這是癌症的特徵。

label: Stomatitis
