description: A Certificate of Analysis is the document by which Quality Assurance confirms that a regulated product meets its product specification. In a research setting it plays the same role for chemical reagents that batch-release testing plays for pharmaceuticals.
description_zh_TW: Certificate of Analysis 是品質保證部門確認受規管產品符合產品規格的文件。在研究情境中，它對化學試劑所扮演的角色，與批次放行測試對藥品所扮演的角色相同。

label: CaMKII
description: CaMKII phosphorylates caspase-2 on Ser135 — distinct from the Ser164 site regulated by CaMKII in the metabolic context — rendering the apical caspase inactive. This phosphorylation is itself shielded by 14-3-3ζ binding, and the shield's integrity depends on the acetylation state of 14-3-3ζ, which SIRT1 controls. The system layers a phospho-switch (CaMKII/Ser135) on top of an acetyl-switch (SIRT1/14-3-3ζ K49), so nutrient-driven PPP flux ultimately decides whether caspase-2 stays suppressed.
description_zh_TW: CaMKII 會將 caspase-2 的 Ser135 磷酸化——與其在代謝脈絡中調控的 Ser164 位點不同——使頂端 caspase 處於不活化狀態。此磷酸化本身又被 14-3-3ζ 的結合所保護，而保護罩的完整性取決於 SIRT1 所控制的 14-3-3ζ 乙醯化狀態。整個系統在乙醯開關（SIRT1/14-3-3ζ K49）之上再疊加磷酸開關（CaMKII/Ser135），因此養分驅動的 PPP 通量最終決定 caspase-2 是否維持被抑制。

label: ABT-263
description: ABT-263 (navitoclax) is the orally bioavailable successor of ABT-737, developed to overcome poor solubility. Both inhibit Bcl-2, Bcl-xL and Bcl-w; Bcl-xL inhibition causes on-target thrombocytopenia.
description_zh_TW: ABT-263 (navitoclax) 是 ABT-737 的口服生物可利用後繼藥物，旨在克服溶解度差的問題。兩者皆抑制 Bcl-2、Bcl-xL 和 Bcl-w；Bcl-xL 抑制會導致標靶性血小板減少。

label: C9orf72
description: C9orf72 repeat expansions are the most common genetic cause of familial amyotrophic lateral sclerosis and frontotemporal dementia, producing loss of function, repeat-associated non-AUG translation of dipeptide-repeat proteins, and nuclear RNA foci.
description_zh_TW: C9orf72 的重複擴增是家族性 amyotrophic lateral sclerosis 與 fronto-temporal dementia 最常見的遺傳病因，會造成功能喪失、重複相關的非 AUG 轉譯產生二胜肽重複蛋白，以及核內 RNA  foci。

label: Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins
description: Smac DIABLO is a pro-apoptotic mitochondrial protein whose principal function is to neutralize Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins. Released from the mitochondrial intermembrane space into the cytosol during apoptosis, it binds the BIR3 domain of XIAP, cIAP1 and cIAP2 through its exposed N-terminal AVPI IAP-binding motif, displacing Caspase-9 and Caspase-3/Caspase-7 from IAP inhibition and allowing the caspase cascade to run to completion.
description_zh_TW: Smac DIABLO 是一個促凋亡的粒線體蛋白，其主要功能是中和 Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins。凋亡時它由粒線體膜間腔釋放至細胞質，透過暴露的 N 端 AVPI IAP-binding motif 結合 XIAP、cIAP1 與 cIAP2 的 BIR3 結構域，將 Caspase-9 與 Caspase-3/Caspase-7 從 IAP 抑制中置換出來，使 caspase 级聯得以完整進行。

label: Thioglycerol
description: Thioglycerol is a sulfite-free alternative to the conventional sulfite preservative Sodium Metabisulfite in epinephrine formulations. Replacing sulfites with thiol stabilizers reduces allergenicity while preserving catecholamine stability, since sulfites can provoke hypersensitivity and complicate stability profiles.
description_zh_TW: Thioglycerol 是 Epinephrine 製劑中傳統亞硫酸鹽防腐劑 Sodium Metabisulfite 的無亞硫酸鹽替代方案。以硫醇類穩定劑取代亞硫酸鹽可在維持兒茶酚胺穩定性的同時降低過敏原性，因為亞硫酸鹽可能引發過敏反應並使穩定性資料更複雜。

label: Retrograde Signaling
description: Mitochondria communicate stress to the nucleus through retrograde signaling pathways. In yeast this involves the Rtg1/Rtg3 transcription factors, whose activation extends replicative lifespan; in mammals the retrograde response involves calcineurin-dependent NF-kappaB activation and may include the Retinoid X receptor alpha, PGC-1alpha, JNK, and ROS generation. Mitochondrial perturbations such as mtDNA deletion, respiratory chain inhibition, misfolded matrix proteins, or stalled ribosomes all elicit coordinated changes in nuclear gene expression that reconfigure metabolism and induce cytoprotective programs.
description_zh_TW: Mitochondria 通過 retrograde signaling pathways 與細胞核溝通壓力。在 yeast 中，這涉及 Rtg1/Rtg3 轉錄因子，其激活可延長 replicative lifespan；在 mammals 中，retrograde response 涉及 calcineurin-dependent NF-kappaB activation 且可能包括 Retinoid X receptor alpha、PGC-1alpha、JNK 和 ROS 生成。Mitochondrial perturbations 如 mtDNA deletion、respiratory chain inhibition、misfolded matrix proteins 或 stalled ribosomes 都會引發 coordinated changes in nuclear gene expression，重新配置代謝並誘導 cytoprotective programs。

label: 5xFAD
description: 5xFAD is a transgenic mouse model that co-expresses five familial Alzheimer's Disease mutations in APP and PSEN1, driving aggressive, early-onset Amyloid Beta plaque deposition. It reproduces amyloid pathology faithfully but with accelerated phenotypes relative to late-onset human disease.
description_zh_TW: 5xFAD 是轉殖小鼠模型，共表達 APP 與 PSEN1 上五個家族性 Alzheimer's Disease 突變，造成侵襲性、早發的 Amyloid Beta 斑塊沉積。它能忠實重現類澱粉樣病變，但表型相較於晚發型人類疾病更為加速。

label: Glutamic Acid Decarboxylase
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: Glutamic acid decarboxylase (GAD) catalyzes the decarboxylation of glutamate to synthesize GABA, the principal inhibitory neurotransmitter in the brain. It exists as two isoforms, GAD65 and GAD67; GAD67 is constitutively active and maintains basal GABA levels, whereas GAD65 supplies GABA for regulated release.
description_zh_TW: Glutamic acid decarboxylase（GAD）催化 glutamate 的去羧化反應以合成 GABA——腦部主要的抑制性神經傳遞物質。GAD 有兩種同功型 GAD65 與 GAD67；GAD67 為組成性活性、維持基礎 GABA 濃度，GAD65 則供應受調控釋放所需的 GABA。

label: Fructose
source_file: _document_ - Dietary Advanced Glycation End Products and Aging.md
description: The two-enzyme glucose to sorbitol to fructose route produces fructose, setting the advanced glycation feed rate. Sorbitol dehydrogenase closes the pathway output.
description_zh_TW: 葡萄糖到山梨醇到果糖的雙酶路徑產生果糖，設定晚期糖化供養速率。山梨醇脫氫酶關閉路徑輸出。

label: miR-137
description: In melanoma, miR-137 negatively regulates ferroptosis by directly targeting the glutamine transporter SLC1A5: knockdown of miR-137 promotes ferroptosis, whereas its presence protects melanoma cells from iron-dependent death. Because SLC1A5 is itself ferroptosis-protective in this context, loss of miR-137 raises glutamine import, GSH supply and antioxidant defence, increasing ferroptotic resistance.
description_zh_TW: 在 melanoma 中，miR-137 藉由直接標定麩醯胺酸轉運蛋白 SLC1A5 而負向調節 ferroptosis：miR-137 的敲除會促進 ferroptosis，而其存在則保護 melanoma 細胞免於鐵依賴性死亡。由於 SLC1A5 在此脈絡下本身具有保護作用，miR-137 流失會提高麩醯胺酸輸入、GSH 供應與抗氧化防禦，進而增加對 ferroptosis 的抗性。

label: Stilbenoid
description: Beyond sirtuin activation, stilbenoids counteract oxidative stress and inflammation by scavenging radicals and dampening NF-κB signalling; certain derivatives also show estrogenic and senolytic activities.
description_zh_TW: 除了 sirtuin 活化之外，stilbenoid 藉由清除自由基與抑制 NF-κB 訊號來對抗氧化壓力與發炎；某些衍生物另展現雌激素作用與 senolytic 活性。

label: FoxM1
description: FoxM1 is overexpressed in a broad range of carcinomas and correlates with proliferation, chemoresistance and poor prognosis; it also promotes senescence bypass and EMT, making it an oncology target complicated by its physiological indispensability in tissue regeneration.
description_zh_TW: FoxM1 在廣泛的 carcinomas 中過度表現，並與增殖、化療抗藥性與不良預後相關；它也促進衰老逃逸與 EMT，因此成為腫瘤學標靶，但其參與組織再生的生理必要性使抑制策略更為複雜。

label: RNF185
description: RNF185 is a mitochondrial ubiquitin E3 ligase that forms part of the non-Parkin E3 ligase network providing backup mitophagy capacity. Together with parallel ligases such as MUL1 and Ambra-1/HUWE1, it maintains mitochondrial quality control when the primary PINK1/Parkin pathway is impaired, so cells can still clear damaged mitochondria when the canonical pathway is compromised.
description_zh_TW: RNF185 是粒線體泛素 E3 連接酶，屬於提供備援 mitophagy 能力的非 Parkin E3 連接酶網路。它與 MUL1 及 Ambra-1/HUWE1 等平行連接酶一起，在主要 PINK1/Parkin 途徑受損時維持粒線體品質管制，使細胞在典型途徑失效時仍能清除受損粒線體。

label: Follistatin
description: Follistatin binds and neutralizes Activin A extracellularly, acting as a soluble antagonist that can block its paracrine senescence-inducing activity. This provides a natural brake on Activin A signaling and a potential therapeutic route to limit SASP-mediated arrest spread in tissue. The follistatin-Activin A axis is a classic antagonistic ligand-binding pair, and neutralization experiments confirm its functional relevance in paracrine senescence models. Because follistatin also regulates other TGFbeta-family ligands, it represents an endogenous checkpoint on the arrest-inducing arm of the senescent secretome.
description_zh_TW: Follistatin 在胞外結合並中和 Activin A，作為可阻斷其旁分泌衰老誘發活性的可溶性拮抗劑。這提供對 Activin A 訊號的自然制動，以及限制組織中 SASP 介導停滯擴散的潛在治療途徑。follistatin-Activin A 軸是經典的拮抗性配體—結合對，且中和實驗確認其在旁分泌衰老模型中的功能相關性。由於 follistatin 也調節其他 TGFbeta 家族配體，它代表衰老分泌組停滯誘發臂的內源性檢查點。

label: Bisulfite
description: Bisulfite (sodium bisulfite or metabisulfite) is a reducing agent added to pharmaceutical epinephrine injections to prevent oxidation of the catechol and thereby inhibit adrenochrome formation. By scavenging oxygen and reactive oxygen species and reducing oxidized intermediates, bisulfite keeps adrenaline solutions stable and usable for extended periods, preventing the pink-to-red discoloration that signals adrenochrome accumulation. This practical application reflects the general principle that the epinephrine-to-adrenochrome oxidation can be slowed by antioxidants, acidic pH, low temperature, and protection from light. Without such stabilizers, adrenaline auto-oxidizes visibly within days to weeks.
description_zh_TW: Bisulfite（sodium bisulfite 或 metabisulfite）是一種 reducing agent，添加於藥用 epinephrine 注射劑中，以防止 catechol 氧化從而抑制 adrenochrome 形成。透過清除氧氣與 reactive oxygen species 並還原氧化的中間產物，bisulfite 使 adrenaline 溶液保持穩定且可長期使用，防止標示 adrenochrome 堆積的粉紅至紅色變色。此實際應用反映了一般原則：epinephrine-to-adrenochrome 氧化可透過 antioxidants、酸性 pH、低溫與避光而減緩。若無此類 stabilizers，adrenaline 會在數天至數週內明顯 auto-oxidizes。

label: Genotoxic Stress
description: Genotoxic insults directly produce DNA lesions as their defining consequence. Causation is definitional for the stress class.
description_zh_TW: 基因毒性傷害直接產生 DNA 病變作為其定義性後果。因果對此壓力類別是定義性的。

label: 89-kDa PARP1 Fragment
description: Caspase-3 (with caspase-7) cleaves full-length 116-kDa PARP1 at Asp214/Gly215, separating the DNA-binding from the catalytic domain and releasing the 89-kDa C-terminal p89 fragment. This cleavage was classically read as simple inactivation of PARP1 to conserve apoptotic energy, but p89 is now recognized as a signalling-competent product rather than a passive one.
description_zh_TW: Caspase-3（連同 caspase-7）在 Asp214/Gly215 切割全长 116 kDa 的 PARP1，將 DNA 結合區與催化區分開，釋出 89 kDa 的 C 端 p89 片段。此切割過去僅被視為單純抑制 PARP1 以節省凋亡能量，如今則認為 p89 是具備訊號活性的產物，而非被動碎片。

label: eEFSec
description: By delivering selenocysteine in response to a recoded UGA codon in the SECIS-dependent context, eEFSec converts a nominal stop signal into a sense codon. This recoding is tuned by the Um34 modification of tRNA[Ser]Sec installed by FTSJ1, which sets the efficiency of Sec insertion for a subset of antioxidant selenoproteins.
description_zh_TW: eEFSec 在 SECIS 依賴的脈絡下，針對再編碼的 UGA 密碼子遞送硒半胱胺酸，將原本的終止訊號轉為有義密碼子。這項再編碼的效率由 FTSJ1 安裝於 tRNA[Ser]Sec 的 Um34 修飾調整，決定部分抗氧化硒蛋白的 Sec 插入效率。

label: c-Fos
source_file: _document_ - Neuro-Modulating Effects of Honokiol A Review.md
description: c-Fos is an immediate-early response gene encoding Fos, a core subunit of the AP-1 transcription factor heterodimer. It is rapidly induced by mitogenic signalling and promotes cell-cycle progression and proliferation, and as a proto-oncogene it is linked to oncogene-induced transformation. Fos-Jun heterodimers bind AP-1 sites to regulate genes controlling proliferation, differentiation, and stress responses.
description_zh_TW: c-Fos 是即刻早期反應基因，編碼 Fos——AP-1 轉錄因子異二聚體的核心次單元。它受促分裂訊號迅速誘導，促進細胞週期進程與增殖；作為原致癌基因，它也與致癌基因誘導的轉型相關。Fos–Jun 異二聚體結合 AP-1 位點，調控控制增殖、分化與壓力反應的基因。

label: DAF-2
description: Reduced insulin/IGF-1 signaling through dietary restriction, intermittent fasting, or genetic reduction of DAF-2, the C. elegans insulin/IGF-1 receptor, derepresses autophagy and doubles lifespan via DAF-16/FOXO, making it one of the most robust lifespan-extending interventions.
description_zh_TW: 透過飲食限制、間歇性禁食，或在 C. elegans 中遺傳性降低胰島素/IGF-1 受體 DAF-2 來減少胰島素訊息傳遞，可解除對自噬的抑制並經由 DAF-16/FOXO 使壽命加倍，是最穩健的延壽介入之一。

label: DDX3Y
description: DDX3Y is the Y-chromosome homolog of DDX3X. The two share ATP-dependent RNA unwinding and translation initiation, stress granule and Wnt functions, but the overlap is not identical: X-X female compensation is stronger than X-Y male compensation (36% chrX loss vs 8.2% chrY loss among mutated tumors, P=0.0022), leaving a net female advantage.
description_zh_TW: DDX3Y 是 DDX3X 的 Y 染色體同源基因。兩者共享 ATP 依賴性 RNA 解旋、轉譯起始、stress granule 與 Wnt 功能，但重疊並非完全一致：女性 X-X 補償強於男性 X-Y 補償（在突變腫瘤中 chrX 喪失 36% 對 chrY 喪失 8.2%，P=0.0022），因而保留了淨的女性優勢。

label: Phenelzine
description: Phenelzine is a classical irreversible Monoamine Oxidase Inhibitor antidepressant, the pharmacological prototype of the class that raises synaptic monoamines to produce antidepressant and anxiolytic effects.
description_zh_TW: Phenelzine 是經典的不可逆 Monoamine Oxidase Inhibitor 抗憂鬱藥，是該類提高突觸單胺以產生抗憂鬱與抗焦慮作用的藥理原型。

label: Atg17
description: FIP200 (RB1CC1) is the mammalian ortholog of yeast Atg17. As the Atg17 scaffold, FIP200 holds the ULK1-Atg13-Atg101 kinase complex together and is required for Autophagosome formation during Macroautophagy initiation.
description_zh_TW: FIP200（RB1CC1）是酵母 Atg17 的哺乳類直系同源物。作為 Atg17 支架，FIP200 將 ULK1-Atg13-Atg101 kinase 複合體維持在一起，並為 Macroautophagy 起始時的 Autophagosome 形成所必需。
